Wang Lan turned his face innocently to look at Jiang Xinyu, who was wearing a smile. "Can you say something fair? Although I know I used to knock him down a peg back in junior high, I genuinely feel like I’m far behind you guys this time."
"Heh..." Xu Xiangwen rolled his eyes. "Xinyu, do you see? He’s comparing himself to us—a Star Martial Warrior who just awakened two days ago, with us veterans who’ve been awakened for two years. How much more arrogant can he get?"
"Only you’ve been awakened for two years," Gong Feiyu grinned. "I’ve been at it for three, and Xinyu for eight."
"Wild Imprisonment Finger!" Annoyed, Xu Xiangwen simply extended a middle finger to show his ’respect’.
"Wang Lan is still quite impressive. I remember on my first venture into the trial grounds with a team, it took several of us half an hour just to kill a Snow Spider, and we were over the moon to get a Starlight Bead, thinking we had won a great victory. You can’t compare us; we’re at the Star Shine Stage," Wang Youle offered a fair comment.
"Wang Lan, what are you dawdling for? Get the Soul Bead," Jiang Xinyu urged.
"Oh!"
Wang Lan knew that the Soul Bead was found inside the head of an Exotic Beast; this was common knowledge among Star Martial Warriors.
He split open the Snow Spider’s head with a knife and, suppressing his disgust, reached in to extract a Soul Bead.
*Absorbing Star Power, skill point +1.*
The Soul Bead in his hand disappeared.
"Eh? You absorbed it just like that?" Wang Youle exclaimed in surprise.
"Ah? If not absorbing, then what?"
"You should collect Soul Beads and absorb them all at once for better effect. Absorbing them now mostly just replenishes the Star Power you’ve used up."
"Is that so? It’s all the same to me." Wang Lan smiled faintly.
Being a system user, he understood that while Soul Beads could help others improve their strength, for him they could only add skill points. To increase his Star Martial level, he could only rely on experience points, either from completing tasks or from kills.
For other Star Martial Warriors, their goal in killing Exotic Beasts was solely for the Soul Beads, but for him, it was different: kills for experience points, and Soul Beads for skill points and replenishing expended Star Power—seemingly more efficient.
With the first kill rewarding him thirty skill points, his Close Combat Sword Skill was at Bronze 2. In the current situation, Close Combat Sword Skill seemed more practical, so he decided to allocate all thirty skill points to it.
Upgrading his Close Combat Sword Skill to Bronze 5, Wang Lan immediately realized the many flaws in his previous tactics and fighting style. There were far more efficient ways to kill the Snow Spiders.
"Alright, let’s continue luring Snow Spiders. Second round begins!"
This time, Wang Youle and Jiang Xinyu lured ten Snow Spiders over. The previous five were just appetizers for warming up. Wang Lan once again faced a single Snow Spider.
As the Snow Spider approached, at Jiang Xinyu’s command, Wang Lan instantly lunged at his target. This time, his attacks were sharper; as he closed in on the Spider, a flash of his blade warded off an attacking leg from the Snow Spider.
Moving swiftly, Wang Lan vanished from the Snow Spider’s sight. The spider suddenly felt a heavy blow to its legs, its body lifted by a powerful force as a blade flashed. Wang Lan then retreated.
All his movements were smoothly executed in one go. Had it not taken about three minutes to close in on the Snow Spider, he could have finished the battle in less than five minutes.
After slaying the Snow Spider and retrieving its Soul Bead, Wang Lan saw the battle at Jiang Xinyu’s side was still ongoing. Jiang Xinyu, a Mage-type Star Martial Warrior, was mainly focused on collecting enough Soul Beads for a breakthrough and refrained from using Star Martial Skills whenever possible. Hence, she was in a supportive role, with the main kills being carried out by Gong Feiyu and Xu Xiangwen.
Wang Youle was also a fire type, but it seemed his only Star Martial Skill was spewing fire, which dealt limited damage to Snow Spiders, and his close combat abilities were quite deficient.
This wasn’t Wang Lan being biased; his skills truly weren’t up to par.
Wang Lan even felt that Wang Youle wouldn’t last a minute against him.
Gaining five experience points and one skill point from that kill,
he didn’t hesitate and instantly joined the wider battle, using Wang Youle’s flames as cover to get close to another Snow Spider in a flash.
An Inch Strength explosive uppercut followed by a straightforward stab into its chest and an upward slice.
The sprint, the kill—it all took less than ten seconds.
"Holy shit—"
Wang Youle, who had been watching Wang Lan execute a beautiful kill, couldn’t help but curse out loud.
Previously, Wang Youle had looked down on Wang Lan from his higher standing as a Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warrior, while Wang Lan was only at the Starlight Stage. But at this moment, Wang Youle suddenly realized just how naive his own understanding had been and how greatly he had underestimated Wang Lan’s strength.
Considering the killing ability Wang Lan just displayed, killing me would be as easy as flipping his hand!
Wang Youle thought, a strong sense of crisis instantly arising in his heart.
Before, I only thought Wang Lan *might* threaten my position, but now I’m certain he *can*,
Wang Youle mused.
It took me a year of building a good relationship with Xu Xiangwen to join Jiang Xinyu’s squad, where I’ve always been obedient, clever, and hardworking.
How can I be replaced? How can I allow myself to be replaced?
At this moment, Wang Youle’s heart churned with complex emotions.
"Holy shit, a one-hit kill? Lan bro, are you an assassin?" Xu Xiangwen, having just dealt with a Snow Spider, called out in amazement.
"Sigh, what could I do? The Snow Spider’s position was just too perfect. I wouldn’t have felt right if I hadn’t stabbed it—that felt incredibly satisfying, like everything just clicked," Wang Lan said with a flick of his sword, looking quite pleased with his recent move.
"Alright, time is limited. Let’s go for another round."
"No problem, send two Snow Spiders my way this time. I want to take on two!"
As Wang Lan became more familiar with the Snow Spiders and his Close Combat Sword Skill progressed rapidly, he became faster and faster at killing them. Gradually, Wang Lan no longer needed to fight the Snow Spiders alone but instead teamed up with Xu Xiangwen to decapitate them.
The tactic was simple: the other three would restrict the Snow Spiders, and then Wang Lan and Xu Xiangwen would rush in and kill the enemy with one move.
After two continuous hours, they had killed about ten waves of Exotic Beasts.
"That’s about it. A large group of Snow Spiders has become alert and is heading this way. Let’s withdraw for now," Xu Xiangwen said calmly after his group finished off a wave of Snow Spiders, his Heavenly Eye active.
"Alright, let’s head back to recuperate and wait for half an hour," Jiang Xinyu decided, as the leader of the squad.
The place they chose for rest was a cave with an entrance two meters wide, easily defendable by one person. After more than an hour of intense fighting, it was exhausting even for Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warriors. Wang Lan, however, was in high spirits, counting his skill points in his Spiritual Sea of Consciousness.
After more than an hour of combat, killing a total of twenty Snow Spiders had yielded twenty skill points, pushing his Close Combat Sword Skill to Bronze 7.
Although it was still at the Bronze level, its application in real combat made a huge difference. The sword skill was sharper, speeding up his kills. From the last encounter, it was evident that it only took him a few seconds to strike and kill. If timed perfectly, he could achieve a one-hit kill.
But time on the battlefield isn’t calculated that way. An effective kill might be quick, but the actual combat engagement could be lengthy. After all, the Snow Spiders were fast, and their attack power wasn’t something this group could ignore or be immune to.
Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Currently, his sword skill combined with his movement technique was already sufficient. For the next step, he needed to enhance his overall capabilities. It was rare to get a chance to enter the trial grounds, so it was important to accumulate as many skill points as possible to upgrade skills. Who knew when the next chance would come?
"The Snow Spiders have retreated; we can continue," Xu Xiangwen said, after scanning the area with his Heavenly Eye.
"Alright, let’s continue then."
Killing Exotic Beasts in the trial grounds was monotonous but never boring. One was always in danger, so boredom was impossible. Perhaps the trial grounds were vast, or maybe there really were very few people; for three straight days, they hadn’t seen a single Star Martial Warrior other than themselves.
「Three days later.」
Wang Lan and his four companions were covered in blood and showed signs of exhaustion. However, these three days had brought immense gains for Wang Lan.
Having killed so many Exotic Beasts, his level had risen from Starlight Stage 5 to Starlight Stage 7, and he had accumulated three hundred skill points. Wang Lan allocated all of them to upgrading his skills. When he first entered, his skills were all in the early Bronze stage; now, they had all reached the late stage.
Wang Lan noticed a problem: Basic Skills couldn’t be developed in isolation. They were akin to the various hardware components of a computer—interconnected and mutually limiting.
For example, if his movement technique was at Bronze 1 and his sword skill at Bronze 9, then in actual combat, he could only exert Bronze 5 combat power. This was because the weakness in his movement technique restricted his sword skill’s potential.
The same principle applied to how the sword skill’s combat power was influenced by overall fighting ability. Most close combat involved general fighting moves, and the sword skill only came into play when specifically wielding and swinging the sword.
This realization made Wang Lan cautious about recklessly focusing his points. The freewheeling skill point allocation that worked in games clearly wasn’t suitable in reality. The various skills had to complement each other.
The ideal balance was to have movement technique and fighting skill at equal levels. Other abilities like sword skill, spear skill, and other Basic Combat Skills were built on top of these two. Movement technique reflected agility and reaction speed, while fighting skill represented practical combat application and adaptability.
At this moment, Wang Lan’s movement technique and fighting skill had reached Bronze 8, while his sword skill was at Bronze 7. Compared to when he first entered, his combat strength had at least doubled.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 Wang Youle’s Hidden Thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21 Wang Youle’s Hidden Thoughts
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
After spending three hundred skill points, only fifty remained. He allocated all fifty skill points into his Phoenix Form, which was Wang Lan’s trump card. Even though fifty skill points were only good for five seconds, those five seconds in the Galaxy Stage could save his life at a critical moment.
In the cave, a fire burned, with five people sitting around it, warming themselves. Jiang Xinyu sat by the fire, counting the Soul Beads in her backpack.
"How many?" Xu Xiangwen asked with concern after Jiang Xinyu finished counting.
Jiang Xinyu frowned slightly. "Four hundred! I need at least a thousand Soul Beads to break through to the Star Cloud Stage. At a rate of four hundred Soul Beads every three days, it would take until the eighth or ninth day to accumulate a thousand."
The atmosphere suddenly grew quieter. This number was a hundred more than the last time they entered the trial field, but the other four were well aware that the number of Exotic Beasts killed this time was double that of the last. Even accounting for Star Power replenishment, they should have saved five hundred beads.
If that were the case, Jiang Xinyu would only need six or, at most, seven days to reach her goal, and the Soul Beads from the remaining three or four days could be evenly split among the team. The shortfall compared to expectations was due to Wang Lan’s inclusion.
Although Wang Lan was part of the team, he killed a significant number of Snow Spiders. He didn’t participate in the distribution. To put it bluntly, if Jiang Xinyu also received Wang Lan’s three hundred Soul Beads, she would have enough in just two days.
Yet, the other three tacitly remained silent. However, there was someone in the team who did not want Wang Lan to get away with such a comfortable deal.
"Jiang Xinyu, I think this distribution is unreasonable..." Wang Youle hesitated for a long time before he finally spoke.
"Wang Lan’s haul of Soul Beads amounts to a third of ours. Yet, he hardly uses Star Martial Skills and doesn’t need Soul Beads to replenish his Star Power. You haven’t even had your breakthrough, while he has already advanced from the early to the late Starlight Stage.
Since we are working as a team, there shouldn’t be two different methods of distribution."
"Wang Youle, what do you mean by that?" Gong Feiyu asked with a sneer. "Jiang Xinyu had already explained everything before we entered the trial field. Why didn’t you object then? Are you trying to stir up conflict now?"
Wang Youle quickly gestured with his hands. "No... no... That’s not what I meant. It’s just that Student Wang Lan is too strong, isn’t he? We originally thought we were just bringing him for experience. Who knew he’d be so capable, easily handling his own prey and even helping us..."
Wang Lan raised his head, deep in thought.
He had initially joined to be carried by the experts. But because of his own strength and efficiency, he ended up taking many of the kills. And since the Soul Beads he collected were his own, Jiang Xinyu ended up with fewer beads, despite his efficient monster-killing. Wang Lan hadn’t considered this before; he had been focused on amassing his own wealth and enjoying himself. Since he enjoyed the team’s convenience, he shouldn’t monopolize the spoils during distribution.
"Since we had an agreement beforehand, let’s not quibble over such trivial matters," said Xu Xiangwen mildly, who was quite close to Wang Youle.
His good relationship with Wang Youle was one thing, but Wang Lan was his best friend. If a conflict arose between Wang Lan and Wang Youle, Xu Xiangwen would undoubtedly side with Wang Lan, even helping him deliver a kick. Furthermore, Xu Xiangwen had witnessed Wang Lan’s strength; Wang Lan’s efficiency in killing Exotic Beasts surpassed his own.
Unsurprisingly, Wang Lan would likely replace Wang Youle next time. And with Wang Lan’s growth rate, he was undoubtedly a terrifying prodigy—a true Demon. Soon, he would become the team’s absolute core, and even Jiang Xinyu might have to defer to him.
In the past three days, everyone had witnessed Wang Lan’s rapid progress. His talent was so monstrous it far outstripped Jiang Xinyu’s; he was a true Demon. Whether for the sake of years of friendship or future plans, Xu Xiangwen would drop Wang Youle without a second thought.
Before Jiang Xinyu even spoke, two teammates had already clearly sided with Wang Lan. Previously, Wang Youle had only sensed a looming crisis. Now, he was almost certain. Wang Lan’s arrival meant he would be ejected from the team he had schemed so hard to enter.
At this thought, Wang Youle lowered his head, killing intent gradually rose in his eyes.
Wang Lan snapped back to reality. "Hmm, I think Wang Youle raises a valid point. I’ve gained a lot these past three days. Besides, the purpose of this trial is to gather enough Soul Beads for Xinyu’s breakthrough. I agree with Wang Youle’s suggestion. From now on, I will partake in the team’s distribution."
"Wang Lan, it’s okay. Even if I divide the Soul Beads now, it’s no big deal. A thousand Soul Beads are only worth eighty million. That’s not much to you or me."
Her casual words were like a knife twisting in Wang Youle’s heart.
He had always understood why he didn’t fit in with the team. It wasn’t his lack of talent or insufficient strength, but his poverty.
The disparity in wealth had created a divide in their values. Although there was no contempt, such a casual phrase could inflict soul-piercing pain on Wang Youle.
Eighty million was an unimaginable sum for Wang Youle, yet Jiang Xinyu mentioned it so casually. It was an astronomical sum for ordinary people, but for the Jiang Group, it was merely a quarter’s profit.
Using a quarter’s profit to help Jiang Xinyu advance to the Star Cloud Stage was a profitable deal from any angle. Jiang Xinyu’s parents had long intended to do so.
Xu Xiangwen’s family owned Xu Tech, and Gong Feiyu’s family had the Gong Financial Group. Although Wang Lan wasn’t known to be a rich heir, how could someone who befriended these wealthy scions be poor?
"This isn’t about money; it’s about principle. The prerequisite is not affecting the main objective. It’s just my fault for being too outstanding; I can’t even carry the four of you properly. Forget it, I won’t make things difficult. I’ll carry you all instead."
"Damn it!" Xu Xiangwen shot up. "Feiyu, are you going to tolerate this?"
"Can’t tolerate it! Let’s get him!"
Their cheerful laughter echoed through the cave. Jiang Xinyu’s icy expression suddenly thawed, revealing a reminiscent smile. The laughter of youths chasing each other under the setting sun—though youth had not yet passed, it had already become a cherished memory. Such a scene deserved to be recorded.
Meanwhile, Wang Youle sat in the shadows beyond the firelight, looking utterly out of place.
With Wang Lan joining the distribution, the speed of collecting Soul Beads indeed increased significantly. Wang Lan also stopped constantly spending skill points on upgrades, and his killing speed increased another notch.
Especially after Wang Lan joined the distribution, he officially began coordinating with the other four. With Jiang Xinyu and the others creating favorable conditions, Wang Lan achieved a near one-hit kill with almost every attack. His kill rate was frighteningly high; after an hour, he had independently harvested forty Soul Beads, averaging one every two minutes.
If they maintained this pace for the entire day, the team’s haul for today alone could reach five hundred Soul Beads, more than the previous three days combined. At this rate, they would have enough by tomorrow.
Just as Wang Lan and the others were delighting in their slaughter, the Snow Spiders suddenly became agitated.
Xu Xiangwen quickly activated his Heavenly Eye to observe, but oddly, the Snow Spiders were retreating towards the great snowy mountain, their lair.
"What’s going on? Why are all the Snow Spiders returning to their nest?"
"There’s only one explanation for this behavior; the Spider Queen is in danger," Jiang Xinyu stated calmly. "Shall we follow and see?"
"Are you serious? The Snow Spiders are the largest tribe in the primary trial area. If we get surrounded, we’ll all perish here," Gong Feiyu asked nervously.
"What’s there to fear? Don’t you have me?" Xu Xiangwen patted his chest. "But Xinyu, you’ll need to give me a few Soul Beads. Activating the Heavenly Eye consumes a lot of power."
"Alright! Stay on guard at all times, and retreat immediately if there’s any danger."
The team advanced three kilometers, following the Snow Spiders’ retreat, when Xu Xiangwen suddenly stopped.
"Whoa, this is a huge scene..."
"What happened?"
"The Flaming Leopards and Gale Wolves are attacking the Snow Spiders from both front and rear. At the front, the Leopard King and Spider King have already clashed. The situation at the rear is hard to tell. Gale Wolves are very cunning; I don’t know if their Wolf King has made a move. If the Wolf King attacks, the Snow Spiders will be in trouble. So many Snow Spiders are returning, likely to fend off the Gale Wolves."
"Why would the Flaming Leopards and Gale Wolves attack the Snow Spiders at this time?" Gong Feiyu asked in confusion. "The Snow Spiders live near the great snowy mountain and have no territorial conflict with the Flaming Leopards. The Gale Wolves also reside in the Wind Valley... Although it’s nearby, they’ve always minded their own business."
Jiang Xinyu suddenly raised her wristwatch, clicked a few times, and a virtual screen appeared in front of her.
"Spider Queen Sherry. She became queen in year 4978 of the Celestial Calendar. This year, she should be... forty years old."
"The lifespan of a Snow Spider is three years, that of a Spider King is ten, and a Spider Queen’s is between thirty to forty years. That means... the Spider Queen’s lifespan is nearing its end?"
"That should be it. However, a Snow Queen typically gives birth to a successor before her own life ends, so there shouldn’t be any risk. Besides, the first act of a new Spider Queen is to devour the old one, ensuring a seamless transition of power."
"Perhaps something unexpected has happened this time. Should we get closer? What if we can pick up some scraps?"
They were all daredevils, audacious enough to approach a large-scale battle, practically dancing in a hail of gunfire. If they were surrounded by Exotic Beasts, they’d be devoured before they could even send a distress signal.
The five of them slowly advanced under the cover of the snow until they reached a vantage point overlooking the battle.
At this moment, the battle between the Leopard King and the Spider King had reached a white-hot intensity. Both combatants were injured.
The Spider King was more than ten times the size of an ordinary Snow Spider. Its white carapace was as thick as tank armor. Yet, despite its apparent bulk, the Spider King was surprisingly swift.
Frigid vapor billowed from its body like smoke from an engine, and the Ice Needle Rain Dew it unleashed was like a hail of bullets. Moreover, these ice needles were incredibly fast; any Flaming Leopard struck by one was instantly killed.
The Snow Spiders were fast, but the Leopard King was faster still. It moved like a meteor, its speed accentuated by the blazing flames engulfing its body, making it shimmer like a shooting star.
With one breath of fire, the Leopard King could engulf an area with a twenty-meter diameter in a sea of flames.
The Leopard King and Spider King were evenly matched in strength. However, faced with the Snow Spiders’ swarming tactics, the Flaming Leopards were outmatched and steadily pushed back.
One-on-one, a Flaming Leopard could easily kill a Snow Spider. Against two, it became difficult. If ganged up on by three or four, a Flaming Leopard was doomed.
It was an epic battle scene, but also a blood-soaked slaughterhouse.
Wang Lan had never imagined Snow Spiders could eat so quickly, devouring an entire Flaming Leopard in just a few bites. And they didn’t even spare their own kind! Whenever a corpse appeared, countless Snow Spiders would swarm to feast on it. Even those severely injured but still alive were quickly consumed by their companions.
"This is too brutal..." Xu Xiangwen said, his face pale and his voice trembling slightly.
"That’s why I hate spiders. At least the Flaming Leopards don’t eat their own kind."
AWOOOO—
Suddenly, a wolf howl echoed.
Xu Xiangwen quickly activated his Heavenly Eye. "The Gale Wolves are retreating! It seems the Wolf King didn’t come."
"How do you know?" Wang Youle asked, puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Pulling Off a Big One
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22: Pulling Off a Big One
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Are you an idiot? A Snow Spider nest houses only one Spider Queen and one Spider King. With the Spider King fighting the Leopard King head-on, the back entrance would definitely be hard to defend if the Wolf King also showed up."
"But look, the Gale Wolves retreated first. The Wolf King definitely didn’t come. Those Gale Wolves are so cunning; I even suspect they only feigned an alliance with the Flaming Leopards, their real goal being to betray them."
"But there’s no conflict between the Gale Wolves and the Flaming Leopards; their territories are thirty kilometers apart..." Wang Youle asked again, perplexed.
"Fire overcomes wind! As long as the Flaming Leopards are around, the Gale Wolves can never become the regional hegemon. The Snow Spiders became the hegemon precisely because they have no natural predators," Wang Lan said casually.
"The Flaming Leopard King has retreated," Jiang Xinyu stated flatly.
Indeed, the distant battlefield changed. After launching a wide-area Star Martial Skill to repel the Spider King, the Leopard King didn’t continue the fight but turned and fled into the distance.
"Typical of the Flaming Leopard King. Such a stylish retreat, abandoning the pack he brought along."
With his formidable strength, the Leopard King burst through the Snow Spiders’ encirclement, but the Flaming Leopards he left behind could not. Moreover, the Leopard King showed no intention of turning back to save his subordinates, charging straight out of the spider horde and vanishing without a trace.
Sorrowful howls echoed from behind. The Flaming Leopards were hopelessly trapped by the swarm of Snow Spiders, awaiting their fate.
"So powerful... What level of strength do the Spider King and Leopard King possess? They’re practically... war machines."
"Peak of Star Cloud."Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"Something’s wrong!" Xu Xiangwen suddenly exclaimed in a low voice. "The Snow Spiders have gone berserk—"
His voice was so strained it cracked.
"The Snow Spiders went berserk? How?" Gong Feiyu immediately demanded, his voice tight with anxiety.
"I don’t know! Dense swarms of Snow Spiders are pouring out of their nest, spreading rapidly in all directions. There must be... at least tens of thousands of them!"
"We retreat, now!" Jiang Xinyu ordered decisively.
They had originally planned to scavenge, but with the Snow Spiders rampaging, there was no advantage to be gained. Endless hordes of Snow Spiders, like a tsunami, surged outward, leaving devastation in their wake.
After running for a kilometer, Xu Xiangwen glanced back. That one look was enough to make his face turn pale with fright.
"This is bad! The Snow Spiders are less than a kilometer behind us!"
"Can we detour to get around them?"
"They stretch for hundreds of meters. We’d be cut off before we could get around them. We can only run straight ahead."
Jiang Xinyu frowned, then suddenly stopped. "Stop!"
Star Energy fluctuated around her, and the glacier beneath her feet instantly cracked, forming a large pit.
"Jump down."
Almost as soon as she gave the command, Wang Lan and the other four jumped into the pit. Jiang Xinyu then activated her Star Power, instantly sealing the top of the pit with a layer of ice more than two feet thick.
"Xinyu, are you serious? If they find us, we’re dead for sure."
"But if they don’t find us, we’ll hit the jackpot. Think: what could trigger a Snow Spider rampage?"
"Something must have happened to the Spider Queen! If Sherry, the Spider Queen, was truly at the end of her lifespan, a new queen should have already emerged. The emergence of a new queen wouldn’t trigger a rampage. So, there’s only one explanation: a disruption in the Snow Spider Queen’s succession!"
"Sherry is dead?"
"Yes. The Snow Spider rampage will continue until a new queen emerges to quell it. During this time, the trial grounds will likely become very chaotic," Jiang Xinyu said.
"Quiet! I hear something... The Snow Spider army is coming."
"No, those don’t sound like Snow Spider footsteps. It sounds like... people?"
The moment he finished speaking, several figures appeared overhead. They were moving incredibly fast; there were about six or seven of them.
"It seems this Snow Spider incident isn’t an accident but someone’s deliberate doing. Damn it! To think they’d go this far for the Spider Queen’s Soul Bead..."
Just then, a gigantic Snow Spider shot past overhead. It was quickly followed by a vast, endless swarm of Snow Spiders rushing above them.
Everyone’s heart leaped into their throats. The only sound in the ice cave was the frantic THUMP-THUMP-THUMP of their own heartbeats.
Imagine thousands of enemy troops charging overhead. If discovered, they’d be dead without a burial.
The Snow Spider army finally passed completely after about ten minutes.
Once no more Snow Spiders appeared, the five of them finally let out a quiet sigh of relief.
"The Spider King has mobilized... Is it chasing those people?" Gong Feiyu said gravely.
"They’re doomed. With tens of thousands of Snow Spiders converging on them from such a short distance... unless the trial grounds’ garrison is ahead to intercept, they’re as good as dead," Xu Xiangwen said, a hint of schadenfreude in his voice.
He had a point. The trial grounds had been stable; why stir up trouble? Meddling with the Snow Spiders like this... their rampage wouldn’t just cause chaos in the snowy mountains; it could affect the entire trial grounds.
"No, this isn’t a simple Snow Spider rampage. If the queen had died, the Snow Spiders would also be slaughtering each other in their frenzy. But just now, the Spider King was leading the Snow Spiders in pursuit."
"What could make the Spider King abandon protecting the current queen to lead his troops in pursuit?" Jiang Xinyu paused, her eyes suddenly brightening. "The new Spider Queen is with those people! They’re carrying a space beast cage!"
"Damn! A Spider Queen is listed for a hundred billion at the Exotic Beast Trading Market! And even with such a price tag, they’re almost impossible to find on the market. People will really do anything for wealth."
"A hundred billion? That expensive? You’re kidding, right?" Wang Lan’s heart lurched.
That kind of money is completely out of my reach.
"It’s not that expensive considering its true value. A Spider Queen isn’t just about the creature itself; it represents an entire Snow Spider tribe. Gaining one means you can establish a private trial ground.
Do you understand what a private trial ground means to those Star Martial families? There are hundreds, perhaps thousands, of Star Martial families, but only a select few possess their own private trial grounds. These grounds are the bedrock of their family’s prosperity, capable of nurturing an endless stream of exceptional members.
Compared to the rise and prosperity of a family, what’s a hundred billion? It’s a lot of money, sure, but ultimately just a number. A private trial ground, however, can yield endless, boundless benefits."
"I see."
"But there’s one crucial condition right now."
"A condition? What condition?"
"Sherry, the current Spider Queen, isn’t dead yet. If she were to die, the new queen would instantly mature and assume her role. The space beast cage couldn’t hold her then, nor could they carry it. So..." Jiang Xinyu’s lips curved into a crafty smile.
To Wang Lan and others familiar with Jiang Xinyu, that smile was a dangerous omen. When Jiang Xinyu smiled like that, it meant she was about to hatch a serious scheme.
Jiang Xinyu usually acted with integrity, forthright and principled, but that didn’t mean she was incapable of cunning. With her intelligence, her schemes could leave a lasting impression. If Jiang Xinyu decided to be devious, she would undoubtedly weave a complex web of plots, a scheme within schemes, a trap within a trap.
"Just tell us the plan," Wang Lan sighed.
"The Snow Spider nest is currently defenseless. Both the Spider King and the other Snow Spiders have abandoned Sherry to rescue the new queen. Sherry must be feeling quite pitiful right now..."
"So, since we’re conveniently positioned, we can send Sherry to her maker?" Gong Feiyu nodded.
"Our main objective is to prevent those people from escaping with the new Spider Queen. Snow Spiders are a treasure of the trial grounds, a national asset of Jade Country. Their actions are criminal. As citizens of Jade Country, we cannot ignore this.
After Sherry is killed, the new queen will complete her evolution. With the Spider King arriving shortly after, their conspiracy will collapse. And incidentally... there should still be many unhatched eggs in the Snow Spider nest. Their Soul Beads contain Star Power. It might be a bit less, but it’s free for the taking..."
"That’s your real goal, isn’t it? Fine, we’ve come this far. Let’s do it!"
With the plan set, Xu Xiangwen used his Heavenly Eye to scout the surroundings, confirming no Snow Spiders were outside. They broke through the ice layer, and the group shot out of the ice cave like a dagger, streaking towards the Snow Spider nest.
The Snow Spider nest was less than two kilometers away. At their speed, it would only take Wang Lan and the others a few minutes to reach it. Surprisingly, they didn’t encounter a single Snow Spider along the way. All eyes were fixed on the dark, maw-like cavern ahead—the Snow Spiders’ lair, once home to tens of thousands of them.
Wang Lan and Xu Xiangwen led the charge directly into the cave. Only when they were inside did they encounter Snow Spiders. However, their numbers were small; only a few dozen appeared simultaneously.
"I’ll clear the way!" Gong Feiyu declared. He noted the cave interior wasn’t covered in ice or snow, meaning his Earth Lance would be effective. Moreover, the Snow Spiders’ weak point was their abdomen. It seemed both timing and terrain favored him.
Star Power surged around Gong Feiyu, and multiple earth lances erupted from the ground. While not instantly lethal, they heavily wounded the Snow Spiders.
The path ahead cleared, and the five-person squad advanced without slowing.
They knew the Snow Spider nest was large, but they hadn’t expected it to be this vast.
After advancing three kilometers, they finally reached the heart of the Snow Spider nest: a massive underground cavern. In its center, a gigantic Snow Spider lay quietly.
If the Spider King was a three-meter-tall behemoth, this Spider Queen was easily three times larger. Yet, judging by her appearance, one would hardly recognize her as a Snow Spider.
To me, she just looks like a long, fleshy worm,
Wang Lan thought. Her eight legs couldn’t even reach the ground, and her round, bulging body seemed incapable of movement.
As Wang Lan and the others entered, the Spider Queen suddenly emitted a series of high-pitched SQUEALS.
"She’s calling for reinforcements! We need to deal with her immediately!"
"What about these larvae?" Wang Youle asked, looking somewhat reluctantly at the dense swarm scattered around.
That’s a lot of money just lying there.
"Once we’ve dealt with the queen, all of these will be ours. What’s the rush?" Xu Xiangwen snapped.
Jiang Xinyu instantly charged the Spider Queen, slashing down hard with her sword.
Wang Lan was taken aback.
A reminder to stay grounded,
he thought.
You were getting arrogant again, weren’t you? Thinking your close-combat skills were the best in the squad? Look at Jiang Xinyu. Could you make a strike like that?
CLANG—
The Spider Queen lacked offensive power but possessed astonishing defenses. The ice armor covering her body was harder than steel, and its one-foot thickness was utterly daunting.
When her initial strike failed, the light from Jiang Xinyu’s sword suddenly exploded outward.
That’s an incredibly refined sword technique, and it’s also a type of basic martial skill,
Wang Lan mused.
But I can’t identify which specific Star Martial Skill it is.
Under Jiang Xinyu’s assault, ice fragments flew like snowflakes from the armor, scattering frost and ice everywhere.
Meanwhile, Wang Lan, Xu Xiangwen, Gong Feiyu, and Wang Youle formed a defensive perimeter, intercepting Snow Spiders attempting to reach their queen. Just ten seconds later, the number of attacking Snow Spiders surged dramatically.
"Xinyu, how much longer?"
"Less than twenty seconds! Hold on! Xu Xiangwen, find us an escape route!"
"I’ve already checked! The cliff wall behind us is only thirty centimeters thick and not very dense. Wang Lan should be able to shatter it with his Inch Strength!"

chapters.title: Chapter 23 Bloom, the Phoenix Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23 Bloom, the Phoenix Form
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Good!" As Jiang Xinyu finished speaking, spiritual power instantly surged from her body. The blade erupted with a piercing howl of wind as the green light spun at high speed, like a bullet firing from its chamber.
Jiang Xinyu was an Ice Attribute Star Martial Warrior, but those of the Ice Attribute inherently possessed both wind and water attributes, with the Wind Attribute known as the strongest in cutting ability.
Wang Lan had always thought that Jiang Xinyu was not skilled in Wind Attribute Star Martial Skills. Only now did he understand that not only could she use them, but she also possessed a high-level Star Martial Skill.
The howling wind, causing the entire cave to tremble violently, was proof enough of this move’s extraordinary piercing capability.
The Snow Spiders before them grew even more agitated and frenzied. Sherry, the Spider Queen, shrieked with increasing shrillness.
Suddenly, an angry scream filled the air. The Spider King burst through the mountain wall, its massive body moving as fast as a shooting star, pouncing towards Jiang Xinyu’s head almost at the exact instant she launched her stabbing attack.
"Not good—"
Fear instantly surged in the hearts of Wang Lan and the others. The Spider King’s power had reached the pinnacle of the Star Cloud Stage. If the Spider King returned, whether Jiang Xinyu succeeded or not, they were doomed to a horrible death.
How could it be so fast... How could the Spider King return so quickly?
Xu Xiangwen thought desperately.
Jiang Xinyu felt the crushing pressure from above. Her calm façade instantly crumbled, her eyes revealing deep despair.
What I can’t bear even more than death,
she thought,
is that I’ve led the entire team into this desperate situation. If I hadn’t been so arrogant, if I hadn’t chosen to take this risk, it wouldn’t have come to this...
This moment was brief, yet it seemed to stretch on forever.
It was enough time for Wang Lan to react decisively. "Activate, Phoenix Form!"
In an instant, a Phoenix Tail Flower seal blazed on Wang Lan’s forehead. Simultaneously, numerous dark red seals lit up around his body.
An immeasurable power erupted from Wang Lan’s chest, a scorching, magma-like force instantly flooding his entire being.
BOOM—
A deafening explosion resounded.
The rocks beneath Wang Lan’s feet shattered instantly, creating a shallow crater a meter in diameter. In the blink of an eye, Wang Lan appeared above Jiang Xinyu, positioning himself before the Spider King just as its deadly attack was about to land.
"BOOM—"
Wang Lan’s fist, seemingly wreathed in flames, shot out with the Inch Strength Fist, leaving a streak of light in the air.
The enormous Spider King, its body covered in tough, thick armor, froze in mid-air for a second before suddenly exploding into countless fragments, like an egg violently smashed on the ground.
"Cross-rank kill. Reward: 1,000 experience points, 50 skill points."
A warm current flowed through Wang Lan’s body as his experience points soared. He instantly leveled up from Starlight Rank Seven to Starlight Rank Eight, and his experience bar filled by more than half.
Witnessing the Spider King being obliterated in mid-air by Wang Lan’s single punch left everyone utterly aghast.
Damn... What the hell did I just see? It must be an illusion, definitely an illusion...
Xu Xiangwen roared internally. Though his facial expression was petrified, his inner turmoil was like a raging tempest.
"What are you waiting for! Kill!" Wang Lan roared at Jiang Xinyu. Using the last second of his transformation’s power, he punched the weak section of the wall.
SQUEAK—
A sharp cry pierced the air as Jiang Xinyu’s Speedy Wind Stab viciously plunged into the Spider Queen’s ice armor. The armor, already damaged by Jiang Xinyu, could not withstand the wind blade’s cutting power. Her blade, along with her entire arm, buried deep into the Spider Queen’s head.
When Jiang Xinyu withdrew her arm, she held an egg-sized Soul Bead in her hand.
"Quick, retreat—" Wang Lan called out weakly, his strength completely drained.
"Wang Youle, what the hell are you doing? Run—" Xu Xiangwen, having charged through the frenzied Snow Spiders, was dismayed to find Wang Youle still lagging, searching for something, while the encircling Snow Spiders closed in rapidly.
Spider King Soul Bead, Spider King Soul Bead... I must find it... I must...
"To hell with that bead! Don’t you even care about your life?!" Xu Xiangwen furiously cut down the surrounding Snow Spiders, grabbed Wang Youle by the collar, and dragged him away.
After bursting out of the cave, Gong Feiyu supported Wang Lan while Xu Xiangwen dragged Wang Youle, and they fled desperately. Until a new queen emerged, the Snow Spiders, having lost their current one, would descend into a chaotic frenzy. They would attack any creature not of their kind, be it Exotic Beasts or humans. Their combat power would surge dramatically, as if fueled by a berserker’s rage.
Fortunately, the Snow Spiders had succumbed to madness. Once the team broke free from the battle, the spiders didn’t pursue them. After retreating for five kilometers, they finally found a safe canyon near Wind Valley.
The Spider King Soul Bead... to think we didn’t find it... what a pity... such a terrible pity...
Wang Youle lamented, slumping to the ground, lost in remorse. Meanwhile, Jiang Xinyu sat cross-legged, absorbing the Spider Queen’s Soul Bead, preparing for her breakthrough.
As long as Jiang Xinyu broke through to the Star Cloud Stage, they would truly be safe. Even if they encountered a king of Exotic Beasts, they could escape if they couldn’t defeat it.
Wang Lan lay on the ground, limbs limp, feeling completely hollowed out. He stared at the sky with lifeless eyes.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
Who can tell me why the after-effects of the Phoenix Form are so agonizing? It felt like being relentlessly drained by a dozen wealthy women for three days and three nights, leaving behind an empty, soulless husk.
Xu Xiangwen closed his Heavenly Eye. "The Snow Spiders aren’t chasing, and the Gale Wolves haven’t discovered us. We’re safe for now."
Having said that, a sly smile spread across his face. "Feiyu, give me a hand."
"OK!"
The two of them approached Wang Lan from either side. Xu Xiangwen nudged him gently. "Stop playing dead!"
"Leave me alone... Go cool off somewhere else."
"Oh? Pretty cocky, are we?"
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu suddenly grabbed Wang Lan’s arms, slung them over their shoulders, and then each scooped up one of his limp legs, hoisting him up.
"Hey, what are you doing? Is this some ’village kids ganging up on the helpless old man’ routine?"
"Lanzi, see that tree up ahead?" Xu Xiangwen said. "It’s about twenty centimeters in diameter, perfectly round and straight. The bark is covered in thorns, each about a centimeter long, hard as steel needles."
As they spoke, the two of them slowly carried Wang Lan towards the tree trunk.
"Stop messing around, I’m not kidding, this could kill someone... Stop playing..."
"Confess and you’ll be treated leniently."
"Resist and you’ll get cracked eggs!"
"Fine! Fine! I’ll talk, okay?"
"Speak up!"
"Hurry up and talk!"
"Well, are you going to ask your damn questions or not?"
"Do we even need to ask?"
"Have you no freaking clue what you pulled off in the Snow Spider cave?"
"Exactly! You’re just playing dumb. This reminds me of that time in eighth grade when some little bastard claimed he’d bombed the test, saying he didn’t even get ninety in math."
"And then you, this asshole, got eighty-nine point five in math, full marks in physics, chemistry, English, and biology, and only lost ten points on your Chinese composition. You were still top of the grade!"
"That’s right! And that time the teacher accidentally gave you the advanced B-version test paper meant for research, and you still managed to score eighty-nine on an exam where the highest score in all of Tong City was only sixty-two!"
"You’re a master pretender! You had me gloating for less than ten minutes before you slapped me in the face with your scores."
"It’s the same this time! All that nonsense about ’just awakened as a Star Martial Warrior,’ ’just a weakling tagging along with the team’... You were playing the pig to eat the tiger all along! I actually believed you and looked out for you the whole way. And what do I find out? You’re the real powerhouse, and I’m the noob!"
"That moment felt pretty awesome, didn’t it? Power surging, one-punch superhero style!"
"Hey, have you guys said enough? Listen to my explanation... I really wasn’t playing the pig to eat the tiger..."
"Still talking tough? Feiyu, time for some serious persuasion!"
"Stop! Listen to my explanation! That move is a Star Martial Skill, a very dangerous one. It’s incredibly powerful, as you saw, but it completely drained me in just a few seconds. Five seconds! Just five seconds! Not even enough time to drop your pants!"
"Bullshit! Five seconds is more than enough time for you to finish... AH, PFFT! You’re sidetracking me! You’re saying that was a Star Martial Skill? What kind of Star Martial Skill is that powerful? How come I’ve never heard of it?"
"Ever heard of the Phoenix Form?" Wang Lan gently patted their shoulders. "Put me down."
"Can you stand?"
"I think so."
Wang Lan’s legs were still a bit shaky, but he managed to stand firmly.
"Phoenix Form? I’ve never heard of it. Feiyu, have you?"
"There are at least a hundred thousand Star Martial Skills in the world, and at most, only about ten thousand or so have been publicly documented. And that’s just the existing ones. If you count those that appeared throughout history but were never recorded or have been lost, the number is astronomical."
"So, what exactly is this Phoenix Form Star Martial Skill?"
"It’s a Star Martial Skill that stimulates one’s latent power. I haven’t mastered it yet, so I don’t know much. But I do know that the basic requirement to learn it is the Galaxy Stage."
"Fuck!" Xu Xiangwen looked ready to kick him again. "Are you seriously trying to tell me you’re at the Galaxy Stage?"
"Is that even possible? If I were at the Galaxy Stage, I could have flattened this entire trial ground. Who the hell would bother slowly fighting monsters with you guys? This Star Martial Skill was left to me by my mom, so perhaps it’s special, allowing me to learn it even at the Starlight Stage."
"But what I can use is just a watered-down version. I don’t even know what the real Phoenix Form is like. Satisfied with that answer?"
Silently listening to their conversation, Wang Youle’s eyes reddened with jealousy.
He had never even heard of a Star Martial Skill as powerful as Phoenix Form, let alone seen one. It was something he feared he might never attain in his entire lifetime, yet Wang Lan had obtained it so easily.
Why? Why him?
Does being born into an ordinary family mean I’m destined for nothing? Why are things so easily available to Wang Lan completely out of my reach? If I had this Star Martial Skill, I’d be a genius too, an even greater prodigy than Jiang Xinyu!
They’re just luckier, that’s all... just luckier...
BUZZ—
Suddenly, a visible ripple of energy emanated from behind them, causing the three to stop talking and turn around abruptly.
Jiang Xinyu sat cross-legged on the ground, surrounded by ripples visible to the naked eye. In an instant, snowflakes began to drift down around her.
A powerful aura overflowed, and the biting cold stung the faces of Wang Lan and the others.
Jiang Xinyu slowly opened her eyes, her beautiful large eyes resembling a serene autumnal pond.
"Did you succeed?"
"Did you break through?" Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu hurriedly asked.
"Yes! Actually, I broke through a little while ago. I absorbed a few dozen more Soul Beads to stabilize my realm. I’m now basically stable at the Star Cloud Stage." Saying this, Jiang Xinyu slowly stood up. "What kind of Star Martial Skill is Phoenix Form? If the basic learning requirement is the Galaxy Stage, that Star Martial Skill must be S-rank, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Kneeling to the Crown Prince of the Flame Emperor
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24: Kneeling to the Crown Prince of the Flame Emperor
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"I’m not sure. You know, I just awakened as a Star Martial Warrior..."
"I’m very curious. S-class Star Martial Skills aren’t something ordinary people can possess. The four major Star Martial Academies are so exceptional precisely because it’s possible to learn S-class Star Martial Skills there... But you..."
At this moment, Jiang Xinyu felt envious.
"I’m also not clear if the Phoenix form is an S-class Star Martial Skill; anyway, my mom never told me."
"Wang Lan, we’ve known each other for many years, haven’t we?" Xu Xiangwen put an arm around Wang Lan’s shoulder. "You know whether you can trust my character or not."
"Yeah, clear as day. You’ve got no character at all."
"Who exactly is your mother? Could she be one of those famous heroes that are rumored?"
"Yeah, to have an S-class Star Martial Skill passed down, your mother must be some high-ranking military official, right?"
"Probably not. Plus, my mother disappeared on a mission many years ago, don’t you know that?"
"Back when we were in elementary school?"
"I did meet Wang Lan’s mother once," Jiang Xinyu nodded thoughtfully. "She was called Wang Ling, a very gentle auntie. I always thought she was a corporate white-collar worker. If it hadn’t been for the accident that happened later, I really wouldn’t have known she was a Star Martial Warrior..."
Wang Lan looked at Jiang Xinyu in surprise.
Do you have some misunderstanding about the word ’gentle’?
"Wang Ling? Never heard of her..."
"Could she be some hidden big shot? Hey, Wang Lan, stop beating around the bush. Can you tell us or not? If you can, just say it quickly; if not, we won’t ask anymore."
"I can tell. There’s nothing I can’t say; it’s just an identity... As Xinyu said, my mom is just an ordinary Star Martial Warrior. Her name is Wang Ling. There are tens of thousands with this name across the country, so it’s nothing special."
"Really?" Xu Xiangwen was somewhat skeptical. "Could your ancestors be a very impressive family? Your Star Martial Skill is definitely not ordinary. You, at the Starlight Stage, could blow up the Spider King with one punch. When you reach the Galaxy Stage, who knows how incredible you’ll be? Could it be that you’ll blow up a Star Sea Stage cultivator with one punch?"
"Isn’t that an exaggeration? Because the Phoenix form is a Star Martial Skill learned at the Galaxy Stage, it has the power of the Galaxy Stage. Actually, even when I reach the Galaxy Stage, the power of this Star Martial Skill won’t increase by much. However, my aunt did mention that my mom seemed to have earned a title given by others."
"A Star Martial Warrior with a title?" Gong Feiyu exclaimed in shock.
"No wonder we’ve never heard your mother’s name. Once a Star Martial Warrior is given a title, that title is generally what spreads. Jade Country has so many titled Star Martial Warriors. Even for those who are renowned, we often don’t know their real names."
As he spoke, Gong Feiyu ceremoniously clasped his hands together and bowed. "May I inquire as to what title your esteemed mother has...?"
"Can you not make it so ceremonial?" Wang Lan smiled wryly. "My aunt said my mom’s title is Flame Emperor."
"PFFT—" Gong Feiyu spewed out a breath he hadn’t managed to inhale properly.
"Impossible, right? The Flame Emperor... one of the Five Emperors is your mom? You’re... kidding, right?"
"The Flame Emperor is a woman? This is the first I’ve heard of it."
"It’s not impossible..." Jiang Xinyu said calmly after taking a deep breath. "The only ones who could possess an S-class Star Martial Skill are the top-tier experts. And since she’s one of them, it’s not so hard to accept that Wang Lan’s mother is the Flame Emperor."
"THUMP!" Next to Gong Feiyu, Xu Xiangwen dropped to his knees with a thud.
"Hey, do you have to be so dramatic? It’s just a title, right?"
"I’m kneeling to the Flame Emperor’s heir... This flex of yours is too much; I can only kneel. The Flame Emperor, do you even know what that means? Right, you don’t. Even though you’re the Flame Emperor’s son, you don’t have a clue about the Flame Emperor.
"The Five Venerables and the Five Emperors—Jade Country invincible.
"This is a universally recognized axiom on Sky Blue Star: as long as the Five Venerables and Five Emperors are all present, Jade Country is invincible. The Five Venerables represent the highest prestige; the Five Emperors, the ultimate combat power.
"Your mom is the Flame Emperor? Your mom is *actually* the Flame Emperor?
"Holy crap... AH!
"Why is your mom the Flame Emperor, and not mine? Bro, dear brother! Did you know? I’m actually your brother, lost for sixteen years—your own flesh and blood brother—"
Xu Xiangwen suddenly pounced and tightly hugged Wang Lan’s leg. "Bro, as soon as I get out, I’ll change my household registration, acknowledge my ancestors, and return to the family..."
Wang Lan looked at Xu Xiangwen, goosebumps rising all over him. "This is the character you so emphatically wanted me to trust? Get lost!"
"No, wait, Wang Lan, the Flame Emperor hasn’t disappeared," Jiang Xinyu asked gravely.
"Yeah, she hasn’t disappeared. She must be in some secretive position or place. But because her existence is now a top-level national secret, even I can’t know her whereabouts. Maybe that’s why I’ve been an orphan all these years," Wang Lan said with a half-forced smile.
The state had covered up the Flame Emperor’s disappearance. But, on reflection, could that really be the truth? Perhaps Wang Ling intentionally cut off contact for Wang Lan and Wang Qi’s safety, to separate Wang Ling from the Flame Emperor. Auntie is just an ordinary person; she couldn’t possibly know the real story. Maybe for her, the ’truth’ at Jade Country’s level is just a cover. Even with the video Wang Ling left, I started to doubt after thinking it over. I’m already sixteen; are they still treating me like a child? If, as Auntie said, Wang Ling really is the Flame Emperor and disappeared during a mission, her fate unknown to this day... this information shouldn’t, and couldn’t, possibly be known to Wang Qi. Would Wang Qi really not leak it? If the country wanted to cover up Wang Ling’s disappearance, the best way would be to keep even Wang Qi and me in the dark. Wang Qi knowing about the Flame Emperor’s disappearance is more likely because the higher-ups in Jade Country *wanted* her to believe Wang Ling had disappeared. That’s also why I revealed my identity and Wang Ling’s. If it’s truly a secret, then come find me. Slap a gag order on me. If Wang Ling really has disappeared, give me an explanation. But if not, then I won’t let this go so easily. You took me in, raised me, and then abandoned me for eight years without a care! Doesn’t your conscience bother you at all?
WHOOP! WHOOP! WHOOP!—
While Wang Lan and the others were resting, the alarm from the garrison in the beginner’s trial space suddenly blared.
The Southeast Military Region’s Star Martial Special Warfare Brigade, Martial Arts Corps, Third Battalion command center instantly became a scene of chaos.
"What’s going on? Why did the Snow Spiders suddenly go berserk?" roared Battalion Commander Wu Changfeng, his eyes bulging like a bull’s with fury.
"We’re not sure yet. Our men have gone to investigate, but the most likely reason is that someone killed the Spider Queen."
"Which son of a bitch did it? If I catch him, I’ll make him pay with his life. The top priority is to stabilize the situation. Has the rescue team set out? Are there any casualties?"
"The rescue team has already departed. No casualties reported so far."
"Commander, there’s been a coup among the Flaming Leopards! The Old Leopard King has been driven out of the tribe..."
"Commander, the Snow Spider upheaval has triggered unrest in the Red Flame Demon Tribe! They’re expanding aggressively!"
"Commander, the Gale Wolves are moving southward..."
"It’s chaos, complete chaos! The entire trial field is a mess. Damn it!"
"What should we do?" a subordinate officer asked, somewhat lost.
"What else can we do? Suppress it by force! First and Second Companies, plus five special combat teams, deploy immediately! Quell the uprising! We must restore order before any casualties occur!"
"Yes, sir!"
Wu Changfeng slumped back into his chair, grumbling, "Damn it. Why can’t we use tech products in the Different Dimensional Space? Firearms being useless is bad enough, but no surveillance equipment either? If we could use it, we wouldn’t have so many problems..."
After an anxious half-hour wait, a warrior hurried into the command center.The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"Commander, we’ve found the Spider Queen on the outskirts of the Snow Mountain. Many Snow Spiders are converging on her. Not far from her, we discovered a spatial Exotic Beast cage."
"Damn those poachers... Where are they? Caught yet?"
"Afraid they’re all dead. The men speculate that the poachers probably calculated that Spider Queen Sherry’s life was ending. They stole the new queen she laid, before it could hatch, planning to take it out and sell it. Unfortunately, they didn’t account for Sherry dying before they could escape. The new queen evolved instantly, and their plans were foiled."
"Hmph, they got off easy. But the poachers must still have contacts out there. We must find them. They’ve caused me so much trouble. If we catch them, every last one will be executed by firing squad!"
"The men feel the same way, sir."
"Fu!"
"Present!"
"You stay here and coordinate. I’m going out myself."
"Commander, is that wise? For you to go personally?"
"Leaving it to those kids to suppress this, who knows how long it’ll take? If I go, it’ll be faster, and maybe fewer people will die. How many Trialists are in the trial field this time?"
"Twelve hundred."
"Notify the gate to temporarily close the trial field until the Exotic Beasts settle down. Also, have the Trialists gather at the gate area as soon as possible to avoid unnecessary casualties."
"Yes, sir!"
Outside the Wind Valley, north of the Snow Mountain, Wang Lan and the others sat around a campfire, eating energy bars. Compared to the chaos outside, this place seemed like a peaceful haven.
"Rested enough?" Jiang Xinyu asked casually.
"Yeah, pretty much."
"What about Wang Lan?"
Wang Lan exited the system interface. Activating the Phoenix form not only cost ten skill points per second but also had a damned cooldown period—a full twenty-four hours.
But thinking of the horrifying aftereffects of using the Phoenix form, Wang Lan felt the cooldown period was no big deal.
Believe it or not, I swear I’ll never use such a self-destructive skill again. After using it, I felt like I was going to die.
"I’m fine too, mostly recovered."
"Good. I still have a hundred Soul Beads. I’ve already made a breakthrough, so I won’t be included in the distribution of these. You can divide these hundred Soul Beads among yourselves," Jiang Xinyu said.
"I was already allocated some before. I won’t take part in dividing these hundred beads; you three take them. We’ll distribute the Soul Beads from our future kills together," Wang Lan chimed in first. It was important to be generous at the right time. Killing the Spider King had earned him fifty skill points, so he considered it a net gain.
"What’s the next target? We obviously can’t go after Snow Spiders anymore."
"Flaming Leopards. Don’t we have someone in our team whose fire-based strength is too weak?" Jiang Xinyu said with a hint of indifference.
"Ah?" Wang Youle lifted his head in surprise, looking as if he’d received an unexpected favor.
Xu Xiangwen’s mouth twitched slightly. He gave Wang Youle a deep look but said nothing.
One must be considerate; he feared the child might take it too hard.
The Flaming Leopards were neighbors to the Snow Spiders. Taking a detour around the back would be about fifteen kilometers. The terrain in the Different Dimensional Space was complex, but fortunately, with Xu Xiangwen as their human navigator, Wang Lan and the others could avoid getting lost.
They encountered no threats along the way. The five of them didn’t rush, proceeding at a normal pace toward the Flaming Leopards’ territory.
Suddenly, Jiang Xinyu stopped. The other four looked at her, puzzled.
Without warning, Jiang Xinyu crossed her hands. An icicle materialized between her palms and, with a WHOOSH, shot into the vegetation not far behind them.
"AH!" A figure darted out. "Don’t attack, don’t attack! I’m a Star Martial Warrior, here for the trial..."

chapters.title: Chapter 25 The Attacker
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25 The Attacker
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"The Snow Spiders outside have gone berserk, my teammates are all dead, and I escaped alone. I made my way here through a detour from Wind Valley. My tactical watch is broken, and I just happened to see you guys. I have no ill intentions; I just want to follow you and find a way out..." the person said, slowly approaching Jiang Xinyu and the others.
"Stop!" Jiang Xinyu called out coldly.
"You have to believe me, I really have no ill intentions, it’s just me alone... You have five people, even if I had any bad ideas, I wouldn’t have the guts..." the other party explained in a panic, but their steps steadily advanced towards Jiang Xinyu’s group of four.
"Attack!" At Jiang Xinyu’s command, the ready Gong Feiyu instantly launched Earth Spike.
At the same time, their opponent’s figure moved in a flash, as quick as Speedy Wind, leaving behind afterimages, effortlessly circumventing the Earth Spike and charging towards Xu Xiangwen and Wang Lan.
Xu Xiangwen instantly created a Physical Clone to meet the oncoming attacker. The two Xu Xiangwens, one to the left and one to the right, flanked the enemy, slashing down with their swords simultaneously. However, the opponent’s figure shimmered suddenly, as if turning into a shadow under the moonlight.
The eerie figure slipped through their attack. The clone was struck; its movements stalled for a moment, and then it instantly vanished.
This scene caused Wang Lan’s expression to change drastically. The enemy’s dagger was so fast that Wang Lan couldn’t see the actions clearly; he only vaguely saw two stabs targeting the clone’s throat.
If it weren’t for the clone vanishing the next instant, Wang Lan would have thought Xu Xiangwen himself had been killed in the blink of an eye.
"Wind Attribute? Wang Youle, attack with fire!" Jiang Xinyu shouted.
"Me... should I go? I can’t... If I go up, I’m just asking to be killed..." Wang Youle retreated repeatedly.
"Forget it, Feiyu, you control the field, I’ll go!" Wang Lan drew his sword, dedicating all his remaining points to Self Healing, upgrading it to Bronze 9.
"Be careful, his speed is very fast!" Jiang Xinyu warned gravely.
"My speed isn’t slow either!"
This wasn’t an understatement from Wang Lan. With his movement technique having reached Bronze 9, even most warriors at the Star Shine Stage, or even the Star Cloud Stage, might not match his speed.
Gong Feiyu instantly activated his Star Martial Skill, causing Earth Spikes to repeatedly thrust from the ground in front of him. Although the opponent was extremely fast, this kind of hidden attack, ready to strike from underground at any moment, could still cause some trouble for him.
Wang Lan seized the opportunity to burst forward, his swordwork exploding like fireworks.
The opponent’s Star Martial Skill was wind-based, using the properties of wind to boost their movement speed to several times normal. Speed-related Star Martial Skills were generally powerful, but there were two ways to counter them.
The first was an attribute counter: fire overcomes wind. Flames would scorch air, making wind attributes chaotic and hard to control upon encountering fire. Unless suppressed by several times more Star Power, it would be almost completely countered by fire.
The second was to restrict the area. High-speed movement required sufficient space. Because of Wang Youle’s hesitation, and Wang Lan not having a fire-attributed Star Martial Skill, this tactic was their only option.
With Gong Feiyu using Earth Spike to cause disturbances, Wang Lan took the chance to close the gap for melee, ready to engage face-to-face without giving the opponent any chance to pull away.
CLANG, CLANG, CLANG—
The continuous flashes of light from the sword made it seem as if Wang Lan was back to the day he was in a close-quarters slashing match with Huang Feilong.
It had to be said that professional Star Martial Warriors indeed possessed more solid foundational strength than those trained in academies.
The opponent looked to be around forty. While his sword skill might not have been as exquisite as Wang Lan’s, his execution and momentum were stronger. Especially at critical moments, he could unleash a dazzling move to neutralize Wang Lan’s assault, creating an impression of transforming decay into magic.
Each of the opponent’s moves was an aggressive attack, a tremendous drain on stamina. Though Star Power circulating within could enhance one’s physical abilities, Wang Lan had Star Power, and so did the opponent, whose Star Power was denser than Wang Lan’s.
Judging by the situation, Wang Lan seemed unlikely to win. Suddenly, a cold wind howled past, causing both Wang Lan and the opponent to involuntarily pause.
BOOM— A shadow burst into the fray, landing a punch that sent the Star Martial Warrior flying.
Surprised, Wang Lan turned his head to look at Jiang Xinyu, her arm covered in a layer of ice armor as brilliant as diamonds. Her speed had been so fast that Wang Lan didn’t even have time to react.
Although I’d never seen Jiang Xinyu’s close-combat prowess before, it definitely shouldn’t have been as exaggerated as what she just displayed. The Star Cloud Stage... is it really that terrifying?
COUGH, COUGH, COUGH— The middle-aged Star Martial Warrior coughed violently, clutching his chest.
"I advise you to get out of here. Dare to target us again, and I’ll kill you!" Jiang Xinyu’s words, coupled with the chilling coldness she emanated, inexplicably made Wang Lan shiver.
"HEH, HEH... Kill me? So you’re at the Star Cloud Stage now... so young... you must be a genius, right?
"I despise you geniuses the most. Why do we struggle so hard in cultivation, striving so much to improve our strength, while you can reach such heights so effortlessly?
"You are still students, aren’t you? Being able to afford the trial grounds at your age means you must come from wealthy families... Why do all the benefits go to you geniuses? It’s really infuriating!"
"So bitter... A grown man, yet you have such strong jealousy? I’m truly ashamed for you," Gong Feiyu said dismissively, covering his nose.
"Something’s not right!" Wang Lan sensed a hint of danger from the middle-aged man and instinctively warned, "Everyone, be careful. There’s something off about this man."
Suddenly, red spots blossomed on the man’s face, as vivid as a starlight rash. The red blotches spread rapidly, and an aura like a blood mist billowed around him.
The oppressive aura churned, gripping the hearts of Wang Lan and the others as if a giant hand were clenching them tightly.
"Handing you over would definitely get me another dose of Strengthening Liquid, wouldn’t it... Well then!" The middle-aged man abruptly lifted his head, his eyes wide and filled with malicious red. Indistinctly, one could see a pair of vertical pupils, not belonging to any human.
BOOM— The opponent suddenly launched towards Wang Lan and the others, and Jiang Xinyu’s figure dashed forward in a flash.
From her palm emerged a sword of Air Blade Flow, and in an instant, she was engaged in battle.
The figures of the two combatants blurred with dizzying speed. Jiang Xinyu’s Star Cloud Stage strength completely overshadowed that of the Star Shine Stage—a clear difference in class. The middle-aged Star Martial Warrior possessed peak Star Shine Stage strength, but, having been enhanced by some unknown means, his combat power was not inferior to Jiang Xinyu’s.
In an instant, I couldn’t help feeling a chill of fear. If Jiang Xinyu hadn’t broken through to the Star Cloud Stage, wouldn’t we, even after escaping from the Snow Spider’s lair, have likely died here?
"Why would a Star Martial Warrior attack another Star Martial Warrior?" Wang Lan asked in a low voice, not understanding why fellow humans, moreover Star Martial Warriors from the same country, would turn on each other.
"These Star Martial Warriors are just a minority of degenerates, but their existence has increased the danger level of the trial grounds by an order of magnitude. Not everyone is good, and not all Star Martial Warriors are good people.
"The trial grounds have no surveillance or cell phone signals. Even if you kill someone, their bodies will be eaten by Exotic Beasts, so the place has become lawless. Maybe outside the trial grounds they abide by the law, but inside, they shed their humanity and become beasts.
"Especially those of us who look like students; we are prime targets in their eyes. This isn’t the first time we’ve encountered this, it’s just that we haven’t faced someone this powerful before. Fortunately, Xinyu broke through to the Star Cloud Stage, otherwise this time..."
Gong Feiyu’s words stirred an unsettling feeling in Wang Lan. Indeed, human morality needed the constraints of law; without them, their baser instincts could erupt, and they would be capable of anything.
Jiang Xinyu continued her battle with the middle-aged Star Martial Warrior, displaying her foundation in sword skill, which was elusive and agile. Moreover, it was Wang Lan’s first time truly perceiving Jiang Xinyu’s strength.
Her Basic Skills should be above mine; I’m now Bronze Nine, but I still feel a clear gap.
However, what’s puzzling is that after reaching Bronze Nine, I can’t add any more skill points. The first skill to hit this limit was Inch Strength Star Martial Skill; the point-addition button disappeared once it reached Bronze Nine (9/10).
Initially, I thought Inch Strength Star Martial Skill could only be maxed out at Bronze and felt dejected for a few minutes. But when my sword skill also couldn’t be improved after reaching Bronze Nine, I realized it wasn’t about reaching the skill’s cap; rather, the ability to add points was restricted.
I’m aware that above sword skill, there’s sword qi, like in the Water Cutting Flow and Air Blade Flow techniques. If honed to a high level, these skills allow one to cut through a mat three meters away with a single strike that sends out blade energy.
The only restriction I can think of is my own rank. In a sense, I’ve indeed maxed out my skill points for my current level—the peak of the Starlight Stage.
To further enhance my skill strength, I must break free from the confines of the Starlight Stage.
So, even with the system assisting me, it’s unrealistic to think I can catch up with Jiang Xinyu in the short term.
Wait... aren’t we missing someone from our team?
.ɴet
Xu Xiangwen has been missing since the fight began! Where did he go?
Wang Lan signaled Gong Feiyu with his eyes, and Gong Feiyu mysteriously pointed towards the ground. As it turned out, from the beginning, Gong Feiyu and Xu Xiangwen had been coordinating. Gong Feiyu had used his Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill to create a space underground while Xu Xiangwen lay in wait, ready to strike a lethal blow from beneath.
Understanding dawned on Wang Lan, and a plan suddenly formed in his mind.
"Xinyu, get ready. We’ll create an opening for you." As soon as Wang Lan finished speaking, he charged towards the battle. A slash cut through the air, the blade’s light icy and biting.
Jiang Xinyu immediately retreated from the battlefield, and the middle-aged Star Martial Warrior furiously focused on Wang Lan.
Engaging with a Star Cloud Stage genius? I’d be delighted! Battling a genius proves my own strength, doesn’t it? But what’s this Starlight Stage trash doing? Daring to seek death?
The opponent smashed through Wang Lan’s blade light with a punch. Instantly, Wang Lan’s combat knife shattered, and the punch continued its unaltered trajectory towards Wang Lan’s head. If this punch connected, Wang Lan’s head would burst open like a watermelon.
"Inch Strength Fist—"
My Inch Strength Fist at Bronze Nine could take out a low-ranking Demon Soldier of the Demon Clan with one punch. I wonder if this Star Martial Warrior’s defense is stronger than a Demon Soldier’s.
BOOM—
Their fists collided, creating a powerful shockwave that exploded like a hurricane. Wang Lan and his opponent were momentarily frozen in mid-air.
CRACK—
Almost simultaneously, a crisp sound of bone fracturing echoed from both of their fists.

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Great Harvest, So Joyful
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26: Great Harvest, So Joyful
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Wang Lan’s face, along with those of his two opponents, turned ashen almost simultaneously. For two of them—Wang Lan and one of the opponents—the agony of their shattered fists felt like countless steel needles stabbing into their fingers, the pain twisting their expressions instantaneously.
Hang in there! Hang in there! I must hang on! But... I can’t hang on any longer... AWOOOO—
Wang Lan let out a wolf-like howl toward the sky, quickly channeling the Self Healing Star Martial Skill into his fist. If an X-ray had been taken at that moment, his palm would have looked like a cookie smashed on the ground.
His opponent’s face contorted with pain as he quickly retreated. Suddenly, the ground beneath the middle-aged Star Martial Warrior collapsed, and he fell in before he could react, his legs sinking into the earth. Out of nowhere, two figures burst from the ground behind the Star Martial Warrior. Two Xu Xiangwens, one on each side, slashed down with their battle blades.
The coordination this time was exquisite. Even Jiang Xinyu, poised for a fatal strike, was taken aback; she knew that if she had been in the Star Martial Warrior’s place, she certainly would have fallen to this blow.
CLANG—
The dual blades struck the Star Martial Warrior’s neck, but the expected beheading didn’t happen. Xu Xiangwen’s blades felt as if they had struck steel.
Horror spread across Xu Xiangwen’s face. In that instant, a carapace, like that of an armored creature, had appeared on the back of the Star Martial Warrior’s head. This tough shell protected his vulnerable neck, causing Xu Xiangwen’s lethal strike to miss.
But... did you think the middle-aged Star Martial Warrior would simply avoid disaster and begin a second round? You’d be sorely underestimating the cunning of these kids. Given the slightest opportunity, they would unleash a relentless barrage of attacks, giving their enemy no chance to breathe.
The moment Xu Xiangwen’s attack missed, Jiang Xinyu’s figure brushed past Wang Lan. In her left hand, a Wind Blade Spire, like a spinning gyroscope, howled as it transformed into a phantom image and plunged deep into the Star Martial Warrior’s chest.
The cyan armor was no match for the terrifying cutting power of the Wind Blade Spire, and Jiang Xinyu’s entire forearm plunged deep into his chest.
"Gah—" The middle-aged Star Martial Warrior looked up, his eyes filled with confusion.
Jiang Xinyu instantly retreated, leaving a hole the size of a football in the Star Martial Warrior’s chest.
"Damn... it!"
"Cross-level kill! Reward: 200 experience points, 10 skill points!"
Only 10 skill points? What a waste!
"Are you okay?" Jiang Xinyu asked Wang Lan, her voice laced with concern.
"N-no... I’m fine." By then, Wang Lan’s shattered fist had been completely restored by the Self Healing Star Martial Skill. Although it had consumed nearly all his Star Power, he had to admit the skill was truly amazing.
"I thought I heard..."
"See? No problem." Wang Lan opened his palm and flexed his fingers. He definitely wouldn’t have been able to do that if he were still injured.
"I must have misheard then." Jiang Xinyu glanced at the corpse. "Let’s go. The Gale Wolves will be here soon to dispose of the body. Xu Xiangwen, any loot in his bag?"
"Damn it! For someone this strong, his bag is completely empty! What a pauper. Could he have just entered the trial grounds and not had a chance to get anything yet?"
"Never mind, let’s move on," Jiang Xinyu said. "We still have six days. The more we hunt, the better."
Wang Lan, however, still had some lingering doubts about this enigmatic man.
For instance, he was clearly only at the Star Shine Stage, so why did he erupt with Star Power comparable to someone at the Star Cloud Stage? And how did that guy suddenly grow a carapace?
But Star Martial Warriors possessed many strange and varied abilities.
Maybe, perhaps, probably... that was just his special skill.
「After traveling another 10 kilometers or so, they arrived at the Ground Flame Magma Region, the territory of the Flaming Leopards.」
On the outskirts of the region, they found a well-ventilated canyon, which they designated as the resting base for their five-person team. After establishing a tactical routine for resting and luring monsters, Jiang Xinyu took the lead, guiding Wang Lan and the others toward the Flaming Leopards.
Previously, when luring Snow Spiders, they had pulled 10 at a time. Since individual Flaming Leopards were much stronger than Snow Spiders, they decided to try luring 20.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Twenty Flaming Leopards would have meant certain death for any other Star Martial team. But for Jiang Xinyu, who had broken through to the Star Cloud Stage,
it was a piece of cake.
「The commotion caused by the Snow Spiders outside had finally been suppressed.」
The Exotic Beasts in various locations obediently returned to their respective territories. This disturbance had lasted for eight long hours. If Wu Changfeng hadn’t acted decisively to quell it, many Exotic Beast tribes, on the verge of joining the uproar, would have been swiftly disciplined by the Star Martial Army. His actions prevented the unrest from escalating and allowed the situation to stabilize relatively quickly.
「A reconnaissance Star Martial team appeared just outside Wang Lan’s Wind Valley.」
"Captain," one reported, "there’s no anomaly in the Flaming Leopard tribe. The Old Leopard King is missing, but the pack is stable. The new Leopard King has established his position and shouldn’t cause any trouble."
"That’s good. Return and report."
"Wait, there’s something!" Suddenly, one of the Star Martial Warriors covered an eye, the pupil of his other eye turning pure white.
"Is that a Star Martial team luring Flaming Leopards to hunt them?"
"What? A Star Martial team? Weren’t they all supposed to be stationed at the entrance? Why are some still lingering here?"
"They probably didn’t receive the initial notice. Perhaps they came over from Wind Valley and are unaware of the recent upheaval in the trial grounds."
"That would make sense. Otherwise, they’d have been caught in the middle of the chaos and finished for sure. What a lucky team. Let’s go take a look."
