Wang Lan and his two companions skillfully weaved through the Ground Flame Magma Region, relentlessly pursued by over a dozen fire-breathing Flaming Leopards. Countless fireballs, like a barrage of artillery, exploded around them, leaving faint scorch marks where they landed.
"Damn, why are ones so young looking for death?" exclaimed one of the Star Martial Army members.
"They’re just kids... probably high school students from Suzhou City. A single Flaming Leopard would be a handful for them, yet they have 15 or 20 chasing them! They’re running out of room up ahead. Prepare for a rescue!"
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM—
Suddenly, Jiang Xinyu, standing in the middle of the canyon, unleashed her power. Her hands crossed as surging Star Power flowed from her. A ripple spread outwards, and then, more than a dozen ice lances materialized before her, shooting out instantly like a volley of arrows.
The Star Martial Army squad, which had been about to rush out for the rescue, came to an abrupt halt, frozen in place as if petrified.
The ice lances precisely avoided Wang Lan and his companions, striking every single Flaming Leopard. Flaming Leopards, equivalent in strength to mid-tier Star Shine Stage cultivators, were like paper before Jiang Xinyu, a Star Cloud Stage expert. They were killed instantly.
Wang Lan skidded to a halt and looked back. All the pursuing Flaming Leopards lay dead.
The three of them grinned, then went over to each Flaming Leopard, swiftly collecting their Soul Beads.
What they didn’t know was that atop a nearby cliff, sharp intakes of breath could be heard from the Star Martial Army squad.
"That young lady... is she at the Star Cloud Stage?"
"Looks like it."
"How did someone at the Star Cloud Stage get in here? Check their identities!"
One of them pulled a tablet computer from his backpack. "They’re Star Martial Students, class of ’16 from Suzhou No.1 Middle School. The team leader is Jiang Xinyu, heiress to the Jiang Technology Group of Suzhou City. She was at the peak of the Star Shine Stage when she entered the trial grounds; she must have broken through while in here."
"The others are all sons of wealthy families from Suzhou City. Heh, who would’ve thought this bunch of rich kids would be so capable?"
"Don’t be prejudiced against them just because they’re from wealthy families. Do you think they’re all just coasting on their parents’ success? They train just as hard as we do, if not harder. Otherwise, do you believe they could achieve such strength at their age solely due to their birthright?"
"Alright, Captain, spare me the lecture, I get it. Judging by their teamwork, it’s clear they’re not just pampered young masters. Daring to lure beasts under a barrage of fire from Flaming Leopards—you can’t do that without guts and real skill."
"They’re all geniuses, aren’t they?"
"Genius... That word is thrown around too easily. Only those who survive and continue to grow can be called true geniuses. Let’s go."
"Go? We’re not watching anymore?"
"Watch what? With a Star Cloud Stage expert in their squad, they can handle even the Leopard King and retreat safely if necessary. Time to report back!"
「The Star Martial Army squad departed.」
Meanwhile, Wang Lan and his team continued their hunt.
Each time, they lured 15 to 20 Flaming Leopards, and Jiang Xinyu would then obliterate them with an attack, leaving a pile of corpses. This consumed a significant amount of Jiang Xinyu’s Star Power, but even using five Soul Beads at a time to replenish it, the massive returns made it feel like simply picking up money off the ground.
Moreover, Jiang Xinyu also needed opportunities like this to practice her Star Martial Skills. Some skills, though learned, would have depleted all her Star Power in a single use back when she was at the Star Shine Stage, and their effectiveness would have been reduced. Thus, she’d never had a chance to train them properly.
How could she pass up such a perfect opportunity under these conditions?
An hour later, the Flaming Leopards grew wary, and countless more began to pour in from the surrounding area. Upon noticing this change, Xu Xiangwen immediately instructed the team to evacuate. As they escaped into the canyon, they could still hear the continuous, angry roars of the Flaming Leopards behind them.
Just like angry cats.
"What’s the haul?" Wang Lan eagerly asked once Jiang Xinyu finished counting.
"Three hundred..." Even Jiang Xinyu herself could hardly believe the number. Previously, hunting Snow Spiders, it had taken them three strenuous days to gather 400 Soul Beads. Now, against Flaming Leopards—each much stronger than a Snow Spider—they had collected 300 in just one hour.
Is this hunting? No, this is slaughter! Is this earning money? No, this is like picking money right off the ground!
"Three hundred in an hour!" Xu Xiangwen exclaimed. "Wow, at this rate, 2,000 a day isn’t just a dream! We still have five days... so in five days, that’s over 10,000, right? Feiyu, do the math for me—how much are 10,000 primary Soul Beads worth?"
Feiyu estimated, "That should be... over 10 million, right?"
"Bullshit! That’s the buy-back price!" Xu Xiangwen retorted. "If we sold them on the open market, that would be... at least several billion, right? Five days! In five days, I could earn several billion! If my dad found out, he’d hug me and cry tears of joy..."
"He’s got a point..." one of the others mumbled.
Wang Lan felt a chill watching the two of them shamelessly boasting without any restraint.
Open market prices? Bullshit! The trade of Soul Beads is a state monopoly; they can’t even be taken out of the trial grounds. There’s an electronic search at the exit. You either absorb them inside the trial grounds or sell them back to the authorities for 1,000 credits each. Several billion? Dream on! And over 10,000 Flaming Leopards? How could they even imagine that? There are only a few thousand Flaming Leopards in total. Are they planning to wipe out an entire tribe in two days?
Still, it had to be said that after breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage, Jiang Xinyu was practically an exploit within the primary trial grounds. No wonder these grounds only permitted entry to those below the Star Shine Stage; cultivators at the Star Cloud Stage were meant for the intermediate trial grounds. If there were three more cultivators like Jiang Xinyu, the trial grounds would probably have to close down prematurely.
In fact, entering at the peak of the Star Shine Stage and then breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage was a loophole others had exploited before. However, the prerequisites were steep: one had to collect enough Soul Beads within 10 days and possess the talent to guarantee a breakthrough. Very few who attempted this had actually succeeded.
"Alright, let’s divide the Soul Beads," Jiang Xinyu announced. "I won’t take any this time. The four of you can split these; that’s 80 each."
Jiang Xinyu casually tossed the bag of Soul Beads, carrying herself with the air of a monarch bestowing rewards upon her loyal ministers.

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Eyes Red with Envy
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27: Eyes Red with Envy
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Everyone else carefully put away their Soul Beads, but when they reached Wang Lan’s hands, he absorbed them one by one as if they were sugar beans.
After absorbing more than a dozen in succession, Wang Lan suddenly felt several pairs of eyes staring straight at him.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Looking up, he saw a variety of expressions. Jiang Xinyu was all right, just a bit surprised, but Gong Feiyu’s expression was somewhat twisted. Wang Youle’s eyes were blood-red; that look was all too familiar, like a guy in junior high who used to pick fights with Wang Lan for no reason.
It was said that the boy’s parents were highly educated. He transferred from Tong City and, on his first day of school, declared to the entire class with a condescending attitude that he would take first place in the grade.
That year, Wang Lan was still a low-key good kid. A hundred thousand primary school students hadn’t yet hoisted Wang Lan upon a pedestal. In the first month’s exam, he dominated the first place with a twenty-point lead over the boy.
Wang Lan still remembered that boy’s eyes, as red as Wang Youle’s were at this moment.
Afterwards, every exam saw the boy explode with jealousy. For the sake of his eye health, he returned to Tong City to dominate there for the second term.
Looking back, Wang Lan still felt a twinge of guilt.
"Why can you score so well? Why, why can’t I surpass you no matter how hard I try?"
"I’m leaving. Being in the same class as you was my misfortune. Suzhou City may be yours, but Tong City is mine!"
Recalling that sunset farewell, Wang Lan internally sent his blessings but also felt helpless. After all, I didn’t want this, but... what can I do if my strength doesn’t allow it?
In Wang Youle’s heart, Soul Beads were more precious than gold, time, or even life itself. Seeing Wang Lan squander them so carelessly, he felt a pain that made it hard to breathe—a pain that was slowly tearing him apart.
But Wang Lan didn’t mean to hurt his soul like that. After all, the only value Soul Beads held for him was skill points, even if they could also replenish Star Power. What else was he supposed to do if not absorb them to extract those points? Was he supposed to just let them pile up and weigh him down?
"Xu, your expression is getting more and more ferocious... If there’s something you want to say, just say it. I can take it."
"What the hell can you accept wholeheartedly? You obviously don’t know how hard it is to come by Soul Beads; don’t you feel any regret? Who absorbs them like you do? The best value of Soul Beads comes from absorbing them in the largest quantity. At least after accumulating three hundred, you should absorb them all at once to maximize your chance of breaking through the shackles of Star Power limits and advancing to a new stage. You’re absorbing them one by one, what? Are you lacking mana that badly? Is your Star Power being consumed so much? Doesn’t wasting Soul Beads like this hurt you? I’ve noticed this habit of yours before. I always thought you were using some ineffective Star Martial Skill that depleted your Star Power. But now I see you’re just absorbing them for fun."
"That’s not true, Soul Beads really do help me a lot..." Wang Lan said seriously, and then took out another Soul Bead.
SNAP— The Soul Bead shattered as its Star Power was drained and dissipated. The sound of breaking echoed like the snapping of Xu Xiangwen’s heartstrings. In an instant, veins bulged on Xu Xiangwen’s forehead.
"Feiyu, quick, stop me! I’m afraid I can’t restrain myself and might kill him... hurry..."
"I want to kill him too, but hold back. The Soul Beads are his; let him do what he wants with them. Besides, it’s not like you can beat him anyway."
Wang Lan continued to absorb Soul Beads, and Xu Xiangwen silently turned away, pretending not to see.
All of Wang Lan’s skills had reached the peak of the Bronze Nine levels, and there were no more skill points to allocate. But even if he couldn’t allocate points to skills, Wang Lan still poured them into the Phoenix Form.
I, Wang Lan, have always kept my word. Even if I encounter danger, even if I am beaten to death, I will never use the Phoenix Form again. Its side effects are worse than a clean death.
Thinking this, he added another ten skill points to the Phoenix Form.
Keeping ten Soul Beads in hand in case he ran out of mana, Wang Lan finally stopped his nerve-wracking behavior for everyone else.
"We’ve rested enough, let’s continue," Jiang Xinyu stood up, gently untied the ribbon from the back of her head, letting her long, flowing hair dance in the air, as beautiful as a sky full of flying dandelions.
If Snow Spiders were the main force of Exotic Beasts in the junior trial grounds, then Flaming Leopards, Gale Wolves, and dozens of other Exotic Beasts could be collectively referred to as other Exotic Beasts.
Snow Spiders could easily spawn tens of thousands of offspring, while the entire population of Flaming Leopards numbered only a few thousand. However, after Jiang Xinyu’s team’s tragic, inhumane cycle of herding and slaughtering for several hours, the number of Flaming Leopards had already decreased by a third.
In the central den of the Flaming Leopards, the newly ascended Leopard King had successfully inherited everything from his predecessor. Besides the loyal little brothers, there were also dozens of the most beautiful female leopards in the tribe.
While the Leopard King was diligently working for the propagation of his tribe, a one-eyed Flaming Leopard rushed into the den in a panic, "My king, terrible news..."
The Leopard King shuddered with fear and turned his ferocious gaze to the cyclops as if looking at a corpse. If it hadn’t been for the fact that this loyal subordinate had made great contributions to defeat the Old Leopard King, he would already be dead.
"A small team of trialists is brutally slaughtering our brethren. Nearly two thousand brothers have been killed already. If this goes on, our tribe will be exterminated..."
ROAR—
A leopard’s roar shook heaven and earth. Wang Lan and his teammates, who had just finished collecting Soul Beads, stopped in their tracks.
"What’s happening?"
"The Flaming Leopards are rallying to their central tribe. Perhaps we’ve hunted them too fiercely. Shall we change locations?"
"The intelligence of Exotic Beasts isn’t high. Even if they’re temporarily aware of danger, they will come out again after a while. It would be a waste of more than an hour to change spots, and in that time, we could collect quite a number of Soul Beads." Wang Youle was in a good mood now; anyone would be happy after successfully gathering seven to eight hundred Soul Beads in a day.
Having just stepped into the Star Shine Stage, Wang Youle was set to advance to the middle phase with so many Soul Beads. His position in the team was secure. Moreover, Wang Youle’s ability to join Jiang Xinyu’s team was definitely not an undeserved reputation. At least his strength was top-notch among the children from ordinary families in the class. The trial not only yielded a large number of Soul Beads but also marked significant progress in Basic Skills. Even though there was a clear gap compared to Wang Lan and the others, he was still far better than most.
"Even if you want to fleece someone, you can’t just focus on the Flaming Leopards. If we keep killing like this, the Flaming Leopards will become protected animals."
"Let’s kill another batch," Jiang Xinyu decisively quelled any potential dissent before it could sprout. "Next batch, we switch places. Gale Wolves, Tierra Mice, and Extension Beasts in turn, one type a day, and the ten-day limit will be almost up."
"Alright then."
After resting for half an hour, Xu Xiangwen used his Heavenly Eye to scope out the area and found that most of the Flaming Leopards were concentrated on a gentle slope.
There’s nothing wrong with using old tricks if they’re effective. Given the pitiful intelligence of the Flaming Leopards, they weren’t the kind to learn from their mistakes. After being harassed by Wang Lan and the others for a short time, thirty Flaming Leopards unleashed a roar indicative of the beast clan’s indomitable spirit and charged after Wang Lan and the others in unison.
The collective chase inflamed their blood, numbing their sense of vigilance and fear. They had no idea that the pack of Flaming Leopards behind them was getting further and further away, with many more of their brethren not joining their charge.
With prey ahead and no backup behind.
In that moment, the Flaming Leopards felt invincible, as if all obstacles before them would be annihilated under the force of their charge.
That is, except for... powerful Star Martial Skills.
So it was only when Wang Lan and the others scattered in an instant and snow began to whirl around Jiang Xinyu, with countless icicles pouring down like a barrage of bullets, that the Flaming Leopards realized they had fallen into the despicable humans’ trap again.
After a sweeping strike, the Flaming Leopards were frozen, dumbfounded. Before they could recover, a huge shadow suddenly fell at their feet. Looking up, they saw massive hailstones the size of basketballs falling from the sky like meteors.
BOOM, BOOM, BOOM— Those crushed to death on the spot were considered lucky. Many more had their spines broken or legs smashed.
In the spirit of humanitarianism, Wang Lan and the others quickly went forward to relieve them from their suffering with swift blade strikes. Compassion for the world, infinite merit, amen.
"Something’s not right... The Flaming Leopards are charging in unison," Xu Xiangwen, with his Heavenly Eye open, shouted harshly.
"Towards us?"
"Yes, led by the Leopard King."
"Retreat!" Jiang Xinyu shouted, making a split-second decision.
"But there are still a few that haven’t dropped Soul Beads..." Wang Youle called out reluctantly.
"We can afford to lose those, move it!"
Quite a few, really... such a pity to leave them... but...
Seeing his teammates turning to leave, Wang Youle gritted his teeth and quickly followed. The valley walls on either side retreated swiftly as the roaring of Flaming Leopards echoed behind them.
"Have they caught up?"
"No, but they’re blocking the mouth of the valley. Our exit at the back is essentially sealed. It looks like we’ll have to go back the way we came to Wind Valley. Gale Wolves aren’t as foolish as Flaming Leopards. It’s possible..."
Suddenly, Xu Xiangwen’s words ceased, and Jiang Xinyu and the others stopped in their tracks in an instant.
A huge Flaming Leopard, as big as a warhorse, suddenly appeared in everyone’s field of vision, only about a dozen meters away.
A pair of blood-red eyes stared coldly at the group of five, and from its slightly parted mouth, saliva dripped continuously.
"He looks hungry..." Xu Xiangwen asked somewhat nervously.
"Now all I want to ask is how you scouted. How could you not notice it when it’s so close? Didn’t you say that the Leopard King was behind us? Then what is this thing?"
"I was too focused on watching behind us and didn’t pay attention to the front. Also, the Leopard King is indeed behind us, still with the Flaming Leopards at the valley entrance roaring... This one... perhaps... it’s from a different tribe, here for a family visit?"
"Stop joking around. This Leopard King is the one that fought with the Spider King before, and those injuries were left by the Spider King," Jiang Xinyu said coldly.
"So you mean the Leopard King behind us is the new king, who took advantage of the old Leopard King’s injury to stage a coup and exile him? The Old Leopard King has been lingering nearby, licking his wounds, and now, hungry, he’s come out to hunt and happens upon a five-course human buffet delivered to his doorstep?"
"Lanzi, you still have the mood for jokes at a time like this?" Gong Feiyu looked at Wang Lan speechlessly.
"He’s injured, and his strength hasn’t fully recovered," Wang Lan said gravely.
"Although there’s a certain gap between the peak of Star Cloud and the early stage of Star Cloud, this gap is not insurmountable," Jiang Xinyu slowly extended a finger. "Let’s take him down!"

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Brilliant, truly brilliant
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28: Brilliant, truly brilliant
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Perhaps Jiang Xinyu’s gesture was an insult to the Leopard King’s dignity, and in an instant, the Leopard King roared, charging toward Wang Lan and his team.
On either side were towering cliffs that reached into the clouds. The path was at most ten meters wide, a true narrow passage. The Leopard King’s charge was like a high-speed train barreling down, and the confined space left Wang Lan and the others with no room to dodge.
Gong Feiyu quickly activated an Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill, erecting an earthen wall in front of the Flaming Leopard.
BOOM—
The Leopard King’s momentum remained unaltered. It rammed into the earthen wall, which shattered instantly. The Flaming Leopard, enveloped in flames, broke through the wall and opened its huge mouth to spray out a giant fireball.
The fireball instantly engulfed the entire canyon, filling the space between the cliffs, and surged toward Wang Lan and his party with terrifying speed. Wang Youle, standing at the very back, turned pale with fear.
To make a comparison, the Leopard King’s fireball was like a bonfire, while Wang Youle’s was, at best, a matchstick. If any other Star Shine Stage team faced this situation, they would undoubtedly be wiped out.
In an instant, Jiang Xinyu’s figure flashed to the front of the group, her Star Power surging as she brought her palms together before her.
"Extreme Wall of Water—"
A column of water sprayed from Jiang Xinyu’s mouth. As it funneled through the Star Martial Array in front of her, it gushed out like a river, colliding violently with the incoming fireball.
BOOM— A thick cloud of smoke arose, and the silent gorge transformed into a sauna. Dense steam obscured their vision; suddenly, it was impossible to see a thing within the gorge.
Seizing this opportunity, Wang Lan rushed toward the Flaming Leopard. Neither Wang Lan nor the Flaming Leopard could see, but in this long, narrow gorge, only about ten meters wide, one merely needed to know the approximate distance, not see clearly.
For a beast, locking onto prey and then killing it is a sequence. If it couldn’t lock onto its prey, a beast would rather let the prey escape than attack.
Thirty meters, for Wang Lan, was a distance covered in only two or three seconds.
By the time Wang Lan lunged at the Flaming Leopard and it registered his presence, his punch was already hurtling toward the Flaming Leopard’s jaw.
"Inch Strength—"
Had its vision been clear, the Flaming Leopard might have nimbly dodged Wang Lan’s attack. However, it spotted him too late; before it could react after locking onto him, Wang Lan’s punch had already landed.
BOOM—
A ripple, visible to the naked eye, spread from Wang Lan’s fist, and a terrifying force exploded on the Leopard King’s jaw. At that moment, the Leopard King’s eyes bulged, almost popping from their sockets, bloodshot veins spreading throughout.
Its body flew high into the air, shooting up towards the sky almost vertically.
SWISH, a blade’s gleam appeared in Wang Lan’s hand. Taking advantage of the moment the Leopard King arched its body, he thrust his battle blade fiercely toward its abdomen.
THUD—
With a muffled sound, the Leopard King’s body bent sharply like a shrimp. The blade had failed to pierce the Flaming Leopard’s soft belly. Wang Lan’s strength was already more than double that of an ordinary person. Coupled with the sharpness of his battle blade, he was confident he could pierce a three-millimeter-thick steel plate. Yet, this strike couldn’t even penetrate the Flaming Leopard’s skin.
Its soft fur is even tougher than a Snow Spider’s stacked armor?
All the Snow Spiders that had died by Wang Lan’s hand would likely be turning in their graves.
In that instant, the Leopard King also reacted, snapping its jaws toward Wang Lan’s shoulder. Wang Lan hurriedly raised his battle blade to block the Leopard King’s sharp teeth.
CRACK— The Leopard King bit Wang Lan’s battle blade in half as if it were a biscuit, snapping it crisply.
Wang Lan, having narrowly escaped, quickly retreated. Suddenly, the ground beneath his feet cracked open, and two figures, wielding two-handed great swords, struck down at the Flaming Leopard from either side.
THUD! THUD!—
Two muffled, heavy sounds, yet the two-handed great swords also failed to inflict significant damage on the Leopard King. After the impacts, the Leopard King rolled backward, retreating more than ten meters before shaking its head and staggering to its feet again.
"Logically, our coordinated strike should have killed it," Xu Xiangwen said. "But who could have anticipated its defense would be so terrifying? It’s on a completely different level than an ordinary Flaming Leopard."
"Besides their fire attribute, Flaming Leopards also possess a hardening ability. The Leopard King can harden its entire body... I underestimated its strength. We’re helpless against its hardening ability. The most we can likely do is retreat unharmed; killing it is unlikely," Jiang Xinyu added calmly, stepping up.
While the disparity in levels isn’t absolute, in ninety-nine percent of cases, such a gap renders one powerless. To kill an opponent of a higher level, too many conditions must be met. Just like the coordinated strike moments ago, the Leopard King nullified Wang Lan’s and Xu Xiangwen’s attacks merely by using its full-body hardening.
"But clearly, the Leopard King doesn’t think so," Wang Lan said coldly, staring at the beast before him.
The Leopard King stood up again, its expression even more twisted and ferocious. Droplets of saliva dripped from its bared fangs, and flames surged violently around its body.
The flames on a Flaming Leopard indicated its state; the more furiously they burned, the more enraged and aggressive it was.
ROAR— Suddenly, flames erupted beneath the Leopard King’s feet, and in an instant, its body transformed into a streak of light. Flame Acceleration—this was another of the Leopard King’s Talented Skills.
Although Flame Acceleration only lasted for about thirty seconds, under its effect, the Flaming Leopard’s speed could exceed five hundred yards per second. At such a velocity, no prey could escape its pursuit.
The moment flames shot out from beneath the Flaming Leopard’s feet, Wang Lan and the others leaped high into the air. Confronting the Flaming Leopard head-on during its full-speed charge was suicidal. While using Flame Acceleration, the Leopard King would also employ its full-body hardening. Being struck by an object moving at five hundred yards per second would send even a tank flying.
Almost the instant Wang Lan jumped, a burst of flame shot past from beneath their feet, heading behind them. The five of them clung tightly to the cliff face. They had just managed to look back when Xu Xiangwen saw the Leopard King completing another charge.
This time, the Leopard King was actually scaling the vertical cliff face, heading straight for Xu Xiangwen.
"Damn it, it’s cheating!"
It was indeed cheating. A leopard, running up a sheer cliff as if on flat ground, completely defying gravity. It was enough to rewrite Xu Xiangwen’s understanding of middle school physics.Follow current novᴇls on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
With no time to hesitate, Xu Xiangwen leaped down from the cliff. The Flaming Leopard, a fiery blur, brushed past where Xu Xiangwen had been a moment before, nearly touching him.
"Xinyu, do you have a plan?" Wang Lan shouted, panicked. The Leopard King had unleashed its ultimate move, one that could instantly kill anyone in its path. Wang Lan’s Phoenix Form was still on cooldown; Jiang Xinyu was their only hope.
But Jiang Xinyu’s brow was furrowed. "I don’t have any lockdown skills. Even with powerful Star Martial Skills, I wouldn’t be able to hit it. But..."
Suddenly, Jiang Xinyu stopped mid-sentence and leaped down from the cliff.
Everyone was momentarily stunned, not understanding her intentions. After landing back in the canyon, Jiang Xinyu’s body shimmered with Star Power. A rapidly spinning cone of Speedy Wind appeared on her arm, solidifying into an extremely dense green spear.
"Xinyu, are you insane? Fire overpowers wind! Your Spear of Wind will melt when it gets near the Leopard King’s flames!"
Jiang Xinyu heard Wang Lan’s outcry, but her expression remained resolute. As the team’s only Star Cloud Stage warrior and its captain, she was acutely aware that the fire attribute countered the wind attribute. But what else could she do?
Her strongest offensive Star Martial Skill was wind-attributed, and it possessed the greatest single-target killing potential. Ice-attribute Star Martial Skills were indeed powerful, but she hadn’t had the chance to learn them before breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage.
So, despite knowing that wind was suppressed by fire, she had no choice but to grit her teeth and face it head-on.
At least, if she took action, there was a slim chance of survival. For anyone else, it would be certain death.
Meanwhile, the Leopard King had turned, its blood-red eyes locked onto Jiang Xinyu. Flames erupted beneath its feet once more, and in an instant, it shot toward Jiang Xinyu like a streak of light.
"Feiyu, make a runway for the Leopard King!" Wang Lan suddenly had a stroke of inspiration and shouted urgently.
"Got it—"
Speed, beyond a certain point, becomes uncontrollable, whether by others or by oneself.
Under Flame Acceleration, the Leopard King could only charge forward, following its inertia. The only way to stop was to deactivate Flame Acceleration and then slow down to a controllable speed.
So, if a track was provided, the Leopard King would follow it. It was like playing with slot cars; even if the car had no steering, as long as there was a track, it could race along complex routes at high speed.
As the Leopard King began its charge, a raised layer of earth instantly appeared on the straight path before it. The layer didn’t need to be very thick; at such high speed, the Flaming Leopard’s feet exerted minimal force on the ground, its body almost floating.
WHOOSH— The Flaming Leopard shot up the suddenly formed ramp and sped along it, straight into the sky. By the time the Leopard King realized its intended target had vanished, it was already airborne.
Jiang Xinyu, who had braced herself for a desperate fight, stared in bewilderment at the collapsing earthen ramp before her, then looked up at the Flaming Leopard now soaring freely through the air.
"Whose idea was that?"
"Only Wang Lan could come up with such a devious plan," Gong Feiyu said, jumping down from the cliff and clapping his hands. "What seemed like an unbeatable killing move was just a matter of not finding the right approach. If you find it, it’s actually quite easy to handle."
Providing a runway for the Flame Acceleration skill was a stroke of genius.
Once the method was revealed, anyone could understand its principle, yet no one had thought of it before. People died at the hands of the Leopard King every year, and its Flame Acceleration skill was spoken of by Star Martial Warriors at the trial grounds as a nightmare, yet no one had found a way to counter it.
Wang Lan felt a surge of gratitude.
QQ Speed really is a great game.
ROAR—
Having crashed down from the sky in a disoriented heap, the Flaming Leopard let out an enraged roar. It couldn’t understand how it had suddenly been launched into the air. Perhaps it would conclude it had awakened a flying ability, but it would never guess its Flame Acceleration had been so effortlessly thwarted.
The flames beneath its feet burned with scorching intensity. Once again, the Flaming Leopard transformed into a beam of light, charging towards Wang Lan and his comrades, who were now grouped together.
This time, I will shatter you all—
the Leopard King thought, its eyes burning red with fury.
Gong Feiyu took a step forward but was stopped by Jiang Xinyu’s outstretched hand. "My turn!"
As her words fell, an ice bridge suddenly materialized in front of the Leopard King. It morphed into a spiraling, roller-coaster-like track, one end connecting to the side of a greenish cliff face.
Witnessing this, Wang Lan gave Jiang Xinyu an impressed thumbs-up. "Brilliant! Absolutely brilliant!"

chapters.title: Chapter 29: The Charm of That Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29: The Charm of That Sword
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The roller coaster Jiang Xinyu built from solid ice was the most terrifying Wang Lan had ever seen. Even a ’devil’s roller coaster’ couldn’t compare to this level of thrill; a normal person would go up lively and spirited but come down scared out of their wits.
The Leopard King could never have imagined that its previous aerial launch was the doing of these detestable humans. Although an underlying unease pricked at its heart, it still had absolute confidence in its ultimate move.
Once more, the Leopard King transformed into a streak of light, charging towards Jiang Xinyu and the others. At that precise instant, a crystal-clear ice track suddenly materialized before it.
The ice surface was as smooth as a mirror, with protective guide wings installed on both sides. In short, it was designed to ensure that once the Leopard King charged onto the track, it would safely complete the entire course before being swiftly sent on its way.
The Leopard King’s expression was savage; in its eyes, the five abominable humans before it seemed destined to be torn to shreds in the next second. But WHOOSH, the scene before its eyes changed.
The humans were gone. All it could see was crystal-clear ice, like something from the Immortal Realm.
The Leopard King hurriedly cut off its Flame Acceleration skill. It was moving at five hundred meters, and combined with the mirror-smooth ice bridge, even with its acceleration halted, the terrifying inertia carried it forward. Without slowing one bit, it was whipped around seven or eight large loops, soaring to a peak and then plummeting rapidly.
Within about five seconds, the Leopard King entered the final sprint section of the track.
The Leopard King tried to steady its somewhat dizzy head. The strong centrifugal force had caused some internal imbalance, and its vision had started to black out.
Suddenly, the Leopard King shuddered. The greenish-brown cliff face was rushing towards it at an alarming rate, its fierce expression distorting and twisting.
It’s going to crash! Stop! Stop! Stop...
These were the Leopard King’s thoughts, but what erupted from its maw was a howl like that of a cat in heat.
"AWOOO—AOW... AOW AOW AOW!"
BOOM—
The sight made Wang Lan and the others wince. Smashing face-first into a cliff must have hurt... a lot.
This violent collision drove the Leopard King’s entire head into the cliff, embedding it almost up to its neck in the rock.
Seizing such a heaven-sent opportunity, Jiang Xinyu wasn’t about to let it slip. She instantly activated her Star Martial Skill. A burst of Extreme Cold Aura swiftly followed, striking the Leopard King’s neck. Frost appeared in a blink, instantly freezing half of the Leopard King’s body to the cliff face.
Only its tail, stiff as a steel whip, remained, thrashing violently behind it as if powered by a motor.
Wang Lan, Two-handed Great Sword in hand, suddenly charged forward. Xu Xiangwen quickly followed suit.
Xu Xiangwen was still considering how to kill the Leopard King. Although it had crashed into the cliff and its body was frozen by Jiang Xinyu, its Steel Hardening skill surely hadn’t been disabled.
With its entire body hardened, my two-handed sword will have a hard time breaking through its defense... Should I use the Speedy Wind Slash? I haven’t fully mastered that move yet. Using it could likely result in multiple fractures all over my body... What should I do?
But in Wang Lan’s eyes, only one target remained—the small, pink bull’s-eye located at the base of the Leopard King’s tail.
Thus, Wang Lan was the first to dash behind the Flaming Leopard King. He raised his palm-wide, one-and-a-half-meter-long Two-handed Great Sword and thrust it viciously into the target.
The sword met hardly any resistance. It skewered the flesh as easily as a skewer through meat, penetrating right to the hilt.
The atmosphere suddenly went quiet, save for the whistling cold wind in the canyon and a sharp, indrawn hiss, like the sound that sets one’s teeth on edge.
CLANG— Xu Xiangwen’s two-handed sword fell to the ground, his eyes wide like two split salted duck eggs.
"Fuck..."
ROAR—The most update n0vels are published on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
A piercing roar exploded from the cliff wall after half a second of suppression.
BOOM— Suddenly, the ice encasing the Leopard King shattered. A mass of fire, as hot as molten lava, splattered out from the cliffside. Wang Lan’s hands trembled, and he forcefully wrenched his sword to the side.
CRACK— The handle of the Two-handed Great Sword actually snapped right off.
Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu retreated explosively. After delivering the final attack of its life, the Leopard King collapsed, convulsed twice, and died.
A message chimed in Wang Lan’s mind:
Defeated an opponent of a higher level. Reward: one hundred experience points and ten skill points.
Hearing the prompt, a happy smile appeared on Wang Lan’s face. Yet, in Xu Xiangwen’s eyes, this smile looked particularly sinister. Recalling how the Leopard King had died, Xu Xiangwen shivered and took a step back.
"What’s wrong with you guys?" Wang Lan exited the system interface and looked up at them. The strange looks in their eyes made him wonder if they had a problem with him.
"Nothing... nothing..." Xu Xiangwen stammered. "Wang Lan, I never realized you had such a... twisted sense of humor."
Wang Lan was speechless.
"Was there a better way to handle that situation?" he asked.
"I know there wasn’t," Xu Xiangwen admitted, looking at Wang Lan with admiration, his feelings inexplicably mixed. "But most people would never have thought of that."
"The Leopard King’s final burst was truly frightening. To think it blew such a big hole in the mountain!" Wang Youle exclaimed in amazement, looking at the blasted-out, sooty black cave in the cliffside.
"Are you stupid? Obviously, the inside of the mountain wall was already empty," Gong Feiyu said, coming to stand beside Wang Youle and sighing softly as he looked at the cave entrance.
"Not good!" Xu Xiangwen exclaimed, a bit panicked after activating his Heavenly Eye. "The noise from the fight has lured in Flaming Leopards. Also, Gale Wolves have detected the commotion and are now lingering at the canyon exit. If we try to leave now, we’ll definitely run into them!"
Wang Lan asked, "What’s the situation inside the cave? Is it dangerous?"
Xu Xiangwen quickly scanned the cave with his Heavenly Eye. "There’s a huge internal space, and I haven’t detected any immediate danger. I’m just not sure if there’s air circulation inside."
"If there’s no danger, let’s hide inside the cave first," Jiang Xinyu decisively ordered.
With a WHOOSH, everyone filed into the cave. The interior was a very large space, but it was so dark they couldn’t see their hands in front of their faces. Wang Lan and the others hurriedly took out glow sticks. Once activated, these cast a light as bright as torches.
After walking forward for nearly a hundred meters, the group stopped.
Suddenly, Jiang Xinyu turned around and looked at Wang Youle. Being stared at by Jiang Xinyu like that, Wang Youle’s expression became somewhat unnatural.
"Jiang Xinyu..." Wang Youle began, his expression a little strained. "Is there... something wrong?"
"The Soul Bead of the Leopard King doesn’t belong to you," Jiang Xinyu said, her voice calm yet piercing Wang Youle’s heart like an arrow.
His face changed slightly, and then he forced a smile. "Of course, I understand. I didn’t help much; I only collected it because I saw you all had forgotten to pick it up."
Saying this, he took the Soul Bead from his backpack. "Here!"
"Give it to Wang Lan. He killed the Flaming Leopard King, and it was his plan," she instructed.
"Wang Lan!" Wang Youle’s heart was bleeding inwardly, but he forced a sycophantic smile. It was so strained that even a fool could see how difficult it was for him to feign it.
Wang Lan took the Soul Bead but didn’t absorb it immediately. While this particular Soul Bead was only worth one skill point, it contained pure Star Power. It would be too wasteful to absorb such a high-quality Soul Bead directly for just that.
Wang Lan pocketed the Soul Bead without any guilt. After all, he had almost single-handedly killed the Leopard King, so no one could object to him taking it.
"Eh? I think I’ve discovered something incredible!" Xu Xiangwen suddenly exclaimed.
"What is it?" Wang Lan asked.
"Electric wires! There are actually electric wires here!" Xu Xiangwen cried. "This cave isn’t natural—or rather, it’s natural but has been modified by humans. Could it be a secret military base?"
"If there are electric wires, there should be power. Let’s look around," Jiang Xinyu suggested.
Holding a glow stick, Xu Xiangwen felt his way deeper into the cave. After about three hundred more meters, SNAP!
With a crisp sound, the passage before them suddenly lit up. Wang Lan and the others then realized that beyond this vast natural cave lay another, man-made corridor.
"Could it really be a military base?" Gong Feiyu asked, astonished.
Building a base within a Different Dimensional Space is extremely challenging, as many physical rules differ from the outside world. For instance, simple things like generating and using electrical energy would require research and development practically from scratch within a Different Dimensional Space.
"It shouldn’t be," Jiang Xinyu said. Her Jiang Technology Group cooperated closely with military enterprises, so she had some understanding of military bases. "If it were a military base, there would be clear military insignia. To an outsider, there might seem to be no difference, but to an expert, the distinctions are significant."
"It looks like this base has been abandoned," Wang Lan mused. "How about we go in and take a look? If it’s not a military base, then this is a serious problem. Building a secret base inside the training grounds... who knows what they were plotting?" For some reason, Wang Lan suddenly thought of the Demon Clan.
The Demon Clan dared to target the parents of students from the Multi-wheel Bilingual Academy; there’s no guarantee they aren’t stirring up trouble in other ways too.
The group entered the corridor, which led them into an area resembling an experimental factory. Rows of objects looking like incubation chambers were densely arranged within it.
"These seem like... a biotech processing plant," Wang Lan spoke gravely, looking at the equipment. "Many of the machines are identical to those used by my aunt’s biotech company."
"AHH—"
A scream suddenly pierced the air. Everyone turned to see Wang Youle sitting on the ground, scared out of his wits.
"What are you doing?" Gong Feiyu snapped. "Suddenly screaming like that could scare someone to death!"
"N-no... M-monsters! These incubation chambers... they’re full of monsters!" Wang Youle stammered, his face pale and trembling.
"Monsters?" Wang Lan strode forward. When he saw the creatures inside through the transparent covers, his face immediately darkened.
The creatures looked similar to the Demon Soldiers he had seen but were larger, with more extensive carapace coverage on their bodies. Judging by their thick limbs, they also seemed stronger.
Jiang Xinyu and the others checked the other incubation chambers, and their expressions grew grim.
"This is a Demon Clan base?" Jiang Xinyu murmured, her expression grim. "Are they secretly breeding Demon Clan warriors here?"
"Most likely," Wang Lan declared, his face solemn. "Let’s go. We need to inform the training ground garrison immediately."
"Wait a moment," Xu Xiangwen suggested. "Since this base has already been sealed, the Demon Clan must have evacuated. Let’s explore further; we might find something else. If we can uncover the Demon Clan’s plans, we’ll have made a great contribution."
Wang Lan’s point was valid, but Xu Xiangwen also had a good argument. Achievements were particularly important for students like them. Having such a discovery on their records could give them preferential consideration during recruitment by the Star Martial Academy.
They soon found another room that appeared to be a laboratory area. Inside, they discovered a huge computer that had been running for who knows how long.
When they turned on its monitor, a password prompt appeared.
"Don’t touch it!" Jiang Xinyu’s voice suddenly rang out, just as Wang Lan was about to fiddle with the computer. "That’s a trigger-activated password. If you enter even one wrong digit, the computer will immediately self-destruct."

chapters.title: Chapter 30 Demon Clan Base
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30 Demon Clan Base
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"I know," Wang Lan said solemnly.
This encryption method was considered very clever and secure by the general public, but for Wang Lan, one of Sky Blue Star’s top hackers, breaking this type of encryption was no problem.
However, there’s a saying: even the cleverest housewife can’t cook without rice.
Even though Wang Lan knew that with the right tools, she could break the password in minutes, all she could do was sigh.
"If only I had brought my Xiao Ai. This kind of password would only take Xiao Ai three minutes."
"You can crack passwords?" Xu Xiangwen asked Wang Lan in surprise.
"With the right tools, yes. Without them, no. It seems we’ll have to notify the garrison and ask them to send an expert to crack it."
"There’s no need for such trouble," Jiang Xinyu said indifferently as she pushed Wang Lan aside. She took out a necklace from her bosom, pulled it, and a USB plug popped out from its center.
Jiang Xinyu expertly inserted the plug into the computer’s port. Instantly, a dialogue box popped up on the computer screen.
"Master, Ice Snow at your service."
"Break this computer’s access for me," Jiang Xinyu quickly typed in the command.
"Okay, please wait..."
Witnessing this, Wang Lan let out an exclamation, "So it was you..."
But under Jiang Xinyu’s warning gaze, Wang Lan chose to keep her mouth shut.
Wang Lan usually had good self-control and didn’t show excessive emotion in general situations. Even the last time she faced danger in the secret place and realized it was the work of the Demon Clan, her emotions hadn’t fluctuated much.
But at this moment, Wang Lan’s blood pressure soared
So it was you... it really was you! I’ve finally caught the culprit in person.
The history between Wang Lan and Ice Snow went back to the third grade. Half a year after Wang Ling disappeared, an artificial intelligence program suddenly appeared on Wang Lan’s computer.
At that time, Wang Lan was shirtless, playing a game to relax, when Ice Snow popped up from the bottom right corner. The first thing it said was, "Oh, I finally got in."
The second thing was, "Could you put on some clothes?"
The program didn’t interfere with Wang Lan, but it watched her every move like a ghost. When Wang Lan was doing homework and managed to solve a Demon King-level difficult problem, Ice Snow would suddenly control her computer’s speakers to ask, "How did you think of this solution?"
The study room would be silent, with only Wang Lan working hard on problems, when suddenly a ghost-like voice would appear. If Wang Lan’s heart hadn’t been strong enough, it probably would have scared her into quitting.
While practicing Star Martial Skills, drenched in sweat, Ice Snow would occasionally pop up with a piece of advice. Although Ice Snow never caused trouble for Wang Lan, being constantly monitored by an unknown entity was unbearable for anyone.
After that, Wang Lan started to teach herself programming and everything about computers. It took her three years to independently develop the intelligent lifeform Xiao Ai and finally remove Ice Snow from her home.
During those three years, Wang Lan was under Ice Snow’s domination. Sometimes, even when sleeping, she felt as if, in the dark night, a pair of eyes were coldly watching her.
Although her private room had no cameras or other surveillance, which prevented her from being photographed naked, she had been dominated by Ice Snow for so many years. Even Xiao Ai hadn’t been able to track down Ice Snow’s whereabouts or origins.
Wang Lan had thought that since she had eliminated it, she might as well let bygones be bygones. However, she hadn’t expected to discover the culprit under these circumstances. And she could hardly believe that Jiang Xinyu was the one responsible!
After learning her mother’s identity, Wang Lan had even suspected for a time that military personnel were monitoring her.
"The hacking is complete. Ice Snow has acquired the highest authority," the familiar electronic voice suddenly came through the speakers, stirring Wang Lan’s memories once again.
Jiang Xinyu, as if nothing had happened, swiftly worked on the computer. If not for her slightly red ears, one might really believe she felt no embarrassment at being caught.
Wang Lan gnashed her teeth.
You little witch, I’ll remember this. When we get out, we’ll settle this properly!
"The computer has been cleaned, but Ice Snow found some deleted data and is restoring it," Jiang Xinyu said lightly after working for a while.
"Restoration complete. Experimental data folder found... Would you like to open and play?"
"Open and play!"
Suddenly, a large retractable screen descended in the center of the lab, and soon, the screen lit up.
"The fifth-generation gene warrior experiment record begins!" a deep voice resounded. Along with the voice, a fully enclosed metal cage appeared on the screen.
In the metal cage, bound to one wall, was a Demon with arms like Mantis Blades. Its appearance was very similar to the creatures in the cultivation tanks outside. Its carapace, resembling the armor of ancient warriors, was sensibly distributed over its body, with sharp, blade-like spurs protruding from all its joints.
"What are you going to do? What are you doing? Let me go! Let me go!" Amidst frantic shouts, a cage slowly descended from above the secret room. Inside was a human Star Martial Warrior, who, judging by his clothes, appeared to be one of the Trialists who had entered the trial ground.
"Li Gang, male, twenty-nine years old, peak Star Shine Stage, skilled in war blade combat. Comprehensive combat evaluation: Professional Grade A-."
When someone appeared, the humanoid Demon Clan warrior suddenly fixed its blood-red eyes on the person in the cage. Its Mantis Blades whirled aggressively; if not for its body being restrained by steel straps, it might have immediately charged at Li Gang to tear him to shreds.
"Li Gang, your current mission is to kill the Biochemical Demon Soldier before you. Of course, you can also choose not to resist and be eaten by the Demon Soldier," the voice rang out.
Suddenly, the cage imprisoning Li Gang opened, and two war blades were thrown at his feet.
"You may begin now."
"Who are you? Bastards! How dare you conduct human experiments!"
"The Biochemical Demon Soldier will be released in five seconds."
The moment the voice faded, Li Gang suddenly grabbed the war blades at his feet and instantly charged toward the restrained Biochemical Demon Soldier. Just as Li Gang launched his attack, the restraints on the Mythical Demon Soldier abruptly released.
"ROAR—"
In the blink of an eye, Li Gang was locked in combat with the Demon Soldier. Li Gang’s close-combat skills were incredibly solid.
Even Wang Lan had to admit that in a face-to-face confrontation, Li Gang could kill her in less than five minutes.
But in the experimental records, Li Gang’s strength was not on the same level as the Mythical Demon Soldier’s. Li Gang’s blade couldn’t penetrate the Demon Soldier’s defenses, and his Star Martial Skills were easily dodged. However, each of the Demon Soldier’s attacks made Li Gang dance on the edge of life and death.
In less than a minute, the Demon Soldier’s Mantis Blade struck bizarrely, instantly gripping Li Gang’s shoulder and pulling him close. The Demon Soldier opened its gaping maw, and with a CRUNCH—
Jiang Xinyu and the others hurriedly turned their heads away; the scene was too bloody and brutal.
Xu Xiangwen clicked his watch and quickly found Li Gang’s information. "Li Gang, entered the primary trial field for trials in 5015. Went missing in the Snow Spider Zone three days later. Presumed dead."
"It seems now that Li Gang was captured by the Demon Clan for experiments."
In the footage, Li Gang was quickly devoured by the Biochemical Demon Soldier. Then, the Demon Soldier suddenly went berserk, violently attacking the alloy walls of the chamber. The video cut off there.
But immediately after, that neutral voice came from the video again, "The seventieth experiment of the fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers begins."
This time, the sealed space contained three restrained Biochemical Demon Soldiers. These Demon Soldiers appeared extremely agitated, their bodies twisting at an even higher frequency.
Similarly, a cage was lowered from above, but this time, it held five Star Martial Warriors.
"The purpose of this experiment is team combat."
Xu Xiangwen quickly found information on this squad too; it was a Pioneer Star Martial squad that had gone missing at the end of the year, three years prior. They had planned to improve their skills in the trial field before the new year, but the entire squad met their end here instead.
The fight began quickly. When the experimenters released the three Biochemical Demon Soldiers, they didn’t immediately attack the Star Martial squad. Instead, they suddenly started killing each other. The Star Martial squad stood aside and watched coldly.
After two Demon Soldiers were killed and the remaining one was riddled with wounds, the Star Martial squad swarmed and killed the injured Biochemical Demon Soldier. But even after claiming victory, the Star Martial squad wasn’t granted the rights of victors; they were soon knocked unconscious by a toxic gas, and then the screen went blank.
"Biochemical weapons have a serious flaw: they lack rational thought, instinctively attacking individuals who seem most threatening. In the eyes of the Biochemical Demon Soldiers, there is no difference between enemy and kin. Apart from themselves, all others are enemies."
"Although the strength of the Demon Soldiers meets the Empire’s requirements, such flawed Demon Soldiers cannot be deployed on the battlefield. Doctor, you must overcome this problem."
"Of course, I already have a general direction. The current ecological situation of the Demon Soldiers is very similar to that of the Snow Spiders. Snow Spiders also don’t differentiate between friend and foe and will even devour each other. However, Snow Spiders are able to coexist peacefully and can unite to fight like a legion. My idea is to introduce Snow Spider genes into the Biochemical Demon Soldiers and to create a Spider King-type commanding Biochemical Demon Soldier."
"That’s a possibility, but how do we control the Biochemical Demon Soldiers? Even if the commanding type is still a Biochemical Demon Soldier, how do we ensure it obeys our orders and issues commands accordingly?"
"That requires my research..."
Again, the video ended, but the player quickly began playing a new experimental video.
"After a year of breakthroughs, we have finally found a way to control Biochemical Demon Soldiers. Now, we will proceed with the one hundred and thirtieth trial of the Biochemical Demon Soldiers."
The screen lit up, still showing the fully enclosed surveillance room. But this time, the Biochemical Demon Soldiers inside were not restrained; they were all standing quietly together.
"Issue the command!"
What had been a solemn scene suddenly turned ridiculous before Wang Lan and the others. The lineup of more than a dozen Demon Soldiers quickly formed ranks and then danced in unison.
Accompanied by music, a group of Biochemical Demon Soldiers performed a sensual dance. If this were to spread to Bilibili, it would definitely cause a bloodbath, and Bilibili’s "virus library" would gain a new "source of all evil."
But despite the farcical imagery, Wang Lan and the others couldn’t laugh.
It meant that the Demon Clan had overcome the flaw in the Biochemical Demon Soldiers. They possessed powerful individual combat abilities and strong obedience, and such Biochemical Demon Soldiers could be mass-produced continuously.
If war were to break out, this would be a nightmare for human Star Martial Warriors.ŸŸŸ

chapters.title: Chapter 31 A powerful enemy is on our tail
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: 31 A powerful enemy is on our tail
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The screen froze. Soon after, new footage began to play.
This time, the setting wasn’t a cramped, enclosed space, but the immense cavern that Wang Lan and the others had entered before.
At the bottom of the cavern, hundreds of Biochemical Demons densely packed the area, while above them on the Sky Bridge, stood a human-looking figure. Next to this person was a wheelchair, upon which sat a man with withered, twisted limbs and a gaunt physique, wearing glasses.
"Doctor, shall we start the live-fire test now?"
"Only by passing through the crucible of war and enduring its trials can one become a qualified warrior."
"But... controlling five hundred Demon Soldiers at once..." the middle-aged man behind him voiced his concern.
"A qualified Demon General must control at least ten thousand Demon Soldiers. A mere five hundred is a very small number," the doctor said as he slowly extended a hand, swiftly pressing buttons on the console before him.
The heavy doors opened, revealing a colossal figure before Wang Lan and his group.
It was a monstrous creature with the lower body of a spider and the torso of a gigantic Demon Soldier. Its eight sharp spider legs resembled eight menacing Mantis Blades. Its upper body, though humanoid, was twice the size of a normal Demon Soldier.
Its appearance alone sent a clear message: it was not to be trifled with.
Upon the Demon General’s appearance, the Demon Soldiers suddenly knelt in unison. Their movements were orderly and disciplined, like well-trained elite troops.
"What are they preparing to do? Launch an attack on the trial site’s military garrison? But... there have been no reports of attacks on the trial site for three years, right?"
"Maybe the military suppressed the news?"
"Move out! Annihilate the Star Martial Army!"
"ROAR—"
"WHOOP! WHOOP! WHOOP!" Suddenly, a red alert began to blare.
"What’s happening?" The Doctor’s face turned pale as he cried out.
"The Demon General’s consciousness is starting to rebel! The controller is struggling to regain control..."
"Mental connection severed. Initiate forced connection?"
"Initiate forced connection. The controller’s mind is being eroded by the Demon General: twenty percent... fifty percent... seventy percent..."
"Quick, seal it—"
ROAR—
A loud roar echoed. Suddenly, the Demon General leaped up, its massive claws striking down fiercely onto the Sky Bridge where the Doctor was. The video clearly showed the Doctor, along with the person pushing his wheelchair, being slashed to pieces by the sharp claws.
This scene was inexplicably shocking, yet also strangely exhilarating.
No one expected the experiment to fail so spectacularly; the apparent main villain of the story met such an early and unexpected end.
The alarm continued to blare. "Biochemical Demon Soldiers are rioting! Combat units, engage and suppress immediately!" Then, BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!—
After that, the video went completely dark.
No more experimental records appeared.
The atmosphere suddenly fell deathly silent; only a few heavy breaths were audible.
"The Demon Clan’s fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers... was it a failure or a success?" After a long while, Xu Xiangwen asked doubtfully.
"I don’t know. The last records are from a year ago. But... with the Doctor leading the Biochemical Demon Soldier project dead, the project likely ground to a halt, didn’t it?"
"Was the Demon Soldiers’ riot successfully suppressed? Did they kill all the Demons at the base?" Wang Youle asked anxiously.
"Don’t ask such stupid questions. If the riot hadn’t been suppressed, do you think this base would still be here? It would have been discovered long ago, right? The riot must have been successfully suppressed. However, the Doctor’s death likely forced the project to halt, which is why the base was sealed and the Demon Clan retreated," Jiang Xinyu analyzed coldly.
"Ice Snow, has the data copy been completed?"
"It finished a long time ago."
"Good!" Jiang Xinyu unplugged the USB drive, transformed it back into a necklace, and put it on. "Let’s go to the Star Martial Army’s command headquarters."
Xu Xiangwen activated his watch to pull up the map. "The military command headquarters is only ten kilometers from here. We can cut through the Wind Valley to reach it."
The group retraced their steps out of the cave. The Flaming Leopards in the valley had retreated, and the Gale Wolves from the opposite gorge entrance had also left.
As they walked on, Wang Youle hesitated several times before finally speaking in a low voice, "Um... there are still four days left in the trial period... Reporting this to the Star Martial Army might lead them to seal off the trial site. Why don’t we collect some Soul Beads for a few days first? Since the Demon Clan sealed the base, they must have already left."
"This discovery is too urgent to ignore. There are still dozens of Biochemical Demon Soldiers lying in the incubation pods, and any single one of them could cause immense casualties among the Trialists. Don’t you understand the gravity of the situation?" Jiang Xinyu rebuked Wang Youle without any courtesy. Perhaps this was her true nature.
Wang Lan scratched his chin in confusion.
Could it be that the reasonable Jiang Xinyu I thought I knew was a facade?
「Not long after Wang Lan’s group departed, two figures appeared in the gorge.」
Upon seeing the huge crater blasted into the middle of the gorge, their faces turned ashen.
"Damn it, how could we not have realized this spot was so thin... We’ve been discovered."
"They haven’t been gone long. I’ll go alert the leader; you go kill them."
"Okay!"
Jiang Xinyu and her two companions were still engaged in a heated discussion about the Biochemical Demon Soldiers, analyzing from every angle the odds of human Star Martial Warriors winning if they confronted them.
Biochemical Demon Soldiers were ultimate weapons of war, created solely for battle. Those below the Star Shine Stage had no advantage against them.
The conclusion of their discussion was bleak: under equal conditions, human Star Martial Warriors had no advantage whatsoever. Against equal numbers, annihilation would be inevitable. Their only hope was that the project had been permanently shelved due to the doctor’s death. Otherwise, it would be a nightmare for humanity.
Wang Youle silently followed the squad without joining the discussion, like a ghost lingering outside the group. The reason Wang Lan wasn’t participating was that a red ’Task in Progress’ notification had suddenly appeared in his system.
This ’Task in Progress’ notification had appeared before, when the bus entered the Different Dimensional Space. At the time, Wang Lan thought he hadn’t heard the alert sound due to his nerves. But now, it seemed the system didn’t issue any audible alert when accepting tasks.
It seemed to be triggered entirely by Wang Lan’s current situation—whatever predicament he faced could potentially activate a task.
"Hey, Wang Lan, what are you thinking about? You’ve been so glum this whole time," Xu Xiangwen’s voice interrupted Wang Lan’s thoughts.
"Nothing much. Listening to you guys is quite insightful. After hearing what you all said, I feel like the past ten-plus years of my life were lived in vain. You’re all experts; as a newbie, I should just listen quietly."
"Get lost!"
"Men should be more magnanimous..." Jiang Xinyu said to Wang Lan out of nowhere. Then, with a haughty toss of her hair, she turned and continued walking forward.
Heh... If you hadn’t reminded me, I would have almost forgotten. Jiang Xinyu, I didn’t expect you to have such a weird quirk,
Wang Lan thought, though he didn’t dare say it aloud.
Suddenly, the five of them stopped in their tracks. Around the corner of the cliff ahead, a man with purple hair swaggered out. The five hadn’t encountered a single Trialist on their journey. The sudden appearance of this man instantly put them on high alert.
"I thought you’d be much farther by now. You made me waste half an hour," the man said with a laugh, his tone familiar. Instantly, Wang Lan and the others tensed up.
"This is bad! Signal now!" Wang Lan hastily ordered.
While speaking, he took out a signal flare from the side of his backpack. Just as he was about to launch it, a strong sense of crisis surged from below. Wang Lan quickly retreated backward.
A figure burst from the ground, a streak of blade light swept past where Wang Lan had just stood. Just as Wang Lan regained his footing, the figure quickly closed in, slashing at him.
He hastily drew the spare saber Gong Feiyu had given him, holding it horizontally before him to block the attack.
The person before him looked identical to the one slowly approaching in the distance. In the world of Star Martial Warriors, looking exactly alike didn’t necessarily mean they were twins; it was more likely to be a Physical Clone. Xu Xiangwen could create two Physical Clones, but this skill wasn’t a rare ability.
"Attack—" Jiang Xinyu immediately ordered.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
But as the four were about to converge and assist, four figures burst from the purple-haired youth attacking Wang Lan, each intercepting one of them.
The situation flipped in an instant, turning into a five-on-five standoff.
The Physical Clone before Wang Lan continued its relentless assault, its sword skills sharp and swift. Even though his combat prowess far surpassed that of an average Star Shine Stage warrior, Wang Lan was still forced onto the defensive.
Wang Youle, in particular, was wounded in the very first exchange.
Fear appeared in Wang Youle’s eyes. A cruel smile touched the purple-haired youth’s lips as his blade slashed down toward Wang Youle’s head.
"CRACKLE—"
Suddenly, an ice bloom burst from the purple-haired youth’s chest. The descending blade froze just in front of Wang Youle. In an instant, the purple-haired man was covered in frost and turned into an ice sculpture.
"BOOM—"
With a loud blast, the ice sculpture shattered.
But before Jiang Xinyu could catch her breath, the purple-haired man attacked her again.
Jiang Xinyu intended to use the same technique again to deal with the purple-haired man. This time, however, she found that his strength had skyrocketed many times over. She, like Wang Lan, was also drawn into a bitter struggle.
Seeing Wang Youle still in a daze, Wang Lan grew furious. "Wang Youle, are you a damn idiot? Fire the signal flare, quick!—"
"Oh, oh—" Wang Youle fumbled for the signal flare.
The purple-haired man fighting Wang Lan suddenly flickered, and a new clone shot out, instantly appearing before Wang Youle.
Wang Youle quickly raised his blade to defend. CLANG! CLANG! CLANG! The fierce sounds of combat immediately erupted.
Seeing Wang Youle miss the chance to send the signal, Wang Lan’s anger surged. A surge of anger fueled his sharp sword skills. He unleashed them, instantly turning the tables and fighting his opponent on equal footing.
The battle now seemed to hover in a strange balance. Whether it was the strongest, Jiang Xinyu, or the weakest, Wang Youle, each was locked in an intense, evenly matched struggle with their opponent.
But the power differences are so obvious. If they were clones, shouldn’t their strength be evenly divided?
Yet, to Wang Lan, each of the purple-haired man’s clones clearly possessed different levels of strength.
Is the purple-haired man toying with us? Impossible. His killing intent is undoubtedly real; if I reveal any opening, he’ll definitely deliver a fatal blow.
Then why is this happening? Is he displaying different levels of strength tailored to each of us? From my own experience, the clone that first attacked me seemed slightly stronger than this current one.
While his hands were busy with the fierce combat, his mind raced, rapidly analyzing the situation.
After several seconds, a spark of understanding lit up Wang Lan’s eyes.
So that’s how it is. I understand now.

chapters.title: Chapter 32 Weakness is the Original Sin
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32 Weakness is the Original Sin
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Xinyu, Xiangwen, everyone, pay attention. These clones aren’t what we understand them to be. Xiangwen’s clones split his Star Power evenly between two bodies, but their fundamental abilities like strength and speed don’t diminish. However, this person is different. It’s less like he has clones and more like different expressions of the same being. His Star Power, his strength, and his speed are all a constant, fixed quantity. Whether he splits into ten or five, his overall power remains unchanged. He can adjust the strength of each individual clone to counter each of our attacks. But no matter how he allocates his power, his total is only at the Star Cloud stage."
As Wang Lan’s words fell, Jiang Xinyu’s eyes immediately lit up.
As long as they could analyze the enemy’s abilities, they’d have a chance of devising tactics to win.
Xu Xiangwen instantly created two clones and intensified his attack. "Lanzi, nicely done! Hehehe, I thought his clones were like mine, but they’re not! With my two clones now, my power has doubled! Come on if you dare! Hahaha... We are not the same!"
As his laughter subsided, the two Xu Xiangwens instantly began swinging their Two-handed Great Swords, whirring like windmills as they charged the purple-haired man. Left with no choice, the purple-haired man created another clone to go one-on-one with one of Xu Xiangwen’s clones.
But in that instant, Wang Lan and the others clearly sensed that the strength of the purple-haired man facing them had significantly decreased.
"’It’s just as I thought!’" Gong Feiyu exclaimed joyfully.
"I can’t believe you analyzed my ability in just one minute! You brat, you can’t be left alive! Perish!"
Suddenly, the man’s aura surged violently, and Wang Lan hurriedly switched to a defensive stance. The descending blade carried an imposing air, much like a flashy online video clip with brilliant skill effects that ultimately delivered the weakest damage. Before the blow landed, it indeed gave Wang Lan a great scare; his heart leaped into his throat. But when it did land, it felt as if a child had playfully tapped him with a wooden stick.
In an instant, a jolt shot up Wang Lan’s spine as he realized the purple-haired man’s intent. His eyes frantically swept towards Jiang Xinyu and Xu Xiangwen. But as his gaze swept over them, Xu Xiangwen’s blade had already severed his opponent’s head, Jiang Xinyu’s sword had pierced her opponent’s throat, and even Gong Feiyu had kicked his opponent flying.
The enemies facing those three weakened instantly. That means only one thing: the enemy in front of one of us has suddenly become stronger!
In a rush of panic, Wang Lan whirled and flung his combat blade towards the distant clone of the purple-haired man behind him.
"Wang Youle, retreat—!"
SLICE—
A large head soared into the sky.
Wang Lan’s warning came too late. The purple-haired man’s clone facing Wang Youle experienced an instant surge in strength, shattering Wang Youle’s defenses with devastating ease. Then, with a swift stroke, it decapitated him. Bright red blood sprayed through the air like a mist. A look of shock remained frozen on Wang Youle’s face, as if he couldn’t believe he had been killed just like that.
CLANG—
The clone suddenly raised its hand, deflecting Wang Lan’s thrown blade. At that moment, this purple-haired man’s appearance began to shift; the raised arm no longer resembled a human hand but was covered with hard, brown, chitinous plates.
Seeing this, Jiang Xinyu and the others simultaneously gasped.
"Demon Clan!"
"Hehehe... You were able to analyze my ability, but how will you counter my tactics? My clones are a more advanced version than those of you Star Martial Warriors. For example, that boy there—if his clone is killed, he loses half his Star Power. But I never have to worry about my strength being reduced. No matter how many clones I make, I am still me."
Wang Lan immediately pulled out a signal flare, but the Demon was well-prepared. It gave Wang Lan no time to activate the flare, instantly closing in on him. The moment battle erupted near Wang Lan, the fight near Jiang Xinyu and the others reignited.
"Kid, you’re clever. Now, care to guess which of your teammates will die next?"
The Demon’s taunting voice echoed, trying to disturb Wang Lan’s composure.
Wang Lan lunged forward, his fist striking out like lightning.
"Inch Strength Fist—!"
BOOM—
Just as the Demon was about to speak, its eyes bulged, bloodshot, staring at Wang Lan. Wang Lan’s Inch Strength Fist was a more lethal technique than his combat blade.
VMMM—
The figure before him instantly split into another clone, while the one Wang Lan had struck suddenly burst like an overinflated balloon.
"Disappointed, aren’t you? In a way, I possess an Undying Body!" the Demon said proudly, a smile playing on its lips, but its eyes filled with cold, murderous intent. "You care a lot about that girl, don’t you? How about I kill her?"
"That depends on whether you have the ability!" Jiang Xinyu retorted coldly from the side. In an instant, Star Martial Skills of three different attributes erupted one after another, and the battlefield was immediately submerged in ice and snow.
Although Wang Lan wasn’t swayed by the Demon’s words, after Wang Youle’s death, the Demon’s clones had indeed become much stronger. Moreover, they could concentrate their full strength for an attack regardless of distance.
To put it bluntly, this is an almost unsolvable situation.
The Demon can instantly concentrate most of its power into one clone, then gather all its strength into a single strike to kill another one of us. Afterward, with only three of us left to face its clones, their individual strength will increase again.
Just as the Demon said, it can kill off our team one by one. Who will be its next target? Definitely not Jiang Xinyu or me. Between Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu, it’s more likely to be Xu Xiangwen.
Xu Xiangwen’s clones allow him to double his close combat strength; he’s the team’s melee backbone.
Wang Lan knew how unfavorable the current situation was. His mind raced, trying to cope with the enemy’s increasingly strong attacks while desperately searching for a countermeasure.
"Do you remember passionate basketball from junior high?" Wang Lan suddenly shouted.
"Lanzi, this is no time for nostalgia! What we do now is critical! One more attack like that, and we’re done for!" Xu Xiangwen cried out urgently.
"Xiangwen, quiet down! Lanzi wouldn’t bring up basketball for no reason," Gong Feiyu said hastily.
"Soccer isn’t a one-man sport, and neither is basketball! We agreed this was a team fight, so why has it turned into a series of solo duels?"
As Wang Lan’s words registered, Jiang Xinyu’s eyes lit up.
"I get it!"
"I get it too!" Gong Feiyu quickly exclaimed.
"I... I..." Xu Xiangwen stammered.
"Do you understand or not, damn it?!" Wang Lan roared.
"Mostly, I think... But, where’s the ball?"
"What ball, you idiot! What’s that in your hand?"Googlᴇ search novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
"The signal flare?" Xu Xiangwen asked, raising it.
Thinking Xu Xiangwen was about to send a signal, the Demon clone reacted instantly, kicking the signal flare out of his hand. But this momentary disruption in rhythm gave Wang Lan the fleeting opportunity he needed.
Forcing back the Demon clone in front of him with a punch, Wang Lan instantly turned and rushed towards Xu Xiangwen. He paid no mind to the Demon clone pursuing him from behind.
We’re a team, not individuals fighting solo. We lost sight of that because we each had our own opponent. But that was the wrong mindset. A team is a team, whether facing one enemy or many.
I can trust my teammates to cover my back. And they can trust me to handle the dangers they face.
After his signal flare was kicked away, Xu Xiangwen instantly retreated three meters, creating distance.
So, Xu Xiangwen’s earlier dumbfounded look, as if he hadn’t understood, was just an act!
That guy’s only hobby is basketball; how could he not understand what I meant?
Seeing Xu Xiangwen immediately break through the Demon clone’s attempt to block him, Wang Lan felt reassured and instantly threw the signal flare towards him.
Seeing this, the Demon clone’s expression changed drastically. Wielding its war blade, it viciously pursued Xu Xiangwen.
The main reason I’m using these clone tactics is to stop them from sending a signal!
Once the Star Martial Army gets here, they’ll definitely search the area. What if they search the canyon and find that blasted-out cave? Repairing it would take at least a day!
But just as the Demon clone charged towards Xu Xiangwen, a figure instantly darted in front of it.
"Inch Strength Fist—!"
BOOM—
Perhaps the Demon clone hadn’t noticed Wang Lan charging so abruptly, or maybe it simply couldn’t spare the attention to guard against him. In any case, Wang Lan’s punch landed so fast that the Demon clone couldn’t even attempt to block before being struck squarely in the chest.
BOOM—
Under the impact of Wang Lan’s Three Strengths in a Fist, the Demon clone’s chest armor shattered. The force pierced through its body, instantly obliterating its internal organs. He had activated Three Strengths in a Fist, tripling the power of his Inch Strength Fist. Although it didn’t consume Star Power, the strain on Wang Lan’s body was immense. He wouldn’t use it unless absolutely necessary. Though the punch had instantly killed the Demon clone, Wang Lan’s hand bones were now riddled with fractures.
But at that moment, the Demon clone behind Wang Lan attacked. This strike was deadly enough to claim Wang Lan’s life. The Demon clone’s blade plunged viciously towards Wang Lan’s back, and just as its tip was about to pierce his skin, Jiang Xinyu’s ice spike arrived. Instantly, the Demon clone behind Wang Lan was impaled by the ice spike.
SWOOSH—
Simultaneously, Xu Xiangwen successfully caught the signal flare thrown by Wang Lan. He quickly pulled the igniter, and the flare launched successfully, streaking towards the sky.
"Damn it—!" The true Demon’s face turned pitch black. The Demon, which had maintained a humanoid form, now completely unleashed its power. Its bone armor turned jet black, and fierce flames instantly erupted around it. Its speed exploded, and it transformed into a streak of light, rushing towards Jiang Xinyu’s face. A blazing flame erupted from its mouth, forming a Kylin that charged at her. In her haste, Jiang Xinyu conjured the Extreme Wall of Water.
BOOM—
The blast wave roiled, engulfing Jiang Xinyu. Scalding hot steam instantly scorched her face, causing countless blisters to erupt. Despite the intense agony, Jiang Xinyu didn’t utter a single sound of pain. Her eyes narrowed, and in their depths, a cold glint flashed. A sharp blade gleam appeared reflected in her eyes, directly before her face. In that instant, the hairs on the back of Jiang Xinyu’s neck stood on end.
CLANG—
With a crisp sound, Wang Lan’s punch knocked the blade aside, rescuing Jiang Xinyu in the nick of time, just as she faced certain death. But immediately after, an armored spike shot through the air, viciously impaling Wang Lan’s chest.
A spray of blood blossomed in the air, warm droplets falling on Jiang Xinyu’s face like rain.
The sight of Wang Lan impaled by the spike, lifted into the air, shattered Jiang Xinyu’s heart. Boundless anger and sorrow instantly overwhelmed her.
"AHHH—!"
A shrill scream, like the mournful cry of a winter cicada, tore from her. Jiang Xinyu’s Star Power suddenly surged violently around her.
