chapters.title: Chapter 33: Lanzi, You Weren’t Dead?
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Chapter 33: Lanzi, You Weren’t Dead?
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"I’ll kill you—"
A deep voice, as if talking to oneself.
But the chill in the voice seemed capable of freezing the soul. Neither Xu Xiangwen nor Gong Feiyu had ever felt such a terrifying aura from Jiang Xinyu.
At this moment, Jiang Xinyu’s face was unrecognizable, but the rising chill enshrouded her like a Fairy from the Moon Palace.
The moment the words left her lips, Jiang Xinyu’s figure dashed toward the Demon in front of her. Her hands crossed, and the temperature around the Demon plummeted.
"Hmph! A desperate surge of power? Even if you unleash your full strength, you’re still just a young girl at the early Star Cloud stage..." The Demon crossed his hands before him, and a fire dragon erupted from his mouth.
Meanwhile, an Ice Dragon shot out from Jiang Xinyu, fiercely colliding with the fire dragon.
In an instant, the Ice Dragon was engulfed in flames, turning crimson. Almost simultaneously, it shattered explosively, and endless icy dewdrops rained down from the sky.
The Demon’s eyes narrowed slightly; Jiang Xinyu’s figure had vanished from his sight. He perked up his ears, listening intently to every movement around him. Suddenly, the Demon punched the ground.
The solid earth instantly cracked, layer by layer, and stones floated upwards as if gravity had vanished. Scorching flames flowed through the fissures in the ruptured ground, turning the earth beneath into a living hell.
Despite the punch’s effectiveness, the Demon’s expression changed instantly.
"What? She’s not below."
High above in the clouds, a figure burst through the mist—Jiang Xinyu, clad in ice armor, rapidly spinning ice blades in her palms as she fiercely thrust towards the Demon.
The Demon whirled around, spewing a mouthful of flame that engulfed Jiang Xinyu.
"Hmph! A mantis trying to stop a chariot..."
A drop of rain landed on the Demon’s face. He reached out to wipe away the droplet...
Not good!
By the time the Demon realized his flames hadn’t instantly killed Jiang Xinyu but had been blocked by her ice blades, she had already broken through the inferno, thrusting her sword towards his chest.
SHH— A piercing whistle cut through the air. The rapidly rotating ice blade, possessing a cutting force even more terrifying than a wind blade, tore into the Demon’s chest armor, which couldn’t hold for even a second. The sharp blade pierced the Demon’s chest.
"Die—"
BOOM— The Demon’s body was torn apart by the powerful torque, his limbs and torso scattering everywhere.
"Cough, cough, cough..." Jiang Xinyu suddenly clutched her chest and began to cough.
"Xinyu, how are you?" Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu rushed over, asking anxiously.
"It’s nothing, just two broken ribs." As she spoke, she lifted her head, her deep eyes gazing at Wang Lan’s fallen body. Her face was as calm as a still lake, yet her eyes held a sorrow as profound as an autumn pond.
"Take Wang Lan’s body... Let’s go home together. It was my fault for bringing him here..."
"No one could have expected this. At least you’ve avenged Lanzi," Gong Feiyu said gravely.
"This revenge is far from over!" Xu Xiangwen’s eyes filled with tears as he ground his teeth. "Lanzi’s life won’t be avenged until we take the lives of a hundred thousand Demon Clan members!"
"You almost got me there..." A playful laugh rang out. Suddenly, not far from Wang Lan’s side, the Demon Jiang Xinyu had supposedly killed crawled out from the depths of the earth.
Seventy percent of his bone armor was shattered, and fresh blood flowed unceasingly.
But he... was still alive!
"You really can’t underestimate human Star Martial Warriors these days... If I hadn’t created a decoy clone just then, you might have actually killed me. But in battle, luck is crucial. I was lucky enough to survive, which means you’re the unlucky ones. Little girl, you have no strength left to fight, do you? You’re quite a fine experimental subject. Using you to create Biochemical Demon Soldiers would surely result in a very successful product line..."
SHH— Suddenly, the Demon felt his body become incredibly light, his vision swirling. Then, his perspective froze. A headless corpse appeared beneath him.
That headless corpse... doesn’t it look like me?
This sudden turn of events left Jiang Xinyu and the others momentarily stunned. Wang Lan had suddenly sprung up from the ground, beheading the Demon with a lightning-fast slash. The speed was imperceptible, the move breathtaking. The Demon’s head thudded to the ground.
"Cross-level kill. Reward: 500 experience points, 50 skill points..."
Only then did Wang Lan let out a long sigh of relief.
It’s finally dead.
A warm current swept over him, and Wang Lan successfully advanced to Starlight Nine. He had entered at Starlight Five, thinking it would be a long journey to reach the Star Shine Stage. To his surprise, in just six days, he had reached Starlight Nine. Just one more level, and he would reach the Star Shine Stage.
At the Star Martial Arts Campus of Suzhou No.1 Middle School, one-third of the students were at or above the Star Shine Stage. Though not placing him at the very top, it was certainly among the foremost ranks.
If he continued growing at this rate, catching up with Jiang Xinyu before graduating from high school wouldn’t be just a dream.
"Lanzi? You... you... you’re not dead?"
"I was faking it." Wang Lan sheathed his sword, turning back with a charming smile.
"Holy crap! How... how did you do that? That Demon clearly... clearly... Wait, where’s the wound on your chest? Did I imagine it?"
Jiang Xinyu also stared at Wang Lan incredulously. That stab, piercing the heart, would have surely killed any normal person.
Actually, at that moment, Wang Lan himself had thought he might die. But luckily, he possessed the Leopard King’s Soul Bead. Its surging Star Power provided a continuous supply of energy for his Self Healing Star Martial Skill to repair the injury.
Even so, Wang Lan had to continuously use Self Healing for ten minutes to save his life.
It was also fortunate that he had upgraded his Self Healing Star Martial Skill to the peak of Bronze Nine. If it had been any lower, the healing speed wouldn’t have outpaced the speed of death, and Wang Lan would have truly died.
"Although many Star Martial Warriors awaken without Innate Abilities, quite a few do possess them. Haven’t you ever asked what my Innate Ability is?" Wang Lan said, hands behind his back, his tone feigning a profound loneliness.
"What is your ability?"
"An Undying Body?"
"I wish. Unfortunately, my ability is just average—a plain self-healing ability. I can use Star Power to accelerate the healing of my injuries."
"A Medical Attribute talent?" Jiang Xinyu asked, her eyes brightening.
"I can only heal myself... At best, I’m just a durable punching bag, I suppose?"
"Lanzi, why didn’t you tell us you have a Medical Attribute talent? Do you have any idea how sought-after medical talents are? If you can heal yourself, you might be able to heal others. Medical Star Martial Techniques are strictly guarded by major families and Star Martial Academies. If you reveal this talent, many Star Martial Academies will compete for you, and even some Star Martial families will extend an olive branch. If you ever learn Medical Star Martial Techniques, you’ll become the team’s most protected member! You’ll just lie back, eat, and drink, and when necessary, ’donate’ some blood to save everyone. What a life! Enough to make anyone die of envy..."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Get lost! Even if I learn Medical Star Martial Techniques in the future, I still have the heart of a warrior. Xinyu, your injuries..."
"It’s nothing!" Jiang Xinyu coughed lightly, pulling her hair forward to cover the burn on her cheek. "I look pretty ugly now, don’t I?"
"If only my ability could heal others..."
Although I was in a daze earlier, I saw how desperately Jiang Xinyu fought for me. It would be a lie to say I wasn’t moved.
"It doesn’t matter. Once we get out of here, I can ask a Medical Star Martial Warrior to treat me. I won’t be an ugly monster forever."
"Collect Wang Youle’s bag and belongings. Let’s get out of here quickly. Since one Demon appeared, we can’t be sure there aren’t others. We must be cautious."
Gong Feiyu picked up Wang Youle’s backpack and suddenly froze. He opened it and pulled out an egg-sized Soul Bead.
"The Spider King’s Soul Bead? He had it?"
Seeing this, Xu Xiangwen’s face instantly darkened. But in the end, he bit his lip and refrained from cursing.
"Forget it, he’s dead..."
"Uh, since Wang Youle died, will we be in any trouble?" Wang Lan asked Jiang Xinyu.
"No trouble at all. What trouble could there be from being killed by a Demon? The country might even posthumously award Wang Youle a martyr’s medal. Died fighting a Demon Clan spy to the death—born ordinary, died gloriously," Gong Feiyu said, lightly patting Wang Lan’s shoulder with a smile.
As long as Wang Lan was alive, Gong Feiyu could genuinely smile. After all, surviving such desperate circumstances was incredibly fortunate, and the relief of their own survival somewhat tempered the sadness of their teammate’s death.
"Let’s go. No more delays."
Wang Lan carried Jiang Xinyu on his back, and together with Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu, they quickly left. As for why Wang Lan was carrying Jiang Xinyu... well, the official explanation was that both Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu were injured.
Less than ten minutes later, they encountered another group of figures approaching. Xu Xiangwen, more cautious this time, immediately signaled a warning. They relaxed only after confirming that this elite unit was part of the garrison for the Novice Trial Grounds.
In Suzhou City—no, in the entire Jiang Province—all Trial Grounds were under the jurisdiction of the Southeast Military Region’s Star Martial Army. The Novice Trial Grounds were defended by a battalion of five hundred, intermediate grounds by two battalions, and Advanced Trial Grounds by a regiment of two thousand.
The stationed Star Martial Army was responsible for maintaining stability in the Trial Grounds, rescuing Trialists, and responding immediately to any emergencies.
Typically, garrisons rotated every six months or annually.
After Xu Xiangwen fired the signal flare, a Star Martial Army rescue squad mobilized immediately, reaching the scene within fifteen minutes.
Because the Trial Grounds were part of a Different Dimensional Space with bizarre physical Laws, most machinery couldn’t function properly. Therefore, they had to rely on their own feet to reach the scene. Arriving in fifteen minutes was quite an impressive feat.
"Was it your group that sent the signal?" the leader of the approaching unit asked, stopping and scrutinizing Wang Lan and his companions. They actually recognized this small squad; they had witnessed the girl now being carried on Wang Lan’s back use an Ice Snow technique to annihilate a large number of Flaming Leopards in their designated region.
"Yes. We discovered a Demon Clan experimental base and were attacked by a Demon..."
"What did you say?"
The leading Star Martial Warrior took only a single step—Wang Lan was certain it was just one—yet that step seemed to cross an immense distance, as if shrinking the world.
Even Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu, standing in front, didn’t have time to react before the military captain appeared right before Wang Lan.
So powerful...
"You said a Demon Clan base? Where is it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Mom No Longer Has to Worry About Me Lacking Blue
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Chapter 34: Mom No Longer Has to Worry About Me Lacking Blue
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"We accidentally discovered a Demon Base in a valley about ten miles from here. Inside, there were incubation chambers where the Demon Clan was breeding Biochemical Demon Soldiers, and there was also video material of the Demon Clan’s experiments."
"We’ve been searching for a year, and at last, we found it..." The other party narrowed his eyes slightly and said calmly, "Hello, I am Captain Ren Xingwu of the Martial Arts Corps, Star Martial Special Combat Brigade, Southeast Military Region. Thank you for the information. Please guide us to the Demon Clan’s secret base for reconnaissance."
"That’s no problem, it’s just that my companions are all injured..." Wang Lan set Jiang Xinyu down and then gestured towards Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu.
"Lanzi, why don’t I take them? You take Xinyu to the Star Martial Army’s garrison?" Xu Xiangwen said seriously.
"Xu, you’re badly injured too. Let me do it," Gong Feiyu quickly interjected.
"Stop it, both of you. You’re six of one and half a dozen of the other. At least I have my Self Healing ability. It’s settled," Xu Xiangwen stated firmly.
Jiang Xinyu wanted to speak, but the words reached her lips, and she ultimately swallowed them. Wang Lan was indeed the only one of the three unharmed, but the injuries he had previously suffered were all life-threatening. He fought the toughest battles and sustained the most severe injuries, yet he was the only one to make a full recovery.
"In that case, Whitebeard, you take them back to the garrison to report to the battalion commander. I’ll have this young man lead the way."
"Yes, sir!"
After handing Jiang Xinyu over to that soldier, Wang Lan immediately set off with Captain Ren Xingwu to the Demon Clan’s secret base they had discovered earlier.
"My name is Wang Lan, a second-year high school student from Suzhou No.1 Middle School!"
"I know. I just saw your files."
After a ten-minute sprint, Wang Lan brought Captain Ren Xingwu to the canyon where they had killed the Flaming Leopard King. Pointing at the hole before them, he said, "It’s right here."
"Let’s go in."
"Wait, be careful of ambushes. As you saw, the Demon Clan pursued us shortly after we left the base. They probably know the base has been exposed and might have set an ambush."
"Xiaoyu, recon!"
"Yes, sir!" A Star Martial warrior stepped forward. Covering his right eye with one hand, his left pupil suddenly turned white, his eyeball spinning continuously like a globe.
"No traces of the Demon Clan or any signs of activity detected inside the base."
"Good, let’s go in."
Wang Lan gave Xiaoyu a long look, wondering how this person’s ocular ability differed from Xu Xiangwen’s.
Wang Lan was positioned in the middle of the ten-person team, a protected spot.
The lights inside the base were off, but Wang Lan remembered he hadn’t turned off the main switch when they left. He navigated to the electrical box with ease and flipped the switch.
The corridor lights illuminated.
"The Demon Clan came here after we left. Soldier Xiaoyu, if you can scout, please remain on alert at all times. There might be unknown enemies lurking in the base."
Being addressed as ’Soldier Xiaoyu’ by Wang Lan made Xiaoyu’s face light up. In Wang Lan’s previous life, respectfully and familiarly calling a military man ’soldier-brother’ was common. But in this world, this particular address, ’Soldier Xiaoyu’, was new and felt surprisingly warm and pleasant.
"Xiaoyu, stop grinning and focus on scouting. Our squad’s lives depend on you," Captain Ren ordered.
"Yes, sir!"
They entered the corridor and reached the incubation chamber area. However, the doors of the dozens of incubation chambers were now open, and the Biochemical Demon Soldiers inside had vanished.
"Just as I thought... Captain Ren, these incubation chambers were all closed before, and they contained Biochemical Demon Soldiers being bred by the Demon Clan. But now... the Demon Soldiers have been released. At least seventy or eighty of them."
"This means the Demon Clan is still in the primary trial grounds, or perhaps there’s more than one Demon Clan base there. But simply confirming the existence of a Demon Clan base is a victory for us. Even if it means a ground-penetrating search, I want every single one of these bastards dug out."
Next, Wang Lan led them to the laboratory. The central control computer there had already been destroyed, and even its remains still crackled with sparks.
"Hmph!" Captain Ren Xingwu snorted angrily. "The reconnaissance is complete. This is confirmed as a Demon Base. The intelligence from a year ago was accurate; the Demon Base was just hidden too well to be found until now. Mission accomplished. We will return to report."
"Yes, sir!"
"Not good!" Suddenly, Xiaoyu cried out in alarm.
Those two words, "not good," made Wang Lan’s heart leap into his throat, startling him into quickly opening the system to check the cooldown time for his Phoenix Form.
Less than an hour left... This is a disaster!
"What’s wrong?"
"Many Demon Soldiers with Mantis Blade hands have appeared outside the cave entrance. They must be the fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers you mentioned, young brother Wang Lan. They’re entering the cave."
"Is there another way out?"
"No, this base is sealed. All rear passages are blocked."
"Then we fight our way out!"
"Wait, Soldier Xiaoyu, aren’t the Demon Soldiers attacking each other?"
"Attacking each other? No! Why would they do that?"
"That means there’s still a Demon General present. Demon Soldiers lack sentience and are indiscriminate killing machines. Without a Demon General to control them, they would attack any entity they perceive as a threat. If two Demon Soldiers encountered each other, they would definitely fight. Only under a Demon General’s control do they become elite troops. The last entry in their experiment logs mentioned a failure to control the Demon Soldiers; the Demon General and the Biochemical Demon Soldiers revolted, even killing the project’s lead doctor. I initially thought the Demon Soldier project was shelved, but it seems the Demon Clan’s project has not only continued but has been perfected."
"What do we do now?"
"Fight our way out!" Captain Ren ordered decisively.
Instantly, surging Star Power emanated from the ten-member squad. Their formidable Star Energy Fluctuations revealed that every one of them was at the Star Cloud Stage. Captain Ren, in particular, had reached the peak of the Star Cloud Stage.
Wang Lan’s eyes lit up. If Captain Ren’s squad possessed such strength, they might actually be able to fight their way out.
"Captain Ren, is the Star Martial Army this powerful?"
"Of course. But not every squad is this strong. Don’t forget, we’re not just any unit from the Southeast Military Region; we are also part of the elite Martial Arts Corps, which has a designated unit number. The most outstanding soldiers in the Southeast Military Region’s Star Martial Army are all concentrated in the Special Combat Brigade, and the Martial Arts Corps is the elite of the elite within that brigade. Our battalion commander, though ’only’ a battalion commander by rank, is a top graduate from Modu City’s Star Martial Academy, with a Cultivation Level at the Galaxy Stage. Those Demon Clan bastards picked the wrong time to cause trouble while our Third Battalion is on duty!"
"They’re charging!"
"Hold the entrance! Old Wolf, An Huo, use your ultimate skills!"
"Understood!"
Two Star Martial warriors stood at the forefront of the passage. In front of them, over a dozen Biochemical Demon Soldiers charged ferociously. The soldiers’ Star Power surged, and suddenly, An Huo spewed flames from his mouth. Meanwhile, Old Wolf blasted out ferocious winds, fanning the inferno. Wherever the gale swept, flames instantly engulfed the area, rolling out like a fiery carpet towards the group of Biochemical Demon Soldiers.
The combined Star Martial Skill continued scorching for over ten seconds before ceasing. The foremost Biochemical Demon Soldiers were charred black but hadn’t died. With these dozen or so Biochemical Demon Soldiers clearing the path, the large number of Demon Soldiers behind them quickly closed in.
Seeing this, Wang Lan’s heart sank. The Biochemical Demon Soldiers were stronger than indicated in the test records. The records suggested that, at most, the Biochemical Demon Soldiers would be at the peak of the Star Shine Stage, not yet having reached the Star Cloud Stage. But now...
"Forward! Don’t let them get close!" Captain Ren commanded, charging ahead first.
They had no time to finish off the Biochemical Demon Soldiers who were already on the brink of death from the flames.
Wang Lan, protected at the rear, saw the nearly charred Biochemical Demon Soldiers on the ground, and his eyes glinted.
What’s this? Experience points and skill points!
There was no room for politeness. His figure instantly shot forward. He rushed in front of a Biochemical Demon Soldier and brought his saber down on its forehead.
"Experience points plus one hundred!"
He extracted the Soul Bead but didn’t absorb it. He quickly moved to another Biochemical Demon Soldier and struck again.
Wang Lan’s finishing blows seemed unnecessary, but... whatever makes him happy.
Captain Ren thought.
The pressure from the Biochemical Demon Soldiers was immense. Only upon engagement did they realize how terrifyingly powerful these purpose-built weapons of war were. If the Star Martial Army encountered them on the battlefield, it would be a nightmare. The Star Cloud Stage soldiers could hold their own one-on-one, but they struggled when facing two opponents. Captain Ren’s squad only had ten members, yet the Biochemical Demon Soldiers kept pouring in relentlessly.
The situation was dire.
"Experience points plus one hundred..."
"Experience points plus one hundred..."
Wang Lan didn’t know how many finishing blows he’d delivered, nor how many more experience points he needed to level up. If he saw one still breathing, he unhesitatingly went to deliver the killing blow.
"Experience points plus one hundred..."
"AH—"
A scream echoed. A blood-covered soldier rolled to Wang Lan’s feet, and Wang Lan instinctively raised his blade.
"Shit!"
"Sorry, sorry..." Wang Lan hastily withdrew his hand and, with another slash, killed the Biochemical Demon Soldier beside the fallen man.
"Xiao Gang, how are you?"
"Damn it... My lung’s been pierced... Captain, I think I’m done for... Only managed to kill four Demon Soldiers. Didn’t even break even. What a loss..."
"Damn it! I’m not dead yet, so you’re not allowed to die either!" Ren Xingwu roared.
"I can hold on a bit longer. I’ve saved some Star Power. When I can’t hang on anymore, I’ll set off some fireworks for you guys."
"Xiao Gang, you damn fool, just hang in there! If anyone’s setting off fireworks, I’ll be first!" another soldier shouted.
"Experience points plus one hundred..."
Suddenly, a warm current flowed through Wang Lan, and a shocking wave of Star Energy emanated from him. Instantly, the Star Palace above his head opened automatically, and a twinkling Starlight burst forth with dazzling brilliance.
Xiao Gang, watching Wang Lan closely, widened his eyes, his breathing becoming so ragged it seemed like he was about to stop breathing altogether.
Freaking unbelievable!
The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
At this moment... under these circumstances, you can actually break through? Is this timing for your breakthrough too perfect or what? Without any warning?
And... I didn’t see you condensing Star Power or absorbing Soul Beads. You were just happily delivering finishing blows! How can you break through like this?
Upon breaking through to the Star Shine Stage, his Star Power skyrocketed severalfold. On the system interface, the most direct change was a sudden increase in all basic stats. The blue bar surged with data. Although the blue bar itself didn’t lengthen, the numerical value it represented had increased more than fivefold.
Momma won’t have to worry about me running out of mana anymore...

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Please, Be Human
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35: Please, Be Human
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The most direct benefit of leveling up was that Wang Lan’s frozen skill points reappeared.
Indeed, the previous guess was correct: the skill level is limited by the character level. As soon as the character level breaks through, the cap on the skill level is unlocked.
Looking at the seven or eight skills on the skill panel, all were pure bronze 9.9! With just one more point, they would all be uniform silver skills. A smile like that of a Shiba Inu split across Wang Lan’s face.
"COUGH... COUGH..." Xiao Gang suddenly coughed under his breath, with silk-like froth of blood spewing from his mouth with each cough.
"How are you?" Wang Lan asked with concern.
"Did you... just break through?"
"Ah!"
"From the Starlight Stage to the Star Shine Stage? How did you do that? Don’t you need to break through? Don’t you need to build up force to break through the bottleneck? You... you..."
"Calm down, don’t get too excited, you’re seriously injured. Your lungs are damaged, putting a lot of pressure on your breathing. Don’t get excited," Wang Lan urged.
Not get excited? Can I freaking not get excited? I’ve seen your file. You awakened at the end of June and got your Star Martial Badge at the beginning of July. It was only a three-day difference, and you were already at mid Starlight Stage when you got the badge. Although what Wang Lan did during those two days was classified by the Tianjian Bureau and not known to the public, going from just awakened to mid Starlight Stage in three days was already scary, right? But as scary as that is, the growth after awakening to the Starlight Stage is very rapid. Plus, at sixteen, Wang Lan was at the prime age for an explosion in strength. Going from early to mid Starlight Stage is just a transitional phase, nothing special. But, come on, it’s been only ten days, just ten days since you got your Star Martial Badge, and only six since you entered the trial grounds. You completed the transition from the Starlight Stage to the Star Shine Stage in six days. That’s outrageous. Those who awakened their Star Martial Warrior talent at the age of seven or eight would be at most at the peak of the Star Shine Stage at your age! And those are the geniuses among geniuses. You awoke so late yet spent only half a month to reach what those geniuses achieved in five or six years! Have some decency, will you? Genius? No, demon! A demon among demons!
"I’m about to go meet the martyrs, and you tell me to calm down? A genius like you shouldn’t be dying here with us... we really shouldn’t have let you lead the way..."
"I’m not that much of a genius, really. Just now was an accident. Seeing you guys fighting the enemy so fearlessly, my blood boiled as well, and that led to the breakthrough. Hang in there, you must hold on..."
Xiao Gang didn’t say anything more, merely raising a middle finger at Wang Lan!
My blood boils and, excited, I break through? Do you think I’ve never experienced a breakthrough? Can you really break through a major realm just with excitement and passion? If it were that easy, would anyone be stuck at a bottleneck for years? Do you think breakthroughs depend on luck?
Xiao Gang’s bodily functions had declined significantly; it wasn’t that he didn’t want to speak, he simply couldn’t. He was waiting for that moment of a last rally before charging at the Biochemical Demon Soldiers.
At this moment, Wang Lan was quickly finishing his allocation of points to the Self-Healing skill.
*Self-Healing skill evolved to silver level, Healing Silver LV1 (0/100)*
Indeed, after advancing to the silver level, even a minor stage improvement required 100 skill points. And to raise a skill from Silver 1 to Gold 1, 1,000 skill points were needed.
Glancing at his accumulated 1,000 skill points, he once thought he was rich, but with the change in skill, he instantly became poor, having just enough to improve a single silver-level skill.
Suddenly, Wang Lan shuddered; he finally noticed that Self-Healing had transformed into Healing. Although it was a difference of just one word, the implications were worlds apart.
*"Healing skill: Consumes Star Power to quickly heal one’s own injuries and can be used on other targets. The area covered by the palm can also accomplish healing."*
Healing was an upgrade from Self-Healing, so it first healed one’s own injuries, but the addition of healing others was revolutionary.
Only capable of self-healing, you’re just a punching bag, but being able to heal others, you’re an ancestor. In the future, a whole bunch of people will be calling me ’Healer’... no, they should be calling me ’Father’.
Wang Lan’s spirits lifted, his green eyes gleamed, fixed on the dying Xiao Gang beside him. Without any hesitation, he pressed his hand onto Xiao Gang’s chest.
"Kid, move aside, my time has come, I’m gonna light the fireworks... ah... what’s going on... why is your hand so hot... it feels so good... what is that..."
Wang Lan’s Star Power was draining rapidly, but the speed of healing was almost the same as when he was at Black Iron 1. This healing speed was unacceptable to Wang Lan.
Need to add points!
Since I have 1,000 skill points, just add them!
One hundred skill points were swiftly added, turning Healing to Silver LV2.
The consumption of Star Power decreased slightly, and the healing speed was noticeably faster. But it still wasn’t enough.
Continue adding points!
In just a few seconds, Wang Lan poured 900 points into the Healing skill.
The Healing skill will be my bedrock for securing a position in the future. It will help me act cool when I need to show off, and allow me to survive when in danger.
As Huang Feilong said, "If you awaken the Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior talent, you’re the ’Father’ wherever you go. A whole bunch of people will be fighting to have you, and a crowd will be fighting to protect you. Your presence means the team’s sustainability; it signifies not fearing injuries, and possibly even death."
If it weren’t for the fact that, for a skill at Silver Level 9, having anywhere from 0 to 99 (out of 100) skill points towards the next level made no practical difference to its current effectiveness, Wang Lan would have wished he could raise the skill to Silver LV9 (99/100).
In those few short seconds, Xiao Gang finally realized what Wang Lan was doing and what changes were happening to his body.
His body was warm, pain-free, and he felt relaxed all over.
Breathing lightly, the air was slightly cool, and that suffocating, panting feeling had completely disappeared.
In an instant, Xiao Gang stared with eyes like a bull’s, fixated on Wang Lan. At this moment, Wang Lan had already moved his palm away, and Xiao Gang’s body had completely recovered from the injuries.
"All done!"
"Are you a Star Martial Warrior of the Medical Attribute?" Xiao Gang said with a dumbfounded look, a question that made even Wang Lan want to grimace.
Wasn’t my Medical Attribute Star Martial Skill clearly apparent?
"Shouldn’t you be heading back to the battlefield? Captain Ren and the others can hardly hold on!"
"Dammit! Demon Bastards, your grandpa Xiao is coming—" Xiao Gang roared like a panther, turning into a streak of light as he dashed towards the battlefield.
"Damn it, Xiao, don’t you dare compete with me for glory. If anyone’s going first, it’s gonna be me! Outta the way, I’m pulling down ten to cushion my fall."
"Cushion your fall, my ass! Get the hell back, I’m here to kill the enemy, not for glory," Xiao Gang kicked his blood-soaked comrade back. With Dual Battle Knives in hand, he charged like a mad demon at the Biochemical Demon Soldiers ahead.
"Xiao? Weren’t you almost dead?" Ren Star Martial trembled all over. Xiao Gang looked lively and vigorous, not at all near death.Follow current novels on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
"Dead my ass, the guy back there is a high-level Star Martial Warrior of the Medical Attribute. Those with grave injuries, retreat for treatment immediately; those with light injuries, hold your ground. Heaven has eyes, we aren’t meant to die yet..."
The soldier whom Xiao Gang had kicked towards Wang Lan had dozens of knife wounds all over his body, each deep enough to see bone. Wang Lan couldn’t even imagine how, with such serious injuries, he didn’t even frown and kept on fighting.
Although he had always heard that soldiers were the most respectable people on earth, he had never really felt it. At this moment, Wang Lan was convinced.
If such people were not respectable, the word ’admiration’ wouldn’t exist in this world.
"Don’t move, it’ll be quick!" Wang Lan pressed down on the man, his palms rapidly stroking over the wounds to stop the bleeding first. Feeling his body rapidly recovering, the soldier, whose name Wang Lan couldn’t even recall, was moved to tears.
"Don’t cry, trust me, I will heal you soon."
"I believe you, but... can you be gentler when you touch my wounds? It hurts like hell..."
The pain continued through the healing process and would only stop once the wounds were completely healed. Hence, as Wang Lan roughly stroked over his dozen wounds, it was like the soldier reliving the pain of all his injuries at once.
Even a will of steel couldn’t hold back his tears of pain.
Shit, I’m out of power...
Just as he was about to heal the man, his Star Power was nearly depleted.
"There are Soul Beads in my backpack."
"You should have said that earlier." Wang Lan snatched the man’s backpack, one hand absorbing Star Power from inside while the other swiftly healed each wound.
*Skill Point +1... Skill Point +1... Skill Point +1...*
"Done, next! Soldiers, anyone who has Soul Beads, throw them over here. Healing uses up a lot of Star Power."
As he finished speaking, more than a dozen backpacks fell from the sky like meteors, nearly burying Wang Lan.
"I’m back to full health... Demon Bastards, come at me again! Old Wolf, are you fighting with your guts spilling out? Get back and heal up before you return!"
"Old Wolf, go back first."
"Or let An Huo."
"Stop bullshitting, you’re wasting a second, this is an order!" Ren Star Martial roared in fury.
Before Wang Lan could catch his breath, a middle-aged soldier covered in blood lay before him, "Young man, be gentle, I fear pain."
"Your guts are almost spilling onto the ground, and you’re still fighting, and now you tell me you fear pain?" Wang Lan quickly stuffed Old Wolf’s intestines back into the wound, not bothering to arrange them properly. He hoped the Star Martial Skill would reposition the intestines.
The Star Martial Skill activated, and his warm palms, like a mini-sun, revived Old Wolf’s nearly exhausted body. Within seconds, not only were the intestines back in place, but there was not even a scar where the wound had been. Afterward, having healed Old Wolf’s multiple knife wounds, a man of steel and iron once again charged onto the battlefield.
"Next!"
Wang Lan didn’t have time to count how many people he had treated or how many times he had healed. Anyway, Xiao Gang had been taken care of by Wang Lan three times. But more and more fifth-generation Demon Soldiers were appearing outside.
Initially, it was one against two or three, but it soon became one against four or five.
This situation led to fully revived warriors being injured by Demon Soldiers working together before they could kill even one Biochemical Demon Soldier. Even if they succeeded in killing one, it was a close call with death.
Soon, there was a scenario, like in games, where loss of health outpaced the speed of healing.
And soon, even with a strong Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior like Wang Lan, deaths still occurred.
The first casualty was An Huo, a Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior with a fire attribute. After successfully killing one Biochemical Demon Soldier, he was slain by three others working together. His comrades were too late to save him, and he was literally sliced into pieces.
Where one death occurred, a second soon followed.
And this scene filled Wang Lan with desperate urgency.
It’s only thirty seconds away, just thirty more seconds until the cooldown time for the Phoenix form is over...
"Soldiers, hold on for thirty seconds! Don’t die within these thirty seconds. As long as you don’t die in thirty seconds, I can deal with them! You must keep your lives, hold on!"

chapters.title: Chapter 36 His Identity Is Not Simple
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36 His Identity Is Not Simple
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Wang Lan wasn’t sure if Ren Xingwu and the others had heard him, and he knew his own credibility was too low.
You, a mere Starlight... no, a rookie who just broke through to the Star Shine Stage, claiming you can take care of them? Do you take the elite squad of the Martial Arts Corps for a joke?
Yet, it seemed that just as Wang Lan spoke, Ren Xingwu and his team’s offensive suddenly intensified.
"Demon Bastards... Grandpa is taking you home—"
"Old Wolf, don’t be reckless—"
"BOOM—"
Old Wolf suddenly transformed into a streak of light and charged into the midst of the Biochemical Demon Soldiers. His limbs and body were instantly severed by them.
But then, his Star palace unfolded, the Starlight within extinguished, and a powerful explosion erupted, engulfing the seven or eight surrounding Biochemical Demon Soldiers.
Life as splendid as summer flowers, death as brilliant as shooting stars.
The fleeting glory of that moment, that Fanghua, deeply shook Wang Lan’s heart.
Wang Lan possessed awareness and willpower. He believed he could even face the enemy’s forces calmly, ready to die a heroic death. But he was still profoundly moved by the unwavering resolve of the soldiers before him. Even in death, they chose the most impactful way to perish, unleashing a relentless will to fight until their very last breath.
Suddenly, a poem echoed in Wang Lan’s mind:
"What meaning is there in this crippled form I leave behind? Let my broken body become a bridge, to lead the enemy to the netherworld’s distant shore.
Alive, I fight. Dead, I fight on."
"Old Wolf—you bastards! I’ll fight you all!"
"Xiao Gang! Calm down!"
"Phoenix Form... Activate!"
A cold voice, like a judgment from Hell, resounded.
The moment the cooldown finished, Wang Lan activated the Phoenix Form without hesitation. He had already invested three hundred skill points into it.
Three hundred skill points, active for thirty seconds!
A Phoenix Tail Flower insignia appeared between Wang Lan’s eyebrows. This time, the Phoenix Form seemed different from before. The instant the insignia manifested, blood-red patterns bloomed across Wang Lan’s body. A swirling mist of vivid red enveloped him—like blood, like fire, like a dream, like an illusion.
In an instant, Wang Lan materialized before Ren Xingwu. His palm shattered the Mantis Blade of the Biochemical Demon Soldier confronting Ren Xingwu, followed by a lightning-fast punch that made the creature’s head explode.
Wang Lan seemed to teleport, appearing beside each warrior to resolve their immediate crisis, then transforming into a blur of afterimages as he charged the surging Biochemical Demon Soldiers.
The Biochemical Demon Soldiers were formidable, each possessing strength equivalent to the mid-Star Cloud Stage. But before Wang Lan in his Phoenix Form, none could withstand a single punch.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
In less than ten seconds, only a handful of Biochemical Demon Soldiers remained in the cave.
Ren Xingwu and the others, however, remained frozen in their defensive stances, their eyes fixated on the scene unfolding before them. Even with the resilient hearts of soldiers, men tempered by the crucible of war and fire, accustomed to remaining stoic even if mountains crumbled before them, their minds were utterly blank.
Moments ago, a Biochemical Demon Soldier’s Mantis Blade had been less than five centimeters from his vital points. In that instant, Ren Xingwu had been prepared to make the ultimate sacrifice. But then, a figure wreathed in red mist flashed past, and then... the Biochemical Demon Soldier simply ceased to exist.
"PFFT~"
A long, continuous farting sound broke the oppressive silence.
The soldiers, who had been frozen solid, suddenly snapped back to reality, instinctively tensing up and shrinking back.
"Captain? What happened?"
"I’d damn well like to know too! That person... it looked like... Brother Wang Lan?"
"A moment ago, I thought I heard something about ’thirty seconds’... Did anyone else catch that?"
"It was Brother Wang Lan! He told us to hold on for thirty seconds..."
"It really was him? But... how is that possible? Wasn’t he just at the Starlight Stage? Is *this* the Starlight Stage? Could our understanding have been wrong all along? Maybe the Starlight Stage isn’t the starting point for a Star Martial Warrior? Have we been reading our cultivation progression charts upside down?"
"Whether we’ve got it backward or not, I don’t know... but... wasn’t Brother Wang Lan supposed to be a healer?"
"What are you all standing around for? Brother Wang Lan has already charged out! Hurry and provide support!" Ren Xingwu suddenly snapped to his senses, his voice cracking like a whip as he became the first to dash towards the cave entrance.
Exiting the cave, Ren Xingwu and the others collectively gasped, drawing in sharp breaths of cold air. Outside, dozens of Biochemical Demon Soldiers lay strewn across the ground, every single one dead, their heads exploded. They had fallen in a chaotic array of postures.
Ren Xingwu had witnessed such a scene once before.
Years ago, he’d been deployed to support a small Middle Eastern nation ravaged by Exotic Beasts. A terrifying secret realm had suddenly opened, unleashing countless humanoid Exotic Beasts that swarmed the country. In a single night, they had slaughtered one hundred thousand people. The United Nations had passed an emergency resolution, requesting peacekeeping support from the Five Permanent Countries. Ren Xingwu, a lieutenant at the time, had been leading a squad.
After a night of fierce fighting, he and his unit were trapped in an abandoned factory, overrun by an endless tide of Exotic Beasts. Their only option was to hide in the factory’s underground warehouse and await rescue.
A day later, a knock came at the basement door. After confirming the countersign, Ren Xingwu led his teammates out. The sight that greeted them was a field of humanoid Exotic Beast corpses, scattered in disarray, much like the scene before him now.
Only later, after reviewing surveillance footage, did they learn that the powerful, unnamed Star Martial Warrior who had saved them had annihilated thousands of Exotic Beasts in the warehouse area in a mere instant. The creatures had been slaughtered en masse before they even registered the presence of an enemy, which explained the chaotic scattering of their bodies.
And now, it seemed hundreds of Biochemical Demon Soldiers outside the cave had met a similar fate, wiped out before they even had a chance to detect an enemy.
"Brother Wang Lan!" Xiao Gang suddenly cried out. At the far end of the field of corpses, Wang Lan lay on the ground in a contorted posture, his condition unknown. Xiao Gang sprinted to his side like the wind.
"Brother Wang Lan, you can’t die! Brother Wang Lan!"
"Don’t... don’t shake me... Stop... I’m... falling apart..." Wang Lan glared resentfully at Xiao Gang, whose concerned shaking was, in fact, nearly finishing him off.
Right now, Wang Lan seriously wanted to retract his earlier assessment of these Soldiers. Adorable? My ass! I hate you all...
"Little Brother, how are you?" Ren Xingwu approached, his expression grave as he asked.
"He’s completely drained!" an older warrior declared after squatting to examine Wang Lan. "No serious injuries, though."
"Xiao Gang, carry Wang Lan. We’re heading back to report."
This time, Xiao Gang was exceptionally careful. As he carried Wang Lan and sprinted, Wang Lan felt no jolts.
But... it was still unbearable. I really want to die! My head is spinning, my body feels hollowed out. My organs, my entire being... none of it feels like it belongs to me anymore. This Phoenix Form! I have no idea what kind of twisted mind created it... I, Wang Lan, swear I’d rather be beaten to death, even torn apart by five horses, than ever use it again! It’s just too agonizing...
"I say, Little Brother," Xiao Gang said while running, "next time you collapse, could you try for a slightly more... conventional posture? The way you were twisted up back there, at first glance, it really looked like you’d kicked the bucket."
"There won’t *be* a next time... I guarantee it!" Wang Lan mumbled.
"What Star Martial Skill was that anyway? How can it be so powerful? It has to be an S-rank Star Martial Skill, right? Maybe even higher! Could it be a super S-rank forbidden art?"
"I don’t want to talk about it... Let me just... get some sleep..."
Drifting into a daze, Wang Lan peacefully closed his eyes.
Ren Xingwu arrived at Wu Changfeng’s office, his expression grave. "Commander," he reported, "the situation is serious!"
"I can see that. Your squad lost three members, and everyone else is injured," Wu Changfeng replied, his face grim as he sat behind his desk.
"That young woman brought the data logs from their experiment earlier. Fu and I examined it. We’ve never encountered this type of Biochemical Demon Soldier before. Previous generations were, at best, high-tier Starlight Stage. We’d never even seen Star Shine Stage Demon Soldiers. But this time... these fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers... I’m afraid even Star Cloud Stage cultivators might not be enough to suppress them!"
Ren Xingwu continued, "It’s not just that Star Cloud Stage might not be enough to suppress them; it’s a certainty. While scouting the Demon Clan base, we were ambushed by Demon Soldiers—over a hundred Biochemical Demon Soldiers! They surrounded our squad, intending to annihilate us. If it weren’t for Brother Wang Lan, we would have undoubtedly perished."
"Wang Lan?" Wu Changfeng queried. "The young man your team carried back? Isn’t he merely at the Starlight Stage? What happened? Does he possess some extraordinary support abilities?"
"He personally killed seventy or eighty of those Demon Soldiers. Commander Wu," Ren Xingwu said, lowering his voice, "are you familiar with a Star Martial Skill that, upon activation, places an insignia on the user’s brow... like a... like a Phoenix Tail Flower? A red mist, like fire, envelops the body. Their speed becomes like lightning, their strength capable of shattering mountains. In an instant, they can kill dozens of Star Cloud Stage warriors like myself..."
Ren Xingwu dared not continue. At that moment, he felt as if Wu Changfeng was about to devour him whole. Those intense, bull-like eyes were fixed on him, their gaze so piercing it seemed to touch his very soul.
"Phoe... nix... Form?" Wu Changfeng enunciated each syllable slowly, his sharp eyes boring into Ren Xingwu’s as he asked in a low, deliberate tone.
"I... I don’t know its name, Commander Wu. What Star Martial Skill is it? Have you encountered it before?"
Wu Changfeng slowly shook his head. "I haven’t seen it myself, but I’ve heard of it. You know I graduated from Modu City Star Martial Academy. There’s a legend there.
"Ten years ago, Eld Di, one of the five great elders of Jade Country, was transferred from Yanhua Star Martial Academy to become the dean of Modu City Star Martial Academy. To the outside world, it might have seemed like a routine administrative transfer, but for Modu City Star Martial Academy, it was profoundly significant.
"What is the foundational teaching of Modu City Star Martial Academy? The Dragon Transformation Decision. For two hundred years, countless powerful Star Martial Skills have been derived from it, forming the very bedrock of our academy. But for us students, the Dragon Transformation Decision also had another name: the Dragon Emperor Form! You can probably guess the significance I’m implying about this Phoenix Form now, can’t you?"
Ren Xingwu’s eyes widened. "Are you saying... this Phoenix Form is akin to the Dragon Emperor Form? Powerful enough to be the cornerstone of an entire top-tier Star Martial Academy?"
"Precisely." Wu Changfeng nodded. "Eld Di’s arrival as dean was celebrated throughout Modu City Star Martial Academy. It meant he could potentially establish another such foundational pillar for us.
"The Phoenix Form is an S-rank forbidden Star Martial Skill of Jade Country, a powerful technique passed down from ancient times, with origins tracing back to the mythological era. However, the prerequisites for learning this Star Martial Skill are incredibly stringent. In all of Jade Country, fewer than ten individuals have ever cultivated it, and as far as I know, only one person has ever truly mastered it."

chapters.title: Chapter 37 Treatment
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Chapter 37 Treatment
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Who..." Ren Xingwu instinctively asked.
"One of the Five Emperors, the Flame Emperor from the south!"
"HISS..."
Such things would not have been deliberately conveyed to Ren Xingwu in the past. Therefore, even as a seasoned warrior, the fire of gossip within him blazed fiercely. This was especially true when it concerned the Five Emperors, which caused his eyes to sparkle with excitement.
"Are you suggesting that Wang Lan is the first to successfully cultivate the Phoenix Form after the Flame Emperor?"
"You’re overthinking it!" Wu Changfeng looked disdainfully at Ren Xingwu. "The Phoenix Form is a top-tier Star Martial Skill. Learning a bit of it and mastering it are completely different concepts. The Phoenix Form has three transformations, and only the Flame Emperor could truly execute all three. Others can only exhibit some superficial aspects of it."
"Even so, just the superficial aspects of the Phoenix Form are terrifyingly powerful. What I’m more concerned about is how Wang Lan, a Starlight Stage Star Martial Warrior, learned the Phoenix Form. And how someone with his background even had the chance to learn it."
"This... I haven’t investigated yet. Preliminary information shows that he grew up in a single-parent family. His mother, Wang Ling, was a Star Martial Warrior, but she died on a mission when Wang Lan was very young. His father has always been a blank."
"That’s precisely the issue. Born into such an ordinary family, it’s impossible to come into contact with a top-tier Star Martial Skill like the Phoenix Form. Moreover, as far as I know, the conditions for learning the Phoenix Form are extremely harsh. Firstly, it requires immense physical strength. The body must be trained to be as resilient as refined steel to endure the erosive fire-attribute power of the Phoenix Form. It’s an extremely violent force, demanding meticulous control over physical strength and Star Power down to the finest detail. One slight misstep, and the fire-attribute Star Power will erupt into flames, burning the body to ashes. The second requirement is a pure fire constitution; one must refine their fire-attribute affinity to over ninety-eight percent."
"That’s why the Phoenix Form is classified as a forbidden technique. One must meet the conditions and receive permission to cultivate it. This Wang Lan... his background is definitely not ordinary, and he must be a genius among geniuses."
"Yeah, I agree on that. Just based on his medical abilities, he’s definitely the most incredible Medical Star Martial Warrior I’ve ever seen."
"What did you say?" Wu Changfeng spun around abruptly, staring at Ren Xingwu.
"Medical Attribute? You’re saying he knows Medical Star Martial Skills?"
"I don’t know if it’s a Star Martial Skill or not, but he just presses his hand on our wounds, and after a short while, they heal without even leaving scars. During our squad’s recent encounter with the Demon Soldiers, every one of us was treated by Wang Lan at least three times. In just ten to twenty seconds, injuries that looked fatal were completely healed, like a full recovery. I’ve seen Medical Star Martial Warriors in the military, but none possess such potent healing abilities. Old Wu, why don’t we try to recruit Wang Lan?"
"Hmm..." Wu Changfeng pondered for a moment. "Forget about poaching him. He’s just in high school. He still has one year of high school and then four years of university before he can even enlist. Even after he graduates from university, it’s uncertain if he’ll join the military. And even if he does, what makes you so sure he’d choose our Southeast Military Region?"
"As long as you wield your pickaxe well, no wall is unbreachable. If we handle it right, he’s sure to consider the Southeast Military Region. Once he’s in the Southeast Military Region, he’ll be ours for the taking, a prize for our Martial Arts Corps, right?"
"Let’s not get ahead of ourselves. Notify all company and platoon leaders, as well as the special operations group leaders, for a meeting!"The source of this content ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
"Yes, sir!"
Wang Lan didn’t know how long he had slept. The side effects of using the Phoenix Form this time, although not as intense as the last, felt like a much heavier burden on his body.
Slowly waking, Wang Lan didn’t immediately open his eyes. Instead, he immersed himself in the system to check his current status.
Indeed, the Phoenix Form is in cooldown. The remaining time is twenty-two hours. This means I was unconscious for two hours.
Ugh... It seems the feeling that the discomfort wasn’t as intense was just an illusion. Last time, I only used the Phoenix Form for five seconds, and the feeling of being completely drained lasted for two hours before subsiding. But this time... it wasn’t that it was less severe; I just passed out completely! I’ve been unconscious for two hours, and the discomfort is still this strong?
Thinking of this, Wang Lan couldn’t help but shiver.
If I hadn’t passed out earlier, what kind of living hell would that have been? Damn it! Never again! I swear, I’m never using it again, not even if it means dying!
I still have fifty skill points left... Recalling when I had over a thousand skill points, feeling like an absolute tycoon, now seems like a distant dream from a bygone era.
Of course, spending nine hundred skill points on the healing skill was worth it. The healing skill can treat others; its value is far greater than my own life. To put it bluntly, my one hundred and thirty pounds of flesh are just a bonus that comes with the healing skill.
With the remaining fifty points, Wang Lan decisively added one point to each of his nine Bronze-rank skills.
Instantly:
Basic Combat, Silver LV1 (0/100)
Movement Technique, Silver LV1 (0/100)
Close Combat Sword Skill, Silver LV1 (0/100)
Inch Strength Fist, Silver LV1 (0/100)
All silver-ranked skills. They look amazing.
And it wasn’t just about looking good. In that instant, Wang Lan felt as if he had traversed eons. That momentary enlightenment was like an ascension of the soul from the flesh.
Recalling his previous combat skills and fighting prowess, it felt like a third-grader looking back at their first-grade exam papers.
Damn, I could ace this kind of test with my eyes closed! Impossible, how could I have made such elementary mistakes? No, that definitely wasn’t me!
Anyway, at this moment, Wang Lan utterly despised his former self.
Bronze is bronze, after all. I was so complacent before. In the eyes of a true master, my past self was just a joke.
Although Wang Lan was still light-years away from becoming a true master, it didn’t stop him from adopting a master’s perspective to reflect on his previous shortcomings.
"Awake?" a voice, cold yet not without a hint of tenderness, sounded.
Groggy, he opened his eyes to find a graceful figure emitting a faint fragrance sitting by his bed.
Jiang Xinyu had changed out of her combat suit, yet she still wore armor on her chest—the Medical Stabilizing Armor. A moon-white mask, devoid of any pattern or design, was worn sideways, and a pair of beautiful eyes looked at Wang Lan through its eyeholes.
"Have you been taking care of me all this time?" Wang Lan struggled to sit up. Although his limbs still felt a little weak, he wasn’t paralyzed.
"Yeah! Don’t get me wrong. Those two young masters are always being served. At least I have experience taking care of Xincheng..."
"Actually, you don’t need to explain anything." Wang Lan’s eyebrows twitched slightly. "Take off the mask. Let me see!"
"No, it’s ugly! We’ll be able to leave soon. Once we’re out, I’ll find a Medical Star Martial Warrior to treat me. This level of injury isn’t a problem; it’ll heal. Don’t worry about it."
"Don’t waste the money. I’ve broken through to the Star Shine Stage."
"Really?" Jiang Xinyu’s eyes suddenly lit up. "That fast? How... how did you do it?"
Even Jiang Xinyu, a genius in her own right, found it incredible, almost incomprehensible. Wang Lan’s growth rate was enough to make him tower over his peers. But Wang Lan knew his own situation.
My leveling speed is somewhat predictable. The experience points needed in the Starlight Stage started at one hundred, and by Starlight Nine, it required one thousand points. However, starting from the Star Shine Stage, my initial experience requirement was ten thousand. I doubt going from Star Shine Two to Star Shine Three will only be eleven thousand; it’ll definitely be twenty thousand at the very least. Following this pattern, leveling up through the entire Star Shine Stage will require five hundred fifty thousand experience points. How long would it take to earn that much? Even if I could, what about the Star Cloud Stage? Five million five hundred thousand?
The system appears generous, giving me hope for continuous progress. But the massive amount of experience and skill points required for leveling up is also a deeply felt, daunting limitation. No wonder some people spend their entire lives stuck in the Star Shine Stage. The slightly better ones might break through to the Star Cloud Stage and barely avoid being cannon fodder. Above the Galaxy Stage, only a handful, as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns, remain. I really wish the system was like those Greedy Wolf web games, where killing a single monster grants hundreds of thousands of experience points. Unfortunately, this system is very serious.
"Let’s not talk about how I did it for now... What I want to say is, I think my innate Star Martial Skill evolved after my breakthrough. It can not only heal myself but can also heal others."
"Really?" Jiang Xinyu exclaimed excitedly, her voice a mix of joy for her own potential recovery and for Wang Lan awakening what seemed to be a true Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior talent.
Wang Lan reached out and removed Jiang Xinyu’s mask.
Half of her face was covered in ghastly blood blisters, and the entire side was swollen. No wonder Jiang Xinyu wore a mask—even Wang Lan found the sight hard to bear.
His hand slowly touched Jiang Xinyu’s injured cheek. Suddenly, Jiang Xinyu flinched.
"HISS! It hurts!"
"Okay, I’ll be gentle. I’ll try not to hurt you."
Wang Lan knew that to allow the healing skill to thoroughly channel into the target’s body, he needed to press his palm firmly against the injured area. Since it was already injured, being pressed like that would naturally be very painful. Back at the Demon Clan base, when Wang Lan was treating the members of Ren Xingwu’s squad, even those tough-as-nails fighters had tears welling up from the pain. Wang Lan understood.
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu had just reached the doorway of the room when they suddenly heard these two sentences. The motion of opening the door froze instantly, their faces stiffening as if turning to stone.
Wang Lan gently placed his palm on Jiang Xinyu’s cheek. A warm energy rose from his palm, penetrating her skin and awakening her cells. The pain vanished instantly, and her entire cheek felt warm and soothed, as if she were basking in a hot spring.
Feeling so comfortable, Jiang Xinyu couldn’t help but let out a soft moan.
"Mmm..."
The moment the moan sounded, Xu Xiangwen felt his hair stand on end. He stiffly turned his neck, giving Gong Feiyu a questioning look.
Gong Feiyu also wore a peculiar expression, silently shaking his head, then nodding.
"How is it? Not painful anymore, right? If it doesn’t hurt, I’m going to apply more pressure..."
As he spoke, Wang Lan pressed his hand firmly against Jiang Xinyu’s cheek, his entire palm completely covering the injured area. Star Power surged, and a hazy white light could faintly be seen emanating from his palm.
The blood blisters on Jiang Xinyu’s face gradually darkened, and her skin visibly began to stiffen. After about a dozen seconds or so, the injured part of her cheek hardened, resembling a dry, scab-like layer.
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu quietly slipped away, their retreating figures looking utterly dejected.
"Old Gong!"
Startled, Gong Feiyu leaped away from Xu Xiangwen, his eyes wide with alarm as he watched him warily.
"Xiangwen, we should have seen Lanzi and Xinyu getting to this point. Though it’s a bit sudden, surely you’re not so shocked that you’re... questioning your preferences, are you?"
"I..." Xu Xiangwen also realized that the way he had just called out was somewhat inappropriate. "No, no! Your surname is Gong! I wasn’t implying... *that*! Don’t get me wrong... What I mean is, from now on, it’ll just be the two of us single guys left. They’re bound to start flaunting their affection all the time, and we need to stay strong."
"You’re the one who needs to stay strong. I’m actually fine. That freshman girl from school has been after me for ages. If I can’t take it anymore, I might just give in to her. As for you... you’re too much of a playboy, always fooling around. If you want to find someone, you’ll have to completely turn over a new leaf, which might be tough for you."
"Get lost! How could you give in so easily? Don’t you believe I’ll go out and have a talk with that girl? Sigh! How did they get to this stage so quickly? Just a little while ago... and now this! Here in the trial area, in the garrison’s break room... Unbelievable..."
"Wait, someone’s coming! Not good, we need to guard the door!" Xu Xiangwen suddenly exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 38 Your Supporting Force is Very Powerful
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Chapter 38 Your Supporting Force is Very Powerful
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
Wang Lan released his hand, and Jiang Xinyu immediately grabbed her cheeks; it was just too itchy, and moreover, her face felt oppressively stuffy.
With that grab, the scars on her face started peeling off in pieces. In no time, her flawless cheeks appeared before Wang Lan, as smooth as a peeled egg.
"Is it done?" Jiang Xinyu asked nervously.
"Beautiful, perfect! But... your wound on the chest..." Wang Lan’s eyebrows kept twitching, a lecherous smile spreading across his face.
Not good, there was a murderous aura!
In an instant, the smile disappeared.
"It’s nothing, this injury is not a problem; the ribs have already been set. There’s no need for battle up ahead, I can heal on my own," Jiang Xinyu said, her face slightly flushed as she turned her head away.
"Um, Soldier, are you looking for Wang Lan? It’s not very convenient right now... or maybe..."
"Not convenient? Has little brother Wang Lan not woken up yet?"
"Uh... this..."
Wang Lan gave Jiang Xinyu a puzzled look, then Jiang Xinyu strode to the door and pulled it open.
"Wang Lan is already awake; how come you two haven’t come in yet?"
"Uh... can we come in under these circumstances?" Xu Xiangwen cast a glance.
"Don’t block the doorway, let them come in first."
As Commander Ren entered the room and saw that Wang Lan was already up, he smiled warmly, "Little brother, how’s your recovery?"
"I’m almost there, Captain Ren. Are you looking for me... Is there something you need?"
"Our battalion commander has something to say to you. He was planning to come in person, but he’s tied up at the moment... Are you available?"
"Available, nothing inconvenient. Let’s go!"
Though still feeling a bit weak, it did not impede his movement. Under the puzzled gazes of Jiang Xinyu and the others, Wang Lan left the rest area following Commander Ren.
The base camp of the junior training ground was not large, like a rural primary school. There were two rows of two-story buildings: one for accommodations, the other for offices.
"Report!"
"Come in!"
Wang Lan was brought inside. Wu Changfeng set down his pen and stood up, moving to the couch and gesturing for Wang Lan to sit. Then he personally poured a cup of water and handed it to Wang Lan.
"Thank you very much for the information you’ve provided us, and also for your help with my subordinates. Without you, I might have lost ten good brothers."
"No need for thanks, Major. It’s what I should do. As a Star Martial Warrior, fighting the Demon Clan is our duty and obligation," Wang Lan said reservedly, unsure of the Major’s intention.
"Don’t be nervous. My name is Wu Changfeng, and I’m the battalion commander of the third company of the Martial Arts Corps, currently in charge of the Suzhou City junior training ground. You can call me Wu, or Old Wu, whatever you prefer."
"I wouldn’t dare... I’ve never met such a high-ranking official before..." Wang Lan said with a dutiful smile.
"Official my ass!" Wu Changfeng let out a local dialect phrase with a sneer.
Definitely a person from Shu! Totally confirmed.
"I’m not exaggerating, little brother. With your talent and your strength as a Medical Star Martial Warrior, your future achievements will certainly surpass mine. In no more than ten years, your legend will spread throughout Jade Country."
"Wu, you’re putting me on too high a pedestal; I might fall to my death," Wang Lan humbly replied.
"Is your medical ability really that impressive?"
"I... I don’t even know how to answer that question. I’ve only been a Star Martial Warrior for a few days. I’ve only met a few Star Martial Warriors, and my knowledge about Star Martial Arts is limited. I have no idea what kind of level other Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors are at. Without comparison, how can I claim to be impressive?"
"What kind of injuries can you treat?"
"My Star Martial Skill should fall under restoration, I guess. It’s derived from Self Healing. Self Healing is about using Star Martial Skill to repair the body when it’s damaged. So rather than calling it a Medical Star Martial Technique, it’s more of a Restoration Star Martial Technique. As long as the person isn’t dead, I can activate my Star Martial Skill to repair injuries. But it also depends on the type of injury; if it’s about severed limbs... I’m afraid I can’t help."
"Hmm, it’s pretty much as I analyzed. Your ability is highly targeted and has a wide range of applications. It’s a great fit for our military, especially battlefield medicine."
Hearing this, Wang Lan instantly became vigilant.
Was this an attempt to recruit him into the military?
Looking puzzledly at Wu Changfeng, Wu Changfeng simply smiled. "I mean later, in the future."
In fact, becoming a full-time doctor wouldn’t be too bad. When he was treating Commander Ren and his men, curing each one added experience points. No matter how you looked at it, he could get stronger even while lying down.
Plus, treatment consumed Star Power, so he could legitimately request Soul Beads to replenish skill points—truly a sustainable and classic route to getting stronger.
But Wang Lan did the math. To upgrade from Star Shine to Star Cloud Stage, he would need 550,000 experience points, which meant treating 5,500 people. Setting aside how much time it would take, the question was whether there were even that many people who needed his healing.
Unless a full-scale war broke out, where would so many injured come from?
And breaking through from Star Cloud to Galaxy was even more daunting, requiring the treatment of 55,000 people. Like, was this even humanly possible? Even if he healed ten people a day, it would still take damn near fifteen to twenty years. To think of leveling up to Star Sea Stage by healing alone, that truly seemed like a ’once in a lifetime’ kind of deal.
A dedicated career in the Medical Attribute looked safe, but it wasn’t the life Wang Lan wanted.
Spending a lifetime, possibly dying before even breaking through to the Star Sea Stage, would be an utter disgrace among those who had transmigrated.
Wang Lan smiled and shook his head. "Who knows what the future holds?"
"Right! I heard from Commander Ren that you used a very powerful Star Martial Skill at a critical moment, saving them all. That skill should be called ’Phoenix Form,’ right?"
Wang Lan looked at Wu Changfeng in surprise, not expecting anyone to know about this Star Martial Skill. He had specifically searched the internet for it—there were Phoenix Wings, Phoenix Wing Sky Soaring, Dance of the Phoenix, and other Star Martial Skills, but he couldn’t find any information on Phoenix Form.
"You don’t need to look so surprised. A classic and powerful Star Martial Skill like that cannot be kept secret. Plus, I graduated from Modu City’s Star Martial Academy. A very influential incident occurred back then, making Phoenix Form well-known among students of my class."
"Indeed, it is."
"So, I’m very curious. Phoenix Form is an S-rank Star Martial Skill, also a forbidden technique. Even many powerful Star Martial Warriors don’t have the opportunity to learn it. How did you get it?"
"This... Will it put me in danger?"
"That depends on how you acquired it. If the way you obtained it isn’t proper, the country won’t let you off easily. If it’s a legitimate method, then the country will protect you. After all, an S-rank Star Martial Skill is enough to make many drool with envy, even to the point of trampling over the law."
"My mom left it to me," Wang Lan replied straightforwardly.
Having a treasure on him, being coveted by others—it was obvious how dangerous it could be. And if he didn’t manage to gain powerful protection, who knows, he might end up dead on the streets one day.
"Your mom?" Wu Changfeng’s gaze suddenly became serious. "I’ve looked at your file. Your mom is named Wang Ling, a Star Martial Warrior. But what’s strange is, I can only access the most superficial layer of information. The data on your mom is limited to the most basic details. All her past, like her birth, education, work—all experiences are blank. It must have been classified. However, I have a guess about your identity, so I still hope you can tell me. Rest assured, I am a soldier and a member of the Ministry of Defense’s Sword Plan. My political leanings and identity are trustworthy, and I understand the confidentiality regulations. Even if you tell me, I won’t disclose it. And you are in great danger; the fact that you possess Phoenix Form won’t stay hidden for long."
"Is that so?" Wang Lan didn’t hesitate for long. "Actually, I don’t know much about my mom either. I was told at the age of eight that she had died on a mission. So... But soon after my awakening as a Star Martial Warrior, my aunt gave me my mother’s belongings and revealed her identity to me. She may not be dead, perhaps just missing, or maybe not missing at all. My mom is named Wang Ling; her title, Flame Emperor!"
Wu Changfeng’s breathing suddenly became rapid. Although he had had suspicions, hearing the confirmation firsthand was like being swallowed by a tsunami, struck by the sheer force of the reveal.
In the entire Jade Country, fewer than ten people had trained in Phoenix Form, and the only known successful practitioner was the Flame Emperor. Those who hadn’t succeeded wouldn’t dare pass on the skill to others unless they intended harm. Only those who had mastered the route would enable another to replicate their successful experience. Therefore, Wu Changfeng had surmised that Wang Lan’s Phoenix Form came from the Flame Emperor. But Wang Lan’s social circle was spotless, and there was no chance of intersecting with the Flame Emperor. The only connection could be through Wang Lan’s mother, Wang Ling, whose records were mysteriously clean. Trusting his sharp intuition, Wu Changfeng speculated that this Wang Ling must have a close connection with the Flame Emperor. And now, this speculation had been confirmed: the Flame Emperor was Wang Ling, and Wang Ling was the Flame Emperor.
The son of the Flame Emperor... a descendant of the Five Emperors... what a dazzling identity?
The Five Elders and the Five Emperors are always spoken of together, but who knew that they achieved greatness together?
Why were they called the Five Elders? It was because these five respected Elders nurtured disciples like the Five Emperors, whose brilliance was universally acknowledged. And it was the strength of the Five Emperors that elevated the status of the Five Elders.
The Five Elders didn’t *only* have the Five Emperors as disciples; their other disciples were spread across various industries, and all of them were elite talents.
It’s unlikely that the Five Elders could cultivate another set of Five Emperors, so the status of a descendant of the Five Emperors is like a brilliantly glittering star in the eyes of the Five Elders’ lineage and their sphere of influence.
With such a status to rely on, who would dare make a move? And yet, such an identity had remained so obscure for sixteen years?
Amazed, Wu Changfeng also admired the Flame Emperor; truly worthy of her reputation, to have kept her child hidden so well, so deeply...
"I understand now. Since the Flame Emperor’s child has appeared... I suppose I was overthinking it, and there is no need for me to worry about your safety."
"Oh? Wu, what do you mean by that? I don’t quite understand."ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"You don’t need to understand. Just continue eating, drinking, and living as you always have."
"I wasn’t worried before, but now that you say that, I’m suddenly feeling a bit anxious..."
"It’s not what you think. Having Phoenix Form won’t cause you any trouble, don’t worry. You are the son of the Flame Emperor; who would dare mess with you? Anyway... I called you here because I wanted to discuss something with you."
Wu Changfeng’s tone shifted abruptly. Although previously he didn’t display an arrogant attitude, the conversation had been led by him. But now, his tone seemed almost deferential.

chapters.title: Chapter 39th - : Decision to Stay
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: 39th Chapter: Decision to Stay
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
"Please go ahead, Big Brother Wu!"
"From the experimental video Student Jiang brought, we can conclude that the failure of the fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers caused a riot a year ago, which even led to the death of the lead scientist. Although the Demon Clan eventually suppressed it, the base was sealed, and it seemed the plan had been shelved."
"However, judging by your encounter, the Biochemical Demon Soldier project has made a breakthrough. They have successfully gained control over the Biochemical Demon Soldiers, and their strength has once again been enhanced."
"Moreover, there are dozens of cultivation pods inside the sealed base, but the army of Biochemical Demon Soldiers you encountered far exceeds the number of those pods. This leads us to two conclusions."
"First, there are other Demon Clan bases in the primary trial field, and Demon Clan members are secretly creating Biochemical Demon Soldiers there. Second, the Demon Clan’s Biochemical Demon Soldier project has been perfected."
"Whether they hid the base in the primary trial field to secretly cultivate Demon Soldiers or for some other purpose isn’t important. What’s important is that we need to find them and eliminate them."
"We will immediately shut down the primary trial field completely, forcibly clear out all Star Martial Warriors, and then carry out a carpet search and excavation. Inevitably, we will have a tough battle to fight."
"And your medical abilities are what we urgently need. I hope... you will stay and help us, to provide treatment."
"Don’t you have any Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
"No! Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors are too precious. It’s hard to find even one among a hundred Star Martial Warriors. The Southeast Military Region’s Star Martial Army has one hundred thousand members, of whom only about a thousand are Medical Attribute."
"Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors are so highly valued; how could they possibly be assigned to rotate shifts in the trial fields? They are either on vacation or studying and are only dispatched during wartime."
"Don’t you request instructions from your superiors or ask for reinforcements?"
"Of course, we ask for instructions and reinforcements! But the order I received from military headquarters is to hold out for two days. Although I don’t know why, there must be a reason. It’s likely related to something the Demon Clan has orchestrated."
"Young man, do you think the Demon Clan will give us two days to wait for support safely? I’m certain that within these two days, they will make a move."
"I just hope you can help me save those injured brothers. You don’t need to join the battle. And I promise, should any danger arise, I’ll be the first to send you out. How about that?"
"Protecting our homeland and safeguarding human civilization is the mission of every Star Martial Warrior. I am duty-bound! It’s just... although I possess the Phoenix Form, the overdraft after a single use is too great, and I need twenty-four hours before I can use it again. So even if you want my help, you’ll have to wait for twenty-four hours."
"Understood, of course. The Phoenix Form is an incredibly powerful Star Martial Skill. Logically, you don’t even meet the conditions to learn it. The fact that you can use it must come at a price."
"And I’ll be blunt: with my mid-Galaxy Stage Cultivation Level, suppressing a primary trial field is more than enough."
"In that case, I’ll entrust my life to you, Big Brother Wu!"
"Rest assured, even if it costs me everything, I’ll ensure you remain unharmed. If anything happens to you under my watch, my life might as well be over. Don’t worry!"
After Wang Lan left, the trial field garrison began a carpet-style clearance of the Trialists. Because the previous Exotic Beast riot had already been cleared once, all Star Martial Warriors had been gathered at the entrance, and the trial field’s lockdown had not yet been lifted.
This time, however, it was even more thorough. The previous announcement stated that due to a riot in the trial field, and for the safety of the Trialists, everyone should remain at the entrance. Trialists would be allowed to resume their trials once the garrison completed the suppression.
The trial fee is five thousand a day; for the Trialists, every day of delay felt like having their own flesh carved out. They were anxiously waiting for the trial field to reopen after the Exotic Beast riot was suppressed, practically staring holes into the distance.
"Dear Trialist friends, the Exotic Beast riot in the trial field has been suppressed. Please, all Trialists... Wait, an urgent notification has just been received. An unknown malfunction has occurred in the trial field. The trial field garrison requires all Trialists to evacuate immediately. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and any losses incurred by our Trialists."
"Repeating the announcement..."
"What the hell..."
"What’s going on? Weren’t the Exotic Beasts suppressed already?"
"Unknown malfunction? My ass! What kind of unknown malfunction could a trial field even have? Did the trial dimension collapse or something? I paid good money to get in, and now you’re telling me to clear out?"
"Refund, refund!"
