"Dear Trialist friends, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. We will issue full refunds for the period from the start of the Exotic Beast riot to the end of your remaining trial days. We ask for your understanding, Trialist friends..."
"Understanding? Like hell! Do you think we care about this paltry sum? We want Soul Beads!"
"That’s right, we want to continue our trials!"
The uproar, however, had no impact whatsoever on the Star Martial Army’s decision. Though they grumbled loudly, when it came time to be cleared out, they still obediently handed over their items and departed.
Argue further? Not a chance.
A platoon of the Star Martial Army stood there, each soldier emanating Star Energy Fluctuations of the Star Shine or Star Cloud Stage. You lot, at Star Shine Stage at best, want to try something? They’d teach you a lesson in humility in minutes.
In the pitch-dark underground secret chamber, the dim yellow incandescent lights overhead flickered faintly. The dim lighting barely illuminated the round table below and the shadows of three figures, but their appearances remained obscured.
"The base in the primary trial field, sealed for a year, has been discovered."
"How was it discovered? Were they still searching all this time?"
"No, it was an accident. A trial team encountered a Flaming Leopard King in a canyon outside Wind Valley. In the ensuing battle, they inadvertently blasted open the rear wall of the base. You know how it is, the cliff faces of Wind Valley have been eroding for years and have become progressively thinner."
"What should we do now? Launch the plan ahead of schedule?"
"We can only launch it early. Only..."
"Only what?"
"This time, the unit garrisoning the primary trial field is the Martial Arts Corps’ Third Battalion. And it just so happens that within the Southeast Military Region’s Star Martial Army, the Star Martial Special Operations Brigade is the strongest, and within the brigade, the Martial Arts Corps is the most formidable. This time, we’ve unfortunately run into the elite of the elites."
"The Martial Arts Corps’ Third Battalion. Its commander, Wu Changfeng, is at the mid-Galaxy Stage. The deputy commander, Fu Qiaoshi, is at the peak of the Star Cloud Stage. The entire battalion boasts as many as one hundred seventy Star Cloud Stage elites, comprising one-third of the whole corps."
"After they discovered the sealed base, one of their action teams went in again to investigate. I wanted to test the Martial Arts Corps’ strength, so I deployed one hundred and fifty fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers."
"However, the result was beyond my expectations!"
"Were the losses heavy?"
"All one hundred and fifty fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers were eliminated, while their twelve-member special operations team lost only four."
"What?" The middle-aged man opposite him could no longer remain composed.
"How is that possible? Three fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers should be enough to kill a human Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior! How did they manage to annihilate one hundred and fifty of our Biochemical Demon Soldiers with only four losses?"
"Did Wu Changfeng make a move?"
"I wish that were the case, but it wasn’t. Wu Changfeng was still at their military command center and hadn’t left."
"There are only one thousand Biochemical Demon Soldiers in the primary trial field. If the battle plays out like this... our plan has no chance of succeeding. Can we put the Demon Soldiers into silent mode? Hide the base?"
"’It’s no use!’ The youthful-looking speaker shook his head. ’This time is different from a year ago. Back then, they weren’t certain our base existed, so when one search yielded nothing, they dropped it.’"
"’But this time, they’ve confirmed the base’s location. They will undoubtedly dig three feet deep, even if it means turning the entire trial field inside out. Our base can’t be hidden, nor can the Demon Soldiers and Demon Generals.’"
"’Damn it... This is our first operational plan. If it fails, the Empire will lose confidence in us.’"
"’Therefore, this plan must succeed. Of course, based on my intelligence, even the Martial Arts Corps shouldn’t be as strong as they appeared in that engagement. There might have been an unexpected element contributing to that battle’s outcome.’"
"’Furthermore, a Demon General’s combat prowess is estimated to be at the late Galaxy Stage. We’re not without a chance of victory.’"Follow current novels on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"’Let’s hope so! If the Martial Arts Corps weren’t stationed there, advancing the plan wouldn’t be an issue. Destroying a primary trial field means severing one of Jade Country’s Star Martial Warrior training bases...’"
"’Fate won’t always be on our side. Unexpected events are something we must face directly.’"
The secret chamber once again sank into dead silence.
At the entrance to the trial field, Wang Lan, Jiang Xinyu, and the others arrived at the exit. Wu Changfeng had already prepared Wang Youle’s death report and analysis. Jiang Xinyu would face no trouble after leaving, and Wang Youle would be honored posthumously as a martyr.
In times of peace, martyrs are highly valued. They receive public adulation and media praise. Their parents also receive special consideration for being the parents of a hero. However, if war were to erupt, these intangible benefits would likely vanish.
In an all-out war against the Demon Clan, anyone could die, and many likely would!
Jiang Xinyu passed through the security checkpoint safely. She had only taken two steps when she suddenly stopped.
Wang Lan was right behind her, but she hadn’t heard him pass through the security checkpoint.
A terrible premonition surfaced in her mind, and Jiang Xinyu’s heart suddenly began to pound. Panic evident on her face, she spun around abruptly, only to see Wang Lan standing behind the security checkpoint, smiling and waving at her.
"Wang Lan, what are you doing? Get over here!" Xu Xiangwen looked somewhat panicked as he gestured urgently.
"You guys go on ahead. I’m staying behind to assist the Star Martial Army. They need me."
"Are you kidding me? You’re not a soldier; you’re still a student!"
"On the battlefield against the Demon Clan, is there any distinction between soldiers and students? I’m a Star Martial Warrior, and that’s enough. Besides, I’m a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior. It’s very safe in the rear echelon. Don’t worry, I’ll be out in a couple of days."
Wang Lan smiled and turned to leave.
"Stop!" Jiang Xinyu’s voice was like ice. "I brought you here, so I’m taking you out! Are you coming or not?"
"This is my decision. No one will blame you. Someone here will inform my aunt, so don’t worry."
"Don’t worry my—" Jiang Xinyu managed to bite back the last word. Her eyes flashed, and she strode towards the security gate.
"BEEP, BEEP, BEEP! Miss Jiang, please step back. The trial field is now sealed. All Trialists must leave."
"I’m a Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior! I can assist the military in combat!"
"I’m sorry, we cannot approve your request. Please leave immediately."
"Trial zone clearance complete. All Trialists have exited the trial field."
"Seal the trial field!"
"Trial field sealing in progress..."
The heavy iron door slowly closed, gradually separating the two worlds. In their respective visions, the other’s figure grew increasingly narrow, smaller and smaller.
BOOM—
The iron door slammed shut. The sound seemed to strike Jiang Xinyu’s heart directly, and for an instant, she felt as if she had lost her entire world.
"That bastard Wang Lan, ditching us like this! Does he even think of us as his brothers?"
"Xinyu, don’t worry too much. Wang Lan is a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior; he won’t be sent to the front lines. Besides, doesn’t Wang Lan have his Phoenix Form? You know him; he never does anything he’s not confident about."
"Let’s go. We’ll wait for him outside the gate." Jiang Xinyu wiped a tear from the corner of her eye and said softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Do You Realize You’re Flaying the Skin?
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Chapter 40: Do You Realize You’re Flaying the Skin?
Editor:
EndlessFantasy Translation
The night sky was silent and dimly lit. Within the secret realm, day and night still existed. However, daytime wasn’t very bright, and night wasn’t too dark. The sky overhead seemed like a lamp that changed with the passage of time.
The Exotic Beasts of the junior trial field had completely quieted down. Soldiers of the Third Battalion of the Martial Arts Corps spread out to every corner of the field, starting a carpet search from the outside in.
The command center bustled with people.
Wireless devices couldn’t be installed in the trial field, and there weren’t even any wired telephones. Consequently, contact with subordinate units relied solely on messengers running back and forth.
Wu Changfeng commanded from the center, while Wang Lan quietly watched him swiftly issuing orders and rapidly receiving situation reports.
This scene resembled ancient television dramas from his previous life.
"Report to the Battalion Commander! Squad 32 discovered traces of Biochemical Demon Soldiers. They were attempting to attack the White Ape tribe and incite chaos among the Exotic Beasts. Squad 32 has eradicated them. Awaiting instructions."
"Continue steady exploration. Focus on the areas where Exotic Beast tribes reside."
"Yes!"
"Order Squads 15 through 30 to pay special attention to the Exotic Beast tribes. I predict the Demon Clan will create chaos before making their move."
"Understood!"
While the main camp was bustling with activity, at the perimeter of the Star Martial Army’s encampment, the ground suddenly bulged with large mounds. With slight tremors, fifth-generation Biochemical Demon Soldiers emerged one after another from beneath the ground.
One by one, in the blink of an eye, nearly three hundred densely packed figures appeared.
They made no sound, appearing and approaching the camp in utter silence. The camp’s main forces had already deployed to search for the Demon Clan. The Star Martial Army never imagined the Biochemical Demon Soldiers would launch a sneak attack on their base at this critical moment.
As expected, the camp’s defenses were thin. Yet, the lights of the distant command center shone as conspicuously as fireflies in the night.
The Demon Soldiers advanced stealthily, converging from all directions. When they were within two hundred meters of the command center, the Biochemical Demon Soldiers suddenly charged, transforming into streaks of dark light as they rushed towards it.
"ROAR—"
Wolf-like howls resounded. Anything standing in the Demon Soldiers’ path was mercilessly torn to shreds.
Encountering almost no resistance, they successfully breached the command center’s gates.
The overhead lights swayed slightly. Inside, the flickering figures were all dummies.
The Demon Soldiers, naturally, couldn’t distinguish between real people and dummies; their only directive was to shred everything in sight.
"RRRIP—"
"WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH—"
Flares shot into the sky. In the temporary command post, hidden in a canyon north of the main command center, Wu Changfeng slammed his hand on the table and shot to his feet.
"Good! The fish have taken the bait! Brothers, follow me and slaughter those Demon Bastards!"
The controller behind the ambushed Demon Soldiers hastily ordered a retreat. But just as they pulled back to the encampment’s perimeter, they ran headlong into Wu Changfeng’s approaching forces.
"You think you can run after coming all this way? Kill!"
Wu Changfeng ripped off his shirt, his bare upper body exposed, and roared as he charged toward the Demon Soldiers.
Wang Lan, at the rear of the team, felt his blood boil.
A true man should be like this!
Wu Changfeng had to be a Gold Attribute Star Martial Warrior—a rare yet exceptionally powerful attribute. After ripping off his shirt, his body seemed to inflate like a balloon.
However, this wasn’t an inflation that made him larger yet more fragile; rather, his muscles grew at a terrifying rate, reminiscent of the Hulk’s transformation.
As his muscles bulged, his body gradually took on a steely sheen. He charged to the very front. Facing the nearest Demon Soldier, he raised a fist as large as a pot lid and smashed it down on the Biochemical Demon Soldier.
The Biochemical Demon Soldiers were mere war machines, devoid of thought and fear. Even knowing it was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot, they would resolutely swing their Mantis Blades at Wu Changfeng.
The sharp blade grazed Wu Changfeng’s body, striking brilliant sparks from his silver-white, steely form, and then...
Nothing.
The Demon Soldier’s head vanished as if bitten off clean.
One punch. Instant kill!
If the Biochemical Demon Soldiers were war machines, then Wu Changfeng was a war behemoth. His body was like steel, his power immense enough to topple mountains. If the Biochemical Demon Soldiers possessed thoughts, facing such a high-attack, high-defense tank in close combat would have plunged them into utter fear and despair.
In less than half an hour, all three hundred Demon Soldiers were annihilated. Wu Changfeng himself accounted for half of them—one punch, one kill; sometimes, one punch took out several.
When the battle concluded and all Biochemical Demon Soldiers lay slain, the original encampment was completely obliterated. Wu Changfeng walked with heavy steps. Each movement produced a clang of metal on metal, like a Transformer.
Wu Changfeng’s body was now completely drenched in green blood, his original silver-white sheen entirely obscured.
"Little Brother, these Demon Soldiers... aren’t much, are they?"
Wang Lan was speechless.
I used to think he was a serious person. Only after getting to know him did I realize this guy isn’t all that proper. You’re a mid-stage Galaxy Stage warrior, and a tank at that; of course, you’d find mere Demon Soldiers weak.
He’s clearly posturing. How can I let him get away with it?
"Well, they are just Demon Soldiers. To the Demon Clan, they’re expendable cannon fodder. The Demon Clan wouldn’t care less how many are killed. Taking half an hour for three hundred of them... what a waste of time." With that, Wang Lan turned and left decisively.
"Battalion Commander, all invading Biochemical Demon Soldiers have been eliminated! Awaiting further instructions!" Ren Star Martial approached Wu Changfeng’s side, saluted, and reported crisply.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"Mm. Right, how many of these Demon Soldiers did you encounter last time?"
"One hundred and fifty," Ren Star Martial replied, looking at Wu Changfeng with puzzlement.
Did his brain turn to muscle when he bulked up? Hasn’t this already been reported? His memory can’t be that bad, can it?
"And how long did it take Wang Lan to kill one hundred and fifty Demon Soldiers?"
"Around... less than a minute."
"..."
Wu Changfeng’s body gradually shrank, soon returning to its original size.
Hmph, what’s there to be proud of? Our combat styles are different. Fast doesn’t necessarily mean strong!
Wu Changfeng felt somewhat indignant. As a top student from Modu City’s Star Martial Academy, he had always been the one showing off in front of others; when had anyone ever stolen his spotlight?
"Report to the Battalion Commander! One hundred soldiers participated in the operation. Twelve are seriously injured, thirty-three lightly injured. No fatalities."
Hearing this, Wu Changfeng exploded, pointing at the mangled remains of a Demon Soldier on the ground. "And *these things* managed to injure our men?"
The surrounding soldiers looked at Wu Changfeng, their eyes filled with silent reproach.
Previously, injured warriors meant a loss of combat strength. Even lightly injured soldiers would need seven to eight days of rest before rejoining a battle. Although the Demon Clan lost three hundred Biochemical Demon Soldiers, they had, in turn, managed to incapacitate fifty soldiers of the Star Martial Army.
Demon Soldiers were mass-produced. To the Demon Clan, their deaths were inconsequential; they could always make more. Thus, trading them to reduce the Star Martial Army’s numbers by fifty was a worthwhile exchange.
Of course, this was assuming an anomaly like Wang Lan wasn’t present.
"Line up, one at a time! One Soul Bead for light injuries, two for serious! Three for those close to death. Soul Beads have a price, but life is priceless. Don’t you dare hide your injuries!"
"Anyone dying? Anyone on the brink of death over here?"
"None? Then the seriously injured, come on in! Two Soul Beads a piece!" Wang Lan called out excitedly, like a hawker drumming up business on a small-town street.
A single Soul Bead not only replenishes Star Power but also allows me to accumulate skill points. What a sweet deal, truly sweet!
"Zhang Xiaofei, Lieutenant, Third Battalion, Martial Arts Corps, seriously injured... That’s two... two..."
"Hold on, don’t speak!" Wang Lan pressed down on Zhang Xiaofei, tearing open his shirt. "I mean, man, you call this a serious injury? Just one Soul Bead, is it worth all this fuss?"
"Young Brother, don’t try to rip me off! I was just grazed by a Demon Soldier’s armor spike. Calling it a serious injury is already stretching it. If there were no Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors here, this would barely count as a light injury!"
"What the hell? You call that a graze? You were pierced from front to back! It went through your lung and nearly got your heart! Near death, that’s three Soul Beads!"
"Have some decency! How can I be near death when I’m this lucid? Besides, even if my lung was pierced, what the hell has that got to do with my heart?"
"The left lung lobe! Plus, this clarity you’re experiencing, there’s a medical term for it: ’terminal lucidity.’ Another three minutes and you’d have been a goner. I’ll start the treatment. Brother Ren, mark down three Soul Beads."
"Alright..."
"Alright, my foot! Old Ren, you can’t help this tyrant... This kid’s a complete skinflint! Can’t you see he’s war profiteering?"
"I can’t see that, but I *can* see you coughing up bloody foam."
"HISS—" Zhang Xiaofei glared angrily at Wang Lan. "You bastard, press any harder and you’ll squeeze all the blood out of me... Damn... Ugh... Ah... that’s... that’s better..."
"Control yourself! Don’t make it sound like a cat in heat. Alright, next!"
"Liao Mingming, left artery damaged, serious injury..."
"Damn it! That last guy had a puncture wound and called it serious, I let it slide. But your throat was cut, and you have the gall to call it a ’serious injury’?"
"I used a Star Martial Skill to seal the wound. For now, at least, my life isn’t in danger."
"Foolish child, you need to listen to the doctor! Just because you say there’s no danger doesn’t make it so. Even mental patients claim they’re not sick! Brother Ren, if someone slashed *your* throat, would you die or not? Near death! Mark down three!"
The treatment room was filled with clamor, and it was even noisier outside.
"Fuck, our Military Department’s Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors are so arrogant; begging them for help is like kowtowing and calling them ’Daddy’. This Wang Lan, though, he’s quick to act. I thought he was a good comrade."
"Damn it, turns out he’s a damn skinflint! My leg fracture, such a minor injury, and he calls it severe? Two Soul Beads! That’s half my monthly quota of four Soul Beads!"
"Be glad. With that injury, in an outside hospital, they’d amputate your leg. Calling it a serious injury isn’t wronging you. I just broke two ribs, and he had the nerve to demand two Soul Beads!"
"I’ve figured it out. This Little Miser Wang doesn’t even have ’light injury’ in his vocabulary. Even if you just scraped your skin, he’d call it a serious injury!"
"Battalion Commander!"
"Good to see you, Battalion Commander!"
"Alright, how are all the brothers holding up?"
"Battalion Commander, the brothers are hurting..."
"Can’t you lot have some backbone? Are there really soldiers in the Martial Arts Corps afraid of pain? Did you sneak your way in here?"
"Our bodies don’t hurt, Battalion Commander, but our hearts do! That Miser Wang is too ruthless with his fees. One treatment, and two or three Soul Beads are gone!"

chapters.title: Chapter 41: On Acting, I’m a Professional
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Chapter 41: On Acting, I’m a Professional
In the Central Command Room, Wu Changfeng looked spirited as he gazed at the multitude of junior officers seated below.
"The plan to lure the enemy was a complete success. Last night, the Demon Clan’s Biochemical Demon Soldiers launched a surprise attack on our command post, and we wiped out all three hundred of them. None of us fell in battle!" Applause erupted.
"But victory is only temporary, and it’s just the beginning. We only thwarted one despicable surprise attack by the Demon Clan; we haven’t yet eliminated them. From this lure-the-enemy plan, I’ve observed several issues, some favorable and some unfavorable.
First, the Demon Clan choosing to launch a sneak attack on our command post implies their Biochemical Demon Soldiers are led by a highly intelligent commander. We already know Biochemical Demon Soldiers lack reasoning and thought. However, their combat strength is formidable. Their ignorance is what makes them fearless. If they were to obey orders, they would be a very terrifying and disciplined elite regiment.
Of course, this also indirectly shows us the Demon Clan’s deficiency in troop strength. If they had enough troops, they wouldn’t have needed to implement a decapitation strike on our command base.
For the Demon Clan, Biochemical Demon Soldiers are expendable. There is absolutely no strategic intent to achieve maximum combat results with minimal cost. Therefore, the Demon Clan’s forces remaining in the trial field are inadequate—even in their own view—to defeat us head-on. This is good news.
Knowing the enemy and ourselves, we will prevail in a hundred battles. We now have a general assessment of the Demon Clan, so next up is to devise tactics. Last night, Chief Fu and I developed an operation plan for this situation. Let’s call it the Plowing Field Plan!"
Wang Lan’s mouth twitched.
What kind of plans were depicted in TV shows? Death Plan, Thunder Plan, Trojan Horse Plan. And you named it Plowing Field Plan? I seriously doubt you bought your education.
"As the name implies, it’s about overturning every corner of the trial field, rooting out those Demon Bastards. The trial field isn’t particularly vast, nor is it small. It spans forty kilometers in length and width, so there aren’t many places where so many people can hide. Teams of five will carry three types of signal flares each. Blue signals safety. Green indicates a situation has been found but no reinforcements are needed. Red means encountering Demon Soldiers and lacking the strength to match, thus requiring reinforcements. Launching red and blue signals simultaneously means Demon Soldiers are in pursuit. Is everyone clear on this?"
"Understood!"
"Each team must send signals every fifteen minutes. If there’s no signal for over half an hour, the battalion will assume they’re dead. Any delay in signaling not caused by accidental factors will result in a court-martial. Is that clear?"
"Understood!"
"Dismissed. Spread the word!"
The meeting ended, but Wang Lan didn’t leave. Wu Changfeng and Fu Qiaoshi looked at Wang Lan curiously, "Young man, what’s the matter?"
Wang Lan took a small notebook out of his pocket, "Wu, a hundred and five Soul Beads in total. I’ll round it down, making it an even hundred. Thank you for your patronage."
"Speaking of this... Brother Wang, that’s not very brotherly of you... Charging so much to treat the brothers’ wounds? Before, you spoke so nicely, offering free treatment to the warriors, only asking for Soul Beads to replenish Star Power. But yesterday, you practically stripped those brothers down to their underwear! Do you feel no remorse? They’re fighting and bleeding for the country, yet you’re peeling off their clothes, you... you..."
"Hey, hey, hey... stop acting, that’s enough! Rein it in. You’re a warrior, one who bleeds but doesn’t shed tears!"
"I’m heartbroken for my brothers. Do you know what they called you last night? Wang the Miser..."
"Wu, do the brothers really say that about me?" Wang Lan’s eyes reddened with shock, a pain sharper than any in his heart, like a sword thrust into Wu Changfeng’s.
No good!
A thought instantly lit up in Wu Changfeng’s mind.
The act was overdone; Wang Lan’s feelings were hurt.
"I never expected... I truly never expected... I didn’t expect you all to see me this way... Last night, to save the brothers’ lives, I didn’t delay even a second. When my Star Power was insufficient, I paid out of my own pocket. In a whole hour, I used up one hundred and twenty Soul Beads. These Soul Beads were all earned with my life on the line. Now, I’m only asking you for a hundred in return, taking a loss of twenty, and I’m still called a skinner... I..."
He gazed up at a 45-degree angle to the starry sky, falling into philosophical contemplation.
"Ah, young man, don’t be angry. The brothers have it tough! Really, it’s not easy to save up Soul Beads. They only get three or four a month, and then they have to stick it out in this godforsaken place for half a year, sometimes a whole year. Look at this environment! If it isn’t desert, it’s an ice field; if not lava, then it’s howling wind. We eat energy bars and compressed biscuits, and drink filtered water. Occasionally, some kind-hearted Trialist is willing to give us some food from outside, and we can’t bear to eat it, hoarding it to share a few bites with everyone on a special day. When you ask for two or three Soul Beads upfront, it’s painful for the brothers... But I also know you have your difficulties. Every single Soul Bead is earned by risking your life to hunt Exotic Beasts. Having you here, not a single brother has perished; I’m elated. They’re just venting, but deep down, they’re incredibly grateful to you. Fu, one hundred and twenty Soul Beads. We can’t let the young man take a loss, right? We’re grown men; we should be generous, not stingy."New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"Oh..."
Wang Lan’s pained expression gradually faded from his face, and he sneered inwardly.
Were all those years I spent acting in Hengdian for nothing? Trying to out-act me? KO!
Fu returned quickly, his face etched with pain as he handed a bag of Soul Beads to Wang Lan. Although these expenses could be reimbursed by the military later, it still hurt to part with them.
Wang Lan gleefully accepted them, choosing not to absorb them on the spot and test their nerves. Suddenly, Wang Lan’s smile vanished, his expression turning serious.
"Wu, there’s something... I’ve been unable to figure out, and I hope you can enlighten me. Your Plowing Field Plan... I just feel... it doesn’t seem very reliable."
"Oh? Let’s hear it!" Wu Changfeng immediately showed surprise, then asked with a smile.
"I remember Third Company only has five hundred men. If these five hundred men are dispersed to dig three feet deep across a trial field of one thousand six hundred square kilometers, with such complex terrain and changeable weather, how long will it take to find them? It’s not that I doubt our brothers’ capabilities, but if the Demon Clan just keeps hiding, or stays underground... I just feel like they won’t be easy to find. Shouldn’t we wait for reinforcements before proceeding with the Plowing Field Plan?"
"Of course they won’t be easy to find. But then, think again: why am I doing this?"
"If it’s not because Wu is being too naive... then it’s..." Wang Lan’s brain rapidly processed the information, and soon his eyes lit up. "The real plan isn’t the Plowing Field Plan, but a tactic to lure the snake out of its hole."
"Oh? What makes you say that?" Wu Changfeng poured two glasses of water, placing one by Wang Lan’s hand.
"Previously, Wu, you mentioned that the Demon Clan doesn’t have enough strength, at least not enough to overpower Third Company. So you’re using this ’digging for sweet potatoes’ method, hoping to flush out the Demon Clan’s forces. But the Demon Clan also knows this, and obviously, they won’t let us find them easily. This stalemate... is unfavorable for the Demon Clan. They have to worry about being found, and also worry about us seeking external assistance. So... if I were the Demon Clan, I would definitely try to destroy the trial field before outside support arrives. And to destroy the trial field, the first step is to destroy Third Company. Are you waiting for them to launch another decapitation operation?"
"Smart! It seems you have a talent for tactics. How about joining the Southeast Military Region in the future? With your capabilities, your talent, and your identity as a medical Star Martial Warrior, you’re bound to become at least a general."
"That... we can talk about the future later. But there’s still something I can’t figure out. Our command post was chosen randomly and temporarily; the Demon Clan shouldn’t know where it is, right? If you want the Demon Clan to launch a decapitation strike, you have to give them a target. By keeping the command post so well hidden, and with such strict security..."
"Hahaha..." Wu Changfeng laughed. "Little brother, it’s about making the real seem false and the false seem real. If we deliberately exposed a flaw for the Demon Clan to see, would they still dare to launch a decapitation strike? What’s needed is to appear unassailable. The more unassailable we appear, the more the Demon Clan will believe it."
"But if there’s no bait on the hook, how will the fish bite?"
"That’s because you haven’t systematically studied tactics and strategy; you’ll understand once you go to college. Never assume the enemy are fools. On the contrary, you should always overestimate their capabilities to develop appropriate countermeasures. Just because I don’t offer them any flaws, does that mean the Demon Clan can’t discover the command post? I believe they have their ways."
「At dawn」
The battle plan commenced. Nearly seventy search teams seemingly dispersed chaotically in all directions, beginning a carpet-style search.
「Meanwhile, in another quiet chamber」
Three people were still seated under dim lighting.
"It’s been two days. We don’t have much time left."
"I estimate that the Star Martial Army’s reinforcements will arrive within four days."
"Four days? How little regard do you have for Jade Country’s army? Paradise Bird promised to win us four days, but we’ll have to halve that time."
"Two days?"
"Correct. By tonight at the latest, a continuous wave of reinforcing troops will enter the trial field, and we’ll be stuck in the middle like dumpling filling."
"Then what do we do..."
"So the plan must start now! Right now!"
"Report! Team Ten has issued a red and blue signal. They’ve spotted traces of the Demon Clan and are in pursuit."
"Report Team Ten’s position!"
The person hurried to the sand table in front of them and placed the Team Ten flag at the location where they had launched the signal flare.
"Report! Team Seventeen has sent a red and blue signal. Traces of Demon Soldiers found, and they are in pursuit."
"Report Team Seventeen’s position."
"Report! Team Eighteen has sent a red and blue signal..."
"Report! Team Nine has sent a red and blue signal..."
Soon, reports came in one after another, and ten teams quickly appeared at various locations on the map.
"The Demon Clan has gone mad, appearing everywhere as if their small squads can pick us off one by one. How naive!" Fu Qiaoshi exclaimed, looking at the scattered flags that nearly covered the entire sand table.
Wang Lan’s brow furrowed, his eyes glinting sharply. "Wu, have all teams report their positions again."
"Alright!" Wu Changfeng, surprisingly, had no objections to the suggestion and promptly gave the order.
"Report, Team Ten’s position confirmed..."
"Report, Team Nineteen’s position confirmed..."
Soon, the new positions of the flags appeared on the sand table. They weren’t too far from their previous locations; the furthest was less than a kilometer away.
But upon seeing the new flag positions, both Fu Qiaoshi and Wu Changfeng’s expressions changed drastically.
"How can this be?"

chapters.title: Chapter 42 Dad’s Milk
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Chapter 42 Dad’s Milk
Though the flags moved only short distances, their direction was exceedingly orderly. If one only looked at a single squad, there would seem to be no issue, but with ten squads all moving away from the Central Command, there could only be one explanation.
"How did the Demon Clan pinpoint the Central Command? And the surveillance team hasn’t reported anything?" Fu Qiaoshi cursed, his face grim.
"Fu, hold your anger for now. Things might not be as we suspect," said Wu.
"Right. I suspect that the Demon Clan still doesn’t know the exact location of our command center. But they are in the process of confirming it..." Wang Lan said in a deep voice, stroking his chin.
"Wang Lan, share your thoughts."
"The Demon Clan squads that were discovered are all on the periphery—about twelve of them, not all. And these squads are chasing the Biochemical Demon Soldiers in a direction away from us."
"Report! Squad 25 has sent out red and blue signals!"
"Report! Squad 3 has sent out red and blue signals!"
"Just as I thought. Squads 3 and 25 are closer to us now; the Demon Clan has successfully narrowed the search area. This indicates they’re using a very effective method to rapidly eliminate possible locations for our command center. If they had already pinpointed our location, all squads would have been drawn away in a very short time."
"Hahaha... The Demon Clan certainly hasn’t disappointed me. They’re smart enough to lock down our location so quickly."
"Report! The Twenty-fourth Squad has escorted a group of Trialists back."
"What? There are still Trialists? Bring Squad 24 in."
"Report!"
"How did you find the Trialists? Where were they discovered?"
"Report, we found them here," the captain said, indicating a position on the sand table. "By the time we found them, they had been starving for many days. According to their account, they were driven to desperation by the Snow Spiders and then, unfortunately, trapped in an ice cave, out of ammunition and provisions. They had lost their signal flares and had been trying to send a distress call, but no one heard them. If we hadn’t scouted that location—right here—they would have starved to death undetected."
"What route did you take on your return?" Wang Lan quickly asked.
The captain of the Twenty-fourth Squad hesitated slightly but soon began to draw on the sand table.
"We passed the Anti-Golden Beast Tribe, crossed the glacier, went through Wind Valley, and circumvented the vine forest..."
"It seems I was right. There’s something wrong with this group of Trialists."
"Oh? How did you figure that out?"
"Isn’t it obvious? The first subsidiary squads discovered just happened to be in the areas along this route. When Squad 24 passed by, those squads were drawn in the opposite direction. Even if they weren’t certain of our command center’s exact location, they made sure the general direction was correct. This group of Trialists is the Demon Clan’s tracking device. And since the squad has come to the command center, the Demon Clan has pinpointed its location."
"Ah?" The captain of Squad 24 went pale upon hearing this, and everything became clear in an instant.
The Demon Clan didn’t know the exact location of the command center, so they had used the Trialists with tracking devices. And he, cheerfully, had brought the Trialists with the tracking device straight to the command center. What was this called during wartime? Treason!
In an instant, the captain’s face turned as black as ink. "Damn it, I’ll kill them myself!"
"Wait! Would it work if we took them away again?" Fu asked anxiously.
"Definitely not. As soon as the tracking stops, the Demon Clan will have fixed the coordinates. Their next plan will be to attack the command center."
"Take out that squad!" Fu Qiaoshi ordered murderously.
"No! First, confirm their identities. What if they’re not truly traitors? What if they don’t even know they’re carrying the Demon Clan’s tracking device?" Wu Changfeng quickly intervened. "We are soldiers of the people, not bandits!"
Wu Changfeng turned and walked outside, Wang Lan swiftly following. In the center of the camp, seven haggard-looking Star Martial Warriors huddled together, trembling. It was unclear what they had endured these past days.
"Your names, your identities, to which faction do you belong?" Wu Changfeng stepped outside and questioned the group of Trialists.
"We belong to the Ninth District Pioneer Corps... we came back last month for rest and reorganization... we..."
"Wu, just take them all out," Wang Lan said flatly, barely glancing at them.
"Why?"
"I’ve seen these guys before. They are the culprits who stole from the Snow Spiders and sparked their rampage. When I last saw them, they were being pursued by the Spider King. With their capabilities, there’s no way they could have survived. The only possibility is that the Demon Clan saved them, or that they *are* Demon Clan."
"No... we’re truly human, we’re not demons... please believe me..."
"Stop right there!"
"ROAR—"
Suddenly, the seven people before them let out a ferocious roar, their bodies twisting and transforming in an instant. Almost in the blink of an eye, they turned into seven fearsome and daunting Demons.
"Kill them!"
Seven low-level transformed Demons, caught within the headquarters of the Star Martial Forces with their identities exposed—their fate was predictable. Any single person present could have killed them alone, let alone over a hundred elite masters. In less than a second, the squad of seven was blasted into nothing but residual fragments.
As the dust settled, everyone looked up at Wu Changfeng, whose eyes also showed gravity.
"The prelude has played out long enough. It’s about time for the main act. All units, be on maximum alert! The Demon Clan might launch a decapitation strike on the command center at any moment. Too bad for them, those Demon Bastards probably don’t know that I’m a Gold Attribute Star Martial Warrior, with a head too tough to be chopped off."
"Yes, sir!"
Three seconds later, a piercing alarm sounded.
"Wang Lan, our medical tasks are in your hands. With you here, even if the Demon Clan has triple our forces, I’m not afraid. Bring up any requests you have, because once the battle starts, I’m afraid I won’t be able to pay attention to you."
"Wu, that puts a lot of pressure on me... As long as there are enough Soul Beads, I promise I can bring our brothers back in one piece, even if they’re only half-alive."
"That’s great! I’ll give you all our stock of Soul Beads. However, it’s not much, so use them sparingly."
"If that’s not enough, don’t we have all those Exotic Beasts?"
"Those are national assets. We can’t touch a single one without the nation’s permission. Does that sound too pedantic? But that’s discipline!"
"I understand, not to take even a needle or thread..." Wang Lan said with a respectful smile. He suddenly stood at attention, saluted Wu Changfeng, and declared, "I guarantee I will complete the mission!"
"I’m counting on you!"
Wang Lan returned to the rear to await orders, his heartstrings suddenly taut.
"Enemy attack! Report! Around three hundred Biochemical Demon Soldiers have been discovered in the canyon due south of headquarters!"
"Only three hundred?" Wu Changfeng tapped his fingers, puzzled.
"Commander, isn’t three hundred a lot? There are only a hundred of us at headquarters..."
"Notify the recon squads. Tell the brothers to stop messing around; it’s time for the main course."
"Yes, sir!"
"Report! Squad Seven has fired a green signal!"
"Report! Squad Nine has sent a green signal!"
"Report! Squad Seventeen has sent a green signal..."
One after another, the reports rang out. The previously quiet primary trial site suddenly erupted into war, the conflict spreading instantly throughout the whole area.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Commander, something’s not right. The paths for our scattered brothers to return for support are all blocked. Not a single squad can make it back! We... we haven’t fallen into a trap, have we?"
"I get it now! Well done, Demon Clan. I thought I had overestimated them, but it turns out I still underestimated them. I was wondering why only three hundred Biochemical Demon Soldiers came for a decapitation strike; so that was their actual plan. This move is brilliant. I’ll have to report this to Command HQ after this is over. The Demon Clan’s commander isn’t an idiot—a stroke of genius, to level the playing field between us. We sent out four hundred brothers to confuse the Demon Clan, and they turned our ruse to their advantage, directly cutting those four hundred brothers off. They’ve long known how many people we have in our camp. They figured out that the command post only has a hundred men, so they sent three hundred. This gives them a three-to-one advantage in numbers, and their actual strength is by no means inferior to ours. The remaining Demon Soldiers only need to stop our scattered brothers from returning, which puts less pressure on them than on us. To eliminate our entire command post with three hundred Biochemical Demon Soldiers—that’s a profitable deal for them."
"Then what do we do?"
"The bayonets are already fixed, what else is there to do but fight? Let’s see if those three hundred Demon Soldiers are enough for us to chew on."
"Commander, are you going to take action?"
"Unless a Demon General shows up, I can’t make a move. Who knows if the Demon Clan is targeting our rear command post? Ren Xingwu!"
"Present!" Ren Xingwu appeared before Wu Changfeng in a flash.
"You take the lead. Bring all members to hold off the Demon Soldiers."
"I guarantee I will complete the mission!"
The battle outside suddenly commenced. Apart from Wu Changfeng and ten personal guards, all the warriors went to the frontlines to block the Biochemical Demon Soldiers. The fighting erupted just outside the command post, less than five hundred meters away.
Wu Changfeng stood atop a hastily constructed watchtower, observing the battlefield through binoculars.
They faced off against three hundred Biochemical Demon Soldiers with just one hundred warriors. Considering these Biochemical Demon Soldiers were specifically engineered for warfare and killing, the pressure was immense, even though all the warriors remaining were elites.
Wang Lan’s heart suddenly tightened. This was a real war.
Damn exciting. Just half a month ago, I still thought I was living in a peaceful era, in a strong and prosperous country. Becoming a Star Martial Warrior indeed meant facing dangers, but those dangers could be managed with caution. Yet, in just half a month, I’ve witnessed a war and am right here on the battlefield, a part of it. Life’s experiences are truly as dreamlike and illusory as they come.
The battle of an entire battalion could hardly be described as a minor skirmish.
The Demon Clan, that nightmare lurking throughout human history, was awakening once more, sharpening its knives as it loomed over human civilization.
"Hurry, hurry—"
A shout came from outside the door; a warrior covered in blood was carried into Wang Lan’s room by two personal guard soldiers.
"Damn it, I’m such a waste... to be the first one down... fuck... fuck..."
"Calm down, there will be plenty of chances to fight back. Tear open the clothes on the wound quickly!"
"AH—"
As Wang Lan’s palm pressed down, the warrior suddenly screamed, "Mommy... gentler... gentler... it hurts!"
"With that form of address, I’ll have to apply more force."
"No, I was wrong! Daddy, Daddy... Can I call you Father, huh? Oh... oh... it’s warm, feels good..."

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Phoenix Form, Take Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chapter 43: Phoenix Form, Take Off
The battle had been raging for less than ten minutes when wounded soldiers began to be sent back. From the moment the first wounded soldier returned to the battlefield, the speed at which casualties were retrieved noticeably increased.
With strong support from the rear, their hearts knew no fear.
The Star Martial Army at the front had realized they had a formidable Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior in their rear. Screw the notion of "minor injuries don’t leave the frontline, major injuries mean facing death with equanimity"! If it affects your ability to fight, withdraw for treatment! Staying on the frontlines with compromised combat effectiveness meant you could be dead within minutes.Thɪs ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Why try to be a hero when you could keep fighting at full strength?
After twenty minutes of continuous fighting, Wang Lan had already successfully treated thirty people without a single death. On the other hand, over twenty Biochemical Demon Soldiers had been slain on the frontlines.
If things continued this way, the scales of victory would completely tip in their favor within an hour.
Everything was perfect except for the high consumption of Soul Beads.
The orderlies shuttling wounded soldiers back and forth watched Wang Lan absorb Soul Bead after Soul Bead to replenish his Star Power, a pang of heartache so intense it almost took their breath away. Most of the current Star Martial Warriors had never experienced a real war.
Even the Martial Arts Corps, renowned as the elite of the elite, had only participated in minor combat missions—mere skirmishes that some wouldn’t even consider a warm-up. At this moment, the orderlies truly understood the essence of the saying, "war is fought with money."
A Soul Bead sells for 80,000 on the open market, and he’s absorbing seven or eight in a minute? Even at the internal buy-back price of 1,000, he’s burning through over 10,000 in just a minute or two.
Extravagant! Inhumanly wealthy!
But no matter how quickly Wang Lan consumed the Soul Beads, the warriors felt nothing but gratitude. To return to the battlefield at full health—what were mere Soul Beads compared to that?
「Another twenty minutes passed.」
The scouting squad, still isolated outside the command center, had yet to secure a supply route. Meanwhile, the scales of battle outside the command center were subtly tilting.
With a three-to-one numerical superiority, the Biochemical Demon Soldiers should have held a decisive advantage, whether in a blitzkrieg or a battle of attrition. Half an hour should have been enough to breach the command center’s defenses, and the entire battle should have been over within an hour.
But why? Why hadn’t the Star Martial Army buckled under the pressure as expected? Why were heavily wounded soldiers, who had retreated from battle, returning to the frontlines full of vigor so quickly?
The Demon Clan commander initially suspected another trap.
Are there far more than a hundred defenders in the command center?
But he quickly dismissed this idea.
He had thoroughly investigated the numbers of the Martial Arts Corps’ Third Battalion; four hundred soldiers were undeniably tied up elsewhere. The Star Martial Army command center definitely held only one hundred men. Therefore, anyone with a bit of sense could arrive at one conclusion.
"There’s a top-tier Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior in the Star Martial Army command center, possibly even a Galaxy Stage Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior."
"What should we do then? Order the Demon General to attack the command center directly?"
"Useless!" the Demon General’s controller shook his head. "Wu Changfeng hasn’t made an appearance, and I’m certain he’s protecting that Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior. It seems our only option is to deploy the Demon General for a direct confrontation. In this situation, we must draw our sword! Let’s see who is stronger—Wu Changfeng or our Demon General!"
"But the Demon General cannot easily join the battle. If it meets with an accident, the Biochemical Demon Soldiers will descend into chaos."
"That rule no longer applies! There are no military laws, no regulations—only life and death, victory and defeat!"
BOOM—
Suddenly, the frontline erupted. The cliff face behind the Biochemical Demon Soldiers exploded with a deafening roar, and a terrifying, five-meter-tall figure appeared before the Star Martial Army.
The lower body of this colossal figure resembled that of a Snow Spider Queen, but its carapace was pitch-black, and its legs were like sharpened blades. Its upper body was like that of a Biochemical Demon Soldier, but three times larger.
The Demon General was incredibly fast. The moment it appeared, it plunged into the battle, and in that single second, it slaughtered at least ten Star Martial Army soldiers.
Against the Demon General’s terrifying speed and immense power, even Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warriors had no means of resistance.
"Bastard—" Wu Changfeng bellowed. In that same instant, his figure transformed into a streak of light as he leaped from the watchtower.
His body swelled rapidly in mid-air. By the time he landed, he had become a giant nearly three meters tall.
His steel-transfigured body granted him not only tremendous strength and defense but also terrifying explosive power and speed.
His landing shook the earth.
With a single leap, he crossed five hundred meters and crashed violently into the rampaging Biochemical Demon General.
"ROAR—" Sensing the threat from above, the Demon General ignored the Star Martial Army soldiers. It raised its head, the armor on its chest instantly glowing red-hot. Opening its maw, it spewed a torrent of blue flames, engulfing Wu Changfeng in a sea of fire.
"Die—"
BOOM—
Although his steel body couldn’t withstand such high temperatures indefinitely, even five-thousand-degree flames needed time to melt steel.
With the force of a falling mountain, he pinned the Demon General beneath him. Raising a fist the size of a pot lid, he began to relentlessly pummel the Demon General’s face. After five or six punches, Wu Changfeng suddenly leaped off the Demon General.
Looking down at his knee, molten iron was trickling down.
The Demon General not only has astounding defense and attack power, but it also emits incredible heat. Its body temperature must be at least three thousand degrees. And fire is the perfect counter to metal.
This is troublesome...
Wu Changfeng thought.
Previous experimental data didn’t indicate the Demon General had fire-attribute abilities, let alone that it could generate such extreme heat.
"ROAR—" The Demon General rose again, letting out a terrifying roar at Wu Changfeng.
The roar snapped Wu Changfeng out of his thoughts. He immediately made a decision, "You all continue to kill the Biochemical Demon Soldiers! I’ll handle this guy one-on-one!"
The moment his words fell, Wu Changfeng’s figure shot forward like a streak of light, crashing into the Demon General. The two then rolled away into the distance, like an intertwined Yin and Yang Tai Chi fish.
"Battalion Commander—" Ren Xingwu exclaimed.
"Old Ren, what do we do?"
"What else can we do? Kill!"
In the rear, Wang Lan suddenly frowned. Nearly thirty seconds had passed without any new wounded being brought back. Before, as soon as one was treated, another would arrive. This sudden half-minute lull was unsettling.
A gap didn’t necessarily mean good news. Besides the slim chance that no one was injured, there was a far more terrifying possibility: fatalities. Sudden deaths, with no chance for rescue.
"Quick, quick! Over here!"
Seconds later, more wounded were brought down. Wang Lan quickly pressed his potent palm onto one soldier’s wound.
"What happened just now? Why were no casualties sent back for thirty seconds?"
"The Demon General appeared! Damn it, it’s too strong! In an instant, more than a dozen of our brothers were gone. Xiao Heizi was right beside me, less than three meters away. But I didn’t even have time to save him... Fuck! His family was counting on him..."
Just as I thought!
"Has the Battalion Commander made his move?"
"The Battalion Commander went to fight the Demon General one-on-one, leaving the rest of the Demon Bastards to us. The battle is incredibly intense."
"All healed! Be careful! Survive!"
"Of course, I’ll survive! Next time, drinks are on me!"
"Quick, healer—Xiao Wu’s almost done for..."
"Fuck, call me Daddy!"
In such a high-stakes situation, everyone’s nerves were stretched taut. Modesty, decorum, respect for hierarchy—all were forgotten. Words flew out unfiltered, anything to vent the pressure.
One hand pressed down on a wound, the other clutched a Soul Bead.
"Where’s his hand? Damn it, where’s his hand?"
"Shit, I was just holding it! Did it fall off?"
"You idiot! I swear I’ll die because of you one of these days! I entrusted you with his hand, and you lost it? You want me to lose your damn life for you next time?"
"Found an arm! Whose is it?"
"Mine! Over here!"
Wang Lan snatched the arm, pressing it firmly against Xiao Wu’s severed stump. He channeled his Star Power, unsure if a severed limb could be perfectly reattached like other injuries.
"Try moving it. Can you use the reattached arm?"
"Of course, I can use it! The moment you pressed it on, I felt my arm come back! I’m off! Going to kill another Demon Bastard and come back!"
Wang Lan became even busier. Previously, he healed one person every seven or eight seconds; now, he practically needed both hands to treat two at once. This indicated the battle outside had reached its most ferocious stage.
The Demon Clan also realized this was their last desperate chance. If the Star Martial Army managed to endure this current assault, the numbers would even out to one-to-one. And in a one-to-one fight, the Star Martial Army held an absolute advantage.
Wang Lan had no time to check his skill points, no time to catch his breath. His ears were filled with the din of battle and the pained groans of the injured. His hands pressed down on gruesome, terrifying wounds.
He lost count of how many he had saved, forgot whether minutes or seconds were passing.
As he sent another treated soldier away, Wang Lan suddenly realized his hands were empty. No more wounded were coming.
"What’s going on?"
"Brother Wang, we’ve held them! We’ve held them! The Demon Bastards no longer have superior numbers. The brothers have started a counterattack; it’s becoming a rout!"
"How’s Wu doing over there?"
"I can’t see that far, but there’s a huge commotion. It sounds like he’s also in a desperate struggle."
Wang Lan quickly focused inward and glanced at his skill points. In the past two days, he had accumulated over 1,800. Without hesitation, he allocated all 1,800 points to his Phoenix Form.
With a righteous expression, Wang Lan stood up. He walked with the swagger of a protagonist in a grand finale, a gait that recognized no kin. Just as he reached the doorway, two figures blocked his path.
"Little brother, where are you going? Something’s off about your expression. You look like a martyr resigned to fate."
"Your eyes are playing tricks on you! Can’t you recognize my majestic stride? Since there are no more wounded needing my treatment, it’s time for me to join the battle."
"Stop joking! You’re just deliriously excited. Have you forgotten you’re a healer?"
"No. I’ve never considered myself just a healer! Although heaven blessed me with medical talent, I still possess the heart of a warrior."
"Sorry, but my mission is to ensure your safety and prevent any actions that might threaten it."
"You can’t stop me," Wang Lan said with a faint smile. "He, remember this saying of mine."
"What is it?"
"Not all healers are the ’Guaranteed Loss’ type."
BOOM—
As his words fell, a radiant Phoenix Tail Flower mark suddenly appeared on Wang Lan’s forehead. The moment the mark materialized, a fierce gust of wind erupted.
He Changzai, stunned as if he were a wooden chicken, stared at the empty space where Wang Lan had been, his mind blank.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Task Completed, Generous Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Chapter 44: Task Completed, Generous Reward
The Demon General before him had transformed into a Magma Beast, its once black shell now a deep dark red, its body enveloped by thick, bright red flames.
Wu Changfeng, clutching his belly, moved to the side. Molten iron trickled down between his fingers, solidifying into bright red clumps of metal once it hit the ground.
Exotic Beasts naturally have an advantage in Star Power. At the same level, their Star Power is several times, or even tens of times, that of a human. Scientists have researched and proposed a conclusion that has never been confirmed: Soul Beads can rapidly absorb and transform Star Power.
Both Exotic Beasts and the Demon Clan possess Soul Beads. These are part of their power, their very essence. Humans, while possessing Star Power and Star Palaces, do not have Soul Beads.
Earlier, Wu Changfeng’s abdomen had been carelessly pierced by a spike on the Demon General’s armor. Blood gushed out, mixing with other fluids as it dripped. Wu Changfeng couldn’t metallize the wound. The wound brought not only intense pain but also impaired his mobility.
And the Demon General before him...
Though seemingly covered in numerous wounds, they were visibly healing at a rapid pace.
The battle behind him had concluded, but Wu Changfeng knew that the true decisive factor, the one that could change the battle’s outcome, lay here. If the Demon General won, none of his comrades behind him would be a match for it. The Elementary Trial Grounds would soon be cleared out, then destroyed and shut down. Therefore, Wu Changfeng could not lose; he not only had to win, he absolutely had to.
Once the mission was clear, the method no longer mattered.
The stabbing pain in his lower abdomen made each breath Wu Changfeng took excruciatingly difficult.
It’s time to set off the fireworks... I wonder if Qin Qin can handle it when she finds out... The kid is still young... When he grows up, I wonder if he’ll even remember me, his old dad...
HEH HEH HEH... A ferocious smile suddenly appeared on Wu Changfeng’s lips as the Demon General charged toward him at breakneck speed.
"Come on!" Wu Changfeng roared to the heavens, his aura soaring. Gazing at the sky, with his sword in hand, he felt like a hero whose ambitions reached the clouds, stirring them in all directions.
BOOM—ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
The Demon General before him was sent flying backward, Wu Changfeng’s ferocious expression frozen in place.
Had he finally steeled himself to be a hero, only to be denied the chance?
"Brother Wu, how are you?" Wang Lan clapped his hands, looking at the fresh blood still dripping from Wu Changfeng’s abdomen.
"Why are you here?" Wu Changfeng exclaimed, his eyes fixed on the Phoenix Tail Flower at Wang Lan’s brow and the blood-red mist around his body that burned like flames.
Phoenix Form! Indeed, it was the Phoenix Form...
Wang Lan rushed forward, placing his hand on Wu Changfeng’s lower abdomen. Surging Star Power flowed, and within merely two seconds, Wu Changfeng’s wound was as good as new. Then, Wang Lan pulled out the Spider King Soul Bead and held it in front of Brother Wu.
"Brother Wu, can this be reimbursed?"
"Tch, it’s just a high-grade Soul Bead. Those aren’t rare in the military. Consider it reimbursed!" Wu Changfeng laughed heartily, snatching the Spider King Soul Bead and instantly reviving to full health.
"Two Galaxy Stage Star Martial Warriors. We’ve got this battle in the bag."
"No, I can only hold out for three minutes. We must finish the battle within three minutes. Brother Wu, I will create an opportunity for you to deliver the killing blow."
"Okay!"
The Demon General, sent flying by an Inch Strength Fist, staggered to its feet. Glaring with blood-red eyes, it let out a heaven-shattering roar.
In Phoenix Form, Wang Lan had once punched the Spider King into oblivion mid-air, but the Demon General before him seemed hardly affected. The gap between the Galaxy Stage and Star Cloud Stage was indeed immense.
「Darkness falls!」
Time was running out for Wang Lan. Once the plan was set, he immediately dashed toward the Demon General, his speed so swift that he left trails of afterimages behind him.
The Demon General, realizing Wang Lan was no easy foe, unleashed flames that swirled around its body, forming a complete cover. Such blistering flames would be unbearable for even Wu Changfeng for more than three seconds.
But before Wang Lan in his Phoenix Form, did these flames even have a temperature?
The Phoenix, a divine bird reborn from fire, considered flames its swimming pool. In Phoenix Form, Wang Lan was immune to all fire-attribute attacks.
Instantly, Wang Lan was in front of the Demon General.
"Inch Strength Fist!"
BOOM—
A ripple of force exploded across the Demon General’s chest, the flames surrounding its body instantly spreading out with the shockwave.
So tough!
Wang Lan’s expression changed drastically.
The Demon General’s armor provided one hundred percent coverage, and its hardness was comparable to high-strength alloys, with a hardness rating of at least eighty.
In an instant, Wang Lan realized that a normal Inch Strength Fist could not breach the Demon General’s defenses.
The Demon General was sent flying once again. Wang Lan had underestimated its defense, while the Demon General had overestimated its own flame protection. It hadn’t expected someone could ignore its Hell Demon Flame and take Wang Lan’s punch head-on.
Its body flew back once more, smashing hard against the cliff face behind it.
Wang Lan swiftly closed in, reaching the Demon General’s chest amidst the scattering debris the instant its body froze.
"Inch Strength Fist, Triple Force!"
Fingertips, knuckles, fist—within an inch, three forces stacked, unleashing triple the power of an Inch Strength Fist.
This was a move Wang Lan was reluctant to use lightly. If he didn’t hold back with Triple Force, his hand bones would instantly shatter from the impact, resulting in a gruesome comminuted fracture.
The immense power of Triple Force finally left a fine crack on the Demon General’s chest carapace.
Wang Lan’s body instantly withdrew and turned, dodging the Demon General’s Mantis Blade, while his left hand launched another lightning-fast punch.
"Triple Force!"
Another strike, successfully hitting the exact same spot.
CRACK—BOOM—
The Demon General’s chest armor finally burst open under the two applications of Triple Force, cracks spreading across its entire chest like a spider web.
"Brother Wu—" Wang Lan roared, darting to the side.
Wu Changfeng’s figure flashed by Wang Lan, nearly brushing against him as he arrived before the Demon General, his arm completely transformed into a lance like those wielded by medieval knights.
A wild, savage charge, coupled with the terrifying penetrating force of the rapidly spinning knight’s lance.
BOOM—
The bone carapace of the Demon General’s chest shattered into pieces. The lance pierced deeply into the Demon Sword’s chest, and the Demon General’s body was utterly crushed against the hard cliff face.
HISS—
The knight’s lance, having pierced the Demon General’s body, erupted instantly. Countless steel needles blossomed inside the Demon General like fireworks.
The Demon General suddenly let out a piercing scream, which lasted for three seconds before its flames extinguished and its body went completely still.
"Slaying a foe beyond your level: Reward 800 experience points, 80 skill points!"
The system’s notification echoed in Wang Lan’s mind, allowing him to finally relax.
The moment the Demon General was killed, the Biochemical Demon Soldiers blocking reinforcements from the Star Martial Army instantly fell into chaos, indiscriminately fighting each other.
The various squads hastily retreated, watching the unexpected turn of events with dumbfounded expressions.
"The Demon General is dead... Did we win?"
"We won!"
The warriors, realizing what had happened, erupted in cheers. Their shouts echoed over the mountains and valleys, reverberating in the sky above the trial grounds.
"Catch!" Wu Changfeng tossed something to Wang Lan with a flick of his hand.
THWACK! Wang Lan looked and saw an egg-sized Soul Bead land in his palm.
"Reimbursed!"
"Hey, Brother Wu, wasn’t this Soul Bead mine to begin with? Even if we teamed up, it should be split fifty-fifty. You’re reimbursing me with my own thing? Have you no shame?"
"What do you mean, ’your thing’? All spoils of war belong to the Ministry of Defense; soldiers are not allowed to keep them privately. This Soul Bead is neither mine nor yours. I’m already breaking regulations by reimbursing you, so what complaints could you possibly have?" Wu Changfeng glared and retorted.
"I’m taking a loss here!"
"Who said war is profitable? War is inherently a losing proposition."
"Not good!" Suddenly, Wang Lan cried out, his face pale.
"What’s wrong?" Wu Changfeng immediately tensed up and quickly looked around, but he found no immediate danger.
"My... my time... is up!"
As he spoke, the Phoenix Tail Flower on Wang Lan’s forehead disappeared. His body instantly collapsed in an incredibly twisted position, as if his soul had been sapped from him.
His face was pressed to the ground, his rear end high in the air. If not for his continuous convulsions, one might have thought he had achieved immortality in that pose.
"Hah! These side effects sure are timely!" Wu Changfeng chuckled, gently picked up Wang Lan, who was sprawled face down with his rear comically in the air. He then slung Wang Lan over his shoulder like a sack of potatoes and turned to leave.
Not long after the battle ended, reinforcements from the Ministry of Defense arrived.
The commander of the Martial Arts Corps, He Jinze, dressed in his military uniform with colonel’s insignia on his shoulders, listened to Wu Changfeng’s report with his hands behind his back.
"Commander, that’s the gist of it. Although we thwarted one of the Demon Clan’s conspiracies, I believe their target isn’t limited to the Elementary Trial Grounds. There may be similar plots in the Advanced Trial Grounds or other trial grounds as well.
"Their plan is strategic. Destroying our trial grounds would sever the foundation for our Star Martial Warriors’ growth. If the plan succeeds, the development of new Star Martial Warriors will be suppressed, the supply of Soul Beads will be obstructed, and humanity’s effective strength will be greatly weakened."
"Hmm! Your speculation is highly likely. After we return, I will submit a risk assessment to the Ministry of Defense and include your conjectures. You’ve done very well this time, thwarting the Demon Clan’s plot with minimal losses. Truly the soldiers I’ve trained!"
"You flatter me, Commander."
"You’re not that modest, from what I know of you! Although the Demon Clan’s plot failed this time, we can’t guarantee that no enemies escaped. We should temporarily close the trial grounds and only reopen them once they’ve been thoroughly cleared."
"Yes!"
"Oh, that Wang Lan... does he really possess the Phoenix Form?"
"Yes!" Wu Changfeng replied with a single word and then fell silent.
"Why? Why don’t you elaborate?"
"I promised him I would keep it a secret!"
"Secret? Nonsense! His file clearly states ’Mother: Wang Ling.’ With those words written so plainly, do you think there’s any point to secrecy?"
Seeing Wu Changfeng’s puzzled look, He Jinze gave a strange laugh. "I’m He Jinze, Imperial Capital Star Martial Academy, class of ’97. Wang Ling was my junior martial sister! And you’re trying to keep secrets from me?"
Eh?

chapters.title: Chapter 45: It feels...not too difficult.
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Chapter 45: It feels...not too difficult.
"Completion of the rescue mission for the primary trial grounds awarded thirty thousand experience points and five hundred skill points."
Wang Lan originally wanted to sleep in a bit longer, but the reminder in his mind woke him up.
After being roused, the negative side effects from using the phoenix form hit Wang Lan like a tsunami.
In an instant, all I wanted was for someone to end my misery quickly.
I’ve realized that the after-effects of the phoenix form are directly proportional to the duration of its use. The first time I used it for five seconds, it took two hours to recover. The second time for thirty seconds, I was utterly listless for three hours.
This time, I used it for three minutes. Although five hours have passed since I fell unconscious, now... I want nothing more than to die.
Time passed indeterminably. As if enduring one brutal torture after another in hell, Wang Lan finally felt a bit less miserable.
Bearing with a splitting headache, he opened up the system to investigate.
First was the character panel—
What a sight, Star Shine Stage 3!
Completing this mission had allowed Wang Lan to evolve straight from Star Shine Stage 1 to Star Shine Stage 3. Both his health and mana had been greatly enhanced, and the changes in his base stats were earth-shattering.
Strength broke past the threshold of twenty points. Agility, defense, and other stats all exceeded fifteen.
What does this mean? The limit of a normal person’s physical fitness is ten, with most people having a physique of six, and those who exercise regularly around seven or eight. Those who manage to reach ten points in physical quality are rare existences, one in ten thousand from ancient times to the present.
As for me, the quality of my physique at this moment exceeds that one-in-ten-thousand benchmark by more than one and a half times. I’ve truly surpassed human limits and reached a non-human level.
In other words, if I were to participate in sports events for ordinary humans, except for technique-based ones, I could easily come in first in all the rest.
The enhancement of his physical attributes was just a bonus. What truly delighted Wang Lan was the enhancement of his Star Power.
Star Shine Stage 3. I’ve completely left my weakling days behind, becoming a core force in the world of Star Martial Warriors. But the problem is, I only awakened as a Star Martial Warrior half a month ago.
Thinking about it, Wang Lan felt a bit carried away.
My skill points were depleted by the phoenix form, and the mission reward was a mere five hundred skill points. Was that a loss? It couldn’t be considered that way. How could I have completed the mission without spending skill points? And without completing the mission, how could I level up? Skill points are like money. Money is a real bastard, but it sure looks good... Ah, whatever! If I run out, I’ll just earn more.
To me, as long as I can level up, spending any amount of skill points is worth it.
Five hundred skill points isn’t too little. After getting out, I can go to the Star Martial Hall to buy and learn a few Star Martial Skills, and my combat power will soar instantly.
The Starlight Stage wasn’t suitable for learning Star Martial Skills; that’s common sense. At the Starlight Stage, one has so little Star Power that they can hardly release even the most basic Star Martial Skills more than a few times, making it rather meaningless.
Besides, I’m not short on money. Why buy low-level Star Martial Skills? If I’m going to learn, I need to learn the impressive ones. And the minimum requirement to learn impressive Star Martial Skills is the Star Shine Stage. Therefore, leveling up is the foundation for my strength growth.
"If you’re awake, stop pretending to sleep." An unfamiliar voice sounded by his ear, so close it felt like the person was sitting right by his bed.
Yet despite being awake for so long, Wang Lan hadn’t noticed anything! In an instant, Wang Lan’s eyes snapped open, and he turned his face nervously to look.
A middle-aged man, who looked to be in his forties. But extremely handsome, his face was both masculine and beautiful, with stubble that made him especially sexy.
Such older men can be quite attractive to young girls, but for male creatures like me... completely immune. MISS!
Wang Lan’s gaze moved from the man’s face and then noticed the shoulder badge.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Whoa, a colonel! That’s a pretty high-ranking officer! In Jade Country, military officers are divided into three classes and twelve ranks. Although colonels are considered mid-ranking officers, the higher the rank, the fewer their number. In a regular army, a colonel could be a brigade commander or even a deputy division commander. Star Martial Warrior military ranks tend to be one level higher... so this person in front of me must be a regimental commander, right?
"My name is He Jinze, commander of the Martial Arts Corps of the Southeast Military Region’s Star Martial Special Combat Brigade!"
Just as I thought!
"Now, I have a question for you. How did you learn the phoenix form?"
He Jinze was holding a pen, with a notebook already open in front of him. He looked at Wang Lan, full of expectation, ready to take notes.
This question exploded like a bomb in my mind. He wasn’t asking where I learned it from, nor how I managed to learn it, but how I *came to master* it.
That left Wang Lan somewhat puzzled about the other party’s intentions.
"You don’t need to feel any psychological burden. Your phoenix form was acquired legitimately, and no one will object to it. Plus, you don’t have to worry; nobody would dare to covet the phoenix form you possess," he said, which counted as a promise to Wang Lan.
Nobody would dare, not that they didn’t want to. Even if there were those who had ideas, they wouldn’t have the guts. This made me curious about what Wu Changfeng had previously said about Eld Di’s lineage, or the possible forces behind my mother.
"As far as I know, you learned the phoenix form shortly after awakening your Star Martial Warrior talents, right? The conditions for learning the phoenix form are incredibly stringent. Even your mother managed to master it only by a stroke of good fortune at the Star Cloud Stage."
"She was already a miracle. Yet, to my surprise, you turned out to be even more miraculous than your mother. It’s simply... simply..." He Jinze really wanted to describe it as ’freakish,’ but felt that the term wasn’t quite appropriate, so he ultimately kept quiet and just stared intensely at Wang Lan.
"Colonel He..."
"Your mom and I were classmates and had a good relationship, so you can call me Uncle He. I’m not an outsider, so don’t be so formal."
"Uncle He? What exactly happened to my mom? Is she dead or missing?"
"Don’t ask me about that. I don’t know! And even if I did, I couldn’t tell you."
"Okay. Well, my mom left me a Soul Bead, which was in my aunt’s possession. After I awakened as a Star Martial Warrior, it was given to me. The phoenix form was imprinted in the Soul Bead, and that’s how I learned it."
"..."
He Jinze’s eyes suddenly bulged as big as a bull’s.
Imprinting a Star Martial Skill into a Soul Bead wasn’t incomprehensible. To ordinary people, it might seem like highly advanced technology. However, for someone like He Jinze, who had access to a vast amount of confidential information, it wasn’t particularly remarkable. Spirit Engraving was a subject taught at the university, instructing how to record Star Martial Skills or some memory images into Soul Beads.
But... you just learned it? What kind of explanation is that? Is that even an explanation? I’m asking how you learned it, and you just fob me off with ’I just learned it’? It’s like someone asks you how to solve a math problem, asking for the method, and you just blurt out the answer to dismiss them?
"How did you learn it?" He Jinze felt his heart couldn’t take much more.
"I don’t know. After I absorbed the Soul Bead, the method to cultivate the phoenix form was imprinted in my mind. I just tried it out according to the method, and that’s how I learned it."
"It felt... not too difficult," Wang Lan remarked.
Not too difficult... not too difficult... too difficult... difficult...
"SNAP!"
The pen broke, the crisp sound surprisingly melodious.
He Jinze’s face gave nothing away. Even the smile that hung on his lips was as refreshing as a cool breeze. But... the pen in his hand had snapped, and ink spilled all over Wang Lan’s pristine white sheets.
"Sorry... The quality of this pen isn’t great," He Jinze said awkwardly as he came back to his senses.
Wang Lan’s mouth twitched slightly.
"Alright, rest up. The Corps will commend you for your part in thwarting the Demon Clan’s plot this time. You’re still a student, so your military achievements will be recorded in your file. I heard you’re doing well in your studies?"
"Average, I guess," Wang Lan replied modestly.
He Jinze felt an itch in his hand. Looking at Wang Lan’s innocent expression and his rather cute face, he didn’t know why, but he just felt like smacking him. Average? First in the entire city is ’average’? Thinking of his own troublesome son, he decided it was better to go home and discipline him instead.
"Uncle He!" Wang Lan called out, seeing He Jinze getting up to leave.
"I think I’ve rested enough... Um... When can I leave?"
"You can leave now!"
"Then I’ll go now. I came here with my companions. We only stayed behind to assist the Star Martial Army. They must be worried sick."
"No problem. Just wait here for a moment; I’ll get you a release form."
Not long after He Jinze left, Wu Changfeng entered the room with a beaming smile.
"Wang Lan, how on earth did you do it?"
"Do what?" Wang Lan replied, utterly confused.
"Making our Corps Commander as furious as a charred coal briquette! I haven’t seen that in years. You’re something else."
"I... Did I make him angry? You must be mistaken. Our exchange was very pleasant. I answered all his questions fully and frankly."
"Alright, alright. I heard you’re leaving?"
"Ah, yes. Now that everything’s sorted, it’s time to go. Otherwise, my friends will worry," Wang Lan said.
"Yeah, there’s nothing else for you here. Here, take this. You’re allowed to take it out." Wu Changfeng said, handing a backpack to Wang Lan. Wang Lan opened it to find a layer of Soul Beads inside.
"There aren’t many Soul Beads, just a hundred. But they’re a token from the brothers; it’s their way of showing their appreciation."
"This... It’s really too much," Wang Lan said, feigning reluctance.
"Are you going to refuse? Well, then I..."
"Then it would be disrespectful of me to decline! Thank you, Wu, and thanks to all the Soldiers..." Wang Lan hastily interrupted.
"You... still the same old opportunist. How about coming to the Southeast Military Region in the future?"
"Let’s talk about the future when it comes. I’ll consider it when I’m about to graduate from university. No point in thinking about it now."
"Fair enough!"
「Outside the trial grounds, the atmosphere was somewhat desolate.」
Because the trial grounds were closed, Star Martial Warriors had stopped visiting, leading to the successive shutdown of the shops at the entrance.
Where once the trial grounds’ entrance teemed with life, now only three cars were quietly parked at the gate.
Jiang Xinyu, dressed in a sexy T-shirt and hot pants and wearing a grayish-white sun hat, stood under the scorching sun, her arms folded, quietly looking at the firmly closed gates of the trial grounds.
A breeze blew by, lifting the long hair beside Jiang Xinyu’s ears.
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu sat in the shade of a tree nearby, each holding a roasted chicken wing sprinkled with cumin.
"Xinyu, the chicken wings are ready. Want to have some?" Xu Xiangwen called out.
"No thanks!" Jiang Xinyu replied coldly.
