This program is produced by Jiang Brand Entertainment and brought to you by..."
The host rattled off several hundred words of advertisements in under a minute.
"Alright, let’s turn our cameras to the backstage preparation area. Tonight, three rounds of duels will take place, producing three champions who will advance to challenge in the next round of the Star Martial Warrior Competition.
Behold the heavens, where the four winds stir the clouds! With sword in hand, who in this world is the true hero? Let’s eagerly await who can stand undefeated on this stage and become the champion of our third season’s Star Martial Warrior Competition!
Please welcome our first-round contestants: ’Swift-Blade Octo-Arm’ Hu Qing, and our very own ’Iron Mountain Kong’ Chang Shuangyue!"
Amidst the stirring background music, Hu Qing stepped into the arena, his expression grave.
This battle, he could not lose!
Chang Shuangyue was a powerful Physical Shield Type Warrior, his defense and strength unparalleled. Normally, Star Martial Warriors who emphasize defense and strength usually have speed as a shortcoming. Chang Shuangyue, however, seemed to have no such weakness.
His punching speed only seemed slow because it was overshadowed by his astonishing defense and strength. In reality, his fist speed was not inferior to any other contestant in this competition. Even Hu Qing’s renowned speed was only marginally faster than Chang Shuangyue’s.
Chang Shuangyue’s Star Martial Art talent seemed to be his own physique. When he activated his Star Martial Skill, his skin would turn red. In this Red Skin Mode, his physical defense was monstrously strong.
Wang Lan had personally witnessed a match where a wind-attribute Star Martial Warrior used slicing attacks, attempting to breach his defense. But in the end, even the sharpest wind-attribute attacks couldn’t scratch his skin.
Star Martial Warriors with physical-type talents also form a large category. Some undergo partial Beastification when using their Star Martial Skills. Whether this ability stems from activating some primal, beastly part of human genes or something else entirely, biologists have yet to explain.
In Wang Lan’s view, this was an opponent who, so far, hadn’t revealed any weaknesses. Hu Qing’s weakness, on the other hand, Wang Lan had already identified.
"In a match, surrendering, being knocked down, or being knocked out of the ring all count as a loss. I must reiterate: victory and defeat are common in battle. Do not stubbornly persist out of mere pride. Do both contestants understand?"
"Understood."
"Stop nagging!"
"Then, cameras in position! Barrier up! Match, begin!"
The instant the whistle blew, Hu Qing surprisingly deviated from his usual style. Instead of instantly closing in on his opponent, he suddenly slammed his hands to the ground.
In an instant, countless concrete spikes erupted densely from the stage.
"Holy crap, I had no idea Hu Qing was an Earth Attribute Star Martial Warrior! I always thought he was a close-combat specialist."
"Don’t say you didn’t know; I didn’t know either. It seems like since the competition started, Hu Qing hasn’t used any Earth Attribute Star Martial Skills, right?"
"Didn’t you two watch the episode before last? In the battle Hu Qing barely won, he turned the tide with an Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill. His opponent from that match must have felt incredibly wronged. Just when he thought victory was in his grasp, Hu Qing caught him off guard with a sudden Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill, causing him to make a mistake and fall out of the ring.
If his opponent hadn’t made that mistake, Hu Qing might not have even made it into the top thirteen, let alone be competing for the top seven now."Follow current novᴇls on
The stage was made of concrete, so the emerging spikes were naturally concrete spikes. How could their hardness compare to ordinary earthen spikes?
But these concrete spikes were like tofu under Chang Shuangyue’s fists, shattering with a light touch and exploding with a gentle squeeze.
A forest of countless spikes surrounded Chang Shuangyue. Suddenly, he activated his Red Skin Mode and charged at Hu Qing like a tank.
The resulting dust cloud obscured vision like a dense fog. Not just the audience, even the host closest to the stage couldn’t clearly see what was happening inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 78: That... I’m in a hurry.
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78: That... I’m in a hurry.
A plume of thick smoke, like a dragon, burst from the dust, retreating to the edge of the arena.
Chang Shuangyue’s skin had turned crimson, his muscles swelling as if inflated. His face was contorted in ferocity, veins bulging.
Dust filled the arena stage, where Chang Shuangyue’s ruthless eyes coldly stared into the swirling motes.
Suddenly, a cyan silhouette shot out from the top of the dust cloud. Hu Qing’s slender form became a streak of light, piercing through the dust and instantly appearing above Chang Shuangyue.
Hu Qing’s entire arm was now covered in a layer of grayish-white rock.
The rock covering his arm, while providing protection, also increased the power of his fist. However, this type of enhancement wasn’t particularly effective. How could a layer of rock, no matter how thick, compare to the metal armor of a Gold Attribute Star Martial Warrior?
Hu Qing descended from the sky, his fist viciously striking Chang Shuangyue’s chest.
THUD—
A muffled sound echoed as a ripple, visible to the naked eye, instantly spread out from Hu Qing’s fist.
Wang Lan’s eyes lit up at the sight.
"Gravity Fist!"
"It’s definitely Gravity Fist! Hu Qing really hid his strength well, mastering such an advanced application of Earth Attribute Star Martial Skills." Backstage, the expressions of the four remaining competitors filled with astonishment.
The Earth Attribute was weaker in both defense and offense compared to the Gold Attribute, but it possessed one characteristic the Gold Attribute lacked: control over the Law of Gravity. Any object with mass should possess gravitational force; the greater the mass, the stronger the force.
Yet, in the world of Star Martial Warriors, this principle was particularly special. Logically, metal has a much greater mass than earth, yet paradoxically, only the Earth Attribute could derive control over gravity and manifest it as the Gravity Fist. Currently, there is no precedent for the Gold Attribute to derive control over gravity.
If Hu Qing could use the Gravity Fist, his damage output would exceed the limits of common sense. Destroying a tank with a single punch would no longer be an impossibility.
BOOM—
With a colossal impact from Hu Qing’s Gravity Fist, Chang Shuangyue was thrown backward, crashing onto the arena. The dust beneath him billowed up once more.
"GRAAAH—" The grayish rock covering Hu Qing’s arm suddenly turned an even deeper cyan, as Spirit Power Fluctuations surged wildly from his body.
"BOOM—"
Another loud BOOM, and under a ripple of air, the concrete arena beneath Chang Shuangyue shattered and cracked. The entire section of the stage collapsed under the force of Hu Qing’s fist.
The audience present gaped in shock.
Smashing a five-meter-wide crater into the concrete arena... just how much force did that punch carry?
Not only the audience but also the judges and the host, fell into a brief, stunned silence.
The viewers watching the live broadcast were the first to react.
"Holy moly, Hu Qing is truly a wolf in sheep’s clothing, isn’t he?"
"Let me calculate... the concrete arena is one meter thick, and its hardness is... what was it again?"
"Stop kidding, commenter above! Smashing such a huge hole in the concrete arena? That’s definitely rocket-launcher level power!"
"Exactly! That punch wouldn’t just flatten a person; even a tank would be turned into a pancake!"
"If that punch hit me, I swear I’d become one with the good earth."
"Flattened into a paste, the kind you can’t scrape off."
The live broadcast’s comment section exploded.
Hu Qing, drenched in sweat and panting, climbed off Chang Shuangyue. Looking down at the motionless Chang Shuangyue, Hu Qing revealed a victorious smile.
"I told you I’d win." Hu Qing turned and gave the host a meaningful look.
"Ahem..." The host cleared his throat. "Absolutely shocking! Who would have expected contestant Hu Qing to hide such a powerful Star Martial Skill? At the most critical moment, he delivered a stunning match! Chang Shuangyue is down and hasn’t moved. I hereby announce... Wait! Contestant Chang Shuangyue is getting back up!"
"What?" Hu Qing whirled around. Indeed, Chang Shuangyue was slowly rising, his eyes bloodshot.
"Damn it, is he even human?"
"I thought it was a miracle he wasn’t flattened, but this monster can still stand? I suggest we take him to the Scientific Research Institute immediately for dissection and study!"
"Are you kidding? The academicians from the Scientific Research Institute are already on their way!"
How... is this possible...
Hu Qing stared in disbelief at Chang Shuangyue, who was once again standing before him.
That was the Gravity Fist, the Gravity Fist he’d unleashed with all his might! With that punch, he had once killed an Exotic Beast leader at the Star Cloud Stage.
Even an armored tank couldn’t withstand that punch!
"Hu Qing, surrender quickly! You’re out of Star Power!" Wang Lan suddenly shouted from backstage.
"No! I can’t surrender! I can’t lose!" Hu Qing snapped back to reality, barely mustering his Star Power. His arm once again flashed with a cyan light.
But this time, he gathered his Star Power too slowly—agonizingly slow, slower even than someone who had just awakened their Star Martial Talent.
Before he could fully execute his Star Martial Skill, Chang Shuangyue raised a hand and viciously slapped at Hu Qing’s cheek.
Hu Qing’s expression changed. He was about to dodge when a sudden, sharp pain shot through his foot, causing his body to freeze for a second.
BANG—
Chang Shuangyue’s hand viciously struck Hu Qing’s face, sending him flying backward like a swatted insect.
He hit the ground and rolled for over ten meters before coming to a halt.
His mind was a blur. Hu Qing struggled to clear his head as consciousness slowly returned. Just as he was about to get up, Chang Shuangyue was already beside him.
A ferocious sneer on his face, Chang Shuangyue stomped on Hu Qing’s back.Follow current novels on
"AAARGH—"
Chang Shuangyue instantly raised his massive fist and hammered it down onto the back of Hu Qing’s head.
BOOM—
With another loud BOOM, Hu Qing’s face slammed hard against the concrete floor. The floor cracked beneath him as the brutal impact instantly plunged Hu Qing into unconsciousness.
"Hu Qing has lost!"
Backstage, Xing Feng crossed his arms and sighed deeply. "Hu Qing had the strength to contend for the championship. Unfortunately, he encountered Chang Shuangyue, that monster."
"Yeah, to withstand such a powerful Gravity Fist... Is he even human?"
Everyone had assumed Chang Shuangyue would stop after that punch, but unexpectedly, he swung his fist again.
BOOM—
This punch jolted Hu Qing from unconsciousness. But it was merely a flicker of awareness; his consciousness sank even deeper into obscurity.
"Chang Shuangyue, what are you doing? You’ve already won!" Wang Lan shouted, leaping up from backstage.
"Won? This guy hasn’t admitted defeat, has he? As long as he hasn’t conceded, I’ll keep hitting."
With one foot on Hu Qing’s back, Chang Shuangyue relentlessly rained punches down on the back of Hu Qing’s head, one after another, without a moment’s hesitation.
The bloody scene made many in the audience turn their faces away, unable to bear watching.
Hu Qing’s face was now a bloody, unrecognizable mess, the concrete beneath him stained crimson.
His consciousness seemed to drift into an endless descent. The last image that formed in his mind was his sister’s once joyful, lovely face.
Feifei... I’m sorry... Your brother lost...
"Stop it! Are you trying to kill him?" Wang Lan shouted again.
"Contestant Chang Shuangyue, please stop!" The host, finally reacting, rushed to intervene.
Yet Chang Shuangyue still held his fist high, poised to strike.
"If contestant Chang Shuangyue continues to attack contestant Hu Qing, your qualification to compete will be revoked!"
The fist froze, hovering inches above Hu Qing’s head.
The entire scene was clearly transmitted to every viewer watching the broadcast. However, the camera used a long shot, so the audience wasn’t shown the gruesome details.
But even without seeing the specifics, they were terrified by Chang Shuangyue’s brutality.
Each punch resonated throughout the venue, and every audible THUD seemed to strike at the viewers’ hearts.
"That’s too cruel..."
"But it’s very real, isn’t it? This is a true battle between Star Martial Warriors—striking hard, showing no mercy, eliminating the enemy without giving them any chance to turn the tables."
"But this is a competition! Is he really going to kill someone?"
"Hu Qing was clearly unconscious after the first of those follow-up punches. Moreover, none of those blows were necessary. By the time Chang Shuangyue stepped on Hu Qing’s back, Hu Qing had already lost. According to the rules, in a real combat scenario, Hu Qing would be considered dead. So Chang Shuangyue had no reason to be so vicious."
"But what Chang Shuangyue did isn’t technically against the rules. He’s just too ruthless. Even if he wins the championship, he’ll only be seen as a villain."
"I feel so sorry for Hu Qing... He’s so thin—"
"To the commenter above, I’m pitiful too, even thinner than Hu Qing! Seeking a sugar parent!"
Hu Qing was carried away. Wang Lan quickly rushed out from backstage to reach him.
When Wang Lan saw Hu Qing, he could hardly recognize him. Hu Qing looked like a bloody heap of flesh.
"Contestant Wolf, please step aside! We need to get him to a Medical Star Martial Warrior for treatment immediately. He’s severely injured; any further delay and it’ll be too late!"
"I’m also a Medical Star Martial Warrior." Wang Lan pressed his hand onto Hu Qing’s face. He couldn’t worry about causing more pain now; survival was paramount.
Hu Qing’s fatal injuries were to his head. Chang Shuangyue’s relentless punches had fractured his skull. If not for a Star Martial Warrior’s superhuman vitality, Hu Qing would already be dead.
As Wang Lan’s Star Power surged, Hu Qing’s mangled features rapidly began to reform. The shattered skull knitted back together, and even the severely damaged brain tissue quickly healed under the influence of the Star Power.
When it came to Medical Star Martial Techniques, Wang Lan’s healing abilities were undeniably on a cheat-like, BUG level.
In just over ten seconds, Hu Qing looked much better, aside from being covered in blood. However, while the fatal head injury was being addressed, his body still bore numerous other wounds.
Just as Wang Lan was about to continue the treatment, an announcement boomed from the main stage.
"Contestant Wolf and Contestant Wu Xiao, please come to the stage—"
"Hu Qing, wait for me. I’ll be right back." Not knowing if Hu Qing could even hear him, Wang Lan hurriedly ran backstage, washed his hands, and then rushed to the stage.
"Should we take him to the medical room?"
"Yes, let’s get him there... He’s covered in blood; he needs to be cleaned up at the very least."
Amidst the cheers of the crowd and the intense BGM, Wang Lan walked onto the stage to face Wu Xiao.
"Dear audience members! The second match of our top-seven contest is about to begin! I know you’ve all been eagerly awaiting this, haven’t you? That’s right! Our second match features the most popular and mysterious contestant of this third season’s Star Martial Contest—Wolf! He became famous worldwide after a stunning performance in the preliminaries..."
"Ahem... Host, could you please speed things up? I’m on a tight schedule," Wang Lan interjected with a light cough, interrupting the host’s enthusiastic speech.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: It’s really helpless to meet someone who cheats
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: It’s really helpless to meet someone who cheats
This line, when broadcasted live, reached the ears of every audience in front of their TVs and computer screens.
"I’m in a hurry? Impressive! Although there’s not a single domineering line, why does it sound so domineering?"
"Right now, I really want to interview Wolf. How did you manage to say that line so sincerely and politely?"
"Is that sincere? Clearly, Wolf is getting cocky, even starting to make sweeping attacks. What does the other side, Wu Xiao, feel when he hears this?"
"Right, you said Jin Cheng had poor decorum before, but now it seems Wolf’s decorum is just as bad; both are wildly arrogant."
"The two commenters above who know nothing, Wolf and Hu Qing are friends, okay? Hu Qing got seriously injured; didn’t you see Wolf rush out directly from backstage? Now that Hu Qing has gone for emergency treatment, Wolf is definitely very worried."
"Rescue is the doctor’s job. The organizers have Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors. Even if Wolf is worried, it’s of no use, right? Perhaps what he said was a bit thoughtless. Even if you’re worried, shouldn’t you be mindful of the occasion?"
"Um... Wolf, do you have something important?" Mr. Qin, one of the judges, asked indifferently from the stage.
"Just now backstage, I only gave Hu Qing preliminary treatment to stabilize his life, but to heal his injuries, I still need to continue the rescue. My previous statement was thoughtless, and I ask Wu Xiao to forgive me."
Wu Xiao’s mouth twitched.
Is the problem now about forgiving or not? You really consider me a nobody in your heart, don’t you? Do you think you can beat me if you’re in a hurry? I’m a peak Star Shine Stage all-rounder, alright? Although I’m not strong against the weak, I’m not weak against the strong either. Otherwise, how could I have made it to the top seven? Aren’t you underestimating me too much? So you think you can finish me off in a flash, huh? Fine, later on I want to see how you ’hurry’!
"What? You are... a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior?" Mr. Xiaobao, a judge, suddenly stood up.
"Yes," Wang Lan said indifferently, "Can we start now?"
"Let’s start!" Director Min’s voice suddenly rang out over the public address system.
"Begin!" The host immediately said upon receiving the instructions.
But the moment the host announced the start, Wang Lan’s body instantly turned into a beam of light and shot towards Wu Xiao on the opposite side.
Wu Xiao lightly stomped the ground, and in an instant, the arena’s surface was covered with a dense, interlaced arrangement of cement spikes.
The same scene had also occurred during Hu Qing’s match.
Earth Attribute Star Martial Warriors changing the terrain to restrict their opponents was their standard opening move in a duel. Therefore, nine out of ten Earth Attribute Star Martial Warriors would adopt the same approach at the moment of attacking.
An old routine isn’t necessarily bad; it’s about how well it’s executed.
At least Wang Lan is an agile warrior, and this move can effectively limit his mobility.
But... didn’t we just hear Wang Lan admit he’s a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior? Is he a support-type? Since when did support start dealing damage?
In an instant, the bullet comments flew.
"This is a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior? This is the most unconventional Medical Attribute I’ve ever seen, right?"
"Bragging, right? Doesn’t look like a healer at all."
"Hey, commenter above, watch your words! Healers can be formidable too! Are you looking down on my Tauren warrior?"
"I don’t think it’s fake; there’s no need for that. Wolf entered anonymously, so there’s no benefit in deceiving us."
"What kind of Medical Attribute is this? He’s totally an agile warrior. The Medical Attribute is just incidental."
"You ask me what kind of Medical Attribute this is? I’ll tell you now!"
"If the shooter can’t kill someone, the healer does."
"If the tank can’t hold on, the healer withstands!"
"If the DPS can’t destroy a target, the healer destroys it!"
"In one sentence, what teammates can do, the healer can do. What teammates can’t do, the healer has to do even more. After all, he’s your dad."
"Damn it, can you stop the bullet comments? This is the final battle; Wolf is about to one-shot him... miss one frame and believe it or not, I’ll hunt you down through the internet cable!"
"Then turn off the bullet comments!"
Online, the chat exploded in an instant. At the competition venue, Wang Lan’s hands, wielding Flame Swords, crossed like cutting machines, sweeping across all the protruding spikes as if they were weeds, clearing a large swath.
No matter how hard Wu Xiao pushed his Star Power to grow the spikes, Wang Lan’s pace didn’t change in the slightest.
Wang Lan’s speed grew faster and faster, and the distance... also grew shorter and shorter.
However, standing in place, Wu Xiao’s face showed no fear as Wang Lan approached. Under his lowered face, a strange, cold smile tugged at his lips.
You think only Hu Qing knows how to hide things?
Suddenly, Wu Xiao lifted his head, and Star Power surged around his body.
"Water Sword Attack!"
A bright stream of water shot out of Wu Xiao’s mouth, so fast it surpassed vision.
The moment that flash of white light appeared, it had already reached Wang Lan’s face.
Many ordinary people would think, water, what power could it have? Water Attribute Star Martial Warriors are either gentle girls or warm-hearted guys, with soft personalities and gentle skills.
But those who really witness a true Water Attribute Star Martial Warrior using Star Martial Skills would realize how absurd their past notions were.
Water Attribute women are very gentle, and Water Attribute men are also very warm. But to say Water Attribute Star Martial Skills lack attack potency? Most who thought that way are already dead.
Water can change its form and its properties. Water possesses immense, majestic power as well as terrifying impact force. The speed of water can be limitless. As long as your strength has no upper bound, you can endlessly accelerate water.
No one knew Wu Xiao had both Earth and Water Attributes; he had always used only his Earth Attribute from beginning to end.
No one knew how fast the Water Sword he suddenly unleashed was. At least, it was faster than the speed of sound.
Therefore, Wang Lan was pierced through the chest by the Water Sword in an instant.
"AHHH!"
"Someone’s dead!"
"AHHH!"
Whether in the stands or in front of their televisions, everyone let out a scream. But just an instant later, they were horrified to discover there were now two Wolfs in the arena.
As one figure was pierced through the chest, another had already dashed two meters away.
"What?" Wu Xiao was astonished.
How could you dodge such a sudden Water Sword attack?
"Star Cloud Dance? Wolf has used the Star Cloud Dance to avoid Wu Xiao’s hidden trump card! Huh, why have all the judges stood up? Why would they stand up? Was there something unbelievable about that last scene?"
But the judges, as if they hadn’t heard the host’s comments, were staring with shock at Wang Lan, who was still rapidly closing the distance to Wu Xiao without any change in momentum.
"Earth Thorn!"
In an instant, countless tiny Earth Spikes appeared before Wang Lan, forming a thorn wall in an attempt to block his advance.
In the blink of an eye, Wang Lan’s hands brandished his Flame Sword, slashing through the thorn wall.
"Water Sword!"
As Wang Lan cut through the thorn wall, the Water Sword came rushing at him again. And for the second time, Wang Lan successfully avoided the Water Sword’s attack with Star Cloud Dance.Follow current novᴇls on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Impossible, how is this possible? He... he doesn’t need time to switch between Star Martial Skills? How could there be no interval at all, instantly completing the switch? Those are two different Star Martial Skills! One is a Form Changing Star Martial Skill, the other an Attribute Changing Star Martial Skill. The methods to control Star Power for them are as different as heaven and earth; how could he instantly complete the switch? You... you’re defying science—
But while this thought was still crystallizing in his mind, Wang Lan appeared in front of Wu Xiao in an elegantly flowing manner, his palm stopping right beside Wu Xiao’s neck.
The host looked up in amazement at the match timer.
The digits were frozen at thirty seconds!
A battle in the Top Seven Competition, resolved in just thirty seconds of fighting...
How... how is today’s recording supposed to continue? There were only three matches today; the first took five minutes, which was already considered extremely fast. The expectation was that the second match, Wang Lan’s duel, would last a bit longer. After all, with Wang Lan’s popularity, the audience would enjoy a longer fight. But you, ending the fight in thirty seconds, are you even a man?
"I’m sorry, I’m really in a rush," Wang Lan apologized sincerely, even bowing slightly.
With a flash, he had disappeared from sight.
"Where’s Hu Qing?"
"We were cleaning him up when he woke up and walked out. He seemed alright, so I didn’t stop him."
"Understood." Wang Lan turned and walked towards the exit of the TV studio.
"It was indeed a match that defied expectations. The outcome came too quickly, too suddenly... truly hard to believe. Wu Xiao, what’s your take on this match?"
With limited time, the host resorted to stalling tactics. Otherwise, the hour-long Top Seven Competition would truly end in just twenty minutes.
"I’m completely convinced of Wolf’s strength. I didn’t expect that my trump card, which I had hidden until now, would be utterly ineffective against Wolf. Wolf’s dodging and movement technique were simply unfathomable. So, there is no feeling of defeat in losing to such an opponent; I feel rather fulfilled. I still lack in many areas."
"Wolf’s strength is indeed there for all to see. Mr. Xiaobao, Mr. Qin, I saw you both jump up in surprise just now. May I ask what you saw? I think both the audience here and those watching from elsewhere are filled with curiosity."
"Ahem..."
"I don’t know how to put this, or maybe what I say will just come across as a joke. This thing that shouldn’t have happened... but it did happen right before our eyes," Mr. Qin said, his expression still full of disbelief.
"By all accounts, under normal circumstances, Wolf should have lost."
"WOW!"
Those words instantly stirred up a storm.
"Wu Xiao’s tactics weren’t flawed. His strategy, strength, and timing were all very precise. He used his Earth Attribute to lull Wolf into complacency, then unexpectedly struck a heavy blow with a rapid Water Sword. Against anyone else, Wu Xiao’s strike would have surely worked. But no one can understand why it didn’t work on Wolf."
"This... We still don’t understand. Mr. Qin, could you explain a bit more... clearly?"
"It involves a common-sense fact: there’s a delay when switching between two different Star Martial Skills. It’s like switching modes; there needs to be a lag. Wolf’s Star Cloud Dance should be a Form Changing Star Martial Skill, while Flame Sword is an Attribute Changing Star Martial Skill. The fastest recorded time for switching from an Attribute Changing Star Martial Skill to a Form Changing Star Martial Skill is 0.8 seconds. But just now, from the moment Wu Xiao launched his attack until it should have hit its target, less than 0.3 seconds elapsed. And yet, Wolf dodged effortlessly, even without the slightest strain. This means Wolf had no interval between switching Star Martial Skills. As of now, that should be impossible for anyone to do."
Now everyone understood. Wu Xiao’s move was flawless; tactically, there were no issues. So, if anyone else had been his opponent, Wu Xiao’s strike would have worked.
He shouldn’t have lost, but he just happened to meet someone who was basically cheating.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 This isn’t Bone Cancer
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80 This isn’t Bone Cancer
The most helpless thing in life isn’t encountering setbacks, but facing an opponent who’s practically cheating when you’re on the verge of a sure win.
How did Wang Mang lose? He lost to the son of destiny.
How did Wu Xiao lose? He lost to Wang Lan—a one-in-a-million talent, possibly even the only monster capable of switching Star Martial Skills without needing any time interval.
The battle began with everyone watching intently and ended with them utterly dumbfounded.
"Damn, I looked it up. Apparently, you do need to adjust after using one Star Martial Skill before you can use another. It takes time. It’s like when you’re eating and want to do the laundry; you have to set down your bowl and chopsticks before doing the laundry. No time interval? That’s not scientific!"
"Wu Xiao must have thought the same thing at that moment."
"Holy shit, I rewatched it in slow motion, thirty times slower. Wolf’s Flame Sword did indeed extinguish while he was performing the Star Cloud Dance, but the process definitely didn’t take 0.3 seconds."
"Forget 0.3 seconds, it wasn’t even 0.1 seconds! He’s a monster!"
"Seriously, it’s like seeing a ghost!"
Online, there was a heated debate about how Wolf could possibly be so overpowered. Meanwhile, Wang Lan had already arrived at the place where he had met Hu Qing before that night’s competition.
"Lang, is there really no way to back out?"
"I’ve said it time and again. When it’s bought, it’s final; no backing out. You wouldn’t be having second thoughts, would you?"
"No!" Hu Qing clenched his fists tightly, his face still wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.
"Lang, lend me some money."
"How much?"
"Three million!"
"Three million? That’s nothing. I’d even give it to you, let alone lend it. But I have one condition."
Hu Qing’s lips moved, his body trembling with a mix of emotions. He knew what condition Lang was about to propose. Once he agreed, there would be no turning back.
"Fine, I agree. Three years. I’ll only sign with you for three years."
"No problem. One million a year to hire you is a good deal."
"Once you step into the mafia, it’s like an endless ocean; from then on, conscience becomes a stranger."
A voice suddenly interrupted their conversation. Lang’s expression changed, and he whirled around. When he saw the white mask on Wang Lan’s face, his eyes flickered with apprehension.
Lang was just an ordinary man. In the eyes of his underlings, he might be a formidable boss, but he was well aware of his own limitations. An ordinary man was just that—ordinary. To a Star Martial Warrior, he was someone they could crush with a mere flick of a finger.
"What’s the point of your three-year agreement? After three years, do you really think you can just walk away?"
Wang Lan’s words seemed to drain all the strength from Hu Qing.
"I’ve been waiting for you to ask, but you never did," Wang Lan said indifferently.
"If we’re friends, we don’t talk about money. If we talk about money, we’re not friends." Hu Qing gave a bitter smile. "I’ve already thrown away my dignity and lost all face. Now, I’m on the verge of discarding my conscience too, yet here we are, still talking about friendship? How hypocritical."
"Stop berating yourself. We agreed to go see your sister together, remember? Let’s go."
Lang chuckled softly, turning and leaving without a hint of reluctance. He knew that with Wolf present, Hu Qing wouldn’t agree to his terms that night. But it didn’t matter. His sister’s illness was a bottomless pit for money. As long as she lived, that pit could never be filled.
Lang believed that before long, Hu Qing would come back to him.
After Lang left, Wang Lan and Hu Qing walked out of the park. Suddenly, a black SUV pulled up beside them.
The window rolled down slowly, and Jiang Xinyu, wearing sunglasses, appeared before Wang Lan.
"Get in."
Without hesitation, Wang Lan pulled open the door and ushered Hu Qing inside. Throughout this, Hu Qing was utterly confused.
"Did you come to watch me compete live?"
"Yes! With a top-seven contender like Wolf competing, how could I not come to show my support? Did you know that your phrase ’I’m in a hurry’ is the number one trending search term right now?"
"Ah, well, you know I really was in a hurry. I have some time now. Here, Hu Qing, your hand bone is fractured, and there’s a crack in your shinbone. Let me treat you."
"Thanks! Your Medical Star Martial Technique is amazing. Stronger than any Medical Attribute user in the Southeast Military Region. But why can’t Star Martial Skills treat ordinary people...? If they could..."
"Who knows. Maybe when we unlock the secrets of Star Martial Warriors, Star Martial Skills will be able to benefit ordinary people too."
"Have you two talked enough? A lot of people are gathering. Where to?"
"Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University," Hu Qing said hastily.
The SUV’s engine roared to life, then sped off onto the city roads beyond the park.
"Hey Xinyu, since when can you handle this beast?"
"You still doubt my driving skills?"
"I wouldn’t dare, I wouldn’t dare!"
Wang Lan had never believed the saying that money makes the world go round. He was already quite wealthy, yet he still had to register and queue at hospitals and had never used a VIP lane at the bank. Wang Lan had never flown, so he didn’t know about those kinds of privileges. But at least, throughout his childhood and into adulthood, he had lived like an ordinary person, never enjoying special treatment.
Wang Lan knew how tight parking was at the Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University. It was basically impossible to find a vacant spot, especially at this hour.
But when Jiang Xinyu took out a card and handed it to the guard, the guard respectfully let them through. Not only that, he personally led Jiang Xinyu to a designated indoor parking spot.
It turned out that Wang Lan didn’t lack the money to enjoy privileges; he simply didn’t know how. No one had taught him, and being a homebody, he didn’t like mingling with those rich second-generation kids. At most, he would grab a barbecue with Xu Xiangwen, Gong Feiyu, and the others.
The three of them arrived at the intensive care unit. Jiang Xinyu, disliking the smell of alcohol, quietly put on a mask.
Following Hu Qing, they entered a ward with six beds.
As Hu Qing entered, a joyful cry suddenly came from one of the beds.
"Brother!"
Wang Lan looked in the direction of the voice and saw a little girl about the same age as Song Jia, around ten years old. She was bald but, contrary to Wang Lan’s expectations, not skinny; her cheeks looked quite full and soft.
By her bedside sat two haggard middle-aged adults, their faces etched with hardship, their hair prematurely white.
Hu Qing strode over to the bedside and took the little girl’s hand. "Feifei, how are you feeling today?"
"Dr. Huang just came to see me. He even congratulated me, saying I get to live for another week," replied the little girl with a sweet smile. Her smile even brought a tender expression to the face of Jiang Xinyu, who stood beside Wang Lan.
As Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu approached, Hu Qing hastily introduced them. "Feifei, Brother has brought some friends to visit you. Mom, Dad, these are friends I met during the competition. That’s his... girlfriend."
Hu Qing naturally assumed this. Wang Lan didn’t explain, and Jiang Xinyu didn’t deny it.
"Thank you, Brother and Sister," Hu Feifei greeted politely.
"Uncle, Auntie, I came straight from the competition, so I was a bit rushed and didn’t get a chance to buy anything," Wang Lan said. As soon as he finished speaking, Jiang Xinyu naturally opened her bag and took out a stack of cash.
The gesture seemed as if they had planned it beforehand.
"Ah, how could we possibly accept this..." Hu Qing’s father instantly panicked.
"Uncle, Hu Qing and I are friends. When a friend is in trouble, how could I pretend not to see? Aren’t friends supposed to help each other? This money is just a small token from us. It might not be much to us, but it’s a significant amount for you. Please, just accept it from the heart and don’t push it back and forth."
Wang Lan spoke with such propriety and an undeniable forcefulness that Hu Qing’s father found himself momentarily unable to think of a refusal. Jiang Xinyu then pressed a wad of cash, which looked to be about fifty thousand yuan, into Hu Qing’s father’s hands. "Please, accept it."
"I... I won’t waste words on thanks, but my Hu family will remember this for a lifetime."
"Director Li!"
"Director Li is here! My father’s illness, is it really..." a middle-aged man asked earnestly.
"Mr. Yuan, it’s cancer," Director Li stated. His words made the man’s expression instantly fall. Any other illness might have been manageable, but cancer... that was hopeless.
"Little Feifei, does it hurt today?" Director Li approached Hu Feifei with a smile and asked cheerfully.
"It hurts, but not as much as yesterday."
"Hmm, even though it’s not as painful as yesterday, you still need chemotherapy tonight. One more session, and the growth of those bone spurs will slow down."
Watching the kindly Director Li, Wang Lan felt an unexpected sense of goodwill towards him.
Some people talk grandly about a doctor’s benevolent heart yet treat patients with cold indifference. Others never boast, but they treat every patient with the warmth of sunshine.
"Director Li, does Feifei’s illness really have no hope?"
"This type of bone cancer is unlike anything I’ve seen before. It doesn’t grow bone marrow tumors; instead, it uncontrollably produces bone spurs. These spurs grow wildly within the flesh, each one stabbing into Feifei’s flesh like a steel needle.
I’ve urged their family many times to reconsider, but they’re unwilling to give up. As a doctor, I know how intense that pain must be—being constantly pricked by needles all over your body. It’s chilling just to imagine it.
Feifei is also the strongest little girl I’ve ever met. To endure such pain every day and still be so cheerful and happy, never crying or making a fuss... if there was anything I could do, I’d trade places with her in a heartbeat. Sigh..." Director Li shook his head.
"So, even with money, there’s no solution?"Thɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"It’s not about the money. Sure, money might persuade Yama to delay taking her, but it can’t buy back her life," Director Li spoke softly, careful not to upset Hu Qing’s family.
Wang Lan desperately wanted to help this resilient little girl, but the ineffectiveness of Medical Star Martial Techniques on ordinary people had been proven countless times.
As for why, there was still no definitive explanation. The prevailing theory was that ordinary people hadn’t awakened the innate talents of a Star Martial Warrior. Medical Star Martial Techniques worked by stimulating healing through Star Power, which implied a fundamental difference in constitution between Star Martial Warriors and ordinary people.
Thus, even if there were many Medical Star Martial Techniques capable of reviving the dead and mending broken bones, they simply couldn’t save ordinary patients suffering from diseases.
However, Wang Lan still instinctively reached out and touched Hu Feifei’s small hand.
Hu Feifei obediently placed her hand in Wang Lan’s palm.
What kind of hand was this? Wang Lan could hardly believe it. Such a small hand, yet it felt as hard as cast iron; it was as if beneath the skin lay a sheet of metal.
"Brother, don’t be sad for Feifei. Feifei doesn’t want to make other people sad because of me."
At that moment, however, Wang Lan’s eyes suddenly widened, his face etched with disbelief.
"Holy shit, this isn’t bone cancer!"
"What?" Wang Lan’s exclamation plunged the entire ward into dead silence. Hu Qing’s family stared in disbelief, Jiang Xinyu looked shocked, and as for Director Li, standing behind Wang Lan, his face instantly darkened.

chapters.title: Chapter 81 Activating the Star Martial Warrior Talent
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81 Activating the Star Martial Warrior Talent
"Young man, don’t speak nonsense if you don’t understand. Feifei’s bone cells are proliferating, growing wildly and without limit. This diagnosis of bone cancer is the result of discussion and repeated confirmation by several of our chief physicians."
"We arrived at this conclusion through advanced instrumentation and scientific verification. Yet you take one look and blurt out such an irresponsible statement. Do you realize how much damage this could do to our hospital’s reputation?"
"Director Li, please don’t get agitated. I’m not saying your diagnosis is wrong. Feifei might indeed have bone cancer, but her bone cancer is different from the one you understand."
"What do you mean?"
Hu Qing grew even more agitated, grabbing Wang Lan’s sleeve. "Wang Lan, what’s wrong with Feifei? Is there a cure? Do you have a way?"
"Regarding this problem... First, listen to my explanation. The doctors might be correct in diagnosing Feifei with bone cancer, but Feifei’s situation is very special. It’s possible that she awakened her Star Martial Warrior Talented Skills just as her bone cancer first emerged."
"That can’t be, can it?" Hu Qing’s face filled with even more incredulity at Wang Lan’s words. "Feifei, have you awakened?"
"No... I haven’t!"
"Your bones contain Star Power. I’m absolutely certain of this. Normally, a Star Martial Warrior’s Star Power is mostly in their flesh cells. This is the first time I’ve seen someone whose Star Power is primarily contained within their bones, like yours.
"You must have awakened your Star Martial Attributes and then encountered a pathological change, leading to a mutation in those attributes. The spikes and sharp protrusions growing from your bones are actually being driven by disordered Star Power."
Could it really be like this—
Director Li was dumbstruck by Wang Lan’s explanation. Feifei’s strange condition finally had an explanation. Even if it *is* bone cancer, why would it only cause bone spikes to grow?
"Let’s not delve into the cause for now. The question is, can Feifei’s illness be treated?" Hu Qing asked anxiously.
"I have no confidence. Feifei’s Star Martial Talented Skill *is* bone cancer; the bone cancer *is* her Star Martial Talented Skill. I can’t guarantee whether her Star Martial Talented Skill will control the cancer or if the cancer will claim her life."
"Brother..." Feifei suddenly grabbed Hu Qing’s hand. "Brother, please let this young man help me... It really... hurts so much. Every time, it hurts so much I want to cry, but I’m afraid crying will make you all sad. So I can only smile... but it truly, truly hurts."
"This..." Hu Qing looked up at Wang Lan. "What will happen if your attempt fails?"
Wang Lan turned his head and glanced at Director Li, who also looked tense. "It might be the same as the worst-case scenario he mentioned."
Feifei’s illness had reached a terminal stage, like an oil lamp about to run dry. Even if she underwent treatment, it would only delay the inevitable. And every day she lived now was excruciating torture for Feifei.
"Dad, Mom—" Hu Qing looked up at his parents, seeking their opinion.
"Seeing Feifei like this, your mother and I are heartbroken. So, is this a gamble now?" Hu Qing’s father asked Wang Lan anxiously.
"More or less."
"How confident are you?"
"Uncle, although I’m a Star Martial Warrior of the Medical Attribute, this is my first time encountering such a mixture of illness and Star Martial Talented Skills. If you insist on asking, I can only say I have no confidence at all."
"Young man, don’t be nervous. Just go ahead and try your best. I won’t blame you. Whether I live or die, it will be a good outcome for me. It has to be better than this living death I’m enduring now, right?"
"Wang Lan, go ahead."
"We’re counting on you, young man."
Wang Lan slowly extended his hand, unbuttoned Feifei’s collar to reveal her smooth chest, placed his palm on it, and activated his healing skill.
Suddenly, Feifei’s body lit up, a hazy, crescent moon-like glow emanated from her entire body.
Feifei’s body began to tremble slightly. Every pore on her skin opened, and bead-sized drops of sweat poured out incessantly. In no time, her entire body was drenched in sweat.
But Feifei showed no sign of pain; instead, she let out a comfortable-sounding moan.
"BEEP BEEP BEEP—"
On the heart rate monitor beside her, Feifei’s heart rate spiked drastically, reaching a terrifying 130-140 beats per minute.
"Young man, stop for a moment! Feifei’s heart rate is too fast!"
"I can’t stop. I’m helping her open her Star Palace!" Wang Lan declared in a deep voice.
It wasn’t clear if it was due to the bone cancer or the daily chemotherapy, but although Feifei had already awakened her Star Martial Warrior Talented Skills and possessed Star Power, she hadn’t opened her Star Palace.
Star Power without a Star Palace is like a masterless, uncontrolled force. This was why her Star Power had erratically stimulated her bones to grow wildly into spurs.
Soon, Feifei’s heart rate reached a frightening 150 beats per minute. Sustaining such a heart rate for ten minutes could lead to myocardial infarction or heart failure.
The thumping heartbeat sounded like a drum.
Simultaneously, a visible ripple suddenly undulated above Feifei’s head. Within these ripples, a vortex of energy gradually formed and converged.
Director Li wanted to speak up and stop him, but Jiang Xinyu, with quick eyes and deft hands, restrained him. At this critical juncture, any interruption would mean all previous efforts were wasted.
BOOM—
The vortex above her head finally stabilized. The stable vortex began to rotate slowly. Then, its center suddenly collapsed and converged rapidly. In no time, a star, shining as brightly as the most brilliant star in the night sky, appeared within Feifei’s Star Palace.
Wang Lan slowly withdrew his hand, his face pale and covered in sweat.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
He looked at Feifei with utter shock in his eyes.
What kind of monster was this?
With Wang Lan’s current Star Power, healing even three dying individuals consecutively would have been as easy as flipping his palm. Yet, healing Feifei had consumed all his Star Power in just a single minute.
Furthermore, as the one who had personally assisted Feifei in opening her Star Palace, Wang Lan could clearly sense the immense, surging Star Power contained within her star.
Though she was only at the Starlight Stage, the sheer volume of her Star Power was almost comparable to his, a mid-stage Star Shine Stage warrior. Such a high starting point and such formidable talent made Wang Lan feel an urge to weep in frustration.
He already had his ’cheats,’ but he hadn’t expected to meet someone whose ’cheats’ were even more outrageous than his own.
Indeed, this world was never short of ’cheaters’; the only difference lay in who was more ruthless.
Someone like Jiang Xinyu, whose ’cheats’ were still somewhat ’dignified,’ simply had high talent and good resources.
Someone like Wang Lan, with his ’cheats,’ was utterly shameless.
And now, this ’cheater’ Feifei—if you asked her if she had any shame, she’d probably retort, ’Shame? What’s that? It doesn’t exist.’
Wang Lan released his hand, but the Star Energy Fluctuation around Feifei’s body did not dissipate. Suddenly, Feifei’s skin turned jade-like. Large patches of bone-like material began to appear on the surface of her skin, and in the blink of an eye, it covered her entire body as if she were wearing true exoskeletal armor.
"It doesn’t hurt anymore... Brother, I don’t hurt anymore! I’m better... My illness is gone!" Feifei exclaimed, leaping up from the bed with a WHOOSH.
At that moment, she felt no pain in her waist or legs. Her body was brimming with energy, and she felt clear-headed and invigorated. She even felt she could run like the wind and was as light as a swallow.
But... Feifei’s appearance at this moment was quite terrifying.
Can you imagine something resembling a skeleton, encased in bone, leaping about and yelling excitedly on the bed?
CREAK—
The door to the hospital room was pushed open, and a nurse entered, pushing a medical cart.
Then, she looked up and saw a skeleton ’dancing’ on the hospital bed. The nurse froze for a second, her eyes rolled back, and she fainted dramatically. If not for the fact that everyone else in the room had witnessed how this all happened and were thus less terrified, anyone else would have found it unbearable.
The middle-aged man in the adjacent hospital bed quickly covered his recently awakened elderly father’s eyes, afraid that if his father caught even a glimpse of the scene in the next room, he might just pass away on the spot.
"Feifei, get down from there first!" Wang Lan quickly called out. "Try to control your Star Power. See if you can make this exoskeleton retract."
"Huh? What’s this growing on me? Huh? What is this stuff?"
"When one has just awakened their Star Martial Warrior Talented Skills, it’s initially difficult to control them. You’ll need some time to get used to it," Jiang Xinyu said calmly, moving to Wang Lan’s side. "When I first awakened as a Star Martial Warrior, a single sneeze from me nearly killed someone."
"I’ll do it." Wang Lan reached out, took Feifei’s hand, and guided her Star Power with his own.
The effect was immediate. The exoskeletal material on Feifei’s body quickly began to break down and gradually receded into her flesh.
Once all the exoskeletal material had vanished, Feifei’s hand not only returned to normal, but the previous stone-like hardness was also gone.
Now, Feifei was just a perfectly normal, healthy little girl.
"There, mission accomplished," Wang Lan said with a smile, gently patting Feifei’s cute, bald little head. "Feifei, your illness is completely cured. You can go back to school happily, and just like your brother, you can become a powerful Star Martial Warrior."
Curing a strong little girl, reward 100 experience points, 5 skill points.
Wang Lan heard the system prompt in his mind. This reward was trivial to him, but it was even more insignificant compared to seeing the little girl healthy and recovered.
"I’m really cured? Does that mean I can go home now?" Feifei looked hopefully at Director Li among the crowd.
"If this young man says you’re cured, then you definitely are. Feifei, get your clothes on now, don’t catch a cold."
"That’s great! Dad, Mom, I want to go home! I miss home so much..." Feifei cried, stretching out her hands. One of them transformed into a sharp Nine Yin White Bone Claw.
"Ah!"
"Don’t get too excited! You need to learn to control your Star Power quickly, or you won’t be able to go to school," Wang Lan said hastily.
Jiang Xinyu shot him an almost imperceptible sidelong glance, recalling how, eight years ago, a sneeze had gotten her temporarily expelled from school, forcing her to stay home for a month.
"Wang Lan, thank you!" Hu Qing said gravely to Wang Lan. "Words cannot express my gratitude for this great kindness. In the future, if you need me to go through fire or water, I will do so without a second thought."
"You should be thinking about your future now," Wang Lan said with a calm smile. "Feifei is cured and has also awakened. Your family should strive for a new life. What are your plans? Raising one Star Martial Warrior is difficult enough, let alone two."
"I had some thoughts before but couldn’t spare them much attention. Now, however, I really need to plan properly.
"When I was discharged from the army, my old squad leader had a good suggestion: he told me to become a security officer. Although cases involving Star Martial Warriors are handled by the Tianjian Bureau, the regular police precincts also need the strength of Star Martial Warriors. I think with my status as a Star Martial Warrior and my commendations from my time in the army, I should be able to get a position as a security officer."
"A security officer, that’s great! Punishing villains and eliminating evil, becoming a guardian of the people—it certainly doesn’t disgrace the status of a Star Martial Warrior. I have high hopes for you. Good luck!"
"Mm."
"It’s getting late, so we’ll take our leave. Little Feifei, this big brother will come see you again when I have the chance."
"Young man, Feifei’s illness is cured. This money, you..."
"Uncle, Feifei has just recovered, and your family will need some money for urgent needs, so please don’t be so formal with me. We’re leaving!"
Wang Lan gave a suave wave of his sleeve, turned, and departed with Jiang Xinyu.
"I didn’t realize you were actually quite kind-hearted."
"Didn’t realize? I’ve known you for so long, and you still haven’t discovered my kindness?" Wang Lan retorted, feigning heartache.
"I..." Jiang Xinyu was rendered speechless.
Is this guy’s brain made of wood?
"Is there a great sense of accomplishment in helping others?"
"Not really. I’m used to it."
"Used to it?"
"Yeah."

chapters.title: Chapter 82 Demonized Star Martial Warrior
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82 Demonized Star Martial Warrior
After Jiang Xinyu dropped Wang Lan off at his doorstep and saw that it was already late, Wang Lan considerately told Jiang Xinyu to go home early. It wasn’t good for a girl to go home too late, and driving at night was unsafe. Even now, Wang Lan was still not very confident in Jiang Xinyu’s driving skills.
When Jiang Xinyu closed the car window, she was still smiling, but the moment the window shut, her expression turned to grinding her teeth in anger.
Among those who were single by their own sheer ability, she was only impressed by him!
Wang Lan had overexerted himself with Star Power that night. Although he had recovered somewhat after such a long time, his stomach was grumbling with hunger.
Wang Lan lived in the Xinyu Building, part of the Eastern Heaven Gate business district. Just a few steps outside his door was a bustling large shopping center. Ordering takeout would take over half an hour, so after a slight hesitation, Wang Lan decided to change clothes and go out to eat.
"WOO WOO WOO—"
The loud police sirens cut through the night sky.
In Suzhou City, especially in the bustling business districts, it was common to hear fire alarms, but Wang Lan seldom heard police sirens throughout the year. Moreover, the direction from which the sirens were coming was exactly where the large shopping mall Wang Lan was planning to visit was located.
Following the sound of the sirens, Wang Lan found that dozens of police cars were densely parked outside the large shopping center. From a distance, there were at least a hundred police officers present.
Outside the police cordon, many citizens were gathered around, discussing something fervently. It was a noisy crowd, and Wang Lan couldn’t make out much from their conversations. The only thing he knew was that there was a very dangerous person inside the mall.
"Excuse me... What happened inside the mall?" Wang Lan approached the cordon and asked a police officer inside.
"Move along! Don’t gawk, there’s a Star Martial Warrior inside. Please cooperate with us and leave quickly," the officer on the other side replied impatiently.
"BOOM—" Just then, an explosion sounded from inside the mall, and glass shattered everywhere.
"AAH—"
The onlookers let out a cry of shock and scattered in panic.
"Wasn’t it you who asked for help from the Tianjian Bureau? Why are we being pushed away when we’ve come to assist?" A voice sounded just in time, and Wang Lan turned to see Xu Shiyun had appeared behind him without him noticing.
"Xu, you’re here?"
Xu Shiyun took out his credentials. "Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau, Intelligence Division Action Team Captain, Xu Shiyun."
"Ah? I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I didn’t know he was..."
"Xu, he’s just doing his job and he didn’t know my identity. It’s all a misunderstanding."
"You live here?" Xu Shiyun patted Wang Lan’s arm, signaling him to follow.
"Yes, Xinyu Building."
"Oh? You can afford to live in Xinyu Building? You must come from a well-off family. What floor? I’ll come and visit someday."
"The whole building!"
Xu Shiyun, who was in front of him, staggered slightly.
"Xu? What happened?"
"A Star Martial Warrior. He was at his own wedding banquet. After taking a few insults, he went on a rampage, killed six or seven people, and then fled. He’s in the mall now."
"This... We’re not in a Different Dimensional Space. Couldn’t a few guns outside take him down easily? Why is there a need to call the Tianjian Bureau to take action?"
"First off, cases involving Star Martial Warriors are, in theory, the responsibility of the Tianjian Bureau. Of course, the police superintendent also has the authority to shoot in emergency situations. But this Star Martial Warrior has military experience and is very adept at concealment. He’s holding hostages, and the superintendent, concerned for their safety, dared not open fire. He is now hiding in the mall with a dozen hostages, in a blind spot for snipers, so they had no choice but to request our assistance."
As they spoke, Wang Lan followed Xu Shiyun into the mall. Inside, the mall was in disarray, devoid of people. The sound of their footsteps echoed clearly in the empty space.
Wang Lan’s eyes swept around constantly, while Xu Shiyun walked ahead calmly with large strides, riding the escalator up slowly.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Stop looking. He’s on the third floor now."
"How do you know?"
"As long as he steps on the ground, he can’t escape my perception," said Xu Shiyun with a mysteriously amused smile.
They took the escalator straight to the third floor. At the escalator entrance, a charred body lay outside in the hallway. Seeing this, Xu Shiyun’s brows furrowed deeply.
"I wanted to bring him back alive initially, but now it seems that we don’t need to leave any survivors."
Star Martial Warriors possess great strength, but having strength doesn’t mean one can trample over the law. In the face of the law, everyone is equal. This is especially true for Star Martial Warriors, who are subject to even stricter legal regulations.
If a Star Martial Warrior gets into a conflict with a regular person and it resorts to fisticuffs, that’s considered a brawl. But if a Star Martial Warrior uses a Star Martial Skill, it’s considered attempted murder.
Thus, while a Star Martial Warrior might kill recklessly in a Different Dimensional Space, back in human society, they generally restrain their temper. One accidental use of a Star Martial Skill could be disastrous.
However, Star Martial Warriors don’t typically get into conflicts with regular people. Even mafia types give Star Martial Warriors a wide berth. And even if conflict arises, a Star Martial Warrior could beat up dozens with just fists and kicks. Only a fool would use a Star Martial Skill against a regular person.
If the other party has firearms, then it’s their misfortune. Using Star Martial Skills then can be considered self-defense and doesn’t carry legal repercussions.
But the one currently in front of him was clearly an idiot.
In the middle of the third-floor corridor stood a young man with a ferocious face and fierce eyes, staring coldly in their direction. Next to him were three bodies of people who had attempted to escape, and seven or eight women curled up beside him, crying in pain.
There were young girls, middle-aged women, and even a girl who looked to be barely thirteen or fourteen.
"When did a mighty Star Martial Warrior stoop to bullying women and children? Wang Jianjun, you used to be somewhat of a man, but now, you’re no better than a beast."
"Are you the negotiator they sent? Cut the crap! I’m already at this point, what’s there to negotiate, man? No bullshitting! Get me a car and ten million in unmarked bills. You have ten minutes. Once those ten minutes are up, I’ll kill a hostage every minute. I wasn’t going to make it out alive anyway, so I might as well take a few of you with me. Fuck! You look down on me, but what gives you the right? Without us Star Martial Warriors going to battle and killing enemies, you wouldn’t even have shit to eat. Fuck!"
"In this regard, I beg to differ," Xu Shiyun said lightly as he removed his glasses from his nose, resembling a negotiator. He folded them neatly and slipped them into his suit pocket.
"They don’t look down on Star Martial Warriors; on the contrary, they respect them a lot. They probably only look down on you. And, I’m not here to negotiate."
The moment his words landed, Xu Shiyun lightly stepped on the ground.
In an instant, a wall of concrete rose up around the adversary.
And the moment Xu Shiyun moved, Wang Lan burst forth with the Butterfly Passing Through Flowers Star Martial Skill. Even though he and Xu Shiyun hadn’t coordinated before, even though they hadn’t discussed tactics, at this moment, their teamwork was flawless.
BOOM—
In an instant, the earth wall that Xu Shiyun raised was burned red-hot by flames. The terrifying heat from within the wall turned it into a horrendous furnace. The hostages barely had time to react and were just about to escape when Wang Lan reached the wall’s side.
He delivered a punch with Inch Strength.
BOOM—
The fiery red wall shattered explosively, taking the Star Martial Warrior inside along with it. Wang Lan’s fist sent him flying through the balcony passageway, out from the third floor, and crashing down onto the first floor.
"Good chance, open fire!" The police on the first floor who were on standby immediately seized the opportunity. A dozen officers’ guns spewed flames.
"RAT-TAT-TAT—"
Bullets instantly hit the Star Martial Warrior’s body, splattering his blood everywhere.
"You all deserve to die... all of you—"
"ROAR—"
Suddenly, the Star Martial Warrior roared to the sky. His clothes burst open instantly. His body quickly changed, covering itself with a hard shell as if he were a transforming Transformer.
This scene unfolded before their eyes, and Wang Lan’s expression finally changed.
Because during the beginner trial, that strange Star Martial Warrior who suddenly attacked them also transformed similarly in the end. Only, he didn’t complete the transformation as thoroughly, or as much like a member of the Demon Clan as this one.
"Demonization! What a specimen!" Xu Shiyun’s voice echoed from upstairs as he leaped from the third floor.
"Mud River Pouring Down—"
Xu Shiyun jumped down from the sky, but the moment he did, a mud dragon materialized instantaneously beneath him, descending ferociously to crush the frenzied Star Martial Warrior below.
BOOM—
The Star Martial Warrior who was about to wreak havoc hadn’t had a chance to feel imposing before he was immediately buried under tons of soil. In the central hall, a small hill about the height of a single story was left standing.
"BOOM—"
A muffled sound, and suddenly the top of the small hill cracked open, spewing flames towards the sky. To outsiders, it looked like a volcano erupting.
"Still daring to be wild!" Xu Shiyun shouted angrily, instantly landing on top of the small hill and pressing down upon it. "Five Elements Suppression!"
A visibly rippling wave spread out, and the small hill shrunk in an instant by a third as if it were enchanted.
"Mud Dragon Strangulation—"
The shrinking hill twisted violently, and as it did, its size rapidly diminished, shrinking by another third in the blink of an eye. The once dark brown hill was now a pale grey rock.
From the third floor, Wang Lan watched, his heart surging.
Xu was still Xu! He had clearly been holding back an ocean’s worth of strength when they fought before. Using his Star Martial Skill, he easily strangled a Star Martial Warrior who could reach the Star Cloud Stage after metamorphosis.
This series of skillful applications of Star Martial Skills was like flowing clouds and water. Perhaps the Star Martial Warrior didn’t even realize what was happening before he was already a goner.
"Assisted in the kill. Reward: fifty experience points and five skill points."
He’d only contributed one move, barely any help at all, yet he still received experience and skill points as a reward?
Wang Lan revealed a slight smile.
Unexpected gains always bring such joy.
Xu Shiyun hopped down from the small hill, as dozens of cautious police officers with their guns slowly approached.
"Put your guns away," Xu Shiyun said with a roguish face, waving his hand at the surrounding officers. "He’s stone-cold now."
Having said that, he gently slapped the small hill, which suddenly made a sound of bursting. It trembled, then crumbled and collapsed. This scene made the tense officers quickly raise their guns again.
But when they saw the extremely distorted body lying underneath the small hill, twisted into a spiral and bright red, the officers all collectively let out a synchronized gasp of air.
Although firearms are effective against Star Martial Warriors, and those below the Galaxy Stage are still not immune to sniper rifle injuries, it must be said that ordinary people holding guns are still at an absolute disadvantage against Star Martial Warriors.
"Damn, switched clothes and left my smokes behind."
"Chief of Tianjian Bureau, here, have one of mine." A nearby officer quickly pulled out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket. Xu Shiyun didn’t hesitate and took one out.
"What bloody chief? My name is Xu Shiyun. Call me Old Xu, or Captain Xu." Xu Shiyun said, lightly placing the cigarette on the Star Martial Warrior’s corpse. It instantly lit up. He took a satisfying puff, then exhaled a cloud of smoke.
"You piece of trash, this is all you’re worth now."
"Captain Xu, you’re really fast, huh? I just got the call, and you’re already here?" A voice rang out, and a young man in a red military uniform strode in through the front door of the shopping mall.
Wang Lan saw the other person, and his eyes shifted slightly.
It’s him!

chapters.title: Chapter 83 Semi-finals Countdown
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83 Semi-finals Countdown
The young man was the same one Wang Lan had encountered on the second floor during his first visit to the Tianjian Bureau. Cold and ruthless, he had lectured Wang Lan the moment he opened his mouth. Initially, Wang Lan had thought everyone in the Tianjian Bureau was like this, but his worries were dispelled after meeting the young lady from the human resources department.
The youth’s head was slightly raised, his eyes glancing at Wang Lan in the third-floor corridor.
"It’s not that I arrived quickly, but rather that you, Captain Li, are too slow," he said.
"This incident should have been handled by our Action Department; isn’t the Intelligence Department overstepping its authority?"
"Internally, that is true. But externally, what Action Department or Intelligence Department? We’re all part of the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau. Saving lives is like fighting a fire; naturally, we should rush over immediately upon receiving an alert. Unlike Captain Li, who leisurely took his time to even change his clothes."
Xu Shiyun watched with a mocking smile as Lige stood there in his meticulous military uniform.
"I wear a military uniform all year round, both indoors and outdoors. What clothes would I need to change into? It’s clearly the Intelligence Department that deliberately delayed transferring the information to the Action Department by ten minutes."
"Is that so? We always forward intelligence to the Action Department immediately upon receipt," he replied.
With a cold huff, Lige turned and left. After taking just a couple of steps, his figure twisted slightly, vanishing as if by magic.
Wang Lan descended the stairs and glanced at the mangled corpse on the floor.
"What is this thing?"
"A Magical Martial Artist," Xu Shiyun said gravely. "This phenomenon has only started occurring recently. The Tianjian Bureau from the northwest region has alerted all bureaus across the country that a type of Magical Martial Artist has emerged there. How they transform is unknown. All we know is that certain Star Martial Warriors can suddenly transform into Demon Clan warriors, and after the transformation, they have Soul Beads in their brains."
"They’re not replacements by the Demon Clan?" Wang Lan inquired, surprised. After all, the Demon Clan and Human Clan are completely different species. How could such a switch be made so casually?
"No!" Xu Shiyun shook his head grimly. "DNA matching analysis has confirmed that they were indeed human Star Martial Warriors before. However, for some unknown reason, they have acquired Demon Clan DNA. The Demon Clan’s DNA is extremely invasive; once stimulated, it rapidly overwhelms human DNA. But they are clearly two different species. We have yet to determine how their DNA could be compatible. Furthermore, this has only been occurring for a short time, so we lack more detailed information. The higher-ups suspect this is a new invasion tactic by the Demon Clan: assimilating our Star Martial Warriors to achieve their invasion objectives. Initially, we thought these Magical Martial Artists were only present in the northwest, but it turns out they’re in Suzhou City as well."
"I’ve seen such Magical Martial Artists before," Wang Lan said softly.
"You have? Where?"
"It was back in the initial trial area. My team and I had just escaped a Snow Spider outbreak when a Star Martial Warrior ambushed us. He was initially at the Star Shine Stage, but later he mutated, similar to that one. His mutation wasn’t as extensive, though; his body was merely covered with a shell-like armor, and blades grew out of his arms, things like that. At that time, Jiang Xinyu had just broken through to the Star Cloud Stage, so our team managed to kill him. I initially thought he was just a Star Martial Warrior with special abilities. However, when you mentioned ’Demonization’ just now, it reminded me of him."
"The northwest region reported the first case of a Magical Martial Artist less than a month ago. If what you’re saying is true, then the first discovery of a Magical Martial Artist wasn’t in the northwest region but... in our Suzhou City. I need to report this to Director Wang."
"Oh, and what’s up with that guy?"
"You mean Lige? He’s just a chuunibyo. Spoiled since childhood, he has connections, a strong background, and high talent, so he feels he should be accommodated wherever he goes. Accommodated my ass! He’s trying to get promoted to Major; don’t I want that too? He’s like a starving wolf now, his eyes go red at the sight of any mission, desperately accumulating achievements."
"What? You’re only a Captain?"
"What’s with that look?" Xu Shiyun became instantly indignant, especially hearing Wang Lan’s incredulous tone and the disdain in his voice.
"What do you mean ’only’? Do you think it’s that easy to get promoted in the military? Do you think a Captain is nothing? Only graduates from the top four Star Martial Academies have a chance to be appointed a Junior Lieutenant upon graduation. As for other Star Martial Warriors, it takes at least three years to advance from private to Second Lieutenant, at least five years from Second Lieutenant to Junior Lieutenant, and at least eight years from Junior Lieutenant to Captain. And that’s only if they have enough achievements. I’m only thirty-two this year. Being a Captain at this age is already damn impressive, okay?"
"Alright..."
"Your tone sounds pretty forced."
"Not at all!"
"You little..." Xu Shiyun glared. "If we weren’t in the same Intelligence Department, I’d smack you right now."
"Calm down, Xu. I just don’t get it. I’ve heard that high-achieving students from military academies start as Junior Lieutenants immediately after graduation."
"That’s for technical soldiers, and these so-called high-achieving students have at least a master’s degree. Ordinary undergraduates only qualify to become officers; whether they get promoted depends on their performance. Don’t mistake hearsay for fact," Xu Shiyun retorted.
"Alright, alright, you’re right. Captain Xu, you’re powerful and promising, a Captain at such a young age with boundless prospects. Say, why don’t you come over to my place for a visit?"
"No thanks, I need to get back and report to Director Wang." Turning to the guards, he called out, "Protect the scene. Wait for my colleagues to come and collect evidence."
"Understood!"
Xu Shiyun hurried off, and Wang Lan didn’t get to eat anything hot. In the end, he opted to order takeout delivered to his home.
Fortunately, the food and beverage industry in this world generally operated twenty-four hours a day.
After a day of rest at home, on Sunday evening, Wang Lan left his home after dusk to head to the Suzhou City TV station.
Tonight, the championship match, which was also the true essence of the Star Martial Competition, would take place.
Two semifinals, one final—no runners-up or third-place finishers, only the supreme winner who stood atop the arena.
And after Wang Lan’s previous rush for time, his popularity completely exploded.
Gestures like Jin Cheng’s, which carried a humiliating undertone intended to disparage opponents, were met with national scorn. In contrast, Wang Lan’s hurried appearance not only failed to offend the silly netizens but was instead perceived as full of swagger.
Of course, there were keyboard warriors who accused Wang Lan of being arrogant, inflated, and the like. But to be pretentious, you need the ability to pull it off; to be inflated, you need the capital to back it up.
Wang Lan ended the battle in thirty seconds, proving through action that his so-called arrogance was well-founded.
Moreover, Wang Lan truly was pressed for time, so even though his words ignited a national debate, those who opposed him were indeed few.
And because of this incident, netizens changed their nickname for Wang Lan. The moniker "Wolf" could no longer satisfy Wang Lan’s hugely inflated swagger, so a new nickname was very easily accepted by the public.
Wolf King!
「Star Martial Competition, the final episode!」
There was still an hour to go before the match was broadcast live, but the channel’s ratings had already broken through four. Viewers in front of their TVs would rather wait with the screen on than switch channels.
The four contestants in this Star Martial Competition were Chang Shuangyue, Xing Feng, Wang Lan, and Cheng Qingzhu.
Apart from Wang Lan, all three were at the peak of the Star Shine Stage. Especially Chang Shuangyue; it was clear from how effortlessly he defeated Hu Qing last time that not only had he reached the peak of the Star Shine Stage, but he might also have stepped up to the Star Cloud Stage.
Among the four, Cheng Qingzhu was somewhat worried. The other three posed a great challenge to him. He was a Wind Attribute Star Martial Warrior with solid fundamentals and strong power.
But it all depended on whom you compared him to. Chang Shuangyue was a freak, and against Wang Lan, Cheng Qingzhu faced an attribute disadvantage. All he hoped for now was to draw Xing Feng, because his Wind Attribute countered the Thunder Attribute.
But there’s a principle in this world called Murphy’s Law: the more you fear and worry about something, the more likely it is to happen.
After the drawing for matchups, Wang Lan was set to face Xing Feng, and Cheng Qingzhu was to face Chang Shuangyue.
Seeing the matchup list, Xing Feng let out a sigh of relief, while Cheng Qingzhu maintained a dark, expressionless face the entire time.
"Tonight is the finals night of the third season of the Star Martial Competition! Tonight, four strong contenders will vie for the title of hero! Tonight, we’ll witness three thrilling, blood-pumping bouts! And tonight, to whom will the ultimate glory belong? The grand final of the third season of the Star Martial Competition is about to begin, bringing you the live broadcast! Viewers outside the arena, please send your champion choice, using the designated code, to the mobile number ******. We will select ten lucky viewers immediately after the champion is announced..."
The host today seemed especially excited, speaking breathlessly and incessantly for over half an hour.
「Backstage」
Wang Lan sat on his throne, one of four technologically advanced and magnificent chairs.
Xing Feng was a Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warrior, known as Thunder Starlight. If Wind Attribute Star Martial Warriors were known for speed, then Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors were known for instantaneous flashes of movement.
Although Xing Feng hadn’t yet demonstrated the Thunder Attribute’s most representative Instantaneous Movement Technique, there was no guarantee he wouldn’t.
The Thunder Attribute possessed incomparable penetrating power, explosive force, and speed. If it weren’t countered by the Wind Attribute, Wang Lan would wonder if Thunder Attribute really belonged among the seven basic attributes.
In the world of Star Martial Warriors, there was a doctrine—unofficial but recognized by many. For the Thunder Attribute, there was only one rule: "The only one who can defeat me is Wind."
Wang Lan only had the Fire Attribute. Although Fire and Thunder didn’t have a mutually countering relationship, Fire fell a bit short when it came to potency.
The masked Wang Lan was bowed in deep thought. But the image broadcast by the cameras—what exactly did it show?
The Ice Throne, the pensive contemplation of supreme nobility.
Even just sitting there motionless, a compelling aura poured out like an avalanche from a snow-capped mountain. Not to mention the viewers watching on their screens, even the other three contestants seated on their thrones could feel the subtle yet menacing pressure emanating from Wang Lan.
"So stately... so handsome... Is there any Wolf King replica gear? I really want to buy a set."
"Online shopping! You can find countless replicas on LeGo; there’s bound to be a flamboyant one that suits you."
"The Wolf King’s swagger isn’t about the equipment; it’s that aura of a dark noble that exudes from within... Even if you wear the same outfit, you’ll just look like a fool."
"The poster above is brain-dead. Confirmed."
"Where do you see a noble aura? That’s clearly the aura of a king."
"Ten minutes to countdown, so excited!"
"Fifteen minutes to countdown, so excited!"
"Huh, is the person above a protagonist who can reverse their age? How can the countdown increase?"
"You’re anticipating the first match; I’m anticipating the second. That’s why *my* countdown is fifteen minutes."Google seaʀᴄh NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"Fair point! Thirteen minutes to countdown."

chapters.title: Chapter 84 Excessive
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84 Excessive
Under the eager anticipation of the audience, the finals of the Star Martial Arts Tournament began.
The first match: Chang Shuangyue versus Captain Cheng Qingzhu.
It was unclear whether Chang Shuangyue had flipped some hidden switch during his previous fight with Hu Qing or if something else had happened. Previously, although Chang Shuangyue was powerful, he fought with great stability.
From the preliminaries to the official matches, regardless of his opponent’s strength, he fought steadily and secured victory steadily.
But ever since fighting Hu Qing, Chang Shuangyue’s attacks had become increasingly violent and aggressive.
Once his skin turned red, the aura he emitted was like that of an enraged wild beast.
Moreover, this state seemed to be an invincible mode—it appeared as if he could become immune to Star Martial Skill attacks at the level of the Laws.
Hu Qing’s Gravity Fist, strong enough to flatten a tank, seemed to have no effect on Chang Shuangyue. And now, Cheng Qingzhu’s wind-attribute Star Martial Skill, a powerful cutting attack that took the form of an airborne dragon, instantly struck Chang Shuangyue’s chest.
But apart from a minor tear in his skin, Chang Shuangyue seemed unaffected.
"Is this... still human?"
Beside Wang Lan, Xing Feng exclaimed in astonishment.
Indeed, could this still be considered human?
