An image surfaced in Wang Lan’s mind: the figure he had seen in the mall, a face so handsome one might feel an urge to slash it twice, and those proud, untamed eyes that screamed, "I am number one in the world."
Such a douchebag is destined to die alone.
Wang Lan humphed disdainfully. It was a mystery where Wang Lan himself found the audacity to think such a thing.
With no missions available on the Tianjian Bureau’s list, Wang Lan switched to the official website of the Star Martial Hall.
Jade Country had two million Star Martial Warriors. These were divided into several major groups: about five hundred thousand who enlisted in the military; approximately six hundred thousand young Star Martial Warriors from various colleges across the country; and about seven hundred thousand in the Pioneering Legions, diligently developing the wilderness nationwide.
Young Star Martial Warrior students naturally relied on the national education system for support. Meanwhile, Star Martial Warriors in the military were cultivated and promoted by the armed forces. As for the Pioneering Legions, those needing to raise their Cultivation Level and acquire sustenance could only hunt Exotic Beasts in the vast, boundless Different Dimensional Spaces to earn Soul Beads.
But what about the remaining Star Martial Warriors who were neither soldiers nor participated in pioneering? The nation did not leave them without options. The Star Martial Hall would issue missions, and completing these missions earned points. With those points, one could exchange for Soul Beads from the Star Martial Hall.
The nation implemented this series of regulations to ensure Star Martial Warriors fought to their maximum potential and realized their own value. What if a Star Martial Warrior couldn’t endure the military’s harshness, refused the hardships of pioneering, and was unwilling to complete tasks from the Star Martial Hall, preferring to live solely on Star Martial Warrior benefits? Sorry, the state didn’t support idlers.
Such idlers had essentially renounced their status as Star Martial Warriors, integrating into mainstream society to become ordinary people.
Upon entering the mission acquisition page, the first thing that popped up was a guide on how to accept tasks.
Accepting a task wasn’t something just anyone could do. First, you had to be a Star Martial Warrior. Second, you had to spend points to accept corresponding tasks. Moreover, you could only take on tasks that matched the level of your Star Martial Badge.
This was also why the Star Martial Badge needed an annual audit: to ensure strength and badge level were aligned.
Only the very first task acceptance was free of charge, and this was a one-time opportunity.
Thus, a friendly reminder: for your first task, don’t choose something too difficult; it’s best to pick one you can ensure completing. Otherwise, if the task failed, you would never be able to accept tasks again.
After reading the guide once, Wang Lan had practically memorized the key points of the nearly twenty-thousand-word document.
He clicked on the mission page, searching seriously and devoutly for a task he could be sure to complete.
SWISH—
In an instant! Probably... not even a second had passed.
The dozen or so available tasks that had just refreshed were all instantly marked as ’taken’.
Wang Lan swore he hadn’t even managed to read the full name of the first task.
What’s the point of this ’friendly reminder’ then? ’Be cautious when taking on tasks, make sure you can complete them.’ Cautious my ass!
Wang Lan internally ranted.
Wang Lan refreshed the page again.
In less than three seconds, all tasks were taken once more. This time, Wang Lan did manage to read an entire task name, but that was all. A summary? Heh...
Snatching red envelopes isn’t even this fast! Are these people snatching tasks all bots? Has some scalper company already extended its greedy claws to Star Martial Warriors?
Wang Lan seriously suspected.
Wang Lan was undeterred and refreshed again.
He clicked.
Damn, it’s already taken?
My hand speed, honed over forty years of being single across two lifetimes, still can’t beat them? This is unscientific!
He refreshed again, his finger a blur, not even looking at what the mission was, just trying to grab anything.
"Task acquisition successful!" The webpage even thoughtfully displayed a cute fireworks animation to celebrate.
Damn it!
Indeed, rules were rigid, but people were adaptable. To get a mission, one had to be quick and strike first. Wang Lan, feeling as if he’d grasped some profound life philosophy, calmly opened the task description.
"Investigate Red Maple Forest Park: The Mystery of the Time Tunnel."
A time tunnel? That sounds kind of interesting.
Wang Lan stroked his chin, carefully reading the details.
Time and Space Tunnels were not rare in this world; Different Dimensional Spaces were one type of Time and Space Tunnel. Many people believed that since Different Dimensional Spaces appeared on Sky Blue Star, they must exist within Sky Blue Star itself.
But this claim was unscientific. Scientifically speaking, a spatial rift is essentially a wormhole visible to the naked eye. Stepping through such a rift into a Different Dimensional Space could transport a person to a planet millions, or even billions, of light-years away.Thɪs updatᴇd by
Of course, this was just a possibility. Different Dimensional Spaces weren’t random spatial transports like wormholes. For instance, it was difficult to explain why almost every Different Dimensional Space contained Exotic Beasts, and why all these Exotic Beasts possessed Soul Beads.
Every year, there were people who accidentally entered Time and Space Tunnels. By taking one wrong step, they could traverse thousands of miles, finding themselves transported from the Southern Hemisphere to the Northern Hemisphere.
Even ancient great emperors who traversed star systems, upon witnessing such a feat, would have to remark with admiration, "Fellow Daoist, your cultivation is truly profound to achieve such instantaneous travel across vast distances! Would you dare to dismount and engage in battle?"
But Time Tunnels were different; they presented a problem with the flow of time. Although one might remain in the same physical location, the passage of time would be incongruent. Such situations were extremely rare, so much so that Wang Lan wasn’t even sure if one had ever truly occurred.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Searching for the Time Tunnel
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 91: Searching for the Time Tunnel
Since June of this year, rumors of a time tunnel at Red Maple Forest Park began to circulate. Some visitors mysteriously disappeared while touring the park. After fruitless searches by their accompanying visitors, they sought help from the park management.
After one or two hours of unsuccessful searching, the missing person would return on their own. However, they claimed to have only ventured deep into the forest to relieve themselves, insisting the whole ordeal didn’t last more than five minutes.
Moreover, the watches worn by those who disappeared showed a discrepancy of one or two hours from the outside world. Previously, the management of Red Maple Forest Park had called in experts to investigate, but months of research turned up nothing. Instead, incidents involving the time tunnel occurred from time to time.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
After reading the summary, Wang Lan’s face showed a bitter smile.
This sort of thing wasn’t really within the job scope of a Star Martial Warrior, right? Searching for time tunnels, that’s a physicist’s job. Star Martial Warriors can do physical labor, but scientific research... Only someone with good math and science skills like me could perhaps give it a try.
Yet, the likelihood of success for this mission, in my view, did not exceed one percent. Is it still not too late to regret taking it on?
The missions undertaken by Star Martial Warriors only had two outcomes: either voluntarily giving up and deeming the mission a failure, or succeeding and earning points.
Damn! That’s just inhumane.
Wang Lan sank into his Spiritual Sea of Consciousness to pull up the system, and sure enough, the mission board had added an ongoing task.
"Xiao Ai, help me look up information related to the time tunnel at Red Maple Forest Park."
"Okay, searching for information. Search complete. There are a total of three hundred and forty news articles and posts related to the time tunnel incidents at Red Maple Forest Park."
The next day, Wang Lan left his home equipped for battle, taking Line 7 to the final station, which led directly to Red Maple Forest Park.
Originally, Red Maple Forest Park, as a tourist holiday area, peaked in visitor numbers during the National Day holiday. Especially in November, when the maple leaves began to turn red, the beauty was extraordinary.
However, due to the time tunnel incidents, the park management opted for safety and chose to close the park. They could not open for business until the matter was thoroughly investigated.
This was why the management was so desperate to throw a hail Mary pass and assign this task to the Star Martial Warrior—the closing of the park meant losing money every day. Perhaps in the management’s eyes, Star Martial Warriors were akin to superheroes, psychics, and deities.
Capable of catching tigers on the mountain and capturing dragons in the water, there was nothing they couldn’t do.
You’re right about all that. Star Martial Warriors just had to accept it!
Arriving at the firmly shut gate, notices about the park’s closure were plastered in the most conspicuous place. Many clusters of tourists arrived excitedly only to leave disappointed.
Watching the groups of dejected visitors leave, the project manager’s face was painted with an apologetic smile, but inside he was in agony.
Don’t those departing figures resemble the God of Wealth enshrined at home?
They did. They looked so damn much like them.
As Wang Lan approached the entrance, he glanced at a middle-aged man in a suit and asked, "Excuse me, are you in charge of Red Maple Forest Park? I’m Wang Lan; we had an appointment."
"Ah? You?" The man was obviously not expecting the student-looking Wang Lan to be the Star Martial Warrior he had scheduled.
He’s just... too young, right?
Eyeing Wang Lan with a slight distrust, he asked, "Young man, are you sure you have a... professional rank?"
He had specified a B-level professional rank requirement on the task, meaning that only Star Martial Warriors who were battle-hardened and experienced could take on the job. Yet, the young man before him clearly didn’t fit that description.
"Here’s my Star Martial Badge, and this is my mission acceptance proof!" Wang Lan handed over his credentials, which upon verification made the man smile warmly, "Impressive, young fellow. To be a B+ professional rank Star Martial Warrior at such a young age. Are you familiar with the mission details?"
"I’m aware. Have you prepared the precise map of the locations where the time tunnel incidents have occurred that I asked you for?"
"Yes, yes!" he said, hastily taking an enlarged tourist map of Red Maple Forest Park from his briefcase. Locations one through ten were marked on it.
This indicated that there had been at least ten time tunnel incidents over the past four months. Taking the map, Wang Lan entered the forest park. At the entrance, he had put on an air of confidence, but once inside, his assured demeanor quickly deflated.
No confidence at all, not even a clue.
Oh well, I’ll just go try my luck.
Red Maple Forest Park was previously just a few mounds of earth situated in the southeast of Suzhou City. Starting from the 1950s, as part of a national effort to develop the tourism industry, Suzhou City was naturally part of this wave.
Red Maple Forest Park was developed at the same time as Sky Curtain Lake Wildlife Resort, Xishan Tourist Resort, and a dozen or so other A-class scenic areas. Decades of restorative efforts have shaped what is now the forest park.
Striving to preserve the original essence of the forest park while also ensuring tourists enjoy their visit required meticulous consideration from the management.
The winding, labyrinth-like stone paths spread like a spider web throughout the maple forest, which covered an area with a radius of three kilometers. When filled with tourists, the park didn’t feel that large, but now that Wang Lan was alone, it felt like entering a deep, remote forest.
At the first location, everything was normal.
At the second location, everything was normal.
The third location... What the heck am I doing?
I walked to the marked places, found nothing, and sensed no anomalies. Wandering around like this is a complete waste of time.
Ask a Star Martial Warrior to look for something tangible, and they might find it. But to have a Star Martial Warrior search for a time tunnel? Do they think Star Martial Warriors are some kind of spatial detectors?
Continuing to wander around aimlessly like this is just a waste of time.
"Help me out here—"
"I know, but wait until I’m steady. Stand still."
"You’re a grown man, getting tired like this after just an hour of walking? Are you feeling weak?"
"You’ll find out tonight whether I’m weak or not. Look at me, carrying dozens of pounds of equipment alone."
"Lanlan, stop teasing Chen Jing. It’s hard enough for him carrying all that gear."
"Mumu’s still the best; she actually knows how to be considerate."
"Fine, you two are the good ones, and I’m the bad one. Why don’t you two just get together then?"
"Stop messing around!"
In the distance, Wang Lan heard voices in conversation. Following the sound, he saw two women and a man with backpacks struggling to climb toward the third marked spot.
Wang Lan stood at the top of the slope, looking down at the three people below him. They seemed to sense someone watching and turned their heads to look up at Wang Lan.
Four pairs of eyes met, staring at each other.
"Ah! We are... here to investigate the time tunnel... We’re master’s students from Suzhou University."
"Red Maple Forest Park is closed; how did you sneak in?" Wang Lan asked in a deep voice.
"Little brother, you aren’t a staff member of the park either, are you?" a girl wearing a duckbill cap asked as she raised her head to look at Wang Lan with a smile.
Wang Lan took out the pass he had just received from the middle-aged man, put it around his neck, and asked, "How about now?"
"..."
"Big brother... We came here out of curiosity about the time tunnel for a research project we’re working on. Please, be a dear, don’t drive us away..." another sweet-looking girl pleaded with Wang Lan, putting on a cute act.
"Oh my god! I can’t take it, Lanlan, you’re an older sister calling someone who isn’t even twenty ’big brother’... have you no shame?" a bespectacled young man beside her cried out in a hurry.
"What’s the matter? Are you jealous?"
"Not at all..."
Wang Lan ignored their blatant public display of affection. Instead, the equipment on the man’s back held his gaze for a long moment.
"What is this? Is it used to search for the time tunnel?"
"Yes! This is a magnetic field exploration device that can detect magnetic fields. Besides velocity, time flow can also be affected by strong gravity or magnetic fields. According to the formulas of relativity theory, we calculated that the force causing changes in time flow is..."
"Wait!" Wang Lan quickly interrupted the girl with the duckbill cap from launching into a lengthy exposition.
For such a science fanatic, letting her start could mean she wouldn’t finish for an hour or two. I’m in no mood to listen to her ramble on about science and theories.
At least, the existence of Different Dimensional Space still can’t be explained by science.
"This thing can help us find the time tunnel, right?"
"In theory, yes."
"Come up here; let’s search together. I was entrusted by the park management to come here and discover the truth about the time tunnel."
"Huh? The park management entrusted you? Why not entrust us?" the girl named Lanlan asked curiously.
"Perhaps, they are a bit naïve."
With Wang Lan’s help, the three managed to climb the slope. They had the equipment but did not know the exact locations where the time tunnel occurrences took place. Wang Lan, however, had the precise coordinates of places where the time tunnel incidents had occurred multiple times.
It was practically a match made in heaven, a divinely ordained union... Pfft!
The party of four began their search, checking each marked location starting from the first.
The girl with the duckbill cap held a computer that displayed a radar-like scanning circle, refreshing round after round.
They spent more than three hours and visited five locations. However, far from detecting any magnetic field anomalies, they didn’t even find a single metal tin can.
"What’s going on... we’ve searched five places, and our legs are about to break, yet we found nothing..." the girl named Lanlan sighed in dismay.
"If it were that easy, the professors wouldn’t have come back empty-handed last month. Could it be that the magnetic field changes of the time tunnel don’t occur continuously but are caused by a combination of various factors?" the bespectacled man asked in a grave tone.
"That’s possible. If that’s the case, we either need to monitor it for a long time, or it’s a matter of luck. If we’re lucky, we might just encounter it. We have five more points to check. If we still come up empty, we’ll have to change our strategy."
"Wait a minute!" Lanlan suddenly spoke up, "Li Jing, come with me."
"What for?"
"Put the equipment down! Hurry up and follow me..."
"This... isn’t right, is it?" Li Jing glanced from Wang Lan to Mumu.
He felt it wasn’t right to leave Mumu alone with a man he didn’t know well.
"Are you an idiot? I need to pee!"
"Oh—"
Li Jing then set down the device, and the girl pulled him into a secluded part of the maple forest. "Mumu, keep an eye on this guy for me; don’t let him wander off," Lanlan’s voice came from a distance.
Wang Lan looked innocently at Mumu, who covered her mouth and giggled, "Do I look that untrustworthy?"
"Not at all; you’re quite handsome... But you know, as a woman, you should learn to protect yourself. By the way, what’s your name? Are you still in school? How did they think to ask you to help with the investigation?"
"I’m still in high school. I’m a Star Martial Warrior."
"Oh? No wonder," the girl’s eyes lit up when she heard Wang Lan was a Star Martial Warrior. "Could I have your QQ number?"
"Sure, no problem."
"AAAH—"
Just as Wang Lan was about to take out his phone, a scream from Lanlan suddenly rang out nearby. In the instant the sound reached him, Wang Lan had already vanished from the spot in a flash of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 92: The Truth About the Time Tunnel
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 92: The Truth About the Time Tunnel
"Quick, pull me up! Ah—so filthy, so filthy—"
Wang Lan had just burst out of the dense forest when he suddenly heard a cry of alarm in front of him. In an instant, Wang Lan halted in his tracks.
For some reason, the girl named Lanlan had accidentally fallen into a pool of sewage. The pool was only as deep as her chest, and a young man named Li Jing was using a tree trunk to pull her out.
Seeing Li Jing struggling, Wang Lan flashed over to lend him a hand.
"How did you get here?" Li Jing suddenly turned his head and frowned as he asked.
"I came running when I heard her scream."
"Heard a scream?" Li Jing turned his head to look at the distant dense forest.
It must be at least one or two hundred meters away, right? How could it be, in just a few seconds?
At once, Li Jing’s gaze toward Wang Lan grew even more unfriendly.
"Don’t doubt it; Mumu can vouch for me. I was with her before I heard the scream. I’m a Star Martial Warrior; this distance is nothing for me."
"You’re a Star Martial Warrior!" Li Jing’s face showed surprise, and he immediately understood. He knew about Star Martial Warriors, so it made complete sense for him to arrive so quickly. Besides, it was very reassuring to have a Star Martial Warrior nearby in the wilderness.
"It stinks to high heaven... My skin’s going to rot... It’s over, I’m going to break out in a rash!" Lanlan wailed towards the sky after climbing ashore.
The pool of stagnant water hadn’t been changed in who knows how long; you can imagine the smell. Plus, it was early November. The temperature difference between day and night was substantial, but their attire was still quite light.
As Lanlan fell into the pool, she inadvertently gave Wang Lan a view of her drenched form. Wang Lan’s cheeks reddened, and he silently turned away.
"What is this? Algae or hair? Ah—" Lanlan had just started to complain when suddenly, an even sharper scream erupted.
Wang Lan turned back to see Lanlan had fallen to the ground, terrified, staring straight at the edge of the pool.
Wang Lan’s expression changed drastically. He flashed to the poolside, spotting a soggy skull lying there, the kind that was completely decayed.
It seemed to be a woman’s, as long hair was tangled around Lanlan’s ankles.
"Call the police! Damn it, why is there no signal... Hurry, let’s go, someone died in the forest park..." After regaining her composure, Lanlan frantically pulled at Li Jing, screaming.
There was only a skull, and it was uncertain how long it had been dead—perhaps there were other bones in the pool.
Wang Lan stood up. Just as he turned around, he suddenly dashed beside Lanlan with lightning speed, pinching a leech off her snow-white thigh.
Lanlan was startled by Wang Lan’s sudden move and snapped back, "What are you doing?"
"There was a leech on you from the pool; it was this big." Wang Lan dropped the leech to the ground. It wriggled like a plump earthworm; it looked to be a hefty five or six grams.
Lanlan, being a young woman, was petrified by the horrifying sight of the leech.
"Ah—" She grabbed her hair and let out a series of bloodcurdling screams.
"What do I do... Li Jing, what do I do... I was completely in the water just now! Is there still something on me? Is there?!"
Wang Lan calmly looked at the leech on the ground and gently raised a foot.
SQUISH! Wang Lan crushed the leech underfoot, and its bright red blood splattered out.
"You’re asking me? I don’t know either. How about we hurry home, or maybe go to the hospital?"
"By the time you get to the hospital, the leeches will have already burrowed into your flesh! I suggest you take off your clothes now and have your boyfriend check your entire body. Don’t worry, I’ll turn my back and won’t peek."
With that said, Wang Lan turned around. Lanlan quickly stripped off her dress, her snow-white body standing before Li Jing. "Quick, check for me!"
"Oh, oh..." Li Jing suddenly came to his senses. "There’s nothing on the front, but on the back... ah, there are three on the back!"
"Then what are you waiting for? Help me pull them out—"
"But they’ve burrowed in halfway! I can’t grab them!"
"Little brother, help—" Lanlan suddenly shouted imperiously and kicked her boyfriend in front of her to the ground.
Instantly, Wang Lan turned around, his fingers pinpointing the three leeches on Lanlan’s snow-white back that were desperately burrowing in. He plucked out the three leeches and tossed them onto the ground, then decisively turned away.
"Put your clothes on slowly; check if there are any leeches inside them first."
Lanlan, about to get dressed, paused. She shook her clothes in a panic, and sure enough, three leeches fell out.
After checking several times and being certain there were none left, she hurriedly slipped on her dress.
"Little brother, it’s good now..."
"Damn it, damn it!" Li Jing, kicked aside by his girlfriend, felt a profound sense of humiliation. But he couldn’t bring himself to blame Wang Lan, for he wasn’t the type to repay kindness with enmity. So, he could only vent by stomping on the leeches on the ground.
After much stamping, the leeches were still lively.
"Stop messing with the bugs; let’s hurry back," Wang Lan stopped the man, who was clearly in his twenties yet still behaved so childishly. As he passed the leeches, he very carelessly—SPLAT!—crushed the three that had been pulled from Lanlan’s back until they burst.
The bright red blood made Lanlan’s face turn white as a sheet again.
In a panic, they quickly left in the direction they had come from.
But when they arrived at the spot where Mumu had been, Mumu was nowhere to be seen. From the moment Wang Lan had left until their return, barely twenty minutes had elapsed. Yet Mumu’s disappearance at this time seemed highly abnormal.
When Lanlan screamed, Wang Lan had rushed over immediately. Mumu should have also come right away. It was only a distance of a little over a hundred meters; logically, Mumu should have met them at the poolside.
But clearly, Mumu had not come.
Yet all the equipment they carried was left intact in its place.
"Mumu—Mumu—where are you?" Lanlan called out anxiously.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs
"Where has that damn girl run off to? Disappearing at a time like this, did she stumble into a time tunnel?" Lanlan cursed, stomping her foot in frustration.
"It’s possible!" Li Jing moved to the computer, observing the fluctuations on the screen that jumped rapidly, like Mario.
"There’s a strong magnetic field anomaly here, covering a range of five hundred meters. That’s why our cell phone signals are being interfered with," Li Jing said, peering at the computer screen as he immediately switched into scientist mode.
Wang Lan watched, taken aback by how quickly Li Jing’s demeanor had changed. One moment he was all flustered, saying they needed to leave quickly, and the next he was as calm as an old dog?
Hearing Li Jing’s explanation, Wang Lan took out the cell phone issued by the Tianjian Bureau. After glancing at it, his expression changed drastically.
"Quick, let’s get out of here."
The cell phone Wang Lan carried came with military-grade signal transmission and reception, which meant interference shouldn’t disrupt it this completely. Besides, Wang Lan had at least finished high school physics.
If it was truly a strong magnetic field disrupting the signals, then both their cell phones and the computer would have been rendered useless. But in reality, the phone was stable, and the computer was running just fine.
"Leave? No, I can’t just leave Mumu alone here. Mumu—Mumu—"
Lanlan called out in distress, even daring to walk away from Wang Lan and Li Jing towards the dense forest opposite them.
"Mumu—"
Adversity reveals true friendship; this clearly wasn’t just superficial sisterhood.
"Hey! Lanlan? I’m here—"
At that moment, Mumu’s response came from within the woods. Soon after, Mumu, wearing a duckbill cap, emerged from the forest.
"Lanlan, what’s wrong? You look like you’ve been bullied," the girl called Mumu teased with a laugh.
"Mumu, where did you run off to? I was so worried about you, and you’re making fun of me? Where have you been all this time?"
"All this time? It’s only been a moment. The detector sensed some magnetic field fluctuations, so I rushed over there. But after going around a bit and finding nothing, I came back. It was three minutes at most."
"What three minutes? It’s been half an hour!"
"Really? You’re exaggerating, aren’t you?" Mumu said incredulously, lifting her wristwatch. "Look, three minutes."
"Look! Thirty minutes!"
"Hey, you two, is this really the time to argue about three minutes versus thirty minutes? Now that we’re all here, let’s go! Get out of here!"
"Wait... does this mean... we’ve found the time tunnel?" Mumu suddenly realized, shouting with excitement.
"It could be! The laptop has been recording all along, right? Let’s go back and analyze the recorded patterns; our graduation report this year could depend on it!"
"That’s great—"
"We should still leave quickly; this place isn’t safe," Wang Lan urged, looking around warily.
"Alright, alright, let’s go, move it!" Li Jing reacted swiftly, snapped the laptop shut, grabbed the equipment, and stood up.
"Mumu, I need to tell you, someone was killed in this forest park. Just now, in that pond, there was a skeleton..."
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s hand shot out like lightning, touching Mumu’s neck.
"What are you doing?" Mumu turned around in fright, glaring coldly at Wang Lan.
On the tip of Wang Lan’s finger, a sluggish leech squirmed slightly.
"There was a leech on your neck, though I’m not sure how it got there."
"Ah? Get it off, that’s disgusting!" Lanlan shrieked, her body trembling as the leech in Wang Lan’s hand seemed to revive some unpleasant memories.
Wang Lan casually tossed the leech to the ground.
SPLAT!
The leech burst, and green blood splattered out.
In that instant, Wang Lan’s steps halted, and a sharp glint flashed in his eyes.
And precisely at that moment, Li Jing, who had been standing aside, caught sight of it. "Huh? Mumu, why is your blood green?"
That must be what they call a ’fool of a teammate.’
In the instant Wang Lan internally criticized, his Ghost Wail sword appeared, and his form turned into a streak of light as he thrust his sword towards Mumu.
Mumu instantly flipped backwards, spinning twice in midair before landing steadily two meters away.
This sudden change left Lanlan and Li Jing stunned. It had all happened too fast; it felt like a ridiculous dream.
"Mumu... you... since when did you learn martial arts?"
"Mumu is already dead!" Wang Lan declared, Star Power surging around him as he pointed Ghost Wail at the Mumu before him. "It’s now a Demon... Only Demon blood is green."
"I wondered why that leech was so sluggish; turns out your blood is poisonous. Besides, there’s no such thing as a time tunnel. The process of their disappearance is the process of the Demon Clan killing them to take their place."
"Your watch’s time... was deliberately set to show only three minutes had passed. Demon Clan... are you beginning your invasion again?"
"Hmph—" A cold snort sounded. The face of the Mumu before them suddenly began to distort. Its eyes bulged from their sockets, and its skin turned into a dark brown, keratinous texture.
Its hands suddenly grew longer, and its legs twisted grotesquely. In less than three seconds, a two-meter-tall, powerfully built Demon Clan warrior appeared before the trio.
"A moment of carelessness led to a slip... but no matter. As long as I kill you all, it still won’t affect our plans," boomed the deep, layered voice from the Demon’s pincer-like jaws.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 A Great Achievement
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 93 A Great Achievement
"AHHH—"
It was at this moment that the girl named Lanlan finally realized what was happening.
"Mumu... what is this thing? This..."
"This is the Demon Clan!" Wang Lan declared, drawing Ghost Wail from behind his back, his expression intense as he faced the adversary.
The Demon Soldiers they had previously encountered at Sky Curtain Lake were only the lowest tier, possibly Biochemical Demon Soldiers. But this one could speak, which meant it was a member of the Demon Clan.
Wang Lan had never fought a member of the Demon Clan before, but judging from how a member of the Demon Clan had killed the demonized Chang Shuangyue with a single move a few days ago, their strength was extraordinary.
Just then, rustling noises emerged from the dense forest, and dozens of previously unseen Biochemical Demon Soldiers appeared, surrounding the three of them.
Seeing the Biochemical Demon Soldiers, Lanlan and the one named Li Jing were so frightened they turned pale. Besides trembling, they were now incapable of anything else.
"Little brother... what should we do... are we going to die?"
If not for these two burdens, Wang Lan might have thought of retreating immediately and then notifying Director Wang to dispatch experts from the Tianjian Bureau to sweep the area. But with these two in tow, Wang Lan had no choice but to fight.
Without any hesitation, Wang Lan instantly activated his Phoenix Form.
As the Phoenix Tail Flower on his forehead lit up, Wang Lan’s form transformed into a streak of light, appearing right in front of the Demon.
The Demon was considering how to cook this Star Martial Warrior who had almost ruined its plans. It had heard that the flesh of Star Martial Warriors was delectable when fried.
But in the blink of an eye, the weak-looking human primary warrior disappeared. Then a streak of light, like a white thread, flashed past right before its eyes.
In an instant, the Demon’s eyes bulged, its face twisting in disbelief and terror.
"You are... at the Galaxy Stage? Impossible... How could a low-level warrior like you be... at the Galaxy Stage?"
Wang Lan was also puzzled, looking back at the Demon. It wasn’t until the Demon’s head dropped from its shoulders and the kill notification sounded in his mind that Wang Lan finally believed it. The Demon warrior, whom he had imagined to be incredibly powerful, had indeed been taken down by his single move.
"Killing above one’s level, reward: 1,000 experience points, 50 skill points."
Only fifty skill points...
Wang Lan felt somewhat dissatisfied.
I thought the Demon Clan was supposed to be strong... How could there be such a weak one? What a waste of my Phoenix Form.
Since he had already activated his Phoenix Form, his figure flickered, and the heads of the surrounding Biochemical Demon Soldiers were chopped off in the blink of an eye.
Having done this, Wang Lan immediately deactivated his Phoenix Form. The Phoenix Form consumed ten skill points per second. He had used it for five seconds, spending fifty skill points.
Fortunately, each of these Biochemical Demon Soldiers had a Soul Bead, providing Wang Lan with several dozen skill points. Overall... he didn’t lose out.
Li Jing and Lanlan had truly experienced the unpredictable nature of their situation.
What had happened in the past hour? The two youngsters tried to sort through the chaos. First, they fell into a pond. After crawling out, one found a skull tangled around their ankle.
Wow, how thrilling!
Just as they recovered from the terror of the skull, several leeches were cheerfully burrowing into their skin. Then, they dealt with the terrifying and thrilling task of removing the leeches, only to find that a good friend had disappeared.
The good friend was found, and just before they could rejoice at their reunion, the good friend turned into a member of the Demon Clan. Then, they were surrounded by a group of monsters, looking as if they were about to die for sure.
Then, this young man erupted in power, instantly killing all the monsters.
Perfect...
The continuous climax of events and the soaring blood pressure had numbed Lanlan’s nerves. As Stephen Chow says in his movies, when a person experiences too much excitement in a short period, it can exceed their limit of endurance, and then... they won’t react anymore.
So, when the Demon Clan drooled over them, the young girl bravely pulled through. But when Wang Lan eliminated all the Demons, the young girl’s eyes rolled back, and she fainted gracefully into her boyfriend’s arms.
"Lanlan—what’s wrong with you?"
"Stop shouting, let’s get moving!"
With Wang Lan’s urging, Li Jing put down the equipment, lifted his girlfriend, and ran as fast as he could.
Speaking of which, this man named Li Jing must have decent physical stamina among ordinary people. He was able to carry his girlfriend swiftly even after bearing a heavy load of equipment for so long.
No wonder a science guy like him managed to get a girlfriend; physical strength must have been a big factor.
After running for half an hour, Wang Lan finally found the entrance to Red Maple Forest Park based on his memory. As he rushed out of the entrance, he was surprised to see that the chubby middle-aged man from before had not left.
"Eh? Young Master Wang, you’re out? Did you find the cause?"
"Why haven’t you left?"
"I don’t have much to do, so I was waiting here for you."
"I figured it out. Do me a favor, take these two to the hospital for a full check-up," Wang Lan said, pointing to Li Jing and the unconscious Lanlan. Then he took out his mobile phone to find the signal had indeed been restored.
He dialed the number.
Twenty minutes later, the roaring sound of helicopters filled the sky. Three helicopters sliced through the clouds and quickly arrived above Wang Lan’s head. There was no indication that the helicopters intended to land; instead, figures began jumping down from them.
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH—
Thirty people landed in the clearing in front of Wang Lan. Leading them was Lige, whom Wang Lan had met before.
Lige, dressed in a crisp military uniform without a single wrinkle, strode up to Wang Lan and stood at attention, saluting.
This formal manner of greeting took Wang Lan by surprise, and he instinctively returned the salute.
"Wang Lan—" Wang Qianfeng landed gently like a feather, coming to a stop in front of Wang Lan.
"Director Wang!"
"Tell me the details."
"Yes! Last night, I took on a mission from the Star Martial Union to investigate the mystery of the time tunnel at Red Maple Forest Park. This morning I came here to investigate, and during my search, I encountered three students from Suzhou University. They were also here to investigate the mystery of the time tunnel.
"Later, during the investigation, one of the three, a girl named Mumu, disappeared. After half an hour, we found her. She claimed she had entered the time tunnel and tried to be vague about it.
"But just then, I saw a leech sucking blood from her neck. When I removed the leech and stepped on it, I noticed the blood it had sucked was green. From that, I determined that this Mumu was not human but a member of the Demon Clan.
"Therefore, I deduced that the so-called time tunnel was actually a sham. The Demon Clan captures humans, kills them, and then replaces their identity with a member of their own, successfully infiltrating human society.
"The so-called time tunnel is nothing more than a lie they’ve spun.
"As expected, after I exposed her identity, that Mumu transformed into a demon. Moreover, several dozen Demon Soldiers appeared in the dense forest, the same kind I previously encountered in the Different Dimensional Space beneath the ring road.
"The Demon from before and the newly emerged Demon Soldiers have been killed by me, but I’m certain there are still other members of the Demon Clan in the forest." Wang Lan spoke clearly and concisely, summing up the situation.
"Lige, did you get all that?"
"Loud and clear. I guarantee their total annihilation."
"Go then."Thɪs updatᴇd by
"I’ll go too," Wang Lan said hurriedly.
"No need for you to go. You’ve already earned primary credit for discovering the Demon Clan’s tracks and their plans. The combat task falls to the Action Department. We’re the Intelligence Department; our job is to provide information," Wang Qianfeng consoled, patting Wang Lan’s shoulder.
Wang Qianfeng himself had gone through this stage. When he first joined the Tianjian Bureau, he was full of young pride, with a single-minded desire to earn recognition and to act.
But everyone wants to rack up achievements, everyone wants to get things done, and everyone wants to get promoted. Not one person can do it all by themselves. And not one person can take all the credit. Wang Lan had already taken the juiciest piece of credit; it was only fair to leave some soup for the brother departments.
Wang Qianfeng thought Wang Lan wouldn’t understand this and planned to teach him later. However, Wang Lan was currently thinking about those skill points.
"Um, Captain Li," Wang Lan said cautiously, "there’s a pond in the center of the forest. By the pond, there’s a woman’s head. It might be the remains of a victim. Please retrieve it."
"Got it!" Lige said indifferently, giving a wave of his hand. The thirty individuals behind him instantly sprang into action, turning into streaks of afterimages as they charged into Red Maple Forest Park.
It wasn’t long before the sounds of combat reached their ears.
"Wang Lan, come over here." Wang Qianfeng leaned casually against the doorway, lighting a cigarette. "You did well this time! Truly worthy of someone I handpicked."
"Director Wang, you’re too kind. About Lige... I met him once before, and it seemed like he had some friction with Brother Xu. He didn’t seem to have a favorable impression of me either?" Wang Lan remarked, discreetly trying to badmouth Lige. After all, Lige had baselessly scolded him for three minutes last time; Wang Lan hadn’t forgotten that grudge.
Wang Qianfeng replied, "It’s not so much a conflict, more of a competitive relationship. Xu Shiyun was promoted to Captain a year before him, and both are now vying for the rank of Major. With competition, of course, things won’t be harmonious.
"However, even if we are competing, the Intelligence Department and Action Department can’t be at odds. That’s also why I brought Lige this time instead of Xu Shiyun.
"The same goes for you. You have capability, talent, and damn good luck. Tell me, how many times has this happened in just a couple of months? For someone else, it might not happen even in several years.
"But you can’t hog all the benefits. If you eat meat, others should at least get some soup; then they will remember your kindness. When you’re in trouble, they will help you. If you hog everything, you become the nail that sticks out, like that Lige.
"You can’t be like him. Be tactful; know how to share the benefits. By sharing them, you’re also distributing troubles and dangers, even if those benefits are rightfully yours."
"Yes! I sincerely appreciate the advice."
"Keep up the good work," Wang Qianfeng continued, patting Wang Lan’s shoulder again. "With your luck, are you worried about future merits? I will definitely secure this primary credit for you; no one can take it away."
"Director Wang, is this considered good luck for me? Seems more like bad luck," Wang Lan interjected.
"It depends on the person," Wang Qianfeng replied, his eyes looking off into the distance. "For other Star Martial Warriors, it would indeed be very unlucky. For an ordinary person, it would be utterly disastrous.
"But you’re different. You’re one of us at the Tianjian Bureau, a soldier under me, Wang Qianfeng of the Intelligence Department. What do we at the Tianjian Bureau do? Isn’t it our job to clean up these Demon Bastards?
"Encountering Demons causing trouble isn’t a bad thing for you; in fact, the more, the better. The more there are, the more merits we get. Honestly, I still can’t believe how lucky you are. How do you just stumble upon Demon Clan conspiracies while on completely unrelated tasks?"
"Heh..." Wang Lan had nothing to say in response, so he could only chuckle dryly.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: He’s Having a Better Time Than Us
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 94: He’s Having a Better Time Than Us
"BOOM—"
Suddenly, deep within Red Maple Forest Park, lightning flashed and thunder roared, and intense waves of Spirit Power Fluctuations swept through.
Wang Lan and Wang Qianfeng’s conversation halted abruptly as they both turned to look in the direction of the surging Spiritual Power.
"It seems there’s something going on inside."
"Should we send support?"
"Lige’s abilities are quite good; he should be able to handle it," Wang Qianfeng said lightly.
"Director Wang, what if there is a master from the Demon Clan inside? Since the Demon Clan has been the greatest threat to humanity, constantly suppressing us, their masters must be no weaker than ours. And since they have infiltrated the Human World as spies, they must be the elite of the Demon Clan. We can’t afford to take this lightly."
"It’s true that they are elites of the Demon Clan, but you may not be aware of some common knowledge." Wang Qianfeng suddenly realized that this young man who had accomplished so many extraordinary feats was actually just a rookie Star Martial Warrior who had awakened to his talent only two or three months ago.
"The Demon Clan and the human race are situated in different spacetimes. Human high-tech cannot be used in Different Dimensional Spaces, much less in the Demon World. So, do you think the world’s Laws only restrict us humans?"
"You mean... the Demons are restricted too?"
"The only way for the Demon Clan to retain its strength when coming to Sky Blue Star is through dimensional incursion. They have an Array that, when activated, can gradually erode and eventually merge two spacetimes.
However, this type of dimensional incursion emits very strong energy fluctuations, and dimensional incursions anywhere can be detected by us. Once the incursion is complete, the Demon Clan is no longer affected by the spacetime laws, and our technology is no longer hindered by the Different Dimensional Space.
That’s why, when Dongdao Country was eroded by the Demon Clan and turned into part of the Demon World, the nuclear bombs hidden in Dongdao Country could still be detonated at a critical moment.
Without completing spacetime incursion, the more powerful an individual is, the less able they are to cross the spacetime boundary into the Human World. On this point, humans have a significant advantage.
Once our human Star Martial Warriors awaken their talent, they can freely enter Different Dimensional Spaces."
"So you’re saying... even if the Demon Clan has infiltrated our human civilization, their strength isn’t that strong?"
Wang Lan would never have thought of this if no one told him.
This could explain why the Demon Clan member he killed with a single strike was so weak. In Wang Lan’s mind, a spy infiltrating behind enemy lines should have been the elite of the elite.
"We can’t be blindly optimistic, though, because the spatial restriction is only in place as the Demon Clan enters the Human World. Once they successfully arrive, this limitation dissipates.
So the Demon Clan has thought of a workaround; they send some of their noble offspring to the Human World when they are young and weak, where they then lie in wait, waiting for the right moment to activate.
These Demon Clan spies haven’t just recently infiltrated; in the seventy years since the war ended, they have never stopped their infiltration. But in terms of growth potential, the Demon Clan matures much later than we do."
Having listened to Wang Qianfeng’s explanation, Wang Lan came to understand. The real situation was far more complex than he had imagined. The conflict between the Demon Clan and humans wasn’t merely a war between nations; it was a race war that transcended time and space. There was so much more for Wang Lan to learn.
At that moment, the aftershocks of the distant battle suddenly erupted intensely, followed by a strange distortion in the space far away.
"Looks like Lige has finished the task," Wang Qianfeng said as he took out his phone to make a call.
Before long, several figures emerged from the dense forest. Gradually, warriors from the Tianjian Bureau Action Department walked out of the forest, with seven or eight of them carrying the bodies of fallen comrades on their backs.
Lige approached Wang Lan and handed over a skull. "Is this the one?"
"Yes!"
"Then that’s good."
"Is it confirmed?" Wang Qianfeng asked Lige lightly as he approached.
"Reporting to Director Wang, it has been confirmed that Brother Wang Lan’s conjecture is completely accurate."
"Good!" Wang Qianfeng took out his cellphone again. "Xu Shiyun, we can close the net now."
Wang Lan guessed that the net Wang Qianfeng asked Xu Shiyun to close referred to those who had experienced the time tunnel incident in Red Maple Forest Park. In Wang Lan’s estimation, these people had already been replaced by the Demon Clan.
"For completing the Red Maple Forest Park Time Tunnel Mystery Mission, you are awarded 3,000 experience points and 300 skill points."
In his mind, Wang Lan heard the system’s voice.
The helicopter once again sliced through the clouds, hovering above everyone’s heads.
"Are you coming back to the bureau with me, or do you want to go home by yourself?"
"Is there anything else you need me for?"
"If you return to the bureau, you’ll be part of the case debrief. You’ll need to write a detailed report on the cause and course of the event. If not, then it’s not necessary. After all, you are still a student and haven’t officially joined the workforce."
"Then forget it, I’ll take the subway home." Wang Lan instinctively sensed that Wang Qianfeng did not want him to accompany him back to the Tianjian Bureau, so he prudently proposed that he leave on his own.
The mission was complete, and the benefit had been reaped. Now all that was left was to figure out how to spend the seven-day vacation.
「Upon returning home」
Wang Lan first added the 300 experience points to Star Cloud Sword Dance, thereby raising Star Cloud Sword Dance to the high level of silver 8.
Lying on his bed out of boredom and scrolling through his phone, he found that Xu Xiangwen, that showoff, had posted over a dozen updates today. The trio and Jiang Xinchen were playing in Modu City, fully deploying the law of money talks to enjoy VIP pathways, obliviously posting updates about the extremely crowded Wanxiang Amusement Park, where it was so packed one could hardly move.
Please don’t change to a new thrill ride every ten minutes, okay? Give me a break!
Seeing Xu Xiangwen and the others having so much fun, Wang Lan suddenly felt a tinge of envy.
Maybe... get up and continue to grind missions?
Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
As soon as he thought of it, he opened the Star Martial Hall’s official webpage, submitted the completed task, and got one hundred points. Then he found a short-term task and clicked to accept it.
Actually, many tasks for Star Martial Warriors are quite easy, with no combat involved. For example, providing protection for someone, escorting something valuable, such as treasures, money, and transporting important industrial machinery, and so on.
"Xinyu, are you going to post another one? I think if I keep posting, I’ll probably be targeted by those red-eyed people, tracked down, and beaten to death," Xu Xiangwen said. In the artificial sunroom, Jiang Xinyu and the other three were leisurely enjoying a sunbath, while outside the sunroom, a sign stood.
The sign read: "Equipment Under Maintenance, Temporarily Out of Service."
But... do they think amusement park goers are blind? Equipment under maintenance? Then what are those four doing lying in there? So, Xu Xiangwen’s worries were completely unnecessary. Why would anyone need to track them? They could be found in a single glance.
"Don’t you usually love making a spectacle of yourself?"
"Do you think Modu City is devoid of wealthy people? Acting like this might make some affluent individuals feel uncomfortable. By the way, do you think Wang Lan, that blockhead, will be provoked by me?"
"What does Wang Lan have to do with it?" Jiang Xinyu asked, turning her face away coldly.
"Hey, you’re being pretty obvious, aren’t you? You personally invited him to come out with us, and he dared to say he loves studying instead? Isn’t that a slap in the face to our Queen Jiang? Didn’t you remind me to post an update just to tell him how wrong he was for not coming?"
"That’s some strong survival instinct..." Gong Feiyu remarked, peering out from his magazine. He was impressed that Xu Xiangwen could explain the complex relationship between Jiang Xinyu and Wang Lan so innocently under such circumstances.
Explaining a rejected date as a lack of respect for her... makes sense. Impressive.
"No, Lan has posted an update," Jiang Xinchen said, sitting up.
"Oh? He actually posts updates? Has the caveman been resurrected?"
"No, he seems to be on a date with Li Xiaoqin."
"What?" Xu Xiangwen let out a shout of surprise and opened his social media to find a new post, indeed from Wang Lan.
In the photo, Wang Lan was laden with various shopping bags, looking like the common boy suffering through a shopping trip with his girlfriend. Next to him was the big star Li Xiaoqin, dragging him into a mad dash into a shopping mall.
The caption beneath the photo read: "I’m never accompanying a woman shopping again in my life."
With all the braggy updates Xu Xiangwen had posted, none could counter the bitterness of Wang Lan’s single lament.
Looking at the photo, Xu Xiangwen suddenly felt that all the privileges he enjoyed were tasteless.
That was... the national idol of Nanli Country, an A-list star even in Jade Country!
Wang Lan, you sly dog! Usually so straightforward, but it turns out you’re this kind of person!
"CRACK—"
A crisp sound echoed as the lounge chair beneath Jiang Xinyu transformed into an Ice Throne.
"No, when did Wang Lan and Li Xiaoqin get together? They shouldn’t have crossed paths at all," Xu Xiangwen said, sitting up and asking urgently.
"Nonsense! You should know what kind of person Wang Lan is. Li Xiaoqin is Nanli Country’s top actress, a national treasure idol. This time she’s in Suzhou City to shoot a major TV series, *Great Zhou Dynasty*, in collaboration with Jade Country. Never mind when they got together; they wouldn’t even have had the chance to meet. Unless Wang Lan has been to Nanli Country?"
"So you’re saying... the photo is photoshopped?"
"See for yourself!" Gong Feiyu handed his phone to Xu Xiangwen. "The task list of Suzhou City’s Star Martial Hall shows a four-day job as Li Xiaoqin’s personal bodyguard. Li Xiaoqin likes to shop and despises having dozens of bodyguards trailing her conspicuously, so she decided to hire Star Martial Warriors from Jade Country to protect her for ten hours each day. The person who took the job is precisely Wang Lan.
That kid knows how to play better than we do. You idiot were still playing bungee jumping while Wang Lan was already taking Star Martial tasks.
"
「In the dead of night」
Silence enveloped the Suzhou City branch of the Tianjian Bureau. Director Lu Zhao walked briskly through the deserted corridor to the meeting room door at the end and pushed it open.
SWISH—
Wang Qianfeng and a group of lieutenant colonels all stood up neatly.
"Everyone, take a seat."
Despite his unimposing appearance, Lu Zhao commanded irrefutable respect from everyone present. This veteran, who had once joined the United Security Organization, had a file in the United Nations archives half a meter thick. His wealth of experience and knowledge was so astounding that those who saw it were taken aback.
Naturally, someone capable of heading the Tianjian Bureau in such an important city was no unknown figure.
"We’ve just received a definitive report from the inspection department regarding the DNA match for the skull Lige brought back from the secret realm. Her name is Chang Yu, a twenty-four-year-old from the Gunan district of Suzhou City, a nurse at Renhe Hospital. And she is not on the list of those involved in the multiple incidents related to the time tunnel mystery."

chapters.title: Chapter 95: What Belongs to Wang Lan, No One Else Should Covet
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 95: What Belongs to Wang Lan, No One Else Should Covet
Hearing Lu Zhao’s words, the brows of the department heads present all rose slightly.
"Are there still fish that slipped through the net?" the Director of the Action Department, Li Weixin, asked indifferently.
"It seems so. And judging by this Chang Yu, it’s likely she’s not the only one. Moreover, we’ve discovered that almost all targets on our list became active when we began apprehending individuals who’ve been through the time tunnel. However... that Chang Yu went to and from work as usual, without any abnormal behavior. Therefore, the intelligence group speculates that Chang Yu and those who’ve experienced the time tunnel belong to two completely different groups, with different infiltration methods."
"Director Lu, Director Wang, Director Li," a middle-aged colonel with glasses said as he opened the file before him, "Chang Yu previously underwent a series of identity verification checks under our supervision. In addition to routine checks, we also conducted DNA verification. Ultimately, we concluded that this Chang Yu is indeed human. This check was conducted just half a month ago."
"So, Chang Yu was replaced by the Demon Clan within the last half-month?" Li Weixin asked doubtfully.
"No! The skull Captain Li brought back was tested. The time of death was determined to be over half a year ago. If this skull belongs to Chang Yu, then the Chang Yu who passed our layers of screening, the one we confirmed as human, was actually a member of the Demon Clan at that time."
"This..." Wu Chen of the medical department had just finished speaking when shock appeared on everyone’s faces. As veterans in this field, they all understood the terrifying implication behind those words.
The Demon Clan could already fool their precise instruments, even simulate human DNA to achieve complete deception. If every spy infiltrated by the Demon Clan could do this... it would be a nightmare for humanity!
Their expressions turned grim, and Li Weixin’s face became even paler. "Damn it! Arrest Chang Yu and use any means necessary to find out how they did it."
"When we captured those Demon Clan spies who infiltrated through Red Maple Forest Park, they all chose suicide once they knew escape was impossible. This indicates that this batch of Demons received extremely strict training and were committed to their infiltration mission with a die-hard resolve," Wang Qianfeng’s words once again dismissed Li Weixin’s suggestion.
"Then what do we do? Demons can fool our DNA testing now. If we don’t quickly find the cause and a countermeasure, how can we continue our work? Walking down the street, anyone could be a member of the Demon Clan. We might not even know if the person smiling at us is a Demon Clan spy."
"Director Li, Director Lu! There’s still more to Chang Yu’s background that we can dig into. She happens to be connected to an intelligence lead the Intelligence Department is currently investigating. Remember the Magical Martial Artist? The Magical Martial Artist actually didn’t first appear in the northwest. It had already appeared as early as this summer vacation in the beginner trial grounds. To date, there have been three cases of Magical Martial Artists.
The most recent case was at the Star Martial Art Championship arena. He MingXue and I rushed to the scene immediately. However, in the end, we only witnessed the Magical Martial Artist being killed by a Demon Clan master. That Demon Clan master was very powerful, likely no weaker than any of us here. After the kill, she escaped with an elusive movement technique. He MingXue and I couldn’t track her.
It was precisely because the Magical Martial Artist was Chang Shuangyue, Chang Yu’s brother, that we requested Chang Yu’s cooperation for the checks. At the time, Chang Yu showed no abnormalities. In hindsight, the Demon we almost apprehended that day was this Chang Yu. And Magical Martial Artists must be connected to the Demons. This Chang Yu should be our key breakthrough.
I suggest monitoring her twenty-four hours a day. We must know everyone she contacts and all her connections thoroughly. We might even directly uncover a high-level Demon Clan spy ring."
As Wang Qianfeng finished speaking, Lu Zhao gave a slight nod. "What does everyone think of Director Wang’s proposal?"
"Agreed!"
"Agreed!"
"Agreed!"
"Since everyone agrees, it’s settled. The surveillance of Chang Yu..." Lu Zhao’s gaze wandered between Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin.
Surveillance targets weren’t clearly categorized; they could fall under either the Intelligence Department or the Action Department.
Among the department heads in Suzhou City’s Tianjian Bureau, Wang Qianfeng was undoubtedly the most capable and best-performing. In the nine years since he came to Suzhou City to serve as Director of the Tianjian Bureau’s Intelligence Department, he hadn’t made a single oversight. It wasn’t that the other department heads weren’t good; Wang Qianfeng was just exceptionally outstanding.
Lu Zhao favored Wang Qianfeng. However, he still had to maintain an even hand. Sometimes, for the sake of balance, Lu Zhao even had to pass opportunities and benefits that should have gone to Wang Qianfeng to others. Lu Zhao preferred harmony among his subordinates but disliked it when they formed overly solid alliances.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"Director, let our Action Department handle this. We have sufficient manpower and experience to be fully competent for this task," Li Weixin said.
"Li, you’re being a bit excessive with your words, aren’t you? Are you implying our Intelligence Department is short-handed and lacks the experience for this task?" Wang Qianfeng countered.
"Wang, was that my implication? Don’t pick a pointless fight, alright? Surveillance of suspects is also part of the Action Department’s duties," Li Weixin retorted.
"Investigating a target’s background, identity, and covert organizational network seems to fall under the Intelligence Department, doesn’t it?" Wang Qianfeng countered.
"Alright, I won’t argue with you over this." Li Weixin quickly backed down upon seeing Wang Qianfeng’s firm stance. "The surveillance of Chang Yu can be assigned to the Intelligence team. However, Director, I have another matter. This time, Lige successfully led his squad to annihilate the Demon Clan’s hidden secret realm base and slay an early Galaxy Stage Demon General. Shouldn’t he be promoted?"
"Lige..." A faint smile appeared on Lu Zhao’s face. "I remember this young man. He was only eighteen when he first arrived, wasn’t he? An eighteen-year-old at the late Star Cloud Stage. It’s rare to find such talent anywhere in the country outside the four major academies."
"That’s him."
"Are his merits sufficient?"
"He has completed two hundred C-rank missions and seventy B-rank missions. The only missing A-rank mission has now been fulfilled with this," Li Weixin said, a proud smile on his face.
"Your dignity? Li, where’s your dignity?" Wang Qianfeng propped his chin on his hand and sneered.
"Wang, you’re deliberately picking a fight this time," Li Weixin retorted sharply, his face turning cold.
"Discovering a Demon Clan secret base and killing an early Galaxy Stage Demon. The merit is indeed great—an A-rank mission! In our Suzhou City, we might not even encounter one A-rank mission all year. However, is it appropriate to credit such an A-rank mission solely to Lige? Who discovered the Demon Clan’s conspiracy? Who found the clues about the Magical Martial Artists’ appearance? Was it Lige? I admit Lige is outstanding. We’ve all witnessed his performance over the past three years. I have no personal issue with him or his promotion, but the primary credit for this A-rank mission must go to Wang Lan."
"Director Wang, the main difficulty of this mission was destroying the Demon Clan’s base..."
"Aren’t you ashamed to say that?"
Li Weixin felt deeply ashamed! Especially when he said it, the mocking looks from the other directors made his old face burn.
But what could he do? He had finally nurtured a standout talent like Lige; of course, he had to promote him. But why, oh why, was it Wang Lan who discovered the Demon Clan’s conspiracy and confirmed the location of their base...?
"COUGH, COUGH." Lu Zhao coughed lightly, interrupting their argument. "Let’s not dispute that the primary credit for this matter belongs to Wang Lan of the Intelligence Department. If Wang Lan hadn’t discovered the Demon Clan’s conspiracy and their hidden base, all of us, Lige included, would have remained in the dark. Let’s do this: the task of surveilling Chang Yu to find other Demon Clan infiltration teams will be assigned to the Action Department. The primary credit for this A-rank mission goes to the Intelligence Department. As for promotions, we’ll consider Lige’s after he successfully completes this current mission."
Lu Zhao’s words finalized the decision. Li Weixin still wanted to argue for Lige, but seeing the look Lu Zhao gave him, he swallowed his words.
"That concludes today’s meeting. Its contents are top secret."
RUSTLE! Everyone rose to their feet in unison. "Yes, Sir!"
Lu Zhao turned and left the meeting room; the others also began to pack their things, preparing to leave.
"Wang, why did you have to block me now? If you’d let me promote Lige first, I would have fully cooperated with you to promote Xu Shiyun. Wouldn’t that have worked? You know me; I’m not cut out for work at the Tianjian Bureau. In another year or two, I’ll probably return to the military. Lige is the successor I’ve trained, you know that," Li Weixin complained in a low voice while packing.
"Lige is fortunate to have met you; it’s a blessing from eight lifetimes. But haven’t I already made concessions for him? Wang Lan reported the discovery of the Demon Clan’s base directly to me. If I had assigned Xu Shiyun to handle it, Lige wouldn’t have been involved at all. I’ve already conceded such significant merit, so why are you still trying to push for more? We can concede the merits of others, but I cannot yield Wang Lan’s. Besides, even though you’re grooming Lige, does he truly possess the capability to be your successor yet? He has potential, but potential is merely potential. He still needs much more tempering."
Alright... perhaps I was too hasty,
Li Weixin thought.
「Meanwhile」
Wang Lan had also completed his protection detail for Li Xiaoqin, earning a reward of one thousand experience points and fifty skill points.
Four days for such a meager reward,
Wang Lan thought,
it feels somewhat not worth it. But then again, to earn fifty skill points otherwise, I’d have to find a Star Martial Warrior of comparable strength and beat him up in a corner fifty times. Getting fifty points for four days of doing nothing but carrying bags and running errands... it’s actually a pretty good deal.
"Wang Lan, you must come visit me in Nanli Country sometime, okay? You spent four days shopping with me. When you come to Nanli Country to find me, I’ll definitely clear my schedule to spend four days having fun with you!" Li Xiaoqin said, somewhat reluctant to part, as they said their goodbyes.
"I thank you!" Wang Lan said with a smile, though internally he was seething.
Yeah, right! In the future, I’ll make sure to go miles out of my way to avoid wherever you are! It’s unbelievable how such a seemingly frail woman could exhaust a Star Martial Warrior of my stamina to the brink of collapse just by shopping!
"Don’t be so formal! In your Jade Country, there’s an old saying: ’Is it not delightful to have friends coming from afar?’"
Once the task completion was confirmed, Wang Lan turned and left without a moment’s hesitation. His posture, which was more like a hasty escape, looked to Li Xiaoqin like a suave and graceful departure...
"Why doesn’t Nanli Country have such refined and charismatic young men?" Li Xiaoqin turned her head and asked her agent.
"Perhaps Nanli Country is too small... This kind of grand bearing... perhaps only people from a great nation like Jade Country can possess it."
After spending four days with Wang Lan, it wasn’t just Li Xiaoqin; even her agent was deeply impressed by him. From the very first day, Wang Lan didn’t act like a bodyguard they had hired, but more like a friend welcoming them.
Confident but not arrogant, carefree and composed, cultured and elegant, graceful in manner.
Within just one day, their interactions made them forget their respective statuses; they got along like old friends. Wang Lan was charming and knowledgeable. This, combined with his status as a Star Martial Warrior, led Li Xiaoqin to subconsciously suspect that he might actually be a young nobleman from some prestigious family in Jade Country.
In a sense, she wasn’t wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 96 Trace of a Demon Clan Spy
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 96 Trace of a Demon Clan Spy
Wang Lan sat on a street bench and submitted his task, earning a hundred points. To many Star Martial Warriors, this was a significant income. But for Wang Lan, it was just a trivial way to pass the time.
There were still two days left until the end of the vacation.
Forget it, I won’t look for more tasks in these two days.
"I really envy you students, with over a hundred days of vacation every year," a voice sounded. Wang Lan had just completed his task submission when, looking up, he saw Xu Shiyun in casual attire appearing before him.
"Xu? Are you looking for me? Is there a mission?" Suddenly, Wang Lan’s eyes lit up.
"Why are you like Lige? The moment you hear ’mission,’ your eyes glow green. I’m off today, just bored and walking around. By chance, I saw you..."
"This... what a coincidence," Wang Lan replied, his face full of black lines. "In Greater Su City, with at least ten million people, you just walk around and run into me randomly? Bullcrap!"
"Stop whining. I’m frustrated, can’t I ask you out for a drink?"
"I’m only sixteen, I can’t drink."
"Can you drink milk then?" Xu Shiyun reached out, slinging an arm around Wang Lan’s shoulders. And thus, Wang Lan was coaxed by Xu Shiyun into the restaurant across the street.
In the private room, Xu Shiyun efficiently ordered about twenty to thirty dishes, then asked for two bottles of white liquor and got five cans of Red Bull for Wang Lan.
"Xu, are you trying to get me hyped up all night?"
"Pfft, you think it really has any effect? It’s all a lie."
Wang Lan could tell that Xu Shiyun was indeed troubled. After a moment of silence, he played with a toothpick and, with a smile, looked at Xu Shiyun. "Xu, feeling down? Had a fight with your wife?"
"Possible? My wife and I never fight," Xu Shiyun said, raising his head proudly. "We prefer action over pointless chatter."
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH—" Wang Lan almost spat out his water. "Where are you hurt? Let me check."
"No! It’s about work." The dishes quickly arrived one by one, and Xu Shiyun poured himself a drink.
Good heavens, a forty-five percent alcohol white liquor, downed in one gulp—how aggrieved must he have been?
"Wang Lan, do you think our Director Wang is stupid?" Xu Shiyun said, his cheeks slightly flushed after finishing his drink. "How have we, his subordinates, failed to satisfy him? Is he elbowing us out?"
"Because of the incident at Red Maple Forest Park?" Wang Lan instantly understood.
Wang Qianfeng’s explanation to Wang Lan was that, from his perspective, he had to consider the interests of the entire Intelligence Department and make concessions for the department’s relationship with other fraternal departments. But to Xu Shiyun, it looked like Director Wang was indeed giving away credit that rightfully belonged to the Intelligence Department.
"Exactly! You discovered the Demon Clan, you called Director Wang. This A-class mission was meat on a plate for our Intelligence Department. Why give it to the Action Department?"
"Maybe Director Wang had his reasons."
"I know he has other considerations. He says we can’t hog all the credit. We’re the Intelligence Department; providing intelligence is our duty. Capturing and fighting are the Action Department’s tasks. But then... what’s the point of having an action team in the Intelligence Department?"
"Xu, didn’t Director Wang leave you the task of rounding up and capturing them?"
"Those guys all committed suicide as soon as we started the roundup. Not a single survivor was caught, and we got a scolding from Director Wang. Anyone can talk big. If he’s so capable, let him do it."
Wang Lan lowered his head and said nothing.
"Forget it, there’s no use complaining now; what’s done is done. By the way, next time you come across something good, don’t just call Director Wang. Director Wang is too magnanimous; he doesn’t need a promotion himself, so he’s unaware of how hard it is for us brothers to get one. If you come across new intelligence, remember to give the brothers in the Intelligence Department a call."
"This... is that okay? To take action without reporting to Director Wang?"
"It’s not about taking unilateral action. This time, you had confirmed the Demon Clan’s whereabouts, so you had to report to Director Wang. But it’s not always possible to locate the Demon Clan so smoothly. As long as you have a hunch, even a slight suspicion, you can ask our brothers in the Intelligence Department for assistance. As long as the brothers get a piece of the action in such good opportunities, Director Wang can’t then offer up the credit they’ve already earned to curry favor elsewhere."
Wang Lan looked at the red-eyed Xu Shiyun with a disgusted expression. "Such things are rare and unpredictable; they’re not easy to come by..."
"For someone else, perhaps, but you’re different. You’re the lucky charm of our Intelligence Department... you step in dog shit without even stopping."
The chicken tender on Wang Lan’s chopsticks dropped with a PLUNK.
"We have an agreement, alright? This isn’t just my idea; it’s the collective wish of the brothers in the Intelligence Group."
"Understood, understood. By the way, any new developments in that case?"
"Of course there are developments," Xu Shiyun leaned closer and whispered. "Do you know whose skull was found in the forest park?"
"Whose?"
"Chang Yu!"
"Her! What are the odds?" Wang Lan’s eyes gleamed with insight. "Now I get it! Chang Shuangyue underwent Demonization during the competition because of Chang Yu. Chang Yu had a direct connection with Magical Martial Artists. Not good!"
Suddenly, Wang Lan exclaimed in a low voice.
"What’s the matter?"
"Chang Yu can’t be touched right now. Taking action against her would mean severing all the lines we have to follow. We don’t know how many Magical Martial Artists are still out there in Suzhou City... She’s our only lead right now, and we should play the long game to catch the big fish."
Xu Shiyun looked at Wang Lan in a daze, an expression of astonishment on his face.
"What’s wrong, Xu? Is there a problem with what I said?"
"To think of all this in such a short time... You’ve made me see you in a new light. It seems I was wrong about you. Director Wang said you were a koi, and we all took you for one. Who in the world really has such good luck? You rely on real strength. You picked up on all this so quickly; even Director Wang didn’t react as fast as you. But he has thought of it as well... Speaking of this, brother, it’s tough for me!"
"What happened again?"
"Not even the task of surveilling Chang Yu fell to the brothers; it was snatched up by Lige of the Action Department."
"Is he Director Wang’s actual son?"
"No, this time it was Director Lu who designated him."
"Then he’s Director Lu’s actual son."
After having dinner with Xu Shiyun, Wang Lan went straight home. The next day, Jiang Xinyu and the others returned from Modu City and invited Wang Lan out to dine together. Wang Lan, having nothing better to do, naturally did not refuse.
During the meal, Jiang Xinchen asked about Wang Lan’s relationship with Li Xiaoqin. Wang Lan did not hide anything and candidly explained it was due to a protection mission. Wang Lan had an enriching five days, and they too had a fantastic time during these days.
Time always flies especially fast when you wish it could stay a little longer. Wang Lan had just begun to relax when the holiday came to an end.
The main academic focus before the National Day holiday was improvement, but after the holiday, it was all about preparing for the end-of-term tests. The end-of-term tests involved both academics and martial combat, with rankings for the whole school.
In Suzhou City’s Star Martial Arts Campus, the fight for the new top ten spots among senior year students always led to a fierce battle at the end of each year. Academic subjects just meant endless practice tests. Starting from the first day after the holidays, there was almost a test paper every day, four in total. For the afternoon practical combat classes, Liu Jie first arranged students of equal caliber to spar in pairs, followed by two hours of high-intensity physical training.
「Ten days passed quietly.」
Under such an intensive study rhythm, Wang Lan’s fear of his strength being inadequate was effectively relieved.
Exhausted in both body and mind after school each day, he only needed to train briefly in the Training Room before he could fall asleep the moment his head touched the pillow.
Thanks to the rigorous training, Wang Lan was able to earn seven or eight skill points every afternoon. His practical combat strength had already far surpassed Liu Jie’s. In the class, only Jiang Xinyu and Mingyue Wucheng could give Wang Lan a challenge.
Most of the time, Wang Lan was grouped with Mingyue Wucheng. His initial wish to beat Song Bo eight or ten times a day wasn’t fulfilled, but he got to beat Mingyue Wucheng seven or eight times a day instead.
And Mingyue Wucheng, truly worthy of being a scion of a Star Martial family, was well-educated. Each time he was knocked down by Wang Lan, far from getting angry or frustrated, he would earnestly grasp Wang Lan’s arm and say, "Thank you for the lesson!"
Once, Wang Lan spotted an opening in Mingyue Wucheng’s defense and considered pressing his advantage. However, not wanting Mingyue Wucheng to lose too badly, he held back. Mingyue Wucheng, however, wasn’t pleased and repeatedly asked Wang Lan not to hold back.
Faced with such a request, Wang Lan thought to himself, you asked for this!
From that day on, instead of earning just seven or eight skill points each day, he could earn at least twelve.
While reaping the benefits of improvement, Wang Lan also noticed that Mingyue Wucheng’s clothes hung looser and his face grew increasingly haggard. After a week, his cheeks had sunk in deeply.
To prevent Mingyue Wucheng from being crushed by Wang Lan, Liu Jie eventually changed the groups. Jiang Xinyu, Mingyue Wucheng, and Wang Lan were put in one group, meaning Wang Lan would rotate sparring with the two of them.
Actually, Liu Jie had also realized Wang Lan was far stronger than he was, which was why he came up with the idea of letting Wang Lan take his place to give intense training to the two top-seeded students. As for Wang Lan, he accepted all challenges and even went to Liu Jie’s office once to suggest, "How about I take on the entire class by myself?"The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFirenᴇt
You’d even suggest such a thing? Should I just quit my job then?
Liu Jie was so infuriated he nearly kicked Wang Lan out of his office.
Every time Wang Lan sparred with Mingyue Wucheng and Jiang Xinyu, a girl, Xie Sisi, would stand on the sidelines, staring intently at Wang Lan.
Wang Lan simply thought Xie Sisi was observing their battles to learn from their experience.
「Before he realized it, half a month had gone by, and there were less than two months left until the winter break.」
Wang Lan leisurely packed his school bag. His movements were always slow when he wasn’t in combat.
"Wang Lan, do you have any plans for this winter break?" Jiang Xinyu suddenly asked indifferently.
"Ah? Are we going out to have fun again? I’ve already made a training plan. After all, there’s still such a big gap between me and you all. If I don’t work hard, I’m afraid I won’t catch up before next year’s college entrance examination," replied Wang Lan.
"Is that so? Today, an announcement was posted at the trial facility, saying that all three trial areas will open on December 1st. I was planning to go to the intermediate trial area during the winter break, but if you have other plans, then never mind..."
"Other plans? What other plans?" Wang Lan immediately looked at Jiang Xinyu in confusion.
Jiang Xinyu’s lips twitched slightly, struggling to suppress a smile.
"Um..." Xie Sisi, who was sitting next to Wang Lan and overheard the conversation, quickly moved closer and looked at Jiang Xinyu. "Can I come with you?"
