During this time, Xie Sisi had grown quite close to Jiang Xinyu, although not quite to the level of best friends. Xie Sisi’s Cultivation Level was at the peak of Starlight. Although she might break through to the Star Shine Stage soon, her current strength was barely enough for the beginner trial area, let alone the intermediate one.
Jiang Xinyu, not wanting to dampen her spirits too much, could only say regretfully, "The intermediate trial area costs a hundred thousand a day, and we plan to go for ten days."

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Promotion
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 97: Promotion
Xie Sisi’s eyes dimmed, like a flickering candle about to be extinguished in the wind.
For Xie Sisi, hailing from a family of ordinary workers, awakening as a Star Martial Warrior was already a source of pride for her parents. Because she was a Star Martial Warrior, her parents could enjoy many benefits, such as free medical care, low-interest loans, and more.
But even so, her parents’ combined salary didn’t exceed twenty thousand a month, and the exorbitant daily cost of one hundred thousand was beyond what a family like Xie Sisi’s could even consider.
Although she knew she shouldn’t blame anyone, she still felt deeply despondent.
"Monitor Xie really is forgetful, huh..." Song Bo’s voice once again rang out gratingly. For some reason, since yesterday, Song Bo’s gang seemed to have become arrogant again.
Since yesterday, Wang Lan had been considering whether to find some excuse to make some extra money.
"Watching Monitor Xie shamelessly fussing over Jiang Xinyu, you really thought she would see you as an equal? Now you know, right? All that groveling, and in the end, you’re still left with nothing."
"Monitor Xie, you should feel lucky. If they were really willing to take you along, who knows, you might have ended up as Exotic Beast dung in the trial grounds. Then, you wouldn’t even have a grave marker, how sad and desolate..."
"What’s going on? Have these four dogs not been beaten for two days? Why are they acting so high and mighty?" Xu Xiangwen spoke up indifferently, standing up and rubbing his wrists.
"Hmm... It’s probably because Duan Ziqi managed to break through to the Star Cloud Stage yesterday, making these dogs think they have someone backing them up," Mingyue Wucheng said nonchalantly as he grabbed his backpack and slung it over his shoulder.
"I was wondering what was going on... so Duan Ziqi made a breakthrough, huh?" Xu Xiangwen mused. "Why only now? Xinyu broke through two months ago. Is Duan Ziqi falling further behind?"
"Xu Xiangwen, think you’re tough? Fight Ziqi after school if you’re so brave," Song Bo, seeing himself about to become the public enemy of the class, snarled angrily.
"Song Bo, to be honest, it might be too cruel for you to hear this, but seeing you acting so clueless, I can’t help but tell you. Do you know why, even after Duan Ziqi broke through to the Star Cloud Stage, he’s still keeping such a low profile?" Mingyue Wucheng stepped closer to Song Bo.
"You... what do you mean?"
"Star Cloud Stage? Duan Ziqi? Heh... In our class, there are at least five people who could beat him so badly he wouldn’t know north from south."
"Heh... anyone can boast..." Suddenly, Song Bo’s words were abruptly cut off, his incredulous eyes staring at Mingyue Wucheng’s slowly unfolding Star palace.
A cluster of clouds slowly revolved inside the Star palace like a windmill.
"Believe it or not, even if you were beaten into a state where you couldn’t take care of yourself here, Duan Ziqi wouldn’t dare to let out a fart. Why not be a quiet, good dog?" Mingyue Wucheng patted Song Bo’s shoulder and smiled.
Song Bo’s face changed rapidly, and in the end, he quietly grabbed his backpack and, along with the other three, slinked out of the classroom.
"Duan Ziqi broke through?" Jiang Xinyu asked for confirmation once again.
"Yes," Wang Lan confirmed. "Not just Duan Ziqi. Mu Shaoyun also broke through. Duan Ziqi isn’t a concern, but we should be more cautious about Mu Shaoyun. His strength might not be beneath yours."
"Being a bit formidable is good," Jiang Xinyu said calmly. "Otherwise, winning wouldn’t feel like an achievement."
One by one, the classmates left the room. Wang Lan headed for the bus stop after parting with Xu Xiangwen and others at the school gate. Nearby, Xie Sisi stood with her head bowed, her expression despondent, lost in thought.
"Monitor... uh..."
"Ah? Wang Lan, do you need something?" Surprised, Xie Sisi saw Wang Lan approaching from behind.
"Actually... Xinyu didn’t mean to look down on you."
"I know. Jiang Xinyu has always been nice to me, and she’s never been condescending to other students. Song Bo and the others were just trying to stir up trouble. Most of the class knows this. I’m not mad."
"Before... when Wang Youle went with us to the junior trial grounds, we faced the pursuit of a member of the Demon Clan. We watched helplessly as a Demon beheaded Wang Youle, unable to do anything to save him. If the troops hadn’t arrived in time, we might have been wiped out in there. The trial grounds are very dangerous. You never know when Exotic Beasts will appear out of nowhere, and accidents can happen in the blink of an eye. Thinking about it now, it really scares me. You panic too easily in combat. What would you do if you had to fight Exotic Beasts in the trials?"
"Actually, I’m not timid... it’s just that I get nervous, really nervous," Xie Sisi’s bright eyes earnestly fixed on Wang Lan’s face. "I will overcome it. I have been working hard in secret, and I’m not losing to anyone in class. Wang Lan, if I had a million, you would be willing to take me, right?"
Xie Sisi’s eyes were filled with longing. Wang Lan had never imagined such a look could appear in the eyes of a girl in the full bloom of youth.
Wang Lan had seen that look countless times before. In his previous life, at Hengdian, those aspiring young men and women would have the same humble and trembling eyes when pitching themselves to some director.
Wang Lan couldn’t understand what kind of pressure Xie Sisi was enduring, pressure she shouldn’t have to bear at her age, that made her so desperate to go to the trial grounds to hunt Exotic Beasts. But, even though dreams are precious, they are reserved for those with strength and preparation.
"It’s not a matter of money..."
"The bus is here, Wang Lan. See you tomorrow." Xie Sisi didn’t wait for Wang Lan to finish speaking and turned to rush toward the bus, fleeing as if in panic.
Standing at the bus stop, a confused look crossed Wang Lan’s face as he thought to himself,
I’m not listening, I won’t listen to nonsense...
With a wry smile, Wang Lan shook his head and turned to walk towards the Xinyu Building along the sidewalk.
BEEP BEEP—
The car horn sounded in his ear, and a black business car stopped next to Wang Lan. The window rolled down, revealing Xu Shiyun in front of Wang Lan.
"Wang Lan, get in."
"Xu, what’s going on?" Wang Lan quickly made his way to the passenger seat.
"Back seat!"
"Oh—"
Wang Lan obediently opened the door and got into the car. A set of unopened clothes lay on the seat.
"What are you dazing for? Get changed."
"For me? Is there a mission?" Wang Lan asked with a puzzled face, noting Xu Shiyun’s serious expression.
This seems like a big deal,
he thought.
"Mission my ass! On Director Wang’s orders, I’m taking you to the bureau for a celebration banquet. You’re quite the big shot, having a captain like me personally drive you. Tonight, you have to have a few drinks with me. If I’m not satisfied, you’re not leaving."
"Celebration banquet? Is it for crushing the operation at Red Maple Forest Park?"
"Isn’t that stating the obvious? These past few years, the Demon Clan has become increasingly active nationwide. Every time, we only find out after they’ve already made their move. Even if we respond quickly, all that’s left is cleaning up the mess. Across the country’s twenty-six provinces, our three hundred-plus Tianjian Bureau branches have been driven to distraction by the Demon Clan, and the Imperial Capital headquarters is constantly scowling. But this time, we in Suzhou City seized the initiative. We crushed their conspiracy and annihilated their base before they even had a chance to strike. The higher-ups are pleased, specially announcing national commendation and urging all three hundred and forty-two Tianjian Bureau branches to take Suzhou City as a model. Unravel the thread, take the initiative, and crush the Demon Clan spies. You, my boy, have brought us honor. Because of you, all the brothers in the bureau have basked in reflected glory."
Flattered by Xu Shiyun’s praise, a modest smile appeared on Wang Lan’s face. "It’s just minor merit, just doing my duty. Eh? That’s not right, isn’t this the wrong uniform? Why is it white?"
"No mistake, you’ve been promoted."
"Really? I remember that white is for... lieutenants to wear, right? I’m just a temp, so even with a promotion, it should be to official rank, or maybe ensign, right?"
"A temp? Do you still think you’re a temp?" Xu Shiyun stared at Wang Lan with an incredulous expression and scrutinized his face seriously for a long time.
"Isn’t that what Director Wang said initially, that I was an auxiliary personnel?"
"Do you remember the test assessment I conducted with you? If you had failed, you would indeed be auxiliary personnel. But you passed, so you’re official staff. Otherwise, do you think auxiliary personnel get special phones? Or a Tianjian Bureau identification code? Besides, the Southeast Military Region commended you for bravery, and you played a leading role in the Red Maple Forest Park operation. Therefore, the Jin City headquarters specially promoted you by skipping ranks to lieutenant. Although you still have no position within the Tianjian Bureau, you are now a backbone team leader. Have you changed your clothes? Tonight, the bureau chief will personally bestow your rank and issue the commendation decree."
"I’ve changed... Talking with you like this, I’m getting a bit excited..."
"Neither Lige nor I snagged a promotion, but you did. However, I’m not upset about it. After all, we can claim this merit in our Intelligence Department. The Action Department dreaming of snatching the credit is a fantasy. Buckle up, I’m driving now."
As for Xu Shiyun’s driving skills, how can I put it? Very fierce, very showy. If it weren’t for Xu Shiyun’s calm behavior, Wang Lan would have thought a woman was driving.
The twelve-kilometer journey took less than fifteen minutes. This was during the peak hours of after-work and after-school traffic. Weaving through the endless stream of cars in fifteen minutes almost made Wang Lan throw up.
The celebration banquet was held in the Tianjian Bureau’s cafeteria, decorated like a wedding venue. It was the first time Wang Lan realized that the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau had so many people—exactly one hundred tables, nearly a thousand people.
Everyone attending the banquet wore military uniforms, mostly traditional green ones. A few wore white, standing out conspicuously like flowers among green leaves. As for the red-clothed elite members, they were even rarer—a mere ten or so people in the whole scene. The black-clothed leaders, however, were nowhere to be seen yet.
Of course, for the Tianjian Bureau warriors attending the banquet, the real highlight wasn’t the sprinkling of white or red-clothed elites among the crowd. It was the chance to get close to the many female warriors they usually pined for but rarely had the opportunity to approach.
Since it was a grand event for the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau, all the female Star Martial Warriors were beautifully made up. It was like a pack of wolves amidst songbirds, a flurry of flitting swallows and warblers.
The number of female Star Martial Warriors was about half that of males. Normally, the proportion of male to female Star Martial Warriors is one to one, but in terms of combat talent, women are slightly inferior to men.
Plus, with the Tianjian Bureau’s policy of recruiting only elites, this had led to an imbalance in the gender ratio within the Bureau.
On missions, female warriors usually wore masks. Even when they didn’t, they presented themselves without makeup.
Who knew that the female warriors, once made up, could look so beautiful? They enticed the male warriors so much that they nearly transformed on the spot.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Eh? Zeng, look... such a young guy in white? I’ve never seen him before," a green-clothed female warrior whispered to a red-clothed female warrior next to her.
"Him? He’s today’s star." Zeng Xiaomo wore a sweet smile, and the image of her first encounter with Wang Lan in the Different Dimensional Space created by the Demon Clan on the Suzhou City ring road flashed through her mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 98 Arrest
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 98 Arrest
At that time, Wang Lan was only a newly awakened Star Martial Warrior who hadn’t even applied for his Star Martial Badge. Yet, he single-handedly killed nine low-level Demon Soldiers.
To her, this was absolutely impossible, but Wang Lan had done it.
From that moment on, the incredible young man had been etched deep in Zeng Xiaomo’s heart.
She had originally thought that the legend named Wang Lan would only rise in the next decade.
But to her surprise, just a few days later, this name once again reached Zeng Xiaomo’s ears. He had uncovered the Demon Clan’s plot to destroy the training field and assisted the Southeast Military Region’s Martial Arts Corps in thwarting the Demon Clan’s scheme.
This young man was different from what she had imagined. Other talents at least had a period of accumulation and growth, but it seemed he did not need it. He was like a star shooting into the starry sky, shining brightly the moment he appeared.
This time, he even brought benefits to the entire Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau.
"Is that Wang Lan? Hmm... he may not be as handsome as Lige, but... he seems warm," a female Star Martial Warrior mused, resting her chin in her hand.
"Xiaoxiao, he’s only sixteen. You’re not going to rob the cradle, are you?"
"What do you mean, Zeng? Are you calling me an old cow? I’m only eighteen!"
"Have some shame! You were eighteen two years ago."
"My Xiaoxiao is eighteen every year. If it weren’t for her Star Martial Badge, she’d probably forget her real age herself. But... he really does look good. If he dressed up, he wouldn’t be any worse than Lige."
"Why do you lovesick fools keep comparing Wang Lan to Lige? What’s so good-looking about Lige’s stone face? Aside from trying to look cool, what else is there?"
"Listen to this. Lige said one thing to Qingqing last year, and she’s still holding it against him..."
"I’m a woman. What’s wrong with being petty? Isn’t it expected for women to hold grudges? The so-called number one heartthrob of the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau can’t even hold a candle to our junior brother. I heard he even had the nerve to fight for the top credit this time. Where did he get the audacity?"
"Qingqing, just keep this talk at this table. Don’t go spreading it around. Director Li fought for the credit on his behalf; he didn’t pursue it himself. Although Lige can be harsh, there’s nothing wrong with his character. Besides, Lige’s abilities and accomplishments are solid and real."
"Got it, Zeng. But I just can’t stand him. Don’t expect me to give him the time of day in the future."
"Great! One less rival for us."
"Xiaoxiao, show some restraint. You just said you were interested in our junior brother."
"Wasn’t it Zeng who called me an ’old cow eating tender grass’? I humbly accept the criticism and will steadfastly guard my moral principles."
"PFFT!" A tableful of beauties spat in unison, feigning disdain.
Wang Lan didn’t stay at the venue for long. After Xu Shiyun showed him to his seat so he would recognize it, Xu Shiyun then took him backstage to Wang Qianfeng.
"In a bit, Director Lu will personally confer your rank. Normally, a lieutenant’s promotion doesn’t warrant such a ceremony. But given the current national situation, we in Suzhou City have set a good precedent. Plus, even though you’re only being promoted to lieutenant, your contributions are indeed significant, so we’re making an exception this one time."
"Thank you, Director Wang, for your guidance."
"The country nurtured you, and your performance is your repayment. This is what you deserve. But I must remind you: guard against arrogance and rashness, and proceed with steady, sure steps. I have higher expectations for you. I hope that in the future, you can bear the heavy burden of human civilization and carry it forward."
"Director Wang, that burden... is truly heavy," Wang Lan said with a playful grin.
"You are the son of the Flame Emperor. Many people are silently watching over you," Wang Qianfeng said, not returning Wang Lan’s playful smile, his expression serious.
Seeing Wang Qianfeng’s earnest expression, Wang Lan also sobered, stood at attention before Wang Qianfeng, and saluted solemnly. "I will definitely remember Director Wang’s teachings."
"It’s good that you remember. Those silently watching over you will help you hold up this sky, and so will we."
「In the outskirts of Suzhou City」
Far from the prosperous areas, this was perhaps one of the few remaining rural landscapes in the highly developed city.
Lige stood quietly at the top of a tree, gazing up at the sky.
Only in this place, away from the city lights, could one truly see the Starlight.
"Damn it... it’s November, how are there still so many mosquitoes? Guarding here all night, I’ve probably lost at least three pounds from blood loss."
"Skinny Monkey, do you even have three pounds to lose?"
"With this many mosquitoes, each taking a bite, wouldn’t I lose three pounds overnight?"
"Stop your whining. If you really lost three pounds of blood, you’d be ready for cremation tomorrow. But seriously, we’ve been here for over half a month without a single discovery. When will this end?"
"Patience!"
"Hey, look! Old Yu posted in the group chat—wow... so many beauties! What a waste! If I’d known so many girls were at the celebration banquet, I’d have swapped shifts with someone, no matter what."
"These women usually look so plain without makeup, I never thought they were that pretty. But now, all done up, they look like goddesses... If only I hadn’t tried to act so cool back then. After tonight, it’ll be too many wolves for too little meat; the success rate will drop by a solid ten percent..."
"That’s why they say East Asia has its ’Three Great Sorceries.’ Mastering them can grant a divine, transformative effect, like being completely reborn."
"You guys..." Lige tore his gaze from the stars, frowning slightly at his team members. "If you don’t want to be on surveillance, you can go back. I’m enough here by myself."
"No, Team Leader Lige, that’s not what we meant..."
"Right, we were just talking... How could a celebration banquet be more important than our mission? We’re doing crucial work here. If this mission is successful, we’ll get the Director to throw a special celebration just for us."
"Exactly..."
"I’m not being sarcastic. I’m serious," Lige said again.
"No, no, the mission is what matters."
"I heard the top credit for the Red Maple Forest Park operation went to a newcomer from the Intelligence Division, and he’s getting promoted to lieutenant at the celebration banquet. The Director himself is going to confer his rank?"
"Why him? We were the ones who destroyed the Demon Clan base! We closed their Different Dimensional Space! We lost six brothers, and the top credit isn’t ours?"The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"Exactly! He just provided some intelligence."
"Stop being sour!" Lige said coolly. "His intelligence was the main contribution; there’s nothing to be resentful about. While we’re here grumbling that he ’just provided some intelligence,’ the Intelligence Division is probably saying we just helped out a bit and still got a significant share of the credit."
"For this Red Maple incident, intelligence was absolutely crucial. Without Wang Lan discovering the clues, who knows how long we would have been kept in the dark?"
"Team Leader Lige, are you really okay with this?"
"Let’s be realistic. There’s nothing to be resentful about. If you really want to earn some respect, then go out and achieve something even greater that overshadows his accomplishment."
"Something’s not right!" Suddenly, one of the men on surveillance duty spoke in a low voice.
"Chang Yu is packing her clothes. Looks like she’s planning to run."
Could she have noticed something?
Lige frowned. In a flash, he was beside the observer, raising infrared binoculars to look at the target.
"I don’t know. She was on her phone, then suddenly stood up and started packing. She might have really noticed. Should we..."
"Move in to capture," Lige ordered decisively.
"Should we request authorization from above?"
"No good! She’s out the door! No time to request authorization!"
"Move out!" As his words fell, Lige led the charge, transforming into a streak of light and shooting towards the target.
Chang Yu had just gotten into her car and hadn’t even started the engine when an intense force suddenly converged on her from all directions. The car couldn’t withstand the pressure and rapidly deformed, crumpling like a squashed soda can.
"Pressure Field!" Chang Yu’s expression turned cold. A glint of icy light flashed, and the car was sliced neatly in half down the middle. Instantly, Chang Yu shot out from the wreckage, attempting to flee into the sky.
"Pressure—"
A visible shockwave rippled above her, and a terrifying pressure bore down, slamming Chang Yu to the ground in an instant.
Only then did Chang Yu realize she was surrounded by six plainclothes agents from the Tianjian Bureau. They had joined forces to deploy a Gravity Field, firmly trapping her within it.
The Tianjian Bureau not only gathered elite Star Martial Warriors but also a host of individuals with extraordinary abilities.
These six were each only at the mid-Star Cloud Stage in their Cultivation Level. But when they combined their strength, they could unleash a Star Martial Skill so powerful that even a Galaxy Stage expert couldn’t withstand it. This was the source of Lige’s confidence in ordering a live capture.
"Electrocharge!"
Lige descended from the sky, his palm crackling with dazzling lightning, as if he wielded a thunderbolt.
CRACKLE—
The brilliant lightning struck Chang Yu, who was immobilized by the intense pressure. The current engulfed her, dazzling arcs of electricity dancing over her body.
"AAARGH—" A deep, masculine cry, overlaid with her own, erupted from Chang Yu’s lips as her strength seemed to drain away, and she collapsed limply.
Lige executed a spectacular flip in mid-air, landing beside the team of six.
The seven agents coordinated flawlessly. The entire operation, from start to finish, took no more than three seconds.
"Seal her! Take her down!"
The Star Power of the six agents surged once more. The Gravity Field instantaneously contracted, transforming into strands of Star Power Binding that wrapped around the thoroughly charred Chang Yu. Only after Chang Yu was completely bound did smiles appear on the faces of the six agents.
"We should’ve just done this from the start instead of wasting time on surveillance. Later, we’ll get a Spirit Engraving expert to perform a ’mental probe’ on her. Whatever secrets she’s hiding, she’ll have to spill them all."
"The Demon Clan spies are all incredibly tough. We’ve never captured one alive before. Do you think it’ll be that easy to probe her mind?"
"Well, isn’t this one alive right here?"
His words had barely faded when an intense wave of energy suddenly burst forth from Chang Yu.
"What’s happening?"
"Not good—"
Suddenly, Skinny Monkey forcefully shoved Lige aside.
BOOM—
A deafening explosion erupted. Lige’s eyes widened in horror as he watched the flames engulf his six teammates.
Before he could react, a fireball roared towards him.
CRACKLE—
Arcs of electricity flared, and in the split second before the fireball engulfed him, he managed to activate his Thunder Shield.
「The Tianjian Bureau – Cafeteria」
"I believe that with favorable circumstances, geographical advantages, and the unity of our people, the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau is invincible! I believe that a Jade Country, united and resolute, is invincible! And I believe even more strongly that human civilization, which has journeyed from the primeval wilderness to the present day through tens of thousands of years of heritage, is invincible!"
"The Demon Clan’s ambition to destroy humanity will never die, but humanity’s will to resist will never falter! We will carry the burden of human civilization, marching forward to protect our people until no external threats remain and the continuation of our heritage is secure!"
"Tonight, besides sharing the joy of this victory with all of you, we will also present awards to the heroes who achieved it! Please welcome the one who single-handedly obtained the intelligence on the Demon Clan’s conspiracy and pinpointed their hidden base—the primary contributor from the Intelligence Department, Wang Lan!"
Lu Zhao finally concluded his impassioned declaration. As his voice faded amidst thunderous applause, Wang Lan, dressed in a white military uniform adorned with flame patterns, advanced with the formal, measured steps Xu Shiyun had hastily taught him, approaching Director Lu.
He came to attention and saluted smartly.

chapters.title: Chapter 99 Who Can Prove
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 99 Who Can Prove
Lu Zhao gently removed Wang Lan’s shoulder insignia and picked up the brand-new Lieutenant insignia from the tray, personally pinning it onto Wang Lan.
"You are our meritorious officer, and also a hero of humankind. I hope you remain humble and strive for further achievements. The future belongs to young people like you."
"Yes, your subordinate will not disappoint your instructions, Director."
"You may leave."
Wang Lan kept his face tight as he saluted and had just walked off the stage.
"DING! Military rank page activated. Congratulations to the host for being promoted to Lieutenant. Reward: 5,000 experience points, 500 skill points."
What followed was naturally the toasting celebration. As the main character of the banquet, Wang Lan was inevitably the target of many.
"Esteemed brothers and sisters... I am still a student; I can’t drink alcohol," Wang Lan said with a full-faced apologetic smile.
"You’re already over sixteen years old; a little drink won’t hurt."
"Exactly! We are coming over to toast you. You must drink, or else it’s disrespectful."
"Can I switch to beer?"
"No! How can a soldier not know how to drink? It is proper to practice in moderation."
"My alcohol tolerance is incredibly poor; I’ll pass out after just one cup... Brothers and sisters, please have mercy..."
"Bullying a kid like this, have you no shame..." Zeng Xiaomo, dressed in red, slowly approached with a glass of champagne.
"You’re just bullying Wang Lan because he’s young. Even if he can drink, he can’t handle so many people. So, I, as a representative of the women of Tianjian Bureau, will toast Wang Lan as a gesture of congratulations."
Wang Lan listened to Zeng Xiaomo’s voice; it was very familiar. The last time he saw Zeng Xiaomo, she was on a mission wearing a mask.
Seeing Wang Lan’s expression, Zeng Xiaomo gave a flirtatious smile. "Wang Lan, don’t you recognize your big sister? You used to be so sweet-talking."
"You’re Sister Zeng? No wonder the voice is familiar. With such beauty, why did you wear a mask back then? Sister Zeng, allow me to offer you a drink. As your junior, I dare not decline."
"At that time, without Sister Zeng’s timely rescue, I would have died at the hands of a Demon Soldier. I won’t say much to express my gratitude. Sister Zeng, please."
Wang Lan lifted his glass and gulped it down in one go.
That was 58-degree baijiu he just drank like water, shocking all the surrounding comrades who were cheering him on; their eyes went wide.
"You call that not knowing how to drink?"
"Good! I told you our little junior brother could drink, but he was just pretending. Just now, he said he couldn’t, that he didn’t know how to drink. But look now, downing three ’liangs’ of strong liquor in one go. We soldiers all know how to drink!"
"Exactly! Downing it in one gulp without his face flushing or his breath catching. What a capacity!"
Zeng Xiaomo smiled and also drained the champagne in her hand.
"Wang Lan, you..." Suddenly, Zeng Xiaomo noticed that something was off about Wang Lan. Why did his face turn so pale all of a sudden?
At that moment, Wang Lan opened his mouth slightly and exhaled a breath of alcohol, which lingered above his head like a Soul Out of Body, forming a mist. Then, with a rigid smile, Wang Lan fell backward motionless.
"Oh no! Wang Lan, are you alright?"
"Little junior brother..."
Xu Shiyun checked Wang Lan’s forehead and took his pulse, a mocking smile appearing on his face. "Truly out after just one cup. A man of his word. I respect that."
"HAHAHA..."
Laughter erupted.
At Director Lu Zhao’s table, Wang Qianfeng and ten other top officials watched the commotion surrounding Wang Lan with smiling eyes.
"It’s been a long time since our bureau has been this happy..."
"Indeed, Director. It’s rare to win such a great victory, uplifting and gratifying. We should be happy," Li Weixin said with a beaming smile. Suddenly, the phone in his pocket began to ring.
Li Weixin gave Lu Zhao an apologetic smile and took out his phone, placing it to his ear. "What’s the matter?"
Three seconds later, the smile on Li Weixin’s face froze, and a fierce anger appeared in his eyes.
"What did you say? How is Lige? I understand..."
"Weixin, what happened?" Lu Zhao put down his chopsticks and asked gravely.
"Something happened to Lige and the others; there was a severe explosion on-site. Lige is unconscious, and Skinny Monkey and the rest... I’m afraid it’s more bad news than good."
As the words fell, Wang Qianfeng and the others immediately stood up.
"Qianfeng, Weixin, MingXue, handle this promptly. Where is Lige now?"
"The National Defense Hospital."
"Is his life in danger?"
"Severe burns across a large area of his body. He hasn’t yet passed the critical phase for survival."
"Qianfeng, have Wang Lan go and treat him. His Medical Star Martial Technique is most suited for these injuries."
Wang Qianfeng quickly approached Wang Lan, who, although propped up in his seat, was still unconscious. Wang Qianfeng came close and struck Wang Lan’s lower abdomen.
Before long, Wang Lan’s face was covered in sweat, exuding a strong smell of alcohol.
"UGH—" Wang Lan moaned unconsciously and slowly opened his eyes. "Where am I...?"
"Awake? If you’re awake, come with me."
Wang Lan instantly sobered up. Though still a bit unsteady on his feet, he quickly stood and followed Wang Qianfeng out. In an instant, the whole banquet quieted down. Many people witnessed the hurried departure of the high-ranking officials, whispering inquiries about what had happened.
In Wang Qianfeng’s car, Wang Lan was taken to the National Defense Hospital. Hit by the cold wind, Wang Lan completely sobered up.
Upon arriving at the intensive care unit, Lige was in a terrible state. He suffered burns over large areas of his body, all tightly bandaged. Inside the ward, a very intellectual-looking female doctor was inserting monitoring equipment all over Lige.
The pain of being scorched all over the body was many times worse than that of a wound. Luckily, Lige was in a coma and didn’t feel the torment.
"Wang Lan, begin treatment."
"Yes! But Director Wang, I need three Soul Beads for such a large area; without them, it can’t be done."
Wang Qianfeng gave Wang Lan a deep look, then ordered someone to bring over five Soul Beads.
Wang Lan approached Lige’s sickbed and reached out to tear off the bandages on Lige’s body. Suddenly, a hand pressed down on his. "What are you doing?"
"Mrs. Jiang, Wang Lan is a Medical Star Martial expert from our Tianjian Bureau. His Medical Star Martial Technique has miraculous effects on injuries."
"Lige’s main injuries are skin scorch wounds; his bandages are smeared with special effective medicine. Try treating the wounds on his face first. If it works, I will help you remove the bandages. These bandages are Lige’s lifeline right now; I cannot take the risk."
Mrs. Jiang’s tone carried a special concern for Lige, as if... as if Mrs. Jiang knew Lige.
Wang Lan nodded. Mrs. Jiang’s caution was not unfounded. She quickly unraveled the bandages on Lige’s face. Lige’s face was terrifying, a bloody mess resembling a freshly served steak. With such injuries, an ordinary person would have died long ago.
Wang Lan placed his hand on Lige’s forehead. Star Power surged, and the flesh on the forehead quickly scabbed over. Suddenly, Wang Lan looked up in surprise. His Star Power was spreading like overflowing water, quickly flowing down from the forehead.
Normally, when Wang Lan treated others, it was through his palm. Wherever the palm touched, that area would receive healing from the Healing Star Power. But this time, Wang Lan’s Star Power could easily flow to the entirety of Lige’s body.
But in just an instant, Wang Lan understood.
For Healing Star Martial Arts, the epidermis was actually one whole. Whether you touched the skin on the hand or elsewhere, skin was skin; touching it anywhere was the same.
With the consumption of Wang Lan’s Star Power, he calmly took out a Soul Bead and absorbed Star Power. Under Wang Lan’s treatment, Lige’s tightly bandaged body visibly swelled.
"What... What’s happening?" Mrs. Jiang nervously asked.
"Don’t worry, Dr. Jiang. This is the thick scab peeling away from his body, creating a bulge. It’s like an egg forming a shell around it."ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The Star Power used to treat Lige actually required only one Soul Bead for Wang Lan. He asked for three mainly because he believed one shouldn’t lose out in a deal. Moreover, since he wasn’t pleased with Lige, these three Soul Beads would naturally be deducted from Lige’s share. Five Soul Beads—that was a windfall! Since such a high price had already been paid, of course, he had to treat Lige well. As Lige had extensive skin scorch wounds, Wang Lan chose not to mend but to renew. His Star Power completely forged a new skin for Lige, ensuring not even old scars would remain.
"It’s done!" Wang Lan stopped, picked up a towel, and wiped his sweat. "After a while, just peel off the scabs on his body, and once he wakes up, he’ll be lively and energetic again."
Mrs. Jiang’s eyes widened in astonishment as she looked at Wang Lan, as if all this was challenging her understanding.
She had seen Medical Star Martial Techniques before. Powerful Medical Star Martial Techniques, she had seen them too. If Wang Lan were a Star Sea Stage Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior, Mrs. Jiang wouldn’t find it strange. But the Star Energy Fluctuation Wang Lan exhibited was at the Star Shine Stage! Weren’t Star Shine Stage Medical Star Martial Techniques only capable of stopping bleeding? Weren’t they just able to stabilize injuries and prevent them from worsening? Since when did Star Shine Stage Medical Star Martial Warriors become so powerful? Is this still a Medical Star Martial Technique? This is practically rebirth! In just a few minutes, someone gravely injured and on the brink of death was revived?
The sight of Mrs. Jiang looking as if she’d seen a ghost was quite satisfying for Wang Qianfeng.
"It’s okay now. You can go back," Wang Qianfeng said lightly after seeing Wang Lan finish the treatment.
"Yes, your subordinate takes his leave. By the way... is there a problem on Chang Yu’s side?"
"We still aren’t clear on that, but it’s likely."
Wang Lan saluted and took his leave, then went straight to Eastern Heaven Gate by subway.
Having returned home, Wang Lan couldn’t wait to open the system. A new page had appeared on the system’s interface: the Promotion Page. At that moment, the icon of the Lieutenant insignia in the second slot had lit up, while the first slot remained dim.
"I’ve already been promoted to Lieutenant, so why isn’t the Second Lieutenant icon lit up? System, can’t you be a bit more intelligent, like Xiao Ai?"
"Wang Lan, are you complimenting me?" Xiao Ai’s voice resonated within the room.
"Don’t flatter yourself. Order me some takeout."
"Wang Lan, didn’t you eat enough at the banquet you just returned from? Although you are a Star Martial Warrior, overeating can still cause significant harm to your body..."
"I only had one sip of wine, and even that was forced out of me! What do you think I ate, air? Go on, the usual."
"Understood."
Wang Lan looked at the first dim icon, contemplating asking Director Wang for a Second Lieutenant’s insignia some other day.
Without the Second Lieutenant rank, it felt as if life wasn’t complete. He probably wouldn’t refuse.
The Jade Country’s military rank system has three tiers and twelve levels. Junior officers range from Second Lieutenant to Captain, while field officers are from Major to Senior Colonel.
Although, nominally, field officers were mid-level, even they commanded over a thousand soldiers. A Senior Colonel, especially, in a regular military corps, held command over special units such as armored corps, artillery corps, or even missile corps.
Upon promotion to First Lieutenant, he had received five hundred skill points. Now, all three of Wang Lan’s Star Martial Skills were at the silver peak. Star Cloud Sword Dance was at Silver 8; after adding one hundred points, it advanced to Silver 9.
He allocated the remaining four hundred points entirely to Inch Strength Fist, boosting it to Silver 7.
He couldn’t simply discard the ancient martial art of Inch Strength just because he now possessed Star Martial Skills. Although the power of Inch Strength might not be as strong as Flame Sword or as agile as Star Cloud Sword Dance, Inch Strength possessed characteristics that Star Martial Skills did not. It doesn’t consume Star Power. Although it uses Star Power, it doesn’t deplete it. The utilization of Star Power merely enhances the body’s strength and increases speed, but the force of the punch still comes from technique and terrifying power.
After completing all this, Wang Lan contentedly took a bath and lay in bed to sleep. As he closed his eyes, his mind speculated about what exactly had occurred that led to Lige and his squad’s total annihilation.
"Director Wang, the investigation is clear," Xu Shiyun reported to Wang Qianfeng. "Tonight, Lige and his squad attempted to capture Chang Yu, but they underestimated his methods. In the end, Chang Yu self-detonated, and all members of Lige’s squad perished in the explosion except for Lige himself."
"Attempt to capture? We never issued an order for his capture," Wang Qianfeng said nonchalantly, tapping on the desk.
"What else is there to guess? It’s obvious Lige was overzealous for merit. Today was the celebration banquet for Wang Lan’s promotion and award. Lige has nearly gone mad over his own promotion for the past two years. Just when he was about to get promoted, Wang Lan got ahead of him. Feeling disgruntled, Lige thought he’d gain back some face by scoring another achievement, never expecting to try to steal a chicken only to lose the rice used to lure it. Chang Yu was our only lead in tracking the Magical Martial Artists. Lige’s reckless pursuit for merit caused us to completely lose this lead. This time, not only is promotion out of the question, he might even face a military tribunal."
"Don’t jump to conclusions," Wang Qianfeng warned sharply. "Although Lige is ambitious, he has integrity. He wouldn’t violate his principles just for the sake of achievement. I think there’s more to this than meets the eye..."
"Who knows?"
"Let’s wait for the Law Enforcement Department’s interrogation results."
"Director Wang, what should we do next?"
"Gather all of Chang Yu’s connections, especially everything from the past six months—every move Chang Yu has made. Collect as much as possible. Hopefully, we’ll find something."
"Lige, you’re saying that Chang Yu suddenly realized she was being monitored, then started packing to leave, and under those circumstances, you decided to capture her? Then why didn’t you request permission before the capture?"
"Chang Yu moved quickly! From the moment we realized she was about to flee to when she walked out her door was less than a minute. There was no time. If we’d requested permission, she might have already been gone. That’s why I ordered the immediate capture."
"Who can corroborate this?" He MingXue’s penetrating gaze stabbed right into Lige’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 100 Tonight’s serene beauty is perfect for murder.
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 100 Tonight’s serene beauty is perfect for murder.
Emerging from the interrogation room of the Law Enforcement Department, Lieutenant Lige’s body wouldn’t stop shaking. It wasn’t fear but rage that caused the tremors.
He couldn’t accept the interrogation-like questioning from the Law Enforcement Department, let alone their judgment of his actions.
For recklessness in pursuit of merit, spooking the enemy, and thereby causing important leads to be severed: one major demerit and a demotion of one rank.
"Captain Li, how did it go?"
Lige walked past slowly, ignoring the question.
"Captain Li, we believe in you..."
Lige continued to walk past emotionlessly, like a soulless corpse.
"Captain Li, Director Li wants to see you."
"Oh!"
Mechanically, Lige turned and headed towards Li Weixin’s office door.
"TAP TAP TAP—"
"Come in!"
"Lieutenant Lige, reporting to you."
"Lieutenant Lige? You’ve accepted the punishment so quickly?"
"Do I have any choice but to accept the punishment handed down by the Law Enforcement Department?" Lige asked with a bitter smile.
"You’re really not convinced?"
"How do you expect me to be convinced?" Lige roared in fury, as if Li Weixin had lit his fuse. "What evidence do they have to accuse me of being reckless? On what grounds do they refute the facts I’ve stated? Chang Yu suddenly started packing up and left, all within less than a minute. If I had sought instructions, she would’ve run away by then! Was it wrong for me to order her arrest? Chang Yu self-detonated; she didn’t escape from my hands. How can my actions be deemed a failure? Director Li, do you think He MingXue’s judgment was fair? Is there not even a hint of him trying to protect Wang Lan?"
"Enough!" Li Weixin slammed his hand on the desk and shot to his feet. "You can still stand here and yell at me, but Lu Hua and the others can’t even have their bodies pieced back together. Do you have the gall to yell? Go and look at your comrades’ remains now! Look at them, and see if you can still yell!"
Pain contorted Lige’s face at Li Weixin’s words. "I didn’t want this... I really didn’t expect... They were my brothers. I’m not just upset for myself; I feel wronged for them too! They all fell in battle, yet... yet they’re labeled as reckless... They..." Lige began to sob.
"So now you know to cry, to regret? Why didn’t you think before you gave the order? Your mission was to monitor Chang Yu’s every move. Surveillance means surveillance! What right did you have to order an arrest? Even Wang Qianfeng and He MingXue working together weren’t sure they could capture Chang Yu. What’s your skill level? What makes you think you could capture her? Did you really believe you’re the top talent from the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau? Have you gotten so complacent over these years that you’ve forgotten your own limitations?"
"But I almost succeeded..."
"How do you know that ’almost success’ wasn’t a trap deliberately laid by Chang Yu? Perhaps it was to lure you closer and then she planned to detonate herself, destroying this lead and taking all of you down with her? Do you think self-destruction is really a last resort, a desperate measure? Since she was being monitored by the Tianjian Bureau, she couldn’t escape our grasp. Do you think that just because she slipped away from your team, she eluded the Tianjian Bureau’s overall surveillance? Dream on! Even Chang Yu knew better than that! Only a fool like you would think Chang Yu was trying to flee. Was she really fleeing? She knew she was exposed, so she feigned escape to draw you closer. Then she self-destructed to obliterate this lead, planning to take you down with her. Can you honestly say that at the moment you ordered the arrest, there wasn’t even a trace of glory-seeking in your thoughts? If you had reported it, the Intelligence and Communications Departments could still have tracked Chang Yu. In Suzhou City, there are cameras and surveillance everywhere; she couldn’t have gotten far. Do you genuinely not understand, or are you refusing to understand? Still feel wronged? Do you still think you’re wronged now?"
After Li Weixin’s tirade, the defiance in Lige’s eyes crumbled.
Since regaining consciousness, he had clung to the belief that he was right, that he had nearly succeeded. If only he had sealed her head as well, none of this would have happened.
But now, in the face of Li Weixin’s sharp words, all his persistence vanished like smoke.
What if, from the very beginning, it was Chang Yu’s trap? What if, from the start, Chang Yu had planned to take them all down with her?
He wasn’t just wrong; he was irredeemably at fault.
Lige slowly crouched down, covering his face and wailing in grief.
"Wipe your tears. A warrior of the Tianjian Bureau doesn’t let tears show on their face."
The sobbing abruptly stopped.
"This time, you were wrong. But I hope you learn from this, and I don’t want to see you succumb to a single setback. Falling down isn’t scary, but being unable to get back up after a fall is truly terrifying."
"Yes—"
Due to the major incident involving Chang Yu, the lead for investigating the origins of the Magical Martial Artists was completely severed.
Wang Lan was keen to join Xu Shiyun’s investigation plan, but he still had to attend school.
Being a student was an identity that offered protection, but it also imposed restrictions. At least, Wang Lan didn’t yet have the power to free himself from these constraints.
Dare to drop out of school? Just try it. His aunt, Wang Qianfeng, and the school authorities would quickly make Wang Lan face reality.
But... seeing such a huge mission, emitting an irresistible allure right in front of him, Wang Lan really wanted to take a bite.
Wang Lan constantly refreshed the Tianjian Bureau’s information bulletin board. He couldn’t find any leads on Chang Yu, but he did find a posthumous promotion notice. The six Tianjian Bureau warriors who had perished while trying to capture Chang Yu were posthumously declared martyrs and awarded Second-Class Martyr Medals.
Following that was the disciplinary report for Lige. He was penalized for suspected glory-seeking and recklessness, receiving one major demerit, a one-level demotion in military rank, and a one-level demotion in position.
Wang Lan couldn’t easily judge Lige’s actions, especially since it was unclear whether Chang Yu had genuinely detected the surveillance and chosen to flee. But one thing was certain: Lige was now shouldering all the blame.
「A week later, Sunday.」
Wang Lan was planning to head to the Tianjian Bureau to get an update on the situation when Xu Shiyun unexpectedly visited. Wang Lan hastily invited Xu Shiyun into his home.
"Wow, your house is huge! How many rooms does it have?"
"Not that many, only six," Wang Lan replied, leading Xu Shiyun into the sunroom. They basked in the warm autumn sunshine, feeling as if every cell in their bodies had been revitalized.
"Xu, what brings you over so suddenly? Is there anything your little brother here can do to help?"
"Nothing much, just frustrated. Lige created this mess, so why the hell should I have to clean up after him? He was so quick to try and claim credit, but now that there’s a mess to deal with, where’s all that enthusiasm?"
"Hasn’t he already been punished?" Wang Lan said with a smile, pushing a cup of coffee towards Xu Shiyun. "Besides, even if he wanted to get involved now, the higher-ups wouldn’t allow it, right?"
"Serves him right!" Xu Shiyun sneered. "If it weren’t for his reckless ambition in arresting her, we might have already identified her superior by now. Actually, our Communications Department did monitor Chang Yu’s sudden escape. We initially thought she might meet up with other Demon Clan spies and planned to follow that lead, but Lige ruined everything."
"I doubt Chang Yu would be foolish enough to meet with others, knowing she was under surveillance. By the way, how did she realize she was being monitored?"Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on
"Someone must have tipped her off. Before Chang Yu left, someone used a public phone to call her, and then she started preparing to escape. We immediately launched a pursuit after finding out, but unfortunately, she got away."
"No clues were found at Chang Yu’s home?"
"Nothing! We didn’t find a thing."
"We monitored Chang Yu for half a month, and found nothing during that entire time?"
"Chang Yu led a very regular life—or rather, the Demon Clan spy did. Apart from work, she would just go home, play with her phone, and read books. She never went out and had no close friends."
"Didn’t she act out of the ordinary when Chang Shuangyue got into trouble?"
"What could be out of the ordinary? She killed Chang Shuangyue with her own hands. When we told her Chang Shuangyue was arrested for intentional injury, Chang Yu’s reaction was flawless. It was just that we didn’t realize Chang Yu was the problem at that time. Hmm... wait a second..." Xu Shiyun suddenly paused. "Not many people knew we had identified Chang Yu as problematic. Even Chang Yu thought she was completely undetected, only realizing it after receiving that tip-off. How did the informer know?"
"Could it be... there’s a mole?" Wang Lan asked gravely.
"That possibility can’t be ruled out. It looks like the Tianjian Bureau will have to conduct an internal investigation."
"Xu, Chang Yu was replaced by the Demon Clan half a year ago. So, is there anyone she met during this past half-year?"
"I’m tracing that line of inquiry, but so far, nothing has come up. Her colleagues haven’t raised any suspicions yet. However, we can’t afford to exclude any possibilities now. Chang Yu was able to evade our sophisticated detection equipment; other Demon Clan members probably could too. Perhaps one of Chang Yu’s accomplices is someone within Renhe Hospital."
Xu Shiyun left after a short visit at Wang Lan’s place. His main purpose in coming had been to vent his frustrations. After all, with Chang Yu dead, she had left a huge mess behind. It was almost impossible for the Intelligence Department to pick up any leads from the chaotic aftermath.
Wang Lan also felt it was a pity, but
with things having come to this, what could be done?
That evening, Wang Lan was enthusiastically working through practice problems when a chat notification blinked on his computer. It was a message from Jiang Xinyu.
"Happy Birthday—"
Huh?
Wang Lan pulled out his phone and glanced at it. Indeed, today was his birthday.
He had actually forgotten his own birthday, which meant...
In his previous life, Wang Lan had read a saying: Before a man turns thirty, he remembers his own birthday every year. On that day, he looks forward to who might send blessings, who still remembers him. After thirty, aside from those closest to him, even he starts forgetting his own birthday. After thirty, the only ones who still send birthday wishes are family.
Looks like I’ll have to start calling myself an old man from now on.
Wang Lan chuckled and replied, "Thank you!"
On the other end of the connection, Jiang Xinyu bit her finger, hesitating.
What should she say? This awkward chat wasn’t what she wanted, but... there didn’t seem to be anything else to say, did there?
"DING-DING—"
"Hand over the red envelope."
Jiang Xinyu smiled faintly and readily sent a red envelope.
"One cent? Are you still the rich young lady I know?"
"At least it’s more than you sent. When it was my birthday, you didn’t even send a one-cent red envelope!"
The two of them bantered effortlessly over the internet. Wang Lan probably wouldn’t have dared to be so cheeky face-to-face.
Just as he was about to retort, Wang Lan’s expression suddenly changed.
His brow furrowed, an epiphany streaking through his mind like a shooting star.
Suddenly, Wang Lan shot up, grabbed his jacket, and rushed out the door.
Jiang Xinyu, who was typing rapidly, suddenly stopped. In the bottom-right corner, his chat status showed he was offline.
After a moment of stunned silence, Jiang Xinyu exhaled deeply.
The moon tonight is beautifully tranquil, fitting for murder.

chapters.title: Chapter 101 Not One, But a Group
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 101 Not One, But a Group
Following his GPS, Wang Lan quickly navigated the bustling streets of Suzhou City on his electric scooter. The Suzhou branch of Penguin Corporation was located in the Eastern Heaven Gate commercial district, not too far from Wang Lan’s Xinyu Building.
While chatting with Jiang Xinyu, Wang Lan suddenly realized a loophole in the Tianjian Bureau’s surveillance network. The Bureau had only monitored Chang Yu’s phone and the people she contacted, but what era was this? It was the information age, the internet age.
In the internet age, there were numerous ways spies could contact each other: visiting certain websites, browsing specific posts, communicating with particular individuals, or making certain statements. And contact might not necessarily be interactive.
What if Chang Yu didn’t initiate contact but passively received information?
If so, the channels through which she could obtain information were vast. She could open a forum, scroll through posts, and potentially receive instructions from a specific entry.
Currently, the internet in Jade Country was practically monopolized by Penguin Corporation. This was why Wang Lan had come to Penguin Corporation. The broadband they used was Penguin’s, the search engine was Penguin’s, and even the chat tools were Penguin’s.
Arriving at the entrance of Penguin Corporation, Wang Lan saw that the lights in its fifteen-story standalone office building were still blazing.
"Hello sir, may I help you?" The security guard at the door stopped Wang Lan.
Wang Lan didn’t hesitate, pulling out his Tianjian Bureau ID. "Tianjian Bureau investigation. Please contact the person in charge of the Suzhou City branch of Penguin Corporation. Thank you."
The citizens of Jade Country might never have seen a Tianjian Bureau warrior, but they had almost certainly heard of the Bureau’s renown. Many jokes and stories about the Tianjian Bureau circulated both online and by word of mouth. Some respectfully called them special agents; others, more irreverently, referred to them as ’the relevant department.’ In any case, when comedians joked about ’someone coming to check the water meter,’ they were usually referring to the Tianjian Bureau.
The security guard’s expression changed instantly. After carefully examining Wang Lan’s ID, he quickly made a phone call. Soon after, a portly, balding middle-aged man hurried out from the lobby of the office building.
"May I ask if you are a senior official from the Tianjian Bureau?"
"Are you the person in charge of Penguin Corporation?"
"I am the CEO of the Suzhou City branch. Sir, please come inside. May I ask, has Penguin Corporation committed some offense?" the CEO asked cautiously while leading the way.
Although people might joke about the Tianjian Bureau, when they were actually ’having their water meter checked,’ they were genuinely anxious. Besides, minor issues would, at most, involve police visits. For the Tianjian Bureau to show up, it had to be something significant.
"No, I need Penguin Corporation to help me investigate some information. After all, Penguin Corporation’s cloud contains data on almost everyone. This shouldn’t be too much trouble for you, right?"
"Not a problem, not a problem at all," the middle-aged man quickly agreed. As long as the company hadn’t committed an offense, he was relieved. His posture straightened, and his voice naturally became more relaxed.
"It’s so late, and your company’s employees are still working overtime?"
"Isn’t this typical for programmers? They burn the midnight oil while they’re young. That’s just how it is in this industry. Sir, this way, please."
"Please, don’t call me ’Sir’; I’m not used to it. My name is Wang Lan; just call me Wang Lan. And don’t call me Little Wang, especially not with any diminutive suffixes."
"Haha... Brother Wang Lan, you have quite the sense of humor. This way, please. This is our data analysis department. Their responsibility is to analyze data traffic to adjust its distribution. Oh, and they’re also responsible for targeted user recommendations. Essentially, all aggregated internet data flows here. Mr. Lou, could you come over for a moment?"
From the office, another middle-aged man, also with male-pattern baldness, stood up and hurried over. "Mr. Jin, you called me?"
"This is Wang Lan from the Tianjian Bureau. He needs your cooperation for an investigation. Whatever he asks, just cooperate fully. Pause what you’re working on; it can wait."
"Alright. Hello, Chief Wang."
"Hello, Mr. Lou. Just call me Wang Lan. I need you to extract someone’s internet data from the past six months. Chang Yu, ID number *********, phone number *******."
"Okay! Please wait a moment!"
Wang Lan sat beside Mr. Lou, watching his fingers fly across the keyboard with lightning speed. Soon, a progress bar appeared and began to advance. After about half an hour, the data download was complete.
"Done!"
"In the last six months, what has her online activity been like?"
"Very low. Almost no activity. Her ID says she’s only twenty-four? For a girl her age, one week’s data usage would typically exceed her usage over the past six months."
"Was her data usage like this before?"
"Hmm... let me check."
After another flurry of keystrokes, the results came up in about ten minutes.
"Starting from March, her data usage plummeted. Before that, her data consumption level was fairly average. Since then, she seems to have rarely gone online. Her main data consumption in the past six months has been downloading ten movies."
"Compile a list of the forums and websites she frequently visited."
"Okay! Hmm, her interests are quite unique. A young woman who likes to browse military forums and visit the National Bureau of Statistics website to check data... This is usually something only people in social sciences or military enthusiasts would follow."
"I need a computer. I want to look through the web pages she browsed."
Wang Lan sat beside Head Lou and used a laptop to go through every website Chang Yu had visited. Fortunately, Chang Yu hadn’t browsed much, but it still took Wang Lan nearly two hours to review everything.
"From March until now, has she interacted with anyone online?"
"Yes! There’s interaction on her Penguin account. But it’s all things like greeting messages and some forwarded messages. She hardly ever posts status updates or comments online... This person... she’s too much of a recluse, isn’t she? It’s hard to believe for such a beautiful girl. Usually, it’s middle-aged or elderly people who aren’t tech-savvy who are like this."
"Can you covertly log into her Penguin account? I want to see her interaction messages and who she has been interacting with."
"Okay. I’ll sync it to your computer." As Head Lou spoke, he quickly worked on his terminal, and soon, a web interface for a Penguin account popped up on Wang Lan’s screen.
"I’ll list the recent contacts..."
For nearly seven months, Chang Yu’s external contact had been practically non-existent. She hardly chatted with anyone online, didn’t post status updates, share her thoughts, or her moods. It was as if she were living in a bygone era, completely out of sync with the current times.
The first few contacts seemed to be her suitors; some invited her to dinner, others for outings. But she hadn’t replied to any of them. One person, driven to frustration by Chang Yu’s cold attitude, sent a questioning message and was blocked after just one sentence.
All Wang Lan could think was, ’You’re lucky to be alive. If Chang Yu had actually agreed, you’d probably be knocking on death’s door.’
As he scrolled down, a contact suddenly caught Wang Lan’s eye. This contact had sent Chang Yu advertising messages—each one a lengthy spiel of at least a thousand characters, with much of the content repeated. There were more than ten such ads, all sent by this person. Chang Yu had neither responded to them nor blocked the sender. This very fact made Wang Lan suspicious.
Who in their right mind would tolerate such lengthy, rambling advertisements? Most people would block the sender after the first one, so how could she have accepted so many?
Furthermore, these rambling ads also contained some meaningless numbers. The numbers weren’t phone numbers, nor were they verification codes or anything of the sort.
"Check when this person became friends with Chang Yu."
"Okay! It was April 1st."
"April? That was after Chang Yu’s data usage plummeted?"
"That’s right!"
"Who initiated the friend request?"
"The other party sent the request, and Chang Yu accepted."
"Covertly log into this person’s account from the backend!" Wang Lan ordered, a sharp glint in his eyes.
"Okay!"
A moment later, another web-based Penguin account interface appeared on Wang Lan’s computer. This account had pitifully few friends: only thirty in total, with just twelve contacts in the last six months. Wang Lan opened the contact’s chat interface. It was all the same: streams of advertising messages sent to those individuals. And none of these twelve people had blocked this account either.
"Covertly log into the Penguin accounts of these twelve people!"
"Okay!"
"Check the network data usage status of these twelve individuals. Are they practically offline, similar to Chang Yu?"
Head Lou was now quite excited.
He had a gut feeling he was involved in something incredibly thrilling and significant, like decrypting something layer by layer, peeling back a mysterious veil. Even though he still had no idea what Wang Lan was investigating, he just had this strong intuition.
"Young Brother Wang Lan, you guessed right. All twelve of these individuals have virtually no data usage. The time frames vary, though. The most recent one started two months ago, while the one who’s been inactive the longest has been practically offline since last year."
"Check their data usage patterns. See if there are any commonalities with Chang Yu."
"There are! They all pay close attention to military affairs and current political events. When they go online, it’s basically to check national developments and see if any new military weaponry has emerged."
"Looks like I was right!"
At this point, Wang Lan was almost certain that his flash of inspiration, his guess, had been completely validated.
He took out his phone and dialed a number.
"Hello, Director Wang!"
"Wang Lan, what time is it... What’s the matter?"
"I might have found them."
"Found them? Who?"
"The Demon Clan spy group, including Chang Yu."
CLATTER—
A dull thud came from the other end of the phone, followed by a sharp, grating intake of breath.
"Director Wang, are you alright?"
"Say that again! What did you find?" Wang Qianfeng’s voice suddenly boomed from the other end.
"I said I might have found the identities of the Demon Clan spy group, including Chang Yu."
"Where are you right now?"
"At the Suzhou City branch of Penguin Corporation."
"Don’t go anywhere. I’m on my way."
After hanging up, Wang Lan continued to examine the data on these twelve individuals. The true identity of the person sending messages to Chang Yu was also easily traceable through the account: Qin Jiaqing, male, sixty years old. Based on data flow analysis, this Qin Jiaqing was likely the leader of this fourteen-person cell. He issued orders to the others in the guise of advertising messages. Although these messages hadn’t been decrypted yet, Wang Lan was confident it wouldn’t be a challenge for the Tianjian Bureau.
The remaining members included both men and women, their identities completely unrelated. There were chefs, programmers, engineers, and so on.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Activate Level B Permissions
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 102: Activate Level B Permissions
About half an hour later, the sound of a car horn suddenly rang out from outside. Wang Lan hurried to the window and looked down. More than a dozen vehicles were jamming the entrance of the Penguin Corporation. The remaining personnel maintained a security cordon around the area as Wang Qianfeng and Xu Shiyun practically burst into the Penguin Corporation branch.
Under the guidance of the branch president, Wang Qianfeng and Xu Shiyun made their way to the Cloud Data Analysis Department.
"Director Wang," Wang Lan quickly stood up and saluted Wang Qianfeng.
"Wang Lan, you said you’ve found the spy group that includes Chang Yu? Who did you discover? Were they connected to Chang Yu? Are you certain?" Wang Qianfeng asked hurriedly.
The usually calm Wang Qianfeng lost his composure at that moment. This intelligence was too important. If confirmed, the achievement would be significant enough to shock even the Ministry of Defense.
In the struggle against the Demon Clan spies, the Tianjian Bureau had always been at a disadvantage. The disadvantage wasn’t due to a lack of strength, but because the enemy was hidden while they were exposed.
The Demon Clan members were not the mindless beings the common people imagined, nor were they as inept as depicted in television and movies. The Demon Clan was a species of higher intelligence, possessing its own civilization.
Although the Demon Clan’s combat methods seemed primitive, this didn’t mean their technology was equally primitive. On the contrary, the Demon Clan might possess technology on par with, or even surpassing, human civilization.
They learned human concepts quickly, such as the use of electrical power. In the Different Dimensional Space, under different physical laws, they successfully harnessed electricity. Human scientists, however, were still struggling to figure out how to do the same in that space.
Previously, at Red Maple Forest Park, Wang Lan’s discovery of the Demon Clan’s secret base and conspiracy had involved a certain degree of luck. Although it provided an auspicious start and earned him relatively significant merit, it was not something that could be replicated.
But this time, if they could confirm the identity of another Demon Clan spy when the trail had gone cold, it would be a hard-fought victory.
"Director Wang, I can’t guarantee it with absolute certainty. But it’s not just one. Besides Chang Yu, there are thirteen others—possibly a complete spy ring."
"What?" Wang Qianfeng’s eyes widened in disbelief, while Xu Shiyun, standing beside him, was already flushed with excitement.
If it were anyone else saying this, Xu Shiyun wouldn’t believe it. But coming from Wang Lan, he did. After all, Wang Lan was a walking enigma! Which newly awakened Star Martial Warrior was as lucky as Wang Lan, repeatedly encountering the Demon Clan causing trouble? This was no longer just luck; it was practically destiny.
"Quick, how did you find out?"
"Today, I was chatting with a friend online. I didn’t say much, but my friend was quite talkative. Suddenly, it dawned on me: Chang Shuangyue could receive instructions by passively consuming data, without needing to actively generate it. I’ve heard Brother Xu mention the scope of our surveillance before, but it seems we haven’t monitored which websites Chang Yu browsed, or what she read or watched. Our focus has been primarily on her social circle and contacts.
"So, I came to Penguin Corporation and asked Head Lou to help me analyze Chang Yu’s data usage over the last six months. That’s when I found a very strange contact in her account."
As he spoke, Wang Lan pulled up Qin Jiaqing’s chat window. "This person added Chang Yu as a friend on April 1st. Over the past six months, he sent her more than a dozen advertisement messages, each over a thousand words long.
"Any normal person would have blacklisted such an annoying contact long ago. But Chang Yu didn’t. She didn’t respond, nor did she block him; she just pretended not to see the messages.
"That aroused my suspicion. So, I covertly logged into that person’s Penguin account from here and discovered that over the past six months, he had sent the same advertisement messages to thirteen individuals. And strangely, none of those thirteen people had blocked him either.Thɪs updatᴇd by ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"Afterwards, I asked Head Lou to investigate the data usage of those thirteen individuals. I found that, just like Chang Yu, they were almost exclusively interested in military and political affairs. Moreover, although they had been very active online before, at some point they all suddenly stopped engaging in online entertainment, as if they had transcended worldly concerns."
"What’s there to be uncertain about... Haven’t you basically got irrefutable proof?" Xu Shiyun let out a long breath after hearing everything.
"Director Wang, with all this evidence, how could we be wrong?"
Wang Qianfeng frowned deeply. "These findings alone can’t be considered conclusive evidence. And even if we could confirm their identities, what are their objectives? Do they have any plans? Is there another spy ring operating in parallel with them? All of these questions need further confirmation."
"Director Wang, are you going to do this again? What’s in hand is what’s real. Don’t cast a long line hoping to catch a big fish. If the big fish isn’t caught and you lose the bait too, it’ll be a huge loss."
"Maximizing our gains has always been our pursuit. Unless absolutely necessary, we must operate based on the principle of maximizing benefits. You can make arrests now, but the most likely outcome is that these thirteen Demon Clan spies will commit suicide. We’ll end up with nothing but a pile of corpses."
"But wouldn’t we have destroyed a Demon Clan spy ring?"
"Is our aim merely to destroy one Demon Clan spy ring? Once we’ve taken down this ring, can we rest easy? We must not only uproot the spies but also trace the leads, obtain their intelligence, and completely eradicate the Demon Clan spies in Suzhou City. There’s a lot we need to do. Print these materials and take them back."
Then, addressing Head Lou and the cooperating staff of the Penguin Corporation, he said, "Today’s events are a matter of national security. It is imperative that you keep what happened tonight strictly to yourselves. Revealing even a single word will result in severe punishment by the state.
"I trust everyone will cooperate."
"Yes, yes, yes! We promise not to say a word, not even in our dreams."
"Right, there was a BUG in the system today, and we all worked overtime to fix it. Nothing else happened."
"Good. Ayun, let’s go."
"Um, Director Wang... could I get involved? Look, I discovered the lead. Logically and emotionally, I should be involved, right?" Wang Lan asked with a broad smile, tugging at Wang Qianfeng’s arm.
"You?"
"Yes, me! Me!" Wang Lan nodded eagerly, like a chicken pecking at grain.
"Aren’t you supposed to go to school tomorrow?"
"I went through so much trouble to find such an important clue, and you’re just going to kick me aside? That’s not very kind, is it? How many times has this happened now?"
"If we successfully crack this case, the primary credit will be yours; no one can take that away. I must say, for someone so young, you’re quite the opportunist, aren’t you? Just how badly do you want to earn merits?"
"Brother Xu, listen to Director Wang. Is he being reasonable? I’m striving for the safety of humanity, the security of Suzhou City, and world peace! And Director Wang... he actually thinks of me like that? It’s truly disheartening."
"Scram. Go home and get some sleep."
"Oh!" Realizing there was no chance of getting involved in the case, Wang Lan could only resign himself to his fate, albeit grudgingly.
"By the way, Ayun, arrange for Wang Lan’s clearance to be upgraded. From today, Wang Lan will have B-level access within the Intelligence Department. He can view all the latest progress and materials on the case."
"Understood!"
Wang Lan had just reached the elevator when he suddenly stopped, a delighted smile spreading across his face.
It wasn’t because Wang Qianfeng had agreed to grant him the clearance, but because a "Task in Progress" notification had appeared in his system. This notification hadn’t been there before he came to Penguin Corporation.
A task! Does this mean I’ve successfully gotten involved? So, even if I do nothing, as long as this spy ring is arrested, I’ll have completed the task? Without even lifting a finger?
"It’s just a clearance upgrade. What’s there to be so happy about?" Xu Shiyun said, somewhat bewildered.
"You wouldn’t understand my joy. You work hard; I’m going back to sleep. Don’t bother me if it’s not important... Hmm, even if it is important, you don’t have to bother me."
"Why such a sudden change in attitude?"
"In front of the bosses, of course, I have to appear proactive. But actually, my dream is to do less and earn more, to lie back and count money. I’ve already secured the main credit, so you guys can do the hard work."
"Kid, you’re really something!" Xu Shiyun was speechless and gave a sincere thumbs-up.
「」
By the time Wang Lan got home, it was past midnight. He turned on his computer and saw several messages from Jiang Xinyu. He considered replying but then thought better of it.
Jiang Xinyu must be asleep by now, right? Such a good guy; that’s how thoughtful and considerate I am.
Lying in bed, he should have been sleepy, but his mind was too excited, and he couldn’t fall asleep. Tossing and turning, Wang Lan pulled out his phone. Just as he lit up the screen, a notification popped up.
"Wang Lan, ID: Suzhou E******, B-level clearance successfully activated."
Previously, Wang Lan hadn’t known what level of clearance he possessed, but aside from browsing announcements and checking some internal updates, he couldn’t seem to do much else. He wondered what was different about B-level clearance.
He logged into the Tianjian Bureau homepage. A new row of buttons, labeled from E-level to B-level, suddenly appeared in the menu bar.
So, my previous clearance wasn’t even E-level? Without an official position, they treated me like such an outsider? How realistic of them!
Clicking on the B-level clearance button, his phone screen went through a series of redirects before finally opening a new page. There were buttons for various departments, but all of them were grayed out except for the one for the Intelligence Department.
Perhaps because I’m part of the Intelligence Department, I can only access its permissions. When will they give me full network access?
Entering the Intelligence Department section, the topmost item was "Latest Compiled Information on the Chang Yu Case."
He clicked the link, which opened a file containing evidence collected by the Intelligence Department from Chang Yu’s home, including photographs taken at the scene.
Chang Yu’s family lived in the countryside. Although their area was zoned as part of the city, it hadn’t undergone urban redevelopment. Theirs was a common two-story Western-style house, typical of rural areas. Despite its remote location, transportation was convenient. An overpass was right outside, and it was at most a half-hour drive to the city center.
Only Chang Yu and her older brother lived in the house; their parents had died in an accident ten years ago. The bookshelves in Chang Yu’s room were filled with medical books. Although she hadn’t managed to get into a medical university and had only attended a vocational health school, she still harbored the dream of becoming a real doctor.
On Chang Yu’s desk lay the Antu Prose Collection, a computer, a desk lamp, and some cute decorations. Judging by the room’s decorations, the former Chang Yu had possessed a naive and romantic girlish heart. It was a pity that such a young woman, in the bloom of her youth, had been killed by the Demon Clan.
The room was clean and tidy. Even after being searched by the Tianjian Bureau, it remained remarkably pristine.
After looking for a long time, his eyelids grew heavy, and before he knew it, he fell asleep.
Wang Lan, who hadn’t dreamt in a long time, had a dream. He dreamt he accidentally stepped into a Time and Space Tunnel. In the blink of an eye, he returned to his past life—to a world almost identical to this one, but without the threat of the Demon Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 103 This person’s luck is too good, right?
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 103 This person’s luck is too good, right?
Wang Lan had a pleasant dream, but Wang Qianfeng and his brothers in the Intelligence Department couldn’t sleep at all.
Upon returning to the Tianjian Bureau headquarters, Wang Qianfeng immediately notified the intelligence analysts, the cryptographers, and the head of the Communications Department to rush back to the Tianjian Bureau to work overtime.
After finishing this round of calls, Wang Qianfeng finally had a chance to catch his breath and take a sip of water.
Looking at the clock on the wall, it was already two o’clock in the morning. After some hesitation, Wang Qianfeng still picked up the phone and dialed the number.
"Hello!" A clear and authoritative voice answered the phone.
"Director, you haven’t slept yet?"
"Haven’t slept? Don’t you see what time it is? What’s the matter?"
"There’s a situation that I think is necessary to report to you. We may have... identified the entire spy group, including Chang Yu, totaling thirteen people."
"Wait a minute! What did you say? Not only do you have the latest leads based on the clues left by Chang Yu, but you’ve also identified the other members of the spy group?"
"It seems so! We just haven’t decrypted the content of their encrypted messages yet, so... we can’t be one hundred percent certain, but I’m ninety percent confident."
"Are you at the bureau right now?"
"Yes!"Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
"I’m coming over right away."
In less than half an hour, Lu Zhao, along with the heads of the Action Department, the Law Enforcement Department, the Communications Department, and other key departments, had all returned to the Tianjian Bureau.
"Director!" Wang Qianfeng hurried forward. "Here’s what happened..."
"Let’s talk in the meeting room," Lu Zhao quickly interjected.
Once the five high-ranking officials from the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau were in the conference room and the signal jamming device was activated, Lu Zhao nodded to Wang Qianfeng. "Feng, explain."
"The significant breakthrough in the case was discovered by our department’s Wang Lan."
"Him again?" Li Weixin interrupted in surprise. "This... this is too lucky, right? It’s only been a few days! The Demon Clan stumbled into his hands again? This time, if you say he’s not the child of fate, fuck, I wouldn’t believe it. Can anyone be this lucky?"
"Weixin, let Feng finish," Lu Zhao said in a deep voice.
"Director, this time it wasn’t all luck. Wang Lan noticed a loophole in our surveillance and screening. This is my oversight. Times have changed, but our way of thinking is still stuck in the last era, and that’s not right.
