In the last era, our contacts relied mostly on telephones, and secret contacts were usually made by arranging a meeting place. Now, with the internet so developed, there’s no need to meet at a specific location.
It could be a completely nonexistent website, or logging into a page that almost nobody else would.
Today, Wang Lan realized that our focus was too much on reality, so he went to the Penguin Corporation branch to extract Chang Yu’s network traffic usage for the past six months. He discovered that Chang Yu visited military forums and political forums to browse information.
This led to the discovery of a strange contact on Chang Yu’s Penguin account."
As he spoke, he held up a photo of a middle-aged man in his fifties or sixties. "This man’s name is Qin Jiaqing, currently a security guard at Yihua Garden. On April first, he added Chang Yu as a friend through a ’people nearby’ search.
Each time, he added dozens of people and sent them advertisement messages, but almost everyone blocked him after being harassed just once.
Over the past six months, he sent about a dozen long advertisement messages, of around a thousand words each, to Chang Yu. Wang Lan thought that any normal person would have blocked him after one such message, but Chang Yu didn’t; instead, he acted as if he hadn’t seen them.
This raised Wang Lan’s suspicions. After logging into the back-end of Qin Jiaqing’s Penguin account with the help of technicians from the Penguin Corporation, he found twelve others in situations similar to Chang Yu’s: they had neither blocked him, nor muted him, nor had they responded. The content of the advertisements was similar but not identical. I suspect these advertisements are instructions for them.
These twelve people, all like Chang Yu, suddenly started showing interest in politics and military matters at some point and rarely interacted with others.
Thus, Wang Lan inferred that these twelve people, along with their superior Qin Jiaqing, constitute a spy group."
When Wang Qianfeng had finished explaining, there was only one thought in the minds of everyone present.
Perfect!
Meticulous deduction, a solid chain of evidence—there was no doubt about it. This was definitive proof.
And then, in an instant, everyone felt a tremor within.
A complete Demon Clan spy group had been identified without them taking action or exposing themselves?
What was this? A great achievement!
It was a much more substantial accomplishment than that time in Red Maple Forest Park.
At Red Maple, if the Tianjian Bureaus in other affiliated cities were to get envious, they could still say it was luck, a mere coincidence. But this time, it couldn’t just be chalked up to luck.
This was a case of legitimately digging them out, particularly a spy group in a state of hiding—an act of monumental significance.
If they successfully dismantled it, there would be numerous benefits. Speaking of the larger implications, Suzhou City had set a precedent by taking the initiative, successfully preparing in advance and nipping the threat in the bud before the enemy could even bare its fangs.
This would have to be recorded as a significant entry in their list of achievements.
Speaking practically, bonuses, allowances, military funds, and dividend shares would all increase as a result. Jealousy from others would be pointless.
Jealous? Then bring out some real battle achievements.
Therefore, the five colonels in black laughed.
"Director, should we grab them?" Li Weixin was eager.
Lu Zhao lowered his head in thought, and after a while, looked up at Wang Qianfeng. "Feng, what do you think?"
"Let’s keep them on the line for a bit. They’re already in our grasp, so there’s no fear of them escaping. Keep a close watch. There must be more than this one spy team in Suzhou City. Let’s see if we can pull more leads from them.
Plus, the Magical Martial Artist situation is likely their group’s doing. So far, we know nothing about them; we hope to find a breakthrough regarding them through this team.
Of course, we should also learn from Chang Yu’s incident. If they show the slightest unusual move, seize them immediately."
Everyone present was an experienced special agent with a keen sense of smell. The urge to arrest them immediately was simply the impulse to claim credit first. If one analyzed rationally, Wang Qianfeng’s suggestion was what would maximize the benefits.
Once they were in their grasp, there was no fear of them getting away. Even if they managed to slip past surveillance, they couldn’t escape the omnipresent monitoring in Suzhou City.
"Then... that’s settled. Feng, surveillance is up to you. Make sure to be careful and cautious. I don’t want to see a second incident like Chang Yu’s."
"Understood!"
"That Wang Lan... really is something..." After the meeting, Lu Zhao suddenly said with a light laugh, "He hasn’t even started his duty at the Tianjian Bureau yet, and he’s already racked up a series of merits. If we wrap this up smoothly, he won’t be able to escape the lion’s share of the credit. How should we reward him then?"
"That will require some thought from the Director," He Mingxue smiled and stood up, glancing at his watch. "It’s four o’clock sharp. Too late to go back to sleep; might as well work overtime."
「That day」
Wang Lan was somewhat tired all day, though it wasn’t too obvious. What puzzled Wang Lan was that during today’s sparring, Jiang Xinyu clearly used much more strength.
Watching from the side, Mingyue Wucheng broke into a sweat. If he knew what Wang Lan really thought about Jiang Xinyu, he would have asked Wang Lan if he misunderstood the term "using strength."
Is this called using strength? Attacking vitals with every move? That’s practically homicidal.
However, with Wang Lan’s current strength, he had completely surpassed Jiang Xinyu in basic combat, so he felt that it was just a little extra strength and nothing to worry about.
That day, nothing special happened. Life as a student was just that monotonous and ordinary. Mornings were spent on exams or reviewing papers, while afternoons were dedicated to combat practice or honing internal skills and techniques.
Strength wasn’t something learned, but rather earned through practice.
That day, Jiang Xinyu didn’t speak to Wang Lan.
Jiang Xinyu’s temperament is good, quite fitting the nickname others have given her. Other than this feeling, there’s nothing more,
Wang Lan thought.
At five-thirty in the afternoon, Wang Lan walked out of the school gates with his backpack and, from a distance, saw the class monitor Xie Sisi not taking the crowded bus as usual, but leaving in a large Mercedes.
It was only then that Wang Lan realized Xie Sisi had suddenly become what his classmates were calling a great beauty.
Xie Sisi was naturally pretty, tall and elegant, with a beautiful face. If she paid a bit more attention to fashion and makeup, her attractiveness would skyrocket. However, Wang Lan was always slow to notice these things. Or rather, he never cared, so he was slow to notice.
Now, seeing that scene, Wang Lan had a moment of realization.
Has something changed in Xie Sisi’s life?
What shops are most common around a school gate?
Stationery shops, printing and copying shops, and bookstores.
"Antu has released another prose collection..."
"Fuck, him again. Can’t he pick a better time to release his books? It’s always in November."
"Last year, his ’Rollercoaster’ was selected for the college entrance exam reading comprehension, and my sister cried after the exam. Nobody, including Antu himself, knows how many layers of meaning his prose has. Answering his reading comprehensions is all about sudden inspiration."
"Stop it... With three consecutive prose collections having entries selected for reading comprehension, what do you think are the odds that this new collection will also be chosen?"
"Fuck! Do we even need to guess? The teacher banged the blackboard today. Antu’s latest prose collection is here, and it’s certain that one of the pieces will be on the exam. We’re ordered to get a copy each and practice daily. It’s killing me—"
"Let’s crowdsource to take that bastard down, shall we? His prose has no logic, just writing whatever comes to mind."
"How else would it be called prose? Isn’t prose supposed to be ’loose’?"
A faint smile touched the corners of Wang Lan’s mouth. Antu’s prose, indeed, was the only thing he had ever found truly challenging in exams. Wang Lan could practically ensure a perfect score in the sciences and handle most of the language arts with ease, but he always had to account for losing about twenty points to reading comprehension and essay deductions.
Especially when encountering Antu’s prose for reading comprehension, he had to reserve at least six to ten points.
And it just so happened that Antu’s prose was favored by the Jiang Province test paper setters.
Worried the paper might be too easy? Simple, just throw in an essay from Antu’s collection. So many testable points, any one of them could be a killer question.
As for the correct answer... What correct answer? Isn’t it all just a guess?
The everyday troubles of a regular high school student were something Wang Lan could no longer relate to. For this, Wang Lan admitted to feeling a tiny bit of regret.
He turned to leave but suddenly stopped in his tracks.
A student who had just come out of the bookstore was holding a brand new Antu Prose Collection, and it was... the very same book that had been on Chang Yu’s dormitory desk.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Successful Decryption
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 104: Successful Decryption
In an instant, Wang Lan identified a contradiction. Having attended a regular high school, he understood all too well the hostility students harbored toward the Antu Prose Collection. When they hated it, they wished they could chew the Antu Prose Collection to bits and swallow it. Yet, they had to buy it, read it, and learn the profound metaphysical ideas contained within the prose. So, every time a new edition of the Antu Prose Collection was released, they would basically purchase it at the first opportunity.
Today, the billboards at the school gate were all announcing the launch of the new Antu Prose Collection, indicating that this book must have only arrived on the Suzhou City market in the last couple of days.
Then where did the copy on Chang Yu’s desk come from?
With that thought, Wang Lan went to the bookstore.
"All sold out... The new shipment won’t arrive until the day after tomorrow."
"Really! It’s all gone just like that?"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"Disperse, disperse..."
The students, who were almost exclusively there for that book, left without hesitation upon hearing that it was out of stock. The kids these days are more realistic than adults. The once-crowded little bookstore emptied in the blink of an eye.
"What would you like, student?"
"Boss, I just saw students carrying the Antu Prose Collection..."
"It’s out of stock. I got in three hundred copies, and they sold out in less than half an hour."
"Is this the latest edition?" Wang Lan suddenly asked. "I mean no offense, Boss, but I saw an identical one at a friend’s house about ten days ago."
"That’s nothing strange. The Antu Prose Collection was officially released two months ago in Nandu and the Imperial Capital. It arrived in the provincial capital last month. By the time it got to us in Suzhou City, more than two months had passed. The copy you saw might have been bought for him by someone from the Imperial Capital or Nandu."
"Is that so? Suzhou City only got it recently?"
"Certainly. We always know right away when Suzhou City gets stock. The Antu Prose Collection is so popular, we naturally wanted to get our hands on it as soon as possible."
What a load of crap!
Wang Lan thought.
If it weren’t for the fact that murder was illegal, Antu Nas would have been long gone.
However, the prose he wrote did have quite the highbrow appeal, beloved by literary-minded ladies, with many popular quotes originating from the Antu Prose Collection.
But that was not Wang Lan’s focus.
The new edition of the Antu Prose Collection had started selling three months ago, but it wasn’t yet available in Suzhou City. However, half a month ago, this latest edition was on Chang Yu’s desk.
Wang Lan certainly didn’t think that the Demon Clan-replaced Chang Yu was a literary hipster.
Rushing back home, Wang Lan hurried to his study.
"Xiao Ai, look up the content of the latest edition of the Antu Prose Collection."
"Wang Lan, piracy is illegal."
"Can I pay for it? The physical version."
"Task searching... Search complete. Physical book layout version downloaded. One hundred and five yuan."
"Bring up the promotional SMS Qin Jiaqing sent to Chang Yu."
"It has been retrieved."
"Filter out the repetitive content... filter out the promotional content... filter out emojis. Extract the numbers and regroup them."
Following Wang Lan’s continuous instructions, the message Qin Jiaqing sent to Chang Yu was stripped of nearly all content, leaving behind only a seemingly meaningless string of numbers.
However, as Wang Lan looked at these numbers, a sharp light flashed in his eyes.
These numbers, how familiar they were. Scenes from his past life, watching the TV show ’The Spy’ where Yu Zecheng received orders through coded radio broadcasts, surfaced in his mind.
"Match the Antu Prose Collection with these numerical codes and list the decrypted content."
The advantage of the human brain lies in sudden flashes of insight, while a computer’s advantage is its rapid calculation speed. The human brain might guess the correct decryption method based on intuition, while a computer can swiftly enumerate all possible methods.
In the blink of an eye, lines of text were listed one after another.
"Stop—" Suddenly, Wang Lan told Xiao Ai to halt the decryption. Among the decoded messages, one contained a meaningful sentence.
"The potion is in the second flowerbed at the entrance. Retrieve it quickly."
"Xiao Ai, what is the decryption method for number eleven?"
"The first number denotes the page, the second the line, and the third and fourth numbers indicate the specific character position. Four sets of numerical codes, reordering successful."
"Excellent! Decrypt the remaining messages in the same way."
Indeed, this was the correct decryption method. Starting from April, the first three messages were requests to meet, with the following one stating that the Ant Hole Plan was officially in motion. The subsequent messages were all about the potion.
Potion...
Wang Lan fell into thought, his intuition telling him that this potion might be related to Magical Martial Artists.
The Ant Hole Plan, unsurprisingly, must be derived from the saying, "A dike of a thousand miles is destroyed by an ant hole." Indeed, if a potion that could cause the Demonization of Star Martial Warriors was widely circulated, wouldn’t that equate to countless ant holes undermining human civilization?
With that thought, Wang Lan stood up, got dressed, and left the house.
"Director Wang, the code-breaking department has successfully cracked the code."
"Oh? What is it?"
"At first, we were wrong. The real key isn’t hidden within those advertising words, but in the jumbled numbers within the ads. Each piece of information contains a number, and these numbers correspond to the position of a word in a previous sentence. That’s why we felt that the ad copy was often awkward to read. These texts, when strung together, form a car license plate number and a link."
"A car license plate number? What car’s license plate number?"
"An Island country movie’s license plate number..." the female secretary said in a low, flushed voice.
"Island country movie’s... license plate?" Wang Qianfeng lifted his head. "I understand each word you’re saying, but I can’t make sense of this sentence. Is there a problem with your ability to express yourself, or is there a problem with my ears?"
"This... ’license plate number’ is internet slang. It actually refers to a film title that’s not suitable for children..."
"I see." Wang Qianfeng’s face showed no sign of embarrassment as he put away his pen. "Then what? What is the code-breaking department doing?"
"They believe the Demon Clan’s contact order is hidden in these movies. The code-breaking department is downloading them using the link, but these movies require a lot of bandwidth, so they have to wait for them to download."
"Understood. Let me know once you have the results."
"Yes, sir."
Only after the secretary left did an odd expression cross Wang Qianfeng’s face.
Since when did the Demon Clan become so sleazy? Knowing that such adult content is banned in Jade Country, they decided to use this method? Are they underestimating us?
"Wang Lan? What brings you here?" Xu Shiyun’s inquiry came from outside the office door.
"Xu, are you also here to see Director Wang?"
"Yes! Reporting on some work."
KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK—
"Come in!"
The office door opened, and Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun entered Wang Qianfeng’s office one after another. "Reporting—"
"Wang Lan, just got out of school, right? Why are you here at the bureau at this time? What’s the matter?"
"Director Wang, I’ve successfully deciphered the SMS code."
"Huh? You work that efficiently? Cracked it at nearly the same time as the code-breaking team?" Wang Qianfeng was in a good mood, a quirky smile on his face. "Have you seen it?"
"I have..." Wang Lan felt somewhat guilty.
He was now unsure what Wang Qianfeng meant. Was the content something he shouldn’t have seen? Had he breached confidentiality by seeing it?
"Young man, it would be wise for you to avoid such things. You’re still young; it’s not that time yet."
"Director Wang, from your smile, I feel... could there be some misunderstanding about the code I deciphered?"
"Misunderstanding? More than a dozen... ’license plates’... ’license plate numbers.’ Can you handle that?"
"Please forgive my ignorance, sir, but I fail to understand what you’re implying." Saying this, he pulled an A4 sheet of paper from his pocket and presented it to Wang Qianfeng. "This is the content of the message."
Wang Qianfeng took it and scanned it briefly, his brow suddenly furrowing. "A potion! It must be this. The Demon Clan has developed a potion that can cause Star Martial Warriors to undergo Demonization. Ant Hole Plan... they wish."
"No, Wang Lan, how did you decipher it?"
"Xu, do you remember the Antu Prose Collection on Chang Yu’s desk? It was the latest version. I only found out today that this collection just hit the shelves in Suzhou City. Before that, it wasn’t available here. And this book has only been out for two months; by that time, Chang Yu had already been replaced by the Demon Clan. If you were a Demon, would you be interested in the Antu Prose Collection? That’s why I suspected the collection must serve another purpose. Then I thought about the messages Qin Jiaqing sent to Chang Yu. I extracted numbers from those messages. I used the first number for the page, the second for the line, and the third and fourth numbers for the character position within the prose collection to find the corresponding characters and decipher the content."
"Wait, how... how did you even think of that?" Xu Shiyun looked at Wang Lan in disbelief.
Such a complex and ingenious code, and you actually guessed it? That’s blatant cheating! This world has no spy dramas, nor any real history to use as a reference. Wang Lan managed to think of this method, inspired by spy dramas from a past life. Without that inspiration, guessing this type of decryption approach could only be described as a stroke of genius. The Antu Prose Collection is a bestseller, so Chang Yu having a copy isn’t suspicious, right? SMS messages and the Antu Prose Collection—two completely unrelated things—and you managed to link them? And you actually deciphered it?
Meanwhile, Wang Qianfeng’s expression gradually became more intrigued.
"Just thought of it like that; it didn’t take much time. Didn’t the code-breaking team also crack it?" Wang Lan replied.
Suddenly, Wang Qianfeng picked up the phone. "Code-breaking team, stop downloading those movies. Your approach is completely wrong."
"Director Wang, we can’t even download them if we wanted to... Our computers got infected with a virus. Good thing we used an isolated computer for the download; otherwise, the consequences would have been unthinkable."
"Fools! You’ll write an incident report on this yourselves later."
"What happened?" Wang Lan looked confused,
feeling as though... the code-breaking team had gone in the wrong direction?
"The Demon Clan is really cunning; they even hid traps. Initially, the code-breaking team’s approach was correct; they focused on the numbers in the information. However, they didn’t realize the key was the Antu Prose Collection. Instead, they tried to find patterns within the messages themselves. They used the numbers to extract text from the messages, which gave them a ’license plate number’ and a link. The team believed intelligence was being transmitted through those movies, so they intended to download them. Little did they know, they had fallen right into the Demon Clan’s trap... The link contained a virus."
After hearing Wang Qianfeng’s explanation, Wang Lan broke out in a cold sweat.
To think they dared to click on and download a link provided by the enemy?
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s complexion changed drastically.
"Not good!" Wang Lan exclaimed. "Once this link was downloaded, the Demon Clan’s spy group would have already been alerted."

chapters.title: Chapter 105 The Ruthlessness of the Demon Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 105 The Ruthlessness of the Demon Clan
Wang Lan’s cry of surprise instantly awakened Wang Qianfeng and the others.
Right, was it just about embedding a virus in the connection? It was also an alert system.
The decryption team’s method was not too difficult; within a day, they would certainly finish decrypting it.
Even after so much disguise in the information, once the key point behind the numbers was noticed, decrypting these links was almost a matter of minutes.
The Demon Clan wouldn’t expect Wang Lan to find the correct way to read. As long as someone downloaded their linked movie, it would be tantamount to telling them that their chat information had been captured and cracked, exposing all thirteen groups.
In haste, Wang Qianfeng picked up the phone. "Director, we’ve fallen into a trap and have triggered the target’s alert system; they already know they’ve been exposed."
"Then proceed with the capture."
"Yes! I request He MingXue and Li Weixin to join the capture operation. We’re dealing with an elite group of the Demon Clan; their strength should not be underestimated."
"Agreed, I’ll call them right away."
「Three minutes later.」
All combat units of the Tianjian Bureau were fully assembled.
The Tianjian Bureau had rehearsed the capture drill many times. They were very proficient.
The Tianjian Bureau had eleven Red Elites, but that didn’t mean these eleven Red Elites were all the high-level Star Cloud Stage warriors in the Bureau. In fact, many in the ranks of the White Lieutenants were in the mid to late Star Cloud Stage.
In terms of real strength, Wang Lan, a Lieutenant, is definitely an outlier. Mid-Star Shine Stage, a White Lieutenant of the Tianjian Bureau—if said aloud, nobody would believe it.
Therefore, even if they were to capture fourteen targets at the same time, the Tianjian Bureau could handle it with ease.
"Wang Lan, you’ll join me in capturing Qin Jiaqing," Wang Qianfeng spoke indifferently.
"Yes!"
「As dusk fell and the brilliant lights came on.」
It was the peak hour for evening rush hour. The city’s traffic police started blocking roads to clear the way for the Tianjian Bureau operation. The piercing sound of police sirens echoed throughout Suzhou City.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
These thirteen individuals were spread throughout the city. As expected, as night fell, they all began to move. However, they were all under the Tianjian Bureau’s surveillance for twenty-four hours. Even if they wanted to escape, it would be too late.
Wang Lan sat in Wang Qianfeng’s car, joining Li Weixin en route to Xinyi Garden. Qin Jiaqing was a security guard in the complex. Before their car approached Xinyi Garden, a fierce whirlwind suddenly swept through the area.
The wind was so strong it was nearly impossible to keep one’s eyes open. The residents’ clothes hung outside were lifted into the sky by the whirlwind. Qin Jiaqing, who was opening and closing doors at the entrance, squinted his eyes slightly...
"You came quite quickly!"
Suddenly, a net made of wind blades formed in the sky and descended like a large net from above.
This scene went unnoticed by the pedestrians approaching the entrance.
Qin Jiaqing’s figure flashed, teleporting onto the rooftop of the guard booth and spewing a dragon of fire toward the sky.
Fire overcomes wind. The sharp net of wind blades could cut through water, earth, metal, even lightning, but it couldn’t cut through the inherently formless fire.
On the contrary, when the net of wind blades met the flames, a huge rift was torn open. As soon as the rift appeared, Qin Jiaqing’s figure shot up like a rocket, rushing into the broken void.
Suddenly, Qin Jiaqing’s eyes narrowed. A vertical column of water surged from the sky, crashing down like the Milky Way.
"HA—" Qin Jiaqing raised his hand to slash, and the column of water split in two. Yet, he also reluctantly fell back down.
BOOM—
The guard booth exploded, and the surging water sprayed all around. But it was blocked by an invisible barrier, spreading only within a fifty-meter radius.
"AH—" At this moment, the surrounding civilians realized what was happening and panicked, scrambling to flee in all directions.
"Others assist in evacuating the crowd! Barrier Group, stabilize the barrier for me! As for him, leave him to the two of us."
Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin locked their sights on Qin Jiaqing, one in front and one behind. At this moment, Qin Jiaqing also transformed rapidly, changing from an old man in his fifties or sixties into a two-meter-tall Demon Clan warrior, covered in exoskeleton armor.
Seeing this Demon took Wang Lan by surprise.
Wang Lan had always thought that Demons looked like Biochemical Demon Soldiers with disgusting, wide-open maws and densely packed sharp teeth.
But the one before him seemed more like an action figure from an anime.
Its face had two large yellow eyes, like an insect’s compound eyes, with no visible nose or mouth. A pale blue, jewel-like lamp was embedded in its chest. The full-body armor was segmented very logically, as if custom-designed.
The figure was slender, its muscle lines well-defined, not at all like the bloated and disgusting form of Chang Shuangyue after demonization.
"Suzhou City’s Tianjian Bureau, Wang Qianfeng, Li Weixin. I didn’t expect you to hold me in such high regard, letting the heads of the Intelligence Department and the Action Department join forces to catch me."
"Enough talk. You must be somewhat seasoned among the Demon Clan spies, judging by your appearance. You are a high-ranking Demon. If you are determined to serve the Demon Clan, I’ll give you a chance to end things yourself.
"If not, I suggest you surrender. You know, you don’t have a chance to escape."
"But I can kill you—"
As the words fell, the Demon’s figure vanished in an instant, reappearing before Wang Qianfeng. With a swipe of its claw, Wang Qianfeng was instantly torn into several pieces.
This sight changed Wang Lan’s expression drastically. But instantly, Wang Lan’s face relaxed again. Wang Qianfeng’s form dissipated into a breeze before reappearing behind the opponent, pressing a rapidly spinning wind blade saw against the Demon’s back.
CRACK—
The Demon moved incredibly fast, responding in an instant, blades springing from its arms to slash at Wang Qianfeng behind it.
CRACK—
Despite the faint sound, infinite whirlwinds, carrying the water spray within the barrier, instantly shrouded the entire area within the barrier in thick fog.
Wang Lan and the others outside could no longer see the battle inside clearly. But deep, piercing reverberations from the battle echoed from within. Although invisible, one could feel the ferocity of the fight.
People in the residential complex were being rapidly dispersed. Despite his concern, Wang Lan was of no help.
He was brought along merely to collect credit. If two Galaxy Stage masters from the Tianjian Bureau couldn’t handle their opponent, that would have truly been a disgrace.
"Damn, the barrier’s about to collapse! Brothers, come over and lend a hand!" shouted someone maintaining the barrier.
"Coming!" Another dozen or so Tianjian Bureau members who had been evacuating the crowd joined to support the barrier.
Wang Lan wanted to help too, but he simply didn’t know how.
BOOM—
An intense explosion suddenly erupted, shattering glass on several nearby high-rise buildings. Some of the evacuating civilians collapsed on the spot, terrified by the blast.
"Quickly retreat! Don’t just lie there, get up and evacuate—"
BOOM—
Suddenly an even more terrifying explosion sounded. A dreadful pressure struck their hearts. Billowing waves of water swept out in all directions, and the barrier maintained by thirty Tianjian Bureau masters shattered violently amidst the battle.
A shadow turned into a streak of light, shooting off into the distance, with two figures instantly chasing after it like beams of light.
"Shit—" a comrade, who was swept away by the shockwaves and landed next to Wang Lan, cursed as he picked himself up again. "Even a barrier of this intensity couldn’t hold! The power must be at least at the Star Sea Stage, right?"
Wang Lan hesitated for a moment before also quickly following suit.
Although his strength was only at the Star Shine Stage, with the Phoenix form activated, he was definitely a Galaxy Stage expert.
The skill points stored in the Phoenix form had also reached a thousand; enough to support him for a couple of minutes.
Xinyi Garden was a large complex with 7,000 households, and evacuating such a massive complex wasn’t so easy. Although efforts to disperse the crowd were vigorous, many people still remained in their homes, reluctant to leave.
Therefore, the battle must not be allowed to escalate and had to end with a kill in the shortest time possible. As for capturing him alive, Wang Qianfeng and the others had given up on that thought.
By the time Wang Lan reached Wang Qianfeng’s side, both Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin were standing by a building in the complex. On the ground by them lay a Demon Clan corpse, split in half.
"Is he dead?"
"This is his shell. He has escaped."
"He must be hiding nearby. He is badly wounded and couldn’t have escaped under our watch," Li Weixin said somberly.
Wang Lan scanned the surroundings and suddenly noticed a few dark spots on the exterior wall of a nearby residential building.
"Director Wang, look, could those be bloodstains?"
"On the twenty-fifth floor! Up!" As soon as his words fell, Wang Qianfeng charged straight up the residential building, running up the vertical facade.
Wang Lan wanted to follow, but he realized he had yet to learn this skill.
With no other choice, he rushed into the building. Inside the elevator and the stairwell, people were intermittently rushing out in panic.
It took Wang Lan three minutes to reach the twenty-fifth floor via the elevator.
As soon as he stepped out of the elevator, the sounds of intense combat came from inside one of the apartments. Wang Lan burst in, ready to activate his Phoenix form to help, when a dark shadow rushed out the window and vanished into the night.
"You think you can run—"
With a fierce shout, Wang Qianfeng turned into a gust of wind and pursued the shadow out of the window. Wang Lan didn’t even have time to activate his Phoenix form before Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin had already given chase.
"Quick, over here—" The voices of his Tianjian Bureau comrades sounded in his ears.
Only then did Wang Lan notice the two bodies lying in the apartment. A man and a woman, both around thirty.
They might have been preparing to dine—the woman was carrying a dish from the kitchen when a Demon struck her in the chest, gouging out her heart. The man, panicking, ran towards his right, likely for the bedroom, but the Demon attacked him from behind, gouging out his heart as well.
The thick scent of blood assaulted everyone’s nostrils, and their eyes reddened at the sight.
"Where’s the Demon?"
"He escaped through the window. Director Wang and Director Li have chased after him. I saw Director Wang hit the Demon again just now; he probably won’t get far."
"Damn Demon! What should we do?" The dozen or so people around all stared intently at Wang Lan.
"Uh? You’re asking me? I’m new here."
"But you’re in white clothes. We’re all in green clothes. Of course, we’ll follow your lead."
"We... let’s stay here and wait for orders then."
"Who’s there?" Suddenly, a Star Martial Warrior tensely fixed his gaze on a room inside the apartment and shouted aggressively.
BANG—
After kicking the door open and rushing into the room, they found a girl around ten years old fearfully hiding in the corner, staring at them in terror.
"Who are you... why are you in my house... where are my mom and dad..."
"Are you alone in the room?" Wang Lan asked, puzzled as he entered the room.
"I had a fever... I’ve been sleeping all afternoon. Who are you? Why are you in my house?"
"Don’t be afraid, little one. We’re police officers. A bad person came into the complex just now, and we’re here to help you," one of the warriors said gently, walking in and tenderly taking the girl’s hand.
Perhaps the military uniforms gave the girl a sense of trust. She looked up and asked, "Uncle Soldier, where are my mom and dad?"
"Your parents are hurt. They’ve just been taken to the hospital for treatment."
But in the living room outside, her parents already lay cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: No Matter How Cunning You Are, You Can’t Escape the Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 106: No Matter How Cunning You Are, You Can’t Escape the Law
The warriors stood in a line like a wall, escorting the little girl out of her home. At this moment, the entire building’s population had already been evacuated. The elevator was surprisingly empty.
Wang Lan and the others took the elevator, accompanying the little girl downstairs. The girl’s eyes were bright, yet she stood silently in the elevator.
How could a child of her age, who hadn’t yet outgrown her childish temperament, be so quiet?
Suddenly, a sharp light flashed in Wang Lan’s eyes.
His mind replayed the scene he had witnessed upon entering: Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin chasing the Demon out of the window, and the two corpses that had appeared in the living room.
But there were three sets of bowls and chopsticks on the dining table. One of the bowls, with a cute design, was obviously meant for a child. If that was the case, the story of the little girl being sick and sleeping all afternoon deserved further scrutiny. Even if... the young couple had planned to call the little girl to eat after the meal was ready. But the position of the young couple’s bodies was problematic. The kitchen was on the left side of the living room. If the young woman was carrying dishes from the kitchen and the Demon killed her from the front, then the Demon’s position should have been between the woman and the man. With a Demon between them, how could the young woman have been killed without any reaction, her heart extracted? And then the man turned and ran towards the opposite direction, only to have his heart taken from behind. By calculation, the Demon’s position would have been exactly where the girl’s bowl and chopsticks were placed.
After considering this hypothesis, Wang Lan’s mind became extremely active. The previously overlooked details resurfaced in his mind.
The open window on the 25th floor—that was the little girl’s room, wasn’t it? If you were sleeping in there earlier, wouldn’t you know when the Demon Clan broke in? Would you still be alive? Even if the Demon Clan deemed you unworthy to kill, Director Wang had chased in from outside. He had no reason to miss seeing you, a living person. And with such commotion, you had no reason not to hear. From the room to the living room, one would have to open the door. But when we found the little girl earlier, her door was locked from the inside. With everything that has happened, could there be any other possibility?
At this thought, Wang Lan’s heart started beating violently.
Cicada Sloughing Its Shell!
DING—
The elevator doors opened.
"Little sister, come with us. Big brother will hold your hand," Wang Lan said softly.
"Hmm—" Wang Lan held the little girl’s hand, slowly leaving the residential building. In the neighborhood, many Tianjian Bureau warriors were scattered about, evacuating the residents.
Once they reached an open area, Wang Lan suddenly gave the order, "Assemble—"
The warriors of the Tianjian Bureau nearby immediately gathered around upon hearing the command.
"Can we still set up a barrier?"
Wang Lan’s question was so sudden that the warriors were momentarily confused. But after only a moment, they all nodded.
"We can. Setting up an isolation barrier is an essential skill for us."
"Set up a barrier around us."
"What?"
"This is an order!"
"Big brother, aren’t we going to see Mom and Dad? Why are we not leaving?"
"I’ll take you to see your mom and dad, but I won’t be going with you," Wang Lan said, retreating abruptly and creating a three-meter distance between himself and the little girl.
At this moment, the barrier was successfully erected. Although they did not understand why Wang Lan had issued such an order, carrying out orders had almost become an instinct for them, so there was little hesitation.
"Big brother, I don’t understand what you’re saying... I want my mom and dad... Are you guys... do you not know where my mom and dad are? Are you the bad guys?"
The Tianjian Bureau members who had raised the barrier understood Wang Lan’s intention.
But... are you sure you’re not joking? This little girl is a spy for the Demon Clan? Didn’t the Demon Clan spy already escape? Didn’t Director Wang and Director Li go after him? Is our intelligence failing to keep up, or is the plot progressing too fast?
"We saw some bloodstains on the wall of the residential building downstairs, and only the window on the 25th floor was open. That’s why Director Wang went to the 25th floor to pursue the murderer," Wang Lan explained.
"But the open window I saw just now—that belongs to your room, right? If, as you said, you were sick in your room and sleeping, would you still be alive? Would the Demon pass through your room and be kind enough to lock your door for you? Your mother was attacked in the chest, your father from behind. There’s only one possibility for this kind of wound—the killer was between your parents. And that attacking position just happened to be where your bowl and chopsticks were placed. This means you were sitting at the table at that time. You suddenly attacked and killed your mother, then your father. After that, you hid. When Director Wang and Director Li were lured away by the Demon’s decoy, you quietly returned to your room, pretending to have just woken up. At that time, I hadn’t considered all of this. But after calming down in the elevator, your behavior was full of holes. You were using the Cicada Sloughing Its Shell strategy. Actually, you’ve been a Demon for a long time. Aren’t you and Qin Jiaqing the same person?"
"No, even so, why would she and Qin Jiaqing be the same person rather than two separate Demons?" one of the warriors asked.
"If there were two Demons, why would Qin Jiaqing go to her house?" Wang Lan replied. "I think Qin Jiaqing went to her house to switch with her. One as the main, the other as the alternate."
After listening to Wang Lan’s explanation, the faces of those who had set up the barrier finally showed understanding. They looked at Wang Lan with admiration.
This person, called a "Lucky Carp" by the intelligence department, was rumored to be extraordinary. It made everyone believe that Wang Lan truly had amazing luck to have achieved so much in such a short time. This discovery of the entire Demon Clan spy group was also considered by many to be a stroke of luck. But at this moment, they finally understood. Luck isn’t just luck; without strength, one can’t grasp an opportunity even if it’s right before their eyes. If Wang Lan hadn’t noticed the details, the Demon Clan spy leader might have slipped away right under their noses.
Admiration. It was the only emotion they could feel.
"HEH HEH HEH..." The little girl suddenly let out a deep, throaty laugh.
"You, human, are different from the others... If I’m not mistaken, you must be Wang Lan, the one who’s messed up our plans multiple times. Good, I’ve remembered you."
"It’s no use remembering me!" Wang Lan retorted. "At this point, the bait you’ve thrown out must have reached its limit, right?"
"You’re clever but at the same time so foolish... Do you really think that you and your bunch of good-for-nothings can stop me? From the moment Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin fell for my Cicada Sloughing Its Shell strategy, you’ve already lost."
「At the same time, in the green belt under the overpass in the suburbs of Suzhou City, Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin had already blocked the escaping Demon from both sides.」
Locked within their Star Power, the Demon’s aura was completely restrained; at this point, whether it fled or not, the outcome would be the same.
"Wind Ling Cliff—"
"Water Vortex Strangling—"
Suddenly, Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin launched their lethal Star Martial Skills simultaneously. With its aura locked down, the Demon revealed a smile of relief. Then it was washed over by two waves of Star Martial Skills, the onslaught lasting a full thirty seconds before it stopped.
Wang Qianfeng approached the corpse; the Demon’s remains were completely obliterated.
"Let’s go back! We won’t be able to take any prisoners alive," Li Weixin sighed, speaking indifferently.
"Something’s not right. Why is there only one hand?" Wang Qianfeng muttered.
"The other half must have been obliterated..." Suddenly, Li Weixin’s face also turned pale, as he realized there was an issue.
Even if the body was torn to pieces, this seemed too convenient, didn’t it? Just one hand, and just one foot. Although the body was blasted apart, wasn’t it too coincidental which parts were missing?
"Damn it, we’ve been had! Cicada Sloughing Its Shell!"
"Retreat!"
「On the other side, the little girl completed her transformation in an instant, her two-meter-tall body emitting intense energy fluctuations. Imprisoned with the Demon in the barrier, Wang Lan looked like an insect that could be squashed at any moment.」
"Lieutenant Wang, let us help you."
"No need! You all just stabilize the barrier!" As his words landed, a Phoenix Tail Flower pattern suddenly lit up between Wang Lan’s eyebrows. "The avatar you split off to create a convincing deception must have cost you a great deal, right? Your current strength must have dropped below the Galaxy Stage. And yet, you dare claim victory."
No sooner had his words landed than Wang Lan’s figure instantly appeared in front of the Demon. He threw a punch, and a surge of flames instantly ignited upon his fist.
BOOM—The source of this content ɪs novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
His punch hit the chest straight on. Wang Lan’s fist, like a sharp spear, effortlessly broke into the Demon’s chest. His entire arm entered its torso and then exploded out the back.
The Demon’s originally red compound eyes flashed rapidly like stoplights.
The punch was too fast, faster than I could have imagined. Before, Wang Lan hadn’t shown this level of power! Before, only Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin were a threat to me! Before... he’s not supposed to play possum like this!
The Demon roared frantically inside, but the roar couldn’t change its fate.
If I hadn’t split half my body to create the decoy, I might have had a chance to dodge Wang Lan’s punch! But at this moment, my body is so weakened that I’ve dropped a cultivation stage. I can see Wang Lan’s fist coming, and I know how to dodge, but my body just can’t comply!
The Demon’s body might have been slow, but Wang Lan’s actions were anything but.
As his right fist inflicted heavy damage on the Demon, his left hand swung a purple Flame Sword down from the sky.
The Demon’s body was cleanly sliced in half by the sharp Flame Sword, its top half sliding off at a 45-degree angle.
"At such a young age... to have such strength... you will be a great threat to our Divine Clan... Let’s die together!"
Suddenly, a terrifying wave of Spiritual Power emerged from within the Demon’s head.
It’s trying to self-destruct!
The terrifying sense of crisis, instead of slowing Wang Lan down, instantly prompted him to take countermeasures.
He hammered down a punch, deploying the technique of Three Strengths in a Fist, targeting the head on the ground.
BOOM—
A shockwave swept outward from Wang Lan’s fist; wherever it spread, the earth cracked and splintered.
BOOM—
The ground collapsed, creating a shallow pit five meters in diameter before the onlookers. The ground swept by the shockwave showed severe signs of carbonization and charring.
If not for the barrier’s protection, who knows how far the shockwave might have spread?
As dust rose, the Demon’s head beneath Wang Lan’s fist had vanished. In his hand, a chicken-egg-sized Soul Bead shimmered with light before it quieted down.
"For defeating an opponent above your level, you are awarded 1,000 experience points and 50 skill points. For completing the mission to eliminate the Demon Clan spy group, you are awarded 50,000 experience points and 500 skill points."
As 50,000 experience points dropped at once, Wang Lan’s experience bar exploded to full as though with added special effects, his body flashing momentarily with a Star Energy Fluctuation.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Did I Just Break Through?
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 107: Did I Just Break Through?
Upon receiving Wang Qianfeng’s urgent order, Xu Shiyun hurriedly led his men to Xinyi Garden in a desperate rush.
Just as they burst through the entrance of the community, they felt a clear surge of Star Energy Fluctuation.
Xu Shiyun squeezed through the crowd. Members of the Tianjian Bureau had formed a circle, staring blankly at Wang Lan, who stood ramrod straight, gazing slightly upward at the sky with an air of lonely invincibility.
Spiritual Power transformed into a swirling vortex of wind, slowly rotating around Wang Lan.
Beneath his feet lay the corpse of a half-Demon—the kind missing its head.
"Xu Shiyun, what’s the situation? Did it get away?" Zeng Xiaomo’s figure flashed, instantly appearing beside Xu Shiyun.
"Don’t ask me, I don’t know... I just got here and saw this monster breaking through... Breaking through mid-combat? Damn it... Is this some kind of novel?"
Xu Shiyun was doubting his very existence.
He knew Wang Lan was an absolute monster, having once made a breakthrough publicly after a Star Martial Art competition. But what was the explanation back then? Oh right, he got thrilled, excited, and just broke through.
But now...
You’re telling me you just went through a battle, right?
Isn’t the precondition for a Star Power breakthrough that your Star Power must surge past its limits, shattering the original shackles? Doesn’t combat consume Star Power? And you still managed to make it surge?
Everyone present had experienced breakthroughs, so that in itself wasn’t particularly impressive. What truly left them all gaping in astonishment was that Wang Lan had *just* finished a battle—and an incredibly exhausting one at that.
And you’re telling me your Star Power surged, breaking through the shackles to achieve this?
Even a monster doesn’t operate like this!
But Wang Lan had indeed broken through, even if the progress wasn’t overtly obvious—just a slight improvement.
Completing a mission and advancing directly from Star Shine Stage Four to Star Shine Stage Five—now *that’s* the proper way to complete a mission!
The surge of upgraded Star Power completely flushed away the lingering after-effects of the Phoenix Form he had just used. After more than a minute of using the Phoenix Form, Wang Lan’s body immediately returned to its peak condition.
So... the after-effects of the Phoenix Form can be negated this way? I’ve learned something new.
"Refreshing—" Wang Lan exclaimed, gazing up at the sky.
"Refreshing my ass!" Xu Shiyun couldn’t hold back any longer and lashed out with a kick. "What the hell happened here? What’s going on?"
"This is the true form of the Demon Clan spy group leader. He managed to deceive Director Wang and Director Li earlier using the ’Cicada Sloughing Its Shell’ tactic. Unfortunately for him, he was a bit foolish and exposed a major flaw, which allowed me to see through his ruse. Then I executed him on the spot, right here."
"Hmm... If he’s considered ’a bit foolish,’ does that make me exceptionally stupid for falling for his trick?" Wang Qianfeng’s voice suddenly cut in as he appeared before Wang Lan amidst the swirling winds.
"Not at all, Director Wang. It was due to the urgency of the situation that some details were overlooked. If you’d had a chance to calm down, this Demon’s tricks wouldn’t have escaped your notice."
"Go back and write me a report," Wang Qianfeng, in no mood for banter with Wang Lan, turned to Xu Shiyun. "How are the arrests of the other spies going?"
"None got away, but..."
"No survivors? Are they all that resolute?" Wang Qianfeng’s expression grew grim.
If the Demon Clan members were all this resolute, they would be incredibly tough to fight. Warriors so tough and brave, undaunted by death, that they would kill themselves upon exposure... Dealing with such enemies, the pressure is immense.
"Not exactly. There seems to be some sort of restriction implanted in their minds. It triggers and detonates their heads if they even think of surrendering or divulging information."
"How vicious!" Wang Qianfeng’s eyes darkened.
"Notify the police department to handle the cleanup. We’re heading back."
"Yes, sir!"
Wang Lan obediently returned to the Tianjian Bureau headquarters and began writing his report in Wang Qianfeng’s office, while Wang Qianfeng himself left to attend a meeting.
"Although this operation was hampered because the decoding team inadvertently tipped off the enemy, preventing us from expanding our success further, overall, it met expectations. I notified the Jin City headquarters immediately after receiving your call about the successful operation. Director Zhang was overjoyed, exclaiming ’Good!’ three times, and decided to drive to the Imperial Capital tonight to report to the main headquarters personally. You’ve all done well."
Hearing the positive keynote set by Lu Zhao, smiles immediately bloomed on the faces of the various department heads.
As long as it’s considered a meritorious achievement, that’s what matters. If headquarters decided to make an issue of us tipping off the enemy, it would have been troublesome.
"Director, although this roundup was a great success, an internal review is still necessary," He MingXue stated calmly. "The decoding team’s carelessness alerted the Demon Clan spies and prevented us from expanding our success. Even if there’s no punishment, they should be required to write a self-critique report."
Wang Qianfeng glanced discreetly at He MingXue.
He’s from the Law Enforcement Department, in charge of internal discipline, so his comment isn’t out of place. But... it’s not really the decoding team’s fault.
It’s just that the Demon Clan spies were too crafty, even setting a decoy password on top of the real one. Nothing like this had ever happened before.
"Furthermore," He MingXue continued, his face flushing slightly with excitement, "although the Demon Clan spy group was entirely annihilated, our subsequent leads haven’t been completely cut off. I truly didn’t expect that Wang Lan from the Intelligence Department would not only capture an elite group but also decipher the correct password. We can confirm that Suzhou City likely harbors many such groups, not just this one. They are executing an ’Ant-Hill Plan,’ and the key to this Ant-Hill Plan is the Magical Martial Artist. A type of elixir is what causes Star Martial Warriors to undergo Demonization. Although the clues are scarce, they are worth investigating."
"The task of investigating this will remain with the Intelligence Department. Feng," Lu Zhao addressed Wang Qianfeng, "although your department secured the primary credit and won a significant victory this time, do not become arrogant or complacent. The battle continues, and I await further achievements from you all. Wei Xin, report this operation’s casualties."
"Reporting to the Director, one hundred and fifty of our operatives participated in the arrests. Among them, seven were injured, and one was killed in action. Additionally, five innocent civilians were maliciously attacked and killed by Demons."
"The compensation for the operative killed in action must be delivered to his family within three days, and ongoing support must be provided. The injured operatives are to take a seven-day leave to recover fully. As for what commendations will come from higher up, we’ll only know after Director Zhang returns from the Imperial Capital. You all discuss how to distribute the credit for this operation."
"This..." Upon hearing this, everyone hesitated.
The allocation of credit seemed clear; who had contributed more and who less was obvious. There should have been no cause for hesitation.
"Director, distributing the credit for the others is straightforward enough! But there’s one person whose contribution is... problematic to assess," Wang Qianfeng said with a wry smile.
"Oh? Who might that be?"
"Wang Lan!"
"If his contributions are so obvious, what’s the difficulty?" Lu Zhao’s brows furrowed in puzzlement.
"If we were to allocate credit based on normal procedure, he would undoubtedly receive the lion’s share; it wouldn’t be an issue even if he alone accounted for seventy percent of the credit. However, he’s only sixteen years old—he’ll only turn seventeen after the New Year. Furthermore, he was promoted to lieutenant only a few days ago. If we report him for the highest credit, a promotion from above is almost certain. He’s still young; his character isn’t yet fully formed and needs tempering."Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Wang Qianfeng’s concerns were valid. Wang Lan’s path shouldn’t be too smooth. He had high hopes for Wang Lan, envisioning him not just as an outstanding warrior, but as a future great leader—perhaps even a spiritual one. The growth of an outstanding warrior is inseparable from trials and setbacks. Yet, has Wang Lan encountered any real setbacks since his awakening as a Star Martial Warrior?
Forget setbacks—his Cultivation Level has soared at an alarming rate, and his talent is so high it’s infuriatingly enviable. On top of that, his luck and intelligence are enough to make anyone jealous. He casually visits a trial area and discovers a Demon Clan base that the stationed Star Martial Army had been searching for for half a year. He takes on a random mission and uncovers a hidden Demon Clan base. This time, he merely chats with someone and, damn it all, uncovers critical clues that lead to the neutralization of an entire Demon Clan spy group! Can you attribute it all to luck? Not entirely. The clues were right there; others missed them, but he saw them.
Having Wang Lan on their side was a stroke of immense fortune for Wang Qianfeng. But at the same time, he was deeply worried about the boy. Wang Lan is just a teenager. If he, Wang Qianfeng, had achieved so many significant accomplishments at Wang Lan’s age, in just a couple of months, he shudders to think how it might have affected him—he’d likely be insufferably arrogant. As someone with experience, Wang Qianfeng understood one thing profoundly: one must never get carried away by success. Once pride takes root, danger inevitably follows. Wang Qianfeng genuinely liked Wang Lan, but he felt it was necessary to rein him in a bit, to keep him grounded.
But Lu Zhao did not see it that way.
After contemplating for a long moment, Lu Zhao lifted his head. "How does Wang Lan compare to Wang Ling?"
The moment he spoke, both Wang Qianfeng and He MingXue were startled. It had been a long time since they had heard the name Wang Ling, and its mention left them momentarily dazed.
"Compare him to the Flame Emperor? Is such a comparison even possible?" He MingXue laughed.
In their hearts, the Flame Emperor was held in such high esteem, almost mythical in status. There was no comparison, absolutely none.
"Is that so? Wang Ling’s true ascent didn’t begin in middle school, did it? Back then, she was merely among the top students in her grade, not conspicuously above everyone else."
"How can that be the same?" He MingXue countered. "The Flame Emperor came from an ordinary family. She didn’t have Soul Beads to enhance her Star Power, yet managing to keep pace with those geniuses through sheer effort alone was already an incredible feat. It was only after being discovered by Eld Di that the Flame Emperor truly began her meteoric rise, ascending to the pinnacle of Star Martial Warriors at a speed almost unimaginable to ordinary people."
"Ah, you," Lu Zhao said, "perhaps because you see Wang Lan regularly, you overlook just how extraordinary he is. Can Wang Lan truly not be compared with Wang Ling? Wang Lan hasn’t benefited from any special consideration due to Wang Ling’s influence. He earned all his Soul Beads himself in the trial areas, and the Star Martial Skills you provided, he mastered on his own. This year, Wang Lan turned sixteen. Today, less than half a year since awakening his talents as a Star Martial Warrior, he has already mastered the rudimentary application of the Phoenix Form, the advanced use of the Star Cloud Sword Dance and the Flame Sword, and he can switch between Star Martial Skills perfectly, with no discernible delay. He is already a mid-stage expert of the Star Shine Stage. He achieved all this progress in just half a year. Even when Wang Ling was rapidly advancing under Eld Di’s tutelage, her pace might not have been faster than Wang Lan’s is now."
"Back then, many also questioned Wang Ling’s rapid growth, suggesting it might not be beneficial and that she needed to experience some setbacks. But what did those setbacks ultimately become? Mere stepping stones in Wang Ling’s legendary ascent."
"Indeed, young people should experience hardships; only those who can withstand setbacks can truly succeed. But that applies to mere mortals! For someone like Wang Lan, such deliberate trials are unnecessary. If he has the capacity, why worry about praising him too highly? Are you afraid he’ll fall to his death if we elevate him too much? I believe those destined to fall will fall regardless, while those who are not meant to fall will survive, no matter how high they are lifted. Report his contributions fairly. How he is rewarded is a matter for headquarters to decide. If we withhold the recognition he deserves, it will only lead to his disillusionment."
While Wang Qianfeng agreed with some of Lu Zhao’s points, he also had his reservations. However, since Lu Zhao had spoken, Wang Qianfeng naturally proceeded to make the arrangements as discussed.

chapters.title: Chapter 108 Fallen?
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 108 Fallen?
After working at the Heavenly Sword Bureau until late into the night, Wang Lan was relieved that the next day was Sunday, so he didn’t have to worry about dozing off in class.
By the end of the weekend, the case at the Heavenly Sword Bureau was essentially closed.
Wang Lan composed himself once more, returning to the monotonous yet fulfilling rhythm of his end-of-term sprint in studies.
"Sigh... Such a nice girl, how did she end up like this?"
At noon, on the rooftop, Xu Xiangwen suddenly blurted out without any preamble.
"Who are you talking about?" Wang Lan carefully flipped the steak in front of him, brushing it with olive oil.
"Who else? Our Class Monitor Xie, of course. In just this short month, Class Monitor Xie has undergone a complete transformation. How come we never noticed before that she was actually this beautiful?"
"What exactly do you mean?" Wang Lan asked, puzzled. "Does becoming more beautiful have anything to do with a downfall?"ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
"Of course, it does! Before, Class Monitor Xie just had an innocent look. But recently, with a little makeup and dressing up, her looks have skyrocketed, easily rivaling the top four campus beauties. I was even mulling over whether to pursue a sweet, innocent first love before graduation, but today I heard that Class Monitor Xie is being kept by someone."
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH..." Wang Lan choked on smoke upon hearing this. "Cut the crap, will you? Xie Sisi is a Star Martial Warrior. Being kept by someone?"
"So what if she’s a Star Martial Warrior? Can’t Star Martial Warriors be materialistic? I wasn’t suspicious at first either. But today, I overheard two female classmates discussing it, and then I took a look. The clothes Class Monitor Xie is wearing are new arrivals from major department stores, probably costing between five hundred to a thousand."
"Five hundred to a thousand would only buy that pair of socks you’re wearing, right?"
"Nonsense, my socks only cost a hundred, okay?"
"That ’only’ was well used. My entire outfit probably wouldn’t even cover the cost of two pairs of your socks."
"You’re not like us; we’re on completely different levels. But given Xie Sisi’s family situation, how could she possibly afford clothes over five hundred? She’s dressed plainly for the past two years. For her to suddenly upgrade her wardrobe by several tiers, there must be something going on. There’s a saying: ’Men turn bad when they get money, and women get money when they turn bad.’ What else could it be besides being kept? I just don’t know how far things have gone..."
"I can’t take it anymore!" Gong Feiyu suddenly exclaimed, sitting up. "It’s one thing for women to gossip, but Xu, why are you so gossipy too? What does it matter to you whether she’s changed for the better or worse?"
"Don’t you feel it’s a bit of a pity?"
"Sorry, I’m devoid of such feelings."
"I think... Xu might actually have a crush on Class Monitor Xie," Wang Lan said as he slowly removed the perfectly grilled steak, admiring his handiwork.
"How could that be... Someone from my family background, they’d never agree to me being with someone like... Class Monitor Xie..." He trailed off, then suddenly stopped.
"Just as I thought! Wang Lan, you’re a sharp one, easily tricking this beast into revealing his thoughts. You’ve already considered marrying her, and you still say you have no feelings for her? Have you even picked out names for your future children?"
"I was just stating a fact to prove a point! Besides, after hearing that discussion today, I’ve lost all such ideas."
"Xu, let me offer a theory. It might sting a bit."
"What is it?"
"How do you know for sure she’s being kept? Xie Sisi is a Star Martial Warrior, after all, and she’s not lacking in qualities. There’s no need for her to go down that path. It’s like, a naturally beautiful girl would have to be foolish to become an escort when she could be a model or a star, right? Even if someone is paying for Xie Sisi’s expenses, the most likely scenario is that she’s found a young, wealthy boyfriend. This person might not even be ordinary; perhaps he’s a rich, second-generation Star Martial Warrior, just like you. Thinking about it this way, don’t you feel a heart-wrenching, suffocating pain?"
Xu Xiangwen stared at Wang Lan with wide eyes. The more he thought about it, the more sense it made.
Why assume the worst, most extreme scenario? It’s true that unusual events often indicate something amiss, but it might not be the unacceptable kind of ’amiss.’ If he put himself in her shoes, this seemed like the most plausible explanation. Xie Sisi is a very strong-willed and self-disciplined person. How could she be kept by some balding old man, as the gossip suggested? It’s far more likely she met a young, wealthy Prince Charming.
"Ah, such a beauty, right before our eyes every day, yet some people turn a blind eye. But this world never lacks eyes that can appreciate beauty. Perhaps some guy—not as handsome as Young Master Xu, not as talented, from a family not as wealthy, maybe even with a worse character than Young Master Xu—has snatched this most adorable little ’pet’ away right from under Young Master Xu’s nose..."
Wang Lan sighed leisurely. By now, Xu Xiangwen’s face was as dark as the bottom of a pot.
"Wang Lan, are you a devil? Is this just ’stinging a bit’? This is like ripping Xu’s heart out, sprinkling it with salt and cumin, and then grilling it over charcoal!"
"Wait a minute..." Suddenly, clarity returned to Xu Xiangwen’s eyes. "
I was almost led astray by Lanzi. What relationship do I even have with Xie Sisi? What does it matter to me if some rich young guy has won her over?
"
"Who was it just now saying it was a ’pity’?"
"I was just saying! Besides, am I, Xu Xiangwen, the playboy type? Would I mess with a woman I can’t make any promises to? Hmph..."
"That’s true..."
Wang Lan did believe Xu Xiangwen on this point.
Everyone has principles they adhere to, and Wang Lan’s group of four was no exception. Although Xu Xiangwen had the flaws of a narcissistic, showy, second-generation rich kid who sometimes threw money around, he surprisingly held a pure and beautiful expectation for love.
It was almost a miracle that, in current society, a rich kid like him still believed in pure love. This was likely related to Xu Xiangwen’s family; at least his parents genuinely shared a purely romantic love. Xu Xiangwen had mentioned more than once that his parents’ love story was as romantic and beautiful as a poem. Consequently, he rejected all women who approached him with ulterior motives and had never impulsively made a mistake.
Gossiping about a female classmate didn’t last long for Wang Lan and his friends. The topic soon shifted to preparations for hunting Exotic Beasts in the intermediate trial grounds during the upcoming winter break.
The intermediate trial grounds were actually just a bit larger than the primary ones, with more ferocious Exotic Beasts. However, the ordinary Exotic Beasts there weren’t necessarily stronger than those in the primary trial grounds. The intermediate trial grounds housed mutated Exotic Beasts of the Star Cloud Stage, and a few tribal leaders of Exotic Beasts might even possess Galaxy Stage strength.
With Jiang Xinyu, a Star Cloud Stage cultivator, leading the way, and Wang Lan, a hidden Demon King, providing protection, their trip to the intermediate trial grounds was virtually risk-free. The four of them were even considering something most people wouldn’t dare to imagine: wiping out one or two Exotic Beast tribes.
「」
Classes ended at the usual five o’clock, after which Wang Lan trained in the Training Room for three hours, drenched in sweat.
"BRRRING—" His cellphone rang beside him.
"Hello!"
"Mr. Wang Lan, this is a delivery person from Mallon Mall. The fresh groceries you ordered have been packed and are ready for dispatch. Are you home now? Is it convenient for us to deliver?"
"Convenient! I’m home. Please call me again when you arrive."
"Alright."
Always ordering takeout... honestly, Wang Lan was tired of it. Plus, his recent lunchtime barbecues at school had drastically improved his cooking skills. A sentiment of self-sufficiency had begun to stir within him. Perhaps, after he tired of his own cooking, he would fall in love with takeout again. People are just that fickle.
So, yesterday, Wang Lan had placed a massive order for fresh ingredients from Mallon Mall: beef, lamb, pork, fish, shrimp, and crab—he got everything. The final bill came to a staggering twenty thousand Yuan. However, this amount was pocket change for Wang Lan, so he didn’t bother to alter the order. Today, the mall was delivering, which led to the earlier call.
"WEE-OO WEE-OO—"
The piercing wail of sirens tore through the air as seven or eight police cars sped past the main road outside.
Since Wang Lan’s Training Room was in the second-level basement parking garage, he couldn’t see what was happening outside.
This was already the second time this year. The last time sirens blared like this, Wang Lan encountered a Magical Martial Artist. Could there be another incident this time?
Wang Lan hesitated.
Should I follow? But the delivery from Mallon Mall is due soon. Never mind, I can’t keep stumbling upon such events. Perhaps it’s just an arrest of a common criminal.
After all, in a densely populated metropolis like Suzhou City, the crime rate among ordinary people was far higher than that among Star Martial Warriors.
「」
About forty minutes later, his phone rang again.
"Hello, Mr. Wang Lan, I’ve arrived at the entrance of Xinyu Building. Where should I unload the goods?"
"How big is the crate?"
"2.5 cubic meters."
"Just drive into the underground garage."
"External vehicles aren’t allowed in the Xinyu Building’s underground garage; we can’t get in."
"If I say you can get in, you can get in. Drive down to the second basement level."
"Alright!" The driver reluctantly hung up, started the vehicle, and slowly drove towards the entrance gate of the underground garage.
I’ve been to Xinyu Building before; their underground garage only allows entry to vehicles with registered license plates. You say I can get in, so I can just get in? Do you think Xinyu Building belongs to you?
"BEEP—"
As he approached, the license plate recognition system approved his vehicle, and the barrier instantly lifted.
"This..."
The driver was dumbfounded but quickly shifted into gear and slowly drove into the underground garage, following the signs to the second level.
Upon reaching the bottom level, his eyes widened. Only four cars were parked on the B2 level, and all four were luxury vehicles whose makes he couldn’t even name. You could tell if a car was luxurious with just a glance. Although he couldn’t find emblems on any of the four cars, their magnificent designs alone screamed that they were absolutely top-tier luxury vehicles.
A young man in a tank top appeared before him. The young man gestured with his hand, and the pickup truck stopped.
"Are you Mr. Wang Lan?" the driver asked, hopping out of the car. His tone towards Wang Lan had become respectful.
Though Wang Lan looked ordinary, the fact that Xinyu Building granted him access meant he was an unimaginably wealthy young master.
It made sense; after all, who other than a tycoon would buy tens of thousands of Yuan worth of fresh ingredients at once?
"Yes!"
"Where should I unload the goods?"
"Right here is fine." Wang Lan glanced around the spacious, empty parking lot. It didn’t matter where. Robots would move it later anyway.
The driver opened the rear cargo bed, and a chill mist billowed out. He deftly dragged a wooden crate—one meter wide and two meters long—from the refrigerated compartment, sliding it down a ramp onto the ground.
"Mr. Wang Lan, would you like to inspect the goods?"
"Yes, let’s take a look."
The driver quickly undid the seals on the wooden crate and then pried open the wooden planks.
In an instant, both the driver and Wang Lan froze.
Inside the crate, along with the fresh produce Wang Lan had ordered, lay a young girl, curled up and asleep, dressed only in her underwear.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: The Unexpected Xie Sisi
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 109: The Unexpected Xie Sisi
The girl’s skin was as pale as cream, her black hair flowing like ink, covering her cheeks so her features were indiscernible.
But this sight did not strike the two as sensual; instead, a chill crept up their spines.
Wang Lan raised his head to look at the delivery man. "What’s this? Is this some new promotion from your store?"
"I... I don’t know... This... this, I checked it when I sealed the package... Could it be that some seafood has come to life? I’ll call the police... call the police!"
"Hold on a second!" Wang Lan reached out and placed his hand on the girl’s neck. He felt an icy touch but, thankfully, a clear pulse. This meant the girl was still alive...ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
Damn, to lie there almost naked on ice-covered seafood for so long, not only did she not freeze to death, but she still has such a strong pulse?
Wang Lan gently brushed the hair away from the girl’s cheek, revealing a beautiful profile before his eyes. In that instant, disbelief crossed Wang Lan’s face.
At that moment, the girl on the ice blocks suddenly opened her eyes.
BOOM—
A loud noise erupted, and the container of fresh seafood exploded.
A Water Sword instantly struck towards Wang Lan’s face.
Wang Lan’s figure blurred, leaving afterimages as he dodged the incoming Water Sword. Before he could steady himself, a whip-like leg, as white as jade, swept toward him.
Wang Lan swiftly blocked with his hands, catching the kick.
But the girl’s offensive didn’t stop. In a blink, her moves swept in like a peacock spreading its tail. Every single one of the girl’s techniques was a Basic Combat move, but they were incredibly sharp.
Even with all of Wang Lan’s silver later-stage Basic Combat strength, he felt like he was being oppressively overpowered, unable to catch his breath. With such martial prowess, wouldn’t she be top-notch even amongst professional Star Martial Warriors?
"I say, Monitor Xie, you’re quite the actress, aren’t you! In school, you seem so weak in combat, yet now you display such formidable strength. Just who are you, and are you here to assassinate me?"
"Monitor Xie? Are you..." Suddenly, the Xie Sisi before him halted, her eyes alternating between confusion and sharpness, as if shifting rapidly between two modes.
"Hmm?" Wang Lan’s eyes narrowed as a huge amount of fresh blood suddenly surged from Xie Sisi’s shoulder. Blood gushed out like a fountain.
"A gunshot wound? What is going on with you? If you don’t start talking, I won’t be so polite."
"Wang Lan... save me..."
No sooner had Xie Sisi spoken than her body softened and she collapsed. Wang Lan did not immediately rush to catch her, waiting until she had actually fallen to the ground and lost consciousness before he went up to check her injuries.
The bullet had struck her shoulder. Since she had been hiding in the freezer, the ice had numbed the wound, so it hadn’t bled much initially. However, the fight with Wang Lan had accelerated her blood flow, causing the wound to suddenly erupt with blood.
Given the amount of blood, Xie Sisi would not survive five minutes.
Obviously, the possibility that Xie Sisi had come to assassinate him could be ruled out. Would she come attacking with injuries? Therefore, there’s another explanation—Xie Sisi was being hunted.
Damn, could this be like something out of those movies? Our gentle and frail Monitor Xie appears to be a student of the Star Martial Class, but behind the scenes, she’s a member of some assassin organization?
But what do I do now? The bleeding’s not stopping, just like the proverbial flood of aunt Flo.
After a moment’s hesitation, Wang Lan still placed his hand over the wound on Xie Sisi’s shoulder.
As the Star Power surged, the pained furrow in Xie Sisi’s brows eased slightly.
The sound of a car horn starting up rang out. When Wang Lan looked up again, the delivery man had already jumped into the vehicle and started the engine.
"Hey, wait—"
Wait for nothing. That fight scared the hell out of me. The delivery man had only one thought—to get away. Who knew what terrible things he’d accidentally witnessed, and who knew if he’d be silenced for it?
Watching the truck speed away into the distance, Wang Lan swallowed his explanations, lodged deep in his throat.
Wang Lan lifted his hand; the bullet from Xie Sisi’s shoulder had been expelled during the healing process, and the wound had completely healed without even a scar.
But due to the severe blood loss, Xie Sisi remained unconscious.
Looking at Xie Sisi lying on the ground, Wang Lan felt his blood surging. Her figure, it was just too good. Having lived two lifetimes and currently at this age of burgeoning youth, this really could be the death of him.
In his mind, an iconic line surfaced unbidden, "My lord, she’s still warm!"
Bending down, he picked up Xie Sisi and headed for the elevator.
"Xiao Ai, clean up."
"Got it! Wang Lan, do you need me to call the police?"
"No need."
In Wang Lan’s room, as he rapidly worked on his laptop, a faint sound suddenly came from the bed. Wang Lan stopped and turned around, on guard, towards Xie Sisi.
Xie Sisi’s brows were tightly knit; then abruptly, she opened her eyes.
Then she quickly sat up to check her body.
Wang Lan couldn’t understand. She was only wearing lingerie; what was the point of her checking her body like that? But women seemed to have their own ways of discerning whether they’d been violated. Anyway, Xie Sisi’s expression relaxed after three seconds with a long exhale.
"Xie Sisi, you still haven’t explained things to me," Wang Lan said.
"Ah?" Xie Sisi only then realized that Wang Lan was in the room, looking over in a daze.
The series of actions Xie Sisi took upon waking up seemed too amateurish to Wang Lan. The previous suspicion that Xie Sisi was someone trained by an organization began to waver.
A professional warrior would first check their surroundings to ensure safety upon waking up, not check their own physical condition. But Xie Sisi behaved in the opposite way.
If she were trained professionally and still ended up like this, Wang Lan thought she shouldn’t have survived long enough to graduate.
"Wang Lan? You... why are you here? Wait, where am I?"
"This is my house."
"Your house? How did I get to your house?" Xie Sisi’s question made Wang Lan’s nerves twitch on the spot.
How did you get to my house... Don’t you have any idea?
"How you got to my house is something I still haven’t figured out, but shouldn’t you explain how you ended up with a gunshot wound?" As he said this, Wang Lan’s gaze sharpened.
He opened his palm, revealing a bullet lying quietly in the center.
"A 0.6 cm caliber self-loading pistol with an effective range of under fifty meters. Such pistols are generally police issue. Military standard pistols are 0.8 cm caliber. If it were some unofficial organization, they likely wouldn’t use such a small caliber firearm."
"I..." Hearing Wang Lan’s words, Xie Sisi’s face became frantic.
"I didn’t want this... I was drugged... When I was groggy, I felt someone undressing me... I woke up in shock and saw a man with a face like a pig.
"I... I instinctively used my Star Martial Skill to injure him... Then I jumped out the window and escaped. And then... someone pursued me. Then I heard police sirens chasing me too...
"My head was a mess, and I felt dizzy... I ran for my life, but the guard kept chasing me relentlessly. He told me to stop, but... I was too scared...
"For a Star Martial Warrior to attack ordinary people with Star Martial Skill, by law, they’re charged with intent to commit murder. If the victim doesn’t die, it’s attempted murder. Then... he fired his gun.
"I kept dodging, and then I took a bullet in my shoulder.
