"After that, I hid inside a warehouse in a shopping center. I heard someone inside talking about making deliveries. I saw a box, then hid inside it. It was so cold... but... my head was so dizzy. Soon, I didn’t know anything else. When I woke up, I was here."
"What you said... Why don’t I believe it?" Wang Lan scoffed, his arms crossed. The story sounded as thrilling as a movie script, even more so than most scripts.
"I’m telling the truth... I’m not lying."
"Wang Lan, please save me... I don’t want to go to jail, I just wanted to defend myself... I didn’t intend to use Star Martial Skill. But... I was so weak at that moment, I couldn’t resist without using Star Martial Skill."
"Are you sure?" Wang Lan stared into Xie Sisi’s eyes, sensing the plea in her gaze. "Then... tell me why you’re pretending?"
"Pretending?" Xie Sisi looked puzzled at Wang Lan.
"You’re pretending even now. Your strength isn’t just not below mine. It’s actually even above it. You managed to fight me and even had me suppressed, despite being wounded in the shoulder and frozen for so long.
"This kind of strength, among national high school students, is rare. But in school, your combat skills appeared so weak! If it isn’t pretending, then what is it?"
"She’s not pretending!" Xie Sisi suddenly spoke up, but instantly gave Wang Lan a chilling sensation.
Xie Sisi’s appearance hadn’t changed one bit, yet her gaze became unusually sharp.
The same face but a change in her eyes gave the impression of a completely different person.
In that moment, Wang Lan’s Star Power began to circulate quietly through his body.
"Split personality?"
"Something like that, but you don’t need to worry, my emergence is harmless to her," the other’s voice was even colder than Jiang Xinyu’s.
"My appearance originates from an incident when she was nine years old. That year, I was nine, our parents worked night shifts, and my brother stayed at his school. It was my mother’s birthday, and I personally made a bowl of dumplings to take to my parents’ factory."
"You could make dumplings at age nine?" Wang Lan asked in surprise.
"What’s so surprising about that? I learned how to chop vegetables and stir-fry when I was six. People like us from the lower strata of society start doing household chores to help our parents from an early age."
"What happened after that?"
"I encountered a pedophile. He tied me up in the green belt under the overpass and tried to..." As she reached this point, Xie Sisi’s eyes flashed with intense killing intent.
"And then what? You emerged?"
"Not at that time. She was incredibly scared, especially when she saw that man’s... thing. She only had one thought in her mind: wishing for someone to come rescue her...
"Just then, an accident occurred on the overpass. A dump truck tipped over, and its concrete mixer barrel rolled down from above. He abandoned me and ran, but the barrel crushed him to death."
"Eh... You were okay?" Wang Lan stared wide-eyed; the plot was even more dramatic than a TV drama.
If he hadn’t run, it wouldn’t have hit him. Yet, he effectively sealed his own fate by running right into its path, and the rolling mixer barrel crushed him to death on the spot.
"Later, the guards came and rescued me. Following that, she had a fever for half a month. During that illness, I came into being."

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Not Fighting with Heaven, Only Ashes Remain
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 110: Not Fighting with Heaven, Only Ashes Remain
"So, the one who fought me before was you?"
"Yes! If you’re asking what I am, medically speaking, I am indeed her second personality. But I don’t see it that way. I am her Guardian Angel. My purpose in appearing is to protect her from harm. She’s actually very smart; she learns the teacher’s movements almost instantly. But in combat, she’s overwhelmed by intense nervousness and fear. In that state, she can’t even move her body, which is why she performed so poorly."
"Is the strength you displayed her true strength?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
"Not entirely. I am both her Guardian Angel and her subconscious. So, there are many moves I can perform that she can’t. Theoretically, though, anything I can do, she should be able to do as well. Originally, I shouldn’t have appeared and met you. But... I hope you can help her."
"Huh?" Wang Lan looked teasingly at Xie Sisi’s second personality before him. "Why? Can’t you help her? You could just show up during combat. In that case, Xie Sisi would definitely become one of the top students, right?"
"I am me, and she must always be herself. I can help her for a time, but not forever. Besides, if she one day gains the strength to protect herself, I will disappear. I appeared to protect her, and I will vanish when she no longer needs protection. She likes you!"
Suddenly, the Xie Sisi before him looked earnestly into Wang Lan’s eyes and said this.
"What?"
"She likes you, ever since your first day of school. That time you saved her, she wasn’t actually unconscious. She was aware of everything. Since that day, she has liked you, liked you a lot. But we both understand that this affection is destined to be unrequited. That’s why I hope you can help her. If you help her, she will undoubtedly help you with all her might in the future. Everyone needs a few trustworthy people in life, right?"Thɪs ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"You think I don’t have any?"
"You do! But you wouldn’t mind having more, would you?"
"Then... I want to know what exactly happened tonight? Why did she get shot?"
"She already told you what happened; she didn’t lie. But it all started when you parted ways at the bus stop. Anyway, it’s better if she tells you about that herself. By the way, don’t tell her what I’ve told you. She doesn’t know I exist."
Before Wang Lan could agree, Xie Sisi’s eyes suddenly became vacant again.
If the change in her eyes was purely acting, then her skill was truly superb. To instantly adopt a dark persona with just a look in her eyes is something most people can’t achieve without exceptional talent and professional training.
"Wang Lan... where were we? Oh, right, pretending? I wasn’t lying to you, I really wasn’t. I practice well at home, but when it comes to an actual fight, I just... I just... panic. It’s embarrassing to admit, Wang Lan, but on the first day of school, I specifically bought tranquilizers and took them before the test. But when it was my turn, I... I completely lost my composure."
"Alright, let’s not dwell on that. What happened to you? Why were you drugged?"
"I..." Xie Sisi suddenly drew her legs up, hugging her knees.
Good thing that pose was hidden under the covers; otherwise... who could bear it?
"I wanted to go to the training ground with you all, but I didn’t have a million. My parents’ combined monthly salary isn’t even fifteen thousand. My brother earns a bit more as a chef... but it’s still far from enough. Later, when my brother’s boss learned about my situation, he suggested an idea: I could perform Star Martial Skills at his restaurant. My grades for Star Power form manipulation are excellent, and I’m a Water Attribute Star Martial Warrior. While customers ate, I would use water to create many beautiful things to attract them. But I never expected that scumbag to have such wicked intentions...
"At first, he paid me two thousand yuan per day as an appearance fee. Although this was a lot of money, even at two thousand a day, it would take two years to earn a million. Later, a customer asked me to drink with him. I wasn’t willing. That customer then pulled out twenty thousand on the spot for me to have just one glass. I... I drank it."
As she said this, Xie Sisi suddenly buried her face in her knees and began to sob.
"Wang Lan, do you also think I’m a shameless woman? Drinking with a customer for twenty thousand yuan? I feel so ashamed of myself..."
"Well... just one drink isn’t that big a deal, is it? Celebrities do commercial appearances... if people pay them to sing and dance, they do it. It’s a kind of job... yours should count too, right?"
Although Star Martial Skills weren’t meant for performance, using them for entertainment was a Star Martial Warrior’s prerogative. It wasn’t illegal, and Wang Lan genuinely didn’t look down on Xie Sisi’s reasoning.
In other words, if he could earn five hundred skill points for singing a song, Wang Lan would probably kneel and belt out ’Conquer.’ If just singing wasn’t enough, he could even bring himself to dance to ’Paradise.’ Anything to earn skill points; what was dignity in comparison? By the same logic, if Xie Sisi could get twenty thousand for one drink, then drink it. Why be so pretentious?
"That boss was very generous. He just had someone film it with a phone and didn’t make any other unreasonable demands. I was already performing Star Martial Skills for money; I’d long since stopped caring about face. Later, thanks to me, the restaurant’s business boomed, and many customers generously tipped me. In a little over a month, I’d already saved five hundred thousand. If this continued, earning a million before winter break wouldn’t be particularly difficult.
"Today, that most lavish-spending regular came again. I always knew he had other intentions toward me, but to earn money, I endured it. But today, Zhang Zhiyun actually drugged me. During a break in my performance, he handed me a glass of water. After drinking it, I felt something was off. Soon after, I became dizzy and fell asleep. When I was startled awake, I was lying on a bed, my clothes stripped until only this much remained. That fat pig saw I was awake and still tried to force himself on me, so I... I hit him with a Star Martial Skill. What happened after that is what I told you before."
"So, Zhang Zhiyun is... that fat pig?"
"No, he’s the restaurant owner."
This sequence of events... mostly added up. And it also explained Xie Sisi’s recent changes. She went directly to the restaurant to perform after school, which was why she dressed so fashionably and well, and wore subtle makeup.
"I think I understand the situation now, and I should be able to help you. But I don’t quite get why you’re so fixated on going to the training ground. Many students like you don’t go to the training ground before graduating high school."
"Fixated?" Xie Sisi lifted her tear-streaked face to Wang Lan, a sarcastic smile suddenly appearing. "Yes, to you, it must seem like a fixation.
"I come from an ordinary background. But no one like us, born ordinary, wants to remain ordinary their whole life. We also hope to make a name for ourselves.
"We are Star Martial Warriors, and for Star Martial Warriors, strength is what matters.
"I’m currently in the later phase of the Starlight Stage. In my class of fifty students, four or five are at the Star Cloud Stage, and nine are at the Star Shine Stage. The rest are at the Starlight Stage. My class rank is twentieth, right?
"What’s the use of good academic scores? For the college entrance exam, academics only account for forty percent. The other sixty percent is Star Martial Art performance, where Star Martial level accounts for sixty percent of that score, and combat results for forty percent.
"My Star Martial level ranks around one hundred and fiftieth in the entire year. With such a rank, forget about top-tier universities; even average second-tier universities might not accept me.
"If I can’t get into a good university, I might just drift through four years of college in mediocrity. Afterward, I’d either join the military or the Pioneering Legion. In the military, someone like me would never have a chance for promotion. If a war breaks out, people like me will be sent to the front lines.
"Due to insufficient strength, I could be killed in the first engagement. It’s even possible my body wouldn’t be brought back.
"Joining the Pioneering Legion would be much the same. Without strength or a degree from a prestigious school, I’d just be one of the many cannon fodder. This is almost my predetermined future.
"To change all this, the college entrance exam is my only chance.
"The college entrance exam changes the fate of ordinary students; how could it not also change the fate of ordinary Star Martial Warriors like us? Only by getting into a good Star Martial Academy can one access better Star Martial Skills, obtain more resources, and find more opportunities for advancement.
"I don’t want my life to be a meteor that just streaks across the night sky."
Wang Lan looked at the girl before him in shock. He never imagined that this girl, whom he had always overlooked, possessed such mature thoughts.
"You... when did you start thinking about all this?"
"I suppose it was from the moment I awakened my Star Martial Warrior talent," she said, her voice regaining some composure. "I understood from a very young age how cruel this society is.
"I have seven maternal uncles. My grandmother was quite remarkable; all seven sons she bore awakened their Star Martial Warrior talent. Isn’t that incredible?"
"That is indeed incredible. The country should have given your grandmother an award."
"They did... a long time ago. Do you want to hear what happened to my uncles?
"None of my seven uncles awakened naturally. They all awakened through Soul Resonance Awakening after graduating from middle school.
"Their talents weren’t particularly high, nor particularly low. Like most of their peers, they got into third-rate or second-rate Star Martial Academies.
"Later, my eldest, fifth, and seventh uncles chose to join the military. My second, third, fourth, and sixth uncles chose to go pioneering.
"The year my sixth uncle had just joined the Pioneering Legion, the military sent back my eldest uncle’s ashes. He was killed by Exotic Beasts during a mission, in a single encounter.
"My eldest uncle was posthumously honored as a martyr. Less than three months later, my second and third uncles died in a pioneering battle, their bodies never found."
In just two short sentences, three of her seven uncles were gone.
Wang Lan stared at Xie Sisi in horror. Three uncles dead, so tragically, yet she could speak of it in such a calm tone?
Wang Lan usually wasn’t interested in matters unrelated to him. But now, he suddenly became interested. Xing Feng, as well as Lan Die, who had left a deep impression on him, seemed to be the ordinary Star Martial Warriors Xie Sisi was describing. They had taught Wang Lan a very vivid lesson, making him feel the weight and helplessness of ordinary Star Martial Warriors. Wang Lan had little contact with Star Martial Warriors; those he knew were either from his school or the elites from the Tianjian Bureau. But what Wang Lan heard more about was the Pioneering Legion; they were like adventurers venturing into different worlds. Wang Lan had heard many stories about the Pioneering Legion since he was young. In Wang Lan’s eyes, pioneering in a Different Dimensional Space was both brutal and romantic. But in Xie Sisi’s words, there was only brutality, no romance.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Duty-bound
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 111: Duty-bound
"There’s nothing to be surprised about. Three of my uncles died before I was even born. Now, the only ones still alive are my fourth and sixth uncles," Xie Sisi said.
"My sixth uncle lost a leg and has a job at the Star Martial Hall in Tong City. It’s... a way for him to live out his later years, I suppose. My fourth uncle is the one who climbed highest among the seven; he’s a regimental commander in the Pioneering Legion."
"He’s at the Star Cloud Stage cultivation level and has over a hundred Star Martial Warriors under his command. That’s why my cousin is better off than me; he often gets Soul Beads from our uncle. Last summer, my fourth uncle’s family hosted a banquet."
"My cousin successfully broke through to the Star Shine Stage. He’s half a year younger than me but in the same grade. Reaching the Star Shine Stage means he’s practically guaranteed a spot in a fairly well-known Star Martial Academy. If he does well, he could even get into a top-tier one."
"Do you know how much I envied him back then? My cousin isn’t as talented as I am, and he fools around with bad company all day. But because he has Soul Beads, he still progresses faster and further than I do."
"You know, that day, my aunt asked me, ’What stage are you at now?’ I told her, ’Mid-Starlight Stage.’ She said, ’It’s alright. After you graduate from university, go pioneering with your uncle. I guarantee he’ll push you to the Star Shine Stage within a year.’"
"Heh... I’ve remembered that sentence to this day. Wang Lan, my seven uncles exemplify the plight of grassroots Star Martial Warriors. I don’t want to stay at the bottom. I just want to climb high enough so I won’t drown."
Wang Lan leaned against the wall, his expression calm.
He knew the world of Star Martial Warriors was dangerous, but he hadn’t realized just how dangerous.
But if the world of Star Martial Warriors was so perilous, why did so many people yearn for it?
Wang Lan was a transmigrator, having lived a past life before this one.
The two worlds were remarkably similar in terms of culture and technology. If it weren’t for Star Martial Warriors and the Demon Clan, Wang Lan would find it hard to distinguish between them.
So, Wang Lan didn’t understand. If the world of Star Martial Warriors was so brutal and life for grassroots Star Martial Warriors so difficult, why not just return to ordinary human society and be a normal person?
"Xie Sisi, have you ever considered... giving up your status as a Star Martial Warrior?" he asked.
"Give up?" Xie Sisi’s eyes widened in disbelief. Her expression was like... like someone suggesting you donate your five-million-dollar lottery winnings to charity right after you’d finally won.
"That’s not what I meant. I mean... since being a Star Martial Warrior is so dangerous, why not do what some in the big cities do? Like... open a martial arts training center or work as a bodyguard?" Wang Lan asked.
"Don’t you know about the Star Martial Warrior Obligation Act, Wang Lan? If a Different Dimensional Space suddenly appears in a city and releases a large number of Exotic Beasts, ordinary citizens have the right to evacuate or seek refuge in shelters. But Star Martial Warriors, regardless of their status, must join the battle."
"The Pioneering Legion exists to eliminate these spontaneously opening Different Dimensional Spaces at their very source. If all Star Martial Warriors did as you suggest—avoided pioneering, avoided fighting—what would we do when a Different Dimensional Space appeared right next to us?"
"That would be no different from sitting by and waiting for death."
"Besides, once you’ve become a Star Martial Warrior, who would be willing to settle for less? Hunting Exotic Beasts yields Soul Beads, and Soul Beads allow you to advance. The more you hunt, the greater the rewards."
"The state won’t let any talented Star Martial Warrior go to waste. If you have the ability, the state will provide cultivation resources. Star Martial Skills, wealth—both are attainable."
"I’m not saying grassroots Star Martial Warriors have no opportunities. I just don’t want... to start so low that I might die on the battlefield before I even get a chance to prove my worth."
"And isn’t the very purpose of Star Martial Warriors to protect human civilization? The nation’s Star Martial Warriors protect the nation, and humanity’s Star Martial Warriors protect humanity," Xie Sisi explained.
When it came to ideological indoctrination of Star Martial Warriors, Jade Country was probably the best among the more than two hundred countries on Sky Blue Star.
"So that’s it... That’s why you were so insistent on going to the trial grounds with us," Wang Lan mused.
"I’m currently in the late Starlight Stage. I have to break through to the Star Shine Stage before the end of my third year of high school. Only then will I have a chance to get into a decent Star Martial Academy. That way, I might reach the Star Cloud Stage before graduating."
"If I can do that, then whether I join the army or go pioneering, I won’t be assigned to the first wave as cannon fodder," Xie Sisi said, her eyes filled with aspiration.
This young woman had her future mapped out so clearly at such an early age. Wang Lan had, at most, planned up to getting into university, but Xie Sisi had already planned half her life.
WEE-WOO! WEE-WOO! Suddenly, a piercing siren wailed from directly below the Xinyu Building.
That delivery boy who left in a hurry... he ended up calling the guards after all.
Hearing the siren, Xie Sisi’s face instantly turned pale. Being with Wang Lan had been so reassuring that she’d almost forgotten her predicament. Only now did she realize how ridiculous her dreams for the future seemed.
If the guards took her away now, all her future plans would evaporate. Xie Sisi would face years in prison... she might not even make it out alive.
"Wang Lan, there are many guards outside! What should we do? Do you need help packing your bags?" a voice suddenly asked.
Wang Lan: "..."
Xie Sisi frantically looked around, searching for the source of the voice.
"Wang Lan, the guards are requesting to communicate with you," Xiao Ai informed him.
"Connect it," Wang Lan commanded.
Wang Lan turned to the TV on the wall. It lit up instantly, showing several guards in uniform on the screen.
"Huh? Hu Qing? You’re a guard already?" Wang Lan recognized Hu Qing’s familiar face on the screen.
"Brother Wang Lan? Is this your place?" Hu Qing asked, clearly surprised to see him.
"Brother Wang Lan, we received a report that a dangerous fugitive Star Martial Warrior fled into your apartment."
"Send three of them up. No more," Wang Lan said, then instructed Xiao Ai to grant them elevator access.
The video call ended. Behind him, Xie Sisi was curled into a ball, trembling violently.
Wang Lan smiled reassuringly. "Don’t worry. I know that guard. I can negotiate for you."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
As he spoke, he went to the wardrobe and opened it. "I don’t have any women’s clothes here, but you’re about my height, so these should fit."
He tossed a shirt and a pair of pants to Xie Sisi, then turned and left the room.
The elevator doors soon opened, and three guards, led by Hu Qing, walked into the living room. Their immediate reaction was to scan their surroundings. Fleeting astonishment crossed the faces of the other two guards.
This place is huge!
"Wang Lan, the informant said you might know the Star Martial Warrior. Is she your classmate?" Hu Qing asked, getting straight to the point.
"Yes, I know her. Someone drugged her. She only attacked in self-defense when he tried to assault her."
"We’ll investigate that. However, the victim currently has several fractured ribs. He’s also a local entrepreneur and has hired a lawyer. Even if what you say is true, without sufficient evidence, your classmate is in serious trouble."
"He claims to be Xie Sisi’s pursuer and says he spent hundreds of thousands on her. They had apparently arranged to get a room, but he didn’t expect her to try and kill him. He has transaction records and witnesses. And Xie Sisi did, in fact, use a Star Martial Skill on him."
"A Star Martial Warrior using a Star Martial Skill on an ordinary person is a completely different matter. Unless you can prove Xie Sisi was indeed drugged, and that he was the one who drugged her. If the victim wasn’t directly involved in the drugging, she’ll find it hard to escape an attempted murder charge."
"Hu Qing, stop wasting time with him. Let’s just take her in," one of the guards beside Hu Qing interjected. "It’s late. Let’s wrap this up and go home."
"I won’t let you take her," Wang Lan stated calmly.
"I’m afraid that’s not an option, unless you want to be charged as an accomplice."
"Theoretically, cases involving Star Martial Warriors fall under the jurisdiction of the Tianjian Bureau, don’t they?" Wang Lan took out his identification from his pocket and showed it to the guard.
"You..." The guard’s expression changed. He carefully took the ID and examined it.
Hu Qing was also stunned. "Wait, Wang Lan, aren’t you a student?"
"I am a student," Wang Lan replied with a gentle smile, as warm as the sun. "And also a special agent of the Tianjian Bureau."
"Fake, right? Sixteen years old? A lieutenant?"
"It has an anti-counterfeiting code. You can verify it."
"Damn, it’s real? Lieutenant Special Agent, Intelligence Division, Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau..." After checking, the guard stared at Wang Lan in utter disbelief, looking as if he’d seen a ghost.
A sixteen-year-old lieutenant! And from the Tianjian Bureau, no less! The Tianjian Bureau—what was their motto again? They only cultivated elites; they only accepted elites. They’d also heard that becoming a Tianjian Bureau special agent came with an extremely strict condition: no matter how accomplished you were before, no matter your previous rank, everything was reset to zero the day you joined. That’s why the Tianjian Bureau was full of hidden masters, yet their official ranks were often low. A middle-aged non-commissioned officer you might dismiss could easily have been a captain in the past. Therefore, a lieutenant in the Tianjian Bureau was exceedingly rare and incredibly difficult to achieve. For this young man, barely sixteen, to already be a lieutenant... it was unbelievable.
"Finished checking? The Tianjian Bureau is taking over this case."
"Wang Lan," Hu Qing said, "I know you want to help your classmate, but this is a society ruled by law. Even with the Tianjian Bureau’s backing, if the other party insists on pressing charges, you won’t be able to stop them."
"I know. Don’t worry, I can handle it."
"Alright then. I won’t disturb you further. Let’s get a meal sometime," Hu Qing said, patting Wang Lan’s shoulder before leading the other two guards away.
Just as Wang Lan was about to turn, Hu Qing suddenly called out to him.
"Um... Wang Lan, how do you work this elevator?"
Wang Lan: "..."
"Xiao Ai, see them out."
As his voice fell, the elevator doors opened.
Wang Lan pushed open the bedroom door. Xie Sisi, already dressed, stood timidly by the bed.
Xie Sisi really knew how to wear clothes. Wang Lan had thought that even though she was about his height, his clothes would look baggy on her. But she had tied the hem of the shirt into a knot at her abdomen, instantly transforming the shapeless garment into something youthful and stylish.
"Not bad," Wang Lan commented. "The pant legs are a bit wide, but the length is perfect."
"They... they’re gone?"
"They’re gone, but your problems aren’t. First, we need to find Zhang Zhiyun, the one who drugged you. He’s the key to breaking this. Do you know where he is?"
"I don’t know," Xie Sisi replied, shaking her head.
Wang Lan took out his phone and dialed a number. "Hello, this is Wang Lan, Intelligence Division, ID number... Please help me find the current whereabouts of Zhang Zhiyun. He’s the owner of the Cloud Sea Hotel. Thank you."
Xie Sisi watched Wang Lan with wide, curious eyes. A moment later, Wang Lan received a text message.
"Let’s go." Wang Lan led Xie Sisi to the elevator, and they descended directly to the second basement level.
This time, Wang Lan didn’t head for his small electric scooter. Instead, he surveyed the four luxury cars parked there, eventually selecting a large, rugged-looking vehicle that resembled an SUV. He pressed his fingerprint to the sensor, and the car door unlocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Execute First, Report Later, Exceptionally Permitted by National Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 112: Execute First, Report Later, Exceptionally Permitted by National Law
Wang Lan didn’t like playing with cars, but he knew how to drive. Before Wang Ling went missing, Wang Lan had been taken by her to learn how to drive in one of their sports cars when he was very young. At that time, Wang Lan wore an expression as if he had seen through the vanity of the world.
"Mom, do you think it’s appropriate to put a seven-year-old child in the driver’s seat?" young Wang Lan had once asked, a question that seemed to come from the depths of his soul.
Although Wang Lan was an experienced driver in his past life, at that time his arms and legs were so short that if he reached for the brake or accelerator, he couldn’t see over the car’s hood. Driving? Wasn’t that courting death?
"Black Girl can already drive. Lan, you’re so smart; surely you’re not worse than Black Girl, right?"
Black Girl was a German Shepherd raised by Wang Ling, purebred and highly intelligent. A special agent among dogs, skilled in all sorts of tricks. But no matter how smart, a dog was still a dog.
Black Girl was already five years old when Wang Lan was born, so she had passed away from old age a few years prior.
From this, one could see that no matter how prestigious the Flame Emperor of the Jade Country was, Wang Ling had her quirky side in private. Her thought process wasn’t exactly normal.
After Wang Ling disappeared, Wang Lan lived in Suzhou City. In such a densely populated metropolis, driving anywhere was inconvenient and not as satisfying as riding an electric scooter. As a result, Wang Lan rarely drove.
If he hadn’t been bringing Xie Sisi with him today, Wang Lan probably would have taken an electric scooter instead.
Isn’t it nice to whip through the wind at a full speed of eighty miles per hour?
He started the car and skillfully engaged the gears.
Wang Lan lightly pressed a button, and the seatbelts automatically fastened. Xie Sisi watched with curious eyes the entire time; all these things were too far removed from her life.
Driving onto the elevated highway, they left the industrial park, reached the New District, and then turned into the entrance of the Han Ding Platinum Hotel.
This was a five-star hotel in the New District, covering an extremely large area. Its grand entrance resembled that of a major tourist attraction.
"Get out."
After getting out of the car with Xie Sisi, they walked towards the hotel. Just as they entered, a receptionist in a qipao came to greet them.
"Good evening, sir. Are you looking for a room?"
As she spoke, she glanced at Xie Sisi, who was standing next to Wang Lan, her eyes filled with a hint of envy. They had all seen the car Wang Lan arrived in. Although it had no visible emblem, in this world, cars without obvious logos were the truly impressive ones.
Then a man and a woman got out of the car and headed straight for the hotel. Based on the receptionist’s extensive experience, it was clearly some rich heir bringing his girlfriend to get a room.
The receptionist even subconsciously sized up Xie Sisi’s face.
I don’t look bad either, do I? Aside from not being as innocently youthful as her, I should be better in other aspects.
Why haven’t I ever encountered such good fortune?
"Tianjian Bureau, official business," Wang Lan said, pulling out his badge and holding it in front of the receptionist. Her expression immediately became serious.
"Huh?"
"A criminal is staying in your hotel, room 705. You should have a key, right?"
"Yes, yes! Could you please come over to verify the credentials?" The lobby manager hurried over and professionally guided Wang Lan to the side.
After swiftly completing the verification, a trace of fear appeared on the lobby manager’s face. It wasn’t Wang Lan he feared, but the guest in room 705.
For the Tianjian Bureau to come for someone this late at night, they must be an extremely vicious criminal.
He’s a little flustered now. What should he do?
Led by the lobby manager, they arrived at the room door. The manager keyed in the code to open it, and Wang Lan and Xie Sisi stepped inside.
It was more of a suite than a regular room. Although there was only one bedroom, a huge living room was right by the entrance. Opposite the living room was a balcony of over ten square meters.
Wang Lan switched on lights as he went, heading straight for the bedroom and opening the door.
"Fuck! Who the fuck turned on the lights?!" an irate roar erupted. A naked, middle-aged man sat up in bed, squinting and shouting.
On his bed were two equally naked young women, looking to be only eighteen or nineteen years old.
"Is it him?"
"It’s him!" Xie Sisi said, gritting her teeth.
"Zhang Zhiyun, you’re under arrest! Come with me!"
"Who the fuck are you? Kid, do you know who I am...?"
Wang Lan had no time for his bluster. A single karate chop silenced him completely.
"AHH—" At that moment, the two women who had been asleep on the bed were startled awake and let out terrified screams.
Wang Lan paid them no attention and directly carried Zhang Zhiyun away.
Driving back to the Xinyu Building, Zhang Zhiyun was tied to a chair in the training area. But Wang Lan hesitated about what to do next. His previous plan had seemed solid: capture Zhang Zhiyun, then interrogate him about how he drugged Xie Sisi and who had instructed him.
But as good as the plan was, the execution turned out to be completely different from what he had anticipated.
Zhang Zhiyun remained defiantly silent, vehemently proclaiming his innocence and even daring to threaten Wang Lan, accusing him of kidnapping.
Since Zhang Zhiyun dared to drug Xie Sisi, it surely wasn’t his first time engaging in this kind of business; he was very practiced. He would have meticulously disposed of any evidence long ago. The drug he used was a high-end product, one that modern medicine would struggle to detect. This was the source of his confidence in targeting a Star Martial Warrior.
Now, with Zhang Zhiyun acting emboldened and taking a tough stance, Wang Lan truly had no idea how to handle the situation.
Torture him for a confession? I don’t seem to have any experience in that area.
After half an hour of interrogation without getting much, Wang Lan had only managed to make Xie Sisi cry twice.
It’s true what they say: every trade has its master. Alright then!
Wang Lan picked up his phone and called Xu Shiyun.
"Listen, kid, don’t think I’m scared just because you’re hiding behind the Tianjian Bureau’s name. The Tianjian Bureau doesn’t have jurisdiction over ordinary people like us. You say I drugged that bitch? Screw you! Does she even need drugging? I’ve slept with her countless times."
"You... I’ll kill you—" Xie Sisi, trembling with rage, lunged at Zhang Zhiyun, ready to tear him apart.
"Go on, try it. If you leave even the slightest mark on me, it’ll be evidence in court. Medical bills, nutritional expenses, compensation for lost work... I’ll make sure your parents pay up a million or more! Go ahead, touch me. I dare you."
Xie Sisi’s whole body shook with fury, but she really didn’t dare to lay a finger on him.
Seeing Xie Sisi so enraged yet helpless only made Zhang Zhiyun even more smug.
"Go ahead, tie me up. It doesn’t matter. The hotel staff knows my whereabouts. If my family doesn’t hear from me within twenty-four hours, they’ll call the police. You can assault me, even kill me, it’s fine—you won’t get away with it. Kid, you’re from the Tianjian Bureau; you’re tough, I admit. But this is a society ruled by law. Whether you’re Star Martial Warriors or whatever, you’re all bound by the law. You don’t have evidence, so you can’t do anything to me. Hell, I can even sue you. Kid, just let me go. Messing with me won’t do you any good..."
Wang Lan turned a deaf ear, simply sitting to the side and waiting patiently.
About twenty minutes later, a car pulled into the underground garage. Besides Xu Shiyun, who was in plain clothes, there were four Tianjian Bureau warriors in green military uniforms.
Wang Lan quickly went to greet them. "Xu, sorry to trouble you so late. I feel bad about this."
"Cut it out. We’re brothers; why the formality?" Xu Shiyun gestured to the four men behind him. "You know them, so no introductions needed. What’s the situation?"
Wang Lan recounted Xie Sisi’s situation to Xu Shiyun in detail. After listening, Xu Shiyun looked at Wang Lan with an astonished expression.
"And you can’t handle this?"
"It’s not that I don’t know how... well, actually, I don’t. But I knew Xu would know what to do. We just need to get him to confess to drugging Xie Sisi and who instructed him."
"You and your classmate... what’s your relationship?"
"Just classmates. When something like this happens, I can’t just pretend I didn’t see it, right? The law is meant to constrain the behavior of us Star Martial Warriors, but it shouldn’t be exploited by criminals as a weapon to frame us, should it?"
"Sigh..." Xu Shiyun shook his head with a wry smile. "You kid, I really don’t know what to say about you. Yes, this is a society governed by law, and you’re a good, law-abiding kid. But have you forgotten your identity? You’re a Law Enforcer, aren’t you? A lieutenant in the Tianjian Bureau, and you’re helpless against a common thug? Don’t let word of this get out; my intelligence department can’t afford that embarrassment."
Wang Lan was speechless.
"What? Still feeling indignant? Let me put it this way: even if you beat him to death right now, nothing would happen to you." Xu Shiyun slowly walked over to Zhang Zhiyun. "Or, to save trouble, why not just kill him here?"
"Hey, who the hell are you people? You... you trying to scare me? You think I was born yesterday?"
"Heh. Still won’t cry until you see the coffin, huh? Alright, put him in the vehicle and take him away."
The four men efficiently untied Zhang Zhiyun, then escorted him into the van.
"Wang Lan, you might not fully understand the nature of our Tianjian Bureau. For us, killing an ordinary person is as easy as child’s play. We can just slap them with the charge of collaborating with the Demon Clan or being a traitor to humanity, and that’s it."
Xu Shiyun’s words made Wang Lan shiver.
"This... isn’t right, is it?"
Xu Shiyun continued, "You know the Tianjian Bureau reports directly to the Ministry of Defense, and you know all our work is classified. Haven’t you ever thought about what kind of organization the Tianjian Bureau truly is? We don’t need to answer to the public or explain ourselves to them. We hold the ultimate right of interpretation. In ancient times, we would be the Guard, the Eastern and Western Factories. Authorized by state law to act first and report later—that’s the Tianjian Bureau."
Xu Shiyun’s words indeed shook Wang Lan profoundly, but he still felt something was off.
If the Tianjian Bureau is truly like that, then people should turn pale at the mere mention of it, just like in my memories of history. For example, the Military Unity or Unity from historical records of my past life. But the public’s impression of the Tianjian Bureau isn’t fear; they just find it mysterious and even dare to joke about it, calling it ’the relevant department’.
"Xu, if the Tianjian Bureau really has that much power... isn’t that a bit much?"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
"You don’t like having great power? You’re one of us too. Besides, although the Tianjian Bureau has this power, have you ever seen anyone abuse it? Do you think the Law Enforcement Department is just for show? Do you think the annual political reviews are fake? We have this authority, but we don’t abuse it. At the same time, we have the right to adapt and act according to the circumstances. Take that scumbag, for example. We know he’s human dregs, a menace if left alive, so why bother with courtesy? Use your special privileges to eliminate him, and the higher-ups won’t blame you. Our special privileges are for dealing with such degenerates and scum. Forget it. In time, when you’ve become a seasoned old hand, you’ll understand. Leave this man to me; I’ll take care of him for you."
"How are you going to ’take care of him’? I have a bad feeling about... his fate."
"We’ll determine his fate after the interrogation. It’s late; I’m heading back. I’ll let you know the outcome."
With that, Xu Shiyun waved, turned, got back into the car, and drove away.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Executed on the Spot
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 113: Executed on the Spot
"Are you... planning to stay here tonight?" After Xu Shiyun’s car roared away, Wang Lan asked awkwardly.
"My parents must be worried about me... Can I call them?"
"It should be fine now, to let your family know you’re safe."
"May I use your phone?"
Xie Sisi had been stripped down to her underwear, and obviously, she had left her phone and wallet behind. Wang Lan gave her his phone, and she walked over to a corner to make the call.
Some time passed, perhaps half an hour, before Xie Sisi returned with swollen eyes.
"Here’s your phone back. I really want to thank you this time. If it weren’t for you, my life would have been over."
"We’re classmates; we should help each other out," Wang Lan said, setting the phone aside.
The basement suddenly grew quiet, and the scent of Xie Sisi’s perfume filled Wang Lan’s nostrils. Only the two of them were present, and the atmosphere suddenly became very intimate.
"Umm... Xie Sisi."
"Hmm?" Xie Sisi’s nasal response sounded so tantalizing that a surge like an electric current flowed through Wang Lan, nearly causing him to shiver.
What kind of enchantress was this, so captivating?
Wang Lan turned his head and glanced at the Training Room. He took off his jacket to reveal a snug white undershirt beneath.
"It’s already so late, and so much has happened to you, I figure you won’t be able to sleep tonight anyway. How about... we practice together?"
What he said at first sounded sensible to Xie Sisi, but the rest... Did that even make sense?
Practice together?
Alone with a man in a room, especially when this woman was in distress. To come up with the idea of practicing together at such an opportune... No, a heaven-sent chance like this?
Xie Sisi looked at Wang Lan in astonishment as he folded his jacket neatly and put it aside, her expression completely petrified.
Upon hearing the start of his sentence, Xie Sisi had almost guessed where the conversation was heading.
That part about "I think you won’t be able to sleep tonight, how about..." Shouldn’t it have been followed by "we sit down for a chat"? Talk a bit?
This twist, wasn’t it a bit off-script?
Practice? Who would be in the mood to practice in this situation?
"When you were freed from the box earlier, your movements were quite impressive. You weren’t fully conscious at the time, but you demonstrated such remarkable skills. This shows that your strength is far from ordinary..."
"I... I practice very late every night. I have specially made weighted gear for myself; I exercise with a 30-kilogram load, doing kicks, running, jumping. Every few days, my dad makes some concrete posts for me to practice striking with hands and feet, and I break one every day... I’ve told you before, I’m very hardworking privately. It’s just... just... during competitions, I get so nervous, I can’t control that kind of nervousness..."
"But when your consciousness was blurred, you managed to evade the guards’ pursuit and demonstrated such fierce moves. This indicates that your true strength is very strong. It’s just that you can’t overcome the anxiety, and that’s why your combat skills are significantly lacking in real fights. I guess it’s because you don’t have someone to practice fighting with regularly. Fight with me, and see if you can overcome it."
Wang Lan was eager to try, his face showing an expression of excitement looking forward to the hunt.
Wang Lan had always thought his Basic Combat ability was among the very best of his peers; even his combat teacher Liu Jie was no match for him. But tonight, the other Xie Sisi taught Wang Lan a lesson.
Fierce combat and the powerful force it unleashed. Moreover, Wang Lan distinctly felt the Star Energy Fluctuation in Xie Sisi’s moves.
She had used Star Power but did not perform a Star Martial Skill. Others might not understand how Xie Sisi applied Star Power to her combat, but Wang Lan understood.
Once the Inch Strength Fist reached the silver level, mere physical strength was no longer enough to bring out its power. Therefore, Star Power was needed as a supplement. It would mix with the skill of energy channeling to burst forth with strength that was simply not possible for a normal person.
One punch could split mountains and shatter rocks.
And Xie Sisi managed to apply Star Power to all her combat moves, making each punch and kick extraordinarily powerful. How could this skill not make Wang Lan envious?
This was certainly the pinnacle of silver-level combat. Although one could learn it by adding skill points, aren’t skill points precious? If you could comprehend it on your own, wouldn’t that save a tremendous amount of skill points?
Xie Sisi saw the expression on Wang Lan’s face and reluctantly nodded. But she knew inside that the feelings of nervousness and fear were not simply due to anxiety. This feeling had plagued her for many years.
Since that one time when she was nine years old.
"Alright then..." Xie Sisi followed Wang Lan to the training platform.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"This is where I used to practice combat with instructors. Let’s start with punches and kicks. You come at me with an attack!"
"Okay!" As soon as Xie Sisi got into position, her hands began to tremble.
The extent of the shaking was so noticeable that Wang Lan, standing two to three meters opposite her, could see it clearly.
"Come on, attack. Don’t be nervous."
"Alright... Wang Lan, I’m in your hands," she said, then Xie Sisi charged towards Wang Lan with shuffling steps, sending a stiff punch towards his chest.
This punch not only lacked momentum but was also poorly executed. Xie Sisi left herself no room to adjust or change her attack.
So Wang Lan merely sidestepped slightly and struck Xie Sisi’s shoulder with a chop of his hand.
"AH—" Xie Sisi collapsed, clutching her shoulder and looking pitifully hurt.
"What are you crouching for? To gain sympathy? Would an enemy on the battlefield show mercy to you for your weakness? Would the Exotic Beasts of the Different Dimensional Space spare you for your frailty?"
Originally, Xie Sisi expected Wang Lan to crouch down and ask her with concern, "Xie Sisi, how are you feeling?"
But she had never expected to hear these words from Wang Lan.
Aggrieved, so very aggrieved.
Her nose felt sour, but she forced back her tears.
"Understood!" Xie Sisi stood up once more.
"Continue!"
"Yes!"
Wang Lan had always seemed like a warm guy to his classmates, with a warm smile and a gentle tone of voice. But in this moment, Xie Sisi saw a completely different side of him.
Wang Lan was not warm, especially when fighting. His moves were sharp and vicious, aiming for the vitals with each strike.
Unbelievably, Wang Lan actually punched right at Xie Sisi’s beautiful face.
That punch left Xie Sisi completely stunned. Her head was in a fog, as if the world had been peeled away around her.
Wang Lan showed no sign of stopping, his hand slicing toward Xie Sisi’s throat. But in that instant, Xie Sisi arched backward to dodge Wang Lan’s hand strike.
Her steps shifted, instantly creating a distance of two meters.
"Good!" Wang Lan’s eyes suddenly brightened; Xie Sisi’s last-minute dodge finally looked decent.
"Again—"
In front of him, Xie Sisi suddenly crouched down, covering her face and crying.
SOB... SOB...
Seeing this, Wang Lan belatedly realized how harsh and painful the string of fierce attacks had been for a girl. Wang Lan had aimed for her face with his strikes.
It wasn’t Wang Lan’s fault; after all, Huang Feilong had taught him that way.
During the fights with Wang Lan, Huang Feilong used a combination of Traceless Fist and FoShan Shadowless Kick. In the first half month, they left Wang Lan battered to the point of feeling disintegrated.
It was precisely this ruthless and unsparing way of teaching that allowed Wang Lan, even before awakening as a Star Martial Warrior, to have a bronze LV3 in movement technique.
Wang Lan saw this method of training as excellent, though the process was extremely brutal.
SOB... SOB...
"Don’t cry, I... I’m sorry."
"It’s not... I don’t blame you; I blame myself... I’m so... useless... I..."
"Take your hands away!"
"No, I must look like a pig’s head right now."
"How can I treat you if you don’t move your hands away?"
Only then did Xie Sisi remove her hands, revealing several bruises on her face from Wang Lan’s punches.
Indeed... quite cruel.
He placed his palm over the bruised areas, and in a short while, her face was restored to its original state.
"I’m sorry... I know this way of fighting is too cruel for you. When I practiced combat, my instructor used to beat me like this. My current level of combat strength is all thanks to this method of fighting. This style of battle trains your dodging, reaction, and adaptability. It provides a comprehensive and all-around improvement..."
"Is my face okay now?" Xie Sisi suddenly interrupted Wang Lan, anxiously asking.
Wang Lan felt like a wire in his brain was about to snap. What’s wrong with this woman’s thought process? I’m explaining the necessity of the training method, and all you care about is your face? If this keeps up, I’m going to give you a *real* training session!
"My face... is it still ugly?" Seeing that Wang Lan had not responded, Xie Sisi asked nervously.
"It’s already healed."
"Really? So... you’ll heal me whenever you hurt me?"
"Yes."
"Then let’s continue!" Xie Sisi stood up joyfully, her resilience in recovering her composure was unexpectedly good.
So Xie Sisi’s tears weren’t about being beaten? They were about her face swelling up? Is this... a woman’s way of thinking?
"Wang Lan, please continue, I can take it."
"Good! This time, I’ll go on for ten minutes, and I won’t stop within those ten minutes. My training method is different from the school’s. At school, if you surrender or get knocked down, it’s over. With me, unless the time is up, I won’t stop striking."
"Good! Please start."
Ten minutes, with Wang Lan’s rate of attack, was simply torture for Xie Sisi. It seemed like Wang Lan’s attacks were coming from everywhere, with pain striking her body every second.
But after the initial stiffness and numbness, Xie Sisi realized that she was taking significantly fewer hits in the final minute. Particularly after being punched a few times in the face and her head feeling dizzy, she instinctively dodged most attacks.
Wang Lan noticed this as well.
As soon as the ten minutes were up, Xie Sisi collapsed like a wooden doll. Wang Lan hurriedly started to treat her, and just as he finished, his phone signaled a communication alert.
"Rest for a while, I’ll check this out."
This time of day, it should be a message from Xu Shiyun.
He opened his phone, and sure enough, it was a video message from Xu Shiyun. Wang Lan clicked to download, and after a few seconds, the video was ready.
He clicked play.
"Zhang Zhiyun, engaged in organized criminal activities from the year 5012 to 5018 of the Celestial Calendar, issued high-interest loans, harassed other people’s families, and bullied others. After interrogation by the Tianjian Bureau, Zhang Zhiyun was found guilty of rape by deceit, forcing into prostitution, murder, illegal fundraising, and endangering society. Convicted of multiple offenses, he was sentenced to death and executed by shooting immediately."
In the video, Xu Shiyun read the verdict while holding a folder, with Zhang Zhiyun kneeling on the ground of the parade field. Behind Xu Shiyun stood two men in green clothes.
After Xu Shiyun finished reading, she closed the folder.
"Execute!"
BANG—

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Settle Publicly or Privately
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 114: Settle Publicly or Privately
The man in green clothes behind him instantly pulled out a pistol and fired a shot at the back of Zhang Zhiyun’s head. Clean, crisp, and as fast as lightning.
What preparation? What one, two, three?
None whatsoever!
Wang Lan’s eyes widened, struggling to believe the video’s authenticity.
Killed just like that?
Wang Lan had carefully read the duty regulations for special agents of the Tianjian Bureau. Indeed, one rule stated that Tianjian Bureau special agents had the authority to enforce the law and to carry out executions. When necessary, they were permitted to execute a target first and submit a written report afterward.
But Wang Lan had always thought this power was to be used in situations like capturing Demon Clan spies—when those spies resisted arrest and posed a substantial threat to surrounding civilians, making elimination of the target the primary consideration.
He had never really thought it could be used like this.
"Wang Lan, what’s wrong? Is there a result?" Xie Sisi approached, a little nervous. Seeing Wang Lan’s pale face made her heart flutter again.
"Yes, there is. Don’t worry, you’re in the clear."
Then, another file arrived on his phone. Wang Lan hurriedly opened it. The file contained a very complete chain of evidence for Zhang Zhiyun’s crimes. With testimonies and tangible evidence, it was enough to get Zhang Zhiyun a death sentence, even in a court of law.
But how could Wang Lan believe it? In just over an hour, they had gathered such comprehensive evidence?
The phone screen lit up. Xu Shiyun was calling.
"Hello!" Wang Lan answered.
"Received it?" Xu Shiyun asked.
"Xu... your way of doing things is kind of frightening. Executed just like that, with a gun? There won’t be any problems, right?"
"Problems, my ass! I’ll tell you the truth, Zhang Zhiyun was involved in quite a lot. In the past eight years, he’s been connected to at least seven or eight cases of families ruined and lives lost. That restaurant he runs? It’s just a front for his illegal activities."
"He’s both the restaurant owner and an intermediary for underground dealings: forcing minors into prostitution, extorting citizens with predatory loans, bribing government officials, and so on."
"If this evidence were presented in court, he’d get at least fifteen years. But I think, scum like him getting fifteen years would still be a waste of the nation’s food for fifteen years. Better to just execute him and be done with it."
"By the way, we also got him to confess to evidence of corruption among some government officials, as well as evidence of illegal activities by some underworld forces. Do you want it?"
"What would I want it for? You’ve already dealt with the guy."
"You don’t want it? If not, these merits will all be mine," Xu Shiyun said with a chuckle.
Huh?
Wang Lan suddenly became alert and quickly opened the system. Sure enough, there was a prompt in the system indicating a task was in progress. He didn’t even know when it had started.
Wang Lan was full of contempt for the system; it didn’t even have a notification feature.
"Wang Lan, I’ll submit the evidence of corruption among those officials to the Discipline Inspection Commission. As for the evidence on those underworld gangs, I’ll hand it over to the police. Is that division okay? You uncovered this criminal, Zhang Zhiyun. Based on your intelligence, my four brothers and I tracked him and, in doing so, uncovered this entire illegal profit chain. How’s that sound?"
"No problem. By the way, can the evidence regarding those underworld gangs be given to a specific person?"
"A police officer?"
"Yes!"
"That’s fine. We just need to notify the police department. Who do you want to handle it? It’s your call."
"Hu Qing. I’ll send you his contact information right now."
"Alright. If there’s nothing else, I’ll hang up?"
"Okay!"
After hanging up, Wang Lan frowned. Logically, this matter should have been concluded by now. But the system hadn’t issued the rewards yet.
Could it be...
Wang Lan glanced at Xie Sisi, who looked nervous beside him.
It must be that her trouble hasn’t been resolved yet.
Picking up his phone, he called Hu Qing. "Hello, Hu Qing, where’s the person Xie Sisi injured?"
"Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University, ICU, Ward Seventeen," Hu Qing replied, surprisingly coherent.
"ICU?" Wang Lan asked. "Is he that badly hurt?"
"Badly hurt, my ass! Just two broken ribs, no internal organ damage. But he insists on staying in the ICU. I just got back from the hospital. He was still threatening me, saying if we don’t arrest the person by tomorrow morning, he’s going to pressure our police department through the media."
"The chief just called me too. If he really goes to the media and pressures us, we might have to bring the Tianjian Bureau into it. You should... give the Tianjian Bureau a heads-up in advance, okay?"
"I understand. Oh, by the way, a colleague of mine will call you later to give you credit for something. It’s evidence of crimes committed by some underworld organizations. Consider it my way of thanking you."
"We’re brothers, why the formality? If anything, my family owes you a huge debt of gratitude. If someone hadn’t reported a tip with the address today, and if two of my colleagues hadn’t been there, I would have just taken your word for it and looked the other way."
"Understood. If there’s nothing else, I’m hanging up."
After hanging up, Wang Lan patted the distracted Xie Sisi on the shoulder. "Let’s go. We’ll completely resolve your issue tonight, and then you can go back and get a good night’s sleep."
He drove Xie Sisi to the Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University.
It was already three in the morning, but there were still vacant parking spaces at the hospital. Wang Lan led Xie Sisi to the ICU. Actually, they didn’t even need to look for room numbers; they just had to find the door with four bodyguards in black suits standing outside.
"Who goes there?" As Wang Lan approached, the four bodyguards eyed him sharply.
Wang Lan took out his Tianjian Bureau badge. "I’m here to handle the case of Zhao Xiaoliang being attacked by a Star Martial Warrior."
"You?" one of the bodyguards questioned, clearly skeptical; Wang Lan was simply too young. However, the badge he presented made them hesitate.
"What’s the matter?" a strong, middle-aged male voice called from inside the ward.
"Someone from the Tianjian Bureau is here. He says he’s investigating the attack on the boss," a bodyguard reported.
"Then why are you still blocking him? Let him in."
The ward door opened. Lying on the hospital bed was a man who, just as Xie Sisi had described, looked strikingly like a fat pig. His bare chest was bound with a rib brace. Though he looked miserable, his complexion was rosy, and his spirits seemed high.
Zhao Xiaoliang turned his head to look at Wang Lan, but the first person he saw was Xie Sisi standing behind him. Instantly, Zhao Xiaoliang’s face turned deathly pale.
"You... you! Guards! Guards!"
"Boss—"
"Boss, my ass! Call the police! Call the police! She’s the one who hit me! Quick!"
Zhao Xiaoliang might have dared to shout in front of the police, but the moment Xie Sisi actually appeared before him, he was instantly as frightened as a terrified stray dog.
Xie Sisi had a sweet face and a delicate figure. But no matter how sweet or delicate-looking a Star Martial Warrior was, she was still a Star Martial Warrior.
Even when drugged and disoriented, Xie Sisi had managed to break three of his ribs with a single blow. In her current, clear-headed state, she could slaughter him in minutes.
Having four bodyguards was useless; they were just ordinary men. Even if ordered to protect him, they might not dare lay a hand on Xie Sisi.
And the man now before him, Wang Lan, was even more terrifying. Daring to bring Xie Sisi here meant he was very likely here to back her up.
"Don’t bother the police officers," Wang Lan said, handing his ID to Zhao Xiaoliang. "Mr. Zhao, I’m Captain Wang of the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau. This is my ID."
"Regarding the conflict between you and Xie Sisi, we’ve essentially completed our investigation. I’ve come to mediate."
Wang Lan’s tone was very polite. This was because, after reviewing the evidence provided by Zhang Zhiyun, he had found no criminal evidence against this Zhao Xiaoliang.
According to Zhang Zhiyun’s statement, Zhao Xiaoliang was just an ordinary businessman who had indeed been charmed by Xie Sisi over the past two weeks, which was why he had casually splurged over a hundred thousand yuan on her.
However, despite spending over a hundred thousand yuan, he hadn’t even managed to touch Xie Sisi’s hand. Zhang Zhiyun, aware of Zhao Xiaoliang’s intentions, had proactively contacted him, saying that if Zhao Xiaoliang paid one million yuan, he would guarantee Xie Sisi would willingly spend the night with him.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
Zhao Xiaoliang, his judgment clouded by lust, hadn’t thought much of it and assumed it was Xie Sisi’s idea. Later, at the hotel, although he sensed Xie Sisi might have been drugged, he was already overcome by his desires. Driven by lust, he had still planned to go through with it.
But ultimately, nothing had actually happened, and without substantial evidence, Zhao Xiaoliang couldn’t be convicted. This was why Wang Lan was being polite. If he had evidence of Zhao Xiaoliang’s crimes, he wouldn’t have been so courteous; he would have beaten him up first and then had Hu Qing arrest him.
"Mediation? I don’t accept mediation! We’ll see each other in court! Hmph, a Star Martial Warrior attacked me. That’s attempted murder! Unless..." Zhao Xiaoliang’s eyes flicked towards Xie Sisi, but he quickly shut his mouth.
With Captain Wang from the Tianjian Bureau present, it wasn’t appropriate to discuss his terms.
I’ll wait for a private opportunity,
Zhao Xiaoliang thought.
She won’t refuse. Either complete the deal or go to jail—a smart person knows how to choose.
"Mr. Zhao, please ask your bodyguards to step out for a moment."
Fear instantly appeared on Zhao Xiaoliang’s face. "Wh-what are you going to do?"
"You don’t need to be nervous. If I wanted to do something, your four bodyguards wouldn’t make a difference, here or not. Unless, of course, you’ve hired Star Martial Warriors. What I’m about to say isn’t suitable for outsiders to hear."
"I..." Zhao Xiaoliang’s eyes flickered. Deep down, he recognized the truth in Wang Lan’s words. Subconsciously, he also respected Wang Lan’s status as a Tianjian Bureau special agent.
"You all step out. Stay alert to the situation inside. If you hear anything unusual, call the police immediately!"
"Yes, Boss!"
Once the bodyguards had left, Zhao Xiaoliang looked at Wang Lan, his face grim. "Captain Wang, can we talk now?"
"Xie Sisi is an external associate of our Tianjian Bureau. Although her conflict with you was a private matter, the Tianjian Bureau still needs to get involved."
"As for why you were injured, you know perfectly well. To put it bluntly, you attempted rape, and Xie Sisi acted in self-defense. You’d be the one spending a few years in jail, while she wouldn’t face any trouble at all."
"Are you trying to scare me? Do you have any evidence? I negotiated a price with Xie Sisi; it was consensual! You can check how much money I spent on her. My injuries are my evidence! You think you can overturn this without any proof? Not a chance!" Zhao Xiaoliang retorted, refusing to be intimidated.
"Mr. Zhao, do you know Zhang Zhiyun?"
"The owner of Cloud Sea Restaurant? Yes, I know him. So what? Zhang Zhiyun negotiated the price with me on Xie Sisi’s behalf. I don’t think his testimony would count as evidence for you. He’s an involved party too!"
"It’s good that you know Zhang Zhiyun. Mr. Zhao, please don’t get angry just yet. Let me show you something."
With that, Wang Lan took out his phone and played a video.
The video, of course, showed high-definition footage of Zhang Zhiyun being executed by gunshot. Zhang Zhiyun’s face was quite distinct; Wang Lan was sure Zhao Xiaoliang would recognize him.
As Zhao Xiaoliang watched the video, his expression changed repeatedly. Wang Lan could even clearly hear Zhao Xiaoliang’s heartbeat accelerating.
BANG!
A gunshot rang out in the video.
Zhao Xiaoliang’s hand trembled, and the phone slipped from his grasp, falling onto the hospital bed.

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Be Even More Fierce
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 115: Be Even More Fierce
Wang Lan picked up his phone and, with a slight smile at Zhao Xiaoliang, asked, "Did you see everything clearly? Do you want to watch it again?"
"Murdered... You... you can kill people?" Zhao Xiaoliang looked at Wang Lan with horror in his eyes, filled with disbelief.
To be sentenced to death is something only a court can decide. And to carry out the execution is the duty of a different department. Even the fastest process would take at least seven days, right? But what had he seen? On-the-spot sentencing, on-the-spot execution, Zhang Zhiyun hadn’t even had the chance to utter a word from beginning to end.
"We do have the right to kill, as long as the person deserves it. That Zhang Zhiyun not only drugged Xie Sisi; he had also engaged in other criminal activities. Basically, once in the Tianjian Bureau, there’s little chance of concealing anything. It’s like some celebrities or enterprises using accounting tricks to evade or dodge taxes."
Wang Lan’s words were already a naked threat.
Which enterprise nowadays didn’t evade or dodge taxes? Those were merely fudging small amounts or evading a small portion and paying the larger part; the relevant departments would turn a blind eye to that. Only those who evade or dodge taxes on an excessive scale, tens of millions or even hundreds of millions, would be seriously penalized by the relevant departments. So, when Wang Lan used this tactic against entrepreneurs, he hit the mark every time.
"It seems Mr. Zhao isn’t in any serious trouble. Then there’s no need for you to stay at the Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University any longer; let’s move to the National Defense Hospital. I came today to confirm your intentions. If you agree, my colleague will step in. Oh, right, that person who announced the execution in the video is from the intelligence department. He’s particularly adept at tracking and investigating clues; he cleared up the illegal evidence against Zhang Zhiyun in just one hour."
"Is there... any chance to settle this privately?"
Where would Zhao Xiaoliang dare to be tough now? It was clear from Wang Lan’s words: if he kept making a fuss, Xie Sisi might not be in trouble, but he surely would. They both dealt with important matters; how could they fail to grasp the priorities?
"Settle privately? How so? You still want to complete the deal?"
"I wouldn’t dare... I wouldn’t dare..." Zhao Xiaoliang hurriedly shook his head. "Actually... I believe Xie Sisi was drugged; this was all Zhang Zhiyun’s doing. Both Miss Xie Sisi and I were deceived by him. He drugged Miss Xie Sisi and tricked me into making the deal. Miss Xie Sisi and I are both victims."
"Wait a moment!" Suddenly, a voice sounded at the door. Hu Qing, dressed in a police uniform, strode in and pushed the door open. "This is the form to renounce the right to press charges. Fill it out."
Then he set up a camera in the hospital room.
Hu Qing quietly approached Wang Lan. "Bro, do I owe you another favor?"
"Did you get the materials?"
"Got them. We’ll start casting the net tomorrow."
"That’s your police department’s business; you don’t need to tell me."
「」
Recording Zhao Xiaoliang and handling the paperwork for him to renounce his right to press charges took another half hour.
A system notification sounded in Wang Lan’s mind the moment he stepped out of the hospital:
"Mission: Rescue the distressed classmate—Complete. Reward: 5,000 experience points, 100 skill points." You could have at least given a notification when I accepted the mission!
Wang Lan then invited Hu Qing to a meal at a nearby restaurant before bidding goodbye and leaving. He escorted Xie Sisi back to the entrance of her apartment complex; she had remained silent throughout the journey.
Perhaps it was because too much had happened tonight,
Wang Lan thought.
"Xie Sisi, you’re home," Wang Lan said. "Um... please keep my identity a secret. Although it’s not an identity that can’t be made public, it’s better if the other students don’t know."
"Yes! I understand." Xie Sisi opened the car door and jumped out. "Um... Wang Lan."
"Yes?"
"Can I still spar with you? Like we did tonight."
A trace of confusion appeared in Wang Lan’s eyes.
Normally, people wouldn’t accept his way of sparring, especially a delicate girl like Xie Sisi. At first, he was quite interested, but he soon found that Xie Sisi and her other self were completely different. No matter how hard he pushed Xie Sisi in their spars, her other persona never appeared. So, his interest gradually fizzled out. However, he hadn’t expected Xie Sisi to take the initiative to ask now; it made him see her in a new light.
"Sure. I go straight home after school every day. You can come over and spar with me. Weekends are fine too."
"Thank you, Wang Lan." Xie Sisi bowed deeply.
「The next day, in Class One of Senior Year Three at Star Martial Arts Campus, two model students—who had never been late and would attend school even with a fever—both requested leave simultaneously.」
"Wang Lan, Wang Lan..."
While Wang Lan was sleeping soundly, he heard Xiao Ai calling him.
Without opening his eyes, Wang Lan murmured and rolled over, "Xiao Ai, what time is it?"
"Four o’clock."
"Why are you waking me up at four o’clock? Isn’t the alarm set for seven?"
"It’s four in the afternoon, Wang Lan. Your classmate is here; she’s at the elevator downstairs. Shall I let her in?"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"Classmate?" Wang Lan instantly woke up. He sat up in bed; the room was dim.
"What’s the weather like today?"
"Today is clear and cloudless, temperature ten to twenty-two degrees Celsius, southeast wind at level three, air quality excellent."
"Activate Sunlight Mode."
The curtains slowly drew open, and bright sunlight instantly poured in through the enormous floor-to-ceiling windows. An overhead panel flipped open, allowing sunlight to stream through the glass roof, filling every corner of the home.
"By the way, which classmate is it?"
"The classmate from last night, the one the supermarket ’gifted’ you."
"Xiao Ai, since when did you learn to make jokes? Open the elevator and let her come up."
「」
Xinyu Building was thirty-six stories tall, one hundred and fourteen meters in total. It took twenty-two seconds to get from the ground floor to the top.
That was just enough time for Wang Lan to get dressed.
DING DONG—
Wang Lan stepped out of his bedroom as the elevator doors opened.
Xie Sisi walked into Wang Lan’s home, dressed plainly and carrying a fruit basket and a bag of clothes.
"You’re here! You didn’t have to bring anything," Wang Lan called out casually. "I just got up, sorry about that. Make yourself at home; I’m going to brush my teeth and wash my face."
Sometimes, such a casual greeting could make people feel more at ease.
"My mom said you saved me, and that’s a huge favor. Even though a fruit basket isn’t worth much, it’s a courtesy we couldn’t skip."
"It wasn’t really about saving you; it’s part of my duties. Have you forgotten my identity?"
"That’s different."
Wang Lan went to freshen up and came out a minute later.
"Are we starting today?" Wang Lan looked at Xie Sisi’s clothes, noting she wore a snug athletic outfit under her coat.
"Yes. I didn’t realize you hadn’t gotten up yet. Sorry to disturb you."
"Actually, I’m not usually this lazy. I don’t know what happened today; I slept the whole day through without waking up once. I’m hungry. Xiao Ai, please order two takeout meals for me."
"Alright!"
"This... is your high-tech computer?" Xie Sisi asked, her eyes wide with curiosity. She had known about Xiao Ai since yesterday and was very intrigued.
It seemed the technology wealthy families had was on a completely different level from hers.
"She’s called Xiao Ai, my smart home management system," Wang Lan explained. "She connects to all the electronic devices in the house via a central processor. When I give her commands, she can turn lights on and off, clean, serve tea, and things like that. But she can’t make the bed or fold blankets; no one has invented a blanket-folding robot yet."
"Wow, that’s amazing..."
"It’s alright. I ordered two servings of takeout. Let’s eat together later."
"No... no need. I’ve already eaten."
"You had lunch, right? It’s almost dinnertime now. Don’t be so polite with me. Come on, let’s go down to the Training Room and wait there."
He took Xie Sisi in the elevator straight down to the second basement level.
"By the way, how did things get resolved afterward? Does your family have any plans?"
"Hasn’t everything been taken care of already?"
"I mean Cloud Sea Restaurant. Your brother used to be a chef there, and now that Zhang Zhiyun has been executed, your brother is out of a job."
"That’s not a big deal. My brother’s cooking skills are excellent; finding another job won’t be difficult for him, so it won’t affect our family much. The police department posted a notice clearing my name, so the damage to my reputation has been handled too." Although Xie Sisi said this, a shadow of sadness flashed across her brow.
"What is it? You don’t look as relaxed as you claim."
"It’s nothing... It’s just, I’m a girl. After something like that happens, there’s bound to be gossip. But it’s okay. As long as I know the truth, that I’m innocent, then idle talk can’t hurt me," she said.
As she spoke, Xie Sisi took off her coat, revealing the combat suit underneath.
The two jumped onto the sparring platform. A flurry of THWACKS followed.
「Five minutes later」
Xie Sisi lay on the ring, her nose bruised and face swollen, yet a complex smile played on her lips, one that seemed to emanate genuine joy.
Wang Lan pressed on Xie Sisi’s face to heal her, a sense of trepidation creeping into his heart.
Had he accidentally flipped some kind of incomprehensibly awesome switch in her? To be beaten so badly and not only not cry, but actually smile?
"Xie Sisi, please, you must take this seriously," Wang Lan said firmly after a moment’s thought. "You are a warrior. When I fight you, I forget you’re a woman. I need you to forget it too. I don’t want to see your frail, feminine side. Show me ferocity!"
"Hmph—"
"More fierce!"
"RAWR—"
SLAP! He smacked Xie Sisi on the forehead. "Ferocity comes from your eyes, your aura, your reactions—not from howling! Is that fierce? That’s just being cute. When I hit you, your reaction shouldn’t be to cower and cover your head. You should dodge, counterattack! Counterattack while dodging. Never defend if you can attack. The best defense is a good offense. No defense is more effective than eliminating the enemy. Alright, let’s continue."
"Okay!"
Xie Sisi’s willpower was quite strong. At least, after being so ruthlessly beaten by Wang Lan, she showed no fear, nor did she entertain any thoughts of retreating.
She got up, and the two of them created some distance.
"Begin."
THWACK! THWACK! THWACK...
Wang Lan’s fists once again rained down mercilessly on Xie Sisi. She performed slightly better this time, but only marginally so.
However, as long as there was improvement, it was enough for Wang Lan.
Even a little progress each day would accumulate into significant advancement over time. Xie Sisi was different; she wasn’t lacking in ability. Her strength was formidable, possibly even greater than his own. His training method was merely to help her overcome her nervousness and fear, and to unlock her potential.
「」
After four rounds of beatings and healing, the takeout arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Song Bo, please advise
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 116: Song Bo, please advise
When God closes a door on you, often there isn’t a window left open, but a key is secretly left behind. Moreover, God doesn’t tell you where the key is hidden.
Some people search for it in vain their whole lives, while others don’t even bother looking.
Talent is something one is born with, but it’s not extremely rare.
In a broader sense, everyone has hidden talents. It’s just that you haven’t discovered yours yet.
Jiang Xinyu was a genius with extremely high intelligence, learning ability, and battle consciousness. She had a natural ice attribute and also possessed the basic wind and water attributes.
Her genius was visible to anyone but the blind.
In front of Jiang Xinyu, Xie Sisi was like an ugly duckling compared to a swan.
God personally opened the door for Jiang Xinyu but closed Xie Sisi’s, leaving behind a key.
As long as the key is found and the door opened, talent can shine with dazzling brilliance.
Possibly, even Xie Sisi herself didn’t realize how precious her exceptional Star Power control talent was in the world of Star Martial Warriors.
Wang Lan’s control of Star Power was already top-notch in the class. But Wang Lan could only achieve such delicate Star Power manipulation because of his two ’cheats’: the system and skill points. Xie Sisi, however, seemed to have been born with it.
In Xie Sisi’s words, from the moment she awakened her Star Martial Warrior talent, controlling Star Power was as flexible as controlling her own fingers. This was a skill that others couldn’t learn.
But Xie Sisi never felt that her talent was anything extraordinary. This allowed Wang Lan to finally understand how Mingyue Wucheng must have felt when watching Wang Lan show off back then.
Squeeze him to death... Just squeeze him... It’s too demoralizing... Squeeze him until his thoughts are clear...
If her Star Power control talent was cultivated well, it could absolutely become an unparalleled, brilliant talent. There are many Form Changing Star Martial Skills in the world that involve controlling Star Power, and any one of them could propel Xie Sisi to soaring heights.
But developing Xie Sisi’s talent wasn’t something Wang Lan could focus on at that moment. What Wang Lan was currently considering was how to get Xie Sisi to apply this talent in Basic Combat.
Wang Lan was still unrelentingly hopeful.
The ’other’ Xie Sisi could already perform the skill smoothly, so theoretically, this Xie Sisi should be able to as well. If the ’other’ Xie Sisi could do it, it meant this Xie Sisi had practiced it before and succeeded.
Over these ten days, Wang Lan spent every day sparring with Xie Sisi. Her progress was beyond Wang Lan’s expectations. It was as if in just ten days, she had experienced what took Wang Lan five years.
This proved that there were no insurmountable psychological barriers, only undiscovered methods. Liu Jie’s combat teaching, while correct, wasn’t suitable for Xie Sisi.
For Xie Sisi’s psychological issues that resulted in her combat weakness, the solution was to fight. Keep fighting. As long as she wasn’t killed, she was to fight to the brink. Treat her after fighting, then fight again after treatment.
The goal was to make her fight until she forgot fear and nervousness, until she didn’t even have time to think and could only react instinctively.
Wang Lan had apparently succeeded in drawing out Xie Sisi’s instinctive reactions. On the stage, Wang Lan and Xie Sisi rapidly exchanged blows, their punches and kicks as swift as lightning.
Although it looked like Xie Sisi was still being overpowered by Wang Lan, that was because she was a woman, and there was an innate difference in strength. If Xie Sisi could use Star Power combined with Basic Combat, Wang Lan might have been the one suppressed.
With a dull THUD, Wang Lan executed an over-the-shoulder throw, pinning Xie Sisi to the ground.
"Still unable to do it?" Wang Lan asked in a soft voice as he released Xie Sisi.
"I’ve been really trying hard. It requires multitasking, and during a battle, I subconsciously focus on countering your attacks, with no chance to do two things at once. Wang Lan, did I really use it before?"
