An A-grade Star Martial Skill, mastered in just a few months and even cultivated to an advanced stage! I’ve been practicing an A-grade skill for half a year and have barely scratched the surface...
"That stings!" Gong Feiyu gently patted Wang Lan’s shoulder and said seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 Xie Sisi’s Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 123 Xie Sisi’s Breakthrough
At first, luring and killing the monsters went fairly smoothly, but after roughly five waves, the Golden mantises also grew alert. Aside from the ones Jiang Xinyu had frozen solid and rendered unable to struggle, about a dozen more would discover the situation and arrive as reinforcements.
The combat power of the unrestrained Golden mantises skyrocketed instantly, like the invulnerable golden bodies of the Eighteen Bronze Men Formation.
How to describe the melee capabilities of the Golden mantises... Unparalleled Swordsmen, and dual-wielding Unparalleled Swordsmen at that. Although Exotic Beasts don’t understand specific sword skill moves, human sword skills were originally learned from animals.
In Wang Lan’s view, the Golden mantises’ sword skill was the most primal, the most original form of killing technique. Fortunately, the quintet had primarily focused their recent training on close-quarters combat; otherwise, ordinary people couldn’t withstand the sensation of a blade’s edge flashing so close to their faces.
Wang Lan’s Flame Sword possessed unstoppable sharpness, and his efficiency in killing the Golden mantises was the highest. With his Flame Sword advancing to Silver Nine, his understanding of it reached an entirely new level.
The enhancement from system attribute points was all-encompassing. Even though a Star Martial Skill might have been passed down for hundreds of years, it didn’t mean all its possible applications had been fully explored.
So, when Wang Lan first used the vertical Flame Sword, even He MingXue leaped up excitedly, exclaiming that Wang Lan was truly innovative to have devised such a creative move.
However, skill points had limitations; they couldn’t enhance actual combat experience.
The Flame Sword at Silver Nine had almost pushed its variations to their ultimate limit. But Wang Lan had to figure out how to apply these techniques in battle himself.
Now, the opportunity had arrived.
His dual Purple Flame Swords could no longer satisfy Wang Lan’s boundless creativity, which was as wild as an untamed mustang.
Have you ever seen a Solar Wheel?
Wang Lan’s Flame Sword was no longer a triangular, flame-cutting spear but had transformed into a circle. Its circular edge, like a sun from a cartoon, bristled with jagged serrations. These serrations rotated at high speed, elevating its cutting power to a terrifying level.
The Solar Wheel Flame Sword: a mere graze inflicted severe injuries; a direct hit meant certain death.
This spectacle dealt a heavy blow to Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu.
We’ve all practiced A-rank Star Martial Skills, and while we’re still learning to imitate, Wang Lan is already innovating with flair.
When they learned these were all Wang Lan’s spur-of-the-moment creative ideas, the two completely shut down.
There’s no communicating between normal people and monsters like him.
Xie Sisi, sticking close to Wang Lan, remarked, "Are you guys really that shocked? I haven’t even said anything yet."
The squad always took great care of Xie Sisi, looking out for her safety and ensuring she had opportunities for real combat. With each wave of Exotic Beasts, Wang Lan and the others would leave one Golden mantis for Xie Sisi.
How nice are Golden mantises? So well-behaved, ignorant of Mage-type attacks. All their attacks are melee. And they’re just so cute: over a meter tall, with two-meter-long blades, egg-sized eyes, coconut-sized heads, and bodies gleaming with a black metallic luster.
Weren’t they the perfect sparring partners for a Star Martial Warrior like Xie Sisi, whose strength lay only in close combat?
Xie Sisi’s combat talent was fully unleashed in her battles against the Golden mantises. It wasn’t that her strength had made another rapid leap, but that her mindset was rapidly transforming.
Previously, Xie Sisi would become fearful and terrified whenever she faced melee combat. But since Wang Lan had ’corrected’ her, it seemed he might have overdone it, pushing her to the other extreme.
The more dangerous the situation, the more excited she became. To put it audaciously, she loved the thrill of "dancing on Yama’s head," finding exhilarating joy in dancing amidst blades and swords.
Xie Sisi’s tactics grew increasingly daring, sometimes scaring Wang Lan nearly out of his wits.
How fast were the Golden mantis’s blades? Yet she dared to dance up close and personal with it, even finding time to slip under its belly to find a good spot to strike?
Does she really think the Golden mantis is just an ingredient on her chopping board?
In response, Wang Lan sternly and righteously criticized Xie Sisi. But in her excited state, Xie Sisi was too alluring; she sensually licked her lips, making Wang Lan’s legs nearly buckle.
Another coquettish remark from her, and the Two-handed Great Sword on Xu Xiangwen’s back would feel as limp as noodles.
But it had to be admitted: the more excited Xie Sisi became, the crazier she fought, and the crazier she fought, the stronger and more stable her performance. So Wang Lan even thought it was a mistake for Xie Sisi to take calming agents before exams; she should have downed a bottle of strong liquor instead.
Their second foray into the trial grounds not only showed Wang Lan the varying degrees of danger in different trial areas but also highlighted the rapid progress of the others.
An intense and stimulating day passed unnoticed.
Wang Lan’s group of five returned to the cave they had previously selected to rest and recover.
The campfire blazed, and the five of them gathered around it, counting the day’s haul.Thɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Three hundred and sixty!"
"Four hundred!"
"I... I only got a hundred," Xie Sisi said, counting her Soul Beads, her voice somewhat pitiful. The difference was just too big...
Most of these one hundred Soul Beads came from the Golden mantises Jiang Xinyu had frozen. If counting only those Xie Sisi had killed independently, there probably weren’t even thirty.
"Not bad, Sisi," Jiang Xinyu said softly to console her. "Think about it; an ordinary Star Martial Warrior team might not earn three hundred Soul Beads in ten days. You earned a hundred in one day. That’s already very impressive."
"Are other Star Martial Warrior teams really that weak?" Wang Lan asked, a look of surprise on his face.
Jiang Xinyu immediately rolled her eyes at Wang Lan. This guy was getting more and more infuriating.
"Wang Lan, I feel like your perception is way off from ours," Xu Xiangwen began. "As your brother, I have to set you straight. Many things you take for granted would terrify ordinary people.
"Take today’s haul, for example: I got three hundred and sixty, Feiyu got four hundred. That’s already five or six days’ worth for other Star Martial Warrior teams. Some squads might not even gather that many in ten days."
"Why? Are their abilities too poor? That can’t be right. The entry requirement for the intermediate trial grounds is a squad with at least one Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior. One Star Cloud Stage warrior leading several Star Shine Stage members shouldn’t be that pathetic, right?"
"Do you have some kind of misunderstanding of ’pathetic’? How can you so recklessly raise the bar for what counts as pathetic?
Look at our squad! What kind of people are we? Out of five members, three are combat specialists. The remaining two, though not specialists, are at the peak of their respective classes!
And look at our squad composition! One long-range Mage—a high-damage Star Cloud Stage Mage at that! One with unobstructed long-range scouting! One for terrain control and support! An incredibly top-tier healer! And a close-combat specialist rookie!
And at the same time, our healer can double as an agile fighter, our Mage can handle crowd control, our scout can tank, and our terrain controller can act as a shield!
Do you understand what kind of god-tier team this is? We’re five people: one Star Cloud leading four Star Shines. But... damn it, are any of our four’s abilities even remotely normal?
Our five-person squad is a golden lineup, a peak combination! Exotic Beasts aren’t smart and don’t use targeted tactics against us. It’s perfectly reasonable for us to display seven or eight times the combat power of other teams, alright?"
Xu Xiangwen practically roared, berating Wang Lan for his cluelessness.
After listening, Wang Lan pondered seriously for a moment and finally nodded in agreement.
"So, you’re saying the other squads are still too pathetic, right?"
"You win!" Xu Xiangwen flopped onto his back, staring skyward in defeat.
"Wang Lan, how much did you gain today? Do you think there’s a chance to break through to the Star Cloud Stage this time?" Jiang Xinyu suddenly asked.
"How could that be possible!" Wang Lan immediately shook his head, though inwardly he was crying a river of tears.
Wang Lan’s haul for the day was indeed substantial. Seven hundred Soul Beads, yielding seven hundred experience points. Among them was one mutant Star Cloud Stage Soul Bead, the size of a chicken egg.
Gathering so many Soul Beads in one day... if this rate continues for ten days, I could definitely break through to the Star Cloud Stage.
But... my upgrade requirements are different from others.
What were Soul Beads to me? Skill points and mana potions. Beyond that, they had no other value.
And the system didn’t care about the level of Soul Beads for skill points. Damn it!
Low-grade, mid-grade Soul Beads... they all converted to just one skill point. This infuriated me...
He had already converted the low-grade Soul Beads into skill points but couldn’t bring himself to do the same with the mid-grade ones. The Star Power contained within a mid-grade Soul Bead could instantly restore half of his mana pool.
"Have we rested enough? Should we get going?" Xu Xiangwen asked.
"Let’s rest a bit longer," Jiang Xinyu said coolly. "The intensity of the intermediate trial grounds is much higher than the primary one. Plus, we’re dealing with tough opponents like the Golden mantis. We still have ten days; there’s no need to rush."
"Alright!" Xu Xiangwen agreed without further discussion.
The purpose of this trip was to help Gong Feiyu and Xu Xiangwen break through to the Star Cloud Stage. The Soul Beads in the intermediate trial grounds were of higher quality than those in the primary one. Given the team’s strength, they could easily manage, so there was no need to exhaust themselves unnecessarily.
"Sisi, you try and see if you can break through," Wang Lan suddenly said.
"Now?" Xie Sisi was incredulous. She had a hundred Soul Beads from the day’s battle that she hadn’t dared to absorb.
Soul Bead distribution was at the team leader’s discretion, typically done collectively at the end. So, Xie Sisi hadn’t expected Wang Lan to tell her to attempt a breakthrough now.
"The Star Power needed to go from the Starlight Stage to the Star Shine Stage isn’t much; a hundred Soul Beads should be more than enough. Your current realm is too low. Breaking through will increase your chances of survival. I don’t think anyone will object."
"Sisi, try to break through now. If it’s not enough, I still have three mid-grade Soul Beads," Jiang Xinyu added, her words nearly bringing Xie Sisi to tears.
She had always cultivated alone, forging ahead solitarily. Her practical combat skills were so poor that even peers from ordinary backgrounds were unwilling to train with her.
In the past, Xie Sisi had acquaintances, but no close friends.
Only after meeting Wang Lan had she recently begun to feel she wasn’t alone anymore. She had trustworthy companions, genuinely caring friends, and, indispensable for any girl, a best friend.
"Thank you!" Xie Sisi said gratefully, taking a Soul Bead from her tactical backpack.
She wasn’t as clueless as Wang Lan had been, who hadn’t even known how to absorb Star Power from a Soul Bead his first time.
CRACK! The Soul Bead shattered.
A few seconds later, another soft pop was heard.
After a minute, Star Energy Fluctuations began to surge from Xie Sisi’s body.
This indicated that the Starlight in her Star Palaces was brimming with Star Power and swelling, beginning to break free from the constraints of the Starlight Stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Making You Human in Minutes
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 124: Making You Human in Minutes
A surge of Star Energy Fluctuation washed over them, similar to the fluctuations Wang Lan experienced with each level-up. No wonder people always assumed Wang Lan had made a breakthrough whenever he leveled up in public.
These Star Energy Fluctuations were indeed indicative of a breakthrough.
But Wang Lan had truly been misunderstood. His progression through each martial realm wasn’t divided into the usual early, middle, and late stages like others. Instead, each realm was segmented into ten distinct levels, meaning he had to achieve a breakthrough ten times within every single realm.
Just thinking about it was exhausting. I’m such a low-key person, yet I’m given such a high-profile setting.
"Mmm—" Xie Sisi let out a groan. In an instant, Spiritual Energy converged above her head, and the gate to her Star palace opened. A brilliant star emitted a dazzling light.
Xie Sisi opened her eyes, somewhat dazed and disbelieving.
"Did I... break through to the Star Shine Stage?"
"Yes, a very beautiful Star Shine," Wang Lan said, his smile gentle and comforting, like a father’s affectionate gaze. It was impossible to tell that he had been so merciless when training her initially.
"Thank you... thank you all!" Xie Sisi exclaimed, her voice choked with emotion, thanking Wang Lan, Jiang Xinyu, Xu Xiangwen, and Gong Feiyu.
It was too difficult for a Star Martial Warrior from an ordinary family.
The social structure was already highly stratified, and resource allocation had long been fixed. Star Martial Warriors from ordinary families had only one or two possible paths—though, in reality, it was usually just one.
After all, if one was extremely talented and diligent, it was unlikely they would wait until their education was complete and they officially stepped into the world of Star Martial Warriors before showing their brilliance. A commoner prodigy would make their mark before high school graduation.
Then, after the college entrance exams, they would enter a top-tier university. In university, they could seize the opportunity to soar to great heights. For Star Martial Warriors born into ordinary families, there might only be one or two such chances. If both were missed, rising again would be exceedingly difficult, almost impossible.
And Xie Sisi was teetering on the brink of that first opportunity.
She was a genius, yet one held back by her own flaws.
Even though she had overcome her psychological hurdles and her combat strength had soared to a professional level, her poor past performance meant her recent surge wasn’t enough to catch the eye of a top Star Martial Academy.
Now, having reached the Star Shine Stage, she didn’t have to despair over the first opportunity that was so close at hand.
This breakthrough was a moment that would change the trajectory of Xie Sisi’s entire life.
"You earned this through your own efforts. Let’s rest here for a bit. We’ll take turns on watch, three hours each. After six hours, we’ll set off again."
Xie Sisi’s breakthrough didn’t significantly enhance her actual combat strength. She possessed no Star Martial Skills, and her combat abilities were still limited to Basic Skills. However, she became much quicker, and her punches and kicks packed more power.
「Five days passed quietly.」
Wang Lan’s five-person team seemed to have singled out the Golden mantises, determined to keep fleecing these creatures, which other Star Martial Warriors considered a tough nut to crack.
The more they clashed with the Golden mantises, the more they appreciated such Exotic Beasts. While others found their carapaces impervious to blades and spears, Wang Lan’s team found cutting them increasingly easy.
Even in motion, the five could instantly target the gaps between the carapace segments, then effortlessly slice their blades in for a masterful dismemberment.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
In five days, nearly 8,000 Golden mantises had lost their lives at the hands of this group. In five days, Wang Lan’s team advanced ten kilometers, penetrating deep into the Golden mantis territory.
They had no choice, as they had wiped out all the Golden mantises in the outer areas.
Any other elite squad, even one composed entirely of Star Cloud Stage warriors, likely wouldn’t have achieved half their kill count in five days. Over those days, several Star Martial Warrior teams had come and gone.
During these five days, some had tried to strike up a conversation, some had tried to get close to pick up scraps, and others had attempted to team up with Wang Lan’s group to hunt monsters together.
But Wang Lan’s team gave them all the cold shoulder. Those who were perceptive left on their own, while the oblivious ones, though covetous, still wary of Wang Lan’s team’s formidable strength, eventually departed reluctantly.
Perhaps because Wang Lan and his team had been feasting so well recently, another Star Martial Warrior team, about two hundred meters away, began to emulate their strategy against the Golden mantises.
The strategy was the same, but its effectiveness depended on who employed it. The other team, consisting of about six members, managed less than a fifth of Wang Lan’s team’s daily haul. But even that amount of loot was enough for Wang Lan to judge them as an elite Star Martial Warrior squad.
The other teams they had encountered in the previous days had lasted four hours at most.
Back in their resting cave, Xu Xiangwen counted the Soul Beads like a gleeful landlord, a Shiba Inu-like grin spreading across his face.
"2,100... All high-quality basic Soul Beads."
"I have 1,800," Gong Feiyu said with a relaxed smile.
"I think that’s enough, right?" Wang Lan asked, seeking their opinions.
"I guess it should be. If not, I have ten intermediate Soul Beads, and Wang Lan has five," Jiang Xinyu stated calmly.
"Then what are we waiting for?" Xu Xiangwen, of course, understood what they meant. Absorb them, break through—wasn’t that their purpose for coming to the intermediate training field?
Moreover, the strength enhancement from breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage was completely different from that of Starlight advancing to Star Shine. The Starlight and Star Shine Stages still categorized one as a low-level Star Martial Warrior. But the Star Cloud Stage represented core strength.
Breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage during high school would earn anyone the title of genius wherever they went.
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu began their breakthrough attempts, while Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu stood guard at the entrance.
Xie Sisi hesitated, wanting to go over, but ultimately decided against it, quietly leaning against the wall and closing her eyes.
"You were a bit more alert today. Did you notice something?" At the cave entrance, Jiang Xinyu suddenly asked.
"Was I that obvious?" Wang Lan looked at Jiang Xinyu, surprised.
"Not obvious! An ordinary person wouldn’t notice, but I could sense it."
"Do you remember that Star Martial Warrior squad that was near us all day today?"
"I remember. What about them? Is there a problem?" Jiang Xinyu asked, puzzled.
"That squad is an elite one. Although their efficiency in killing Golden mantises doesn’t match ours, we can’t say their overall strength is less than our team’s. It’s just that they aren’t as adept at dealing with Exotic Beasts like the Golden mantis.
Their team of six had three long-range mages, two defensive specialists serving as tanks, and one control-type support. Is such a team composition suitable for slaying Golden mantises?" Wang Lan asked with a smile.
Jiang Xinyu thought for a moment, then shook her head. "No, it’s not! Such a lineup should target Exotic Beasts with high damage output but relatively lower defense. Golden mantises are defensive Exotic Beasts, but they are also agile warriors with the ability to fly.
It might seem that long-range mages have the advantage, but if the Golden mantises get close or launch a large-scale assault, that team would have little means to resist."
"Golden mantises are clearly not their ideal targets. As experienced Star Martial Warriors, there’s no reason they wouldn’t know that."
"So you think they’re suspicious? Is that why you had Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu attempt their breakthroughs right now?"
"It’s better to be safe than sorry. Besides, I noticed today they looked over at us an abnormal number of times. They weren’t observing us to learn how we kill Golden mantises; they couldn’t replicate our methods even if they did. Anyone sensible would have moved on by now."
"Then... should we change locations tomorrow?"
"We’re not familiar with other Exotic Beasts; rashly choosing one we don’t know carries certain risks. Besides, the Golden mantises are very suitable. However, tomorrow, let’s make a detour and hunt Golden mantises on the opposite side.
We’ve ventured too deep into their territory. If someone were to block our exit from the outside, we’d be caught like dumplings in a pouch."
"Alright!"
Just as she finished speaking, a surge of Spirit Power Fluctuations emanated from behind them as Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu made their breakthroughs.
Xie Sisi had advanced from the late Starlight Stage to the Star Shine Stage; 100 Soul Beads had been enough for her. But to break through from the late Star Shine Stage to the Star Cloud Stage, even 1,000 Soul Beads might not suffice.
Therefore, among all incoming university freshmen nationwide, aside from those in the four major Star Martial Academies, most students even in first-tier academies were at the Star Shine Stage. Among these Star Shine Stage students, there could be hidden peerless geniuses who, once discovered and nurtured by their academy, would soar to great heights.
Anyone who could reach the Star Cloud Stage during high school was aiming for one of the four major Star Martial Academies.
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu’s breakthrough to the Star Cloud Stage before the start of their final semester also gave them a chance to enter this ’paradise for Star Martial Warriors.’
The future opportunities available to students from the four major Star Martial Academies were enticing enough to make anyone drool. Even elite Star Martial Warriors would burn with envy.
BOOM—
A resonant sound erupted above the two. As Star Power surged, their Star palaces slowly materialized above their heads. Within each Star palace, starlight danced like vapor, and a Star Cloud formed into a vortex, rotating slowly and steadily.
Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu returned to the cave. Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu opened their eyes simultaneously. Feeling the potent Star Power circulating within them, smiles they couldn’t suppress spread across their faces.
They had wanted to feign calmness, perhaps even affect an air of profound mystery. But the joy bubbling inside was utterly irrepressible. They recalled Jiang Xinyu’s breakthrough—now that had been a display of true composure and style!
Ah, such poor self-control!
I wanted to keep a straight face too, but I ended up grinning.
"Why shouldn’t you smile on such a happy occasion? Come on, you two, give us a laugh," Wang Lan said.
"Hehehe—"
"Attaboys!"
"Feiyu, Lanzi doesn’t seem to grasp the situation. What should we do?" Xu Xiangwen said to Gong Feiyu.
"Set him straight, of course."
"Wait a sec, what do you two mean? What situation am I supposed to understand?"
"Lanzi, I’m at the Star Cloud Stage! And my comrade here, Gong Feiyu, is also at the Star Cloud Stage. You have two Star Cloud Stage powerhouses before you; shouldn’t you tone down that arrogant attitude a bit?
Before, we might not have been able to beat you, so we endured your taunts. But now... hehehe..."
"What the hell?" Wang Lan’s eyes widened in mock astonishment. "It’s just a breakthrough to the Star Cloud Stage, isn’t it? Look at you, all puffed up. I thought you’d broken through to the Star Sea Stage or something."
"Feiyu, what do we do if Lanzi refuses to face reality?"
"What are we waiting for? A good beating will sort him out," Gong Feiyu declared, leaping to his feet with a WHOOSH.
"Hey, Xu Xiangwen, Gong Feiyu..." Seeing the three about to scuffle, Xie Sisi quickly stood up and began to speak nervously.
Before she could get a word out, Jiang Xinyu pulled Xie Sisi’s hand, stopping her. "Let them be, those three idiots."
Wang Lan wasted no time. With a SWISH, Purple Flame Swords ignited in both his hands.
"This blade is called the Purple Flame Sword."
He crossed his hands, and instantly a vertical Purple Flame Sword materialized before him, as dazzling as a magic trick.
"This is called the Vertical Flame Sword." As he spoke, Wang Lan swiftly crossed his hands again before his chest. "And this is the Horizontal Flame Sword."
Now, a cross-shaped Purple Flame Sword hovered before Wang Lan, the heat it radiated causing the very air to distort.
"The Cross Decapitation Sword. Which hero wants to test it?"
"Damn... Showing off skills is one thing, but this is just too much..."
"Can’t mess with him, definitely can’t mess with him," Xu Xiangwen meekly conceded.
Wang Lan was no longer the ’Bronze’ ranker they could easily push around, no longer someone they could threaten by just finding a small tree. This display of his Star Martial Skill left the two new Star Cloud Stage cultivators with tingling scalps and a chill down their spines.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Counterkill
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 125: Counterkill
Getting cocky just after breaking through to Star Cloud Stage?
Wang Lan mused.
I could casually display a Star Martial Skill and make them recognize reality. As for Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu right now, at best, they’re Jiang Xinyu from six months ago—possibly not even as good.
Our strategic objective has already been met, but there are still four days left. During the next four days, of course, it’s about expanding our victories.
Although Wang Lan has already saved more than 2,000 skill points in the system, when it comes to skill points, can one ever have too many? The skill points in the Phoenix Form are only 800. It wouldn’t be too much even if we added another 1,000 to it.
After resting for six hours, Wang Lan and the others left the original battlefield and detoured to the back of the Golden Mantises to continue hunting them from a different angle.
The tactic employed by Wang Lan and his team drove some of the Golden Mantises that had fled from the opposite area completely mad.
I, a fearless Exotic Beast, have been forced to the other side, and I still encounter you?
I can’t stand it anymore! Brothers, charge!
Then, they were easily decapitated, and their Soul Beads were taken.
Soul Bead +1.
After hunting for just two hours, Wang Lan suddenly noticed that three people were also hunting Golden Mantises 200 meters behind him.
Jiang Xinyu naturally noticed Wang Lan’s unusual movements.
"Is it them again?"
"Three from yesterday’s group: one at Star Cloud Stage and two at Star Shine Stage."
Wang Lan frowned and spoke slowly, "If it was a coincidence yesterday, then today we can be sure they are targeting us."
"Aiming for us? They better have teeth sharp enough for the bite," Xu Xiangwen said with a disdainful sneer.
"With three of us at Star Cloud Stage here, would they dare make a move?"
"This... Wang Lan, what are you guys talking about?" Xie Sisi asked confusedly. It was her first time in the trial field, and she was still very naïve, unaware of the actual dangers within.
"Sisi, within the trial field, the real threat isn’t the Exotic Beasts but our own fellow Star Martial Warriors. It’s not just the trial field, but also in the Different Dimensional Space of the Pioneering Legion. Do you know why Pioneering Legions all have their own squads, small teams, and large teams, and so on? Without forming a group, they can’t trust their backs to fellow warriors they don’t know."
"This... There’s such a thing?"
"Of course, there is, but it’s just not made public. Xu, keep a close eye on our surroundings. Those three definitely won’t dare to attack us—I guess others will come."
"Got it!"
Wang Lan and his team pretended to be oblivious and continued their cycle of hunting monsters, resting, and hunting again.
The trio on the other side also seemed to be there purely for hunting monsters, staying away from Wang Lan and his companions, picking off one Golden Mantis at a time.
After about five hours, Xu Xiangwen suddenly stopped his actions.
"Lanzi, something’s not right."
"Have they made their move?"
"Not certain, but there are two Star Martial Warrior squads, each about 800 meters to our left and right, in a one-lead-three formation. There’s also another team 200 meters from that squad’s flank that is approaching. They’re not moving quickly, but they’re definitely heading here."
"Then there’s no mistake—they’re trying to encircle us. What’s their strength?"
"An estimated four at Star Cloud Stage and twelve at Star Shine Stage. Damn it, if it weren’t for Feiyu and I breaking through yesterday, we would have been in deep trouble today. Now we have three at Star Cloud Stage, and you, Lanzi. What’s there to fear? Let them come and try!"
"Three against four is a bit difficult. They’re not rookies but battle-hardened elites. Plus, there are twelve at Star Shine Stage; this won’t be easy," Wang Lan analyzed objectively, not as optimistic as Xu Xiangwen.
"With you here, Lanzi, even if they had ten more at Star Cloud Stage, they’d be trash," Xu Xiangwen said, still not fully grasping the situation, laughing with some complacency.
"I shouldn’t use my Star Martial Skills if I don’t have to—never revealing them unless absolutely necessary. Moreover, I surmise they dare to make a move because they don’t know you two have already broken through to Star Cloud Stage. This way, we can hit them with a surprise advantage."
Jiang Xinyu’s expression became serious. "Wang Lan, you mean we should strike first?"
"Wait a minute... they haven’t shown any intent to attack us yet. Would it be okay to take action first?" Xie Sisi suddenly asked, tense.
"Their intention to attack is very clear, with a three-sided encirclement and sealing off the exits. Once they finish encircling us, we will either get trapped here or have to fight our way out through the Golden Mantis lair. Therefore, we must break through before they complete their encirclement."
"Which direction?"
"The direction we are looking at now. If I remember correctly, there’s a lake about 1 kilometer away in that direction. We could set up an ambush there."
Xie Sisi looked at Wang Lan with a shocked expression.
Wow, this man is so cool! His tactics are awe-inspiring—he’s even already considered how to counter-attack after the enemy pursues!
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu, on the other hand, showed fear in their eyes and gave Wang Lan a thumbs-up.
"Wang, you’re ruthless! Are you planning to annihilate them? I don’t remember you being this ruthless before."
Indeed, the first time they entered the trial field together, Wang Lan was still very immature, an innocent and harmless child. But after several incidents, Wang Lan’s mentality had grown rapidly. Especially after Zhang Zhiyun was executed on the spot, Wang Lan began to reflect on his own views. Zhang Zhiyun, such scum... Executing him on the spot was definitely too harsh; perhaps fifteen years of imprisonment would have sufficed. But killing such a person only benefits society; there’s no harm. Similarly, Star Martial Warriors who could bring themselves to strike down their own companions—can you expect them to support humanity and bravely fight the enemy in times of national peril? Don’t dream. It’s a miracle if they don’t turn traitor. So, since we have to strike, and the enemy is bound to pursue us, it’s better to just counter-attack and kill them all.
Having decided on a plan, Wang Lan and his group stopped luring monsters and turned to retreat the way they had come.
This was the last chance Wang Lan was giving them. If they stayed their hand and let Wang Lan withdraw successfully, this level-one alert status would automatically dissipate. But if the enemies approached, attempting to obstruct, then...
Wang Lan had offered the chance. Unfortunately, it seemed the opponents failed to grasp his kind intentions.
Pretending to be overwhelmed by the Golden Mantises’ attacks, they gradually closed in on Wang Lan’s group of five.
"Bro, help us out... we can’t hold on any longer..." the disheveled trio called out when they got within 30 meters of Wang Lan’s party, quickly rushing towards them.
"Alright, hang in there, we’ll be right there," Wang Lan responded immediately, and the five-member squad charged toward the trio in a flash.
"Heh heh..." A cold smirk appeared on the lips of the Star Cloud Stage warrior leading the trio.
Chicks are indeed chicks. Seems like they’re truly just students.
"Qi, we’re going to strike it rich this time."
"Of course. These past few days, they’ve gathered at least 5,000 Soul Beads. Holy mother, are students these days always this fierce? If they live, they’re definitely going to be badasses."
"Only those who survive are badasses. The dead are trash. Cai, are you going soft?"
"Soft my ass! How many times have I done this? That woman last time, kneeling and begging me to spare her—when have I ever gone soft?"
"You only get a soft heart when you’ve got a hard-on! When you’re limp, your heart’s like stone! Scum!"
"They’re coming. Stop talking. Put some effort into your acting. Kids these days are shrewd."
The trio instantly put on expressions of joyous relief, their acting quite skillful, as if they had found kin in a foreign land, the emotion of reuniting with fellow villagers welling up on their faces.
"Brothers, thank you so much..."
Before they could finish their sentence, Jiang Xinyu’s Star Martial Skill erupted without warning, enveloping the trio with a ferocious assault. Not even a second passed. Her Star Martial Skill, already primed, was thunderous upon activation.
The three-man squad hadn’t realized their clumsy ploy had been exposed. They were totally unguarded and got completely blindsided by Jiang Xinyu’s Star Martial Skill.
But even so, seasoned warriors remained seasoned warriors, instantly dodging effectively.
However, Jiang Xinyu’s Star Martial Skill wasn’t meant to kill. To conceal the Star Energy Fluctuation, she could only use ice-sealing-type Star Martial Skills.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The trio’s movements instantly stiffened.
On the ever-changing battlefield where life and death were decided in an instant, a moment’s rigidity marked the boundary between life and death.
Before the Star Cloud Stage warrior could even react, Wang Lan’s figure flashed past him. The Flame Sword sliced across his throat, and Wang Lan casually snatched the tactical backpack from his back.
All of this was accomplished in about a second.
Wang Lan’s form swept by like the wind; only then did the man’s head tumble from his neck.
"Kill above your level. Reward: 300 experience points, 20 skill points."
Only 20 skill points? Trash!
A second after Wang Lan finished, Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu also deftly handled the other two Star Shine Stage warriors and completed the looting.
The five-person squad, from engagement to action, to looting and withdrawal—the entire process took less than five seconds. Breaking through the blockade, they dashed straight for the riverbank not far opposite.
At that moment, Xie Sisi was still in a daze.
What had she just seen? In a flash, a Star Cloud Stage warrior and two Star Shine Stage warriors had been decapitated! Their actions were precise and swift, without the slightest hesitation. She hadn’t seen even a trace of doubt in them. Xie Sisi knew she couldn’t have done it, at least not in the situation just now. In her mind, they were all human Star Martial Warriors; how could Star Martial Warriors slaughter each other? Yet, the precociously mature Xie Sisi understood. In such situations, one had to be ruthless; any hesitation, and she could be the one to die. But understanding was one thing, acting on it another. At least, Xie Sisi hadn’t been able to act just now. Even as Jiang Xinyu made her move, she had still been hesitating, conflicted.
They covered 1 kilometer in less than ten minutes.
This place was a lake, with dense underbrush and woods by its shore.
It wasn’t until they reached this spot that Wang Lan allowed himself a slight exhalation. Looking back, he asked, "Xiangwen, keep an eye out. Are they following us?"
"Not for the moment, but they have started to gather," Xu Xiangwen replied, a smile appearing on his face. "Perfect cooperation! Come on, let’s open these bags and see what we’ve got."
As he spoke, he quickly opened the tactical backpack in his hands. "Trash! Is this all the Soul Beads they had?"
"There are only about 100 in my bag. I can’t even be bothered to count them."
"This bag feels pretty heavy; seems like a lot," Wang Lan said as he opened his bag. Indeed, the bag was brimming with Soul Beads, easily 1,000 or more.
"Huh? What’s this?"

chapters.title: Chapter 126 Is this the current student?
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 126 Is this the current student?
From his backpack, Wang Lan took out a small blue bottle resembling a perfume container, but the substance inside was more paste-like.
Star Martial Warriors generally didn’t bring irrelevant items to the trial field. All cumbersome items, such as cell phones, were left in storage lockers. Yet, besides the Soul Beads, there was also this seemingly useless item in his backpack.
"Who cares what it is? Just count them. See how many there are."
"You guys do the counting. Xiangwen, keep a close watch. Don’t screw up now."
"Understood. Haven’t you seen my Heavenly Eye open this whole time?"
Gong Feiyu quickly took the bag and began counting with incredible speed. In less than a minute, he finished, "One thousand."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"Wow, we’re rich! It’s like they say, ’a horse doesn’t get fat without night fodder, a man doesn’t get rich without a windfall.’ The ancients truly weren’t kidding!"
One kilometer away from where Wang Lan was resting, thirteen people gathered around the three that Wang Lan had killed. The way they lay there, the shock still lingering on their faces, was deeply imprinted, as if frozen in time.
"The opponent struck very quickly; Qi didn’t even have time to react. It must have been a successful ambush..."
"With Qi’s strength and experience, he actually got taken down by a few students? I can’t quite believe it. Lei, could there be someone else?"
"I don’t give a damn if there’s someone else. Qi was my brother... His death must be avenged! Where are those five students?"
"Based on their direction, they should have gone that way."
"Chase!"
Elsewhere, by the lake where Wang Lan and the others were resting, all five had absorbed Soul Beads to replenish their Star Power, ensuring they were in optimal condition for combat.
"Lanzi, they’re coming."
"How many?"
"Thirteen! Three at the Star Cloud Stage, ten at the Star Shine Stage. They’re not moving fast; they’re tracking our footprints. They’re all old hands, very cautious."
"Those who aren’t cautious are already dead. Stick to the plan!"
"Understood!"
"Footprint analysis complete. Confirmed there are five of them: three men, two women," a Star Martial Warrior in the group of thirteen, skilled in intelligence analysis, spoke in a low voice.
"It seems there’s no one else, just those five students. They must have used their student identities to get close to Qi and successfully ambushed him."
"Chase!"
The thirteen people accelerated instantly, reaching the vicinity of the lake in the blink of an eye.
SWISH, SWISH, SWISH— Suddenly, arrows shot out from the forest. This startled the group of thirteen, but they quickly realized the arrows, though unexpected, lacked any lethal power.
Easily dodging the arrows, many of them sneered inwardly with contempt.
"Damn it, who was so careless as to step into their warning trap?" Lei, his triangular eyes fierce, bellowed viciously.
"I..." one of them raised his hand.
This was a Star Martial Warrior at the Star Cloud Stage, also one of Lei’s men.
"Lai, are you regressing? How could you step into such a basic trap? The enemy has been alerted, and they’re definitely watching us from the shadows."
"They’re just some students, Lei. No need to fuss. Let’s just go in and kill them."
"Don’t underestimate a few students; even Qi had his head taken by them. Moreover, if they can set up a warning trap that even you fell for, are these just ordinary students?"
"What ordinary student would dare to come to an intermediate trial field? But even if they are geniuses, so what? They’re still unweaned children. They must lack experience. As long as we stick together and stay alert, they won’t be able to pull off anything significant."
After pondering for a moment, Lei nodded. "Okay, go after them."
Instantly, the thirteen formed a triangular formation and charged toward the lakeside like the tip of a spear. At the same moment they moved, five figures dashed out from the riverside bushes, turning into afterimages as they ran towards the lake’s surface.
The moment they jumped onto the lake’s surface, a streak of white light illuminated it, and the lake froze solid where the five landed.
"An Ice Attribute Star Martial Warrior! It’s them."
"Be careful of ambushes. Stay alert and follow."
"There are five people, all accounted for. No ambush. Chase!"
The lake was vast, about a kilometer across to the other shore. Wang Lan and his group sprinted desperately toward the opposite bank, not even glancing back once, giving the appearance of a panicked escape.
How could their pursuers miss such an opportunity? The lake surface offered wide visibility with nothing to hide behind. When Wang Lan and the others reached the center of the lake, Lei, leading the three Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warriors, suddenly accelerated.
The distance between the two groups steadily closed.
"Lei—" The ten Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warriors behind couldn’t keep up and had fallen ten meters behind the three.
BOOM— Suddenly, a huge explosion erupted from behind. The ice beneath the trailing ten shattered instantaneously. As it burst, the shards seemed to come alive, transforming into ice snakes that swallowed one Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warrior each.
As the explosion occurred behind them, the three Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warriors in front had already reacted, quickly turning around.
But it was too late to help their comrades who were ten meters away. The three could only watch helplessly as their ten Star Shine Stage underlings were taken out by Jiang Xinyu in one move.
The sky filled with falling ice crystals, and suddenly it began to snow heavily.
Jiang Xinyu trod on the ice and snow, slowly approaching. In this moment, she truly lived up to her nickname.
The true demeanor of the Ice-Snow Queen.
"Good! Good! The ambush was beautifully executed!" Lei gritted his teeth as he looked at Jiang Xinyu. "You were hiding underwater from the start... One of your team members has a cloning ability. You switched clothes with him to confuse us.
"I had always been wary of you, but I didn’t expect to still fall for your ploy. When I saw them jump onto the lake and the surface instantly froze, I was convinced you were among them.
"But I forgot, even if you hid underwater from the start, you could still freeze the lake’s surface. It’s just that your team’s coordination led us to believe it was one of them who froze the lake.
"Young girl, at such a young age, you are already so shrewd. If you grow to your full potential, you would definitely be a blessing to humanity."
"For that to come from your mouth proves you are beyond salvation."
"Hahaha..." Lei laughed boisterously, looking up at the sky. "There’s a saying that has always circulated in the world of Star Martial Warriors: Only those who’ve matured can be called geniuses. Those who die before maturing, we call them defective products.
"Our existence helps human civilization eliminate these defective products. We are indeed contributing to humanity..."
"Shameless to the extreme!"
"Young girl, your tactics were very successful. But unfortunately, you shouldn’t have targeted my subordinates. They are merely at the Star Shine Stage. If you had ambushed and killed one of us first, you might still have had a chance to escape.
"Now... with the three of us at the Star Cloud Stage, how can you possibly win?"
"Wow, we’re so scared! Three Star Cloud Stage experts, ooh..." A mocking voice came from behind them.
Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu flanked them, pinning down the three in the middle, with Xie Sisi and Wang Lan providing support from farther away.
Star Power surged around Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu. Their star palaces ascended overhead, with a Star Cloud slowly rotating in the middle of each.
The complexions of Lei and his two men instantly paled.
The intelligence was wrong! Damn it, those two weren’t peak Star Shine Stage warriors; they were also at the Star Cloud Stage!
In that instant, Lei understood. The young girl in front of them hadn’t made any tactical errors. She wasn’t trying to escape with her life; what she wanted was to take him and his entire squad down.
These kids nowadays are truly something else!
The two must have broken through recently; otherwise, their Star Energy Fluctuation wouldn’t be so chaotic.
Who should we try to break through?
The three battle-hardened Star Cloud Stage warriors moved in an instant. Their target was not Jiang Xinyu in front of them, but Xu Xiangwen behind them.
However, in an instant, Lei suddenly darted towards Gong Feiyu on the other side. Lei’s move instantly darkened the faces of Lai and the other man.
By doing this, Lei was making the two of them attract Jiang Xinyu’s attention, whose true strength was unknown. After all, the result of two or three of them rushing Xu Xiangwen would be the same. Xu Xiangwen, who had just broken through to the Star Cloud Stage and was still a novice, couldn’t possibly withstand two Star Cloud Stage experts and might even be killed instantly. Therefore, Jiang Xinyu would definitely take action, her target absolutely being the two of them. Lei, charging alone to the other side, although not necessarily able to achieve a kill, would definitely not be attacked and would remain in an invincible position. Although this was the most self-serving course of action, it was utterly devoid of loyalty.
These thoughts flashed through the minds of the two men in an instant. By the time they processed this, they had already charged at Xu Xiangwen.
Jiang Xinyu instantly launched a Star Martial Skill from behind, but her target wasn’t Lai and his companion, as Lei had assumed. It was Lei’s own back.
What? How is this possible!
Shock was written all over Lei’s face.
Doesn’t she care about her teammate’s life? Did I happen to choose her boyfriend or something? It’s clear that kid’s life is hanging by a thread, yet she’s coming after me?
Although Lei was shocked, his body reacted extremely fast. Almost instantly, a gust of wind enveloped him as he converted to the Wind Attribute just a tenth of a second before the frost attack hit.
BOOM—
The very moment Jiang Xinyu launched her attack, the ice behind Lai and his companion shattered. As it blew apart, a figure burst out from the frost.
The figure, hidden within the ice and snow, was indistinct. The only thing the two Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warriors managed to see clearly as they hastily turned around were the purple flames blazing in his hands.
Wang Lan’s dual blades came down like a bolt of lightning slashing the sky. By the time you saw the bolt, it had already struck.
"There’s... a sixth... person?" Lai murmured in bewilderment as he watched the aloof Wang Lan land back on the ice.
A trickle of blood slowly seeped from his forehead, meandering down.
THUMP— A soft sound echoed—the sound of his comrade’s head hitting the ice. It was also the last sound Lai would hear in his life. The next second, Lai’s body split cleanly down the middle and collapsed to either side.
"Cross-level kill. Reward: 3,000 experience points, 30 skill points."
"Cross-level kill. Reward: 3,000 experience points, 30 skill points."
CRACK— A sound of ice shattering rang out.
A cyan shadow dropped swiftly, materializing as Lei on the ice. But at this moment, Lei’s body was covered in frost, as if he had aged decades in an instant, turning into an old man.
He had seen the deaths of Lai and his other man with his own eyes. And it was precisely because he saw it so clearly that his heart was filled with terror.
What kind of people are these? What kind of monsters... Are they telling me they’re students? Middle school students, my ass! They’re ancient monsters, aren’t they?

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Demonic Transformation Potion
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 127: Demonic Transformation Potion
Lei, who always prided himself on being battle-hardened and having faced all sorts of situations and opponents, was now completely flustered. Even when facing a Galaxy Stage leader of the Exotic Beasts, Lei could stay calm and think clearly to find that glimmer of hope in a desperate situation. But in front of these five students, he lost his cool.
Just look at the tactics these five students set up! Are these even human tactics? Traps within traps, a chain of traps, all interlinked, every step a calculated move. From beginning to end, they didn’t give me the slightest chance of survival.
Lei thought he had been very careful. He had confirmed the number of opponents and their strength, making sure he could completely overwhelm them before daring to pursue. He hadn’t chased recklessly either, only accelerating confidently after confirming they had reached the center of the lake, where the view was open. But he still fell for their scheme!
That time, I admit defeat! After all, it was my fault for underestimating them. I deserved it! But everything that happened afterward was completely unexpected. Damn it, when you set up an ambush with two people, do you really need to have them take turns making their entrance?
Lei couldn’t guess any of the students’ thoughts. However, the students had predicted every single one of his moves with chilling accuracy. No matter how Lei and his men reacted, they were merely struggling within the confines of the students’ trap. Step by step, he had been meticulously maneuvered into this dire situation.
Sixteen men. In just ten short minutes, only he remained, a lone ember.
So ruthless! So vicious! Are these even students anymore? I, Lei, am considered a ruthless man in this line of work, but you... you’re absolute wolves!
The situation had suddenly reversed. Three Star Cloud Stage cultivators... no, that boy who killed two of his brothers with a single move—could he really be just Star Shine Stage?
Perhaps he’s a high-level Star Cloud Stage expert in disguise.
Four Star Cloud Stage warriors. Lei didn’t even entertain the thought of turning around and running.
On the ice now, standing on the ice and thinking of escaping from an Ice Attribute Star Cloud Star Martial Warrior? Are you kidding me?
CLINK—
A crisp sound echoed as something fell onto the ice.
Wang Lan looked towards the sound. At Lei’s feet, an empty vial, much like a perfume bottle, lay on the ice. A long needle for injection was attached to its top.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Wang Lan’s brows furrowed, a sense of deep unease rising in his heart.
Is that blue bottle an injectable drug? A stimulant, or something else?
RASPING—
Suddenly, a strange noise emanated from Lei’s throat, and his entire face began to distort. His originally decent-looking face became exceptionally terrifying due to its savage contortion. Yet, this very face sparked a sudden, dawning familiarity in Wang Lan.
Chang Shuangyue! The potion... Magical Martial Artist... Demonic Transformation Potion!
Several key points flashed through Wang Lan’s mind.
"Everyone, be careful!" Wang Lan suddenly roared. "Xinyu, you three fall back! Leave this one to me."
Although they didn’t understand Wang Lan’s decision, they didn’t hesitate, instantly retreating a considerable distance.
"You all deserve to die... I’m going to kill you... all of you... KILL—" Lei let out a heart-wrenching howl. Instantly, a terrifying, blood-red aura flared around his body.
His clothes burst apart. Countless spiky carapaces bulged from under his skin, tearing it open. Lei frantically ripped at the molting skin, and in moments, a monster over two meters tall, resembling a humanoid cricket, stood before Wang Lan and the others.
"Another one? Lanzi, what the hell is this thing?" Xu Xiangwen exclaimed.
"It’s called a Magical Martial Artist. You all, get back further!" Wang Lan warned.
"You trash... weren’t you going to kill me? Come on! Why the hesitation? I’m going to eat every last one of you... and then turn you into shit... HAHAHAHA..."
"Phoenix Form, activate!" Wang Lan declared.
Lei’s mind was incredibly hazy. After the Demonization, his intellect had plummeted. Even his own consciousness began to waver, as if it were drifting away. The only thought remaining in his mind was to kill these beings before him.
Just as Lei was swelling with an arrogant delusion of being invincible, Wang Lan’s deep, powerful voice reached his ears.
His vision, now through compound eyes, was difficult to process. In a daze, his multifaceted eyes caught the image of a phoenix, wings spread, wreathed in flame. Then, the phoenix vanished in a flash.
Wang Lan’s figure became a streak of light, instantly appearing behind Lei. The Cross Decapitation Sword in front of Wang Lan flickered once, then extinguished like a snuffed-out lamp.
Suddenly, green blood began to drip slowly from Lei’s forehead.
It’s like I’m trapped in a tiny space,
Lei thought.
My body... I can’t move, like something’s binding me. Suddenly, it felt like something fell.
In the next instant, before Jiang Xinyu and the others’ eyes, the Star Martial Warrior who had just undergone a grotesque transformation seemed to be sliced by an invisible cross. His body then split into four pieces and scattered across the ground.
A notification-like voice sounded: "Killing an enemy of a higher level. Reward: 5,000 experience points, 50 skill points."
Exiting Phoenix Form, a wave of weakness instantly washed over Wang Lan. Fortunately, it didn’t last long; the weakness was still within a tolerable range.
"Holy shit!"
After a long moment, Xu Xiangwen finally managed to force out those two words. It wasn’t his fault; he wasn’t a man of letters and couldn’t find the words to describe his complex emotions. A simple "Holy shit!" conveyed it all.
"It’s... over?" Gong Feiyu asked, still somewhat dazed. Even though it had happened right before his eyes, it was too fast, almost unbelievable.
"What do you think?" Jiang Xinyu retorted coolly, instantly moving to Wang Lan’s side to support him. "How are you?"
"B-ba...g..." The pain in his body began to flare, like numb, tingling feet suddenly shot through with electric currents. Each slight movement sent an intense, almost perversely satisfying jolt through him.
Jiang Xinyu was momentarily taken aback, then a blush quickly spread across her face. She held Wang Lan tightly.
"B-bag..." Wang Lan clenched his teeth, forcing out the word.
"A hug is enough. If you keep this up, I’ll get angry," Jiang Xinyu said, flustered. "Wang Lan, when did you become like Xu Xiangwen? I always thought you were a decent person."
Xie Sisi had wanted to go over and check on Wang Lan, but seeing Jiang Xinyu there, she stopped. She watched them with envious eyes.
They’re so perfect together, a match made in heaven.
A profound sense of guilt even washed over Xie Sisi for harboring feelings for Wang Lan.
"AHEM... Xinyu," Gong Feiyu interjected awkwardly, "I think Lanzi means... ’bag.’ The tactical backpacks from those guys. They’re still frozen in the ice..."
A cold breeze swept by. The blush on Jiang Xinyu’s face didn’t fade but deepened, spreading to her earlobes and neck. Jiang Xinyu released Wang Lan, pretending nothing was amiss. She lightly tapped her foot on the ice, and thirteen tactical backpacks rose from its depths.
"Wang Lan just used his Phoenix Form and is still weak," she explained, a little too quickly. "I was just supporting him..." Her explanation sounded rather weak and unconvincing.
The intense, electric jolts of pain finally began to subside. Though Wang Lan’s limbs were still sore and weak, he could move again.
"Let’s go. We need to find a safe place first," Wang Lan said.
The five of them left the lake area and found a relatively safe spot on the map. Gathering together, they began to count their spoils.
Xie Sisi was no longer dazed, but an expression of lingering fear still haunted her face.
Today... I was part of killing people.
Killing people was fundamentally different from killing Exotic Beasts; the psychological impact on her was entirely different. A butcher who had slaughtered hundreds, even thousands, of pigs might still not dare to kill a human. Although Xie Sisi hadn’t personally killed anyone, she was part of Wang Lan’s team. This counterattack had been a team effort. What the team did, she had a part in; there was no difference in her mind.
Perhaps noticing Xie Sisi’s troubled thoughts, Jiang Xinyu moved to her side and put an arm around her shoulders. "These are things we Star Martial Warriors cannot avoid—both death and killing. If we don’t kill them, they’ll kill us. For our own safety, we have to strike first. The first time Xu Xiangwen, the others, and I entered the Elite Trials, we nearly died. The experienced guide we hired taught us a brutal lesson with his own life. In these Different Dimensional Spaces, places beyond the reach of the law, you can only trust yourself. Anyone else trying to get close is likely after your life."
"Thank you," Xie Sisi murmured. "I understand... it’s just hard to adjust to so quickly. After all, they were human."
"Except for the last one," Xu Xiangwen chimed in, looking up with a smile after counting the Soul Beads. "We’ve struck it rich this time! A total of ten thousand Soul Beads!" he announced. "Those sixteen guys must have been in the Elite Trials for seven or eight days and were probably about to leave. They likely targeted us thinking we were fat sheep for a final score before heading out. We might have looked like fat sheep, but they weren’t exactly poor themselves! So, with five of us, that’s two thousand each."
The distribution of Soul Beads brought joy to everyone. Especially Xie Sisi; clutching her heavy backpack, she was so excited she was almost in tears.
She had never imagined, not even in her wildest dreams, that she would one day possess so many Soul Beads.
"Three days left. Should we continue grinding? We should probably change locations, though," Xu Xiangwen said, his smile fading.
Wang Lan was toying with the blue vial in his hand, lost in thought. Hearing Xu Xiangwen, he suddenly looked up. "We’re leaving."
"What?" Xu Xiangwen stared at Wang Lan in disbelief. "Leaving? The one hundred thousand per day fee for the Elite Trials is non-refundable if we leave early!"
"We’ve already far exceeded our expected gains, plus we got all these extra Soul Beads. It’s time to go. There’s a limit to everything; going too far is as bad as not going far enough."
Jiang Xinyu’s eyes flickered, her gaze finally settling on the blue vial in Wang Lan’s hand. "I think Wang Lan is right," she said. "We should leave. After what just happened, the Elite Trials aren’t safe anymore. Since we’ve achieved our objective, it’s better to leave early."
With both Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu in agreement, Xu Xiangwen also consented. Leaving now was a bit of a pity, but considering their haul, they had made a massive profit. So be it. They could always come back after the college entrance exams.
The group left the rest area, heading straight for the Elite Trials entrance according to the map. Soul Beads couldn’t be taken out. They either had to be absorbed in the designated safe rooms within the Elite Trials or turned over to the facility for recycling.
All four of them chose to absorb the Soul Beads. Money wasn’t an issue for them. Xie Sisi, too, felt that money was far less important than Soul Beads; absorbed Soul Beads became truly hers. Two thousand Soul Beads would be enough to push her to the middle, or even late, Star Shine Stage. Besides, thanks to Wang Lan, her entry fee had been halved, so the five hundred thousand she paid was just right for the shortened trip.
Wang Lan, however, left the group and found the members of Camp Three. He was then taken to meet the camp commander, Wu Changfeng.
"Wang Lan, my friend!" Wu Changfeng greeted him enthusiastically, pulling him into a hug. "Back so soon? What’s up? A huge haul?"
"The haul was significant, Brother Wu," Wang Lan replied. "But I have some urgent intelligence for you. Have you ever heard of Magical Martial Artists?"

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Lottery Can’t Earn as Fast as Collecting Rent
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 128: Lottery Can’t Earn as Fast as Collecting Rent
"A Magical Martial Artist? How would you know about Magical Martial Artists? You’re just a student!"
Wang Lan hadn’t expected Wu Changfeng to be unfazed by the mention of a Magical Martial Artist, but rather shocked that he himself knew about them.
"I... am a special operative of the Tianjian Bureau! It’s perfectly logical and reasonable for me to know about Magical Martial Artists," Wang Lan replied, choosing his words carefully, his tone as even as possible to avoid provoking the man before him, who had a penchant for transforming and streaking at a moment’s notice.
But Wang Lan had miscalculated.
"BANG!" Wu Changfeng slammed his hand on the table. "What? You joined the Tianjian Bureau? The Tianjian Bureau dares to poach someone from our Martial Arts Corps?"
"Wait a minute!" Wang Lan raised his hand.
"When did I become a member of the Martial Arts Corps?"
"Someone the Martial Arts Corps has its eye on! Is there a problem with that?" Wu Changfeng narrowed his eyes slightly, scanning Wang Lan back and forth as if reading a barcode. "That’s not right! Kid, with your qualifications, how could the Tianjian Bureau possibly notice you?
The Tianjian Bureau claims to recruit only the elite. They require splendid achievements, rock-solid qualifications, or a recommendation letter penned by a powerful individual at the Galaxy Stage or above. Otherwise, those below the Star Cloud Stage shouldn’t even think about it.
You only awakened as a Star Martial Warrior a few days ago. How could the Tianjian Bureau let you join? Just the year before last, that kid Ren Xingwu couldn’t even get his application approved when he wanted to transfer to the Tianjian Bureau. You, kid... where do you get the gall?"
"Wu, I don’t like hearing that," Wang Lan pouted slightly, a touch of disdain in his voice.
Back then, Wang Qianfeng had to coax and threaten me into joining. Why do you make me sound so worthless?
"Have you ever been on a real battlefield? Not a trial field with docile Exotic Beasts and detailed maps, but a real battlefield where enemies can appear at any time. Have you achieved anything on a battlefield?"
"I have the Phoenix Form," Wang Lan replied coldly.
"Uh... have you reached the Star Cloud Stage? And at least possess top-tier strength within the Star Cloud Stage?"
"I have the Phoenix Form."
"You... you don’t have any real internship experience; you’re still a student. You haven’t even attended university or undergone military training. You haven’t met even the most basic requirements of the Tianjian Bureau, have you?"
"I have the Phoenix Form!"
"Can you say anything else besides that? Is that your only reason?"
Wu Changfeng hopped in frustration.
Why can’t you understand my intentions? We in the Martial Arts Corps have considered you a sure catch for ages! The plan was to let you mature for another couple of years, maybe go to university or something. Damn it, the Tianjian Bureau moves too fast! Did they pick the peach before it was ripe? No, the Tianjian Bureau definitely broke the rules. I must report this!
"Is this reason not enough?"
"Enough, my ass! Tell me, what’s wrong with the Martial Arts Corps that you’d run off to the Tianjian Bureau? Huh? Have we brothers not treated you well enough, or is our Corps Leader an outsider to you?"
"That’s not what I mean... It’s just that joining the military is inconvenient, isn’t it? I still have to attend school. If I join the military, won’t my studies be neglected? The Tianjian Bureau is great. I have a nominal position there, so I don’t need to go to work and can still attend school as usual. Plus, the Tianjian Bureau has branches all over the country. In the future, wherever I go, I can check in with the local Tianjian Bureau..."
"The Tianjian Bureau sweet-talked you, didn’t they? How is joining the military inconvenient? Don’t you know about military registration? Besides, we soldiers can even study abroad. How could you not attend school?
Wait a minute! You haven’t really been fooled, have you? That won’t do. I have to talk to our Corps Leader about this. We can’t let the Tianjian Bureau snatch away a talent like you."
"No, joining the Tianjian Bureau was my own choice. Wait, I almost forgot the important matter."
"Your affiliation *is* the important matter!"
"Is my affiliation more important than the issue with the Magical Martial Artists? Are you sure?" Wang Lan blinked at Wu Changfeng, who backed down under Wang Lan’s gaze.
"You tell me."
Wang Lan took out a blue potion from his backpack. "We’ve already obtained reliable intelligence. The appearance of Magical Martial Artists is linked to Demon Clan spies, and a potion is what triggers their transformation.
Until now, we hadn’t obtained a sample of the potion. We unexpectedly obtained this sample during our training in the intermediate trial field. This is the potion for Magical Martial Artists.
I’m telling you this so you’ll be vigilant during security checks. If you find this potion, detain the person immediately."
"Got it. I’ll pass the message on immediately. Stay right here. This business with you isn’t over. Wait until I’ve briefed the others, then we’ll continue this discussion," Wu Changfeng said, turning to leave. "Get Old One and Old Six for a meeting..."
Stay put? He had to be joking.
The moment Wu Changfeng wasn’t looking, Wang Lan zipped out of the office with a WHOOSH, disappearing in a few flashes.
Back at the entrance, Jiang Xinyu and the others were also emerging one by one around the same time. In terms of gains, Xie Sisi benefited the most. With so many Soul Beads absorbed at once, she, who had just broken through to the early Star Shine Stage, unexpectedly broke through again to the mid-to-late Star Shine Stage, nearly catching up to Wang Lan’s cultivation level.
Although Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu didn’t reach the middle stage, they were only a step away.
Having just broken through, the limiters on their Star Power were still very stable. Never mind three thousand Soul Beads; even five thousand would hardly be enough to trigger two consecutive breakthroughs.
The only thing they couldn’t accept was that Wang Lan had absorbed three thousand Soul Beads yet still hadn’t broken through to the Star Cloud Stage.
Sensing a hint of disdain in Xu Xiangwen’s gaze, Wang Lan knew this guy was probably itching for a beating again.
Can I help it? My breakthrough method is different from yours; I’m frustrated too!
Besides, Wang Lan wasn’t short on skill points; he was short on experience points.
The Star Martial Warrior Competition had propelled him to Star Shine Five. After this trip to the trial field, his experience bar was only at eighty percent for Star Shine Five. Star Shine Five required fifty thousand experience points, and Star Shine Six would need sixty thousand... Thinking about these astronomical figures, Wang Lan wanted to wail.
He had gained three thousand skill points. He allocated one thousand to his Phoenix Form. Adding these to the nearly three thousand skill points he’d earned before, he upgraded several Basic Skills to silver nine and still had three thousand skill points remaining.
This trip to the trial field had made Wang Lan thoroughly rich.
After exiting the trial field with Jiang Xinyu and the others, Wang Lan quickly got into his car and started the engine.
Just as he was about to shift gears, the car phone rang.
"Xinyu, what’s up?"
"What’s going on with you? Why do I get the feeling you’re running for your life?"
"Whoa, you’re too perceptive! How did you even notice that?" Wang Lan broke out in a cold sweat; he had indeed been thinking of making a quick getaway.
"Lanzi, have you forgotten that Xinyu can reproduce a painting perfectly after just one look? Her eye for detail is like a camera," Gong Feiyu’s voice came through the phone.
"Actually, it’s nothing. Didn’t I run into some acquaintances this time? They were just too enthusiastic. If I hadn’t left quickly, I would have had a hard time getting away today."
"Are you sure you haven’t done anything bad?"
"Do I look like that kind of person?"
"Never mind that, where are we hanging out tonight?" Xu Xiangwen asked urgently. After every joint operation, they would pick a place to eat, drink, and have fun.
"How about we switch to Eastern Heaven Gate this time?" Gong Feiyu asked.
"Fine! If we stay out late, we can crash at Wang Lan’s place. He’s got plenty of rooms."
"Agreed!"
"Everyone go home and freshen up. We’ll meet at six o’clock this evening at Eastern Heaven Gate, Suzhou Central Plaza."
"I..." Xie Sisi’s hesitant voice came through the phone.
"No refusals! Be there on time. And no, I’m not taking you home; you’re coming straight to my place. I have plenty of clothes. It’s settled!"
VROOOM—
The engines roared. Four cars sped onto the opposite highway, vanishing over the horizon in an instant.
Wang Lan didn’t go home but drove directly to the Tianjian Bureau headquarters in Suzhou City.
Upon reaching the seventh-floor Intelligence Department, Wang Lan first went to the assistant’s office by the entrance. "Is Director Wang in today? Is he available?"
"Little Junior Brother, you haven’t been here in a while! Director Wang is in his office; you can go right in."
A long time?
Wang Lan calculated; it had been less than two months.
KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK.
"Come in!"
Wang Lan entered the office. Wang Qianfeng was at his desk writing. He briefly glanced up at Wang Lan without much concern. "Well, look who it is. Did the sun rise in the west today? What brings you to the bureau? Don’t tell me you’ve found some important intelligence again?"
Wang Lan walked to the desk and stood at attention.
"Director Wang, I’ve confiscated a vial of Demonic Transformation Potion and have come to turn it in."
SNAP—
Just like that, a sheet of calligraphy practice was ruined.
Wang Qianfeng looked up, staring intently at Wang Lan. His eyes seemed to ask,
Are you messing with me?
Wang Qianfeng’s earlier remarks had just been casual teasing. Everyone knew Wang Lan had been busy with school for the past month or so. He had just finished his final exams, and the holidays had only started a few days ago. Where would he find the time to uncover any clues?
He was merely grumbling that Wang Lan never visited the Tianjian Bureau unless he had specific business, acting as if he weren’t part of the Bureau at all. He hadn’t expected Wang Lan to actually live by the principle of "never visiting a temple without a cause."
"What did you say? You confiscated a Demonic Transformation Potion? Where did you confiscate it from? What trouble have you stirred up this time? Why don’t I know anything about it?"
Wang Qianfeng fired off a rapid series of three questions.
Wang Lan took the blue potion out of his pocket. "This should be the Demonic Transformation Potion. On the third day of the winter vacation, my classmates and I went to the intermediate trial field."
As Wang Lan recounted the events, Wang Qianfeng’s expression became increasingly strange, then almost mournful.
Is this kid even human? The first time he went to the primary trial field, he discovered a Demon Clan base and their conspiracy. The second time he entered a trial field, a Magical Martial Artist practically delivered themselves to him, and he even managed to seize the Demonic Transformation Potion! The importance of the Demonic Transformation Potion is self-evident; it’s the most vital clue to understanding the origin of Magical Martial Artists. Headquarters in the Imperial Capital issued an order to find the source of the Magical Martial Artists at all costs and eliminate them completely. That order came down a week ago. I’ve sent out all my best agents, and so far, not a single one has reported any progress. And now, you just casually hand me the Demonic Transformation Potion? Am I supposed to be surprised? Or just shocked speechless?
"You must be one of destiny’s chosen, aren’t you? With luck like yours, it’s a shame you don’t buy lottery tickets..." After a long moment, Wang Qianfeng finally let out a sigh full of complex emotions.
"Director Wang, you’re joking. Why would I buy lottery tickets? Collecting rent is much faster money."
These words... they make me want to kill someone! What am I supposed to do?
Still, deep down, I have to agree with Director Wang. I really have been chosen by destiny. Isn’t the system in my mind called the Destiny System?

chapters.title: Chapter 129 The S-class Star Martial Skill Sales Area is a Redundant Feature
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 129 The S-class Star Martial Skill Sales Area is a Redundant Feature
"Director Wang, if there’s nothing else, I’m heading back. I’ve got plans to hang out with some friends tonight and relax."
"Wait! Come with me to see the Bureau Chief."
"The Bureau Chief is looking for me?" Wang Lan asked, a hint of nervousness in his voice.
Wang Qianfeng looked at Wang Lan as if he were looking at a fool. "What are you thinking? You’re going to report to the Bureau Chief about the great achievement you’ve made again."
"Couldn’t you report it yourself?"
"It’s good for you to show your face in front of the Chief more often."
Wang Lan wasn’t truly foolish, and he got the point immediately. When navigating bureaucracy, the most important thing was to ensure your superiors kept you in mind—to be the first to come to their thoughts in favorable situations. To achieve that, you had to make your presence felt often.
Following Wang Qianfeng to the Bureau Chief’s office, Wang Qianfeng straightened his collar before knocking on the door.
"Intelligence Division, Wang Qianfeng, reporting an issue."
"Ah, Feng, come in."
Lu Zhao, wearing his reading glasses, was vigorously writing at his massive desk. The desk, as large as a ping-pong table, was crammed full of various documents.
Lu Zhao was actually quite old, with his fully white crew cut and a skinny but spirited frame.
Looking up and seeing Wang Qianfeng followed by Wang Lan, his face broke into a smile. "Don’t tell me this lucky mascot of yours has done another great service?"
Lucky mascot? Surely, he doesn’t mean me?
Wang Lan thought, his expression unchanging as he slightly lowered his head, grumbling inwardly.
"The Chief is indeed wise." Saying so, Wang Qianfeng placed the blue potion on Lu Zhao’s desk. "This is the Demonic Transformation Potion seized by Wang Lan."
Lu Zhao’s expression briefly froze, not much different from Wang Qianfeng’s initial reaction, but his composure was much better.
"What’s going on? Where did it come from?"
"Wang Lan, come here and report to the Chief."
"Yes!" Wang Lan stood at attention. "Reporting to the Chief, this subordinate found these in the intermediate trial ground of Taoyuan District, following a conflict with a group of Star Martial Warriors. They were seized from their possession. This subordinate also personally witnessed one of the Star Martial Warriors injecting themselves with this potion, after which they became a Magical Martial Artist."
Then, Wang Lan repeated his encounter in the trial grounds.
After everything had been said, Lu Zhao slowly stood up and approached Wang Lan, looking him up and down. After a while, he suddenly pointed at Wang Lan and began to laugh with Wang Qianfeng.
"Ah, Feng... This guy is our koi fish, and you are our discerning eye. I’m impressed by this kid’s luck. If he were to find several gold rings just by tying his shoelaces on a walk, I wouldn’t be surprised."
"Chief, luck is just a small part of it. Even if luck comes, it still requires the eyes to discern it. This time, Wang Lan was the first to discover the Demonic Transformation Potion and successfully disarmed the enemy. His contribution is indispensable."
"Hahaha... You and your coddling of the young! You think I’ll let this kid be shortchanged? Alright, regarding those Star Martial Warriors, their identities, and where the Demonic Transformation Potion came from, you’re responsible for investigating thoroughly."
"Yes! I will get to the bottom of this and leave no stone unturned."
"Good. Keep the potion here; I will have the relevant experts analyze it. You two may leave now."
Leaving Lu Zhao’s office with Wang Qianfeng, Wang Lan felt relieved.
Wang Qianfeng didn’t say anything, nor did Wang Lan ask. He drove away from the Tianjian Bureau, and Wang Lan went home for a comfortable bath. After changing his clothes, it was almost time to head out.
The Eastern Heaven Gate was right outside his doorstep. Wang Lan walked there. He had just arrived at the square when he saw three luxury cars slowly pulling into the roadside parking spots.
Four people got out of the cars, and the sight of Xie Sisi brightened Wang Lan’s eyes immediately.
Xie Sisi, dressed up with care, was as stunning as a TV star, especially with her tall frame and a pair of long, straight legs. Those legs captured all of Wang Lan’s attention.
The moment their Simu occurred, Wang Lan quickly looked away and went up to greet the group.
If one were to ask who was more beautiful, Xie Sisi or Jiang Xinyu, it would naturally be Jiang Xinyu. With her good genes and careful nurturing from a young age, both her appearance and temperament were impeccable.
Perhaps because Wang Lan was too familiar with her, he didn’t really feel anything. But if he took a closer look, he nearly couldn’t resist Jiang Xinyu’s charm.
Xie Sisi and Wang Lan had not been acquainted for long, which made her seem even more attractive to him.
Even though Xie Sisi was brought home by Jiang Xinyu, Wang Lan was sure that the clothes on Xie Sisi were definitely not Jiang Xinyu’s. The size was clearly off.
"I’m telling you, you guys are amazing. At this hour, you still managed to get a spot on the ground?" Wang Lan, knowing he’d been caught stealing glances at Xie Sisi, quickly changed the subject.
"Pfft, it’s not a big deal! Just find some cars with phone numbers, make a call, and with five thousand bucks, you get a parking spot in minutes," Xu Xiangwen laughed, making light of it.
