Xu Shiyun quickly went forward to check. Only after a while did his expression improve.
"It won’t die, but it’s close. It’s connected to the Demonic Transformation Potion. If it dies, you’ll be taking another demerit."
"No—" Xu Shiyun’s expression suddenly changed drastically. "There’s someone underground—"
"Not good—" Lige’s roar, almost simultaneous with Xu Shiyun’s cry, rang out. In an instant, Lige violently pushed Wang Lan away.
Wang Lan’s body was suddenly lifted off the ground. At the same instant Lige pushed him, an electric arc barrier flickered around Lige. Suddenly, a streak of lightning shot out from underground; a Thunder Sword pierced Lige’s back, skewering him in mid-air. Another Thunder Sword impaled the fallen Crow on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 Indeed, Being Too Handsome Is Unreasonable
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 136 Indeed, Being Too Handsome Is Unreasonable
BOOM—
A figure burst up from underground, zipping past Lige in a flash and heading straight for Wang Lan.
At that moment, Wang Lan’s body was still suspended in mid-air. If it weren’t for Lige’s swift push, that Thunder Sword would have pierced Wang Lan.
Although Wang Lan might not have died, he had to acknowledge that Lige had saved him.
In a split second, Wang Lan activated his phoenix form. At the same time, a woman with flowing black hair wearing a moon-white mask charged at Wang Lan’s face.
Wang Lan’s Flame Sword, three feet long, swung down at the woman.
WHOOSH—
Like a comet bursting before everyone’s eyes, the woman brushed past Wang Lan.
Then the woman transformed into lightning, soaring into the heavens, and in the blink of an eye, she vanished into the high sky. The night was ink-dark, and the woman’s presence suddenly disappeared as if she had broken through space and left this world.
"Chase her!" Xu Shiyun roared furiously. "The duck was already cooked, how could it still fly away?"
"Don’t chase!" Wang Lan suddenly bellowed in a deep voice.
Xu Shiyun halted abruptly. "Wang Lan, what’s wrong? How are you?"
Wang Lan turned around woodenly. A deep, bone-exposing wound on his chest made Xu Shiyun gasp.
"That woman has at least mid-Galaxy Stage strength. We just exchanged blows. My injuries should be about the same as hers, but I’m not sure how badly she’s hurt. Such an expert can only be dealt with by a few directors. If you go after her, you’re seeking death."
Before their very eyes, Wang Lan’s wound quickly began to heal.
"Lige! Lige!" Just as Wang Lan’s injuries fully healed, he heard Xu Shiyun’s voice.
"Wang Lan, hurry, save him!"
Wang Lan quickly went to Lige’s side, placing both hands on Lige’s chest. Without Wang Lan, this wound meant certain death for Lige. There was a palm-sized through-and-through wound in his chest, the internal organs within directly melted away.
But with Wang Lan there, it wasn’t a big problem.
However, as soon as Wang Lan pressed his hands down...
Damn it, something doesn’t feel right.
Those pectoral muscles... quite large!
An odd expression crossed Wang Lan’s face as he carefully examined Lige. Impeccably handsome features. A buzz cut, thick, dense eyebrows... Besides being handsome, there was a hint of androgynous beauty.
How can a man be so good-looking? How can a man be even more handsome than me... With all that wrapping, won’t they get deformed?
As these thoughts flooded his mind, he looked up to see Xu Shiyun’s anxious expression.
Having discovered this secret, should I tell Xu Shiyun? Does Xu know?
After a moment’s hesitation, Wang Lan decided to beat around the bush.
"Xu, didn’t you find him annoying? Why do you care so much about him? Don’t tell me you’re secretly in love, despite being at each other’s throats on the surface?"Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Screw off! My orientation is normal, and I’m already married, for crying out loud! Lige has a complicated background; anyway, his file in the Bureau is confidential. If he dies, we’ll all catch hell for it. Besides, although I don’t like the guy, we’re all comrades-in-arms. When facing external enemies, I’d still trust him to watch my back. Stop dawdling! How is he? Is there still hope?"
"Trust him to watch your back? You bending over to pick up soap or what?" Wang Lan muttered.
"Screw off!" Xu Shiyun instinctively lifted his hand but didn’t dare to strike, afraid of disturbing Wang Lan’s treatment.
"Don’t worry, he won’t die," Wang Lan said, withdrawing his hands and slowly standing up. "But I’m low on Star Power. I can only manage organ and internal tissue repair. How about giving me a Soul Bead?"
"Left in a hurry, didn’t bring any," Xu Shiyun replied. "Since he won’t die... if he won’t die, then never mind." He very practically called over a team member, "Take Captain Li to the hospital."
Two men swiftly carried Lige away from the scene.
Xu Shiyun, his face dark, approached Crow’s body. Crow’s head had been completely scrambled by a Thunder Sword. With the brain damaged so severely, even Spiritual Engraving couldn’t retrieve any information.
Xu Shiyun sighed deeply. When he turned around, he saw Wang Lan seemingly searching for something on the ground.
"Wang Lan, what are you looking for on the ground?"
"The assailant’s blood."
"Blood? The assailant is from the Demon Clan, what use is finding their blood..." But in that instant, Xu Shiyun’s expression stiffened.
Right, that figure just now was human. Magical Martial Artists have the Demon Clan pulling strings behind them, so I subconsciously attributed the mastermind to the Demon Clan. But who said it must be the Demon Clan? Couldn’t there be human traitors? If it were the Demon Clan, they should have transformed into demons during the sneak attack.
"She’s not from the Demon Clan? She’s a human traitor?" Xu Shiyun asked, approaching Wang Lan.
"I can’t be certain. But when the Demon Clan replaces our people, they can even replicate the DNA encoding. Whether she’s Demon Clan or a human traitor, finding her blood might help determine her identity through DNA matching. Crow has been silenced; we can’t let this clue die, can we?"
Soon, Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin from the Action Department arrived.
"How’s the situation?"
"Director Wang," Xu Shiyun reported, "we had just apprehended the target when an assassin-type expert suddenly arrived. She could completely mask her presence, approaching silently without a trace. I was using Earth Sensing at the time and also employing an Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill. But the assailant not only avoided my Earth Sensing, she also passed casually through my Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill. Not only did she silence the target, but she also severely wounded Lige. Even with Wang Lan activating his Phoenix form, we couldn’t hold onto her. We could only see that her figure was that of a woman; nothing else was clear. Wang Lan is already collecting her blood, hoping to identify her through DNA matching."
"A stealth expert!" Wang Qianfeng said to Li Weixin, his brow deeply furrowed. "Three years ago, in Lian City, a stealth expert successively assassinated seven top experts of the Tianjian Bureau. The weakest of those killed were in the late Star Cloud Stage, all taken out in a single blow. Before it happened, there wasn’t a single warning, which threw Lian City into a panic. Later, headquarters dispatched five Star Sea Stage experts, and only then did that person’s killing spree stop. But not even five Star Sea Stage experts could capture that assassin... What you’ve described sounds a lot like that person."
"Old Wang, if it’s him, then this is troublesome," Li Weixin said. "I’ve seen the file on that assassin. He really is capable of absolute silence; even perception-type Star Martial Skills can’t detect him."
"Director Wang!" Wang Lan saluted Wang Qianfeng after finishing his collection, then held up the small vial in his hand. "This soil contains the assassin’s blood. Take it back for DNA matching."
"Good! Hard work. You two stay behind and continue assisting the police with the cleanup. Bring the relevant individuals back to the Tianjian Bureau for overnight interrogation."
"Yes!"
Wang Qianfeng took Wang Lan’s small vial and left. Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun remained to assist the police with the aftermath. Actually, there wasn’t much left to deal with. The fight here had ended, and operations in other locations had concluded much earlier.
The eastern sky showed a streak of white; overnight, everything had settled.
Xu Shiyun sat on a bench at the entrance to the police department’s garden and lit a cigarette. "Damn it, all this for nothing. The police department made a huge haul, but the two of us got nothing out of it."
"Not entirely for nothing," Wang Lan said, more optimistic than Xu Shiyun. "At least we didn’t let Crow escape."
Besides, the system’s reward has already arrived. For me, this was a profitable venture. It wasn’t necessary to capture the Demon Clan spy to complete the mission; striking down their influence was also part of my assignment. Eight thousand experience points and three hundred skill points—isn’t that sweet?
"Damn it, that assassinating woman is really freaky. I didn’t detect her at all," Xu Shiyun grumbled.
"Didn’t you raise an alarm earlier?" Wang Lan remembered Xu Shiyun and Lige both exclaiming a warning.
"That was because I sensed a Star Energy Fluctuation. When there’s a fluctuation, it means a Star Martial Skill has been activated. By the time I noticed it, at such close range, it was too late. Lige was just lucky; he only scraped through because you were here."
"Right, when did Lige show up? When did you first run into him?"
"Last year, I think. Maybe May, or July, August, something like that, I can’t recall," Xu Shiyun began. "The director personally brought him in. That kid was so arrogant! Even with the director backing him, he insisted on going through the Tianjian Bureau’s entrance examination—written and combat tests, the whole lot.
"His solo exam made it seem like everyone else had nothing better to do.
"What a pain in the ass! He already got in through the back door but still put on this ’I don’t want special treatment’ charade. Who was he trying to impress? If he really met the Tianjian Bureau’s standards, he should have presented his resume first to see if he even qualified to join.
"Moreover, with someone personally brought in by the director, who would really be strict with the assessment? Weren’t they just going to let it slide quietly?"
"And that’s why you started to dislike him? Just because he was too arrogant?"
"Not entirely. It was more about how we got along—or didn’t—afterward. You know what I’m like. And he, well, he couldn’t stand my ways. Then we clashed a few times during missions. We were just destined to butt heads. I couldn’t stand his sanctimonious act, and he looked down on my roguish demeanor. So what if a grown man like me is a bit rough around the edges? It’s not like I was a rogue *to him*..."
As soon as he said that, he realized it sounded off, especially seeing the disdainful look on Wang Lan’s face. Xu Shiyun’s expression darkened instantly.
"Are you thinking dirty thoughts again, kid? I’m not that kind of person!"
"Xu, I didn’t say a thing... You’re the one who let it slip."
"Damn it! Are you asking for a beating?" Xu Shiyun immediately jumped up.
"Wait a second!" Wang Lan suddenly shouted. "
I feel like I’ve forgotten something...
"
"What? Did you remember some important clue?"
"No... I think I still have dozens of Crow’s underlings locked up in my basement. In my rush to get over here, I forgot about them. I’ll call Hu Qing to get someone..." With a SWOOSH, Wang Lan vanished.
Hu Qing arrived with a few vehicles and transported the thirty people from the storage room in Wang Lan’s basement. Once everyone had dispersed, the world finally fell silent.
Busy all night, Wang Lan was exhausted. He went back, took a shower, and fell straight asleep.
"Wang Lan. Wang Lan."
"
Huh? It’s vacation, no need to wake me up.
"
"Wang Lan, someone is here to see you."
"
Not seeing anyone!
"
"It’s your colleague."
Wang Lan squinted his eyes open a tiny slit and finally poked his head out from under the covers. "What time is it?"
"Four in the afternoon."
"
This time again? Who is it?
"
"I haven’t seen them before. Do you want me to connect to the camera?"
"Transfer the feed, but don’t turn on the video."
At the elevator entrance, Lige stood ramrod straight in a pristine white military uniform.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Some People Are Naturally Incompatible with the Kitchen
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 137: Some People Are Naturally Incompatible with the Kitchen
Wang Lan didn’t feel uneasy about discovering Lige’s secret. After all, it was Wang Lan who had healed Lige’s extensive burn injuries last time.
However, last time it was a skin burn, and the system might have considered the skin as a whole without regional distinction. By touching Lige’s face, Wang Lan could conduct Star Power to Lige’s entire skin.
This had spared the awkwardness of having to touch every inch of Lige’s body; otherwise, Wang Lan would have discovered Lige’s secret last time.
After curing Lige, Lige hadn’t specifically come to express thanks. This sudden visit left Wang Lan somewhat puzzled.
Could it really be a visit to seek redress?
After getting up and freshening up, Wang Lan then asked Xiao Ai to open the elevator for her to come in.
When the elevator door opened, Wang Lan had just settled down at the small table on the balcony, brewing a cup of black tea and enjoying the afternoon sun.
Most people who visited Wang Lan’s home for the first time would take an extra glance at his huge living room. However, Lige didn’t; she merely glanced around before fixing her gaze on Wang Lan on the balcony.
She walked over directly. "Mr. Wang Lan, sorry for the intrusion and disturbing your rest."
Her tone was quite polite.
Wang Lan returned a mild smile. "We’re all colleagues; there’s no need for such formality. Just call me Wang Lan. Please, take a seat, Captain Li."
"Thank you."
"Would you like something to drink?"
"Black tea."
Wang Lan had Xiao Ai bring over another cup of tea, fragrant and aromatic. Lige was a person of refined taste. Her posture while holding the teacup was graceful, and her movements as she sipped the tea were aesthetically pleasing.
"Did Captain Li come to tell me something?"Follow current novels on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"I came especially to express my thanks. Last time it must have been you who healed my injuries, and this time you saved my life again."
"Ha... there’s no need for thanks. We are colleagues, after all, and it’s all part of the job. Besides, I’m just moonlighting as a medic, aren’t I?"
"That may be true, but you did save my life. Also, I want to apologize for an earlier offense."
"Offense?" Wang Lan was confused.
"It was the day you came to report for duty. I shouldn’t have presumptuously assumed you were late without asking. Nor should I have judged you for not participating in the standard assessment, thinking that you were only placed in the Tianjian Bureau through backdoor channels.
You possess powerful medical abilities, and even your combat abilities are not too shabby. Someone with your talents indeed deserves exceptional recruitment. Mr. Wang Lan, I sincerely apologize to you."
"It’s been so long; I’d already forgotten about that." Wang Lan lifted his teacup and took a small sip.
"In that case... I’ll take my leave," Lige suddenly stood up, speaking somewhat abruptly.
From the moment she stepped in, Wang Lan had sensed her stiffness. In fact, he had known her purpose from the first sentence she spoke.
A special visit to say thanks? What a joke. If it really were just to say thanks, she should have done it last time. If she came up with such an excuse, the real reason must be quite embarrassing for Lige to speak of.
And from the moment she sat down, Lige hesitated several times, as if wanting to speak but then stopping. This made it clear to Wang Lan what she really wanted.
He couldn’t understand why it couldn’t be straightforward. Did women always have to be so affected when handling matters?
Lige turned and left quietly.
"Captain Li, I won’t tell anyone about your identity, rest assured."
Lige’s footsteps halted abruptly, but Wang Lan could distinctly feel that at that moment, Lige’s tensed body suddenly relaxed.
"Thank you!"
"May I be so bold as to ask? The Tianjian Bureau has many female colleagues, and in the Star Martial Warrior’s world, there’s hardly any distinction between male and female. Why do you choose to be this way?"
"It’s related to my family. My clan is a bit old-fashioned, and their ideas... are even more so."
"Alright then!" Wang Lan shrugged, uninterested in other people’s private affairs.
「At the Tianjian Bureau, the laboratory’s test report was also out.」
"Director Wang, the DNA match results are in. The DNA in this bloodstain belongs to a person named Li Mingxue, but this Li Mingxue was declared dead eight years ago. Along with Li Mingxue’s team, a total of thirty-two people died; their bodies were never found."
"Was it a confirmed death or a disappearance?"
"It was a disappearance at first. A month later, their deaths were confirmed."
"Are Li Mingxue’s records still available?"
"We’ve checked. Coincidentally, Li Mingxue was a shadow assassin back then. Her stealth ability was particularly unique. Her Innate Ability was the Heart of Nature, allowing her to perfectly blend her aura and body with the surrounding environment.
However, her recorded abilities were not as strong as they appear to be now. If she truly is the killer who hunted our Tianjian Bureau colleagues in Lian City three years ago, her progress over these eight years has been too rapid. She wasn’t even at the Star Cloud Stage when she disappeared. Furthermore, aside from her Innate Ability, her other talents weren’t considered particularly high."
"That means this isn’t the original her; she must have been replaced by the Demon Clan. And from this analysis, I can draw a conclusion," Wang Qianfeng said calmly as he paced to the window.
"What is it?"
"That unresolved mystery? At the time, Chang Yu had clearly been replaced by the Demon Clan, but we couldn’t detect it from her DNA. Even if the Demon Clan has an advanced civilization, they still belong to a different dimension. Their civilization might not overlap with ours.
Some of their methods seem like myths to us, and our technology might appear the same to them. Theoretically, it should be impossible for them to deceive our sophisticated detection instruments.
Ever since Chang Yu’s incident, I’ve been thinking about this. Later, I learned from Chang Yu’s colleagues that there had been no signs of abnormality before or after. Think about it: Chang Yu was a nurse, and a very skilled one at that.
Don’t underestimate nurses; giving injections and setting up IV drips are technical tasks. After the Demon Clan replaced Chang Yu, they managed to blend perfectly into her life without arousing suspicion, even from those who were around her day and night.
I believe that the Demon Clan’s method isn’t just simple replacement, but fusion.
You know about insects, right?"
"Of course."
"What’s the difference between an insect’s larva and its adult form?"
"Insects undergo complete metamorphosis. To the outside world, it seems larvae grow into adults. However, the reality is that the adult lives parasitically inside the larva. The larva continuously eats to nourish itself, but in truth, these nutrients become sustenance for the adult developing within.
Until one day, the adult consumes the larva completely and then emerges from its body. What’s called ’breaking out of the cocoon’ is, in fact, leaving behind the larva’s corpse. If insects had human consciousness, the larvae would live in constant fear and pain."
"So, Director Wang means the Demon Clan are the adults, and the people they replace are the larvae? Before the Demon Clan ’break out of the cocoon,’ the person is still human, but their thoughts and will have been controlled by the Demon Clan? They are like Trojan horses, with the Demon Clan hidden inside them?"
"Does this explanation have any persuasiveness?" Wang Qianfeng asked with a touch of dark humor.
"From a scientific perspective, this is impossible. But the Demon Clan themselves aren’t exactly ’scientific.’ Or, as Director Wang said, what’s unscientific in our eyes could be perfectly logical to them.
Likewise, our science might seem nonsensical to them. For instance, the Demon Clan can’t create nuclear bombs. They probably think that something as powerful as a nuclear bomb shouldn’t be within the grasp of a seemingly weak life form like ours."
"So, technology is our last resort. Perhaps when human science reaches even greater heights in the future, we can use it to eradicate the Demon Clan entirely."
"Let’s hope so. Then... is there still value in pursuing Li Mingxue’s lead?"
"The outlook is bleak. If the Demon Clan really infiltrates in this way, it will be tough to detect them with technology. If they lie dormant, we will be very passive."
"I will report this to the Academy of Sciences and hope they can develop a targeted detection device. If this theory is correct, we could potentially scan their genetic codes. Insect genetic codes inherently contain this kind of metamorphic encoding; it’s their way of survival."
"Mm, thanks for your hard work."
"It’s all for the Jade Country!" The other person saluted sharply and then turned to leave.
「New Year’s Eve, the last day of the year.」
Early in the morning, his aunt called and asked Wang Lan to come over for the family reunion dinner. In the afternoon, Wang Lan arrived at his aunt’s house; for a change, she wasn’t at the company and was home.
It seemed that his aunt’s product had reached a critical juncture. Ever since a few days before New Year’s Eve, she had been leaving early and returning late every day. If Song Jia hadn’t recently made new friends, she would have revolted by now.
Wang Lan adeptly changed his shoes and entered the living room, finding his aunt bustling about in the kitchen. As he took a closer look, thick smoke billowed throughout the kitchen.
"Auntie, don’t force yourself! In this day and age, not knowing how to cook is okay. Just don’t hurt yourself."
"No! I only cook once a year. Surely, I, a Ph.D., can’t be defeated by this? Don’t come over; I can handle it!"
"Are you sure? Then I’ll open a window for you."
"Okay..."
Wang Lan took another step back, then turned back and said, "Auntie, please give it a rest. What if the neighbors think our house is on fire and call for help? It’s New Year’s; the firefighters deserve to celebrate too. Besides, didn’t you already book a restaurant for the reunion dinner?"
"But it’s still the New Year; you need a sense of ceremony. Even if I only make one dish, it’s made with my own hands. The recipe for Cola Chicken Wings looks so simple. How did it get burnt? The recipe must be wrong."
"I agree. Turn off the stove, and let’s air it out for a bit." Wang Lan calmly opened the windows in the living room, kitchen, and bathroom.
His aunt couldn’t cook, and neither could Wang Lan’s mother.
Perhaps it was genetic. Those who can cook learn it easily, but for those who can’t, entering the kitchen often leads to one disaster after another. Wang Lan had learned how to calmly handle such ’crash scenes’ since he was a child.
After helping his aunt tidy up, Wang Lan washed his hands. "Where’s Jiajia?"
"She’s upstairs."
Wang Lan went upstairs and gently knocked on Jiajia’s door.
"Who is it?"
"It’s me!"
"The T-virus is rampant! Level S alert! For the safety of the refuge, the shelter will not be opened!"
"The alert has been lifted. Report complete."
CLICK! The door opened, and Song Jia, wearing cute bunny pajamas, pulled Wang Lan into the room and quickly closed the door.
"Wang Lan, why are menopausal women so stubborn? Don’t they have any self-awareness about their cooking skills? They insist on making a fuss like this, and it’s the same every year, no improvement whatsoever."
"Is that any way to talk about your mother?" Wang Lan tapped the girl’s head.
"Quick, play VR games with me. It’s no fun playing alone."
"Games are so boring... How about we work through some practice problems?" Wang Lan suggested excitedly.
Song Jia dramatically fell backward. "Oh my goodness... What kind of people are in my family...?"

chapters.title: Chapter 138 The Strange Relationship between my Aunt and the Teacher
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 138 The Strange Relationship between my Aunt and the Teacher
After messing around with Jiajia for a while, suddenly, a car horn blared from outside.
Wang Lan was standing by the window on the second floor when an extended Huadragon luxury business car slowly approached.
"Do we have visitors today?" Wang Lan stepped out onto the balcony. The luxury car came to a stop in the parking area outside his aunt’s villa. The door opened, and an elderly man with a full head of white hair stepped out.
The old man looked very old, at least in his seventies or eighties. He held a cane with a dragon head made of pure gold and was dressed in a light grey suit, his leather shoes polished to a shiny black.
His silver hair was meticulously combed, and the gold-framed glasses on his face made him look extraordinarily refined and learned.
From every angle, this old man’s identity was clearly anything but ordinary.
It was already New Year’s Eve. And at this time of year... Auntie apparently had no idea someone was going to visit. Just a moment ago, she was still in her casual clothes, conducting her "witch’s chemistry experiments" in the kitchen. If she had known someone was coming, she definitely wouldn’t have been dressed like this.
At that moment, the driver’s door opened, and a heavily made-up woman leaned out. She wore a black women’s suit with her hair casually draped over her shoulders and a short skirt that showed off her long, slender legs.
The woman supported the elderly man step by step to his aunt’s front door, then reached out and pressed the doorbell.
"Who is it? Come on in—" His aunt’s voice rose from downstairs.
"Teacher?" Suddenly, his aunt exclaimed in surprise from downstairs.
"Qi Qi, it’s been over a decade, hasn’t it?" the old man’s vigorous voice sounded from downstairs.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Teacher, please, take a seat here!" His aunt’s tone was very polite and respectful, but Wang Lan sensed a hint of distance in it.
If it were truly her teacher, her tone would likely be more casual, more intimate. But her voice carried a heavy formality, which made Wang Lan quite curious. Moreover, he had never heard his aunt mention having a teacher in Suzhou City. The car at the door had a Suzhou license plate.
"Time flies; more than a decade has passed. The world has changed, and people are not what they once were. The naive and romantic young girl from those days has now become a renowned scientist and entrepreneur, celebrated both at home and abroad. Seeing your accomplishments today brings me great comfort, Teacher..."
"You flatter me, Teacher! Aren’t you the same? In the past ten years, you’re the one who has changed the most. You’re an internationally renowned scientist with achievements spanning multiple fields, including biology, chemistry, and medicine. You’re also a globally recognized entrepreneur and the founder of Senma Pharmaceutical, a Fortune 500 company."
"I heard that this year you made it onto the Forbes list of billionaires. Congratulations, Teacher..."
"As you know, making money isn’t my interest. My passion remains in research. Making money simply provides me with better conditions to carry out that research. The events of twelve years ago were painful memories that neither of us wishes to recall. I don’t want the same thing to happen again."
"Teacher, if you don’t wish to recall them, why bring them up now?" His aunt’s voice turned cold.
Wang Lan frowned slightly. After a moment’s hesitation, he patted Song Jia on the head. "I’ll go down and keep Auntie company."
From those few sentences, it was clear the old man’s intentions weren’t good. Auntie was alone downstairs and seemed vulnerable. Wang Lan felt it was necessary to go down and sit by her side, to lend her some support. An individual’s presence, though invisible and intangible, might not seem like much on its own. But if one or two people stand by your side, the atmosphere changes completely. Isn’t that how it is in the movies? A boss walking alone on the street looks destitute, but if he’s followed by two henchmen, his aura is entirely different.
As Wang Lan slowly descended the stairs, a piercing gaze instantly fell upon him.
Wang Lan looked up alertly. The gaze came from the professional-looking woman.
Average people don’t have such a sharp look. This woman was a Star Martial Warrior! Wang Lan made this determination in an instant. Moreover, her incisive gaze held a strong aggressiveness. It wasn’t hostile, but rather like she was assessing prey upon seeing him.
Wang Lan continued downstairs unperturbed. He walked over to his aunt but remained standing, staring instead at the woman beside the old man.
"Miss, do you know me?"
"No, I don’t!" The woman withdrew her gaze, her voice indifferent.
"But your eyes tell me you do," Wang Lan’s voice was soft, yet his assertiveness was undeniable.
In fact, he really wanted to add, ’It doesn’t matter. I’ll remember you. You’d better watch out.’ However, those words were too provocative, so Wang Lan held back.
"Xiaoxue, mind your manners," the old man reprimanded, his face dark and his voice cool.
Then, looking at Wang Lan’s aunt apologetically, he said, "This is my niece. And this young man is...?"
"My nephew. My sister’s son. I’ve never heard you mention having a niece, Teacher..."
"And I’ve never heard of your sister having a son," the old man said with a smile.
"Teacher, aren’t you going back to have a reunion dinner with your wife today? You must have something important to discuss, coming to me at this time. Please, speak your mind."
"My wife passed away seven years ago, Qi Qi. I know you’re researching the genetic coding left by Zifeng. However, genetic technology is a very sensitive subject. Without the protection of authoritative experts, it can easily come under public attack and face resistance from the populace."
"I appreciate your concern, Teacher, but I’m not worried about this. Besides, the gene coding I’m researching isn’t a taboo subject."
"You’re still so confident! What do you think of my abilities, then?"
"Of course, Teacher, your abilities are beyond question. In the fields of biology, chemistry, and pharmaceutical chemistry, you are an undisputed top scientist. Over the past ten years, I have read all the papers you’ve published and learned a great deal from them."
"If we join forces, I believe we can overcome all technical difficulties within three years and make this technology truly benefit all of humanity. What do you think?"
His aunt seemed to have anticipated this. No surprise showed on her face, only a faint shake of her head. "I have faith in myself and my team."
"Fifty billion!" The old man suddenly leaned forward and whispered the number. "I’ll contribute fifty billion for only a fifty percent stake."
That number made even Wang Lan, who had never cared much for money, feel his heart skip a beat. Fifty billion Jade Coins! What did that even mean? The valuation of the world’s top company was only three trillion. Although Auntie’s Jiayi Biotech Company had some fame in Suzhou City, in the grand scheme of Jiang Province, it was merely an insignificant small company, let alone on a national or global scale. Fifty billion was enough to build a Fortune 500 company. Fifty billion... that might be the entire worth of Senma Pharmaceutical.
Completely bewildered, his aunt looked at the old man. "Are you planning to trade the entirety of Senma Pharmaceutical for fifty percent of my shares?"
"I’m getting old. What would I do with more money? I’ve told you before, making money is just to facilitate my continued research. If it allows me to participate in research I’m interested in, no amount of money is too much."
"I’ve brought the contract. If Senma Pharmaceutical and Jiayi Biotech merge, we will change the future of humanity and lay the foundation for biotechnology. Is there anything more meaningful than that? Xiaoxue, bring the contract for Wang Qi to see."
"There’s no need." His aunt shook her head lightly. "Although your offer is very tempting, Teacher, Jiayi Technology is mine and Zifeng’s. I won’t part with any fraction of the shares. Not fifty percent, not even one percent. I’m sorry, but I must decline your kind offer."
"Won’t you reconsider?" the old man asked, frowning deeply.
"I won’t. I’m sorry."
"Well... alright then." The old man stood up, patting non-existent creases on his clothes. "It’s a shame. Since that’s the case, I’ll take my leave. However, I still hope you will reconsider. I’m getting old. After I die, the shares I hold will be yours."
"Don’t you have a son, Teacher?"
"I made a will long ago. After I die, all the money I’ve earned will be donated to the state. Wealth must be created with one’s own hands. If they can’t even support themselves, giving them money would only lead them to a more degenerate life."
"You’ve always been honorable and principled, Teacher!"
"No need to see me out; my car is right at the door." Leaning on his cane, the old man walked away step by step. His aunt stood smiling at the doorway, watching the luxury car depart.
Once the luxury car turned the corner and disappeared from sight, the smile vanished from his aunt’s face. With a cold expression, she returned to the living room and sat down on the sofa.
"Auntie, do you... have a conflict with that old gentleman?"
"No! I still respect him very much." His aunt’s expression was calm. She leaned against the sofa and sighed deeply. "His name is Ma Bo. He was my PhD supervisor."
"Back then, he was guiding just me and your Uncle Zifeng. He’s a very talented person, just not very tactful, and his words often offended people."
"Later, that incident happened. The experimental equipment malfunctioned, and an explosion occurred in the laboratory. Your Uncle Zifeng... died in the experiment. Devastated, Teacher also left the university and established Senma Pharmaceutical."
"After Teacher left, I also completed my studies, and we lost contact. By the way, Teacher’s Senma Pharmaceutical is also developing an anti-cancer drug. It seems to have completed clinical trials and will be launched after the New Year."
It seemed to him that the relationship between his aunt and Ma Bo was more than just a business rivalry.
"That’s all. What more could there be? Stop asking. Anyway, right after New Year’s, Jiayi’s biological coding technology will be launched. Then, my treatment will fundamentally solve cancer, and his drug won’t stand a chance against mine."
"Alright then! But... that woman with him... I felt there was something off about her."
"What was off about her?"
"She’s a Star Martial Warrior! While it’s not strange for a businessman to have Star Martial Warriors as bodyguards, this woman... I just feel she has a very strong aura. She doesn’t seem like one of those Star Martial Warriors who grew tired of fighting and chose to return to city life."
"You’re just a student. Why are you so suspicious? Instead of worrying about things that don’t concern you, you should be thinking about your college entrance exam in a few months."
"Your mother was admitted to the Imperial Capital Star Martial Academy. My standards for you aren’t that high. I don’t expect you to get into Imperial Capital Star Martial Academy, but you should at least get into one of the top four Star Martial Academies."
"That’s ’not asking for much’?" Wang Lan cried out, his eyes wide. "The top four Star Martial Academies are ranked equally. What’s the difference?"
"There are differences. They differ in location, teaching methods, and style. With so many variations, there’s bound to be one that suits you."

chapters.title: Chapter 139 Something has happened
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 139 Something has happened
All-night revelry, all-night fireworks, all-night wishes.
New Year’s Eve is just one night, and the arrival of the New Year is also just one night.
With only a slight ripple in the heart, the first day of the New Year arrived.
On the first day of the New Year, most shops and businesses would close. This phenomenon, unique to Jade Country, demonstrates the country’s devout dedication to this festival.
However, entertainment venues were not among those closed. After all, wouldn’t everyone off work want to play? Normally so busy and hardworking, why not have a great time during the New Year?
Cinemas, theme parks, and amusement parks became the best destinations for those staying in Suzhou City to celebrate the New Year.
Wang Lan originally didn’t plan to go out, but Jiang Xinyu called inviting him to hang out. After giving it serious thought, Wang Lan couldn’t bear to refuse. He felt guilty about standing her up so many times over the past six months.
When he met up with Jiang Xinyu, Jiang Xinchen was walking towards him, arm-in-arm with Jiang Xinyu.
"Huh? Why is it just you two? Where are Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu?" Wang Lan asked in confusion as he approached. The group of four usually went out together, and those two were always especially keen on hanging out, typically the first ones to arrive.
Even the girls, who needed to get ready, had arrived earlier than them.
Could those two still be sleeping in?
Jiang Xinchen looked at Wang Lan with a face of despair, covering his forehead heavily. In Jiang Xinchen’s impression, Wang Lan was a genius with off-the-charts intelligence. But it seemed geniuses couldn’t escape one universal law: extremely high IQ, but pitifully low EQ.
And this seemed especially pronounced with Wang Lan, whose thought processes were astonishingly unique.
"They both have to go to their relatives’ houses for New Year greetings, so they’re busy," Jiang Xinyu said calmly, handing over a cup of milk tea she had just ordered for him.
"Thanks," Wang Lan took the cup casually. "So, where do we go on the first day of the New Year when hardly any place is open? Even if I go shopping with you, there’s nowhere to really go, right?"
"Why don’t you guys go watch a movie?" Jiang Xinchen suggested. "There’s a sci-fi blockbuster from White Eagle Country that just got released, and a mythology film from West India Country has good word-of-mouth."
Movies, huh...
Wang Lan used to work in the movie industry in his past life. But after coming to this world, it was as if his soul had been affected along with his body. He seemed uninterested in anything fictitious.
He rarely watched TV and almost never saw movies. He used to use the excuse of having to relentlessly study to complete tasks, but now, Wang Lan had come to terms with himself. It was just an excuse; he simply didn’t like that kind of entertainment, which didn’t seem to offer any real help in life.
Wang Lan loves studying... Damn, why does no one believe it when I say it?
"Xinyu, what do you think?"
"Since we have nothing better to do... let’s just watch a movie. Xinchen, go buy three tickets."
"Two. I have a gathering with classmates soon, so I’ll be leaving shortly," Jiang Xinchen said, winking at his sister.
This kid is teachable!
Jiang Xinyu was satisfied.
"School starts again in just over ten days... In less than three months, the Provincial Martial Arts Tournament will take place. Three years of effort are about to be put to the test."
"I’ve always heard the Provincial Martial Arts Tournament is more important than the college entrance exams. But from the official information I gathered, it seems like just an annual competitive event organized by the Ministry of Education for third-year high school students. Is it the same nature as the annual autumn sports meet?"
"That’s what is publicly claimed, but it’s not really the case. Star Martial Academies from all over will send special inspectors to all twenty-five provinces to observe and evaluate the strength and potential of the participating students.
If they take a liking to you, thinking you might have talent, they’ll send you an invitation to enroll."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lan immediately understood.
So, it’s just like getting a direct admission offer!
"The reason it’s considered even more important than the college entrance exams is that the Four Great Star Martial Academies will also send inspectors. As you know, these academies do not recruit new students every year.
If their discretionary admission quota is filled, they won’t admit students through the standard examination process that year. If we’re unlucky and they don’t recruit externally this year, no matter how well we do, it won’t matter.
Moreover, these academies have a quirk: they either all recruit together or none of them recruit at all. So, if your goal is one of the Four Great Star Martial Academies, you must participate in this Provincial Tournament."
"I’ll participate if I have to. Why are you telling me this so solemnly?" Wang Lan was relaxed, but Jiang Xinyu’s serious expression made him feel somewhat uncomfortable.
"You’re only at the Star Shine Stage! Almost everyone who dares to compete in the Provincial Tournament is a top fighter from the third year of high school in cities across Jiang Province. Not to mention others, for dominant cities like Tong City, Zhen City, and Jin City, their ten-person representative teams are almost entirely comprised of Star Cloud Stage experts."
"It shouldn’t be a big problem, right? I’m not just any Star Shine Stage practitioner, and the number of Star Cloud Stage experts who’ve died at my hands is more than one or two. Are you perhaps feeling too much pressure? You need to remain calm to perform consistently."
"The pressure is indeed great! My goal is to get into one of the Four Great Star Martial Academies. But it’s incredibly difficult to be admitted. Every year, they only accept one thousand students. With so many hidden dragons and crouching tigers among the nation’s senior high school students, picking just one thousand from among so many experts is daunting.
Moreover, many real geniuses receive invitations very early on. There might not even be three hundred spots left in the Four Great Star Martial Academies. Thinking about the terrifying elimination rate, I’m not feeling confident at all."
At that moment, Jiang Xinchen came running back, four tickets in hand, thrusting them into Wang Lan’s. "My classmate just called me, I’m off—"
"Wait, why are there four tickets?"
"For you and my sister. Two people, two movies, four tickets. Any problem?"
"Two movies?"
Looking at the ticket times... a blockbuster lasts two hours, and there’s only a ten-minute interval between the two movies, both of which are visual effects extravaganzas. Isn’t this just asking for us to watch until we puke?
"Lan, Sis, I’m off! Have fun!" Jiang Xinchen waved goodbye, leaving Wang Lan feeling somewhat duped.
"The movie is about to start. Let’s go," Jiang Xinyu said.
"Mhm!" Jiang Xinyu responded softly, her cheeks blushing, looking very cute.
The cinema was crowded, perhaps because entertainment was quite scarce on the first day of the New Year. Just as they sat down, Wang Lan’s phone buzzed with a barrage of messages.
DING-DONG—
DING-DONG—
Jiang Xinyu sat next to Wang Lan, holding a tub of popcorn. With a gentle toss of her head, her loose hair wafted a delicate fragrance as it brushed past Wang Lan’s nose, causing his heart to stir unexpectedly.
In the dim cinema, Wang Lan turned to gaze at Jiang Xinyu’s profile. It seemed like a very long time since he had taken a close look at this girl he had known since childhood, whom he had practically grown up with. She was no longer the girl with the ponytail who liked to wear floral dresses from his memory.
DING-DONG—
Wang Lan pulled out his phone, only to see a message from Xu Xiangwen.
"Lanzi, save me, please... I’m so bored... Someone, please come... Keep this poor kid company..."
"Lanzi, are you at home? I’m dying of boredom... Feiyu was taken out by a girl. It’s the first day of the New Year! What’s the point of studying? Let’s go have fun, my treat! Whatever you want to do, I’ve got it covered..."
"Lanzi, say something! If you don’t, I’ll take that as a yes. I’m coming to your place right now. Let’s go for barbecue, fishing, or even clubbing if you’re up for it."
As he read each message, Wang Lan’s expression grew increasingly strange.
Jiang Xinyu, with her keen senses, had noticed Wang Lan secretly watching her.
Is this blockhead finally getting a clue?
she had thought, a thrill of pleasure shooting through her. But her joy was short-lived; barely three seconds passed before he was engrossed in his phone, his expression growing increasingly bizarre.
"What’s up? The movie’s about to start."
"Didn’t you say Xu Xiangwen was going to his relatives’ place and wouldn’t be hanging out with us?"
"Ah? What happened?"
Wang Lan placed his phone in front of Jiang Xinyu. "He’s on his way here."
"He’s always like this every year." Jiang Xinyu snatched Wang Lan’s phone and immediately sent Xu Xiangwen her location.
Xu Xiangwen had just stuffed a bunch of things into the trunk of his car: fishing rods, barbecue gear, a flashy leather coat. He hadn’t even started the car when his phone chimed.
Finally, a response! I thought you’d disappeared on me.
When he saw the location details, his brows furrowed...
Weilong Cinema? Doesn’t that kid Wang Lan never watch movies? Would he go to a cinema by himself?
A crisp cracking sound suddenly echoed in his heart, as if he had chipped a tooth.
Heavy-hearted, he replied to the message.
"You’re at the cinema watching a movie? With whom? Little Song Jia?"
"With Xinyu. Just the two of us. Are you still coming?"
CRACK— SNAP—
Xu Xiangwen’s heart shattered on the spot.
In his mind, he could almost see a chibi version of Wang Lan laughing triumphantly.
Single dog... single dog... single dog...
WAAAH! Xu Xiangwen collapsed onto the steering wheel, wailing!
So lonely... so alone... so bored...
DING-DONG—
Just as Jiang Xinyu was about to return the phone to Wang Lan, another message popped up. It was a text from Xie Sisi.
"Wang Lan, Happy New Year! What are you doing?"
The corners of Jiang Xinyu’s mouth curled up in a rare smile. Her thumbs quickly danced over the phone, and a message flew out.
"I’m watching a movie with Xinyu; it just started."
Far away, Xie Sisi, dressed in beautiful new clothes, was twirling in front of the mirror. Her phone rang, and she quickly picked it up. After a glance, the light in her eyes slowly dimmed.
"Sisi, aren’t you going out with your classmates today?" her mother asked, puzzled to see her daughter changing out of her going-out clothes.
"Not anymore..."
The movie was very exciting; at least, the laughter in the cinema never seemed to stop. Wang Lan’s assessment?
It was okay.
After back-to-back movies, their butts were a little numb. Coming out of the cinema, it was already two o’clock in the afternoon. Jiang Xinyu, walking ahead, looked very excited, her steps in high heels resembling those of a prancing fawn.
"Xinyu, are you playing a prank? The way you’re walking is making me uneasy." Wang Lan understood Jiang Xinyu very well; his knowledge of her was comparable to that of her own younger sister. They had been classmates for nine years and had known each other for fifteen.
"Shall we go eat?" Jiang Xinyu immediately changed the subject.
"I’ve been hungry for a while. I thought you weren’t."
At that moment, Wang Lan’s phone rang.
"Wait for me, I need to take this call."
The call was from Song Jia, and Wang Lan casually answered.
"Wang Lan, come quickly! Mom was taken away by the guards..." Song Jia’s voice broke into sobs. "Hurry!"
"Jiajia, don’t cry. What happened?"
"Just now, lots of guards came... They took Mom away," she sobbed again. "I’m so scared..."
"Stay at home. I’m coming right away."
Hearing Wang Lan’s words, the smile on Jiang Xinyu’s face vanished. "Wang Lan, what’s wrong?"
"Not sure yet. You drove here, right? Take me to Fragrant Courtyard Bay."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"Okay!"

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Your Reaction Is a Bit Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 140: Your Reaction Is a Bit Off
Arriving at Fragrant Courtyard Bay, Wang Lan hadn’t even gotten out of the car when Song Jia rushed out from her house. She threw herself into Wang Lan’s arms. "Wang Lan, what should we do? My mom has been abducted... WAH WAH WAH... I’m so scared..."
"Don’t worry. Tell me, who abducted your auntie?"
"They were dressed in security uniforms... They showed some badges after coming in... and then... then Mom was taken away by them..."
"Was your aunt taken by force, or did she go willingly?"
"Mom... Mom went with them willingly."
"Did they put handcuffs on your aunt?"
"No... No!"
Once Wang Lan had the details, he dialed Hu Qing’s number.
"Hello, Brother Wang Lan, Happy New Year."
"Hu Qing, I need to ask you something. Was my auntie arrested by the police?"
"Your auntie? Ms. Wang Qi?" Hu Qing asked hesitantly.
"Yes!"
"I haven’t heard anything about it. Hold on, let me call the station and confirm."
After Hu Qing hung up, Wang Lan’s expression instantly darkened.
Almost instantly, Wang Lan recalled the visit from Senma Pharmaceutical the previous afternoon. The negotiations had failed yesterday, and today his aunt had been arrested—could Senma Technologies be behind this?
While he was speculating, Wang Lan’s phone rang. He hurriedly answered, and Hu Qing’s voice came through.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"Wang Lan, I can assure you, the Suzhou City police did not arrest Ms. Wang Qi today. Ms. Wang Qi has a significant profile; she’s a listed entrepreneur in Suzhou City. An arrest of Ms. Wang Qi wouldn’t be carried out so casually."
"Are you sure?"
"I’m positive!"
"Got it, thanks."
After hanging up, Wang Lan’s heart instantly clenched. If the police had genuinely taken her, Wang Lan wouldn’t have been overly concerned. But if it wasn’t the police, or if someone was impersonating them, then it was a serious matter.
Suddenly, Wang Lan felt a gaze directed at him. He quickly looked toward the source. The gaze shifted away instantly, and Wang Lan couldn’t see anyone watching him from the shadows.
A sense of alarm rose within him.
"Xinyu, take Jiajia inside."
"Do you need help?"
"No need. You know my strength; don’t worry."
Jiang Xinyu nodded gravely and led Jiajia into the house. Wang Lan pretended to follow them, but as he passed the flowerbed by the entrance, his figure flickered and vanished.
He activated Star Cloud Sword Dance in an instant, transforming into a streak of light as he sprinted towards the suspected ambush position on the opposite side. About two or three seconds later, the other party seemed to notice Wang Lan’s rapid approach.
However, they didn’t immediately try to evade. Instead, they boldly stepped out from the shadows.
With a flash of light, Wang Lan appeared before the person. "Who are you... Wait! Are you... Yao Zhixin?"
Wang Lan’s voice suddenly rose, his face filled with disbelief. Wang Lan recognized Yao Zhixin. He was a member of the Tianjian Bureau’s Intelligence Action Team in Suzhou City.
"What’s going on? Did you guys take my aunt?"
"Brother Wang Lan, I apologize. We were acting under orders."
"Orders? Director Wang’s orders?" Wang Lan’s eyes narrowed as he spoke in a low voice.
"Yes! Ms. Wang Qi is very likely the developer of the Demonic Transformation Potion. We didn’t tell you in order to avoid suspicion. I’m sorry..." Yao Zhixin said, carefully observing Wang Lan, wary that he might suddenly fly into a rage.
But strangely, after frowning for a few moments, Wang Lan’s expression calmed.
The phrase ’to avoid suspicion’ made Wang Lan sense something was amiss. If this had truly happened and Song Jia wasn’t prevented from calling him, he would have known immediately. So, what suspicion was there to avoid?
But Yao Zhixin looked conflicted.
This isn’t going according to the script! Isn’t Wang Lan supposed to have an incredibly close relationship with Ms. Wang Qi? Learning that his closest relative has been captured by his own comrades—shouldn’t he look despairing and furious? Shouldn’t he be grabbing my collar and yelling, ’Why... why... why did you take my aunt?!’ But what’s with the calm expression on his face? He’s completely off-script! How are we supposed to continue with the act now?
Initially, Wang Lan had indeed been agitated. Even if the Tianjian Bureau had taken his aunt, doing so without any forewarning was unacceptable. But ’avoiding suspicion’? That made Wang Lan realize the Tianjian Bureau seemed to be plotting something, and he, too, was a pawn on their chessboard. He had accumulated so much merit—and while one could argue it was for humanity and Jade Country, hadn’t the Tianjian Bureau also benefited? When it came time to turn on him, would they truly disregard all past connections? Right, perhaps I, Wang Lan, am just insignificant, not worthy of their concern for my feelings. But Wang Qianfeng was my mom’s former subordinate, left in Suzhou City ostensibly to look after me. And what about my aunt? As my mother’s own sister, wouldn’t Wang Qianfeng look out for her too? The creator of the Demonic Transformation Potion? What a joke. Was Auntie so bored with her comfortable life in Jade Country, where she’s practically a protected species, that she decided to create Demonic Transformation Potions for the Demon Clan? Besides, my mom is the Flame Emperor of the South. Would the Flame Emperor’s only sister betray Jade Country? It’s logically incoherent. Whether analyzed emotionally or rationally, it’s absolutely impossible for my aunt to be involved in anything nefarious. If my aunt isn’t the problem, then the Tianjian Bureau must be... If they truly wanted to hide this from me, Song Jia would never have been able to make that call. Knowing the Tianjian Bureau’s methods, such a contradictory oversight was impossible. Therefore, there could only be one reason they hadn’t told him earlier. To infuriate me?
"Uh, Brother Wang Lan, are you alright?"
"I’m fine! What’s up?"
"Don’t you want to know why we suspect Ms. Wang Qi is the creator of the Demonic Transformation Potion?"
"Sure, I do! But didn’t you say I needed to avoid suspicion? So? You can tell me now?"
"She’s already been apprehended; whether you need to avoid suspicion is no longer important." Saying this, he pulled out his phone and opened a few photos. "Look, these are from clinical trials at Jiayi Biotech Company. These patients are all in the late stages of cancer, undergoing Jiayi Biotech’s gene-coding treatment. The cancer was indeed effectively suppressed, but look at their bodies."
In several clear, enlarged images, the patients’ bodies showed distinct signs of mutation, a mutation that resembled the carapaces formed during demonization.
"Moreover, when we extracted the molecular formula of the gene potion Ms. Wang Qi submitted to the Pharmaceutical Supervisory Bureau, we found it was ninety percent similar to the Demonic Transformation Potion you provided. This is definitely not a coincidence."
After listening to Yao Zhixin, Wang Lan nodded in agreement. "Indeed, it’s not a coincidence. What a clever frame-up. Thankfully, you acted quickly. If you had been any slower, and the other party had managed to stir up public opinion first, then even if my aunt were later cleared of all charges, she would still be a black mark in the public’s mind."
"That’s not... Wang Lan, have you misunderstood our intention?"
"I say, Brother Yao? What kind of mission to provoke me did you accept? Don’t you think playing this kind of push-and-pull game is pretty boring? This is clearly a protective arrest. Do you take me for a fool?"
"How can you be sure it’s a protective arrest and not a genuine one?" A voice suddenly cut in. Wang Qianfeng had appeared beside Wang Lan at some point.
His face was very dark, conveying a sense of suppressed fury he couldn’t unleash.
"Firstly, consider my aunt’s identity. To others, she might just be an ordinary entrepreneur, the founder of Jiayi Biotech. But Director Wang knows that she’s my mom’s only sister. She’s closer to me than any blood relation. As long as my aunt doesn’t collude with the enemy and betray the country, no one would target her."
"But the evidence I possess indicates the exact opposite: that she has colluded with the enemy, and the Demonic Transformation Potion very likely originated from her."
"That’s the second reason it’s impossible! Her status means she has absolutely no reason to betray the country. The fact that clinical trials showed signs of demonization directly eliminates my aunt as a suspect. If she had created the Demonic Transformation Potion, why would she use it in clinical trials? Moreover, the Demon Clan already knows we’ve obtained the Demonic Transformation Potion. If my aunt really were its creator, why would she still submit the gene potion to the Pharmaceutical Supervisory Bureau? If the gene potion were indeed almost identical to the Demonic Transformation Potion, and my aunt was aware of this, wouldn’t submitting the potion be tantamount to a confession? Clearly, this is a frame-up by the Demon Clan."
"What if I told you that the gene potion submitted by Ms. Wang Qi is indeed almost identical to the Demonic Transformation Potion?"
"It would still be a frame-up!" Wang Lan replied calmly.
"And how do you figure that?"
"I’ve already analyzed it!"
"But Ms. Wang Qi doesn’t see it that way." Wang Qianfeng sighed, his hands behind his back. "Ms. Wang Qi stated that she is the only one who knows the gene-encoding formula for her potion. Furthermore, the molecular formula of her gene potion can only be derived using her specific gene-encoding formula, a process that required extensive experimentation. She spent ten years overcoming all the obstacles. So, when I told her about the Demonic Transformation Potion, she... appeared very agitated."
"Agitated?"
Wang Lan’s face showed surprise.
"Yes, agitated!" Wang Qianfeng’s gaze grew exceptionally profound. "Because she said there were only two people who knew that molecular formula—one is her, and the other is..."
"Song Zifeng!"
"Exactly!"
"So you suspect that Song Zifeng is the one producing the Demonic Transformation Potion?" As Wang Lan reached this conclusion, a sharp light flashed in his eyes. "Are you planning to use Jiajia?"
"Song Jia is Song Zifeng’s daughter. My script was already prepared. Our arrest of Wang Qi was intended to cause a break between you and us. Then, since you are Jiajia’s only remaining relative, she would undoubtedly stay with you. We would then create circumstances to lure out Song Zifeng, using Jiajia as bait."
"Isn’t the feasibility of this plan too low?" Wang Lan shook his head immediately. "First, we can’t be one hundred percent certain that Song Zifeng is the one producing the Demonic Transformation Potion. Even if it is him, how can you be sure he has any affection for Jiajia? Moreover, the Demon Clan might have already replaced Song Zifeng. If he has been replaced, he’s even less likely to take the bait. The feasibility is far too low."
"Not necessarily! First of all, Song Zifeng is a great scientist. His value lay not only in the achievements he had made before his presumed death but also in his boundless future creative potential. Do you remember the experimental data you copied after discovering the Demon Clan base during your first entry into the trial grounds?"
"I remember."
"That scientist—would you say he was human or a member of the Demon Clan?"
Wang Lan’s brow furrowed.
Back then, that scientist was killed by a single slap from the rampaging Biochemical Demon General, unable even to attempt an evasion. If he were a Demon Clan member, he wouldn’t have been so vulnerable. Besides, he was in a wheelchair. Clearly, he was a human scientist.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 Suspected Subject
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 141 Suspected Subject
"His name is Xu Yingfei, one of our top human biomedical scientists. He was obsessed with human experiments and had been sanctioned by the law multiple times. Later, he insanely experimented on himself and his family; his wife and daughter both died on his experimental table.
But in the end, he vanished from the face of the Earth. Alive, he was seen no more; dead, his body was never found. If it weren’t for the video you brought back, his whereabouts would still be an unsolved mystery.
Humans truly are complex animals, each with independent thoughts, values, and principles of action. That’s why there are so many scoundrels, degenerates, and beasts among humankind.
Such people have existed throughout history.
Song Zifeng died in an experimental accident, but in the end, we did not find his body either. It may have been disintegrated, or he might still be alive. But one thing can be confirmed.
Suppose the Demon Clan orchestrated that accident, suppose they were after Song Zifeng, suppose the Demonic Transformation Potion was created by Song Zifeng.
One thing can be certain, Song Zifeng would not be replaced by the Demon Clan. Because the value of Song Zifeng lies in his creative worth. If these suppositions hold true, even if he betrayed the whole world, he would still hold some special regard for Song Jia."
"Director Wang, if your assumptions stand, and he has already abandoned his stance as a human being, would he still care about Jiajia?"
"How can we know it won’t work unless we try? But your reaction has been rather disappointing. You didn’t throw a fit or break with the Tianjian Bureau, casting a bit of a shadow over the plan.
You are still one of the Tianjian Bureau’s own, and your identity will make the other side hesitant to act rashly... especially since you are the one who has inflicted great losses on the Demon Clan."
"How about... we have an argument now?"
"Would that make any sense?" Wang Qianfeng said with a cold laugh. "Although you didn’t follow my script, I am quite satisfied with your performance. I underestimated you.
When faced with an emergency, you did not lose your judgment. After learning that it was the Tianjian Bureau that captured your dearest, you didn’t act rashly; instead, you quickly calmed down and immediately derived the conclusion closest to the truth.
You... indeed exceed many others in excellence.
Especially when the evidence fabricated by the Demon Clan against Ms. Wang Qi was overwhelming, enough for us to really arrest her, yet you managed to ascertain almost instantly that it was a frame-up by the Demon Clan."
"She’s my aunt, how could I not trust her?"
"Emotional trust is different from rational trust. The reasons for your trust are solid, and your arguments are meticulous. It’s not just because she’s your aunt.
Alright, you should head back now. Comfort Song Jia; you can tell her Ms. Wang Qi is safe and won’t be in any danger. However, for now, I cannot allow them to contact each other."
"Where is my aunt now?"
"At the Tianjian Bureau! Someone is guarding her around the clock. It’s just that her mood is a bit down right now."
"That assumption might not hold true."
"But she firmly believes that only she and Song Zifeng knew the gene formula, and besides her, only Song Zifeng could have created the Demonic Transformation Potion. If Wang Qi wasn’t so adamant in her belief, I wouldn’t have crafted a plan reliant on assumptions.
I trust her conviction. If that person truly is Song Zifeng, then my bait might just catch the fish, right?"
After parting with Wang Qianfeng, Wang Lan returned to his aunt’s villa. He walked into the living room to find Jiajia asleep on Jiang Xinyu’s legs. Jiang Xinyu was holding up a finger, but Jiajia then lifted her head.
"Brother..."
"Hmm!" Wang Lan approached the sofa, and Jiajia immediately jumped into Wang Lan’s arms, looking up at him with a pitiful expression.
"Jiajia, Auntie is fine; the people who took her away are friends of your brother. Some bad people want to set up Auntie, so your brother’s friends took her away to protect her. Don’t worry, Auntie will be okay very soon."
"Really?" Jiajia lifted her innocent eyes to look at Wang Lan.
"Really! For the next few days, you’ll stay with Brother. Do you want to stay at Brother’s place, or should Brother stay here?"
"Brother should stay here... That way, if Mom comes back one day, I can see her right away..."
"Okay! As you wish."
After escorting Jiang Xinyu to the door, Jiang Xinyu looked worriedly at Wang Lan. "Do you want my family to intervene, help you out a bit?"
"No need; didn’t I just say? My aunt is being protected."
"You think I’d believe what you told a child?" Jiang Xinyu obviously didn’t buy the story Wang Lan told Jiajia.
"What I said is true." Wang Lan revealed a knowing smile.
"Huh?" Knowing Wang Lan as she did, Jiang Xinyu knew that if he was speaking so earnestly at this time, then it must be true. Wang Lan never repeated a joke.
"You just said... the people who took away Auntie Wang Qi were your friends?"
"Ah! They are my colleagues." Wang Lan gestured for Jiang Xinyu to come closer and whispered, "I am a special agent of the Tianjian Bureau. Don’t tell anyone; I prefer to keep a low profile."
At the moment Wang Lan spoke these words, Jiang Xinyu’s eyes widened in shock.
"Really?"
"Of course, it’s true."
"How is that possible... you... when did you?" Jiang Xinyu certainly knew about the existence of the Tianjian Bureau. Not only did she know, but she also understood its nature.
Even when dreaming about the future, she had considered it. Her first choice was to join the military, and perhaps later she might join the Tianjian Bureau. But these were plans for after she completed her education and fully stepped into life.
Jiang Xinyu couldn’t believe it; the thing that was still so far away from her, Wang Lan had already become.
It’s like sitting together making wishes, one says, "I want to become an entrepreneur in the future, to start a company and make lots of money."
The other says, "I already am."
It was that unexpected, that surprising a revelation, that left Jiang Xinyu stunned for a long time, unable to react.
"It was probably after the first time I came back from the trial grounds, so you don’t have to worry too much about me. Of course, don’t tell anyone else. Pretend you know nothing."
"Okay!"Follow current novᴇls on
After seeing Jiang Xinyu off, Wang Lan went back inside to accompany Jiajia.
Right after watching the movie with Jiang Xinyu, he received a call from Song Jia. He hadn’t felt anything due to the prior tension, but now, a strong sense of hunger struck.
"Jiajia, are you hungry?"
"Hungry!" Perhaps knowing that her mother wasn’t arrested by the police for doing something wrong, Jiajia’s mood improved significantly. Only children of her age could be so easily deceived; a few years older, and Wang Lan wouldn’t be able to fool her so easily.
He went to the kitchen and found some ingredients in the fridge. Only during the New Year would his aunt’s fridge have ingredients. Wang Lan was not like his aunt and mother, who just couldn’t bond with the kitchen; he could cook, and he was pretty good at it.
The only reason he always ordered takeout was simple: laziness.
After preparing some food and cleaning up, it had already grown dark outside.
It was too early to sleep, and though Song Jia’s mood had improved a little, she was still very low. Wang Lan simply sat with her on the sofa and turned on the TV.
"Our clinical trials have confirmed that Life Number One can effectively inhibit cancer cells. These three people standing next to me are the results of Life Number One’s clinical trials.
A year ago, their cancer cells had spread throughout their bodies, and they had even lost the ability to eat. After taking Life Number One, their cancer cells were effectively suppressed, and after two months, their cancer cells began to shrink.
Six months later, their physical condition improved significantly, and now, though they still have cancer cells in their bodies, they can live like normal people.
According to clinical analysis, they only need to continue taking it for another three years, and the cancer cells will be completely eliminated. Life Number One is a milestone in the history of human medicine..."
The TV news from Suzhou City was broadcasting the evening news. Mankind had conquered cancer, which was an epoch-making victory for humanity, much like the announcement of the complete conquest of the smallpox virus had once thrilled the world.
Neither Wang Lan nor Song Jia was interested in the news, but when they saw this report, Wang Lan’s hand, moving to change the channel, paused.
Life Number One...
The name Senma Technology flashed through his mind.
Ma Bo was his aunt’s and Song Zifeng’s teacher, and Song Zifeng was still studying under Ma Bo when the incident happened. Although he didn’t know why his aunt was so certain Ma Bo didn’t know about the genetic formula left by Song Zifeng, to Wang Lan, he completely could have had access to it.
Moreover, just yesterday on New Year’s Eve, Ma Bo was still planning to use the entire Senma Pharmaceutical for a deal with his aunt, but today he publicly released Life Number One? And it just so happened that his aunt was taken away by the Tianjian Bureau today.
From every angle, this all seemed like a setup.
His aunt once said, her gene potion, once released, could fundamentally alter the human body. It could quickly cure diseases inherent to the body. It could treat cancer, but it was not limited to just cancer.
If his aunt’s results were made public, it would be a perfect strike against Life Number One. The two were not on the same level at all; Life Number One would stand no chance.
So the contradiction arose: Ma Bo was willing to pay such a high price yesterday, obviously knowing about his aunt’s research results. Yet why release it publicly now? Was it because he knew his aunt had been taken away, or was there another reason?
Could the Demon Clan have framed his aunt for purposes other than diverting the Tianjian Bureau’s investigation?
His brain worked swiftly, countless possibilities colliding in Wang Lan’s head in an instant.
At that moment, the news switched to footage of Ma Bo and a cool female bodyguard at his side.
The camera gave the female bodyguard a fleeting profile shot. But in that moment, a strong sense of familiarity flooded over him.
He might have seen this female bodyguard before.
Otherwise, there wouldn’t be such a strong sense of familiarity.
But Wang Lan was absolutely certain he had not seen her before yesterday. Otherwise, with Wang Lan’s memory, he would definitely remember someone he had met.
The thoughts in his mind continued to collide, hypothesizing that if Ma Bo was the third person to know Song Zifeng’s gene formula, then everything about his aunt being framed fell into place.
But then, why hadn’t his aunt ever suspected Ma Bo, someone so closely involved?
Was it because Ma Bo was willing to pay such a high price for Song Zifeng’s gene formula? But paying such a price didn’t necessarily mean he wanted the formula; what if it was to delay the release of the gene potion, or simply because he saw the potential profits from it in the future?

chapters.title: Chapter 142 More Clues Point to Target
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 142 More Clues Point to Target
The more Wang Lan deduced, the more suspicious he found Ma Bo to be, and by extension, the more suspicious Ma Bo’s bodyguard seemed.
"Brother, I don’t like that man," Song Jia said, noticing Wang Lan hadn’t changed the channel.
"I don’t like him either, but... wait a moment, I’m going to make a phone call." Wang Lan took out his cell phone and dialed Hu Qing’s number.
"Wang Lan, how are things? Did you figure out what’s happening with Ms. Wang?"
"My aunt is fine now. By the way, are you free right now?"
"I’m free; I’m on leave today. What’s up?"
"Could you come over to Fragrant Courtyard Bay?"
"Sure! Just wait for me."
"Jiajia, go watch TV in your aunt’s room. I need to find some information."
Seeing Wang Lan’s serious expression, Song Jia obediently nodded.
Wang Lan returned to his room, turned on his computer, and quickly searched for Ma Bo from Senma Pharmaceutical. Soon, he found many photos of Ma Bo on the web, and in every photo of Ma Bo, the female bodyguard was with him. He printed out these photos. Not long after, Hu Qing arrived outside his aunt’s villa.
Wang Lan welcomed Hu Qing inside. "Hu Qing, I remember you said a woman delivered the Demonic Transformation Potion to Crow. Was it her?" Wang Lan pointed to the printed photos and hurriedly asked.
Hu Qing frowned, studied the photos for a long time, and eventually shook his head. "I’m not sure. The woman had changed her attire and hairstyle, wore heavy makeup, and had sunglasses on. Honestly, if you dress up any woman like that, no one could tell them apart."
"What’s your gut feeling?"
"Gut feeling?" Hu Qing gave a bitter smile. "We can’t identify a person based on a gut feeling."
"Why would you think this woman is the one I saw? I remember the person standing next to him was Dr. Ma Bo, right?" Hu Qing asked, puzzled.
"Yes, and I also suspect that Ma Bo is the developer of the Demonic Transformation Potion," Wang Lan said in a low voice.
Hu Qing inhaled sharply. "Don’t just say things like that! Dr. Ma Bo is a globally renowned scientist, an authority in the medical field, and someone who has made outstanding contributions to the country. You suspect him? Do you have any solid evidence? If not, you absolutely must not voice such a thought."
"Why are you so nervous? I’m just suspicious."
"Suspicion can be very dangerous! Especially now that he has developed Life Number One, which has been verified by the drug regulatory agency as the most effective cancer drug currently available. Do you know what that means? It means all of humanity will remember his benevolence; all of humanity will protect him. Whoever dares to harm him is making an enemy of all humanity."
Wang Lan’s eyebrows knit together slightly; he had thought of that too.
The launch of Life Number One wasn’t just about a simple cancer medication; it was also Ma Bo’s protective amulet. As long as Life Number One existed, Ma Bo couldn’t be touched haphazardly.
"Wang Lan, what evidence do you actually have to suspect Ma Bo? And please, don’t mention ’gut feeling’ again."
"My aunt was protectively arrested by the Tianjian Bureau."
"Huh?" Hu Qing looked at Wang Lan in surprise.
"The reason given was that the Gene Potion she developed was actually the Demonic Transformation Potion, and cancer patients treated with her Gene Potion began showing signs of Demonization. The Gene Potion and the Demonic Transformation Potion are ninety percent similar. Someone clearly framed my aunt by swapping her Gene Potion with the Demonic Transformation Potion. And then yesterday, on New Year’s Eve, Ma Bo personally visited my aunt, offering to exchange the entirety of Senma Pharmaceutical for fifty percent of the shares in Jiayi Biotech Company. My aunt refused at the time... but this morning, incidents of patients experiencing Demonization during clinical trials occurred. How could it be such a coincidence? And today, New Year’s Day, Life Number One is released."
"According to my aunt, Jiayi Biotech’s Gene Potion fundamentally cures inherent human conditions. It can treat cancer, but it’s not limited to just cancer. Life Number One requires three years of treatment. A month’s treatment costs one hundred thousand. That’s one point two million a year, and three point six million over three years. People diagnosed with cancer have often already spent all their money. Where would they find another three point six million for treatment? The Gene Potion, with just a single dose, changes human genetics and eliminates defective genes by leveraging the body’s own immune system. If cancer could be recognized and repelled by the immune system, cancer cells would be nothing."
"Business competition is common, so I wouldn’t normally be suspicious. But the timing of these events is too coincidental; it forces me to suspect him."
Wang Lan’s words made Hu Qing frown deeply. "Now that you say it, I suddenly remember something. While interrogating one of Crow’s men, he confessed to loan sharking and had locked up about ten people in the countryside. Among them were a woman and child, taken after the winter vacation started. He claimed Crow ordered their kidnapping. Only after rescuing them did we learn that the woman’s ex-husband was a researcher at Jiayi Biotech Company—your aunt’s company."
"Ex-husband? What’s his name?"
"Qian Qihan. He was constantly busy with work and neglected his family, so his wife couldn’t take it anymore and divorced him last November. We weren’t sure why Crow wanted them—the mother and daughter—kidnapped, and we planned to look into it after the New Year. But now that you mention it... could Qian Qihan have been the one who swapped the Gene Potion with the Demonic Transformation Potion at Jiayi Biotech?"
"It’s possible. If we add your information, then it all starts to make sense. Crow is directly linked to the Demonic Transformation Potion. He must have kidnapped Qian Qihan’s wife and daughter to coerce him into swapping the potions, thereby framing my aunt. Framing my aunt would also serve Senma Pharmaceutical’s agenda. Their Life Number One could then reap enormous profits for years."
"If that’s the case, what do you plan to do? Ma Bo is no ordinary person. We can’t just arrest him, nor can we investigate him directly. If we stir up public opinion, we’ll be in serious trouble."
"We don’t have to touch Ma Bo, but we can make a move on his female bodyguard. Suppose Ma Bo is the human traitor who developed the Demonic Transformation Potion and is collaborating with the Demon Clan. Then, wouldn’t the Demon Clan assign someone to monitor him constantly? Look, no matter the occasion, that female bodyguard is always right beside him. If the Demon Clan were monitoring Ma Bo, she’s the most likely candidate."
"What do you intend to do? Arrest her?"
"Verify! Let’s check this woman’s identity and home address."
Hu Qing and Wang Lan acted separately, pulling out their mobile phones and beginning to search their respective network systems. This era had that advantage: the rise of smartphones allowed people from various departments to access their internal information systems at any time.
Soon, Wang Lan and Hu Qing found the female bodyguard’s identity. Ma Xiaoxue. Her official record states she’s Ma Bo’s niece and a graduate of Shenxing Bodyguard Academy—just an ordinary person.
From this, Wang Lan was certain there was definitely something suspicious about her. Their previous eye contact had convinced Wang Lan she was definitely a Star Martial Warrior. That meant the information he’d found was falsified.
"At Jinghua Manor, Building Thirty-two, Room 2706," Hu Qing reported, having found Ma Xiaoxue’s home address.
"Right now, Ma Bo is at the launch event for Life Number One, and it will be fully available starting tomorrow morning. So, Ma Xiaoxue should be with Ma Bo, not at her apartment."
"Let’s search her apartment," Hu Qing said, his face showing eagerness.
"Wait a moment." Wang Lan quietly left the room and opened the door to Song Jia’s room. Song Jia had been in there for a while and had already fallen asleep in bed, still in her day clothes and without having bathed.
