Wang Lan gently lifted Jiajia, tucked her under the covers, and then tiptoed out of the room.
"Did you bring your police uniform?"
"No, but I have my work ID. Why?"
"Just bring something to prove your identity to avoid any unnecessary misunderstandings. That’ll be fine. Let’s go now."
The two quietly left the house. They had gone no more than fifty meters when a plainclothes agent from the Tianjian Bureau appeared by the roadside. Wang Lan knew that from today onwards, his aunt’s villa would be under twenty-four-hour surveillance and protection by the Tianjian Bureau.
"Wang Lan, where are you going this late?"
"I have some theories I need to verify. Please look after Jiajia’s safety. If she wakes up before I return, please comfort her. I’ve left her a note; you can show her your credentials to earn her trust. Thank you for your hard work."
"What do you need to verify? Can’t we do it for you?"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"I’ll go. You can track my location through my phone. You can also report this to Director Wang."
"Understood. Be careful."
Wang Lan held a special status in the Intelligence Department, earned through his many concrete achievements. It was fair to say the entire Intelligence Department had immense trust in him. Although Wang Lan leaving in the middle of the night deviated from the plan, his colleagues wouldn’t stop him. Naturally, they would report it to Wang Qianfeng.
Currently, Wang Qianfeng was sitting opposite Ms. Wang Qi, trying to console her. Wang Qianfeng and Wang Qi had known each other for a long time and understood each other well.
"Ms. Wang Qi, is there a possibility that a third person knows about this? Are you sure only you and Song Zifeng knew?"
"That day, when I found out I was pregnant, Feng was so overjoyed he was practically bouncing off the walls at home. He was too excited to sleep all night. After finally dozing off, he suddenly sat bolt upright, opened his laptop, and wrote down that formula. Even he didn’t fully understand the formula himself; it was merely a hypothesis. At that time, Feng and I had already completed our graduation theses, and this was the intended direction for our future research."
"Feng was a cautious person. At that time, he was having some academic disagreements with his professor, so he wouldn’t have shared such an important hypothesis with him. He was very self-assured and was determined not to discuss this potentially groundbreaking formula with anyone until he could prove it himself. Because I was pregnant, he didn’t let me participate in the experiments. He had already contacted a new laboratory and was planning to make a significant breakthrough after graduation to celebrate the birth of our child."
"He was supposed to be on leave that day, but his professor called him to the university to complete an important experiment. Unexpectedly... the accident happened."
"Was that lab incident truly an accident?" Wang Qianfeng asked in a low voice.
"My sister personally sent people to investigate; it really was an accident. The equipment had malfunctioned more than once or twice before, but the university refused to repair it. Previously, it had only resulted in power outages. No one expected that particular experiment to cause an explosion."
"Could it be..." Wang Qianfeng began to ask, but his phone rang, interrupting him.
"Hello?"
"What? Wang Lan went to verify some theory? That kid..." Wang Qianfeng was about to scold but suddenly stopped himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 143 Brushing Past Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 143 Brushing Past Each Other
If it were someone else like Wang Lan, Wang Qianfeng would definitely accuse them of being unorganized and undisciplined. But with Wang Lan, Wang Qianfeng didn’t dare to. Just think about what Wang Lan had accomplished over the past six months... This guy always seemed to bring you huge surprises when you least expected it.
Last time, in the middle of the night, he went to Penguin Corporation and rounded up an entire elite spy group from the Demon Clan for Wang Qianfeng.
This time... could there be another major breakthrough?
Reason told Wang Qianfeng it was impossible; Wang Lan wasn’t really the Chosen One, and nobody could be that lucky all the time.
Yet emotion kept bombarding Wang Qianfeng’s reason, telling him to stop being so rational. Think about Wang Lan’s discoveries over the past six months. He was just that lucky. He was just that unscientific.
They rode in Hu Qing’s car, heading straight for Jinghua Manor.
Jinghua Manor was considered a high-end estate in Suzhou Park, evident from the greenery of the residential area. In lower-end estates, the buildings were usually tightly spaced, with sunlight often blocked by the row of tall buildings in front. Having six hours of sunlight would be considered good.
In contrast, the buildings in Jinghua Campus were spaced at least eighty meters apart, and even buildings side by side were more than fifty meters apart. There were car lanes and bike lanes surrounding each building, with charging stations, carports, vending machines, and medicine cabinets scattered throughout the estate.
As Hu Qing walked, his eyes scanned the estate, a look of longing faintly emerging on his face.
"The average price per square meter in this estate must be over fifty thousand, right?" Hu Qing said softly with a sigh.
"It was fifty-five thousand at launch, and that was four years ago. Now it must be seventy or eighty thousand."
"You investigated this as well?" Hu Qing was curious. How could Wang Lan respond so readily to his casual remark? And Wang Lan wasn’t just guessing; he at least knew the opening price.
"When this estate was launched, my financial advisor had urged me to invest in two buildings here. I found the return a bit slow, so I passed on it."
"A nearly fifty-percent increase in four years is slow to you?"
"Where do you get the kind of investment that doubles in value every year?"
Hu Qing fell silent... That was quite disheartening.
They entered the building and took the elevator straight to the 27th floor. After getting into the elevator, their expressions grew serious.
As soon as the elevator doors opened, they were on high alert. Room 2706 was a west-facing unit, and they approached the door. "Hu Qing, sense if there’s anyone at home first," Wang Lan instructed.
Hu Qing immediately emitted a faint Star Energy Fluctuation around him, the Star Power conducting through the ground. After half a minute, Hu Qing shook his head.
"It’s empty!"
"Unlock it!"
CLICK— A sound of unlocking rang out, but it wasn’t from the door in front of Hu Qing; instead, a unit door behind them opened.
A young girl wearing a white down jacket and cute bunny ear muffs walked out of her home.
The girl was startled by the sight of Wang Lan and Hu Qing. "Who are you...?"
"Mr. Cui? You live here?" Hu Qing exclaimed in surprise.
"Uh? Are you... a parent of a student?"
"I’m Hu Feifei’s brother, Hu Qing. My sister is in your class."
"Oh! I remember you now, you’re Feifei’s brother who’s a security guard! Hello, I’m glad to meet you. What are you guys doing here...?"
"It’s like this. We’re on official duty. This is my colleague. A resident of room 2706 is suspected of a major crime, so we’re here to investigate. Do you know anything about this family?"
"I don’t really know them. I’ve lived here for three years, but I’ve never seen anyone from that household. In fact, it’s possible that the owner bought the place and never came. You might be making a wasted trip here."
"You haven’t seen them in three years?"
"Not once, not even once... If there’s nothing else, I need to head out..." Mr. Cui said with a cute smile.
"Ah, sure, sure..."
Hu Qing watched as Mr. Cui got into the elevator, and only reluctantly took his eyes off her when the elevator doors closed.
"She’s pretty indeed. If you’re interested, don’t wait; a girl like that must have lots of suitors."
"Heh... A girl of her caliber, could a poor security guard like me even think about it?"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"You’re a Star Martial Warrior, what are you afraid of? Don’t Star Martial Warriors have an advantage over ordinary people?"
"Enough talk, let’s unlock the door." Hu Qing placed his hand on the lock, Star Power surged, and the lock was trashed.
Locks, since their inception, have always been to deter gentlemen, not villains. If someone truly wants to open your lock, not even a safe can withstand forced entry.
The door opened, revealing a dimly lit room. It was clear that no one had been there for a long time; even the sofa was covered with a dust cover.
Did we really come for nothing?
Wang Lan thought with a sinking feeling. If the occupant truly hadn’t lived here, or hadn’t been here for a long time, obtaining hair or other samples for DNA identification would be challenging.
The houses in Jinghua Manor were all fully furnished, and everything was clean when handed over to the owners. As the two stepped in, their feet disturbed a thin layer of dust on the floor, leaving faint footprints behind them.
"I’ll go check the bathroom for any fallen hair," Hu Qing said.
"Okay!"
Wang Lan then turned towards the kitchen. All the necessary cookware and the stove were present, and they didn’t look brand new, indicating they had been used at least once. In the large kitchen stood an upright refrigerator and a chest freezer.
Suddenly, Wang Lan noticed something unusual. The refrigerator was plugged in and still running. Normally, if a place was long unoccupied, the owner would turn off the power, not just to save on electricity bills but also for safety reasons.
Wang Lan opened the refrigerator, and his expression changed instantly.
Inside were all sorts of organs. Although the fridge wasn’t packed full, there were at least five or six livers, hearts, and the like.
What kind of bizarre taste does Ma Xiaoxue have?
He closed the refrigerator and opened the freezer beside it. As soon as the freezer was opened, Wang Lan felt utterly sickened.
Inside the freezer, dismembered human parts were piled up. There were arms, legs, and what appeared to be human rib racks, neatly trimmed. Considering the organs in the refrigerator, Wang Lan suddenly felt his stomach churn.
At this point, how could he not be sure that something was wrong with Ma Xiaoxue? He picked up his phone and dialed Wang Qianfeng’s number.
"Hello, Wang Lan, did you find something?" Wang Qianfeng asked eagerly on the other end.
"Director Wang, I’m currently in the home of Ma Bo’s female bodyguard, Ma Xiaoxue. Her refrigerator is full of human organs, and her freezer is crammed with human hands and feet. She feeds on humans."
As Wang Lan spoke, his Adam’s apple kept bobbing.
He had killed before, but processing a human like food and stuffing them into a freezer was a scene that deeply disturbed Wang Lan.
Especially the contents of the freezer... this they call ’trotters,’ this they call ’rib rack,’ this is... damn it, I can’t take it anymore.
"Okay, I’ll be right there."
Hearing Wang Lan on the phone, Hu Qing also came over from the other room. "What did you find? You look so pale."
"The contents of the freezer make me feel extremely uncomfortable."
Hu Qing chuckled lightly and reached out to open the refrigerator.
"Don’t look. It’s all severed hands and feet."
"My talent may not be at your level, and my strength might not be either, but brother, I’ve been on the battlefield, I’ve killed people. A few severed hands and feet are just a small scene. I might even find some clues..."
Saying this, he opened the freezer. After just one glance, Hu Qing slammed it shut again.
"How about it? Find any clues?"
"Ugh—" Hu Qing suddenly started retching over the sink.
Who was it that just called this a ’small scene’?
Wang Lan thought.
"What kind of freak is she?"
"It might not be a perversion. To the Demon Clan, aren’t we just ingredients? Did you find anything on your end?"
"Nothing. There was no hair in the bathroom. I don’t know if we’ll find any in the bedrooms."
"Let’s go have a look together."
Leaving the kitchen, they pushed open a bedroom door. It appeared to be a guest room, the bed also covered with a dust sheet.
After searching around and finding nothing, they moved on to another room.
The moment the door opened, a strong scent of perfume wafted out. It was a very intense perfume, the kind rarely used in Jade Country but common among Westerners.
And when they smelled this perfume, the expressions on both Wang Lan and Hu Qing’s faces changed almost simultaneously.
Hu Qing looked up sharply, his gaze locking with Wang Lan’s. A deep, unspoken understanding passed between them.
"Is it her?"
How could that be...
Hu Qing’s face turned white. At the apartment door just moments ago, he had smelled this same perfume on Mr. Cui. Although it wasn’t as strong then, the scent was identical.
"Not good!" Wang Lan instantly rushed out of the room and towards the apartment’s main door.
At that moment, the elevator doors happened to open, and Wang Qianfeng, along with a group of agents from the Intelligence Department, burst out, running right into Wang Lan.
"Director Wang!"
"Wang Lan, where is the evidence?"
"In the kitchen freezer. Open it and you’ll see." Saying this, he summoned his Flame Sword and slashed towards Mr. Cui’s apartment door.
The blade was swift and decisive, cutting through the lock. Wang Lan gave it a light tug, and the door opened.
"What are you doing? Does this apartment also have a problem?"
"There likely is." Wang Lan entered the apartment. This place felt more lived-in than the one next door, its furnishings and belongings neatly arranged. He turned on the light and went straight to the bedroom.
The lamp on the bedroom desk was still on. A stack of student notebooks lay on it, one of them open. It appeared Mr. Cui had been in the middle of grading homework before suddenly leaving.
Inside the bedroom, a fragrance similar to the one from the bedroom in the adjacent apartment filled the entire space.
"Who lives here?" Wang Qianfeng asked curiously, having come up behind Wang Lan. Xu Shiyun and several other agents were already searching the adjacent apartment; they had, of course, also seen the evidence Wang Lan had pointed out.
Ma Xiaoxue had a problem; that was indeed confirmed. Hence, Wang Qianfeng instantly thought of Ma Bo. If Ma Xiaoxue had a problem, how could Ma Bo escape? If Ma Bo had a problem, then those folks at Jiayi Biotech, the ones making the Demonic Transformation Potion... their involvement was clear.
"In Ma Xiaoxue’s room, Hu Qing and I smelled a particular perfume. I also detected that same scent on the occupant of this apartment, Mr. Cui. I hope it’s not a coincidence. However, it is coincidental that just as we arrived to investigate Ma Xiaoxue’s place, Mr. Cui left this apartment. If she’s in league with Ma Xiaoxue, she’s probably fled by now, right?"
"Who is she?"
"Cui Xiaolv, the homeroom teacher of Class Three, Fourth Grade, at Tang Town Elementary School," Hu Qing said, walking over from the doorway.
Wang Qianfeng took out his phone and dialed a number. "Connect to the communications department. Hello, I’m Wang Qianfeng. Check the whereabouts of someone for me: Cui Xiaolv, a teacher at Tang Town Elementary School. Yes, she lives in Jinghua Manor."
As Wang Qianfeng made the call, Wang Lan had already begun to quickly search Cui Xiaolv’s home. From a drawer in the desk, he suddenly picked up a notebook, a thoughtful look appearing in his eyes.
Liu Jia...

chapters.title: Chapter 144 This is already the truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 144 This is already the truth
Wang Lan had definitely heard the name Liu Jia before. And with a homework booklet as a search criterion, an image of a little girl immediately surfaced in his mind.
"Director Wang, look!"
"A homework booklet? Is there any clue from this?"
"The child’s name is Liu Jia. Do you remember Xinyi Garden? Back then, Qin Jiaqing used the ’Golden Cicada Sloughing Its Shell’ tactic, and the girl Qin Jiaqing replaced was named Liu Jia. So, it seems Cui Xiaolv was Liu Jia’s teacher, and all the students in her class..."
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s back was soaked with sweat. A sense of terror he had never experienced before instantly gripped his entire being.
Cui Xiaolv wasn’t just Liu Jia’s teacher; she was also Song Jia’s teacher...
Hu Qing, standing behind him, also turned pale with fear.
If Wang Lan hadn’t seen through Cui Xiaolv’s identity today, Hu Feifei would have remained in danger, wouldn’t she?
Wang Qianfeng’s grip on the chair suddenly tightened. With a series of sharp cracks, the armrest shattered.
Damn Demon Clan, so vicious, so ruthless!
DING DING DANG, DING DING DONG... Wang Qianfeng’s cell phone rang.
"Hello, it’s me."
"Director Wang, that Cui Xiaolv you mentioned just bought a high-speed train ticket to Xu City. However, I tracked the train, and she wasn’t on it. We’ve also lost her trail on surveillance. She has counter-surveillance skills. Should we conduct a comprehensive search?"
An expanded search didn’t just mean searching within the Tianjian Bureau’s jurisdiction; it meant employing comprehensive measures like public surveillance, shopping mall security cameras, and store CCTVs. Data from cameras everywhere would be compiled to search for her, requiring coordination from multiple departments.
"Expand the search. She’s a hidden Demon Clan spy."
After they left Cui Xiaolv’s home, Xu Shiyun and his team had also finished their work. Xu Shiyun looked unwell. No, to be precise, none of the men looked well.
They could accept the Demon Clan killing people, even their own comrades, but they couldn’t stomach their comrades being treated like food—stored in a refrigerator to be eaten at will.
"Reporting to Director Wang, everything has been processed."
"Take it back for analysis," Wang Qianfeng said, then took out his cell phone again. "Li Weixin, are you ready on your end?"
"Old Wang, why so serious? I’ve been ready for a while."
"Make the arrest!"
"Have you got the evidence?"
"Enough talk. Make the arrest. Especially his female bodyguard—we absolutely cannot let her get away."
"Alright, alright! Why so angry?" On the other end of the line, Li Weixin chuckled and hung up. The moment the call ended, his expression instantly darkened. "Move out. Make the arrest."
"Director, does the Intelligence Department have evidence? Arresting Ma Bo will be like stirring up a hornet’s nest."
"If Wang Qianfeng hadn’t seen something that infuriated him, he wouldn’t speak to me like that. Make the arrest! Even if it’s a mistake, he’ll take the fall. Remember, Ma Bo’s female bodyguard, Ma Xiaoxue, must be apprehended."
Back at the Tianjian Bureau with Wang Qianfeng, the forensics team was already bustling with activity. Perhaps because it was their job, they had a stronger stomach for it than the Intelligence Department agents, calmly categorizing and sampling limbs and other body parts.
Not long after Wang Lan returned, Li Weixin also came back, his task completed.
"So quick? No trouble?" Wang Qianfeng asked hurriedly as soon as Li Weixin walked in.
"They were cooperative, but we only apprehended Ma Bo. His female bodyguard supposedly took leave and didn’t come to work today."
"Bullshit. I saw her on the news today during the Life Number One launch event."
"But we searched everywhere and didn’t find her."
"Take him to the interrogation room!"
Wang Lan had intended to listen in on the interrogation, but his cell phone rang. Song Jia had woken up and was crying for her brother and her mother. The others couldn’t comfort her. Wang Lan thought for a moment.
Most of today’s critical tasks are done, and we have leads now. Staying here won’t help much.
After a brief word with Wang Qianfeng, he left.
He requested a car and drove back to Fragrant Courtyard Bay. Just as he walked in the door, Song Jia leaped onto him like a koala.
"Brother... I thought you didn’t want me anymore," she cried, "Mom’s gone, and you were gone too... I was so scared..."
"Brother went to catch bad guys. Once brother catches them, Auntie will be safe, and she can come home. Didn’t I leave you a note?"
"I..." Song Jia buried her head in Wang Lan’s shoulder. "Did you catch the bad guys?"
"Almost. But they can’t escape. Brother has many friends; he’s not working alone. With so many of us after them, we’ll definitely catch them."
"Oh..."
"By the way, Jiajia, do you know someone named Liu Jia?"
"Liu Jia?" Song Jia looked up, her brow furrowed. "I don’t think so..."
"What about your Teacher Cui? Do you know if she was close to any particular students? Did she often talk to them privately?"
"Talk privately? No... She got along better with the students from Class Seven. Teacher Cui only became our homeroom teacher this semester. Before that, she always taught Class Seven."
"Class Seven? Was Liu Jia in Class Seven?"
"I just transferred to this school this semester, how would I know? Brother, why are you suddenly asking about Teacher Cui?" Song Jia looked up, her small eyes fixed on Wang Lan. "Wait a minute. You went to catch bad guys today, and now you’re asking all these questions about Teacher Cui... Are you saying Teacher Cui is the bad guy?"
Wang Lan looked at Song Jia in surprise.
This little girl could be surprisingly perceptive sometimes...
Then, Wang Lan carefully channeled a stream of Star Power into Song Jia’s body. Although he believed the Song Jia before him was still his Song Jia, his heart had been on edge ever since he discovered Cui Xiaolv was a Demon Clan spy and Song Jia’s homeroom teacher.
Another way to identify a Demon Clan member was to test them with Star Power. Ordinary people wouldn’t react to it. Furthermore, Star Power was unique to each individual. If one Star Martial Warrior’s Star Power entered another’s body, it would naturally trigger a rejection response.
If Song Jia had awakened her Star Martial Warrior abilities, or if she harbored latent Demon Clan traits, her body would automatically resist the moment Wang Lan’s Star Power entered, much like white blood cells attacking foreign bacteria or viruses. This method was only effective on those who were not Star Martial Warriors.
"Brother... what’s happening? My body suddenly feels so hot... Did you drug me?"
Wang Lan decisively tossed the girl onto the sofa.
He just couldn’t take it anymore.
"Hee hee... Just kidding. Did that make you angry?"
I seriously question the education at your school. What kind of things are filling that young mind of yours?
"Blame me? Look at the TV shows these days! You can’t pick one at random that *doesn’t* have that stuff. By the way, what was that hot, burning thing you just sent into my body? Is that the Star Power you Star Martial Warriors use?"
"Yep! I have a fire attribute, so mine feels hot. If Sister Xinyu channeled her Star Power into you, I guarantee you’d be shivering from the cold."
"So, why did you do that?"
"I’m not telling you!" Wang Lan didn’t explain. It wasn’t good for Song Jia to know too much. At least, he was relieved that she was alright.
Wang Lan had wanted Song Jia to go back to sleep, but she refused, so he had no choice but to stay with her, chatting and watching TV.
Meanwhile, outside the Tianjian Bureau, a huge commotion was already underway.
Countless citizens and journalists had gathered outside the Tianjian Bureau, demanding an explanation. The arrest of Ma Bo had undeniably stirred up a hornet’s nest, and the repercussions spread nationwide, even globally, overnight.
Just as Ma Bo was about to receive national and international awards, the Tianjian Bureau in Suzhou City arrested him that very night? And apparently without any reason?
The public, of course, wouldn’t stand for this. The journalists were as energized as if they’d been shot with adrenaline.
At that moment, the phones at the Tianjian Bureau were ringing off the hook, from top to bottom.
"Citizens, friends from the media, this matter involves confidential information that I cannot disclose. Please cooperate and disperse as soon as possible."
"The Tianjian Bureau first arrested Dr. Wang Qi of Jiayi Biotech, and now they’ve arrested Dr. Ma Bo of Senma Pharmaceutical. Have they broken any laws?"
"Exactly! Before the New Year, Jiayi Biotech announced a breakthrough in treating genetic diseases and said they would release their findings after the holidays. They were arrested before they could make any announcement! Then today, the very day Life Number One is released, you arrest Dr. Ma Bo. Are you trying to suppress anything that can cure cancer, just so cancer can continue to threaten our lives?"
This question was designed to paint them as villains.
The spokesperson’s sharp gaze fixed on the middle-aged female journalist who had asked the question. "Madam, please watch your words. We have reliable intelligence indicating that both esteemed doctors were targeted by the Demon Clan. It is not us who wish for diseases to continue threatening human life, but the Demon Clan. We brought them to the Tianjian Bureau for their own protection. All Tianjian Bureau operations are confidential, so please do not probe further. Once the matter is resolved, we will naturally release the details. For now, please disperse. If you refuse to cooperate, we will be forced to disperse you."
Inside the Tianjian Bureau’s high-level conference room, Lu Zhao’s expression was also grim.
Of course, he wasn’t blaming Wang Qianfeng for the day’s actions, as he himself had approved them. Although he knew arresting Ma Bo would create public pressure, he hadn’t anticipated it would be this intense.
And the pressure wasn’t just from the public; it was also coming from other official channels.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Cancer! A medicine that could actually treat cancer!
Who among the living wouldn’t be excited? Everyone fears death. It wasn’t just cancer patients who were agitated; anyone afraid of dying would be.
The Tianjian Bureau had never needed to explain its actions to anyone.
But tonight, Lu Zhao witnessed another kind of power, one that was incredibly formidable.
"Feng, brief everyone on the situation."
"It all began with problems in Jiayi Biotech’s clinical trials. The five patients who received treatment all showed localized signs of demonization.
Meanwhile, the molecular formula Jiayi Technology submitted to the drug regulatory agency was a ninety percent match to the Demonic Transformation Potion we acquired.
I quickly ruled out Jiayi Biotech as suspects because that ten percent difference was precisely the Demon Clan gene. This means the Demonic Transformation Potion and the Life Potion were created using the same fundamental method.
The difference is that the Life Potion is made by editing healthy human genetic codes, whereas the Demonic Transformation Potion is infused with Demon Clan genes, designed to corrupt human genetics.
Therefore, we arrested the creator of the Life Potion, Ms. Wang Qi. From her, we obtained a crucial clue: to create the Life Potion, one must know the formula for the human genetic code.
This formula is known only to her and her deceased lover, Song Zifeng. Consequently, we speculated that her late lover, Song Zifeng, was likely the creator of the Demonic Transformation Potion, and we devised a plan to lure him out using this information.
But before the plan could even be implemented, someone else disproved our theory. Not only that, but he uncovered the truth in a single night."
"The truth?"
"Yes. In my opinion, this is the truth."
"That person... it’s Wang Lan again, isn’t it?" Lu Zhao’s expression at that moment was priceless.

chapters.title: Chapter 145 has something special
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: 145 has something special
Although Wang Qianfeng had also reported to Lu Zhao over the phone before, the report was very brief. Wang Qianfeng only shared the most important parts: Ma Bo’s niece and bodyguard was from the Demon Clan, and many human corpses were hidden in his ice chest.
Ma Bo and his female bodyguard were inseparable, which is why Lu Zhao had ordered the arrest despite knowing there would be pressure.
Yet, deep down, Lu Zhao hoped that Ma Bo was innocent. The betrayal of a great human scientist would be a tremendous loss to humanity.
But now, looking at Wang Qianfeng’s expression, Lu Zhao suddenly felt that things were far worse than he had hoped.
"Yes! Wang Lan came up with a hypothesis different from my own, and it’s even more substantiated.
He believed that it wasn’t Song Zifeng who made the Demonic Transformation Potion, but Ma Bo. Ma Bo taught both Song Zifeng and Wang Qi and had the opportunity to access the genetic coding formula back then.
And Ma Bo’s Life Number One competed directly with Wang Qi’s Life Potion. Moreover, the Life Potion was a step ahead in its field. If the Life Potion and Life Number One were released at the same time, Life Number One would be immediately pushed out of the competition.
Therefore, on the afternoon of New Year’s Eve, Ma Bo visited Wang Qi’s home, offering to trade Senma Pharmaceutical’s valuation for a fifty percent stake in Jiayi Biotech. His aim was to acquire the manufacturing technology for the Life Potion."
"Wait a minute!" Li Weixin suddenly raised his hand. "Didn’t you previously say that the Demonic Transformation Potion was made by Ma Bo? The Life Potion and the Demonic Transformation Potion are made using the same method. Aren’t you contradicting yourself now?"
"It’s not contradictory. Ma Bo had to maintain his public persona. Only Song Zifeng and Wang Qi were known to have the genetic coding formula; he supposedly didn’t. At least, acting this way would make others believe he didn’t know.
If anyone suspected him, this action would also serve as evidence that Ma Bo wasn’t the creator of the Demonic Transformation Potion. However, what Wang Lan subsequently uncovered in his investigation overturned the conclusion that Ma Bo didn’t know the genetic coding formula.
First, the next day, Jiayi Biotech reported an experimental anomaly. The timing was very coincidental. Subsequently, Life Number One was launched with great fanfare after Wang Qi’s arrest.
Meanwhile, the police department discovered another lead. The ex-wife and daughter of a researcher at Jiayi Biotech were kidnapped by an underworld gang. The person who ordered the kidnapping was Crow, our primary target in this crackdown.
It has been confirmed that Crow has a direct connection to the Demonic Transformation Potion. Crow threatened the Jiayi Biotech researcher to frame Jiayi Biotech, which also benefited Senma Pharmaceutical. This indicates they must have a shared financial interest.
Furthermore, Wang Lan used this speculation as a basis for verification. Evidence was found at Ma Bo’s female bodyguard’s home proving she was from the Demon Clan. This essentially confirms Ma Bo has Demon Clan support.
Ma Bo starting Senma Pharmaceutical from scratch in ten years is a commercial miracle. But could there also be clandestine forces supporting him? Otherwise, how could a man in his seventies build such a massive enterprise in just twelve years?
In the current pharmaceutical industry, there are no blank spaces left. Pioneering new territory without the combined strength of economic and technological power is impossible.
We are currently consolidating leads, and further breakthroughs are expected."
After listening to Wang Qianfeng’s report, the department heads, including Lu Zhao, looked somewhat bewildered.
What Wang Qianfeng said wasn’t particularly outlandish; it was a completely logical deduction. However, the significance behind this matter was entirely different.
What is the Tianjian Bureau’s top priority right now? What are the higher-ups at the Ministry of Defense most concerned about? The origin of the Magical Martial Artists, the source of the Demonic Transformation Potion.
Have they found it?
On the first day of the New Year, so unexpectedly?
Talk about an auspicious start! Could it get any better than this?
"Heh, heh, heh..." Lu Zhao suddenly chuckled. "At times like this, I suddenly recall something my granddaughter often complains about: ’You never know which will arrive first, an accident or tomorrow.’
For me, it’s truly a case of not knowing whether a pleasant surprise or tomorrow will arrive first. Wang Lan’s commendation order is still with the Jin City headquarters; they’re asking me when to issue it. Back then, I even said, ’Why just one Xuan Yue Medal?’ Now it looks like they’ll have to delay it again. Wang Lan is accumulating merits too quickly; the speed of rewards can’t keep up with the speed of his contributions."
"Ha, ha, ha..." Laughter filled the conference room.
"Then... Director, the pressure on us..."
"I’ll report directly to the Ministry of Defense later. After noon today, there won’t be any more pressure. This battle feels great!"
「At dawn」
Song Jia fell asleep in Wang Lan’s arms. Wang Lan carried Song Jia back to her room. Jiajia could sleep, but he couldn’t just yet.
He got up and drove to the Tianjian Bureau.
DING-DONG.
A message popped up on his phone; it was from Xie Sisi.
"Wang Lan, I heard your aunt is in trouble? Is it serious? I’m very worried about you."
Wang Lan smiled and had Xiao Ai reply, "Everything is under control, don’t worry."
RING RING—
Xu Xiangwen’s call came in.
"Lanzi, need help?" Xu Xiangwen’s voice came through as soon as the call connected.
"No need, it’s nothing."
"Don’t be polite with your brother. I might not have many other skills, but I’m pretty confident I can make the silent speak. Gong Feiyu feels the same way; he’s with me now."
"Really, it’s nothing. If you don’t believe me, ask Xinyu. She knows. Things aren’t as you imagine. My aunt is just being protected."
"Oh, it’s nothing? Alright then, I’m hanging up."
The incident happened yesterday, but the news only started to spread this morning. Wang Lan was very touched that Xu Xiangwen and the others had called to show their concern so early in the morning.
These brothers were truly worth having.
If they were superficial friends, they would have already tried to distance themselves by now.
Being arrested by the Tianjian Bureau is definitely no small matter.
When he arrived at the Tianjian Bureau, the crowd of citizens demanding an explanation had already dispersed. It was the second day of the New Year, and the entire Tianjian Bureau seemed exceptionally busy.
"Report!"
"Come in!" Wang Qianfeng’s office already had three people reporting their work.
"You’re here. Good, listen in as well."
"Yes, sir!" Wang Lan stood straight to one side.
"Director Wang, the limbs brought back have been analyzed. They all belong to individuals who went missing in the last year.
Some weren’t even reported missing; perhaps their relatives don’t even know they’ve met with foul play.
Among them, we found a leg belonging to the little girl, Liu Jia. Based on the examination, Liu Jia was killed in the first half of the year before last, by May at the latest.
From this, we can deduce that the Liu Jia who had been attending school for over a year was, in fact, already a Demon Clan shell. This suggests that a Demon Clan spy, or rather a high-level Demon Clan spy, has at least two hidden identities they can alternate between.
Furthermore, we also found a diary in Liu Jia’s home. The last entry was dated May 5th, 2017."
"Where is that diary?"
"Here it is!" The person handed a diary, carefully wrapped in what looked like tree bark, to Wang Qianfeng’s desk.
"Report. We interrogated Ma Bo all night yesterday, but he was very uncooperative and feigned ignorance about everything.
Especially when we revealed that his bodyguard and niece is a Demon Clan spy, his expression was one of shock, as if he genuinely didn’t know."
"You think he’s unaware?"
"No, I believe he definitely knows. However, due to his special status, we cannot use harsh interrogation methods on him.
The subsequent questioning reached an impasse. He stated that he would refuse to answer any questions until his lawyer arrived."
"Absurd! Still asking for a lawyer... Does he think this is a police station?"
"But if we cannot use harsh methods, the interrogation cannot proceed."
"What about Spiritual Engraving?"
"Ma Bo is already eighty years old. His cerebellum is showing signs of atrophy. Spiritual Engraving could cause irreversible damage to his brain.
If we find the truth, that’s fine, but if by some chance we don’t... We dare not take such a gamble.
Major Wu also said that for Spiritual Engraving, it’s better to wait until we have more evidence and a higher degree of certainty before proceeding. It’s too risky under these circumstances."
"Report, Director Wang. We have searched the entirety of Senma Pharmaceutical, including its related subsidiaries, contract manufacturers, and even companies that have cooperated with it.
We found no trace of Demonic Transformation Potion manufacturing, not even the equipment."
"Director Wang, everyone," Wang Lan suddenly spoke. "I remember my aunt mentioning that the experiments for the Life Potion require very sophisticated equipment.
The manufacturing equipment also has very high requirements. The equipment in my aunt’s company was all imported through foreign channels. Could we investigate from this angle?"
Hearing Wang Lan’s words, the three men’s eyes instantly lit up. "Yes! Thank you, Lieutenant Wang. Such advanced equipment must be very rare. We’ll go back and investigate this right away."
"Alright! You may leave. Continue the investigation," Wang Qianfeng said.
After the three left, Wang Qianfeng smiled at Wang Lan. "Sit down. You did very well this time."
"You praise me too much, Director Wang. I was just doing my duty. Director Wang, may I see that diary?"
"Take it."Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Wang Lan took the diary and opened it.
Liu Jia’s handwriting was beautiful. It was hard to believe it was written by a child who was then only in second grade, not yet in third. Evidently, Liu Jia’s parents had been very attentive to her education; she must have practiced penmanship for many years.
Wang Lan started flipping from the back of the diary. Important clues would surely be in the last few pages.
"Not capturing Ma Xiaoxue and the Cui Xiaolv you discovered is the biggest regret in this case. If we had caught them, this case wouldn’t be so troublesome.
We’ve mobilized all the forces we can, but those two seem to have vanished into thin air. Perhaps they’ve returned to their hidden nest," Wang Qianfeng sighed, as if to himself.
"I met Cui Xiaolv face-to-face, but I wasn’t vigilant at the time. Thinking back now, I was indeed a bit careless.
I should have asked Cui Xiaolv to stay and assist with the investigation then. I think if I had just said that one sentence, Cui Xiaolv might have been exposed on the spot."
"You can’t be blamed for that. In such circumstances, who would suspect Cui Xiaolv without reason? We’re not gods; we can’t predict the future."
Suddenly, Wang Lan stopped flipping through the diary. His brows furrowed tightly.
"What is it? Have you discovered something again?" Wang Qianfeng suddenly stared at Wang Lan’s face, tense.
Perhaps since yesterday, Wang Lan had transformed in Wang Qianfeng’s mind.
Previously, in Wang Qianfeng’s mind, Wang Lan was still a junior, a subordinate. Just a rather lucky junior who had accumulated a fair number of merits.
But after yesterday, Wang Qianfeng suddenly realized just how much he had underestimated Wang Lan.
What appeared to be good luck wasn’t entirely luck. Wang Lan could always spot details that they had missed, and details often determined success or failure.
"Director Wang, look. This diary entry seems to have something to it."

chapters.title: Chapter 146 Locking the Target
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 146 Locking the Target
"Something interesting? What is it?" Wang Qianfeng took the diary, skimmed through it, and then looked at Wang Lan with puzzlement. "Her parents found her a tutor, and the child is just complaining. Is that all?"
"Director Wang, look at this sentence," Wang Lan said, pointing. "’Mom, why do you always compare me with Zhang Jixi? You say her grades have improved quickly and that I also need a tutor. After school, I have to go to the teacher’s house for more lessons. I can’t play or watch TV anymore. I’m so sad, so upset...’"
"This is the fourth-to-last entry in the diary. Can I assume she was harmed on the third or fourth day after starting these tutoring sessions?"
That sounds about right...
Wang Qianfeng’s mind sharpened at Wang Lan’s prompting. "Are you saying that the teacher could very likely be Cui Xiaolv? And that Liu Jia was killed because she started tutoring with her?"
"Exactly! And that leads to something else. Liu Jia’s parents liked to compare her with her classmate Zhang Jixi. This usually means their grades weren’t too different. And if their parents are making such comparisons, they must be in contact. So, if Zhang Jixi’s academic performance was on the rise, who would Liu Jia’s parents likely choose as her tutor, following conventional thinking?"
"They would definitely ask Zhang Jixi’s parents how their child’s grades improved so much. And then..." A sharp light flashed in Wang Qianfeng’s eyes.
This Zhang Jixi might be in the same situation as Liu Jia.
"Indeed. Check for a fourth-grade student named Zhang Jixi at Tang Town Elementary School."
Wang Qianfeng immediately made a phone call to order his subordinates to investigate.
"Director Wang, may I see my aunt?"
I was wondering how long you could hold it in... You finally asked.
"Since you uncovered this, you should be the one to tell her. She’ll be happy to know all this. She didn’t misplace her trust back then."
"Yes!" Wang Lan affirmed.
Getting the address from Wang Qianfeng, Wang Lan walked toward the Tianjian Bureau’s internal dormitories. Climbing the stairs to the third floor, he saw Lige, dressed in casual clothing, leaning against the balcony railing, quietly smoking.
Previously, Wang Lan’s impression of Lige was one of affectation, which made him somewhat dislike this person.
A man should be unpretentious and forthright; such finicky affectation is unsettling.
However, after learning that Lige was actually a woman, Wang Lan had let go of his previous sentiment.
No matter how convincingly a woman disguises herself as a man, her true nature will eventually show. Isn’t it natural for a woman to be a bit affected? Even the most tomboyish woman can’t be as forthright as a man.
Lige still had short, choppy hair and two thick, long eyebrows. Beneath a high nose bridge were two large, bright eyes. By male standards of beauty, Lige’s features might seem somewhat effeminate. By female standards, she would likely be considered a rather handsome woman.
Lige held her collar with one hand, tilting her head slightly to exhale smoke into the sky.
Perhaps to avoid getting the smoke smell on her clothes.
"Haven’t you ever seen someone smoke?" Lige asked. Her voice was as neutral as ever, lacking any feminine tone.
"I just didn’t expect you to smoke."
"Is it strange that I smoke?" Lige asked lightly, extinguishing the cigarette in her hand.
"You’re a person with meticulous hygiene and strong self-discipline. I wouldn’t expect you to try smoking. And besides, you are... a woman."
"Smoking helped me feel more like a man. Though I later realized it wasn’t a good way to achieve that, by then I was already addicted. Are you here to see Ms. Wang Qi?"
"Yes! Is she available now?"
"Available! Very available..." Lige replied with an odd expression.
"What’s wrong? My aunt is easy to get along with."
"But she often asks me questions that I think very few people in the world could understand, let alone answer. I finally understand why you moved out to live on your own so early. Being around her makes me feel like an idiot."
"I’ve never felt that way," Wang Lan smiled and pushed open the door. "Auntie, I’m here to see you..."
His aunt sat cross-legged on the couch, rapidly writing something on paper. Hearing Wang Lan’s voice, she didn’t even lift her head, just kept writing more quickly.
"Yay, done! Forty-three seconds!" his aunt cheered, holding up the Sudoku puzzle to show off to Wang Lan.
"A ten-by-ten Sudoku? Auntie, you’ve still got it."
"Of course! Come on, Lan, come here."
Wang Lan moved closer to his aunt.
His aunt ordered, "Sit!"
Wang Lan obediently sat down.
"Closer..." she urged.
Suddenly feeling a sense of foreboding, Wang Lan dutifully moved next to his aunt. She reached out, tenderly caressing Wang Lan’s cheek, then suddenly grabbed his ear and tugged sharply.
"OUCH! IT HURTS, IT HURTS, IT HURTS!"
"Does it hurt? Feeling bold now, are we? Not only have you learned to act first and report later, but now you’ve progressed to acting without reporting at all? Joining the Tianjian Bureau is a huge deal, and you haven’t breathed a word to me in six months? Huh? Think you’re all grown up and your auntie can’t manage you anymore, is that it?"
"No, listen to me explain. I’m just listed on the roster; I don’t have an actual position. My primary focus is still my studies. It’s just early preparation for employment. This way, when I graduate from university and start working, I won’t have to search for a job like others."
His aunt, not really willing to hurt Wang Lan, quickly released his ear. "Do you think I’m that easily fooled? You’re the first person I’ve heard describe joining the Tianjian Bureau as mere job hunting."
"Although the position is somewhat special, in essence, it’s not much different..."
"You’re just holding a title?"
"It’s definitely just an honorary title. If you don’t believe me, ask Director Wang. I don’t even have an official position at the Tianjian Bureau."
"Really? Then how do you have a military rank?"
"Just a mere lieutenant... hardly worth mentioning."
Lige, who had just finished a cigarette at the door, paused in her steps, her hand trembling slightly.
He, too, should be the unremarkable little lieutenant Wang Lan mentioned, right?
"A lieutenant in the Tianjian Bureau isn’t the same as a military lieutenant; their significance is entirely different. You were promoted to lieutenant within six months? How am I supposed to believe that?"
"There’s something else you’ll find even harder to believe." Wang Lan sat cross-legged on the sofa, smiling at Wang Qi. "Auntie, I think I might have found out who created the Demonic Transformation Potion."
The smile vanished from Wang Qi’s face, and her eyes turned icy cold as she looked at Wang Lan. "Ma Bo?"
"You guessed it, Auntie? Then why were you so sure before..."
"I was sure because I believed that apart from Zifeng and myself, no one knew the genetic coding formula. But if there had to be a third person who knew it, then it could only be Ma Bo. If that’s true... Zifeng’s death was no accident."
"Why are you so certain Ma Bo didn’t learn about it from my uncle?"
"I know Zifeng. He wouldn’t tell anyone the formula except for me. For Ma Bo to obtain the formula, he must have used Spirit Engraving to directly extract it from Zifeng’s mind. So, the story about Zifeng dying during an experiment must be false. He was murdered by Ma Bo."
At this, a chilling murderous intent surfaced on Auntie’s face.
If the circumstances allowed, Wang Lan had no doubt his aunt would have flayed Ma Bo alive.
"Didn’t you find anything suspicious about what happened back then?"
Auntie shook her head. "No, nothing. The investigation was thorough and turned up no suspicious elements. Thankfully, Zifeng didn’t betray humanity. That’s a great weight off my mind."
"The man my aunt chose wouldn’t be a spineless person."
"When can I leave?"
"You’ll probably have to wait until this matter is resolved. I don’t think it will take much longer."
Just then, Wang Lan’s cell phone suddenly rang. Seeing it was a call from Wang Qianfeng, Wang Lan quickly stood up to answer it.
"Wang Lan, come here a moment. Your speculation might be correct."
"Yes, sir!" Wang Lan replied.
"Auntie, Director Wang wants me to see him. Please, make yourself at home here. Don’t stand on ceremony with them. Ask for anything you need, especially from that fellow outside—he owes me two lives. Order him around as much as you like; don’t treat yourself like a guest."
Leaving behind these words, Wang Lan hurriedly left the room and ran off. Lige, standing at the door, twitched the corners of her mouth. "You really don’t act like an outsider, do you... Me, a member of the esteemed Chu Family..."
Never mind.
Lige exhaled a long breath and reopened the door to enter Wang Qi’s room.
In Wang Qianfeng’s office, Xu Shiyun, Li Weixin, and others were all present.
"Reporting in!" Wang Lan announced.
"Come in!" Wang Qianfeng called.
His face glowed with excitement. "Just now, Wang Lan discovered something in young Liu Jia’s diary. I had it verified, and we’ve learned that the girl, Zhang Jixi, is indeed Ma Bo’s granddaughter. For some unknown reason, Ma Bo divorced his wife twelve years ago. Afterwards, his son stayed in the Imperial Capital with his mother, while Ma Bo came to Suzhou City alone. Ma Bo’s granddaughter didn’t take her father’s surname, Ma; instead, she uses the surname Zhang."
"Three years ago, Ma Bo’s son came to Suzhou City to pursue business opportunities, but he had no open dealings with Ma Bo. Ma Bo’s ex-wife also died seven years ago. Our previous investigation into Senma Pharmaceutical’s financial outflows revealed nothing unusual. This was because Ma Bo had been sending his son at least ten million yuan annually for many years. A father sending money to his son is perfectly normal, so this lead didn’t raise any alarms for us."
"However, considering Zhang Jixi’s connection, it’s likely Ma Bo’s son isn’t truly innocent. Furthermore, we just examined the bank records of Ma Bo’s son, Ma Xiangru. Ma Xiangru has been involved in venture capitalism in recent years. Over three years, he invested nearly eighty million yuan in about a hundred companies. However, eighty percent of these companies quickly vanished along with the invested funds, yet Ma Xiangru persisted with such investments, undeterred."
"Through network surveillance, we found that these venture capital firms nearly all employed the same tactics, suggesting a single team was operating behind them. However, because they used numerous overseas proxies, tracing them back to the source has proven very difficult. But we can be certain that Ma Xiangru has been funneling funds to the hidden Demon Clan through these venture capital activities. Senma Pharmaceutical has also been bankrolling the Demon Clan. Well, isn’t this something: a family boasting five doctorates, yet the father and son are both traitors."
"Then what are we waiting for? Let’s bring Ma Xiangru in," Li Weixin said, standing up with a faint smile.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Director Li, Director Wang, do you think Ma Xiaoxue and Cui Xiaolv could be hiding at Ma Xiangru’s place?" Wang Lan suddenly asked.
"Possibly!" Wang Qianfeng said in a low voice. "The Action Department and the Intelligence Department will conduct a joint operation this time."

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Over-Level Slaying
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 147: Over-Level Slaying
The Tianjian Bureau took this operation very seriously. Fifteen cars roared toward their target, Sky Swan Garden.
Wang Lan sat in the back seat, casually glancing at Lige, who sat ramrod straight beside him, seemingly uncomfortable. It was rather unfortunate that of the five people in the car, Lige, Xu Shiyun, and Wang Lan were all in the back. With Lige sandwiched between Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun, the atmosphere was particularly awkward.
"What are you looking at me for?" Lige finally asked, unable to stand Wang Lan’s probing gaze any longer.
"You’re on this operation, so who’s protecting my aunt?"
"She’s in the Tianjian Bureau’s internal dormitory. What danger could your aunt possibly be in?"
"It’s better to be safe than sorry. There’s no such thing as an absolutely safe place. Usually, when you think you’re safe, that’s precisely when you might be in danger..."
"Zeng Xiaomo is protecting Ms. Wang Qi. What else are you worried about?" Seeing Wang Lan about to launch into a long speech, Lige cut him off with a single sentence.
"Nothing else," Wang Lan said, decisively turning his head away.
"He really is the darling of the Action Department, huh?" Xu Shiyun remarked. "Able to drop his duties to join an operation. Poor Xiaomo slaved away day and night at the Action Department, risking life and limb for so many years, only to recently be promoted to Captain. And now, with an operation underway, she can only watch eagerly from the sidelines. That’s why I say, it’s good to have both strength and connections."
"No one would think you’re mute if you just kept quiet," Lige retorted.
"Did I strike a nerve? Are you lashing out in embarrassment?" Xu Shiyun taunted.
"Haven’t I faced life-and-death situations? Haven’t I worked diligently?" Lige shot back.
"True, acting rashly and nearly getting yourself killed does count as facing a life-and-death situation," Xu Shiyun conceded with a smirk.
"Hey, can you two stop arguing?" Wang Lan quickly interjected as the tension between them flared. "What are you grown men bickering for? If you can fight, don’t just yap."
"Hmph! If it weren’t for Tianjian Bureau discipline, you think I’d have put up with you this long?" Lige sneered.
"After the operation is complete, I’m all yours," Xu Shiyun replied coolly.
"Let’s see if you’re even standing after the operation. Don’t make our little mascot have to revive you again."
Wang Lan silently covered his ears.
「Arriving at Sky Swan Garden」
They drove directly to Ma Xiangru’s front door. Sky Swan Garden was a comprehensive residential complex, with villas at the front, apartment buildings behind them, and even taller high-rises further back. The stark, tiered design symbolized a very real wealth gap.
Ma Xiangru’s home was naturally in the villa district. When the Tianjian Bureau team arrived, it seemed Ma Xiangru’s family was having dinner.
Fifty Tianjian Bureau warriors, dressed in military uniforms, leaped from their vehicles and instantly surrounded the villa.
"Barrier seal—ACTIVATE!"
"Huh? Who are you people? What do you want?" a middle-aged man yelled, cracking the door open a sliver.
"Tianjian Bureau..."
BANG—
With a sharp sound, the villa’s front door was decisively slammed shut.
"Oho, quite the temper, aren’t we?" Xu Shiyun’s mocking voice came from the crowd.
"I’ll get it!" As soon as the words left his mouth, a flash of lightning shot toward the door.
BOOM—
With a deafening crash, the door flew inward.
Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin led the charge, a dozen agents storming into Ma Xiangru’s home. Inside, Ma Xiangru, his wife, and a young girl, Zhang Jixi, cowered in a corner, trembling.
"Search!"
Instantly, the Tianjian Bureau agents, like a pack of hungry wolves, fanned out into every corner of the villa.
Wang Qianfeng approached Ma Xiangru with a smile. "Mr. Ma, I apologize for the intrusion. I’m Wang Qianfeng, Director of the Tianjian Bureau’s Intelligence Department. We have a case involving a Demon Clan spy that requires your cooperation."
"What Demon Clan spy? I don’t know anything! You arrested my father yesterday, and now you’re coming after me? What is the Tianjian Bureau trying to do? Prevent cancer medication from being developed? Are you helping those vultures who prey on the sick and suffering?"
"Don’t try to paint yourself as some kind of martyr. The Tianjian Bureau never acts without just cause," Li Weixin scoffed.
"Report! Nothing here!"
"Report! Nothing here either!"
"Report! No discoveries!"
As the reports came in one after another, the atmosphere in the villa grew increasingly oppressive, chilling to the bone.
Wang Lan stood beside Wang Qianfeng, his gaze fixed on the little girl clutched in Mrs. Ma’s arms. Zhang Jixi looked terrified, but instead of burying her face in her mother’s embrace as a scared child would, her eyes kept darting over Wang Lan and the other Tianjian Bureau brothers.
If there were no children in the house, this subtle anomaly might have gone unnoticed. But Wang Lan realized this wasn’t how an eleven-year-old should react when frightened.
Notably, the little girl’s eyes had swept over the sofa more than once.
"Director Wang, what are you looking for? There’s nothing you want in my house. Please leave," Ma Xiangru said.
"It seems Mr. Ma doesn’t quite understand his current predicament," Wang Qianfeng said with a faint smile. "Asking for your cooperation was the polite way of putting it. The impolite way is arrest."
"On what grounds are you arresting me? What law have I broken?"
"Participation in Demon Clan espionage. Is that charge serious enough? Take him away!"
Six Tianjian Bureau agents instantly moved in and subdued Ma Xiangru.
"Wait! If you have to arrest someone, just take me! It has nothing to do with my wife. My daughter is only eleven; she’s even less involved!"
"I haven’t even asked you anything, and you’re already trying to clear your wife and daughter?"
"Whatever it is, it has nothing to do with them!"
At that moment, Wang Lan moved, slowly approaching the sofa. During Ma Xiangru’s apprehension, the little girl’s gaze had swept across the sofa once again. This time, Wang Lan was certain there was something there.
Wang Lan picked up an item of clothing. Beneath it lay a tablet computer. As he slowly picked up the tablet, a scream erupted from behind him.
"Don’t touch my things—"
The instant the cry rang out, Zhang Jixi tore herself from her mother’s arms and rushed toward Wang Lan.
In that same instant, an intense wave of danger washed over Wang Lan. Almost instinctively, he activated his Phoenix Form.
BOOM—
A terrifying Star Power Fluctuation swept out. When she was less than two meters from Wang Lan, the little girl instantly transformed into a two-meter-tall Demon.
A punch, carrying world-destroying pressure, thundered toward Wang Lan’s back. In that split second, Wang Lan twisted slightly, unleashing a counter-punch with Inch Strength Triple Force at the attack behind him.
BOOM—
A shockwave rolled outward, a ripple of force exploding from Wang Lan and the Demon. The surrounding furniture shattered under the onslaught of Star Power.
CRACK—
Once again, Wang Lan’s hand bones fractured, while the opposing Demon’s entire arm violently shattered under his punch.
Wang Lan shot backward like a streak of light, landing among his comrades.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
All these changes had occurred in a single second.
While this turn of events was unexpected, it wasn’t entirely illogical. Wang Qianfeng, Li Weixin, and the other Tianjian Bureau experts instantly switched to combat mode.
Star Power boiled, Starlight filled the sky.
Two were at the Galaxy Stage, and the rest were all Star Cloud Stage, with seven or eight of them at the peak of Star Cloud Stage.
No more pretending; it was time to show their hand!
Ma Xiangru and his wife instantly swelled, completing their transformations. Three two-meter-tall Demons now stood within the agents’ encirclement.
In that moment, all explanations became meaningless.
"Suzhou City’s Tianjian Bureau... truly extraordinary," the Demon who had first attacked Wang Lan said, a new arm already regenerating from the stump.
"You’re not actually Zhang Jixi. You must be Mr. Cui Xiaolv, right?" Wang Lan said, stepping out from the crowd, his body burning with a crimson aura of blood energy. "And this Mrs. Ma isn’t just Mrs. Ma; she’s also Ms. Ma Xiaoxue. Ma Xiangru never even came to Suzhou City three years ago. Director Wang, let’s move. I’m in a hurry."
The moment his words landed, Wang Lan shot like lightning toward the Demon opposite him.
Last time, Wang Lan had insta-killed a high-ranking Demon Clan member, but that was because the Demon was already severely weakened and had fallen from its realm. This time, Wang Lan needed to kill a full-strength, high-ranking Demon within a limited time.
Only after they clashed did Wang Lan truly understand the Demon’s terrifying strength. In Phoenix Form, Wang Lan’s speed and power reached incredible levels. He dared say that in terms of raw speed and power, he could leave Wang Qianfeng in the dust.
Yet, the Demon before him easily kept pace with Wang Lan, matching him blow for blow, fighting him to a standstill.
The instant Wang Lan attacked, Li Weixin and Wang Qianfeng also charged. The clash of six Galaxy Stage masters instantly overwhelmed the villa with terrifying Star Power.
An incredibly suppressive pressure wave exploded outward, and the entire villa seemed to vanish as if erased. If not for the barrier erected outside, the explosion would have shaken the entire residential complex.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!—
Wang Lan’s Flame Sword danced like lightning, relentlessly striking at the Demon’s vital points. The Demon facing him was also far stronger than Wang Lan had imagined. It managed to narrowly dodge Wang Lan’s Flame Sword attacks every time, while also counterattacking instantly.
Wang Lan slashed his sword toward the Demon’s throat. The Demon’s figure, like a streak of light, instantly moved behind Wang Lan, its Demon Armor spike thrusting toward Wang Lan’s back like a meteor.
BOOM—
Wang Lan’s body seemed to explode, countless fleeting afterimages appearing in the Demon’s vision. The Demon’s body was horizontally bisected at the waist as a Flame Sword swept past.
But even after such a grievous blow, the Demon’s aura didn’t diminish in the slightest. Its separated halves merged back together, completely unharmed, as it punched toward Wang Lan’s heart.
Time seemed to freeze. The Demon’s Demon Armor spike was mere centimeters from Wang Lan’s chest.
Instantly, a Solar Wheel materialized before Wang Lan. The spike struck the razor-sharp Solar Wheel and was split in two. The Solar Wheel’s high-speed rotation generated incredible cutting power, instantly severing the Demon’s arm as well.
Just as Wang Lan was about to strike the Demon’s chest, its figure vanished. An intense sense of danger assaulted him from behind.
Activating Star Cloud Dance, Wang Lan instantly evaded the Demon’s renewed attack, countering with a sword thrust to its throat.
The sword pierced its throat, but the Demon still didn’t stop its assault.
Wang Lan slashed his short sword horizontally. The Demon’s head flew into the air, but in an instant, as if equipped with GPS, it returned to its neck.
An Undying Body?
Impossible. If it had an Undying Body, its fighting style wouldn’t include dodging. The Demon had dodged his attacks multiple times.
Scenes of the Demon dodging flashed through his mind. Suddenly, the mental image froze: a ruby-like crystal on its chest became fixed in Wang Lan’s mind.
SWISH—
He thrust his sword, and the Demon, as expected, dodged again. While dodging, its Demon Armor spike once more stabbed toward Wang Lan’s chest. But this time, unexpectedly, Wang Lan didn’t evade.
THUNK—
The Demon Armor spike plunged deeply into Wang Lan’s shoulder.
Before a flicker of joy could even surface in the Demon’s mind, it was cut short as the Demon shuddered violently. Stiffly, it looked down. Wang Lan’s Flame Sword was deeply embedded in the gem-like crystal on its chest. Green blood gushed out.
"Cross-level kill. Reward: 3,000 experience points, 50 skill points."
That’s a tank’s fighting style! You hit me, I’m fine. I hit you, you’re finished!

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Putting on the Whole Act
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 148: Putting on the Whole Act
"Captain!" The other two Demons let out a simultaneous roar.
This call made Wang Lan stare dumbfounded at the Demon’s corpse lying on the ground, thoroughly dead.
Is my luck really this good? Did I just pick out the strongest of the three at a glance?
"Double Flash Dragon Flight!"
"Purple Lightning Blast!"
Seizing the opportunity, Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin instantly unleashed their powerful moves, which they had been preparing for a long time, just waiting for the chance to kill the enemy. The moment the Zhang Jixi Demon was killed by Wang Lan in a life-for-life attack, there was a slight pause in their actions.
Facing two veteran Galaxy Stage experts, a slight pause was enough to doom them.
"Assist in killing, reward 500 experience points, 10 skill points."
"Assist in killing, reward 500 experience points, 10 skill points."
BOOM—
The terrifying aftershocks exploded, instantly breaking through the top of the barrier, turning into a beam of light shooting up into the sky.
In the raging wind of the aftermath, the silhouettes of three supreme beings flickered in and out of visibility. All the warriors of the Tianjian Bureau looked up with admiration at the three powerhouses emerging in the wind.
Three high-ranking spies from the Demon Clan, any one of whom could have caused incalculable damage to humanity.
In the past, even if a spy from the Demon Clan was captured, they were just small fry. High-ranking Demons, apart from that one time in Xinyi Garden, had never been encountered before. And this time, three were killed outright.
What a meritorious feat!
It could be imagined that everyone involved in today’s operation would have a significant entry in the record of merits.
Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin were also exhilarated. Starting the new year with the discovery of the source of the Demonic Transformation Potion, and on the second day, a spy group of high-ranking Demons was wiped out in one fell swoop.
Such merits were not only exciting for the subordinates; even the two of them were brimming with smiles.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Facing the admiring gazes all around, Wang Qianfeng felt he should say something.
Just as he was about to speak, Wang Lan, under everyone’s gaze, collapsed straight to the ground.
The Phoenix form had lasted for three minutes... three minutes of the Phoenix form.
When the three-minute Phoenix form ended, the intense negative conditions hit him like a blob of mustard straight to the forehead.
Wang Lan fell, a fierce smile hanging at the corner of his mouth.
SWISH—
Everyone’s eyes were transfixed on Wang Lan lying on the ground, his body still twitching unconsciously.
"Junior brother, is this... did he fall victim to a Demon Clan sneak attack?" a woman from the intelligence department asked hesitantly.
"No worries, he’s just overexerted himself, causing muscle spasms," Wang Qianfeng stated lightly after inspecting him. He had received information about such a scenario six months ago.
"Successfully destroyed the elite Demon Clan spy group, reward 30,000 experience points, 1,000 skill points..."
System notifications chimed in Wang Lan’s daze.
And the experience bar that was already over eighty percent full was instantly flooded by this surge of experience, bursting the meter.
In an instant, his character level jumped from Star Shine five to Star Shine six, and the experience bar surged past thirty percent.
"Captain Xu, you carry Wang Lan back..." Wang Qianfeng’s words were cut off as his teeth chattered, biting his tongue.
A clear wave of Star Energy Fluctuation rose up from Wang Lan’s body.
In the silent night, when everything seemed settled, a sudden ripple emerged.
Xu Shiyun was just about to respond, but his step halted abruptly. His eyes, filled with astonishment, stared at the man-shaped beast on the ground...
When was Wang Lan’s last breakthrough? It seemed to be... in November, right? That was just over two months ago? Another breakthrough? No! That’s not the point. Absolutely not. Last time, Wang Lan broke through after an intense battle, explaining that he was just so happy and exhilarated from personally killing a high-ranking Demon spy that he broke through in his excitement. At that time, I thought of him as a beast, breaking through after a battle, even after consuming Star Power. But compared to this time, last time he still seemed human.
Right now, many of the Tianjian Bureau’s brothers had contorted expressions on their faces. That kind of incredulous, "are you kidding me?" look was deeply etched on each of their faces.
You’re completely exhausted, near collapse! How did you break through in such a state? Can a normal person pull off such a feat?
"Director Wang... shall we... take him to the Science Academy for research?" Xu Shiyun suggested in a low voice, his face twisted.
"Hmm... you handle it, and I’ll pretend I don’t know, how about that?"
"Isn’t that a joke..." Xu Shiyun pointed at Wang Lan who was still twitching on the ground. "To break through in this state? Although the breakthrough is minor, just a little progress. But still, it’s a breakthrough... Star Power consumed to the point of exhaustion, the whole person is twitching, and you don’t want to cut him open and study that?"
"I do want to, so didn’t I just agree to your proposal?"
"Are you giving me a written order or not?"
"If I issue an order, how are you supposed to take the fall for this?"
Xu Shiyun clammed up.
Only Director Wang,
he thought,
could say something so blatantly shameless with such righteous conviction.
Wang Lan opened his eyes and, like someone waking up in the morning, slowly sat up. He stretched out his arms, taking a long, lazy stretch.
"Fantastic!"
"Fantastic your ass!" Xu Shiyun slapped Wang Lan back to the ground. "Stretcher! Stretcher!"
"No, Xu, I’m fine. No need for a stretcher, I can stand up."
"No, you can’t! Stay down."
"But really, I’m fine..."
Xu Shiyun firmly held down Wang Lan, pinching his neck. "Don’t you want a first-class merit?"
"What?"
"Merit Class Three, stand to receive; Merit Class Two, lie down to receive; Merit Class One, receive after death. Do you still expect to stand to receive Merit Class One? Lie down for me!"
"The stretcher is here!"
Then, the classic scene unfolded. Two Tianjian Bureau brothers carried Wang Lan swiftly, as if any slower would mean losing him. And Wang Lan picked up the tablet computer that the girl had been so fixated on, the one for which she had risked revealing herself.
He took out a key ring, flipped it to reveal a specialized USB drive, and inserted it into the tablet computer.
"Xiao Ai, wake up."
"Xiao Ai 120 reporting. Wang Lan, how can I help you?"
"Help me carefully check the computer for any hidden files."
"Okay!"
"Brother Wang Lan, put the tablet down for now. Come on, let’s take a picture."
"Cheese!"
"Cheese my ass! Act like you’re at death’s door!"
"Oh!" Wang Lan instantly got the message, body jerking, legs stretching out, head lolling to the side.
Perfect!
Back at the Tianjian Bureau, Wang Lan didn’t really want to rest. The negative effects of the Phoenix form had been washed away by the character level-up. But the organization cared for its meritorious officers and wanted Wang Lan to stay in the Tianjian Bureau dormitory to rest.
In reality, they were afraid that a group of stimulated brothers would drag Wang Lan out and beat him to death.
Wang Qianfeng, along with a host of brothers involved in the operation, were already busy. Even though three Demon Clan spies had been executed on the spot, evidence still needed to be collected. What remained was to extract from Ma Bo the location of the Demonic Transformation Potion’s production workshop and put an end to the Demon Clan’s ant nest plan.
"Director Wang! The hairs collected from Ma Xiangru’s home have been successfully analyzed. The DNA matches Ma Xiangru, his wife, and his daughter. The Demon Clan members didn’t just disguise themselves as Ma Xiangru’s family; they replaced them."
"Does this mean Ma Xiangru’s family is already dead?" Director Wang asked in surprise.
"It appears so."
"Does Ma Bo know?"
"Not sure, he probably doesn’t know. Should we interrogate him?"
"Let’s go, I’ll interrogate him myself."
In the rest room, Wang Lan held the tablet computer and rapidly typed code on the laptop.
Normally, this tablet computer should have been handed over as evidence to professional evidence analysis experts. But maybe it was too busy today, or maybe they chose to ignore it.
From the end of the battle until now, no one had come to take the tablet from Wang Lan’s hands, and he had not thought about turning it in.
Intuition told him that there was definitely a secret hidden in this tablet.
The tablet was mostly filled with leisurely fun games. Xiao Ai thoroughly searched once more, and indeed there were no hidden encrypted files in the tablet.
"Xiao Ai, bring up the apps she used most often."
TAP, TAP, TAP—
A dozen little games, all incredibly childish, were downloaded from official app store channels.
"Analyze who she interacted with in the games."
"The data has been deleted; we’ll need to extract the data from each game company."
"So many little games, and they’re spread all over the country, impossible to trace..."
Wang Lan held the tablet, scrutinizing it carefully.
There should be a secret here. That Demon was so anxious earlier; there must be something hidden in this tablet.
Suddenly, a worn handprint on the screen caught Wang Lan’s eye.
Wang Lan kept switching screens, and on the seventh page, the worn handprint matched with a game icon that was seldom seen.
Wang Lan tried tapping on it.
HUM—
The game opened quickly, basically a match-two style game.
"Wang Lan, this game runs on a private server."
"Private server? It’s not a standalone game?"
"No, there’s a remote server behind the game. Should we track the location of the server?"
"Track it."
Xiao Ai was capable of sweeping through half of Jade Country in a minute. Since the game connected to the other party’s server, which was virtually undefended against Xiao Ai, it took her less than three minutes to lock down the server’s location.
"In Suzhou City, Changxiang District."
"Mark it on the map."
The Penguin Map in the tablet computer opened and instantly, a coordinate lit up—a remote location 42 kilometers from Wang Lan, near the Yangtze River.
Seeing this, Wang Lan immediately stood up.
Without a doubt, this place either hid a Demon Clan base or another group of Demon Clan spies. Otherwise, who would set up a workshop in such a secluded, deserted area? Well, it was a case of pulling out one radish and getting a load of dirt; this single vine seemed to have seven melons.
He stood up, opened the door, and walked out of the dormitory.
"Ma Bo, you still refuse to confess? We’ve obtained concrete evidence that proves your betrayal, colluding with the Demon Clan. If you continue to resist, we’ll have to use Spirit Engraving Extraction to get your memories."
"My brain doesn’t belong to just me; it’s a treasure for all humankind. If you want to destroy humankind’s treasure, then go ahead. I’m old enough not to care about life and death anymore."
"But your brain has become a sin against all humankind," Wang Qianfeng coldly shouted as he pushed open the door. "I just came back from Sky Swan Garden. Guess who we caught?"
Ma Bo lifted his head, looking at Wang Qianfeng with hesitation.
"You’ve been giving Ma Xiangru millions each year, claiming, by your account, that it was money for your son. Yet when we inquired just now, we found your son, daughter-in-law, and even your granddaughter are all Demon Clan spies. The money you’ve been wiring every year was actually funding for Demon Clan spy activities. I have video evidence of the entire process; do you still dare to deny it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Your Way of Thinking Is Different from Others, Isn’t It?
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 149: Your Way of Thinking Is Different from Others, Isn’t It?
"What? My son is a Demon Clan spy? Don’t spout nonsense." Ma Bo still had that unyielding demeanor, as if he was certain that as long as he denied everything, the Tianjian Bureau would have no way to deal with him.
This tactic might work on a police inspector, but it’s useless against the Tianjian Bureau.
"Ma Bo... you might not know this. We have received reliable information that your son, daughter-in-law, and granddaughter were not protected by the Demon Clan, but were killed by them. The Demon Clan used you and killed all your relatives. And you are still delusional, not waking up to the truth?"
"What? My son... is dead? And my Xixi... she’s dead too?" Ma Bo stared with bewildered eyes, looking incredulously at Wang Qianfeng.
"Dead!" Wang Qianfeng stated flatly.
"You’re lying, you’re lying to me—"
"Indeed, they are dead. They ate your son, granddaughter, and daughter-in-law and now reside within their bodies. Only you, a fool, are still working for them. Tell us everything you know; at least you can get revenge for your son and granddaughter."
"I don’t know... I really don’t know. I don’t know anything... I just run my company, do my research... I had no idea my niece was of the Demon Clan, nor that my son and the others..."
Wang Qianfeng had originally thought that Ma Bo would confess after learning of his son’s death. However, he had underestimated the old man’s cunning, as Ma Bo still tried to argue even at this point.
"Forget it, you are still clinging to false hopes." Wang Qianfeng let out a long sigh. "But you’re seriously underestimating us. Wu Chao!"
"Present!" Wu Chao responded sharply.
"Spirit Engraving."
"Now? Are you sure?"
"If something goes wrong, I’ll take the blame!" Wang Qianfeng commanded unequivocally.
"Yes!" Wu Chao strode towards Ma Bo, who looked at the approaching Wu Chao with terrified eyes. It was only at this moment that the Tianjian Bureau members conducting the interrogation saw true fear in Ma Bo’s eyes.
Some people refuse to shed a tear until they see their own coffin, while others only start crying when they’re lying inside it.
Ma Bo was overly confident, or rather, arrogant. He did not believe that the Tianjian Bureau would lay a hand on a scientist like him. Spirit Engraving is extremely violent; even a young person would suffer brain damage during the process, let alone an old man like him. And he was confident that his knowledge, expertise, and status in the scientific community would make the Tianjian Bureau hesitate, fearing to damage his brain through engraving.
But then... the person for Spirit Engraving was actually approaching. Was this a bluff, or were they serious?
Wu Chao had received his orders and, naturally, would carry them out. "Mr. Ma Bo, don’t resist when I perform the Spirit Engraving. If you don’t resist at all, it won’t harm your brain."
Speaking, he pressed his hand onto Ma Bo’s head and took out a Soul Bead with his left hand.
But not resist? How could that even be possible? It’s like someone telling you not to blink while they poke a needle at your eye. Could anyone do that? Just try!
Only those who, deep in their subconscious, trusted someone implicitly, or who could completely control their instinctive reactions, could manage not to resist at all during the engraving. Ma Bo certainly couldn’t achieve that.
So when Wu Chao’s Star Martial Skill shone and invaded Ma Bo’s brain, Ma Bo’s body suddenly shook violently. The arms that bound Ma Bo instantly bulged with veins.
"Don’t... don’t... stop... stop..."
Wang Qianfeng stood with crossed arms, unmoved.
"I’ll confess... I’ll spill everything... I’ll tell you all—" Ma Bo suddenly screamed desperately.
"Stop!" Wang Qianfeng commanded.
Wu Chao retracted his hand.
Wang Qianfeng came over to Ma Bo coldly and lightly lifted Ma Bo’s chin. "You only have one chance, and just one minute. No... thirty seconds!"
"I’ll talk... I’ll talk... Stop using Spirit Engraving... I don’t want to become an idiot."
"Did you create the Demonic Transformation Potion?"
"Yes, I made it..."
"Where is the production workshop?"
