An opportunity for profit without any capital investment came knocking. How could I resist such temptation? He was interested in my KTVs and bars, and I admired his strength. We had just struck a deal when you guys showed up... I swear on my life, that’s the truth."
"Is your head still yours to swear on?" Wang Lan asked, glancing at the rearview mirror with a cold smile.
Hei shut his mouth.
Just as they reached the police station, people from the Tianjian Bureau arrived. It was the Zhang Yeqiu sisters, whom Wang Lan knew.
"You two? Why didn’t Xu come?"
"Is our presence not good enough for you?" Zhang Xiaoxue retorted indifferently.
"Of course, it’s fine. Such a minor issue hardly requires two red-robed Captains to come in person; the Bureau is taking this too seriously. Really, I should have delivered him myself," Wang Lan immediately conceded. Zhang Xiaoxue and Zhang Yeqiu were twins, but probably the least alike twins in the world. Though they shared identical faces, they presented completely different countenances to everyone.
"Don’t mention Xu Shiyun," Zhang Yeqiu said. "That guy got promoted to Captain and is insufferably smug now. He’s dragging the men through training and drills every day. Xiaoxue and I were free, so they sent us. Come on, let’s go see that piece of trash."
Wang Lan led Zhang Yeqiu and her sister to the detention room. Though Stone’s wounds had been stitched up, his limbs were essentially ruined.
Wang Lan had been ruthless this time. He hadn’t merely injured Stone’s limbs but had also seared the meridians within. Unless a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior treated him, he was definitely crippled. As for treating him... that was out of the question. Not executing trash like him on the spot was already merciful.
The door to the interrogation room opened. Stone slightly raised his head. When he saw the military-clad Zhang Yeqiu sisters, his pupils shrank sharply, a fleeting fear flickering in his eyes.
"It seems you recognize this uniform I’m wearing. That makes things easier. What’s your name?"
"Ye Feng!"
"Hah! Still so defiant? You think you’re Nie Feng, is that it?" Zhang Yeqiu’s finger twitched, and a ripple emanated from Stone’s position. Suddenly, with a series of creaks and groans, the chair beneath Ye Feng slowly deformed and then collapsed.
This display immediately surprised Wang Lan. The Zhang Yeqiu sisters were only twenty, four years older than him, but this demonstration of power gave Wang Lan a sense of their unfathomable depth. This was the Earth Attribute’s Gravity Law, which Wang Lan had seen Hu Qing use before. But Hu Qing’s manifestation had been immense and dramatic, while Zhang Yeqiu controlled the gravity around Ye Feng with precision, using just a flick of her finger. Standing right next to Zhang Yeqiu, Wang Lan felt nothing out of the ordinary.
The gravity intensified. Ye Feng’s stitched wounds burst open again, and even the air around him seemed to distort under the immense pressure.
"I... I really am Ye Feng..."
"Still talking tough?"
"Sis, he says his name is Ye Feng, not that celebrity Nie Feng."
"Oh—" Zhang Yeqiu lifted her finger, and the gravity vanished.
"Where are you from? Your Star Martial Badge?"
"In my... in my clothes pocket." With a flick of Zhang Yeqiu’s finger, a Star Martial Badge appeared in her hand.
She pulled out her phone to scan the code. BEEP.
"Your name really is Ye Feng, huh? Your parents gave you such a good name, just so you could traffic drugs? Linhai Military Region? Dismissed two years ago for insubordination. What happened after that? Tell me everything you did, honestly."
Ye Feng lay on the ground, gasping for breath. Hearing Zhang Yeqiu’s questions, his breathing grew even heavier.
"You shouldn’t be hoping for any luck now that you’re in our hands, right? Keep gasping. Believe it or not, I can make you stop breathing altogether in a moment." As she spoke, Zhang Yeqiu’s fingers lifted again.
"I’ll talk! I’ll confess! I’ll confess everything!" Fear was evident on Ye Feng’s face as he hurriedly spoke.
"Not long after I was dismissed, my former squad leader found me... He said... he said that we Star Martial Warriors make such great contributions to humanity, so why should we live like dogs? The military has its discipline, and we accept that. But when we’re out pioneering, we eat pig slop, sleep in caves, and constantly worry if we’ll even open our eyes the next morning. Honor, faith, responsibility—what are they? In the name of honor, faith, and responsibility, we end up living worse than animals, worse than the neighbor’s dog! This world runs on money, not on Star Martial Warriors. So what if we give up being a Star Martial Warrior? Isn’t it better to live comfortably with money?"
"And you believed him?"ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"I started to hang out with him."
"Are you an idiot?" Zhang Yeqiu looked at Ye Feng with contempt. "Your records show your parents are healthy, and you have a younger brother and a younger sister. They are proud of you.
"You’re a Star Martial Warrior. Your parents are entitled to free medical care and receive a monthly pension subsidy. If you had a wife, the state would arrange a job for her. Your children could attend school without paying a penny, and all their expenses from birth to adulthood would be covered by the state.
"Isn’t that enough? The state has addressed all conceivable worries for Star Martial Warriors. What more could you be dissatisfied with? The state has arranged everything for Pioneers, hoping you will guard the Different Dimensional Space for the country. What more could you ask for?
"Living worse than a dog? Who feeds a dog when it’s sick or hungry? Living worse than ordinary people? Do you know how much it costs an ordinary person to buy a house in Suzhou City, compared to a Pioneer? You’re ungrateful when receiving benefits but full of complaints when it’s time to fulfill your duties..."
"Sis, why bother wasting words on trash like this? Just kill him. This piece of garbage doesn’t deserve to live."
"Talk. Who was your squad leader? Who else is behind you?"
Wang Lan folded his arms, looking amused at the Star Martial Warrior before him.
He might be the most spineless Star Martial Warrior I’ve ever seen,
Wang Lan thought.
Interrogating him took no effort at all; he spilled everything like beans from a bursting pod.
His gang consisted of seven people, all Star Martial Warriors dismissed from the military. In the army, such individuals were referred to as ’rust.’
They were trash, unable to be forged into steel, and their presence in the military would only corrupt others.
The other three had gone to Xu City, Chang City, and Tong City. Of those remaining, two were at the headquarters in Jin City, and one was in Nankun, responsible for drug importation. In short, they were a bunch of unreflective societal malcontents who, on a whim, decided to dabble in an extremely high-risk industry where one misstep meant death.
Wang Lan was confident that their operation hadn’t even truly begun. Even if it had, it would be uprooted within a year.
Zhang Yeqiu finished the interrogation and drove the man back to the Tianjian Bureau. Hei’s case, however, was a matter for the Major Crimes Unit.
Zhang Yeqiu’s interrogation progressed rapidly, but things were stalled with Hei.
No matter how Hu Qing pressed him, Hei refused to admit any involvement in the Flower Snake Six’s bank robbery, insisting he knew nothing.
"Zhao Laohei, I’m trying to be reasonable here, so don’t push it! We have ways to make you wish you were dead without leaving a single mark. Don’t force my hand."
"Officer, I’m telling the truth! Why would I bother? I lost control of those six guys long ago. Besides, each of them makes millions a year—why would *they* bother? Robbing a bank with submachine guns? Are they filming a movie?"
Hu Qing frowned, a seed of doubt planted in his mind.
Zhao Laohei’s explanation did have some merit. The entire bank robbery, from start to finish, seemed like an elaborate prank; stealing money didn’t appear to be the primary goal. Yet, they had indeed stolen several million and killed over a dozen people.
Wang Lan returned after seeing off Zhang Yeqiu and Zhang Xiaoxue and happened to overhear this part of the conversation.
"Have the autopsy reports for those six people come out yet?"
"Not yet. What about it?"
"His words made me realize something was off too," Wang Lan said. "I shot an arrow and killed one of them in the car. Normally, the driver should have panicked. But he was very calm and just slammed on the accelerator, trying to ram me. Then, after I shot out a tire, the vehicle overturned. But... the strange thing is, both people in that vehicle died. An armored truck should have some shock-absorption features, shouldn’t it?"
"Report! The autopsy reports are in! The members of the Flower Snake Six gang have been dead for over twenty-four hours!"
"What kind of joke is this?" Hu Qing exploded. "They were robbing a bank and killing people twelve hours ago, and now you’re telling me they’ve been dead for over twenty-four hours? Were the robbers corpses?"
Wang Lan looked up at the female forensic medical examiner. "Are you sure it’s been over twenty-four hours?"
"Positive!"
"Hu Qing, let’s transfer this case to the Tianjian Bureau," Wang Lan said. "I’m sure... there’s something very wrong here."

chapters.title: Chapter 169 Dangerous Person, Wang Mingling
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 169 Dangerous Person, Wang Mingling
"Director Lu, you wanted to see me?"
On a Sunday morning, Wang Qianfeng was on duty when a call from Lu Zhao summoned him to the office. A new year had begun. While the intelligence department had achieved many victories and honors, those were now history. Wang Qianfeng was adept at maintaining his composure and perspective. The calmer things seemed, the more vigilant one needed to be.
"Feng, this case was sent over by the Suzhou City Security Department. Take a look and see if there are any issues."
Wang Qianfeng received the documents with both hands. Upon first glance, his eyes landed on the name Wang Lan. He let out an involuntary snort of laughter.
"Wang Lan just can’t sit still, can he? School just started, and in the very first week, he’s already off helping the police catch robbers."
"That’s not the point," Lu Zhao said, his voice low.
Seeing Lu Zhao’s expression, Wang Qianfeng’s own face immediately became solemn, and he read through the case report in detail. When he finally read that the bank robber known as ’Six Serpent Fury’ had been dead for over twenty-four hours, his pupils contracted sharply.
Instantly, Wang Qianfeng looked up, his gaze fixed on Lu Zhao’s eyes, as if searching for an answer there.
"It seems you’ve guessed it too..." Lu Zhao sighed, his voice heavy.
"The Xiangnan Wang Family?" Wang Qianfeng asked tentatively. "It must be them. The Xiangnan Wang Family, famous for their Soul-Forming Sword, with Sword Qi that could span three hundred li and a single strike that could chill the seven provinces. Yet, thirty years ago, they were suddenly exterminated."
"This matter has been classified as top-secret, but thirty years have passed, and the confidentiality period is about to expire. In fact, the truth behind the Wang Family’s annihilation had already been thoroughly investigated," Lu Zhao propped his chin on his hand, his voice low as he continued.
"It’s been thoroughly investigated?"
"Correct! The one who exterminated the Xiangnan Wang Family was none other than Wang Mingling, hailed as the once-in-a-millennium prodigy of the Wang Family. The Wang Family possessed an extraordinary talent for soul cultivation. Over thousands of years, their descendants branched out, forming the Qinghe Wang Clan, the Langya Wang Clan, and the Xiangnan Wang Family.
The Xiangnan Wang Family’s application of soul power was the most esoteric and versatile. However, the methods of the Xiangxi Wang Clan were truly insignificant compared to this prodigy from thirty years ago. Wang Mingling, born with the innate Soul Out of Body ability, could furthermore have his soul inhabit others’ bodies to access their memories.
As his power grew, his abilities became increasingly sinister. The attitude of the Xiangnan Wang Family towards him gradually shifted. From a universally admired and beloved family genius, he slowly became an outcast—feared, and eventually, even seen as an enemy by his own kin.
Wang Mingling wasn’t content with the family’s secret techniques; he even delved into their Family Forbidden Skills. Family Forbidden Skills were Star Martial Skills reserved for desperate times, cultivated only under extreme duress. Any technique designated as forbidden was so either because its cultivation was exceedingly perilous, its effects were devastatingly vicious, or it was deemed heretical.
Yet, Wang Mingling not only disregarded the elders’ counsel but became irrevocably engrossed in these forbidden skills. Finally, thirty years ago, the Xiangnan Wang Family made the agonizing decision to eliminate their own kin—to eradicate Wang Mingling.
However, the Wang Family was unaware that their Third Elder, Wang Mingling’s own paternal grandfather, had long been under Wang Mingling’s control. Thus, Wang Mingling was already privy to the family’s secret plot.
Before the family could make their move, Wang Mingling struck first. He conspired with the Cloud Sea heretical organization, initially poisoning all the Wang Family experts. Then, alongside these heretics, he slaughtered three hundred and seventy-two members of the Wang Family.
Initially, the blame was placed solely on the Cloud Sea heretical organization. However, after a year-long investigation, Jade Country finally uncovered the full truth. By that time, Wang Mingling had already absconded overseas. For the past thirty years, Wang Mingling has been active in the war-torn nations of the Middle East, where he established his own mercenary and assassin syndicate—Hellfire.
Our intelligence indicates that Wang Mingling can control corpses, frequently using them to execute suicidal terrorist attacks. However, the precise method he uses to control them remains unknown."
"If it’s Wang Mingling, why would he control Six Serpent Fury to rob a bank? Does he lack funds? What’s his motive for doing this?" Wang Qianfeng wondered aloud.
"I can think of two reasons. First, Wang Mingling entered Jade Country through illegal channels and couldn’t bring money with him, so he needs funds to support himself.
Second, he’s announcing his return; he’s declaring war on us."
"Declaring war!" Wang Qianfeng’s complexion instantly turned grim. "Does he really think Suzhou City is defenseless? If he wants a war, then a war he shall have! If he dares to come to Suzhou City, he won’t leave it alive."
"Feng, I’m assigning you to investigate Wang Mingling’s whereabouts. You are authorized to mobilize any and all necessary resources from the Tianjian Bureau. However... once you confirm his location, you must not act rashly."
Lu Zhao slowly stood up, his expression stern as he looked at Wang Qianfeng. "He is mine to deal with."
"Understood!" Wang Qianfeng nodded gravely.
For Lu Zhao to make such a solemn decision to personally intervene indicated that Wang Mingling’s strength was undoubtedly extraordinary. When he defected thirty years ago, he was already at the peak of the Galaxy Stage. Now, three decades later, he has likely reached the pinnacle of the Star Sea Stage.
While the Tianjian Bureau was on high alert, Wang Lan, having changed his clothes, stepped out of his house just as dusk began to settle.
Today, Xie Sisi was treating him to dinner. She had sent Wang Lan the location that morning. It was a seafood hotpot restaurant situated in the Ancient City District. This establishment was renowned in the culinary world for its exceptional service, a less-traveled path in the industry.
While most other eateries promoted their specialty dishes and gourmet cuisine, this hotpot restaurant carved out its own niche by prioritizing service excellence.
Their philosophy was ’The customer is king,’ with servers trained to the standards of airline flight attendants, making diners genuinely feel like VIPs. Initially, competitors scoffed, viewing this focus on service as an unorthodox gimmick.
Diners come for the food’s taste, not for pampering,
they thought. However, experience proved that customers sought not only culinary satisfaction but also fulfillment of their emotional and experiential desires.
Your watermelon is delicious!
If a customer said this, the restaurant would give them a whole watermelon to take home.
Your hotpot base is excellent!
The restaurant would promptly package some of their hotpot base for the customer to take home.
Today is my birthday!
The restaurant would immediately present a cake, a birthday gift, and their best wishes.
Thanks to its stellar word-of-mouth reputation, securing a table at Undersea Hotpot at the desired time required booking a day in advance.
By the time Wang Lan arrived, Xie Sisi and Jiang Xinyu were already there. Xie Sisi was wearing a long woolen coat, her makeup exquisitely done. As she rose, her nearly six-foot-tall, model-like stature instantly drew the attention of many in the restaurant.
As Wang Lan walked over, he even noticed several people surreptitiously taking photos of Xie Sisi with their phones. Of course, some considered approaching her to strike up a conversation. However, Jiang Xinyu, seated beside her, periodically exuded an icy ’keep your distance’ aura. Many were tempted, but none dared to act on it.
"Just the two of you? Xiangwen and Feiyu aren’t here yet?" Wang Lan sat down across from the two women.
"Traffic," Jiang Xinyu said flatly, glancing up from her phone before looking at Wang Lan with disdain. "So drab."
Drab?
Wang Lan looked down.
It’s a perfectly standard outfit, isn’t it?
ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ
"Fifty-buck jeans, an eighty-buck T-shirt, and a hundred-twenty-buck jacket. This is Sisi’s first time treating us; couldn’t you put in a little more effort?"
"Not at all!" Xie Sisi interjected. "Wang Lan’s attire is very approachable, so down-to-earth. Wang Lan, let me tell you something hilarious. A moment ago, some handsome guy came over, dangling his car keys, clearly intending to hit on Xinyu. He hadn’t even gotten close when Xinyu casually tossed her own car keys onto the table. The guy immediately veered left and headed for the restroom. I’m dying of laughter..."
"What’s so funny?" Jiang Xinyu retorted. "I can tell what guys like that are after with a single glance. Dangle keys to a two-million-yuan car, pretending to be some rich heir on the prowl. They look presentable on the outside, but their minds are filled with filth. Sisi, you’ll encounter plenty of these types in the future. I was just giving you a demonstration."
"Wait... someone with a two-million-yuan car isn’t considered a rich heir?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
"Assuming an eight percent ratio of car value to total assets, his net worth would be thirty million at most—not even enough for my yearly pocket money. Besides, guys who use fancy cars to pick up women rarely fit that ratio. That car probably accounts for half his assets. The more they show off, the poorer they usually are. He likely has seven or eight million in assets, tops. What’s that supposed to be?"
Xinyu might have a skewed definition of ’poor,’
Wang Lan thought."The traffic was insane!" Xu Xiangwen, dressed to the nines, rushed in as he spoke.
"Where’s Feiyu?"
"He and his girlfriend are still on their way. They should be here soon, ten minutes at most. Have you ordered yet?"
"Not yet. Wait, Gong Feiyu brought his girlfriend?"
"Yeah, that ’Golden Flower’ from sophomore year. Apparently, she’s distantly related to Feiyu’s maternal grandmother. They’ve known each other since childhood, practically childhood sweethearts... Ugh, it infuriates me just talking about it! Why do you all get childhood sweethearts, and I don’t? I want one too!"
We all do?
Wang Lan thought. "Don’t spread rumors."
"Still denying it? Feiyu’s got Hu Ling, you’ve got Xinyu. What about me? It’s always you three who have these connections, and I’m just here, your brother."
"Perhaps your parents’ love story is so enviable that the heavens grew jealous, hence your lack of such good fortune," Jiang Xinyu remarked, surprisingly pleased by Xu Xiangwen’s lament and even cracking a rare joke.
"Enough talk, let’s order! Menu, please! I shall channel my grief and indignation into my appetite!"
Xu Xiangwen was a seasoned pro at ordering, knowing everyone’s preferences perfectly. He rattled off the dishes, skillfully catering to each person’s taste while keeping a precise rein on the cost. His flurry of expert moves looked so impressive that the smiling server nearby thought they’d landed a tycoon. In reality, the final bill would definitely not exceed one thousand yuan.
The server departed with the order just as Gong Feiyu arrived with his girlfriend.
Hu Ling was one of the ’Four Golden Flowers’ of the Star Martial Arts Campus. Wang Lan had heard her name mentioned multiple times but had never actually met her. Living up to her title, Hu Ling possessed a stunning beauty that was by no means inferior to Jiang Xinyu’s. She was not tall and had a petite frame, exuding the delicate air of a clinging vine.
Wang Lan had only heard of Hu Ling’s renowned beauty, not of any particular talent or strength.
Perhaps her abilities are unremarkable,
he mused. Given the significant height difference between her and Gong Feiyu, even if Hu Ling harbored the ambitions of a soaring Dapeng Roc, she probably lacked the wingspan to achieve them.
"Sister Xinyu, Brother Xiangwen, and you must be the legendary top scholar, Brother Lan, right?" Hu Ling greeted the three enthusiastically as soon as she arrived.
Then, she turned to Xie Sisi. "You must be Sister Sisi? I’ve come uninvited; please forgive my impertinence..."
"Not at all, not at all! Server, please add another set of utensils for us," Xie Sisi responded quickly.
"Thank you, Sister Sisi. Happy birthday!" As she spoke, Hu Ling took a gift box from her bag and presented it to Xie Sisi with both hands.
Xie Sisi looked utterly astonished. "You... how did you know?" Then, her gaze swept questioningly over Wang Lan and the others. "You all knew?"
"Sisi, what kind of question is that? As if you could keep it from us!" Xu Xiangwen chimed in, pulling a gift box from his bag. "Happy birthday."
"Sisi, happy birthday."
"Sisi, happy birthday—"
Instantly, Xie Sisi’s eyes brimmed with tears.

chapters.title: Chapter 170 The Ultimate Kill with That Arrow
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 170 The Ultimate Kill with That Arrow
Xie Sisi spent almost every birthday by herself. Her parents worked in manufacturing, relying almost entirely on overtime to make ends meet, so they hardly ever passed up any opportunity to work extra hours.
Her brother was a chef and never had any time off either. Although she received blessings and gifts every year, Xie Sisi had hardly any truly memorable birthday moments in her memories.
Since Xie Sisi got to know Wang Lan, her life had begun to take a turn. Before the New Year, her father had been promoted to a management position by his superiors. During the winter vacation, she herself had successfully broken through to the Star Shine Stage in the trial field, even reaching the mid-stage of the Star Shine Stage in one fell swoop.
In the New Year, Xie Sisi accompanied her parents to her fourth maternal uncle’s house in the distant Xu City, a visit that truly allowed her to hold her head high. Her cousin, who had broken through to the Star Shine Stage a year prior, was still only in its early phase. Xie Sisi, on the other hand, had merely been at the Starlight Stage back then.
Now, not only had she surpassed him in rank, but her strength also overwhelmingly outstripped his. During her visit, her uncle personally tested Xie Sisi’s strength, and the results shocked everyone.
Even without using Star Martial Skills, Xie Sisi could actually fight to a draw with her uncle, who was at the Star Cloud Stage. It wasn’t the kind of draw where the opponent held back—it was a genuine stalemate.
Recalling her aunt’s displeased expression brought joy to Xie Sisi. Previously, her aunt always assumed that Xie Sisi would eventually try to take advantage of her uncle. But now, it wasn’t so certain who would be relying on whom for support. For the first time, when her uncle generously handed Xie Sisi a large red envelope, her aunt didn’t utter a single word of protest.
Xie Sisi understood that deep down, her uncle cared for her. He just couldn’t show it because of her aunt.
Xie Sisi cherished the help Wang Lan and the others had given her, which was why she was determined to treat them to a meal.
But without a good reason, they definitely wouldn’t agree. Even if they did, they would undoubtedly fight over who paid the bill.
She just hadn’t expected them to find out about her birthday today; she certainly hadn’t managed to keep it a secret.
"Sisi, don’t just stand there looking touched. Aren’t you going to open them?"
"Can I?"
"Of course."Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Xie Sisi first opened Xu Xiangwen’s gift box. Inside was a pair of metal gloves. They were quite different from the fist-type gloves Xu Xiangwen had previously worn; these were more intricate and far cooler.
Xu Xiangwen’s previous punch gloves had only a single loop for the fingers, while this pair featured five individual finger stalls, each leaving only the top joint of the finger exposed. The gloves extended all the way to the elbows, gleaming like silver or platinum.
Simple yet elegant, understated yet exquisite.
"This... this must be very valuable, right?" Xie Sisi asked hesitantly.
"Valuable? What’s that got to do with anything? Sisi, you should know us by now. The word ’valuable’ shouldn’t even be in our vocabulary when it comes to friends. These are gloves made of Star Pattern Mus steel. You understand how much they can help you."
Star Pattern Mus steel was a metal alloy accidentally synthesized a hundred years ago by the metallurgical master Mus. This metal was known for its high strength, excellent tensile properties, and most importantly, it was the fastest known material for conducting Star Power.
Items made from this material, whether weapons or protective gear, were highly sought after and beloved by Star Martial Warriors. The only drawback was its extreme expense.
"Xiangwen, this is too valuable... I..."
"Are we friends or not? If we are, then don’t refuse. Since I dared to give them to you, it means I believe our friendship is far more precious than these gloves. If you consider me a friend, accept them."
Touched, Xie Sisi accepted the gloves. She then opened Gong Feiyu’s gift, which was a pendant.
"Sisi, I’m not very good at choosing gifts. Lingling picked this out."
"Thank you, I really like it," Xie Sisi replied with a smile, accepting it. Since she had already accepted Xu Xiangwen’s incredibly valuable gift, she naturally wouldn’t refuse this pendant.
Then, Xie Sisi excitedly opened Wang Lan’s gift. When she saw the Soul Bead lying quietly inside, her expression changed abruptly.
"Is this... a Star Martial Skill?"
"Yes, this is the Water Substitute Star Martial Skill. I thought it would suit you, so I bought it."
"Thank you!" Xie Sisi’s cheeks flushed. She didn’t even ask the price. After all, Star Martial Skills were never cheap. A single Soul Bead started at eighty thousand; how inexpensive could this possibly be?
"That’s very timely. Since Wang Lan gave you a Water Attribute evasion-type Star Martial Skill, I’ll give you a Water Attribute defense-type Star Martial Skill. Don’t refuse it; this skill wasn’t purchased by me. It was imprinted from my mind by a Star Martial Skill engraving master. A Grade-B Star Martial Skill, Extreme Wall of Water."
"What? Imprinted from your mind? Could that affect you?" Xie Sisi asked nervously.
"What are you worried about? Many profound aspects of Star Martial Skills can only be understood intuitively and cannot be conveyed through words. That’s why the inheritance of Star Martial Skills is mostly done through Spiritual Engraving. Imprinting it into someone’s mind is the same as imprinting it onto a Soul Bead."
The gifts from Wang Lan and the others caught Xie Sisi completely off guard. She truly hadn’t expected them to know it was her birthday, much less that they would give her such incredibly valuable presents.
Just the two Star Martial Skills were priceless, not to mention Xu Xiangwen’s Star Pattern Mus Steel Gloves. The combined worth of these items was probably several million.
If it were merely a matter of value, Xie Sisi would have insisted on refusing. But these items weren’t just precious; their significance was far deeper. If she refused, Wang Lan and the others would genuinely be upset. In the end, not only did she avoid any expense, but she had also profited immensely.
The dishes arrived quickly. For six Star Martial Warriors, it was time to demonstrate their true eating capacity.
An entire table of food was devoured in less than twenty minutes. When everyone was having such a good time, who worried about the cost? They ate with abandon, ordering dishes to their hearts’ content.
Two hours later, all that remained was a table piled high with plates like a small mountain, and two waiters panting from exhaustion.
The final bill came to over four thousand.
"Sisi, get in the car, I’ll drive you home," Jiang Xinyu said, wrapping her arm around Xie Sisi.
"No need, I can get a taxi myself. It’s still early..."
"Sisi, let Xinyu take you home. Xinyu, if you encounter foreigners trying to flag you down, don’t stop. If someone tries to forcibly stop you, just ram through them. I’ll take responsibility for anything that happens."
Upon hearing this, Xie Sisi’s expression froze. Jiang Xinyu silently nodded and asked, "Is it table seventy-six?"
"Yes!"
At table seventy-six, three tables away from theirs, sat four foreigners. From the moment Xie Sisi had started opening her gifts, these four had repeatedly glanced in her direction.
Although it’s said one shouldn’t flaunt wealth, in the Jade Country, under broad daylight, there was generally no need to be overly cautious. Ordinary people wouldn’t recognize the value of items like Star Martial Skills or Star Pattern Mus Steel Gloves. Even if other Star Martial Warriors were present, the chance of them acting with malicious intent was incredibly small.
But these particular foreigners seemed to have a robber’s instinct. The moment Xie Sisi opened the first box, their greedy gazes shot over, completely undisguised. With Wang Lan’s alertness, how could he have failed to notice?
The four cars started and drove off. In truth, not many people would dare to commit robbery in broad daylight in Suzhou City. Even if those blond-haired, blue-eyed foreigners harbored greedy thoughts, it was unlikely they would actually dare to make a move.
Half an hour later, Wang Lan received a call from Xie Sisi, notifying him of her safe arrival home. Soon after, Xu Xiangwen and the others also phoned in, having reached their destinations safely.
Wang Lan arrived home around nine in the evening. School was starting again the next day. After taking a bath, he went to bed early.
Just as he was drifting off to sleep, he was jolted awake by his ringing phone.
Who could it be?
Wang Lan irritably picked up his phone. A single glance at the screen instantly banished all sleepiness.
It was an emergency alert from the Tianjian Bureau.
Every official member of the Tianjian Bureau was equipped with a special mobile phone that had an emergency alert function. In urgent situations, pressing the alert would summon all Tianjian Bureau members in the jurisdiction, who were to rush to the target location.
The source of the alert wasn’t far from Wang Lan’s location. It originated from a villa district one and a half kilometers southeast of the Eastern Heaven Gate commercial district.
Without hesitation, Wang Lan sprang out of bed. He threw on his clothes while heading downstairs. Two minutes later, his electric scooter, its speed limiter disengaged, roared out of the underground garage.
In this mode, the scooter’s top speed could reach one hundred and twenty kilometers per hour. Zipping through the city, it was faster than any car, especially now, around eleven or twelve at night, when the roads were still quite busy.
In less than ten minutes, Wang Lan arrived at the targeted residential complex. The area had already been disturbed by a series of explosions, causing many residents to rush out of their homes in shock. However, the site of the explosions was some distance away, and they lacked the courage to investigate.
Upon entering the complex, Wang Lan leaped into the air, bounding across the tops of streetlights as he sped towards the target location.
From a distance, he saw three figures engaged in a chaotic battle in the yard of a villa. Wang Lan didn’t need a closer look to know who to help: two blond, blue-eyed foreigners were attacking someone who appeared to be from the Jade Country.
Wang Lan leaped high, instantly linking his Crescent Arrow and Flame Sword techniques.
A Purple Flame Arrow shot out within a second. SIZZLE—
"RUN!" a shout escaped one of the foreigners as his body was flung backward. The other foreigner had just stabbed his sword into the chest of the Tianjian Bureau agent. He barely had time to retreat before the Purple Flame Arrow reached his face.
There’s no time to dodge!
The blond foreigner clenched his teeth, crossing his arms before his chest. Instantly, a golden gleam flickered around him, and moments later, he was encased in a layer of silvery-white metal. Transformed into a statue, he intended to withstand Wang Lan’s arrow head-on.
Among the seven attributes, the Gold Attribute possessed the highest defensive power. Just as the Thunder Attribute was famed for its claim, "There is no absolute defense I cannot pierce," the Gold Attribute, in turn, boasted, "There is no attack I cannot block."
BOOM—
This arrow had been shot from a hundred meters away. Normally, the greater the distance, the weaker the attack. Moreover, Wang Lan’s attack had been launched in haste and clearly wasn’t at full power. This thought had barely formed in the blond foreigner’s mind when, in the next instant, his expression changed drastically.
Wang Lan’s arrow pierced deeply into the silver statue, half its length sinking into the chest.
But that wasn’t the end. Before the blond foreigner could recover from the severe impact, the terrifying power within the Purple Flame Arrow erupted. In that instant, all the foreigner had time to feel was overwhelming terror.
BOOM—
He was blown to pieces.
The Tianjian Bureau agent on the receiving end of the foreigner’s attack stared wide-eyed, his face a mask of disbelief. He clutched his chest and slowly collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: The Importance of Participation
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 171: The Importance of Participation
"Overkill reward: 1,000 experience points, 20 skill points." The moment Wang Lan arrived at the scene, the system notification echoed in his mind.
"Bro, hurry... chase..." A weak voice rang out. The middle-aged man who had been injured by the blonde foreigner struggled to prop himself up and urgently spoke to Wang Lan.
Chase under these circumstances? Chase my ass.
When Wang Lan approached, the man had one hand pressed against his chest, from which fresh blood was spurting out; his body was convulsing non-stop, and he was clearly on the brink of death.
"I’m a Captain from the Tianjian Bureau’s Intelligence Department. Who are you?"
"I know you... you’re Wang Lan, the mascot of the Intelligence Department. My name is Ma Weidong... from the Action Department... leader of the Second Action Team."
After confirming they were on the same side, Wang Lan yanked open the man’s collar and pressed his palm on the wound, activating his Healing Star Martial Arts.
It wasn’t long before there was a commotion nearby. Soon, members of the Tianjian Bureau arrived in twos and threes.
"What’s going on? Who’s calling for backup?"
"That was a fierce battle... the area within a hundred meters was completely wrecked."
"COUGH, COUGH! Old Yu, can’t you stop with the snide remarks?" Ma Weidong opened his eyes and cursed weakly.
"Yo, Captain Ma? Sorry, didn’t recognize you since you were beaten so badly. What happened? When did you get back? Weren’t you away for advanced training?"
"Go to hell, I’ve been back for a month. I took on a mission to protect Mu Liancheng from a high-priced foreign organization’s assassination attempt. But I didn’t expect the assassins to be so powerful, sending four Star Cloud Stage experts for the hit."
"Did they succeed?"
"They did."
"Captain Ma, something doesn’t add up. Everyone knew that foreign organizations were targeting Mu Liancheng for assassination, so why weren’t full precautions taken? Even if you took on the mission, you couldn’t have been expected to complete it alone, right?"
"How the hell would I know? Are the guards at the border dead? How could they let such a dangerous Caucasian get through? Fine, even if they managed to slip through the border, how could they possibly make it all the way to Suzhou City? Since when has our Jade Country’s counter-infiltration been so worthless? Besides, the foreign organization’s bounty is only 20 million. Can 20 million hire four Star Cloud Stage masters? My guess is, at that price, they could at most send one or two hitmen. Who would have thought..."
At that moment, Wang Lan also stood up. "Alright!"
"Thank you, Brother Wang."
"Captain, there’s a survivor here," a Tianjian Bureau member suddenly called out.
"Right, I almost forgot. It’s Mu Liancheng’s son. If it weren’t for this kid, I probably wouldn’t have even had the chance to signal for help. He’s just a high school student, yet he already has the cultivation level of the Star Cloud Stage. He’s a genius!"
"Captain Wang, could you take a look at him?"
Wang Lan didn’t hesitate, instantly walking over to the individual in question. After just a glance, he showed a surprised expression on his face.
"It’s him!"
"Captain Wang, you know him?"The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"His name is Mu Shaoyun. We’re from the same class year, but not the same class."
Mu Shaoyun, a genius who had long dominated the first rank in the Star Martial Arts Campus at Suzhou No.1 Middle School. Even Jiang Xinyu had managed to suppress him only for a few months at the beginning of their senior year. Once Mu Shaoyun successfully broke through to the Star Cloud Stage, he took back the lead.
The conditions of Mu Shaoyun’s family were similar to those of Jiang Xinyu; his parents were engaged in overseas trade, earning them the nickname of South Ship King in Jade Country. Given Mu Shaoyun’s exceptional innate talent and the vast resources at his disposal, Wang Lan wasn’t the least bit surprised that he ruled over the Star Martial Arts Campus.
Yet, it was unexpected that the renowned South Ship King would be assassinated, and right before his eyes?
"His body is not seriously harmed; he’s just drained of Star Power," Wang Lan stated.
"That’s good to hear."
Soon enough, more members from the Tianjian Bureau arrived, and the leader of the Action Department, Li Weixin, also reached the scene.
Wang Lan was only there to provide temporary support. After the arrival of more backup, he briefed Li Weixin on the situation and then took his leave. Even if Mu Shaoyun was his classmate, even if South Ship King Mu Liancheng’s assassination would cause international shockwaves, these matters had nothing to do with Wang Lan. If it wasn’t his business, he wouldn’t care too much, especially when the system didn’t prompt any mission—he was utterly detached.
「The next day, Wang Lan shouldered his backpack and went to school as usual.」
As soon as he arrived at his class, before he even had time to set down his bag, Xu Xiangwen grabbed Wang Lan’s arm. "Wang Lan, did you hear?"
Wang Lan nodded gravely. "I heard! The preliminaries for the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting are about to start, and Old Liu might give us the registration forms today."
"I’m not talking about that!"
"Is it about the possibility of this year’s Provincial Martial Arts Meeting being broadcast on television?"
"No! It’s about an incident at Mu Shaoyun’s home. I heard his parents made some enemies and were assassinated by them, leaving Mu Shaoyun seriously injured."
Wang Lan looked at Xu Xiangwen oddly. What kind of intelligence capability did this guy have? Last night’s event was already news by the early morning?
"Don’t disbelieve me. I heard it from a classmate in class five this morning. Someone in class five lives in the same neighborhood as Mu Shaoyun."
"So be it... I’ll trust you for now, but no gossiping. Let’s wait for the truth to come out."
"I get it. Whether it’s true or not, Mu Shaoyun is our classmate after all. It’s not right to talk behind his back, and it’s even worse to gloat over his misfortune."
"When did I gloat?"
"The smile on your face has already given you away."
Even if Wang Lan and Xu Xiangwen stopped discussing it, by noon, the rumors about Mu Shaoyun’s family being in trouble and his Star Palace being ruined, reducing him to an ordinary person, were still spreading among the classmates.
Gossip, indeed, is human nature. Besides, when three people say something, it takes on a life of its own, turning the rumor outrageous.
"Students, the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting is starting in a month, and this year’s event might be different from the past. But no matter how different it is, for us, that makes no difference. Strive to improve and actively prepare, to meet this event in your best form—a once-in-a-lifetime event for you. In the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting, each city will send a team of ten representatives. We, in Suzhou City, only have one Star Martial High School, so it’s not that complicated. Those who are interested in registering, please submit your application forms to my office before the end of school today."
Before the afternoon class, Liu Jie distributed the application forms. The main task for today was to register for the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting. Registration was purely voluntary, but as a teacher, he hoped that all the capable students in his class would participate.
Especially Mingyue Wucheng and his two companions; their strength was unfathomably deep. If they were serious, even Jiang Xinyu might not win against any one of them. But the three of them seemed to have no interest in the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting, as they absentmindedly shoved the registration forms into their drawers, not intending to take them out again.
"Wucheng, are you guys...not planning on competing?" Wang Lan curiously leaned over and asked.
"Not competing!" Mingyue Wucheng said with a wry smile, shaking his head. "People like us, if we compete, wouldn’t that be denying others any chance of victory? Win a championship that’s already reserved, and there’s no sense of achievement."
"Damn!" Wang Lan raised his Wild Imprisonment Finger as a sign of respect. "So the Star Martial Warrior families aren’t participating?"
"Not necessarily, it depends on the person." Obviously, Mingyue Wucheng knew Wang Lan had not just leaned over out of simple concern for whether they were participating or not.
"For descendants of Star Martial Warrior families like us, there’s really no need to compete in the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting. Winning doesn’t help much, and losing would bring shame to the family. But for those Star Martial Warrior families that are declining or rising, it’s a stage to announce their comeback. Hence, each year at the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting, the ones who truly shine are often the descendants of Star Martial Warrior families. Not to dampen your spirits, but whether it’s you, Wang Lan, or classmate Jiang Xinyu, making it into the top ten in the province would already be an extraordinary achievement. You indeed have peerless talents and resources. But even if you rely on your talent and resources, it would be tough to compete with those Star Martial Warrior families with a solid background. One point, in particular, is the Inborn Talent of the Bloodline, which you lack. Well, it seems you have one, but your Inborn Talent of the Bloodline is of the Medical Attribute."
"There are at least five hundred Star Martial Warrior families in Jiang Province, if not a thousand. Star Martial Warrior families can’t be simply described as a lineage of Star Martial Warriors passed down over five generations. A recognized Star Martial Warrior family not only has an ancestry of Star Martial Warriors, but they also must possess the family’s Inborn Talent of the Bloodline and ancestral secret techniques. Their Inborn Talents of the Bloodline and secret techniques have been perfected over countless generations. If there was a way to break them, it wouldn’t be up to us students to find it. Against those Inborn Talents of the Bloodline and secret techniques, we’re basically helpless. I heard that this time, for Jin City’s delegation, more than half are descendants of Star Martial Warrior families. Jiang Province has thirteen cities, so the top ten masters will likely be dominated by Star Martial Warrior family descendants."
"Are Star Martial Warrior families really that powerful?" Xu Xiangwen asked with some dissatisfaction.
"Sorry to say, but Star Martial Warrior families are indeed that powerful. What I said earlier about how if I participated, no one else would stand a chance, was just bragging. Actually, it’s because I’m not sure I can make it into the top ten that I decided to give up. The Mingyue Family of Suzhou City is also ranked within the top one hundred Star Martial Warrior families in the whole of Jade Country. Among the Mingyue Family’s new generation, my talent and strength are considered outstanding. However, this world is never short of demons and freaks. If you could easily defeat me at my full strength, then there might still be hope for competing for the top ten. If you can’t do that, you might not even make it into the top twenty. I’m not intentionally trying to discourage you—it’s genuinely tough."
Mingyue Wucheng and Wang Lan’s group had a good relationship, so they believed what he said. But because they believed it, Jiang Xinyu’s face also became somber.
"No matter how difficult it is, I must participate in the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting. If I don’t try hard enough, how will I know if I can succeed, right?" Gong Feiyu said with a light smile.
"Of course. I’ll collect some intel on the other cities for you these days. As a friend, I hope you can achieve good results too and maybe even get noticed by one of the four major Star Martial Academies."
"Thank you!"
Of the fifty students in the class, most of them actually didn’t dare to fill in the form. It wasn’t about courage; it was about reality. Only ten people would be chosen for Suzhou City’s team. If you impulsively decided to fill in the form, then ask yourself: can my strength rank within the top ten in the entire grade?
If you honestly reflected, most people would throw their pens down and think, "To hell with the Provincial Martial Arts Meeting. I’m doomed not to even qualify to represent Suzhou City, so why bother signing up..."
Xie Sisi was struggling with this right now.
Looking at the sign-up form in front of her, Xie Sisi could only write her name before finding herself unable to continue.
Although Xie Sisi’s strength had increased dramatically, and she reigned supreme in unarmed combat among Suzhou City’s high school seniors, what was her true combat level?
Perhaps only eighth in the class.
Eighth in the class, at most, could put her in the top thirty of the whole grade. Joining the ten-person team... was nearly impossible. To sign up would be to inevitably face elimination.
After pondering for a while, Xie Sisi finally set down her pen.
"You’re quitting too?" Jiang Xinyu asked after she finished filling out the form.
"There’s almost no chance I’ll represent Suzhou City in the competition... I better not bother," Sisi said with a wry smile on her face.
"It’s about participation, right? What if you do make it into the top ten and represent Suzhou City? That could also add a feather to your school’s cap. Even if you get eliminated early, just being able to represent Suzhou City would be a testament to your strength," Wang Lan turned around and persuaded.
Encouraged by Wang Lan’s gentle, encouraging gaze, Xie Sisi picked up her pen again and began to fill out the application form seriously.
This scene made Jiang Xinyu really want to kick Wang Lan.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Dare to Covet What’s in My Bowl?
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 172: Dare to Covet What’s in My Bowl?
In the intelligence department of the Tianjian Bureau in Suzhou City, Wang Qianfeng lifted his head from the documents, wearily rubbing the space between his brows.
Brave assumptions and meticulous investigations were Wang Qianfeng’s consistent style. Although initially, he had suspected that Wang Mingling’s shadow was behind those bank robbers, Wang Qianfeng had only been preparing for the worst.
However, as the investigation deepened and more clues converged, this worst-case scenario tilted bit by bit towards reality. It appeared from the myriad of subtle hints that Wang Mingling was not only plotting against Suzhou City but might have already arrived there.
Moreover, Wang Qianfeng was certain that for Wang Mingling to return so smoothly and silently, he must have formed some collaboration with certain domestic powers.
Wang Mingling, a supreme expert of the Star Sea Stage, possessed numerous bizarre secret techniques that made him an unpredictable opponent.
What a difficult adversary...
Wang Qianfeng sighed, closed the file in his hand, stood up, and walked towards the classified documents department with the file.
"Wow, so handsome... How did I not notice this before?"
"You’re just out of the loop. Do you think the sisters calling Wang Lan and Lige the ’Twin Prides of Suzhou Bureau’ is just made up? You’re just slow on the uptake, not seeing Wang Lan’s potential from the start.
In the past, those who swooned over Lige argued with us, saying that aside from being lucky, Wang Lan had nothing else going for him, that he wasn’t as strong as Lige, not to mention not as handsome. Handsome my foot. Lige only knows how to pose cool, but he’s not as warm as Wang Lan.
Wang Lan is only seventeen and already at the mid-stage of the Star Shine Stage. He will definitely reach the late phase of the Star Cloud Stage before turning twenty. Speaking of handsomeness, with his Crescent Arrow, Wang Lan leaves Lige several streets behind..."
"AHEM—" Wang Qianfeng cleared his throat lightly.
"Ah! Director Wang, I’m sorry, we..."
"Archive the classified documents," Wang Qianfeng said indifferently, his eyes inadvertently scanning the two nearly thirty-year-old women, whose cheeks flushed as they eagerly discussed the young heartthrob, Wang Lan.
After the New Year, Wang Lan’s popularity did indeed soar. Wang Qianfeng was aware that many female officers in the bureau hailed Wang Lan and Lige as the ’Twin Prides.’ He had even heard that the fans of both men had several quarrels in the bureau’s chat groups.
To Wang Qianfeng, this was simply trivial. With the time and energy spent on these matters, it would be better to devote oneself to training and improve one’s own strength. However, reality proved that when it came to idolizing, women were irrational creatures.
Their argument, in essence, was: "What’s wrong with being a fan? It’s an attitude, a way of life. We work at the Tianjian Bureau; can’t we have hobbies outside of work? At least our admiration stays in-house; the one we’re fawning over is a brother from our own bureau, right?"
The flustered women took the file Wang Qianfeng handed over. "Director Wang, should this be destroyed?"
"No need, but it requires Level A confidentiality. By the way, what’s with the buzz around Wang Lan again?" Wang Qianfeng asked nonchalantly. He remembered that since school started more than half a month ago, that guy Wang Lan hadn’t shown his face at the bureau once.
After receiving a military rank and a Sun Shine Medal, he had completely vanished. He had interfered with the robbers’ case and had a hand in dealing with the foreign assassins’ assassination attempt. So why was he so indifferent about finding Wang Mingling’s whereabouts and locating the foreign assassins’ hideout? Had he become too arrogant?
At that moment, Wang Qianfeng had run out of patience. Even if Wang Lan were in front of him, Wang Qianfeng would have the moral high ground to point at Wang Lan’s nose and scold him.
Aren’t you the lucky mascot? Aren’t you the koi? Aren’t you the legend who can find a traitor in one day, crack an elite spy group in two, and uncover a Demonic Transformation Potion production workshop in three? Do it again, what’s stopping you from doing it again?
You better find them for me!
However, out of concern for face and the fact that Wang Lan was preparing for the provincial martial arts examination, Wang Qianfeng had never resolved to bring Wang Lan into the bureau to give him a boost in his Lucky Attribute.
But today, after hearing the conversation between the two girls, it seemed like Wang Lan hadn’t been idle and was stirring up some trouble again.
"No, it’s still about the bank robbery by Snake Six. Didn’t Wang Lan just happen to come across it? The place where he took action was a high-speed section on an overpass, equipped with a surveillance camera that captured the footage of Wang Lan in action."
"Oh? Send it to me."
The two girls from the classified documents department didn’t dare delay and quickly sent the video to Wang Qianfeng. After completing the handover of the documents, Wang Qianfeng returned to his office. Looking at the calendar, it was the weekend again.
As soon as the video played, it showed a black armored vehicle speeding along the winding overpass ramp. In the distance, from the rooftops of a residential area, a figure descended from the sky like a great Roc spreading its wings.
With a bang, he landed on the overpass, and the camera angle only caught a side view of Wang Lan. The breeze brushed his face as his trench coat danced like flames, and his disheveled hair made his silhouette exceptionally dashing and handsome.
Seeing the scene in the video, Wang Qianfeng felt a tightness in his chest. For a moment, he seemed to see another woman, shining like a dazzling sun. Their silhouettes, at that moment, overlapped so perfectly.
All of a sudden, Wang Lan raised his hand, stretching his arm forward in the shape of a handgun. Instantly, golden Star Power surged, causing his cloak to flutter even more intensely. In a split second, a pair of golden wings unfolded on Wang Lan’s wrist, as if drawing a full moon longbow.
WHOOSH—
An arrow shot forth from the tips of Wang Lan’s fingers, instantly striking the armored car that was charging from afar.
This scene, this arrow, could indeed be described as breathtakingly cool. Any girl who saw this image would be guaranteed to have stars in her eyes.
But at this moment, Wang Qianfeng’s expression suddenly darkened.
"Crescent Arrow! Vermilion Bird!"
What followed was naturally Wang Lan firing another arrow, directly shattering the left wheel of the armored car, causing it to flip and rush toward the opposite lane.
This scene, however, failed to bring any warmth to Wang Qianfeng’s face, which turned as black as the bottom of a pot.
The Vermilion Bird Squad was the shame of Wang Qianfeng’s life—a special force he couldn’t even qualify to apply for, no matter how hard he tried.
Wang Qianfeng held no grudge against the Vermilion Bird Squad. They only recruited elites from the Star Sea Stage and above, so Wang Qianfeng’s insufficient strength was understandable. "If a place doesn’t cherish me, there’s surely another place that will," right?
But digging people out of my bowl is crossing the line! What about your rule of only recruiting Star Sea Stage elites? Fed to the dogs? You’re teaching such an iconic Star Martial Skill like Crescent Arrow; can’t you at least respect me a little and cover up your intentions?
The Vermilion Bird Squad has four major Star Martial Skills, and every member must master each one; the Crescent Arrow is one of them.
The thought that Wang Lan would soon be coaxed and tricked into being poached by the Vermilion Bird Squad made Wang Qianfeng’s temples twitch uncontrollably.
Picking up the phone by his side, he dialed the number.
「In Wang Lan’s underground Training Room」
Jiang Xinyu was intensely exchanging Star Martial Skills with Xie Sisi. It had to be said, Xie Sisi’s talent was indeed terrifying. In just a week, she had not only mastered the Water Bomb Steel Cannon taught by Liu Jie but also the Water Shadow Substitute gifted to her by Wang Lan.
However, although she had learned these two Star Martial Skills, she had not yet trained them to the point of instant activation. She certainly hadn’t reached the extent where she could activate them instinctively in a life-or-death moment.
Even so, it had only been seven days. Xie Sisi’s ability to learn two C-grade Star Martial Skills in seven days had already won the full admiration of Xu Xiangwen and the others.
As for the Extreme Wall of Water that Jiang Xinyu taught her, Xie Sisi was still unable to master it. After all, she wasn’t a freak like Wang Lan.
During this week, the five-person squad had been continuously practicing real combat with Star Martial Skills in Wang Lan’s house, progressively improving their combat experience in the chaotic skirmishes.
RING RING RING—
The mobile phone rang. Wang Lan casually picked it up, saw it was from Director Wang, and hurriedly ran to the side to answer the call.
"Director Wang."
"Wang Lan, today is Saturday. You shouldn’t be at school, right?"
"Director Wang, is there a mission? I’m completely free. I guarantee I’ll complete the mission."
"Come to the bureau to report first."
"Yes!"
BOOM—
A loud bang resounded as Xie Sisi was hit by the backlash of Jiang Xinyu’s Star Martial Skill. Her body was thrown high into the air before slamming hard against the electromagnetic barrier.
"COUGH COUGH COUGH—" Blood spattered from her mouth along with violent coughing.
"Sisi, are you okay?" Jiang Xinyu asked anxiously. Although Wang Lan was there to protect them, she was always afraid whenever Xie Sisi got hurt.
"I’m fine... My internal organs just took an impact, that’s all. Indeed, I still have a long way to go to reach Xinyu’s level. As soon as Xinyu uses a Star Martial Skill, I stand no chance at all."
"Sisi has made great progress in strength. At this rate of improvement, catching up with us before graduation won’t be a problem," Xu Xiangwen said, standing up and taking off his jacket to comfort her.
The gap between Xie Sisi and them wasn’t something that could be closed in one or two months. At the very least, it would take until their first or second year of college.
"Guys, I need to step out for a bit. Keep going without me. If I’m not back by evening, don’t wait up, and remember to lock the door, okay?"
"Something from above?"
"Not sure, but they asked me to make a trip there. Sisi, come here, I’ll treat your injury first."
After treating Xie Sisi, Wang Lan rode his electric moped to the Tianjian Bureau, went straight to the fifth floor, and knocked on the door of Wang Qianfeng’s office.
"Come in!"
"Reporting to Director Wang, Wang Lan reporting for duty."
"Wang Lan... when do you plan on job-hopping?" Wang Qianfeng straightened up, leaning back in his chair with a smile in his eyes as he asked.
"Job-hopping? No, I haven’t..." Wang Lan replied, baffled.
"Have you had contact with anyone from the Vermilion Bird Squad?"ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Images of Gong Jian immediately came to Wang Lan’s mind. Unsure of what Wang Qianfeng really meant, he could only silently nod.
"What kinds of perks have they promised you?"
"No, Director Wang, have you misunderstood something? I know someone who retired from the Vermilion Bird Squad; his name is Gong Jian, and he’s the manager of the Star Martial Skill Trading House at the Suzhou City Star Martial Hall."
"Retired? Haha... do you have some misconceptions about the Vermilion Bird Squad? In the Vermilion Bird Squad, there are only martyrs, no retirees. Sure, you can retire—once you’re dead!"
"Is it that fierce?"
"How did you get to know Gong Jian? Tell me in detail."
Wang Lan then recounted the whole story of purchasing the Crescent Arrow to Wang Qianfeng in great detail.
As Wang Lan explained, Wang Qianfeng felt utterly exasperated listening to the details. The Vermilion Bird Squad indeed had no intention of poaching Wang Lan, but Wang Lan had practically delivered himself to their doorstep!
Long-range, A-grade Star Martial Skill. Do you think A-grade Star Martial Skills are cabbages, something you can just have if you want? How many A-grade or higher long-range shooting Star Martial Skills are there? Which one isn’t tightly held by various forces? You think you can buy one with money? Those who possess A-grade Star Martial Skills don’t lack money!
Wang Qianfeng managed to suppress his frustration for a long moment, but finally decided to vent it on Wang Lan. "You already have two A-grade Star Martial Skills, so why are you still learning Crescent Arrow? Aren’t two A-grade Star Martial Skills enough for you? What do you think Star Martial Skills are? The more the merrier? What is the biggest taboo for a Star Martial Warrior? Being a jack of all trades and master of none.
Even if you know ten Star Martial Skills, they’re no match for perfecting one to the utmost. Do you think you’ve mastered the Star Cloud Sword Dance and Flame Sword very well?"
"I think... they’re okay!" Wang Lan replied obediently, with a meek expression.
"You..."

chapters.title: Chapter 173 I Must Teach You a Lesson Today
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 173 I Must Teach You a Lesson Today
Wang Lan’s remarks left Wang Qianfeng with a stinging pain in his chest.
Despite knowing that Wang Lan’s talent was commendable, did he really have to disregard the warnings of his seniors so blatantly? What did he mean by thinking it was ’all right’? These were the collective experiences of countless Star Martial Warriors. Did he think that amounted to nothing?
But Wang Lan was still young. If his blood didn’t run hot with arrogance and high spirits, would he still be a youth?
At that moment, a cold smile curled at the corner of Wang Qianfeng’s mouth.
"You think so? Good... you’ve finally shown me your immature side. You’re at the Star Shine Stage, and you think your Star Power is profound, do you? How much Star Power do you need to release an A-Grade Star Martial Skill?"
"Well... it depends. Flame Sword and Star Cloud Sword Dance are sustained Star Martial Skills. I can keep them up for about... ten minutes straight."
"Ten minutes? It seems your Star Power isn’t particularly exceptional. I can maintain Star Cloud Sword Dance for more than four hours. A Star Cloud Stage practitioner can maintain it for at least an hour, and you only last ten minutes.
Ten minutes, and you think that’s a long time? You believe you can end a battle in ten minutes? You’re only at the Star Shine Stage. Even with all your talent, in the world of Star Martial Warriors, you’re just cannon fodder.
Surviving real, brutal battlefields is all down to luck. Do you think you’ve already mastered Star Cloud Sword Dance and Flame Sword? Your goal should be to sustain combat for the longest possible time with the least Star Power consumption. To unleash the strongest power of your Star Martial Skills in the most Star Power-efficient way—this is what you should be striving for, rather than haphazardly learning Star Martial Skills and biting off more than you can chew."
Facing Wang Qianfeng’s scolding, Wang Lan respectfully accepted the lesson.
"Director Wang, I know you mean well, but my combat style has obvious weaknesses. Flame Sword and Star Cloud Sword Dance are only effective in close combat, and my attributes are easily countered. If I encounter Star Martial Warriors who can control the field, engage in aerial combat, or attack from a distance, I’ll be at a significant disadvantage.
The provincial tournament is coming up soon, which is why I’m learning Crescent Arrow."
"The reason isn’t important. What’s important is that you’ve strayed onto the wrong path. Your combat style is one-dimensional. Instead of focusing on honing the application of your Star Martial Skills, you’re trying to compensate with sheer numbers? You’re only making things harder for yourself. Follow me!"
Saying so, Wang Qianfeng slammed the door and stormed out of the office.
Escorting Wang Lan, Wang Qianfeng arrived at the Tianjian Bureau’s training field. "So, you think you’ll be at a disadvantage against opponents who use aerial combat, long-range attacks, or crowd control? Watch closely!"
As soon as Wang Qianfeng finished speaking, his Star Power instantly surged around him. The Star Energy Fluctuation was unmistakably that of the Star Cloud Sword Dance, which Wang Lan recognized in a flash.
"Sky Step!" With a fierce shout, Wang Qianfeng’s body shot straight up into the sky, his feet rapidly tapping the void. Explosions erupted beneath his feet as he seemed to stroll through the air, swiftly changing his position.
"Sword Qi!"
Wang Qianfeng formed a sword with his fingers, executing sword forms in the void. Bursts of Sword Qi rained down like a shower of lotus petals from the heavens.
This was still an application of Star Cloud Sword Dance, but a much more advanced one. Watching Wang Qianfeng dance through the sky like an ethereal spirit, Wang Lan felt a shiver run down his spine.
An elder is truly an elder, after all! I thought I had developed Star Cloud Sword Dance to a profound level by reaching Silver Nine. But now, it seems I still have a long way togo.
The Silver-level Star Cloud Sword Dance merely develops its forms to their utmost, while the Gold-level Star Cloud Sword Dance elevates it to another dimension, achieving dominance over land, sea, and air.
If I could elevate Star Cloud Sword Dance to the Gold Level, I indeed wouldn’t need to learn new Star Martial Skills. But isn’t that impossible? Breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage before the provincial tournament? With only a month left? Isn’t that a joke?
Moreover, the benefit of learning Crescent Arrow wasn’t just gaining a ranged attack Star Martial Skill; it also paved the way for compound Star Martial Skills. Therefore, even though Wang Qianfeng’s words held logic, Wang Lan didn’t feel he was wrong.
If one has skill points to upgrade skills, is there still a risk of becoming a jack of all trades, master of none, or of having breadth without depth? If so, it can only mean not having enough skill points.
"Kid, do you now understand how foolish your greed is? Other Star Martial Warriors painstakingly pursue Star Martial Skills because even when they reach the Star Cloud Stage, they might not have learned any good B-Grade skills.
Look at you! You started with an Ultra S-Grade Forbidden Technique and two A-Grade Star Martial Skills to boost you from the get-go. What more could you be dissatisfied with that makes you chase after even more Star Martial Skills? Will you dare to do this again?"
Wang Lan lowered his head.
It’s already been a week,
he thought.
Why is there still no news from Gong Jian about the A-Grade Lightning Attribute Star Martial Skill? With lightning, I might even be able to take on any Star Cloud Stage warrior.
When Wang Qianfeng suddenly posed the question, Wang Lan subconsciously replied, "I still dare!"
"I..."
Wang Qianfeng’s eyes bulged, and he panted heavily with anger. If it weren’t Wang Lan standing before him, he would have slapped this insolent fool to death on the spot.
Has he grown wings? Does my word no longer carry weight?
"Xu Shiyun, come to training ground number three right now," Wang Qianfeng ordered, picking up his phone to make a call.
"Director Wang, please calm down. My situation is a bit special... Really, I won’t end up in the predicament you described. Besides, I’ve already asked Gong Jian to find me an A-Grade Lightning Attribute Star Martial Skill..."
"Lightning Attribute?" Wang Qianfeng’s eyes widened even further. "You’re a Fire Attribute, damn it!"
"No, I think I might be a hidden All-Attribute Star Martial Warrior. I should be able to cultivate any..."
Wang Qianfeng raised his palm, cutting Wang Lan off. His eyes shimmered with profound disappointment. "I truly don’t know what happened to you that it hit you this hard... You’ve fallen into delusion. A hidden All-Attribute Star Martial Warrior? Are you mistaking your dreams for reality? In human history, there have been fewer than ten All-Attribute Star Martial Warriors.
Moreover, there’s no such thing as ’hidden.’ If there were, you’d be sent to Zhongnanshan for dissection."
"Oh, maybe I just dreamed it yesterday..."
"Director Wang, you called for me?"
"Xu Shiyun, you’re just in time. Mr. Wang Lan has been getting a bit carried away recently. You will properly educate him. I’ll only allow you to use one Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill."
"Director Wang, are you... serious?" Xu Shiyun asked again for confirmation.
Only allow one Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill? I *am* an Earth Attribute Star Martial Warrior, aren’t I? Only one Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill? Aside from the four C-Grade ones, I only have three B-Grade and two A-Grade skills.
"Just use your Earth Spirit. I want Wang Lan to understand that even a single Star Martial Skill must be utilized well. Learning a myriad of flashy techniques is a meaningless waste."
With that, Wang Qianfeng turned and left.
At this moment, news of Wang Qianfeng ordering Xu Shiyun to fight Wang Lan spread throughout the Tianjian Bureau. Although no one understood what Wang Lan had done recently to anger Wang Qianfeng, they weren’t too busy to be intrigued. Besides, given Wang Lan’s current high popularity, many people expressed their interest.
Gradually, some of the Tianjian Bureau’s high-level elites gathered around Training Ground Three.
Atop a tree, Lige stood with her arms folded, watching quietly. Zhang Yeqiu and Zhang Xiaoxue found a bench outside the training ground and sat down.
And from various hidden corners, pairs of eyes fixed on the training ground.
"Wang Lan, Director Wang has ordered me to teach you a harsh lesson, but I, your Brother Xu, am reluctant. What on earth did you do to offend Director Wang? Isn’t an apology enough?"
Wang Lan’s mouth twitched slightly.
With that eager-to-fight expression on your face, do you think I’m blind?
"Brother Xu is right. Director Wang, I was wrong..."
"Wang Lan, orders from Upper Peak cannot be disobeyed! Take this—" Xu Shiyun shouted, unable to wait any longer.
Star Energy Fluctuation spread out, swift as an electrical current, reaching Wang Lan’s feet in an instant. Wang Lan’s body immediately shot backward, retreating all the way to the edge of the training area.
The ground before him, however, seemed to ripple and glisten like the surface of the sea.
At this moment, Xu Shiyun, like an otherworldly immortal, stepped onto this sea-like surface, walking step by step to the center of the training ground.
"Wang Lan, this is the A-Grade Star Martial Skill, Earth Spirit. In essence, it’s merely a skill for controlling earth. However, Star Martial Skills possess unique profundities, enabling perfect earth control. Thus, what was originally a basic Earth Attribute application, through countless improvements and research by our predecessors, evolved into the current A-Grade Star Martial Skill.
I’ll stand right here and won’t move. Come and attack me."
As his words fell, Xu Shiyun provocatively beckoned with his finger.
Wang Lan couldn’t stand such posturing, but he didn’t recklessly charge forward. Seeing Wang Lan remain still, Xu Shiyun suddenly moved. His figure blurred into an afterimage as he closed the distance to Wang Lan by several meters. As Xu Shiyun advanced, the ground beneath his feet, seemingly sensing the Star Energy Fluctuation, also surged forward by the same distance.
In an instant, it reached the ground beneath Wang Lan’s feet.
In an instant, Wang Lan sensed something was amiss. The ground beneath his feet didn’t just shimmer like the surface of the sea; it had genuinely transformed into a liquid mire.
His body was about to plunge downwards.
Wang Lan had experienced Xu Shiyun’s Earth Movement Skill before. The last time Xu Shiyun had led him underground, it had felt like moving through water. Now, that sensation returned.
But this ’water’ was deadly. Wang Lan knew that if he became trapped in the earth, it would be over for him.
Just as his ankles were about to sink into the liquefied earth, Wang Lan successfully activated his Star Cloud Sword Dance. The flow of Star Power from his Star Cloud Sword Dance disrupted the Earth Attribute Star Power’s control over the earth. Wang Lan instantly broke free, landing safely on solid ground.
Wang Lan’s figure shot towards Xu Shiyun, closing to within ten meters. Suddenly, the ground around him churned, rising like giant waves in a stormy sea.
"Wang Lan can’t win," Zhang Xiaoxue, wearing fluffy earmuffs, suddenly said nonchalantly.
"Xiaoxue, the way you say that... it’s as if you actually considered the possibility of Wang Lan winning before?" Zhang Yeqiu asked in surprise.
"Hmm! I didn’t expect Xu Shiyun to have cultivated Earth Spirit to such a degree. Earth Spirit is one of the top-tier Earth Attribute Star Martial Skills, but it’s also notoriously difficult to master.
Wang Lan possesses many advantages, though they are somewhat obscured by his Star Shine Stage cultivation. He can switch between Star Martial Skills without any delay, his speed far surpasses that of ordinary people, and his combat awareness is not inferior to ours. These are Wang Lan’s strengths.
Conversely, Xu Shiyun can only use one Star Martial Skill, without the aid of others—this is his disadvantage. Considering these dynamics, Wang Lan wouldn’t have lacked a chance to win. But now... with Xu Shiyun demonstrating such mastery over Earth Spirit, all of Wang Lan’s advantages are rendered useless."
"That’s not necessarily true!" Lige’s voice suddenly interjected into the sisters’ conversation.Thɪs updatᴇd by NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Purple Flame Arrow
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 174: Purple Flame Arrow
"Oh? Captain Lige, do you have any insights?"
"None," Lige shook his head and said indifferently. "From a rational analysis, I agree with your conclusion, but my intuition tells me that Wang Lan may not necessarily lose."
"Intuition?" Zhang Yeqiu looked at Lige with a shocked face, as if he had discovered a new world.
Lige actually talked about intuition? Was this still the same cold and ruthless Lige who kept others at bay?
"Wang Lan is a person who creates miracles. When we believe he will surely lose and that he has no chance of winning, he always unexpectedly turns the tables." As he spoke, Lige’s eyes were intently fixed on Wang Lan, who was surrounded by a whirlwind of rising soil at the center.
At this moment, however, Wang Lan’s situation was far from as rosy as Lige described. In fact... it was very dangerous.
The mud tornado encircling Wang Lan was rapidly contracting. Wang Lan had tried to break through time and time again, only to be pushed back by the mudflow wall. This spinning twister was like the wrapper skillfully made by a dumpling chef, and at this moment, Wang Lan was the filling inside the dumpling wrapper.
Wang Lan vividly remembered how that Magical Martial Artist was compressed and squeezed by Xu Shiyun with earth until he became nothing but a pile of mud. Although Xu Shiyun wouldn’t do that to him, Wang Lan found it unacceptable to lose without any resistance.
Xu Shiyun held his hands at his chest, gradually bringing them together.
"Wang Lan, aren’t you going to admit defeat? If you don’t surrender now, you won’t have another chance."
"Brother Xu, I think I can still struggle a bit."
"Then struggle! Earth Burial!" Xu Shiyun’s hands instantly came together, and above his head, the swirling earth roared down from the sky.
In the nick of time, Wang Lan instantly switched his Star Martial Skill.
"Dual Flame Slash—"
A loud shout burst forth from the collapsing mudflow, as Wang Lan’s Flame Swords suddenly changed shape again, extending to about two meters. Wang Lan spun violently, and the collapsing flow of mud was instantly sliced through by the Flame Swords, like cutting off the neck of a bottle.
BOOM—
A figure burst forth.
The Flame Sword, too, was fire. In the enclosed space, it suddenly scorched. Wang Lan was instantly propelled by a blast of pressure, flying out from the hole at the top and into the sky.
Having shot into the sky, Wang Lan immediately switched his Star Martial Skill, his fingers forming a gun-shape as he pointed down from on high at Xu Shiyun.
"Crescent Arrow—"
A silver-white arrow traversed tens of meters, surging fiercely towards Xu Shiyun.
"Huh?" Surprise flickered in Xu Shiyun’s eyes, but there wasn’t a hint of panic. Earth rose in front of him, and in the blink of an eye, it formed an earthen wall before him.
BOOM— The Crescent Arrow struck the earth wall, shattering it to pieces. But alas, it did not break through Xu Shiyun’s layer of defense.
The defensive power of the Earth Attribute is second only to the Gold Attribute, but the Gold Attribute does not have the flexibility of the Earth Attribute. If strength isn’t enough, thickness will compensate—a common strategy used by Earth Attribute Star Martial Warriors. Hence, while Wang Lan’s Star Moon Arrow could penetrate a half-meter stone defense wall, it could not break through a one-meter thick one.
Seeing that one arrow wasn’t effective, a hint of regret appeared on Wang Lan’s face, and a look of relief on Xu Shiyun’s. Just now, he hadn’t planned to use such a thick defense wall. Fortunately, based on his understanding of Wang Lan’s craftiness, he had reinforced the wall in a flash.
That was a close call. Indeed, one should always treat interactions with Wang Lan with utmost seriousness.
With this thought, Xu Shiyun’s gaze instantly grew solemn. His hands came together, and as Star Power surged, the controlled area began to shrink, but his control over the earth became absolutely stronger.
"Old Wang... what’s going on? Suddenly in the mood to let Xu Shiyun train Wang Lan?" He MingXue asked with a smile.
In the past half-month, He MingXue had indeed been on cloud nine. The establishment of the Shadow Guard Office had allowed his power to explode. The Shadow Guard Office could be non-existent or omnipresent.
When it wasn’t needed, it would vanish without a trace. But when its presence was required, anyone from the various departments could become a ghost in the night. Now, the formation of the Shadow Guard Office was nearly complete. Apart from the director and He MingXue, no one knew the members’ list of the Shadow Guard Office.
He MingXue had considered pulling Wang Lan into the Shadow Guard Office. However, he soon realized that Wang Lan’s identity as a special operative for the Tianjian Bureau was already covert. There was no room to maneuver him into the Shadow Guard Office.
