Ordinarily, the person would have retorted; with everyone watching, Duan Ziqi wouldn’t dare do anything to him. But that look, it was like an arrow piercing his heart. In that moment, he felt that Duan Ziqi was truly terrifying.
Just as Wang Lan had taken his seat, Jiang Xinyu quietly shifted over. "What’s going on with you? Why were you late today?"
"Xinyu, he’s here now, so don’t worry. Didn’t I tell you Lanzi wouldn’t have any problems? Lanzi, you have no idea, before you arrived, Xinyu kept trying to call you... Wait, why is your phone off?"
Wang Lan bent down quietly, and the four of them leaned in curiously.
"I turned off my phone on purpose. I arrived ten minutes ago and have been secretly observing today’s third-round contestants."
"Observing? Is that necessary at this time?"
"That’s a long story..."
"Dear teachers, distinguished guests, fellow students! The Jiang Province martial arts competition, Suzhou City representative team selection, third round—the top ten selection match—is about to begin! All contestants, please take your places. We’re about to start the draw for the matches."
The broadcast suddenly interrupted Wang Lan. Everyone pricked up their ears and looked attentively towards the stage. Wang Lan also closed his mouth and said no more.
"Since Xu Donghai, a student from Senior Year Class Eight, is unable to participate in the competition due to an accident, one student will replace Xu Donghai’s spot in the twenty-advancing-to-ten match. Following the school’s decision, the student with the highest average score from previous comprehensive exams among those eliminated in the first and second rounds will be selected to take Xu Donghai’s place."
As the announcement concluded, the big screen instantly lit up. Rankings from previous exams quickly scrolled by. Eventually, ten names appeared on the screen, with Zhuang Haotian at the top.
When the host mentioned selecting someone based on the cumulative academic results over the past three years from the eliminated contestants, Zhuang Haotian’s selection was almost a certainty. If not for his misfortune of drawing Wang Lan, he would have undoubtedly made the representative team.
Therefore, while a few might have felt some resentment, most considered his replacement of Xu Donghai in the round of twenty to be a stroke of good fortune.
However, what the students present truly cared about wasn’t Zhuang Haotian replacing Xu Donghai, but the reason Xu Donghai had forfeited such an important competition. After all, making the representative team meant bonus points for the college entrance examination. Many renowned Star Martial Academies had a clear criterion: whether an applicant had represented their city or school in major events.
Zhuang Haotian, beaming with joy, ran over from the distance to join Wang Lan and the other candidates. As his gaze swept across Wang Lan, Zhuang Haoran’s expression changed abruptly; remembering yesterday’s embarrassing incident, his face paled slightly.
"Move over a bit," Duan Ziqi commanded coldly.
"Why? Is this seat taken?"
Zhuang Haotian was from a Star Martial Art family and usually had no conflict with Duan Ziqi. The Commoner Genius Association, led by Duan Ziqi, hadn’t targeted the children of Star Martial Art families. Suddenly being snapped at by Duan Ziqi, Zhuang Haotian’s face also turned somewhat unsightly.
"Can’t you smell the stench of crap on yourself?" Duan Ziqi taunted coldly, raising an eyebrow.
"You—" Zhuang Haotian exploded, raising his fist. Suddenly, a hand intervened between them.
Wang Lan, sitting right behind them, separated the two on the verge of conflict with a Flame Sword. "So many people are watching, and there are guests from other schools. Let’s not embarrass our academy, okay? Student Zhuang Haotian, I’m really sorry about yesterday; I didn’t do it on purpose.
"As for what Student Duan Ziqi said, don’t take it to heart. After all, no one knows who made off with the pants you changed out of yesterday. Whether they stink or not, only someone who’s ’tasted’ them would know."
"PFFT—"
At his words, the group of top twenty senior year geniuses couldn’t hold back their laughter. Those who had maintained stern faces instantly burst out, some almost rolling on the floor. Even Shui Miao’s mouth twitched uncontrollably as he struggled to suppress a grin.
The only one who couldn’t laugh was Duan Ziqi, his face turning from livid to purple with rage.
"Whether they stink or not, only someone who’s ’tasted’ them would know... Hahaha... Lanzi, are you serious? I’m dying of laughter... Lanzi, could you give us a heads-up before you tell a deadpan joke next time?"
"Would it still be a deadpan joke then? Hahaha... Wang Lan, your comment reminds me of someone from last semester, nicknamed Pi. You gave him that nickname, didn’t you?"
"Shut up! Have you all laughed enough?" Duan Ziqi, trembling with fury, bellowed.
"The draw for the first match is starting."
"It’s out! Senior Year Class One, Wang Lan, versus Senior Year Class Four, Duan Ziqi—"
"Am I up first?" Wang Lan looked at the screen in astonishment.
"Wang Lan, I hope you’re resilient enough. I’d hate to accidentally kill you," Duan Ziqi said, slowly turning his face to give Wang Lan a chilling, grim smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 181 Unlucky You
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 181 Unlucky You
No one expected the starting lineup to be Wang Lan and Duan Ziqi. One was a commoner genius who had long ranked among the top three in the school, and the other was a former academic genius who had risen rapidly within a year.
As sighs for the cruelty of this match arose, discussions about Wang Lan buzzed in the stands the moment the match-up chart appeared.
Wang Lan’s strength had always been a mystery. Though only at the Star Shine Stage, he had managed to instantly defeat Zhuang Haotian of the Star Cloud Stage in the first match. Consequently, many believed Wang Lan had better odds of winning this match than Duan Ziqi.
But no sooner was this speculation voiced than it was bombarded with disagreements from those nearby.
"Can Zhuang Haotian’s strength even compare to Duan Ziqi’s? Who knows how many pills Zhuang Haotian popped to reach the Star Cloud Stage. Duan Ziqi, on the other hand, had no family background or resources; he relied purely on his own strength to reach the Star Cloud Stage."
"That’s nonsense! Is Zhuang Haotian’s strength fake? He consistently ranked in the top ten, didn’t he? Even if Duan Ziqi is stronger than Zhuang Haotian, it’s only by a limited amount. Wang Lan managed to instantly defeat Zhuang Haotian; it’s possible he could do the same to Duan Ziqi."
"I think... Wang Lan’s instant defeat of Zhuang Haotian involved some luck. After all, the gap in their cultivation stages is undeniable. The advantage of the Star Cloud Stage over the Star Shine Stage is so significant that it’s hard to replicate such a result."
"Stop arguing! The match is about to start. We’ll know the outcome soon enough, won’t we?"
Wang Lan and Duan Ziqi stood in opposite corners of the fighting arena. The referee, seeing both were ready, gently lifted the whistle to his lips.
TWEEET—
The moment the whistle sounded, Star Power surged around Duan Ziqi.
His figure instantly transformed into a streak of light, charging toward Wang Lan in an S-shaped pattern.
Duan Ziqi was a Wind Attribute Star Martial Warrior, an attribute countered by Wang Lan’s Fire Attribute. Even so, Wang Lan couldn’t afford to be careless. Attribute counters are relative; an attribute having a theoretical advantage is one thing, but possessing the skill to exploit it is another entirely.
Duan Ziqi was at the Star Cloud Stage and possessed an overwhelming advantage in Star Power. Thus, Wang Lan had long anticipated his tactics.
"Speedy Wind Blade—"
Duan Ziqi crossed his hands before his chest and expelled a fierce gust of wind from his mouth. The wind was sharp and visible to the naked eye. Within this tempest, countless tiny wind blades, like a net of water sprayed from a showerhead, surged toward Wang Lan.
Duan Ziqi’s Speedy Wind Blade was a wide-area Star Martial Skill, unleashed suddenly when he was about fifteen meters from Wang Lan. At this distance, under normal circumstances, it would be challenging to dodge instantly.
Moreover, this Star Martial Skill could be maneuvered flexibly. No matter where Wang Lan dodged, Duan Ziqi could follow, ensuring Wang Lan remained enveloped by the attack.
The Fire Attribute indeed countered Wind, but fire’s nature was violent, harming not only the enemy but also the wielder. No Star Martial Warrior used a fire-based Star Martial Skill for defense. Even if they did, it would be impossible to envelop oneself completely without blind spots.
Duan Ziqi’s tactic was simple: wind could be everywhere, but fire could not. Any area devoid of fire would be Wang Lan’s vulnerability.
The ground beneath Wang Lan’s feet exploded instantly, a visible shockwave rippling outward. In a flash, Wang Lan’s body leaned slightly forward.
A sharp glint flashed in Duan Ziqi’s eyes.
Planning to move forward, eh? Let’s see if you can dodge faster than my wind blades!
Instantly, Duan Ziqi’s Star Martial Skill surged at high velocity toward the space in front of Wang Lan.
At the same time, however, Wang Lan’s body bizarrely shifted four to five meters laterally, moving in an unexpected direction to dodge Duan Ziqi’s wind blade assault. He performed a brief Sky Step in mid-air.
This Star Martial Skill amazed all the students in the stands. If they hadn’t known Wang Lan was merely at the Star Shine Stage, his execution of this technique would have made them worship him, mistaking him for some top-tier expert.
Such a flashy maneuver could only elicit gasps of astonishment.
It was so elegant and fluid. This retreat seemed to usher in a new era.
Duan Ziqi, retracting his Star Martial Skill, was dumbfounded. Wang Lan’s maneuver was completely illogical.
Logically, if your exertion force is backward, your body should move forward. How did you manage to move in the same direction as your exertion?
If Wang Lan knew Duan Ziqi’s thoughts, he would undoubtedly sneer. If the trajectory of the Star Cloud Dance could be so easily captured, could it still be considered an A-grade Star Martial Skill?
Duan Ziqi’s attack having failed, he hastily retreated.
But Wang Lan had already rapidly initiated the Star Cloud Dance, closing in on Duan Ziqi.
Damn it! The rumors are true after all. Wang Lan is the Wolf King, champion of the Star Martial Art Competition. If that’s the case, apart from my advantage in Star Power, I have no other edge over him.
The news that Wang Lan was the Wolf had become known to students at the start of the semester. However, for some reason, this information didn’t become a hot topic. Even among his schoolmates, it was merely heard, acknowledged, doubted, and then casually dismissed.
Song Bo had told Duan Ziqi that Wang Lan was the Wolf King, champion of the Star Martial Art Competition. But when Duan Ziqi first heard this, he had scoffed.
The Wolf King is obviously from a Star Martial Art family. How could it be Wang Lan, this rich second-generation kid? Even if his family owned mountains of gold and silver, could he start with two A-grade Star Martial Skills? That’s not something money can buy. Compared to the true, long-established Star Martial Art families, a rich man’s wealth is insignificant. But seeing Wang Lan’s movement technique now, how naive and ridiculous that initial denial seems! Not only did Wang Lan start with two A-grade Star Martial Skills, but he actually is rich!
Almost instantly, Duan Ziqi’s mind retrieved all available information on the Wolf King.
When the Star Martial Art Competition was popular, Duan Ziqi had studied this person. Back then, he had judged his own chances against the Wolf as fifty-fifty. Although the Wolf was only at the Star Shine Stage, there were too many unpredictable aspects to his fighting style.
His breathtaking close-combat ability and battle awareness, his ability to switch Star Martial Skills with no discernible interval, and his two A-grade Star Martial Skills cultivated to an advanced level. Against such an opponent, the only way is to suppress him with the advantage of a higher Star Martial Art level. And while doing so, I must ensure I remain undefeatable.
With this thought, a determined glint shone in Duan Ziqi’s eyes.
"Wind Travel—"
As Duan Ziqi continuously dodged Wang Lan’s attacks, Star Power surged around him. A burst of azure light emanated from his body, and a gentle breeze began to waft from him.
Instinctively, Wang Lan suddenly retreated and halted.
The instant Wang Lan stopped, Duan Ziqi transformed into a streak of light, rushing toward him at high speed. According to the students in the stands, they only saw a flash of green light before Wang Lan and Duan Ziqi collided.
Then, the two figures brushed past each other, standing back-to-back on the dueling field.
"What just... happened?"
"Did Duan Ziqi unleash his full power? Is this the decisive clash?"
"Who won? Who lost? Did anyone see clearly?"
A buzz of conversation rose from the stands.
"So fast—" Xu Xiangwen sighed, his face tense. "Twice as fast as when I activate my Pure Yang Skill. Duan Ziqi truly lives up to his reputation."
"Your speed and his are different," Jiang Xinyu said indifferently, arms crossed. "You’re fast in terms of reaction time, movement, and attack speed. Duan Ziqi’s Wind Travel Skill only increases his movement speed; his attack speed isn’t particularly fast."
"Even so, speed at that level is still very troublesome. This fight won’t be easy for Wang Lan," Xie Sisi said, worry etched on her face.
"Wang Lan has plenty of experience dealing with this type of opponent," Jiang Xinyu added.
Zhuang Haotian, sitting in front of them, deeply understood Jiang Xinyu’s words.
Speed? What damn use is speed against Wang Lan! He had replayed yesterday’s battle in his mind countless times, taking nearly eight hours to understand how he had lost. I lost due to an information disparity, lost because I practically offered my face up to be hit, lost because I walked right into his trap. My Thunder Attribute wasn’t even countered by Wang Lan’s Fire Attribute! Yet, Wang Lan’s reflexes and motor skills are extraordinary. So extraordinary, in fact, that he could completely break down and analyze my speed under the Thunder Attribute’s enhancement. I knew very well that when I activated my Thunder Attribute’s speed enhancement, I moved so fast that my own consciousness could barely keep up. Yet Wang Lan was able to analyze it completely. That’s why my defeat was so humiliating. If I hadn’t embarrassingly rushed headlong into his trap with my speed, how could I have lost so decisively?
Therefore, when he saw Duan Ziqi activate the Wind Travel Skill, Zhuang Haotian was filled with anticipation.
Someone else is about to be beaten to a pulp.
CLANG—
With a sharp sound, half a dagger fell from Wang Lan’s hand.
Wang Lan stared at the fallen half of the dagger, his expression grim, a cold glint in his eyes.
The Wind Travel Skill was incredibly fast, even a step faster than Xu Xiangwen. However, the actual movements were very simple, relying entirely on the Star Martial Skill for high-speed travel. Thus, once Wang Lan activated his dynamic perception, Duan Ziqi’s movements couldn’t escape his eyes.
But that was Wang Lan. Anyone else would have failed to notice Duan Ziqi drawing a tactical dagger and aiming to slash Wang Lan’s throat.
Moreover, Duan Ziqi had imbued his dagger with Wind Cutting, which was why Wang Lan’s tactical dagger had been sliced in half.
In the school selection trials, using weapons and Star Martial Skills was permitted, but intentional killing was forbidden. Duan Ziqi’s slash could have been aimed anywhere else, but he had specifically targeted Wang Lan’s throat.
The two slowly turned, their gazes meeting. Facing Wang Lan’s icy stare, Duan Ziqi slowly raised his dagger, giving Wang Lan a provocative look.
The evasiveness of the Star Cloud Dance was too agile and utterly unconventional; ordinary Star Martial Skills could hardly hit Wang Lan. Therefore, the Wind Travel Skill became the only technique that seemed capable of suppressing him.
Although Gan Lie’s Wind Travel Skill was countered by Wang Lan during the Star Martial Art Competition, Gan Lie’s version of the skill is trash in my opinion. A Wind Travel Skill that can’t even execute curved trajectories—how did he even have the courage to show his face and embarrass himself with that? If Gan Lie had been able to execute complex curved trajectories back then, neither a horizontal nor a vertical Flame Sword could have defeated him. The same technique’s effectiveness depends on who wields it.
At this thought, a slight smile touched the corners of Duan Ziqi’s mouth. The howling wind around him intensified, enveloping him in a cyclone, as if he had completely transformed into a wind sprite.
WHOOSH—
Once again transforming into a streak of green light, Duan Ziqi instantly bolted toward Wang Lan. To the students in the stands, Duan Ziqi appeared to move in a straight line. However, under Wang Lan’s dynamic perception, Duan Ziqi’s Wind Travel Skill was actually following a spiraling trajectory.
To be honest, before mastering dynamic perception, I might truly have had no counter to this move. But now...
Wang Lan thought,
...you’re just unlucky.

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Shooting You Down Like an Upside-Down Onion
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 182: Shooting You Down Like an Upside-Down Onion
With his Sunlight Wheel in Both Hands, Wang Lan slashed down the instant Duan Ziqi’s dagger attacked.
Even with his dynamic vision, Wang Lan could clearly see the rapidly changing expression on Duan Ziqi’s face: terror, bewilderment, disbelief.
If Wang Lan hadn’t held back, this Solar Wheel strike could have beheaded Duan Ziqi. In an instant, Wang Lan’s Solar Wheel slightly trembled, shifting at an angle and brushing past Duan Ziqi.
The scene froze, as if in a time replay, the previous image once again appearing before everyone’s eyes.
Only this time, their positions were swapped, and there was something slightly off about Duan Ziqi’s appearance...
Duan Ziqi originally sported a buzz cut with spiky hair, but having been grazed by Wang Lan’s Solar Wheel, he was now prematurely balding.
"You’ve lost," Wang Lan said indifferently, turning to walk toward the stands.
If I hadn’t shown mercy with that strike, it wouldn’t have just been his hair taken off, but his head.
"What kind of joke is this? You cut a few strands of my hair and say you won?"
Wang Lan’s footsteps halted. A breeze swept past him from behind.
Wang Lan hadn’t expected Duan Ziqi to be so shameless. He turned his head to look at the on-site referee. The Star Martial Referee, merely a school teacher with a Star Shine Stage cultivation level, couldn’t possibly discern such details.
The referee team hastily brought up the video for slow-motion playback. However, the results couldn’t prove whether Wang Lan had mercifully aimed for the top of Duan Ziqi’s head or if Duan Ziqi had dodged the strike.
"Wang Lan, Duan Ziqi, the video footage cannot determine the outcome of your match. Therefore, we’ve decided to continue the competition. Wang Lan, do you object?"
Wang Lan’s brows furrowed, and he slowly shook his head. "No objections. But if it really comes to that, I cannot guarantee there won’t be unforeseen consequences."
The referee nodded. The school had already taken this into account. "Duan Ziqi, I also hope you can face reality. If there is indeed a strength gap between you and Wang Lan, please don’t push yourself..."
Even the referee felt a bit uncomfortable saying this.
Advising a Star Cloud Stage cultivator not to overdo it against a Star Shine Stage opponent? This is truly absurd.
"Teacher, what makes you think I’m less capable than Wang Lan? Just because of my hair?" Duan Ziqi’s face turned a shade of green with anger as he reached up to his head.
Wind-attribute Star Power surged. In the blink of an eye, sharp winds chopped his full head of black hair, leaving a shiny bald head under the sunlight.
The referee stepped back as Duan Ziqi suddenly WHOOSHED into the sky, his body enveloped by winds like fluttering ribbons. Duan Ziqi quietly ascended high into the air.
Seeing this, the expressions of Xu Xiangwen and the other three changed drastically.
"Shameless! Duan Ziqi had already lost, and he shamelessly refused to accept it just for this... He has mastered a flying-type Star Martial Skill!"
Flying-type Star Martial Skills were rare. This wasn’t because they weren’t needed, but because the conditions for flight were too exacting. Only the Wind attribute met the requirements for flight; other flying-type Star Martial Skills involved changes in the form of Star Power.
Moreover, any Form Changing Star Martial Skills that granted flight required an extremely high level of control over Star Power. This high barrier to entry limited the number of Star Martial Warriors who could fly.
Being able to fly was the source of Duan Ziqi’s audacity to deny his loss.
From high above, it’s a dimensional reduction strike! I’m already flying sky-high, shoulder to shoulder with the sun. How can I possibly lose?
"Duan Ziqi, can you use two Star Martial Skills at the same time?" Wang Lan looked up, smiling as he asked.
"I can’t! But do you think I don’t have a way?" Duan Ziqi sneered. His Star Power surged in an instant, and as it did, his flying-type Star Martial Skill faltered, and he began to fall from the sky.
But after falling no more than twenty meters, a vacuum bullet shot out from Duan Ziqi’s mouth, targeting Wang Lan like a missile.
The moment the vacuum bullet struck, Duan Ziqi’s Star Power surged again, and he ascended to the sky once more.
Damn it, this tactic is pure air raid bombing, isn’t it? Dive, drop a bomb, then climb? If I hadn’t mastered a shooting-type Star Martial Skill specifically designed to counteract flying types, I would have been in trouble.
"Wang Lan, just surrender! Otherwise, you’re going to die," Duan Ziqi called from above, arms spread like a deity. Being so high, he had never felt so good.
That feeling of looking down on all living beings gave him a sense of being their master.
"There won’t be a next time." Wang Lan slowly raised his right hand, shaping his fingers like a gun.
Seeing this stance, everyone was puzzled. Even Jiang Xinyu and the others had no idea what Wang Lan was about to do. Only Principal Zhang in the stands shot to his feet, his face filled with disbelief at the sight of the gesture.
In a trance, memories of glorious bygone days surfaced. It was a time when countless flying Exotic Beasts rampaged across the sky. These beasts not only flew at great speeds but could also spew scorching molten lava from their mouths.
It was a battlefield akin to hell, littered with charred corpses. A small city spanning ten kilometers was devastated by this sudden onslaught of flying Exotic Beasts.
Just as they, the volunteers, despaired, reinforcements arrived.
Facing thousands of flying Exotic Beasts, only fifty troops came as support. At the time, Principal Zhang and the others thought these reinforcements were just lambs to the slaughter.
But the moment they engaged in battle, an unforgettable image was seared into their minds. Each soldier made the same gesture as Wang Lan, pointing a finger gun towards the sky.
In an instant, as if countless laser cannons fired, the arrogant flying Exotic Beasts rained down from the sky. In just an hour, tens of thousands of powerful flying Exotic Beasts were wiped out.
Principal Zhang still remembered the name of those reinforcement troops.
Vermilion Bird!
A golden glow emerged around Wang Lan, a pair of wings spread, and in an instant, a silver-white Crescent Arrow shot from his fingertip.
"What?"
Duan Ziqi’s face changed dramatically, and he hastily tried to dodge.
But Wang Lan instantly fired six Crescent Arrows, sealing off all of Duan Ziqi’s escape routes. Panicked, Duan Ziqi attempted to climb higher, but his ascent was no match for the speed of the Crescent Arrows.
"Wind Barrier—" In his haste, Duan Ziqi quickly activated his Star Martial Skill, and his body began to fall from the sky.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Two arrows struck the barrier and exploded on impact, while the remaining four zipped past. Duan Ziqi, like a falling meteor, plummeted from the sky and, with everyone watching in stunned silence, landed headfirst precisely into a sandpit outside the combat arena.
Wang Lan coldly glanced at Duan Ziqi, then turned to the referee.
"First match, Wang Lan wins!"
"Successfully advanced to the top ten. Awarded five thousand experience points and two hundred skill points."
The moment the prompt sounded, the experience bar on the system’s character panel leaped from ninety-seven to one hundred percent.
As the experience points filled up, a surge of Star Energy Fluctuation emanated from Wang Lan.
"What is Wang Lan doing? He’s already won, so why is his Star Energy Fluctuation surging?" This spectacle was quickly noticed by the students who had regained their composure, immediately causing an uproar.
"He’s so ruthless! He beat Duan Ziqi that badly and still doesn’t plan to let him off? Is the referee blind? Why isn’t he stopping Wang Lan?"
"Would the referee dare to stop him? If Wang Lan really got serious, he could take on all the Star Martial Art teachers in the school by himself..."
"You two idiots, that’s enough! Can’t you even tell the difference between the fluctuation of releasing a Star Martial Skill and that of a breakthrough?" As his words fell, the speaker suddenly slapped himself. "Damn it, he can break through like this?"
"A breakthrough? He can actually break through like this?"
This question spread like a virus in an instant.
He just finished a battle and released so many Star Martial Skills? Seriously? After consuming so much Star Power, how can he still break through?
The Star Energy Fluctuation grew even more pronounced and intense. Suddenly, with a series of crackling sounds, the Star Energy Fluctuation around Wang Lan calmed down.
His consciousness sank into the system. Character: Wang Lan.
Level: Star Shine Nine!
Just one more level. Just one more level to break through to the Star Cloud Stage! Sweet...
But when Wang Lan saw the experience points needed for Star Shine Nine, his face instantly darkened.
Ninety thousand experience points.
What does ninety thousand experience points even mean? Over the New Year, destroying an elite spy group plus finding the Demonic Transformation Potion production workshop combined only yielded ninety thousand experience points.
Such a huge reward from that mission is only enough for one level-up. The road ahead is long and arduous; I’ll have to strive and scramble.
"Medical staff, quick, medical staff—"
"How is student Duan Ziqi?"
"He suffered shock from the intense explosion, resulting in a slight concussion and mild internal organ trauma. The problems aren’t significant..." the medical staff quickly reported after a hasty check.
"He’s okay? That’s good. Carry Duan Ziqi off to rest. Next match, Zhuang Haotian versus... Jiang Xinyu!"
The moment this matchup was announced, Zhuang Haotian’s expression instantly turned from schadenfreude to one of utter constipation. Originally, Zhuang Haotian had derived great pleasure from seeing Duan Ziqi pummeled by Wang Lan. Although it was Wang Lan doing the beating, Zhuang Haotian felt as if he were the one delivering the punches.
Before he could enjoy his delight for long, the next match plunged Zhuang Haotian’s heart into the depths of despair. Wang Lan had defeated him with a single strike. Zhuang Haotian believed he had chosen a poor strategy.
It was like using a hand full of bombs only to play a pair of threes.
But facing Jiang Xinyu... Damn it, she’s a monster with a hand full of royal flushes!
Watching Jiang Xinyu get up to enter the arena, Zhuang Haotian just wanted to grab the teacher who drew the matchups by the throat and ask.
What was the point of letting me revive in Xu Donghai’s place? Just so I could make a brief appearance before being gloriously eliminated?
When Zhuang Haotian entered the arena, the stands immediately erupted into laughter, especially from those contestants who believed their strength was no less than Zhuang Haotian’s yet had narrowly missed resurrection due to the comprehensive exam.
Zhuang Haotian, just stop struggling. The stands are where you belong. Come on back, buddy.
BEEP BEEP—
Just as Wang Lan returned to his seat, the phone in his pocket rang.
He picked it up and answered, "Hello, Xu?"
"You’re at school now, right?"
"Yeah! I’m here."
"Is your competition over?"
"The morning session is done. There’s still the challenge tournament this afternoon."
"I’m also at your school. Come to the back mountain for a bit."
"Alright!"
Suzhou No.1 Middle School was built strictly following the characteristics of Suzhou’s gardens, emphasizing harmony between heaven and earth, and the blending of mountains and water. This was especially true for the Star Martial Arts Campus, which required an open field for wilderness training. Even without real mountains, a man-made hill spanning ninety thousand square meters had been constructed.
The so-called back mountain referred to that place.
When Wang Lan arrived at the back mountain, the school’s Director of Academic Affairs and the homeroom teacher of Class Eight were both present.
"Wang Lan, what are you doing here? Go back! Is the competition over?" the Director of Academic Affairs shouted.
"Director Mo, I called Wang Lan over," Xu Shiyun said, beckoning to Wang Lan. "Besides being your student, Wang Lan is also a Red Elite of our Tianjian Bureau. Wang Lan, come take a look."
Within a few leaps, they were once again standing atop the hill.
Before Wang Lan’s eyes, a field of four-leaf clovers stretched from the hilltop down to its base.

chapters.title: Chapter 183 He’s Looking for Something
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 183 He’s Looking for Something
"Is this the first crime scene?" Wang Lan looked at the clover patch and immediately understood why Xu Shiyun had come here.
"It should be. The clover, combined with Xu Donghai’s identity and the absence of clover in Star Sea Park, are enough to make me suspect that the first crime scene was here at the school. Wang Lan, look at this spot. There are obvious signs of trampling."
"Any bloodstains?"
"None! And tests have confirmed the blood that almost dyed the pond red was indeed Xu Donghai’s. But even if Xu Donghai was killed in Star Sea Park, it doesn’t prove that it wasn’t a staged scene. Traces of Star Power Binding were found on Xu Donghai’s body, which means he was immobilized and at someone else’s mercy before he died."
Hearing Xu Shiyun’s words, a solemn expression appeared on Wang Lan’s face. "Is the killer someone from the school?"
"Correct. Hu Qing told me you made a hypothesis? That the killer did it to make you miss the academy selection? If so, that narrows the range of suspects down to twenty people. Wang Lan, is there anyone who really didn’t want you to participate in today’s competition?"
Instantly, the eyes of the head teacher and other school leaders all turned towards Wang Lan in unison.
"This morning, I only made a preliminary speculation. In fact, there are many aspects of this speculation that are inconsistent. For instance, not many people in the school know my true strength. Even if I defeated Zhuang Haotian with a single move yesterday, most people still think it was a fluke. After all, my apparent Star Shine Stage strength is there for all to see."
That damn Star Shine Stage strength!
Xu Shiyun almost wished she could slap this guy to death. Remembering how Wang Lan had sent her soaring into the sky with a single blow just a few days ago, Xu Shiyun felt a knot of frustration. Although being limited to one Star Martial Skill restricted the display of her true strength, she could at least use one, right? As an elite of the Star Cloud Stage, it was shameful enough not to be able to instantly defeat a Star Shine Stage opponent, let alone be defeated by Wang Lan! In those days, Xu Shiyun felt that even the way the men under her command looked at her felt a bit off. Wang Lan’s Star Shine Stage was too damn deceptive. In Xu Shiyun’s view, Wang Lan’s overall strength had already reached the Star Cloud Stage, and given the right conditions, he could exhibit the strength of an elite Star Cloud Stage expert.
Wang Lan, arms crossed, faced the wind and fell into deep thought. "There are only seven or eight people in the school who know my real strength. They are all people I trust and have no reason to stop me from competing. The other competitors don’t know my true strength, so they wouldn’t be wary of me. Though the scope of suspicion seems small, I have an intuition that perhaps none of them is the one."
"What about Duan Ziqi? Is that possible?" Hu Qing suddenly interjected. "You just defeated him. He is very strong, also an expert of the Star Cloud Stage. If he hadn’t encountered you, he should have been a shoo-in for the Suzhou City team. Plus, I learned something not long ago. Xu Donghai left the Commoner Genius Association a week ago. Could a conflict have arisen from that?"
"That’s possible! But before today, I had no conflict with Duan Ziqi. Moreover, he wasn’t aware of my strength. Even if my attribute could counter his, as a Star Cloud Stage expert, he wouldn’t need to be afraid of me. Compared to Duan Ziqi, I have another suspect in mind," Wang Lan said, an idea flashing in his mind.
"Who?"
"Zhuang Haotian."
"Zhuang Haotian lost to me yesterday, so he must bear a grudge against me. And with Xu Donghai dead, the person who benefits the most is also Zhuang Haotian." As Wang Lan spoke, he was completely immersed in deduction mode, totally oblivious to the head teacher’s face turning as dark as the bottom of a pot.
Zhuang Haotian is my nephew! How dare he suspect my nephew right in front of me? Is he doing this on purpose?
"No!" Wang Lan suddenly shook his head again. "Zhuang Haotian’s attribute is lightning. If Xu Donghai’s fatal injury was caused by a Star Martial Skill, there should be signs of scorching. Could there be an accomplice?"
"AHEM. AHEM. AHEM... Wang Lan, uh, can I interrupt for a moment?" the head teacher asked, forcing a smile.
If Wang Lan were just an ordinary student, the head teacher would have started scolding him already. But besides being his student, Wang Lan was also an elite agent of the Tianjian Bureau.
Damn it! That status was definitely something he could only look up to. What did it mean to win at the starting line? Wang Lan wasn’t just at the starting line; he was already at the finish line that others strived their entire lives to reach! Who could possibly claim that, even by retirement, they could join the Tianjian Bureau and attain the rank of an elite captain? A captain in the Tianjian Bureau could hold nominal posts nationwide, be treated like family wherever they went, and enjoy benefits so good they’d make ordinary people green with envy.
"Wang Lan, I can assure you it’s not Zhuang Haotian. He spent the whole night at my house yesterday, and my house wasn’t empty – it was my son’s wedding. Many people can attest to that."
"Oh, is that so? Hu Qing, once the evidence chain is complete, we can eliminate him from the list of suspects."
"Alright."
RING RING RING— At that moment, Hu Qing’s phone rang.
"Hello? What? Are you sure?" Shortly after, Hu Qing hung up and looked at Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun with a serious face.
"The men just called to confirm that Xu Donghai’s parents have disappeared, and their house has been searched."
"Let’s go! To Xu Donghai’s house," Xu Shiyun immediately ordered.
"I’ll come too..." Wang Lan blurted out instinctively but paused mid-step. "Damn, there’s still the challenge match this afternoon."
"Wang Lan, no worries. The challenge match for this afternoon has already been postponed. With an incident like this, we can’t proceed without an investigation. Moreover, the provincial bureau has sent a notice for the principal to attend a meeting this afternoon, so the challenge match is postponed until the principal returns."
"Then that’s perfect. Head Teacher, I’d like to request a leave of absence, if that’s alright."
The head teacher’s eyebrow twitched.
My approval? With his status, does he even need to ask for leave? Could I possibly say no?
He waved his hand. "Go on, go on. The sooner you find out what happened, the better."Just as the three of them stepped out of the school gate, a police car came speeding over.
"Captain Hu."
Hu Qing invited Xu Shiyun and Wang Lan into the car, then took the passenger seat himself.
"Xu Donghai lived alone near No. 1 Middle School in a house his family rented for him. His parents live in Xiangyang District. We went to his parents’ company first, and the company said they hadn’t come to work today. Then we went to their house. The door was locked from the inside. The house was in complete disarray, but no valuables were missing. We suspect they were looking for something."
"Locked from the inside? No sign of the door being forced?"
"The door was intact before we broke it down."
"Does that mean the killer had a key?"
"Not necessarily. If the killer were an Earth Attribute Star Martial Warrior, they could have easily entered using the Earth Travel Skill."
The car sped through the city, running red lights, and in less than twenty minutes, they arrived at the home of Xu Donghai’s parents. His parents’ house was a rural dwelling. By now, police tape had been set up around it, and curious neighbors were peering from outside the cordoned-off area.
"I heard Xu Qingshan’s house was burglarized? Wow, so many officers are here!"
"The police are getting much better these days. In the past, when you reported a crime, the officers would dilly-dally and take forever to arrive. Later, if you reported an incident, the officers would guarantee arrival within half an hour. Now it’s even more impressive; officers show up even if you don’t report anything."
"Are you stupid? How would the police come without a report? And even if something was stolen from the house, would it necessitate such a scene? Look at the officers standing guard inside—they’re carrying guns!"
"So, what’s going on? Didn’t they say he was robbed?"
Amidst the townsfolk’s chatter, a police car charged through the cordon and into the yard.
Four people got out of the car.
"Captain Hu, over here!"
Wang Lan entered the scene. From the living room to the kitchen, then up to the bedrooms, the storage closet, and even the adjacent shack full of junk—everything was tossed into disarray.
"The team is currently gathering fingerprint evidence. We can be certain the killer was searching for something, and that item might be related to Xu Donghai’s murder."
"Did you check the surveillance cameras? Any trace of Xu Qingshan and his wife?"
"Xu Qingshan and his wife both work at a township enterprise five li away. Surveillance shows they got off work at eight o’clock yesterday and rode an electric scooter home. After that, they moved out of the surveillance area. Since then, they haven’t been seen again. The citywide Skynet surveillance system just finished scanning. No, there’s no sign of them."
"Are there any hidden spots nearby? Places where something could happen without anyone noticing?" Wang Lan quickly asked.
"What do you suspect?"
"Just because the house was ransacked like this doesn’t necessarily mean the killer found what they were looking for. I guess the missing Xu Qingshan couple might have been kidnapped by the killer for interrogation. For convenience, the killer wouldn’t have taken Xu Qingshan and his wife far. Perhaps... a nearby grove or something similar."
Xu Shiyun stepped into the yard and lightly stamped her foot.
Instantly, a cylindrical platform rose from under her feet, carrying Xu Shiyun dozens of meters into the air.
She surveyed her surroundings before slowly descending.
"Nothing. It’s either villages, industrial zones, or residential areas."
Wang Lan walked through Xu Qingshan’s bedroom, where officers were meticulously collecting every trace of evidence. Suddenly, Wang Lan stepped on a large photograph.
"Wait, Brother Hu, does Xu Donghai have any other immediate family besides his parents?"
"Sir," an officer replied, "he also has a sister who married five years ago and lives in Dongxing District. We just called her, and she picked up. When we told her about her parents, she initially thought it was a scam. After we called her from the station’s official phone, she believed us and said she would arrive immediately. Then she hung up. We were about to offer to pick her up. Afterward, her phone rang, but no one answered. It might have been left at home in her haste."
"How long ago was that?"
"Approximately twenty minutes."
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s expression changed dramatically.
"Hu Qing, quick! Let’s go to Xu Donghai’s sister’s place! His sister might also be in trouble!"
Hu Qing quickly had one of his men bring a car around. Wang Lan and Hu Qing jumped into the vehicle, which took off with a roar.
"Hey, where are you going? Not waiting for me?" Xu Shiyun looked bewildered as she watched the taillights of the departing police car.
"Brother Hu, the Xu family photos are scattered all over the floor. I saw many of their family portraits.
"Xu Donghai has a sister; how could the killer not know that? If I were the killer and couldn’t get the information I wanted, I would definitely expand the scope of my interrogation.
"Twenty minutes ago, when the officers called Xu Donghai’s sister, she said she would be right there and then hung up.
"After that, her phone became unreachable. The men suspect she left it at home. But nowadays, especially for people from the ’80s and ’90s generation, who would forget their cell phone when going out? Especially if it was just in her hand?
"Twenty minutes is enough time to get here from Dongxing District, but she still hasn’t arrived. I suspect that the person who answered the phone wasn’t Xu Donghai’s sister. It might have been the killer."

chapters.title: Chapter 184 Rescuing Xu Dongdong
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 184 Rescuing Xu Dongdong
Police cars rushed into Hanjing Garden and took the elevator to the floor where Xu Dongdong lived. Wang Lan had already received information about Xu Dongdong during the time in the car.
Xu Dongdong was eleven years older than Xu Donghai. She had married five years ago, and her husband was part of their company’s management team. He had left for Holy Cross Country on a business trip seven days prior and had not yet returned.
"WOOF WOOF WOOF—"
As they reached the door, they heard a series of intense barks coming from inside.
Wang Lan looked gravely at Hu Qing, who nodded. Wang Lan raised his Flame Sword and slashed open the front door. Kicking it open, he saw a home in complete disarray.
"Are we too late?" Hu Qing took a deep breath. "If the men had reacted immediately when they received the call, we might have made it in time. Damn it!"
"Ai, immediately access the community surveillance. Go through every person and vehicle that entered or exited the neighborhood within the last twenty minutes... no, make that half an hour," Wang Lan commanded.
"Yes!"
"WOOF WOOF—"
Another round of barking sounded, prompting both Wang Lan and Hu Qing to look over. In a corner of the messy living room, inside a dog cage, a Golden Retriever stared at them with bright, intelligent eyes.
Hu Qing quickly averted his gaze and began searching for clues in the chaotic home.
"WOOF WOOF—"
Wang Lan observed the Golden Retriever with puzzlement.
There was something familiar about the dog, particularly its eyes, which were as spirited as Black Girl’s used to be when she looked at him.
Wang Lan approached the cage and saw that a lock had been added. He extended his hand, and flames erupted, visibly melting the lock away.
BANG— The Golden Retriever slammed open the cage and then bolted out of the house.
Wang Lan hesitated for a moment, but then his expression changed dramatically, and he hurried out. Just then, the elevator doors opened, and the Golden Retriever dashed inside. Wang Lan hurriedly followed, squeezing into the elevator just as the doors were closing.
The Golden Retriever looked up at Wang Lan. They stood in opposite corners of the elevator, warily eyeing each other.
From the Golden Retriever’s lively eyes, Wang Lan could tell that the dog was highly intelligent.
The dog had pressed the elevator button and selected the ground floor. When the elevator reached the ground floor and the doors opened, the Golden Retriever burst out and sprinted away.
Wang Lan quickly followed.
The Golden Retriever was extremely fast, running wildly once it determined a direction. After a few minutes, it would stop to sniff around before resuming its mad dash.
Wang Lan followed the Golden Retriever’s frantic run for half an hour. Their route led them to increasingly remote locations, gradually nearing an industrial park.
"WOOF WOOF—"
The Golden Retriever suddenly stopped and turned to look back at Wang Lan before squeezing through a gap in a fence. Wang Lan observed the company name.
Meat Union Factory?
With a flash, Wang Lan followed. As he entered the Meat Union Factory, his eyes were drawn to the sealing tape on the door. It then dawned on him. Suzhou City had recently discovered a large quantity of uninspected, substandard pork. Consequently, authorities had taken strong measures to regulate the market, sealing multiple Meat Union Factories suspected of illegal activities.
This is a sealed Meat Union Factory. It looks like my guess was right; this Golden Retriever really can find its owner,
Wang Lan thought as he cautiously sneaked into the shadows, keeping his eye on the distant Golden Retriever.
"WOOF WOOF WOOF—"
A series of urgent barks rang out. Wang Lan immediately activated his long-range vision, bringing the scene before him into clear focus.
In a warehouse, directly in Wang Lan’s line of sight, a woman was suspended in a spread-eagled position, her hair disheveled and her head hanging low, making it impossible to see her face.
"Where did this dog come from!" A bare-chested, bald thug with tattoos on his neck came to the window and spat.
"This is the Meat Union Factory; isn’t it normal for dogs to come here? Cats eat fish, dogs eat meat."
"Speaking of which, Boss, are we still going to interrogate her? This woman clearly doesn’t know anything. Further interrogation is just a waste of energy."
"What? Zipper, even you’re going soft on her?"
"Bullshit! I’ve been sick of this for a long time. I stopped considering myself human ages ago. If she really knew something and was being stubborn, I might have the interest to play with her. But it’s clear she doesn’t know, so what’s the point of us messing with her further?"
"It’s one thing for us to know, but the higher-ups don’t care. If we don’t torture her to the end, they’ll think we didn’t try our best. Getting a result isn’t important; what matters is our attitude. Have you rested enough? Once you have, resume the interrogation. Hand me the scissors; let’s start with her fingers."
"WOOF WOOF WOOF—"
"HAHAHA... Stupid dog! Keep hitting it; if you die, you’ll be tonight’s extra dish.
But this dog... it looks kind of familiar, where have I...
"
His voice cut off abruptly as a silvery Crescent Arrow pierced through his mouth, entering from the front and exiting through the back of his head.
"GURGLE... GURGLE..."
"Raki, what the hell are you gurgling about? Stop teasing the dog and get back to work..."
His words were abruptly cut off as Raki collapsed backward, blood gushing from his mouth like a fountain.
"Someone’s here! Who is it!" The remaining few immediately tensed and jumped up. Their sharp eyes scanned the surroundings, but they couldn’t find the attacker.
Two of them pressed against the wall, watching Raki as blood spurted from his mouth. "It’s a sniper," one whispered.
"What do we do?"
"Use the hostage to threaten him!" one of them said. With that, he swiftly rolled across the ground, using an army-style evasion move to reach the hanging woman, his dagger flashing like a streak of cold light. He moved to place the dagger against the woman’s neck, thinking the sniper would then be forced to comply...
Suddenly, his movements halted. A tingling sensation hit him right between the eyebrows, and in an instant, endless darkness engulfed him.
"Chain—" The complexions of the remaining three changed drastically, terror quickly surfacing on their faces.
Hidden in the shadows, Wang Lan’s eyes sparkled.
This arrow also confirmed something for him: the people in the warehouse were not Star Martial Warriors. They were just ordinary people.
Having confirmed they were not Star Martial Warriors, Wang Lan no longer had any reservations. His figure darted forward, transforming into a streak of light as he rushed toward the warehouse. Covering the distance of less than three hundred meters took him only about twenty seconds.
To the three men inside the warehouse, Wang Lan’s speed resembled that of a high-speed train charging at them—they had barely noticed him before he was already upon them.
BOOM— The wall collapsed thunderously, and Wang Lan’s figure entered the warehouse. His dynamic visual tracking activated, he swiftly scanned the entire environment, ensuring there were no hidden threats. Then he moved to shelter the woman behind him.
"Brother, which gang are you from? Announce yourself!"
"Tianjian Bureau! I’m going to ask you some questions. Answer a single word incorrectly, and you die! What are you looking for?"
"Kid, keep talking like that and you’ll—AARGH!"
A flash of silver light zipped by, and an arrow instantly pierced his shoulder. Blood gushed profusely from the wound.
"Star... Star Martial Warrior?"
"This is your last chance. What are you searching for?"
"We are looking for... AARGH—" The voice abruptly cut off as the remaining two robbers suddenly clutched their heads and began to wail miserably.
Wang Lan’s eyes immediately sharpened. The heads of the two robbers before him began to squirm violently, resembling balloons being squeezed.
POP! The heads of the two robbers burst open like smashed watermelons. A hideous beetle crawled out from each of their skulls.
Wang Lan’s fingers instantly shot out flames, a stream scorching the creatures.
Under the intense heat, the two beetles emitted horrifying shrieks and then turned to ash.
Wang Lan hurriedly rescued the hanging woman. Checking her, he found she was still breathing. He promptly pressed on her chest, but alas, she was just an ordinary person; Wang Lan’s Healing Star Martial Arts were ineffective on her.
WEE-OO WEE-OO WEE-OO—
The sound of sirens grew louder, and before long, the wail of police sirens could be heard right outside the warehouse.
Wang Lan carried the woman out. The Golden Retriever nervously circled him, its eyes never leaving the woman in his arms.
"Wang Lan, how is she?"
"She should be Xu Dongdong. She’s in critical condition; get her to a hospital fast."
"Feng, hurry and get her to medical care! What about the robbers?"
"Dead!" Wang Lan said somberly, shaking his head. "The robbers had beetles in their heads. These would quickly consume their brains if they showed any sign of betrayal. Moreover, these aren’t any beetle species known to humankind. I’m certain they’re not native to Sky Blue Star. The Demon Clan is behind this."
"The Demon Clan?" Xu Shiyun’s voice arose as he slowly materialized from underground. "Does Xu Donghai have ties to the Demon Clan? Are there Demon Clan spy teams in Suzhou City?"
"As one of Jade Country’s top-ranked major cities, Suzhou City is naturally of great interest to the Demon Clan. The spy teams we’ve captured likely represent less than a tenth of those the Demon Clan has deployed. The emergence of a new spy team wouldn’t be strange. But if the Demon Clan is behind this, what was their purpose in killing Xu Donghai? What are they trying to find from him? But that’s not my primary concern. What worries me most is the Demon Clan’s clear attempt to prevent me from participating in the provincial martial arts competition."
"The Demon Clan wants to sabotage the provincial martial arts competition?" Xu Shiyun’s expression changed drastically as he asked gravely.
"It’s a strong possibility. Right now, Xu Dongdong is our only clue. Saving Xu Dongdong is crucial; she might reveal what the Demon Clan is looking for."
"Then let’s go!" Hu Qing left some of his men behind to collect evidence and escorted Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun to the hospital with Xu Dongdong.
RING RING RING—
Wang Lan’s phone rang. Seeing the caller ID, he saw it was Jiang Xinyu.
"Hello?"
"Wang Lan, where did you run off to? The morning matches are over, and you didn’t even show up?"
"They’re over? That fast? How did you all do?"
"Sisi was unlucky; she faced Qian Shichen and lost narrowly. Xiangwen and Feiyu both made it through. Also, the challenge matches scheduled for this afternoon have been postponed. They might be in three days, or perhaps even later; the specific time is still to be announced."
"I already know. I’m busy with something right now; I’ll call you when I’m done."
"Something’s up? Is it work-related?" Jiang Xinyu quickly sensed something.
"Yes."
"I heard... Xu Donghai is dead? Is that true?"
"Yes. I can’t say more right now."
"Okay. I’ll hang up."
When the three men arrived at the hospital, Wang Lan saw the Golden Retriever lying quietly by the entrance, ever vigilant. Its lively eyes scanned the gatekeeper, as if waiting for an opportunity. As soon as it saw Wang Lan get out of the car, it immediately got up and trotted over, wagging its tail.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: A Bloody Incident Sparked by a Dog
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 185: A Bloody Incident Sparked by a Dog
"This dog is very smart, and it played an indispensable role in rescuing Xu Dongdong this time. Shouldn’t we take care of it?"
"Qi, take the Golden Retriever back to the police car. We’ll take it with us later."
Wang Lan and the others arrived at the emergency department, where the guards waiting there promptly stood up and saluted.
"How is Xu Dongdong’s condition?"
"Very critical, but we’ve requested the best doctors to attempt resuscitation. The doctor said that the main issue isn’t the physical damage, but rather the psychological harm. Xu Dongdong’s nails and teeth have been violently pulled out."
"Her hair was violently plucked out, and her body has several wounds that were also rubbed with salt and chili pepper. The bastard who did this is an animal to be able to harm her so cruelly."
"The animal who did this has already been slaughtered. Did the doctor say when the resuscitation will be done? When will Xu Dongdong regain consciousness?"
"This... I asked the doctor to do it as soon as possible."
"BANG—" The doors to the operating room suddenly opened, and a young doctor in white came out, wiping sweat from his brow. Right after, a hospital bed was pushed out from the operating room.
"Doctor, how is she? Xu Dongdong, is she..."
"You’re the guards, right?"
"Yes!" Hu Qing promptly nodded, taking out his credentials.
"It’s good you’re the guards. Whoever did this to Miss Xu Dongdong was very professional, an expert in torture, causing maximum pain with minimal physical injury. This is the distinct hallmark of Holy War International Security Company. The person who tortured Miss Xu Dongdong must have been trained there."
At these words, Hu Qing and the others looked at the young doctor with an unusual gaze.
"Don’t make wild guesses. I was also a soldier in the past. Of course, the code number of the unit I was in is a secret and I can’t tell you."
"027, right?" Xu Shiyun suddenly smiled, extended her fist, and tapped it downwards.
The young doctor instinctively raised his hand, meeting Xu Shiyun’s fist. The movement was so skilled and natural, as if it were instinct.
"You’re also..." the young doctor asked in surprise.
"No! But I do know your number one Pack Leader. No wonder you could do it so quickly; you completed the wound treatment, suturing, and bandaging in just ten minutes."
"On the battlefield, time is life."
"How is Xu Dongdong?"
"After the treatment, her life is not in danger, but not just anyone can endure the interrogation methods of Holy War. Untrained individuals could go mad within an hour. Xu Dongdong’s condition is not very optimistic."
"The anesthesia will wear off in half an hour, so we’ll have to wait another half an hour to see how she is."
Xu Dongdong was sent to the intensive care ward, and Wang Lan and the others waited inside. Time ticked by, and Hu Qing periodically checked his phone, making a call every few minutes.
The young doctor’s prediction was very accurate. About twenty-five minutes later, Xu Dongdong indeed started showing signs of waking up. Then, several nurses quickly and professionally attended to Xu Dongdong as she stirred.
"Dongdong... Xu Dongdong..."
Although Xu Dongdong opened her eyes, her gaze was hollow. After about ten minutes, her eyes suddenly showed terror, and her body began to shake violently as though she had been electrocuted.
"No... don’t... I don’t know... I really don’t know... please... I don’t know... don’t know..."
"Xu Dongdong, we are doctors. You are safe now... don’t be afraid..."
"I don’t know... I don’t know... don’t ask me... I don’t know..."
"Dongdong... Dongdong... we are doctors..."
But no matter how the nurses comforted her, Xu Dongdong’s body continued to shake violently, gripped by a fear that seemed to have permeated her very soul.
"Quick, a sedative!"
The doctor hurriedly administered a sedative to Xu Dongdong to calm her down.
"I don’t know... really... I don’t know..."
"Peter... my Peter..."
"Please save me... I’m so scared... Dad... Mom... where are you... SOB... Husband... Husband... I’m going to die... SOB..."
Gripped by utter fear, even after being injected with the sedative, Xu Dongdong’s body continued to tremble violently.
"Peter?" Wang Lan’s eyes flickered. "Hu Qing, bring the Golden Retriever here."
"Okay." Hu Qing promptly dialed the phone. "Qi, bring the Golden Retriever here, emergency department, third-floor ward."
"Wang Lan, why do you want the dog brought here?"
"When I was rescuing Xu Dongdong, the Golden Retriever first went outside the warehouse. It barked furiously at the warehouse, and as its owner, Xu Dongdong would undoubtedly recognize it as her own dog’s bark."
"In her utter despair, the barking of the Golden Retriever was like a Life Potion injected into Xu Dongdong’s heart. That’s why she unconsciously called out for Peter. If we bring the Golden Retriever here, it might be the key to unlocking Xu Dongdong’s mind."
Soon, Qi led the Golden Retriever in. The dog was brought into the ward and immediately set its eyes on Xu Dongdong, who was shivering at the head of the bed. Even though Xu Dongdong was wrapped up like a mummy at this moment, the Golden Retriever recognized its owner instantly.
It jumped onto the bed and began licking its owner’s face.
"Peter... my Peter..." Xu Dongdong held the Golden Retriever tightly, burying her face in its fur.
"Miss Xu, we are the guards. It was Peter who led us to save you. You’re safe now..."
"I’m saved... Am I really saved? SOB... Why did you... why did you take so long to come!"
Suddenly, Xu Dongdong lifted her head and let out a heart-wrenching howl to the sky—
"My dad and mom... they were all killed by them... I didn’t know... the things my little brother stole... how could I have known..."
"What were they looking for?"
"I don’t know... I really haven’t seen any Evolution Potion..."
"Evolution Potion?"
Wang Lan’s eyes narrowed, his heart pounding. Beside him, Xu Shiyun’s expression also changed dramatically, her gaze instantly meeting Wang Lan’s.
"Demonic Transformation Potion?"
"It must be!"
"WOOF—"
The Golden Retriever, lying on Xu Dongdong, suddenly barked loudly and jumped down from the bed. "WOOF—"
It barked at Wang Lan and then walked out of the hospital room.
Is it asking me to follow?
Wang Lan immediately understood and hurriedly turned to chase after the Golden Retriever.
Once the Golden Retriever left the room, it sprinted off, with Wang Lan hastily following. The dog’s athletic ability was far too developed; as a Star Martial Warrior, Wang Lan definitely couldn’t keep up without using Star Martial Skills.
The Golden Retriever bolted out of the hospital, then sprinted along the city road. A few elderly men out for a stroll only felt a gust of wind rush past them.
"What was that just now? Looked like a dog?"
"That was indeed a dog..."
WHOOSH, Wang Lan’s figure instantly surged past them, chasing after the distant Golden Retriever.
"Do they walk dogs like that now? It’s a good thing I keep a turtle. If I had to walk a dog like that, my old bones would surely fall apart." Saying this, he looked down at the palm-sized Brazilian turtle at his feet. "Alright, slowpoke, another hundred steps."
The Brazilian turtle looked up at the old man with a face of despair, then simply flipped over, legs in the air, pretending to be dead.
The Golden Retriever’s stamina was better than Wang Lan had expected. It sprinted full-speed the whole way, covering seven or eight kilometers without stopping. Watching the direction the Golden Retriever was heading, Wang Lan’s eyes flashed with insight.
It was obviously heading towards Xu Qingshan’s home.
Xu Qingshan lived in the countryside, while his daughter and son-in-law lived in the city. The distance between their homes was less than ten kilometers.
"WOOF WOOF—"
The cordon at Xu Qingshan’s home had not yet been lifted. Many police officers were still searching for clues at Xu Qingshan’s place. Suddenly, frantic barking erupted, and a streak of golden light charged from afar.
Just as the guards were about to stop it, Wang Lan’s figure appeared instantly in front of them.
"Wait!"
The Golden Retriever entered the yard and started sniffing around in the vegetable garden. Before long, it began to dig furiously, and soon it had dug a hole.
"WOOF WOOF—"
The Golden Retriever barked twice at Wang Lan.
Wang Lan approached and saw several bones hidden in the pit, as well as a black cloth bag. He hesitantly picked up the bag, hearing a clanking noise from inside. Wang Lan quickly reached in and indeed pulled out two bottles of blue potion.
Seeing the potions, everything became clear to Wang Lan.
Why was Xu Donghai killed? He had stolen the Demonic Transformation Potion. Unexpectedly, the Golden Retriever had taken it and hidden it away like a bone.
Since the dog stole it, Xu Donghai’s family naturally didn’t know. Moreover, who could have thought that the thief would be a dog?
"RING RING RING—"
"Hello!" Wang Lan picked up his phone to answer.
"Wang Lan, I’ve almost finished my questioning here. It’s definitely the Demonic Transformation Potion. The people who kidnapped Xu Dongdong were asking about the whereabouts of the Demonic Transformation Potion, which was stolen by Xu Donghai."
"But the killer’s statement is that Xu Donghai had brought the Demonic Transformation Potion home, and it vanished in the blink of an eye. They suspected a family member had taken it, or something of that sort. It was for exactly this reason that Xu Qingshan and his wife were kidnapped."
"The killer had already questioned Xu Qingshan and his wife before interrogating Xu Dongdong, and Xu Dongdong had seen a video of her parents being brutally murdered. Hu Qing has already ordered his men to search the scene of Xu Qingshan and his wife’s murder."
"I’ve found the Demonic Transformation Potion here as well," Wang Lan said after listening.
"Hmm... Wait, you found the Demonic Transformation Potion? How did you find it?" Xu Shiyun suddenly exclaimed.
The killer had gone to such lengths, killing and interrogating, yet failed to find it, and Wang Lan found it in less than half an hour?
"Yes, you would never guess that the thief was this Golden Retriever. The Golden Retriever may have a bit of a spirit beast trait. It instinctively sensed the power of the Demonic Transformation Potion, so it stole it and buried it in the yard."
"When we were asking about the potion in the hospital, the Golden Retriever might have understood what we were looking for and led me to Xu Qingshan’s yard, where it dug up the Demonic Transformation Potion from the vegetable garden—a total of two bottles."
"I can’t believe it!"
The information Wang Lan provided left Xu Shiyun incredulous. What was this? A bloodbath triggered by a dog?
Then, Xu Shiyun’s subdued voice came through the phone.
"Now, we need to figure out whether these two bottles of Demonic Transformation Potion were produced before the potion production workshop was destroyed, or after."
"So, for now, we need to know where Xu Donghai stole the potions from."
"Leave it to me," Xu Shiyun said without hesitation.
"Let’s do it together. I’ve taken leave for a few days. I can’t miss a case like this."
"Alright."
Finding Demon Clan spies meant a massive amount of experience points, and experience points were what Wang Lan currently lacked the most.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 Really a Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 186 Really a Misunderstanding
After returning from Xu Qingshan’s home, Wang Lan quickly regrouped with Xu Shiyun. As for Xu Dongdong’s matter, it was handed over to the police department for handling. This was the second time Wang Lan witnessed the capabilities of the Tianjian Bureau’s intelligence department.
The first time was when he resolved the trouble with Xie Sisi. In just about an hour, they had thoroughly investigated Xie Sisi’s matter and executed her on the spot, nearly cremating the body immediately afterward.
This time, it only took half a day to track down Xu Donghai’s movements over the past six months, including the contacts he had made.
In the Star Mansion’s top floor, Wang Lan’s home printer buzzed rapidly, printing out faxed documents. These were intelligence reports collected from various stations of the intelligence department. Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun only needed to filter out the useful information from these reports.
"Apart from being a member of the Commoner Genius Association, Xu Donghai also took private jobs on the side? No wonder he could afford a B-level Star Martial Skill and three C-level Star Martial Skills despite his family’s financial conditions."
"He quit the Commoner Genius Association a week ago..." Wang Lan sighed while holding the report. "Did he leave because he obtained the Demonic Transformation Potion and climbed onto a higher branch, or did he steal the potion from the Commoner Genius Association?"
"Wang Lan, you suspect your classmate? Duan Ziqi, right?"
"Yes!"
"Indeed. The initial crime scene was at the school, but neither Xu Donghai nor Duan Ziqi are boarding students, so it’s not necessarily related to students. Moreover, if it’s almost certain that the Demon Clan doesn’t want you to participate in the provincial tournament, the likelihood of a student being involved is low. Look at this information: Ancient City District, underground casino boss Li, known as the Vampire. He runs underground casinos and issues high-interest loans, leading people to financial ruin. However, for some unknown reason, the Ancient City District police department has never clamped down on this area. Not long after Xu Donghai awakened as a Star Martial Warrior, he connected with this Li. While working for him, Li always wore a mask, earning the nickname Ghost Face in the Ancient City’s mafia. Only a few of Li’s close confidants knew Ghost Face’s real identity was Xu Donghai."
"Wang Lan, do you remember the former Crow?"
"You suspect Li is like Crow?"
"Very likely! I even suspect that Li, just like Crow, is a hidden Star Martial Warrior."
The more information was collated, the clearer it became that Xu Donghai’s interactions pointed in three directions. The first was his relatives. However, his entire family had been murdered, with only a brother-in-law surviving because he was away on a business trip. This made it unlikely that Xu Donghai had obtained the Demonic Transformation Potion from them.
The second direction was the school, or perhaps the Commoner Genius Association. But as Wang Lan knew, the Commoner Genius Association’s activities were limited to school. There, they exchanged cultivation insights and verified methods and ideas with each other. They didn’t interact closely after school. In the words of the wealthy students, they were just a bunch of cannon fodder huddling together and wailing.
The third direction, of course, was Li’s side, which Xu Shiyun felt was the most probable. After discussing with Wang Lan, they decided to gather intelligence around Li and act tonight to take down Li and his operation in one fell swoop.
Li’s ability to run an underground casino in the Ancient City District for so many years without being eradicated meant he had some survival tactics. To avoid alerting the enemy, this operation would be led by the Tianjian Bureau, with the police department providing support. For the Tianjian Bureau, dealing with a mafia gang was overkill.
As night fell and the city lights began to shine, the famous entertainment streets of the Ancient City District dazzled with lights and colors. But if someone looked down from the sky, they’d see that several streets spreading outwards from a central, palace-like building were quietly being cordoned off by police cars.
As the night grew darker, the blockade of the streets intensified. Slowly, those in the underground forces of the Ancient City District began to sense something unusual about tonight.
"Is it Li’s territory?" A middle-aged man missing two fingers stood on his balcony, deeply puffing on a cigar. "What on earth has Li done recently to make the police department willing to disrupt the balance to go after him?"
"I haven’t heard anything. Could it be related to the debt collection before the New Year? That doesn’t seem right either. Li is very measured in his actions; it’s usually the crooked merchants who get heavy-handed."
「At Hanjing Juegong, the top floor of the only five-star hotel in the Ancient City District, a young girl in a black lace dress played idly with a feather fan in her hand.」
"Miss Ji, you called for me?"
"Tell the girls to clock out early tonight."
"Ah? Why?"
"Haven’t you seen the big move from above? Although it’s aimed at Li, innocents could be affected. Call the sisters working on Li’s turf to evacuate immediately. Whatever it takes, just run if you can."
At that moment, it wasn’t just the hostesses who were on the run; Li’s subordinates also realized something wasn’t right. This wasn’t some routine inspection; this was an ambush without any prior warning.
Starting from three streets away, they gradually sealed off Li’s den as tightly as an iron wall.
At this moment, Li was reflecting deeply on what he had done over the past year. The Ancient City District had a triple power standoff, maintaining a balance that had ensured it was the safest area in Suzhou City for the past two years. Although attributing the district’s good order to the influence of the mafia was quite shameless, in Li’s words, as someone from the underworld and a gang leader, as long as he didn’t initiate trouble or unrest, he deserved a good citizen award.
In places where there is light, there will also be darkness, especially in Suzhou City, with its particularly thriving entertainment industry. "Above there is heaven, below there are Suzhou and Hangzhou"—how did this saying come about? Just because of the beautiful scenery? Just because of the lakes and mountains?
The starry sky over the grasslands is also beautiful, and the scenery in Shu is also magnificent, isn’t it? So what’s so special?
It’s all because in Suzhou and Hangzhou, one can enjoy the pleasures of heaven. More people who were particular about leisure and had taste would even travel thousands of miles to experience the fleeting beauty of Suzhou City.
And these glitzy places had long been infiltrated by the mafia. Even if one was removed, others would still seep in. So, those who were eliminated were often the dishonest ones, those who had crossed the line in Suzhou City.
For so many years, I’ve been upright and honest. Even though I run a casino and issue high-interest loans, I’ve never targeted students, the elderly, or honest folk.
The ones I target are those crooked merchants, or the rich playboys looking for a good time. I’ve racked my brain, but I just can’t figure out what I’ve done wrong.
Under the lights, Li’s bald head shone as bright as a bulb. In front of him was a statue of the Second Master, while in his hands, he clutched Buddha Beads. Li appeared composed, yet his two underlings behind him were panicked and sweating profusely.
"Li, are you still thinking? The police are about to come knocking! Let’s run!"
"Yeah, I’ve got your clothes ready, and even brought you a wig. The brothers will cause a distraction; you take that chance to break out in the chaos. As long as you’re safe, the brothers will be too. Just getting you out gives the brothers hope."
"Yeah! Li, at times like this, it’s us brothers you can count on. When you’re in trouble, we stick by you every step of the way. And where is Ghost Face now? If he were here, he could get you out with his skills. Who knows, maybe he’s the one who stirred up today’s trouble."
SNAP! The Buddha Beads in Li’s hands shattered, spilling to the ground.
"Ghost Face... he had something on today, so he couldn’t come... He asked for leave a few days ago. But now that you mention it, I do think it’s possible." Saying this, he picked up his phone to make a call.
When he heard the message that the number he dialed was not in service, Li’s face immediately turned pitch black.
"Li, let’s run!"
"We can’t. With such a big operation, how could they not be fully prepared? All of you might be able to run, but I alone can’t. If you want to run, go ahead."
CLAP! CLAP! CLAP! A round of applause rose as Xu Shiyun and Wang Lan silently ascended from underground. This scene took Li’s breath away.
"Star Martial Warriors? Is this necessary? Did you really need to use Star Martial Warriors to catch me?"
"Li! Ghost Face works for you, right?" Xu Shiyun didn’t like to beat around the bush. Once the intimidating effect was achieved, he got straight to the point.
"So it really was him... Am I being dragged down by him? Even if I have to die, I accept it. But could you two gentlemen at least tell me how I was set up?"
"He’s in cahoots with the Demon Clan. Since he happens to be one of your men, logically, you’re also implicated in dealings with the Demon Clan..."
"I..." Li’s eyes bulged as he pointed to his own head. "Brother, that’s not fair reasoning! My relationship with Ghost Face is strictly business. He was recommended to me by Mr. Qi. If anyone is his superior, it’s Mr. Qi, not me."
"Mr. Qi? Which Mr. Qi?" Wang Lan asked eagerly, his brow twitching.
"Mr. Qi’s name is Duan Ziqi. People in our circles call him Mr. Qi, and over time, it just stuck."
"Duan Ziqi? The Duan Ziqi from Suzhou No.1 Middle School?" Wang Lan asked, his eyes widening once more.
"Yes. Who in the Ancient City District doesn’t give face to Mr. Qi? He never gets involved in the business of the Ancient City District. However, by rule, we have to donate ten percent of our yearly profits to the orphanage. It’s like earning some good karma for us. If you’re looking into Ghost Face’s dealings with the Demon Clan, you shouldn’t be coming to me."
"Ten percent each year, that’s quite a lot. You’re generous, aren’t you?"
"Hehehe... They call me Li, but in the Ancient City District, the real boss is Mr. Qi. The rest of us are just small fry."
"So, we got the wrong person?" Wang Lan didn’t doubt Li’s words. He hadn’t known that Duan Ziqi had arranged Xu Donghai’s association with Li. If he had, he would have targeted Duan Ziqi directly. In Wang Lan’s view, Duan Ziqi was far more suspicious than Li.
Hearing Wang Lan’s words, Li’s face brightened. "Right! You definitely got the wrong person! You can ask around on the streets what kind of person I, Li, am. I hate traitors the most! This is all a misunderstanding, a complete misunderstanding."
"If it’s a misunderstanding..." Wang Lan turned to look at Xu Shiyun. "Shall we call Hu Qing to make the arrest?"
Li was about to express his gratitude, the words on the tip of his tongue, but they caught in his throat.
What does that mean? Still getting arrested? Wasn’t it all a misunderstanding?
Wang Lan smiled at Li’s bewildered look. "Well, now that we’re here, how can we return empty-handed? It would be a waste to make a trip for nothing, right?"
"I’ll pay..." Before Li could finish his sentence, Wang Lan grabbed his throat. A surge of Star Power flowed into Li’s body.
"AH! HOT! HOT! HOT!"
Wang Lan released Li’s throat. "No Star Power resistance. He’s indeed an ordinary person."
Xu Shiyun took out his phone. "Inspector Hu? Time to close the net."

chapters.title: Chapter 187: The Divine Team
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 187: The Divine Team
Li’s words might be true, or they might be false; taking him down was also a safety precaution. However, it was Li’s intelligence that provided a stronger suspect.
That evening, the intelligence department’s system began investigating Duan Ziqi.
"Duan Ziqi has unclear parentage. It is speculated he could be the result of young, inexperienced teens tasting forbidden fruit; he was left at the doorstep of an orphanage not long after birth. There’s no birth record of him in the hospital, and he weighed less than two kilograms when he was found.
He survived with the care of the orphanage, growing up there and developing a very strong sense of independence. By the age of ten, Duan Ziqi’s thought and action patterns were already very mature.
Duan Ziqi awakened as a Star Martial Warrior at nine, which could be considered genius. However, due to limited resources, his progress wasn’t fast. It wasn’t until he reached puberty in middle school that his power surged.
In high school, he had already reached the Star Shine Stage, and then around last October, he broke through to the Star Cloud Stage. He mastered one A-grade Star Martial Skill, one B-grade Star Martial Skill, and three C-grade Star Martial Skills. However, that’s just the public data; whether he has other unknown Star Martial Skills isn’t known."
After gathering the intelligence, Xu Shiyun summarized it.
"Duan Ziqi is just an orphan, yet his growth rate is no less than Jiang Xinyu’s... Don’t you find that strange?"
"Not strange at all!" Xu Shiyun said, leaning back in his chair. "Duan Ziqi grew up in an orphanage. Before him, quite a few older boys had left the orphanage when they came of age. Some joined various professions, while a few got involved with the mafia.
It wouldn’t have been difficult for Duan Ziqi to infiltrate the underground forces of the Ancient City District. Plus, with his identity as a Star Martial Warrior and his considerable strength, he has dominated the Ancient City District’s underground forces for the past five or six years and amassed a significant sum of money.
A kid in his teens, and he’s already in control of a district’s underground forces. If it were any other child that age, they’d probably be thinking about toys all day.
Moreover, Duan Ziqi has visited the trial grounds many times. His growth trajectory, although not as legendary as yours, has much in common with a few of your friends.
