Of course, I’m inclined to think the Demon Clan paved the way for Duan Ziqi’s smooth rise. Now we have two options. First, we capture Duan Ziqi immediately and dig out the Demon Clan forces behind him. Second, we monitor him secretly and close the net quietly."
Xu Shiyun’s eyes blazed as he looked at Wang Lan, who wore a pensive expression.
Although arresting him directly would yield the most immediate benefit, surveillance could lead to unforeseen complications.
Wang Lan recalled the scene where the two kidnappers who had abducted Xu Dongdong were killed instantly, just as they were about to reveal their mastermind.
The Demon Clan’s methods are bizarre and ever-changing. No one can guarantee Duan Ziqi hasn’t had some spell cast upon him. The most likely outcome of capturing Duan Ziqi would be ending up with a corpse.
"Let’s monitor him secretly," Wang Lan decided. "I’ve already challenged Duan Ziqi. If the Demon Clan’s intent is to prevent me from participating in the provincial martial arts competition, might they have other means? I’ll observe him at school, and you send someone to watch covertly.
I have a feeling the Demon Clan might make some moves targeting this provincial martial arts competition. If Duan Ziqi truly is a pawn of the Demon Clan, then this pawn will definitely make a move."
"Alright then!"
In the pitch-dark night, amidst dazzling lights, Duan Ziqi walked slowly through a deep alley, his face grim. Suddenly, the sound of flapping wings broke the silence. A bat landed on Duan Ziqi’s shoulder.
"How did the Tianjian Bureau take down Mori? Have you been exposed?"
"Xu Donghai is one of the top students at the school; his case was bound to cause a stir. It’s not hard to trace the connection between Xu Donghai and Mori, so it’s normal that the investigation led to him."
"But it was the Tianjian Bureau that took down Mori."
"Xu Donghai is a Star Martial Warrior. Isn’t it perfectly normal for the Tianjian Bureau to get involved?"
"Aren’t you underestimating the Tianjian Bureau? Their strength is not to be taken lightly; they’ve likely already traced it back to you."
"If that were the case, you wouldn’t be talking to me right now, and I’d probably be a corpse on a medical examiner’s dissection table," Duan Ziqi sneered.
"This series of incidents was caused by your mistakes. Don’t provoke my bottom line. In our infiltration plan, you are far from the best."
"But I will be the best, sooner or later. Neither of us has found the Evolution Potion, so the Tianjian Bureau probably can’t find it either. As long as the Evolution Potion remains unfound, they won’t pay this case much attention. In a few days, if the case isn’t solved, it will be closed as an unsolved case.
If you’re not convinced, why not manipulate a Star Martial Warrior into exposing himself and then pin Xu Donghai’s murder on him?"
"Just be careful yourself."
"The school has notified us: the challenge tournament begins in three days. Should I continue to thwart Wang Lan?"
"Are you confident?"
"Give me an Evolution Potion, and I should have no problem. After a year of experiments, I’ve managed to use the Evolution Potion’s power without transforming."
"Without my permission, you are not to act rashly!"
The bat flapped its wings, flew high into the night sky, and disappeared into the darkness. All of this was done so covertly that even those secretly watching failed to notice.
「Three days passed quietly, and another weekend arrived.」 Principal Zhang returned from Jin City, and the challenge tournament, postponed for three days, was scheduled to begin on Monday.
After school, the leaders of the Star Martial Arts Campus gathered for a meeting.
"This trip to Jin City for the meeting was mainly to convey the directives from above regarding the upcoming nationwide provincial martial arts competition. This year’s provincial martial arts competition will be different from the past. Previously, it was a closed event where only observers from various high schools and the representing team from the host city could watch on site.
But this time, the provincial martial arts competition will be broadcast live on television. Provincial TV stations and online platforms across each province will directly broadcast the event."
"What? This is unprecedented in the fifty-year history of the provincial martial arts competition! Isn’t this foolhardy? Don’t the higher-ups understand the importance of the provincial martial arts competition? Broadcasting it live?" the Director of Studies asked incredulously.
"Yes, I was puzzled too. But I heard it was decided after a discussion by the elders."
"Principal," Mr. Liu raised his hand and asked, "the provincial martial arts competitions have always been closed events. I just thought it was the norm. But from your tone and the Director of Studies’, it seems holding it privately is a necessary measure? With information technology being so advanced, shouldn’t we keep up with the times?"
"Mr. Liu, you are still young. Consider this: who attends the provincial martial arts competitions?" the Director of Studies asked, looking at Mr. Liu with a somber tone.
"They are... all the most outstanding students from each city, right?"
"Let me put it another way. The Southern Flame Emperor placed eighth in the Jiang Province provincial martial arts competition twenty-five years ago. The Eastern Azure Emperor was the champion of the Qi Province provincial martial arts competition, and the Western White Emperor was the champion of his provincial martial arts competition forty years ago.
In our Jade Country, out of the 1,720 existing Titled Strongmen, all have participated in provincial martial arts competitions, and eighty percent of them achieved top-ten rankings in their respective provinces.
The seeds of today’s provincial martial arts competition are the future pillars of the Jade Country. Now do you understand why it cannot be made public?"
The reasoning was immediately clear. Where do the Jade Country’s Star Martial Warriors come from? All are products of the Jade Country’s basic education and training system. Those who can participate in the provincial martial arts competitions are undoubtedly the most elite and talented students from their respective cities.
They are the future of the Jade Country. Going public would mean exposing an entire generation of the Jade Country’s future leaders to everyone. If opposing forces targeted these talents, what would become of the Jade Country in twenty years?
"Alright, this decision was made after consultation with the elders, so there’s no point discussing it now. Besides the public nature of the provincial martial arts competition, there’s another matter: the host city for each province... has not yet been determined."
"Hasn’t it always been Jin City?"
"In the past, the provincial martial arts competitions were held in the provincial capitals. Strangely, this year it seems to be a random draw among several cities, with no prior notice. Jiang Province has thirteen candidate cities, with Jin City, Suzhou City, Tong City, Xu City, and Wuxi City as five of the options. I’ll discuss this with the mayor tomorrow. If Suzhou City is chosen, we’ll need to plan accordingly."
"Arranging it like this... it feels like they’re guarding against something."
"Right, Principal, will the challenge tournament to select Suzhou City’s participants start on Monday?"
"Have the other cities submitted their rosters?"
"They have. I’ve already obtained their lists of participants."
"How’s their strength? Do we stand a chance to make a comeback this time?"
"Well... if Mingyue Wucheng were participating in the provincial martial arts competition, we might have some hope, but he has no intention of registering.
Jiang Xinyu is strong and talented, but compared to the representatives from established powerhouses like Jin City, Chang City, Tong City, and Tai’an City, she falls a bit short.
Especially Jin City’s starting team—they’re all at the Star Cloud Stage! Tong City has several multi-attribute talents. Tai’an City has descendants from Secret Skill Clans and Star Martial Arts clans competing. And Chang City, needless to say, leads Suzhou City with talents from both Star Martial Arts clans and commoners."
"Is that so? It seems I was too optimistic. Apart from Jiang Xinyu and Mu Shaoyun, what about other promising candidates? Duan Ziqi? Wang Lan? And Zhuang Haotian, Xu Xiangwen, and Gong Feiyu?"
"Principal, Mu Shaoyun’s family experienced a major incident, and he hasn’t been to school for nearly twenty days. Duan Ziqi was eliminated by Wang Lan during the preliminaries, and Zhuang Haotian was eliminated by Jiang Xinyu. Even if they make a comeback in the challenge rounds, it seems only Jiang Xinyu can carry the team.
However, relying solely on Jiang Xinyu is unlikely. As usual, let’s aim for sixth place or fight for fifth."
"Hmm, let’s settle on that then."
「Meanwhile, information on the teams representing each city was circulating through Jiang Province via various channels.」 Almost all the primary team details for each city were exposed, except for two or three cities that hadn’t yet confirmed their rosters for various reasons.
This intelligence naturally fell into Jiang Xinyu’s hands as well. Her intelligence-gathering abilities had always been strong. Even though Xu Xiangwen and the others could have gathered it themselves, they were too lazy to bother.
They were accustomed to Jiang Xinyu sharing the information as soon as she acquired it.
When Xu Xiangwen saw the lineups of each city’s primary team sent by Jiang Xinyu, he couldn’t help but blurt out a curse.
Is this really the primary lineup?
Compared to last year’s primary teams from each city, the difference was as stark as that between a primary school team and the national team!
In the past, having three Star Cloud Stage cultivators was considered a strong team. Teams predominantly consisting of Star Cloud Stage cultivators were championship favorites.
But this year, Jin City’s starters are all Star Cloud Stage! Tong City has nine Star Cloud Stage cultivators and a representative from a Secret Skill Clan. Chang City has eight powerhouses leading two others each, and Tai’an City is the same!
What kind of monstrous squads are these?!
Xu Xiangwen had thought that as a Star Cloud Stage expert, he could at least shine for a while and last a few rounds in the provincial martial arts competition. But looking at this lineup,
it feels like I’m on course for a first-round knockout!

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Just to Annoy You
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 188: Just to Annoy You
Gong Feiyu let out a gentle sigh upon receiving the information, stood up, and poured himself a cup of coffee to calm his nerves. He took a small sip and suddenly chuckled.
Wang Lan carefully went over the information, picked up a pen, and circled several names. Ordinary Star Cloud Stage combatants posed little threat to Wang Lan; the real threat lay in all-rounders like Jiang Xinyu and those who possessed secret techniques and an Inborn Talent of the Bloodline that she had circled.
"I’m still not strong enough... If I could master a Thunder Attribute A-class Star Martial Skill, I could double my power," she said, picking up her phone to log into the Star Martial Hall’s Star Martial Skill Trading House.
There was still no news from Gong Jian, but the Trading House had several B-class Star Martial Skills. Wang Lan was considering whether she should buy a B-class skill as a stopgap. The Water Attribute wasn’t bad, and the Earth Attribute was decent too. However, after reading through the descriptions of these skills... the restrictions were quite limiting and unsuitable for use in the matches.
Moreover, even with her system cheat, Wang Lan’s Star Power was still at the Star Shine Stage, and using these Star Martial Skills twice might deplete her energy. For now, Wang Lan was best suited for skills that were more concentrated, which required less energy and lasted longer. Area-effect Star Martial Skills would be better learned after reaching the Star Cloud Stage.
Over the weekend, the five-person group continued with their unwavering training and exchanged opinions on the upcoming provincial tournament. Before the information was released, they were full of confidence, but once they received the reports from other cities, everyone turned pessimistic.
「On Monday, the Star Martial Arts Campus was aflutter with colorful flags.」
After a three-day delay, the final round of the city selection challenges was about to begin. The challenges aimed to select the strongest lineup of senior third-year students to the maximum extent possible.
Even those eliminated in the preliminary rounds could still challenge the victorious ten-person team, and if successful in the challenge, they would replace the former and join the city’s representative team.
So early in the morning, Wang Lan and the other nine winners sat at the pre-battle seats. Any of the preliminary round losers could register to challenge and then specify an opponent for battle until no challengers remained.
But the candidates who made it into the top ten were essentially the strongest lineup already. Aside from Wang Lan’s group of four, the rest were one Star Cloud Stage and five Star Shine Stages. These five Star Shine Stages were naturally the primary focus of the challengers.
The Challenge Match began, and Zhuang Haotian was the first to take the stage. This guy was securely one of the main lineup, but he was so unlucky it almost invited sympathy.
He was defeated in the first round by Wang Lan, taken by surprise due to asymmetrical information. He managed to revive by replacing Xu Donghai, only to draw Jiang Xinyu as his opponent.
Jiang Xinyu’s strength completely overwhelmed Zhuang Haotian. He couldn’t win in close combat nor at range. Jiang Xinyu could control and defend, focus on single-target attacks or opt for area attacks, and possessed slowing Star Martial Skills as well as restrictive ones. Zhuang Haotian was directly made to question his life due to Jiang Xinyu’s flurry of moves.
Zhuang Haotian plunged into deep self-doubt these few days, always having been a favored child of the heavens. Even if he couldn’t match up to Jiang Xinyu and Mu Shaoyun, he was still firmly seated in the top ten of his grade, stable as an old dog.
Beaten by Wang Lan, he admitted his defeat, but then he was crushed by Jiang Xinyu.
Might my achievements be false?
The problem was, if he could have put up a struggle before falling, he could have at least claimed a close defeat at Jiang Xinyu’s hands. But the reality was that he was instantly taken out by Wang Lan, and it wasn’t much better with Jiang Xinyu.
Zhuang Haotian became disheartened, locked himself in his room for two days to ponder a question:
Did he truly have talent, or had he always overestimated himself?
If it weren’t for his uncle, the dean of instruction, coming to counsel him, he wouldn’t have had the courage to step out and challenge again.
And Zhuang Haotian, who had faced two blows, no longer had the sharp gaze he once possessed; in his calm eyes, like a tranquil autumn pond.
"I challenge student Zhang Xingcheng," he said.
"What?" The students in the stands let out a collective gasp of surprise.
Many couldn’t believe Zhuang Haotian was the one to challenge Zhang Xingcheng. Zhuang Haotian was such a proud person that even when challenging, he would choose the strong.
For three years, Zhuang Haotian had always been like that, pushing his limits and choosing opponents of equal valor. It would make sense for him to challenge Gong Feiyu or Xu Xiangwen, but no one expected him to challenge Zhang Xingcheng, who relied on luck to enter the top ten.
Always liking to gnaw on the hardest bone, he now suddenly picked the softest persimmon.
"Zhuang Haotian is finished," Xu Xiangwen shook his head with regret, "He’s lost his edge. The Zhuang Haotian who would rather take the straight path than seek a crooked one is gone."
"No, Zhuang Haotian has matured," Wang Lan disagreed.
A man’s true growth is letting go of his burdens and learning to make choices.
Despite the whispers of doubt from the surrounding students, Zhuang Haotian’s face always wore a peaceful, mild smile, showing no shame, irritation, sorrow, or arrogance.
Zhang Xingcheng shook his head with a bitter smile and stood up, "I forfeit!"
Not to mention Zhuang Haotian at the Star Cloud Stage, he couldn’t win against any of the five Star Shine Stages present. To have made it this far was already far beyond his expectations.
Zhang Xingcheng forfeited, and Zhuang Haotian advanced.
Under the gaze of all those eyes, Zhuang Haotian slowly took his spot at the challenger’s bench, replacing Zhang Xingcheng.
"Inviting the second challenger!"
"I challenge Ye Yun."
In the preliminary rounds, several dark horses emerged only to be cut down. It was only natural for them to participate in the challenge match. Everyone had only one chance to challenge, and for safety, they naturally focused on the five Star Shine Stage combatants.
However, curiously, Wang Lan stood out like a bright torch in the night as a Star Shine Stage, yet no one stepped forward to challenge her. After five matches, three of the six Star Shine Stage members had been replaced, yet it was as if everyone had forgotten Wang Lan, not challenging her even once.
"Next up, Duan Ziqi."
The moment Duan Ziqi’s name was called, Wang Lan’s gaze sharpened instantly. As if sensing Wang Lan’s look, Duan Ziqi turned towards her and suddenly broke into a smile.
"I challenge... Xu Xiangwen!"
"?"
Wang Lan looked at Duan Ziqi with confusion.
What do you mean by provoking me non-stop just now?
"Lanzi, I’ve noticed a strange phenomenon. The people you beat up always seem to need me to beat them up again. What does that say? They’re asking for it, right?"
"Maybe. Don’t hold back and don’t underestimate him. I guess he’ll use a flying Star Martial Skill, and once he does, you’ll be completely restrained."
"Understood!"
After the two of them entered the arena, Duan Ziqi turned his head back and gave Wang Lan a slight smile. Up to this moment, Duan Ziqi had not taken Xu Xiangwen seriously at all.
"The match begins——"
As soon as the voice fell, Star Power surged around Xu Xiangwen, and within an instant, three Physical Clones appeared in the center of the arena.
"Pure Yang Skill——"
Star Power exploded around the four Xu Xiangwens, and in the moment of the Star Power burst, their figures turned into streaks of light rushing towards Duan Ziqi on the opposite side.
It was only then that Duan Ziqi turned his head, revealing a grin at the approaching Xu Xiangwen.
SWOOSH——
A gust of wind blew up, and almost instantly, Duan Ziqi’s figure swept past the middle of Xu Xiangwen’s four figures, just like a bullet piercing through.
Suddenly, Wang Lan sprang to her feet, her face showing utter disbelief.
"So fast——" All the classmates watching this scene had their mouths agape in disbelief.
This Star Martial Skill was so fast that it was even twice as fast as the previous match with Wang Lan.
This was also the reason why Wang Lan couldn’t help but stand up.
If Duan Ziqi had shown such strength before, even Wang Lan with her dynamic vision might not have been able to keep up. Had Duan Ziqi been hiding his power before, or had his speed made a huge breakthrough in these three days?
It must have been a breakthrough over these three days.
Wang Lan quickly theorized.
If Duan Ziqi had possessed such speed before, he would have had no reason to hold back when fighting me.
This speed, it must have already reached the limit of Wind Travel Skill. Any faster, and it would be instant teleportation.
BOOM——
A cloud of smoke lingered, and one Xu Xiangwen exploded into dust. Three more Xu Xiangwens still remained on the spot.
A drop of cold sweat slid down Xu Xiangwen’s face. Duan Ziqi’s dagger had nearly grazed his throat. If it were not for Xu Xiangwen using the rebound from Exploding Fist to retreat thirty centimeters, Duan Ziqi’s dagger would have passed over his throat.
The brush with death was not what truly scared Xu Xiangwen; rather, it was the unreasonable speed of Duan Ziqi’s attack.
With the Pure Yang Skill activated, Xu Xiangwen’s eyes and reactions couldn’t keep up with Duan Ziqi’s attack speed.
How could he even hope to counter Duan Ziqi’s next attack?
Behind him, Duan Ziqi slowly turned around, his smile as refreshing as the spring breeze, yet it felt like the cold sunshine of winter ice and snow, bright but bone-chilling.
"Will you surrender on your own, or die?"
"I might lose, but I won’t concede defeat." As he spoke, a cloud of smoke once again enveloped him, and another Xu Xiangwen appeared by his side.
"Next strike, I will pierce your throat." Instantly, a breeze once again enveloped Duan Ziqi.
Meanwhile, the four Xu Xiangwens instantly stood back to back, forming a formation. Star Energy Fluctuations emerged from each of them, each with a slightly different fluctuation.
"Pure Yang Skill, Thousand Hands Buddha!"
Duan Ziqi’s form instantly turned into a streak of light charging at Xu Xiangwen, and in an instant, a barrier seemed to form around Xu Xiangwen. A ten-meter-high Buddha phantom enveloped Xu Xiangwen, and behind the Buddha, hundreds of arms extended. In the moment it formed, they turned into countless fists hammering down.
"Holy cow, is it really a thousand hands? Xu knows this move?"
"This move is the true form of the Pure Yang Skill. Xu must reach the Galaxy Stage to master it. But unexpectedly, Xu took a different approach, using four clones to cover different areas, and together, the four clones managed to complete a pared-down version of the Thousand Hands Buddha."
"Wang Lan, that idea of drawing a circle with the left hand while drawing a square with the right suits Xu perfectly."

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Cunning Operation
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 189: Cunning Operation
Upon hearing Gong Feiyu’s words, Wang Lan instantly understood. Wang Lan had said before that to use a complex Star Martial Skill, one needed four minds to act as one. Normally, it is very difficult for a person to divide their attention four ways. However, Xu Xiangwen, who could split into four Physical Clones, with each clone dominating a part, plus the collective unity of the clones, had truly achieved the feat of dividing his attention four ways. If Xu Xiangwen had more than just the Yang Attribute, performing a complex Star Martial Skill would have been much simpler for him than for other people.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! A swirl of dust enveloped the area as a figure was violently blasted backward from the forceful strikes. Duan Ziqi retreated continuously until he reached the edge of the competition arena where he suddenly choked, vomiting a pool of fresh blood.
"Classmate Duan Ziqi, how are your injuries? Can you continue the competition?" the referee standing beside the arena quickly asked.
"I’m fine." After spitting out a mouthful of blood, Duan Ziqi stood up again and gently wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
He looked up at the Thousand Hands Buddha phantom formed by Xu Xiangwen.
"This move already has the strength of the Star Cloud Stage. It’s just a pity that your Star Martial Skill is launched by four people working together. Being unable to move is this move’s biggest flaw," he said.
"Even if I stand still, I can still beat you till you crap yourself."
The hem of Duan Ziqi’s clothes fluttered. Enveloped by a gentle breeze, he slowly ascended high into the sky. From his vantage point, he looked down upon Xu Xiangwen like a deity.
Hundreds of meters in the air, Duan Ziqi’s figure was obscured by sunlight. Everyone craned their necks, holding their breath and enduring the glaring sun as they watched tensely.
Suddenly, Star Power surged in the sky, and fierce winds whipped up a storm. The clear sky changed dramatically in an instant as wild winds gathered the clouds.
Wang Lan watched with a grave expression as Duan Ziqi plummeted from the sky, his heart leaping into his throat. This attack exuded an intense pressure that Wang Lan could feel.
If it were Wang Lan, he would have had to use the Purple Flame Arrow to counter Duan Ziqi’s attack, and that was only because his flames countered Duan Ziqi’s Wind Attribute.
Head down, Duan Ziqi transformed into a rapidly spinning wind drill. The wind blades concentrated at his fingertips seemed to turn into lightning.
Lightning’s characteristic is its focused power. The combination of the wind blades’ cutting force and lightning’s terrifying speed made this attack not only incredibly sharp but also frighteningly fast.
"Xu Xiangwen won’t be able to withstand this move," Jiang Xinyu suddenly said, her voice filled with tension.
Not only would Xu Xiangwen be unable to withstand it, but no Star Martial Warrior below the Galaxy Stage could, not even a Gold Attribute Star Martial Warrior known for their defense.
In an instant, Duan Ziqi’s attack descended upon Xu Xiangwen’s head. Xu Xiangwen’s Thousand Hands Buddha immediately launched a dense barrage of terrifying attacks at Duan Ziqi in the sky. However, Duan Ziqi, like a Ghost in the wind, deftly evaded the Thousand Hands’ bombardment and fiercely slammed into the Buddha phantom’s forehead.
BOOM— The intense air pressure exploded instantly, and a violent wind swept through the area.
"Xiangwen, retreat—" Wang Lan shouted.
BOOM—
The moment Wang Lan’s voice rang out, an explosion erupted. A figure was sent flying outward by the shockwave from the center of the blast.
Wang Lan’s figure flashed and disappeared from the preparation platform. He moved like a nimble snake, taking a serpentine path to catch Xu Xiangwen before he hit the ground.
The moment he caught Xu Xiangwen, Wang Lan’s face immediately darkened. Xu Xiangwen’s injuries were ten times more severe than he had imagined. His entire body was covered with dense wind blade cuts.
Through his senses, Wang Lan detected countless tiny wind blades still cutting through Xu Xiangwen’s muscle tissue. Without the intervention of a powerful Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior, all of Xu Xiangwen’s organs and limbs would lose connection. Even if he survived, he would be nothing more than a senseless lump of flesh.
As Wang Lan caught Xu Xiangwen, Jiang Xinyu and Gong Feiyu instantly appeared beside him. Wang Lan had already torn open Xu Xiangwen’s clothes and pressed his palm onto Xu Xiangwen’s chest. Star Power surged as he activated his Healing Star Martial Skill.
"How is Xiangwen?"
"Give me a Soul Bead!" Wang Lan demanded in a low voice.
Upon hearing this, Jiang Xinyu’s expression changed instantly. Her icy eyes stared coldly at Duan Ziqi, who had created a large crater in the competition arena. Duan Ziqi was currently kneeling on one knee, surrounded by a hazy mist of wind.
Jiang Xinyu knew how potent Wang Lan’s healing abilities were. With his Star Power reserves, he could save two people on the brink of death. The more severe the injury, the more Star Power was required. The fact that Wang Lan needed a Soul Bead to complete the healing meant Xu Xiangwen’s injuries were many times worse than near-fatal.
It could be said that tiny wind needles were slicing every part of Xu Xiangwen’s body, down to every square millimeter. Therefore, Wang Lan’s treatment was tantamount to completely reconstructing Xu Xiangwen’s physical body.
With such injuries, no one but a deity—or Wang Lan—could save him.
Without hesitation, Jiang Xinyu took out a Soul Bead from her waist bag and handed it to Wang Lan. With the Soul Bead as support, Wang Lan’s heart settled down.
"Classmate Wang Lan, how are Classmate Xu Xiangwen’s injuries?" the referee asked urgently as he ran over.
The sheer force of that last blow had given him quite a fright. The violent collision had almost made him think both contestants would perish together. Fortunately, Duan Ziqi was unharmed, and Xu Xiangwen also seemed to be alive.
"He’ll be fine, just give me three minutes."
In the stands above, after a brief silence, a buzz of discussion arose.
"Damn, I used to think we were classmates, all just ordinary folks with two shoulders and a head. But now I realize, they’re gods and we’re mere mortals."
"With that kind of display, if we could achieve that in our lifetime, we could die content. Is this how two Star Cloud Stage warriors fight? If you told me they were at the Galaxy Stage, I’d believe it."
"Forget it. What’s the point of a bunch of us at the Star Shine Stage guessing? Maybe that’s really the normal combat power of the Star Cloud Stage. Galaxy Stage warriors are probably the kind who can destroy a city with one punch," someone said.
"Yeah, you’ve watched too much anime! Galaxy Stage warriors destroying a city with a punch, Star Sea Stage crushing a country with a stomp... Then the Five Emperors can blow up a planet with one punch, and the Five Elders can wipe out half a galaxy with a single shockwave!"
"Hey, you’ve got that wrong. The Five Emperors are Jade Country’s strongest fighting force. It’s not certain that the Five Elders are stronger than the Five Emperors."
The buzzing discussion continued. After depleting two Soul Beads, Wang Lan finally moved his hand away from Xu Xiangwen’s chest.
"How is he?" Gong Feiyu asked anxiously.
"He should be fine now."
"Why hasn’t he woken up yet?"
"Xinyu, how about chilling him a bit?"
HISSS—
A stream of cold mist shot from Jiang Xinyu’s palm, blasting Xu Xiangwen right in the face.
"I’ll get right up, immediately—" Xu Xiangwen let out a strange yell and flipped over to sit up. But even as he sat up, his eyes remained closed as he groped around with his hands.
"What are you looking for?"
"My clothes..."
"Can’t you freaking open your eyes?"
It was then that Xu Xiangwen finally opened his blurry eyes. "Huh? How come I’m here? This is the sports field, right? What day is it today?"
After suffering a severe impact, a person might experience a brief period of memory loss. This is the body’s self-preservation mechanism. The memories gradually return once the mind determines that recalling them won’t cause further harm.
"Today is the challenge match." Wang Lan grabbed Xu Xiangwen’s hand and pulled him up. As long as Xu Xiangwen was okay, Wang Lan and the others’ mood immediately improved, and they resumed their usual teasing.
"To avoid being late, you decided to simply sleep at the school last night. Now we’re waking you up for the match."
"Bullshit, even if I slept at the school, there’s no way I’d sleep on the sports field... Wait, it seems like I was in a match... I didn’t get my memory knocked out of me, did I?"
"Your memory might be fuzzy, but your IQ is still online. You’re fine. Stay in the stands for now. You can challenge again later; you still have one more chance."
After sending Xu Xiangwen off, Wang Lan, Jiang Xinyu, and Gong Feiyu returned to the stands, where Duan Ziqi had already taken Xu Xiangwen’s seat.
"That’s my spot, and I’ll definitely get it back. Wang Lan, your Medical Star Martial Skill is truly impressive. After the provincial martial arts competition, I hope I can count on your support, alright? You wouldn’t hold a grudge over this little incident and retaliate officially, would you?" Duan Ziqi said to Wang Lan with a faint smile, as if nothing had happened.
"I won’t," Wang Lan replied with a smile, shaking his head.
"Wang Lan, actually, I was thinking of challenging you again, but the principal sought me out earlier and said that you must participate in the provincial competition. Not because of your strength, but because your identity as a Medical Star Martial Warrior is indispensable to the city’s representative team."
Duan Ziqi chattered endlessly. Beside him, Jiang Xinyu and Gong Feiyu maintained cold expressions, not even glancing at him. Jiang Xinyu tapped her fingers lightly, while Gong Feiyu stroked his chin,
Hmm, should I take care of this after school...
"Hmm... have you finished talking? What makes you so confident that you’re already on the team?" Wang Lan asked with a full-faced smile, looking at Duan Ziqi.
"I’m already sitting here, do you think anyone can kick me out?"
Wang Lan quietly pulled out his phone. "Hello, Sisi, how is Xiangwen doing? Can he still fight?"
"His thoughts are still a bit scattered. It might take him another hour to recover."
"You participate in the challenge."
"Ah? Me? Challenge who? I can’t beat any of them."
"Challenge me."
When those two words landed, Jiang Xinyu smiled. Gong Feiyu snapped his head around, looking at Wang Lan with an expression of sheer admiration.
Damn, what a genius! Why didn’t I think of that?
Meanwhile, Duan Ziqi, who had overheard the entire conversation, felt his face turn pitch black. He had never expected Wang Lan to pull such a stunt. Wang Lan had fought his way into the top ten; even if he lost a challenge, he still had one more chance to challenge someone else.
"Ah? Isn’t that a bit improper?"
"Don’t worry. My goal is to participate in the challenge match; you understand."
"Is there anyone else who wants to challenge? If you want to challenge, please come and register. If there are no more challengers, the challenge match will conclude."
"I challenge!" Xie Sisi shouted, approaching the registration desk for the challenges.
"You?"
The Dean of Discipline frowned. He knew Xie Sisi; she was indeed a promising seedling. However, Xie Sisi’s platform to shine was definitely at university, not in high school. With her current strength, she wouldn’t even pass the first round of the provincial martial arts competition.
But the rules were the rules. Although he was reluctant for Xie Sisi to participate in the challenge, he still nodded and approved her application.
"Classmate Xie Sisi, whom do you wish to challenge?" the Dean of Discipline asked perfunctorily. In his view, she was bound to lose regardless of whom she challenged.
"Classmate Wang Lan."
PFFT—COUGH! COUGH! COUGH... The Dean of Discipline choked, nearly spitting out the goji berries he was presumably chewing.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: If once doesn’t suffice, then fight again
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 190: If once doesn’t suffice, then fight again
"Xie Sisi, who did you say you wanted to challenge?"
"I want to challenge Wang Lan!"
Before the Head of Discipline could react, Wang Lan had already stepped down from the preparation platform to the center of the arena. "I concede!"
"Damn! They’re in cahoots!" The students on the platform burst into an uproar upon hearing this.
"Although it was well-known that Xie Sisi and Wang Lan were close, who would have thought they were *this* close? Isn’t this blatant cheating?"
"That’s why I said they’re in cahoots!"
"Ahem... Wang Lan, this city-level selection is no joke. You can’t just concede without a plausible reason, right? Plus, deliberately faking things could get you penalized by the discipline office."
If he hadn’t known Wang Lan’s background, the Head of Discipline would have cursed him out already. The fact that Xie Sisi challenged Wang Lan was outrageous enough, and now he was actually conceding? Are you kidding me?
"Head of Discipline, both Xie Sisi and I are at the Star Shine Stage in Star Martial level, and I hold no advantage in Star Power. Moreover, Xie Sisi is a Water Attribute Star Martial Warrior who has mastered various Water Attribute Star Martial Skills. My Fire Attribute is countered by hers, so my concession is perfectly reasonable."
Reasonable, my ass!
Xie Sisi beating Wang Lan? Even if they’re both at the Star Shine Stage, Wang Lan successively defeated two cultivators from the Star Cloud Stage, and both times it was an overwhelming victory. He can’t beat Xie Sisi?
But... Wang Lan’s reasoning was impeccable. Logically speaking, at the same level, a Fire Attribute Star Martial Warrior would indeed be countered by a Water Attribute one. It wasn’t as if he could ask Wang Lan if he was just a *normal* Fire Attribute Star Martial Warrior. He couldn’t bring himself to say that out loud.
"Sisi, what are you waiting for? Come sit down," Xu Xiangwen stood up and waved to Xie Sisi.
"Go on, Sisi." After speaking, Wang Lan smiled at the Head of Discipline. "Sir, I want to challenge!"
The Head of Discipline snapped back to his senses, his expression warming slightly.
So, Wang Lan wanted to help his little girlfriend qualify for the provincial tournament... Well, as long as the main lineup for the city’s representative team remains unchanged, that’s fine. It didn’t matter who filled those spots anyway, as they’d likely be eliminated in the first round.
Although early romances were strictly forbidden in high school, since they were about to graduate, the Head of Discipline decided to turn a blind eye.
"Alright, whom do you challenge?"
"Duan Ziqi."
Upon hearing this name, the Head of Discipline’s face instantly darkened.
Duan Ziqi, Wang Lan, and Xu Xiangwen were all tacitly considered the school’s starting lineup. The fact that Duan Ziqi had eliminated Xu Xiangwen had already made the Head of Discipline’s expression quite ugly. But at least Xu Xiangwen still had the right to challenge again.
However, Duan Ziqi had already used his challenge opportunity; if he was challenged and defeated this time, he couldn’t be revived. This was something the Head of Discipline did not want to see.
"Wang Lan, maybe you could choose someone else?"
"Sir, is this the school’s official position?"
"It’s my personal suggestion. I know you have some issues with Duan Ziqi, but you can’t ignore the bigger picture just because he challenged Xu Xiangwen down, can you? This is the selection for the Suzhou City representative team. I hope you can put personal grievances aside and prioritize the honor of the school and Suzhou City. Xu Xiangwen still has a chance to challenge and be revived, but if Duan Ziqi loses, he’ll have no more chances. Duan Ziqi’s strength could make him your comrade in the provincial tournament..."
"Sir, I insist on challenging Duan Ziqi," Wang Lan repeated firmly.
"As long as it doesn’t violate the rules, in principle, we cannot forcibly intervene to change it," Principal Zhang, who was also on the viewing platform, suddenly spoke up.
"Well... alright then. Wang Lan has issued a challenge to contestant Duan Ziqi. Duan Ziqi, please come down and accept the challenge."
Duan Ziqi’s ashen face suddenly changed, a gloomy, cold sneer appearing.
Standing up, he walked down from the preparation platform step by step, entering the competition arena.
"I’ve already been going out of my way to avoid you, yet you’re still so relentless. After our last fight, have you become so conceited as to think you’re really stronger than me?"
Wang Lan stood still, silently observing Duan Ziqi’s gloomy expression.
He wondered what Duan Ziqi had experienced these past few days; his skin tone seemed much darker than it was three days ago.
For the past few days, members of the Tianjian Bureau had been monitoring Duan Ziqi twenty-four/seven. However, aside from training, Duan Ziqi hadn’t engaged in any other unusual activities. The amount of training he’d done these few days had secretly astonished even the Tianjian Bureau members.
But who ever heard of getting a tan from training at night?
"The challenge match between Wang Lan and Duan Ziqi begins now!"
BEEP—
The moment the whistle blew, Duan Ziqi’s figure vanished, transforming into a streak of light that disappeared from sight. At the same instant the whistle sounded, Wang Lan activated his dynamic vision.
Under his dynamic vision, Duan Ziqi’s charging speed was continuously slowed. The more it slowed, the greater the consumption of Wang Lan’s Star Power and the strain on his eyes.
Wang Lan’s Star Power surged around him, and the light in his right eye seemed to overflow its socket. His eyeballs bulged, and sharp pangs of pain shot through them. Only after slowing the speed by twenty times could Wang Lan barely make out Duan Ziqi’s movements.
However, at a twenty-fold slowdown, Wang Lan’s body felt as if it were fixed in place, each movement like a snail crawling.
No good, I won’t make it in time.
Within a mere instant of conscious thought, Wang Lan determined that even if his eyes could keep up, his body’s movements absolutely could not match Duan Ziqi’s strike.
Instantly, Wang Lan changed tactics, abandoning his plan to use the Flame Sword and instead activating Star Cloud Sword Dance.
Duan Ziqi’s speed was achieved using a Wind Attribute Star Martial Skill. It lacked flexibility and couldn’t achieve the super-fast neural reaction speeds of the Yang Attribute or Thunder Attribute.
HISS—
The students in the stands only felt their vision blur. A streak of light flashed before their eyes, and then the two fighters had already switched positions.
At Wang Lan’s throat, the sharp sensation from Duan Ziqi’s blade grazing past still lingered. Confusion also showed in Duan Ziqi’s eyes. He had roughly gauged Wang Lan’s speed during their previous encounter. By his estimation, Wang Lan shouldn’t have been able to avoid that attack at such speed.
Yet Wang Lan had dodged. And in Duan Ziqi’s eyes, Wang Lan had merely floated backward gently, effortlessly evading his throat-slitting strike.
Wang Lan gently rubbed his right eye.
So dynamic vision has its limits too. If the speed is too high, you might not see clearly even if your eyes popped out.
But the current problem wasn’t his eyes—it was how to win this match. The strength Duan Ziqi displayed this time was a bit too much. The current Duan Ziqi could easily defeat two of his past self from three days ago.
Three days. Can someone really improve that quickly?
Once again, Duan Ziqi’s figure transformed into a streak of green light. This time, Wang Lan was well-prepared, instantly pushing his dynamic vision to its maximum, his Flame Swords igniting in both hands simultaneously.
Under dynamic vision, Duan Ziqi transformed into a wind fiend lunging for his face. The wind pressure hammered him, the violent gale seeming to tear at his features. In Wang Lan’s vision, he saw the wind fiend’s illusion baring its terrifying, sharp teeth.
"Cross, Flame Sword!"
BOOM—
A wind dragon suddenly exploded and spiraled. Before Wang Lan, the cross-shaped Flame Sword burned with purple flames, like a sacred crucifix. Before the cross-shaped Flame Sword, a long gouge, over ten meters in length, had appeared in the ground. Duan Ziqi’s figure, however, seemed to have vanished into thin air.
DRIP—
Wang Lan extended a fingertip. A drop of blood landed on it, slowly trickling down.
He silently looked up. Above Wang Lan’s head, a dark shadow hovered a hundred meters in the air. The blood was dripping from Duan Ziqi.
That last exchange had been decided by a hair’s breadth.
Besides Wang Lan and Duan Ziqi themselves, no one else knew the details of what had transpired.
In that critical instant, Wang Lan had successfully summoned his Flame Sword and blocked Duan Ziqi’s attack just before it landed. The sharpness of the Flame Sword easily cut through the wind blade barrier.
Naturally, Duan Ziqi wasn’t willing to just wait for death. His dagger thrust out, intending to pierce Wang Lan’s throat and achieve mutual destruction. But Duan Ziqi had miscalculated the length of his own arm. If he had continued to thrust the dagger forward, his entire arm would have been severed.
Duan Ziqi had no choice but to use the updraft created by the meeting of wind and fire to shoot straight up into the sky.
However, Duan Ziqi’s shoulder was still injured by the Flame Sword, blood dripping down steadily.
Never mind the spectators in the stands; even the school leaders on the main platform were all dumbfounded.
"Principal, this is definitely a duel of finals-quality! Even in the finals of the past two years, did anyone display this level of strength? Look at this Star Energy Fluctuation, look at the perilous nature of these tactics... Wang Lan and Duan Ziqi should both be on the city representative team."
"Then have you considered the consequences if the team isn’t united? Even if Wang Lan fails his challenge today, Jiang Xinyu will be next to challenge. You should be aware of the extent of the conflict between the likes of Duan Ziqi and Jiang Xinyu over these past three years. Who is right and who is wrong, what do you say?"
"But for the honor of the school and Suzhou City, they should set aside their prejudices..."
"Heh heh heh... You don’t understand the thinking of these post-millennials. In their words, ’What do the school’s honor or Suzhou City’s honor have to do with me?’ Young people these days, don’t they just seek to follow their hearts and feel refreshed?"
Duan Ziqi hovered high in the sky, but he knew that against anyone else, his ability to fly would render them helpless. But Wang Lan possessed ranged Star Martial Skills; in Wang Lan’s eyes, he, Duan Ziqi, airborne, was merely a target.
Sure enough, just as I quickly restored my Star Power, Wang Lan raised his right hand towards me,
Duan Ziqi thought.
"Your Star Martial Skill is merely a form-transformation type, essentially a gun that doesn’t need bullets. If that’s the case, let’s settle this in one blow! Greedy Wolf Roar!"
Instantly, the Star Power in the sky surged wildly. A sweeping gale churned the heavens and the dark clouds, and an incredibly condensed wind blade took shape in the sky, while Duan Ziqi’s body plummeted rapidly downward.
Watching this scene, Xu Xiangwen on the viewing platform suddenly shot to his feet.
"I remember now... Damn it, Wang Lan, dodge! That move is terrifying! That wind blade is made of countless wind needles! It’s indefensible, unblockable!"
Xu Xiangwen’s agitated voice erupted, but it was powerlessly swallowed by the howling gale.
Suddenly, Star Power surged around Wang Lan. From his hand, raised towards the sky, a pair of enormous wings burning with purple flames instantly unfurled.
In a daze, in the eyes of many, Wang Lan’s arm transformed into an Anubis spear made of purple flames.
"Purple Flame, Arrow!"
WHOOSH—
The arrow formed of purple flames shot towards Duan Ziqi in the sky. Almost instantly, the arrow met Duan Ziqi’s wind blade.
Time seemed to freeze for an instant; the heavens and earth paused momentarily.
Then, the enormous wind blade in the sky also seemed to turn purple. Almost in an instant, the purple flames engulfed the massive wind blade.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Confirming Duan Ziqi
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 191: Confirming Duan Ziqi
"Wow!"
Everyone in the stands of the entire field was stunned. The power of Duan Ziqi’s move had just been displayed half an hour ago.
With one move, he had defeated Xu Xiangwen of the Thousand Hands Buddha soundly. Everyone thought that when Duan Ziqi used this move, Wang Lan could only respond with an even stronger technique. No matter how earth-shattering it was, one of them would fall after this move.
But no one expected Wang Lan to just casually shoot an arrow.
Although this arrow burned with flame, its momentum and impact could not compare to the move unleashed by Duan Ziqi.
"This is a bit incomprehensible. Could the elemental counter really be this significant? Such a powerful wind blade attack, yet it can’t withstand a single Fire Arrow?"
"Are you kidding me? Did Duan Ziqi chicken out or what?" Murmurs of discussion could vaguely be heard from the stands.
"Teacher Liu Jie, you don’t seem very surprised, huh? Do you know what’s going on? Wang Lan’s Star Martial Skill... I don’t think I’ve seen it before," a female Star Martial teacher said softly as she approached Liu Jie.
"Wang Lan’s arrow might seem ordinary, but if you truly understand what it represents, you’ll realize it’s only natural. You recognized the Flame Sword Wang Lan used against Duan Ziqi earlier, right?"
"The signature skill of the Wolf King, last year’s Star Martial Competition champion. Wang Lan is Wolf, right? But even if he is Wolf, Duan Ziqi’s move is definitely not comparable to those Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warriors from the Star Martial Competition."
"Correct. But you must remember what that purple flame is. Purple flame, with a temperature close to ten thousand degrees, is acclaimed as the limit of colored flames. Beyond that lies pure light and heat. Purple flame is already one of the highest temperatures a fire-element Star Martial Warrior can control. For example, the Fire Emperor’s Purple Sea Surge creates a purple sea of flame covering a hundred meters. All Exotic Beasts within this area are annihilated by this move. Even the Fire Emperor uses purple flame. Wang Lan might not be able to use purple flame over a large area, but the quality of his flame has reached the Fire Emperor’s level. It’s a miracle that Wang Lan can use purple flame at his current stage, and yet he managed to shoot it as an arrow. Don’t you understand the mystery behind it now?"
"A compound Star Martial Skill?" the female teacher asked in astonishment, taking a deep breath.
"Precisely! A compound Star Martial Skill. Fire overcomes wind, and purple flame perfectly counters wind. However, if they had been closer, even the purple flame wouldn’t have been able to instantly melt the wind blade. Wang Lan could still have been defeated. But a distance of several dozen meters is enough for the purple flame to completely engulf the wind blades. In this duel, from element to form, Wang Lan perfectly countered Duan Ziqi. This outcome was to be expected."
"BOOM—"
Suddenly, a loud explosion erupted in the air.
It blossomed like fireworks in the sky.
Amidst the fireworks, Duan Ziqi’s body fell, trailing a plume of pitch-black smoke, and smashed fiercely onto the field.
Duan Ziqi looked pitiful, as if he had just been dug out of a coal mine. His clothes were still smoldering with tiny sparks.
"Duan Ziqi! Wang Lan, quickly treat Duan Ziqi!"
"Teacher, please announce the result."
"Alright, I hereby announce—"
"Wait!" Suddenly, a grim shout rang out. Duan Ziqi, who had seemed to be in a coma, stirred. Slowly, almost eerily, he propped himself up from the ground.
"I’m fine. I’m perfectly fine!" Duan Ziqi stood up, rolled up his sleeves, and gently wiped his face. "That was exhilarating! Fighting you is the best thing that’s happened to me in three years."
Engulfed by the purple flame, yet Duan Ziqi only appeared superficially charred and was otherwise unharmed?
Wang Lan was secretly shocked but showed no sign of it on his face.
"I thought encountering me would be your misfortune. At least, with me around, you can forget about participating in the provincial Martial Arts Competition."
"Hahaha..." Duan Ziqi laughed loudly, looking towards the sky. "You don’t think this is all the strength I have, do you?"
"BUZZ BUZZ BUZZ—" Suddenly, an irritating noise arose. Wang Lan furrowed his brows sharply. Opposite him, Duan Ziqi’s expression changed drastically, shifting from unwillingness to pain, then anger... and finally, to helplessness.
"I concede!" Duan Ziqi suddenly said, raising his hand.
"What?"
"I concede!"
Duan Ziqi uttered those two words, then turned. He glanced reluctantly at the preparation stage, at the seat he had just occupied and which had yet to warm, before walking towards the edge of the field.
"Duan Ziqi concedes. Wang Lan wins the challenge. Please proceed to the preparation area."
Wang Lan watched Duan Ziqi’s retreating figure, his thoughts churning. Duan Ziqi definitely hadn’t seemed like he was going to concede earlier. He must have had other moves prepared, and his fighting spirit wasn’t faked. So why did he suddenly give in? Did he receive some instruction at that moment? Was that sudden buzzing sound just an illusion, or something else?
"DING DING DING—"
Wang Lan’s cell phone rang. He picked it up and saw it was a call from Xu Shiyun.
"Hello, Xu."
"Did you hear a buzzing noise at the school just now?"
"Just now? Yes, I heard it. What was that?"
"Demon Sound! It’s the ultrasonic communication language of the Demon Clan. In the past, the Demon Clan often used Demon Sound for short-distance communication. After we decrypted it thirty years ago, they stopped using this type of communication. Unless it’s an emergency, the Demon Clan definitely wouldn’t use it. The communications team just notified me that they detected Demon Sound. After they provided a rough range, the first place I thought of was your area."
"Demon Sound?
Then it’s almost certain,
" Wang Lan muttered, moving to a corner.
"Certain about what?"
"Certain that Duan Ziqi is a spy for the Demon Clan, or, more accurately, a human traitor. I was just battling Duan Ziqi when the Demon Sound occurred, and he suddenly conceded. He must have received an order through the Demon Sound. It’s almost certain Duan Ziqi is compromised. Do you want to make an arrest?"
"I’ll ask Director Wang."
"Alright!"
Wang Lan returned to the preparation area. The challenge matches continued unabated, with Xie Sisi watching the field, a tense expression on her face. Every new challenger made her heart pound.
She had already used her one challenge opportunity. If she were challenged and defeated now, she would be completely out of the running for the provincial Martial Arts Competition.
Never having the opportunity wasn’t so bad, but watching it slip away when it was within reach... that was a hard pill to swallow.
Strangely, even after Xu Xiangwen returned to the preparation area, no one challenged Xie Sisi.
The challengers weren’t fools. It was clear Xie Sisi was protected by the four top contenders; Duan Ziqi’s fate was a harsh lesson. Wang Lan had already had his match. If they challenged Sisi, Jiang Xinyu was another of her powerful protectors they might have to face.
"Are there any more challengers? If not, then the Suzhou City team representing Jiang Province in the provincial Martial Arts Competition will be set..."
"Wait a moment!"
Suddenly, a voice, as if carried on a distant breeze, reached everyone’s ears. Upon hearing it, the Dean of Instruction, who had seemed somewhat displeased throughout the event, immediately stood up, his face breaking into an excited smile.
"And me!"
A gust of Speedy Wind blew, and a shadowy figure gradually materialized on the competition field.
"Mu Shaoyun?"
"Mu Shaoyun!"
"Mu Shaoyun! He’s finally here! I knew he could pull himself together."
Mu Shaoyun had always been a formidable rival to Jiang Xinyu. Academically, Jiang Xinyu held a slight edge over Mu Shaoyun. However, in actual combat results, she had lost to him more often than she had won.
Even though Jiang Xinyu always believed she would win in a true life-or-death battle, Mu Shaoyun was definitely a competitor she acknowledged and took seriously.
He had disappeared for nearly a month and missed even the preliminary contest. Everyone thought Mu Shaoyun would miss the provincial Martial Arts Competition, yet unexpectedly, he appeared at the very last moment of the challenge matches.
"I registered for the provincial Martial Arts Competition. Due to some personal matters, I was unable to participate in the school selections, which I understand counts as a forfeiture. But according to the rules, I should still be able to take part in these challenge matches, right?"
"Indeed. Mu Shaoyun, whom do you wish to challenge?"
"Qian Yufei."
"Alright. Qian Yufei, please come to the stage."
"No need. I concede!" Qian Yufei declared, giving up promptly and decisively.
There was no chance of victory against Mu Shaoyun.
Qian Yufei was a proud individual. Even if he didn’t participate in the provincial Martial Arts Competition, he was confident he could be admitted to a top Star Martial Academy on his strength alone.
"School selection contest completed. Successfully chosen for the city representative team. Reward: 8,000 experience points, 300 skill points."
As the Dean of Instruction announced the confirmed members of Suzhou City’s team for the provincial Martial Arts Competition, Wang Lan also heard the task completion reward in his mind.
The reward was less than I expected, but then again, this was just a city-wide selection—or to be more precise, a school-wide selection.
The ten-person team had no internal ranking, but a captain still needed to be determined. On any other city’s team, filled with spirited young men and women in the throes of adolescence, this would be a contentious issue. The method of choosing a captain was obvious—it would be fought out. The captain of a city team at the provincial level virtually represented the strongest combatant among that city’s high school seniors. This was an incredibly important credential for a resume.
"Why do you think you are qualified to study at our academy?"
"I once represented my city’s high school seniors in the provincial Martial Arts Competition."
"Participated in the provincial Martial Arts Competition? You’re the seventh one today."
"I was the captain!"
"A true master indeed!"
That was the difference! A very realistic disparity.
This time, however, the usually fierce fight for captaincy was met with a long silence. Everyone looked at one another. The ten-person team consisted of: Jiang Xinyu’s group of five; Zhuang Haotian and his three companions; Mu Shaoyun, on his own; and Ma Chengcheng, a dark horse who didn’t usually stand out but had shown tenacious strength to secure his spot.
The Suzhou City team, with five members at the Star Cloud realm and five at the Star Shine Stage, boasted an extraordinarily strong lineup compared to previous years. However, when looking at Jiang Province as a whole this year, they were still only considered middle-tier.
In the end, almost everyone agreed with Xu Xiangwen’s suggestion.
"Alright everyone, now that the fighting’s done, we’re all brothers in the same trench. After school, it’s my treat—how about we all go for barbecue? As for choosing a captain... what’s there to really choose? Only three people are truly qualified for consideration. Jiang Xinyu, Mu Shaoyun, and Zhuang Haotian. As for the rest of us, I guess none of us are really qualified to contend for it, right?"
"Cut it out, Xu Xiangwen, are you trying to make fun of me?" Zhuang Haotian immediately waved his hands dismissively. "You all saw my performance during the selections. If I were captain, I’d bring shame to us across the entire province."
"I’m not interested in being captain either," Mu Shaoyun added. "Let Jiang Xinyu take the role. In terms of strength and reputation, she’s well-suited to represent Suzhou City."
And just like that, with a few sentences, the matter was pleasantly decided.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 Help Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 192 Help Out
The city-wide selection was complete, and with less than an hour left until school dismissal, the school generously decided to let the students out early.
Shitanji is a nationally renowned barbecue chain, beloved by Star Martial Warriors with big appetites for its genuine ingredients and generous portions.
There were seventeen or eighteen Shitanji franchises in Suzhou City, but the one in Han Ding Square in the Ancient City District was the most famous. The sun still hung in the sky. Meanwhile, Wang Lan and the rest of the ten-member team had already gathered early in a private room at Han Ding Square.
"Want some alcohol?" Xu Xiangwen, who was treating everyone, asked hospitably.
"Aren’t we all underage? Drinking isn’t good." Zhuang Haotian had always been an obedient child. Living under the watchful eye of his uncle, the dean of discipline, he never touched cigarettes or alcohol.
"I don’t mind. I don’t reject alcohol, but I don’t particularly like it either," Mu Shaoyun said indifferently.
"Let’s not drink. Wait until we’re eighteen," someone suggested.
"Lanzi, if you can’t drink, just say so; there’s no need to make excuses. Jade Country’s legal age of adulthood is sixteen. I’m puzzled why you keep pushing the age of adulthood back by two years. Since ancient times, hasn’t sixteen been the age of maturity?"
"Then how do you explain the saying about reaching adulthood at twenty?"
"Let’s just not drink and go for some juice instead," Jiang Xinyu suggested.
Shitanji was known for serving quickly and providing top-notch service. Three waiters were responsible for grilling the meat, while Wang Lan’s ten-person team focused on eating. Evidently, the waiters had underestimated their eating speed. If the ten hadn’t slowed down and cracked jokes to lighten the mood, the three waiters would have been overwhelmed.
"Waiter, bring the menu. I want to order more food," Xu Xiangwen stood up and suddenly said.
"Of course, sir. Please wait a moment."
Suddenly, Xu Xiangwen frowned. Star Power surged through his body, and his Heavenly Eye opened on his forehead.
A waitress, who was about to refill their tea, was startled by a vertical pupil that suddenly appeared on Xu Xiangwen’s forehead, causing her to tremble and drop the teapot.
CLANG.
A hand shot out suddenly and easily caught the falling teapot. With a smile, Mu Shaoyun handed the teapot back to the waitress. "Miss, don’t be afraid. We’re Star Martial Warriors, not monsters."
"Under... understood... Thank you!"
The service industry staff were not unaccustomed to Star Martial Warriors. It was just that the sudden opening of Xu Xiangwen’s Heavenly Eye had given her a scare, but she quickly recovered and was no longer afraid.
"Xiangwen, what are you doing, opening your Heavenly Eye all of a sudden?" Wang Lan asked, slightly reproachful.
"I saw Duan Ziqi. He’s in the alley behind us, surrounded by a lot of people. It looks like they’re from the mafia?"
"Him? Never mind, those mafia guys are out of luck... Wait, someone dares to mess with Duan Ziqi in the Ancient City District?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
"Should we go check it out?"
"Why bother watching him? He can handle it. Let’s keep eating," Xu Xiangwen said nonchalantly.
Suddenly, Wang Lan stood up, pulled back the curtains, and said, "I’m going to take a look. Save some for me; I’ll be right back."
No sooner had he spoken than Wang Lan’s figure vanished.
"That guy, when did he become so enthusiastic?" Xu Xiangwen asked, bewildered.
Behind Han Ding Square lay a section of ancient architecture preserved by the government. They wouldn’t tear it down, no matter how much the developers offered. Otherwise, Han Ding Square would definitely be more than three times its current size.
In an alley of the ancient town, Duan Ziqi leaned against a wall and slowly lit a cigarette. He took a deep drag and exhaled a plume of smoke.
"Kid, who the hell are you? What did you call us here for?"
"You used to hang around with Li?" Duan Ziqi asked, glancing sideways.
"That’s right. Li’s been taken down, and we have to watch his territory for him. Who are you? Don’t beat around the bush; my patience is limited. Don’t wait until I run out of it, or it’ll be too late for you."
"It’s nothing much... Today... I’m just in a bad mood and really feel like hitting someone. I called you all here hoping to beat you up a bit."
"Damn!"
In an instant, Duan Ziqi moved, his form swift as the wind, darting among dozens of thugs wielding steel pipes and machetes. Even without using Star Martial Skills, Duan Ziqi was incredibly fast. Not just fast, but brutally efficient.
One punch broke a rib, a twist snapped an arm, an easy grab dislocated a shoulder, a slight turn misaligned meridians. In less than three minutes, nearly twenty thugs were sprawled on the ground.
Duan Ziqi casually dusted off his hands. "Feels better now," he said, then straightened his jacket and walked past the groaning thugs toward the end of the alley.
After Duan Ziqi had left, a figure appeared beside Wang Lan, who didn’t turn but asked softly, "Not planning to arrest him?"
"Director Wang said to keep him under surveillance for a while longer. There’s a risk he’ll be silenced if we move now."
"If that’s what Director Wang said, then so be it. By the way, what’s he up to? Cleaning up Li’s mess?"
"No! From my observations, he was just in a foul mood today. This is already the third batch."
"How many of you are on watch?"
"Just me. Another brother will take over at eight tonight."
"You’ve had it rough. After this is all done, I’ll treat you to a meal."
"Hehehe... How about the barbecue at Shitanji?"
"No problem."
Wang Lan bid farewell to the operative from the intelligence department and returned to Shitanji. He didn’t know how much they had eaten during the ten or so minutes he was gone, but the number of waiters in the room had increased by seven, with three barbecue grills operating simultaneously.
The meal lasted until eight in the evening before they dispersed. Afterward, Wang Lan sat in Xu Xiangwen’s car, deep in thought.
"Lanzi, what’s on your mind?" Xu Xiangwen asked softly, turning off the music.
I was thinking, your abilities are well-suited for surveillance.
"That’s true. Within a hundred meters, my unobstructed clairvoyance can penetrate anything, and within five hundred meters, no movement can escape my Heavenly Eye search. I’ve already figured out my path: a team scout. If you guys enlist in the future, I’ll enlist with you. If you go to pioneer new territories, I’ll be right there pioneering with you."
"Damn, why do I feel so moved by what you said? Do you have to be so sentimental?"
"Sentimental my ass. Where else could I find partners as complementary, in sync, and completely trustworthy as us? Our four-person group has a compatibility rate of over ninety percent. We’re destined to be a team, get it?"
"Now it’s five of us."
"Sisi is indeed great. I’m just speaking factually. In terms of complementarity, Sisi isn’t essential, but she is completely trustworthy. Once she matures, she can be a team controller. Then, with Sisi and Feiyu also on team control, me on recon and quick battle, and you on medical and team fighting, our team will be invincible."
"Heh... Since you’re so sincere about wanting to roll with your big brother, how about I give you a task?"
"Have some dignity. What do you mean, ’roll with you’? We cooperate for mutual benefit; it’s a win-win."
"I’m serious."
"Huh?" Xu Xiangwen’s smile froze. "What task? Whatever you want me to do, I’ll do it without hesitation."
"Using your clone for surveillance at night won’t affect your rest, will it?"
"A clone can’t use the Heavenly Eye, okay?" Xu Xiangwen rolled his eyes. "The Heavenly Eye is my Talented Skill. Have you ever seen a clone able to use Talented Skills?"
"Alright then, forget it."
"Who do you want me to surveil?"
"Never mind, it’s too dangerous. Forget I said anything."
"Are you not treating me like a brother?"
"You can’t use a clone for surveillance. If you’re discovered, you might not even have a chance to escape. Do you think I’d dare tell you?"
"It’s Duan Ziqi you want me to surveil, isn’t it?" Xu Xiangwen suddenly asked, a faint smile playing on his lips.
"How do you know?"
"I saw Duan Ziqi being attacked by the mafia today, and you were so concerned that you followed. You, Lanzi, are usually as cool as an old dog and never meddle in others’ business. Apart from us brothers, when have you ever genuinely cared about anyone else? To be this concerned about Duan Ziqi, either there’s an illicit affair, or you have ulterior motives."
"Why does everything sound so twisted when it comes out of your mouth? Let me put it this way: there’s a Demon Clan spy behind Duan Ziqi. We are currently surveilling him, but your abilities would allow for more thorough surveillance. By the way, what level is your Heavenly Eye talent?"
"Talent level, A; potential, S. If it weren’t for this potential, do you think I could have been taught the Pure Yang Skill, such a powerful Star Martial Skill? Speaking of ’we,’ ever since we first discovered the Demon Clan base at the trial grounds, I’ve felt that you’ve suddenly become mysterious. Tell me the truth, have you joined some special department?"
"The Tianjian Bureau."
"I knew it! Ever since your aunt’s incident, I felt your state of mind was off. I thought about it, and the only thing that would keep you so calm is if you had solid backing. The Tianjian Bureau... I’ve considered it too, but I hear it’s hard to get into. We’re still in school, and you’re already contributing to the country."
"Not at all, I’m just a reserve member."
"So, am I considered your subordinate?"
"No."
"Tch! Not even an unofficial position?"
"You’re my brother!" Wang Lan said earnestly.
"Actually, surveilling Duan Ziqi is quite simple for me. Where does he live? Wouldn’t buying a house nearby take care of it?"
The atmosphere suddenly turned very quiet.
Sometimes, people naively fall into misconceptions. The moment surveillance came to mind, why did I only think about hiding in concealed alleys or stealthily crouching in some corner, then keeping an eye on the target?
That kind of surveillance, if discovered, could very likely lead one into a trap. Xu Xiangwen’s concept of surveillance was much more advanced: buy a nearby house for direct observation, or, to be even more audacious, buy the one next door.
Duan Ziqi’s place wasn’t some standalone villa; there were plenty of neighbors upstairs, downstairs, and on either side. Additionally, behind Duan Ziqi’s building was a small plaza. The Han Ding Speed Eight Express, for instance, was there and lacked nothing. Getting a room and monitoring through the wall indeed posed little risk.
"What do you think?"
"It’s possible! But you have to be careful. You absolutely must not meet Duan Ziqi face to face. The moment he sees you, you risk exposure."
"Understood."
"If you discover anything, you must not act on your own. You have to inform me. Don’t take chances; there are Demon Clan spies behind him."
"Although I like to boast, I’m definitely not arrogant, okay? You know what kind of person I am; I never joke with my life. By the way, if I do this well, is there a chance to join the Tianjian Bureau?"
"Are you sure?"
"The Tianjian Bureau! Heavenly Sword Special Duties! How prestigious would that be?"
"I should have one recommendation slot. Plus, with your abilities, the chances are pretty good." Wang Lan was now a Crimson Captain in the Tianjian Bureau. As an elite member of the bureau, a referral spot wasn’t too much to ask for.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 Caught the higher-up
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 193 Caught the higher-up
After Xu Xiangwen dropped him off at Star Mansion, Wang Lan once again cautioned Xu Xiangwen to be very careful and never reveal himself. The consequences would be unimaginable if he were exposed.
However, Wang Lan’s worries also stemmed from his excessive concern for Xu Xiangwen, who was not one of those students without actual combat experience. Xu Xiangwen had gone through real battles in the trial field and was born with a strong sense of perception. Jiang Xinyu and the others had been able to anticipate danger so many times largely thanks to Xu Xiangwen’s indispensable contributions. Moreover, Xu Xiangwen was, after all, at the Star Cloud Stage cultivation level, a strength not considered the lowest tier in the Tianjian Bureau. Even the individual they encountered this evening, who was responsible for surveilling Duan Ziqi, might not necessarily be stronger than Xu Xiangwen.
Objectively speaking, Gujian’s predicament was more perilous than Xu Xiangwen’s. After all, Gujian could no longer secretly monitor Duan Ziqi.
After returning home and freshening up, Wang Lan lay in bed, his head resting on the pillow.
Although they had found signs of the Demon Clan spy’s activities this time, they still did not know what the Demon Clan was planning. The only action revealing the Demon Clan’s purpose was their attempt to stop Wang Lan from participating in the provincial martial arts competition. Whether this was the Demon Clan’s primary goal or just a way to incidentally antagonize Wang Lan remained unknown.
Unconsciously, he drifted into a daze.
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s phone vibrated.
Startled awake, Wang Lan snapped his eyes open and reached for the phone on his bedside table. To his surprise, it was Xu Xiangwen calling.
"Hello, Xiangwen, what’s up?"
"Lanzi, Duan Ziqi just sneakily left his house."
"You started surveillance tonight? Didn’t you say you were going to buy a house?"
"It wasn’t much trouble. I got a room at an express hotel, just three hundred meters away—perfect for surveillance. I just saw Duan Ziqi leaving suspiciously. Lanzi, I want to follow him."
"Share your location with me. You must maintain a distance of over three hundred meters and retreat immediately if anything seems off."
"Understood."
After hanging up, Wang Lan quickly got out of bed and dressed, simultaneously calling Xu Shiyun.
"Hello... Ah..." Xu Shiyun sounded out of breath when he answered the call, but he quickly masked it.
"Xu, is there any update from the team surveilling Duan Ziqi?"
"Nope... What’s up? You sound anxious. Why aren’t you sleeping in the middle of the night? Don’t worry, I’ll inform you immediately if Duan Ziqi makes any move. Nothing else, right? If not, I’m hanging up."
"Xu, it seems you won’t be the one notifying me... I’m the one notifying you. Duan Ziqi just left his house, acting suspiciously. My friend is secretly following him, and I plan to go too."
"What? Are you sure?"
"Would I joke about something like this?"
"What’s going on with Gujian? Why hasn’t he reported that the surveillance target left?"
"Don’t alert Gujian’s team yet. I even suspect they’re under counter-surveillance. Duan Ziqi slipping away in the middle of the night means he’s either fleeing or meeting someone. Bring some people to back me up."
"Alright! Keep your work phone with you. I can locate you at any time."
Xu Shiyun swiftly rolled out of bed. "Honey, I..."
A stunningly beautiful woman with a cold demeanor sat against the headboard, clutching a snow-white pillow and glaring at Xu Shiyun. "How many times do you owe me?"
"Ten times, I guess?"
"Say that again!"
"Twenty times!"
"Go. If you don’t make them up by next week, don’t even think about leaving the house."
"You’re too kind, dear!" he said, quickly pulling open the wardrobe and getting dressed. While dressing, he dialed a number. "Louzi, gather the team. Head toward my location. Remember, this is our Dark Night Action Department’s first operation, so everyone be sharp."
"Understood!"
Wang Lan drove his rugged SUV, roaring out of the underground garage and speeding into the distance. In just twelve minutes, he arrived at the Ancient City District.
Jumping out of the car, he tapped on Xu Xiangwen’s Penguin avatar, checking the location information Xu Xiangwen had shared.
"Xiangwen, where are you now?"
"Right here." Xu Xiangwen emerged from behind a stone pillar of a shopping mall and quickly walked over to Wang Lan. "Duan Ziqi just went into Yage Garden up ahead. He’s still wandering around in the residential complex."
"Let’s go. We’ll follow him and see what he’s up to."
Meanwhile, Xu Shiyun was also speeding toward Wang Lan’s coordinates in his car, frowning deeply. He turned on the car phone.
"Hello, Captain Xu, what are your orders?"
"Are you still watching the target?"
"Yes! Target’s status is normal."
"Normal? What is the target doing?"
"The target is reading under a desk lamp. He does this every day: returns from training at eleven, studies under the lamp, and turns off the lights to sleep at one o’clock."
"Got it. Keep a close watch."
"Understood."
Hanging up the phone, Xu Shiyun’s expression was incredibly grim. He knew Wang Lan wouldn’t joke about serious matters. If Wang Lan said Duan Ziqi had disguised himself and left, then he must have. Yet, his own subordinates responsible for surveillance were still unaware, reporting everything as usual.
Are my men too incompetent, or is Wang Lan’s friend too skilled? Wait, why would Wang Lan even think to ask a friend for surveillance? Doesn’t he trust my team?
Inevitably, Xu Shiyun’s thoughts began to run wild.
Wang Lan and Xu Xiangwen arrived outside the Yage Garden residential complex, finding a spot without surveillance cameras.
"Duan Ziqi moved to the east gate and entered the property management office. If he’s in there, they have access to all the surveillance cameras in the complex. We need to approach while avoiding all camera coverage," Xu Xiangwen said gravely.
"You stay here and report the camera locations to me. My colleagues will be here later to provide backup. You stay here and meet up with them."
"But... are you sure you’ll be alright?"
"You know my strength, don’t you?"
Xu Xiangwen recalled the scene where Wang Lan, in his Phoenix form, had obliterated the Star Cloud Stage Spider King with a single punch. Right... there really wasn’t much to worry about.
Wang Lan patted Xu Xiangwen’s shoulder lightly, then his figure flashed as he jumped into the residential complex.
"There are five cameras ahead: one in the top-left corner, one three meters up on the external wall of Building 15, one on the streetlight opposite, and one hidden in the tree canopy..."
Xu Xiangwen’s voice came through the earpiece, and Wang Lan instantly located all five cameras.
Speaking of which, I also possess Pupil Skill-type Star Martial Skills now, but even though they’re both eye-based, there’s a huge difference. My eyes are only for dynamic visual capture and locking onto distant targets. The magnification is really just how my brain processes it; in essence, it’s still about locking on.
Xu Xiangwen’s eyes, besides farsight and X-ray vision, must also have the ability to categorize and lock onto targets. Otherwise, how could he have found the camera hidden in the tree canopy so precisely and quickly?
There are so many strange and varied senses in this world, leading to the evolution of numerous eye-based Star Martial Skills and Inborn Talents of the Bloodline. Xu Xiangwen’s Heavenly Eye is undoubtedly a very powerful ability among the many functional Pupil Skills.
Thanks to Xu Xiangwen’s flawless guidance, clearing all blind spots, Wang Lan silently crept to the wall outside the property management office where Duan Ziqi had entered.
"Do you know how important the provincial martial arts competition is to me? If I don’t participate, I can’t possibly get into one of the Four Great Academies! If I can’t get into one of the Four Great Academies, then the value you saw in training me will be gone! Isn’t establishing a foothold for me in the human race our mutual goal? Why are you stopping me?"
Just as Wang Lan pressed himself against the corner of the wall, Duan Ziqi’s furious voice roared from inside.
"You shouldn’t have come." After Duan Ziqi’s roar subsided, a slightly hoarse, androgynous voice replied from inside.
"You’ve said that three times now. But I need an explanation! If you don’t give me one, we’ll fight to the bitter end!"
"Fight to the bitter end?" the other party retorted mockingly. "With what? Have you forgotten something? Without my Divine Clan, you would be nothing. You’re just an orphan, abandoned at the doorstep of an orphanage like trash by your parents.
"Even though you awakened your Star Martial Warrior talent at eight, you were still nothing. It took you six years just to crawl from the initial stage to the middle stage of the Starlight realm.
"Without my grooming, you wouldn’t be the Duan Ziqi you are today. Fight to the bitter end? You’re just a dog I raised, and not the only one. If you don’t obey, I don’t mind replacing you."
The chilling aura instantly made the hair on Duan Ziqi’s back stand on end, fear flickering deep within his pupils.
Seeing the fear in Duan Ziqi, a flicker of satisfaction appeared in the speaker’s eyes. "I’ve told you, you possess infinite potential. But potential is merely potential. Until you convert that potential into actual strength, you have neither the right nor the power to resist me."
Duan Ziqi fell silent, despair etched across his face.
