"I’m fed up with struggling at the bottom! If I can’t get into one of the Four Great Academies, I’d rather die!"
"Don’t worry. You’ll definitely get into one of the Four Great Academies. In fact, I can even secure you a guaranteed admission spot. But, you have to be obedient."
"Is that why you won’t let me defeat Wang Lan? Your previous instructions were to prevent Wang Lan from participating in the provincial martial arts competition."
"No! I’m not letting you defeat Wang Lan for your own safety. That foolish plan of yours not only failed to achieve its objective but also successfully alerted the Tianjian Bureau.
"If you reveal your intent to ambush Wang Lan again, you’ll be completely exposed, and my five years of effort will be wasted. Do you understand? Although you can be disobedient at times, I’m reluctant to destroy you unless absolutely necessary."
"You think I can’t defeat Wang Lan? Or that he might even kill me?"
"Of course, you can’t defeat Wang Lan. More than one elite of my Divine Clan has already died at his hands. Also, I never expected you to use such a stupid method as framing Wang Lan. He’s a Red Captain in the Tianjian Bureau; your attempt to frame him was a meaningless act of walking into a trap."
"Ah?" Duan Ziqi let out an involuntary cry of astonishment, his eyes wide with disbelief.
He could accept Wang Lan being slightly better than him, but not *much* better. According to his superior, even ten of him combined couldn’t compare to Wang Lan.
How could he accept this?
"Impossible... right? Wang Lan is only at the Star Shine Stage."
"A person’s power isn’t just about raw strength. If strength alone determined superiority, the Divine Clan would have dominated all the realms ages ago."
Meanwhile, outside Yage Garden, seven or eight cars screeched to a halt at the entrance of the residential complex. "Wang Lan! Wang Lan—"
Xu Shiyun had made several calls to Wang Lan on the way, but they all went unanswered, giving him a bad feeling. The only consolation was that Wang Lan’s location was still clearly indicated here.
"Don’t move! There’s a camera here—" Xu Xiangwen suddenly exclaimed.
"Who’s there?" Instantly, several terrifying auras pressed down on Xu Xiangwen.
BEEP! BEEP! BEEP! The urgent blare of an alarm also sounded from the property management office.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Great Eagle
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 194: Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Great Eagle
In an instant, the woman’s face in the property office changed dramatically. "The people from the Tianjian Bureau have come? You’ve been under surveillance all along? You actually brought the Tianjian Bureau to this place?"
"I... I didn’t," Duan Ziqi panicked. He knew one thing, though: he was under surveillance. He just never reported it. He knew that once he did, he might be treated as a potential threat and dealt with.
"You deserve to die!"
Outside the wall, Wang Lan instantly activated his Phoenix form.
BOOM—
With a loud explosion, the wall burst apart, and Wang Lan’s figure appeared in the room as if crossing through space. In that same instant, the woman’s palm transformed into a bizarre blood blade, slashing towards Duan Ziqi’s throat.
Duan Ziqi, being only at the Star Cloud Stage, had no means to fight back, let alone react, when faced with the attack of an elite Demon Clan warrior at the Galaxy Stage.
CLANG—
The Ghost Wail, wreathed in flames, clashed with the Demon Clan’s blood blade. A terrifying whirlwind erupted, reducing all the furniture in the room to ash in its dreadful wake.
The powerful shockwave blasted Duan Ziqi backward, slamming him hard against the wall behind him. The load-bearing concrete wall cracked like a canyon. Duan Ziqi hung there as if embedded like a sculpture, spitting out a mouthful of blood, his face a mask of horror.
A blood-red mist, dancing like flames, swirled around Wang Lan, as if he were enwrapped in a red lotus. The terrifying pressure coalesced into a fierce wind.
Although his form seemed hazy, his face was still recognizable. Duan Ziqi identified Wang Lan at a glance, his eyes widening in shock.
In his mind, he suddenly recalled what the Serpent had said. Just a Star Shine? More than one elite warrior of the Demon Clan has already died at Wang Lan’s hands. Is this the real Wang Lan? What is my proud Innate Ability, my proud strength, in front of Wang Lan?
Just a Star Shine, but at this moment, the power Wang Lan is displaying is like a terrifying abyss cast in solid form.
BOOM— The two figures rapidly retreated. Wang Lan stood before Duan Ziqi, his eyes fixed on the elite Demon in front of him. In the blink of an eye, the Demon Clan elite transformed into an upright, monstrous creature.
It had a serpent-like head, a body resembling that of a higher-class Demon Clan member, and a pair of bat wings on its back. This demonic figure challenged my understanding of biological evolution. I even began to suspect that the so-called Demon Clan might be creatures from a 2D world that had broken through dimensional barriers.
"Wang Lan! You truly are our greatest obstacle. We should have killed you sooner!"
"It’s not too late for you to kill me now!" As his words fell, Wang Lan’s body transformed into a streak of light, charging towards the Serpent. The Flame Sword became a bolt of purple lightning, but it struck nothing but air.
So fast!
Wang Lan’s heart clenched. In his panic, he activated his dynamic vision to capture everything around him.
A shadow flashed behind his head. The peripheral glow of his golden right eye instantly locked onto it. After activating his Phoenix form, his body’s reaction speed was more than ten times faster than before, and the power of his Flame Sword reached the terrifying level of the Galaxy Stage.
He whipped his sword back, slashing at the Serpent’s throat the instant its sneak attack reached his back. The Serpent’s speed exceeded Wang Lan’s imagination; even with his Phoenix form active, his dynamic vision could barely track it. This strike was partly a gamble, but Wang Lan had gambled correctly.
The Serpent was aghast.
He can keep up with my speed? And even counterattack?
The Serpent had done its homework on Wang Lan. This man had caused disastrous losses for the Divine Clan’s Suzhou City infiltration team.
Initially, they thought Wang Lan was just lucky and lacked real strength, even considering assassinating him directly. But after an elite team of three was annihilated, with Wang Lan single-handedly killing their leader, the Demon Clan had to re-evaluate his strength.
Although the Serpent was an elite of the Demon Clan, it specialized in speed. It was like the difference between a motorcycle and an off-road vehicle: both could race, and the motorcycle might be more agile, but in a head-on collision, the motorcycle would be smashed to pieces.
However, during our brief clash, Wang Lan’s speed was no less than mine. That means his strength must be greater than mine!
As this thought settled, WHOOSH—the Serpent instantly shot out the window, spread its wings, and soared into the night sky.
This scene stunned Wang Lan, and Duan Ziqi even more so.
The formidable Serpent, as strong as a top human expert, is also fleeing in terror?
Duan Ziqi thought.
But the astonishment didn’t last. Wang Lan’s figure shot through the opening in the wall in pursuit.
In the sky, the Serpent, like a magnificent roc soaring ninety thousand li, rushed towards the stars. In an era where flying Star Martial Warriors were rare, the ability to fly was an unparalleled advantage. Its wings beat desperately.
Wang Lan instantly engaged his dynamic vision, locking onto the Serpent in the night sky.
This lock wasn’t merely a gaze; it felt as if it were projected into reality. The frantically fleeing Serpent clearly felt an invisible rope tugging at it from behind.
Wang Lan raised his hand, flames surging around him.
A pair of phoenix-colored wings unfolded with a clear cry, and the complete phantom of a phoenix emerged on Wang Lan’s back. Facing the sky, he lifted his finger.
WHOOSH—
An arrow, like Anubis’s spear, shot from Wang Lan’s fingertips.
In the sky, the Serpent’s face instantly filled with terror. An intense sense of crisis washed over it. It hurriedly turned to look behind, where an arrow radiating terrifying killing intent was already upon it.
In that moment, the Serpent had a sudden, desperate epiphany.
I shouldn’t have run, much less towards the sky! Wang Lan might be stronger, but I wasn’t without hope of escape.
There are so many buildings on the ground for cover, so many bushes, ponds, and obstacles to hide me. What the hell was I thinking, running into the sky?
Even going underground would have been better than ascending into the sky.
Flying into the sky means a clear field of view, and Wang Lan is an archer... Damn it... Was I just volunteering to be target practice?
But at this moment, all regret was too late. The instant of enlightenment was also the instant the Serpent was struck by the Purple Flame Arrow. Launched in Phoenix form, the Purple Flame Arrow was so terrifying that even the Tianjian Bureau, twenty kilometers away, sensed the dreadful might of that cloud-piercing projectile.
BOOM—
A silvery wave of light flashed across the sky, sending shockwaves rippling outward. In an instant, a spectacular firework display exploded hundreds of meters in the air. The dazzling colors enveloped the night sky above the Ancient City District.
The battle seemed to last a long time, but in reality, it was over in just a dozen seconds. Xu Shiyun and his brothers had only just arrived at the Yage Community when they saw Wang Lan standing alone where the lights were sparse, the phantom of a phoenix behind him, its head thrown back as if crying out to the moonlit sky.
An arrow had shot into the clouds. In the pitch-black night, nothing had been clear. Then, fireworks blossomed, beautifying the entire night.
"Cross-level kill achieved. Reward: 3,000 experience points, 50 skill points."
"High-level Demon Clan spy case cracked. Reward: 8,000 experience points, 500 skill points."
Xu Shiyun and the entire Dark Night Action Team froze in their tracks.
The Dark Night Action Team members, all dressed in black cloaks and wearing masks, still exuded an air of mystery despite their jaws dropping as they stared at the sky.
Xu Shiyun removed his mask and slowly approached Wang Lan from behind. "Is it over? Are you done?"
"Xu, was that firework display just now pretty?"
"That... what was that just now?"
"Duan Ziqi’s handler, an elite Demon Clan spy. Very fast, very strong. If we had really fought, I wouldn’t have stood a chance."
"And then?"
"I turned him into fireworks with one arrow. He’s dead."
"..."
Xu Shiyun’s heart twinged. He felt there was something wrong with Wang Lan’s logic.
Hmm, a strong Demon Clan spy that you’d have no confidence against in a real fight? And then you killed him with a single arrow?
"From your tone, I can’t detect any hint that he was strong."
"Duan Ziqi is inside. If he isn’t dead by now, then he probably hasn’t had any restrictive ban placed on him."
Xu Shiyun gestured lightly. "Take him away!"
Wang Lan turned, looking at Xu Shiyun’s attire and the mysterious, cloaked-and-masked figures behind him.
"From the Dark Night Action Department, huh? So you really were poached."
"Not poached. I just have two jobs and two salaries. Anyway, let’s not talk about that. Let’s go, time to report back."
"Captain—"
Suddenly, two figures ran over from a distance. As they approached, Xu Shiyun’s expression darkened immediately.
"Gujian, you finally made it..."
"Captain, we... we messed up. We... lost track of Duan Ziqi."
"Lost track? How did you lose him?"
"He used a silhouette technique to create a string of shadow figures. Then he simulated one sitting before a table lamp, reading. He did this every day, so we didn’t suspect anything. Today, the lights suddenly went out at 1:30 AM, but his shadow was still there, reading... That’s when we realized what you meant when you called earlier to ask about the situation."
"Impressive... Only figuring it out now, are you? Go back and write me a self-criticism report." Xu Shiyun snorted coldly, pushing Duan Ziqi’s head down as he guided him into the car. Suddenly, Xu Shiyun turned to Xu Xiangwen in the front seat. "Kid, I know you. Wang Lan’s good brother, Xu Xiangwen."
"Sir!"
"No need to be so formal. You’re Wang Lan’s brother, so you can call me Xu too. Your surveillance talent is quite strong, isn’t it? Others have to deduce things from various signs, but you can directly see what the target is doing."
"Just an Innate Ability, nothing special."
"Are you interested in joining the Tianjian Bureau?"
Hearing Xu Shiyun’s words, Xu Xiangwen was momentarily stunned, but then a joyful smile spread across his face. "Of course! Xu, can you make an exception for me to join?"
"With your surveillance talent, recruiting you on an exceptional basis is no problem. Just like Wang Lan. Last year, he had just become a Star Martial Warrior but was able to enter the Tianjian Bureau directly. The Tianjian Bureau doesn’t look at seniority, only strength."
"Great!"
"Alright then. I’ll write you a recommendation letter later. It’d be best if Wang Lan could write one too. Recommendations from two Red Robes like us should be enough. Just so we’re clear, once you join the Tianjian Bureau, you’ll be under my..."
"Wait!" Wang Lan suddenly interrupted. "Xu, Xiangwen still has college to attend. Let’s talk about his affiliation after he graduates. That’s four years from now."
"Ah... right, that’s true. It’s only a few months until you all head off to college anyway."

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Actually Trying to Assassinate Eld Di
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 195: Actually Trying to Assassinate Eld Di
It was already three o’clock in the morning, but the office building of the Tianjian Bureau was still brightly lit. Not only had Wang Qianfeng returned, but Lu Zhao had also come back to the bureau after receiving the news.
In the senior meeting room on the seventh floor, Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun entered and saluted Lu Zhao, Wang Qianfeng, and He MingXue.
"Wang Lan, explain what happened with the sudden operation tonight," Wang Qianfeng asked in a low voice.
"Reporting to Director Wang and Chief Lu, it all started with the murder of a student from Suzhou No.1 Middle School. The student was killed, and the murderer seemed to intentionally or unintentionally try to pin the blame on me, preventing me from participating in this year’s provincial martial arts competition. This raised my vigilance.
Afterward, Captain Xu Shiyun discovered that Xu Donghai’s murder, and framing me for it, was merely incidental; their real goal seemed to be finding something. I later found out they were looking for the Demonic Transformation Potion."
"Demonic Transformation Potion? Has it appeared again?" Lu Zhao’s face immediately turned serious.
"Xu Donghai stole the Demonic Transformation Potion from another classmate, Duan Ziqi, and took it home. However, he never expected that because the potion contained biological genes, a spirit dog would steal it and bury it in the vegetable garden. So, in the end, Xu Donghai was killed, his parents were also murdered, and the killer didn’t recover the Demonic Transformation Potion.
After obtaining the Demonic Transformation Potion, I immediately became vigilant and traced the clues to the suspect: Duan Ziqi, whom I mentioned earlier.
Duan Ziqi is a human of extraordinary talent but comes from a poor background. As an orphan, he felt little sense of belonging to humanity or the human race, so a little enticement was all it took for him to betray humankind.
The Demonic Transformation Potion was his.
Later, we placed Duan Ziqi under surveillance. Tonight, we discovered him sneaking out of his house to meet his handler.
Unfortunately, a moment of carelessness allowed Duan Ziqi’s handler to become alert. According to Duan Ziqi’s confession, his handler’s codename is Viper, an elite spy who had been hiding in Suzhou City for twenty years. I killed Viper on the spot as he tried to escape."
Upon hearing Wang Lan’s words, Xu Shiyun’s mouth twitched involuntarily.
That was an elite Demon Clan spy, and he just casually says he killed him on the spot? Seriously?
"Were Duan Ziqi and the Demon Clan spy you killed in contact via a direct line only? Did they not have any other cells or intermediary contacts?"
"Not sure, Duan Ziqi’s interrogation hasn’t begun yet."
"Xu Shiyun," Wang Qianfeng suddenly said, his face stern, "Maximizing our operational gains is the consistent principle of our intelligence department. Wang Lan is still young and might not understand, but Xu Shiyun, surely you do? The day before yesterday, my instructions were for you to observe, follow discreetly, and investigate anyone who had contact with Duan Ziqi.
Duan Ziqi sneaked out for the very first time, and you were already eager to make an arrest? Couldn’t you have followed him discreetly and then covertly monitored his handler to further expand our gains?"
"Ah, Feng, don’t blame them yet," Lu Zhao quickly interjected. "They unearthed this lead themselves. To follow a murder case to this point, they must have exercised considerable restraint and tracked diligently. I believe they wouldn’t have made arrests if it wasn’t absolutely necessary."
"Xu Shiyun, tell me, what happened?"
"Yes, sir!" Xu Shiyun snapped to attention and saluted. "Chief, Director, our men didn’t track Duan Ziqi sneaking away tonight. It was Xu Xiangwen, Wang Lan’s classmate, who did.
Xu Xiangwen called Wang Lan, and Wang Lan decided to investigate personally before calling me. I didn’t go there to make an arrest, but to provide support for Wang Lan, just in case.
If Wang Lan could have withdrawn safely, we would have also retreated quietly. But unexpectedly, the target was extremely alert. His cover was a property manager at Yage Garden, and he had access to the entire Yage Community’s surveillance system to monitor for any slight disturbance.
We were exposed upon arriving at the Yage District. The target became alert, and Wang Lan was forced to act. The target was an elite Demon Clan spy, likely at the Galaxy Stage. If it weren’t for Wang Lan, we probably wouldn’t have been able to apprehend him."
"That’s still a mistake," Wang Qianfeng said, although his tone was not as stern as before.
Capturing an elite Demon Clan spy pleased Wang Qianfeng. However, apprehending just one spy left him somewhat unsatisfied.
Even if it couldn’t be like the New Year’s haul, where pulling out one radish brought a load of mud with it, shouldn’t it at least be like that first time when an entire spy cell was unearthed? Right?
If Xu Shiyun knew Wang Qianfeng’s thoughts, she would undoubtedly offer a candid assessment: Director Wang, you’ve always worried Wang Lan would get carried away. Turns out, you’re the one who’s really getting carried away. In any other city, catching even a low-level Demon Clan operative would be cause for celebration with gongs and drums, and they’d be reporting it to the higher-ups for commendation multiple times over. But you? You kill an elite Demon Clan spy and you’re still not satisfied? You want an entire elite Demon Clan spy cell? You want results like those from New Year’s? If we had successes like New Year’s several times a year, all Demon Clan spies worldwide would be wiped out in less than three years. Director Wang, where’s your rationality? Can’t you be a bit more realistic?
"Feng, MingXue, interrogate Duan Ziqi immediately. Extract the intelligence as quickly as possible," Lu Zhao instructed.
"Yes!"
「Tianjian Bureau Interrogation Room」
In the interrogation room of the Tianjian Bureau, Duan Ziqi sat emotionlessly, restrained in a chair, his gaze sweeping over Zhang Yeqiu and Zhang Xiaoxue before him. He seemed not to comprehend the gravity of his situation, instead focusing intently on distinguishing the subtle differences in the twin sisters’ faces.
Although their differences were immediately evident to a discerning eye, it wasn’t in their physical features but in their demeanor.
"Duan Ziqi, when did you start colluding with the Demon Clan?"
"When? Let me think... probably... about five or six years ago. I think it was right after finishing my first year of junior high... Yes, that’s when."
"Why did you betray humanity?"
"Betray? Did I swear an oath to serve humanity?"
"You’re human. Isn’t that oath implied?"
"Why is it that you only call me your kin, your compatriot, when you need something from me or when you’re accusing me? When I needed compatriots, when I needed the nation, where were you? Where were you when I was starving? When I was bullied by my own kind, did anyone step forward and tell them we were compatriots?
I awakened my talent as a Star Martial Warrior at the age of eight—so amazing, so outstanding. Yet, I received no cultivation, no access to the benefits I deserved. For five whole years, I was stuck, making no progress. It was Viper who gave me the chance to grow. I worked for him, he paid me. It’s as simple as that."
"You still show no remorse even now? It seems you’re truly beyond saving." Zhang Yeqiu sighed and shook his head.
"As if I’d be absolved of my crimes if I broke down now, weeping and repenting my regrets. Every time I see criminals being sentenced on the news, it disgusts me.
They’re all crying and wailing about wanting to turn over a new leaf—what nonsense! If they were truly capable of reform, they wouldn’t have committed those acts in the first place. Since they did it, they should stand tall and face the execution."
"Then you shall be next! I’m glad to see you have such backbone. Since that’s the case..."
"Wait!" Duan Ziqi suddenly cut in.
"Don’t turn into one of those disgusting people you talk about. If you have backbone, be tough until the end," Zhang Xiaoxue said coldly, arms folded.
"I have the information you want."
"What information?"
"Promise to let me go and not to pursue matters further, and I’ll tell you what I know. My information is extremely valuable. If the Demon Clan succeeds, the entire Jade Country will be turned upside down. I can leave the Jade Country and guarantee that I will never set foot here again in my life."
"You wish."
"My information is worth that price."
Zhang Xiaoxue, who had been silent, suddenly raised her hand and snapped her fingers. "Asking you any more questions is a waste of time. Colonel Wu, he’s all yours."
The side door opened, and Wu Chao, dressed in a black military uniform, entered. Duan Ziqi quickly turned his head to look, and the moment he saw Wu Chao, a wave of terror rose in his heart.
Wu Chao had a refined appearance and wore gold-rimmed glasses. But in Duan Ziqi’s eyes, he was the epitome of a cultured villain. Especially after years spent with Viper, Duan Ziqi had the unsettling feeling that this man might rip off his disguise at any moment and transform into a venomous serpent.
"Wh-what are you going to do?" Duan Ziqi struggled fiercely as Wu Chao slowly approached. But with his Star Power sealed and his limbs restrained, he could only watch in terror as Wu Chao’s hand reached out, covering his forehead like a demonic claw.
In the next room, through the one-way glass, Wang Lan curiously turned his head to look.
Xu Shiyun, arms crossed, sneered. "Spirit Engraving. It’s a pure application of spiritual power. It can imprint memories, Star Martial Skills, and so on. With Spirit Engraving, anything in your mind, anything you remember, can be perfectly etched out. The only side effect is some potential brain damage.
For scum like him, there’s no need for idle chatter. Just use Spirit Engraving and get it over with."
"Spirit Engraving?" Wang Lan suddenly recalled Wang Qianfeng and He MingXue touching his forehead and imprinting a Star Martial Skill directly into his mind.
"Spirit Engraving is a compulsory course at university. You can graduate once you’re able to imprint your own Star Martial Skills into someone else’s mind.
Of course, if you wish to specialize further, you could become like Colonel Wu—capable of extracting others’ memories and recording them onto a Soul Bead. However, that’s an advanced application of Spirit Engraving and requires considerable talent."
As they spoke, Duan Ziqi, in the adjacent room, let out a bloodcurdling howl. Star Power surged around Wu Chao as he pressed one hand to Duan Ziqi’s head and held a primary Soul Bead in the other, Star Power swirling within it.
When Wu Chao removed his hand from Duan Ziqi’s forehead, an inscription resembling the character for ’seal’ had appeared on the Soul Bead in his hand.
"Spirit Engraving complete. Hand this over to the evidence department for archiving," Wu Chao said, picking up a towel to wipe his hands. "Let’s go report to the Chief."
In the adjoining room, Lu Zhao and Wang Qianfeng were seated on the sofa; presumably He MingXue was with them, as the three leaders watched the interrogation. The door soon opened, and Wu Chao entered, snapping to attention and saluting Lu Zhao.
"Chief, Duan Ziqi indeed possesses a significant amount of intelligence. The most crucial piece is that the Demon Clan plans to assassinate Eld Di."

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Silenced
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 196: Silenced
"What? An assassination attempt on Eld Di?"
Upon hearing this sudden and alarming intelligence, Lu Zhao’s expression was not one of anger, nor shock, but rather confusion and a touch of helplessness.
"Wu Chao, are you certain it’s an assassination attempt on Eld Di and not some kind of joke?"
"The information obtained from Duan Ziqi’s memory is indeed this. Of course, we can’t rule out the possibility that Duan Ziqi is just a peripheral member of the Demon Clan’s spy group and that all the information he has is false. However, this intelligence was something he investigated on his own; it wasn’t provided to him by Demon Clan spies."
"Director, you... seem to not quite believe it?" Wang Qianfeng asked, looking at Lu Zhao with confusion. "Considering the Demon Clan doesn’t want Wang Lan to participate in the provincial martial arts competition, it’s highly likely that Duan Ziqi’s information is true. After all, we also just received news that Eld Di will personally attend the finals of the provincial martial arts competition in Jiang Province. Assassinating Eld Di while he’s in Jiang Province is entirely plausible."
"Eld Di has always been in Modu City, so why haven’t they assassinated him there? If the Demon Clan wanted to assassinate Eld Di, why would they wait until he left Modu City before acting?"
"Isn’t it because the Demon Clan lacks the strength...?" He MingXue scoffed dismissively. "Eld Di is as secure as a fortress in Modu City. Even if the Demon Clan wanted to assassinate him, they would need the capability to do so."
"And Eld Di becomes vulnerable once he arrives in Jiang Province? What makes the Demon Clan so confident they can assassinate Eld Di?" Lu Zhao asked coldly, tapping his fingers on the table.
"First, Eld Di will personally attend the finals of the provincial martial arts competition in Jiang Province. However, the host city hasn’t been determined yet, though it’s most likely Salt City. If that’s the case, what’s he doing messing around in Suzhou City?
Second, I refuse to believe that after a year of repeated setbacks in Suzhou City, the Demon Clan could still organize an assassination attempt on Eld Di. If they had that capability, my Tianjian Bureau would have been wiped out by now.
Wu Chao, is there any other intelligence besides this?"
"Yes. According to Duan Ziqi, he and his handler, ’Poison Snake,’ were indeed an independent cell. Such cells exist all over the country." As Wu Chao spoke, his expression turned exceedingly grim.
"This plan was initiated twelve years ago and is codenamed ’Infiltration.’ It involves the Demon Clan identifying children from the lower echelons of Jade Country who possess good talent, then brainwashing and training them. Once they grow up, they are to enter various sectors within our Jade Country and act as ’termites’ to undermine it from within.
Infiltration: to destroy from the inside, achieving the objective of collapsing the target.
Duan Ziqi was discovered by his superior, Poison Snake, five years ago. For all these years, Poison Snake and Duan Ziqi maintained single-line contact."
"A plan that’s been in action for twelve years?" This intelligence caused Lu Zhao’s expression to darken instantly. If the news about assassinating Eld Di seemed far-fetched to him, then this Infiltration plan was a slow-acting poison. Silently infiltrating, by the time it’s discovered, the damage would be irreparable, like a body riddled with sores.
"How ruthless! Does Duan Ziqi know the names of other members involved in the Infiltration plan?"
"He doesn’t. From Duan Ziqi’s memory, I saw that these ’pawns’ of the Infiltration plan are all independent. They have no contact with each other; no one knows anyone else. The only complete list is probably kept within the Demon Clan’s headquarters, making it nearly impossible to obtain."
"This intelligence must be reported to the Ministry of Defense immediately. A thorough nationwide investigation is imperative. Is there anything else?"
"One more thing. Over the past five years, Duan Ziqi had also been secretly investigating Poison Snake. Perhaps Poison Snake’s brainwashing of Duan Ziqi wasn’t thorough enough over these years. He identified twelve traitors. These individuals outwardly maintain their own careers, but secretly, they have been funneling intelligence to the Demon Clan. I’ve recorded the identities of these twelve traitors."
"Excellent! Strike while the iron is hot. Let’s eliminate these twelve traitors right now," Xu Shiyun said with an invigorated smile.
Although his impulsive actions had earned him a verbal reprimand earlier, he couldn’t really be blamed for the circumstances at that time, could he? Moreover, even though alerting the enemy prematurely had prevented them from maximizing their gains, the wealth of intelligence obtained from Duan Ziqi was enough to ensure Xu Shiyun’s contributions were firmly recorded. This time, while the primary credit might still go to Wang Lan, Xu Shiyun had been involved from start to finish; he wasn’t just an idle bystander. Imagining himself in the near future, donning a black military uniform with the insignia of a field officer, the corners of his mouth unconsciously stretched into a wide grin.
"Xu Shiyun, why are you grinning like a split gourd? Thrilled, are you? Ready to throw all caution to the wind at the mere sight of potential merits?" Wang Qianfeng couldn’t help but berate him.
"Wang Lan, what are your thoughts?"
"Regarding the first piece of intelligence, the assassination of Eld Di, I think it might actually be genuine," Wang Lan said hesitantly, his brow furrowed.
"Oh? What makes you think so?" Lu Zhao asked gravely, his frown deepening. This wasn’t Lu Zhao disagreeing with Wang Lan, but rather taking his input very seriously. Initially, Lu Zhao hadn’t paid much heed to the intelligence about the Demon Clan’s intent to assassinate Eld Di. To put it bluntly, when did the Demon Clan *not* want to assassinate Eld Di? Forget Eld Di; the Demon Clan probably dreamed of stewing all Five Elders in one pot. But the Five Elders had stood firm at the pinnacle of Jade Country’s Star Martial Art world for decades, like five great monuments guiding the Star Martial Warriors forward, never once harmed by the Demon Clan. Lu Zhao didn’t doubt the Demon Clan’s *desire* to assassinate Eld Di; he doubted their *ability* to do so. However, upon hearing Wang Lan’s words, Lu Zhao’s expression immediately grew solemn.
"Director, Deputy Directors, do you recall the bank robbery by the living dead we encountered in early February?" Wang Lan’s question instantly caused Lu Zhao’s expression to change dramatically.
"Wang Mingling!"
"Director, for a dangerous individual like Wang Mingling, I simply can’t fathom why he would suddenly return to Jade Country. His return means he would face being hunted and cornered by Jade Country’s forces. Without a compelling reason, he wouldn’t come back just for a vacation. And to hire an assassin of Wang Mingling’s caliber, the client would have to be at least a national dignitary, wouldn’t they? Eld Di seems to fit that description perfectly."
The office fell into an unusual silence. After a long moment, Lu Zhao slowly exhaled a plume of smoke.
"Although there’s no evidence proving Wang Mingling is colluding with the Demon Clan, your conjecture is highly plausible. Wang Mingling may have surfaced in Suzhou City, but that doesn’t necessarily mean he returned *to* Suzhou City; he might have returned to Jiang Province. And there aren’t many targets in Jiang Province worthy of Wang Mingling’s attention..."
"Anything else?" Wang Qianfeng asked again.
"There’s also the matter of those twelve traitors," Wang Lan said, his fingers tapping lightly. "Poison Snake and Duan Ziqi’s mission was the Infiltration plan. From this, we can deduce that even if Poison Snake was tasked with gathering intelligence, he definitely wouldn’t have handled it all himself. He couldn’t manage intelligence from twelve traitors alone, could he? It’s likely there’s another spy cell supporting him."
"Mm... very plausible."
"The twelve traitors certainly deserve death, but the Demon Clan spies behind them are the real priority. Poison Snake was killed because Duan Ziqi was exposed. I believe the Demon Clan won’t abandon these twelve traitors. After some time, they will undoubtedly try to take over Poison Snake’s network and re-establish contact with these individuals."
"Feng, Wang Lan’s ideas are very much in line with your usual style," Lu Zhao remarked with a light chuckle.
"Those of us in intelligence work must always strive to maximize the value of the information we gather."
"Alright, everyone’s been working all night. Keep Duan Ziqi under strict guard. The rest of you, go home and get some rest. You’re all exhausted."
"Yes, sir!"
「」
It was already four o’clock in the morning when they left the Tianjian Bureau. In early April, it was still pitch black at that hour. Wang Lan and Xu Xiangwen walked out of the Tianjian Bureau together. On the way back, Xu Xiangwen was still buzzing with excitement.
"Did the Director talk to you?"
"He did! ’If the youth are strong, the country is strong. If the youth are wise, the country is wise. Young heroes, heroic youth, may you live up to the nation’s hopes and become its pillars...’"
Looking at Xu Xiangwen’s elated expression, Wang Lan felt the corner of his mouth twitch. "The Director is a master at firing people up; his words go straight to the soul. So, he gave you a non-permanent position, and you’re already raring to sacrifice yourself for the country?"
"Can’t you phrase things more pleasantly? A temporary position is still temporary, but it depends on who you’re working for! Besides, who doesn’t start in a non-permanent role before becoming an official employee? By the time I graduate from university, I should be able to secure a permanent position."
Not me,
Wang Lan thought, deciding not to provoke the poor kid any further.
「」
After being dropped off at home, he quickly washed up and went to sleep. The city selections had concluded, and the official provincial martial arts competition was scheduled for May 15th. Looking at the calendar, this semester seemed rather short. School had started in February, the provincial martial arts competition was on May 15th, and then the college entrance exams were in early June, from the 5th to the 7th.
He slept so soundly that if it hadn’t been for a phone call, Wang Lan had no idea how much longer he would have continued sleeping. Awakened by the ringing, his head felt groggy. He blearily opened his eyes to check the caller ID.
Instantly, he was wide awake.
"Hello, Director Wang!"
"Come to the bureau. Now."
"Huh? Did something happen...?"
BEEP—BEEP—
The line went dead.
He’d hung up so abruptly? Only then did Wang Lan realize it was already two o’clock in the morning. He had slept for a full twenty-two hours.
Without a moment’s hesitation, Wang Lan shot up, dressed, splashed water on his face, and sped out of the underground garage in his SUV, racing towards the Tianjian Bureau.
「」
Arriving at the Tianjian Bureau, Wang Lan immediately sensed that the atmosphere was off. At the entrance stood two rows of black-clad, masked individuals from the Dark Night Action Department. They were arranged in a V-formation. Although their faces were hidden, the chilling hostility in their eyes, visible through the masks, was palpable.
Just as he parked, another SUV screeched to a halt beside him, executing an impressive drift. A solemn-faced Xu Shiyun stepped out and gave Wang Lan a grim nod upon seeing him.
"Brother Xu, what’s happened? This deployment feels wrong. Don’t tell me the Demon Clan has attacked the Tianjian Bureau?"
"I don’t know, but it’s definitely something serious."
Side by side, they walked into the Tianjian Bureau. Personnel from the Dark Night Action Department guarded every floor. This sight made Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun’s hearts pound in their chests once more.
Upon reaching the fifth floor, they passed by the guards from the Shadow Guard Office. The guards stood like statues, exuding a powerful aura, yet they did not stop Wang Lan or Xu Shiyun. No searches, no interrogations—this silence only deepened Xu Shiyun’s apprehension about what could have possibly occurred.
TAP TAP TAP! "Reporting."
"Come in."
Pushing open the door, they found Lu Zhao and the others already seated in Wang Qianfeng’s office.
"You’re here?" Lu Zhao greeted them.
"Just half an hour ago, Duan Ziqi was silenced," Wang Qianfeng said, his voice heavy as he looked up at Wang Lan and Xu Shiyun.

chapters.title: Chapter 197 New Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 197 New Plan
"Silenced? Where was he sent to be silenced?" Xu Shiyun asked instinctively. As for being silenced within the Tianjian Bureau, Xu Shiyun didn’t even dare to contemplate it.
In the Tianjian Bureau, with such strict defenses, how could someone be silenced?
But Wang Lan instantly associated this with the security situation at the Tianjian Bureau today, and her heart skipped a beat.
"There was no need to send him anywhere; it happened right here at the Tianjian Bureau."
Saying this, Wang Qianfeng turned on the TV in front of him. On the TV screen was the cell where Duan Ziqi was held. Outside the cell, three brothers were patrolling, while Duan Ziqi sat crouched in a corner of the cage, hugging his legs.
Suddenly, the scene on the screen changed, displaying the red hues of infrared detection. "The killer cut the power; the backup power supply would activate five seconds after the outage. During that time, the camera’s reserve power would trigger the infrared sensing device," Wang Qianfeng explained.
As he spoke, a figure indeed appeared on the screen. The figure moved at an incredible speed, appearing instantaneously. With crossed hands, the assailant decapitated one of the guards with a single strike and then immediately attacked the other two brothers.
The time on the camera display flashed rapidly. In an instant, all three brothers were killed on the spot. At that moment, four seconds had passed on the camera’s display. In the final second, the killer threw the knife at Duan Ziqi.
The power restarted, and the image on the camera became clear again.
But the moment the image lit up, only the bodies of the three fallen brothers were visible; the killer had already vanished.
"An inside job! It has to be an insider," Xu Shiyun declared, his face grim.
"Ever since Chang Yu suddenly received that warning call, we’ve suspected an insider lurking among us. We’ve conducted several internal screenings but have never found them. This is... the consequence of negligence," Lu Zhao said calmly, lightly tapping the table.
"Director, fortunately, we had already used the Spiritual Engraving on Duan Ziqi. There’s nothing left to dig up from him. So, the loss isn’t great for us, but for the Demon Clan, they might have just exposed a spy," He MingXue quickly offered.
"Do I need your consolation? Where are the results I want? What about the preliminary investigation results?"
He MingXue’s expression turned somber. "Director, we’re working hard on the investigation. I believe we will have results soon."
"Soon? Do I not know your capabilities? Unless that insider made no mistakes at all, you couldn’t have screened twice without finding a suspect. If you haven’t found them, it means the insider is indeed flawless. If we can’t find them now, the result will be the same tomorrow or the day after. Currently, the Tianjian Bureau is uneasy because of this insider. Aside from those on the battlefield, no one else is above suspicion. Duan Ziqi may not be valuable now, but he was silenced by a Demon Clan spy within the Tianjian Bureau itself, under heavy guard! I simply cannot swallow this affront."
"That... Director," Wang Lan suddenly stepped forward, "perhaps Duan Ziqi wasn’t valuable before, but now... he might still have some value left to us."
"The man is already dead! What value could he possibly have?" Lu Zhao countered. If anyone else had said that, Lu Zhao would have already lashed out. After the turmoil last night, Lu Zhao was filled with anger. At this moment, he was like a powder keg, ready to explode at the slightest touch.
"Director, sometimes, a dead man’s value exceeds that of a living one. Director, everyone, may I ask who else has seen the murderer?"
"If someone had seen the murderer, why would we still need to investigate? It’s precisely because those who saw the murderer are dead that we need to investigate!" He MingXue retorted. He was also seething but didn’t dare lash out at Lu Zhao or Wang Qianfeng.
But he wouldn’t hold back against Wang Lan, would he?
"Director He, two of our brothers were decapitated. The Demon Clan wouldn’t believe they’re still alive. But Duan Ziqi appears unscathed. It’s certainly possible he’s still alive."
"Are you suggesting... we falsely claim that Duan Ziqi is still alive to lure the insider into making another move? No, that’s not right. The knife hit his heart; he couldn’t be deader."
"As long as the lie is convincing enough, you can pass off the fake as real."
"Wang Lan, tell us your plan in detail."
"First, I need to confirm whether the news of Duan Ziqi’s Spiritual Engraving has been kept confidential, and whether there’s a possibility that the insider knows about it."
"The fact that Duan Ziqi underwent Spiritual Engraving is top secret. Unless one of the few people who interrogated him yesterday is the mole, it’s unlikely the mole knows."
"That makes it easier. Don’t we have intelligence on those twelve traitors? We can use that information too. Duan Ziqi’s heart was pierced and destroyed. We can even say it more gravely: Duan Ziqi’s heart was completely shattered. But he has a strong life force; he didn’t die on the spot. And doesn’t the Tianjian Bureau still have me?"
"Are you suggesting... you arrived when Duan Ziqi was still alive, so you used your Medical Star Martial Technique to save him?"
"No, if we say that, the insider definitely wouldn’t take the risk. The insider will only decide to take a gamble when the intelligence is uncertain, when both good and bad outcomes are possible," Wang Lan said confidently.
"We must give the mole some time—not too long and not too short. Three to five days would be ideal. While we’re keeping Duan Ziqi alive, his situation is very dangerous. With his heart shattered, my medical skills can’t regenerate an organ. Therefore, we need to clone a heart. I recall the National Defense Hospital conducts research in that area, right?"
"You want to cast the net at the National Defense Hospital? Why not at the Tianjian Bureau?" He MingXue asked, puzzled.
"MingXue, if it were at the Tianjian Bureau, would the mole dare to make a move? After this recent attack, the bureau will be on absolute lockdown. The mole wouldn’t dare to act again for a while, let alone attempt an escape. If we set it up at the hospital, the mole might be a bit bolder. That way, we can assign suspects from our list to guard the hospital," Lu Zhao responded quickly.
"But how do we prompt the mole to act hastily?"
"That’s where Colonel Wu comes in. While we keep Duan Ziqi alive by a thread, we’ll have Colonel Wu probe his memories. However, because Duan Ziqi’s injuries are so severe, and to ensure his brain isn’t destroyed, we can only probe a tiny bit each day. The twelve traitors will serve perfectly as bait for this operation."
"We’re not fishing for Demon Clan spies anymore?" Xu Shiyun asked on a whim, then laughed at her own question. Compared to Demon Clan spies, the mole hidden within the Tianjian Bureau was a far more critical concern.
"Feng, MingXue, do you have any additions to Wang Lan’s plan?"
Wang Qianfeng contemplated for a long moment, then looked up and shook his head. "No additions. We can proceed according to plan."
"I don’t have anything either. I’ll go make arrangements right away. Wang Lan, starting now, we’ll transfer you to the National Defense Hospital. I’ll request a leave of absence for you from your school."
"Um... Director, prepare some Soul Beads. It takes twenty-four-hour support to keep Duan Ziqi alive; we can’t afford to run short on Soul Beads."
"Alright, that request shouldn’t be an issue."
"Wang Lan, even if the Soul Beads being brought in are just props and must be returned, don’t get any ideas," Wang Qianfeng stood up and solemnly warned.
"Director Wang, do I look like that kind of person?"
"Be more confident. Get rid of the ’look like’!"
「WEE-OO WEE-OO WEE-OO—」
The sound of sirens tore through the night sky. An ambulance, escorted by a dozen military vehicles with black license plates, mysteriously entered the National Defense Hospital. Shortly thereafter, the hospital’s inpatient department cordoned off a separate small building. It was heavily guarded by the Tianjian Bureau.
「At dawn.」
The Tianjian Bureau’s second wave of deployment was in position. Elite teams from the Action Department, Intelligence Department, and Law Enforcement Department took turns guarding the small building.
The atmosphere at the National Defense Hospital suddenly grew tense. Patients visiting the hospital buzzed with curiosity. Despite all the speculation, no one reached any solid conclusions, merely assuming that a very important person must be staying in that building.
「By the flowerbeds outside the isolated ward building.」
Ma Weidong and Lige stood together, taking deep drags from their cigarettes.
"What’s going on? I was in the middle of a field operation, and suddenly I’m recalled?" Ma Weidong complained, tossing his cigarette butt into a designated bin in the smoking area.
"Can’t be helped. There aren’t many brothers in the bureau available to use," Lige said softly, one hand fiddling with his collar as he tilted his head and exhaled a plume of smoke.
"Not many available? What do you mean? Is there a major operation? No, that can’t be right. Why wasn’t I informed?"
"You haven’t heard about the mole in the bureau?"
"I haven’t! I was only called back two hours ago. What’s this about a mole?" Ma Weidong said in disbelief. "After my seven-day hospital stay, I was immediately sent out on a field operation. It’s been two months since I was last in Suzhou City. I came back the day before yesterday for a handover and left again yesterday. A mole? What’s going on?"
Lige’s expression turned somber. Seeing this, Ma Weidong quickly forced a smile. "Never mind, I understand. Discipline."
"It’s alright. You’ve been away from the bureau all this time, so you’ve been deemed trustworthy. There’s no harm in telling you. The night before last, we caught a traitor. But before we could interrogate him, he was silenced last night."
"Oh? Are you sure it was one of our own brothers from the bureau?"
"Who else but one of our own could know details about the power supply, backup power, and other such information needed to kill someone within the heavily guarded bureau?"
"So, what are we doing here? Investigating?"
"No. Last night, the mole acted, killing three of our brothers. Yet that damned traitor is still barely alive... Damn it! Why is that traitor still breathing when three of our brothers are dead?"
Ma Weidong stared intently at Lige. "You know, Lige... the way you swear is... odd. You’re a refined type. Don’t force yourself to imitate us rough-and-tumble guys. It doesn’t suit you, and it’s a bit cringeworthy."
Hearing this, Lige’s expression immediately turned awkward.
"Hey, don’t get me wrong. I’m not saying *you’re* cringeworthy. It’s just that your ’damn it’ didn’t sound very... forceful. Still, it’s good the traitor is alive. He’s likely the only one who knows what the mole looks like."
"Exactly!"
"So, we should be able to find out what the mole looks like soon, right?"
"If only it were that easy," a voice suddenly interjected. Xu Shiyun, dressed in a red uniform, approached with confident strides.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 Waiting for the Fish to Bite
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 198 Waiting for the Fish to Bite
"Captain Xu, come, have a smoke!" Ma Weidong offered, pushing a cigarette forward.
"Weidong, you were called back too?"
"Exactly. I was just about to board my plane."
"I was so frustrated, I had to come out for a walk. Fuck, I was the one who discovered that guy, and the credit was just about to fall into my pocket. The damn duck, already cooked, actually flew away."
"Didn’t Lige say he isn’t dead? As long as he’s not dead, the duck hasn’t flown yet."
"His heart’s been smashed to a pulp. You tell me, is he dead or not?"
"Dead?" Ma Weidong stared at Xu Shiyun in astonishment.
Nearby, Lige’s expression changed drastically. Just as he was about to speak, Xu Shiyun preempted him, blowing out a plume of smoke.
"Not yet!"
"Huh?" Ma Weidong looked completely bewildered, then chuckled. "Don’t joke around. You said his heart was smashed to a pulp. How could he still be alive?"
"Have you forgotten who saved your life last time, after you were pierced through from front to back?"
"Ah!" Ma Weidong nodded in understanding. "That young man, Wang Lan. I wanted to thank him after I was discharged from the hospital, but I found out his identity information has Class-A clearance. I couldn’t even find him..."
"Wang Lan’s Medical Star Martial Techniques are unparalleled, but with a heart turned to mush, even Wang Lan’s techniques are useless. Fortunately, the National Defense Hospital has organ cloning technology. Let’s hope that human traitor can hold on for a few days. Once a new heart is cloned, Wang Lan might be able to save him."
"That traitor deserves to die! Why save him? To waste food?" Lige sneered disdainfully.
"What choice do we have? He knows the identity of the mole."
And just like that, small groups like Lige and Xu Shiyun, discussing the state of the mole and the traitor, spread out like a virus.
「A day quietly passed by.」
The moon cast a cool light, and a gentle breeze rustled through the shadows of the high hill. The grass underfoot was already lush and green. The moonlit night was unexpectedly tranquil. Insect calls were hushed, and the wind grew colder.
A hand eerily emerged from the depths beneath the hilltop, like that of a ghoul crawling from its grave.
"What’s going on? Why isn’t Poison Sting dead?" the shadowy figure emerging from the earth asked in a low voice.
WHOOSH—
A spark flared. It turned out that what had seemed like a stone on the moonlit hilltop was actually a person standing perfectly still.
"Is one Poison Sting really that important? Important enough for me to risk exposure to silence him?"
"If it weren’t for him, how would Poison Snake have been exposed? Poison Snake infiltrated Jade Country fifty years ago, dutifully relaying intelligence for the Empire. After fifty years of painstaking service, all ruined by a single Poison Sting...
Humans are untrustworthy. The higher-ups who devised the infiltration plan are definitely... to put it in human terms, out of their minds."
"So you’re saying... Poison Sting doesn’t need to be silenced anymore? And the reason you asked me to act before was also a lie?" Instantly, the previous voice grew deeper, as if suppressing boundless fury.
"Of course, it’s necessary. At the very least, he knows about the infiltration plan."
"Why wasn’t a Brain-eating Worm planted in his head?"
"It was Poison Snake’s decision! Brain-eating worms would limit Poison Sting’s development. This Poison Sting is the most promising one we have. He could have been cultivated into the best, the one embedded deepest."
"But now... Poison Snake was annihilated by Wang Lan’s arrow, not even bones left!" the shadowy figure declared coldly. "But merely knowing about an infiltration plan isn’t enough to make me take such a risk."
"No. If you had succeeded in killing him, you wouldn’t be in danger. Your danger lies in why you *didn’t* kill him."
"He’s already dead!"
"If he were truly dead, you wouldn’t be this furious, practically beside yourself. If he were really dead, you wouldn’t have requested this meeting."
"I can confirm he’s dead... but... but... I really don’t understand how they did it. Humans are so fragile. They have many vital spots; hitting any one of them could kill them.
My last strike completely destroyed his heart. He should have been dead beyond doubt. However, the Tianjian Bureau now has an exceptionally skilled Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior. This warrior is extremely powerful. It’s entirely possible that he managed to keep Poison Sting alive.
Just today, I personally oversaw the escort of a batch of Soul Beads to the special ward at the National Defense Hospital. The Tianjian Bureau is going to such great lengths. It seems they’re determined to find me and won’t rest until they do."
"What are you implying?"
"I need to withdraw."
"That’s not an option. The next operation requires your cooperation. Your withdrawal would cause all our previous efforts to be wasted. We’ll die horribly, you should understand that."
"No, only you will die horribly. You’re the one who violated the rules and increased my risk of exposure. If I continue to stay, I could be exposed at any moment. I have every reason to withdraw."
"Compared to the upcoming plan, your reasons seem utterly trivial. That is a mission that must be completed, even if it costs us our lives."
The shadowy figure fell silent, taking a deep drag from a cigarette.
"I cannot be exposed. But now, I could be exposed at any moment. You must take responsibility for eliminating the risk of my exposure."
"Can’t you strike one more time? Since Poison Sting is in the hospital, it would be much easier to take him down there than at the Tianjian Bureau."
"The Action Department, Intelligence Department, and Shadow Guard Office have joined forces in their preparations. Superficially, they appear to be securing Poison Sting’s safety, but they are actually conducting internal investigations.
If I make a move, I’ll be exposed immediately."
"I understand. I will assist you."
"As soon as possible. I’ll be preparing to evacuate in the near future. At any sign of probing or trouble, I will evacuate. That’s my bottom line."
"Understood..."
The shadowy figure slowly sank deep into the earth and vanished.
「Without realizing it, two days had passed.」
Wang Lan, at this point, had been isolated for two days. If the Tianjian Bureau hadn’t requested leave for Wang Lan, and if Xu Xiangwen, an unofficial contact, hadn’t known some of the inside story, Wang Qi and Jiang Xinyu would probably have reported him missing by now.
「Another night fell.」
Lige had just finished his shift and returned home, planning to shower and get a good night’s sleep. Just as he reached his doorstep, he suddenly froze.
Ma Weidong had appeared behind him at some unknown point.
"Captain Li, Director Li has given an order: assemble and prepare for action."
"Alright!"
Without the slightest hesitation, Lige pocketed his keys, turned, and followed Ma Weidong. The meeting point was near a residential community street in the park district.
The car stopped. Lige and Ma Weidong got out and saw Li Weixin and several familiar comrades sitting outside a milk tea shop in the community’s open-air area.
"Everyone is here. I will now brief you on the mission." Li Weixin pulled several photos from his breast pocket. "This man is named Huang Ziang. He’s an instructor at the Star Martial Art Club here. For a long time, he has been providing intelligence to the Demon Clan and selling out the interests of the human race. Catch him alive."
"Yes!"
"Director Li, is this intelligence from the Intelligence Department? Everyone outside is swamped. Can the Intelligence Department still be this effective?" a team member asked curiously.
"Don’t ask what you’re not supposed to. Don’t you know that piece of discipline? It was Colonel Wu who dug up this lead. Don’t ask anything else."
"Yes!"
"Move out!"
For two Star Cloud Stage peak elites to capture a Star Shine Stage peak traitor was, of course, an easy task. Huang Ziang had no time to resist before Lige apprehended him. Then, a hood was thrown over his head, and he was dragged out like a dead dog.
"Colonel Wu... This morning when I changed shifts, I clearly saw Colonel Wu going to the hospital. Isn’t there a rule at the hospital that you can enter but not leave? How did he get the intelligence?" an operative from the Action Department blurted out.
"Don’t ask what you shouldn’t," Lige snapped coldly.
"Yes!"
"The men are just grumbling casually. No need to be so serious, right? Lately, the Bureau has been watching us like we’re thieves. It’s normal for the men to feel resentful."
"Everything is for the human race. If the mole isn’t caught, the vigilance won’t be lifted. What’s there to complain about? As long as our consciences are clear, who cares how the Bureau investigates?"
"Even if you say that... one can’t help feeling a bit disgruntled, right?"
「In the dead of night...」
It was that same hilltop, resembling a mass grave. A terrifying, ghostly figure’s hand once again reached out from beneath the ground.
STOMP—
A military boot stamped down on it from above!
"Ah—what are you doing?"
"Why must you appear this way every time? I find it irritating."
"Isn’t it for safety?"
"The fact that you can see me means it’s safe. If it weren’t safe, could I even appear before you? Bastard, what have you two been doing these past two days?"
"Us? We’re laying the groundwork for that plan. We’re very busy... What’s with you today? Why are you so worked up?"
"Are you that forgetful? What did I tell you last time? You must eliminate the threat of my exposure. What have you been doing? It’s been two days. I could be exposed at any moment."
"Oh? Has the Tianjian Bureau already narrowed down the suspects?"
"Poison Sting really isn’t dead. Wu Chao has started reading Poison Sting’s memories. Today, using Wu Chao’s memories, they caught an informant I had turned previously. Damn it..."
"Is that so? It seems the operation needs to be moved up. I originally thought we still had five days..."
"What do you mean?"
"Lately, I’ve been handing over my tasks to others."
"Handing them over to others? What do you mean?"
"That one in the hospital is both your death warrant and the bait to hook us. The Tianjian Bureau is using an overt plot: they want to either find you or lure me out. One of us must die."
"You..." The figure in military boots froze for a moment, staring blankly at the annoying fellow before him, whose face still wore a flippant smile. But at this moment, that annoying face somehow didn’t seem so annoying anymore.
"Cicada, you’re right. You can’t be exposed. Your value extends far beyond merely cooperating to complete that plan. If I die, my mission can be handed over to another team. But if you’re exposed, the plan will be completely impossible to execute.
Since only one of us can live between you and me, that person must be you. I’ve almost finished handing over my tasks. Tomorrow, I will attack the hospital. You should know the distribution of the hospital’s defense forces, right?"
"How much force do you plan to deploy?"
"An elite team, plus some cannon fodder."
"Impossible. An elite team couldn’t even reach the threshold of the isolation building."
"My objective isn’t to conquer the hospital. I only need to kill Poison Sting and remove your threat," the shadowy figure cackled. Like a paper boat sinking into water, he slowly submerged and vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 The Fish Has Come
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 199 The Fish Has Come
"It’s already the fourth day."
In the solitary ward, He MingXue spoke faintly while laying out a three of a kind.
"What’s the rush?" Wang Qianfeng said. "We’re fishing; the most important thing is patience. Pair of fives!"
"Pair of tens," Wang Lan silently played his cards.
"Pair of aces!" He MingXue was still somewhat annoyed. "I’m not being impatient, but as we fish for the mole, we’re also expending internal trust. Many of our brothers have risked their lives for the Bureau, and we all know in our hearts that they can be trusted. Yet we’re still guarding against them like they’re thieves, which is disheartening for them."
"Pass!" Wang Qianfeng declared. "When the safety of the nation is at stake, if they can’t even tolerate this minor grievance, are they still the elite of the Tianjian Bureau? The interests of the nation come above all else, as does its safety."
Just as He MingXue was about to continue playing, a hurried series of footsteps approached from the doorway. All three men paused abruptly as the door was knocked. "Report, the brothers outside the hospital have discovered some activity."
"What kind of activity?" He MingXue asked.
"Near the small building, there have been some patients who seem to be passing by, intentionally or unintentionally. There were none in the past few days, and these patients haven’t been seen before."
"It seems... the fish has taken the bait," He MingXue said, closing his cards, his face alight with excitement.
"The Demon Clan’s target is definitely Duan Ziqi," Wang Qianfeng stated. "We’ll keep it relaxed on the outside but tight on the inside and observe for a while longer. The primary tactic is to lure them into a trap, and we’ll adapt to other changes as they occur."
"Got it! I’ll go make the arrangements." He MingXue smiled, stood up, and left the room.
"It seems the mole isn’t foolish either..." Wang Lan murmured with a bitter smile. "Director Wang is indeed wise, guessing that even if the Demon Clan were to strike, it would most likely be through a Demon spy."
"For a mole to have remained hidden within the Tianjian Bureau for so long proves they’re a highly skilled agent," Wang Qianfeng said. "The traps you’ve set are necessary but also raise suspicion. For example, placing Duan Ziqi in the hospital. According to the safest measures, Duan Ziqi should be protected within the Tianjian Bureau. Keeping him in the hospital clearly weakens his protection. Additionally, you’ve had our men spread word of Duan Ziqi’s condition and let everyone know about the recent arrests of human traitors.
"It’s somewhat too deliberate. Yet, since any one of our men might be a Demon spy hidden among us, it’s necessary to keep everyone informed about Duan Ziqi’s status. The mole must realize that you are trying to draw him out, especially with him in the shadows and you in the light. But your tactic is an open conspiracy. As long as the Demon Clan cannot be sure that Duan Ziqi is truly dead, or that the human traitors we’ve caught recently didn’t provide information extracted from Duan Ziqi’s mind, the mole only has two options: act recklessly or withdraw. If he withdraws, we will know who the mole is. If he acts recklessly, we will also know. The only way for him to avoid exposure is to use Demon spies."
"Even so," Wang Lan interjected, "all we need to do is annihilate any intruding Demon spies. As long as they can’t confirm Duan Ziqi’s fate, sending any more is futile."
"That may be," Wang Qianfeng replied, "but we mustn’t underestimate the Demon Clan. For us, it’s a matter of how many come and how many die. But for the Demon Clan, if they don’t even get the chance to break into the ward and see the truth for themselves, can they still call themselves Demon elites? No matter how we defend, they will find a way. This is a game of strategy. The greatest respect for an opponent is to prepare for the worst. Never underestimate your adversary, and don’t think your plans are foolproof. When you make a plan, always ask yourself: what would you do if the enemy sees through all your schemes and turns them against you? Don’t count victories before they happen; first, consider the possibility of defeat."
"So... what do we do now?" Wang Lan asked. "Should we move Duan Ziqi? That way, even if they break in, they won’t see the truth."
"If this were a competition with the Demon Clan, he would be the trophy we’re fighting for," Wang Qianfeng said. "The trophy is in our hands now. The only way to ensure it’s completely secure is to keep it firmly grasped. We must swallow any meat that has made it to our mouths. Since the Demon Clan has sent another spy team, let’s make sure none of them return."
BOOM—
Almost the instant Wang Qianfeng finished speaking, a violent explosion suddenly sounded from outside. The explosion was abrupt.
"They’ve made their move!" Wang Lan exclaimed, standing up.
"Since we’ve detected them, they will definitely act quickly," Wang Qianfeng said calmly. "Let’s remain seated and keep our cool."
Outside the small building, a dozen or so Demons disguised as patients suddenly transformed, viciously charging toward the isolated inpatient building.
The Demon Clan possesses immense power compared to humans. With Soul Beads, their Star Power endurance and recovery abilities are far beyond what humans can match. If not for humanity’s significant advantage in skill, Star Martial Warriors would be nearly helpless against Demons.
A beetle-like Demon flew into the sky. Its six abdominal legs clasped together, instantly forming a lightning orb over three meters in diameter.
"Super Thunderstorm!"
The lightning orb, like a cannonball fired from a cannon, blasted down toward the Tianjian Bureau’s position. An orb of this size could kill at least five or six people if it hit its target.
"Wind Dragon Roar!"
Within the defensive position, Zhang Xiaoxue looked up at the orb. Star Power surged around her as a huge Star Power array materialized before her. From the array, a wind dragon burst forth and fiercely collided with the speeding lightning orb.
In terms of Star Power consumption, creating such a large lightning orb would require ten times the energy of the wind dragon. But because wind counters lightning, and Zhang Xiaoxue’s control over Star Power was extremely masterful, the seemingly weaker attack prevailed. The meteor-like lightning orb, just as it was about to crash, was shattered midair by the wind dragon’s impact.
"What?" the beetle-like Demon in the sky cried out in surprise.
"Xiaoxue!" Zhang Yeqiu suddenly called out from her side.
They acted almost simultaneously, a red and a cyan Star Power array materializing in front of each of them respectively.
"Fire Dragon Flame Bomb!"
"Wind Dragon Roar!"
A fire dragon burst forth from Zhang Yeqiu, and at the same time, Zhang Xiaoxue’s wind dragon roared out of her Star Power formation. But the next moment, the sisters’ maneuver left all the Tianjian Bureau members staring, wide-eyed in disbelief.
They suddenly slammed their respective Star Power formations together. Instantly, the formations merged into a green-and-red Tai Chi fish.
The wind dragon and the fire dragon intertwined in mid-air.
"Scorching Flame Dragon!"
A golden dragon made of golden flames charged into the sky. The heavily armored, beetle-like Demon stared, its eyes wide, frantically flapping its wings to ascend. However, its bulky body was not agile. Faced with the golden dragon’s speed, the beetle-like Demon could only watch helplessly as the fire dragon struck it, disintegrating it into ashes in a fierce blaze.
"Good!"
"These humans can actually perform combined Star Martial Skills? Damn it!" Hidden in the shadows, a Demon sneered, no longer concealing its presence. It stepped out from the undergrowth, took three light steps, and completed its transformation.
The transformed Demon had an inverted triangular head, like a mantis, a slender and tall frame, and a pair of scabbard-like shells on its back. Its body was green, covered in black spots. Cold, gleaming spines protruded from every mobile joint, and from its elbows grew two terrifying, curved blades.
The Demon’s body was enveloped in a green light that burned like flames. The moment it appeared, a terrifying pressure, like a landslide, swept toward the Tianjian Bureau’s position.
"A high-level Demon!" Wang Qianfeng exclaimed from his hospital room, his head snapping up in shock. "Is the Demon Clan really intending to launch an all-out attack?"
"Should we go support them?" Wang Lan asked quickly.
"He MingXue can handle it. Let’s wait a bit longer," Wang Qianfeng replied.
Step by step, the high-level Demon approached, its aura howling. The terrifying pressure swept past, causing many of the Tianjian Bureau guards to collapse under the strain. Even Zhang Xiaoxue and Zhang Yeqiu unconsciously retreated a step.
"Hmph!"
In an instant, the Demon blurred into a shadow, seeming to leap across time to appear right in front of the Zhang sisters. A blade imbued with Speedy Wind slashed through the air, aimed at Zhang Yeqiu’s head.
ZZZT—
A streak of purple light flared, like lightning splitting the sky. A figure materialized in front of Zhang Yeqiu instantly. Their silhouettes eerily interwove and then separated in the blink of an eye.
He MingXue’s body flickered with lightning. He stared expressionlessly at the Demon, whose aura seethed. The purple Flame Sword in his hands danced like will-o’-the-wisps at his fingertips.
The Demon stood motionless, its eyes fixated on the broken curved blade at its elbow. The eyes on its triangular head flickered like indicator lights.
Instantly, the shattered blade reformed. The two figures tangled together once again. The Demon’s wind-like speed clashed with He MingXue’s lightning-quick movements. For a moment, the shockwaves from their fight seemed to stir the very heavens and earth.
Wang Qianfeng stood quietly at the window, hands behind his back, staring into the distance at the crackling lightning and feeling the harsh howl of the wind.
At that moment, a Demon’s face appeared on the hospital room wall, as if it were a relief sculpture.
Almost the instant it appeared, Wang Lan sharply raised his head, his eyes locking with the Demon’s. In that instant, an indescribable terror gripped Wang Lan’s heart.
"Illusion Technique!"
In a heartbeat, Wang Lan’s heart leaped to his throat. He activated his Phoenix form.
A crest surfaced on Wang Lan’s forehead, and in that moment, the terrible feeling vanished. The Demon on the wall passed through it like a ghost from the underworld entering the Human World, transforming into a ribbon that surged toward Duan Ziqi on the hospital bed.
In his Phoenix form, Wang Lan instantly activated his dynamic vision. His Flame Sword became a streak of light, slashing fiercely at the Demon’s head.
BOOM—
The wall shattered, and the ceiling above shot skyward like a firework. In that instant, the world turned eerily overcast, and an aura of death materialized into a fierce gale.
The newly appeared Demon dripped green blood. Its eyes were fixed on Wang Lan, who had slashed it, then it looked at Duan Ziqi on the nearby hospital bed.
"As I suspected, Poison Sting was already dead. This was just your strategy to lure us into your trap. I must say, you were successful. You’ve won... But your victory ends here!"
BUZZZZ—
Suddenly, an ear-piercing hum emanated from the Demon’s body.
"Not good! Demonic language fluctuation!" Wang Lan shouted, his figure flashing as he slashed toward the Demon. At the same time, Wang Qianfeng, moving like the wind, also struck. The two Galaxy Stage masters attacked in concert. The Demon wore a relieved, bitter smile as its Star Power surged.
SWISH—
A blade grazed past its head.
A palm plunged into its chest.
Under the combined attack of the two Galaxy Stage masters, the Demon didn’t even have a chance to self-destruct.

chapters.title: Chapter 200 The Lightning Star Martial Skill Is Acquired
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 200 The Lightning Star Martial Skill Is Acquired
In the distant forest of the Defense Hospital, a middle-aged man in a black coat slowly removed his hat. He calmly exhaled a thick plume of smoke while watching the aftermath of the clash near the hospital.
"I understand now, brother. Rest in peace!" As his voice faded, rustling leaves fell like colorful butterflies. Amidst the flurry, his silhouette dissolved into butterflies and disappeared.
"For killing an enemy above your level, reward: 1,000 experience points, 50 skill points."
The moment the elite demon—who had appeared suddenly—was killed, a system prompt sounded in Wang Lan’s mind. Concurrently, the ripple effects from the battle outside the ward exploded once again.
Electric arcs flashed, and the wind howled mournfully. Between He MingXue and the wind-attribute demon, it was unclear who had the upper hand. Wind could counter lightning, but He MingXue’s fire attribute could also suppress wind.
Wind possessed its speed, and lightning, too, had its velocity; they exchanged dozens of blows without a clear victor. Once again, they separated after a fierce clash.
"Retreat—" an elite demon bellowed.
No sooner had his voice faded than, just as they were about to make a move, two figures appeared like specters behind the group of demons.
Wang Lan, shrouded in a mist of blood, and Wang Qianfeng, with the mournful howl of the wind flickering around him, blocked the demons’ path in a pincer formation.
Witnessing this, a glint flickered in the demons’ eyes, and they emitted an aura like cold ashes. Suddenly, powerful waves of Star Power surged forth. In that split second, Wang Lan, Wang Qianfeng, and He MingXue attacked.
A triangular head soared into the air, its cyan gemstone shattering like a mirror.
BOOM—
The body of the high-level demon burst open on the spot under the terrifying force of the Star Power.
"For killing an enemy above your level, reward: 1,000 experience points, 50 skill points."
"For annihilating an elite demon spy group, reward: 15,000 experience points, 800 skill points."
At the sound of the two system prompts, a satisfied smile appeared on Wang Lan’s face. This matter was now concluded.
Leaving some people behind to handle the aftermath, the main forces, including Wang Lan, retreated from the hospital in an orderly fashion and returned to the Tianjian Bureau for a post-battle summary and report.
"Although our fishing operation did not successfully lure out the mole hidden within the Tianjian Bureau, overall, it can be considered a complete success. An elite demon spy group has been utterly wiped out within the Defense Hospital."
After explaining the entire operation, Wang Qianfeng publicly presented its conclusion. Upon hearing it, all the brothers involved in the operation revealed knowing smiles.
"MingXue, the mole hiding within the Tianjian Bureau still requires your attention. From now on, raise the secrecy level of internal intelligence within the Tianjian Bureau by one grade. As long as the mole is not eliminated, our intelligence is perpetually at risk of being leaked," Lu Zhao said, smiling, though his tone was stern.
"Director! Based on the results of this operation, we’ve deduced two points. First, the mole must hold a certain position within the Bureau. Otherwise, the Demon Clan wouldn’t be willing to sacrifice an entire spy group to protect them. Second, it’s likely that the mole isn’t a permanent member of the Bureau. I’ve already conducted a comprehensive investigation of the permanent staff, and no one is suspicious. Therefore, the person of interest must be someone we previously cleared of suspicion. But this scope is too large, and it’s difficult to pinpoint them precisely."
"Therefore, screening internal suspects will be an ongoing and crucial task for you, one you cannot slack off on."
"Yes!"
"WeiXin, do you have anything to say?"
"Director, from this incident, I believe we need to strengthen our internal capabilities. Previously, we were confident that our strength was sufficient to protect Suzhou City. However, judging by the Demon Clan encounters this year, their focus on Suzhou City has exceeded our estimations. Since last October, we’ve achieved victories celebrated nationwide, including the elimination of no fewer than eight high-level demons, all possessing Galaxy Stage capabilities. But are these all the high-level demon spies in Suzhou City? Probably not. It’s more likely there are twice or even three times as many Demon Clan masters lurking in Suzhou City. Yet, in our Tianjian Bureau, we only have eleven Galaxy Stage combatants and seventeen elite red-uniformed captains. We operate in the open, while the Demon Clan operates in the shadows. Such strength is likely insufficient to cope with the increasingly severe situation. Director, shouldn’t we raise this with headquarters?"
"Heh? WeiXin, did you perhaps hear something that prompted you to say this?" Lu Zhao suddenly asked with a light chuckle.
"No, not at all!"
"Everyone present here is a pillar of our bureau, individuals who have truly risked their lives against the demons and shed blood for our country. I won’t keep secrets from you all. The Demon Clan is currently restless, and I fear a new war will arrive soon. To face the growing severity of the situation, the Ministry of Defense plans to establish one hundred key Tianjian Bureau departments. These will be built upon the current structure, forming a strategic defense network across the twenty-four provinces of Jade Country. In times of dire need, these one hundred Tianjian Bureaus will have the responsibility to operate independently and defend their local areas. They must be able to function flexibly, even if cut off from superior leadership. Jiang Province, being adjacent to Modu City, will receive three of these hundred bureaus. Jin City, as the headquarters of Jiang Province, will definitely secure one spot. Moreover, Jin City’s geographical location perfectly divides Jiang Province and Hui Province. The remaining two spots were initially out of Suzhou City’s reach, but who would have thought our achievements in the past year would be so brilliant? It’s very likely that Suzhou City will become the reserve headquarters for the Jiangnan defense area of Jiang Province. In such a case, we can support Modu City from the east and assist Zezhou from the south. We can also join forces with our brother cities in Jiangbei to the north and fight shoulder-to-shoulder with Jin City’s headquarters to the west."
"Really?" Even the usually composed Wang Qianfeng’s eyes lit up at this news. "If Suzhou City becomes one of those hundred, does that mean we’ll have a general here?"
"Hahaha... From a rank perspective, that is indeed the case. And this is just a preliminary step. No one knows what will happen when the war truly ignites.
