Alright, let’s set these matters aside for now. Whether or not Suzhou City manages to become one of the hundred, we must still continue to work hard, stay vigilant, and earnestly complete our duties. I expect each department to report their achievements to me within three days, and I’ll forward them to the Jin City headquarters. Director Zhang will surely be pleased to see Suzhou City earning new commendations. Department heads, please stay behind; the rest of you may leave. Oh, and regarding commendations, we’ll proceed with them once we receive a response from above. For today, those involved in the operation are granted three days of leave. You’re free from duty during these three days, but keep your phones on twenty-four hours a day."
"Yes!"
Wang Lan yawned, walked out of the meeting room, and checked the time—it was already past ten. He had taken leave for four days, and tomorrow was Saturday, followed by Sunday.
If I’ve taken leave for practically a whole week, one more day won’t matter, right?
Wang Lan decisively decided to skip class. On his way out, he sent a group message to Jiang Xinyu and the others.
"Quarantine’s over, let’s hang out tomorrow!"
"Lanzi, you’ve finally been released! What did you do to get locked up for so many days?"
Seeing this reply, Wang Lan’s good mood instantly vanished.
Xu Xiangwen, that jerk, knew perfectly well why and still had such a loose mouth. His recommendation report to join the Tianjian Bureau is still sitting on my desk... I’ll let it sit there for another week.
DING-DONG— The notification sound rang again. Wang Lan picked up his phone to see a message from Jiang Xinyu. It was incredibly brief, just two words.
"Okay?"
"I’m fine. Aren’t you supposed to be in class right now? Always on your phone, huh?"
"Don’t worry, Lanzi, both my hands are on the table. Totally safe."
"Then how are you typing? Don’t tell me you dare to use voice input?"
"With my feet!"
In Wang Lan’s mind, he could instantly picture Xu Xiangwen with his feet on his phone, his toes flying across the screen like nimble fingers, typing out characters at breakneck speed, while his classmates, overcome by this biological weapon, were collapsing all around him.
So toxic.
He had just put down his phone when, DING-DONG—
Wang Lan picked up his phone and, after just one glance, almost threw it away in excitement.
"Dear Mr. Wang Lan, the Star Martial Skill you reserved has been matched. Please contact your procurement agent as soon as you see this message. Procurement Agent Gong Jian, mobile number 137********."
The moment the red light ahead changed and the green light came on, Wang Lan, who had originally planned to turn right, decisively chose to go straight. He sped down the road, all the way to the Star Martial Hall. He had already called Gong Jian while in the car, so when Wang Lan’s car pulled up in front of the Star Martial Hall, Gong Jian, dressed sharply in a suit, was already waiting at the door.
Some Star Martial Warriors emerging from the Star Martial Hall saw Gong Jian. The loud, joyful laughter on their faces suddenly vanished, and they quietly pulled their companions to walk a bit farther away. "Is that Gong Jian from the Star Martial Skill Trading House?"
"The manager of the Star Martial Skill Trading House? Their guardian?" another asked, with a Northeastern accent.
"He’s a formidable person!"
"How so?"
"He’s a guardian of a Star Martial Hall on the same level as those in the Imperial Capital and Modu City. How formidable do you think that makes him?"
"Star Sea? Damn, a Star Sea Stage warrior came to Suzhou City to stand guard?"
"He looks like he’s waiting for someone?"
"You must be joking. He’s probably just out to get some sun..."
"Wang Lan, you’re here?" Gong Jian saw Wang Lan approaching and walked up with a warm, welcoming smile.
"Brother Jian, you really made me wait. Last time, for the Crescent Arrow, you got it in just ten days. Why did I have to wait a whole month this time?" Despite his complaining tone, Wang Lan’s face was filled with eager anticipation.
"Do you think A-grade Star Martial Skills grow on trees, easily obtainable?" Gong Jian said, wrapping an arm around Wang Lan’s shoulder and ushering him inside.
"His younger brother, right?" a flamboyantly dressed female Star Martial Warrior not far away asked excitedly, as if she had spotted prey.
"Most likely. But I guarantee you, if you dare to hit on his younger brother, you might end up dead in the street tomorrow. Flower, don’t be rash."
"Get lost! *Me*, hit on him? That would be love!"
"..."
Gong Jian led Wang Lan into his office, where Wang Lan sat on the sofa.
"Here’s the Star Martial Skill." Gong Jian placed an exquisitely crafted metal box before Wang Lan. "Star Martial Skill, Thunder Snake. It’s an A-grade, thunder-attribute, single-target offensive Star Martial Skill. There are few single-target offensive types among A-grade Star Martial Skills, and you’re blaming me for taking too long? Even if a suitable skill is available, what if the owner doesn’t want to sell it to you? Can we just rob them? Some skills are family secrets; do you expect them to just hand those over? We had to do a lot of work to get this Thunder Snake, you know?"
"Is the previous owner still alive?"
"Alive!" Gong Jian replied instinctively, then stared at Wang Lan in disbelief. "Damn, you tricked me into answering?"
"Not at all. I was just asking casually."
"Rest assured, that guy is part of the International Hunter Organization. He’s not exactly an assassin, but he’s pulled off plenty of dirty, double-crossing deals. Last time, he hijacked two of our cargo ships in the Soma Strait. Originally... he was slippery and unpredictable, making him hard to catch. Deploying a special operations unit for just two cargo ships didn’t seem worth it. But when the Company Commander heard my report, he went out for a ’stroll’ under the guise of a training exercise. Well, let’s just say he ended up as part of the spoils of war."

chapters.title: Chapter 201 Thunder Snake
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 201 Thunder Snake
Although Gong Jian spoke casually and with ease, Wang Lan knew that this was a special trip abroad made by the Vermilion Bird Squad just for him, destroying an International Hunter Organization merely to collect a suitable Star Martial Skill for him.
"Thank you!" Wang Lan stretched out his hand, caressing the metal box, and said with some gravity.
"Don’t be so sentimental if you’re a man. Who made you such a freak? You’re clearly at the Star Shine Stage, yet you can master A-rank Star Martial Skills so well. You’re clearly Fire Attribute, yet you also manage to learn Thunder Attribute.
Fortunately, you do have one normal aspect: a deficiency in Star Power. That’s a shortcoming, limiting the Star Martial Skills you can learn. Thunder Snake involves highly concentrating Thunder Attribute Star Power. During its execution, your body will seem as if entwined by a Thunder Snake. When you unleash it, striking with the Thunder Snake, this Star Martial Skill has potential for further development. Discover it on your own."
"A Thunder Snake?"
"If it could only manifest a single Thunder Snake, would it even qualify as an A-rank Star Martial Skill? The number of Thunder Snakes depends on the strength of your Star Power. This Star Martial Skill has high potential for growth and is very controllable. Honestly, I’m even tempted by it."
"Thank you." Wang Lan lifted the metal box and stood up.
"Hey? Haven’t you forgotten something?"
"What?"
"Paying the bill! Do you think A-rank Star Martial Skills are free? That’ll be 8,000,000. Thank you for your patronage."
Regarding money, Wang Lan didn’t feel too strongly about it. He didn’t even know how many zeros were in his bank account; having one more or one less didn’t matter to him. Besides, his money seemed to have the ability to reproduce itself—the more he spent, the more he seemed to have.
Leaving the Star Martial Hall, he headed straight for the Star Mansion.
After parking the car, Wang Lan jumped out impatiently and opened the metal box. As expected, the A-rank Star Martial Skill was contained within an intermediate Soul Bead. Holding the Soul Bead in his palm, with a gentle absorption, a mass of Star Power mixed with a stream of spiritual information surged into Wang Lan’s mind.
"Discovery of learnable Star Martial Skill, would you like to expend 100 skill points to learn?"
Did he even need to ask?
Even after using the Phoenix Form twice, Wang Lan still had 2,000 skill points in reserve; learning another A-rank Star Martial Skill wasn’t a problem.
He added 100 skill points, and on the Star Martial Skill page, the icon for Thunder Snake lit up. It depicted a cobra formed from lightning—fierce and cruel, with chilling fangs.
Wang Lan didn’t continue to add points, instead reflecting on the unique aspects of this Star Martial Skill.
How should he put it? Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills and Fire Attribute Star Martial Skills are as different as apples and oranges. Both fall under the same broad category, yet they’re fundamentally different. The characteristic of the Fire Attribute is ferocity: Star Power colliding and annihilating to release immense energy. Yet, the Thunder Attribute is all about concentration—compressing Thunder Attribute Star Power, a terrifying compression. How much Star Power would be left to execute a Star Martial Skill after such compression? I dare not guess; it might be disappointingly small. For comparison, using the same amount of Star Power to execute a Fireball could produce one as big as a wheel. But to execute a Thunderball? One might only manage something the size of a ping-pong ball.
I finally understand why Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors deplete their Star Power so quickly! Unless they possess Star Power storage skills or have an exceptional natural talent, it’s common for Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors to lack stamina in the world of Star Martial Arts. The Thunder Attribute basically says, ’Apart from the Wind Attribute, everyone else here is trash.’ Then the other attributes can immediately retort, ’You only last three seconds! After those three seconds, if I’m not dead, you will be!’ But typically, the Thunder Attribute seldom fails to achieve results after that initial burst of power.
Previously, I didn’t understand. I thought it was some kind of divine fairness—giving the Thunder Attribute unparalleled speed and destructive power but forgetting to endow its Star Martial Warriors with abundant Star Power. Now I finally understand: it’s not that the Star Martial Warriors lack Star Power, it’s that the Thunder Attribute consumes so much of it! The incredible speed and explosive power of the Thunder Attribute make perfect sense now. Concentration is essence. If, after all that compression, there wasn’t frightening speed and immense destructive power, then Star Martial Warriors of that attribute might as well end themselves to apologize to the world! After understanding this, I could finally comprehend that saying: Glory is what others see; only the one experiencing it truly knows what lies behind it.
Wang Lan arrived at the training arena, activated his PS Armor, and began channeling Star Power towards the target armor mounted on the wall.
Instantly, Star Power flickered around Wang Lan, and the sound of electrical arcs crackling began to circulate around him. As more and more arcs appeared, his body gradually became enveloped in blue electricity, visible currents flowing around him like tiny streams.
SSSS—
Suddenly, a sharp thundering noise resounded, and a Thunder Snake, as thick as an arm, slithered over Wang Lan’s body. He raised his arm and instantly activated the Star Martial Skill.
The Thunder Snake burst forth from Wang Lan’s arm, shooting toward the PS Armor in front of him.
BOOM—
"Twenty energy points."
Wow, it truly lives up to being a Star Martial Skill that consumed nearly a third of my Star Power! To think it could deal twenty energy points of damage at only the Silver One stage. Even Crescent Arrow, without using a composite skill, only reached this damage output at Silver Seven. So, A-rank Star Martial Skills, even if they are of the same rank, can have vastly different outcomes depending on their focus. The Thunder Snake’s activation speed, Star Power consumption, and damage output weren’t entirely satisfactory. However, considering this was only at Silver One and I’d just learned to execute it, it wasn’t too surprising.
After adding 100 skill points, Thunder Snake instantly advanced to Silver Two.
Upon casting it again, the activation speed was noticeably faster, and the Star Power consumption was slightly less than at Silver One. The Silver Two Thunder Snake also shot out more quickly, making it somewhat more effective.
He continued adding points, reaching Silver Three.
By Silver Three, the Thunder Snake could change direction mid-air.
After all, it wouldn’t live up to the ’Snake’ in its name if it couldn’t perform serpentine attacks.
After unleashing it, Wang Lan had one opportunity to alter its trajectory. At this stage, the Thunder Snake Star Martial Skill was quite polished.
Casting Thunder Snake now only took three seconds, matching the speed of most Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warriors when launching their Star Martial Skills.
But this level was still not enough for me. Whether it was Flame Sword or Star Cloud Sword Dance, I could cast them instantly. Even Crescent Arrow, I launched within two seconds. I need to add more points!
When Thunder Snake reached Silver Five, the casting speed had been reduced to under two seconds.
But this is already the limit at the Silver level; any further reduction in casting time will be very difficult.
At Silver Five, Wang Lan could cultivate two Thunder Snakes simultaneously, launching them from both hands. He could also cultivate a single Thunder Snake as thick as a thigh, with a destructive power of fifty energy points.
This destructive power is comparable to the weakest Fire Arrow. But for Thunder Snake, this level of power is just the starting point. As for its ultimate potential, I, at the Star Shine Stage, have no chance to experience it yet.
What truly brought Wang Lan a pleasant surprise was that, like Crescent Arrow, Thunder Snake also came with an auxiliary ability.
Or, to be more precise, it’s not exactly a Star Martial Skill, but a derived ability that manifests when Thunder Snake is cast. It’s a state every Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warrior dreams of achieving: physical activation!
Physical activation is the first clear milestone for Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors. Controlling Thunder Attribute Star Power isn’t easy, but as the saying goes, resourceful people always find a way; there are always more solutions than problems.
No one knows when it started, but Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors became dedicated to wrestling control over the Thunder Attribute.
’You won’t let me control you? I’ll control you no matter what! A huge blob that’s hard to control? No problem, I’ll just fragment it to make it manageable, right?’ Such was their thinking. How do you make a mass of metal flow? One method is to melt it. But melting requires extremely high temperatures; can a normal body withstand that? So, another method is to break the metal down into tiny steel beads. Sand flows based on this principle, so this seemed like the only feasible way to control the Thunder Attribute. But another problem arose: the Thunder Attribute is characterized by concentration. If it’s divided into fine grains, can it still truly be called the Thunder Attribute?
Then, some madmen turned their attention to human cells.
’Look at how dense and compact human cells are! If we could use cells as conduits for our Thunder Attribute Star Power, wouldn’t that be wonderful?’ they thought.
After a heavy price was paid, the first Star Martial Warrior capable of Thunder Activity appeared. For a time, he became the most dazzling figure on the battlefield, transforming into arcs of electricity and moving at lightning speed, instantly stealing the spotlight from Wind Attribute Star Martial Warriors.
The Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors are the most unyielding among all warriors; when in doubt, they charge ahead, and when facing difficulties, they power through. One person’s success led others to follow suit, and various methods of achieving physical activation were developed. Whether or not one could achieve physical activation thus became the measure of how far a Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warrior could advance.
After all, whether one can hit a target with a Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skill is debatable, but it definitely can’t hit a Star Martial Warrior whose body has undergone physical activation. With physical activation, one’s speed and strength reach terrifying levels, and they also become immune to most lightning and electrical damage.
Take Zhuang Haotian, for example. Why was he so confident his Thunder Activity ability would let him shine? With speed that fast, exceeding all limits, what would you fear if even Star Martial Skills couldn’t catch up to you?
Although Thunder Snake wasn’t a Star Martial Skill specifically for Thunder Activity, it could derive the Thunder Activity ability. This is the value of high-rank Star Martial Skills: even if their primary function isn’t a particular ability, they inherently possess it.
It’s like smartphones: their main features are internet browsing and gaming, but they still retain camera functions, right? I might be able to counter Thunder Activity in others, but that doesn’t mean the ability isn’t strong. Honestly, I was so envious my eyes turned red. If I had dynamic vision combined with super-fast reflexes, I can’t even imagine how conceited I might become! Besides, countering Zhuang Haotian’s and Xu Xiangwen’s activation abilities wasn’t a big deal. It would be truly remarkable to counter someone like He MingXue. But I could only dream about it; I saw what happened that day. When He MingXue fully unleashed his Thunder Attribute, even in my Phoenix Form, I couldn’t keep up with half his speed.
If Silver Five was just barely touching upon Thunder Activity, then at Silver Six, Thunder Activity could genuinely be activated. After just three seconds of activation, Wang Lan felt his body become a terrifying sieve, Star Power leaking out from countless pores all over him.
Frightened, Wang Lan quickly deactivated Thunder Activity.
Damn, this Star Power consumption... it’s terrifying! I finally understood Zhuang Haotian’s frustration. To have a Star Martial Skill with such terrifying consumption, only for its incredible speed to be countered and defeated in seconds? If it were me, I’d probably start doubting life itself.
At this point, Wang Lan no longer hesitated and upgraded Thunder Snake directly to Silver Nine.
BOOM— It was as if a quantitative change had triggered a qualitative one; Wang Lan felt his mind explode with new understanding.
At that very moment, the system’s prompt echoed in his mind, "Combinable Star Martial Skill detected. Do you wish to spend 1,000 skill points to combine?"

chapters.title: Chapter 202: Data on Masters of the Provincial Martial Arts Tournament
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 202: Data on Masters of the Provincial Martial Arts Tournament
Wang Lan hurriedly looked at the system panel, only to be surprised to see that the two linked skills were Thunder Snake and Star Cloud Sword Dance.
Huh, wasn’t Thunder Snake supposed to be standard with Crescent Arrow? Why is it linked with Star Cloud Sword Dance?
Though confused, the anticipation of linking Star Martial Skills made Wang Lan choose to link them without hesitation.
One thousand skill points were invested, and the two Star Martial Skills on the system panel lit up instantly, an intangible connection forming between them.
BOOM—
Countless pieces of information exploded in Wang Lan’s mind, as if the two Star Martial Skills had undergone innumerable trials and refinements, countless integrations, and endless applications. Experience and enlightenment fused into his very instincts.
Only after the two Star Martial Skills were linked did Wang Lan understand why Thunder Snake and Star Cloud Sword Dance had combined. The essence of Star Cloud Sword Dance lay in the complete control of Star Power throughout the body; creating its afterimages demanded this perfect, holistic control. Thunder Activity, on the other hand, pertained to the micro-control of the body. When combined, they could create Thunder Snake afterimages. These afterimages retained the terrifying speed of Thunder Activity while also preserving the afterimage characteristic of Star Cloud Sword Dance.
Wang Lan took out Ghost Wail, closed his eyes slightly, and felt the fusion of the two linked Star Martial Skills. CRACKLE...
Suddenly, arcs of electricity danced around him. Endless currents flowed over Wang Lan’s entire body, especially coiling around Ghost Wail, transforming it into a Thunder Sword.
Ghost Wail was originally a short sword, only about forty centimeters long. But when enveloped by lightning, it instantly doubled in size. Moreover, Ghost Wail’s slightly twisted pattern acted as a conduit for the lightning, making the Thunder Sword appear even more arcane and mystical.
Looking at the Thunder Sword in my hand, could this be the correct way to use Ghost Wail?
His form flickered, and in an instant, six figures of Wang Lan, wreathed in lightning, appeared on the training ground. Each of these figures could not only confuse an opponent but also self-destruct with explosive force. When self-destruction wasn’t needed, the Star Power forming these illusions could be reclaimed.
Although fewer in number, their power had increased manifold.
Through electromagnetic attraction, the Thunder Illusions could instantly be drawn back into Wang Lan’s body like ghosts, and the Star Power consumption was the same as for a normal Star Cloud Sword Dance. But once a Thunder Illusion exploded, that burst of Star Power was completely expended, draining a third of his blue energy.
"BOOM—"
Wang Lan controlled one Thunder Illusion to self-destruct. In an instant, lightning erupted like a spiderweb, electric arcs blanketing the entire dueling platform, and the PS armor flickered.
"One hundred energy points!"
Wang Lan was shocked to see the energy data fed back from the PS armor, a look of pleasant surprise on his face. He remembered that even a Purple Flame Arrow, when shot, only registered about three hundred energy points. Three hundred points were equivalent to the power of a rocket launcher—not just a rocket-propelled grenade.
The Jade Country’s rocket launcher was a beast, possessing all the features of a missile except for its explosive yield. The White Eagle Country had even complained, "You call this a rocket launcher? Are your rocket launchers and missiles made on the same production line?"
The self-destruction power of a Thunder Illusion was less than that of a Purple Flame Arrow, but Wang Lan felt he could use the Thunder Illusion’s self-destruct three times consecutively. At one hundred energy points each, three would total three hundred—no less than a Purple Flame Arrow.
Moreover, and more importantly, was the range of application. If Purple Flame Arrow was the king of long-range attacks, then Thunder Illusion was a close-range minefield.
If six Thunder Illusions scattered and were made to self-destruct all at once for a devastating attack, it would guarantee devastation within a fifteen-meter radius of Wang Lan’s position. Of course, if all six exploded together, only three would truly detonate; it was a last resort, not to be used unless absolutely necessary. If he detonated all six Thunder Illusions and the enemy wasn’t dead, then he would be.
The self-destruction of the Thunder Illusions was not the true essence of this linkage. The real essence lay in his Thunder Activity combined with the deceptive nature of Star Cloud Sword Dance—no, and the Thunder Sword formed from Ghost Wail had to be included as well.
Instantly, lightning flashed in the arena. Wang Lan’s body seemed to teleport, appearing in every corner of the dueling ground, his sword freezing in various striking and killing poses.
Ten energy points.
Ten energy points.
Eight energy points.
Five energy points.
Twelve energy points.
Amazing! The damage readout from each slash hitting the PS armor made Wang Lan ecstatic.
"Compatible Star Martial Skills detected. Consume two thousand skill points to link?"
Wang Lan had just finished his experiment when a prompt suddenly sounded in his mind again.
Two more Star Martial Skills to link? I don’t remember learning any others.
He quickly dived back into his Spiritual Sea of Consciousness and opened the system’s skill page to find the icons of four Star Martial Skills flashing in unison."What the hell? Have some shame! You want one thousand skill points for linking two skills, and now a freaking two thousand for linking four? Were the skill points for the previous linkage fed to the dogs? You’re still asking for more skill points?"
Though he grumbled, it was just venting his dissatisfaction. It was a common game tactic: spend for linking two, then spend more for linking four. If he hadn’t only six hundred skill points remaining, Wang Lan would have definitely gone for it.
Even without further linking, Wang Lan estimated his strength had doubled. At least, the problem of being countered due to a single attribute was gone.
Moreover, Wang Lan had discovered something almost outrageously advantageous about himself: his Star Power attributes had no particular emphasis.
Normally, multi-attribute Star Martial Warriors have a focus in their Star Power attributes. Jiang Xinyu was an example: her ice attribute accounted for forty-five percent, and the combination of wind and water attributes made up another forty-five percent. Jiang Xinyu is most skilled in ice-attribute Star Martial Skills; her use of wind or water-attribute skills is definitely not as fluid as her ice skills.
However, Jiang Xinyu was rather unique, as her wind and water attributes were intrinsically linked to her ice attribute. For a multi-attribute Star Martial Warrior lacking such composite properties, the limitations on their secondary attributes would be even more pronounced. But Wang Lan? He made no distinction between primary and secondary attributes.
When he used the fire attribute, it was primary. When he used the Thunder Attribute, it was primary.
As his learning deepened and his knowledge grew, Wang Lan had discovered what truly set him apart—his extraordinary gift.
A system, huh? Right! But even without the system, I’m confident I’d be incredible, all thanks to the unique nature of my Star Power.
His Star Power was inherently attributeless, yet it could directly transform into fire or thunder attributes, bypassing a conventional step. This was why Wang Lan could switch between Star Martial Skills with no delay; the intermediate step that usually caused a time lag was simply omitted.
He went upstairs to his apartment, and after washing up, went straight to bed.
「The next day」
While Wang Lan was still sleeping groggily, Xiao Ai woke him up. "Wang Lan, Jiang Xinyu and the others are here to see you. If you keep sleeping in, they’ll get to see the ’Sleeping Beauty’ in the flesh."
"Piss off! Who authorized you to operate the elevator?"
"You did! You configured it long ago so Jiang Xinyu and her friends can use the elevator directly without verification."
Wang Lan hastily got out of bed. While he was washing up in the bathroom, the elevator door opened.
"I just woke up, make yourselves at home. Xiao Ai, switch to sunlight mode."
Xie Sisi seemed a bit reserved, sitting obediently on the sofa. Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu, however, familiarly headed to the balcony, pulled out the recliners, and settled down.
"Xiao Ai, two colas."
"Sure thing!"
By the time Wang Lan had changed and came out, Jiang Xinyu had taken a USB drive from her bag and handed it to the slowly approaching Xiao Ai butler.
"What’s this?"
"Video footage from the city-level selection tournaments in Jin City and several others." Jiang Xinyu looked up, her gaze concerned as she focused on Wang Lan. "And you? What happened? This is the first time you’ve taken a whole week off."
"I had a mission, the kind only I could handle. But it’s all good now, mission accomplished." Wang Lan smiled and asked, "But how did you manage to get these materials? And you even got videos? I remember how strict the school was about that during our selections."
"With enough incentive, there are always more solutions than problems. Jin City, Chang City, Tong City, and Tai’an City are traditionally the hotspots for championship contenders. Their intelligence reports alone are worth at least half a million."
"Is that so? How much did you spend?"
"One million."
"Lanzi, we’ve already gone through the files. Xinyu brought them especially for you. Study them hard, so you don’t get completely crushed when the time comes," Xu Xiangwen said, sipping his cola with an air of someone who had seen through the vanities of the world.
"Has Xu given up?"
"They’re not human, every last one of them is a monster. Unless I can fully master the Pure Yang Skill, I’ve got no chance. It’s a guaranteed loss. Lanzi, don’t even bother struggling. If you can break through to the Star Cloud Stage before May 15th, with your level of mutation, you might make the top ten. Otherwise, you’ve got no shot."
"Hearing you say that just makes me want to defy expectations even more."
"Don’t be so quick to disbelieve. Take this guy from Tai’an City, for example: early Star Cloud Stage, Thunderfire Attribute. Never mind his Star Martial Skills; he’s a disciple from a reclusive Star Martial family and possesses an ancestral Star Palace Artifact, the Sun Wheel.
Do you know what a Star Palace Artifact is? Experts who have surpassed the Star Sea Stage consecrate their lifelong weapons within their Star Palace. These weapons carry the spiritual will of their former masters. Even after the master perishes, their Star Palace Artifact remains to protect their descendants.
You haven’t seen that guy in action. It’s like he’s using cheat codes! Once he steps onto the stage, he just stands there, casually throws out the Solar Wheel, and it flies right above his opponent’s head, spewing golden True Sunfire. There’s no escape, no hiding. Even Water Attribute Star Martial Warriors can’t counter it.
You either surrender or get incinerated. How are you supposed to fight that?"
"Isn’t that considered cheating?" Wang Lan was surprised. He had heard of Star Palace Artifacts before, from Mingyue Wucheng. However, he had never paid them much mind, as they seemed too distant from his current reality—not something he needed to concern himself with.
The most famous Star Palace Artifacts are legendary divine weapons often depicted in movies and stories—things like the Ten Great Divine Swords, the Xichu Overlord Spear, the Lv Family’s Square Sky Halberd, the Measuring Heaven Ruler, and the Vault of Heaven Shield. But such items were exceedingly rare in reality, and Wang Lan had never imagined one would appear in the provincial tournament.
"Cheating? We all wish it was! But they argue that the Star Palace Artifact is their weapon, a part of their strength. On what grounds should it be considered cheating? If you don’t like it, use one yourself! Tell me, if you face him, how do you fight?"
True Sunfire?
Wang Lan mused, looking up at the sun already high in the sky.
In that case, perhaps my Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth will finally have its use?

chapters.title: Chapter 203 I Just Want Skill Points
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 203 I Just Want Skill Points
"This guy is really tough to deal with, but his reliance on external power isn’t true skill. I studied all last night, and my Frost Aegis Sky should be able to hold up under True Sunfire for ten seconds. If I can get close and engage him in melee within those ten seconds, his Solar Wheel would be broken. I stand a chance against him," Jiang Xinyu said, though she didn’t sound entirely convinced.
"Xinyu, he’s been blitzing through opponents with his Solar Wheel without ever revealing his real strength. But he himself is also dual-attributed in thunder and fire. According to the intelligence we’ve gathered, his true strength is no less than yours. Don’t actually think he became the second-ranked person in Tai’an City just by relying on the Solar Wheel," Gong Feiyu hastily added.
"If you’re all so negative before we’ve even fought, then how can we fight?" Wang Lan asked, spreading his hands with a smile.
"I’m just saying, let’s not get our hopes too high. We’ve done what we can; the rest is up to fate. This competition has too many freaks."
The five of them then went down to the Training Room on the second basement level and trained for a whole day. The exhilarating battles eased the pressure in their hearts. By noon, they went to a restaurant under Eastern Heaven Gate together.
This time, Jiang Xinyu and the others had mainly come to see Wang Lan. Wang Lan had taken a week off, and although Xu Xiangwen said that Wang Lan was on a mission, they couldn’t help but worry. Now that they saw Wang Lan was all right, they naturally felt relieved.
Their training from now on wouldn’t see significant improvement from sparring alone. With the time remaining, it was better to focus on increasing their mastery of Star Martial Skills. For Xu Xiangwen and Gong Feiyu, the A-ranked Star Martial Skills they were learning were still far from being completely mastered. The more they mastered, the better their odds of winning.
After they left, Wang Lan seriously started watching the battle videos secretly recorded from various cities that Jiang Xinyu had sent.
The first battle was between two Star Cloud Stage masters from Jin City.
He watched from noon until night, a total of twenty battles. Wang Lan had only skimmed through them, but the shock he felt lingered for a long time. No wonder Xu Xiangwen, who always preferred to face challenges head-on, was showing such pessimism.
Not to mention the others, but out of the ten representatives from Jin City, Xu Xiangwen definitely couldn’t beat seven or eight of them. The odds for the rest looked fifty-fifty. Xu Xiangwen was, after all, a top-five powerhouse in Suzhou City’s senior high school ranks and had always been considered very strong.
The only ones who could make Xu Xiangwen lose his usual fight were Jiang Xinyu and Mu Shaoyun. But in front of this group of freaks from Jin City, he was completely crushed, with no spirit left to resist.
Apart from Jin City, there were Tong City, Chang City, and Tai’an City – so many freaks in these four cities. Any one of them could easily trash Suzhou City.
The elation from his recent power spike, after linking Star Cloud Sword Dance and Thunder Snake, was instantly extinguished as if by a bucket of cold water. Out of so many people in the videos, Wang Lan was confident against less than half of them.
He gently picked up the coffee in front of him, took a sip, and let his mind sink into the system to look at the four skills waiting to be linked.
Still short 1,400 skill points. If I could finish linking these four skills, I might stand a chance at vying for the championship.
Skill points, huh... short on money again?
Maybe I could take on some missions,
Wang Lan thought, then opened the Tianjian Bureau’s official website and entered the mission area.
With so many already taken, fewer than ten missions remained unclaimed.
Escort a member of our nation’s academic exchange delegation to White Eagle Country for an academic conference, lasting... two months?
Are you kidding me?
Travel to Iceland Country to retrieve a poison sample from a new type of Poisonous Beast, requiring a five-person Star Cloud Stage team?
Forget it, I’m just at the Star Shine Stage, and I’d rather lay low.
A backlog of capital punishment cases from the past year needs clearing. To save national resources and prevent waste, executions are to be carried out sequentially according to their judgment dates?
An executioner’s task? This one doesn’t seem too hard to handle, so why has no one taken it?
Wang Lan hesitated but ultimately did not choose to take the mission. He picked up the phone and dialed a number, recalling the night he caught Duan Ziqi, when Xu Shiyun had come with people from the Shadow Guard Office.
"Hello, Wang Lan, why the sudden call?"
"Xu, I wanted to ask you about something. Do you have any missions suitable for me?"
"Missions? Why, aren’t you in school anymore?"
"I am, but school shouldn’t get in the way of work, right? I am, after all..."
"Cut it out, your job is to study. Seriously though, there are missions—maintaining stability in Suzhou City, investigating Demon Clan spies. Do you have any leads on Demon Clan spies? If so, contact me."
Wang Lan decisively hung up.
If I had leads, why would I be asking you for missions? Looks like I can’t count on that.
He called Lige again. That guy had been elusive these past few months, only surfacing for those few days of fishing; otherwise, he was nowhere to be found.
"Hello! What is it?" The voice on the other end was gruff and low.
"Lige, do you have any missions I can take on? It looks like all the ones at the Bureau have been picked up."
"Yes, I’m on a security detail right now. It’s a three-month assignment. If you want it, I can pass it to you."
"Never mind, sorry to bother you. You’re busy!"
Three months! They’d basically be on summer break by that point; everything would be over.
Taking missions wasn’t an emergency solution. Even if there were suitable ones, the rewards might not be high. With only one month left before the official competition, even if he spent the whole month on missions, it was unlikely he could earn the full 1,600 skill points.
The only way to raise a large number of skill points in a short time would be through Soul Beads.
Maybe I should make another trip to the trial ground? Yeah, that’s a good idea.
"Xinyu, how about we head to the trial ground together this month?" Wang Lan quickly typed out a line and sent it off.
"Don’t you know the trial ground has been temporarily closed for four months?" The reply came back instantly.
"Closed? Why? How come I didn’t know?"
"They said it’s for maintenance, closed right around the time you were on your mission."
Dammit...
He opened a web browser to search and confirmed it was true.
Can’t even go to the trial ground now? There’s only one solution left...
Wang Lan’s expression gradually turned savage, then maniacal.
It’s time to kill someone. Speaking of killing, that yields more than just one skill point... HEH HEH HEH...
"Hey, Wang Lan? Have you found any new clues?" When Wang Qianfeng’s call connected, his opening words caught Wang Lan slightly off guard.
Since when have I been so remarkable in Director Wang’s eyes?
"Cut the crap. If you don’t have any clues, why are you calling me now?"
"Um... Director Wang, we just took out another elite Demon Clan squad. Do you think there’s a chance the higher-ups might give me another Xuan Yue Medal?"
"Just say what’s on your mind. Stop with the awkward attempts to change the subject," Wang Qianfeng’s chopsticks clinked on the other end as he spoke in a low voice, trying to suppress a laugh.
"Director Wang, I just saw on our Bureau’s mission board that there seems to be a recruitment for executing death sentences?"
"Yes, that’s true. What about it? Is there a problem?"
"Do you think I’m suitable?" Wang Lan asked cautiously.
"What do you mean, ’Am I suitable?’ Are you saying you want to take on an execution mission? Are you out of your mind?"
"Nothing’s wrong, Director Wang. Is there something wrong with this mission?"
"There’s nothing wrong with the mission, but it’s a dirty job, and most people don’t want to take it. These criminals can’t be executed publicly, so it has to be handled by our own people from the Bureau. You... are you sure you’re all right? What made you think of taking on such a task?"
"No, it’s just that I was idle and bored. Seeing the organization in need, my heart burned with passion. A little hard or dirty work is nothing. For the country and its people, what’s a bit of reputation? When the deed is done, I’ll flick my sleeves and depart, hiding my achievements and fame."
"Is your mental state a bit off? Should I arrange a psychiatrist for you?"
"Director Wang, my mental state is fine! I’m just acting with a sincere heart..."
"Bullshit! ’Idle and bored’? Do you think I don’t know how heavy your academic workload is? Spit it out, what’s really going on?"
"I’ve just learned a new Star Martial Skill... I’m researching Thunder Activity, but I fear it might harm my body, so... I was thinking of testing it on some small animals. I originally wanted to try it on a little bunny, but bunnies are so cute..."
"You’ve learned a new Star Martial Skill again? Have you been letting what I said go in one ear and out the other? Wait... what did you just say? What are you researching? Thunder Activity?"
"Ah!"
"A Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skill?"
"Yes! An A-grade Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skill, Thunder Snake. Through my research, I’ve discovered that the Thunder Snake Star Martial Skill has the potential for Thunder Activity. If I can complete Thunder Activity before the provincial tournament, my chances of winning will be much higher."
"What nonsense are you talking? You’re a Fire Attribute Star Martial Warrior! What kind of Thunder Activity are you researching? Have you been drinking?"
"But I’ve already learned Thunder Snake."
There was a long silence on the other end of the phone. After a good while, Wang Qianfeng finally said, "Come to the Bureau tomorrow morning."
After hanging up, Wang Lan was sweating profusely.
As expected, lying is not my style; my inability to lie is my biggest weakness.
Early the next day, Wang Lan was awoken by Wang Qianfeng’s phone call.
"Have you arrived?"
"Yes, yes, I’m on my way," Wang Lan quickly said as he scrambled out of bed.
"You’re still f*cking sleeping? I got up bright and early waiting for you, and you tell me you’re still in bed? You have half an hour!"
I’ve made my bed, now I have to lie in it, tears and all.
After getting up and washing, he drove to the Tianjian Bureau. Just as he parked, Wang Qianfeng appeared beside him. "Follow me."
He followed Wang Qianfeng to Building R. Inside, it was bustling with researchers in white uniforms.
"Director Wang, isn’t this... where I came for the Star Martial test?"
"That’s right! We’re giving you another Attribute Test. How could a Fire Attribute Star Martial Warrior possibly learn a Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skill? Unless you’ve cultivated a second attribute. But a second attribute is only possible at the Galaxy Stage."
"And then? What if I do have a second attribute?"
"That would only prove one conclusion: you’ve cultivated a second attribute while still at the Star Shine Stage. That’s something worth researching."
The Tianjian Bureau’s Attribute Tester was identical to the one at the Star Martial Hall. Since this was Wang Lan’s second attribute test, he went through the process with practiced ease. Amidst the CLATTERING printing sounds, the latest attribute test report appeared.
The second lieutenant in the white uniform picked up the report. After one glance, his eyes widened instantly. "What the hell!"
"How is it?" Wang Qianfeng said, snatching the report. He looked at it, and his brow immediately furrowed deeply.
"Director Wang, what is it? Is something wrong?" Wang Lan knew his own status, but Wang Qianfeng’s intense gaze sent shivers down his spine.
"Fire Attribute: 35%. Thunder Attribute: 35%. Yang Attribute: 30%."

chapters.title: Chapter 204: How Many Ways Can a Person Die
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 204: How Many Ways Can a Person Die
Listening to Wang Qianfeng’s words, Wang Lan’s expression relaxed; it was not far off from what he had anticipated. Ever since the Thunder Attribute appeared on his attribute panel, Wang Lan felt that using the Thunder Attribute was not much different from using the Fire Attribute. Concluding that both were at thirty-five percent seemed perfectly reasonable.
If Wang Qianfeng knew about this, he would think to himself, reasonable, my ass!
To say there was a problem with the attribute detector was illogical. Was there any reason that the ones at the Star Martial Hall and the Tianjian Bureau would malfunction simultaneously? If the attribute detector wasn’t the problem, then where did his Thunder Attribute come from? Did he cultivate it himself? But even if he did, how did he cultivate his secondary attribute to be exactly the same proportion as his primary one?
Wang Qianfeng stared at Wang Lan for a long time. "When did you cultivate the Thunder Attribute?"
"I... don’t know... Maybe I’m a bit special. The Thunder Attribute might be a hidden one that suddenly manifested."
"Perform your Thunder Snake," he commanded.
Wang Qianfeng had already given up hope on this demon, so he didn’t continue to delve into how Wang Lan had suddenly acquired the Thunder Attribute. If he kept digging, the only answer he might get would be "God’s arrangement."
Arriving at the Star Martial Arts Testing Field, under the monitoring of numerous unnamed devices, Wang Lan mobilized his Star Power. Instantly, arcs of electricity began to flow around his body.
An arc of electricity suddenly appeared in his palm and then shot out in the direction of his hand. The Thunder Snake traced a serpentine path through the air before striking the erected target.
BOOM—
"Fifty energy points—"
It was nearly the same energy value as that monitored by the PS armor at Wang Lan’s home.
"Activation time was a little over one second but less than two; he’s extremely proficient. The serpentine trajectory of the Thunder Snake indicated a high degree of control over the Thunder Attribute... How many Thunder Snakes can you launch simultaneously?"
"Two. I’m only at the Star Shine Stage and don’t have enough Star Power. Two Thunder Snakes is already my limit," Wang Lan earnestly replied.
You’re actually aware that you’re at the Star Shine Stage!
Wang Qianfeng’s face remained expressionless, but deep inside, he was roaring.
Cultivating a secondary attribute—is that something you, a mere Star Shine Stage practitioner, should be doing?
After a long moment, Wang Qianfeng sighed deeply. "To what extent have you grasped Thunder Activity?"
"Right now, all I know is that Thunder Activity involves mingling the Thunder Attribute Star Power with the body’s cells. The purpose is to stimulate them, activating nerves, muscles, and epidermal tissues at the cellular level."
"Hmm!" Wang Qianfeng nodded, took out his phone, and made a call. "MingXue, are you free right now? Wang Lan is having some issues with his cultivation and needs your assistance."
Then, Wang Qianfeng led Wang Lan out of Building R of the testing center. By the third training field, they saw He MingXue, dressed in a black military uniform and chewing on a toothpick, walking toward them.
"Wang Lan, what kind of cultivation issue requires you to go through Wang to find me? Can’t you contact me directly? Don’t tell me you don’t have my phone number."
"Wang Lan is researching Thunder Activity; I can’t help with that," Wang Qianfeng said.
"Thunder Activity, huh... That’s a hurdle for Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors, one that could halt their progress for life if they can’t overcome it... Wait, Thunder Activity? Isn’t that a concern for Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warriors?" He MingXue looked at Wang Qianfeng, baffled.
"Don’t look at me like that. If you have any questions, ask that demon. He’s cultivated a second attribute."
"Wang, you can’t be serious with a joke like that, can you?"
"Do you think I’d joke with you?"
"Wang Lan, demonstrate it," He MingXue said.
SIZZLE SIZZLE SIZZLE—
The moment Wang Qianfeng finished speaking, dense electric arcs began to dance around Wang Lan. Just to prove he could perform a Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skill, there was no need to actually deploy the Thunder Snake; the surrounding electric arcs were proof enough.
Watching the electric arcs winding around Wang Lan, as if he had donned a coat made of electricity, He MingXue’s expression grew increasingly exaggerated, almost perverse.
The devil within him egged him on relentlessly:
Kill this demon! He’s so damn infuriating, so damn demoralizing!
"What do you think? Any thoughts?"
"Forget it... I’m used to it by now. Just tell me, what’s the problem?"
"Wang Lan plans to use the backlog of death row inmates at the Bureau to complete his research and experimentation on Thunder Activity. Testing it on himself would be too dangerous," Wang Qianfeng said solemnly.
He MingXue suddenly looked at Wang Lan seriously. "How could you come up with such an idea?"
I just wanted to accumulate some skill points; how did I inadvertently take such a twisted path... This is too hard,
Wang Lan thought, close to breaking down.
"Director He, don’t look at me like that. I only came up with this idea after seeing the Bureau post an execution task yesterday. It’s just recycling waste. If you think it’s immoral, I might as well buy some rabbits instead."
"Really? Then there’s no problem," He MingXue said casually.
He MingXue wasn’t opposed to using those who deserved death for Star Martial Skill research. What alarmed him was the idea that Wang Lan would consider using live subjects for experiments without any prompting. However, given the premise of an execution task for death row inmates, Wang Lan’s idea of "recycling waste" seemed quite sensible.
"Do you understand the principle of Thunder Activity now?"
"I do."
"Good. Here, let me first let you feel the state of Thunder Activity; this can save you from taking detours." As he spoke, He MingXue placed a hand on Wang Lan’s shoulder.
A current instantly traveled from He MingXue’s palm into Wang Lan’s body.
What entered Wang Lan’s body was not Star Power, but fine strands of electricity—a micro-current invasion attainable only through extreme control over Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills.
Countless tiny, particle-like currents swiftly surged into every cell in Wang Lan’s body. Each cell seemed to be activated, bursting with strong vitality.
This was the state of Thunder Activity. After Wang Lan had initiated Thunder Activity yesterday, how could that feeling be described? He felt as light as a swallow in the clouds, an exhilarating sense of a heavy burden lifted.
"Wang Lan, remember this sensation. The current for Thunder Activity must not be too strong, as it will damage the cells. Nor can it be too weak, as that would fail to activate them. The ideal Thunder Activity is when every cell in your body feels light and joyful, as if all of them are being massaged by the current."
Having said that, He MingXue released Wang Lan’s shoulder, and the state of Thunder Activity vanished in an instant.
"While Thunder Activity is very powerful, its consumption is also extremely terrifying. To complete this technique, two requirements must be met. The first is physical strength. Even with a perfect proportion of thunder stimulation, it’s still a potent dose for the cells. If the physical body isn’t strong enough, frequent use will overdraw the cells’ lifespan.
"So, after you’ve mastered Thunder Activity, you must build a powerful physique. Moreover, Thunder Activity greatly depletes Star Power. Even I can only maintain it for up to twenty minutes in that state. Thunder Activity is a skill typically mastered by those at the Star Cloud Stage. I’ve seen most Star Martial Warriors at the Star Cloud Stage maintain Thunder Activity for no more than three minutes. As for you... you’re only at the Star Shine Stage, so... Wait, I don’t think I’ve ever seen anyone at the Star Shine Stage master Thunder Activity."
Under He MingXue’s caring guidance, Wang Lan was taken to the Tianjian Bureau’s detention center.
Putting on a snow-white uniform and donning the Death God Mask, Wang Lan became an executioner.
The first prisoner was escorted over. "Xu Mingyi, male, forty-two years old, former captain of an East Sea Pioneer Team. During a pioneering expedition, he led his team to hunt down fellow pioneers, successively plotted the deaths of twelve Pioneer Teams, resulting in one hundred and six fatalities. The evidence is conclusive. Sentenced to capital punishment by the Star Martial Judgement Place. Execute!"
This was a robust man, bare-chested with a full beard, his ferocious triangular eyes glaring at Wang Lan. "Hmph! Hunting down Pioneer Teams is nothing. I was just unlucky enough to accidentally slaughter some highborn young master. Otherwise, who would care about this? Who would bother?"
Wang Lan, with an expressionless face, extended his hand and pressed it against the man’s forehead.
CRACKLE—
An electric arc exploded in Wang Lan’s hand, and the brutal current instantly invaded the man’s mind, destroying his brain. Wang Lan had his own reasons for carrying out the execution; he believed the greatest mercy for the condemned was to minimize their suffering.
"Reward for Slaying Higher-Level Target: 500 Experience Points, 20 Skill Points."
"Er... I might have used a bit too much force," Wang Lan said, turning to He MingXue with a smile.
"No worries, take your time. The Thunder Attribute isn’t easy to control. Come on, next one..."
Five Star Cloud Stage scoundrels were brought out, one after another, each with different crimes. Some had hunted comrades for resources, others embezzled Soul Beads, and some had completely fallen, sinking into the mafia. In short, none of them deserved to live.
Initially, I hesitated, silently apologizing in my heart before each execution,
Wang Lan thought.
But as it went on... dammit, I can’t let you die so easily! Hell, raping a young girl? Slaughtering a village?
These kinds of cases definitely aren’t fit for public announcement. If the common people knew that it wasn’t Exotic Beasts committing village massacres, but the Star Martial Warriors they regarded as their protectors, what kind of backlash would that incite?
A beast like you... even if I char you crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, I should still leave you with a breath of life,
Wang Lan resolved.
Agonized screams tore through the sky. The prison guards escorting prisoners to the execution ground began to look at Wang Lan with increasingly disturbed expressions.
This man is ruthless,
they thought.
The initial executions were just a warm-up, but as it progressed, the way those death row inmates died grew increasingly gruesome. Some were electrocuted until their flesh was mangled and they writhed on the ground, still alive, convulsing. The pleading in the prisoners’ eyes seemed to pierce one’s very soul.
The guards could clearly sense the plea in their eyes:
Give me a quick death! This is too painful!
CRACKLE—
As electricity coursed through him, the prisoner immediately fell to his knees. He opened his mouth to the sky as if to scream, but the arcs paralyzed his vocal cords, rendering him unable to make a sound.
Suddenly, more and more electric arcs converged in the prisoner’s mouth, as if he had swallowed a lit lightbulb.
AAH—
With a bloodcurdling scream, a Thunder Snake erupted from the prisoner’s mouth, shooting straight into the sky.
Witnessing this, the beer can in He MingXue’s hand burst, and he stared at Wang Lan, dumbfounded, his face a mask of utter disbelief.
He MingXue thought,
Aren’t you supposed to be practicing Thunder Activity? What kind of game is this?

chapters.title: Chapter 205 Almost There
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 205 Almost There
WHOOSH! He MingXue arrived beside Wang Lan, his expression shifting as he looked at the limp body of the condemned. To the naked eye, the criminal seemed unharmed.
As a master of the Thunder Attribute, how could He MingXue not see the trick Wang Lan had played? Wang Lan had turned the Thunder Snake, usually a straightforward and direct skill, into something sly and insidious, reminiscent of an assassin’s methods.
The Thunder Snake typically attacks from the surface of the body, making it visible. But to gestate it within the body and then launch it from the mouth was an utterly silent and insidious method, capable of killing someone before they even knew what hit them.
The reason the criminal died was simply that his Star palace had been destroyed, reducing him to an ordinary person, and an ordinary person cannot withstand the powerful current of the Thunder Snake.
"What... what are you doing?"
"Director He, I think I’ve discovered a new way to attack with the Thunder Snake."
As Wang Lan spoke, he turned to face the distance and removed his mask. His body emitted a faint crackling sound of electricity, though the arcs remained hidden inside. Suddenly, Wang Lan opened his mouth. A Thunder Snake shot out, tracing a serpentine path in the air before exploding with a BANG ten meters in front of him.
"This way, the Thunder Snake’s attack telegraph can be hidden. It’s a pity that the power is a bit lacking. After all, the space in the mouth is limited, and internal organs can’t endure as much as the rest of the body."
He MingXue clenched his hands slightly, itching to strangle him.
You still think the power is lacking? Any more and what do you plan to do, launch an electromagnetic cannon? Never mind Star Shine Stage cultivators, even a Star Cloud Stage cultivator caught off guard by your sneaky attack would be paralyzed!
"Are you here to test the Thunder Snake or Thunder Activity, huh?"
"Sorry, sorry, I just discovered it by chance..."
"Bring in the next one."
The prison guard trembled and cast a silent glance at Wang Lan before turning and walking back inside. Shortly after, he brought out another person shackled at the wrists and ankles to the execution ground.
Initially, when Wang Lan executed those at the Star Cloud Stage, he could gain twenty skill points per person. But later, when those from the Star Shine Stage were brought up, he could only gain one skill point each.
This left Wang Lan quite dissatisfied.
"Are there any above the Star Cloud Stage?"
"There are none. Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warriors generally do not break the law; they are the pillars of the nation. The state’s resources and benefits are skewed towards them. Only idiots would commit crimes. Isn’t it good to live in glory and honor?"
"Alright then!"
Wang Lan placed his hand on a man’s shoulder. Electric current flowed, and instantly, crackling sounds emanated from the man’s body. However, the man before him didn’t show any expression of pain. On the contrary... he looked quite comfortable.
The man looked at Wang Lan with a puzzled expression, his eyes carrying a slight challenge.
Is this supposed to be an execution? Are you kidding me? This feels more like a massage, as comfortable as...
ZAP—
Suddenly, a brilliant arc of lightning exploded. In an instant, the condemned man was enveloped in dazzling arcs. A plume of black smoke rose as he was electrocuted, charred on the outside and cooked tender on the inside.
THUD—
The condemned man fell to the ground, and the strong smell of burnt flesh permeated the air.
"How was that?"
"It should be effective enough," Wang Lan replied in a deliberately deep voice. In a moment, a crackling sound surrounded him as well, and lightning arced from his body like threads.
Instantly, Wang Lan’s figure vanished. In his vision, the scene before him seemed to warp and shift, his eyes unable to keep up with his body’s speed.
He was relishing the thrill of lightning-fast movement, his heart soaring, when a wall suddenly appeared in his view. It was too late to stop. In desperation, Wang Lan surged up the high wall, scrambling up it and into the sky with a WHOOSH.
Quickly deactivating Thunder Activity in midair, Wang Lan managed to land gracefully, avoiding embarrassment.
"How does it feel? Fast, right? Did you get the urge to run wild under the setting sun?" He MingXue asked with a hint of a smile.
"It’s alright. I’ve almost grasped the knack of Thunder Activity... but... my body moves too fast; my eyes can’t quite keep up."
"Eyes can sometimes be deceiving. You’ve simply grown accustomed to a certain speed. When it suddenly changes, your brain can’t adjust. But in reality, your eyes and brain are parts of your body. Your eyes and brain can move as fast as your body can. You’ll get used to it with more practice. Shall we continue?"
"No need, I’m not a sadist," Wang Lan forced a smile. After a day’s work, he had only collected four hundred skill points. His total skill points, however, had now fortuitously surpassed one thousand.
"Alright, how many more prisoners are there to execute?"
"About ten or so. We’ll handle their executions ourselves," the prison guard said, a trace of nervousness in his voice. As guards of the Tianjian Bureau, they were known for being cold-blooded and ruthless. Who among the prisoners in the cells wasn’t afraid of them?
But today, they were thoroughly shaken by Wang Lan’s varied execution methods.
They considered themselves cruel, but this Wang Lan was the truly ruthless one. Over twenty condemned men, all killed by Thunder Skills, yet not a single death was identical. They had never before seen someone turn killing into such an art form with so many variations.
"Well then, Director He, I should head back. If I have more questions about cultivation in the future, I will definitely seek your advice again."
"Mm! Wang Lan, I acknowledge your exceptional talent. However, there is one thing on which Wang Qianfeng and I share the same view, and I hope you will take it seriously. Even though you have splendid talent and can immediately learn the basics of an A-grade Star Martial Skill, human capabilities have limits. It’s unwise to chase infinite knowledge with a finite life.
The more you learn, the more superficial your knowledge becomes—broad but not deep, varied but not pure. Instead of pursuing more Star Martial Skills, it’s better to focus on mastering one. This is especially true since you are at the Star Shine Stage, where Star Power is precious. At the Star Shine Stage, your focus should be on breaking through the shackles of the Star palace.
Once you reach the Galaxy Stage, if you have any energy to spare, then you can learn other Star Martial Skills. Moreover, even if all the skills you are learning now are A-grade Star Martial Skills, there are still S-grade Star Martial Skills waiting for you."
"Yes, I will remember your words."
Watching Wang Lan drive away, He MingXue’s smile was as benevolent as the setting sun.
"Has he learned it?" Suddenly, a voice sounded from behind him. Wang Qianfeng materialized out of a gentle breeze.
"Just most of a day... It only took him most of a day to overcome a hurdle that would take many people at least a month."
"With death row inmates to practice on, isn’t that normal? Without such conditions, he’d have to experiment on himself. He could easily get hurt if not careful. Then it would take four or five days to heal before he could continue, only to potentially get hurt again.
Some people get so scared after one injury that they never dare to try again. Others, adopting a sink-or-swim mentality, end up training themselves to death. He has the talent and the ideal conditions; it would be a joke if he couldn’t master it in a day."
"You don’t sound very convinced yourself."
"Unconvinced? What makes you say I’m unconvinced?" Wang Qianfeng turned away haughtily and started to leave, then suddenly stopped. "No, that’s not right!"
"What’s wrong?"
"Wang Lan has healing abilities, so getting injured is the least of his worries! He could perfectly well practice and experiment on himself. There must be other reasons he used prisoners for training!"
Hearing Wang Qianfeng’s words, He MingXue’s expression suddenly changed.
Four hundred skill points wasn’t a small amount, but it wasn’t a lot either. He was still one thousand skill points short of achieving the perfect linkage of four Star Martial Skills. There was still one month until the provincial martial arts competition began. Although, if he weren’t so unlucky as to encounter those freaks right from the start, he could probably gather enough skill points just by getting through a few rounds. But who knew if he would be that unfortunate?
DING DING DING—
Not long after he got home, his phone rang. Wang Lan saw it was Hu Qing calling.
"Hu, why the sudden call?"
"Next Saturday is my sister’s birthday. I’d like to invite you for a meal. I’ll invite Jiajia and Ms. Wang as well."
"Next Saturday? You’re calling me this early?"
"A week in advance, to show my sincerity. You absolutely have to come. I haven’t decided on the place yet; I’ll send you a message once I do."
"Okay!"
After hanging up, Wang Lan stopped thinking about skill points and started to ponder what birthday gift he should get for Feifei. Last time he heard from Hu Qing, she had just advanced to the mid-phase of the Starlight Stage.
The Starlight Stage wasn’t really suitable for learning Star Martial Skills, but Feifei was an exception. When Feifei first awakened, the surge of her Star Power was no less than that of someone at the Star Shine Stage.
What was Feifei’s Star Martial Attribute again... I think it was half Thunder and half Yang,
Wang Lan recalled, opening his computer and logging into the skill area of the Star Martial Hall.
Feifei’s Inborn Talent of the Bloodline was the cancerous, uncontrolled proliferation of bones, an ability incredibly similar to the Corpse Bone Vein, a Kekkei Genkai he remembered from his previous life. While they shared a similar manifestation, there was an essential difference between them.
Undoubtedly, the Corpse Bone Vein was a powerful ability, with nearly indestructible offensive power and unmatched defensive capability. But because this world had never seen such an Inborn Talent of the Bloodline before, Feifei would need to independently discover all related skills herself.
It was unlikely that Jun Malv’s three-stage dance would appear, but exoskeletal armor might be possible. However, that was a matter for the future. For now, Feifei was only at the Starlight Stage, so it was too early to develop her Inborn Talent of the Bloodline.
Feifei’s attributes were excellent, half Thunder and half Yang, which meant she could learn both Yang Attribute and Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills.
Upon first entering the Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills section, he found no low-level skills. The weakest were C-rank, and they were merely auxiliary Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills. Any skill with even a hint of offensive capability started at B-rank.
So, in the entire section, there were only two Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills: one C-rank and one B-rank.
With not much to choose from, Wang Lan switched to the Yang Attribute area. The Star Martial Skills here were surprisingly plentiful, with a dozen or so ranging from C-rank to B-rank.
Among the many Star Martial Skills, a B-rank Star Martial Skill caught Wang Lan’s eye.
Solar Seal?
It involved sealing accumulated Star Power within Yangguan, to be unleashed when needed, providing extra Star Power. The amount of Star Power storable in Yangguan depended on the cultivator’s comprehension, with a maximum capacity of up to three times their normal Star Power reserves.
This is a good skill, but it requires the Yang Attribute to comprise more than thirty percent.
Wang Lan read the introduction of the Star Martial Skill, understanding that if the Yang Attribute was lower than thirty percent, one could not construct Yangguan.
Wasn’t it said that the lower the proportion of the Yang Attribute, the higher the talent? Those with a pure Yang Attribute were an exception.
Wang Lan returned to the Yang Attribute homepage. It also contained an introduction to Yang Attributes, and after reading it, Wang Lan finally understood why.
Everyone is naturally composed of Yin and Yang. The proportion of these Yin and Yang attributes in a person determines their potential to become a Star Martial Warrior of a specific attribute.
For a normal Star Martial Warrior, the proportion of either their Yin or Yang attribute typically ranges between ten and twenty-five percent. Warriors within this range are considered standard. If an attribute’s proportion, like the Yang Attribute, is below ten percent, it signifies that the Star Martial Warrior possesses exceptionally high talent in other attributes and excellent control over their associated Star Power, marking them as extraordinarily gifted. Conversely, if the Yang Attribute proportion exceeds twenty-five percent, it suggests the potential to learn Yang Attribute Star Martial Skills. Reaching above thirty-five percent confirms this potential.
So with my thirty percent, was I hovering on the edge of having talent or not?
Wang Lan felt it was worth a try.
Besides, isn’t there the system, my cheat? If I can learn this, my combat endurance will effectively double!

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Undercurrents Surge
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 206: Undercurrents Surge
Wait, what am I doing? Am I selecting a Star Martial Skill for myself?
Wang Lan gave a wry smile and started searching again.
Body Activation Technique, a C-Class Yang Attribute Star Martial Skill? This isn’t bad.
Activation Technique isn’t only about Thunder Activity, nor is it just about those that improve speed. Some activations stimulate a particular part of the body, enabling it to perform feats that are ordinarily impossible.
This Body Activation Technique also had another name: the Rubber Man Technique. It was an interesting skill that could soften the body, making one immune to most blunt-force physical damage and also somewhat resistant to sharp cuts.
Moreover, the description of this Star Martial Skill mentioned that one could freely change their body, like lengthening arms and bending them in eerie ways. Although it looked horrifying, it was still very practical.
What if Hu Feifei learned this technique?
Wang Lan instantly conjured up a scenario in his mind: the two stood dueling across a distance of over a dozen meters.
Suddenly, Hu Feifei threw a punch, and her arm stretched out over a dozen meters instantly. Caught off guard, her opponent could only defend. Activating her Skeletal Talent, a bone spike shot out like a hidden blade, striking the opponent’s throat and ending in a KO.
There are no useless Star Martial Skills, only useless Star Martial Warriors. With Hu Feifei’s Starlight Stage cultivation, there was still hope for her to learn a C-Class Star Martial Skill.
He placed the order online, planning to make the transaction after school the next day. Ever since he bought the Thunder Snake, Wang Lan’s cumulative spending at the Star Martial Hall had exceeded ten million, earning him the status of a premium VIP customer with the privilege to order online first and trade in person later.
A week passed in quiet busyness as Suzhou City invested substantially in preparation for the upcoming provincial tournament by renting a Magnetic Barrier Venue at the Star Martial Hall, allowing the ten-person representative team to train unrestrainedly.
Of the ten-person squad, only Mu Shaoyun was frequently absent. Everyone else trained with great dedication. Perhaps inspired by the tense and serious atmosphere, the team’s progress was visibly accelerating, especially Xie Sisi, who, despite being the weakest, was improving the fastest.
"Lanzi, the instructor said we could also train tomorrow and the day after. Will you be coming tomorrow?"
"Yeah, why not? It’s a free venue. Why miss the chance when Instructor Qiu, a Galaxy Stage master, is here to guide us?"
"Alright, see you tomorrow."
"Xinyu, don’t take what Instructor Qiu said to heart today."
"Why would I? Instructor Qiu is right. My weaknesses are as prominent as my strengths. It would be easy to target me. I’ll ask him how to compensate for my weaknesses tomorrow."
"Haotian, what are you daydreaming about? Let’s go."
Five days of being together allowed the ten-person squad to gel successfully. Although there were still differences in closeness, they had begun to see each other as comrades-in-arms.
On Saturday, Wang Lan didn’t train as late as the others. Around four in the afternoon, he left the Star Martial Hall, went home to change clothes, and then headed out.
Hu Qing had sent him the coordinates to the restaurant yesterday—it was The Carboniferous, where Wang Lan had previously celebrated with his teammates. Just as he was about to start his electric scooter, his phone rang.
"Wang Lan, why haven’t you arrived yet? Mom and I are already here," Song Jia’s voice came from the other end of the line.
"So early? It’s only four-thirty. I’ll be there in at most twenty minutes," Wang Lan said, then hung up the phone, turned on the power, and the electric scooter roared out of the underground parking lot.
Wang Lan’s electric scooter was the urban commuting version, with a top speed of 120 km/h and a range of 200 km. From Star Mansion to the Ancient City District was just fourteen kilometers. Even at the speed of a regular electric vehicle, twenty minutes was more than enough.
Arriving at Han Ding Square, he spotted Hu Qing waiting at the entrance from afar. Wang Lan approached and greeted him. Hu Qing immediately hugged him and dragged him inside.
In a private room, at a table, were Hu Qing’s family of four, his aunt, Song Jia, and the female police officer who had bought information from Wang Lan at the station.
The officer clearly recognized Wang Lan, her cheeks reddening slightly.
It seems she took my advice to heart and successfully got together with Hu Qing,
Wang Lan thought.
"Brother Hu, congratulations! Even an iron tree has bloomed?"
"Stop your nonsense! What blooming iron tree? It’s still early..."
"I didn’t even say anything..."
"Everyone’s here! Waitstaff, serve the dishes!" Hu Qing, somewhat embarrassed, deliberately changed the subject and ran out of the room to shout.
"Brother Lan..." Hu Feifei held a special affection for Wang Lan and couldn’t help but leap towards him in excitement. "Brother Lan, how long has it been since you called me?"
Perhaps it’s because I pulled her from the depths of despair,
Wang Lan thought, not dwelling on Hu Feifei’s overly affectionate behavior.
"TSK, TSK, TSK... some people... are evolving towards becoming what one might call a creepy uncle..." Song Jia said somewhat sourly as she watched Hu Feifei monopolize Wang Lan.
But what’s the rationale for her dumping this blame on me?
Wang Lan was puzzled.
"Lanlan has indeed been busy lately and hasn’t called me for a long time either," his aunt commented with a teasing smile.
"Auntie, it’s April now, and the provincial tournament starts in May."
"Eh? Right, you’re in your senior year... The provincial tournament is coming up soon. Did you make it to the city representative team? Your mom used to be the captain of the city team."
"Yeah, I’m already on the city representative team. Xinyu is the captain, and we’ve been intensively training with mock battles lately," Wang Lan stated as he sat down.
"Do you think you have a chance? Only the top ten from each province have a shot at getting into the four major academies."
"I’ll try... to bring back a championship," Wang Lan replied.
Hu Qing returned, pushing a trolley with a three-tiered cake on it. A cross-shaped candle was inserted on top.
Hu Feifei and Song Jia were both turning eleven by nominal age, but were exactly ten years old by actual age.
Singing the birthday song, making a birthday wish, and finally, blowing out the candles. All these rituals felt so ceremonial. Seeing the joyful smile on Hu Feifei’s face, a gentle warmth arose in everyone’s heart, like the tenderness of moonlight.
"Thank you. Thank you, Mom and Dad. Thank you, Brother. Thank you, Brother Lan. Thank you, Jiajia. Thank you, Aunt Wang. Thank you, Sister-in-law. Last year at this time, I spent my birthday in the hospital.
"The doctor said it would be my last birthday. I could never have imagined that not only was it not my last birthday, but there would also be many more to come. Thank you, thank you all!"
"Feifei, happy birthday! This is my gift for you," Song Jia hurriedly took out her gift and presented it to Hu Feifei like a precious treasure.
"Happy birthday! This is my gift for you," said Aunt Wang.
"Feifei, your sister here hopes you can be as happy as you are now every day. Study hard, and always strive to be better," said the officer.
"Feifei," Wang Lan said, taking out a metal box and handing it to her. "This is a gift Brother Lan personally selected for you."
"This..." Upon seeing the metal box, Hu Qing’s face immediately changed.
"Wang Lan, isn’t this too valuable?"
"Hu Qing, do you think the term ’too valuable’ suits me?" Wang Lan retorted, feeling the need to counter Hu Qing’s needless politeness.
"Exactly, Wang Lan! Hu Qing is just stubborn. I had already picked something out, but this bullheaded man wouldn’t budge. He made me return it and even argued with me about it!" the policewoman said with a wronged expression.
Hu Qing gave an awkward smile, but he could not refuse Wang Lan’s generous offer.
"BEEP, BEEP, BEEP—" Suddenly, Hu Qing’s phone rang. He glanced at it, paused briefly, and answered the call.
"Zhang, didn’t I tell you? Today is my sister’s birthday. Can’t you handle whatever comes up on your own?"
"What? Are you sure? Okay... okay... I understand..."
After hanging up, Hu Qing’s expression turned somewhat grim.
"What’s wrong?" Hu Qing’s father asked cautiously. "Is there a case?"
"Yeah, Qiu from the Ancient City District has been assassinated... There’s going to be trouble in the Ancient City District..." Hu Qing looked troubled, then suddenly put down his chopsticks. "I have to go. We can’t let a fight break out. Feifei..."
"Brother, it’s okay. Your work is important. I still have Mom, Dad, Auntie, and Jiajia with me..."
"Then... Mrs. Wang, I apologize, but I must leave due to an urgent matter."
"Hu Qing, shall we go together?" Wang Lan suddenly looked up and asked.
"Yes!"
Wang Lan glanced at his System. A new mission had just appeared and was already in progress.
"Auntie, Hu Qing and I will be leaving first..."
"Go ahead, go ahead. Given your current situation... Don’t worry about us."
"Lingling, I’m leaving this place in your care." Hu Qing approached the policewoman, gave her a quick kiss, and turned to leave. Such a bold move made the officer’s face instantly turn red.
Hasn’t he always been clueless? How did he suddenly become so astute today?
Lingling thought, her face still burning.
Getting into Hu Qing’s car, Hu Qing slapped the siren on the car roof. WOO WOO WOO—the siren blared, clearing the way as they sped towards an old residential complex.
"Ever since Mr. Qi and Li were taken down, the tripartite power balance in the Ancient City District, which was like a sword of Damocles hanging over them, has been broken. The underground forces are starting to stir.
"The directive from above is to maintain the stability of the Ancient City District. Especially at this critical juncture, we absolutely can’t have any outbreak of conflict.
"We anticipated movement in the Ancient City District and intervened, urging them to pick a new leader quickly to stabilize the situation. Damn it, if it weren’t for the special circumstances right now, I’d clean them all out.
"They’re shameless, causing trouble at such a critical moment!"
"What critical moment?"
