"The provincial martial arts competition, don’t you know? This year, it won’t be limited to Jin City. Five cities are shortlisted, and Suzhou City is vying for the chance to host. This competition is particularly important. I heard that on the final day of the Jiang Province finals, Eld Di himself will be present."
"Eld Di?" Wang Lan’s gaze suddenly shifted, growing serious.
"What’s the situation with Qiu?"
"Qiu was one of the three old bosses, always suppressed by Li in the past. After Li went to jail, Qiu seized the opportunity to take a good chunk of Li’s territory. Then, Li’s underling, Vulture, regrouped Li’s men and began a counterattack.
"Three days ago, we negotiated with Qiu. He was willing to consider the bigger picture and give up the territories he had taken. In return, we supported him to become the leader of the Ancient City.
"Now, there are dozens of factions in the Ancient City. Some may seem small, but they all have backing from other districts or mafia organizations from other cities. These are remnants of the old order, already integrated into the social structure. Seventy years of post-war governance haven’t completely eradicated these mafia influences; they keep recurring like psoriasis."
"Qiu has been assassinated? What could be the killer’s motive?"
"It’s not clear yet. It could be a vendetta, a struggle for leadership, or an attempt to disrupt the current favorable situation."

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Not Necessarily a Human
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 207: Not Necessarily a Human
Arriving at the scene, it was as noisy as a marketplace. Punks with multicolored dyed hair surrounded the area, hurling insults at each other’s entire families.
"Back off, back off! Don’t come any closer!"
"Fuck your mom! Think you’re hot shit just ’cause you’re a cop?"
"Qiu, I swear I’ll avenge you—"
"It’s the cops who killed Qiu! They grabbed Li first, and now they’ve gone after Qiu! Brothers, don’t give these cops any respect! They screwed over Qiu, so let’s turn their world upside down!"
"Jian, avenge Qiu—"
"Who said not to show the police any respect?" Hu Qing’s voice boomed like thunder through the crowd. As his voice swept over them, everyone present felt a shiver run down their spines.
"Who the fuck are you—"
BOOM—
With a muffled thud, before the talking punk could finish his sentence, his body flew backward, sending the crowd behind him sprawling in chaos.
"The cops are hitting people! The cops—" The shouting abruptly stopped. Realizing no one was echoing him, the punk suddenly clammed up like a rooster with its throat seized.
"Are you fucking looking to die? Wise up! You don’t even know who he is and you’re running your mouth? Don’t drag us all down with you!"
"Who is he?"
"Hu Qing, Senior Inspector of the Suzhou City Police Department and head of the Major Crimes Unit. Li was taken down by him."
"It’s not just Li. Crow from the industrial park, Mr. Qi, and Hei from the brothels—they all fell to him. He’s the Yama of our underworld."
"Damn, he’s that badass? Hasn’t anyone tried to take him out?"
"He’s a Star Martial Warrior. You dare mess with him? If you’ve got the balls, go ahead. Your family and brothers will take care of your funeral arrangements."
"I... Since when did a Star Martial Warrior become a cop?"
"That’s old news, man. The Police Department is recruiting Star Martial Warriors now. The Suzhou City Police Department isn’t the same rule-abiding force it used to be. Let’s just watch and see how the department plans to handle this."
In the past, it wasn’t that the police department didn’t need Star Martial Warriors, but rather that those who idled in the cities weren’t looked upon favorably by the state. They were unwilling to enlist and serve the people, nor were they willing to venture into the undeveloped territories to guard the nation. Lingering in the cities and living comfortable lives, they simply wouldn’t pass the political vetting process.
However, the state was still willing to accommodate Star Martial Warriors like Hu Qing, who had certain unmentionable difficulties. For instance, take Lan Die, who had previously clashed with Wang Lan. After being profoundly traumatized and unable to return to the battlefield to pioneer new territories, the state wouldn’t consider her a deserter.
The police department’s regulations used to be strict. Qualified Star Martial Warriors were reluctant to join, and those who didn’t meet the criteria weren’t accepted. But now, with relaxed regulations, many new Star Martial Warriors have begun to join the police force. Even so, a Star Martial Warrior still had to go through multiple layers of screening to join.
Wang Lan followed Hu Qing to the scene, which was already under police control. A middle-aged officer hurriedly approached. "Captain Hu, the incident happened at five this evening."
"Somehow, word got out that Qiu was collaborating with the police. Rumors on the street claimed that Qiu had allied with the police and sold out Li. Consequently, Qiu had already survived two assassination attempts before this incident."
"Qiu was a cautious man; this was one of his secret hideouts. He had been staying here for the past three days, remotely directing his men."
"After being cooped up for three days, Qiu couldn’t take it anymore and called over a familiar prostitute to blow off some steam. This prostitute, named Qin, was an old acquaintance of Qiu’s, so he let his guard down around her. But who would have thought that this Qin was actually an assassin?"
"While Qiu was... otherwise occupied, she snapped his neck. When Qiu’s bodyguards heard the commotion and rushed in, Qin, completely naked and armed only with a fruit knife, killed two of them and severely injured three before being hacked to death on the spot."
As he spoke, Hu Qing and Wang Lan were led into the room, which was spattered with blood everywhere.
Qiu’s head had been twisted a full 180 degrees, so he lay bizarrely on the bed facing backward. The blood splattered around the room looked like something out of an oil painting, and the pungent, metallic scent of blood assaulted their nostrils.
Hu Qing’s subordinates quickly handed towels to Wang Lan and Hu Qing so they could cover their noses and mouths.
A fair-skinned woman, appearing to be only in her early twenties, lay in a corner. Her body bore seven or eight stab wounds, including two penetrating wounds to her chest and a large gash on her neck.
Near the doorway lay two corpses. One had a hole punched through his throat, while the other’s neck was half torn open, exposing blood vessels and his trachea. Their faces were frozen in masks of sheer terror from before they died, a truly gruesome sight.
"Where are the eyewitnesses?"
"There are three survivors. They’ve been sent to the hospital for treatment. Our guys are at the hospital taking their statements; they should be sent over shortly."
Wang Lan surveyed the scene. Blood was splattered everywhere; ’gruesome’ didn’t even begin to describe it. A single woman had snapped the neck of a head of mafia, then, armed with only a short fruit knife, fought five or six burly men wielding machetes, killing two of them.
Damn it, why does this plot feel so familiar? Like something out of *Naked Weapon*?
"What a formidable woman. It must have taken considerable effort to train an assassin like her,"
Hu Qing sighed, muttering to himself.
"Boss, latest discovery," an officer reported, approaching Hu Qing. "This Qin was a prostitute from Hong’s Phoenix Building. Qiu ordered her services through Hong."
"Hong? The owner of the Phoenix Building?"
"Yes. The owner of the Phoenix Building, who used to form a triumvirate with Li and Qiu."
"Where is Hong?"
Wang Lan followed Hu Qing to the Jun Jue Hotel. By then, hundreds of thugs had already surrounded the building.
"Hong, come on out and greet your clients!"
"Hong, come out! Don’t think hiding will save you! If you had the guts to kill Qiu, then show your face!"
"A bunch of grown men bullying a woman? What kind of heroes are you?" A provocatively dressed woman suddenly stepped out from the Jun Jue Hotel entrance, her voice sharp despite its delicate tone.
"Jiu Mei, why are you the only one out? Where’s Hong? Tell her to come out and entertain her guests!"
"Yeah, the brothers are eager to experience Hong’s ’Phoenix Soaring Through Nine Heavens’..."
"Damn it, why are we wasting time yelling at this broad? Charge in and drag that bitch out! Whoever gets her first can have their fun! Shit..."
"Charge, brothers! Let’s have Jiu Mei as an appetizer—"
"Who dares!" Suddenly, Jiu Mei gave a hard yank, dragging a gas canister in front of her. She plopped down on it and pulled out a lighter.
"Which one of you death-wishers wants to go down with me? Come on over!"
At this sight, the thugs, who had been itching for action, abruptly halted. Then, like a receding tide, they scrambled backward.
"Gutless cowards!"
WEE-WOO WEE-WOO—
Police sirens blared as Hu Qing’s car sped toward them, plowing directly to the entrance of the Jun Jue Hotel without regard for who or how many people were in its path.
Hu Qing kicked open his car door and stepped out. His icy gaze swept over the thugs. "A bunch of trash."
Wang Lan got out of the car and followed Hu Qing toward the hotel entrance.
"Stop! If you come any closer, I’ll light it!"
"Miss," Wang Lan called out, "if you’re going to light a gas canister, could you at least use one that isn’t empty? Who are you trying to scare with a dud?"
Wang Lan’s words caused the faces of several head mafias lingering on the periphery to darken.
SLAP!
One of them struck a subordinate. "Idiots! Scared shitless by an empty canister? Go grab that dame! I’ll deal with her myself!"
BOOM—!
Hu Qing lightly stomped his foot, and a loud explosion erupted beneath it. A shallow pit, half a meter wide, appeared where he stood, cracks spiderwebbing outwards. The thugs who had been about to surge forward froze in their tracks once more.
"Don’t test our patience." Hu Qing snorted coldly, turned, and walked towards the Jun Jue Hotel, brushing past Jiu Mei.
"Inspector Hu, you honor us with your presence. My humblest apologies for not greeting you properly, how terribly rude of me..." A coquettish, seductive voice purred. A voluptuous woman in a shoulder-baring, black see-through dress and sky-high heels swayed towards them.
"You’re Hong?"
"I am."
"Do you know why I’m looking for you?"
"Something must have happened."
"And you know what that is?"
"Inspector Hu, if I knew what had happened, I wouldn’t be in this predicament. My girls and I were just enjoying a game of cards, a little vacation, when suddenly we found ourselves barricaded in. If I’d known something was amiss, don’t you think I would have been prepared? Inspector Hu, what exactly is going on? I can see Qiu’s men out there, and Li’s men too..."
"Qiu is dead!" Hu Qing stared coldly at Hong. "Did you send one of your girls to Qiu’s place today?"
"It was Qin." Upon hearing that Qiu was dead, Hong’s pupils contracted instantly, but her expression betrayed no surprise.
Even before Hu Qing spoke, Hong had her suspicions. The only reason these thugs would dare to target her so brazenly was if something had happened to Qiu.
"Qin killed Qiu. Judging from the struggle at the scene, Qin was a professional assassin. After killing Qiu, she also killed two of his highly skilled men before she herself was hacked to death."
This time, Hong’s composure finally cracked. "Impossible! Qin couldn’t be a professional assassin. She’s been with me for five years, in this line of work for five years! You think I wouldn’t know what kind of person she is?"
"Qin has no dignity, no self-respect; she’d do anything for money. She’s also a hopeless gambling addict. How could someone like that be an assassin? Are you sure you haven’t made a mistake?"
"The evidence at the scene proves it was Qin. We have both witness testimonies and physical evidence."
"This..." After a long pause, Hong finally seemed to accept the reality. "Inspector Hu, if I told you I had nothing to do with this, would you believe me?"
"I only believe in evidence. Right now, I’m hoping you’ll cooperate with our investigation. I don’t have an arrest warrant, so if you’re unwilling, I won’t arrest you by force. What’s your answer?"
"You must be joking, Inspector Hu. If I don’t go with you today, those thugs will torture me to death tonight. Of course, I’ll go with you!"
In the car, Wang Lan remained silent for the entire journey.
"Hey, Lanzi, what are you thinking about?" Hu Qing asked.
"I’m wondering," Wang Lan said, "how much strength it would take to twist a person’s head a full one hundred and eighty degrees. Especially when that person’s neck is twenty centimeters thick."
At these words, Hu Qing’s expression changed instantly.
"We could do it," Hu Qing admitted. "But for an ordinary person, unless they’re a world-class bodybuilder, a real muscle-bound freak, it should be impossible."
"Qin is one point six meters tall and weighs only forty kilograms. She couldn’t possibly possess that kind of strength. Unless... unless she’s a Star Martial Warrior. But if she were a Star Martial Warrior, how could she have been killed by a few ordinary thugs? From the moment I stepped onto that scene, do you know what I felt?"
"What?"
"Unsettling. Terrifying. It was like watching a supernatural horror film."

chapters.title: Chapter 208: The Unscrupulous Head of Mafia
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 208: The Unscrupulous Head of Mafia
"Is it possible that Qin is a professionally trained killer? Even with years of training, couldn’t she achieve that?" Lin, who was driving, suddenly broke the silence and asked.
"Reality is not like the movies. The kind of strength you can exert should match your body size. There is no clever trick to snapping someone’s neck. The only people who can exert strength that far surpasses their physical form are Star Martial Warriors," Hu Qing said, leaning back in his seat.
"But according to the information, Qin couldn’t possibly be a Star Martial Warrior. And the signs of the struggle at the scene are very clear. A woman managed to bite a man’s throat and not let go, tearing off half of his neck in the process. Despite her eyes being slashed blind, she still managed to stab a man in the throat and kill him. I can’t understand her endurance, this determination to die along with her opponent.
It feels like... Qin wasn’t acting on her own, but rather like a... tool.
"
"DING DING DONG, DING DING DONG—" Hu Qing’s phone suddenly rang.
"Hello!"
"Got it..."
After a while, Hu Qing put down the phone and smiled at Wang Lan. "The eight big bosses of the Ancient City are meeting tomorrow night at Arirang BBQ for negotiations."
"Negotiations? About what? Shouldn’t they be fighting since Qiu was killed?"
"Our police department forbids them to fight, so how could they dare? We chose to forbid them from fighting for the temporary stability of Suzhou City. But if they insist on fighting, we won’t be lenient. These mafia veterans are cunning; they know our bottom line very well and when not to cross it. This time, the eight bosses are probably meeting to choose a new head of the mafia."
"Since the mafia doesn’t want chaos, who are you worried about causing trouble now that Qiu is dead?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
"Of course, it’s Qiu’s underlings. When Li was taken down, Li’s men caused trouble for a long time. Back then, with Qiu and Mr. Qi keeping things under control, it didn’t lead to much chaos. But now, with Mr. Qi gone, Li and Qiu gone, and it looks like Hong from Phoenix Building is gone too. Wouldn’t Qiu’s men turn the world upside down?"
Hu Qing chuckled. "Wang Lan, do you think the person who sent Qin could be the one who wants to be the head of the mafia in the Ancient City District?"
"Who could it be?"
"I don’t know. How about we go take a look tomorrow?"
"But tomorrow is Sunday..." Wang Lan hadn’t finished his sentence when Hu Qing’s phone rang again.
"Hello?"
"Team Hu, the autopsy report is out. Ninety-five percent of the blood at the scene belongs to Qiu’s two men, with less than five percent being Qin’s. Moreover, Qin’s time of death should be last night, not this afternoon."
"Last night? Impossible, she just killed people this afternoon..." As these words slipped out, Hu Qing suddenly halted. He was suddenly reminded of the previous case, the bank robbery by the ’Floral Snake’s Six Maniacs’—their autopsies, too, had shown they were already dead.
"Hu Qing, what’s wrong?"
"Wang Lan, it seems the Tianjian Bureau really needs to get involved this time. The autopsy report shows that Qin died last night."
Upon hearing Hu Qing’s words, Wang Lan showed no surprise. Instead, his expression was one of dawning realization, as if to say, ’Just as I thought.’
Qin was just an ordinary person, yet she was able to snap a man’s neck. It was already unreasonable for her to fight to that extent with those skilled mafia hitmen. But if she was already a corpse being controlled by someone else, that would make complete sense.
"Wang Mingling!" Wang Lan coldly stated a name.
Once at the police station, Hu Qing went about his work. Then his aunt called to report that they had reached home safely and everything was fine.
After hanging up, Wang Lan dialed Wang Qianfeng’s number.
"Wang Lan, what is it?"
"Director Wang, Wang Mingling has made a move again."
"Oh?" Wang Qianfeng, who was reading materials in his study, paused and asked in a deep voice after setting aside the documents, "How did you find out?"
"Today, I was having a meal with Hu Qing from the police department when he suddenly received a case. An underground boss in the Ancient City District was killed by a hostess. I went to the scene with Hu Qing and found something peculiar about the hostess. The autopsy report just came out, and it turns out that the hostess died last night. She was just a corpse when she killed people, so... I suspect Wang Mingling is involved again."
"Wang Mingling orchestrated the assassination of a mafia boss? Do you know why?"
"No idea! I just started following this case."
"Then this case is yours. You can report the progress to me at any time, and you can also call me anytime if you need support."
"Um... Am I following up on such a big case alone?" Wang Lan was a bit surprised. Wang Qianfeng used to always hope that he would focus on his studies.
"Yes! Recently, Suzhou City has been targeted by overseas terrorist organizations, which might also be related to Wang Mingling." Wang Qianfeng paused for a moment before continuing, "Half a month ago, a large number of high-value bounties appeared on the international black market. The total value exceeded three billion, targeting hundreds of businessmen in Suzhou City. This flood of assassination bounties attracted many notorious international organizations, drawing them in like cats to the scent of fish. To deal with this provocation, presumably by Wang Mingling, much of Tianjian Bureau’s manpower has been deployed."
"So much has happened in such a short time? Wang Mingling must have some purpose. Did he issue all those bounties?"
"While there’s no direct proof, he’s undoubtedly connected to it."
"There are so many bounties, it’s very likely a smokescreen. Director Wang, could his real intention have something to do with the assassination of Mr. Qiu? And... according to the intelligence from Duan Ziqi, Wang Mingling’s purpose for returning this time might very well be to assassinate Eld Di."
"Assassinating Eld Di is likely Wang Mingling’s ultimate goal. But what all these other things he’s done have to do with that... I just don’t understand." Wang Qianfeng continued, "You follow up on this case. I have confidence in you. If you encounter any difficulties, don’t force things. Your safety must be your absolute top priority."
"Yes, sir!"
After hanging up the phone, Wang Lan’s mind raced, trying to deduce Wang Mingling’s—or rather, the organization behind him—true intentions. The more he thought, the more his head throbbed.
Hu Qing spent the entire night at the office, organizing evidence and searching for clues, incredibly busy. Wang Lan slept in the police department’s rest room. The next day, more detailed clues had been sorted out.
From these clues, there seemed to be absolutely no connection between Wang Mingling and Mr. Qiu. It appeared the motive for killing Mr. Qiu was simply personal dislike, as if Wang Mingling just found him an eyesore and decided to eliminate him.
「Morning, ten o’clock.」
The sun was shining brightly, and there wasn’t a cloud in the sky.
Hu Qing didn’t drive his standard-issue police department car but instead rented one and took Wang Lan to an office building.
As soon as they stepped into the office building, the receptionist rushed to greet them. "Gentlemen, how may I assist you today?"
"We’re looking for Boss Zheng."
"Do you gentlemen have an appointment?"
"No!"
"I’m sorry, without an appointment I can’t arrange a meeting with Boss Zheng. Please make an appointment in advance for next time. Gentlemen, please."
Hu Qing took out his phone and dialed a number. "Hello, Zheng Ji, I’m at your company’s front desk. Come down and get me."
The receptionist initially looked at Hu Qing with a hint of mockery.
Who does Boss Zheng think he is, that people can just see him whenever they want? Why is it that every few days, someone tries to bluff their way in? And now a phone call? Is he calling for backup?
But when she heard Hu Qing say Zheng Ji’s name, the receptionist’s face changed instantly. She bowed her head slightly, acting as if she hadn’t heard or seen anything. From the corner of her eye, however, she began to stealthily observe the two men.
Although they were dressed ordinarily and their looks were... just a bit handsome, their aura was certainly very different. What kind of feeling was it? Righteous? Safe? Sunny?
It wasn’t long before the elevator doors behind the reception desk opened, and a middle-aged, balding man in a black suit and gold-rimmed glasses walked out.
"Boss Zheng."
"Boss Zheng—"
"Good day, Boss Zheng!" The staff at the reception desk kept greeting Zheng Ji, but Boss Zheng seemed not to see them, his eyes scanning the area as he hurriedly walked over.
"Brother Hu! Your presence graces us! Forgive me for not coming out to meet you... Brother Hu, please, come in."
Hu Qing smiled. "I hope my sudden visit isn’t an inconvenience, Boss Zheng?"
"Brother Hu, any time you visit, my humble place is honored by your presence."
Under Boss Zheng’s guidance, Wang Lan and Hu Qing arrived at a conference room on the top floor.
"Brother Hu, what... what brings you here?"
Wang Lan found Boss Zheng’s demeanor strange. This Boss Zheng... didn’t seem like a friend of Hu Qing’s; rather, he appeared quite afraid of him. Yet, the broad smile plastered on his face showed no hint of a villain.
"Tonight, what are you bosses planning for your get-together?"
"Ah? The bosses are having a get-together?"
"You’re playing dumb with me?" Hu Qing slowly lifted his head, his gaze like a killing blade, as if it could pierce one’s very soul.
"No... no... It’s just that Mr. Qiu died. After such a major incident, the brothers need to discuss our future path. We’re not planning to stir up trouble, absolutely no such intentions. Brother Hu, if you’re not happy about it, I’ll call them right now and cancel this meeting."
"Don’t. It would be such a shame to cancel such a good meeting." Hu Qing took a sip of tea. "Tonight, why don’t you take me and my brother here to witness it?"
The words had barely left his mouth when Boss Zheng dropped to his knees with a thud.
"Brother Hu... my dearest brother... you can’t do this to me... In the underworld, I’m just a small fry. If they find out I brought police officers here... they’ll chop me into mincemeat... Brother Hu, I just want to do business honestly now. Please, give me a way to live..."
The corner of Wang Lan’s mouth twitched.
Looking at this man clinging to Hu Qing’s thigh, a blubbering mess, he found it hard to believe this was a head of the mafia. Where was the backbone? The toughness?
"For all the illegal and disorderly things you’ve done over the years—human smuggling, aiding illegal entry—how many years in prison would those crimes add up to?" Hu Qing asked indifferently, unmoved.
"Brother Hu... you’re really pushing me into a corner!"
"How is this pushing you into a corner? Forcing you to testify against those mafia bosses in court, *that* would be pushing you into a corner. Speaking of which, our police department has a lot of evidence that you provided. So, either you cooperate with me tonight, or I’ll publicize everything you’ve done."
"I—" Boss Zheng swallowed the curse he was about to utter. "Brother Hu, you used to say cooperating with the police department was my only way to survive. Now, I feel like it’s my only way to die."
"The only way for you to survive is to ensure those who threaten you are put behind bars. That’s your path. What do you think?"
Boss Zheng took out his phone. "Hello, General Affairs? Send two good sets of clothes over to me..."

chapters.title: Chapter 209: The Inspector is Afraid, We are Even More Afraid
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 209: The Inspector is Afraid, We are Even More Afraid
At nightfall, the small towns of the Ancient City District gradually transformed into a dazzling, dreamy landscape.
In the Ancient City District, large commercial plazas were scarce, and many well-known markets didn’t quite live up to their reputations. The streets and alleys of the Ancient City District still retained the stylistic features of the last century.
If you happened to stumble upon a noodle shop in a deep alley, don’t be surprised; the shop might be older than you.
Following Zheng Ji, Wang Lan and Hu Qing walked along a narrow path paved with fine stones. Wang Lan and Hu Qing were currently wearing suits and black sunglasses. Wang Lan had even glued some stubble onto his upper lip and chin to appear more mature.
This alley, merely a meter wide, concealed bars, internet cafes, and even barbershops. Every time they passed an alley entrance, watchful eyes could be seen peeking from hidden spots.
After traversing the alley, Wang Lan followed Zheng Ji into a spacious courtyard where a round table was set in the center. Dozens of flamboyantly dressed ruffians stood around it.
Six or seven men were already seated by the round table. Lavishly adorned with gold and silver, these middle-aged figures all put on airs, their sitting postures increasingly exaggerated. Though it wasn’t hot, one fanned himself incessantly.
Some rolled Buddha Beads in their hands, muttering ceaselessly, while others looked as if they wanted to prop their feet up on the table.
"HA HA HA... Lord Tian, Lord Fo, Lord Feng... you’ve arrived early..." Zheng Ji said, quickly walking over with a smile and pulling out a chair to sit down.
"Ji’s here? Didn’t you say you didn’t want to come? What made you change your mind?"
"Not at all. I’m indeed not interested in being a gang leader, but it’s been a long time since the brothers have gathered. Coming to have a meal with everyone shouldn’t be a problem, right? Besides, my business has always thrived under the care of all the bosses here, so by sentiment and reason, I had to come show my support..."
"Support my ass! You think this is a birthday celebration? Putting on a grand show of Dragon and Phoenix, are we?"
"Danzi, don’t you fucking disrespect your elders! When Ji was running things in the Ancient City District, you were still suckling milk. Ji, I heard business is booming for you. Some say you’ve wanted to retire and wash your hands of the underworld for a long time. When will that be?"
"Retire and wash my hands..." Zheng Ji chuckled. "You believe that? What era are we in to still talk about retiring and washing hands? If I do, will all the old grudges really be wiped clean? In this life, you can’t always do as you please; retiring is just self-deception. I stepped onto this path at eighteen. If I want to wash my hands, I first have to repay the mountain of karmic debt I’ve accumulated. I owe too much; I can’t pay it back."
Soon, four or five more mafia boss types arrived. Some brought a dozen underlings; others, just four or five. Once the round table was full, dishes from Arirang BBQ were served one after another.
"Didn’t we agree that just the eight of us would meet this time? Why are there two extras?" someone asked, breaking the silence.
"Does Lord Fo have an issue with me? Still sore because I beat you back last time when you tried to step on me? If you’re not convinced, we can go at it again today. You think I, Huang Mao, am afraid of you?"
"What’s a little whelp like you yapping for? Actually think you’re someone important? I wasn’t even serious, and you thought you were a big shot?"
"Enough, Lord Fo. Don’t lower yourself to argue with the younger generation. We didn’t call everyone here today to bicker. Qiu’s gone, but the business he left behind needs someone to take over. We’ve gathered everyone to discuss this seriously."
"Discuss my ass! Territory is won by fighting, not by talking. Why don’t we just fight for it?"
"HA HA HA..." Zheng Ji suddenly burst into loud laughter.
"You old fart, what are you laughing at?"
"Fight? Sure, go ahead and fight. Try it. Back when Mr. Qi was around, and Li and Qiu hadn’t fallen, none of us dared to fight. You dare to fight? Alright, go ahead and hit me. I guarantee I won’t hit back."
"Just make sure you don’t kill me. If you don’t, I’ll be watching you die tomorrow. Do you think Suzhou City is still what it was twenty years ago? Or the Suzhou City of your childhood? Forget the Ancient City District; in the entire Suzhou City, who’s the biggest boss? The Police Commissioner!"
"Damn it, Zheng Ji! Have you fucking been bought by the Commissioner? Why else would you speak up for the police like that?"
"If you put it that way, I can only nod. Can’t help it. The examples of Li and Qiu are right before us; some people are just too blind to see."
"Old Zheng, don’t be angry. You know what kind Pao is, right? He just spouts shit. Don’t stoop to his level."
"Fuck, Lord Feng, are you picking on me?"
"Shouldn’t I? When Ji was the boss, you were just a lackey. What crap are you spouting? Besides, was Ji wrong? Li, Qiu, and even Hong are all in jail now. Today’s Commissioner isn’t the same as before; dealing with us is as simple as lifting a finger for him."
"The Commissioner has only one demand: no chaos, no fighting! No matter how displeased or eager to fight you are, no one can cross this line. Whoever does, we don’t need the Commissioner to act; we’ll take care of him ourselves."
"If anyone wants to die, they can go ram their car into the Commissioner’s; just don’t drag the rest of us down with you."
"Jian, so you’re chickening out?"
"Today, I am chickening out. If I weren’t, I wouldn’t be sitting here. If any of you are tough enough, go ahead, take your brothers out and stir up trouble. But come tomorrow, don’t blame us for being impolite."
At these words, all the bosses fell silent.
"With Qiu’s death, the ensuing upheaval will be huge, and we don’t have much time. Tonight, right here, we need to elect a spokesperson. Whoever it is must immediately stabilize all the brothers in the Ancient City District, and everyone else must cooperate fully."
"How the turf is divided, how it’s taken—the new spokesperson will have the final say. There’s one goal, and no time to dawdle: calm the unrest immediately."
"Jian, what exactly is going on? You look so serious—you must know something. If you don’t tell us, I’m afraid the brothers won’t be convinced. Even as bosses, we might not be able to hold them down."
"You all know the provincial martial arts competition is coming up, right?"
The provincial martial arts competition was an annual event for third-year high school students, considered even more important than the college entrance examination; even ordinary citizens knew about it.
"Yeah, it’s in about a month, isn’t it? What about it?"
"This year, Suzhou City is bidding to host the provincial competition, and several other cities are competing. The provincial committee selects the host city based on public security, environment, facilities, and so on."
"In our Suzhou City, the facilities, environment, and public security are top-notch. Apart from Jin City, no one else can compete. But imagine what would happen if trouble erupts now and Suzhou City loses this bid."
"Guess what the mayor will do when he finds out? You all have an idea of how formidable the Suzhou City Police Commissioner is. Even someone as ruthless as Crow was taken down. Among those at this table, how many could withstand a purge by that cop Hu Qing?"
With these words, all the mafia bosses understood. It was indeed a critical juncture; no wonder the higher-ups were so tense. Moreover, with the Suzhou City Police Commissioner’s power being so potent, they had surprisingly been left to maintain peace themselves without any widespread crackdown.
However, this was just the mafia bosses’ own speculation. Was the Suzhou City Police Commissioner really that strong? Of course not.
Mainly, Hu Qing’s reputation had spread. Underworld ruffians loved to exaggerate, blowing a hundred up to a thousand, even ten thousand. Besides, in their world, does one rely solely on strength? Sometimes, reputation is more important.
Take Hu Qing, for example. Even if he’s incredibly powerful, he’s still just one person. Could one person catch so many? Clearly impossible. But Hu Qing’s notorious reputation alone could make these underworld ruffians freeze in fear at the mere mention of his name.
Mafia bosses might act invincible and bluster in front of their minions, putting on a fearless facade, but who knew how panicked they were deep down? By choosing this path, they had already stepped one foot into the Ghost Gate.
After Qiu’s death, these bosses had been terrified, barely sleeping for days, even abstaining from worldly pleasures for two days.
In the midst of the crowd, Wang Lan’s eyes gleamed.
Suddenly, he seemed to realize a possibility.
Wang Mingling’s purpose in causing trouble in Suzhou City... it might not necessarily be to target Suzhou City itself, but to sabotage its qualification to host the provincial competition!
The moment this guess crossed his mind, many of the problems and doubts he’d considered before gradually began to make sense.
The intelligence Duan Ziqi received indicated the Demon Clan planned to assassinate Eld Di. Eld Di would appear as the guest of honor at the final match of the Jiang Province’s provincial competition. Therefore, the tournament’s venue would dictate Eld Di’s location.
When Wang Mingling was first discovered in Suzhou City, it was likely a distraction. What was the state of the Demon Clan’s power in Suzhou City now? Even Lu Zhao wouldn’t believe Demon Clan spies in Suzhou City could still be active.
Therefore, the actual assassination plan for Eld Di might not even be in Suzhou City. All the trouble Wang Mingling caused in Suzhou City was probably just to push the provincial competition’s hosting rights elsewhere!
Having figured this out, Wang Lan grew impatient to report to Wang Qianfeng.
"Alright, enough talk. Since we’re here tonight to choose a leader, and everyone here is qualified, let’s follow the rules of the underworld. We’ll settle it with a fight and elect an alliance head."
"I have no objections to fighting, but you lot are old bones. Can you still move?" Danzi, one of the bosses, tightened his fists and sneered.
"We’re all bosses; it would be undignified for us to get involved personally. We can each choose one of our men to fight in a direct one-on-one battle. The last one standing will be the leader. We’ll delineate the turf tonight, fix everything by tomorrow, and by the day after, the Ancient City District will be completely stable."
"Agreed."
"No problem for me."
"Can I join in?"
"You can. We’re old; we can’t fight anymore. If it were twenty years ago, we would have fought ourselves."
"HA HA HA... I won’t join. I have no interest in being the spokesperson anyway. You all choose. Once it’s decided, I’ll just listen," Zheng Ji quickly said with a laugh.
"Ji, with your financial resources and seniority, you’d have no problem competing for spokesperson. And though you brought few people today, the two young men with you seem extraordinary. They’ve been standing there for so long without moving a muscle."
"HA HA HA... They’re security guards I hired. Security guards! They’re ex-military, so of course, their presence is different. I just want to do business peacefully and hope people forget I’m from the mafia. Why would I want to be a spokesperson? You all choose, go ahead."
"Alright, stop dawdling. I’m up first. Come on, who wants to fight me? I still need to eat after this..." Danzi stood up, took off his jacket, revealing his solid muscles underneath.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 Further Clues
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 210 Further Clues
Accustomed to seeing Star Martial Warriors fight, Wang Lan initially had little interest in the clashes between ordinary people. But, surprisingly, their fights turned out to be unexpectedly exciting.
The development of this world was, after all, different from his previous life. With the progression of human civilization, a strong martial fighting culture had evolved alongside the Star Martial Warriors.
Especially the mafia, which was born from the pugilistic circles of the old society, had many ancient martial arts schools take root and flourish within it. What he thought would be simple brawling was actually a display of skilled martial artists engaging in brilliant combat.
Without Star Power or Star Martial Skills, ordinary martial artists had to rely more on technique. Their moves ranged from close-quarters combat to wide, sweeping attacks.
After three rounds, Danzi surprisingly took the triple crown.
"No wonder Danzi could claim such a large territory in such a short time; his skills are indeed impressive."
"They’re impressive, but he’s too arrogant. If he becomes the leader, he’s more likely to stir up trouble."
"Who else is there?" Danzi knocked a blond-haired man unconscious with a punch, then cracked his knuckles. "Why isn’t there anyone else who can fight? Bosses, don’t you have any skilled people under you?"
"Danzi, that’s going too far," Lord Fo said, seated above, slowly raising his head as he shifted his prayer beads. "Song Ting, come and test Danzi’s skills."
As Lord Fo finished speaking, a young man emerged from the crowd. Seeing Song Ting, Wang Lan’s lips curled into a casual smile.
This just got interesting.
"You know him?"
"He’s my classmate. He used to be part of Duan Ziqi’s Commoner Genius Association. The Tianjian Bureau secretly monitored him for half a month and only let him go after clearing him of suspicion. I never expected this..."
"Lord Fo, are you out of people? Why choose this young whelp who hasn’t even fully matured?" Danzi mocked upon seeing the young Song Ting.
"Be careful, Danzi."
"Enough talk. Bring it on."
As soon as the words were out, Song Ting’s figure flashed, rushing in front of Danzi like lightning and aiming a punch straight at his nose. The speed was faster than Danzi had anticipated; he hurriedly raised both hands in front of his face, trying to block Song Ting’s punch.
"BANG—"
Song Ting’s fist landed with a thud on Danzi’s arm. A crisp crack sounded. Despite Danzi’s blocking attempt, Song Ting’s relentless punch struck him squarely in the face.
BANG—
Another crisp sound, and Danzi’s nose visibly collapsed.
Before he could even scream, the previously indomitable Danzi was knocked straight to the ground. Blood gushed from his mouth and nose, instantly blurring his entire face.
"Brother Danzi!"
"Brother Danzi—"
His subordinates hurriedly rushed over and helped Danzi to his feet. However, his arms were already massively swollen and unnaturally bent, clearly indicating broken bones.
"Fuck you..."
Song Ting swung his leg lightly, and another blond-haired man, who was about to spit out more curses, had half his teeth fly out of his mouth.
"A Star Martial Warrior?"
"A Star Martial Warrior?"
Several bosses immediately stood up nervously, shock written all over their faces.
The first Li used to hold considerable sway in the Ancient City District because he had a Star Martial Warrior named Ghost Face under him. Unexpectedly, Lord Fo, who had always been suppressed by Li, also had a Star Martial Warrior in his ranks.
"Lord Fo, you’ve hidden your cards well. When did you recruit a Star Martial Warrior?"
"It was thanks to Mr. Qi’s blessing. He introduced Brother Song to me back when Mr. Qi wanted me to contain Li. But I, Lord Fo, am not an ungrateful person. As long as Li didn’t wrong his brothers, he was always my boss. I’ve always taken good care of Brother Song.
Now that Li is gone and Qiu has departed, in terms of seniority, I, Lord Fo, have been in the Ancient City District for nearly thirty years. In terms of strength, I’m no weaker than any of you. Am I, Lord Fo, qualified to be the spokesperson?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the few mafia heads who hadn’t sent anyone into the ring looked distinctly uncomfortable.
They all wanted to be the spokesperson, but they lacked Star Martial Warrior enforcers. Moreover, with a Star Martial Warrior by his side, Lord Fo could indeed treat them as individuals who could be crushed at will.
Even if they were dissatisfied now, they could always be beaten into submission later.
After some thought, they eventually sat back down in resignation.
"Since Lord Fo has said so... we have nothing more to say. I, Old Jian, am convinced."
"I, Black Skin, am also convinced."
"I, Li, think there’s still a fight to be had."
Suddenly, Lord Fo lifted his head and stared sharply at Li, who had been silent until now.
I’ve been careless,
Lord Fo thought, his heart suddenly alert.
This seemingly harmless guy is actually a smiling tiger.
"So, Li also has a Star Martial Warrior enforcer?"
"Hehehe... Rose, come and entertain this young brother a little."
As Li’s words ended, a wave of fragrance instantly swirled through the crowd. A tall woman dressed in glossy black leather and heavy makeup squeezed her way through the throng, stepping toward Song Ting.
In Rose’s hand was a Butterfly Sword, its dazzling blade work blooming in her grip like a butterfly fluttering between her fingers.
"Lord Fo, hand me a dagger," Song Ting demanded coldly.
Lord Fo nodded back, and a subordinate quickly presented a dagger. Clutching the dagger, Song Ting took a deep breath. In an instant, his figure flashed as he charged toward the woman opposite him.
CLANG—
A crisp sound rang out the moment the two met. In a flash, the rapid sound of metal clashing erupted. Both Song Ting and the woman were as swift as lightning, their every move a blur to onlookers. The collision between the dagger and the Butterfly Sword was like the constant crackling of firecrackers.
But as the two engaged, both Wang Lan and Hu Qing couldn’t help but furrow their brows.
Song Ting’s performance was relatively normal, but there was something odd about the woman. She was fast, yet there was no Star Energy Fluctuation. The human body has limits to its speed; for example, in a hundred-meter sprint, the limit is breaking the ten-second mark—it’s impossible to go faster.
If you can run it in under nine seconds, you are certainly surpassing the human running limit, something only a Star Martial Warrior can achieve. Star Martial Warriors can do this because of the enhancement Star Power provides to their bodies.
But with that woman, not even Hu Qing could sense any Star Energy Fluctuation.
Either her strength is so profound that she doesn’t even need to use Star Power against Song Ting, or this woman isn’t normal.
As the fight intensified, Song Ting gradually found himself in grave danger. The ferocity of the woman before him increasingly shattered his understanding.
Although Song Ting was a Star Martial Warrior, he was, after all, just a high school student. He had never experienced a life-and-death battle, nor did he possess the fearless drive to risk everything in a mutual destruction. When the woman traded injury for injury, slashing Song Ting’s arm, his momentum clearly dissipated.
Eventually, it was almost as if the woman was chasing Song Ting around, beating him. Even though Song Ting deployed multiple fighting techniques and severely wounded the woman several times, his own wounds were bleeding profusely. In contrast, only scant traces of blood were present on the woman’s injuries.
"Could she be a Star Martial Warrior with a body-enhancement type talent?" Hu Qing asked gravely.
"’That’s not it. Look at her eyes,’ Wang Lan said. He had already locked onto the woman with Farsight Vision and noticed her eyes were vacant, utterly devoid of spirit."
"I’m done fighting! I’m done! I concede—" Song Ting broke down, suddenly shouting as he scrambled backward.
But the woman relentlessly pressed on, her Butterfly Sword targeting Song Ting’s vital points with every move.
"Act!" Wang Lan’s voice thundered as his figure flashed next to Song Ting, kicking him aside. He precisely grabbed the woman’s wrist that wielded the Butterfly Sword.
The scene abruptly froze. This sudden turn of events left everyone speechless.
Wang Lan had instantly stepped into their fight, subduing both Star Martial Warriors with a single move. Was there even a need to state his strength? He was clearly a master who far surpassed the other two.
But... we’re just a bunch of mafia guys, aren’t we? Since when did our circle have so many hidden dragons and crouching tigers? When did so many extraordinary masters start popping up?
Shocked, Lord Fo looked at Wang Lan and then turned to face Zheng Ji. "Ji... so you’re the real dark horse."
Zheng Ji remained calm, smiled, and said, "I, Old Zheng, am not participating in the spokesperson election, and that still stands. The reason I let my subordinate intervene was merely to prevent any hard feelings among everyone. Since Lord Fo’s side has conceded, Li, wasn’t your fighter a bit too excessive?"
Wang Lan, still holding the woman’s wrist, suddenly changed his expression. He quietly pressed his fingers to her pulse.
No pulse. This is a dead person!
"Hu, take down Li! He killed Qiu."
As Wang Lan’s words fell, Li’s face turned ashen in a flash. He turned to leave, but at that moment, Hu Qing had already transformed into a streak of light and appeared in front of him, capturing Li in one swift move.
Li’s underlings didn’t even attempt to save their boss, merely watching as Hu Qing subdued Li.
"Ji, what are you doing?" one of the bosses asked.
"Zheng Ji, what the fuck do you think you’re doing?" Li, captured by Hu Qing, suddenly roared.
"Bosses, let me explain," Wang Lan said nonchalantly as he let go of the woman’s hand. She fell limply to the ground, dead. "Everyone knows Ji and Qiu were like sworn brothers.
Since Qiu died, it’s natural Ji would seek revenge for him. Ji learned from the police department that the one who killed Qiu wasn’t some Miss Qin. Miss Qin had already died the day before she supposedly killed Qiu.
There’s a Star Martial Warrior who can control corpses; this ability was used to control Miss Qin to kill Qiu. Just now, I became suspicious because this woman seemed unafraid of death. Seeing so few wounds on her solidified that suspicion.
This woman isn’t alive; she’s just a corpse being controlled by someone. Since you brought her here, Li, it means you’re the one who killed Qiu."
"FUCK!" Lord Fo slammed the table and shot to his feet. "I can’t believe it was you—"
"Bai Li, to think you were so ambitious, so ruthless! We truly didn’t see it coming!" the other bosses, having caught on, exclaimed in outrage. Meanwhile, the incriminated Li’s face went as pale as death. "Mr. Jin, save me—"
Instantly, Wang Lan and Hu Qing sensed danger. Almost by reflex, Hu Qing rolled away, gripping Li. Behind where Li had stood, one of the henchmen’s heads exploded.
This sudden, horrifying turn of events drained the color from everyone’s faces.
Wang Lan sharply turned towards the direction of the attack. "Farsight Vision, activate—"

chapters.title: Chapter 211 Human Bomb
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 211 Human Bomb
In the instant Wang Lan activated Farsight Vision, a silhouette flashed across the distant hotel’s rooftop, soaring into the sky. It was at least five hundred meters away; even a Crescent Arrow couldn’t catch up.
"He’s gone," Wang Lan said indifferently.
"You... Who exactly are you people?" Li cried out shrilly. "You can’t possibly be Zheng Ji’s men! How could Zheng Ji recruit experts like you?"
"Hahaha..." Zheng Ji picked up a towel and wiped his hands. "Old Li, Old Li, if you can’t do something, don’t assume others can’t either. You want to compare yourself to me? What gives you, punk, the right to compare yourself to me? When it comes to seniority, I’ve been a boss ten years longer than you. When it comes to wealth, ten of you combined wouldn’t match up to one of my fingers. You judge me by your standards? Do you think everyone else is as incompetent as you? I run such a big business. Is it so difficult to find a couple of Star Martial Warrior experts? Haven’t you ever heard the saying, ’money talks’?"
As he spoke, Zheng Ji stood up and smiled at several of the bosses. "Being the leader? I don’t care for it. But whoever harmed Qiu, I won’t let it rest with them. Continue your talk. I’ll take this son of a bitch, Li, away."
"Ji, why don’t you... become our leader?"
"Yeah, Ji, you have the money and the manpower..."
"Enough said. I, Old Zheng, have no such ambition. I toast you all. Farewell."
Zheng Ji turned and left, Hu Qing pressing Li to hurriedly follow. Supported by others, Song Ting watched Wang Lan’s retreating figure, a contemplative look in his eyes. This figure... he found it very familiar. Yet, for the life of him, he couldn’t remember whose it was.
"Communication team, communication team, please lock onto my location."
"Captain Wang Lan, I’ve locked onto your location. Please go ahead."
"Southeast of my position, on the top floor of the Express Hotel, a sniper attacked me five minutes ago. I request a follow-up investigation."
"Understood!"
Sitting in the car, Wang Lan quickly called the communication team for support. After hanging up, Li, pale with fear, stared at Wang Lan, then whipped his head around to look at Zheng Ji.
"Zheng Ji, you fucking traitor! You’ve been with the police all along? You sold us all out? Son of a bitch, you’re dead! You’re so fucking dead!"
"I don’t know if I’m going to die, but you’re definitely finished. The news about you killing Qiu will spread through both the underworld and law enforcement by tonight. Not only will you die, but your entire family will meet their end. Collaborating with the police is your only way out."
"Damn it!"
After driving back to Zheng Ji’s company, Li was quietly transferred to the police station. Hu Qing escorted Li to the interrogation room, and the Tianjian Bureau’s investigation results also arrived.
"Captain Wang, my apologies, but we couldn’t trace the target’s whereabouts. The target has strong counter-surveillance awareness and avoided all cameras. We only found one photo, captured by a shop’s security camera."
Soon, a photo appeared on Wang Lan’s phone. It featured a blonde foreigner with sunglasses obscuring his features. His hair, styled to look like flames, was quite eye-catching.
Wang Lan sent the picture of the foreigner to an internal group. "Brothers, does anyone recognize this foreigner?"
Quickly, the previously quiet group came to life.
"A missing person has surfaced?"
"Wang Lan, is this foreigner your target? What did he do?"
"This foreigner’s look, with that hair and sunglasses, is quite distinctive..."
"I know!" Suddenly, a reply popped up in the group: "This guy works for Wang Mingling."
"Captain Ma, are you sure?"
"Wang Lan, do you remember when Mu Liancheng was assassinated? That night, three foreigners attacked the Mu residence. You killed one on the spot, and the other two fled. This was one of them, Flame Fire."
"And the other one?"
"The other one uses wind and thunder dual-arts and has shoulder-length hair."
"Okay, thanks a lot."
Wang Lan put away his phone and entered the police station’s interrogation room. Hu Qing was just preparing to interrogate Li.
"Li Dongliu, I advise you to cooperate. Once you’re here, cooperation isn’t optional. Even if you don’t cooperate, we have ways to make you talk. How long do you think you can resist?"
"Inspector Hu, I’m well aware of your fearsome reputation. Street-level guys scatter at the mere mention of your name. How would I dare resist you? Even Boss Zheng, respected by everyone on the streets, has become your informant. How could I underestimate your capabilities? But every family has its struggles, and I had no choice. If you could bring my family here, I wouldn’t just confess; I’d thank you even if you executed me on the spot."
"Where is your family?"
"I don’t know. If they hadn’t threatened my family, would I have worked with them? Inspector Hu, I beg you, don’t ask me. I can’t say, even if it kills me."
Wang Lan walked into the interrogation room, lightly flicked the photo he held, and casually placed it in front of Li Dongliu. "You know this person, don’t you?"
Li Dongliu’s expression changed. He opened his mouth but eventually held back his words.
"He’s a member of the International Mercenary Organization Hellfire. He’s a criminal wanted by eighteen countries and designated by the World United Security Organization as a member of a terrorist organization.
If he’s the one cooperating with you, if he’s the one who took your family... what do you think would happen to them? Or, at this point, do you still harbor any hope that your family could be alive?
Instead of clinging to unrealistic hope, you should consider cooperating with us to avenge your family."
"But I really don’t know anything... He just wanted me to become the leader in the Ancient City District, to take control of the sector while the police are too busy to intervene. I don’t know anything else."
"Why would they do this? What is their purpose? What are their plans?"
"Maybe... it’s for money?" Li Dongliu said, as if taking the question seriously.
"They came all the way from the Middle East and Northern Europe just for money? Do you think anyone would believe that?"
"Then... I really don’t know. Their orders only went that far. My family was taken hostage, so I had to do whatever they said."
"Hu," Wang Lan suggested, seeing Li Dongliu’s uncooperative attitude, "why not get someone to perform a Spiritual Engraving?"
"What do you think this is, your Tianjian Bureau?" Hu Qing retorted. "We don’t have Spiritual Engraving here."
"Then what should we do?"
"Don’t worry, leave it to us. We guarantee he’ll spill everything by morning. It’s already quite late. Why don’t you go home and rest? Don’t you have school tomorrow?"
School? Those two words, which once held such a sacred mission in my heart, now seemed almost laughable. Ever since I took a week off last time, my sense of duty towards school isn’t as strong. School is precious, indeed, but points are dearer; if experience is involved, both can be cast aside.
The provincial martial arts tournament was just around the corner, and everyone was actively preparing. Training and sparring were just ways to get used to the rhythm of fighting and keep their nerves from slackening.
But if there was a chance to improve one’s strength before the competition, training and sparring could be completely set aside. Take Mu Shaoyun, for example. After joining the city’s representative team, he only came to school occasionally. I heard he was cultivating a secret technique.
Wang Lan was currently at Star Shine Nine and needed one thousand more skill points to link four types of Star Martial Skills. Skill points or experience—he urgently needed both. Seeing a wealth of experience right before his eyes, how could he miss out?
He decisively dialed his homeroom teacher’s number.
"Hey, Teacher... I’d like to ask for leave. A week should do it. Yes, yes, to perfect my new ultimate move... That’s right, that’s right. Don’t worry, if I’m not confident before the provincial tournament, I’ll drop out beforehand. Yes..."
He slept at the police station that night. The next morning, Wang Lan was woken by the aroma of breakfast. When he opened his eyes, he saw Hu Qing’s current girlfriend, the policewoman named Lingling.
"You’re awake? I bought you a toothbrush and toothpaste. Wash up and let’s have breakfast," Lingling said with a smile, even more cordial and natural than the day before yesterday.
"Morning, Lingling. How long did it take you to win over Hu?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
It’s only been a little over a month, yet they already seem like family, eating together.
"Hu Qing is very busy with work and sometimes can’t manage to pick up Feifei. One time, I offered to help pick Feifei up, and after that, I was the one picking her up almost every time. Gradually, I grew familiar with Feifei, and his parents.
You’re right. Once Hu Qing’s family accepted me, it didn’t matter whether Hu himself did or not. Heh heh... Just like that, he fell into the palm of my hand. Hahaha..."
"Lingling, a little decorum, please..." Wang Lan reminded her, his face impassive.
"So you’re not really Hu Qing’s cousin, huh?" Lingling suddenly asked.
"You were the one who assumed that. I just went along with your idea. Where’s Hu Qing? Is he up yet?"
"He was interrogating all night and just lay down to rest."
"What’s the result?"
"He’s stubborn as a mule. Besides, our police station has rules; we can’t torture suspects! If it were the old me, I would’ve beaten him until he couldn’t take care of himself long ago," Lingling said, flexing her small fists fiercely.
"RING RING RING—" Suddenly, the phone in Hu Qing’s office rang.
"Hello, this is Wu Ling. Inspector Hu was busy all last night and just went to rest... Okay, I’ll tell him."
After hanging up, Wu Ling looked impatient. "Push, push, push! There are so many people at the police station; why does Hu have to handle everything? Is Hu Qing the only officer, and everyone else is just freeloading?"
Although she complained, she still stood up and headed towards the break room. A short while later, Hu Qing came into the office, rubbing his eyes. Seeing Wang Lan, he smiled.
"How did you sleep last night? Okay?"
"I’m fine. Six hours of deep sleep."
"Juntin Mansion was just attacked; the target was a local tycoon. We interrogated Li Dongliu all last night, and he still insists he knows nothing. But I can tell from his eyes that his willpower is almost gone. By tonight at the latest, we’ll definitely crack him."
Wang Lan’s eyes flashed with eagerness. "Is this related to the recent assassination bounties placed on a hundred tycoons in Suzhou City?"

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Luring the Snake out of the Cave
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 212: Luring the Snake out of the Cave
"A hundred billionaires are being offered bounties for their assassination?" Hu Qing asked in astonishment.
"You don’t know?"
"I don’t. What’s going on?"
"Come on, let’s talk as we go," Wang Lan said, pulling Hu Qing out the door. They got into the car, and Hu Qing drove towards the incident scene.
"Half a month ago, a bounty worth a total of three billion appeared on the international black market, targeting the top one hundred tycoons from Suzhou City. No one knows who issued these bounties, but it’s certainly a declaration of war on Suzhou City. The Tianjian Bureau reacted immediately, deploying a large number of personnel to protect these tycoons. So, when I heard about the human bomb attack, the first thing I thought of was this bounty. Human bombs are a common tactic used by terrorist organizations, and Juntin Mansion is a top-tier villa district in the new area, inhabited by the city’s wealthiest and most influential."
"So what’s the purpose of the person who initiated the bounty? To spend three billion to cause chaos in Suzhou City? And since when did terrorists become so wealthy?"
"That’s why the real mastermind behind this definitely isn’t a terrorist. At least, not the one providing the money."
After concluding this topic, Wang Lan and Hu Qing arrived at the crime scene at Juntin Mansion. The site was already secured by the mansion’s security, who had even set up professional barricade tape.
The incident had occurred in the front garden of a villa. The explosion had a radius of fifteen meters, indicating a very powerful bomb. Most of the villa’s windows were shattered, and by the time Wang Lan and Hu Qing arrived, the owner of the villa still hadn’t appeared.
"Wang Lan, what brings you here?" a voice called out. At the villa’s entrance, Lige, dressed in a black suit, asked with a hint of surprise.
"Lige? Did the Bureau send you to handle this?"
"No, I was assigned to protect Mr. Wan seven days ago. I was his bodyguard when the attack happened," Lige explained, then waved to the security guards at the entrance. "They’re with us, let them in."
Entering the villa, Wang Lan finally saw a middle-aged man sitting on the couch. His hair was slick and meticulously combed, and he exuded the imposing aura of a powerful figure.
"This is Mr. Wan, the chairman of Tongming Jewelry Group. Mr. Wan, this is my colleague Wang Lan, and this is Hu Qing, a Senior Inspector from the police department."
"Greetings, officers. Please, have a seat. Zhang, serve tea for the officers..."
"What exactly happened today?" Wang Lan asked, getting straight to the point after sitting down.
"This morning, around seven, a girl who looked like a student, appearing to be seventeen or eighteen years old and with a large pregnant belly, came and sat down at the villa’s entrance. When a security guard inquired, she claimed to be Wan Qirui’s girlfriend. She said he had gotten her pregnant and was refusing to take responsibility, so she had come to seek justice. By the way, that girl wasn’t ordinary either. She is the only daughter of the president of Golden Circle Entertainment Company. Due to her identity, I wasn’t overly cautious and accompanied Mr. Wan outside. Unexpectedly, the girl was actually there to carry out a suicide bombing; her protruding belly was strapped with explosives. Luckily, I was alert and evacuated Mr. Wan just in time."
"The only daughter of the president of Golden Circle Entertainment?" Hu Qing’s expression suddenly darkened. He took out a photo of a middle-school student from his breast pocket. "Is it her?"
"Yes, it’s her."
Hu Qing and Wang Lan’s faces turned grim, and they let out a long breath. "Truly ruthless!"
"What? Are you also investigating her?" Lige asked.
"Last night, we cracked a case. Li Dongliu, the president of Golden Circle Entertainment, might have been colluding with Wang Mingling. Li Dongliu was arrested last night. According to his confession, he was forced to obey the terrorist organization only because his family had been kidnapped. Although they had anticipated such an outcome, witnessing it firsthand was truly distressing for them."
"Are there surveillance cameras around the villa? Is there a recording of the human bomb attack?"
"Yes!" Mr. Wan quickly replied.
The terrorist attack had not succeeded, and the motive for the attempted assassination of Mr. Wan seemed unrelated to him personally. The attacker had already been blown to pieces by the bomb, leaving no further leads to pursue regarding them.
Hu Qing copied the surveillance footage and drove back to the police department, leaving the follow-up work to his subordinates.
「 」
Inside the interrogation room, a guard was still tirelessly questioning Li Dongliu, repeating the same questions.
At this moment, Li Dongliu was in a terrible state; his eyes, vacant and bloodshot, held a fierce glint.
"Stop asking. I won’t say anything more; you might as well kill me. My entire family’s lives are in their hands. If you’re so capable, then rescue my entire family.
"As long as my family is safe, I’ll tell you whatever you ask. By forcing me to talk now, you’re just pushing them to kill my entire family."
"They are ruthlessly violent terrorists. Do you think they will honor any promise to you? Think about it: what were they trying to do before you were arrested? They were trying to kill you to silence you, weren’t they?"
"I wish they had silenced me. If I had been killed, my family might have been spared..."
"Really? As cruel and murderous as they are, they might have already killed your entire family by now... Don’t you want to avenge them?"
"Don’t push me... Don’t push me... This is my last thread of hope... My very last..."
BANG—
The door was pushed open, and Hu Qing entered the interrogation room, his face grim. Without a word, he activated a control panel on the wall, and a projector screen slowly descended.
He inserted a USB drive into the projector. The image lit up, a timestamp in the bottom right corner showing: Today, 6:50 AM. In the video, a girl with long hair appeared within the surveillance camera’s view.
"Sisi—" Li Dongliu’s eyes suddenly widened, becoming even more bloodshot.
"Officer, that’s my daughter, Sisi... My daughter, she’s still alive... She’s still alive... Where is this? Go save her, quickly, go save her..."
In the video, a security guard approached and questioned the girl. A short while later, Mr. Wan, protected by Lige, walked up to her.
"Officer Hu, what are you waiting for? Save her! If you save my daughter, I’ll tell you everything I know... Please..."
Suddenly, Li Dongliu’s expression twisted violently. He had already had a premonition, but he hadn’t dared to believe it.
BOOM—
In the video, an explosion suddenly erupted. The young girl was instantly engulfed by flames, blown to pieces in the fire.
CRACK—
A sound like a misfiring bullet seemed to catch deep in Li Dongliu’s throat. His eyes, wide and staring, nearly bulged from their sockets. He gazed blankly at the screen, all light gone from his eyes.
"My daughter... She... What happened to her..."
"As you can see, blown to bits!" Hu Qing’s cold voice mercilessly shattered Li Dongliu’s last shred of hope, causing him to collapse helplessly.
"I didn’t say anything... I really didn’t say anything... Why? Why did you have to do this?"
"Dancing with wolves, making deals with tigers—did you expect a happy ending? Terrorists have no humanity. Were you still expecting mercy from them? Or are you still unwilling to confess?"
"I’ll talk... I’ll talk..." Li Dongliu closed his eyes in despair, two streams of tears flowing down his cheeks.
"But I don’t know much. They wanted me, as the dragon head of Ancient City District, to spend seven days eliminating disobedient forces. Then, I was to quickly expand into the surrounding areas and sweep through and consolidate Suzhou City’s underworld."
"Their purpose?" Wang Lan asked.
"I asked them. They said it was to throw Suzhou City into complete chaos, to prevent it from hosting this year’s provincial martial arts meeting."
Hearing this, Wang Lan’s eyes showed he’d suspected as much. It had been speculation before, but now it was confirmed.
Given Suzhou City’s performance over the past year, it was highly probable they would be chosen to host the provincial martial arts meeting. The event had been held in Jin City for the past few years; if it were held there again this year, the current candidate selection process would be meaningless. Among the thirteen cities in Jiang Province, the top five were quite close in standing.
To the Demon Clan, Jin City was a hard target they wouldn’t dare attack rashly. And Suzhou City? Despite its recent heavy losses, the Demon Clan still didn’t want the event held there. Therefore, although they were causing trouble in Suzhou City, their true aim was to prevent it from hosting the provincial martial arts meeting. What a clever ploy of misdirection.
"Have you ever thought about what you’ll face, even if the terrorists achieve their goal?" Hu Qing pressed. "When they’re gone, having dusted off their hands, what awaits you?"
"I know... but what could I do? My whole family is in their hands; they are as unpredictable as ghosts. No matter how I hide or escape, they can find me whenever they want. What choice did I have?
"Besides, I still held onto some wishful thinking, hoping that if I moved fast enough and became the underground emperor of all Suzhou City, the government might not dare to touch me..."
"What a fool’s dream!" Wang Lan rebuked coldly, arms crossed.
The subsequent questioning focused on details, but Wang Lan didn’t stay for it. He left the interrogation room, found a secluded spot, and dialed Wang Qianfeng’s number.
"Wang Lan, what’s the progress?"
Wang Lan recounted everything that had happened over the past two days.
"Director Wang, based on the current clues, it seems the Demon Clan’s goal is to make Suzhou City lose its eligibility to host the provincial martial arts meeting. Has the host city for the meeting not been decided yet?"
"It was supposed to be Suzhou City, but due to the recent undercurrents there, the Provincial Education Department has been hesitant. The intelligence you’ve gathered is a strong boost for Suzhou City’s bid. I’ll report this to the Jin City headquarters later. If you’re able to continue following up, do so. If not, then let it be. The provincial martial arts meeting is about to start, and getting into a good Star Martial Academy is your top priority now."
"Yes! Well then... Director Wang, I’ll hang up now."
"Assisting the police in solving a murder case: Reward 3,000 experience points, 200 skill points." As Wang Lan hung up the phone, a system notification sounded in his mind.
Earning 200 skill points in two days wasn’t bad.
The case could largely be considered closed at this point. While there was still more to unearth, any further investigation would undoubtedly require caution and meticulous, long-term effort. Just as Wang Lan was about to tell Hu Qing he was leaving, his phone suddenly rang.
"Hello? Lige? Is there new information on your end?"
"Mr. Wan just received news. His son was stabbed by a delivery person at Yaqi Academy and has been rushed to the hospital for emergency treatment. Mr. Wan insists on going to the hospital."
"It’s obviously a trap..." Wang Lan responded immediately.
"We all know that, but Mr. Wan’s son’s life is on the line, and he’s determined to go. So..."
"Understood. Luring the snake out of its hole, then. Which hospital? I’ll be right there."
"Jiaoxiao Affiliate Hospital."

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Locking onto the Viper’s Nest
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 213: Locking onto the Viper’s Nest
Wang Lan borrowed a car from the chief inspector and, honking all the way, drove for nearly twenty minutes to reach Jiaoda Affiliated Hospital. After parking, he had just reached the hospital entrance when he saw five identical luxury cars enter the premises in succession.
Mr. Wan’s bodyguards were the first to exit their vehicles. As soon as they stepped out, the vigilant bodyguards spotted the swiftly approaching Wang Lan. They immediately went on alert, with three bodyguards blocking Wang Lan’s path.
"Sir, you cannot come any closer."
"Step aside. He’s one of us," Lige said as he got out of a car, waving to Wang Lan.
"What’s the situation?"
"The chief inspector just called. They found the delivery guy, but he’s dead," Lige whispered to Wang Lan.
A sharp glint flickered in Wang Lan’s eyes as he turned to glance at Mr. Wan descending from his car. Mr. Wan still carried himself with an air of extraordinary grace and composure. However, once he was out of the vehicle, his steps quickened as he entered the hospital.
Wang Lan and Lige, one on each side, escorted Mr. Wan at a brisk pace into the hospital’s emergency department. With the bodyguards clearing the way, they headed straight to the intensive care unit on the third floor.
"The patient, Wan Qirui, male, seventeen years old, a senior in class two at Yaqi Academy, was stabbed at 11:15 AM today. He was brought to the emergency center at 11:45 AM and, after an hour of surgery, is now under observation in the intensive care unit.
The patient was stabbed seven times, with three wounds to vital areas causing life-threatening injuries. We can’t guarantee whether he will make it through this critical period."
Outside the intensive care unit, the chief physician briefed Mr. Wan on Wan Qirui’s condition.
"Doctor, please do everything you can to save my son’s life. As long as my son is okay, I, Wan Lihao, will be immensely grateful. No matter the cost of the medication or treatment plan, just save my son."
At this moment, Mr. Wan had completely lost his composure. He clutched the doctor’s hands, pleading agitatedly.
"We will do our best; that’s all we can promise. But please rest assured, Mr. Wan, as long as Wan Qirui’s condition doesn’t deteriorate further, we are ninety percent sure he will pull through."
This assurance carried significant weight. Injuries that had been treated and medicated were unlikely to worsen unless someone were to stab Wan Qirui again.
"Xiao Li, come with me to change the dressings."
"Okay!"
Pushing the medical cart past the bodyguards towards the door of the intensive care unit, the female nurse wore a mask and cap, revealing only her eyes. Yet, it was these eyes that caught Wang Lan’s attention. They were clear but held a vacant stare. As the nurse approached, Wang Lan detected a strange, heavy scent.
In an instant, Wang Lan made his move.
Simultaneously, the female nurse also acted. A scalpel, hidden in her sleeve, flashed towards Wan Lihao’s throat like dazzling lightning.
CLANG—
Wang Lan was faster. His preemptive strike landed on the nurse’s wrist, sending the scalpel flying. Lige reacted instantly, spreading his hands and emitting an electric net that pinned the nurse to the wall.
The nurse, trapped by the electric net, struggled ferociously for a moment before her head drooped, her expression becoming vacant.
"Xiao Li, what are you doing?" The chief physician, only just reacting, let out a panicked cry.
As the electric current dissipated, Wang Lan stepped forward and felt for Xiao Li’s pulse at her neck. "Dead!"
As I thought.
"Who are you people? Did you kill Xiao Li? You... you..." The chief physician was now so terrified that he lost his composure, stumbling backward until he leaned against the wall.
Even doctors, who regularly confront death, still fear it. Especially in his eyes, Lige was a ruthless butcher who had taken Xiao Li’s life without a moment’s hesitation.
"Doctor Zhang, don’t be afraid. We’re from the Tianjian Bureau," Wang Lan quickly pulled out his ID for Doctor Zhang to see. "Besides, this nurse, Xiao Li, wasn’t killed by my colleague. She was already dead. A Star Martial Warrior assassin killed Xiao Li first and then used their abilities to control her body. Do you understand that explanation?"
Doctor Zhang was somewhat aware of the strange and varied powers of Star Martial Warriors. Whether it was controlling elements or corpses, to her, it all fell under the umbrella of supernatural abilities, which made the reality easier for her to accept.
"Is that so?"
"We saw you’d already called the police. We’ll see what security says when they arrive. But before that, I’d like to ask you some questions about Xiao Li..."
"I need to change a patient’s dressings right now... Please wait a moment." Flustered, Doctor Zhang turned and hurried away. About ten minutes later, after the security guards had arrived, Doctor Zhang returned, pushing another medicine cart.
One of the guards spotted Hu Qing. "Hu!" he called out, then turned to Doctor Zhang. "As soon as I heard it was Jiaoda Affiliated Hospital, I guessed there was trouble here, Doctor. These two really are from the Tianjian Bureau. This is Captain Wang, and this is Captain Lige. You can fully trust them."
"Doctor Zhang, we need to understand Nurse Xiao Li’s basic situation," Wang Lan said.
"Okay, Director Wang, please take this captain to learn about Xiao Li’s situation," Doctor Zhang said to another doctor.
"I’ll go as well," Hu Qing said quickly.
The two followed a middle-aged, bespectacled doctor away from the scene, navigating through the crowded hospital corridors. Wang Lan remained on high alert, scanning for any movement around him. Suddenly, a figure flitted past the corner of his eye. Almost instinctively, Wang Lan’s form flashed, and he vanished.
BOOM—
The glass beside him shattered as Wang Lan burst through the window, charging out of the hospital.
At the hospital entrance, a figure flickered like a phantom and vanished in an instant. Wang Lan landed, but the figure was already gone.
"AAAH—"
Screams erupted from the surrounding crowd, the sudden turn of events having startled many people.
Wang Lan’s eyes, sharp as lightning, swept across the area, scrutinizing every rustle and movement in the corners. Suddenly, he felt a gaze on his back.
He whirled around, activating his far sight.
On the rooftop of a high-rise building at the northwest corner of the hospital, the figure he had just seen inside appeared. A foreigner with shoulder-length blonde hair was staring at Wang Lan.
Though separated by at least three hundred meters, both were certain the other could see them. The foreigner wore a trench coat over a tight grey T-shirt that snugly hugged his well-developed muscles.
The foreigner tilted his head slightly, then made a slitting motion across his own neck in a taunting gesture. With a flash, he vanished, eerily like the wind.
Childish!
"Wang Lan, any findings?" Lige asked, approaching him.
"A foreigner. He was just in the hospital, but his movement technique is too strange; I couldn’t even track him. In such a short time, he covered three hundred meters. His strength is at least at the peak of the Star Cloud Stage, possibly even the early Galaxy Stage."
"A foreigner? Was he planning to carry out the assassination personally? Did he retreat because you discovered him?"
"No, by the time I saw him, he was already retreating... which means... he had already completed the assassination himself..." Instantly, a sharp light glinted in Wang Lan’s eyes.
I understand now... The ability to control bodies isn’t an ultra-long-range control that ignores distance. It has limits; the puppeteer must be within a certain range for the bodies to move!
"So, you’re saying..." Hu Qing’s face suddenly filled with frustration. "Damn it! At the Arirang barbecue stall, the puppeteer was also among the crowd!"
"Exactly. But frustration is pointless now. Let’s go."
Following Director Wang again, the two went to the archives room. Using a computer, they found Zhang Xiaoli’s information.
"Zhang Xiaoli, female, twenty-two years old, a junior college graduate from a health school, single. Currently residing in Love Cloud Village. Here’s her duty roster. Xiao Li was always a very optimistic, cheerful, and strong young woman. She loved her career and her work. Even though her busy schedule led to neglecting her boyfriend and their eventual breakup, she had no complaints. It’s unimaginable... that this happened to her."
BEEP BEEP BEEP— Hu Qing’s phone rang.
"Alright, send it over."
BEEP BEEP BEEP—
"What is it?" Wang Lan asked casually.
"It’s the delivery guy’s information and the autopsy report. The delivery guy died at noon yesterday. Consequently, he didn’t accept any more orders after that time. However, he started accepting orders again this morning."
"Wait!" Wang Lan suddenly interjected. "How do you think the mastermind captures these people he controls?"
