"There are two ways. Either he actively goes out, secretly selects a target, and then follows them to a secluded place to suddenly reveal his fangs and kill them. The other way is to lie in wait, setting a trap for the prey."
"Which one do you think it is?" Wang Lan asked again.
"For the past two days, we’ve had cameras and surveillance equipment across the city searching for the two foreigners twenty-four hours a day, yet we haven’t found a single clue. It’s unlikely they’re attacking proactively."
"If they’re lying in wait... how would they do it?"
Hu Qing’s eyes suddenly lit up. He quickly dialed a number on his phone. "Lin, immediately investigate the last deliveries this delivery guy made before he died yesterday. Also, find out where Qin went and how many clients she serviced before her actual time of death."
This was all Hu Qing could find for now. As for the female singer and the sexy woman Li Dongliu used as a thug, Hu Qing had not yet been able to trace their movements.
The delivery guy’s order history was available online; his company could pull up the list immediately upon request. As for Qin’s appointments, they all went through Hong. For Hong to become the leader among the Ancient City District’s five thousand sex workers, she definitely had a comprehensive management system.
So, Hu Qing didn’t have to wait long; two pieces of information arrived almost instantly.
Detailed listings appeared before Hu Qing and Wang Lan. Wang Lan’s eyes scanned them quickly, then his finger suddenly jabbed at one entry.
"Look here: Love Cloud Village, Building 35, Unit 5. The time is eleven-thirty. After that, he took about ten more orders, and then he didn’t take any more for the rest of that day."
"The areas for the subsequent orders are quite spread out, not as concentrated as before. The murderer did this to create confusion, but it was a clumsy attempt—a dead giveaway."
"Also, Qin had a house call right before her confirmed time of death, also in Love Cloud Village. Considering Zhang Xiaoli as well, the base for these two foreigners must be in Love Cloud Village."

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Catching Them All in One Sweep
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 214: Catching Them All in One Sweep
"Finally found you," Wang Lan sighed in relief and picked up his phone to call Wang Qianfeng.
"Director Wang, I may have located the stronghold of those two foreigners. I’m requesting support."
"Oh? Where is it?"
"Love Cloud Village. I’m currently at Jiaoda Affiliated Hospital."
"Good. I’ll personally lead the team to handle it. Wait for me at Jiaoda Affiliated Hospital."
"Director Wang, could you bring Xu Xiangwen along too?" Wang Lan suddenly asked.
"Xu Xiangwen? Your classmate?" Wang Qianfeng hesitated for a moment. "You really do look after your friends. Sure, as long as it doesn’t violate discipline, it’s fine."
"Thank you, Director Wang."
Wang Lan wanted Xu Xiangwen to come not, as Wang Qianfeng suggested, to look after him, but because Xu Xiangwen’s Heavenly Eye could quickly locate the two foreigners—an extremely useful ability.
Shortly after, Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin arrived at Jiaoda Affiliated Hospital with a team of Tianjian Bureau experts. After picking up Wang Lan, they promptly headed for Love Cloud Village.
"Lanzi, am I... really participating in a Tianjian Bureau operation?" Xu Xiangwen asked excitedly inside the car.
"Calm down. It’s just an operation. Just try to play a minor role."
"But this is a Tianjian Bureau operation! If I tell people about this, it’ll be quite a feather in my cap, right? I could boast about it for a lifetime."
"Well, if you boast about this... it might also be the last boast of your lifetime. The targets we’re after are terrorists who strike fear into many small countries internationally. If they find out you were part of this operation, guess how they’ll treat you?"
"GULP." He swallowed hard. "Is it still possible for me to get out now?"
"Too late. Seriously, your task later will be the most critical. Right now, we’ve only pinpointed the general location of our targets; we need you for precise positioning. Once we get there, lock onto the targets’ location immediately. The targets are two foreigners: one with fiery, spiked-up hair, the other with golden shoulder-length hair."
"Understood."
Outside Love Cloud Village, eight vehicles stopped, and a group of Tianjian Bureau masters disembarked. The Tianjian Bureau regarded this arrest operation with utmost importance. These two foreigners were Wang Mingling’s subordinates and possessed crucial intelligence.
Among the Galaxy Stage masters were Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin. Their Peak Star Cloud Stage elites included Xu Shiyun, the Zhang Yeqiu sisters, Zeng Xiaomo, and other elite red-robed agents. This included Wang Lan, who could transform into a Galaxy Stage fighter at any moment. Furthermore, the Zhang Yeqiu sisters’ combined technique could also unleash Galaxy Stage power.
After getting out of the car, Xu Xiangwen walked through the village gate with Wang Lan.
"Focus on Building 35 first..." Wang Lan reminded him.
Zhang Xiaoli’s home was in Building 35, which was also the delivery location for the food delivery guy. Following Wang Lan’s directions, Xu Xiangwen activated his Heavenly Eye.
"Lanzi, there’s nothing in Building 35. But I’ve found our targets on the 17th floor of Building 8, opposite it. Two foreigners, blond. One has fiery hair; the other has shoulder-length hair and is wearing a duckbill cap. One is playing games on a computer, and the other is working out in the living room."
"Locked on! His assistance is now guaranteed for this operation." Wang Lan quickly ran back to report to Wang Qianfeng.
"Everyone knows the target’s location now, right? Enough talk. Wang Lan, Zhang Yeqiu, Zhang Xiaoxue, Xu Shiyun, secure the perimeter and prevent the targets from escaping. Barrier Group, be ready to erect the barriers at a moment’s notice. Li, let’s move in!"
"Been idle for two months, I’ve nearly gone rusty," Li Weixin muttered.
Instantly, Tianjian Bureau operatives stormed into Love Cloud Village. Xu Xiangwen stayed back in the car outside, while Wang Lan entered the village and headed straight for Building 34, behind Building 8.
His job was to intercept and stop the targets if they managed to break through Wang Qianfeng’s encirclement. Zhang Yeqiu, Zhang Xiaoxue, and Xu Shiyun had the same task.
As the large group of Tianjian Bureau operatives charged into the village, the two foreign targets inside instantly became alert.
"Nick, damn it, they’ve found us! FUCK! I told you not to stupidly provoke them..."
"Go to hell, Frand! You think they wouldn’t have found us if we hadn’t provoked them? Damn it, how did they find us..."
"Whatever. Breaking out is what matters now."
"Nick, I’m warning you, you know Hellfire’s discipline. If you get captured, Hellfire will make you understand what it means to regret ever coming into this world."
"Live with no name, die with no corpse. The same goes for you."
BOOM!
The glass shattered instantly. Without hesitation, the two foreigners burst through the broken window and leaped out. In that same moment, they each saw two figures pouncing at them like ghosts.
BOOM!
The entire building shook violently, glass shards raining down from the sky.
At that moment, Wang Lan had just reached the designated interception point, forming a four-cornered blockade with Xu Shiyun and the Zhang sisters. Suddenly, a powerful wave of air pressure and a terrifying gale swept over them.
Wang Lan involuntarily took a few steps back, shielding his face with his arm, and took a deep breath. If not for the power of the Phoenix Form within him, this aura would have left him paralyzed.
The fierce battle erupted instantaneously. Collisions constantly occurred around Building 8, unleashing terrifying energy, like two violently spinning galaxies colliding.
Power levels soared, rushing into the sky in the blink of an eye. Above, a water dragon danced, and the wind swept across the world. The strength of the two blond foreigners was not to be underestimated; to hold out for so long against Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin, they had to be at least in the early stages of the Galaxy Stage.
BOOM!
A loud explosion thundered terrifyingly in the sky. Wang Lan immediately looked over to see the flame-haired foreigner violently spewing a mouthful of blood, his body sent flying as if struck down.
Hit by the blast, Wang Qianfeng was also thrown backward at high speed, the distance between him and the foreigner rapidly increasing. Wang Qianfeng’s expression changed drastically. "Wang Lan! He’s trying to escape! Stop him!"
Wang Lan dared not hesitate, instantly activating his Phoenix Form. A sigil emerged on his forehead, and a terrifying aura surged forth. He raised his hand, and a brilliant golden light erupted from his right eye.
Lock-on!
Raising his right hand, he formed a gun shape, aiming at the flame-haired man who was still spitting blood while flying backward through the sky. Behind Wang Lan, a pair of wings, ablaze with purple flames, unfurled.
"Phoenix Purple Flame—"
In the sky, the flame-haired foreigner halted, forcefully wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, a triumphant smile on his face. At this distance, Wang Qianfeng could no longer catch up. They both had wind attributes; who was afraid of whom?
SKRAW! A phoenix’s cry rang out, seeming to strike the flame-haired foreigner’s heart and making it tremble violently.
A firebird, like an arrow from an expert archer, shot from Wang Lan’s arm towards the sky. It seemingly transcended time, arriving behind the flame-haired foreigner in the blink of an eye. Only then did the foreigner realize he had been targeted at some unknown point.
"FUCK—"
BOOM!
Purple flames instantly engulfed the target. Within the fiery embrace, he suddenly burst like a firework in the sky.
"Cross-level kill. Reward: 5,000 experience points, 50 skill points." The prompt in his mind suddenly sounded.
Seeing Wang Lan had handled his target, Wang Qianfeng hurried to back up Li Weixin. "Li, capture him alive—"
"Nonsense! If I wasn’t trying to capture him alive, would I have played with him for this long?" As Li Weixin spoke, the Star Martial Array before him activated. "Thousand Thread Willow—"
"Li, let me! Wind Barrier—" Wang Qianfeng called out.
Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin, one on the left and one on the right, unleashed wide-area sealing and compression skills, pressing in on the other foreigner. This was an overt tactic: crushing the opponent with absolute power. To break this tactic, one needed either an elemental counter or enough offensive power to shatter the defense.
"It’s done!" Standing at Wang Lan’s right, Xu Shiyun said with a smile, arms crossed.
"With that guy’s strength, he’s definitely... No, wait!" Zhang Yeqiu’s expression suddenly changed drastically. "Director Wang, be careful! He’s about to self-destruct!"
"Hell’s Fire, eternally burning! I sacrifice my battered body, to die with no corpse! HA!"
"Barrier Group, barrier seal—"
BOOM!
The sky suddenly quaked! As if a giant hand had torn it open, the shockwave from the explosion instantly broke through Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin’s Star Martial Skill seals, spreading terror in all directions, devouring everything.
The power of such an explosion was comparable to a long-range missile, its shockwaves capable of destroying at least three buildings.
Just as the shockwaves were about to spread, four transparent barriers shot up into the sky. The moment the shockwaves neared the buildings of the adjacent residential area, the barriers firmly blocked them.
BOOM!
The unventable shockwave, finding no other outlet, rushed towards the release area atop the barriers, roaring like a terrifying, large-caliber shell.
The dark clouds dispersed, and the haze gradually settled. Wang Qianfeng and Li Weixin descended slowly from the sky, their faces somber.
Although they had successfully killed two elite Hellfire members who had infiltrated Suzhou City, they hadn’t achieved their primary objective. Leaving no one alive meant they couldn’t gather intelligence on Wang Mingling, nor could they discern his purpose or plans in Suzhou City.
The operation seemed successful, but the results were unsatisfactory.
"Director Wang, this isn’t your fault," Xu Shiyun offered. "These two were fanatical terrorists who had no regard for their own lives or others’. It’s understandable that you couldn’t capture them alive."
"There’s only one reason we couldn’t capture them alive: we weren’t serious enough, we didn’t commit enough forces, and our own strength was insufficient. If we were strong enough, he wouldn’t have even had the chance to self-destruct. Don’t try to make excuses for me."
Xu Shiyun stepped back, rebuffed.
"Successful eradication of an internationally wanted terrorist mastermind. Reward: 10,000 experience points, 400 skill points..."
Once again, the system’s reward notification sounded in his mind.
Last time I earned two hundred, this time four hundred. Now I’ve accumulated ten percent of the required experience, and I have 1,600 skill points. Just four hundred more skill points, and I’ll be able to unlock an incredibly powerful finishing move combining four Star Martial Skills.
By my estimation, the maximum power from fusing two Star Martial Skills could strike a mid-Star Cloud Stage opponent or higher. If I managed a full-power strike combining four Star Martial Skills, the impact would likely be no less than the damage output of my activated Phoenix Form.
My heart is burning even hotter now.

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Behind Wang Mingling is Paradise Bird
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 215: Behind Wang Mingling is Paradise Bird
"Director Wang!" Wang Lan approached Wang Qianfeng, whose face looked awful.
"Yes, you did well! Unfortunately, we’re not good enough..."
"Director Wang, I think we can ask Wan Guhao to come to the bureau and cooperate."
"Wan Guhao? Who’s that?"
"The chairman of Tongling Jewelry? The one who has been attacked repeatedly in the past two days?"
"That’s him, the same person these two foreigners have been targeting. Actually, there’s something I’ve always been puzzled about. There are a hundred wealthy individuals with a bounty on their heads in Suzhou City, but only two have actually been killed. One is Mu Liancheng, and the other is Wan Guhao, who narrowly escaped death. Moreover, both were personally targeted by a Hellfire expert. Isn’t it possible that the bounty on these hundred rich individuals was just a smokescreen?"
"Wang Lan, didn’t you say this was to disrupt Suzhou’s public order and cause the city to miss out on hosting the provincial martial arts competition?"
"What if that was just one of the purposes? A bounty of thirty billion, and only Hellfire took it? No other assassin organizations even attempted to take the contract? Moreover, Mu Liancheng was killed before the bounty was even issued. Even if Hellfire committed murder for the bounty, why did they choose Wan Guhao out of a hundred people? And I suspect that Hellfire itself might have issued this bounty. There’s a distinct feeling... of it being a self-scripted, self-directed play."
"It’s indeed suspicious. Li, have Lige bring him in."
"Alright!"
They regrouped and headed back to the Tianjian Bureau. After a while, Lige arrived with Wan Guhao at the bureau.
"Didn’t you say you needed to record a statement? The way you’re setting this up doesn’t look right. Why do I feel like I’m being interrogated?" Wan Guhao asked with a frown, looking at the two civilian staff members in front of him.
"Not too slow on the uptake, figuring it out by the third sentence. Do you know Mu Liancheng?"
"The South Ship King, Mu Liancheng? Who in all of Suzhou City doesn’t know him? What about it?"
"What is your relationship with Mu Liancheng?"
"What kind of relationship? Which specific kind are you asking about?"
"Any kind of relationship."
"Privately, we’ve shared a few meals and played a few games. In business, I had a transportation partnership with Boss Mu," Wan Guhao replied coldly.
"Why does Hellfire want to kill you? And why, to kill you two, would they offer thirty billion and use the lives of a hundred wealthy people as a smokescreen?"
"I don’t know what you’re talking about."
"This assassination bounty was issued by Hellfire. Before it was made public, they had already assassinated Mu Liancheng. The second target was you. Actually, you were already on alert by then. I’ve investigated. After Mu Liancheng was assassinated, you significantly upgraded your security. You hired more than a dozen Star Martial Warriors as bodyguards, but even then, you didn’t feel safe. You went so far as to issue a request to the Tianjian Bureau, hoping we could protect you."
"Seeing Mu Liancheng killed, shouldn’t I have been vigilant? Mu Liancheng had assets of seventy billion, built up over twenty years of hard work. In the end, though, he was killed by an assassin. To die with ambitions unfulfilled... it’s a heroic tragedy. The man is dead, his money unspent—it’s just too damn frustrating. My life is just beginning. With Mu Liancheng’s fate as a lesson, shouldn’t I be responsible for my own life?"
"But your vigilance was a little too quick. While others were still in shock and discussing it, you had already begun to enhance your security. That made it seem to us like you knew what was going to happen, that their next target was you."
"If my reactions weren’t swift and sharp, could I have founded Tongling Jewelry?"
"No! Your explanation is too far-fetched. And this time, my interrogation isn’t about us asking for your cooperation. Rather, if you want to live, you *must* cooperate with us. Cooperating with us won’t just save your life; it will save your entire family."
"Haven’t Hellfire’s assassins already been caught by you?" Wan Guhao suddenly asked in surprise.
"Heh? You know about that too? Your information network is quite something, isn’t it?"
"It’s already been broadcast on the news."
"We only eliminated Nick and Frand. Hellfire can only truly be considered wiped out once Wang Mingling is eliminated. Don’t you think?"
"Wang Mingling came to Suzhou City?" Wan Guhao suddenly stood up in shock. Instantly, as if realizing something, his expression changed drastically.
"It seems you know Wang Mingling. Do you still need to feign ignorance? Come on, since you’ve already betrayed Wang Mingling, why bother keeping his secrets?"
Wan Guhao’s face instantly darkened.
"What are you still hesitating about? Do you really have a choice? Either you cooperate with us, or you wait for Wang Mingling to kill you."
"Mu Liancheng and I are both members of Hellfire," Wan Guhao suddenly spoke.
"I joined Hellfire twenty years ago; Mu Liancheng had joined three years before me. We were both among the first members of Hellfire. Initially, we trusted and protected each other. In less than three years, we earned a vast amount of money in the Middle East.
"Wang Mingling possesses a strong personal charisma; he’s very adept at understanding people. Many willingly risked their lives for him—people from Jade Country, White Eagle Country, Bear Country... many, many more. Regardless of whether they were Star Martial Warriors or not, Wang Mingling treated everyone equally.
"Later on, Wang Mingling told us that while we were selling our lives, we couldn’t let others sell *our* lives. Our lives were ours alone to sell. That’s why Hellfire was established.
"Mu Liancheng and I then took a large sum of Hellfire’s funds back to Jade Country to develop our businesses. Seventeen years ago, Jade Country was truly brimming with opportunities and business prospects. Against the backdrop of a booming economy, entering Jade Country wasn’t as difficult as one might imagine.
"Leveraging resources from the international market and with the financial backing of Hellfire, we quickly became profitable. Over more than a decade, the dividends from our two companies alone were enough for Hellfire to sustain itself. We were content with this situation.
"We are all Jade Country people; as long as we didn’t cause trouble in Jade Country, we could do whatever we wanted in the war-torn Middle East. However, Mu Liancheng and I never imagined Wang Mingling would take on *that* particular job: the assassination of Eld Di!"
Hearing Wan Guhao reach this point, Wang Qianfeng, in the monitoring room, murmured softly, "As expected..." Beside him, the tapping of Lu Zhao’s fingers on the table abruptly ceased.
"Eld Di is one of Jade Country’s Five Elders, possessing immeasurable strength and immense power," Wan Guhao continued. "Assassinating Eld Di... let’s not even ask if it could succeed. Even if it did, Hellfire would undoubtedly suffer a devastating blow. Unless Wang Mingling had gone mad, he would never have accepted such a task.
"But Wang Mingling did accept it. So, he has indeed gone mad.
"We could follow an excellent leader into the jaws of death, but we cannot follow a madman to our graves. Later, Mu Liancheng suddenly contacted me, telling me a secret he had discovered: Wang Mingling had joined Paradise Bird."
"Paradise Bird!" Lu Zhao’s expression suddenly changed, his eyes reflecting a distant, profound memory.
"Mu Liancheng and I decided to sever all ties with Hellfire and ceased providing any assistance for their entry into Jade Country. During that period, we divested almost all of our overseas assets. Yet, unexpectedly, Wang Mingling still managed to smuggle himself into Jade Country and came looking for us."
"Do you have any way to find Wang Mingling’s whereabouts?"
Wan Guhao shook his head. "No. When we separated from Hellfire, we essentially cut all ties with Wang Mingling. Even within Hellfire, very few knew about Mu Liancheng and me. Likewise, we knew nothing of Hellfire’s current affairs. In recent years, our interactions have been purely financial."
"Your financial transactions are quite covert; even we can’t trace them."
"If the World Security Council can’t trace our financial dealings, what chance does the Tianjian Bureau have?" Wan Guhao chuckled. "Wang Mingling’s return to Jade Country isn’t merely to eliminate two traitors like us. He’s undoubtedly here to assassinate Eld Di."
"Juan, ask about Wang Mingling’s strength," Wang Qianfeng instructed into the microphone.
"Mr. Wan, how strong is Wang Mingling?"
"Twenty years ago, he was already a master of the Star Sea Stage," Wan Guhao said. "And his soul secret technique is incredibly bizarre and versatile. Globally, all active Star Sea Stage masters are considered S-rank dangerous individuals. And Wang Mingling, he’s among the top ten most dangerous of them.
"As for now, nobody knows how truly powerful Wang Mingling has become. If someone claimed he had surpassed the Star Sea Stage, I would believe them."
Hearing this, the expressions of Wang Qianfeng and the others once again turned exceedingly grim.
"Wang Mingling has perfected his soul secret technique," Wan Guhao elaborated. "He can connect his consciousness to a puppet he controls. Essentially, his soul directly enters the target’s body, seizing control.
"This is no longer mere corpse control; it’s truly achieving limitless avatars. A person possessed by Wang Mingling retains all their original abilities, including their Inborn Talent of the Bloodline, and can also harness the body owner’s Inborn Talent of the Bloodline. This ability grants Wang Mingling even more bizarre and varied capabilities.
"Furthermore, such avatars are not restricted by region or territory. Even if Wang Mingling’s true body is in the Antarctic, he can control an avatar in the Arctic. It’s possible Wang Mingling hasn’t even infiltrated Jade Country; what’s here might just be one of his avatars."
What a troublesome ability,
Wang Qianfeng thought.
As long as his main body hides somewhere and doesn’t move, he can just capture prey to create avatars and remain undefeated. No, that can’t be right. The avatars’ strength definitely can’t match the true body’s.
"Ask him, what’s the strength difference between an avatar and the main body?"
"Mr. Wan, how significant is the difference in strength between Wang Mingling’s avatars and his true body?"
"How big is the difference? I’m not entirely sure. It seems to be less than a full stage. But even if there is a one-stage difference, Wang Mingling’s true body is already at the peak of the Star Sea Stage. An avatar would, at the very least, possess a Cultivation Level at the peak of the Galaxy Stage or higher.
"The problem is, who is Wang Mingling’s avatar? Nobody knows. Apart from a lower Star Martial Stage, the avatar inherits all skills, including Innate Abilities. Although I sincerely wish I could help you capture him, preferably his true body, unfortunately, I really can’t be of much assistance."
The interrogation of Wan Guhao concluded. Lu Zhao and the others convened a meeting with Wang Qianfeng and various department heads, including Wang Lan, who had been, from start to finish, the agent provocateur in this whole affair.
In Lu Zhao’s mind, Wang Lan had successfully shed the nickname of "mascot" and had become a bona fide troublemaker. If Wang Lan hadn’t, out of sheer boredom, taken an interest in the assassination case of a mafia boss, he would never have discovered Wang Mingling lurking behind it all.
As they unraveled the layers, a vast and terrifying conspiracy gradually emerged before Lu Zhao.
If the Wang Mingling in question were merely the Wang Mingling from the Wang Family of Xiangxi thirty years ago, Lu Zhao wouldn’t be worried. Not even if he was the head of the international terrorist organization Hellfire. But he had never expected Wang Mingling to have joined Paradise Bird.
Damn!

chapters.title: Chapter 216: The Provincial Martial Arts Tournament Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 216: The Provincial Martial Arts Tournament Begins
Paradise Bird, also known as the Legion of Liberty, is the largest assembly of renegade Star Martial Warriors from various countries. Most of them had committed numerous crimes in their native lands but successfully evaded local blockades and fled abroad.
Their origins can be traced back seventy years, to human traitors who sided with the Demon Clan during the war. After the Demon Clan retreated, these traitors were nearly exterminated by the human coalition forces, but some escaped to scarcely populated areas and managed to survive, re-emerging sixty years ago.
Due to the international situation at the time, coupled with the devastation left by the departing Demon Clan, nations prioritized reclaiming lost territories and stabilizing domestic conditions. This led to leniency towards these traitors. By the time the various countries became aware of the threat, Paradise Bird had already grown into a terrorist force spanning five continents with fifty thousand members.
However, if these traitors operated openly, the nations of Sky Blue Star would not be afraid. Paradise Bird operates by dividing into smaller units, engaging in terrorist activities across the globe. They are Unpredictable, yet Paradise Bird claims responsibility for nearly eighty percent of global terrorist attacks.
To every country worldwide, Paradise Bird is like cockroaches: see them, spray insecticide; kill one if you see one, exterminate a nest if you find one. But to claim they could eliminate all cockroaches, not even the five great powers combined have any confidence.
Cockroaches aren’t strong, but they’re disgusting, and they can be found in any dark corner.
The Hellfire Mercenary Corps, active on Middle Eastern battlefields, is merely a mercenary organization. They have no morals, no bottom line, no emotions. Their eyes see only money, which is why they are defined as a terrorist organization.
For a major power like Jade Country, dispatching peacekeeping forces to annihilate a Hellfire group is not difficult. But now that Wang Mingling has joined Paradise Bird, the nature of the situation has changed.
Paradise Bird is notoriously difficult to deal with and extremely vindictive. Seventeen years ago, White Eagle Country’s Thunder Shadow Star Martial Squad pursued them for thousands of miles, destroyed a Paradise Bird stronghold, and killed their Number Five leader.
For the next seventeen years, Paradise Bird conducted over a hundred terrorist attacks on White Eagle Country, leaving it utterly exhausted.
Once targeted for revenge by Paradise Bird, not even the five great powers can withstand it. Of course, these powers will not back down; Paradise Bird’s revenge always comes at a heavy cost—to kill a thousand enemies, they suffer a loss of two thousand themselves. But the problem isn’t the fear of theft; it’s the constant threat of it!
"Director, how should we respond?"
"What else can we do? Whether Wang Mingling is Hellfire or Paradise Bird, if he dares cause trouble in Jade Country, we will show no mercy. Paradise Bird has already attempted something once. Although that was just verbal intimidation, joking with Jade Country means facing our wrath."
"This time they even dare to target Eld Di, as if we’re easy to push around. From now on, Suzhou City is under full martial law. Recall all field agents and those on leave; everyone must be on high alert. We must ensure the stability of Suzhou City, we must ensure the safe convening of the provincial martial arts tournament, and we must ensure Eld Di’s safety."
"What? Has it been confirmed that the provincial martial arts tournament will be held in Suzhou City?" He MingXue asked in a low voice.
"Indeed, the evidence provided by Wang Lan two days ago was very compelling. Since the Demon Clan and Wang Mingling are opposed to holding the provincial martial arts tournament in Suzhou City, we decided to do the exact opposite. Last night, it was decided to hold the Jiang Province provincial martial arts tournament in Suzhou City."
Perhaps because the decision to hold the provincial martial arts tournament in Suzhou City was finalized, both the Demon Clan and Wang Mingling suddenly went quiet. The international bounty on Suzhou City’s tycoons was withdrawn, and the underlying turmoil in Suzhou City also dissipated.
Wang Lan returned to school and joined the Suzhou City representatives in the final preparations for the impending provincial martial arts tournament.
Half a month passed unnoticed. During this time, Hu Qing, leading all thirteen bureaus in Suzhou City, conducted a carpet-style sweep of the city’s underground mafia organizations.
Those who enter the underworld must eventually pay the price.
There were those who lived in constant fear, and those who were willing to sacrifice everything to bring Hu Qing down. A mafia boss even publicly boasted, "We have a hundred thousand brothers in Suzhou City’s underworld. I’d like to ask Hu Qing, do you have that many jail cells?"
But the next day, this mafia boss was personally arrested by Hu Qing. On his way, not a single one of his ’brothers’ came to see him off.
As the police’s anti-mafia campaign escalated in level and intensity, by the end of April, no significant underground forces remained in Suzhou City. Some young punks who had just entered society and were still at the bottom thought they could seize territory now that the ’tigers’ were gone from the mountain. Before they could even celebrate for two days, their newly formed gangs, whatever they were called, were rounded up and taken away.
Wang Lan was occasionally called by Hu Qing to act as a guard or similar role. He almost never had a chance to make a move. He’d just show up, conjure a ball of fire in his palm, and then Hu Qing’s officers would start arresting people.
At the Battle of Chibi, Cao Cao’s army of three hundred thousand was said to be eight hundred thousand strong. These guys were even more audacious. All their big shots and small fries combined amounted to less than ten thousand, yet they dared to claim a hundred thousand.
By early May, Wang Lan had accumulated 1,800 skill points, just 200 short of the amount needed to complete the linkage of four Star Martial Skills. He had wanted to make one last push, but he couldn’t turn back the wheels of time.
The fifty-third provincial martial arts tournament was about to begin.
「May 12th, Friday.」
After the last collective training, the final intensive training for the ten-person Suzhou City team concluded. They would rest on the 13th and 14th, and the tournament would officially begin on the 15th.
The venue for the provincial martial arts tournament was the Suzhou City Gymnasium. Starting from the first official match, Jiang Province Television would broadcast the tournament live to the entire country. Indeed, when the news spread that the provincial martial arts tournament would be televised nationally, people all over the country were ecstatic.
The provincial martial arts tournament is akin to the college entrance exam—or perhaps even more attention-grabbing than the regular college entrance exam for ordinary students. This is because it is the ’college entrance exam’ for the absolute elite among Star Martial Warrior students.
In past years, the provincial martial arts tournament was held in secret. Besides the participants and their families knowing some details, the general public had no idea who the champion or runner-up was, or who had been directly admitted to the four major Star Martial Academies.
But this year, it was going to be livestreamed! And not just by one or two provinces, but by all twenty-four provinces across the country simultaneously. If you didn’t want to watch your own province’s tournament, you could watch another’s. You could take your pick from any provincial TV station.
As the provincial martial arts tournament drew near, television commercials, online platforms, Zhihu, Tieba—everything was abuzz with excitement.
The topic of the provincial martial arts tournament quietly climbed the trending searches, its ranking soaring upward like a rocket.
"I’m taking a week off! If my boss dares stop me from watching the provincial martial arts tournament, I’ll quit to show him!"
"Don’t worry, guy upstairs. Your boss might have taken the week off too."
"Work is what I desire, and watching the provincial martial arts tournament is also what I desire. Since I can’t have both, I’ll sacrifice sleep for the night shift! I’ve already applied with my supervisor and switched to night shifts for half a month."
"Damn, the person above is hardcore."
Although the provincial martial arts tournament adopted livestreaming, seemingly loosening security, the opposite was true. Precisely because it was being fully livestreamed, security measures were even tighter than before.
To ensure the safety of the provincial martial arts tournament, starting May 12th, the commercial area within the Suzhou City Gymnasium began to be cleared. Shops were closed, businesses suspended operations, and residents were compensated to go on vacation.
Within a one-kilometer radius extending outward from the gymnasium, everyone required a pass to enter. In the commercial zones on the periphery, patrolling officers were everywhere. Even a minor verbal dispute would be swiftly handled by officers rushing to take the individuals away.
Thirteen cities from across the province sent representative teams. Each city’s team consisted of ten members, totaling 130 participants. Including coaches, logistics personnel, and liaison staff, each city sent about twenty people. In total, 260 individuals were to stay in the business hotel next to the gymnasium.
Check-ins at the business hotel would begin on the evening of May 13th. From that point on, strict adherence to the regulations set by the Suzhou City organizers was required. No one could leave without permission, and complex, tedious procedures like signing in and out for every entry and exit had to be followed.
Regardless of whether they were representative teams from outside Suzhou City or the local Suzhou City team, everyone had to reside in the business hotel. Not wanting to lose their freedom too soon, Wang Lan and the other nine decided to move into the business hotel on the last possible day, the evening of May 14th.
Ten people, seven rooms. Wang Lan and Xu Xiangwen shared one.
"Suzhou City is Jiang Province’s number one city, for crying out loud! Can’t they be a bit less stingy? Just giving us rooms like this? Standard twin rooms? A suite wouldn’t cost that much, would it? And there’s no balcony?" Xu Xiangwen had been grumbling non-stop since entering the room.
"Stop complaining. The Grand Hyatt Hotel isn’t bad. Thirty-two floors, four hundred rooms in total. Booking the whole place was just right for our needs."
"The Scenery Hotel across the street has five hundred suites, is several times more upscale than the Grand Hyatt, and it’s just as close. Why not choose the Scenery Hotel?" Xu Xiangwen was still somewhat resentful.
"I heard the Grand Hyatt Hotel was free, a gift to Suzhou City for their use, and they’re not taking a penny for any expenses. If you were the Suzhou City government, how would you choose?"
Xu Xiangwen listened, then quickly took out his phone and dialed a number. "Hey, Old Xu, who’s the general manager of the Scenery Hotel next to the gymnasium? Tell him to pack his bags and get lost, now!"
Wang Lan’s movement in lifting the blanket faltered, and he looked at Xu Xiangwen with a confused expression.
Is this the real reason for your grudge?
Wang Lan shook his head with a bitter smile.
"Why? You tell me why! I ask you, what did he do during the bidding for the provincial martial arts tournament accommodations? Offer a fifty percent discount? Fifty percent discount my ass! Why not offer it for free?"
"Cover their own profits and losses? Bullshit! Of course, they cover their own profits and losses. But an idiot who doesn’t even understand the advertising effect of being the athletes’ dormitory for the provincial martial arts tournament—do I still expect him to manage my hotel well? Especially since this is the first-ever fully broadcast provincial martial arts tournament, destined to be recorded in history!"
"And most importantly, the hotel that serves as the athletes’ dormitory for the first year may very well do so next year too. Unless the Grand Hyatt Hotel goes bankrupt, there won’t be a new bidding next year. This tradition will continue on and on."
"Because of that idiot, we’ve lost a hotel brand that could have become a legacy! Tell him to get lost! The farther, the better—"
Xu Xiangwen’s roar was cut off as he ended the call.
"Yo, Xu, what’s with the temper?" Gong Feiyu asked, kicking open the door to barge in.
"What else? I’m not satisfied with the room! It’s just a twenty-square-meter room with two beds; it’s too unsafe. What if Lanzi’s primal instincts flare up in the middle of the night and he covets my stunning looks?"

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Comprehensive Restraint
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 217: Comprehensive Restraint
"Let’s go!" Gong Feiyu beckoned to Xu Xiangwen. "Lanzi, stop packing. Grab your belongings, and let’s go."
Wang Lan exchanged a curious glance with Xu Xiangwen. Pulling his suitcase, he followed Gong Feiyu out the door and into the elevator, heading straight to the top floor.
"Three luxury suites are reserved on the top floor, each with four rooms. Sisi and Xinyu get one suite, the teachers another, and the remaining one is for the three of us."
"Wait a minute, isn’t the Grand Hyatt Hotel’s room allocation managed by the Suzhou City organizers? Shouldn’t the suites on the top floor be reserved for the higher-ups? How did you get one?" Xu Xiangwen had barely finished speaking when his expression twisted, and he began gnashing his teeth.
"The Grand Hyatt Hotel is yours?"
"It was a gift from my cousin on my tenth birthday. I almost freaking forgot about it. If Manager Xu hadn’t called me about the bid this time, I wouldn’t have known."
"Wow—" Xu Xiangwen let out a strange yell as he rushed into a room and slammed the door shut.
"What’s wrong with him?"
"Nothing, just feeling the sting."
In the Suzhou City Gymnasium, balloons floated into the sky and colorful flags fluttered in the breeze. Amidst lively pop music, the opening ceremony of the 53rd Jiang Province Martial Arts Tournament officially began.
Dozens of news media outlets, representatives of Star Martial Warriors from all quarters, and leaders of schools from various cities converged at the gymnasium.
There were speeches from leaders, a talk from the head of the Suzhou City Star Martial Hall, and more from various other dignitaries. An entire morning passed with nothing but speeches.
The 130 contestants from across the province sat yawning in the stands. It wasn’t until around 10:00 a.m. that the various speeches and mutual adulation finally concluded. When it was time for the cultural performances, having already endured nearly two hours of what felt like monotonous chanting, the contestants finally showed a flicker of interest.
The grand opening ceremony, filled with cultural performances interspersed with announcements and declarations, continued until 3:00 p.m.
"Next, we will proceed with the draw for the first round of the provincial tournament battles. Starting tomorrow, there will be 65 matches in the first round. This is what all the participants are concerned about, anxiously waiting to know who their opponents will be.
So, let’s begin the draw for the battle roster. Please look at the big screen—"
On the big screen, two rows of names rapidly scrolled.
"Although we are using an electronic draw, its calculation method is completely random. There will definitely be no intentional interference. This is the first live broadcast of the provincial tournament, guaranteeing fairness and impartiality. Alright, the matchup list for the first group of 20 people is out."
The names of Xu Xiangwen and Xie Sisi were conspicuously listed among the first 10 matchups.
After taking screenshots of the battle roster, the drawing continued.
Soon, the names of Zhuang Haotian, Mu Shaoyun, Jiang Xinyu, Gong Feiyu, and others appeared.
"Wang Lan, your name’s up!" Xu Xiangwen suddenly shouted. At that moment, the big screen froze just as Xu Xiangwen finished speaking.
Wang Lan vs. Jiang Wanzhou.
"Jiang Wanzhou?" Wang Lan mused over the name. "That sounds kind of familiar..."
"Of course it does." Xu Xiangwen turned to Wang Lan with a sympathetic expression. "If I were you, I’d be reflecting right now on what the heck I’ve been doing all year."
"Uh... it’s not that guy from Chang City, is it?" Zhuang Haotian suddenly exclaimed with alarm.
"Yep, that’s the one." A smile of schadenfreude touched Gong Feiyu’s lips. "Lanzi, out of 130 people, you’ve drawn the one who completely counters you. Less than a 1% chance, and you still managed to hit it. I’m impressed."
Wang Lan’s mouth twitched, but he said nothing.
"Jiang Wanzhou, a Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior with dual water and earth Star Martial Attributes... Chang City team, contestant number three," Xu Xiangwen murmured to himself.
"But even if he has dual attributes, even if he is a Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior, he won’t necessarily beat Wang Lan, right?" Zhuang Haotian tried to offer comfort, albeit hesitantly.
"Wang Lan is no ordinary Star Cloud Stage warrior. Even Xinyu wouldn’t dare say she could win for sure. I can’t believe Jiang Wanzhou could be more formidable than Xinyu."
"But have you forgotten about elemental counters?"
"Doesn’t Xinyu’s attribute also counter Wang Lan’s? Yet Wang Lan can fight back with the Star Cloud Sword Dance and Crescent Arrows, can’t he?"
"But Jiang Wanzhou is different. He has mastered a Hydrometamorphosis Secret Skill. Under the effects of this secret technique, his body becomes immune to all physical attacks. Even if he’s reduced to dust, he will reappear unharmed as water.
The only way to counter such a technique is with an Elemental Attack. But an Elemental Attack... Wang Lan’s fire attribute against the Hydrometamorphosis Secret Skill? Don’t make me laugh."
Hearing this, Zhuang Haotian found himself unable to come up with any other reasons for Wang Lan to win.
Outclassed in Star Martial level, completely countered in Star Martial Attributes. Even setting those aside, Wang Lan excelled in all aspects; his Basic Skills and Form Changing Star Martial Skills were outstanding. Yet, this particular secret technique could nullify most physical attacks.
It felt like Wang Lan was about to be pinned under the Five-Finger Mountain for five hundred years.
The matchup draw concluded, and the opening day ended. The real competition would only start the following day.
"Now that you all know your respective opponents, don’t just focus on having fun when you get back. Study your opponents carefully and figure out how to win. As you study your opponents, they are also studying you. You can’t afford to be careless, and more importantly, don’t underestimate any of your opponents.
Our luck isn’t bad this time. Xinyu, Shaoyun, and Haotian all have a solid chance of advancing. Xiangwen, Feiyu, as long as you’re careful, you shouldn’t have any problems. In the first round, 130 contestants will be reduced to 65. As long as our team’s elimination rate is below 50%, we’ll have met our expectations."
The head of instruction, acting as their team leader this time, gave guidance and reminders to Wang Lan and the others. Finally, he looked at Xie Sisi, Ma Chengcheng, and Wang Lan, hesitated for a moment, and then spoke words of comfort.
"Your opponents are much stronger than you. During your matches, don’t push yourselves too hard. Just do your best and know when to stop. The provincial martial arts tournament is just one stage in your lives, certainly not the only one.
Being able to represent Suzhou City in this competition already proves your excellence. So, don’t feel any psychological burden. If your opponent is too strong, concede in a timely manner. There’s no shame in that!"
What else could Wang Lan say? Of course, the director was right; his words were sensible.
All the competitors, including their supervising teachers, ate in the hotel’s ground-floor main dining hall. They could order from a menu or choose the buffet.
The hotel was aware of the appetites of Star Martial Warriors, so every waiter in the restaurant was bustling about, sweating profusely. Although everyone ate with gusto, the dining hall remained relatively quiet.
This was especially true for the students from other cities, who were still in their adjustment period in an unfamiliar place and seemed quite reserved.
Wang Lan was currently devouring a large, square steak. From time to time, he would spread black pepper sauce on a freshly cut surface before quickly popping it into his mouth, swallowing it almost as fast as one might eat a piece of bread.
Sitting opposite Wang Lan was Jiang Xinyu. She stirred her coffee, her eyes occasionally drifting to Wang Lan as he ate. Watching him made her feel hungry again, even though she had just finished her meal.
"Are you really not worried at all? Or have you already thought of a plan?" Jiang Xinyu suddenly asked, her tone indifferent.
"Worried about what? What plan?"
"That Jiang Wanzhou you’re fighting... his abilities strongly counter yours. If it were me, I could easily handle him. If he dared to use his Hydrometamorphosis Secret Skill in front of me, I could freeze him into an ice sculpture instantly. What about you? What will you do?"
"What else can I do? Just burn him dry, and that’ll be that," Wang Lan said with a smile.
Since I’ve mastered Thunder Snake, why would I be afraid of your Hydrometamorphosis? I’ll electrolyze you directly. This Hydrometamorphosis Secret Skill is powerful, but it also has major flaws. Whether it can unleash its full potential depends entirely on who is using it.
"Accompany me to the mall later," Jiang Xinyu suddenly said.
"To the mall? What for?"
"To buy some toiletries."
"Doesn’t the hotel provide those?"
PFFT! The moment Wang Lan finished speaking, a girl with a short Sassoon haircut at the next table suddenly snickered. Seeing Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu look over, the girl quickly waved her hands in apology.
"Sorry, sorry... I didn’t mean to... It’s just that when I heard your boyfriend’s reaction, it was exactly like what people say online... I couldn’t help but laugh."
The girl stood up, came over, and sat next to Jiang Xinyu. "Chang City team, Yu Zhisha. You must be Jiang Xinyu from the Suzhou City team, right?"
"Yu Zhisha? Captain of the Chang City team? The successor to the Shadow Assassination Technique... A pleasure to meet you!"
"Not at all, you’re the amazing one, Jiang Xinyu. An Ice, Wind, and Water tripartite Star Martial Warrior, mid-stage Star Cloud Stage, comprehensively skilled."
"Stop flattering each other, it’s awkward to listen to. By the way, what reaction online were you talking about?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
"Online, they say all men are like pig’s trotters; their minds ignore all the details and only retain a general outcome. For example, when you talk about lipstick color, what’s the first thing that comes to your mind?"
"Red, right? It’s called lipstick, so it couldn’t be green, could it?"
"So, what color lipstick would you buy for a girl?"
"Red, I guess? Or maybe pink?"
"So, you see... There are so many shades of red, each for different occasions, matching different temperaments. If you had to choose carefully, which one would you give your girlfriend?"
"Is it that complicated? Why not just buy one of each kind?"
Yu Zhisha gave Wang Lan a thumbs-up. "Buddy, that’s a very standard answer. But if your girlfriend just wants to pick a fight, she’ll still say, ’You don’t understand me at all.’ Buying one of each kind is like buying a piece of clothing in every size. What’s the difference?
"Getting back to toiletries, girls have specific brands, scents, and even packaging they prefer for their bath products. What the hotel provides might not be what we like. I don’t like the hotel’s toiletries either. Shall we go together later? I want to buy some too."
"Sure!"
"Xinyu, since someone is going with you, I don’t need to come along, right? You guys go ahead."
Yu Zhisha stared at Wang Lan in shock.
Was this guy fearless, or was he just digging his own grave?
"Do you have plans tonight?"
"Not really. I can’t do combat training anyway. But I promised Xiangwen earlier we’d team up for some games later."
"You play games?"
"Not really, but Xiangwen, Feiyu, and Ma Chengcheng said they’d carry me and help me rank up." Wang Lan’s smile was gentle and amiable.
"Accompany me to the mall. Help me carry my things," the queen commanded decisively.

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Definitely a Lie-in Win
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 218: Definitely a Lie-in Win
Wang Lan found it really hard to join in the conversation about women’s topics.
Jiang Xinyu and Yu Zhisha, however, seemed to hit it off like old friends, chatting about everything from fashion to handbags, from this spring’s new arrivals to future trends. Ever since they entered the mall, it was like a rule to go into every shop they came across. The mall, which didn’t seem large in Wang Lan’s eyes, made him feel as though he had traversed an entire training ground map.
After nearly an hour of shopping, Wang Lan found himself carrying six or seven shopping bags, yet the main purpose of Jiang Xinyu’s trip seemed as distant as ever.
"Um, Xinyu, Zhisha, what did we come out here for again?" Wang Lan couldn’t help but ask tentatively as they entered a shoe store.
"Shopping," Jiang Xinyu replied.
"No, I mean, didn’t we come out to buy bath products?"
"We’ve still got time; let’s get the bath products last," Jiang Xinyu said nonchalantly, apparently missing the point Wang Lan was trying to make.
When it comes to shopping in malls, the potential that women unleash can exhaust a husky into collapse. And the stamina of a female Star Martial Warrior during shopping could tire out ten huskies to the brink of despair.
In any case, during the last half-hour, Wang Lan was surviving purely on willpower. It was only at the very last minute that he, laden with bags both big and small, finally entered the Grand Hyatt Hotel.
"I should have decisively snapped up that handbag just now... I have some regrets," Jiang Xinyu lamented.
"In three months, there will be a large release of new products, and they’ll be thirty percent cheaper," Yu Zhisha consoled.
"But they won’t have the serial numbers... The first-release models each come with a unique serial number."
"We can go back in a couple of days; the provincial Martial Arts Competition is going to last at least five days anyway."
Inside the elevator, the two women’s souls seemed to still be lingering in the mall. The Grand Hyatt Hotel had thirty-two floors, with the first six or seven dedicated to various facilities. It wasn’t until the elevator doors opened and someone else entered that the two stopped talking.
DING—
The elevator doors opened again. The two people who had just entered got off on the seventh floor, and suddenly, four teenagers crowded in.
"Captain, what a coincidence!" one of them greeted Yu Zhisha.
"A coincidence indeed. Did you just come from the gym?" Yu Zhisha replied.
"Yeah, we were bored and went to warm up. Captain, the director was just giving us a pep talk; where were you?"
"Me? I went out to buy a few things after lunch. What did the director say?"
"What else could he say? We drew the short straw this time. Except for you and Jiang Wanzhou, who drew weaklings, the rest of us got tough opponents... Sigh, this is going to be a hard fight. If less than fifty percent of us make it through the first round, it’ll be a total disgrace."
Wang Lan’s mouth twitched slightly as he glanced at the short, chubby boy.
It seemed that when he mentioned the "weakling" Jiang Wanzhou had drawn, he was referring to me, right?
"Don’t talk nonsense," Yu Zhisha chided. "There isn’t a single weakling among those competing in the provincial Martial Arts Competition. You must be humble and never arrogant. If you end up getting beaten like a dog by one of these so-called ’weaklings,’ you’ll be disgraced across the nation."
The chubby boy felt Wang Lan’s gaze, glanced back, and quickly looked away. He seemed to have recognized Wang Lan, as he stuck his tongue out towards the elevator wall.
DING—
The elevator doors opened, and the group hurried out. Yu Zhisha turned to look at Wang Lan. "Sorry about that, they didn’t mean any harm..."
"No problem. Strategically underestimating the opponent, eh? I look forward to our meeting on the battlefield."
"We’re looking forward to it as well. I’ll head back now. See you tomorrow."
Only Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu remained in the elevator. The atmosphere grew somewhat tense. As they neared the top floor, Jiang Xinyu suddenly turned to Wang Lan. "Are you confident?"
"Shouldn’t be a big problem. It’s not yet certain who the real weakling is, after all."
「The next day,」
The stirring strains of the Star Martial Army’s departure song echoed above the Suzhou City Sports Pavilion. Drones, like sprites of spring, fluttered in the sky. Dozens of high-definition cameras positioned throughout the sports pavilion provided unobstructed coverage of every corner of the competition field. The exciting provincial Martial Arts Competition was about to begin, and across the internet, countless eager eyes were locked onto Jiang Province’s live-streaming platforms.
Suzhou City had hosted the Star Martial Art Contest for three consecutive years. However, could its significance truly compare to the provincial Martial Arts Competition? Even if the participants in the provincial competition were students, they were city representatives. The quality gap between the provincial Martial Arts Competition and the Star Martial Art Contest was like comparing a national team to a minor league.
"The first round of the provincial Martial Arts Competition is about to start! The three fighting arenas are ready! With that, I now declare the first round of the competition... begins! Please welcome the competitors to the stage!"
"He’s coming, he’s coming, walking towards the field under the watchful gaze of the expectant crowd..."
"The first match features Ji Qianxi from Salt City! The people of Salt City send their blessings to student Ji Qianxi—"
"The people of Xu City say, ’Best of luck to student Ji Qianxi—’"
"Xu City trash."
"Personal attack plus regional attack! Ban him—"
The competition hadn’t even started, but the internet was already ablaze with arguments. Amidst the online chaos and the palpable atmosphere of anticipation and tension on-site, referees in all three competition arenas blew their whistles almost simultaneously.
As expected of the provincial Martial Arts Competition, there wasn’t a single weak participant. Even the relatively weaker contenders possessed professional-level practical experience and combat awareness. The Star Martial Art Contest Wang Lan had participated in previously only began to showcase a high concentration of quality around the final fifty contestants. In contrast, the provincial Martial Arts Competition featured high-quality participants from the very beginning.
Contestants moved like lightning, employing countless battle tactics. The sharp close-quarters combat and spectacular displays of Star Martial Skills offered a visual feast for everyone watching the livestream.
"Holy cow, it’s so thrilling right from the start! I can only imagine how intense the second and third rounds will be."
"Worth it! This day off is so worth it! Screw work! I need Coke, popcorn, and a recliner..."
"I’m on the night shift. No pressure at all—I can earn money and watch the competition simultaneously."
"Hey, person above, careful you don’t suddenly drop dead."
"Jinx! What do you know about youth? For guys like us in our twenties, we’re practically all liver; staying up five days and five nights is nothing." This was followed by an emoji of a figure with white hair and a weather-beaten face.
"Aside from their Star Power only being at the Star Shine Stage, they have almost no weaknesses," Wang Lan observed objectively, watching the contestants clash below.
"Indeed. Even if several cities north of the river are relatively weaker in strength, that’s only in comparison to powerhouses like Jin City. It’s not that they’re weak; it’s just that those other cities are too freakish."
"Even half a year ago, I wouldn’t have been confident of winning," Xu Xiangwen said, his eyes glinting with a warrior’s spirit.
"But this isn’t half a year ago. They’re doomed; they won’t make it past the third round."
Matches were short, some lasting ten minutes, others up to half an hour. All three arenas soon concluded their initial bouts. While some venues were just starting their second match, others were already onto their third.
「An hour later,」
Jiang Xinyu stepped onto the stage. Her opponent was an Earth Attribute Star Martial Warrior. He had mastered a precise Earth Movement Skill and a large-range Star Martial Skill capable of altering terrain. His Star Power level was also approaching the mid-Star Cloud Stage.
Clearly, the opponent had studied Jiang Xinyu’s strengths and launched a targeted strategy. But Jiang Xinyu was well-rounded, rendering such tailored tactics largely ineffective. Within thirty seconds of the start, her opponent’s strategy was thoroughly disrupted.
Subsequently, Jiang Xinyu unleashed a barrage akin to an Ice Snow Gatling gun. From beginning to end, she kept her opponent under pressure. Her opponent, clearly not one to passively await defeat, attempted to close in on Jiang Xinyu for close-quarters combat, hoping for a slim chance of survival.
Unfortunately, before he even got within five meters of Jiang Xinyu, he was frozen into an ice sculpture and eliminated.
Then, Xu Xiangwen took the stage. He used his evasive clone tactics to utterly exhaust his opponent. By the time the opponent was defeated and eliminated, he still hadn’t figured out which was the real Xu Xiangwen.
With the first two Suzhou City representatives emerging triumphant, the director of education was beaming like a gourd.
But when Ma Chengcheng entered the fray, her luck turned sour. Her opponent, initially assessed to be on par with Ma Chengcheng, suddenly unleashed a secret technique that stimulated their body’s potential, blasting Ma Chengcheng out of the arena. Although her opponent ultimately fainted from overexertion, Ma Chengcheng was defeated first.
Ma Chengcheng’s initial loss seemed to open the floodgates for the Suzhou City team’s defeats. In the next match, Xie Sisi, after a hard struggle, was knocked out of the arena by an opponent’s Star Martial Skill.
Xie Sisi stubbornly glared at the girl opposite her, who was similar in height and build, regretting several mistakes she’d made during the match. Her opponent, however, regarded Xie Sisi with an expression of unexpected seriousness and surprise.
"I didn’t expect that with your Star Shine Stage strength, you could fight me to this extent. Throughout Jiang Province, you’re likely the strongest at the Star Shine Stage. With your strength, you might have passed the first round if you hadn’t faced a Star Cloud Stage opponent. It’s a pity you ran into me. What’s your name?"
"Xie Sisi!"
"I’ll remember you. I believe that one day, your name will resound across the skies. Keep it up!"
"You too! Keep it up!"
Xie Sisi’s loss was somewhat expected. However, Zhuang Haotian’s unexpected defeat nearly made the director of education lose his composure. Yet, having watched the entire match intently, he couldn’t fault Zhuang Haotian. The opponent possessed an ability not covered in the intelligence reports, which put Zhuang Haotian at a complete disadvantage. His elimination cast a gloomy shadow over the Suzhou City team.
"Next, please welcome Wang Lan from the Suzhou City team and Jiang Wanzhou from the Chang City team to the stage!"
Shortly after Zhuang Haotian was eliminated, the announcement for Wang Lan’s match resounded from arena number three. Hearing this, the director of education’s expression grew even darker. Suzhou City had already suffered three consecutive eliminations. Now it was Wang Lan’s turn, which seemed like another inevitable loss.
Is Suzhou City heading for a fourth consecutive defeat?
The director quietly turned his head to glance at Principal Zhang, whose face was also grim.
He figured he was in for a serious scolding after today’s events.
It wasn’t just the director who was displeased; the citizens of Suzhou City were also deeply unhappy. While the director could only internalize his dissatisfaction, the netizens of Suzhou City took to the internet to vent their frustrations.
"Trash! Trash! This year’s Suzhou City Star Martial Art third-year high school class is all trash!"
"Exactly! Aside from the Ice-Snow Queen and Xu Xiangwen, who are the others? The moment their opponents use a few tricks, they’re clueless. Are you telling me only contestants from other cities have secret techniques? Doesn’t our great Suzhou City have a single decent Star Martial family?"

chapters.title: Chapter 219 How Do You Beat Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 219 How Do You Beat Me?
The live broadcasts, Suzhou Star Martial Arts Bar, and even the newly launched provincial martial arts forum all exploded into activity.
They didn’t just want to see the exciting fights of Star Martial Warriors; they wanted victories too. As residents of Suzhou City, and moreover, the host organizers, how could they save face being wiped out so effortlessly by others?
"Let’s watch another match. If we lose again, I’m done. It’s infuriating to watch."
"I’m afraid that won’t happen; this match is doomed to be a loss!"
"I suspect the guy above isn’t on our team. Show your team badge, or else my forty-meter sword is coming out."
"A team badge for this? We also want to see the real situation. Can’t you see the data released by both sides? Our guy from Greater Su City, Wang Lan, is at the peak of the Star Shine Stage. That guy Jiang Wanzhou is at the early Star Cloud Stage. He’s an entire realm away..."
"Can’t we kill beyond our level?"
"Upstairs, the major realm divide for Star Martial Warriors is a chasm. The difference between the Star Cloud Stage and Star Shine Stage is like comparing a high schooler to a kindergartener in terms of physique. Their strength, speed, and build are incomparable."
"Then there’s nothing to hope for. We’re screwed."
"Disperse, disperse..."
"Passing by, just passing by!"
Though they said to disperse, their bodies honestly stayed seated in front of their computers, watching the entrance of Wang Lan and Jiang Wanzhou.
"Wang Lan, Jiang Wanzhou, are you ready?"
"Ready!"
"Good to go."
"Then, let the match begin—"
At the sound of the whistle, Wang Lan’s figure instantly moved. His form exploded into a series of afterimages, shooting towards Jiang Wanzhou like streaks of light.
"Earth’s Pulse!"
THUMP—
A heartbeat-like rhythm appeared beneath Wang Lan’s feet. In an instant, the ground beneath him felt as unstable as a water’s surface, making it hard to find footing. Wang Lan’s figure immediately scattered in mid-air, exploding into dozens of afterimages like a peacock spreading its feathers, before landing steadily at the very edge where the other’s Star Martial Skill couldn’t reach.
"Wang Lan, not even Soul Resonance could awaken your Star Martial Warrior talent, yet you’re a genius who managed to awaken it on your own at the age of sixteen," Jiang Wanzhou said with a light tone, stepping across the undulating ground as gracefully as a Medieval European noble.
"If it were just based on your Star Shine Stage Cultivation Level at your age, the title of genius would be somewhat unwarranted. So, I made a point of looking into your background. I wouldn’t have known without looking, and what I found was quite shocking. Awakened at sixteen, you broke through from the Starlight Stage to the Star Shine Stage in just a few days. You haven’t even been a Star Martial Warrior for a full year, and you’re already at the peak of the Star Shine Stage. You’ve traversed in less than a year what took us seven or eight years to cultivate. The title of genius is well-deserved in your case.
"By the way, weren’t you also last year’s champion of the Suzhou Star Martial Competition, the anonymous participant known as Wolf King?"
Typically, the two fighters wouldn’t chat, at least not in the matches before Wang Lan’s.
What’s there to talk about? Either I go down or you do, simple as that.
But the Jiang Wanzhou in front of him exuded a strong aura of being a ’chunibyo’ from head to toe. All this nonsense, said in his unique tone, was transmitted from the live microphones to thousands of households over the internet.
"Such intense ’chunibyo’ vibes! Is that you, Ou Doudou?"
"Had you not mentioned it, I wouldn’t have known how badass Wang Lan actually is. To awaken on his own at sixteen? Looks like I’m not without Star Martial Warrior talent; it’s just that my talent hasn’t awakened yet."
"Wait, what did he say? I didn’t quite catch that."
"I think I heard him say Wang Lan is the Wolf King, last year’s Star Martial Competition Champion?"
"Wolf King? The missing person has returned?"
"Not a missing person; we just never found out Wolf King’s whereabouts, never locked down his identity. He is the Wolf King? For real?"
"That Star Martial Skill Wang Lan displayed just now, doesn’t it look like Wolf King’s signature move to you?"
"Don’t ask if it looks like it. It’s definitely him! That Peacock Spreads its Feathers move just now? I’m absolutely sure. Fuck, I thought he was a bronze, but it turns out a king has returned."
"Wang Lan, Wolf King... making any connections? Suzhou Wolf King Fan Club, congratulations to our king for reclaiming his throne—"
"All the primary school students in Suzhou City, congratulations to our academic god for reclaiming his throne!"
"Worthy of being that man! The academic god and Wolf King united? Suddenly, I’m interested in this match."
The traffic on Suzhou City’s online streaming platforms skyrocketed almost instantly. The anticipation for Wang Lan alone wouldn’t have caused such a miraculous surge in viewership. But when this match featured Wang Lan overlapping with the man from last year who had soared victoriously, stepping over countless fallen to reach the peak of the Star Martial Arts, things changed. The cooled blood suddenly began to boil. At this moment, almost all online streaming platforms were filled with comments declaring that the Wolf King, that man, had returned. And Wang Lan, in the midst of the competition, knew nothing about all this.
Jiang Wanzhou chuckled and said, "I’ve researched every match you fought in the Star Martial Competition. Your clean and swift moves could defeat many seasoned Star Shine Stage professional warriors even within the Star Shine Stage. But this isn’t the Star Martial Competition where only Star Shine Stage fighters participate. You have no chance of winning."
Wang Lan sneered, raised his hand, and pointed at Jiang Wanzhou, who seemed to walk on waves. In an instant, his Star Power surged. A pair of dazzling wings unfolded from his wrists.
WHOOSH—
The Crescent Arrow shot out in an instant, like a bullet leaving the chamber, heading straight for Jiang Wanzhou’s face.
"What?"
In an instant, a wall of earth rose in front of Jiang Wanzhou.
BOOM—
The Crescent Arrow exploded, shattering the earth wall. As Jiang Wanzhou raised the earth wall, his Earth’s Pulse also stopped fluctuating. Wang Lan’s figure shot out like lightning, firing arrows at Jiang Wanzhou in rapid succession.
"Fuck, when did Wolf King become an archer?" The viewers on the streaming platform erupted into a frenzy.
"That’s normal. It’s been a year; it’s totally reasonable for Wolf King to have learned new Star Martial Skills. Wolf King had no long-range attacks before and was severely countered, so of course, he learned his lesson."
"Wolf King, charge—"
"Shoot him! Shoot him point-blank—"
The audience watching online was even more excited than those on site, cheering and roaring, pounding their tables, which went THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!
"Upstairs, there’s an earthquake—"
"Charge—"
Wang Lan transformed into a streak of light, closing in on Jiang Wanzhou to within a dozen meters. Jiang Wanzhou kept retreating. Just as he planned to change his Star Martial Skill to block Wang Lan’s advance, he was faced with another Crescent Arrow.
Finally, Wang Lan’s form closed in on Jiang Wanzhou. The Crescent Arrow transformed into a Flame Sword. With a SWOOSH, two Solar Wheels rose in his hands.
"It’s settled—"
"It’s settled! As long as Wolf King gets close, no matter what stage of Star Martial Warrior you are, you have to kneel. Wolf King, charge—"
The Solar Wheels turned into a streak of lightning that tore through the void, instantly destroying the earth wall defense in front of Jiang Wanzhou. His form, as swift as light, slashed down again as the wall burst.
SLASH—
Water splashed everywhere, and cameras from all directions instantly focused a close-up on the action.
"Won—"
"Definitely! That slash was too sharp, that blood splatter... wait, something’s not right."
As the dust settled, Wang Lan’s entire palm was buried inside Jiang Wanzhou’s shoulder, which rippled away like a shimmering water surface.
"You think I couldn’t dodge that move? Or do you really think I’m intimidated by your Crescent Arrows? Against my Hydrometamorphosis Secret Skill, all your attacks are ineffective."
BOOM—
Wang Lan punched out instantaneously, slamming his fist towards Jiang Wanzhou’s head, which burst like a smashed watermelon.
"Ah—"
Whether they were watching the live broadcast via video or witnessing the match in person, many spectators gasped. That scene was horrifying—as if Wang Lan had really blasted Jiang Wanzhou’s head to pieces.
But then, Jiang Wanzhou’s body turned into a flowing silver liquid, and a new Jiang Wanzhou appeared in front of Wang Lan.
"All your attacks are ineffective against me, including your strongest Flame Sword. Wolf King, I actually hold you in high regard; I even admired you when you participated in the Star Martial Competition. I admired your momentum, the glory with which you stepped onto the throne.
"But this is not your stage. Your Star Martial Art level is not as high as mine, your attribute is firmly countered by mine, and all your powers are useless against me.
"All your advantages are firmly suppressed by me. So tell me, how will you win against me?"
Jiang Wanzhou felt damn good about this speech; he hadn’t had such a full-on, exhilarating chance to brag in a long time. Especially considering this was a nationwide live broadcast with countless viewers watching his domineering performance, he felt so exhilaratingly blissful that every pore on his body seemed to open up.
"Damn it, has Wolf King actually encountered such an unbeatable asshole?"
"Physical attacks are useless, elemental attacks are completely countered... Fuck, Wolf King really can’t win?"
"No way, Wolf King is invincible! Remember during the Star Martial Competition? There were several matches where everyone thought Wolf King was bound to lose. But what happened in the end?"
"Unless Wolf King uses another type of Star Martial Skill that counters water, there’s no chance..."
A keyboard warrior wearing glasses was rapidly typing on his keyboard, but his motions suddenly stopped dead. Through his thick glasses, his squinted eyes widened in shock.
CRACKLE AND POP—
"Fuck—Am I some kind of prophet? No, isn’t Wolf King fire-attributed? This is—"
Electrical arcs began to flicker around Wang Lan, engulfing him in blue electricity in an instant. The current, running along Wang Lan’s arms, surged into Jiang Wanzhou’s liquefied body.
Jiang Wanzhou stared with dull eyes, looking completely dumbfounded at Wang Lan. The electric current invaded his body, causing such intense paralysis that even speaking became incredibly difficult. But through Jiang Wanzhou’s pleading eyes, Wang Lan pretty much guessed the kind of shock he was trying to convey.
"How will I beat you? Just like this!"
CRACKLE— A burst of electricity exploded on Jiang Wanzhou’s body.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: A Mouthful of Old Blood
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 220: A Mouthful of Old Blood
After a long while, the electric arcs dissipated. Wang Lan remained standing, but Jiang Wanzhou had fallen. His body was charred black, emitting wisps of faint blue smoke, especially his elegant flowing hair, which was now standing on end.
"Wang Lan versus Jiang Wanzhou, Wang Lan wins, successfully advancing to the second round."
"Successfully advancing to the second round of the provincial martial arts competition, reward: 5,000 experience points and 200 skill points." The system notification sounded, and Wang Lan’s lips curved into a slight smile.
Before the competition, his skill points had accumulated to 1,600.
The first round gave me 200 skill points, so now I only need 200 more [for my next upgrade/goal]. If I advance another round, the reward definitely won’t be just 200; it should be at least 300.
Feeling absolutely delighted, Wang Lan stepped back to the grandstand with a swagger that seemed liberated after being isolated, unaware that the online world outside was exploding over his drift-like sharp turn of events.
If it were a typical comeback victory, it wouldn’t have seemed so unbelievable. But Wang Lan’s victory was further highlighted by Jiang Wanzhou’s utter foolishness.
Among the dozens who fought earlier, who was as much of a loudmouth as Jiang Wanzhou? It was one thing to bluster about Wang Lan being last year’s Wolf King, but to make such a cringeworthy, middle-schooler-like victory declaration before actually winning?
"Talk the toughest, get hit the hardest"—that must be what this was, right?
"My level is higher than yours, my attribute counters yours, and my Innate Ability crushes yours. I’m better than you in every way, how can you possibly win against me?" Just three seconds after his words landed, he was the one twitching on the ground.
"PFFT—HAHAHA... Is this guy here for comic relief?"
"This is the funniest thing I’ve seen all year! The way he was posturing, I almost believed he was actually a king."
"To the commenter above, can I just say, Jiang Wanzhou *is* actually very capable? His abilities are genuinely strong. I dare say that ninety percent of Star Martial Warriors at the same level couldn’t beat him."
"Look, an honest person! Everyone, come and tease him!"
"Jiang Wanzhou is strong, but he shouldn’t have encountered the Wolf King, let alone try to act tough in front of the Wolf King. All that posturing? The Wolf King did it all last year, and not once did it end up a total disaster!"
"Exactly! ’How can you win against me?’ That’s so lame compared to last year’s Wolf King saying, ’I’m in a hurry.’ Just pathetic."
At this moment, the viewership for the live broadcast of the Jiang Province provincial martial arts competition surged from its original national eighth place, jumping three spots to fifth nationwide.
Upon returning to the stands, Wang Lan immediately felt eight or nine sharp gazes on him. Even Jiang Xinyu and Xu Xiangwen were staring at him with expressions that clearly spelled trouble.
"Um..." Feeling the atmosphere grow somewhat tense, Wang Lan swallowed nervously and forced a strained smile. "Do you have any questions? I can... explain."
"When did you learn Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills?" Jiang Xinyu asked eagerly.
"About... half a month ago, I think..." Wang Lan pondered for a moment.
"No, Lanzi, I remember... you don’t have a Thunder Attribute talent, do you? How did you learn Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills?"
"Don’t be ridiculous. I not only have a Thunder Attribute talent, I have full attribute talents," Wang Lan said, immediately putting on an expression that suggested they knew nothing about the real him, and spread his hands.
I’m done pretending; I’m laying my cards on the table. I’ll have to reveal it sooner or later, so I might as well do it now. I am a genius, the legendary one-in-ten-thousand Star Martial Warrior with full attribute talents.
"Wang Lan, when you applied for your Star Martial Badge, I went with you. Seventy percent of your Star Martial Attributes were Fire, and thirty percent were Yang. Where did Thunder come from?" Jiang Xinyu’s voice was like a piercing north wind.
"Perhaps my physique is rather special, and other attributes can’t be detected by the instruments. I guess my Star Martial Attributes only manifest after I learn Star Martial Skills of that attribute. Xinyu, at the time of the test, I had only mastered one Star Martial Skill, you understand."
Jiang Xinyu’s pupils contracted slightly. She remembered that Wang Lan had later displayed a terrifying phoenix-form Star Martial Skill in the training field.
But... is that even possible? Is he joking?
Star Martial Warriors could only cultivate Star Martial Skills of an attribute if they possessed the corresponding talent. There was no such thing as gaining an attribute talent *because* one cultivated a Star Martial Skill of that attribute. The logic was completely backward.
But then... Wang Lan clearly only had the Fire Attribute, yet now he successfully used a Thunder Attribute skill, and its power was so formidable?
Jiang Xinyu hadn’t ruled out the possibility of him cultivating a second attribute. But cultivating a second attribute was only possible at the Galaxy Stage. Every Star Martial Warrior realm had hurdles that must be overcome and goals that must be achieved.
