The Starlight Stage marked the transition from an ordinary person to a superhuman. The task of the Star Shine Stage was to reach the standard of a qualified warrior—combat skills, combat awareness, combat mentality, and so forth.
At the Star Cloud Stage, the main focus was on Star Martial Skills; one had to cultivate at least four or five Star Martial Skills to perfection. Control over Star Power and proficiency in releasing Star Martial Skills both had to be honed to a certain level, to exert the greatest power with the least consumption of Star Power.
And at the Galaxy Stage, strength underwent a qualitative change. Before the Galaxy Stage, disparities in realm could still be compensated for by numbers, attribute counters, or specific strategies. But at the Galaxy Stage and beyond, the gaps in strength would become increasingly vast.
In the Galaxy Stage, Star Power would undergo a transformation. This transformation would trigger an opportunity, breaking the boundaries of Star Power attributes. The seven basic attributes could then give rise to another attribute.
Thus, almost all Star Martial Warriors at the Galaxy Stage possessed dual or multiple attributes. Multiple attributes helped avoid the disadvantage of being countered, and once one’s understanding of Star Martial Skills reached a certain height, they could attempt to use composite Star Martial Skills.
The power of composite Star Martial Skills was absolutely not a simple one-plus-one addition. It was an upgrade at a fundamental level. Among Galaxy Stage warriors of the same rank, those who had mastered composite Star Martial Skills were undoubtedly among the most outstanding elite.
This was also why Wang Lan being able to use composite Star Martial Skills had caused such widespread disbelief.
But now, even more shocking than Wang Lan’s ability to use composite Star Martial Skills was the fact that he had an additional Thunder Attribute.
The audience began to buzz with discussion, but no one yet knew that Wang Lan inherently only had the Fire Attribute. They assumed he had mastered the Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skill long ago and had kept it hidden as a trump card.
Even so, Wang Lan was indeed dazzlingly impressive, perhaps excessively so. He was only at the Star Shine Stage!
Could someone at the Star Shine Stage truly master so many advanced Star Martial Skills? The question is, where did they come from? Where did he get so many A-grade Star Martial Skills? It’s enough to make anyone green with envy!
This match was the first climax of the provincial tournament’s opening round and perhaps also the turning point that marked the beginning of Suzhou City’s team’s Waterloo. Following Wang Lan, Mu Shaoyun and Gong Feiyu successively defeated their respective opponents.
The first round achieved the expected pass rate of fifty percent. With two contestants remaining, their wins or losses were no longer critical, and the Head of Teaching’s expression had visibly brightened.
The first day of the competition ended at 5:50 p.m., but online, the fallout from the day’s live-streamed matches was just beginning to gather steam.
As the most captivating match of the first round, imaginative netizens began to showcase their talents freely. The dialogue between Jiang Wanzhou and Wang Lan was turned into memes.
"You’re at a lower level than me, your attributes are countered by mine, your specialty is suppressed by me, how can you possibly win against me?"
"SIZZLE—"
"Just like that, I win."
The chibi-style memes spread like a virus through major forums and chat groups. Many witty netizens, not wanting to miss out, quickly flooded the screens with fresh jokes.
"What? Your level isn’t as high as mine, your equipment isn’t as good as mine, how can we even fight? I surrender, I surrender! We Jiang family members know when not to pick a fight!"
Although struck by Wang Lan’s thunderous electrocution, Wang Lan had held back. The blow only caused Jiang Wanzhou to lose consciousness and sustain injuries; there were no life-threatening dangers or risks of lasting complications.
After receiving treatment from the medical Star Martial Warriors, Jiang Wanzhou slowly opened his eyes in the middle of the night.
When he saw the snow-white ceiling, Jiang Wanzhou thought,
Have I arrived in heaven?
"Wanzhou, how are you feeling? Any discomfort?" A voice suddenly reached Jiang Wanzhou’s ear.
Jiang Wanzhou hurriedly turned his head. "Mr. Qin... is this... a hospital?"
"Yes, you were injured in today’s match. Are you feeling any better now?"
Only then did Jiang Wanzhou remember he was here for the provincial tournament.
Today was supposed to be my first glorious battle in the tournament!
He sat up abruptly, grabbed Mr. Qin’s hand, and asked excitedly, "Mr. Qin, did I win?"
The strange look in Mr. Qin’s eyes made Jiang Wanzhou extremely uncomfortable. Mr. Qin reached out and patted Jiang Wanzhou’s head. "Silly boy, you were beaten until you blacked out. How could you have won?"
Jiang Wanzhou’s eyes instantly widened, disbelief plastered all over his face.
I lost? Impossible... Wasn’t my opponent... very weak? How could I, a Star Cloud Stage warrior, lose to someone at the Star Shine Stage?
"Rest well. Victory and defeat are common in battle. If you lose once, there’s always a next time. Your excellence is the result of your consistent hard work; don’t let one defeat negate all of that. I believe in you!"
With that, Mr. Qin left the hospital room, a smile on his face. But the moment the door closed, he let out a long sigh.
Victory and defeat are indeed common in warfare. Yet, some victories, no matter how many, can’t offset a single crucial defeat; and some defeats, no matter how numerous, can’t diminish a single crucial victory. A single loss might mean another chance elsewhere, but in the provincial tournament, there is no next time. This defeat... it’s for life...
I lost?
Jiang Wanzhou picked up the cellphone by his bed.
Although I blacked out, my mind is still working. Even if I can’t remember, I need to find out how I lost.
But as soon as he logged onto the forum, a title caught his eye. As if compelled by an unseen force, he clicked on it, and a GIF loaded on the screen.
"My Star Martial level is higher than yours, my Star Martial Attributes counter yours, my secret techniques completely suppress you, how can you possibly win against me?"
The next second, the GIF showed Wang Lan wreathed in electric arcs, while he himself lay on the ground like a dead dog, convulsing. The shame he felt seeing this was as intense as the smugness he’d felt while boasting.
So I... lost like... this?
The more I think about it, the angrier and more embarrassed I become!
Reading the replies from netizens below, Jiang Wanzhou felt as if countless people were rushing at him, slapping his face relentlessly.
Suddenly, his blood pressure surged. He felt dizzy, his eyes rolled back, and Jiang Wanzhou once again passed out spectacularly.

chapters.title: Chapter 221: You Should Reflect on What You’ve Done This Past Year
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 221: You Should Reflect on What You’ve Done This Past Year
After two days of competition, the first round of the Provincial Martial Arts Meet had ended. Following Gong Feiyu, another contestant successfully made it into the second round’s top sixty-five. With six people from Suzhou City advancing, the results weren’t great, but they met the passing standard.
The end of the first round immediately led to the drawing for the second round’s matchups. The big screen flashed rapidly with rows of avatars. Since there were two hours of spare time after the first round, this time the drawing was done in a one-on-one format, with avatars displayed on the left and right sides respectively.
After a patient wait of ten minutes, the first contestant from the Suzhou City delegation appeared—Gong Feiyu would be pitted against a chubby contender from Xu City. Seeing this matchup, the smile on the Dean of Instruction’s face grew.
"Feiyu, Sun Xin is an Earth Attribute Star Martial Warrior, just like you. His Star Power is more substantial than an average person’s, and his mastery of Star Martial Skills is also noteworthy. But don’t worry. His weakness is quite obvious: his close-quarters combat strength is mediocre. As long as you get close to him, winning against him shouldn’t be difficult."
"Got it," Gong Feiyu replied curtly.
Soon enough, Xu Xiangwen’s opponent also appeared: a contestant from Jin City. Upon seeing Xu Xiangwen’s opponent, the Dean of Instruction’s face suddenly took a grim turn.
Although the contestant from Jin City was neither a team captain nor a seeded player, there were no weak players in the Jin City delegation. Anyone among them could potentially knock Jiang Xinyu out of the competition; they were all forces to be reckoned with.
"Xiangwen, don’t focus on winning against him; focus on showing your best self as much as possible. The teachers from the Star Martial Academies in the audience don’t only pay attention to the victors. Even if you fail, as long as you perform well, they will take note and score you accordingly. Show them the best you have to offer. Of course, winning would naturally be the best outcome."
"Understood!" As the drawing continued, the Dean of Instruction’s expression grew increasingly worried.
Those progressing to the second round naturally had a much higher average strength than those in the first. Aside from the four regular powerhouse cities, the other cities only managed to retain their captains or seeded players for the second round. There was no chance of getting lucky; it all came down to the solidity of their basic skills and control over the rhythm of battle. In the eyes of the Dean of Instruction, the contestants from Suzhou City were quite good in these aspects. In his opinion, the chances of victory were fifty-fifty.
"Match twenty-two, Mu Shaoyun versus Gong Qilin."
At this, the Dean of Instruction lost his composure, springing up from his chair with a SWOOSH.
"How could this happen... How could he face this person..." The Dean of Instruction stared at the matchup in disbelief, then turned to look at Mu Shaoyun, his face full of sorrow.
"This look in your eyes, Dean of Instruction... it’s really unsettling," Mu Shaoyun said lightly, wiping his tactical dagger.
"Gong Qilin is the captain of Tong City. He is also a direct descendant of the Yang Fire Clan and a Sun Law Bloodline Talent with mid-Star Cloud Stage strength. He is a strong contender for champion of this Provincial Martial Arts Meet. Shaoyun, while you are strong and exceptional, the gap between you and those outstanding scions of the Star Martial families is quite evident. Like Xiangwen, your objective should be to showcase yourself at your best."
Mu Shaoyun’s expression remained calm as he acknowledged with a nonchalant ’Hmm.’ Soon after, a new avatar appeared on the matchup screen—a man with waist-length hair who looked unmistakably masculine.
On his chest, he bore an impressive golden tattoo. His bare upper body was covered with sleek muscular lines—an Adonis who would make most girls scream. However, for some reason, this person left a bad first impression on Wang Lan.
Wang Lan could swear by his handsome face
it wasn’t because the other guy was better looking. It was the guy’s arrogant expression and the provocative look in his eyes, piercing through the screen. He was practically asking for a sign to hang by his side: "I’m not targeting anyone in particular. What I mean to say is, everyone present is trash."
Suddenly, the avatar on the right lit up, revealing Wang Lan’s pleasantly sweet smile.
Seeing his own smile, Wang Lan nodded in satisfaction.
Now that was the proper way for a handsome guy to appear...
"Wang Lan, are you going to fight this guy?" a shocked voice rang in his ear, snapping Wang Lan out of his narcissism. He turned his head, looking at Xu Xiangwen’s incredulous expression with a hint of confusion.
"Damn, Lanzi, your opponent is Yang Tianyi!"
"Yang Tianyi? The name sounds somewhat familiar..." Wang Lan murmured, then recalled, "Oh, right, he’s the one with the Star Palace Artifact, isn’t he?"
"Exactly, that game-breaker." Xu Xiangwen patted Wang Lan’s shoulder sympathetically. "You missed his last battle because you were in the bathroom. It was brutal. His opponent clearly had mid-Star Cloud Stage strength and an Ice Attribute that countered Yang Tianyi’s Thunder Attribute, but... Yang Tianyi didn’t even lift a finger. He just unleashed his Star Palace Artifact and roasted him. The poor guy only lasted ten seconds before giving in. Thirty percent of his body was burned. If it weren’t for the three medical Star Martial Warriors on the scene, he might have been done for. When you face him tomorrow, if you can’t handle it, surrender early. His True Sunfire isn’t something to trifle with."
"I can already use purple flames; why should I be afraid of his golden flames?" Wang Lan retorted.
"It’s not the same. His Sun Wheel has a locking feature, imbued with a spirit imprint left by a Star Soul master. Under the Sun Wheel, even those at the Galaxy Stage would struggle to escape." The Dean of Instruction sighed, looking dejected. "I had hoped that with your strength, you could advance a few more rounds. It’s unfortunate to hit this barrier in the second round. Take Xu Xiangwen’s advice—don’t push yourself too hard tomorrow. Preserve your strength; if the other contestants get injured, they’ll still need you to heal them."
Wang Lan pursed his lips.
So, in the Dean of Instruction’s eyes, my only value is as a medic for our allies, huh?
Although everyone knew the Provincial Martial Arts Tournament was a gathering of hidden dragons and crouching tigers, and although everyone knew that Suzhou City would inevitably face a round of desperate adversity, no one expected it to come so swiftly.
Six individuals made it into the second round, but one setback after another followed as the round began.
First was Gong Feiyu. What was thought to be an evenly matched battle turned out to be one where the opponent had been hiding their true strength all along. When their strength erupted, Gong Feiyu was utterly overwhelmed and knocked out of the ring. The seemingly easy-to-bully fatty possessed Star Power far beyond that of a normal person, so when faced with the wide-ranging Star Martial Skills, Gong Feiyu’s pinpoint Star Martial Skills were simply no match. Before he could even understand what happened, he was already out of the competition.
Then, another defeat for Suzhou City followed. Later, when Xu Xiangwen entered the fray with his Pure Yang Skill, he was on the verge of a miraculous turnaround victory but lost due to exhausting his Star Power. The Dean of Instruction beat his chest in frustration; this had been Suzhou City’s closest brush with victory.
"Xinyu, it’s all up to you now..." Before Jiang Xinyu entered the stage, the Dean of Instruction looked almost on the verge of tears.
The scenario of six soldiers going to battle and only one returning was unfolding for the Suzhou City team. With the three who carried their hopes all crushed and defeated, if only Jiang Xinyu advanced to the third round, then Suzhou City would truly become a laughingstock. This year’s team was the best Suzhou City had seen in ten years.
To get the worst results in ten years... that was unthinkable.
At this moment, the internet also exploded.
"Is it really that exciting? Is this year’s team just not up to par, or is each year’s team getting worse than the last? Wasn’t it said that this year’s Suzhou City team is the strongest in history?"
"Boasting is easy. The strongest in history? They haven’t even made it to the third round, and they’ve been whittled down to a lone fighter."
"That’s not entirely true; it’s obvious this year’s team is stronger than those from the past. Suzhou City’s team has five members at the Star Cloud Stage! In the past, having two was enough to be called the Gemini Stars, and with three, they could dream of the championship."
"Right, five Star Cloud Stage members, and one didn’t even make it past the first round. I suspect that particular Star Cloud Stage member just snuck in."
"Let’s be rational and analyze the problem objectively. This year’s Suzhou City team is indeed strong. If this Suzhou City team had participated in last year’s Provincial Martial Arts Meet, they might really have had a shot at the championship. It’s just bad luck this year. While the Suzhou City team grew stronger, other city teams strengthened as well. Moreover, their improvement outpaced Suzhou’s, naturally making them look like weaklings."
"Quick, look! The captain of the Suzhou City team is up."
"If they lose this match, then it’s truly over."
Under the weight of high expectations, the match began. Jiang Xinyu’s tactics perfectly embodied her usual style: reckless! One after another, she used Ice Attribute, Wind Attribute, and Water Attribute Star Martial Skills. She had Ice Slide Techniques to restrict the opponent’s movement, Wind Cutting for penetrating defense, Water Impact to push the enemy back, and plenty of Ice Attribute skills for crowd control and damage output.
The opponent, who was just at the early Star Cloud Stage with Thunder and Fire Dual Attributes, was completely baffled by Jiang Xinyu’s barrage. In less than a minute, they raised the flag to surrender.
Jiang Xinyu walked back with firm steps. Although it was a splendid victory, the gloom hanging over the Suzhou City team did not dissipate because the next two matches were against opponents who were almost impossible for them to beat.
Upon reaching the stands, the Dean of Instruction hurriedly welcomed her with enthusiasm.
Being whittled down to one person was bad enough, but at least there was still one left. Getting completely wiped out would have been truly disgraceful.
"How’s the arm?" Wang Lan asked softly, sitting down next to Jiang Xinyu.
"It’s nothing." She let Wang Lan hold her arm. Soon, a warm current flowed through it, quickly dispelling the burning pain.
It appeared that Jiang Xinyu had dominated her opponent. However, the opponent wasn’t to be underestimated; their counterattack upon facing defeat had even crippled one of Jiang Xinyu’s arms. But for the Suzhou City team, with Wang Lan, their healing Star Martial Warrior, such a wound was trivial.
"Next match: Mu Shaoyun against Gong Qilin."
Mu Shaoyun slowly stood and walked calmly to the battle arena.
"Let the match begin—"
The moment the words fell, Gong Qilin suddenly extended his arms, pointing towards Mu Shaoyun from afar. Instantaneously, a white light flared in his palm, and a beam shot out.
At that distance, with that firing velocity, even Wang Lan couldn’t help but look astonished. The distance between Mu Shaoyun and Gong Qilin was at least fifty meters, and Gong Qilin’s Star Martial Skill launched in less than half a second. The moment the light beam fired, it had already hit Mu Shaoyun.
It was like firing a sniper rifle from fifty meters away: as soon as the sniper pulled the trigger, the target was hit. This Star Martial Skill, in terms of both casting speed and attack velocity, was unavoidable. At least, Wang Lan wasn’t sure he could dodge it in time with his Star Cloud Sword Dance.

chapters.title: Chapter 222 Wolf King Charge
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 222 Wolf King Charge
BOOM! A loud noise erupted as the ground where Mu Shaoyun stood suddenly exploded. This scene caused all the spectators and teachers present to stand up involuntarily.
No one wanted a murder to occur at the provincial martial arts competition, but the scene unfolding before their eyes was horrifyingly real. Gong Qilin had launched a long-distance Star Martial Skill attack, seemingly killing Mu Shaoyun instantly.
"That doesn’t make sense," Jiang Xinyu mused. "Gong Qilin’s Star Martial Skill is fast, but he clearly raised his palm. With Mu Shaoyun’s strength, there’s no reason he wouldn’t have made any attempt to dodge."
In that instant, Gong Qilin stomped his foot, his figure darting away in a flash. His palm aimed at the ground, unleashing the same green energy columns as before.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! The ground was relentlessly bombarded, soil erupting and dust billowing. Suddenly, a figure burst from the earth like a ghost and dashed towards Gong Qilin. Seeing this figure, everyone who had anxiously stood up sighed in relief and sat down again.
As the figure appeared, Gong Qilin launched his attack once more. His Star Martial Skill was peculiar; it seemed to be his Inborn Talent of the Bloodline. The nature of this offensive skill was far superior to attacks of the seven attributes.
"Inborn Talent Skills... truly an enviable ability," Xu Xiangwen sighed.
"You say that as if you don’t have an Inborn Talent Skill yourself?" Jiang Xinyu retorted.
"How can they be the same? My Heavenly Eye is just for scouting. How can it compare to this guy’s? He has the Fire-blooded lineage! Look at his Star Martial Skill—its firing speed, its damage output—can ordinary fire even compare? Never mind me; what would *you* do against him?" Xu Xiangwen asked.
"I’d probably have to use the Star Cloud Dance to dodge until his Star Power was exhausted," Jiang Xinyu replied.
"As someone who also possesses an Inborn Talent of the Bloodline, let me tell you a secret: the Star Power consumption of an Inborn Talent of the Bloodline itself isn’t as high as you imagine," Xu Xiangwen said.
Gong Qilin’s attacks were as dense as a sudden downpour, and his own movement technique was lightning-fast. Every time Mu Shaoyun tried to close in, Gong Qilin would instantly shift positions and evade.
Five seconds later, Wang Lan’s eyes suddenly lit up. "When he’s moving at high speed, his attacks stop!"
"What good is that? He only moves for a second. After that, he’s a Gatling gun again," Xu Xiangwen scoffed.
"One second. Isn’t that enough?" Wang Lan countered.
At that moment, Mu Shaoyun seemed to confirm Wang Lan’s observation, though his method was different. Instantly, Mu Shaoyun’s body flickered, and seven or eight identical versions of him appeared.
"The Skill of Duplicates?!"
Many in the stands exclaimed in unison. The Skill of Duplicates was a D-class Star Martial Skill that created illusory clones to confuse an opponent. These illusory clones had no mass and, naturally, no attack power.
When mastered, it could create multiple clones. This was completely different from Xu Xiangwen’s Physical Clone; illusory clones could only confuse the opponent and possessed no attack power. They weren’t even as effective as the afterimages from Wang Lan’s Star Cloud Dance, as those could at least conceal Wang Lan’s true body.
Using a D-class Star Martial Skill in such a situation, against the powerful Gong Qilin? Many students thought Mu Shaoyun was crazy. What was the purpose of these illusory clones?
However, the eyes of many teachers from the Star Martial Academies lit up.
There are no useless Star Martial Skills, only useless Star Martial Warriors. If the situation and timing are right, even a D-class Star Martial Skill can achieve a decisive victory.
The moment Gong Qilin shifted positions again, Mu Shaoyun activated The Skill of Duplicates. When Gong Qilin saw seven Mu Shaoyuns on the field, he momentarily panicked.
He raised his hand and blasted towards them.
PUFF! PUFF! PUFF! Plumes of dust scattered, revealing that none of them were Mu Shaoyun’s real body.
Instantly, a chill shot up Gong Qilin’s spine as a dense killing intent surged from behind him. Mu Shaoyun erupted from the ground behind him, delivering a slash that seemed to tear through the void.
Gong Qilin had only turned halfway when his body froze. Mu Shaoyun’s blade was already resting on his shoulder.
"You’ve lost."
"I..." Gong Qilin let out a ragged breath. "I’ve lost."
It was an unexpected duel, and a difficult one to comprehend. Gong Qilin was a descendant of a Star Martial Art family. Though the family had declined, its foundations remained.
Moreover, he had awakened his Fire-blooded lineage and was seen by his clan as their hope for resurgence. Gong Qilin had strived to revitalize his family, relentlessly practicing his Inborn Talent of the Bloodline. He was a top expert among Tong City’s third-year high school students. Since those stronger than him hadn’t entered the provincial martial arts competition, he was the captain and the strongest on the Tong City team.
The provincial martial arts competition was meant to be his stage to shine. However, he, who had aimed for the championship, never expected to be eliminated in the second round, failing to advance from the sixty-five contestants to the final thirty-three.
If he had lost to another powerhouse with an Inborn Talent of the Bloodline, Gong Qilin could have accepted it. But his opponent had defeated him using only low-level Star Martial Skills like the Earth Movement Skill, Basic Body Skill, and The Skill of Duplicates. This was a truth Gong Qilin found impossible to accept or endure.
When he uttered the words "I’ve lost," Gong Qilin felt as if all strength had been drained from him, and he collapsed helplessly to the ground. Tears streamed from his sorrowful eyes.
Mu Shaoyun smiled faintly and turned towards the stands. In the Suzhou City team’s section, their Dean of Instruction was already jumping with excitement. He hadn’t expected Mu Shaoyun to deliver such a massive surprise.
Gong Qilin’s Fire-blooded lineage was so strong that even after studying it all night, the Dean of Instruction hadn’t found a way to counter it. Yet, Mu Shaoyun had managed to overcome it so simply, so effortlessly.
This battle sparked heated discussions not only among the spectators at the venue but also caused the online community to erupt into debate. Unlike the on-site discussions, the online debate centered on Gong Qilin being overrated and not living up to his reputation.
So much for Star Martial Art families, Inborn Talents of the Bloodline, and the captain of the Tong City team! Can’t even take a hit!
Under the ridicule of Greater Suzhou City’s citizens, the people of Tong City fought back.
"Our Tong City has eight Star Cloud Stage masters!"
"Your captain lost."
"Eighty percent of our Tong City team made it to the second round!"
"Your captain lost."
"Our Tong City—"
"Your captain lost."
"WAAAH—"
As the saying goes, laymen watch the spectacle, while experts observe the technique. The expressions of almost all the observing teachers from the Star Martial Academies changed as they looked at Mu Shaoyun. A gleam entered their eyes—a covetous green glint.
Mu Shaoyun hadn’t displayed any overwhelmingly powerful Star Martial Skills; he had only revealed the tip of the iceberg regarding his strength. Yet, this glimpse was terrifying upon deeper reflection. The greatest factor in Mu Shaoyun’s victory was his tactical application.
The simpler the tactic appeared, the more profound its underlying complexity. How much incredible experience and terrifying combat awareness were required to identify the simplest, most effective tactic amidst such lightning-fast exchanges?
But it wasn’t just his excellent tactical application. The two Star Martial Skills Mu Shaoyun demonstrated revealed his profound and inscrutable abilities. His Earth Travel Skill allowed him to vanish in an instant. Even these teachers hadn’t seen when Mu Shaoyun had gone underground; they had initially thought he was killed instantly.
To cultivate the Earth Travel Skill to such a level was rare, even among Star Cloud Stage warriors. Then there was The Skill of Duplicates, capable of creating seven incredibly lifelike illusory clones. Many teachers had never witnessed such a flawless execution of The Skill of Duplicates.
What was even more formidable was that, immediately after activating The Skill of Duplicates, his true body went underground again using the Earth Travel Skill for a second time—still unnoticed. The first time might have been because the teachers weren’t paying close attention. But the second time demonstrated genuine skill.
To execute an Earth Travel Skill that even the teachers couldn’t detect—Mu Shaoyun’s mastery of Star Martial Skills had to be unfathomably profound.
This student... he was a must-get!
"Wang Lan, come here for a moment," Jiang Xinyu suddenly said.
The two stood up and walked to the back of the stands. The Dean of Instruction started to call out to Wang Lan, but seeing they hadn’t gone far, he stopped himself.
"Wang Lan, did you grasp Mu Shaoyun’s true strength?" Jiang Xinyu asked.
"His combat awareness is terrifying," Wang Lan replied. "Even though he only used basic Star Martial Skills, his timing and execution were nearly perfect. In that regard, we all fall short."
"Indeed," Jiang Xinyu agreed. "I don’t know what Mu Shaoyun has experienced recently. I used to think our strengths were comparable, but now I feel a sense of powerlessness. Gong Qilin’s strength seemed slightly above mine, yet Mu Shaoyun defeated him easily. Perhaps I, too, would be easily defeated by him."
"No, you’re different from Gong Qilin," Wang Lan said. "I can see that Gong Qilin relies too heavily on his Fire-blooded lineage and has neglected to improve in other areas. You, at least, could have parried Mu Shaoyun’s final strike. Besides, Gong Qilin’s fighting style isn’t as versatile as yours. I didn’t see him use any notable defensive or evasive maneuvers. It might not be as easy for you against Gong Qilin as it was for Mu Shaoyun, but I believe you could still win in the end."
After comforting Jiang Xinyu, Wang Lan and she returned to their seats in the stands.
At three o’clock in the afternoon, Wang Lan’s matchup finally appeared on the battle board.
Wang Lan stood up with a smile, giving his companions a reassuring look.
In their eyes, Yang Tianyi’s Sun Wheel was an invincible Star Palace Artifact, guaranteeing defeat for anyone who faced it. But in Wang Lan’s eyes...
Heh...
When Wang Lan had first received the Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth, he’d thought he shouldn’t use it to cheat; if he were to gain an unfair advantage, he should at least summon its Phoenix form. But seeing Yang Tianyi so brazenly using his Star Palace Artifact, dominating everyone, Wang Lan’s rebellious streak made him want to stomp on Yang Tianyi’s face a few times.
A Star Palace Artifact? So what? Is a Star Palace Artifact really that impressive? It’s not like I don’t have one!
The Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth, though only a Bronze Saint Cloth, was born from the Hellfire of the Underworld. It possessed the immortal trait of rebirth from flames and feared fire least of all.
So, you think you can pay to win and crush weaker opponents, huh? What goes around, comes around.
"He’s here! The Wolf King strikes, leaving nothing standing!"
"The Wolf King is invincible, an unstoppable force!" On the forums, countless fans of the Wolf King roared with excitement.
"Wolf King? Just wait until our Tianyi turns him into a roasted husky!" the Tai’an City online army chimed in.
"Exactly! Our Tianyi is invincible! The Sun Wheel is undefeated!"
"What the—?! Are Tai’an City’s trolls trying to flood the Suzhou City forums and dominate the threads?"
"Brothers, charge!"
The provincial martial arts competition was underway, but even before Wang Lan and Yang Tianyi’s match began, their fans were already clashing fiercely online. Armed with their keyboards, these warriors dominated the discussions, fearlessly taking on all comers. The intensity of the online battle made many self-proclaimed keyboard masters flee in despair.
I thought I was a master of the keyboard arts, but now I see there are always higher mountains to climb, always greater masters out there! No, I must go into seclusion and train for another three to five years...

chapters.title: Chapter 223 Perfect
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 223 Perfect
The warm May breeze rustled the green willows, and white clouds like beautiful cotton tufts dotted the blue canvas of the sky. Yang Tianyi, wearing a pale gold trench coat, walked step by step towards Wang Lan.
His full head of hair, lifted by the breeze, seemed to drift as if in water.
Wang Lan stood quietly ten meters opposite Yang Tianyi, his body surrounded by surging Star Power.
"Student Wang Lan, Student Yang Tianyi, are you ready?"
"Ready, teacher," Wang Lan replied calmly.
"Hmm," Yang Tianyi hummed softly.
"Good, then... the match begins!"
BEEP—
The instant the whistle pierced the air, Wang Lan moved. His body suddenly seemed to explode, splitting into over a dozen silhouettes, much like Mu Shaoyun’s The Skill of Duplicates. This scene caused many contestants from outside Suzhou City in the audience to stare in disbelief.
"Another use of The Skill of Duplicates? Do all the students from Suzhou City specialize in this?"
"Splitting into over a dozen illusory duplicates in an instant? Even more impressive than Mu Shaoyun? And he’s only at the Star Shine Stage!"
As soon as these words were spoken, the surrounding teachers from various Star Martial Academies furrowed their brows. They coldly turned to look at the speaking student. Upon seeing it was an already eliminated contestant, their reaction was understandable.
"Shut up, don’t embarrass yourself. Can’t you even tell if it’s The Skill of Duplicates or not? Even if you can’t, shouldn’t you have read the information on the Suzhou City contestants? What kind of The Skill of Duplicates is this? This is simply Wang Lan’s Star Cloud Dance. It’s just that the afterimages linger longer."
Although its appearance was similar to The Skill of Duplicates, its essence was entirely different. At the very least, The Skill of Duplicates could act independently, while the Star Cloud Dance could not. It merely served to confuse the opponent and conceal the user’s true body.
Yang Tianyi’s lips curled slightly upwards, and the Star Power around his body surged. In a flash, an Array of Star Power condensed before him. He brought a clenched fist to his mouth.
"Great Fireball Skill."
BOOM—
A blaze erupted from Yang Tianyi’s mouth, instantly transforming into a massive fireball over ten meters in diameter. The fireball rolled like a heavy truck, barreling towards Wang Lan. The Great Fireball Skill was a Star Martial Skill that fell between single-target attacks and area-of-effect damage.
Even with Wang Lan’s exquisite Star Cloud Dance and swift evasion, if the entire area was under attack, he could only retreat. The moment he retreated, a Purple Flame Arrow instantly shot out from his wrist.
BOOM—
The fireball exploded, flames spreading outward in all directions. It was as if the ground, doused in alcohol, had suddenly been set ablaze. The match had started with such an explosive Star Martial Skill that many contestants in the stands were struggling to keep up.
Wang Lan had already retreated to the edge of the arena, his mind analyzing his opponent’s tactical psychology.
First, the opponent is definitely underestimating me; otherwise, he wouldn’t be so unconcerned about draining his Star Power. The Great Fireball Skill might not sound impressive, but it’s a genuine A-grade Star Martial Skill, balancing both range and destructive power.
Wang Lan had researched this Star Martial Skill when selecting his own. It had excellent practical effects but consumed a significant amount of Star Power. At the Star Shine Stage, even with full Star Power, Wang Lan could only use it once.
Moreover, this Star Martial Skill wasn’t suited for close-quarters combat. It was fast to activate, with subtle Star Energy Fluctuation, making it suitable for the battlefield or for stealth attacks. Unless the opponent was exceptionally arrogant, he wouldn’t use this Star Martial Skill under these circumstances.
Perhaps the Star Shine Stage of my Star Martial Art gave him too much confidence.
The corner of Wang Lan’s mouth ticked up, and his figure flashed. Once again, his body crackled with fine electric arcs. The electric arcs grew brighter until, in a blink, Wang Lan appeared cloaked in a mantle of lightning.
"Is this... thunder-element combat?"
"What Star Martial Skill is this? Does anyone know?"
Although Wang Lan hadn’t yet demonstrated the power of this state, the light and shadow effects were incredibly striking. It was like the glowing aura of a Saiyan after transforming, but Wang Lan was enveloped in crackling lightning.
Not only did the contestants present not recognize this Star Martial Skill, but even the teachers from the various Star Martial Academies were clueless. They had never seen such a Star Martial Skill; it resembled Thunder Armor but lacked its distinct structure.
The seemingly uncontrollable lightning flowed like water, enveloping Wang Lan and the shortsword in his hand.
In Wang Qianfeng’s office at the Tianjian Bureau, He MingXue frowned deeply.
What is this...?
he wondered.
If others didn’t know what Star Martial Skill Wang Lan was using, it might be excusable. But for a high-ranking member of the Tianjian Bureau like himself not to even have an inkling was deeply unsettling.
"Old Wang," He MingXue asked, "is it from the Vermilion Bird Squad? Do you know?"
"If even you don’t know, how could I? Just observe the form of this Star Martial Skill, and you’ll understand," Wang Qianfeng replied.
On the live broadcast, Wang Lan shot forward instantly, his speed several times greater than before. Having mastered Thunder Activity, this was the first time he had demonstrated the power of this move.
Opposite him, Yang Tianyi immediately dropped his contemptuous expression.
Thunder Activity, huh? I originally thought he was just a lucky guy who made it to the top sixty-five. But now it seems he does have some skill.
Being able to master Thunder Activity at the Star Shine Stage was enough to make him take Wang Lan seriously.
Yang Tianyi’s Star Power surged once more, coalescing into tangible flames that burned around his body. His hands crossed, and his body bent slightly.
Seeing this, all the teachers’ eyes suddenly lit up, their faces filled with anticipation for Yang Tianyi’s next move.
"Feather Ascent—"
Indeed!
All the teachers’ eyes shone even brighter. He had truly mastered Feather Ascent. Feather Ascent was an A-grade Star Martial Skill, but its power could rival some weaker S-grade skills.
With a wave of his hands, he unleashed a dense swarm of flame birds that descended upon his opponent like locusts.
Similarly, the more powerful the Star Martial Skill, the more difficult it was to cultivate. Based on Yang Tianyi’s previous performances, many teachers had a low opinion of him, believing he relied solely on the Sun Wheel and would be nothing without it.
But now, the strength Yang Tianyi displayed had won the recognition of most teachers. Having mastered two A-grade Star Martial Skills and reached the Star Cloud Stage, he certainly deserved to be called a genius. Coupled with his Star Martial family background and the Sun Wheel’s support, their initially poor impression of him was instantly overturned.
The flame birds were incredibly dense, their speed like lightning. Using his Thunder Activity-enhanced movement technique, Wang Lan danced among them like a butterfly flitting through a storm of petals.
As the saying goes, comparisons can be brutal. Feather Ascent was already stunningly magnificent, but when compared to Wang Lan dancing through it with such effortless grace, the difference in skill was stark.
"A thunder-element Star Martial Skill, Thor’s Armor movement technique... How did he achieve such perfect control?"
"This student must possess extraordinary talent in Star Power control to manage even the most volatile thunder-element Star Martial Skill to such a degree... It’s simply... unbelievable!"
"Our Jin City Star Warrior Academy wants this student!"
"Our Southeast Star Martial Academy wants him too!
Why did I say ’too’?
"
Many observing teachers from the Star Martial Academies quietly marked ’Excellent’ on Wang Lan’s evaluation form, and some even wrote ’Exceptionally Excellent.’
At the Tianjian Bureau, Wang Qianfeng and He MingXue were in a state of shock. They stared blankly as Wang Lan conjured one Thunder Illusion after another, his movements as dazzling as the Flash in slow motion. They remained silent for a long time.
Others might not know what Wang Lan’s Star Martial Skill is, but how could we not? This is clearly a Star Martial Skill combining Thunder Snake and Star Cloud Sword Dance, isn’t it? Not a simultaneous release, but a perfectly merged composite Star Martial Skill!
Damn it!
He MingXue vaguely remembered Wang Lan mastering Thunder Activity right under his nose, and it seemed like just yesterday.
How long has it been? He can already perform a composite Star Martial Skill? And a perfectly combined one at that!
"Old Wang, why do I feel somewhat guilty?" He MingXue asked.
"What have you done to wrong me?" Wang Qianfeng retorted.
"Get lost! I’m talking about Wang Lan. I taught him the Flame Sword and guided his cultivation of thunder-element Star Martial Skills. But who would believe me if I said that? Am I even qualified to guide Wang Lan? Do you think that one day, people might believe *he* was the one who taught *us*?"
"You have the nerve to say that? Isn’t it true? Where did you learn your Flame Saber Fluid Technique? Don’t think I don’t know who was secretly practicing the vertical Flame Sword at home, relying on the Solar Wheel!"
"I..." He MingXue chuckled coldly. "And what about you? Don’t you see how strong the composite Star Martial Skill combining the Thunder Attribute and Star Cloud Sword Dance is? Why don’t you learn it?"
"I don’t have the Thunder Attribute."
"But you have the Wind Attribute—"
"Look quickly, Wang Lan is approaching!"
Just as they spoke, Wang Lan closed in to within three meters of Yang Tianyi. At this distance, the Thunder Snake Sword Dance was most powerful.
Wang Lan’s figure instantly split into seven lightning illusions as he fiercely swung the Sword of Thor at Yang Tianyi.
Yang Tianyi’s face turned deathly pale in an instant, experiencing such intense, real killing intent for the first time.
It was also at this moment that some of the more insightful teachers in the stands stood up. They now realized that Wang Lan’s move was not just a simple Star Martial Skill, but a composite Star Martial Skill.
If Wang Lan hadn’t previously displayed the Star Cloud Sword Dance, they wouldn’t have been so certain.
Now, enveloped in lightning, Wang Lan once again executed the same lightning afterimage technique. This was definitely not a coincidence.
"To combine a thunder-element Star Martial Skill with Star Cloud Sword Dance and perfectly retain the strengths of both... this boy can no longer be described as merely a genius."
"To master a composite Star Martial Skill at the Star Shine Stage—something only those at the Galaxy Stage should be capable of—and to fuse them so perfectly that even we almost couldn’t tell."
I finally understand why Wang Lan is only at the Star Shine Stage! With such terrifying talent, he must have spent a lot of time improving his combat skills.
Suddenly, many teachers picked up Wang Lan’s evaluation form, erasing the ’Excellent’ and ’Exceptionally Excellent’ assessments. Then, swiftly, with strokes like a darting dragon, they wrote ’Perfect.’
Given the terrifying talent Wang Lan had displayed, he truly deserved the ’Perfect’ assessment. This was a horrifying level of talent, not inferior to that of the Five Emperors!

chapters.title: Chapter 224 Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 224 Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth Appears
Dozens of sword lights slashed at Yang Tianyi from all directions, each strike bursting forth with a magnificent arc of electricity. Wang Lan’s figure flickered around Yang Tianyi, his shimmering form like Thor descending upon the world.
After a barrage of Thunderbolt Sword strikes, Wang Lan instantly retreated, maintaining a safe distance for evasion. The spreading arcs of electricity gradually dispersed, revealing the figure within.
No, to be precise, it was a large, bell-shaped golden barrier. It was semi-transparent and emitted a faint golden glow. And Yang Tianyi stood within the barrier, arms folded, quietly sizing up Wang Lan with a defiant glare.
The barrier slowly opened and began to rise into the air.
Online, Yang Tianyi’s fans instantly erupted with excitement.
"He’s summoned the Sun Wheel! Yang Tianyi is finally going for the counter-kill!"
"With the Sun Wheel out, who can even compete!"
"Trash! All you know is how to cheat. If you have any guts, fight the Wolf King fair and square. What kind of skill is winning with an artifact?"
"Huh, it’s just like paying in a game. He owns the artifact through his own capabilities, so why can’t he use it? The Provincial Martial Arts Tournament rules don’t even prohibit it, so why are you all complaining?"
"Once a cheater, always despised."
This time, the multitude of fans from Suzhou City was no match for Yang Tianyi’s fans from Tai’an City. After all, they also knew the power of the Sun Wheel. As long as that artifact was used, Wang Lan’s chances of winning were slim.
The Sun Wheel slowly rose. Even before displaying its formidable power, its terrifying presence alone was enough to send shivers down one’s spine.
In the stands, the headteacher was so angry his face turned a shade of green. Was Wang Lan’s performance strong? It had far exceeded his expectations. He had anticipated a one-sided affair, but instead, Wang Lan had been perfectly suppressing Yang Tianyi.
Although he couldn’t understand the Star Martial Skill Wang Lan was using, he was certain that without the Sun Wheel, Wang Lan would definitely have made it to the third round.
"Even if Wang Lan loses this match, I will protest to the Education Bureau! We can’t allow things that compromise the fairness of the competition in the future!"
"Director, a Star Palace Artifact is also a part of one’s strength. Strictly speaking, this isn’t cheating. Since the Provincial Martial Arts Tournament aims to simulate actual combat, any means used are reasonable," Mu Shaoyun said with a faint smile.
"Will you still say that when you’re the one facing Yang Tianyi?" Xu Xiangwen retorted, clearly annoyed, a sneer on his face.
"Being helpless against the Solar Wheel only proves one’s lack of strength. Although a Star Palace Artifact is powerful, it is, after all, just a weapon. How much power it can unleash still depends on the person wielding it."
The Solar Wheel ascended rapidly, and in an instant, the sky brightened, becoming twice as luminous as before.
A beam of light descended from the sky, nearly covering the entire tournament arena. Wang Lan was inevitably enveloped by the light. Looking up, the Sun Wheel resembled a newly risen sun.
Wang Lan moved to dodge, but instantly sensed something was wrong.
A powerful restraining force descended from above, feeling like a mountain pressing down on Wang Lan. The unbearable weight made Wang Lan’s movements stiff, even under the effects of Thunder Activity.
Wang Lan raised his hand, pointing towards the new sun in the sky.
Flames surged around him, and a pair of wings burning with purple fire unfolded from his wrists. In an instant, a purple Fire Arrow, as thick as an arm, shot out from Wang Lan’s fingertip.
BOOM!
A terrifying explosion erupted in the sky, and the arena momentarily plunged into darkness.
"Impressive... another brand new compound Star Martial Skill."
"Can he shoot it down?"
Many hearts leaped into their throats. Only Yang Tianyi remained with his arms folded, a cold sneer on his face.
A Star Palace Artifact... If a mere Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warrior could bring it down, how could it still be called an artifact? Besides, my Sun Wheel holds a significant place among Star Palace Artifacts.
"Die!" Yang Tianyi’s eyes glinted with murderous intent. With a light wave of his hand, the Sun Wheel descended from the sky like a colossal mountain.
As the Sun Wheel pressed down, the area of light it cast rapidly shrank. Wang Lan saw an opportunity to escape the Sun Wheel’s coverage, but just as he was about to move, a terrifying pressure assailed him once more.
Wang Lan’s figure paused minutely, and in that fleeting moment, he missed the optimal window to escape the Sun Wheel’s range. The Sun Wheel hovered above Wang Lan’s head, and golden flames, propelled by the wheel’s rotation, surged towards him.
"Wang Lan—" Jiang Xinyu cried out, jumping to her feet, her face instantly turning deathly pale.
Once engulfed by True Sunfire, how could Wang Lan’s mortal body possibly endure it? And at the moment Wang Lan was engulfed, many who recognized his strength could only shake their heads helplessly.
It was over. Not because he wasn’t strong enough, but because he was unlucky enough to encounter this cheater.
Engulfed by the flames, Wang Lan immediately felt a terrifying heatwave. Fortunately, Yang Tianyi had no intention of killing him. Although flames spread around the periphery, the center where Wang Lan stood was not being directly scorched. However, once the oxygen was depleted, Wang Lan would surely die.
So, in Yang Tianyi’s view, Wang Lan’s only chance was to surrender obediently before the oxygen ran out.
But at that moment, Star Power flickered around Wang Lan. At his summons, the Star Palace above him opened instantly, and immense Star Power surged forth.
"Wang Lan, are you still not surrendering? If you don’t surrender soon, you’ll be nothing but ashes under my True Sunfire..."
His words had just reached that point when he suddenly stopped.
He sensed a powerful force emerging from the starry sky above. Before he could comprehend what was happening, the phantasmal image of a phoenix flickered in and out of existence amidst the True Sunfire.
The Phoenix Saint Cloth appeared above Wang Lan’s head, instantly disassembling and encasing his body. The moment the Phoenix Saint Cloth was donned, the scorching heat around him immediately dissipated. Even the flames now felt strangely familiar and almost welcoming to Wang Lan.
The undying bird from the underworld, the phoenix reborn from ashes—how could it fear mere flames?
He clenched his fist and punched towards the wall of flames formed by the True Sunfire. Feeling almost no resistance, Wang Lan burst out.
"Holy shit! What did I just see?"
"A phoenix?"
"No... it’s Wang Lan! Wait, what’s he wearing? Is that armor?"
"Where did that come from?"
In modern society, armor was long a thing of the past. In the era of firearms, its protective function had become nil. Even Star Martial Warriors, who fought with cold weapons, wouldn’t wear something that hindered movement and offered no substantial protection. Thus, Wang Lan appearing in a full suit of armor was indeed eye-catching.
The azure armor was adorned with brilliant patterns. After breaking free from the Sun Wheel, Wang Lan didn’t launch a sneak attack on Yang Tianyi. Since Yang Tianyi had previously shown him a sliver of mercy, Wang Lan naturally reciprocated by allowing him to maintain his dignity.
Normally, Yang Tianyi should have immediately manipulated the Sun Wheel to attack again. But at that moment, he just stared blankly at the armor on Wang Lan’s body, an incredulous expression on his face.
"A Star Palace Artifact? You have one too?"
Wang Lan smiled and nodded. "How about we both put away our Star Palace Artifacts? This is called the Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth. It’s born from flames; your Sun Wheel is ineffective against me now."
"Is that so?" Yang Tianyi regained his composure. "Even among Star Palace Artifacts, there are differences in power."
As his words fell, Yang Tianyi waved his hand. The Sun Wheel in the sky instantly ignited and plummeted, transforming into a meteor hurtling towards the earth.
That locked-on sensation washed over Wang Lan once more. But this time, before he could even adjust to it, the Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth on his body suddenly pulsed with a mysterious energy, and the locked-on feeling vanished without a trace.
Electric arcs danced around him, rapidly enveloping his body. In an instant, Wang Lan moved. His figure flashed, transforming into a streak of light as he rushed towards Yang Tianyi.
"Damn it!" Yang Tianyi furrowed his brows, his Star Power somewhat depleted. His tactics against Wang Lan had failed; one wrong move had led to a cascade of errors.
But if you think I can only stand here because of the Sun Wheel, you are sorely mistaken!
Instantly, flames erupted around Yang Tianyi, similar to the Leopard King’s fire acceleration. His figure suddenly sped up, the flames behind him forming a fiery trail, and in the blink of an eye, he was before Wang Lan.
Yang Tianyi skillfully dodged Wang Lan’s Thunderbolt Sword and hammered a punch towards Wang Lan’s chest.
But Yang Tianyi seemed to have forgotten that Wang Lan was the man wearing the Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth.
BOOM! Flames erupted, like a brilliant firework exploding against Wang Lan’s chest. Wang Lan’s body only paused for a moment. Then, his figure flickered strangely, vanishing like a ghost before Yang Tianyi’s eyes.
Not good!
Yang Tianyi’s expression changed drastically. Just as he was about to move, his body froze. Wang Lan’s Thunderbolt Sword rested gently on his shoulder.
The scene froze—a moment of breathtaking beauty.
BEEP!
"Second round, Wang Lan versus Yang Tianyi! Wang Lan wins!" the referee announced, his voice booming.
It was an exhilarating battle, one that invigorated everyone in Suzhou City who had witnessed it. The seemingly unbeatable Yang Tianyi had actually lost, defeated by Wang Lan, who also possessed a Star Palace Artifact.
As the referee declared the victor, a system notification sounded in Wang Lan’s mind: "Successfully advanced to the second round of the Provincial Martial Arts Tournament, becoming one of the top thirty-three. Reward: 5,000 experience points, 400 skill points."
Four hundred skill points, that’s great.
A knowing smile touched Wang Lan’s lips. The Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth on his body instantly disassembled, then reformed above his head into a proud phoenix with wings outstretched. Finally, Wang Lan’s Star Palace opened, and the Phoenix Saint Cloth transformed into a stream of light, entering the Star Palace.
This scene was broadcast live to countless households.
"So cool! This armor... it’s simply... it’s like something out of a myth!"
"It can assemble into a phoenix and also transform into armor he can wear? I just had an idea! I have to create a manga series about these transformable armors... It’ll be called... hmm, let’s see..."
"To the guy above, looking forward to your new work!"
"The Wolf King is truly invincible! Hey, Tai’an City’s paid commenters, come on out and try to spin this!"
"Tch, and here I thought the Wolf King won with his actual strength. Turns out he also relied on a Star Palace Artifact."
"Wow, I’ve never seen anyone so shameless! Didn’t your Tianyi use a Star Palace Artifact first?"
"I’m merely rebutting your earlier statement that relying on a Star Palace Artifact doesn’t count as real skill. Didn’t your Wolf King use one too?"
"You don’t know squat! Why do you think the Wolf King didn’t use his Star Palace God Soldier from the start? It shows he has a bottom line. This time, he was just giving your guy a taste of his own medicine. Unlike your Tianyi, who has no shame from beginning to end."
"Damn it, are you looking for a flame war? Brothers, let’s show them what the Suzhou City fans are made of!"
"Scared? Bring it on—"

chapters.title: Chapter 225 Eld Di Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 225 Eld Di Arrives
Wang Lan brushed the matter aside, leaving his achievements and fame deeply hidden. Yet, the countless people who watched the match via livestream were already seething with excitement, unable to remain seated. This was especially true for those of the Flame Emperor lineage who knew Wang Lan’s true identity; they were all contacting each other, making inquiries.
"DINGLINGLING—"
In Wang Qianfeng’s office, the telephone rang.
"Hello, it’s me! Director!" Wang Qianfeng suddenly snapped to attention, his expression respectful.
"Wang Qianfeng, where did Wang Lan get that Star Palace Artifact? Do you know?"
"I don’t. I was also shocked when I saw Wang Lan take out the Star Palace Artifact this afternoon. But it must be something Lord Flame Emperor left for Wang Lan, right? Lord Flame Emperor’s signature technique is the Phoenix Form, and that armor is shaped exactly like a phoenix. I assumed there had to be a connection. Furthermore, we had no prior knowledge that Lord Flame Emperor would pass the Phoenix Form to Wang Lan, so I surmise it might have been given to him along with the Phoenix Form."
"Although that’s the only reasonable explanation, Lord Flame Emperor never produced that Star Palace Artifact before she left. If it belonged to her, why has she never used it?"
"Director, He MingXue and I have discussed this. We believe that while the Phoenix Armor is powerful, it probably serves only as protective gear. With Lord Flame Emperor’s strength, would she really need to wear armor for protection?"
"Hmm... that makes sense. I’ve heard the Demon Clan intends to cause trouble at Jiang Province’s provincial competition? Eld Di is coming to Jiang Province tomorrow. Are there any problems on your end?"
"All combat units of the Tianjian Bureau have returned and are on standby. If those Demon Clan brats dare to cause trouble in Suzhou City, none of them will make it back."
"Good! That puts my mind at ease. If there’s nothing else, I’m hanging up..."
The headmaster approached Jiang Xinyu with a smile. "Jiang Xinyu, I heard you and Wang Lan have known each other since childhood?"
"Yes, since we were very young. If his mother was busy with work and didn’t have time to care for him, she would ask my mother to look after him," Jiang Xinyu said thoughtfully.
"Then, is Wang Lan the heir to some prominent Star Martial family? Are you clear about his background?"
"I know some things, but I can’t say. Wang Lan’s background is very significant, and it’s completely logical for him to possess a Star Palace Artifact."
"I see. In that case, I won’t pry any further," the headmaster said.
If Wang Lan knew the outside world unanimously deemed it logical for him to possess a Star Palace Artifact, he would probably scoff internally.
Turning the virtual into reality through item sacrifices—what part of that is logical?
However, at that moment, Wang Lan was oblivious and indifferent to the outside world’s speculation. His current concern was that he had finally amassed two thousand skill points, allowing him to freely link four Star Martial Skills.
Sitting cross-legged, he focused his mind, opened the system, and called up the Star Martial Skill interface. The four Star Martial Skills on the interface seemed to beckon temptingly to Wang Lan.
Add points, quickly add points...
Two thousand skill points were fed into the system. The instant the last point was entered, the four skill icons blazed with dazzling light. Four streams of information surged directly into Wang Lan’s mind; his eyes immediately became vacant, while his mind painted a different scene.
It might have been an eon, like seas turning into mulberry fields, or perhaps it was but the blink of an eye.
When Wang Lan’s awareness returned, he had changed. He was still the same person, yet he had shed some of his youthful frivolity, gaining a measure of the profound gravity of Mount Tai.
The experience and comprehension required for chaining four Star Martial Skills were on a completely different level compared to chaining just two. Previously, he couldn’t use dynamic vision in his Thunder Snake state. Now, however, he could, and he could also instinctively shoot Crescent Arrows simultaneously.
At this moment, Wang Lan truly understood the sheer magnitude of improvement that a single advancement, a single leap, could bring to his strength.
Even though his Star Power level hadn’t changed, and his skills hadn’t upgraded to Gold or Silver Rank Nine, his past self seemed utterly powerless before his current self.
Crescent Arrow could now activate Thunder Snake, and Star Cloud Thunder Snake could execute Flame Sword. Even more devastatingly, he could combine dynamic vision with Thunder Activity and Thunder Afterimage, and then add Flame Sword. He wondered how his past self could possibly have withstood such a high-attack, high-agility, high-damage-output move. Factoring in the defensive boost from the Phoenix Armor, Wang Lan felt that, in this state, the championship was no longer just a dream.
An unstoppable smile spread across his face. He tried to prevent his grin from widening further, but his body seemed to have a mind of its own.
"DADADA—" There was a knock on the door. "Lanzi, what are you doing holed up in there? It’s not a bathroom! Come out, the live draw for pairings is about to start."
"Oh..."
Wang Lan opened the door. Xu Xiangwen looked at him, puzzled. "What’s up? Did you secretly eat something delicious? You look so happy."
"Have I?"
"Your mouth is split as wide as a gourd dipper."
"Nothing. It just seems I’ve gained some insights from this match." Wang Lan walked into the living room, where Jiang Xinyu and Xie Sisi were also present. On the screen, the drawing for the tournament bracket was already underway. This time, Suzhou City had three representatives who made it into the top thirty-three. Of the thirteen cities in Jiang Province, four had their teams completely wiped out, while another two cities only had one participant advance. Suzhou City’s strength was average within Jiang Province, so having three participants advance was a decent result.
Soon, Wang Lan’s portrait was drawn, and his opponent’s also appeared on the screen.
"It’s him!" Upon seeing the opponent, everyone first looked at Wang Lan in surprise, then their expressions turned peculiar.
Wang Lan muttered to himself, "Lei Tianxu... captain of the Lian City representative team. Why is it another captain?"
"You realize it’s another captain, huh? But this Lei Tianxu isn’t just any ordinary captain; he’s a formidable figure, reputed to be able to take on an entire team by himself."
"Anyone can brag," Wang Lan laughed. "Our captain could also take on their entire team alone."
"Wang Lan, don’t take this lightly. Lei Tianxu is a descendant of an old Star Martial clan. Seventy years ago, the Berserker Clan shed their blood for Jade Country. After the victory, Jade Country mobilized all its resources to find these meritorious clans, but they had all vanished without a trace.
The Berserker Clan was among those that disappeared. It was thought that they had been wiped out. That is, until Lei Tianxu awakened the Berserker Bloodline. DNA matching later confirmed he was indeed a descendant of one of those meritorious clans.
Given the Berserker Clan’s formidable reputation seventy years ago, I was fortunate enough to access some information about them. Their Inborn Talent of the Bloodline can be summed up in two words: sheer dominance."
"Dominance? How so?"
"Once their bloodline is activated, their eyes turn red, and their skin turns brown. They lose all sensation of pain and fatigue, become extremely agitated, and their physical capabilities triple under the surge of Berserker blood. They also gain superior intuition and innate combat instincts."
"So, in other words, they go berserk?"
"More or less. But it’s only their body that goes berserk, not their mind."
"Alright then." The disdain on Wang Lan’s face gradually faded.
「Late that night,」
Across from the Grand Hyatt Hotel, a convoy of cars pulled up slowly to the entrance of the Yalan Hotel. A group of people, who had been waiting at the hotel entrance for hours, eagerly hurried forward to greet them.
Among them were the mayor, the heads of various sectors in Suzhou City, the chief of police, and officers from the Tianjian Bureau.
"Welcome to Suzhou City, Eld Di."
"Welcome, Eld Di."
A car door opened, and a tall young man quickly stepped out. He then opened another door and helped a slender, white-haired old man out of the car.
"You’ve all worked hard, waiting up so late for an old man like me. You should get some rest..."
"It’s no trouble at all! It’s been many years since you last visited Suzhou City, Eld Di."
"It has been about seven or eight years... Suzhou City has changed dramatically. Coming here, I observed it’s almost indistinguishable from Modu City now. Mayor Qiu, you’ve done excellent work."
"It’s all thanks to everyone’s hard work."
"Now that you’ve arrived safely, Eld Di, we can finally relax. It’s quite late; you should get some rest. If you need anything, please don’t hesitate to ask the hotel staff."
"Hmm, you should also go back and rest early. Don’t worry about this old fellow; I can manage on my own. You should all head back now."
「The next day,」
The sports stadium was adorned with vibrant, fluttering banners. As the provincial martial arts competition entered its third round, the matches reached their most exciting stage. Although many rounds remained before the championship battle, the thirty-three contestants who had advanced were largely top-tier. Any match now had the potential to showcase championship-level quality.
For the countless citizens watching the provincial competition live stream, this was a sumptuous feast.
In a secluded section of the arena’s stands, a mysterious old man appeared silently. No one knew when he had arrived; it was as if he had been there all along.
Had Lu Zhao, the director of Suzhou City’s Tianjian Bureau, not been sitting beside the old man, Wang Lan wouldn’t have paid him any mind.
"What are you looking at?" Jiang Xinyu asked curiously, following Wang Lan’s gaze. "Is there something unusual about that old man?"
"Nothing! It’s just that this old man might have an extraordinary identity. When it’s your turn, try to perform at your best."
"What do you mean? You think I’m going to lose?"
"Even if you win, make it an impressive victory." Wang Lan wasn’t certain of his guess, so he said it casually.
"The quality of students from Jiang Province this year seems better than in previous years," Eld Di remarked from the stands. His sunglasses hid his eyes, so Lu Zhao couldn’t tell where he was looking.
"It’s not just Jiang Province. Nationwide, the emergence of new Star Martial Warriors is experiencing a boom, just as our predecessors predicted."
"Great calamity is always followed by rebirth. The war seventy years ago depleted nearly a century of the world’s accumulated strength. Star Martial Warriors were decimated, with fewer than one in ten surviving, and most of those were old, weak, or disabled. After seventy years of recovery and the passing of four generations, we are finally seeing the first major resurgence. It’s a bit late, though."
"Yes, and more critically, the Demon Clan is stirring once more. Given current global capabilities, it would be difficult to withstand a demonic invasion on the scale of a century ago. Fortunately, human technology has advanced significantly. If the Demon Clan attempts an invasion as they did before, we’ll let them taste the power of our missiles."
"The use of conventional weapons is a last resort, only to be employed when sacrificing a city becomes unavoidable. While they would inflict damage on the Demon Clan, our own people would suffer as well. It’s akin to chemotherapy. We must continue to develop Star Martial Warriors and bolster their power," Eld Di stated incisively.
"You’re right, Eld Di. However, there’s something I’ve never understood," Lu Zhao said.
"Go on."
"Why broadcast this year’s provincial competition nationwide? Aren’t we exposing our future talents to Demon Clan spies?"

chapters.title: Chapter 226 Universe Starry Sky
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 226 Universe Starry Sky
"This issue... many people may not understand. It’s been seventy years since the war, and it’s only now that the potential of human Star Martial Warriors has started to explode; this is just the beginning. In the future, for a very long time, outstanding children will continue to emerge endlessly.
But over these seventy years, the strength of human Star Martial Warriors hasn’t always been hovering in a trough. It’s just that the quality of the middle and lower tiers wasn’t up to pre-war standards.
Moreover, have you considered that the development speed of human Star Martial Warriors nowadays is incomparable to that of a hundred years ago? A hundred years ago, one needed fifty years to develop to a level of strength that only requires ten years in this era."
"Is it because of Soul Resonance?"
"Exactly. From two hundred to one hundred years ago, it was the previous invasion cycle of the Demon Clan. At that time, Star Martial Warriors all relied on self-awakening. Occasionally, one or two Star Martial Warriors with a talent for the soul could stimulate human awakening through Star Martial Skills, but that was just a drop in the bucket.
But now it’s different. Since the invention of Soul Resonance a hundred years ago, it has been directly applied since the war. A large number of Star Martial Warriors who previously couldn’t awaken have now done so through Soul Resonance. A great number of middle and lower-tier Star Martial Warriors have bolstered our forces. Their power may be small, but they are the sparks that can start a prairie fire.
The foundation is set. What’s lacking is the vitality lost in the last great war and a large number of talented successors who have yet to step forward. For human civilization, we lack a favorable wind, a Golden Age."
"Now, the Golden Age has arrived. We must not only show the Demon Clan our potential but also demonstrate our depth to the common folk. In recent years, there have been signs of the Demon Clan getting restless, causing many people to become anxious.
It’s not just our Jade Country, but many countries internationally. They are terrified, scared, and some even consider retreating. They are already suffering from the hardship of Different Dimensional Space openings. If they learn that the Demon Clan is about to make a comeback, desperation might lead them to any extreme action.
As the leader of the five major countries, Jade Country must stabilize public morale—not just within Jade Country, but worldwide.
We are the first to publicly hold a provincial martial contest. This will show those frightened countries that we are brimming with talent, giving them a glimmer of hope. Afterward, countries like White Eagle Country, Bear Country, Gran Country, Doron Country, and so on will sequentially showcase their strength. We are setting an example.
And as for your earlier concern about exposing these excellent children to the Demon Clan, do you think the Demon Clan wouldn’t know if we didn’t broadcast it live? Unless we don’t hold the provincial contest, they will definitely find out if we do.
Not making it public is like a lock that keeps out gentlemen, but can it stop villains? Since we can’t hide it from the Demon Clan, we might as well not hide it at all—let’s just lay our cards on the table."
"So that’s how it is... But this batch seems destined to grow through trials and tribulations. With Eld Di making it public like this, wouldn’t the Demon Clan be remiss not to make some kind of statement in response to his ’good intentions’?"
"Even if the Demon Clan does respond, they will only target the champions of each province. These champions will all enter the four major Star Martial Academies. If we can’t even protect a few promising talents, how can we protect Jade Country or the human race?"
"Eld Di, the Demon Clan is growing increasingly restless. Based on your experience, when might they formally invade?"
"It’s been only seventy years since the Demon Clan last left, and historically, the shortest interval between invasions has been a hundred years. When the Demon Clan withdrew back then, it seemed very sudden. We speculate they had a compelling reason to leave.
Otherwise, there was no reason for them to hastily retreat when the fruits of victory were within reach, just a year or a year and a half away from conquering the entire territory. Later, many scholars discovered that this particular war against us took the Demon Clan the longest—a full one hundred and thirty years.
We were already stretched thin at that time. Could the Demon Clan’s hasty retreat also mean they couldn’t sustain their efforts any longer? Subsequent research revealed that the Demon Clan’s invasions, occurring roughly every century, seem quite regular. This doesn’t suggest they can invade whenever they please.
Seventy years have passed since their departure, so there should be about thirty years before their next large-scale invasion. But this is just our optimistic speculation; it shouldn’t be taken as a certainty.
It would be best if we had more time, but even if we don’t, we’re not afraid of them. Look, our Star Martial Warrior forces are recovering, and our technological power is advancing by leaps and bounds. What will it be like in the future when modern warfare is combined with Star Martial Warriors?"
"Exactly! Seventy years ago, when the Demon World launched a major invasion of human civilization, they encountered unprecedented resistance. The Eastern Isles, in particular, showed the Demon Clan our resolve by self-detonating seven nuclear bombs. The human race’s determination to be ’shattered jade rather than intact tile’ will ensure that if they dare to invade again, they will not return, and they’ll have to seriously consider if they can afford the price."
"Furthermore, our galaxy, the Milky Way, is an insurmountable natural barrier for the Demon Clan. For countless years, it has protected us humans, who appear so weak in their eyes. Legend says the Milky Way is actually a colossal array! Moreover, we’ve deduced that their centennial invasions aren’t random; at least, the situation in another star system is roughly similar."
"Eld Di... you... you’re not joking, are you?"
"Of course not. To obtain this intelligence, Little Phoenix might never be able to return."
Lu Zhao knew that "Little Phoenix" was Eld Di’s affectionate nickname for the Flame Emperor. In the entire world, fewer than ten people dared to call the Flame Emperor "Little Phoenix."
"But... Eld Di, such confidential intelligence..."
"It’s not entirely a secret. As the fear of the Demon Clan grows daily, some information will be released. Anyway... the Demon Clan is not as powerful as we imagine, nor are they as invincible as we think."
Lu Zhao had processed a vast amount of information today, but he was also someone who knew discretion. Eld Di could casually share things, but Lu Zhao knew he couldn’t speak carelessly.
His expression was somber as he watched the distant competition grounds, his mind lost in unknown thoughts.
"Eh, what’s the name of that girl?" Eld Di, who was beside him, suddenly asked.
Lu Zhao looked up. At that moment, Jiang Xinyu and her opponent were locked in a fierce battle.
"Jiang Xinyu, the captain of the Suzhou City representative team."
"So, she’s the captain! No wonder, no wonder. Such high combat intelligence... Although her innate talent isn’t exceptional, her potential is boundless. Which family is she from?"
"She isn’t a descendant of a Star Martial family. Her parents are just ordinary people, but her talent is very high; she awakened her Ice Attribute on her own at the age of eight."
"Not from a Star Martial family? Then to have such strength at her age is indeed quite impressive," said a young man with a cold expression, sitting next to Eld Di.
"Yes, if she had the resources of a Star Martial family, she might have reached the peak of the Star Cloud Realm by now."
"Director Lu, Star Martial level isn’t the most crucial thing," the young man spoke again. "For ordinary Star Martial families, they can only pursue Star Martial level because they can’t aim for other things. With ample resources and proper training, advancing the Star Martial level can actually be slowed down to better cultivate a disciple’s Dao foundation."
"Lin, haven’t you understood yet?" Eld Di’s voice was deep. "Prioritizing Dao foundation or Star Martial level isn’t inherently sequential, as long as one isn’t overly emphasized.
Overemphasizing the Dao foundation is just like how you used to excessively pursue Star Martial level—neglecting one for the other. You are going to be a father and a mentor someday. Focusing on both while maintaining balance is the best strategy."
"Yes, Teacher is right."
As the matches of the third round progressed, it seemed as if the Suzhou City representative team was only now truly exerting their strength. The previous two rounds looked like they were intentionally giving points to their opponents.
In the first round, they lost four members. In the second, another three. Following this trend, it seemed they were about to be completely wiped out in the third round.
But in the third round, when Jiang Xinyu fought, she immediately secured a victorious start for the Suzhou City representative team. As always, her performance was rock-solid.
Because she had controlled the rhythm of the match for three consecutive encounters, defeating her opponents with an absolute advantage, the broad netizen community of Suzhou City hailed her as the most reliable captain.
There was no helping it; the Suzhou City representative team had always had a tradition of their captains leading the charge only to be swiftly eliminated. Looking back five tournaments, it seemed the captains of the Suzhou City representative team hadn’t even made it to the third round.
Jokes proliferated online, and someone even concocted a group chat for former captains of the Suzhou City team. The captain from the 14th tournament was eliminated in the first round. The captain from the 15th spent the rest of the tournament in the stands after the first round. The 16th term captain barely made it to the second round before being KO’d by the Jin City captain. The captains of the 17th and 18th terms led their teams by being the first to fall.
Then came the 19th tournament...
Jiang Xinyu, how did you become captain? Is the fine tradition of the Greater Suzhou City captains gone? How could you last until the third round? And even successfully make it into the fourth?
After Jiang Xinyu, Mu Shaoyun took the stage. His opponent had received a bye in the previous round. His strength... really wasn’t much to look at and was dealt with by Mu Shaoyun within a minute.
At three in the afternoon, the scorching sun’s intensity had lessened slightly.
On the huge screen, Wang Lan’s and Lei Tianxu’s portraits each occupied half the display.
Lei Tianxu was very tall and burly. Previously, looking at him from a distance, Wang Lan thought he resembled a large chimney. Now that they were standing on the platform, Wang Lan felt as if this colossal creature was almost outside the human species category.
Lei Tianxu: seventeen years old, height 2.12 meters.
Damn, seventeen and already 2.12 meters! If males typically stop growing around twenty, his height could still increase a bit more.
Weight: one hundred kilograms. A chiseled face and a weathered appearance. Looking at Lei Tianxu’s face, Wang Lan could hardly resist the urge to call him "Uncle."
Wearing just a red vest, his bulging chest muscles seemed ready to burst through his clothing.
His arms, in Wang Lan’s eyes, were even thicker than his own thighs.
Judging by his physique, Lei Tianxu’s fighting style should be tank-like, power-focused. Speaking of which, it seems I also have a talent for strength.
"Wang Lan, Lei Tianxu, are you both ready?"
"Ready."
