"We can start anytime."
BEEP—
The moment the whistle sounded, Wang Lan and Lei Tianxu moved simultaneously. The two of them, as if by unspoken agreement, employed the exact same tactic: rapidly closing in on their opponent with absolute speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 227 Equally Matched
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 227 Equally Matched
In the blink of an eye, the two had already charged at each other.
Wang Lan’s hands summoned the Solar Wheel, which, like the Sacred Fire Order he wielded, was both dazzling and powerful. Lei Tianxu, on the other hand, had his entire arm transformed into a Thunder Eel, with electric arcs like countless tiny silver needles emitting a dazzling light.
At their first exchange, Wang Lan was shocked. Lei Tianxu was not the tank-like warrior Wang Lan had imagined but a high-agility type. His movement speed and neural reflexes were unbelievably fast, and with the stimulation of lightning, his speed became even more extraordinarily fast.
As Wang Lan slashed down, he found nothing but empty space before him. By the time he realized this, a strong sense of crisis struck him from behind. In less than 0.5 seconds, Lei Tianxu had not only dodged his attack but had also moved behind Wang Lan to initiate his own.
With no time to hesitate, the Star Cloud Sword Dance was unleashed, producing over a dozen afterimages that burst forth like a peacock spreading its tail feathers. Lei Tianxu, like a streak of lightning, instantly shattered Wang Lan’s scattered afterimages.
As the afterimages dissipated, the sound of thunder still echoed in Wang Lan’s ears. His figure rapidly retreated, dragging two long furrows in the ground.
The momentary, intense exchange gave way to a slight pause for breath, while in the stands, almost everyone watched tensely, their eyes glued to the action.
Wang Lan stood with his body slightly bowed, warily watching Lei Tianxu, who stood casually upright before him. Seeing the grave expression in Wang Lan’s eyes, Lei Tianxu smiled.
"Many people underestimate me because of my physique, so consider that a warm-up. This time, you won’t hold back, will you?"
"Thank you for your consideration, Lei," Wang Lan said, clenching his teeth tightly.
"Wang Lan, you can equip your Star Palace Artifact as well; I don’t mind. My Thunder Snake Drill hasn’t broken a Star Palace Artifact yet."
Wang Lan didn’t retaliate. Arcs of electricity flashed around him once more, and in the blink of an eye, they completely enveloped him. Instantly, Wang Lan moved, the lightning trailing behind him seeming to form a cloak, and the world around him came to a complete standstill.
The instant Wang Lan moved, Lei Tianxu moved as well. Although their outward manifestations differed, the Star Martial Skill they both employed essentially achieved the same result: using lightning to stimulate all their muscles, allowing their bodies to erupt with incomparable speed.
The world seemed to contain only the two of them—two men, moving so fast they were mere streaks of silver light, exchanged blows rapidly in the arena. Each punch and kick demonstrated both the art of combat and the terrifying beauty of violence.
This was an exceptionally high-quality, high-intensity fight, but for the on-site audience and those watching the live broadcast, it wasn’t quite as accommodating. Those watching the live stream were somewhat better off, as cameras could slow down the footage, allowing them to catch glimpses of the action. However, spectators at the venue, already far from the fight, had to rely on their own abilities to see clearly.
"This must be a championship-quality battle, right?" Xu Xiangwen asked Jiang Xinyu as he came back to his senses. Wang Lan was strong, but in Xu Xiangwen’s impression, he hadn’t been so strong that Xu Xiangwen couldn’t even fight back—no, couldn’t even see his movements clearly.
But Wang Lan had many hidden cards, so Xu Xiangwen wouldn’t have found it incredible if he were even stronger. Facing Wang Lan, whom Xu Xiangwen considered already so powerful, the fact that Lei Tianxu could fight him to a standstill was hard for him to accept.
We’re all at the Star Cloud Stage. Seeing them fight like this makes me feel like I might be a fraud.
"I’m afraid even championship quality might not be this high," Gong Feiyu said with a grave expression. "When I thought Wang Lan had mastered a Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skill and could perform compound Star Martial Skills, I almost believed he was the champion. I underestimated the heroes of the world; there are too many freaks in the provincial martial arts competition. Who would have known Lei Tianxu, whose name wasn’t well-known before, could be such a monster?"
"I would still have a fighting chance if I were to confront Lei Tianxu," Jiang Xinyu said, a fierce fighting spirit glinting in her eyes. "Lei Tianxu is a Thunder Attribute Star Martial Warrior, and warriors of this attribute are inherently very powerful. The only thing that can defeat thunder is wind."
As the saying goes: laymen watch the spectacle; experts watch the technique. Xu Xiangwen and the others were not laymen, but it was impossible to discern the details of the fight from such a distance. However, the many examining instructors present could follow the action.
"Thor!" A young man sitting next to Eld Di, a confident smile touching his lips, said with certainty, "Teacher, that’s Thor! It’s been lost for nearly two hundred years."
"Yes," Eld Di said calmly.
"The Thor Star Martial Skill requires exceptionally strong physical talent, and very few have mastered it since its creation. The nation has been good to this young man, to give him such a powerful S-rank Star Martial Skill, and he actually learned it."
"Mr. Xuan, merely mastering an S-rank Star Martial Skill isn’t that big of a deal," Lu Zhao said indifferently.
"Of course, it’s not a big deal in itself, but mastering an S-rank skill at his Star Cloud Stage Cultivation Level is quite exceptional, especially one as difficult to cultivate as Thor. But the young man he’s fighting..." Xuan Lin trailed off, his eyes widening slightly before he continued, "He’s actually mastered three A-rank Star Martial Skills, all to a profound level, and he’s even... learned to use compound Star Martial Skills? Which noble family does this boy hail from? I’d like to pay them a visit."
"Lin, are you thinking of taking a disciple?" Eld Di asked with a playful smile.
"Descendants of noble families all have their own legacies. Even if I wanted to, they might not be willing. But exchanging insights wouldn’t be bad. What do you think, Teacher?"
"He is no scion of any noble family," Lu Zhao said, looking strangely at the man named Xuan Lin, skepticism filling his eyes.
He doesn’t even know Wang Lan. Is he really from Eld Di’s lineage? Could he be an imposter?
"What? Not from a noble family?" This time, Xuan Lin’s expression became grave. "How can someone not from a noble family lay such a solid foundation? Basic Combat, utilization of Star Martial Skills, and even mastering the application of compound Star Martial Skills? Without a profound heritage, without someone specifically guiding him, it’s nearly impossible to achieve this on his own."
"I know this child; he is indeed not from any Star Martial noble family. In fact, it hasn’t even been a full year since he awakened as a Star Martial Warrior."
"What?" Xuan Lin lost his composure this time.
Lu Zhao continued, "At the end of June or the beginning of July last year, Wang Lan awakened his Star Martial talent on his own. Three days later, he visited the beginner’s trial field, and seven days after emerging from it, he was already at the Star Shine Stage. He then learned the A-rank Star Martial Skills, Star Cloud Sword Dance and Flame Sword. Six months ago, he anonymously entered the Star Martial Arts Tournament and won the championship in one go. By February or March of this year, he had already mastered the application of compound Star Martial Skills—and a fused application at that."
As Lu Zhao explained, Xuan Lin’s expression changed continuously.
His mouth fell slightly agape, and it took him a long while to regain his composure. "Truly a genius," he finally managed.
It was just that Lu Zhao had recounted it all so casually that Xuan Lin had to actively process the implications of such talent. To awaken autonomously at sixteen was already monstrous. Awakening so late usually implied mediocre talent, yet Wang Lan had broken through to the Star Shine Stage in a mere ten days. In less than a year, he had gone from a new awakening to his current level. Who in the world possessed such talent?
"This Wang Lan’s talent... it’s almost on par with Little Junior Sister’s. Teacher, you didn’t come to Suzhou City specifically for him, did you?"
"Yes and no!" Eld Di, who wasn’t eccentric, replied with a cunning riddle.
"I’ve also heard of Princess Yu Ruoyun’s talent," Lu Zhao interjected. "But Mr. Xuan, once you learn what Wang Lan’s first Star Martial Skill was, you probably won’t think that way anymore."
"Oh? Didn’t you say it was Star Cloud Sword Dance and Flame Sword?" Xuan Lin asked.
"Neither!" Eld Di did not speak in riddles this time. Instead, he gazed absently at the two fierce competitors locked in a dragon-and-tiger battle in the arena and sighed deeply. "The first Star Martial Skill Wang Lan learned was Phoenix Form..."
CRACK—
Xuan Lin abruptly twisted his neck. That sharp crack was the sound of his neck turning, a sound so crisp it made Lu Zhao cringe.
"Phoenix Form? How did he learn Phoenix Form? How did he get the chance to learn it and even master it? How is that possible? The minimum requirement to learn Phoenix Form is the Galaxy Stage! Even Senior Sister learning Phoenix Form at the Star Cloud Stage was a stroke of immense luck..."
It wasn’t that Xuan Lin was overreacting; the news was like a massive tsunami to him.
When Xuan Lin became Eld Di’s disciple, Wang Ling had already left on a mission. Not witnessing the true face of the Flame Emperor was Xuan Lin’s biggest regret. Among all his senior brothers and sisters, he was probably the only one who had never seen the Flame Emperor. Even Little Junior Sister had been held by the Flame Emperor when she was small.
In Xuan Lin’s heart, the most respected person was undoubtedly Eld Di, but the one he admired most, without a doubt, was the Flame Emperor. He hadn’t learned the Flame Emperor’s signature Star Martial Skill, Phoenix Form; his senior brothers and sisters hadn’t learned it either. And now, some kid who had popped up in Suzhou City had learned it. This made it very difficult for him to digest the information.
"Don’t be so easily startled; you are, after all, at the Star Sea Stage," Eld Di admonished calmly. "Wang Lan is a child Little Phoenix adopted seventeen years ago. However, when you interact with Wang Lan in the future, never mention that he was adopted; he doesn’t know."
"So he’s Senior Sister’s child! That makes sense then," Xuan Lin exclaimed.
Lu Zhao’s mouth twitched slightly at the side. *Makes sense? Makes sense my foot!* The whole reason I brought it up was to hear your family’s take on it. Is Wang Lan’s monstrous talent really not a problem? Wang Lan is a formidable general in my hands, practically a mascot. But the thought of his abnormalities always unsettled me. Learning Phoenix Form at the Star Shine Stage? That’s unreasonable no matter how you look at it. And I heard he has an all-attribute physique that detection instruments can’t even pick up. Even I, Lu Zhao, can be curious, can gossip! And you just dismiss it with ’that makes sense’? How on earth does that make sense?!
Seeing Lu Zhao’s expression, Xuan Lin seemed to grasp his meaning, smiled, and said, "He’s Senior Sister’s child, so what’s so unreasonable about it? Even if he isn’t her biological son, she raised him. Talent, well... it can be somewhat contagious."
Heh, that’s a new one on me.
BOOM—
Just then, a powerful explosion erupted from the dueling arena. Lightning flashed wildly, and faint smoke rose from the scorched earth. Two figures were flung backward like cannonballs.
Lei Tianxu fared better, his feet carving two deep furrows into the ground as he landed. Wang Lan, however, tumbled repeatedly, rolling a full twenty meters before coming to a stop.
This battle, with its high-frequency close-quarters combat, had already been raging for five minutes.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Competing in Thickness? I’ve Never Lost
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 228: Competing in Thickness? I’ve Never Lost
"Huff—"
Wang Lan bent over, breathing heavily, as if flames were scorching his throat. This close-quarters combat that lasted five minutes was unlike any other battle he had faced before. It was a fight where both parties exerted their full force without any reservation.
The two were evenly matched in speed, but truthfully, Wang Lan’s close-combat skills surpassed Lei Tianxu’s. At least, Wang Lan’s Flame Sword had struck Lei Tianxu more than ten times. However, Lei Tianxu’s body could truly be described as monstrous, as the Flame Sword failed to penetrate the defense of Lei Tianxu’s Thor Garment.
In the end, Wang Lan could only make a desperate move, transforming a purple flame into a Solar Wheel, which finally managed to wound Lei Tianxu. But Lei Tianxu was also ruthless; he kicked Wang Lan with Thunder Power, rendering half of Wang Lan’s body useless.
With his body damaged, the Healing Star Martial Arts automatically activated. During Wang Lan’s heavy breathing, his internal injuries rapidly healed.
On Lei Tianxu’s shoulder, blood flowed like a stream. He tilted his head slightly to glance at it, and with a flash of thunder, the wound was quickly cauterized.
"To have fought me to this extent, you’ve really surprised me." Lei Tianxu’s voice boomed like a bell, making one’s head buzz. "But that kick I landed on you must have been painful. My kick is powerful enough to flatten a tank’s armor. You’d better not act tough. If you feel numb, your internal organs might already be damaged."
Wang Lan was well aware that the kick had nearly obliterated his spleen and kidneys. However, by this moment, he had fully recovered. He slowly stood up straight and raised his hand.
"It seems you still refuse to give up. Fine... I don’t want to drag this out either. Wang Lan, apart from the trial grounds and the Pioneer Space, I have never used the Inborn Talent of my Bloodline in a duel. Do you know why?"
"Because it’s your trump card," Wang Lan replied. "You don’t want to reveal too much, afraid that people will find a weakness."
"Wrong. It’s because the lethality of my Inborn Talent of the Bloodline is too great to hold back," Lei Tianxu said. As he spoke, the Star Power around his body suddenly surged wildly, and above his head, flames seemed to twine around him.
Wang Lan was startled and no longer hesitated. Star Power surged around him, and a flame instantly sprang up. On his wrist, golden wings unfolded, feathers falling and drifting, as dreamlike and stunningly beautiful as a fantasy.
"Purple Flame Thunder Arrow—"
A roar sounded as an arrow wrapped in purple thunder shot toward Lei Tianxu.
In an instant, Lei Tianxu had activated his Berserker Bloodline, and his body surged toward Wang Lan. Before Lei Tianxu could even take half a step, the arrow was already at his face. Wang Lan had locked onto him with his right eye, and Lei Tianxu, unable to dodge in time, could only cross his hands in front of his chest to take the hit head-on.
"BOOM—"
A loud explosion erupted, and Lei Tianxu’s figure was violently thrown backward.
Previously, Wang Lan and Lei Tianxu had kept their distance. Lei Tianxu was about twenty meters from the edge of the competition arena. As Lei Tianxu’s body was thrown back, Wang Lan moved instantly, dashing through the air like lightning, his arrows continuously firing.
"BOOM, BOOM, BOOM—"
"Damn!" Everyone watching this scene couldn’t help but curse. What kind of tactic was this? Way too sly, right?
Previously, Wang Lan and Lei Tianxu had gone head-to-head in close combat, a mistake on Wang Lan’s part due to misjudging Lei Tianxu’s style. Now, of course, he was resorting to ranged attacks to kite his enemy.
The four interconnected Star Martial Skills were now activated. The current Crescent Arrows were shot with speed and precision. Coupled with Wang Lan’s rapid approach, Lei Tianxu, suspended in the air, found himself unable to touch the ground.
Ten meters... five meters... three meters...
"AH—" Suddenly, Lei Tianxu, still in the air, let out a ferocious roar. The resonating sound spread in all directions, and his terrifying Star Power exploded like a nuclear bomb. The arrows shot by Wang Lan melted away instantly, as Ice Snow meets flame.
Wang Lan’s expression changed drastically, and he swiftly retreated.
Through the pervasive thunder arcs and black mist, a figure steadily approached.
Lei Tianxu’s shirt had disappeared. His bare skin had turned a brown color, and the shoulder that had been cauterized was now dripping with fresh blood.
A pair of blood-red eyes, like those of a wild beast, stared at Wang Lan. But these beast-like eyes were not crazed; they were sinister.
"Wow—"
When the condition of the two on the field became clear, the audience gasped in unison.
Lei Tianxu had taken a huge hit this time; his already injured shoulder was now significantly worse. Even though Lei Tianxu’s aura was blazing, his pitiful appearance made it seem like he was about to sing a requiem.
"You’re good, Wang Lan, really good... To think that after I used my Inborn Talent of the Bloodline, you could still injure me so severely. However, it all ends here. In my Berserker form, all of my attributes will be increased threefold. You no longer stand a chance," Lei Tianxu declared.
"But you are injured," Wang Lan replied, kneeling on one knee, his voice cold.
"I do not feel pain," Lei Tianxu retorted.
In a flash, Wang Lan raised his hand, and a Thunder Arrow shot out from his fingertips. But this time, Lei Tianxu was prepared. With a swift motion, he dodged Wang Lan’s Thunder Arrow as fast as lightning, transforming into a streak of light as he rushed toward Wang Lan.
Wang Lan’s Thunder Arrow, imbued with the Thunder Attribute, had a speed comparable to that of a firearm. Yet even at speeds rivaling bullets, Lei Tianxu could still dodge.
After evading two arrows, Wang Lan understood: they were back to close-quarters combat.
The purple Solar Wheel was unleashed, and his Thunder Activity was instantly dialed up to the maximum as he charged fiercely towards Lei Tianxu.
"CRACKLE—" Electric arcs exploded in the air. Lei Tianxu shattered one of Wang Lan’s Thunder Illusions with a punch, causing it to burst instantly. The intense electricity ravaged Lei Tianxu’s body. Seizing this critical moment, Wang Lan slashed towards Lei Tianxu’s injured shoulder.
BOOM—Lei Tianxu and Wang Lan crossed paths. Lei Tianxu’s Thunder Tooth stabbed viciously into Wang Lan’s shoulder. It wasn’t until Wang Lan brushed past Lei Tianxu that he realized he was wounded.
So fast. Way too fast.
Previously, Lei Tianxu’s speed was already on par with Wang Lan’s. Now, having activated his Berserker Bloodline, his speed had become incredibly fast.
But after the two had passed each other, although Wang Lan’s slash had left a scar on Lei Tianxu, Wang Lan’s left shoulder was also heavily struck.
"What—" Many people in the stands exclaimed once again.
"Wang Lan is going to lose. Under the Berserker Bloodline, Lei Tianxu doesn’t feel pain, and his body’s strength has multiplied greatly. But Wang Lan can’t manage. What a pity, to have fought to this extent," said Zhuang Haotian, his face filled with sorrow.
At this moment, the Head of Instruction could only look up at the sky wordlessly. Just a moment ago, seeing Lei Tianxu in such a sorry state, he had hoped all three from Suzhou City would pass the third round. But even if only two did, it would be fine if Wang Lan lost. The Suzhou City team had never made it to the fourth round before. From the fourth round onwards, it had always been a battle for supremacy among the four strong cities.
"Now it’s fair," Lei Tianxu said with a mocking smile, looking at the wound on Wang Lan’s shoulder.
"Is it?" Wang Lan gently tore off his clothes, which had been shredded to ribbons in the fight, and, like Lei Tianxu, went bare-chested.
Compared to Lei Tianxu, Wang Lan was too thin. Although the lines of his muscles were very symmetrical and aesthetically pleasing, the difference in build was like that between a lion and a hunting dog.
But the next instant, Lei Tianxu’s expression froze.
Wang Lan’s shoulder wound began to visibly heal.
"My god—"
"Is this for real?" In the stands, whether it was the students participating in the provincial martial arts tournament or the teachers from various Star Martial Academies who had come to observe, everyone stared dumbfounded at Wang Lan.
A penetrating wound on the shoulder, visibly healing itself? Was this... a Star Martial Skill? Or an Inborn Talent of the Bloodline?
"Forgot to tell you, I’m actually a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior."
A Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior, my ass! Have I ever seen one fight like this? And besides, his Medical Attribute only works on himself, right?
Lei Tianxu merely complained inwardly, while the stands had already exploded into chaos.
"Damn, you claim to be Medical Attribute? A healer? Get real! We didn’t see any sign of that before!"
"No wonder he took so many kicks and punches from Lei Tianxu and seemed fine. I thought he was just unusually tough, but it turns out he was healing himself all along."
Many in the stands refused to believe it, while on the online forum platforms, Wang Lan’s fans were ecstatic.
The Wolf King is a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior. Anyone who has seen the Star Martial Championship knows this is no secret, and those who have studied Wang Lan closely also know it. But Wang Lan is only at the Star Shine Stage. How many of the big shots participating in the provincial martial arts tournament would have paid attention to him?
Hmm, Star Shine Stage. Trash. Skip.
That was likely their first thought when glancing at his information.
By the time the tournament officially started and Wang Lan displayed his formidable strength, there was no more time or opportunity to research him.
So, those who knew, knew; those who didn’t, looked on like fools, completely baffled.
Suddenly, Wang Lan discovered a new strategy that seemed perfect for the current situation. A wicked smile spread across his face.
Alright, let’s trade injury for injury! Let’s hurt each other and see who gives in first!
In an instant, Wang Lan moved again, employing four Star Martial Skills in unison.
Even if I don’t have the advantage in speed, I can use Thunder Illusions to create deceptions. His body might not feel pain, fine, but the injuries he sustains are still real.
Wang Lan’s tactics became shameless. Every move was designed to trade injury for injury, a battle strategy most effective at disrupting rhythm. The orderly combat they were used to—you attack, I block; you strike, I evade—suddenly devolved into confusion, making it unclear how to fight.
Even if Lei Tianxu held the advantage in speed, he couldn’t just let Wang Lan chase him all over the arena, could he? He had activated the Inborn Talent of his Berserker Bloodline, yet not only was he not fighting like a berserker, he was also playing it incredibly safe. How could that be justified?
Trading injury for injury—both were ruthless.
But compared to Wang Lan’s despicable tactics, Lei Tianxu seemed almost innocent. Clenching his teeth and holding his breath, his face filled with anger and grief, he watched Wang Lan’s wounds rapidly heal while his own blood flowed freely.
After being forced to trade blows with Wang Lan yet again, Lei Tianxu gritted his teeth and collapsed.
Even the toughest of men couldn’t withstand Wang Lan’s shameless attrition. Finally, the man fell. And Wang Lan, watching the bloodied Lei Tianxu on the ground, secretly heaved a sigh of relief.
His Star Power was nearly depleted; had Lei Tianxu not fallen, Wang Lan would have had to concede.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 Seeking Medical Help
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 229 Seeking Medical Help
"Congratulations, Host, for advancing to the fourth round. You are rewarded with 10,000 experience points and 600 skill points."
As the judge announced Wang Lan’s victory, the system reward prompt sounded in his mind. Almost all the spectators in the venue stood up, giving Wang Lan a warm round of applause.
This battle had thrilled them to the core and earned their wholehearted approval. It even made them forget that Wang Lan was a Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warrior.
Previously, Wang Lan’s victories could have been explained away by various reasons, such as the element of surprise or the Star Palace Artifact. But this battle showcased Wang Lan’s solid fighting ability. Ask anyone present, whether eliminated or still in the competition, who felt confident enough to face Lei Tianxu in battle?
None! This included several from Jin City, who probably lacked the confidence either.
Although the Lian City representative team wasn’t particularly strong, typically ranking even below Suzhou City, Lei Tianxu was undoubtedly a top-tier captain. Possessing the Berserker Bloodline, he hardly managed to exhibit its power against Wang Lan.
Meanwhile, online, netizens were completely abuzz. Wang Lan’s fans were no longer just from Suzhou City; netizens from other cities also highly recognized him.
Netizens from Lian City, in particular, were thoroughly convinced. Wang Lan had defeated Lei Tianxu—the captain they called the strongest in their history—with righteous strength.
As the competition reached the third round, the battles entered their most exciting phase. Naturally, inevitable accidents also occurred one after another during the matches.
Today, 16 matches took place, with 2 ending in almost mutual destruction. Even those who won were severely injured, to a degree that the stationed Medical Star Martial Warriors might not be able to heal them completely.
"The draw is about to start. I wonder how many will forfeit this time?" Xu Xiangwen said, leaning against the sofa and staring at the television.
"Even if there are forfeits, there will be two at most."
"Two is still good, right? With two strong competitors gone, you’ll be one step closer to the championship, won’t you?"
KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK—The sound of knocking suddenly rang out. Xu Xiangwen stood up to open the door. "Excuse me, Professor... may I ask who you are looking for?"
"Is Wang Lan here?"
Wang Lan looked up. A dignified and beautiful middle-aged female teacher was walking into the room with a girl. Recognizing the girl, Wang Lan’s eyes narrowed slightly; he understood the purpose of their visit.
"You’re all here. Hello, Wang Lan. I am the team leader for the Jin City representative team and a tactical professor at Jin City Star Warrior Academy. My name is Ni Yushu."
The mention of her identity made everyone who was sitting stand up. The team leader from Jin City was one thing, but Jin City Star Warrior Academy was quite another matter.
Besides the top-tier Star Martial Academies, Jin City Star Warrior Academy was undoubtedly one of the best of the second tier. For many outstanding students, if they could not get into one of the top academies, Jin City Star Warrior Academy was definitely their preferred choice.
Jin City Star Warrior Academy, ranked high among numerous Star Martial Academies, had its unique advantages. Among those present—Xu Xiangwen, Gong Feiyu, Xie Sisi—who wouldn’t wish to enter Jin City Star Warrior Academy?
"Hello, Professor Ni... Why would a professor from Jin City Star Warrior Academy... take on the role of team leader for the Jin City representative team?" Xu Xiangwen asked, his eyes filled with a puzzled light as he looked at Xu Ruo beside Ni Yushu.
"I am the honorary principal of the high school affiliated with Jin City Star Warrior Academy, so it’s natural for me to lead the Jin City representative team," she said, glancing at Wang Lan with a slight smile. "Wang Lan, I would like to request your help to treat my daughter’s injuries."
"Xu Ruo is your daughter?" Wang Lan was surprised, looking at the somewhat pale-faced Xu Ruo.
Moved by the noble commitment of a healer to act for the welfare of others, Wang Lan should have agreed without a second thought.
But at that moment, Wang Lan shook his head. "The provincial martial arts competition has Medical Star Martial Warriors; you should let them treat Xu Ruo."
"Xu Ruo’s injuries cannot be fully healed by the Medical Star Martial Warriors provided. Tomorrow is the tournament for the top 17 to advance to the top 9, which will affect her match. Wang Lan, your strength in today’s battle was thoroughly demonstrated. In the entire Jiang Province, there hasn’t been a Star Martial Warrior as outstanding as you in nearly a decade, even at the Star Shine Stage."
"But I know that, by comparison, your Medical Star Martial Technique is even more unparalleled. That’s why I’ve come to earnestly request your help."
"You flatter me, Professor Ni. Under different circumstances, I would feel obliged, but as you know, we are currently participating in the provincial martial arts competition. We are competitors, so it’s difficult for me to agree to your request."
"If you agree to treat Xu Ruo, I can offer you a guaranteed spot at Jin City Star Warrior Academy and, moreover, provide you with Jin City’s best teachers. You know I have the capability to do that."
Looking at Ni Yushu, Wang Lan smiled faintly. "If I agreed, wouldn’t it leave the impression in your heart that I’m a person who forgets justice at the sight of small advantages?"
"Is saving lives and helping the injured considered forgetting justice for small advantages? Or is the offer from Jin City Star Warrior Academy not enough? Could it be that you aim for the Four Great Star Martial Academies?"
"Having come this far, it seems the Four Great Star Martial Academies are not so out of reach if I put in a bit more effort." Wang Lan’s words were modest, but his eyes brimmed with unwavering confidence.
The Four Great Star Martial Academies—I, Wang Lan, am set on them!
"Only by ranking in the top 3 is there a chance to be noticed by the Four Great Star Martial Academies. Wang Lan, are you that confident?"
"I can try."
The atmosphere suddenly became oppressive. Ni Yushu’s face also grew serious. Xu Ruo gently tugged on Ni Yushu’s sleeve. "Mom, let’s go."
Ni Yushu glanced at Wang Lan and then at Jiang Xinyu beside him. "You’re doing this for Jiang Xinyu, aren’t you? With the strength you’ve displayed today, you might have a chance of winning against Xu Ruo. Her Flame Attribute counters Jiang Xinyu’s Ice Attribute."
"Professor, you’re mistaken. In my view, Xu Ruo’s strength definitely ranks her among the top five contenders in this competition. To be honest, I don’t have the slightest confidence. As a contestant, I am under no obligation to treat my opponents."
"Professor, you might not believe this, but I was chosen for the Suzhou City team merely to make up the numbers. I’ve stumbled along to get this far, and it hasn’t been easy. My primary task is to ensure the Suzhou City team enters each match ready to achieve a complete victory. I hope you can understand."
"Of course, I can understand. However, Wang Lan, have you noticed the flaws in your fighting style?"
"I would like to hear more!"
"Setting aside your Star Martial Warrior level for now, you have mastered 4 Star Martial Skills: Star Cloud Sword Dance, Flame Sword, Crescent Arrow, and Thunder Snake. What’s more impressive is that you have perfected these 4 A-grade Star Martial Skills and have already completed training for a composite Star Martial Skill."
"In a head-on battle, your skills and damage output are already first-class; even many university students from Jin City may not be as powerful as you. However, your versatility is lacking. You don’t have long-range crowd control capabilities, nor do you have emergency response abilities."
"Take Mu Shaoyun from the Suzhou City team, for example. His Earth Movement Skill is unrivaled, and he is incredibly elusive, seemingly even more useful than your Star Cloud Lightning Phantom..." As she said this, Ni Yushu’s voice trailed off.
Wang Lan furrowed his eyebrows and sighed inwardly.
It’s no surprise she’s a professor at the Jin City Star Warrior Academy—such a keen eye. Sometimes, the fusion of two A-grade Star Martial Skills isn’t as practical as a single B-grade Star Martial Skill.
"For example, if you face the Water Attribute captain from Chang City, how would you deal with his flood tactic and Nai Luo Rain Technique? You don’t have earth-burrowing abilities, nor any evasion techniques, so all your moves would be firmly countered. And what about Zhang Jing from Tong City with his Mirror Talent? How would you overcome his ability? Not to mention, from my own Jin City, one has absolute speed, and the other, absolute Star Power."
Ni Yushu had listed several examples, all of whom were opponents Wang Lan currently had no way of defeating. Frankly, when facing them, Wang Lan could only adapt as the situation unfolded, looking for weaknesses in battle to secure victory.
"Does Professor Ni have any advice?"
"You lack an escape-type Star Martial Skill, but unfortunately, your attributes are Fire and Thunder. Moreover, while your Thunder Activity might seem very fast to the average Star Martial Warrior, it doesn’t give you an edge in the provincial martial arts competition, which is crowded with geniuses."
"I have an A-grade escape Star Martial Skill here, Phantom Tracer! What do you think about a trade?"
Phantom Tracer, the signature Star Martial Skill of Jin City’s third-ranked expert, was a teleportation technique. It allowed instant movement to an enemy’s side for an attack or to instantly dodge an incoming attack.
That Zhang Yu utilized Phantom Tracer along with his superb neural reflexes to almost instantaneously take down his opponents in the first 2 rounds. In the third round, although he met a worthy opponent, he still managed to defeat them with the teleportation from Phantom Tracer. He was the one known for ’Absolute Speed’.
To Wang Lan, this Star Martial Skill was reminiscent of Flying Thor, leaving him practically drooling for quite a while. The difference, however, was that Phantom Tracer didn’t require placing a marker, couldn’t be used for indefinite teleportation, and had a range limit.
"Wang Lan, agree to it," Jiang Xinyu suddenly said softly from behind him.
Wang Lan turned his head to look back, giving Jiang Xinyu a serious glance.
"I know you’re reluctant because you’re worried about me. My abilities are completely countered by hers. But don’t underestimate me; I, Jiang Xinyu, will not take advantage of someone’s misfortune. Even if I end up facing Xu Ruo, I will fight with honor, win or lose. Besides, even if my attribute is countered, it doesn’t necessarily mean I’ll lose."
Seeing Wang Lan still hesitant, Jiang Xinyu smiled. "And I would very much like to have a fair fight with Xu Ruo. Go ahead and treat her."
"Xinyu, you say to treat her just like that? Have you even considered where Xu Ruo is injured?" Wang Lan sighed with a wry smile.
"The injury is a little below her abdomen," Ni Yushu said, puzzled. "Is that so crucial? Do you have to look at it?"
"Professor Ni, my healing Star Martial Skill requires direct contact. I need to touch the injured part to heal, unlike traditional Medical Star Martial Techniques that can heal from a distance."
At these words, Xu Ruo’s cheeks instantly flushed red, and it seemed as if steam were faintly gathering.
"Then, I’ll have to trouble Wang Lan. May I watch from the side?"
"That’s no problem."

chapters.title: Chapter 230 Phantom Tracer
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 230 Phantom Tracer
After seeing off Ni Yushu and her daughter, Wang Lan returned to his room, holding the mid-grade Soul Bead.
They sure don’t hesitate to splurge, handing over an A-grade Star Martial Skill just like that.
This wasn’t just any ordinary A-grade Star Martial Skill either; it was a particularly powerful one within its grade, likely selling for around eight million.
The moment he absorbed the Soul Bead, a stream of information, accompanied by the Star Power within the bead, surged straight into his mind. The Star Power was stored in his Star palace, while the information flowed into his Spiritual Sea of Consciousness. "Learnable Star Martial Skill detected. Spend 100 skill points to learn?"
Wang Lan had just earned 600 skill points. Combined with the 200 he’d saved previously, he now had a solid 800 skill points, so he wasn’t short on them at all. After spending 100 skill points, a shiny silver skill icon immediately appeared on the Star Martial Skill panel.
Phantom Tracer, Silver LV1 (0/100)
The moment the skill icon lit up, a sense of enlightenment rushed into his mind. Closing his eyes, his vision was no longer pitch black; instead, an indescribable sensation washed over him.
In the distance, there was a shore, and it felt as if I only needed to take one step to reach it.
Wang Lan tentatively took a step.
BOOM!
A loud crash startled everyone in the living room watching TV. They jumped up and rushed toward Wang Lan’s bedroom door.
"DAMN IT!"
From inside the room came Wang Lan’s agonized cry. Xu Xiangwen kicked the door open, only to see Wang Lan splayed out against the wall, stuck fast like a gecko.
The wall was covered in cracks. Wang Lan peeled off the wall like a playing card and landed steadily on the bed. His nose was crooked, and tears streamed down his face. But in that instant, his healing skill automatically activated, and his face returned to normal in moments.
Xu Xiangwen glanced at the human-shaped imprint on the wall, then at Wang Lan on the bed, who looked like he was questioning all his life choices. "Lanzi, if something’s bothering you, talk to us. There’s no need to resort to banging your head against the wall, is there?"
"Damn, that hurt! A miscalculation..." Wang Lan mumbled, clutching his already healed nose, his face flushed with embarrassment.
"I was just trying out Phantom Tracer, experimenting a little. I didn’t expect the room to be so small; it sent me straight into the wall... Damn, that really hurt."
"PFFT— Lanzi, you’re truly one of a kind... Wait a minute..."
Suddenly, the world became utterly silent... The atmosphere grew incredibly tense. Xu Xiangwen’s expression flickered rapidly as he finally fixed an intense stare on Wang Lan.
Seeing the fervent gazes of the four, Wang Lan felt an inexplicable twinge of guilt.
"What did you just say? You wanted to test the Phantom Tracer you just learned? And you ended up plastered to the wall?"
"Ah—what’s wrong?"
"What’s wrong?" Xu Xiangwen grabbed Wang Lan’s collar, shaking him back and forth. "That’s an A-grade Star Martial Skill! A-grade! You learned it in less than ten minutes, and you’re telling me you’ve already got it? It takes at least a week of practice just to get the hang of an A-grade Star Martial Skill, and you’re saying you’ve learned it? Are you even human? Are you?!"
Wang Lan wrenched himself free from Xu Xiangwen’s clutches. "I’m not!"
Wang Lan declared decisively, without a shred of hesitation.
"Is this the first day you’ve known me? I stopped being human a long time ago. It’s just an A-grade Star Martial Skill, isn’t it? Of all the A-grade Star Martial Skills I know, which one didn’t I master in under a minute?"
Overcome by Wang Lan’s shamelessness, Xu Xiangwen clasped his fists. "When it comes to being shameless, I, Xu Xiangwen, concede that you are the strongest."
「Meanwhile, in the elevator.」
Despite her injuries being healed and her strength restored to its peak, Xu Ruo wore a frown.
"What’s wrong?" Ni Yushu asked, wrapping an arm around her daughter’s shoulder.
"Exchanging Phantom Tracer for my treatment... that price is too high," she responded.
"Too high? If you can achieve a good result in the provincial tournament, no price is too high."
"But... if Wang Lan learns Phantom Tracer and shores up his weakness, it won’t be easy for Jin City to win the championship."
"Silly child, that’s an A-grade Star Martial Skill. What are you even thinking? For him to master it, at least a month of dedicated study is necessary. A month from now, not only will the provincial tournament be over, but even the college entrance exams will have concluded."
"But... even so, it’s Phantom Tracer we’re talking about."
"You’re reluctant?"
"Mm, I haven’t even learned it myself..."
"You’re a Flame Attribute Star Martial Warrior, destined for the Mage path. The maximum range of Phantom Tracer is twenty meters, while your Flame Burning has a kill radius of thirty meters. What use would you have for it? Remember, there are countless powerful Star Martial Skills in the world, but not every one is suitable for every Star Martial Warrior. Only when a Star Martial Warrior accurately understands their own strengths and path can they truly begin their journey to power. Phantom Tracer suits Wang Lan, but not you. Besides, using Phantom Tracer to foster a good relationship with him is beneficial for you. No one knows how far Wang Lan will go in the future. You need to work hard and ensure you’re not left too far behind by your peers."
Him?
Xu Ruo tilted her head up proudly.
Although Wang Lan’s talent is exceptional, making him a remarkable genius, who here isn’t a genius in their own right? Who’s afraid of whom?
"I can assure you, if nothing unexpected happens, Wang Lan will become a leader-level figure in the future. If you get the chance, try to stay close to him."
"Understood!"
Just as Xu Xiangwen and the others were in the room, urging Wang Lan to quickly demonstrate Phantom Tracer, the television outside suddenly announced a preview for the drawing of matchups for the round of sixteen to eight.
The group hastily exited the room and settled on the sofa.
The character portraits on the screen flashed rapidly. The first one to stop was Wang Lan’s.
Huh, am I in the first match-up?
Soon, the portrait on the right also stopped, revealing Zhang Yu from the Jin City team.
Seeing this, Wang Lan was momentarily speechless. Does it have to be this coincidental? It feels completely orchestrated.
I just mastered Phantom Tracer, and now I’m supposed to have an instant-kill showdown with an expert in it?
Seeing this matchup, Xu Xiangwen gently patted Wang Lan’s shoulder.
"So, it’s a battle of the Phantoms, eh? Good luck."
"Your tone tells me you don’t really mean that."
"Not at all! I actually have a lot of confidence in you, really, I do!" Xu Xiangwen winked at Wang Lan, but his teasing smile completely betrayed him.
Indeed, even though I’ve learned Phantom Tracer, I’m only a beginner. Compared to Zhang Yu, who can instantly shift positions four times, I’m not even in the same league. But who said I was going to compete with him using Phantom Tracer anyway?
Next, Suzhou City’s second representative to be drawn was Mu Shaoyun. His opponent was also extremely formidable. However, the Suzhou City team wasn’t worried about Mu Shaoyun; his performance was incredibly stable, as reliable as ever. His stability wasn’t about explosive power; it was more like the assuredness of an overwhelmingly superior attack.
It was as if his opponents collapsed before they even had a chance to exert their full strength. This kind of performance baffled many, including some of the observing teachers, who began to feel confused.
Finally, it was time for Jiang Xinyu’s opponent to be revealed. They say fate enjoys playing tricks; whatever you don’t want to face, fate ensures you do. Jiang Xinyu was matched against Xu Ruo—the only contestant among all those Jiang Xinyu had studied whom she felt unsure about defeating.
Gazing at the finalized matchup chart, Wang Lan turned his stiff neck slightly. "Regretting it?"
Jiang Xinyu shot Wang Lan a look, then lightly brushed her hand over her snow-white thigh as she gracefully stood up. "Sisi, let’s go."
"Ah? Xinyu, are you... angry?"
"Going back to sleep, to conserve my energy."
"Oh!"
The drawing of the matchups concluded. Wang Lan and the other two dispersed to their respective rooms to rest. Although it was still early, resting up for the next day’s competitions was essential.
Back in his room, Wang Lan opened the system again. He had accidentally slammed into the wall earlier, so the subsequent upgrade for Phantom Tracer hadn’t been processed by the system. Crashing into the wall during his first attempt right after learning it was entirely his own doing.
It makes sense; having just learned it, the skill is obviously still at the novice stage.
In terms of proficiency, I’m only just barely able to execute it. Mastery is still a long way off.
Opening the system, he added the skill points. The previously vague, indistinct sense of space gradually became clear and vivid.
After all 800 skill points were added, Phantom Tracer finally upgraded to Silver LV7. Wang Lan stood in the center of the room. With a flicker, he appeared right in front of the wall, less than five centimeters away. This time, his control over the teleportation was precise to within ten centimeters.
Wang Lan flickered again. Three afterimages appeared in mid-air before he returned to his original spot. Three flickers, executed with consummate skill. At this stage, his Phantom Tracer could be considered cultivated to a profound level.
Although it’s still a bit weaker than Zhang Yu’s four consecutive shifts, I’m not solely relying on Phantom Tracer to win anyway. Against Zhang Yu, I reckon I have about a seventy percent chance of victory.
Content, he went to sleep. Suddenly, his phone vibrated. In a daze, Wang Lan fumbled for his phone and glanced at the screen. Even a hazy look at the message was enough to jolt him wide awake.
He scrambled out of bed and dressed with lightning speed. The moment he opened the window, Wang Lan’s figure vanished.
The phone’s vibration was an urgent summons from the Tianjian Bureau. The target location was less than three kilometers from Wang Lan. It wasn’t even ten o’clock yet; if not for the competition, Wang Lan wouldn’t have been asleep at this hour.
As he flitted between buildings, his feet barely touching down, a powerful aura suddenly locked onto him. Twisting mid-air, Wang Lan used the Phantom Tracer movement technique to appear on a nearby rooftop. Just as he landed, a bright light shone in his face.
"Who dares cause trouble at the Provincial Martial Arts Competition venue?"
"Sir, I’m one of the competing students. I have urgent official business to attend to." Wang Lan quickly presented his Tianjian Bureau credentials. The person took the credentials, eyeing Wang Lan skeptically. If Tianjian Bureau credentials weren’t impossible to forge, they would never have believed a student could already be a captain in the Tianjian Bureau.
After receiving approval from the provincial martial arts competition security personnel, Wang Lan once again sped towards the target location. When he arrived, the smoke of battle hadn’t yet dispersed, but the fight itself seemed to be over.
This was a small alley in the Ancient City District. Slumped against a collapsed wall, a figure hung lifelessly amidst the rubble. As Wang Lan approached, his expression turned strange. "Captain Ma?"

chapters.title: Chapter 231 Framing and Entrapment
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 231 Framing and Entrapment
Wang Lan hurried forward to investigate. Upon sensing Ma Dongwei still had a faint breath, he quickly pressed Ma Dongwei’s chest and began treatment.
Ma Dongwei was truly unlucky. Last time, three foreigners had ganged up on him, beating him half to death. If Wang Lan hadn’t arrived in time, he’d be pushing up daisies by now.
This time, he was on the brink of death again, and his injuries were even more serious than last time. Had anyone other than Wang Lan arrived first, he would have been a goner by now.
As Wang Lan was treating Ma Dongwei, he heard a disturbance nearby. Several Star Martial Warriors wearing black masks appeared out of nowhere and rushed at Wang Lan. His face darkened. He was about to pause the treatment to counter-attack when he heard several sharp shouts beside him.
"Thunder Hide—"
"Ice Slice—"
With a ripping sound, two streaks of light flashed before Wang Lan’s eyes. The figures slashing towards him were suddenly split in midair, blood spraying like scattered crimson rose petals.
Lige and Zhang Xiaoxue appeared beside Wang Lan, guarding his left and right flanks.
"Wang Lan, what happened?"
"I don’t know. By the time I arrived, Captain Ma was already like this. It seems we can only find out when Captain Ma wakes up."
Ma Dongwei’s injuries were severe, but in Wang Lan’s hands, they were not quite so serious. After three minutes, Ma Dongwei’s injuries had mostly healed, and he slowly regained consciousness. Seeing Wang Lan’s palm pressed against his chest, treating him, a relieved expression spread across Ma Dongwei’s face.
"Captain Ma, what happened?"
"I don’t know. I had arranged to have dinner with Lin today. When I walked here, I saw a few thugs dragging a drunk girl into an alley. I never anticipated it was a trap. They suddenly ambushed me. Caught off guard, I was severely wounded. Although I managed to kill a few, I ultimately lost."
"Lin? Who’s that?"
"His name is Xuan Lin, my childhood friend and a scion of the Qinzhou Star Martial noble family. He had excellent grades and became Eld Di’s disciple seven years ago. He’s now a tactics professor at the Modu City Star Martial Academy. He came to Suzhou City with Eld Di, and knowing I was with the Tianjian Bureau here, he invited me for a drink. We haven’t seen each other for almost ten years."
After hearing Ma Dongwei’s story, Wang Lan’s eyebrows twitched slightly. "He reached out to you first?"
"Yes!"
"Did anyone know about your arrangement?"
"No one knew. He just asked me this afternoon, and I didn’t tell anyone." Ma Dongwei also furrowed his brows, thinking deeply. Tonight’s attack was clearly premeditated; it seems they knew his itinerary.
At this moment, Lige’s phone rang. He answered, "Hello? Director Li, what?"
A short while later, Lige hung up. "Director Li just called. Eld Di’s disciple has been assassinated..."
"What? Lin!" Ma Dongwei’s expression changed drastically, a look of shock, horror, and disbelief spreading across his face. "How is that possible... Lin... he was a Star Sea Stage expert!"
The Star Sea Stage represented the peak power in the Star Martial World. While Titled Star Martial Warriors were the apex combatants, with the exception of the Five Emperors, all Titled Star Martial Warriors belonged to the Star Sea Stage. The differences in Cultivation Levels among those at the Star Sea Stage weren’t vast.
To kill a Galaxy Stage expert was no easy feat, let alone a Star Sea Stage expert.
"Let’s go!"
The four of them shouted almost in unison, their figures flashing as they rushed towards the incident. By the time Wang Lan and the others arrived, the entire area around the restaurant had already been cordoned off. There used to be a restaurant here, but now it had been obliterated as if by a giant hand, leaving nothing but rubble.
Li Weixin, Wang Qianfeng, and others had already arrived. On a stretcher before them lay the still body of a young man: Xuan Lin, the student Eld Di had brought.
"Eld Di has arrived," Hu Qing said quietly, approaching Wang Qianfeng and the other leaders. They hurried to greet him. A black sedan screeched to a halt, and Eld Di, leaning on a cane, hastily exited the car.
"Eld Di, I apologize. We failed in our security arrangements..."
"There’s no need to say more." Eld Di raised his hand, interrupting Wang Qianfeng. "I knew Lin’s strength. Although his foundation was damaged, he was still a genuine Star Sea Stage expert. To kill him in such a short time and depart so calmly, the assassin must be no ordinary individual, definitely not some unknown."
"Yes. Based on the clues we’ve found, we suspect the one who murdered Mr. Xuan Lin is Wang Mingling."
As he spoke, Eld Di had already approached Xuan Lin’s body. Xuan Lin’s injuries weren’t obvious, aside from a single fatal wound to his chest. His face still bore a look of regret and anger.
"Wang Mingling? The traitor who wants me dead?"
"Yes! Wang Mingling is the leader of the Hellfire terrorist organization. However, our investigation suggests he may have already joined Paradise Bird."
"No wonder... Lin was first caught in an Illusion Technique before Wang Mingling killed him. And from my understanding of Lin, even a powerful Illusion Technique shouldn’t have ensnared him so easily, nor trapped him so deeply. Wang Mingling understood Lin very well; he must have targeted a specific vulnerability in Lin’s psyche."
"Mr. Xuan Lin’s psychological vulnerabilities?"
"Lin greatly admired Little Phoenix. Although born into a Star Martial Art family, his family hadn’t produced a Star Martial Warrior in three generations. Lin was the entire clan’s hope. So, from a young age, driven by his own aspirations and family pressure, Lin desperately pushed to elevate his Star Martial Art level and strength.
"But everything must be done in moderation; going too far is as bad as not going far enough. His excessive focus on raising his Star Martial Art level resulted in an unstable foundation. When I discovered this, it was a great pity. He was originally the most promising among my disciples, the one with the best chance to surpass the Star Sea Stage and reach a higher realm. Yet, due to one misstep, he lost that chance.
"When Lin learned of this, he was in agony, and it became his inner demon. He had been so close to Little Phoenix’s level, but his eagerness for quick success led to his downfall just short of his goal. Unless the Illusion Technique specifically targeted this, the killer could never have dispatched Lin so easily."
"So, you’re saying Mr. Xuan Lin’s personal information was leaked? How many people knew about these things?" Wang Lan suddenly asked.
Eld Di turned, looking kindly at Wang Lan. "Very few people knew."
"We have two leads to pursue now," Lige stated calmly from the side. "First, how did the killer know Mr. Xuan Lin’s and Captain Ma’s movements? Who leaked their itinerary? Second, who leaked Mr. Xuan Lin’s personal information?"
"Correct. Let our intelligence division handle this," Wang Qianfeng immediately said to Lu Zhao.
"That’s not right! Shouldn’t this be a matter for our Law Enforcement Department?" He MingXue quickly retorted.
"Is there even a Law Enforcement Department anymore? Aren’t you always swamped with the Shadow Guard Office?"
"But the Law Enforcement Department is still under my purview."
"Stop arguing. Regardless of who investigates, I only want the truth."
Wang Lan had a competition the next day, so he had to leave first.
He walked alone towards the Grand Hyatt Hotel, his mind still trying to unravel what had happened. Even if Wang Mingling intended to target Eld Di, what was the logic in assassinating Xuan Lin? Was it to ’beat the grass to scare the snake’? That seemed even less plausible. Eld Di was one of the Five Elders; he had weathered countless storms throughout his life. Could the mere killing of an associate intimidate him? If so, he wouldn’t be Eld Di.
Because of the assassination, martial law had been declared within a five-kilometer radius. Consequently, the usually bustling commercial district, typically alive with lights and pedestrians, was now nearly deserted.
Suddenly, a shadowy figure darted past Wang Lan. The person was wearing the red uniform of the Tianjian Bureau.
Curiosity sparked within Wang Lan. Why would a colleague from the Tianjian Bureau be here, acting so furtively? If it were a covert operation, Tianjian Bureau members would be in plain clothes.
In an instant, a torrent of information flooded his mind, finally coalescing around two keywords: ’Tianjian Bureau’ and ’mole.’
Wang Lan hesitated briefly but then decided to discreetly follow and see. Although risky, any discovery would be a significant gain.
As for a potential ambush, Wang Lan estimated that the restaurant was less than a kilometer away. If he called for backup immediately, all of the Tianjian Bureau’s top experts could arrive very quickly.
In his Phoenix form, holding out for five minutes wouldn’t be a problem. Combined with the recently learned Phantom Tracer and the power of four fused Star Martial Skills, his combat strength in Phoenix form already surpassed the peak of the Galaxy Stage.
If he didn’t dare take such a risk under these conditions, then he, Wang Lan, truly didn’t deserve to be in the Tianjian Bureau.
His figure flashed, and he silently tailed the person. Watching the figure from a distance, he felt a sense of familiarity.
This person was definitely from the Tianjian Bureau, someone he had seen before.
But since it was only a back view, Wang Lan couldn’t confirm the person’s identity.
Red uniform... that’s a captain’s standard. Who could it be...?
He followed the figure into a small neighborhood park, which was surrounded by three residential communities. But as soon as he entered the park, the figure in front suddenly vanished.
Not good—it’s a trap!
Wang Lan was instantly on alert, quickly pressing the distress signal on his phone. As the signal transmitted, he crouched, warily scanning his surroundings.
His surroundings were utterly silent, as if the person had simply vanished into thin air.
Wang Lan cautiously advanced along the pebble path, alert to any rustle from the trees around him. Suddenly, with a soft sound, a figure dropped from a nearby tree, lunging at Wang Lan in an ambush.
Without a moment’s hesitation, Wang Lan instantly retreated. As he moved, a Crescent Arrow shot out, passing unimpeded through the shadowy figure and soaring into the sky.
"Wan Kui, Wan Kui... Where are you?"
"Wan Kui, quick, look! There’s movement over there!" calls came from the distance.
As the voices approached, a wry smile appeared on Wang Lan’s face.
He’d never imagined that the Demon Clan, or whoever the mastermind was, would stoop to such a childish trick to frame him.
At Wang Lan’s feet lay a person, face up. Wang Lan recognized him: a contestant from the Tong City team, defeated by Mu Shaoyun just two days prior.
This guy’s name was indeed Wan Kui, the name being called out faintly from behind him. Well, well... they’re really throwing all pretense to the wind now.
Soon, the voices drew nearer. Five or six figures appeared: an instructor leading several students.
"Who’s there?!" the instructor shouted sternly, warily eyeing Wang Lan, whose back was turned to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: The Hand Strikes Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 232: The Hand Strikes Again
"Wan Kui—" Suddenly, a student pointed at Wang Lan’s feet, where, under the streetlight, a pale face was revealed.
Right in the chest, there was a hole punched through by a Crescent Arrow. The positioning, the scene—it was a perfect crime scene, and one where the culprit and evidence were caught red-handed.
"Suzhou City’s Wang Lan?" The teacher strode forward. He had barely taken three steps when his expression suddenly changed drastically. "Wan Kui! A Crescent Arrow... Did you... did you kill Wan Kui?"
"If I said I didn’t kill him, would you believe me?"
"Take him down! Take him to the Tianjian Bureau!" The teacher from the Tong City representative team acted in an instant, his figure flashing as he attacked Wang Lan.
The teacher was from Star Martial High School, which, honestly, was about on par with Suzhou City’s Star Martial High School, reaching the Star Shine Stage at most.
Capture Wang Lan? Even if Wang Lan didn’t use any Star Martial Skill and relied solely on hand-to-hand combat, he could knock him to the ground. As the teacher from Star Martial High School threw a punch, Wang Lan stood his ground, unmoving.
The moment the teacher’s fist swung down, leaving an afterimage, Wang Lan’s figure disappeared. When he reappeared, he was already five meters away.
"Sir, could you listen to my explanation?"
"What’s there to explain? If you have explanations, give them at the Tianjian Bureau!" the teacher yelled furiously, and the students from the Tong City representative team instantly surrounded him. Moreover, the students from the Tong City representative team were on a completely different level of strength compared to their teacher. Wang Lan could easily fend off the teacher’s attacks, but he couldn’t withstand an assault from a group of exceptionally talented Star Cloud Stage students.
"Alright, to the Tianjian Bureau then?" Wang Lan took out his credentials from his pocket and spread them out, holding them under the streetlight before the Tong City teacher. "I am from the Tianjian Bureau."
At this moment, Wang Lan felt an odd sensation, as if the phrase
Who in the court below dares to accuse this official?
echoed in his mind.
"Hmph, so young and already faking documents? You’re just a high school student, yet you claim to be from the Tianjian Bureau. You kill someone and impersonate the Tianjian Bureau? You really don’t know how the character for ’death’ is written, do you?"
"Who’s impersonating the Tianjian Bureau?" A cool voice interjected, and the figures of Lige, Zhang Yeqiu, Zhang Xiaoxue, and Wang Qianfeng instantly appeared beside Wang Lan.
Wang Qianfeng’s black military uniform was inconspicuous in the dimly lit park, but the bright red military uniforms of Lige and the others were quite eye-catching.
"I am Wang Qianfeng, Director of the Intelligence Department of the Tianjian Bureau. Is there a problem, sir?"
Looking at Wang Qianfeng and the others beside him, confusion flickered in the eyes of the Tong City team leader. "Really from the Tianjian Bureau? And Wang Lan is too?"
"Wang Lan is a special agent of my Intelligence Department. Could there be some misunderstanding?"
"Misunderstanding? Then, why don’t you deal with Wang Lan for murder?" the Tong City team leader pointed at Wan Kui’s body on the ground. "My Tong City student was shot dead with a Crescent Arrow, and it happened just now, right before my eyes! If the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau intends to cover this up and not deal with it, I will file a report with your superiors."
Wang Qianfeng looked at the body on the ground, then at Wang Lan. "What exactly happened?"
"I had just returned and saw a figure in our Tianjian Bureau uniform flash by. He looked furtive, and since he was in uniform, I suspected a connection to the mole, so I followed. When I arrived here, that person had disappeared. I guessed I was about to be framed, so I sent a message to the organization."
"Then, a dark figure attacked me from a tree, and I reflexively shot an arrow, never expecting... this to happen."
"That’s just nonsense! Can you make any logical sense? What grudge did Wan Kui hold against you to attack you suddenly?"
"Exactly! I have no grudge against Wan Kui, so why would I kill him? Besides, why was Wan Kui here so late? Why would I be here? It’s clear that there are many suspicious points to this case. Can’t you see that?"
"But Wan Kui is dead, and you are alive, and his death is related to you. Even if you are from the Tianjian Bureau, you should cooperate with the Tianjian Bureau investigation. Only after it’s confirmed you’re not a suspect can you be freed."
At these words, Wang Lan’s expression instantly changed, his gaze fixed intensely on the Tong City team leader.
"I have a match tomorrow. Is that your real goal?"
"How ridiculous! It’s just common sense. Your opponent tomorrow is from Jin City, not from my Tong City. Why would I frame you for that? Director Wang, I understand the Tianjian Bureau has great authority, but even the greatest authority is not above the laws of Jade Country, right?"
Wang Qianfeng thought deeply, silent for a long while. Then, he finally spoke, "First, take Wang Lan back to the Tianjian Bureau for investigation."
Sitting in the car, Wang Lan, arms crossed, looked sullen. Lige was driving, glancing over at Wang Lan beside her and then at Wang Qianfeng in the back seat.
"Wang Lan, Director Wang is just following procedure; don’t take it to heart. That teacher from Tong City may not be much, but he is, after all, the team leader of their representative team and represents the face of Tong City. We must act according to the rules. Besides, this case is clearly a set-up. We’ll be able to clear your name quickly."
"That’s not what I’m thinking about. I’m thinking that for a Demon Clan spy to use such a childish and crude method to frame someone, their objective obviously isn’t to truly frame me. Their aim is merely to delay me."
"The Tong City team leader’s words made me realize that they simply don’t want me to continue in the competition. I’m the first match tomorrow, and if I miss it, it’s considered a forfeit, and I can’t participate. But how does it benefit them if I can’t compete?"
"That’s simple. What if the Demon Clan’s plan is set during the competition itself? If you can’t participate, they can exclude you."
"No, even if I miss the competition, I will still be in the stands, and many brothers from the Tianjian Bureau will also be at the venue maintaining order. Just kicking me out of the competition doesn’t make any sense, unless they can get all of us out of the venue."
"Don’t worry about it for now," Wang Qianfeng interrupted from the back seat. "I will clear your suspicion tonight. When we get back to the Tianjian Bureau, you go straight to rest. Don’t bother with anything; just recharge for tomorrow’s competition."
「In the conference room」
Lu Zhao and the heads of each department were gathered.
"Director, the preliminary results are out," He Mingxue said with a solemn expression. "We found surveillance equipment in Ma Dongwei’s phone. It’s very small and can bypass our most advanced counter-surveillance devices."
"A listening device in Ma Dongwei’s work phone?"
"Yes, his work phone. This is also why the enemy knew Xuan Lin was inviting Ma Dongwei out to eat and was able to set up an ambush."
"Is there a problem with Ma Dongwei?"
"No!" He Mingxue shook his head. "It was Xuan Lin who reached out to Ma Dongwei first. They grew up together and hadn’t contacted each other for a long time. Xuan Lin initiated contact after learning that Ma Dongwei was in the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau."
"Then how did Xuan Lin find out about Ma Dongwei?"
"Li Xiao, the head of the Confidential Department," He Mingxue gently pushed his glasses up. "When arranging accommodations and security for Eld Di, Li Xiao mentioned Ma Dongwei to Xuan Lin, and it was Li Xiao who gave Xuan Lin Ma Dongwei’s cell phone number."
"Moreover, it wasn’t just Ma Dongwei’s phone. One-third of the phones in the Action Department have been installed with surveillance devices. These work phones were all distributed by the Confidential Department. Last year, coincidentally, was when the second-generation phones were updated. Two departments were responsible for phone distribution: General Affairs and Confidential."
"General Affairs handled the distribution of new phones, and Confidential was responsible for exchanging old ones. All the phones involved in incidents were distributed by the Confidential Department."
"Does this mean there’s an issue with the Confidential Department?"
"Barring any surprises, the mole we’ve been desperately searching for is Li Xiao from the Confidential Department."
"Then what are we waiting for?" Lu Zhao asked with a displeased expression.
"But Li Xiao has disappeared," He Mingxue said, his face grim. "We cannot determine whether Li Xiao has fled to escape charges or has been silenced after being framed as a scapegoat. We can only reach a conclusion after finding Li Xiao—we need to see him alive or find his body."
"Also, there’s another matter. Tonight, Wang Lan was framed on his way back. The figure in a Tianjian Bureau uniform who lured Wang Lan, after comparison, appears to be Li Xiao."
Wang Qianfeng’s words all but confirmed Li Xiao as the mole. However, the more seamlessly all clues pointed in one direction without contradiction, the higher the chance it was an enemy ploy to frame someone.
"What’s this about Wang Lan being framed?"
"Wang Lan’s suspicion has already been cleared. Although the deceased Wan Kui was shot in the chest with Wang Lan’s Crescent Arrow, Wan Kui’s actual time of death was three days ago. This means that Wang Mingling’s hand has already reached into the provincial martial arts tournament."
"The purpose of framing Wang Lan isn’t hard to guess: to make Wang Lan lose his qualification to compete. Either the Demon Clan is deliberately taking revenge on Wang Lan, preventing him from being admitted to one of the four major Star Martial Academies, or the enemy’s plan is heavily dependent on whether Wang Lan is present or not."
"Being valued so highly by the Demon Clan... it’s hard to say if it’s a good or bad thing for Wang Lan."
"Regardless, Wang Lan will compete as scheduled tomorrow. He’s already resting."
"Since Wang Mingling hasn’t given up on assassinating Eld Di, then let’s ensure none of them leaves alive. Starting tomorrow, all combat personnel from the Tianjian Bureau will be deployed at the provincial tournament venue. If Wang Mingling dares to come, he won’t leave here alive."
"Yes!"
「That night」
Wang Lan slept soundly, without any pressure. Since he hadn’t done anything wrong, he naturally felt no guilt.
But the Tong City team wasn’t idle after returning. Overnight, the news that Wang Lan from the Suzhou City team had killed Wan Kui from the Tong City team and was now being investigated by the Tianjian Bureau had spread like wildfire throughout the city.
There were many onlookers, and discussions were varied and sharply divided. Some believed it; others didn’t. But strangely, no one from the Suzhou City team came out to dispel the rumors or offer any explanation.
It was as if all the outside commotion and gossip had nothing to do with them.
For Jiang Xinyu, the concern wasn’t Wang Lan’s situation, but whether he could make it to the first match of the day. The provincial tournament was a serious and formal event. Just as being late for college entrance exams meant you couldn’t enter the examination room, arriving late for a match naturally meant forfeiture.
「Inside the sports arena」
The colorful flags still fluttered. Jiang Xinyu kept turning to look towards the entrance, but Wang Lan’s figure was nowhere to be seen. For the first time, Jiang Xinyu hoped that the director on stage, who was rambling on, would ramble even more to delay things a little longer. But the countdown to the start of the competition still sounded punctually.
"Now, please welcome the contestants for the first match of the fourth round of the Jiang Province Provincial Martial Arts Tournament: Wang Lan and Zhang Yu—"
"Zhang Yu has already entered. Wang Lan? Is Wang Lan here?"
"Wang Lan has gone to the restroom. Please wait a moment..."
"There is no waiting! If Wang Lan does not enter now, it will be considered a forfeit... Welcome, Wang Lan, to the arena!" The referee suddenly changed his tune as, in the distance, he saw a figure sprinting towards the venue. This morning, the roads were completely gridlocked, so Wang Lan had to sprint thirteen kilometers to get here.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - Phantom Tracer vs. Phantom Tracer
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: 233 Chapter Phantom Tracer vs. Phantom Tracer
Wang Lan arrived just in time, prompting the audience to stand up as many of the already eliminated competitors cheered and applauded excitedly.
By the fourth round, more than half of the thirteen cities had been completely wiped out. Since there was no longer any competition for them, they naturally watched the matches as regular spectators. The strength displayed by Wang Lan had already convinced them; missing a match due to tardiness would have been a pity.
However, the Tong City team did not see it this way.
"I protest—" a voice bellowed. "I protest against the organizers! You can’t allow a murderer to compete! It’s unfair to Wan Kui—"
"Mr. Xing, this is an innocence certificate jointly issued by the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau and the Suzhou City police. There is also a public announcement on the police’s official website. If you have any doubts, you can verify with the police and the Tianjian Bureau. But if you accuse me of being a murderer again, I can sue you for defamation."
Mr. Xing, from the Tong City team’s stands, looked at Wang Lan with a grim expression. He ultimately did not make another scene and instead hurriedly made a call to the Tong City Tianjian Bureau.
Zhang Yu, standing opposite, smiled at Wang Lan. "Do you need a break? I’m not in a rush."
"Thank you!"
"Speaking of which, I was also surprised when I heard the news of you killing someone yesterday. Although the Tong City team has been clamoring about it, I didn’t believe it. Even if you wanted to kill someone, it should be me. Someone who’s already been eliminated isn’t worth your trouble."
"I’m a law-abiding good student."
"Have you ever killed anyone?" Suddenly, Zhang Yu asked with a smile. The question caused Wang Lan’s eyes to turn cold.
What is Zhang Yu getting at?
"I have," Zhang Yu said abruptly. "In the trial grounds, some people think I’m just a student, and that hunting Exotic Beasts alone is an opportunity for them. But it was them who helped me complete Phantom Tracer."
"Then congratulations to you."
"Are you rested?"
"Ready. Wang Lan of Suzhou City, I look forward to learning from you."
"Zhang Yu of Jin City, please enlighten me."
The moment their words ended, Zhang Yu’s figure charged towards Wang Lan. Phantom Tracer had a distance limitation, much like a Mage’s range. Wang Lan, who had learned Phantom Tracer, knew this distance was twenty meters.
Wang Lan’s figure was suddenly enveloped in lightning as he met Zhang Yu’s approach, erupting into seven lightning afterimages. His true body was hidden among these afterimages; no one but he himself knew which one contained the real Wang Lan.
Zhang Yu’s figure vanished and instantly reappeared within one of the lightning afterimages, cutting it apart with his blade. But Wang Lan’s lightning afterimages were not mere illusions. When Zhang Yu slashed it apart, a piercing arc of electricity instantly brightened.
BOOM—
An explosion rang out, scattering in all directions, while endless arcs of electricity engulfed Zhang Yu’s figure. In the stands, everyone held their breath, their expressions filled with astonishment.
Without any preliminary scouting or exchanging blows, they went straight into a life-or-death confrontation?
Zhang Yu’s Star Martial Skill was somewhat unsolvable for the current students at the Star Cloud Stage, let alone Wang Lan at the Star Shine Stage.
Faced with such a difficult Star Martial Skill, shouldn’t he first scout and find weaknesses before countering?
On the Tong City stand, Mr. Xing put down his phone, his expression uncertain.
"Teacher, how is it?"
"Wan Kui’s death might really have nothing to do with Wang Lan. The Tong City Tianjian Bureau also acknowledges Suzhou City’s judgment."
"Then how did Wan Kui die?"
"That’s confidential; it’s not for us to ask. Just focus on the match. Even if you were to participate, what could you do? You couldn’t possibly be Zhang Yu’s opponent anyway. Phantom Tracer, even among A-rank Star Martial Skills, is acknowledged as one of the strongest. It’s known as an A-rank Skill with S-rank power."
As the electrical arcs dissipated, Zhang Yu’s figure was nowhere to be seen. Wang Lan certainly didn’t believe his doppelganger bombs could have obliterated Zhang Yu without a trace. The lightning afterimages kept intercrossing, and Wang Lan’s true body constantly switched positions among them.
Suddenly, a strong sense of crisis struck from behind. Wang Lan’s heartstrings tightened, and his figure instantly flashed into another afterimage. Almost at that same moment, Zhang Yu’s blade swept past the afterimage’s waist.
Before the afterimage could detonate, Zhang Yu’s figure completed a blink, then a second, a third, and a fourth. Zhang Yu instantly carried out four blinks, cutting through four of Wang Lan’s Lightning Doppelgangers.
No matter how well Wang Lan could hide, it was of little use against such cheat-like speedy strikes. Zhang Yu’s figure vanished once again; the remaining two afterimages naturally couldn’t avoid two more high-speed slashes.
SWISH—
Almost instantly, Zhang Yu was in his face. If Phantom Tracer were merely about moving fast or blinking, it wouldn’t pose much of a threat to Wang Lan. But Zhang Yu’s Phantom Tracer was more than simple blinking; it was his ultra-fast reflexes.
It’s like some people can skip rope sixty times a minute, some eighty, some a hundred. But could you imagine doing two or three hundred? That would be beyond most people. Zhang Yu’s reflexes, to use an ancient phrase, were astonishing—a sign of extraordinary talent.
To learn sleight of hand, others would need to practice their hand speed for a year or two, but he could skip that entirely. If he were to venture into thievery, he would undoubtedly be unparalleled.
When Zhang Yu appeared in front of you, before you could even react, his knife had already plunged down. Possessing an innately high body activity attribute was simply a cheat. Even with Thunder Activity, Wang Lan could barely keep up with Zhang Yu’s speed.
CLANG—
With a light sound, Wang Lan’s figure swiftly retreated. In the blink of an eye, he withdrew more than twenty meters.
Zhang Yu’s knife, could it actually withstand Wang Lan’s Flame Sword strike? What kind of divine weapon is this knife?
The Flame Sword, with its nearly ten-thousand-degree temperature plus attribute bonuses from its evolving nature, could instantly slice through a ten-centimeter-thick steel plate. But when it struck the opponent’s knife, his knife was completely unharmed.
The tactic of breaking the opponent’s knife was thus ruthlessly declared a failure.
Although thousands of thoughts streamed through his mind, Wang Lan’s hands didn’t pause for a second. The instant he jumped back twenty meters, he raised his hand and shot a Crescent Arrow at Zhang Yu. The arrow, infused with thunder, was more than three times faster. Zhang Yu’s figure flashed, and he vanished. The Crescent Arrow flew into empty space, disappearing after exceeding its range.
Zhang Yu reappeared but did not close in on Wang Lan; Phantom Tracer only allowed for twenty meters of movement. Therefore, Wang Lan had ample time to summon his lightning afterimages once more.
CRACKLE— Seven afterimages reappeared.
Frankly, it was quite annoying. Though Phantom Tracer was powerful, it also consumed a terrifying amount of Star Power. Similarly, Wang Lan’s Star Power consumption was extremely frightening. If Wang Lan hadn’t learned the Solar Seal and upgraded it to silver, allowing him to store twice the Star Power, his reserves would have been depleted during his first use of Lightning Doppelgangers.
A competition of Star Power between someone at the Star Shine Stage and another at the Star Cloud Stage—what a weird and foolish decision.
But Wang Lan’s tactic was precisely that foolish decision. Even if Phantom Tracer was a high-consumption Star Martial Skill, the sheer volume of Star Power someone at the Star Cloud Stage possessed was still significant.
CRACKLE—
