An hour-long intermission was given for everyone to process the first match’s incident.
"Zhang Hao, carotid artery severed, exhibiting no signs of life."
"Qiu Tianci, heart penetrated, exhibiting no signs of life."
"Is there anything suspicious?"
"That requires further autopsy."
While everyone was still stunned by the sudden mutual demise of Zhang Hao and Qiu Tianci, the school’s head instructor made a phone call, his expression serious yet tinged with excitement.
"Mu Shaoyun, where are you? The train station? Get back here right now! What? The train... Forget the train! You’ve got third place now; you’ll need to be on the podium soon. Details? You’ll find out when you get back. The champion? Not yet, but the final duel is about to begin."
After the head instructor hung up the phone, Wang Lan glanced back.
Mu Shaoyun was getting ready to leave?
"Yes, he’s at the station now, planning to head to E Province. It’s lucky I called him in time; it would have been troublesome if he’d already boarded the train."
"The second match of the semi-finals is about to begin. Wang Lan and Xiao Zi, please take your places."
Wang Lan was about to inquire further when the loudspeaker announced the imminent start of the match. He had to suppress his curiosity, rising to walk towards the repaired arena.
Wang Lan was also shocked by the mutual destruction that had just occurred. However, he always felt there was something more to their end. This, combined with Wang Mingling eyeing the provincial martial arts competition eagerly, made Wang Lan exceptionally sensitive.
Lost in thought, Wang Lan arrived at the tournament ground.
Xiao Zi’s face was still filled with a sunny smile, and her eyes showed nothing but goodwill towards Wang Lan.
"Wang Lan, we’re just having a match, right?" Xiao Zi suddenly scratched her head and greeted him.
"Of course, we are not enemies."
"Then there’s no need to risk our lives, right? If you can’t take it later, just admit defeat. The semi-finals have practically become the final. I don’t want the actual final to be cancelled too."
"The same goes for you. Don’t push yourself too hard if you can’t handle it."
"Are both competitors ready?"
"Ready!"
"OK!"
"Then, Wang Lan versus Xiao Zi, begin now!"
But the moment the referee’s voice finished, Xiao Zi’s Star Power surged wildly around her. Wang Lan instantly transformed into an electric arc and rushed towards Xiao Zi. He was barely halfway there when endless waves came crashing down with a roar.
A normal person’s Tsunami Technique would be like a breached river dam, water pouring forth in a deluge. Even a master’s Tsunami Technique only differed in scale and water volume.
However, Xiao Zi’s Tsunami came from all directions, making Wang Lan personally experience the true meaning of being overwhelmed by a flood. The frenzied water, like thousands of stampeding horses, engulfed Wang Lan with a deafening ROAR.
It’s not that Wang Lan didn’t want to escape; there was simply nowhere to escape to.
The massive amount of water spread across the entire arena. Had it not been for the protective barrier around it, Wang Lan suspected Xiao Zi might even have the ability to flood the entire stadium.
Water continued to spread far and wide. At the spot where Wang Lan was swallowed, a streak of sword light flashed, cutting through the surging floodwaters. Wang Lan’s basic sword technique had already reached the Gold level. Even though his Sword Qi couldn’t extend three feet outwards yet, slicing through the giant waves was no problem for him.
After fending off the impact of the violent waves, Wang Lan instantly burst forth, standing atop the water surface just like Xiao Zi. In that short span, the entire arena had transformed into a cubic water world.
The volume of water Xiao Zi produced was several times greater than during her battle against Xu Ruo.
"Damn, is she even human?" In the stands, many contestants couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise.
If previously Xiao Zi’s level of Star Power was considered unfathomable, at this moment it had risen to an unbelievably incredible level. Everyone present was at the Star Cloud Stage. Yet, when they compared their Star Power to hers, many began to wonder if their own Star Cloud Stage was a sham.
The entire competitive field was about half the size of a soccer field. Yet, Xiao Zi had managed to flood the whole area without any water source and raise the water level by several meters!
Surely, not even a Star Sea Stage master would dare attempt this, right?
This single move had nearly rendered all of Wang Lan’s fire-based Star Martial Skills useless.
What is controlling the field? This is what real control looks like.
Standing on the water, Wang Lan instantly raised his hands, wreathed in purple flames, a purple Flame Sword flickering like ghost fire.
Suddenly, Wang Lan flicked his wrist, and a purple Flame Flying Knife shot out towards Xiao Zi in an instant. With a slight lift of her hand, a koi fish made of water suddenly leaped from the surface.
Colliding with the Flame Flying Knife, it exploded with a BOOM, bursting into a cloud of steam.
Indeed, in this cubic water world, Xiao Zi was the absolute ruler.
With a gentle wave from Xiao Zi, the water surface surged violently. Countless water droplets shot upwards, transforming into a barrage of water needles in mid-air. With a slight push from Xiao Zi, the water needles shot towards Wang Lan like a dense rain of arrows.
In an instant, Wang Lan’s hands danced, and numerous Flame Flying Knives flew out to meet the water needles like bats. A series of explosions followed, dense steam billowing upwards. In the blink of an eye, the cubic water world transformed into something resembling a steamy bathhouse.
Wang Lan’s brows furrowed. The current situation was even more disadvantageous than when he faced Mu Shaoyun in his Black Emperor form. Wang Lan had used the rule against leaving a designated area to win against Mu Shaoyun, and now Xiao Zi was using the same rule to suppress him.
Within the arena, everything was under Xiao Zi’s control. There was no choice but to rise to the challenge. Retreat was not an option.
Steam clouded Wang Lan’s vision, making it impossible to track Xiao Zi’s movements.
"Dynamic Vision, activate!"
After the Crescent Arrow was upgraded to the Gold level, not only did the Crescent Arrow become the Sun-Shooting Arrow, but Dynamic Vision had also been enhanced. Besides an improved locking-on capability, it now possessed heat-sensing abilities. Although water vapor filled the air, it wasn’t steam from heating, but rather a fog-like mist.
Under Wang Lan’s Dynamic Vision, Xiao Zi’s humanoid silhouette appeared in his sight.
At that moment, Xiao Zi’s palms moved slightly, and the surrounding water surface once again surged tumultuously. Countless water dragons reared their heads above the surface and, like a pack of hunting dragons, opened their gaping maws towards Wang Lan.
"CRACKLE—" Electric arcs flashed around Wang Lan’s body. He instantly transformed into a streak of light, darting towards Xiao Zi in a serpentine trajectory.
In a contest of Star Martial Skills, Wang Lan knew he didn’t stand a chance. His only advantage lay in close combat. Xiao Zi was a pure Mage, weak in close quarters. But with field control abilities like Xiao Zi’s, her supposed weakness in close combat was hardly a vulnerability anymore.
Just as a dragon’s head crashed down, Wang Lan narrowly dodged Xiao Zi’s attack.
Yet, as he charged towards Xiao Zi, she could still precisely pinpoint his location.
After dodging five consecutive strikes from the water dragons, Wang Lan’s charging momentum finally had to stop.
Even with Thunder Activity, he couldn’t maintain continuous, split-second evasions indefinitely.
The moment Wang Lan paused, he thrust out a hand, and dense Thunder Snakes erupted from his palm. Dozens of Thunder Snakes, emitting piercing thunderous crackles, rushed towards Xiao Zi.
Xiao Zi remained unmoved; countless water snakes burst out from the water surface.
Intercepting one Thunder Snake with a single water snake was difficult, but ten water snakes against one made it simple.
Having endless Star Power was indeed such a luxury. If it were Wang Lan, he couldn’t even execute one such Star Martial Skill, yet for Xiao Zi, it seemed as effortless as lifting a finger.
Yet another attack failed. Xiao Zi remained steadfast, seemingly unbeatable.
Xiao Zi’s current state perfectly countered every tactic Wang Lan could conceive.
The water created by Star Martial Skills was pure, and pure water does not conduct electricity. Wang Lan’s Thunder-type Star Martial Skills were useless in Xiao Zi’s immense cubic water world.
His fire-type skills, naturally, were utterly suppressed.
Not only could water counter Wang Lan’s Star Martial Skills, but it also provided Xiao Zi with sensory input. Even if Wang Lan attempted the Star Cloud Sword Dance, Xiao Zi could use the water and steam to sense his true location.
The only Star Martial Skills he had left that might be effective were the Crescent Arrow and Phantom Tracer.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 Desperate Turnaround
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 241 Desperate Turnaround
As Wang Lan pondered his strategy, Xiao Zi on the other side made his move again. In an instant, Wang Lan felt the water beneath his feet suddenly turn violently turbulent.
The water level sank, and the surrounding water wall suddenly rose. Wang Lan’s expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly ran upward along the water wall. But after taking less than five steps, the rushing water swept him off it.
"What does Xiao Zi intend to do?" a student suddenly cried out in alarm. Above Wang Lan’s head, a cloud mass was gathering. To the students observing from outside, the competition arena had transformed into a giant water tank.
What was strange was the massive amount of water both below and above, with only a pocket of vacuum in the middle. Wang Lan and Xiao Zi stood facing each other in that vacuum.
"He plans to bury himself and Wang Lan alive! Xiao Zi is a Star Martial Warrior with four attributes, yet he’s using only the Water Attribute to suppress Wang Lan to the point he can’t move. If Xiao Zi were to use his other Star Martial Skills, wouldn’t Wang Lan be instantly defeated?"
"Hmph! Which school are you from?" A teacher in his fifties, an observer, suddenly put away his observation device and turned to curiously ask the student who had just spoken.
"Chang... Chang City Second Middle School."
"You’ve made a fundamental mistake, though considering you’re still a high school student, I can understand. If you were my student and said something like that, you would never graduate as long as you live.
Xiao Zi does possess four attributes. However, it’s not necessary for a multi-attribute Star Martial Warrior to display every attribute they’ve mastered for it to be considered skillful. Xiao Zi has already demonstrated his multi-attribute talent in previous battles.
The battlefield is ever-changing, so tactics must be adapted to the situation. Knowing which tactics and Star Martial Skills to use against specific opponents—that is the true combat awareness of a mature Star Martial Warrior.
According to you, should Xiao Zi also use the Earth Attribute? Fire Attribute? Thunder Attribute? Wang Lan himself possesses dual Fire and Thunder Attributes. Would the Fire and Thunder Attributes be particularly effective against Wang Lan? Or should he use the Earth Attribute, only to be countered by Wang Lan’s Thunder Attribute? Wang Lan is an intelligence-type Star Martial Warrior; the more diverse and numerous your techniques, the more openings you present to him.
Xiao Zi has reached a state of seeking not the ’best’ technique, but the ’most appropriate’ one. You, on the other hand, are still at the stage of a peacock impatiently spreading its tail, eager to show off. Battle isn’t a fashion show; the result is paramount.
Why doesn’t Xiao Zi use other attributes? It’s because pure water has the greatest suppressive effect on Wang Lan. His Fire Attribute Star Martial Skills cannot be effectively utilized, and the non-conductive nature of pure water restricts his Thunder Attribute.
Moreover, Xiao Zi has already comprehended the Law of Water Perception. In the world of water, Wang Lan’s every move cannot escape Xiao Zi’s senses. If he switched to another attribute, could he gain such a significant advantage?
In a real battle, a truly excellent strategy is one where the enemy knows your intentions perfectly but is powerless to stop you.
Wang Lan’s brilliance has already left us in awe, but Xiao Zi’s excellence is clearly a cut above. With this level of awareness, Xiao Zi is assured a place among future Titled Strongmen."
Hearing the senior teacher’s evaluation, the students behind him pursed their lips slightly. Even if they felt unconvinced deep down, they had to agree. Whether you acknowledged it or not didn’t matter; the authority to decide the rules lay in someone else’s hands.
Meanwhile, on the stands of the Suzhou City delegation, everyone’s face was contorted with tension. The head teacher, in particular, was gripping the armrest so tightly he almost crushed it.
For the first time, Suzhou City was so close to the championship throne, so close that with a bit more effort, they could hold the trophy in their arms. But that Xiao Zi seemed to be an insurmountable chasm.
"Xinyu, if you were in Wang Lan’s position, could you break Xiao Zi’s move?"
Jiang Xinyu pondered for a moment, then bit her lip quietly. "No."
"Can’t you freeze his water?" Xie Sisi asked in confusion.
"This isn’t merely static water. Unless I reach the Galaxy Stage and my Star Power undergoes a qualitative transformation, even if I managed to freeze a portion, the opponent would instantly shatter it.
Xiao Zi’s advantage lies in his extraordinary Star Power and his utilization of the Law. If not for the terrain restrictions, Wang Lan might have a chance to win. But with the entire arena under Xiao Zi’s control, Wang Lan’s chances are slim."
As Jiang Xinyu finished speaking, a figure walked up slowly, casually dressed and clearly looking like he was about to go out.
Mu Shaoyun took a seat and asked, "What’s happened? What’s going on?"
"The finals started early. Zhang Hao and Qiu Tianci took each other out—both dead. I really don’t know what was going on in their heads, what kind of deep-seated hatred drove them. Lucky for you, third place is yours," Xu Xiangwen said casually to Mu Shaoyun.
Within the entire Suzhou City delegation, Mu Shaoyun was the most aloof. But despite his standoffish nature, they were still familiar classmates, and Xu Xiangwen bore no ill will towards him. Mu Shaoyun merely responded with a nonchalant "Oh," and turned his gaze to the battlefield.
"Wang Lan is in a tricky situation."
"Indeed, Lanzi has never been so suppressed since becoming a Star Martial Warrior. I’m baffled why he bothers to follow the rules. Just go straight for the Phoenix..."
"Xiangwen! Shut up!" Jiang Xinyu immediately shouted, interrupting Xu Xiangwen.
"Yes, yes! But Lanzi is really being an idiot; it’s like his head got caught in a door! He has the strength but won’t use it. And even if he doesn’t use that, doesn’t he still have the Star Palace Artifact? Just use it!"
"Mu Shaoyun, if it were you, would you have a way out?"
"Of course, I do. Don’t forget, I excel in the Earth Attribute, and earth counters water."
At this moment, Xiao Zi’s earth-shattering strike finally arrived. The water in the sky suddenly pressed down fiercely on Wang Lan and Xiao Zi’s heads. Once submerged, Xiao Zi would have plenty of ways to launch various attacks on Wang Lan.
If Wang Lan standing on the water surface was an insect hopping on a spider’s web, then Wang Lan swallowed by the water was like an insect entangled in spider silk. At that point, whatever Xiao Zi wanted to do, he truly could.
A victorious smile appeared on Xiao Zi’s face, and as it did, Wang Lan’s body vanished in an instant.
Phantom Tracer had also successfully upgraded to Gold Tier. At the Gold Tier, the directions of teleportation for Phantom Tracer had increased from four to six, and the teleportation distance had reached thirty meters.
The cubic mass of water overhead, crashing down like a collapsing sky, was unavoidable by any conventional means of movement. Yet, with Phantom Tracer, escape was possible.
BOOM! A pocket of air exploded at the top of the water, sending an undulating column of water soaring into the sky.
Because the environment was enclosed and the water incredibly clear, Wang Lan’s vanishing act unfolded before everyone’s eyes in mere moments.
"Where’s Wang Lan?"
"He didn’t melt, did he?"
In the water, only Xiao Zi remained. Wang Lan’s figure had eerily vanished.
"Did you all hear a buzzing noise?"
"Sounds like it. Could it be an aerial photography drone up there?"
"No, Wang Lan is in the sky."
Finally, someone spotted the black dot above the cubic mass of water. A hundred meters high in the sky, Wang Lan’s figure hovered and darted about like a tiny bee.
Seeing this scene, Wang Qianfeng couldn’t help but stand up from his seat.
"Sky Step? He actually learned Sky Step?"
"Calm down!" He MingXue cast a disdainful look at his forgetful comrade.
Wasn’t it perfectly logical for Wang Lan to learn Sky Step?
But the Sky Step Wang Qianfeng had previously demonstrated to Wang Lan required Star Power to act upon the void itself. This was different from a regular Star Cloud Dance, where Star Power is applied to the body—a completely different concept. Sky Step was a technique Wang Qianfeng himself had only comprehended in the later stages of the Star Cloud Stage. Could Wang Lan have grasped it so quickly after just breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage?
Seeing Wang Lan stepping on the void, Xiao Zi’s expression instantly changed. Transforming into a fleeting fish, he swiftly dashed towards the water’s surface. But Wang Lan in the sky suddenly launched several Crescent Arrows towards the water.
Each arrow carried a visual lock-on. Xiao Zi’s expression changed, and he quickly sank into the water. However, at this moment, his face had already turned pale.
The very restriction he had placed on Wang Lan had now turned back on him, a trap sprung by his own Star Martial Skill. Xiao Zi’s current predicament was similar to Wang Lan’s earlier one, perhaps even worse. At least Wang Lan could stand on the water’s surface to breathe; Xiao Zi, however, could only remain submerged.
Furthermore, with the water being exceptionally clear, Xiao Zi’s every move was plainly visible to Wang Lan. If Xiao Zi dared to surface for air, Wang Lan would shoot instantly. Yet, if he remained underwater, he would eventually drown.
"PFFT—" When Xu Xiangwen finally understood the sudden reversal unfolding before him, he choked on a laugh.
Immediately after, exclamations of surprise erupted from those around him.
"Damn, what a comeback! This is more outrageous than a novel!"
"By Sodis’s pinch—trapped by the Star Martial Skill he himself released, he has to endure it even if it brings him to tears. I’ve heard of people setting themselves on fire, but never someone drowning themselves in their own water."
"Wang Lan’s brilliant tactics leave us utterly impressed and convinced."
"Same here."
"Now let’s see what Xiao Zi does. Drown or get shot—that’s a tough choice. He’ll probably have to concede."
"Not necessarily. Don’t forget, Xiao Zi has four attributes."
Time ticked by, second by second, and Xiao Zi’s face grew increasingly pale from holding his breath. Suddenly, he plunged headfirst toward the bottom, pressing one hand against the seabed.
RUMBLE— The earth rapidly sank, and as soil churned upwards, the once-clear water turned murky. Seeing Xiao Zi’s actions, how could Wang Lan not guess his intentions?
Wang Lan’s body free-fell from the sky, his fingers extended forward as if holding a gun. At his wrist, a pair of lightning wings unfurled, and an arrow composed of countless electrical arcs materialized at his fingertips.
WHOOSH—
The lightning arrow instantly plunged into the water, piercing downwards fiercely like a javelin. Then... CRACKLE—
Brilliant electrical arcs erupted, as if a powerful searchlight had illuminated the depths. A barrage of lightning arrows continuously bombarded the water.
"The now-murky water conducts electricity. Xiao Zi’s tactic has failed," Eld Di remarked softly, a smile on his face.
SPLASH—
Wang Lan dived into the water, which Xiao Zi had transformed into a vast swimming pool. After the initial splash, the water surface calmed once more.
After a while, a figure burst out of the water: Wang Lan, supporting the now unconscious Xiao Zi, standing on the water’s surface.

chapters.title: Chapter 242 Wang Mingling Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 242 Wang Mingling Appears
"Won?"
Suddenly, an incredulous cry of astonishment erupted, as if a fuse had ignited a powder keg.
"Champion? We’re the champions?" Xu Xiangwen excitedly jumped up from his seat and shouted loudly.
"CLAP! CLAP! CLAP!—" A teacher took the lead in standing up and applauding, followed by students rising one after another. Soon, almost everyone in the stands had risen to deliver a round of warm applause.
This battle left them in awe. Wang Lan’s stunning comeback left them speechless. It wasn’t just overwhelming strength that could win people’s wholehearted approval. Finding that fleeting chance of victory in adversity was the true spirit of a Star Martial Warrior.
In the fight against the Demon Clan, humanity had always been at a disadvantage. Yet, even in adversity, generation after generation of Star Martial Warriors, with their unyielding belief, had carried human civilization’s strong legacy to this day.
This was the truly invaluable quality of a Star Martial Warrior.
So this applause was for Wang Lan, who never gave up in adversity, and for the powerful and unmatched Xiao Zi.
Jiang Xinyu watched Wang Lan in the arena, raising his fist, and her lips broke into a radiant smile. It was at this moment that the man before her had truly won Jiang Xinyu’s heartfelt approval.
"You... after all, you won."
Behind Jiang Xinyu, the Dean of Discipline was now too excited to contain himself. Clutching the handrail tightly, his body trembled as old tears streamed down his face.
How many years had it been? Twenty years, or even longer? The Suzhou City representative team had never achieved such outstanding results. The championship, missed for over twenty years, had finally returned to the embrace of Suzhou City.
The applause in the stadium, along with the cheers of the audience watching the live broadcast, erupted. At this moment, a name resounded throughout Jiang Province. The champion of the 5019th Provincial Martial Arts Competition was Wang Lan.
The waves of cheers rolled on, seemingly endless, showing no sign of subsiding. Suddenly, the smartphones of all the Star Martial Warriors in the stadium began to ring simultaneously. Almost in unison, everyone pulled out their phones.
Upon seeing the message, everyone’s expression changed drastically.
"Demon Clan spies and terrorist organizations have joined forces to attack the Tianjian Bureau. The Tianjian Bureau urgently requests support. This is an emergency!"
Lu Zhao’s face turned deathly pale, his eyes wide with incredulous horror.
The Tianjian Bureau? Why the Tianjian Bureau? Was the Demon Clan’s target actually the Tianjian Bureau?
This message had been issued by Li Weixin, who had remained at the bureau. If the situation hadn’t been critically urgent, he would never have released it.
All of the Tianjian Bureau’s elite were at the gymnasium. Seizing the opportunity while the Tianjian Bureau was vulnerable, the Demon Clan spies struck at its core. At this moment, numerous possibilities flashed through Lu Zhao’s mind.
The Demon Clan’s true target wasn’t Eld Di, nor was it to disrupt this provincial competition. The Demon Clan’s target had always been the Tianjian Bureau.
Because the Tianjian Bureau of Suzhou City harbored deep-seated hatred for Demon Clan spies. Over the past year, the Demon Clan spy network connected to Suzhou City’s Tianjian Bureau had suffered frequent setbacks. As a result, Suzhou City’s Tianjian Bureau had become the exemplar for all such bureaus in the nation.
Assassinate Eld Di? Could the feasibility of assassinating Eld Di be equated with the feasibility of destroying Suzhou City’s Tianjian Bureau?
Lu Zhao had his answer in an instant.
"BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!—"
The call connected, and Li Weixin’s urgent voice came from the other end.
"Director, it’s Wang Mingling! He’s leading Demon Clan spies and a large group of human traitors in an assault on the east gate. We definitely can’t hold them off in a direct confrontation. I’ve activated the protective barrier, but... the situation is very grim."
"How many have come?"
"Several hundred. But Wang Mingling alone is as formidable as a thousand men."
"I understand," Lu Zhao replied, quickly sending a message through his phone: "All units, take note! Return and reinforce the Tianjian Bureau immediately!"
After finishing, Lu Zhao looked apologetically at Eld Di. "Eld Di, I must take my leave."
"Go, go. Do you need my help?" Eld Di asked calmly, his tone nonchalant.
"No need. The Tianjian Bureau fears no challenge."
Wang Qianfeng was about to turn around when he saw Wang Lan quickly sprinting out of the arena.
"Wang Lan, where are you going? You’re the champion."
Wang Lan stopped in his tracks, looking up at Wang Qianfeng in the stands with confusion.
Isn’t the Tianjian Bureau in urgent need?
"You stay. We’ll handle it," Wang Qianfeng said tersely before his figure shot up into the sky.
Although the others in the venue could only guess what had happened and were discussing it animatedly, an announcement from the organizers soon came over the loudspeakers.
"Due to the special circumstances this morning, the Jiang Province Provincial Martial Arts Competition concluded three hours earlier than in other provinces. Now, let’s welcome to the stage our champion, Wang Lan; runner-up, Xiao Zi; and third-place winner, Mu Shaoyun, for the award ceremony!"
The television broadcast continued. The end of the competition wasn’t the final curtain call. Only when the trophy was in hand would the dust truly settle.
What if I miss the award ceremony and the reward that’s rightfully mine disappears? After defeating Xiao Zi, the system didn’t even notify me that I’m the champion.
Wang Lan walked up to the podium at the edge of the field and stood in the center. To his left was Xiao Zi, who had mostly healed after her treatment. To his right was Mu Shaoyun, wearing a duckbill cap, looking as if he were about to go on a trip.
In the midst of the exhilarating music, Eld Di approached the podium, took the championship medal and award from the panel of judges, and came forward solemnly.
Eld Di wasn’t tall; he was a very lean old man with a benevolent smile on his face, just like a grandfather in the park. But from Eld Di, Wang Lan sensed a gravitas as profound as a mountain and a breadth as vast as the sea.
And this old man was his mother’s mentor, the legendary figure who had nurtured the Flame Emperor of the South.
Eld Di solemnly placed the medal around Wang Lan’s neck. "If your mother could see your achievement today, she would be very happy. In the provincial competition, your mother only ranked eighth in the province—that was her lifelong regret. And this regret, you’ve fulfilled for her."
"Thank you!"
Wang Lan thought he would have a lot to say, but when the moment came, it felt as if a rock were lodged in his chest. The only words he managed to utter were a simple "Thank you!"
"You are excellent, no less so than your mother," Eld Di said before turning towards Xiao Zi.
*[System: Congratulations to the Host for becoming the champion of the Provincial Martial Arts Competition. Reward: 30,000 Experience Points, 1,500 Skill Points.]*
"BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!—"
Wang Lan’s phone suddenly rang at that moment. Knowing that the Tianjian Bureau was facing a crisis, he quickly took out his phone. It was a message from Xu Shiyun.
"’The autopsy results just came out: Zhang Hao and Qiu Tianci have been dead for over eighteen hours.’"
The moment Wang Lan saw the message, his complexion changed drastically. He had already had his suspicions, which was why he had asked Xu Shiyun to look into it. But he never expected... to have actually guessed right.
In that situation, those two wouldn’t have killed each other. But that scene truly unfolded before my eyes. If it was artificially manipulated, then the manipulator’s purpose was...
Just then, Eld Di had finished presenting the award to Xiao Zi and was heading towards the third-place winner, Mu Shaoyun. At that very instant, Wang Lan’s Inch Strength Fist suddenly activated. Without warning, he threw a punch at Mu Shaoyun beside him.
Caught completely off guard, Mu Shaoyun was blasted away by Wang Lan’s punch.
This scene was broadcast live on television, reaching thousands of households. Everyone was stunned. On the dais, the leaders from Suzhou City, the host city, instantly leaped to their feet, staring at Wang Lan in utter bewilderment.
"Wang Lan, what are you doing?" Principal Zhang was right beside the podium and, recovering from the shock, burst out thunderously, "This is the award podium, and there’s a live TV broadcast! Whatever grudges you have with Mu Shaoyun, you can’t settle them at this time!"
Wang Lan looked at Mu Shaoyun, still lying motionless on the ground, his own expression impassive.
"Mu Shaoyun... no, I should call you Wang Mingling. Are you still going to pretend?" Wang Lan said, pulling out his phone to make a call. "Director Wang, the mole has been found. It’s Ma Weidong."
"Wang Lan, what on earth is going on? You’ve completely confused me," Eld Di said, still calm and collected, even managing a chuckle and a smile.
"Just now, my colleague informed me that Zhang Hao and Qiu Tianci’s actual time of death was over eighteen hours ago. This means they were murdered last night," Wang Lan explained.
"How could people murdered last night possibly compete today? The only explanation is that their bodies were being controlled by a Star Martial Warrior. And the only person capable of that is Wang Mingling, the Star Martial Warrior traitor from Jade Country.
"But what was Wang Mingling’s motive for making Zhang Hao and Qiu Tianci kill each other? The only reason I can think of is that with them dead, you, who would have originally ranked fifth, successfully moved up to third place.
"The top three finishers stand on the podium to receive their awards from Eld Di. Considering the intelligence we previously obtained—that Wang Mingling returned to the country to assassinate Eld Di—it means that you, who shouldn’t even be on this podium, are the assassin intending to kill Eld Di. Am I right?"
"Hehehe..." Mu Shaoyun, who had been feigning unconsciousness on the ground, suddenly let out a chilling laugh. He stood up stiffly, his body bent at an eerie angle.
"Although Mu Shaoyun was always considered the best in his year, he was never as overwhelmingly powerful as you’ve demonstrated. His strength was, at most, a notch above his peers. But you... you’re unimaginably strong.
"I suspect that back when Mu Shaoyun’s family was assassinated by Hellfire, you had already possessed him. That’s why you can only be Wang Mingling. And if Wang Mingling himself made a move, how could Ma Weidong have possibly held out until we arrived? Therefore, he must be the mole within the Tianjian Bureau.
"I believe your plan was twofold. First, you deliberately created the illusion that you were already at the stadium, luring the Tianjian Bureau’s top personnel to fortify that location. Meanwhile, you colluded with the Demon Clan to launch a surprise attack on the Tianjian Bureau headquarters.
"Once the Tianjian Bureau recalled its forces to defend the headquarters, you would then have the perfect opportunity for an assassination right here. Killing two birds with one stone! Wang Mingling, I have to admit, even if you are ugly, your scheme was quite ingenious."
"Wang Lan was the biggest variable in our plan," Wang Mingling said, his voice raspy. "As long as he was present, our plan could be disrupted. Dongluo of the Demon Clan stressed this to me repeatedly. Yet, I found it strange. How could a mere Star Shine Stage youngster, a student still in school, make them so wary?
"Ah... I regret not heeding his advice and allowing you to remain. I should have killed you in the previous match."
"Kill me? Do you think you could?"
Wang Mingling slowly straightened up. Pieces of skin on his face began to peel away, and in the blink of an eye, an entirely different face was revealed.
Wang Mingling’s gaze shifted to Eld Di. Suddenly, a smile he hadn’t worn in a long time appeared on his face. "Teacher, it’s been over thirty years. Do you still remember me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Blossom, Phoenix Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 243: Blossom, Phoenix Form
"Wang Mingling... of course, I remember." Eld Di’s expression was complicated, conflicted for a moment before he seemed to accept it. He let out a gentle sigh and slowly raised his hand to roll up his sleeve.
"Since you’re here to assassinate this old man, then come."
Wang Lan stood in front of Eld Di. "Xiao Zi, protect Eld Di and retreat! Wang Mingling, your plot has been exposed! With so many teachers here, you don’t stand a chance!"
"There’s still a chance. I’m only five meters away from Eld Di now, close enough to strike before they can reach us. Kid, do you really think that just because you beat me once, you can stop me now? If I hadn’t been trying to avoid attracting the Tianjian Bureau’s attention, killing you would have taken but an instant."
As her voice fell, Wang Mingling’s figure vanished in an instant.
"Phoenix Form, activate!"
In a flash, a bright red Phoenix Tail Flower insignia appeared on Wang Lan’s forehead, and fiery flames erupted around him. The flames billowed like a fiery mist as a terrifying aura surged forth.
He swung a fierce punch, hammering it towards the ground.
"BOOM—"
The ground instantly cracked and buckled, stones soared into the air, and the ten-meter radius around his feet violently caved in.
"BOOM—"
Less than two meters in front of Wang Lan, a figure erupted from the ground, as swift as a phantom.
The moment the figure shot out from the ground, Wang Lan’s fist, carrying the force of myriad lightning bolts, thundered down upon it.
BOOM, BOOM, BOOM—
Countless Thunder Snakes struck the dark silhouette, arcs of electricity rampaging and roaring. Amidst the exploding clouds of dust, a figure swiftly retreated, creating distance.
This exchange of blows, all completed within a single second, was so fast that no one present, except for a few Star Sea Stage teachers from the Star Martial Academy, clearly saw what had happened.
Metallic, shell-like fragments clinked as they fell, layer upon layer, from Wang Mingling’s body. The sudden exchange left Wang Mingling with a palpable sense of trepidation; the Wang Lan before her was no longer the one she had faced previously.
"SWOOSH, SWOOSH, SWOOSH—"
Led by Ni Yushu, several Star Sea Stage experts quickly arrived, encircling Eld Di and protecting him at the center.
"Eld Di, are you alright?"
"With Wang Lan here, what could happen to me? Heh heh heh... It seems this old man was underestimated. Back in the day, I too fought on bloody battlefields where rivers of crimson stained the mountains..."
"Teacher Yang, please escort Eld Di to safety. We’ll handle this," Ni Yushu said to a male teacher beside her.
"Alright. Be careful."
"Don’t!" Eld Di suddenly interjected. "Everyone, step back a bit. Leave this fight to Wang Lan. Show me your strongest abilities; let this old man see what you’re truly made of."
Wang Lan’s mouth twitched slightly.
This old man behind me is a bit unhinged,
he thought.
Why insist on a one-on-one duel when we could easily overwhelm her together? And why am I being pushed into this duel? Shouldn’t everyone be teaming up to take Wang Mingling down right now?
But he’s Eld Di; he’s the boss. Even if I’m reluctant, I have to listen to Eld Di. Besides, with him giving the order, the powerful teachers behind me will only provide support from the sidelines; they won’t intervene directly.
A duel it is, then. Even if I can’t win, the teachers surely wouldn’t just stand by and watch Wang Mingling escape, right?
The teachers escorted Eld Di to the side, though not too far—twenty meters was close enough for them to intervene if necessary. The students in the stands departed in an orderly fashion under the teachers’ direction. Only aerial drones and cameras, positioned in every corner, remained fixated on Wang Lan and Wang Mingling.
"Eld Di, Wang Lan’s current state... is it the Phoenix Form?" Ni Yushu asked, somewhat hesitantly.
"Indeed, it is the Phoenix Form. In just one year, he has cultivated the first aspect of the Phoenix Form to the second stage. This child might truly be able to inherit the mantle of the Little Phoenix..."
Although this was the first time Ni Yushu had heard the title "Little Phoenix," it didn’t stop her from guessing that "Little Phoenix" referred to the Flame Emperor.
"But... Wang Lan is just an ordinary student from Suzhou City. How did he learn the super S-class forbidden technique, the Phoenix Form? Furthermore, as I understand it, the Phoenix Form has extremely stringent cultivation requirements. It requires a pure fire attribute and, at minimum, the Galaxy Stage. Even if those two conditions are met, the chances of successfully cultivating the Phoenix Form are one in ten thousand. Wang Lan... he clearly possesses both fire and thunder attributes, not even meeting the basic requirements to practice the Phoenix Form. How did he learn it? Where did he get the chance...?"
Ni Yushu asked excitedly, her question echoing the primary reaction of most people upon learning Wang Lan had studied the Phoenix Form.
It simply... defied all logic.
"Wang Lan’s performance has already proven his capabilities. He should no longer need to hide," Eld Di said, his expression uncharacteristically solemn. "He is the son of the Little Phoenix. It’s time for him to step forward. As for how he learned the Phoenix Form... the Little Phoenix once took a fragment of his soul and, within her own body, used it to nurture the Phoenix Form. Only after the Phoenix Form’s Star Power stabilized did she imprint that soul fragment and the Phoenix Form together into a Soul Bead. His Phoenix Form was specially crafted for him by the Little Phoenix. But even with such conditions, one would normally need to be at the Galaxy Stage to utilize it. Yet he... the very first Star Martial Skill he successfully learned was the Phoenix Form."
Eld Di’s words caused the complexions of the surrounding Star Sea Stage experts to change drastically. Their gazes towards Wang Lan grew even more fervent.
What was this? A rising star? One destined to soar to unimaginable heights!
On the battlefield, Wang Lan unleashed his full strength against Wang Mingling, holding nothing back. After revealing her true form, Wang Mingling also completely unleashed her power. With Star Power at the peak of the Galaxy Stage and her sublime mastery of Star Martial Skills, her strength far surpassed that of a typical warrior at the peak of the Galaxy Stage.
Once Wang Lan activated his Phoenix Form, his strength also approached the peak of the Galaxy Stage, and his application of Star Martial Skills was no less than Wang Mingling’s. The only disparity, perhaps, lay in combat experience.
Some aspects of combat experience can be compensated for, but certain instincts cannot be developed through shortcuts. These instincts are crucial. For instance, when facing imminent danger or an impending crisis, a subconscious reaction can avert disaster.
This instinct, honed through countless life-or-death situations, was what allowed Wang Mingling to repeatedly evade Wang Lan’s terrifying killing blows.
Even so, Wang Mingling’s mental state gradually neared the brink of collapse; she became increasingly unhinged and perverse.
Why? Why has Wang Lan’s path been so smooth? Why can a mere high school senior fight me on equal terms? Why is it that you, a genius, are adored by thousands, while I, also a genius, am betrayed by my own family? Is my peculiar talent my fault? Did I choose to awaken this insidious ability to control others? Did I ask to devour souls? I didn’t... I didn’t want to be seen as a monster! I wanted to be like all of you! I never wanted to be an outcast! I researched Forbidden and Secret Skills—was it to harm society? No! I never thought of such a thing! I only hoped to change myself through learning! I just wanted to be a normal person! Why did you all reject me more and more, become increasingly hostile, and even... try to kill me, disregarding our blood ties? You are my closest relatives, my uncles, connected to me by blood! What else could I do? I had to strike first to survive! Betraying my country, betraying humanity... only in battle do I feel alive. By constantly hovering between life and death, I reached the pinnacle of a Star Martial Warrior in thirty years. But that legendary realm... I’ve been stalled before it for seventeen years! For even a glimpse of that realm, I joined the notorious Paradise Bird organization! What did I do wrong? You forced all of this upon me! It’s not my fault! I am what I am today because of all of you! You think you’re a genius? I’ll kill you! Kill you! I’ll make every single one of you regret this!
Wang Mingling’s expression gradually twisted, becoming less human and more like a wild beast baring its fangs at the sight of prey.
Their battle raged from the ground to the sky, and from the sky back down underground. At their level, neither the solidity of the earth nor the vastness of the sky could restrict their abilities.
Wang Mingling’s most proficient Earth Attribute Star Martial Skills were perfectly countered by the Thunder Attribute abilities of Wang Lan’s Phoenix Form. Moreover, the Black Emperor Form, obtained by possessing Mu Shaoyun, could not absorb Star Power from the Phoenix Form.
It was an utterly, evenly matched fight.
The stands were now empty. Those who remained were teachers, at least at the peak of the Star Cloud Stage. The students and the leaders of Suzhou City had all been evacuated, yet the surrounding recording equipment continued to operate, fearlessly capturing the scene amidst the danger.
In front of countless television screens in homes everywhere, people stared, dumbfounded, at the battle unfolding before them. Although the fight wasn’t edited and the footage occasionally shook, the thrill of it still made countless people’s blood boil.
Previously, one could find videos of high-level battles online, but they were often blurry, fake, or artificially created. What was happening now, however, was undeniably real.
"Oh my gosh... is this how Star Martial Warriors fight? Calling it a clash of gods wouldn’t be an exaggeration, right?"
"Do you think this could be an impromptu show by the Jiang Province organizers? Could it be fake?"
"Fake, my foot! Do you think this is some variety show taping? What do you take the provincial martial arts tournament for? It’s as serious as the college entrance exams! And it’s specifically for top-tier students! Even if this were a drill, they wouldn’t dare be so reckless at an event like this!"
"That commenter is right. This is definitely a real, ongoing terrorist attack. But it seems the attack was anticipated, and that terrorist is now a cornered beast."
"I’m wondering, can Wang Lan win? What if he can’t?"
"What ’what if’? Chill out! If Wang Lan loses, there’s still a whole group of experts behind him, right? If each of them landed just one kick, they’d beat that guy senseless. It’s just the desperate struggle of a cornered beast."
BOOM—
A deafening explosion rang out, and a terrifying shockwave swept through the area.
Trading injury for injury, Wang Lan struck Wang Mingling’s chest with an Inch Strength Triple Force. In turn, Wang Mingling’s sword slashed down from Wang Lan’s shoulder, cleaving deep into his chest.
Wang Lan had deliberately initiated this exchange. It happened as quick as lightning, so fast that even the teachers behind him were too late to intervene.
By the time the teachers reacted, Wang Lan had already been nearly cleaved in two.
"AH—"
Almost simultaneously, everyone witnessing the scene gasped in horror. Even Eld Di couldn’t help but frown.
A blow that sliced from the shoulder deep into the chest—how many internal organs had it destroyed along its path? Anyone else would undoubtedly be dead after receiving such a wound.
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH—" Wang Mingling stumbled back, spewing mouthfuls of dark blood mixed with chunks of flesh from her mouth.
I won. Even though my ultimate fate is death, I still won in the end. I killed one of your precious geniuses. Do you regret it now? Despair...
Just as a smug look began to spread across Wang Mingling’s face, in the very next moment, her eyes bulged wide in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: The Strongest High School Student in History
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 244: The Strongest High School Student in History
Wang Lan’s body was almost bisected, but he didn’t fall as expected. Apart from some initial spurting of blood, the bleeding stopped.
The grotesque wound on his chest visibly healed at an astonishing speed, as if time was running backward.
"WOW—"
"The Wolf King has Self Healing abilities. HAHAHA... when it comes to endurance, in my life I bow to no one except the Wolf King."
"Damn, what is this? A Healing Skill?"
"No, this is an Undying Body! Can healing speed be this fast? Only an Undying Body could heal this quickly."
In less than five seconds, Wang Lan’s wounds had completely healed, without even a scar left behind.
Wang Mingling’s strike was indeed fierce, but the moment the injury occurred, the Self Healing skill had already activated. Propelled by the Phoenix Star Power, it took only a second to exit the state of near death, and three seconds to move beyond critically wounded. Five seconds later, he had returned to peak condition.
Though the injury on Wang Lan’s body had healed, his clothes could not be mended. Two pieces of cloth fell from Wang Lan’s shoulders. With a light wave of his hand, Wang Lan tore off the remnants from his body. Instantly, Star Power surged around him, and the door to the Star palace swung open.
A streak of light rose, and in a flash, a bronze phoenix burst out of the Star palace. The phoenix disintegrated mid-air, transforming into pieces of armor that covered Wang Lan’s body. For the first time, the process of donning the Saint Cloth was broadcast into countless homes.
Even without an exciting BGM, the scene still made viewers’ blood boil.
Eld Di’s shocked expression faded, and a sharp gleam flickered in his eyes. What mattered to him was not the origin of this Star Palace Artifact, but Wang Lan’s healing talent.
To recover completely in mere seconds from injuries that could kill instantly... this talent was unexpectedly powerful.
With the Saint Cloth on, Wang Lan returned to his peak, but Wang Mingling, with all his internal organs shattered, looked like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered. Even if this Wang Mingling was just a body he had seized, with the organs shattered, this body was already over eighty percent damaged. How much power could it still exert?
"Wang Mingling, you’re going to die—"
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s Saint Cloth blazed with a fierce flame. As the flames formed, they soared with spread wings, and a phantom phoenix appeared before everyone’s eyes.
Wang Lan transformed into a streak of light, rushing towards Wang Mingling with a scorching wind.
Phoenix Wing Sky Soaring—
Though he didn’t know the signature move of the Phoenix Constellation, he still shouted the name "Phoenix Wing Sky Soaring." Countless fists enwreathed in flames, like meteors, pummeled Wang Mingling’s chest.
Wang Mingling was ravaged by continuous punches, unable to mount even a token resistance. He was propelled high into the air by Wang Lan’s barrage of fiery punches. Then, he was smashed from the sky to the ground.
BOOM—
The ground collapsed as if a meteor had struck. Deep cracks spread out like a tortoise shell within a ten-meter radius, forming a crater at least two meters deep.
The dust slowly settled. Wang Lan stood atop Wang Mingling’s chest, looking down coldly at the now unrecognizable Wang Mingling lying on the ground.
The flames around him were not as explosive as before, but they still burned fiercely.
"You lost!"
Wang Mingling’s hollow gaze filled with hatred as he looked at Wang Lan, his fingers suddenly twitching slightly.
"BOOM—"
In an instant, Wang Lan delivered a punch that further sunk the ground by a meter, and Wang Mingling’s body was directly fused with the earth by that punch.
"Defeated a higher level opponent. Reward: two thousand experience points, one hundred skill points."
"Successfully thwarted the Demon Clan’s conspiracy. Reward: ten thousand experience points, one thousand skill points..."
"Successfully achieved the prestigious ’Center of Attention’ reputation. Reward: ten thousand experience points, one thousand skill points!"
One notification after another almost made Wang Lan ecstatically dance on the spot.
As the dust settled, the teachers behind him couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief. Eld Di slowly took off his sunglasses, revealing a pair of piercing eyes.
"This situation is resolved. Now it’s time for the other to end..."
Suddenly, a powerful presence swept over, grand as if encompassing the entire sky. In a moment, Wang Lan’s body tensed, and his hair stood on end.
This was an indescribable feeling, like an ant facing the vast power of nature, one of utter despair.
Suddenly, everyone turned their heads.
Eld Di was enveloped in a golden radiance. Amid the golden light, he was still the same Eld Di, but he seemed to have transcended the ordinary and become divine.
The golden light flashed, and Eld Di’s figure disappeared from view.
Dozens of kilometers away at the Tianjian Bureau, an intense battle was still raging. Although a large number of reinforcements had already arrived, it was unclear by what means the Demon Clan had managed to open five Different Dimensional Spaces around the Tianjian Bureau.
Exotic Beasts poured out, rushing towards the bustling commercial district not far away. The commercial district was densely populated, and the consequences would be unimaginable if the Exotic Beasts broke through. Faced with the choice between the Tianjian Bureau and the lives of the citizens, the Tianjian Bureau would naturally choose the citizens.
But this inevitably delayed the time to support the Tianjian Bureau. While Lu Zhao ordered Li Weixin to hold on, he also led Wang Qianfeng and others to quickly eliminate the five Different Dimensional Spaces. Twenty minutes passed without notice.
The Demon Clan was still fiercely attacking the Tianjian Bureau, and its defense line was in great peril. On the other battlefield, the Exotic Beasts rampaging out of the Different Dimensional Spaces had already been wiped out by the elite warriors of the Tianjian Bureau, who had unleashed their full firepower.
To prevent a single Exotic Beast from breaking into the populated area, the Tianjian Bureau also paid a heavy price.
"Move! Support the headquarters!" Lu Zhao fiercely wiped the green blood off his face and barked the command.
Just as he was about to take action, suddenly, the colors of heaven and earth changed. Gold drenched the world below.
Lu Zhao looked up sharply and saw a golden figure suspended in the clouds. Through the layers of golden light, he recognized it was Eld Di.
"Eld Di—" Lu Zhao’s heart was instantly filled with shock.
Although the Five Elders held distinguished identities and prestigious positions, there were few records of their strength. It was well-known that the five strongest people in Jade Country were the Five Emperors. The Five Elders were simply the five venerable elders who had nurtured such exceptional figures as the Five Emperors.
Eld Di hadn’t made a move in nearly thirty years. Thirty years ago, he was indeed a high-level expert at the Star Sea Stage, even a well-known Titled Strongman. However, with advancing age, Eld Di’s strength was bound to have declined.
The outside world speculated that the current Five Elders, in terms of strength, might have fallen out of the Galaxy Stage.
But at this moment, Lu Zhao realized how laughable the outside world’s speculation was.
With his own Cultivation Level at the Star Sea Stage, he felt like an ant facing the fury of the heavens and earth under the presence before him. Although he didn’t know about the other elders, at least Eld Di, despite his age, had not weakened. In fact, he had grown countless times stronger than thirty years ago.
From the void, Eld Di lightly reached out a finger. In an instant, countless beams of golden light rained down towards the ground.
Each beam of golden light struck a member of the Demon Clan, a Demon Soldier, and even the treacherous humans from Paradise Bird. None could escape the attack of the golden light, nor could any survive under it.
In just the blink of an eye, like a fierce flame melting ice and snow, the world suddenly became peaceful.
Everyone was looking up, staring blankly at the golden light above their heads. They watched as Eld Di, like a divine being, slowly descended.
All the special agents of the Tianjian Bureau felt a tremor in their souls. Each of them had a rich past, stories that inspired awe. They should not have been so astonished by the scene before them, yet the power Eld Di had shown was beyond their comprehension.
The boundless strength, like the firmament itself, inspired fear in everyone’s hearts.
"The one Wang Mingling intended to assassinate... was such a figure?" Xu Shiyun muttered, touching her nose.
As Eld Di descended, the golden aura around him dispersed, and he returned to being an approachable and kindly old man.
Although the Tianjian Bureau had gone through a fierce battle, the Demon Clan had never managed to break into its interior. Apart from the outer area being a mess, the buildings of the Tianjian Bureau remained intact.
No one saw Eld Di’s display of Divine Might, but the exciting footage of Wang Lan’s battle with Wang Mingling was broadcast into countless homes through television. After a brief silence, the internet erupted.
"Wolf King is awesome—"
"Wolf King is so strong! The power he displayed in the provincial martial arts meeting wasn’t even a tenth of his true strength. Especially at the end, after putting on the Phoenix Armor, he could actually soar into the sky and burrow into the earth. The shockwave from his punch knocked down drones tens of meters away! I dare say, if Wang Lan had shown his true strength in the provincial meeting, no one there could have taken a single move from him."
"Completely agree with the above. But here’s the thing: why did Wang Lan fight so hard in the provincial meeting? Every time he seemed to go through a tough fight."
"Maybe he wanted to leave some dignity for his peers? If Wang Lan had shown his true ability from the start, would the other students have had any chance to shine? He might as well have fought them all by himself."
"Makes sense... But... Not to be sour or anything, I just can’t understand. We’re all high school students. We can understand if you’re a bit stronger, but being this much stronger is incomprehensible."
"To the person above, don’t say you don’t understand; we damn well don’t understand either! Let me put it this way: I also attended Suzhou No.1 Middle School, but I don’t have the talent of a Star Martial Warrior. But let me tell you, Wang Lan is non-human. Otherwise, where do you think the title of ’Scholar God’ comes from?"
"Wang Lan, I would call him the strongest high school student in history. Who agrees? Who disagrees?"
"Agree!"
"Agree!"
"I disagree! I think we shouldn’t attract negativity for the Wolf King. The title of ’strongest in history’ attracts too much of it. Let’s go with ’strongest high school student in Jiang Province’s history’."
"My forty-meter sword is already... Never mind, you have a point. The ’strongest in Jiang Province’s history’ and ’strongest in the country’s history’ isn’t much different."
The sensation Wang Lan created in Jiang Province spread like a virus, swiftly expanding outward. The events occurring in Jiang Province, especially under live television coverage, simply couldn’t be concealed.
Eld Di didn’t order the cameras to be turned off; he even left the battle to Wang Lan without any intention of hiding it. So, Wang Lan trended.
While Wang Lan’s popularity was explosive, he quietly returned home. After learning that the Tianjian Bureau was no longer in danger and that all the Demon Clan spies and Paradise Bird traitors had been killed, there was no need for him to provide support.
After the Phoenix form’s cooldown, with his small arms and legs, going to support would have been sending himself to be slaughtered.
When he got home, he didn’t even bother to take a shower but instead collapsed directly onto his bed and fell soundly asleep. Wang Lan had used the Phoenix form numerous times, developing some immunity to its aftereffects. If not for that, he wasn’t sure he could have even made it home.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Major Upgrade
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 245: Major Upgrade
Upon awakening, it was already 3 AM. Although the days in May are long with daylight breaking early, 3 AM was still cloaked in the darkness just before dawn.
Wang Lan picked up his phone. There had been no summons from the Tianjian Bureau, and Jiang Xinyu had only left a text message asking to report in when available.
At this hour, a safety check seemed unnecessary.
Turning over lazily, his fingertip brushed against something hard. He quickly sat up to find the champion’s reward box and medal carelessly tossed on the bed. He had returned home and collapsed straight onto the bed, not yet having had a chance to look at them.
He had previously received 1,500 skill points as a champion reward, and another 3,000 skill points after defeating Wang Mingling. He had reserved 2,000 skill points for the Phoenix form. Including the skill points previously remaining in the system, he now had almost 3,000 points.
At a glance, 3,000 points seemed copious, but that was then and this was now.
After skills upgraded to the Gold-level, a single casual level-up would cost 1,000 skill points.
And not all of them were like that—Phantom Tracer’s upgrade astonishingly wasn’t!
After upgrading to Gold-level, Phantom Tracer required 1,500 skill points per level. With 3,000 skill points, even if he invested them all in Phantom Tracer, it could only ascend to Gold II.
From this, it was evident that skills began to diverge once they reached Gold-level. And after some analysis, Wang Lan comprehended that such variance was only logical.
Gold-level Star Martial Skills, in terms of power rankings within the Star Martial world, were S-level.
There are no weak S-level Star Martial Skills, and the difficulty of their cultivation is nothing short of despairing.
Flame Sword, Star Cloud Sword Dance, Crescent Arrows, including Thunder Snake, belonged to the category of standard Star Martial Skills. Post-Gold-level, their upgrades proceeded normally at 1,000 skill points. However, Phantom Tracer was a blink movement technique, falling under the domain of Space Attribute Star Martial Skills.
But why was Phantom Tracer categorized under Form Changing Star Martial Skills without any attribute? The reason likely lay with the spatial nodes being within a single node unit’s distance. Hence, this Star Martial Skill could be successfully cultivated even without the Inborn Talent of the Space Attribute.
This was an overlooked Star Martial Skill. Seemingly merely a blink movement technique, it bridged to the mysterious and powerful Space Attribute. Hence, it made sense that upgrading this Star Martial Skill was more challenging than others.
If this line of reasoning held, might there be other unique upgrade methods for Gold-level Star Martial Skills in the future?
Wang Lan’s gaze drifted to the bottom of the Star Martial Skills page, where the lone skill shimmered with silver-white brilliance. It was also Wang Lan’s genuine Star Martial Skill—the Inborn Talent of the Bloodline Star Martial Skill that evolved with Wang Lan’s growth, Healing.
Previously, feeling that the Silver IX-level Healing ability was sufficient, he hadn’t been eager to upgrade it to Gold-level. He had saved some skill points for unexpected needs.
Other skills didn’t display significant changes upon reaching Gold-level. They were simply enhanced in terms of power and functionality.
Crescent Arrows shot faster, farther, and with greater force. Thunder Snake became quicker and more numerous. Flame Sword gained the ability to be controlled separately from the hand. Star Cloud Sword Dance merely added to the number of afterimages, the power of the Sword Qi, and the capacity to Sky Step and move through the air.
But every upgrade of Healing gave Wang Lan a sense of profound transformation. At Black Iron, it was a mere passive self-healing; at Bronze, an active ability was added to the passive skill; while Silver enabled healing others. So what would Gold bring?
Wang Lan felt quite expectant.
After spending one hundred skill points, the icon for the Healing ability suddenly changed color. And not just the color; even the shape of the icon transformed. It turned into a fully blossomed flower, basking in golden radiance.
Wang Lan’s mind delved into the skill icon, his expression stiffening slightly.
"Song of Life, provides healing to a designated injured target in the vicinity, restoring their wounds."
Understanding the literal meaning wasn’t enough for Wang Lan to grasp the full scope of changes to the ability. However, with the skill’s upgrade, the knack for using it seemed to be etched into his mind.
Wang Lan could now heal without touch, meaning he could perform healing at a distance. The range was within five meters, and for the time being, only one target could be chosen. But he felt that healing a single target wasn’t the limit; as the skill level rose, the number of healed targets would likely increase.
Moreover, Healing didn’t interfere with any other Star Martial Skill during the process. This was extraordinary. Wang Lan could heal others while still fighting. The support rate on the battlefield was now many times what it was before.
But upon seeing the upgrade requirements for Song of Life, Wang Lan’s expression turned grim.
Song of Life, Gold LV1 (0/2000)
Upgrading from LV1 to LV2 required 2,000 skill points. If the skill points needed remained constant, upgrading to Platinum-level would only need 20,000 skill points. However, if it increased like experience points, reaching Platinum-level would demand 55,000 skill points—more than double.
Although discontent with the difficulty of upgrading, Wang Lan was quite satisfied with the increase in the skill’s power. After organizing his strength, he realized that after reaching Gold-level, his growth was still in its initial phase.
This wasn’t hard to understand. Gold LV1 was merely the entry stage of Gold-level Star Martial Skills. Only by reaching Gold LV9 could one fully unleash the utmost power of a Gold-level skill.
It seemed his future days would be spent striving hard for skill points.
Having assessed his own strength, Wang Lan’s eyes then turned to the metal box on the bed. The provincial martial arts champion’s reward shone with a golden luster.
Though it definitely wasn’t solid gold.
Wang Lan gently opened the box, which contained a jewelry box and a certificate of honor.
The certificate’s content was obvious without opening it; he knew what it would say.
Wang Lan directly picked up the jewelry box and opened it.
Suddenly, a fiery red, goose-egg-sized Soul Bead caught his eye.
This Soul Bead was slightly smaller than Wang Lan’s fist but significantly larger than a medium Soul Bead. It was fire-red in color, undoubtedly a Fire Soul Bead. Having never seen a high-level Soul Bead, Wang Lan could not determine whether this one was high-level or just a larger medium-level one.
Inside the jewelry box was a piece of paper. Wang Lan promptly took it out.
"Star Martial Skill, Earth Surge Fire Sea. Attribute, Fire. Level, S-Rank. Attack range, thirty meters in diameter. Battlefield application, 4 stars, Attack power, four and a half stars, Star Power consumption, four and a half stars..."
Below were the details of the combat application of the Star Martial Skill. The paper introduced this S-Rank Star Martial Skill in incredible detail—its advantages, disadvantages, suitable usage scenarios, environment, etc.
This was a grand gift, a true grand gift.
When put beside the honor of a provincial champion, this award seemed insignificant. If the folks at Mingyue Wucheng knew the provincial champion would be awarded an S-Rank Star Martial Skill, they would likely not stay so calm, claiming there was not much benefit to winning and it’s a loss of face for the clan if defeated. Is this not considered a benefit?
Wang Lan picked up the Soul Bead and swallowed it in one gulp. Instantly, scorching fire-attribute Star Power entered his body from his hand, racing into the Star Palace, while the information contained within the Soul Bead crashed into Wang Lan’s Spiritual Sea of Consciousness.
"A learnable Star Martial Skill discovered, do you wish to spend one thousand skill points to learn it?"
Isn’t that a silly question?
Hurriedly allocating one thousand skill points, suddenly, on the skill icon page, a brand-new Gold Star Martial Skill appeared. It was only after learning this Star Martial Skill that Wang Lan truly understood its special nature.
An attack range of thirty meters in diameter—it wasn’t attack distance, but rather... damn, it covered an area thirty meters in diameter! This was an area-effect Star Martial Skill!
Within that thirty-meter radius, flames would gush forth from the ground. Any living being within the range would suffer indiscriminate attacks. It was powerful, but... also very energy-consuming.
With Wang Lan’s current level of Star Power, he could only use it once, and perhaps it would only last a few seconds at that. Alright, the organizers might have some misconceptions about the robustness of my Star Power; the Star Power consumption has already exceeded my limits.
This kind of Star Martial Skill should have been given to Xiao Zi, right? Or was it that it was meant for Xiao Zi in the first place, but they didn’t expect Wang Lan to win the championship? Then, upon checking, hmm, Wang Lan is also of the fire attribute, so they just handed it over without considering whether Wang Lan could use it?
Although there were many points to criticize, after all, it was an S-Rank Star Martial Skill. What could there be to be unsatisfied about?
The moment Wang Lan saw the upgrade conditions for the Star Martial Skill, he felt frustrated again. Like Song of Life, it required two thousand skill points to upgrade to Gold LV1.
Already short on skill points, and here comes another gluttonous demand. The prospects of a future full of labor were already foreseeable.
By now, two hours had unknowingly passed. At five in the morning, the sun had already risen high.
Wang Lan got up, brushed his teeth, washed up, and changed out of his tattered clothes, throwing them away.
He pondered over how he had returned home yesterday. It seemed like a teacher had taken him back...
At that time, his mental state was poor, and some memories were hard to recall.
After finishing washing up, he changed into a fresh set of clothes.
Once again a stunningly handsome man.
"Alert, alert, an unknown group of individuals has suddenly gathered around the building. Do you want to initiate a defensive counter-attack?"
Wang Lan, who had just finished brushing his teeth, looked bewildered. "Open the camera; let me see who it is."
Ever since the last intrusion into Xinyu Building by Crow’s people, the Tianjian Bureau had allowed Wang Lan to add a defense system to the building. In fact, every Tianjian Bureau operative’s home is a mini armory, with at least ten firearms.
Wang Lan, after retrofitting, connected it with the functional robot and then handed command to Xiao Ai. However, Wang Lan also added restrictions: only after receiving his explicit command could Xiao Ai use the weapons for self-defense.
The TV screen illuminated. Outside Xinyu Building, a crowd of reporters from various media outlets, holding cameras and video cameras, surrounded the building. Additionally, independent media personnel, streamers, and others were gradually arriving from all directions.
After a night of developing, Wang Lan, the sensational provincial martial arts champion, had become their target.
If they’re just journalists, then there’s nothing to worry about!
Wang Lan picked up his phone and moved to the sofa, opening the group chat of his five-member team.
"The sun has risen; here’s to another day full of vigor! Let’s go!"
After sending the message, Wang Lan put down his phone, and a robot brought him a cup of aromatic coffee. Suddenly, the phone rang with a video call invitation.
"Xiao Ai, connect to the TV monitor, receive the video call."

chapters.title: Chapter 246 Strong Response
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 246 Strong Response
The TV lit up, and almost simultaneously, four screens came to life.
Geez, were these four really this in sync, all clicking video chat at the same time?
"Wang Lan, are you okay?" Jiang Xinyu was the first to speak.
"Of course, I’m okay. I’m a man with an indestructible attribute; I won’t ever get hurt in this lifetime. Don’t worry, I’m really fine..."
"Lanzi, how’s headquarters?" Xu Xiangwen asked anxiously.
"Old Xu, you actually care about headquarters before you ask about me?"
"Bullshit. You’re known as the Immortal Wolf King. The whole city could be wiped out, and you’d still be fine. Why should I worry about you? Hurry up, how’s headquarters? I finally managed to get a non-permanent position; don’t tell me I’m going back to being unemployed."
"You’re still a student, for crying out loud. Headquarters is fine, completely unscathed. Only the lawn outside and the park used for cover were destroyed."
"Lanzi, you’re famous! The strongest high school student in the history of Jiang Province! Before, you were only a big deal in Suzhou City, but now, you’re the biggest deal in the whole country... You’re trending number one right now!" Gong Feiyu said with a smile.
"So, is that why there are so many suspicious people downstairs, each carrying professional cameras and long lenses? I was wondering why Xiao Ai kept issuing external threat alerts early this morning. It’s a good thing I stopped it, or Xiao Ai might have initiated a self-defense counter-attack protocol."
"Are you at home now? Want us to come over?"
"Let’s not. The crowd at the door is like a pack of hungry wolves; you’d definitely get overwhelmed if you came. I’ll make a phone call and have the local police clear them out."
"Wang Lan, have any Star Martial Academies called you?" Jiang Xinyu suddenly asked.
"Not yet. They probably know I’m expecting recruitment calls from the Four Great Star Martial Academies, right? Those calls will likely come in a couple of days. What about you?"
"I’ve gotten quite a few recently. Invitations from all the top Star Martial Academies, except for the big four. If they don’t choose me, then I’ll consider the others."
"Your performance was evident for all to see. As long as the top four aren’t blind, they should recruit you. Anyway, I’ve got to go. Hanging up now."
"Okay!"
"Lanzi, you must go online and see for yourself. Just search your name, and you’ll know how famous you’ve become," Gong Feiyu said with a mysterious smile before hanging up.
Xie Sisi hadn’t said a word from the moment the video call connected until the very end, when she finally spoke, "I’m relieved that you’re okay."
Wang Lan didn’t call the Tianjian Bureau; he dialed Hu Qing directly. There was no need for the Tianjian Bureau to deal with reporters; the local police chief could handle it.
By the way, isn’t it time for Hu Qing to get married? I think I heard something from Jiajia when I last talked to my aunt the day before yesterday.
Back in his study, he turned on the computer and searched for "Wang Lan."
WHOOSH. A slew of website links popped up.
"The Strongest High School Student in Jiang Province History: Wang Lan’s Video Compilation."
"He, a ’Study God.’ Even After Trading the Pen for the Martial Path, He Remains the Most Dazzling Star."
"Wang Lan - Baidu Encyclopedia."
"The Young Legend Who Turns the Tide Against All Odds."
There were so many entries it made Wang Lan feel a little embarrassed. The top-ranked video compilation also had the most clicks. He naturally clicked on it.
It was a video link. After a second of buffering, subtitles began to roll.
"July, Year 5018. A young man arrived at a crossroads in his life.
His name is Wang Lan, a student from Class One, Second Grade, at Suzhou No.1 Middle School. He is also the celebrated ’Study God’ of Suzhou City! From elementary school to the present, he has always been number one in every exam.
He was unbeatable among his peers, unbeatable in Suzhou City, even unbeatable in Jiang Province. The apex is a cold and lonely place, yet his yearning for a single defeat went unanswered; his solitude was like snow..."
He’s exaggerating! I definitely never thought that way back then! Was I really that incredible?
Although Wang Lan thought this, deep down... he felt quite a thrill.
A strikingly impressive aura emanated from the video, accompanying the narration and visuals. Even Wang Lan, the subject of the video, had to admit the opening was exceptionally well done.
The scene shifted to an aerial view of Suzhou City.
"Perhaps tired of his invincible loneliness, on the day he graduated from second grade, the very night summer vacation began, he awakened his Star Martial Art talent without Soul Resonance.
Since he was already unrivaled among ordinary people, why not venture into the world of Star Martial Warriors?
After his awakening, no one knew what Wang Lan experienced. But when he reappeared, he had already surpassed the initial stages of a Star Martial Warrior, becoming a Star Shine Stage warrior.
The path others walked for three, or even five years, he conquered in a single summer vacation.
In October 5018, the third season of the Suzhou City Star Martial Art Competition began.
For many in Suzhou City, that season of the Star Martial Art Competition must have left a deep impression, because it was an extraordinarily successful season. And for Wang Lan, it was his stage to shine."
What followed was a montage of a masked Wang Lan fighting splendidly in the Star Martial Art Competition. The ten-minute montage, paired with exhilarating background music, didn’t feel long at all; instead, it left viewers wanting more.
The highlights concluded the moment Wang Lan defeated Chang Shuangyue with a single, decisive blow. The screen then faded to black.
"One year is too short for a Star Martial Warrior. For many people, one year doesn’t bring much change. But for Wang Lan, it was an earth-shattering period.
He had no remarkable family background, no noble birth. But he possessed unbelievable talent and an incredible speed of improvement.
He, once the ’Study God’ of an ordinary school district, is now a Star Martial Warrior. I can almost hear him, standing under the dazzling lights, addressing the masses:
’I’ll let you all have a two-year head start. That way, defeating you will actually be a challenge.’
Two years! Wang Lan started at least two years later than all the other students of his grade, possibly even more. Yet, in just one year, he managed to create a gap that would take them ten years to bridge."
The video then flashed a warning: "High-energy content incoming!"
Suddenly, an exhilarating BGM started playing, and the video rapidly shifted scenes again. At the provincial martial arts tournament, Wang Lan’s thrilling battles were shown one after another, each cool move densely packed into the video.
Never mind the impressionable teenagers getting hyped up; even Wang Lan himself felt his blood boil with excitement.
If you hadn’t narrated it this way, I wouldn’t have known I was this awesome...
Ultimately, Wang Lan defeated Xiao Zi and ascended to the champion’s throne. The music suddenly mellowed, and the scene transitioned to the awards ceremony, with Wang Lan standing calmly on the champion’s podium.
"He is the champion of Jiang Province, the champion among thirteen cities and eight thousand third-year high school students in Jiang Province. From the moment he became a Star Martial Warrior to standing at the pinnacle above all others, it had taken him merely one year.
One year may seem short to many. For Wang Lan, however, it signified the conquest of yet another summit.
Again, he must endure the cold loneliness of being at the top, the solitude of invincibility.
Life, how can it be so devoid of challenges!"
"Shit!" Wang Lan couldn’t help but curse.
You can’t go around making me a target for everyone’s jealousy like that!
But the stream of comments on the video was a chorus of praise.
"Awesome! Awesome!"
"The editor did a brilliant job! I can’t find any reason to refute it."
"High-energy alert! Warning! Warning! Take your emergency heart medication now, or face the consequences!"
As Wang Lan put on the champion’s medal, the screen suddenly turned black again.
"Do you think it’s all over? Do you think the dust has settled?"
BOOM!
An intense explosion kicked off the next segment, and the stirring BGM surged once more. Next came scenes of Wang Lan in his phoenix form battling Wang Mingling. Regardless of the spectacle or the scale of the battle, the visual effects—the interplay of light and shadow—were simply mind-blowing.
The power Wang Lan displayed in this moment truly embodied an invincible solitude.
The soothing finale music began to play as Wang Lan stood quietly in the crater. Beneath his feet lay Wang Mingling’s severely injured body.
"This is Wang Lan, known as the strongest high school student in the history of Jiang Province. From an ordinary person to the peak of his grade, it took him just one year.
Sometimes, I can’t help but wonder: what heights will Wang Lan reach in the next year? In three years, what kind of legend will he become?
Our generation is fortunate to witness such a legendary figure rising, soaring to new heights!"
The video ended, but the comments below continued to flood in, at a rate of five to ten per second.
After watching, Wang Lan silently shut down his computer.
Although he had been famous before, back then he was "Wolf" wearing a mask, not the Wang Lan whose true identity was now exposed. He wasn’t averse to fame, but he was a bit worried. He didn’t know how it would affect his life.
Compared to the organic buzz on the internet, the analyses of Wang Lan by the major Star Martial Academies were far more rigorous.
"Principal, all assessments for Jiang Province’s champion, Wang Lan, are perfect. Star Power control, combat skills, combat intelligence, and even potential—all perfect. These assessment figures are so high, not even the Five Emperors possessed such stats in their youth.
