"Listen, everyone," Wang Lan began, his patience wearing thin. "You’re supposed to be the elite, aren’t you? I’ve explained it so clearly and thoroughly. How can you still not get it? Weren’t we told the average IQ here is one hundred fifty? Are you sure you didn’t underreport by a hundred?"
With a loud THUD, Wang Lan slammed a brick onto the office desk. Carved squarely into the brick was the character for ’Virtue’.
Over these past few days, Wang Lan’s authority had solidified. This was especially true after the first sample of the Black-speckled Spider Toxin Vaccine was returned, confirming not only its effectiveness but also its perfect safety in human trials. All the senior students were now genuinely and wholeheartedly convinced of Wang Lan’s capabilities.
That’s how it worked in this world. While unspoken rules about seniority existed, ultimately, capability trumped everything. Besides, they were all students, so seniority wasn’t really a factor. Since Wang Lan possessed the skill of an instructor, he naturally commanded an instructor’s authority.
Even a Buddha would lose their temper if pushed too far. Wang Lan, infuriated by this group of slow learners, finally snapped. He began spouting classic teacher tirades without holding back.
"Wang Lan, are you sure this is simple?" one senior asked. "Each step is like a labyrinth, full of twists and turns. A single small step requires considering dozens of variables and satisfying more than ten conditions simultaneously. And there are hundreds of such steps! Without computer assistance, how could a human brain possibly manage it?"
"Then why don’t you use a computer?!"
"But I haven’t got the formula down; I can’t edit it to input into the computing software."
"I..."
Three words stuck in Wang Lan’s throat as if a fishbone were lodged there.
Sun Li intervened. "Alright, alright, everyone has worked hard these past few days. Understanding and mastering the gene-editing formula isn’t something that can be achieved overnight. Otherwise, after Ms. Wang Qi published it so long ago, someone would have claimed to have fully mastered it by now, yet no one has.
It’s truly difficult for you to master it in just a few days when so many top scientists haven’t managed to. So, how about this: tomorrow, I’ll give you all a few days off to relax your minds."
"Teacher... you haven’t mastered it yourself and now plan to abandon us, have you?" a female student asked, her expression mournful.
"Hahaha... silly child, what are you saying? Am I the kind of person to burn bridges?" Sun Li chuckled.
All the students nodded vigorously, completely disregarding Sun Li’s attempt to save face.
"Zhang, go fax the virus vaccine data we’ve compiled these past few days to Jiayi. Tell them to prepare the samples for us as soon as possible. I plan to go into seclusion for a week. Don’t disturb me during this time unless it’s absolutely necessary."
"Huh? Teacher, does that mean I can stay here and continue encoding virus vaccines for the entire week?" Wang Lan asked, his eyes shining with eagerness.
Without the teacher’s supervision or the drag of his senior classmates, Wang Lan could go full throttle. Earning five hundred thousand experience points a day would be a breeze.
Ah, the mere thought of it was wonderfully intoxicating!
Sun Li looked at Wang Lan with a mixture of pity and sly amusement. "Silly boy, have you forgotten you’re still a student? And have you forgotten how many classes you’ve missed? Hurry back and make up for your absences. Otherwise, failing your finals and having to retake them won’t look good on your record."
"But didn’t you..." Wang Lan asked cautiously, "Didn’t you talk to those instructors? And smooth things over for me?"
"Yes, I did," Sun Li replied. "I ’smoothed things over’ by applying for a ten-day sick leave for you."
Wang Lan stared at Sun Li, horrified.
A teacher who trolls her own student so expertly? I can only bow in admiration!
"Make good use of this week, all of you," Sun Li continued. "I’ll be busy again once I come out of seclusion. The rest of you students, too: lab reports, study reflections, class notes—not a single thing should be missing. I’ll be checking everything when I return."
After leaving the medical department, Wang Lan dragged his exhausted body back to his dormitory. Compared to the two slackers in his dorm, their life was what real college was like: sleeping through classes, gaming after lectures, and occasional impromptu barbecues for no particular reason.
"You’re back early today?" He Jing looked up and asked casually on seeing Wang Lan return so soon.
"I’ve been liberated! I’ll go to class with you guys normally from tomorrow," Wang Lan called back, then flopped onto his bed to sort through his gains.
In the past ten days, he had cracked some eighty-odd Star Martial Toxins, earning nearly five hundred thousand experience points and thirty thousand skill points. His Star Martial Art level had not only reached Star Cloud Two but was also just a step away from Star Cloud Three.
To avoid causing too much of a stir, Wang Lan had chosen to level up discreetly by retreating to the restroom. He’d essentially used a ’tactical toilet retreat’ to avoid a potential jealous beating from his senior classmates.
He hadn’t used the thirty thousand skill points yet; besides, they weren’t immediately needed, and the number thirty thousand itself felt auspicious. However, now that he had some free time, it was indeed time to consider how to allocate them.
Song of Life, Gold Two! As Wang Lan’s innate Star Martial Skill, it was also the Star Martial Skill Wang Lan valued most.
Remote healing, mobile healing—none of these mattered as much to Wang Lan as the ability to heal himself. His Self Healing Star Martial Skill, even at Silver Nine, could already bring someone back from the brink of death.
As long as his head wasn’t instantly severed, Wang Lan was confident he could revive with full health. After Song of Life evolved to the Gold level, there seemed to be no particular changes to its self-healing aspect...
Well, there was one. Regeneration of severed limbs!
Even if his limbs were severed, they could rapidly regenerate under the light of Self Healing. Of course, if an enemy was capable of severing Wang Lan’s limbs, then severing his head wouldn’t be much more difficult.
So, this skill still seemed somewhat redundant.
What was the point of regenerating limbs if the head couldn’t be regenerated?
Must add points!
Spending ten thousand skill points to upgrade Song of Life to Gold Nine yielded no substantial changes. Apart from increasing the number of people he could heal and the range of the healing, there was no alteration to its self-healing capabilities.
But upon deeper reflection, Wang Lan realized that wasn’t entirely true. Although no outward changes were apparent, he sensed his body undergoing some kind of... mutation.
The sensation was like... being a flower bud on the verge of blooming, feeling an intense urge to open. Yet, even after upgrading to Gold Nine, this metaphorical flower hadn’t successfully blossomed.
Perhaps the powerful abilities stemming from this would only manifest after reaching the Platinum level.
As for his other Star Martial Skills, he figured that after entering university, competitive sparring matches would cease, and opportunities for one-on-one duels would also become scarce. From what he’d gathered from his seniors, mastering an area-of-effect attack skill during university was crucial.
In the future, whether supporting operations abroad or interning in Pioneer Spaces, when facing swarms of Exotic Beasts, the effectiveness of a wide-range Star Martial Skill would be far superior to that of any single-target offensive skill.
Wang Lan’s Earth Surge Fire Sea was quite effective, so he upgraded it to High-Gold rank. As for his other Star Martial Skills—Phantom Tracer was excellent, Universal Decomposition was incredibly potent, and then there were the four foundational Star Martial Skills like Inch Strength Fist... all of these also required continuous upgrading.
Thirty thousand skill points seemed like a lot, but in reality, it was nowhere near enough.
While Wang Lan was carefully and prudently assigning points in the system, over in Suzhou City at Jiayi Technology, Ms. Wang Qi’s office was enveloped in a different kind of emotion.
Three days prior, the sample of the Black-speckled Spider Toxin Vaccine, developed by Wang Qi herself, had been sent to Modu Star Martial Academy. She had considered it a minor event. Even if it were to be mass-produced, that would surely take some time.
Within Jade Country, Poisonous Beasts weren’t particularly common, and Black-speckled Spiders were typically found in Different Dimensional Spaces connected to the South African plate. Jade Country hadn’t provided support to that region for many years.
But unexpectedly, a mere three days later, they had received data for over eighty different vaccines requiring sample production.
What on earth was going on? Could there have been a breakthrough in developing Star Martial Toxin Vaccines? Was it like when she herself had developed the Life Potion? But it had taken her nearly ten years to create the Life Potion, and that was just for a single type of potion.
A potion applicable to most cancers.
However, each Star Martial Toxin Vaccine was unique. Wang Qi had initially assumed that the first vaccine—the one for the Black-speckled Spider—was the culmination of years of research. But now, in just a few days, this team had managed to crack the formulas for over eighty different vaccines?
Her pen spun ceaselessly between her fingers as she pondered for a long time. Suddenly, Wang Qi reached a decision.
"Xiaoling, contact Modu Star Martial Academy for me. I’d like to pay them a visit tomorrow."
"Got it!"
The next day, Professor Zheng Gong’s lecture was the first class in the morning. Wang Lan arrived early, settling into the classroom and setting up his laptop in front of him. To be honest,
he was panicking internally.
He felt just like an elementary school student who had forgotten to do his homework and was now dreading the moment the teacher would come to collect it.
The classroom gradually filled up, the bell signalling the start of class rang, and Professor Zheng Gong stepped into the classroom with his teaching materials under his arm.
"Good morning, students. Today, we’re going to discuss Memory Imprinting," Professor Zheng Gong began. "First, I must state unequivocally that Memory Imprinting is an extremely dangerous procedure and must be approached with utmost caution.
Whether imprinting another’s memories or your own, the risks are identical. The slightest error can obliterate the subject’s brain. And once the brain is destroyed, the person effectively becomes an imbecile.
I am not fearmongering; such tragic incidents have occurred even here at Modu Star Martial Academy, teaching us harsh lessons. I recall a case from the class of ’08. That year, a student, lacking proper mastery, recklessly experimented with Memory Imprinting. While attempting to extract his own memories, his unstable control over his spiritual power caused it to detonate within his mind.
The result... his mental capacity was reduced to that of a three-year-old. He essentially bid farewell to his future. So..." Suddenly, Professor Zheng Gong’s voice trailed off.
His gaze swept across the classroom and, by chance, landed on an ostrich-like figure hunched behind a laptop.
Heh. So, you finally decided to show up?

chapters.title: Chapter 268 Auntie Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 268 Auntie Arrives
"Wang Lan!" Professor Zheng Gong closed his lesson plan, his voice a low shout, seemingly suppressing his fury.
Wang Lan secretly sighed, peeked his head out from behind his notebook, and then stood up.
"Are you feeling better?" Professor Zheng Gong’s words immediately triggered a wave of laughter throughout the classroom.
For Star Martial Warriors, getting sick was considered a joke. Wang Lan’s leave note was particularly outrageous. In the decades since Modu Star Martial Academy had opened, spanning three generations, likely no one had ever submitted such an audacious request.
I have a cold and feel unwell, I hereby request ten days of leave!
A Star Martial Warrior catching a cold? Requesting ten days off?
Isn’t that a joke? But what could be done?
The person had already vanished, and it wasn’t even possible to write ’not approved’ on the leave note.
Such an outrageous leave request should never have been approved. However, someone in the teaching office—who must have had their head caught in a door—actually signed off on it. Since he couldn’t vent his anger on the teaching office, he had to direct it at Wang Lan.
You’ve finally shown up. Excellent!
"I’ve recovered, thank you for your concern, Professor."
"Very well. Let’s postpone today’s lesson content for a bit. We’ll have a quick review session to consolidate what we’ve previously learned. Come on, Wang Lan, come up here and assist me."
Wang Lan walked up to the podium with a wry smile, while countless pairs of bright eyes sent him their silent, sincere encouragement.
Wang Lan, hang in there! Wang Lan, you can do it!
"Let’s start from the part after mirror imaging. Wang Lan, what are the key points when probing someone else’s memory?"
"First, use linguistic cues to induce the target to recall relevant memories. Then, connect to the target’s cerebral nerves with spiritual power, reverse-infiltrating their brain to view the desired memories."
"Besides this method, are there any others?"
"Creating illusions. If not using illusions, then use intimidation, threats, and other methods to unsettle the target’s mind and create chaotic thoughts, thereby finding an entry point."
"What are the essentials for mirror imaging someone else’s memory?"
"It requires synchronization of spiritual power and the simultaneous visualization of thoughts within the mindscape."
Wang Lan answered every one of Professor Zheng’s questions fluently. This gradually wiped the schadenfreude from the faces of the classmates who had expected Wang Lan to be publicly humiliated, replacing it with surprise.
He really took ten days off? Are we sure he didn’t attend any classes? The way he’s answering so fluently, it doesn’t seem like he missed anything at all!
"How do you confirm spiritual synchronization?"
"Huh?" Wang Lan looked at Professor Zheng Gong, bewildered. "Does spiritual power synchronization need confirmation? If it’s synchronized, it’s synchronized, isn’t it?"
Finally, Professor Zheng asked a question Wang Lan couldn’t answer, and a hint of satisfaction touched the professor’s old face.
"Just three days ago, I emphasized that brainwave frequencies are extremely complex and unpredictable. To confirm the brainwave connection, we need precise instruments to measure the degree of connectivity. If it falls below seventy percent, the connection must be immediately severed; otherwise, it will damage the other person’s brain. Unless... the other person is a spy or a traitor you are interrogating."
"But that kind of risk only exists before the brainwave connection is established. After the brainwaves are connected, wouldn’t you just need to manipulate the other person’s brainwaves to match your own frequency?"
Wang Lan raised this question because his Gold-level Spirit Engraving indicated this was indeed the case. Wang Lan had always considered Spirit Engraving the best method for interrogation and intelligence gathering, so he hadn’t hesitated to invest his valuable skill points to upgrade it to Gold rank.
If Professor Zheng Gong knew that Wang Lan viewed Spirit Engraving as merely a tool for prying information from people’s minds, he would likely be so enraged he’d drag Wang Lan before the founder’s tombstone and shoot him to appease the founding master’s spirit in heaven.
Wang Lan could swear on his character that he genuinely wasn’t trying to argue with Professor Zheng. He was simply, humbly, voicing his confusion. Besides, isn’t a teacher’s job to instruct students and resolve their doubts?
However, to the other students present, his words sounded entirely different. Silently, they gave him a thumbs-up.
That’s our Wang Lan, alright! The lone green shoot in a field of flowers—if not a mutant bloom, then definitely a thorn among them!
"Very good!" Professor Zheng praised him emphatically. CLICK. The Folding Space equipment on his wrist emitted a dazzling glow.
If Professor Zheng hadn’t revealed it, who would have guessed that the ordinary-looking watch on his wrist was actually a piece of Folding Space equipment worth tens of millions?
THUD—
With a soft sound, a device resembling a smart guide robot, like one you might find at a mall elevator, appeared in the classroom.
"This is brainwave connection detection equipment, which allows one to visually observe the state of brainwave connections. The possibility you just mentioned... come, let’s connect our brainwaves and see who’s right, you or me?"
"Professor, that’s not what I meant..."
"Aren’t you doubtful? Once brainwave synchronization is complete, it’s not easy to break free. So, since you doubt what I said, let’s test it. After all, practice is the sole criterion for testing truth."
Since Professor Zheng Gong had put it that way, Wang Lan let go of his worries and, imitating Professor Zheng’s actions, placed his hand on another crystal globe on the device.
"Transmit your spiritual power into the device, just as if you were conducting a spiritual probe. This shouldn’t be difficult for you. Are you ready?"
"Ready!"
"Begin!"
Instantly, both individuals radiated a silver-white light, as if enveloped in a saintly aura. Wang Lan’s ability to apply theory to practice had already surprised many of his classmates.
Apart from those born with strong spiritual power and a talent for Illusion Techniques, or those from families with a long tradition of Spiritual Engraving who had learned it early, it was nearly impossible for students starting from scratch to reach this level.
Wang Lan’s performance was both surprising and easily accepted. They simply assumed Wang Lan was a scion of some Star Martial Warrior family who had learned similar abilities long ago.
"Spiritual power connection initiating... connectivity: one hundred percent—"
The instrument’s prompt sounded, and all the students were simultaneously stunned.
Is this instrument... malfunctioning?
It wasn’t as if they’d never connected before. Wasn’t the usual process for spiritual connection something like... ten percent, then fifty percent, then eighty percent? A slow connection might progress in five percent increments. So what was the deal with jumping straight to one hundred percent?
Although the students were puzzled, Professor Zheng’s expression changed.
Because the instant he sent out the spiritual connection signal, Wang Lan’s spiritual power had coiled around it like an octopus.
Furthermore, it had actively established a one hundred percent connection in a mere instant? What kind of spiritual control is this? This kid, Wang Lan... just how high is his talent for Spirit Engraving?
As Professor Zheng pondered the extent of Wang Lan’s Spirit Engraving talent, Wang Lan’s voice echoed in his mind.
"Professor Zheng, actually... my talent for Spiritual Engraving isn’t that high. You overestimate me by calling me the hope for saving Spiritual Engraving..."
The appearance of this voice startled Professor Zheng even more.
He can read my thoughts, and I didn’t even notice? Impossible...
"Professor, what’s the next step?"
"I’m going to try and break our spiritual connection. Let’s see how you stop me!" Professor Zheng steadied himself and immediately manipulated his spiritual power to disrupt the brainwave frequency.
But as soon as he tried, his spiritual power felt like stagnant water, completely unresponsive. The spiritual connection indicator still read one hundred percent.
At this point, Wang Lan finally made a move. He stretched out his hand and gave a lazy yawn. Beside him, Professor Zheng mirrored his exact movements, even the wide yawn was perfectly synchronized.
This scene made the entire class stand up in astonishment.
"Oh my God, seriously? Wang Lan is controlling Professor Zheng?"
"As expected of the man I’ve chosen! He’s almost too outstanding!"
"Ahem... ladies, please be a bit more reserved. Wang Lan has a girlfriend."
"Really? Who is she?"
"Jiang Xinyu from the Mage faculty! I heard it from He Jing, his roommate."
"That woman... she’s pretty intense. Best not to provoke her."
"Wang Lan, sing us a song?"
"Wang Lan, dance a little, do a spin!" Of the forty-eight students in the class, forty were girls. Such a lively scene instantly brought out their true natures.
Besides, is there really a distinction between genders in the world of Star Martial Warriors? Let me tell you, in their world, women can be more ’manly’ than men, even more roguish.
"My dear classmate, please don’t insult me. This young master may offer his company, but not his performances!"
Such words were normal coming from Wang Lan, but from Professor Zheng, they threatened his long-standing reputation. Wang Lan hurriedly disconnected the spiritual connection with Professor Zheng. Regaining control, Professor Zheng stared at Wang Lan, his face a mask of astonishment.
No one else could comprehend the despair Professor Zheng had experienced under Wang Lan’s spiritual control. It was as if his body wasn’t his own, like a mere puppet.
Wang Lan had used the spiritual connection to achieve an effect akin to puppetry—something Professor Zheng couldn’t even have conceived. However, this didn’t mean Wang Lan’s Spirit Engraving abilities surpassed Professor Zheng’s; at least, Professor Zheng didn’t believe so.
But it did prove one thing: in lower-level applications, Wang Lan’s mastery already exceeded Professor Zheng’s.
This talent...
Professor Zheng was astounded all over again.
What was that Wang Lan said earlier? That his Spirit Engraving talent wasn’t very good? Humble. He was being far too humble!
"Quiet. Alright, the atmosphere has been lively enough. Let’s continue with the class. Wang Lan, go back to your seat. Although you have mastered spiritual connection, you still need to listen carefully. Some things, even if you know how to do them, you might not know how to articulate them theoretically."
Wang Lan returned to his seat, and the class resumed. Meanwhile, in the reception room of the Academic Affairs Office, a young assistant served Dr. Wang Qi a cup of fragrant coffee.
Previously, even with her status as a top biologist, Wang Qi couldn’t have visited Modu City Star Martial Academy so unceremoniously. But now, Wang Qi was no longer the Wang Qi of the past.
She was no longer just a top scientist in biogenetics; she was now revered as a one-of-a-kind, almost godlike figure in science. Furthermore, she was a distinguished recipient of the United Nations Award for Human Scientific Progress.
Even Modu City Star Martial Academy was bound to treat her as a most honored guest.
Opposite Wang Qi sat an energetic elderly man. "Dr. Wang Qi, I am the Vice Dean of Modu City Star Martial Academy. May I ask the purpose of your sudden visit?"
"I’d like to inquire if your academy has a teacher named Sun Li?"
"Director Sun? She’s the head of our Medical Department. Is there an issue with her?"
"Over the past few days, my company has received dozens of faxes from Mrs. Sun Li, requesting us to prototype samples for her. Each sample is a vaccine for a specific Star Martial Toxin. I suspect Mrs. Sun Li may have developed a highly efficient method for creating vaccines for Star Martial Toxins, and I’ve come to learn from her."
"What? Such a thing happened?" The Vice Dean before her abruptly lost his composure and shot to his feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Unprecedented Feat
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 269: Unprecedented Feat
The method for creating an antidote to Star Martial Toxins has always been to develop a counteracting Star Martial Toxin to treat the symptoms accordingly.
Where does this idea of a vaccine come from?
But the Vice-Dean also knew that Wang Qi couldn’t possibly have traveled two hundred kilometers to Modu City to deceive him amidst her busy schedule.
After digesting the shock in his heart, ecstasy instantly surged through the Vice-Dean.
What did the advent of the Star Martial Vaccine signify? It represented a groundbreaking change.
The crises facing humanity, aside from the unforeseeable large-scale invasions by the Demon Clan, were the endless hordes of Exotic Beasts that seemed impossible to eradicate.
Exotic Beasts are cunning and their abilities varied. And among the many types of Exotic Beasts, which were the most troublesome? Undoubtedly, the Poisonous Beasts. This was because, as of now, there was no effective method to counter them.
Over eighty types of Star Martial Toxin Vaccines developed in just a few days—the Vice-Dean instantly grasped what this meant.
With this shortcoming addressed, the threat of Exotic Beasts to humanity was reduced once again.
And it was the Star Martial Academy in Modu City that developed the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine?
Thinking about this, the Vice-Dean felt like laughing.
Of the four major Star Martial Academies, the one in Modu City was established the latest.
But being last doesn’t mean one has to play the little brother, right? The Star Martial Academy in Modu City has strength, and it also has Eld Di, the Pillars of Heaven, as its dean.
Descendants of the Qing Emperor and sons of the Flame Emperor are at the Star Martial Academy in Modu City; it should at least be considered the foremost of the Jade Country academies. And the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine was indeed developed by the Star Martial Academy in Modu City. At the next high-level meeting of the Ministry of Education, he, Nangong Meng, will have something to say!
"Ms. Wang Qi, please wait a moment. I’ll make a call to inquire," the Vice-Dean said hurriedly as he took out his phone and dialed. After a long while, frowning, he hung up and dialed again.
"Go and see what Director Sun Li is doing. Find her and tell her to call me immediately."
"Dean Nangong, may I visit your medical department?"
"Of course, I’ll take you there."
The medical department occupied a three-story building; though not tall, it covered a large area. Even though Sun Li was in seclusion, the medical department was still operational. Apart from students who came for experiments and learning, the department itself had many elite professionals recruited from outside.
They were not students of the Star Martial Academy in Modu City, but they were employees of the Academy.
"The third floor houses the research institute for Star Martial Toxins. Our academy has made significant investments in the study of Star Martial Toxins. This research institute was established thirteen years ago, with total investments amounting to approximately eight billion.
The study of Star Martial Toxins has always been our key research area, and Director Sun Li is among the top Medical Star Martial Warriors in the country. Unfortunately, any wound, pain, illness, or disability can be treated with Medical Star Martial Techniques, except for Star Martial Toxins... which are very difficult.
The lethality range of Star Martial Toxins is too vast, covering hundreds of kilometers. A single exposure could affect thousands, even tens of thousands. Medical Star Martial Warriors can’t keep up with treating everyone. Therefore, the only solution is to study Star Martial Toxins to create an antidote."
Suddenly, Wang Qi stopped in her tracks during the visit.
All along the way, nothing had seemed different from other research institutes. But the moment she stopped outside this classroom, Wang Qi saw what she had been looking for.
On the classroom’s blackboard was written a complex Star Martial Toxin Vaccine coding sequence. Only Wang Qi could instantly discern its coding pattern.
"May I go in?"
"Of course!"
Wang Qi entered the classroom and looked up at the code on the blackboard, an increasing sense of familiarity washing over her. She slightly furrowed her brow—it wasn’t the familiarity with the code that struck her, but with the handwriting.
"Hello Ms. Wang Qi, Vice-Dean!" Sun Li’s voice sounded as she walked tiredly into the office.
"Director Sun, why is your phone turned off? I recall requiring you to keep your phones on 24 hours a day."
"I was in seclusion!" Sun Li said nonchalantly. "I was writing a paper. I only had seven days, and it was very rushed."
"A paper?" The Vice-Dean instantly connected it to the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine matter and didn’t press further, simply nodding in silence.
"Did Ms. Wang Qi come to... look for me?"
Now that Wang Qi was a household name as a great scientist, Sun Li recognized her immediately. Looking at Wang Qi, who seemed like a young girl, a trace of envy flashed in Sun Li’s eyes.
She’s nearly forty years old, yet she still looks like she’s in her twenties.
"Director Sun, sending me over eighty vaccine samples all at once really gave me a shock. With so many samples, of course, I had to come and confirm in person."
"I apologize, that was inconsiderate of me."
Sun Li had indeed oversimplified things. If one sample was easy to make, wouldn’t over eighty be just as simple?
But making one sample was a trivial task; making over eighty different samples was a massive undertaking.
"The first time I received the vaccine code, I felt a sense of familiarity. After some scrutiny, I realized that the vaccine was created using the gene coding formula. I’m right, aren’t I?"
Sun Li watched Wang Qi, her eyes flickering. "Ms. Wang Qi, you’re not considering charging a royalty fee, or not allowing us to use it, are you?"
"I’ve already published the formula, so I certainly have no such intention. It’s just strange. In my estimates, the second person to master the formula and apply it practically would take at least three years. It hasn’t even been three months. But now I’m relieved... it was Wang Lan, wasn’t it?"
Sun Li’s face broke into a smile. "Indeed, I couldn’t hide it from you, Ms. Wang. The gene coding formula is so difficult to learn. Wang Lan taught me for ten whole days before I could barely use it, and I still make mistakes often. To be able to come up with such a formula, you... I really don’t know how to describe you."
"The formula wasn’t my idea. It was written by my late husband ten years ago, and it took me ten years to finally understand it. That you could learn to use it in just ten days is quite an accomplishment."
"How long did Wang Lan study it for? You don’t know how arrogant he is. Even though he’s my student, he’d lecture me until I was speechless."
"Wang Lan..." A gentle smile touched Wang Qi’s lips. Under Sun Li’s gaze, Wang Qi shook her head slightly.
"Wang Lan has never caused me any worry when it comes to studying, and I’ve never taught him. He only learned of the formula at the beginning of this year. I always thought he was too busy with the provincial martial arts competition to be interested in such things. To think..."
Alright, I shouldn’t have asked,
Sun Li thought.
Wang Lan was like a landslide in a group of geniuses. No matter what kind of genius you were before, once this landslide came tumbling down, everyone else looked like an idiot.
"Mrs. Sun, is the paper you’re talking about the one related to the successful research of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine?"
"Yes."
"Is Wang Lan’s name listed as an author?"
"Yes! His name is the first author. In fact, his name could be the only one on the paper. After all, the method for developing the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine was truly his own research; I just learned from him."
"Without Mrs. Sun’s name, the paper might not receive the attention it deserves. After all, claiming a freshman solved a problem that has perplexed people for hundreds of years? That would be hard to believe."
"Then thank you, Dr. Wang, for understanding."
"I’ve decided to set up a separate production line dedicated to the prototyping and production of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine. If your academy is interested, we could form a joint venture."
"Really?" Upon hearing this, the Vice-Dean’s eyes immediately lit up.
The financial benefits of a joint venture company producing the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine would be huge; even a fool would know that. And in the world, only Wang Qi’s Jiayi Biotech had the capability to manufacture Gene Potions.
Wang Qi had absolutely no need to form a joint venture with the Star Martial Academy in Modu City. Even if the vaccine research was done by the Star Martial Academy in Modu City, Wang Qi could completely ignore them. Consequently, Wang Qi’s proposal was practically like gifting money to the Star Martial Academy in Modu City.
"Of course! That’s the main reason for my visit this time."
"Great, we can discuss the details further."
"Um... I still need to write my paper. Dr. Wang, Vice-Dean, if there’s nothing else, I’ll take my leave now."
After Sun Li left, Wang Qi was taken to the dean’s office by the Vice-Dean.
"Professor, it’s been a while. How are you feeling? Still robust?" Wang Qi asked Eld Di kindly, her attitude completely different from when she met Ma Bo.
"Hahaha... good, good! I’m no less fit than you young people. Dean Nangong tells me you’re planning to form a joint venture with the Star Martial Academy for the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine? I wouldn’t have known that the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine had already been developed if Nangong hadn’t told me. Great... This vaccine is crucial for the future of humanity. I absolutely support it with all my might!"
Wang Lan only found out about his aunt’s visit to the academy in the afternoon when he received a call from her. Wang Lan was very happy to invite Wang Qi for dinner at the Star Martial Academy’s grand restaurant... which was just the academy’s cafeteria.
Having not seen his aunt in two months, Wang Lan was very excited. As for when Wang Lan had mastered the gene coding formula, Wang Qi didn’t ask at all.
Wang Qi had never doubted Wang Lan’s learning ability. Or rather, she was already used to Wang Lan’s demonic level of talent.
His aunt didn’t stay in Modu City overnight. After dinner, Wang Qi hurried back to Suzhou City. Her visit was just a minor episode in Wang Lan’s college life.
「Four days later.」
Sun Li successfully came out of her seclusion and handed the paper to Wang Lan for review and revision. After all, when it came to editing Star Martial Toxin Vaccines, Wang Lan was the real expert. The only things Wang Lan lacked were experience and proper formatting in writing academic papers.
After three days of revisions, the final version was agreed upon by both. The paper mentioned two important steps. The first was breaking down the Star Martial Toxins and then editing the corresponding counteracting toxins; this prerequisite work belonged to the Star Martial Academy in Modu City.
The subsequent step of editing the counteracting toxins into a vaccine using the gene coding formula was Wang Lan’s contribution. From a contribution perspective, Wang Lan and the Star Martial Academy in Modu City each contributed half.
The publication of the paper was naturally left entirely to Sun Li to handle, while Wang Lan returned to his days of tackling Star Martial Toxins in the medical department whenever he had free time. Despite the busy schedule, Wang Lan was enjoying himself.
Every day, three to five vaccines were developed, earning him twenty to thirty thousand experience points and over a thousand skill points.
Sweet! Truly sweet!
"Xinyu, today is my birthday!" Lan Qi said on Saturday noon, lying on her bed while playing with her phone.
"Oh, happy birthday..." Jiang Xinyu replied, her eyes closed as she practiced controlling her Star Power.
"I’m taking you out for dinner tonight. Consider it... celebrating my birthday with me?"
Jiang Xinyu opened her eyes, looking at Lan Qi with puzzlement. Even though they were roommates, Jiang Xinyu and Lan Qi hadn’t become close friends. At least, their interactions were limited to the time after they returned to the dormitory from their studies.
Besides, the two didn’t have many common topics of conversation, so Lan Qi’s invitation left Jiang Xinyu somewhat perplexed. However, she nodded after only a moment. "Sure!"

chapters.title: Chapter 270: If Someone Wants to Die, You Can’t Stop Them
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 270: If Someone Wants to Die, You Can’t Stop Them
"Going to buy a gift?" In the medical department’s testing lab, Wang Lan answered Jiang Xinyu’s call. "Why?"
"It’s Lan Qi’s birthday today, and he’s treating me to dinner tonight, so I want to buy a birthday gift. Are you free? If not, it’s okay; I can go alone."
"That... I..."
"Wang Lan, I’m giving you half a day off this afternoon," Sun Li said, looking up from the complex formulas. She had completely forgotten that it was Saturday, which was already a day off. Wang Lan had been dragged here to do grunt work.
"Oh, okay, Xinyu. I’m free. When shall we meet?"
"How about now? We can grab a bite to eat while we’re out."
It had been almost a month since Wang Lan last had a meal with Jiang Xinyu. Maybe absence does make the heart grow fonder, because this time when he saw Jiang Xinyu, Wang Lan actually found her stunningly beautiful.
Even though it was the end of October, Jiang Xinyu’s sleeveless white chiffon dress, paired with her straight long hair and exquisite facial features, made it impossible for Wang Lan to find a single flaw, no matter how carefully he looked.
Noticing Wang Lan’s continuous glances at her face, Jiang Xinyu pretended not to notice, but inwardly she was secretly pleased.
Has this blockhead finally wised up? The whole world knows I’m as beautiful as a flower. Since the start of the school year, the boys queuing up to hit on me could stretch from the dormitory to the school gate. And you, you oaf, have always treated me like a brother since we were kids?
Although this was a classic pitfall of being childhood friends, Jiang Xinyu was still unhappy about it.
Now, at last, she saw a look in Wang Lan’s eyes that wasn’t the usual buddy-buddy, shoulder-slapping, chest-pounding kind of gaze.
"By the way, is it just you and Lan Qi tonight?"
"Yeah, that’s what he said."
"Isn’t Yu Ruoyun in your dorm too?"
"Yu Ruoyun has duty at the student council today. Besides, Lan Qi wouldn’t dare invite her."
"Wouldn’t dare? Why not?"
"Have you forgotten Yu Ruoyun’s identity? She is the legitimate princess of the Big Jade Imperial Clan’s Yu Family, the great-granddaughter of Elder Di, and the biological niece of the Eastern Azure Emperor. How could Lan Qi possibly dare?"
"What’s the big deal? I find Yu Ruoyun quite approachable. She doesn’t act like a spoiled princess," Wang Lan said as the food arrived, and they chatted while eating.
"That’s just your impression. Even if Yu Ruoyun really is approachable, her status still puts pressure on others. Besides, you probably wouldn’t feel it. Your own status... isn’t too shabby either."
"Don’t talk nonsense. I’m just an ordinary person, alright?"
"While it’s true that Yu Ruoyun doesn’t show any arrogance, how should I put it... Maybe it’s because of her upbringing. Every gesture and movement of hers exudes an aristocratic aura. To be honest, I don’t even dare to speak loudly in front of her."
"You never liked speaking loudly in the first place!"
"Right, it seems Yu Ruoyun has just broken through to the late stage of the Galaxy Stage. She’s only a sophomore. By the time she’s a senior, breaking into the Star Sea Stage won’t be a problem. To graduate from school as a peak powerhouse... her talent is just despair-inducing."
"That’s not the kind of thing I’d expect from the Jiang Xinyu who has always refused to bow to heaven or earth."
"That’s because before, I was a frog in a well. In Suzhou City, that little place, I thought all the geniuses in the world were just so-so. But after arriving at Modu City’s Star Martial Academy, I’ve seen a completely different picture. In school, there are many who were once on top. Any random person has strength not beneath mine. How could I still be arrogant? By the way, what have you been busy with lately?"
"The medical department, developing the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine."
"Star Martial Toxin Vaccine? That exists now?"
"It didn’t before. But since I arrived, it does."
Caught off-guard by Wang Lan’s successful showboating, Jiang Xinyu rolled her eyes.
After the meal, they spent the afternoon shopping at Phoenix Plaza. For a classmate’s birthday gift, Jiang Xinyu didn’t buy anything too expensive, just a handbag for ten thousand yuan.
By three in the afternoon, the two returned to the academy. After parting with Jiang Xinyu, Wang Lan went back to the medical department to continue developing his Star Martial Toxin Vaccine. Nothing could stop Wang Lan from earning his experience points and skill points—except for Jiang Xinyu.
「As night fell and the city lights began to glow.」
The night view of Modu City was even more brilliant and colorful than that of Suzhou City, especially in the economic center surrounding the Star Martial Academy.
After dinner, Lan Qi took Jiang Xinyu by the hand to the Emperor Star KTV. Jiang Xinyu was averse to singing with strangers, but today was Lan Qi’s birthday, and she couldn’t refuse him, so Jiang Xinyu agreed.
As for safety concerns, Jiang Xinyu was not worried at all. She was at the mid-stage of Star Cloud, and Lan Qi was at the late Star Cloud stage. Together, they were more than capable of handling any emergencies. Even if they encountered a Star Martial expert, they still had to consider their location. The place was less than seven hundred meters away from the Modu Star Martial Academy, practically at the school’s doorstep.
Many of the people who came here to sing were students from the Modu Star Martial Academy. Everyone is human, and everyone needs some leisure and entertainment, after all.
And unlike other KTVs that might have hostesses, there definitely wasn’t, and couldn’t be, such a thing here. This close to the Modu Star Martial Academy, would you dare harbor any filth? Who would you be trying to poison?
So, Emperor Star KTV was also known as the cleanest KTV in the world.
Lan Qi had reserved a private room, where all the equipment was top-quality studio gear. Perhaps the owner of Emperor Star KTV never really counted on making money from this venture.
Besides recording equipment, there was also a holographic VR game room. In name, it was a KTV, but in reality, it was a high-tech entertainment experience park. There was even a swimming pool and a sauna room at the back. Anything you could think of for leisure and entertainment, this place had it all.
Lan Qi called over a waiter and ordered some drinks. Seeing Jiang Xinyu had just finished a song, he offered her a glass of juice.
"Xinyu, you sing so beautifully. If you were to sign with a company, you’d definitely be more popular than Huan Yu’s Magic Sound."
"You flatter me. Actually, I don’t sing that well. Wang Lan used to tease me about it, saying I have the face of a star but I’m tone-deaf."
"Pfft, that’s total nonsense. If your singing is bad, then what am I? A pig squealing? Hee hee..."
KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK— Someone was knocking at the door of the private room. Lan Qi’s face suddenly changed. He hesitated for a moment before walking to the door and, after a slight pause, opened it.
"Hello, Miss Jiang Xinyu," Duanmu Yi said leisurely, appearing at the door with a glass of red wine in hand. Lan Qi stepped slightly to the side, and Duanmu Yi walked into the private room with steps like those of a dancer.
Seeing Duanmu Yi, Jiang Xinyu’s face darkened. She slowly stood up, then suddenly her expression changed drastically. Her angry gaze fixed on Lan Qi, who was hanging his head, not daring to meet her eyes.
In an instant, Star Power surged around Jiang Xinyu.
"Don’t bother. It’s Star Martial Toxin! This is venom from the Silver Crown Snake found in the southern jungles of White Eagle Country. It’s colorless, odorless, and absolutely undetectable when mixed into a liquid. Moreover, this poison is a strong aphrodisiac. Even a Star Martial Warrior can’t resist its potent effects. And the more you struggle, the faster the toxin takes effect..."
Duanmu Yi sipped his red wine, looking smug.
"Since childhood, I’ve never failed to get what I want. Never! So, you will be no exception." Jiang Xinyu glared furiously at Duanmu Yi, her finger subtly touching her phone on the table, which quietly activated.
Jiang Xinyu’s phone, like Wang Lan’s, contained the Ice Snow program, which automatically activated upon launch. With Ice Snow’s intelligent capability, it could naturally assess Jiang Xinyu’s situation.
In the medical department, Wang Lan, who had just finished formulating a Star Martial Toxin Vaccine, let out a breath of relief. Suddenly, his phone started vibrating violently.
Wang Lan picked up his phone, and his face changed instantly as he leaped to his feet. Under the astonished gaze of his senior classmates, his figure vanished in a flash.
"I just don’t understand. In what way does our Duanmu Family not measure up to your Jiang Group? Whether in terms of heritage, assets, or connections, the Jiang Group can’t compare to us. Wouldn’t it be better if we joined forces? Why force me to resort to such extreme measures?"
"Young Master Duanmu, I... I’ll leave now," Lan Qi said softly, turning to go, only to be stopped by Duanmu Yi grabbing his arm.
"What’s the rush? In a little while, you’ll need to record this for us!"
"I..."
"Now that it’s done, there’s no need to feel uneasy. She won’t forgive you no matter how guilty you feel. Since you’ve chosen to rely on the Duanmu Family, let me tell you one of the Duanmu Family’s special rules now: Never hold back when you strike; never regret after you’ve struck! As the saying goes, a moment of spring night is worth a thousand gold pieces. Miss Jiang Xinyu, I won’t keep you waiting long..."
Suddenly, Jiang Xinyu’s Star Power boiled around her.
Duanmu Yi was startled, halting his steps and retreating half a step. But the attack he expected didn’t come. Instead, a layer of frost spread around Jiang Xinyu, quickly thickening, and in the blink of an eye, she was encased in a miniature ice mountain.
"Ice Armor defense? Heh heh heh... Jiang Xinyu, do you really think a layer of ice armor can protect you for long? We have a whole night to play."
In an instant, Duanmu Yi’s figure flashed before Jiang Xinyu. A burst of bright red flame shot out from his palm, pressing onto her ice sculpture.
SIZZLE—
Water vapor rose, and smoke swirled. Jiang Xinyu’s Star Power continuously surged, reinforcing her Ice Armor’s defense; it was the only Star Martial Skill her sluggish body could muster.
But this meant Jiang Xinyu was locked in a contest of Star Power with Duanmu Yi, an exchange where she might harm the enemy by five hundred but would suffer two thousand in return. Duanmu Yi was already an early-Galaxy Stage expert, his strength far surpassing Jiang Xinyu’s. Her Ice Armor was quickly suppressed; the ice mountain rapidly melted, and the meltwater spread like a stream across the private room floor.
Wang Lan looked at his phone. Following Ice Snow’s positioning, he arrived at Emperor Star KTV. Instantly, murderous intent flashed in his eyes, and his figure shot into the KTV.
"Sorry, classmate, this floor is reserved. Please go to another floor," said a student from the Star Martial Academy, his tone cautionary yet polite as he noticed Wang Lan’s uniform.
"Get lost!"
"You’re quite arrogant, classmate!"
CRACKLE— Electric arcs shot out. The student facing Wang Lan was sent flying by the sudden assault. But soon, more than a dozen upperclassmen appeared in the corridor.
Each of them was at least at the mid to late Star Cloud stage. With his normal strength, Wang Lan might not be able to beat even one of them. Moreover, Jiang Xinyu was still calling for help.
Without hesitation, a Phoenix Tail Flower insignia lit up on Wang Lan’s forehead.
"Phoenix Form, activate—"

chapters.title: Chapter 271: It’s a Waste of Youth Not to Be Passionate
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 271: It’s a Waste of Youth Not to Be Passionate
BOOM— Even in his phoenix form, Wang Lan could easily shatter Wang Mingling at his Galaxy Stage peak, let alone a bunch of scum in the middle and later stages of the Star Cloud Stage, with just one punch.
Fortunately, Wang Lan still retained some reason and did not strike with lethal force. Otherwise, these Star Martial Academy students would have faced more than just broken arms and ribs—they would have been sent straight to the afterlife.
CRACK, CRACK, CRACK— The ice mountain was covered in cracks, falling apart like chipped wall paint. Regardless of how many ice blocks Jiang Xinyu created, she could not keep pace with the rate at which the ice was being stripped away.
Duanmu Yi looked like a sculpting artist, smugly and gracefully chipping away the layers of ice on Jiang Xinyu’s body, as if admiring his own crafted artwork.
"Rest assured, this kind of Star Martial Toxins will not leave any residue in the body after it takes effect. And when it does, you will become very aggressive. Plus, I have a camera here as evidence.
Even if you take it to court, I have enough proof to show that you participated willingly. We’re all adults here, let’s not be too prissy, okay?"
BOOM— With a loud bang, the private room door burst open instantly. A phoenix bathed in flames spread its wings in the doorway. Jiang Xinyu, her heart in her throat, saw the phoenix phantom, and a relieved smile touched the corners of her mouth. The frost on her body instantly shattered and fell away.
With a flicker, Wang Lan appeared beside Jiang Xinyu, steadying her teetering figure.
"What happened?"
"Duanmu Yi instructed Lan Qi to drug me!" Jiang Xinyu gasped, not needing to elaborate; a single sentence was enough.
In a flash, Wang Lan’s rage surged straight to his heart, and his eyes immediately turned blood-red.
"Song of Life!" A ray of white light connected to Jiang Xinyu, like a slender chain. A white light began to flicker on Jiang Xinyu’s body.
"Oh? It’s you again! Although I admire your moth-to-flame bravery for trying to save your girlfriend, I must remind you that I am Duanmu Yi, the direct descendant of the Duanmu Family. Offend me, and you’ll have to consider whether you can withstand the wrath of the Duanmu Family.
You didn’t get into Star Martial Academy so easily, but I can make you pack up and leave in minutes. Moreover, I can guarantee that not a single Star Martial Academy would dare to admit you again. Your life’s progress will stop at..."
BOOM— A fist wreathed in scorching flames savagely smashed into Duanmu Yi’s cheek. His words were instantly cut off. In a panic, Duanmu Yi hurriedly raised his hand to block, but Wang Lan’s punch was too fast.
An angry blow in his phoenix form—even Duanmu Yi, in the middle stage of the Galaxy Stage, was too slow to react. The punch landed on Duanmu Yi’s cheek, and his body immediately flew backward, smashing through the walls of the private room and hurtling into the distance.
Flames roiled violently around Wang Lan, and the surrounding walls instantly burst. In the moment the walls exploded, Wang Lan’s figure had already vanished.
"Wang Lan—" Jiang Xinyu, having recovered, let out a cry of alarm.
Duanmu Yi, hurled backward, his cheek already swollen high, stared in a daze at the blood droplets dancing before his eyes.
He dared to hit me? I was actually hit?
Heh heh heh... someone actually dared to hit me...
In an instant, rage exploded in his chest. His figure paused momentarily, stabilizing in mid-air. Just as he was about to rush back and confront Wang Lan, a ball of flame charged at him at high speed from right before his eyes.
"Very well!" Duanmu Yi’s figure flashed, charging towards Wang Lan.
"Yimu Fall—" Extending his palm, a sharp piece of ebony shot out from it at lightning speed, aiming directly at Wang Lan.
CRACKLE— A sharp thunderclap echoed. Instantly, Wang Lan’s hands gathered a dazzling sphere of electric arcs, which coalesced into a brilliant Thunder Knife, immediately clashing with Duanmu Yi’s ebony.
BOOM— Wood chips flew in all directions!
The hardness of ebony was comparable to steel. Furthermore, Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills possessed the characteristic of absorbing others’ Star Power. While Star Martial Warriors themselves didn’t have this trait, their Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills did.
Therefore, when fighting a Wood Attribute Star Martial Artist, it is best to end the battle quickly. Otherwise, if dragged into the late stages, Wood Attribute powers will grow stronger as the fight progresses.
The ferocious thunder and skillful use of the Flame Sword fused, endowing the Thunder Knife with unimaginable sharpness. The incredibly hard ebony crumbled rapidly under the onslaught of the Thunder Knife.
Once again, Wang Lan surged towards Duanmu Yi. The phoenix wings made of flames flapped behind him as his figure rapidly destroyed the ebony and reached Duanmu Yi.
Impossible... How could you be so strong?
Duanmu Yi could hardly believe it. A new student, enrolled for less than two months, actually possessed Galaxy Stage strength?
How could that be? Do you think you are Yu Ruoyun?
But Wang Lan had already reached Duanmu Yi, his hand holding the Thunder Knife high, as if a lightning bolt were cutting through the night sky.
CRACKLE— Duanmu Yi split into two halves in mid-air, but it was just a wooden decoy. The real Duanmu Yi suddenly and eerily appeared behind Wang Lan.
"Entangle—"
In an instant, Duanmu Yi’s palms turned into black vines, wrapping around Wang Lan as fast as lightning, mummifying him.
"Mad Python Soul Swallow!"
Immediately following that, a vine transformed into a pitch-black python, opening its gaping maw to bite at Wang Lan’s head. In an instant, Wang Lan’s body was engulfed in purple, raging flames.
BOOM— The binding vines shattered instantly, and a phoenix bathed in purple flames spread its wings and soared.
How is this possible!
Duanmu Yi inwardly cried out in shock once again.
If before he merely thought Wang Lan was strong, now he felt utterly unable to defeat him!
He was too powerful. Even the constricting vines capable of devouring Star Power couldn’t restrain Wang Lan. This was something that had never happened in his entire cultivation history.
Duanmu Yi’s vines could absorb Star Power at ten times the rate of other Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills. Anyone entangled by them would almost certainly go limp, their Star Power drained to the last drop. Forget using Star Martial Skills to break free; they couldn’t even muster any physical strength.
Yet, facing Wang Lan, Duanmu Yi felt as though his vaunted Death Entanglement skill was a fake. Had all those previously drained of Star Power by him merely been acting? Otherwise, how could it be so utterly ineffective?
In the moment his thoughts whirled, Duanmu Yi was met with a furious punch from Wang Lan.
With no time for hesitation, Duanmu Yi hurriedly opened his Star Palace, summoning forth the Star Palace Artifact, the Azure Dragon Battle Armor.
The Azure Dragon Battle Armor was a Star Palace Artifact granted to the Duanmu Family, one of the four great dragon-guarding families during the imperial era. It perfectly aligned with the Duanmu Family’s Wood Attribute.
The moment the armor settled onto his body, Wang Lan’s punch arrived at his face.
BOOM— Ripples spread across Duanmu Yi’s armor. The force of this punch sent shockwaves that tore apart the clouds, revealing the dazzling starlight in the night sky.
For the first time, people in Modu City saw the sky’s glorious starlight during the night.
But Wang Lan, in the sky at that moment, felt something was amiss the instant his punch landed. Massive amounts of Star Power were frenziedly rushing towards Duanmu Yi. This was a speed of absorption unmatched by any previous Wood Attribute Star Martial Skill.
"Hahaha... kid, you think you can fight? Your strength has indeed impressed me."
CRACKLE— Instantly, Wang Lan’s fist erupted with brilliant electrical arcs. In that explosive flash, his fist broke free from the Azure Dragon Armor’s suction. Wang Lan quickly retreated!
"Do you know what a Star Martial Family is?" Duanmu Yi sneered. "Star Martial Families possess a foundation beyond your wildest imagination. It’s a gap you could never bridge, no matter how talented or hardworking you are.
"My Azure Dragon Armor can absorb the Star Power from any attack and convert it into my own strength. No matter how you strike, you can’t even harm a single hair on my head! Moreover, you’ve broken the taboo against fighting within the city. You’ll be disciplined by the academy and then sanctioned by the law, while I will face no consequences.
"I have countless ways to destroy you, yet you can’t change a thing. Once you’re dealt with, your woman will still be mine. As for your family and friends, I’ll enjoy toying with them slowly.
"Boy, anger only burns away your reason, reducing you to worthless mud. Are you furious now? Do you wish you could kill me? Hahaha... But you can’t!"
A chill flashed in Wang Lan’s eyes. Instantly, Star Power surged around him, and his Star Palace opened. Staring at the rotating Star Cloud within Wang Lan’s Star Palace, Duanmu Yi looked astonished.
Star Cloud Stage? You’re only at the damned Star Cloud Stage?
How could a mere Star Cloud Stage warrior force someone like him, at the mid-Galaxy Stage, to don the Azure Dragon Battle Armor? No, he couldn’t let this kid turn the tables; it would be too troublesome later.
But the next instant, Duanmu Yi’s expression froze. In a flash, a cyan phoenix emerged from Wang Lan’s Star Palace. A metallic phoenix appeared above Wang Lan, beating its wings.
Instantly, the phoenix shattered, transforming into pieces of armor that automatically adorned Wang Lan’s body. The Phoenix Constellation Bronze Saint Cloth awakened in his phoenix form.
Feeling the unceasing power surging within his body, Wang Lan once again charged toward Duanmu Yi. He threw another punch, wreathed in roaring, scorching flames, aimed at Duanmu Yi’s chest.
"It’s useless, the more you strike, the quicker you’ll die. Feel free to hit me, if you injure me at all, count me..."
Immense power transmitted from the chest armor! Duanmu Yi’s expression changed drastically!
How is this possible? Why can’t it absorb Star Power anymore? No, something’s wrong!
Indeed, the Azure Dragon Battle Armor’s Star Power absorption was suppressed by the Saint Cloth. Wang Lan’s eyes instantly ignited with flames, and the purple fire around him surged even more violently. His hands became a blur, flame-wreathed fists blooming like a peacock displaying its tail feathers.
And this multitude of fists were all gold-level Inch Strength Fists, executed in his phoenix form. Even a single such punch could shatter a tank. With countless punches landing on Duanmu Yi, even the Star Palace Artifact couldn’t withstand the assault.
His figure plummeted rapidly, pounded by Wang Lan from above. But this wasn’t what terrified Duanmu Yi the most. The Azure Dragon Battle Armor he wore began to crack, fragmenting just like the ice armor stripped from Jiang Xinyu.
Once the Azure Dragon Battle Armor fractured to a certain degree, its defensive capabilities naturally reached a critical threshold.
In the next instant, Duanmu Yi had no time to ponder the shattering of the Azure Dragon Battle Armor, an artifact passed down for hundreds of years. The overwhelming power from the punches surged into his internal organs.
Pain, an unimaginable agony, shot through his mind, instantly engulfing Duanmu Yi’s consciousness.
Duanmu Yi’s mouth fell open, and a spurt of fresh blood gushed out.
BOOM— Like a meteor crashing to earth, Duanmu Yi slammed fiercely into the green belt in the middle of the Panlong Overpass. A thunderous noise resounded, and a slight tremor could be felt within a two-kilometer radius.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Waiting to Collect His Corpse
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 272: Waiting to Collect His Corpse
In the median of the Panlong Overpass, a ten-meter-diameter pit smoldered, a patch of scorched earth. Duanmu Yi lay motionless in its center. The only remnants of his Azure Dragon Battle Armor were a few shattered pieces clinging to his body. Covered in blood, Duanmu Yi struggled to rise.
Suddenly, the long shadow of a streetlight fell across Duanmu Yi’s cheek. Wang Lan stood calmly before him, his gaze cold and unyielding.
In that instant, boundless fear flooded Duanmu Yi’s heart. He could have accepted a furious glare from Wang Lan, even a harsh reprimand. But there was nothing. Wang Lan didn’t even deign to speak, merely observing him with those cold eyes—as if gazing upon a corpse.
"You... you can’t kill me! If you do, you’re finished too! You have such a bright future, such a beautiful life ahead. Do you really want to throw it all away with me? Just to satisfy your pride and ruin your entire life?
"I haven’t even had a chance to do anything to Jiang Xinyu; I haven’t touched a single one of her fingers! To throw away your own life like this... it’s not worth it!"
"Thank you for thinking of me at a time like this," Wang Lan said coldly. Suddenly, a light flared in his palm! A sharp crackle sounded as a snow-white Thunder Knife materialized.
"You’ve already beaten me up! Shouldn’t that be enough to vent your anger? You can’t keep this up. If you do, I’ll die, and you’ll be buried with me! Think about your family, think about your friends..."
"Wang Lan, don’t kill him!" Jiang Xinyu appeared by Wang Lan’s side. "It’s not worth sacrificing yourself for scum like him."
Duanmu Yi immediately shot Jiang Xinyu a grateful look, nodding incessantly.
"Just cripple his Star Palace," Jiang Xinyu said, Star Power flaring around her. In an instant, a swirling vortex of wind blades gathered in her palm and shot fiercely towards Duanmu Yi’s chest.
The grateful look in Duanmu Yi’s eyes instantly morphed into terror and rage.
Destroying the Star Palace was the harshest, most cruel punishment for a Star Martial Warrior. Due to their unique nature, even if a Star Martial Warrior’s limbs were broken, they could be healed by Medical Star Martial Skills—multiple times, if necessary. As long as one had the money and connections, they could hire the most powerful medical Star Martial Warriors. But destroying the Star Palace would ruin everything for a Star Martial Warrior. It would revert them to an ordinary person, rendering even Medical Star Martial Skills useless on them. Even if his life was spared, he would be a cripple forever.
You’re not kind-hearted at all; you’re utterly ruthless!
Just as Jiang Xinyu was about to press her hand onto Duanmu Yi’s Star Palace, a sharp attack suddenly shot towards her back. Wang Lan moved in a flash, striking out with his palm towards the danger.
BOOM—!
A figure flickered like a streak of light, instantly parrying Wang Lan’s strike and shattering Jiang Xinyu’s attack.
BOOM—! Jiang Xinyu’s attack slammed into the ground, narrowly missing Duanmu Yi. The terrifying shockwave sent him flying, leaving a deep pit where her palm had aimed.
To deflect Jiang Xinyu’s attack while simultaneously parrying Wang Lan’s own strike demonstrated that the newcomer was undoubtedly the most formidable opponent Wang Lan had ever faced.
Instantly, Wang Lan pulled Jiang Xinyu back, and they both retreated explosively, not stopping until they were ten meters away.
A young man in a white trench coat landed before Duanmu Yi, half-crouching, his cloak billowing behind him like a banner.
Seeing the newcomer’s back, Duanmu Yi’s face lit up with ecstatic joy. "Duanmu Fanghua! Fuck, you finally showed up! Why didn’t you just wait until I was dead, huh? Damn it! Quick, kill him for me! Kill him!" he shrieked, pointing at Wang Lan with a savage expression.
"Shut up! You nearly caused a catastrophe!" Duanmu Fanghua snarled. He then turned to Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu, forcing a smile. "Student Wang Lan, Student Jiang Xinyu. I am Duanmu Yi’s elder brother, Duanmu Fanghua. My younger brother is at fault, and I sincerely apologize. Please, find it in your hearts to forgive us!"
With that, Duanmu Fanghua bowed deeply to them both.
"If apologies actually worked, what would be the point of the Tianjian Bureau?" Wang Lan retorted coldly. "This matter won’t end with a simple apology."
"Wang Lan!" Jiang Xinyu said anxiously, gripping his hand.
"It’s okay. Don’t be afraid," Wang Lan whispered. Hearing his words, Jiang Xinyu’s heart settled. She squeezed his hand tightly, ready to face a mountain of daggers and a sea of fire with him—to fight through it together if need be.
Across from them, Duanmu Fanghua’s face paled. "Student Wang Lan, our Duanmu Family is prepared to offer sufficient compensation..."
"Not interested!" Wang Lan cut him off.
"Fuck, Duanmu Fanghua, what the hell are you blabbering to him for? Attack! He shattered our Azure Dragon Battle Armor! The bastard deserves to die a hundred times over for that alone! What are you so scared of? If anything happens, the Duanmu Family will take care of it!"
SMACK! A resounding slap cracked across Duanmu Yi’s face, leaving him stunned.
"You... you dare hit me?"
"How could the Duanmu Family have produced an imbecile like you? ’The Duanmu Family will take care of it?’ Can the Duanmu Family even handle the fallout from this? Do you have any idea who he is?" Duanmu Fanghua’s voice wasn’t loud, but it carried the fury of an enraged lion, momentarily silencing Duanmu Yi.
Duanmu Fanghua slowly turned to face Wang Lan. "How do you propose we settle this? Name your price."
"Cripple his Star Palace!"
"Wang Lan, where it’s possible to forgive, one should forgive..."
"That’s my only condition! Otherwise..." Wang Lan quietly slipped his hand into his pocket, his finger hovering over an emergency call button. He knew pushing someone too far was dangerous, but he couldn’t swallow this insult. Duanmu Yi had to be crippled today.
Suddenly, Star Power erupted around Duanmu Fanghua. Wang Lan tensed, instantly on alert.
SPURT—!
Blood sprayed as Duanmu Fanghua plunged four fingers deep into his own chest, and blood gushed forth.
This scene horrified Duanmu Yi, who stood behind his brother, his face draining of color. Duanmu Yi was a spoiled brat, but he wasn’t a complete fool. With the Duanmu Family backing him, he usually acted without fear.
But for Duanmu Fanghua to make such a concession, especially after saying the Duanmu Family couldn’t handle the consequences... Perhaps Wang Lan’s identity isn’t as simple as my investigation suggested.
"Wang Lan... is this enough?" Duanmu Fanghua panted, staring at Wang Lan as he forced out each word.
Wang Lan looked indifferently at Duanmu Fanghua, whose chest was now stained crimson with blood, and shook his head.
SQUELCH—!
Again, Duanmu Fanghua’s four fingers pierced his own left breast. Blood spurted out once more.
"Now?"
Wang Lan still shook his head.
Despair flickered across Duanmu Fanghua’s face. He slowly drew his battle saber, tucking it under his arm with a reverse grip.
"Don’t bother," Wang Lan said. "Even if you carve yourself into a human stick today, it’ll be useless. I’ve told you, there’s only one condition: cripple his Star Palace."
"Wang Lan, he’s the young head of the Duanmu Family! If you cripple him, the Duanmu Family won’t let this rest!"
"Do you think I’m scared?" Wang Lan sneered. "I’m very interested to see exactly how the Duanmu Family ’won’t let this rest’!"
"They’re here!"
SWOOSH SWOOSH SWOOSH— Several figures suddenly materialized. Led by Yu Ruoyun, a group from the student council appeared beside Wang Lan and Duanmu Fanghua. Yu Ruoyun’s face turned pale at the sight before her.
"Student Wang Lan, Student Duanmu, please calm yourselves," she urged. "I’m aware of the situation. The deputy dean is on his way. Please, try to restrain yourselves."
While Duanmu Fanghua breathed a sigh of relief, Wang Lan frowned.
"Is this your intention, Princess Yu?"
"No, I’m merely relaying Deputy Dean Nangong’s instructions."
"And your stance?" Wang Lan pressed.
"I can’t intervene, nor am I qualified to. Student council, withdraw!"
"President, the vice-president is still..." one member began.
"Silence! He is now a participant. The student council is not to interfere in this matter!" Yu Ruoyun commanded sharply, stepping quietly to the side.
Yu Ruoyun not intervening was the greatest help she could offer Wang Lan. He shot her a grateful glance before turning back to Duanmu Yi.
"I don’t want to waste any more time. You have one minute. Either cripple his Star Palace, or... I’ll settle this account with the Duanmu Family myself, thoroughly."
"Who is causing trouble here?" a commanding voice boomed. The furious Deputy Dean Nangong emerged from the darkness.
When Nangong Meng first heard that Star Martial Academy students were fighting at the Di Huang KTV and had even demolished part of the premises, his initial reaction was disbelief. His students were exemplary youths, well-rounded in morality, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetics, and work ethic. How could they possibly be brawling in a KTV?
But when he learned the student council had been mobilized, Deputy Dean Nangong finally believed it truly involved his students. Instantly, his anger boiled over. Everyone knew that Deputy Dean Nangong cared most about the academy’s reputation. Anyone who dared tarnish it would not be let off lightly.
Arriving on the scene, Deputy Dean Nangong glanced at Duanmu Fanghua. "What happened to your injuries? Who did this?"
"No one, Professor. I did it to myself," Duanmu Fanghua replied.
"You? Weren’t you just at the academy? Was it that troublemaking younger brother of yours again?" The deputy dean instantly deduced that the source of the trouble was Duanmu Yi, who was cowering behind Duanmu Fanghua, looking as dejected as a sick chicken. This wasn’t the first or second time Duanmu Yi had caused such problems.
"Enough of this commotion! If there are conflicts, the academy will handle them! Everyone, return to the academy!"
Duanmu Fanghua heaved a long sigh of relief and started to lead Duanmu Yi away.
"I’d like to see who dares to leave!" Wang Lan’s low voice suddenly cut in. This caused Deputy Dean Nangong’s face to turn ashen.
"Student Wang Lan, I’ve already said the academy will handle this."
"I’m afraid this matter is beyond the academy’s ability to handle."
"The academy can deal with any student matter! Student Wang Lan, if you continue to be so obstinate, I can take disciplinary action. The academy admitted you, and it can just as easily expel you!"
Wang Lan laughed, his voice laced with sarcasm.
Slowly, he retrieved a badge from his pocket. "The Tianjian Bureau is involved in this matter now! Deputy Dean Nangong, I’m afraid I can’t give you face this time," Wang Lan stated, then pressed the distress call button on it.
At the sight of the Tianjian Bureau badge, Duanmu Fanghua’s expression changed dramatically.
"PFFT! I thought it was something impressive. The Tianjian Bureau? We have our people in the Tianjian Bureau too!" Duanmu Yi, perhaps his brain really had been squeezed by a door, couldn’t stand Wang Lan’s posturing and blurted out the idiotic remark.
"Shut up!" Duanmu Fanghua, enraged, slapped Duanmu Yi to the ground again.
"Wang Lan, you said... if his Star Palace is crippled, this matter will be considered settled?" Duanmu Fanghua’s voice trembled slightly as he asked, his tone dark.
As he spoke, lightning suddenly crackled in his hand, coalescing in his palm.
"Duanmu Fanghua, what do you think you’re doing? You dare touch me?"
"I told you long ago that you’d bring ruin to the Duanmu Family, but the old man just wouldn’t believe it! It’s one thing for you to be stupid, but you can’t drag the entire Duanmu Family down into the abyss with you!"
"Enough with the act," Wang Lan scoffed. "If you truly didn’t want him crippled, you would have crippled his Star Palace yourself long ago. You were just waiting for me to reveal my Tianjian Bureau credentials, weren’t you? You clearly wish he were dead, yet you put on this disgusting charade of protecting him. How revolting."

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Wrist-wrestling with the Duanmu Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 273: Wrist-wrestling with the Duanmu Family
As Wang Lan’s words fell, Duanmu Fanghua’s face showed a slight hint of not being able to maintain her composure, while Duanmu Yi behind her still looked completely dumbfounded.
And when Wang Lan produced his Tianjian Bureau credentials, Deputy Dean Nangong’s complexion instantly turned ashen.
"Wang Lan, do you realize how much damage you’re doing to the academy’s reputation with your actions? The academy’s conflicts should be resolved within the academy; why must..."
"Deputy Dean Nangong makes a good point!" Wang Lan smiled slightly. "As the saying goes... one shouldn’t air one’s dirty laundry in public."
"Glad you understand. Now put away your credentials."
"But this isn’t my dirty laundry!" Wang Lan’s smile suddenly changed. "Duanmu Yi, such a scoundrel, is admitted into Modu Star Martial Academy? Deputy Dean Nangong, I would like to ask the Dean what the enrollment criteria of Modu Star Martial Academy are, to accept such a scoundrel."
"Duanmu Yi wasn’t like this before..."
"I’m afraid that’s hardly the case, is it? Right after Duanmu Yi arrived at Modu Star Martial Academy, the incident with Ma Chuchu occurred, and now two years have passed. Do you think that the Tianjian Bureau has really stopped inquiring? The leads from back then have been wiped clean. The school, as the location of the incident, should have more detailed records, but now they’ve been thoroughly deleted.
Deputy Dean Nangong, has Modu Star Martial Academy perhaps taken the Duanmu name? I could have given the academy some face, but the way you seem desperate to keep the issue quiet, intent on covering it up, is very concerning for the students.
First, it was Ma Chuchu, then Jiang Xinyu. I’m afraid there might be more students harmed by him in the future. This matter won’t be taken lightly; not even Eld Di could cover this up! Unless, of course, you abolish the constitution of Jade Country first!"
"You!"
"They’re here—"
"WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH—"
With a series of sounds cutting through the air, over a dozen figures flashed from all directions, landing around them.
"What’s going on? Is Modu Star Martial Academy also involved?"
The leader was Ming Baiye, Chief of the Tianjian Bureau’s Action Department. Upon seeing Wang Lan, Ming Baiye hurried over. "Wang Lan, what’s happening?"
"Director, this man, Duanmu Yi, intended to kill a fellow student and was caught in the act. Based on his skilled methods, I believe he’s a habitual offender with several lives likely on his hands. And when I was about to arrest him, *this* person attempted to obstruct justice and aid the suspect in escaping. He’s likely an accomplice."
As he said this, Wang Lan slightly turned his face to look at the Deputy Dean.
Wang Lan’s accusation instantly made Deputy Dean Nangong furious. "What do you mean, ’attempting to aid a suspect’s escape’? I was mediating the conflict! Wang Lan, how can the same situation sound like two completely different things when you describe it?"
"Deputy Dean, you were the one who suggested they leave first. I’m not even pursuing that. As for that Duanmu Fanghua, she obstructed me multiple times from arresting the criminal and even scuffled with me. Her actions were very clear."
"Wang Lan, you’re fucking slandering me!" Duanmu Yi roared. "I just wanted to *have* her, when did I ever say I wanted to kill her? You ba—"
"Star Martial Toxins can be lethal. Poisoning a classmate constitutes a motive for murder. If I hadn’t arrived in time, I’m afraid something terrible would have already happened. The Tianjian Bureau will thoroughly investigate the truth of this matter. Director, do we arrest him or not?"
"Arrest them! Take them away!"
"Ming Baiye, I am Duanmu Yi! My dad is Duanmu Qingsuang! Do you dare arrest me?"
"It wouldn’t matter if your dad were the Jade Emperor! Take them away!"
With the Tianjian Bureau’s intervention, the matter escalated from a dispute into a criminal case. Not even the high status of Modu Star Martial Academy could prevent the arrests. Thus, Deputy Dean Nangong could only watch helplessly as the Tianjian Bureau took away his disciple, Duanmu Fanghua, and Duanmu Yi.
The only person present who might have been able to intervene was Yu Ruoyun. So, Deputy Dean Nangong quickly looked to her for help.
But Yu Ruoyun appeared to be staying out of it, shaking her head at the Deputy Dean. "Right," she added, "there’s also Lan Qi, who was taken back to the student council. She was a major participant. The Tianjian Bureau can go to the student council to take her away."
"Understood."
Wang Lan held Jiang Xinyu’s hand as they boarded the approaching military vehicle. Throughout the journey, Jiang Xinyu tightly gripped Wang Lan’s hand. The situation seemed to be growing increasingly complicated.
Originally, Jiang Xinyu’s thoughts had been simple: they had beaten him up together. If they had accidentally killed him, they would have killed him together. They would face any trouble together, and if it came to death, they would die together.
But now, it seemed it was no longer just a simple conflict between them and Duanmu Yi. It had escalated into a struggle involving the Tianjian Bureau, the Star Martial Academy, and the Duanmu Family.
Once things reached this level of complexity, it was beyond what Jiang Xinyu could comprehend. Naturally, a sense of unease settled in her heart.
"It’s okay! Don’t worry!" Wang Lan reassured her.
Truthfully, Wang Lan didn’t know how powerful the Duanmu Family was. It might indeed be immense—perhaps so powerful that a mere stomp of their foot could make all of Modu City tremble, or create ripples throughout the entire Jade Country.
But even so, Wang Lan still dared to confront them directly. He had several reasons why he had to fight.
First, Duanmu Yi had crossed a red line. If he wasn’t thoroughly dealt with this time, Jiang Xinyu would constantly be in danger. Therefore, Duanmu Yi had to be crippled, or he had to die. He had initially thought he could use Duanmu Fanghua to take care of Duanmu Yi.
As long as Duanmu Fanghua made a move, Wang Lan had witnesses to prove his own innocence. He could just say, "It wasn’t me, don’t spread rumors..."
Even if the Duanmu Family knew Wang Lan had coerced Duanmu Fanghua, his own identity wasn’t one to be trifled with. He was the son of the Flame Emperor, the standard-bearer for the younger generation of the Flame Emperor’s lineage.
Although this identity was impressive, it wasn’t what truly gave Wang Lan his confidence. His real backing was his position in the Tianjian Bureau.
The Duanmu Family was large and formidable. But no matter how large or formidable they were, could they truly be more powerful than the entire nation?
Duanmu Yi had boasted, "Don’t try to scare me with the Tianjian Bureau, I have connections there too!" Wang Lan believed him. However, Wang Lan was certain that his own connections within the Tianjian Bureau far outnumbered those of the Duanmu Family.
Who was Wang Lan? Merely the son of the Flame Emperor? That title was superficial.
His actual achievements—those were tangible, forged through his own hard efforts.
So what if Duanmu Yi wagered the entire Duanmu Family?
