Wang Lan was certain that while the Duanmu Family itself might not suffer much, Duanmu Yi was definitely finished. And he, Wang Lan, would absolutely not lose this confrontation.
It was this confidence that allowed Wang Lan to dare to face the Duanmu Family head-on! It was this confidence that made him dare to defy Deputy Dean Nangong. And it was because of this that Duanmu Fanghua had said to Duanmu Yi, "Do you know who he is? Are you trying to drag the entire family down with you? Do you think the Duanmu Family can cover for this?"
Although Duanmu Fanghua’s words seemed directed at Duanmu Yi, Wang Lan knew they were actually meant for him.
The message was clear: "Wang Lan, don’t be afraid. The Duanmu Family can’t handle you. Don’t let their reputation scare you off. Don’t back down. Get rid of this bastard, Duanmu Yi, and once he’s gone, I can take his place."
Heh, despicable family infighting.
It was because he was disgusted by Duanmu Fanghua’s duplicitous, honey-mouthed-dagger-hearted demeanor that Wang Lan couldn’t resist exposing her sinister intentions.
However, Wang Lan was quite willing to fulfill Duanmu Fanghua’s wish.
The car started, and Ming Baiye got in.
"Wang Lan, what exactly happened? Tell me in detail."
Wang Lan himself wasn’t entirely clear on all the details of what had transpired that day, so he turned and glanced at Jiang Xinyu. Her face was a little flushed, but she quickly recounted the full story from beginning to end.
The story was simple: Lan Qi wanted to align herself with the Duanmu Family. To that end, Duanmu Yi had set a condition, luring Jiang Xinyu to a place called the Emperor and secretly administering Star Martial Toxins to her.
If the plan had gone smoothly, he would have filmed a video. Under the effects of the Star Martial Toxins, Jiang Xinyu would have appeared very proactive, thereby providing "evidence" of her consent. Moreover, these particular Star Martial Toxins would vanish without a trace after their effects wore off, making them undetectable by current technology.
The plan had seemed perfect, but Duanmu Yi underestimated Jiang Xinyu. Even under the influence of the Star Martial Toxins, she managed to use her Star Martial Skills defensively to buy time. He also hadn’t expected that her nail art wasn’t merely decorative but could remotely control her phone. Still less could he have imagined that her phone was equipped with an Ice Snow intelligent assistant capable of automatically contacting Wang Lan for help.
His objective wasn’t achieved, and the plan was exposed. Jiang Xinyu had even managed to secure the Star Martial Toxins on the spot. Thus, there was a complete chain of evidence against Duanmu Yi, leaving him no room for denial.
Ming Baiye smiled when he heard that Jiang Xinyu had a complete chain of evidence.
"Good, then there’s no problem," Ming Baiye said. "The Duanmu Family is very powerful and has an immeasurable network of connections in Jade Country. But don’t worry. Jade Country doesn’t operate on connections; it operates according to the law! With sufficient evidence this time, he won’t get off easily."
"Thank you, Director Ming!"
"We’re all on the same team here; no need to be so formal."
「Back at the Tianjian Bureau」
Wang Lan accompanied Jiang Xinyu to file a report according to procedure. He was very familiar with this process.
"BEEP BEEP BEEP—" Ming Baiye’s phone rang. He glanced at the caller ID, and a smile spread across his face.
"Hello, Director Gou? Haha... long time no see! What’s up? This matter? Ah, this is a difficult one... You can’t expect me to neglect my duties, can you? The Tianjian Bureau isn’t like other departments; dereliction of duty here is subject to military law.
"The Duanmu Family, you say? This is tricky; the evidence is irrefutable... Suppress it? How could a lowly department chief like me dare to suppress it? What if the Bureau Chief asks about it tomorrow and I say I don’t know, that it hasn’t been investigated? Would I still have a job then? No way... I’m just a grunt here; I don’t make the decisions. That’s how it is. I’ll treat you to a drink another day... Okay, hanging up."
"Hello? Director Li? Between us, do we really need to use words like ’ask a favor’? Makes us sound like strangers! But, if this is about the Duanmu Family’s affair, then it’s really not something I can handle. I don’t have enough authority... Yes... it’s true, the Duanmu Family is not to be trifled with, but there’s someone involved whom I can afford to offend even less.
"What? You don’t know? Well, if you don’t know, then let’s just leave it at that. I’m not at liberty to say much. All I can tell you is that a Crown Prince is involved. Yes. I’d advise you not to get mixed up in this either. If you’re already involved, you’d best extricate yourself cleanly. These are gods fighting; we lesser beings should just watch the show..."
At the Tianjian Bureau, the phones of various department heads were ringing off the hook. Even Cheng Jianlong, the Director of the Modu City Tianjian Bureau, was no exception.
This night was destined to be one of upheaval.
「Meanwhile, back at the Modu Star Martial Academy」
Yu Ruoyun returned to her dormitory alone. The room, usually shared by three, now held only one occupant.
Yu Ruoyun’s expression shifted rapidly. Finally, she heaved a long sigh, took out her phone, and made a call. "Hello? Notify all our media contacts—news outlets, press agencies—to get into position immediately."

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Three Years Later? Who Still Remembers Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 274: Three Years Later? Who Still Remembers Him
"Bastards! All of them! They usually take so many benefits from us, but at the crucial moment, they shirk responsibility! Bastards!"
Within the ancient, elegant architectural complex of the Duanmu Family estate, Duanmu Qingsuang furiously smashed his cell phone to the ground. The phone shattered, its components scattering like ricocheting bullets in all directions.
"Master, what’s wrong? They refuse to help?"
"Hmph! They’re just scared of trouble! Saying the opponent has a powerful backer, someone they can’t handle. Even if one person can’t handle it, if everyone worked together, they could suppress them. Bastards, they’re all a bunch of bastards."
"A powerful backer? How powerful can they be? In Jade Country, aside from the Yu Family, who has more influence than us? Could it be that Yi’er has offended the Yu Family?"
"No!" Duanmu Qingsuang shook his head and sighed deeply. "He has offended the son of the Flame Emperor!"
"The son of the Flame Emperor? But the Flame Emperor never married; how could she have a son?"
"He’s not the Flame Emperor’s biological son. He’s a child the Flame Emperor adopted sixteen years ago. It’s just that the Flame Emperor hid this child too well; for over a decade, no one knew. Otherwise, considering the power wielded by the Five Emperors, how could I not have warned Yi’er to be careful? Yi’er, too, never learns; he actually drugged his girlfriend. If *he* (Wang Lan) were to let this slide, I fear the Flame Emperor Bloodline itself might abandon *him*."
"Adopted by the Flame Emperor? What’s there to fear about an adopted child?"
"Although he’s adopted, he’s no different from her own. That Wang Lan was raised personally by the Flame Emperor. After the Flame Emperor went on missions, her sister looked after him. The Flame Emperor has never married. For a woman as powerful as her, this is both a great fortune and a misfortune. Tell me, who in this world could be worthy of the Flame Emperor? The other four Emperors are all more than ten years her senior. It’s highly unlikely the Flame Emperor will marry in this lifetime, so Wang Lan is effectively her only son."
"Even if the opponent has a powerful backer, our Duanmu Family shouldn’t have to fear them."
"The current problem is that Yi’er’s actions have left him completely vulnerable. If there were no evidence, we could still pull strings to our advantage. But with irrefutable proof, it will be very difficult for Yi’er to escape."
"That Jiang Xinyu wasn’t harmed, right? Wasn’t it just an attempt? Can’t we just go apologize, show some humility, and offer double compensation? Even if they’re relentless, surely they wouldn’t kill Yi’er?"
"They won’t kill Yi’er, but the heaviest punishment is to strip a Star Martial Warrior of their status for life. You know what that means."
"Lose his Star Palace?"
"Correct. If Yi’er’s Star Palace is taken away, he can’t become the head of the Duanmu Family. So, right now, the second and third branches are probably secretly rejoicing. No matter what, we must get Yi’er out."
"What if... we beg Eld Di?"
"What are you thinking? Eld Di is detached from worldly affairs; he wouldn’t concern himself with this. Besides, if Eld Di intervened to help us, how would the Flame Emperor Bloodline view it? Eld Di won’t help us under any circumstances. The best we can hope for is that he doesn’t kick us while we’re down. If Eld Di were to say even one word in support of Wang Lan, the difficulty of saving Yi’er would increase at least tenfold."
"Master... I remember Fanghua was there when it happened, wasn’t he?" Suddenly, Lady Duanmu’s eyes flickered, and an idea came to her.
"Fanghua? You mean..."
"Trade Fanghua for Yi’er. Claim Fanghua did all this, that Fanghua instigated Yi’er. That way, Yi’er would only be an accomplice, not the main perpetrator. We can then maneuver to get Yi’er out on bail. Then, send him abroad to study for five or ten years. Once the dust settles, we can let him return to the country."
"Fanghua..." Duanmu Qingsuang’s expression darkened, a hint of reluctance in his eyes. But seeing his wife’s increasingly grim face, he nodded. "Alright, we’ll do as you say. I’ll speak to Fanghua."
「」
The night was already deep, the stars twinkling faintly above.
Duanmu Fanghua walked out of the Duanmu Family residence, his expression indifferent, his face a mask of calm.
But his bleeding palms betrayed that his inner state was far from the tranquility his face suggested.
"As long as you willingly confess that you orchestrated all of this and incited Yi’er, I will use the Duanmu Family’s power to ensure your safety. After three years, I will bring you back into the family and allow you to establish your own branch as a direct descendant."
"Heh heh heh... HAHAHA—"
Suddenly, Duanmu Fanghua threw his head back and roared with laughter!
"Duanmu Qingsuang, do you take me for a fool? Do you really think I’m that stupid? You’re already planning to trade me for Duanmu Yi. You’ve made me the scapegoat, yet you think I’d believe you’d go all out to protect me?"
"HAHAHA... We’re both your sons! I’m your own flesh and blood too! But in your eyes, I’m worth less than an ordinary Duanmu clansman. No, less than a dog! Because even a dog can carry the Duanmu name, while I don’t even have the right to be called Duanmu!"
"Duanmu Qingsuang, I’m telling you, Duanmu Yi is doomed! I will personally reclaim everything that belongs to me—everything!"
「」
A night passed. For many, it was a difficult one to endure.
But no matter how harrowing the night, dawn always arrives.
"Good morning, viewers. This is the morning news. Last night, a heinous campus crime occurred at the Star Martial Academy in Modu City. Duanmu Yi, a third-year student from Class Two of the Close Combat Department at the Star Martial Academy, attempted to..."
"Hello, everyone, and welcome to ’Today’s Topic.’ Today, we’re talking about one person: the young clan leader of the Duanmu Family, Duanmu Yi..."
"Why did Duanmu Yi dare to act so brazenly? Why did he dare extend his malicious claws toward a fellow student at the Star Martial Academy in Modu City? Everyone knows the caliber of students admitted to this academy. Is there any one of them who isn’t exceptionally brilliant, a genius Star Martial Warrior?"
"Behind this incident, we must begin to reflect: was this an accidental impulse, or an inevitability born of habit? Is this a common occurrence, or an isolated case?"
"From students at the Star Martial Academy, we’ve learned that opinions on Duanmu Yi are polarized. Upon comparison, it was found that those who view Duanmu Yi favorably are all members of an organization called the Student Mutual Aid Association. This organization is vast, encompassing one-fifth of the academy’s student body. Conversely, those not part of this group all hold an unfavorable view of him. This makes me wonder about the nature of this organization: is it truly about mutual aid among classmates, or is it about forming cliques and amassing power like a mafia society?"
「」
Early in the morning, the media erupted. Major news outlets across Jade Country—press, independent media, and new media platforms—all rushed to report the event in unison. Yet, they seemed to have a tacit understanding: Duanmu Yi’s name appeared frequently, but the victim’s name was never mentioned.
All discussions revolved around Duanmu Yi’s actions and the audacity behind them.
This time, Duanmu Yi became infamous, and the Duanmu Family even more so.
"Who is it? Who is pouring fuel on this fire!"
"Old Hu, shut down these media outlets for me, all of them! What? You can’t? Why not?"
Duanmu Qingsuang’s expression was wooden as he put down his newly purchased cell phone. CRACKLE! Amidst flying sparks, the phone was crushed to pieces, its less-than-a-day lifespan coming to an abrupt end.
"Master, what’s going on? Who dares to cause us trouble?"
"The royal family! The Yu Family!"
"The Yu Family? Why? Even though we are no longer official Dragon Protectors, for two hundred years, we’ve always considered ourselves one of the Four Great Dragon Protector Families. Even when the other Dragon Protector clans dispersed, we never abandoned the Yu Family. Why would the Yu Family do this? They say distance tests a horse’s strength, just as time reveals a person’s heart. Our Duanmu Family has loyally followed the Yu Family for six hundred years—six hundred years!"
"You’re asking me? How would I know? But all these news outlets... they’re all being manipulated by the Yu Family from behind the scenes... The Yu Family... The Yu Family... I understand now!"
"You understand what?"
"The Yu Family wants to win over the Flame Emperor Bloodline! For the past few years, the Flame Emperor has claimed to be on a mysterious long-term mission and has rarely appeared. The Flame Emperor Bloodline has been without a clear leader for a long time. But even without the Flame Emperor, the power of the Flame Emperor Bloodline continues to grow. Conversely, the Qing Emperor Bloodline, due to their royal status, has always had their hands tied when acting and are often suppressed by the higher-ups. This is them sending a signal of alliance to the Flame Emperor Bloodline."
"So that means... we’re facing pressure from both the Flame Emperor and Qing Emperor Bloodlines?" Hearing this, Lady Duanmu’s face instantly turned pale with fright.
The Flame Emperor Bloodline alone was already enough to overwhelm them; adding the Qing Emperor Bloodline was simply too much for the Duanmu Family to withstand.
"The only thing we can do now is try to save Yi’er’s Star Palace. Even if he’s found guilty, a sentence of ten years would be acceptable, as long as we can save his Star Palace."
「」
While various factions clashed and maneuvered over this matter, Wang Lan sat as steady as an old dog in the room adjacent to the interrogation chamber at the Tianjian Bureau.
Jiang Xinyu had napped on Wang Lan’s shoulder for a while and was now leaning against him, wrapped in a blanket.
By late October, the temperature difference between day and night was significant. Jiang Xinyu, in a sleeveless long dress, felt quite cold in the evening. Fortunately, Wang Lan was a fire-type Star Martial Warrior, his Star Power naturally generating warmth like a furnace. Indeed, Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu were a perfect match; together, they were the standard for an air conditioner, providing warmth in winter and coolness in summer.
"The commotion outside has mostly died down," Ming Baiye said, pushing the door open. He paused upon seeing Jiang Xinyu sleeping on Wang Lan’s shoulder, but she had already woken up.
Seeing Jiang Xinyu awake, Ming Baiye smiled apologetically. "Sorry for disturbing your rest."
"Not at all!"
"How are things?" Wang Lan asked.
"The Yu Family made a decisive move against the Duanmu Family. The Duanmus have given up trying to suppress the matter. Their main focus now is on preserving Duanmu Yi’s Star Palace. The length of any prison sentence is no longer their primary concern."
"Is there a high probability of abolishing Duanmu Yi’s Star Palace?"
Ming Baiye frowned and shook his head. "The likelihood isn’t high. After all... Jiang Xinyu wasn’t injured, not even a scratch. Under these circumstances, even if Duanmu Yi’s intentions were vile, it was still only an attempt. Abolishing the Star Palace is the most severe punishment for the crimes he has currently committed; it’s typically enforced only when actions incite public fury and cause severe negative repercussions. For this incident itself, he might receive a three-year sentence at most."
"That’ll be fine," Jiang Xinyu said calmly. "In three years, I won’t be the person I am today. In three years, I will undoubtedly be an existence that even the Duanmu Family must take seriously. I will personally settle this score in the future. My potential for growth is limitless."
"No!" Wang Lan disagreed, shaking his head. "A woman can wait ten years for revenge, but we men have poor memories. After three years, we might not remember, nor would we care. Either we finish him off now, or in three years, who will even remember this small fry?"

chapters.title: Chapter 275 Duanmu Yi is Doomed
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 275 Duanmu Yi is Doomed
"What do you want? Don’t mess around!" Ming Baiye’s face changed immediately. "Even if you have the upper hand now, we must act according to the law. The law is the ultimate boundary for everyone!"
"Mr. Ming, what are you thinking? I’m a law-abiding citizen, you know. Duanmu Yi is so practiced in his methods; do you really think this is his first offense?"
"You want to dig something else out of Duanmu Yi? Forget it. We can’t even torture him; it would give him an excuse to apply for medical bail."
"There’s no need for torture. I’ve learned Spiritual Engraving, and I’m quite good at it. I’ll just dig directly from his mind."
"Don’t be reckless! Forcing a Spiritual Engraving on him will turn him into an imbecile. You weren’t responsible for anything before, but if you turn him into an imbecile, you might end up being blamed."
"I’m quite confident in my Spiritual Engraving. Even Professor Zheng from the academy said it’s good. However... I need the help of an Illusion Master." With that, Wang Lan took out his phone and dialed a number.
"Wucheng, are you up?"
"Damn, Wang Lan, you’re incredible! Daring to poke the Duanmu Family’s hornet’s nest? I’m thoroughly impressed. Not only do you dare to mess with the Duanmu Family, but you even managed to strike with the Yu Family’s backing. Tell me, how did you do it?"
"Never mind that for now. I need your help with something."
"What is it?"
"Cast an Illusion Technique on Duanmu Yi for me, so I can successfully invade his mind. Can you do it?"
"Piece of cake! I’ll wait for you at the academy gate. Send someone to pick me up."
"You agreed so readily? It seems you’re not afraid of the Duanmu Family either."
"Heh... The Duanmu Family is formidable, but my Mingyue Family isn’t necessarily afraid of them. Besides, it’s just a favor. The Duanmu Family isn’t likely to take it out on me. With you and the Yu Family taking the heat, what do I have to fear?"
After hanging up, Wang Lan smiled at Ming Baiye and said, "I have a classmate, Mingyue Wucheng, from the Mingyue Family in Suzhou City. Could you please send someone to pick him up at the academy gate and bring him here?"
Ming Baiye gave Wang Lan a profound look and nodded silently. "Okay!"
Although his face showed no other emotion, he was inwardly astonished.
Ming Baiye had originally thought Wang Lan hadn’t begun to build his network yet, especially since his identity had only been public for two months. That was why he had tried to arrange for his son to share a dormitory with Wang Lan, hoping his son could become Wang Lan’s right-hand man.
But he suddenly realized he had overlooked something. True gold doesn’t lose its luster just because it’s hidden in the sand. Even without the status of the Flame Emperor’s son, Wang Lan was still pure, shining gold—just perhaps a smaller nugget.
Since he was shining gold, how could he not be discovered? How could he not attract attention? And how could he not gather a group of exceptional individuals around him?
Jiang Xinyu, Xu Xiangwen, and others like them might have bonded with him due to growing up together, but the Mingyue Family was different. The Mingyue Family of Suzhou City was a top-tier Star Martial Art family in Jade Country, renowned for their Illusion Techniques and their formidable power that awed the world.
Mingyue Wucheng’s friendship with Wang Lan might have stemmed from them being classmates. But was it really just that? Wang Lan had many classmates, and so did Mingyue Wucheng. Why did *they* become friends?
The only explanation Ming Baiye could conceive of was two words: investment!
Wang Lan didn’t have to wait long. In less than an hour, Mingyue Wucheng was brought to the Tianjian Bureau. The Tianjian Bureau was mysterious and powerful; typically, Star Martial Warriors felt a degree of constraint upon entering. Mingyue Wucheng, however, showed none, his posture and expression completely natural.
Inside the interrogation room, Duanmu Yi stared blankly at the two people trying to get a confession from him. "Don’t waste your breath. I won’t say a word until my family’s lawyer arrives."
"Do you think this is a police station? A lawyer? Confess honestly, and you’ll suffer less. We’ve been at this all night; aren’t you tired?"
"I know the Tianjian Bureau’s procedures. Lawyers can’t enter, but family representatives can. I won’t say a word until I see someone from the Duanmu Family."
"So you’re just spouting nonsense then," Wang Lan’s voice interjected as he pushed open the door and walked into the interrogation room, followed by Mingyue Wucheng.
Upon seeing Wang Lan, fear and apprehension flickered in Duanmu Yi’s eyes—a stark contrast to his arrogance the previous night.
The fact that his family hadn’t managed to get him out after an entire night spoke volumes. Moreover, Duanmu Fanghua’s words from the previous night made Duanmu Yi start to reassess Wang Lan.
He was far from the simple individual the initial investigation suggested. Otherwise, how could a commoner with a little money but no significant background dare to challenge the Duanmu Family?
Even his status with the Tianjian Bureau wouldn’t be enough.
"Wucheng, begin!"
Instantly, Mingyue Wucheng fixed his gaze on Duanmu Yi.
THUMP—
A heavy heartbeat resounded, and Duanmu Yi’s eyes instantly glazed over. The Illusion Technique had clearly taken effect.
Ming Baiye’s expression changed as he watched.
Truly an elite disciple of the Mingyue Family,
he marveled inwardly.
He launched the Illusion Technique without any warning, not even a trace of Star Energy Fluctuation! He’s only at the Star Cloud Stage, yet I, a Star Sea Stage practitioner, couldn’t detect a thing.
Impressive. Incredibly impressive!
Wang Lan approached Duanmu Yi and placed his palm on his head. Spiritual power surged, and Wang Lan’s consciousness swiftly invaded Duanmu Yi’s mind.
At that moment, Duanmu Yi was trapped in endless terror. The Illusion Technique Mingyue Wucheng had cast was called ’Death Gaze.’ Those struck by it would be haunted by the vengeful spirits of those they had killed or wronged.
Even if they hadn’t killed anyone, they would be tormented by their past misdeeds and immoral acts, experiencing the agony of their souls being scorched in penance.
This attack occurred on a spiritual level, so the physical body would remain completely unharmed.
While Duanmu Yi was trapped in the illusion, his spiritual power was manipulated by Mingyue Wucheng. This allowed Wang Lan to easily connect with Duanmu Yi’s spiritual power. Once the connection was established, invading his mind became a straightforward matter.
"Duanmu Yi... I won’t let you go even as a ghost... Give me back my life..."
"It wasn’t me... She clearly died by suicide... Don’t look for me... There are so many men in the world... Why did you have to fixate on me?"
"Duanmu Yi, I died so tragically..."
"You... You brought this on yourself... Your sister died by suicide, suicide! What does that have to do with me? You still wanted to appeal? The case was closed, why appeal? Weren’t two million enough for you? Why did you have to keep pestering me..."
"Duanmu Yi, come down with me... be my son-in-law..."
"I was afraid you people would keep pestering me... I just wanted to eliminate the problem for good! Don’t come any closer! I’m not going, I’m not going..."
"Duanmu Yi, and what about me?"
"You... You knew too much about my affairs... So I slept with your girlfriend, so what? She’s just a mundane; anyone can have a go. Why turn against me over her? You knew so many of my secrets. If you didn’t die, how could I sleep soundly?"
One by one, vengeful spirits and fierce ghosts surrounded Duanmu Yi.
Meanwhile, Wang Lan had successfully extracted Duanmu Yi’s memories, holding a Soul Bead in his hand. A pulse of cyan Star Energy Fluctuation occurred, and the memory images transformed into a wisp of smoke, slowly drifting into the Soul Bead.
The Memory Imprint was completed in ten minutes.
"Alright, release the Illusion Technique."
Mingyue Wucheng snapped his fingers softly. Instantly, Duanmu Yi, drenched in sweat, shot up as if waking from a nightmare. However, because his wrists were handcuffed, he stumbled back into the chair.
"What happened... W-what did you do to me?" Duanmu Yi stared in horror at Mingyue Wucheng, who was still wiping sweat from his brow.
He had a bad feeling, a very ominous feeling.
"You couldn’t remember what you’d done, so we helped you recall." Mingyue Wucheng’s smile was as bright and warm as sunshine, but in Duanmu Yi’s eyes, it was as terrifying as a demon’s.
Wang Lan slowly opened his eyes, a smile playing on his lips. "This is the Memory Imprint of Duanmu Yi’s past sins. Hmph, the things he’s done are enough for him to die seven or eight times over."
"You... you... you imprinted my memories? Impossible... How could I not know? It’s fake! It must be fake..."
"Ma Chuchu died because of you. To eliminate any future trouble, you even orchestrated the murder of her younger brother, who was a college freshman, and disguised it as a car accident that killed his entire family.
What’s even more despicable is that over the years, you’ve drugged and secretly filmed your assaults on more than a dozen girls, eight of whom were minors?"
Wang Lan then turned to Ming Baiye and said, "Behind an oil painting in his villa bedroom, there’s a hidden compartment. It contains the videos he’s recorded over these years."
"Understood. I’ll send someone to retrieve them immediately."
"Now that we have conclusive evidence, what’s the next step?"
"Naturally, we’ll convene an internal review meeting."
"Internal review meeting?" Wang Lan asked, puzzled.
"It’s for major cases that cannot be handed over to the courts for judgment, and which the Tianjian Bureau cannot adjudicate independently. Such cases are transferred to the provincial-level Tianjian Bureau. Then, the provincial Tianjian Bureau initiates a process, and the Provincial Standing Committee deliberates and passes judgment.
Conveniently, Modu City is a directly administered municipality, so they can deliberate and issue a judgment directly."
"The Duanmu Family won’t have any opportunity to exploit this, will they?"
"What are you worried about? The City Standing Committee isn’t something the Duanmu Family can sway."
Meanwhile, outside, the news media relentlessly bombarded the public, and the entire incident quickly shot to the top of trending headlines.
The Duanmu Family scrambled to do damage control, but how could their efforts keep pace with the speed at which new fires erupted? They would extinguish one blaze, only for ten more to ignite elsewhere.
Half a day passed. Not only was the Duanmu Family pushed into the eye of the storm, but Modu City itself was also caught in the crosshairs.
"Chief Cheng, this is Cai Xin. What exactly is going on with that incident? Is there still no resolution? I’m still completely in the dark."
"What kind of trouble has the Duanmu Family stirred up this time for so many people to be fanning the flames? There are reactions from the public, the military, official circles, and even from the Pioneer Space?"
"What? It requires a deliberative judgment? Wasn’t the attempt unsuccessful? The young woman wasn’t actually harmed, was she? Can’t this matter be settled privately?"
"Alright, I’ll notify the Standing Committee immediately! We’ll convene for the deliberative judgment today at 1:00 PM!"
This fire burned fiercely! With relentless media bombardment and various influential parties sparing no effort to fuel it, the entire country soon knew about the Duanmu Family in Modu City, and that this family had an arrogant, hedonistic scion who acted with impunity.
Yet, no one seemed to notice that apart from the main figure, Duanmu Yi, no other individuals involved were named. Not even the victims’ names had surfaced.
At 1:00 PM, the deliberative judgment was held in the municipal government office’s conference room. All five members of the Modu City Standing Committee were present.
Once everyone had arrived, Cai Xin cleared his throat. "Chief Cheng, please brief us on the situation."
"Comrades! This incident began when Duanmu Yi administered Star Martial Toxins to a first-year university student, Miss Jiang, intending to control her with the toxins and assault her. However, his plot failed and was exposed, leading to Duanmu Yi’s arrest by the Tianjian Bureau.
Following an investigation by the Tianjian Bureau, it became clear this was not Duanmu Yi’s first offense. He had committed similar crimes on seventeen prior occasions. Many victims, pressured by Duanmu Yi’s family influence and his threats, have been forced to endure this in silence..."

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Duanmu Yi, Dead
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 276: Duanmu Yi, Dead
Cheng Jianlong spoke for half an hour before he finished recounting the crimes committed by Duanmu Yi. After hearing everything, even the seasoned leaders couldn’t help but display expressions of disbelief.
Such a plot? Even movies wouldn’t dare to depict it, right?
To eliminate future troubles, he didn’t hesitate to kill and silence people, destroying whole families? Abusing a friend’s girlfriend, and even killing and disposing of the body to prevent the incident from being exposed?
Is this even human?
"In broad daylight, under a clear sky, to think that such beastly creatures with human faces are still hiding among us?" Cai Xin exclaimed angrily after a long pause.
"For the crimes Duanmu Yi has committed, he deserves to be shot ten times over."
"Director Chen, is the chain of evidence sufficient?"
"The evidence is rock-solid, all imprinted from Duanmu Yi’s mind. Moreover, the related physical evidence has also been collected, including video recordings of Duanmu Yi committing the acts."
"Then what are we waiting for? Death penalty!"
"But the Duanmu Family is no small family. Won’t executing Duanmu Yi potentially cause turmoil in Jade Country?"
"*Zeng, Jade Country is already in turmoil. If we don’t give the people an explanation, where is the dignity of the nation? Where is the dignity of the law?"
"Li* is right. More importantly, we need to deliver justice for those whose deep grievances have yet to be redressed. I agree with Li* and Dong*’s opinions—we should enforce severe penalties and show no mercy."
"The Tianjian Bureau will carry out the execution. Only the result will be announced to the public; the detailed process need not be disclosed. Relevant parties, especially the victims’ families, will be notified privately, but they must be strictly warned against publicizing it widely."
"Okay! I’ll go back and handle it right away."
The Tianjian Bureau had always been known for its swift, accurate, and ruthless way of handling matters. After reaching a conclusion and obtaining the jointly signed document from the discussion group, Cheng Jianlong took the document and returned to the Tianjian Bureau.
Upon opening the door, he saw Wang Lan and Ming Baiye simultaneously turn their gazes towards him.
"The standing committee’s decision is out: execute him. Immediately," Cheng Jianlong said, giving Wang Lan a deep look as he spoke.
It wasn’t out of dread, nor was it a warning, but rather a trace of relief and approval.
The world of Star Martial Warriors had never been one of repaying evil with kindness or convincing others with virtue.
If it were, it would be the kind where ’virtue’ is etched onto swords.
In the world of Star Martial Warriors, decisive killing was the rule. Having all climbed out of mountains of corpses and seas of blood, being soft-hearted was the last thing they could afford.
When one had the upper hand, unless the conflict was brought to a decisive conclusion, one must press the advantage relentlessly. Repaying evil with kindness? With what then would one repay kindness? Even if Wang Lan spared Duanmu Yi, Duanmu Yi wouldn’t be grateful. Therefore, no one would call Wang Lan cold-hearted or cruel for his actions.
On the contrary, he would be praised for his steady disposition and his potential to achieve great things.
"Who will carry out the execution?" Wang Lan suddenly asked.
"What? Do you want to do it yourself?"
"I have experience with executions. Back when I was in Suzhou City, I..."
"Forget it! Doing it yourself might be gratifying for a moment, but it could also bring trouble. We have professionals for executions. You just watch."
"Actually, I don’t mind the trouble."
"But unnecessary trouble should not be courted! Although Duanmu Yi will die, don’t forget there’s still the Duanmu family to consider! On the surface, you won. But did you really win? No, it was those people behind you who provided support and protection."
After hearing Cheng Jianlong’s warning, Wang Lan promptly stood at attention and saluted him. "I understand. Thank you, Director."
"No need to thank me. Remember, you are a hero of the nation. That is why the country protects you in times of trouble. This morning, *Du personally called Mayor Cai to inquire about this matter. If you want to express gratitude, do it by earning more merits for the nation. The nation belongs to everyone, and especially to the younger generation like you. You, Wang Lan, in particular, are someone the nation has great expectations for."
"Understood, sir!"
On the execution ground, five adjudicators clad in white protective suits and wearing Death God Masks stood in the center.
The afternoon sun shone brightly, the temperature soaring past thirty degrees Celsius—a blisteringly hot day. Yet Duanmu Yi felt not warmth but an intense, shivering cold.
If not for the support of two Tianjian Bureau warriors, he wouldn’t even be able to stand steady.
Large beads of cold sweat dripped continuously.
"Where is this place? Where is this? What are you going to do? What are you going to do to me?"
"You’ve come this far and still don’t know what’s going to happen?" a Tianjian Bureau Red Captain sneered.
"Duanmu Yi, you are convicted of rape, murder, child rape, and endangering national security. After deliberation by the Modu City standing committee, it has been decided to sentence Duanmu Yi to death, deprive him of his human rights for life, and carry out the execution immediately!"
"What? You’re going to kill me? Impossible... How could you possibly kill me? I am the young patriarch of the Duanmu Family! My family has rendered meritorious service to the nation! We made immortal contributions during the war of resistance—" Duanmu Yi shrieked, his voice cracking.
"Indeed, the Duanmu Family has made immortal contributions to Jade Country, risking life and limb. But you haven’t. Not only have you failed to contribute to the nation, but you have also dishonored the heroic ancestors of the Duanmu Family. Your death is no loss! Carry out the execution—"
"No, don’t... AAH—"
With a piercing scream, Duanmu Yi’s voice abruptly ceased.
"Punishing a profligate son of heinous crimes: Reward 10,000 experience points, 800 skill points."
The system prompt echoed in his mind.
So Duanmu Yi was only worth 10,000 experience points and 800 skill points. Not even as much as I’d get for developing two doses of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine in an hour.
An instant later, Wang Lan’s brow furrowed. The mission he had accepted due to the Illusion Technique—the one concerning Ma Chuchu—hadn’t registered as complete; it was still marked as ’in progress.’
What’s going on? Could it be... Duanmu Yi wasn’t the mastermind? Impossible! Duanmu Yi’s memories were clear: he had used a similar method to get his hands on Ma Chuchu. The only difference was that Ma Chuchu later resigned herself to her fate and dated Duanmu Yi for over a year. But after the Duanmu Family found out, Duanmu Yi cut off contact with Ma Chuchu. Not long after, Ma Chuchu committed suicide. From the information, it looked like Ma Chuchu was... wait, Ma Chuchu killed herself because Duanmu Yi broke up with her? And Duanmu Yi did it because of the Duanmu Family... No way! Are you telling me I have to take down the entire Duanmu family to avenge you?
I appreciate the high regard, but I must decline!
Toppling one Duanmu Yi was something Wang Lan could manage, relying on his backing and the decisive evidence he’d obtained. But to topple the entire Duanmu family? Wang Lan would probably need to become a national leader for that, right? Better not even think about it for the next ten years.
Duanmu Yi was executed, but the news did not spread. The Duanmu Family was still busy with damage control everywhere. They still harbored a glimmer of hope that as long as public opinion wasn’t too overwhelming, Duanmu Yi would at most be sentenced to ten years. Only if it became a hot topic of national concern would the government be forced by the public outcry to impose a heavier punishment.
In the afternoon, Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu returned to school. After escorting Jiang Xinyu to her dormitory entrance, they bade each other farewell. From this incident, both Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu sensed that their relationship might have undergone some changes.
Both understood what this change was, yet neither of them pointed it out.
Even knowing that if one of them acknowledged it, they would naturally become a couple, they both, by tacit agreement, simply waved goodbye and turned to leave when it was time to part.
Walking along the path, Jiang Xinyu bit her lip.
Blockhead! Does a lady like me really have to be the one to speak up first? Hmph!
Meanwhile, Wang Lan contemplated another issue.
It’s too awkward to bring it up with someone I’m this familiar with. If Xiangwen and Feiyu found out, I’d be laughed at for being a beast! Sigh...
It was likely that Wang Lan was the only one in their five-person group who hadn’t realized Jiang Xinyu had always liked him.
Pushing open the dormitory door, Jiang Xinyu saw a figure with a proud bearing doing toning exercises in front of the mirror. Hearing the door, Yu Ruoyun turned to Jiang Xinyu. "You’re back? Is everything alright?"
"I’m fine!"
"I’m sorry... I was late that day. I shouldn’t have let you go alone..." Yu Ruoyun suddenly said, looking at Jiang Xinyu with a guilty expression. This startled Jiang Xinyu.
"How could this be your fault? It was Lan Qi and Duanmu Yi who schemed against me. Besides, you’ve already helped me a lot."
"I saw early on that Lan Qi was a bit vain, but I never imagined she would harm you. If I hadn’t been on duty that day..."
"I didn’t expect it either. And if you hadn’t been on duty that day, they wouldn’t have made their move. They specifically took advantage of your duty. I really don’t blame you; on the contrary, I’m very grateful. Moreover... I heard from Wang Lan that if you hadn’t been helping us from the shadows, we would have faced even greater resistance. Thank you, truly!"
"Join my student council? Be in my group!"
"Something like that won’t happen again," Jiang Xinyu said with a gentle smile, subtly refusing.
"True! After this, I doubt anyone would dare to have designs on you again. By the way, what ultimately happened to Duanmu Yi?"
"He died," Jiang Xinyu said casually, then went to her room, picked up her clothes, and prepared to take a thorough shower in the bathroom.
But Yu Ruoyun, remaining in the living room, felt her eyes narrow sharply.
It wasn’t that she found it unbelievable, but rather she was shocked at how decisive Wang Lan had been. He either didn’t act, or when he did, he was utterly ruthless. But then she mused that since they had already offended the Duanmu Family, showing mercy or not would have made little difference. An enemy made was an enemy made; no gratitude would be forthcoming.
In contrast to the calm in Jiang Xinyu’s dormitory, Wang Lan’s return to his own was met with a warrior’s triumphant reception.
He Jing, that character, had even bought party poppers. Seeing Wang Lan appear, he readied himself, and the moment Wang Lan pushed open the door, POP! POP! POP! went the poppers, making Wang Lan chuckle despite himself.
"Brother Lan is mighty! Brother Lan is formidable! Taking on the Duanmu Family head-on and emerging unscathed! Brother Lan, you truly are the standard-bearer of our second generation! Who dares say our Flame Emperor lineage lacks worthy successors now?"
"Alright, alright. I haven’t slept for a day and a night; I’m dead tired. Also, today’s Sunday, right? Tomorrow, Monday, there’s a room inspection. Don’t expect me to help you clean up this mess you’ve made."
"Those are minor details. By the way, what price did the Duanmu Family pay to settle things?" Ming Guodong asked, curious.
"What price? Does a life count?"
"Huh? A life? Whose?" Ming Guodong was taken aback, clearly not understanding.
"Who else could it be? I’m going to sleep." With that, Wang Lan entered his room and locked the door.
Their last roommate had rented an apartment and moved out not long after arriving, so Wang Lan had the room to himself.
HISS—
Suddenly, the sound of a sharp intake of breath filled the air.
"Duanmu Yi... is dead?"

chapters.title: Chapter 277: If You Dare Take Revenge, I Can Obliterate the Duanmu Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 277: If You Dare Take Revenge, I Can Obliterate the Duanmu Family
"My Yi’er—" a middle-aged noblewoman collapsed backward upon hearing the news.
"Madam—" the servants hurried to support her.
Lady Duanmu’s face contorted with pain as she opened her mouth wide but couldn’t make a sound of wailing. Her pleading eyes fixed on Duanmu Qingsuang, who sat motionless in a chair like a wooden sculpture.
"Master—"
"A fine man, Wang Lan is, the son of the Flame Emperor... ruthless and vicious indeed... Truly ruthless and vicious! Yi’er merely had the intention; he hadn’t even succeeded, yet you had to be so cruel!"
"Master, our son is dead, murdered! Won’t you avenge him?"
"Of course, we must seek revenge, but we must wait for the right opportunity."
"Master, why not just fight it out with him? Haven’t you always said that our Duanmu family is the number one family besides the royal family? Are we afraid of him? Even if the lineage of the Flame Emperor is powerful, are they not afraid of mutual destruction?"
"I had thought they would be wary of the Duanmu Family, that they would never go as far as taking Yi’er’s life. But, alas!"
"If the Duanmu Family could unite and cooperate, we might be able to fight for justice. But even though I am the head of the family, if I order a counterattack, not many within the Family would be willing to heed my call to fight back."
"Why? We’ve been openly humiliated!"
"Because this time, the Yu Family and the Flame Emperor’s lineage have joined forces to suppress us."
"Then... did Yi’er die in vain?" Lady Duanmu suddenly covered her face with her hands and sobbed in heartbreak.
"Master, someone has arrived outside, claiming to be... the Commander of the Vermilion Bird Squad. But... looking at his rank... he’s a Senior General?"
"The Vermilion Bird Squad?" Duanmu Qingsuang’s complexion changed dramatically, and he rose abruptly from his seat. "You go and bring him to the parlor... No, I’ll go myself."
"Master, the Vermilion Bird Squad is..."
"The direct troops of the Flame Emperor. Although the Flame Emperor stepped down from being the squad commander for many years, the Vermilion Bird Squad remains one of the main combat forces of the Flame Emperor’s lineage. The whole squad is divided into five teams, with just several dozen members, but half of them are elite troops of Titled Strongmen."
Duanmu Qingsuang hurried to the entrance, only to see a middle-aged man in a Senior General’s uniform sitting upright in the hall. Only when he saw Duanmu Qingsuang arrive did he stand up.
"General Zuo, you’re here. Please, let’s go inside."
"Mr. Duanmu, I apologize for the sudden visit and the inconvenience it has caused."
The two entered the inner parlor and sat down facing each other.
"Mr. Duanmu, I am a military man; I prefer to be direct, so I will not beat around the bush. My visit this time is in regards to the conflict between your son and Wang Lan."
"What is there to say? A mere school conflict, yet Wang Lan was so ruthless that he took my son’s life. Such a heavy murderous intent, I fear, is not a good omen for the nation."
"This is not some school conflict. The execution of Duanmu Yi was a unanimous decision by the Modu City Committee." As he spoke, Zuo Ming took out a Soul Bead and pushed it toward Duanmu Qingsuang.
"This Soul Bead contains the deeds of Duanmu Yi, the people he has killed. To be frank, if not for the sake of the Duanmu Family’s face, we would have already made his crimes public for the whole nation to condemn.
"It’s ludicrous that you’re still comparing Duanmu Yi with Wang Lan at this moment. Does Duanmu Yi deserve to be compared with Wang Lan? Wang Lan is someone who has received the Glory of the Sun Medal for his merits.
"If the Duanmu Family still can’t swallow their pride, we can publicize these crimes of Duanmu Yi. When that happens, you probably won’t be able to withstand the onslaught, even without our intervention."
"General Zuo, am I to take what you’ve said as a threat?"
"Don’t! Please don’t be so uncertain; I am indeed here to threaten you. And let me also tell you that if any of Wang Lan’s friends, relatives, or acquaintances suffer inexplicable harm, we won’t need evidence; we’ll directly make Duanmu Yi’s crimes known to all. Additionally..." Zuo Ming stood up, a faint smile on his lips, "The Duanmu Family isn’t exactly clean beneath the surface; destroying the Duanmu Family probably wouldn’t be too difficult."
"You!"
"I won’t bother you further. Farewell!"
Just before leaving, Zuo Ming left behind a meaningful smile. With a flash, he disappeared from sight. Meanwhile, Duanmu Qingsuang, clenching the Soul Bead tightly in his hand, had an incredibly gloomy expression.
He finally understood why the Modu City Committee had approved the death sentence for Duanmu Yi. If it had been just about Jiang Xinyu, it would never have resulted in the death penalty.
What Duanmu Yi had done—how could Duanmu Qingsuang, his father, not know? If not for the family cleaning up after him, he would have been arrested by the Tianjian Bureau long ago.
But... how dare the Tianjian Bureau... how dare they imprint Duanmu Yi’s memories? Duanmu Yi would never have cooperated with the Tianjian Bureau, so the only option was to imprint the memories forcibly. And a forcible memory imprint would surely leave the imprinted person an idiot.
How could the Tianjian Bureau dare to do this? If they had found nothing, how would they explain it to the Duanmu Family? This was why the Duanmu Family had never worried about Duanmu Yi’s memories being probed for evidence of his crimes.
"Damn it!"
The storm within the Duanmu Family quickly subsided. Although it became a topic of conversation at the Star Martial Academy in Modu City for a time, it didn’t last long. Wang Lan’s life continued to be fulfilling: attending classes and using his free time to work on the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine.
With the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine, which allowed for a great harvest of experience points and skill points, Wang Lan even pushed the Nine-layer Pagoda out of his mind.
The Nine-layer Pagoda? Does it offer higher returns than the vaccine? No? Then it can wait.
「Before he knew it, another week had passed.」
Over this week, Wang Lan’s Star Martial level had remained at Star Cloud Three. To break through from Star Cloud Three to Star Cloud Four required a whole four hundred thousand experience points. At least one hundred Star Martial Toxin Vaccines would need to be developed for an upgrade.
His experience points steadily increased, and he reaped a satisfying amount of skill points. Almost all the freshmen’s strengths remained stagnant, while only Wang Lan was skyrocketing at a rapid pace.
「Another weekend arrived.」
But for the students of Star Martial Academy, weekends still meant studying. It wasn’t that the teachers were demanding it, but rather, they had no choice.
There were nine subjects, each one profoundly complicated. If one didn’t dedicate all their time to studying and reviewing, the chances of failing the final exams would increase by fifty percent.
Not everyone was as talented at studying as Wang Lan.
After breakfast, Wang Lan was planning to head to the medical department. Just then, his phone rang.
Wang Lan glanced at it, his expression slightly solemn. "Hello, Mr. Ming?"
"Are you free today? It’s the weekend. Come to the bureau."
"Okay!"
He turned and walked towards the school gate, hailed a taxi, and arrived at the disguised park entrance outside the Tianjian Bureau. The headquarters of the Tianjian Bureau was still located within a large park. To many citizens, it was unknown that the park’s extension housed such a feng shui treasure.
And the entrance to Modu City’s Tianjian Bureau was even more sci-fi than the Tianjian Bureau itself.
Who would have thought that a stone table in a pavilion could actually be an elevator? Anyway, the first time I saw this, I really felt like complaining.
The Tianjian Bureau wasn’t located underground; going underground was just the entrance tunnel. After entering the Tianjian Bureau, Wang Lan went straight to Ming Baiye’s office on the third floor.
"Reporting in!"
"Come in!"
Upon entering the office, Ming Baiye was busily reviewing documents. Seeing Wang Lan, he casually told him to sit.
"I’ve heard from Guodong that you’ve been quite busy lately, always so elusive, like a dragon that only shows its head but never its tail?"
"Well, it’s just my freshman year... The study tasks have been a bit heavy," Wang Lan said with a modest smile.
"That little rascal lied to me, saying that the study tasks were light as a feather and much easier than high school. Seems like he’s itching for a beating..."
Hearing this, Wang Lan’s neck shrank a little.
Guodong, it’s not me throwing you under the bus.
In Ming Baiye’s eyes, Wang Lan was Suzhou City’s academic prodigy, outperforming Ming Guodong by far. If even Wang Lan felt that university study tasks were heavy, how could Ming Guodong dare to say it was easy?
What does that indicate? That he wasn’t studying properly, that’s what! Isn’t this the perfect time for a spanking?
"Mr. Ming, it’s not really like that. I’m taking more subjects than Guodong, and the elective courses I’ve chosen are much more difficult than his. They require a lot of time and research. The general subjects are still quite manageable..."
What a load of crap!
Wang Lan couldn’t help but internally reject his own insincere words.
Those two, Ming Guodong and He Jing, they just skip classes and play games back in the dormitory—with them, even the simplest subjects turn to dregs. They’ve probably resigned themselves to cramming at the last minute.
"Is that so? Wang Lan, you study well and are highly self-disciplined, so please encourage Guodong more. When he was under my and his mother’s supervision, he used to work hard, but without someone watching him, he’s definitely just going to slack off and play."
"Understood! Mr. Ming, you called me here because..." Wang Lan valued his time and didn’t have much to waste on idle chatter.
"Here’s the thing: I have a task for you. Lately, a large number of Soul Beads have appeared on Modu City’s black market, not only severely disrupting the Soul Bead trading market but also causing massive losses to Modu City.
"In the past, when they kept it to a controllable extent, we could turn a blind eye. But this time, they’ve become insatiable.
"The Tianjian Bureau is determined to crack down, but the black market doesn’t have a fixed trading place or a stable network. The Tianjian Bureau doesn’t want to cast a wide net just to catch some small fry. This time, our plan is to decapitate: to take down the mastermind behind the black market Soul Bead trade in one fell swoop."
"Uh... Director Ming, do you want me to take part in the operation?"
This was the first time Wang Lan felt somewhat resistant to a mission. It wasn’t that Wang Lan was getting arrogant; it was just that the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine was too enticing.
"Correct! What do you think?"
"I would lay down my life to serve the country!" Wang Lan immediately stood up, saluted, and declared. "It’s just... how did this black market for Soul Beads come about?"
"Do you think the nationally traded Soul Beads are expensive?" Ming Baiye casually sipped his tea and asked with a smile.
"Not expensive!"
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH—" Ming Baiye almost choked on his water. "Not expensive?"
"A single bead is only eighty thousand, and a hundred beads are only eight million. What can eight million do? In Modu City, it can’t even buy you a house, right?" Wang Lan said earnestly, leaving Ming Baiye momentarily forgetting what he was about to say.
Wang Lan, your standard for valuing things is just too... precise. I’m at a loss for words.
"HAHAHA... Mr. Ming, I’m just kidding... Soul Bead prices aren’t just high; they are exorbitantly high. Never mind ordinary people, even Star Martial Warrior families can’t afford many, right?"
"That’s right."
"Then why set such high prices? This pricing gives me the impression that they don’t really want people to buy them."
"Soul Beads are considered luxury goods. Nowadays, when some couples are dating, boyfriends aren’t gifting perfumes, handbags, or diamond rings anymore; they’re giving Soul Beads. Just last year, a tycoon even customized a necklace with seventeen Soul Beads. That’s all beside the point, but the state set such high prices for Soul Beads indeed because they don’t want you to buy them."

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Investigating the Black Market Trade of Soul Beads
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 278: Investigating the Black Market Trade of Soul Beads
"If they don’t want us to buy, why not just refuse to sell? Why open a Soul Bead Exchange at the Star Martial Hall?"
"It’s simple for Star Martial Warriors who want Soul Beads. Just join the military. The troops get a monthly quota of Soul Beads, especially during missions, where they can obtain a large number. One could also enter the Pioneer Space and join a Pioneer Team. Aside from handing over a fixed quota of Soul Beads each month, the rest can be kept for oneself. The more you work, the more you earn! These two sources are state-supported income streams for Soul Beads. Buying with money? The state’s stance is, if you can afford it, go ahead and buy. After all, a considerable number of Star Martial Warriors come from wealthy families, or they mingle in the cities as celebrities, leading comfortable lives and waving wads of cash. This is unfair to the Star Martial Warriors who contribute to the nation. Why should they be able to enjoy life and also obtain a large number of Soul Beads to enhance their strength? Therefore, Soul Beads are tools to plunder their wealth, forcing them either to pioneer new lands or to enlist in the military. But if we don’t sell, we would only fuel black market trade. Where there’s a market, there will be transactions; this has been true since ancient times. The black market, in fact, has a history even longer than our Soul Bead Exchange. It’s only because Jade Country prohibits private trading of Soul Beads that the black market has become more covert. The trading chain for Soul Beads has also become increasingly difficult to trace."
"During our investigation these past few days, we found a senior student at Modu City’s Star Martial Academy named Chen Xiaoping, who has been secretly collecting Soul Beads from the students there. However, firstly, his actions at Modu City’s Star Martial Academy are very discreet. Secondly, internal trading of Soul Beads among students is permitted because their Soul Beads come from hunting and internships, which are inherently within their own circles. As long as the Soul Beads do not leave this circle, transactions between students are allowed by law. After all, many talented students from poor backgrounds need to sell some Soul Beads to subsidize their living expenses and support their families."
"Are you saying that even if we capture Chen Xiaoping, we can’t convict him?"
"If we can’t prove that the Soul Beads he collected have flowed to the outside, indeed we can’t convict him. Moreover, the Soul Beads he collects are only a small portion, definitely not the source of the large number of Soul Beads we are searching for. However, the Soul Bead black market must be controlled by a mastermind. I believe that through this lead with Chen Xiaoping, you can trace back to find this mastermind."
"Wouldn’t I risk tipping them off if I make contact directly? Mr. Ming, do you have a plan?"
"Chen Xiaoping only deals with regulars, or rather, he only collects Soul Beads from a fixed group of people. This ensures his safety and provides him with a plausible explanation for his actions. One of the regulars in Chen Xiaoping’s network has already been turned into our informant."
"Then wouldn’t it be easier to use that informant to infiltrate?"
"That informant doesn’t have much money, and his abilities aren’t particularly outstanding. He was injured in his sophomore year, which damaged his foundation. The Soul Beads he can provide won’t attract Chen Xiaoping’s attention, much less lead us to the mastermind. I’ve prepared an identity for you. You are a direct descendant of the Lu family, a Star Martial Warrior clan. Although your status is noble, you lack the talent of a Star Martial Warrior. Hence, you are studying at Zhenyu University. All students at Zhenyu University are wealthy second-generations; many are direct descendants of Star Martial Warrior families who haven’t awakened their Talented Skills. And you all like to live it up, so you’re planning to sell some Soul Beads procured from your homes. You just happen to be a friend of my informant, Dong Feifei. Here is a face-changing mask; it’s a Talented Skill from one of our brothers in the bureau. Once worn, it will let you assume another identity. As long as you don’t use any Star Martial Skills, it will be flawless. At the right opportunity, I’ll have the informant arrange a meeting for you. After all, among everyone in the Tianjian Bureau, you’re the only one who resembles a student. And moreover, you look just like a wealthy second-generation."
"Mr. Ming, can we remove the ’resembles’ part?"
"When the time is right, I will inform you. You need to build a good relationship with Chen Xiaoping, obtain more intelligence from him, and ideally extract some leads on the mastermind to help our brothers follow the trail."
"Understood! But how many Soul Beads are you preparing for me?"
"Start with twenty to test the waters."
"Only twenty?"
"What, is twenty not enough? Even on the black market, a Soul Bead is worth forty to fifty thousand; twenty of them amount to at least eight hundred thousand."
"Let’s start with two hundred. You can’t catch the wolf without baiting the trap. A mere twenty doesn’t exactly scream ’wealthy second-generation’."
Ming Baiye stared at Wang Lan in shock. "Are you unaware of how costly things are? Two hundred beads are worth eight million! For a trial run? Do you think the Tianjian Bureau has a gold mine?"
"You just said it yourself, the price of Soul Beads is inflated; that’s not their true value. Two hundred beads might command a high price in the Soul Bead Exchange, but for us, they might not even be worth a few tens of thousands. Slaying an Exotic Beast is just a flick of the wrist for us."
"But still... that’s two hundred Soul Beads!"
"Mr. Ming, please, don’t be such a miser. In addition to two hundred Soul Beads, throw in ten mid-grade Soul Beads."
"What?" Ming Baiye leaped to his feet.
"Calm down, calm down, ten mid-grade Soul Beads isn’t that many!"
"Not many? Ten mid-grade Soul Beads are worth five hundred regular Soul Beads!"
"I’ve personally hunted more than ten mid-grade Soul Beads myself; they’re not that valuable. Mr. Ming, we’re a government department. Don’t we know the true value of Soul Beads? If it can lure out the mastermind, it’s worth it, even if it takes a hundred mid-grade Soul Beads, let alone ten."
"You still want a hundred?"
"I’m just making a point. What do you say? With these, my chances of success are much higher. If not, then forget it; I can’t do this job."
That was Wang Lan’s attitude: if you provide the resources, I’ll do it. If not, find someone else. Anyway, my main job now is attending university.
And that Star Martial Toxin Vaccine is really enticing...
He had completely forgotten how he’d even played the executioner for experience points and skill points back in the day.
"Alright, stay in school for now and don’t go anywhere. I might notify you at any time."
"Hold on, does the Tianjian Bureau have any... high-tech spy gadgets?"
"High-tech spy gadgets? What kind are you looking for?"
"Reconnaissance, for infiltration. The smaller and more covert, the better."
"Follow me!"
Following Ming Baiye, Wang Lan arrived at a secluded, standalone building within the Tianjian Bureau compound. The building resembled the medical department of a Star Martial Academy; everyone entering and exiting wore white lab coats, and some even wore protective gear, making Wang Lan suspect they might be researching biochemical weapons.
"Wang Lan, these are all micro-robots for reconnaissance. However, due to technical limitations, we can’t control them remotely yet. Each one requires a controller to direct its movements. The controller’s sensor range is only three hundred meters. This means you need to operate them within that range. Honestly, I don’t think they’re very useful. You’d be better off using infiltration-type Star Martial Skills."
"But Star Martial Skills cause Star Energy Fluctuations. And even if I don’t use Star Martial Skills, anyone with perception-type Talented Skills could detect a Star Martial Warrior nearby."
"True. Someone capable of controlling the underground Soul Bead trade is unlikely to be an ordinary person."
In the end, Wang Lan chose a spider-type robot and a Qingniao for reconnaissance.
With the two items, Wang Lan returned to his dormitory. He carefully read the plan Ming Baiye had formulated. It was detailed, with each step intricately linked to the next. At first glance, it seemed quite impressive, though somewhat incomprehensible. From the lines of the plan, an aura of masterful strategy, capable of deciding victory from a thousand miles away, seemed to emanate.
But... Wang Lan was dismissive.
Such beautiful, naive optimism. Pure wishful thinking.
The more ingenious a plan, the more critical it is that no step goes wrong. A single unexpected incident could derail the entire plan, leading to a complete collapse.
What’s the perfect plan? It’s setting a trap on the enemy’s inevitable path, precisely when they believe they are absolutely safe. If there are alternative routes, it’s not an inevitable path. If they are on guard, they are not absolutely reassured.
So, after reviewing the plan several times, Wang Lan tossed the so-called "Decapitation Strike Plan" aside and began to mull over his own ideas.
The first part of the Decapitation Strike Plan was still usable. However, the later stages—gaining Chen Xiaoping’s trust, finding a way to connect to the higher-ups, gaining their trust, and collecting evidence during transactions for the Tianjian Bureau to make a clean sweep—seemed unfeasible. Given the Tianjian Bureau’s penny-pinching ways, the part about gaining trust through transactions couldn’t be implemented.
Moreover, Wang Lan was busy with his studies and didn’t have time to waste on such a protracted scheme. He preferred a solution that was once-and-for-all.
It just so happened that after upgrading Spiritual Engraving to the Gold level, he’d gained a new ability. And this particular application of the skill hadn’t even been developed by the Engraving Masters yet.
Even though a Star Martial Skill might have been around for a long time, it didn’t mean its applications had reached their limits. If Wang Lan hadn’t demonstrated his vertical Flame Sword, He MingXue wouldn’t have known the Flame Sword could be used that way.
The plan, repeatedly simulated in his mind, was simple yet lethal!
Now, all that was left was for the Soul Beads to be delivered.
Putting the plan aside, Wang Lan examined the two high-tech robots before him. The Qingniao was fine; it had solar panels and could recharge using solar energy. But the spider robot, being too small, couldn’t. Both robots were highly realistic in their mimicry; unless observed up close, they were indistinguishable from real creatures.
He turned on the power, activating both robots. Then, he connected them to his laptop via the USB port.
"Xiao Ai?"
"I’m here!"
"Copy a clone of yourself into these two robots. Can they be controlled autonomously?"
"Certainly."
Soon, two progress bars appeared and quickly completed. The two robots began to move without Wang Lan’s remote control.
"Wang Lan, I can control both robots. Since I have a quantum connection with my main body, I can remotely transmit instructions to these clones. Apologies, the robots’ capacity is too small to hold all my programs."
"Wait, quantum connection? I don’t remember your data code being that high-end."
"In February this year, Ice Snow and I went on a trip to White Eagle and were inadvertently caught up in their System Number 54. There, Ice Snow and I received a data upgrade. Since we’re just programs, we couldn’t acquire the capabilities of their supercomputers. However, we can still utilize some functions of the quantum data connection module. Wang Lan, if you want me to receive a comprehensive upgrade, how about building me a quantum computer chassis? That amount of money shouldn’t be a problem for you."
"Heh..." Wang Lan sneered coldly. "
Technology that’s still in the ’black tech’ stage is, in a word, expensive! You think I don’t know that?
Being able to control them is good enough. Assist me with a task in a few days."

chapters.title: Chapter 279: Soul Bead Grenade
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 279: Soul Bead Grenade
The next day, the head of the Tianjian Bureau delivered two boxes to Wang Lan. One contained two hundred Soul Beads, and the other contained ten mid-grade Soul Beads.
Ming Baiye verbally refused, but his actions told a different story. Besides, as Wang Lan said, Soul Beads are like diamonds—luxurious and tremendously valuable when sold in a jewelry store. But they’re worthless at the diamond mines.
After all, diamonds are just carbon. The world is abundant in diamond reserves, and synthetic ones can be as large as needed, so they have almost no real value.
With so many Exotic Beasts in Different Dimensional Spaces, if Soul Beads ever became scarce, the crisis of the human race would be resolved.
Upon receiving the Soul Beads, Wang Lan grasped a mid-grade Soul Bead in his hand as Star Power surged around him, channeling a mass of green spiritual power into it.
This was Wang Lan’s trump card. The Soul Beads contained Star Power, a mysterious form of energy. Wang Lan engraved his spiritual power within the Soul Bead, and as long as he activated his spiritual power, the hidden spiritual power would emit a spiritual fluctuation after twenty-four hours.
Coupled with the use of the Star Power within the Soul Bead as energy, the spiritual power would spread like radio waves.
Wang Lan had already set up the radio frequency on the computer with Xiao Ai’s help. With the radio signal, he could pinpoint the exact location of the Soul Bead.
Beheading Plan? It’d be more apt to call it the Trojan Horse Plan.
Imprinting spiritual power into ten mid-grade Soul Beads and over ten standard ones was a vast undertaking for Wang Lan. Compared to this task, a new application for Spiritual Engraving that Wang Lan had discovered was perfected over these days.
TAP TAP TAP—
"Come in!" Professor Zheng Gong continued writing furiously, head bowed, without looking up as he spoke.
"Teacher, you’re busy, I see."
Hearing Wang Lan’s voice, Zheng Gong stopped writing and looked up. "Wang Lan? What a rare visitor. If I’m not mistaken, this is the first time you’ve come to see me privately, right? What’s up, encountered any difficulties with your studies?"
The usually stern Professor Zheng actually made a stiff joke when it came to Wang Lan. Not that the joke was at all funny.
As the most talented student he had found so far in the field of Spirit Engraving, Zheng Gong wished he could whip Wang Lan day and night to study, to delve into it—that within a year Wang Lan could become a ninth-level Spiritual Engraving Master.
But... Wang Lan clearly had more interest in Star Martial Toxins than in Spirit Engraving.
He even seized every opportunity to run off to the medical department.
This made Zheng Gong very angry, feeling that Wang Lan was losing his purpose in trivial pursuits. However, upon learning that Wang Lan had actually developed a vaccine for Star Martial Toxins, Zheng Gong could only heave a long sigh and walk away.
For many days, he hadn’t urged Wang Lan to focus on his Spirit Engraving studies.
Previously, when Wang Lan said he wanted to be a traditional Star Martial Warrior and had no interest in researching Spiritual Engraving, Zheng Gong had sternly reprimanded him. But now, he had no reason, no right to scold him anymore.
The contribution of Spiritual Engraving to the nation was undeniable. A ninth-level Spiritual Engraving Master could double—even triple—a country’s Star Martial Skill reserves within twenty years. A single such master could benefit the entire nation. What reason would one have not to strive for this their entire life?
But... why can some people’s talents be so all-encompassing?
Previously, Zheng Gong thought Wang Lan’s greatest talent lay in Spiritual Engraving.
Now he realized he was wrong, terribly wrong. In the field of medical Star Martial Arts, Wang Lan’s talent eclipsed Spiritual Engraving by streets.
Isn’t the vaccine for Star Martial Toxins important? Compared to the preventative Spiritual Engraving, the invention of the vaccine is the true service to the state and the people for centuries to come.
Compared to this great deed, Zheng Gong truly had no face to say that Wang Lan should focus on Spiritual Engraving.
To see such a fine specimen of jade that could not be fully sculpted by my own hand... It is regrettable, lamentable.
It was exactly because Zheng Gong had not been as pressing as before that Wang Lan hadn’t attended Spiritual Engraving class in five days.
Wang Lan’s visit was indeed unexpected for Zheng Gong.
"Teacher, please stop teasing your student. I’m here to ask for your guidance on a problem."
"Go ahead."
"Teacher, you’ve said that Star Martial Skills must be performed by Star Martial Warriors, haven’t you? If a Star Martial Warrior lacks Mage talent, can they still use powerful Mage-type Star Martial Skills?"
"Theoretically, it’s not practical. Even if one pushes themselves to their limits in training, it’s not worth the cost. If you lack the talent in that area, then it’s better to improve in the areas you’re good at. Wait a minute, I’m not a tactics teacher. Why are you asking me this question?"
"Then... if one lacks a certain attribute talent, can they still use Star Martial Skills of that attribute?"
"That shouldn’t be possible. Even at the Galaxy Stage, one needs to cultivate a second attribute talent before they can use Star Martial Skills related to it. This is common knowledge in high school. What are you getting at? I have an odd feeling about this."
"Teacher, could you spare some time for me? Please come with me."
From beginning to end, Wang Lan’s expression was very serious, which made Zheng Gong even more curious about what Wang Lan was up to.
Following Wang Lan to the academy’s training ground, they found it sparsely populated during class time—only a few individuals were there.
Wang Lan pulled out a Soul Bead and held it in his hand. "Teacher, this is a fire-aligned Soul Bead. I’ve imprinted the method for using Flame Sword into it, and then integrated my spiritual power as a primer."
Listening to Wang Lan’s explanation, Zheng Gong’s brow furrowed. It seemed like he was on the verge of understanding something, but he couldn’t quite grasp the fleeting insight.
Suddenly, Wang Lan threw the Soul Bead in his hand and with his fingers upright in front of his chest, he shouted, "Hah!"
Instantly, a wave of Star Energy Fluctuation came forth, and the tossed Soul Bead shattered, transforming into a Flame Flying Knife that shot off into the distance.
BOOM—
An explosion erupted in the sky, and a visible shockwave swept outwards. On the training ground, several students who were practicing stopped and looked towards Wang Lan curiously. Since they hadn’t seen what Wang Lan had done leading up to it, they weren’t particularly struck by the event.
But Professor Zheng Gong had seen it all; he had watched Wang Lan’s every move from start to finish.
Professor Zheng could understand each of Wang Lan’s actions, but when these actions were put together, he didn’t understand anymore.
At this moment, Professor Zheng’s eyes were wide open, his mouth agape, and his head tilted back.
Even though the aftereffects in the sky had long dissipated, Professor Zheng was still unable to snap back to reality.
What have I seen?
A Soul Bead performing a Star Martial Skill?
I knew that Soul Beads could store Star Martial Skills for people to learn; that’s what I teach. But a Soul Bead releasing a Star Martial Skill? Why have I never seen it before?
A dream? It must be a dream... Haha, haha...
Professor Zheng gently bit the tip of his tongue. It was painful.
Instantly, Zheng Gong’s expression began to transform, gradually becoming exceptionally fierce.
With a flash, he took a step and appeared in front of Wang Lan.
In that instant, Wang Lan was shocked.
Worthy of being a teacher at the Star Martial Academy in Modu City! Such speed!
I originally guessed Professor Zheng would be the least capable fighter among all the teachers. Now I know I was wrong.
Truly living up to its reputation! This devilish school, where even the old janitor is a Sweeping Monk-like figure!
"Wang Lan, how did you do it?" His collar was grabbed by Professor Zheng, who lifted him up to face him.
"How did you do it?"
"Teacher, can you put me down first?"
"While I was practicing Spirit Engraving of Star Martial Skills, I suddenly had a stroke of inspiration. I thought, since we can imprint Star Martial Skills into Soul Beads, why can’t we activate them using the Soul Beads? Because of the Star Power contained within, a Soul Bead can be imprinted with spiritual power. But when absorbing a Star Martial Skill from the Soul Bead, doesn’t that Star Power just go to waste? Moreover, the conditions for activating a Star Martial Skill are the control of Star Power by spiritual power, and the use of Star Power to execute the Star Martial Skill. To break it down, there are three conditions: spiritual power, Star Power, and the activation of the Star Martial Skill. And these steps, we can all fulfill them when we imprint the Star Martial Skill. So, on a whim, I tried to see if I could use a Soul Bead to trigger a Star Martial Skill. It’s like... a hand grenade."
"You... you’re a fucking genius!" Professor Zheng yelled, but he bitterly smiled and shook his head. "This idea had occurred to others before, but upon injecting the spiritual power required to release the Star Martial Skill into the Soul Bead, the Star Martial Skill within the Soul Bead was immediately activated. Because of this experiment, hundreds of Spirit Engraving Masters have died. After that, it was determined that using Soul Beads to activate Star Martial Skills was unworkable and the idea was abandoned. You’re the first one to succeed."
"The reason they activated immediately was the lack of a prerequisite: an enveloping layer of a non-attributed Star Martial Skill. This is like the fuse of a bomb. If a grenade lacks a fuse and you ignite the gunpowder directly, it’s bound to explode instantly. First, we need to wrap the Star Power within the Soul Bead with a non-attributed Star Martial Skill, and then imprint the spiritual consciousness that initiates the Star Power on the outside. And this enveloping layer of non-attributed Star Power must be mixed with spiritual power. Thus, by activating the spiritual power, this mass of non-attributed Star Power will melt away through Star Power dissipation, and then the triggering spiritual power on the outside and the attributed Star Power inside the Soul Bead will merge to release the Star Martial Skill."
Listening to Wang Lan’s explanation, a flash of enlightenment crossed Professor Zheng’s mind. In an instant, such a sudden and refreshing understanding filled his brain.
Why didn’t it occur to me... Why didn’t any of us think of this... Such a simple method... Why didn’t we think of this...
Professor Zheng mumbled to himself in a daze. After a long while, he finally looked at Wang Lan with a face full of relief.
"Wang Lan, your creativity is a divine work... I even wonder if you were sent by Lady Hou Tu to save humanity. Do you know, the method you came up with, how much will it enhance the power of Star Martial Warriors? This isn’t a mere doubling or tripling of power. It will be... an enhancement by tenfold, even a hundredfold! Imagine, using Soul Beads as grenades! Once humanity masters this technique, think of how many lives of low-ranking Star Martial Warriors can be saved! This method must be named after you. Once it becomes known, your name will be immortalized! Hahaha... Worthy of being my student!"
"You flatter me, Teacher. I’m just... just someone who indulges in wild fancy."
Wang Lan was indeed a little embarrassed because this technique was not his own idea. It was an ability derived from his Spiritual Engraving upgrading to Gold II after allocating points.
