There are no useless Star Martial Skills in the world, only people who do not know how to use them. Even Spiritual Engraving, a serendipitous discovery, will change the entire world.
"Come on, let’s go back and write down the detailed steps. Once it’s reported, you’re guaranteed an Outstanding Contribution Medal. With this contribution, forget about the Duanmu Family. As long as you don’t betray your country or harm society, who would dare to lay a finger on you? The Star Martial Warriors of the world will grind him into dust!"
"Wait, Teacher, class is about to start."
"Screw class."
"No, I mean, that’s your class!"
"We’re skipping class! This old man is skipping class too! Hahaha... You rascals have skipped so many of mine, so I’ll skip one too."

chapters.title: Chapter 280 Mr. Jun Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 280 Mr. Jun Arrives
The method Wang Lan described wasn’t complex, but putting it into action was not easy. It required a very high level of skill in Spiritual Engraving.
Even for Professor Zheng Gong, a Level Seven Spiritual Engraving Master, after understanding the method, it took him more than ten attempts to successfully create a Soul Bead Grenade.
After successfully creating it, the smile on Professor Zheng Gong’s face was like that of a child who had just received a beloved toy.
But in an instant, Professor Zheng Gong’s expression turned serious.
"Teacher, what’s wrong? Is there a problem?"
"Releasing Star Martial Skills with Soul Beads is indeed great... It’s just that the road ahead is long and arduous!"
"What do you mean by that?"
"The item is good, but we don’t have the conditions to mass-produce it in the short term! Although I’d love to have a million Soul Bead Grenades overnight... alas! Wang Lan, do you know how many Spiritual Engraving Masters in the Jade Country can imprint Star Martial Skills?"
"I don’t know."
"Three thousand! Spiritual Engraving Masters are even scarcer than medical Star Martial Warriors. There might be seventy to eighty thousand medical Star Martial Warriors in the whole country, but there are only three thousand Spiritual Engraving Masters. Three thousand people, even if each person makes ten Soul Bead Grenades a day, might still not produce enough for our arsenal in a year! And among these three thousand, most are Star Martial Warriors specializing in spiritual power, and the elemental Star Martial Skills they’ve mastered are... generally average. Moreover, making Soul Bead Grenades and skill engraving are different. Skill engraving allows one to imprint Star Martial Skills from another person’s mind into Soul Beads. However, Soul Bead Grenades can only be made using Star Martial Skills that the engraver themself possesses. If the engraver cannot cast a particular Star Martial Skill, they cannot imprint the spiritual power required to activate it into a Soul Bead. This raises the requirements for Spiritual Engraving Masters even further."
"Teacher, throughout human history, haven’t we always been raising our standards?" Wang Lan said with a smile. "From simplicity to complexity, isn’t this the process of human civilization’s evolution? It applies to every trade and profession."
"You’re right! That said, Wang Lan, you’ve been hiding your true strength all along, haven’t you?" Suddenly, Professor Zheng Gong looked at Wang Lan with a smile, making Wang Lan feel uneasy under his gaze. "Every time I try to test your progress, you always surprise me. You not only meet my expectations in quality and quantity but also seem to do so effortlessly. I had thought that even if you exceeded my estimated level of strength, it wouldn’t be by much. After all... you’ve only been studying for two months. If I hadn’t seen it with my own eyes, I would never have known you’ve reached the level of a Level Seven Spiritual Engraving Master."
"Uh... what does Level Seven refer to in terms of ability?"
"It means being able to engrave A-rank Star Martial Skills! Creating a Soul Bead Grenade requires at least Level Seven proficiency."
Too bad, you’ve underestimated me again.
Wang Lan thought."I will apply for a patent for you. Have you thought of a good name for this technology?"
"Let’s just call it the Soul Bead Grenade. I think it fits well. As for the patent... never mind that. This is my contribution to the country. What use do I have for a patent?"
"Young man!" Professor Zheng Gong patted Wang Lan’s shoulder gently. "You have a patriotic heart, and I am very pleased. But giving up benefits that are rightfully yours isn’t patriotism; it’s foolish. You say this technology is an unconditional contribution to the country? Why not register the patent and then license it to the country for free? A patent not only brings you substantial benefits but also many intangible yet real advantages. Consider this: thousands of years from now, when history teachers discuss the advent of the Soul Bead Grenade and its development, how could they not mention Wang Lan, its inventor? Throughout history, with five thousand years of written records, how many heroes and outstanding figures have there been? And how many of them are truly remembered by history? Even members of the Jade Country’s Standing Committee might not be remembered by history thousands of years later. That’s looking far ahead. More immediately, your contribution to the state will bring you unimaginable prestige. Prestige, in many ways, is even more important than strength. With prestige, others will take you seriously, willing to invest in you, willing to follow you through thick and thin. Because of your prestige, no one will dare to offend you or be disrespectful, because they cannot bear the consequences of public condemnation. Human society is very complex. In your eyes, there might only be Exotic Beasts and the Demon Clan. But in reality... there’s so much more. Didn’t you encounter that enemy from the Duanmu Family not long ago? With this patent, the Duanmu Family will never dare to lay a finger on you again."
"Thank you, Teacher!" Wang Lan bowed deeply to Professor Zheng Gong, although, even without it, the Duanmu Family wouldn’t dare to touch him anymore.
Professor Zheng Gong handled the patent registration for Wang Lan. He was quite familiar with the process and could get it done in a few days.
By the time Wang Lan returned from Professor Zheng Gong’s office, it was already three in the afternoon.
Just as he got back to his dormitory, his phone rang.
"Mr. Jun? This is Dong Feifei!"
"Mr. Jun?" Wang Lan snapped awake instantly.
Could the plan be starting already? Why hadn’t the Tianjian Bureau informed him at all?
But in an instant, Wang Lan calmed down.
"What’s the matter?"
"It’s about that matter you asked me to look into last time... there’s been progress. The other party wants me to ask how much stock you have on hand."
"Two hundred!" Wang Lan’s voice was curt, tinged with impatience.
"Two hundred... Mr. Jun, do your classmates have any?"
"Two hundred isn’t enough for you?" A mischievous smile played on Wang Lan’s lips. "How about I throw in an extra ten medium-grade Soul Beads? Would that be sufficient?"
"Enough, that’s enough! My friend would like to invite you for a meal, Mr. Jun. I was wondering if you have the time and could grace us with your presence?"
"Where?"
Putting down the phone, Wang Lan took out a face-changing mask and placed it on his face. Suddenly, like the mask from the movie *The Mask*, it enveloped Wang Lan’s head, transforming his face into that of a different person in the blink of an eye. This mask could not only change his face but also hide a Star Martial Warrior’s aura. It could even shield him from the senses of perceptive Star Martial Warriors nearby. However, Wang Lan could not use Star Power; the moment he did, the mask would automatically fall off.
The Star Martial Warrior who crafted this mask clearly wasn’t skilled enough,
Wang Lan thought.
With further refinement, such an Innate Ability could surely allow a Star Martial Warrior to remain hidden without affecting their combat strength.
He changed his clothes and picked up a briefcase to leave. But on second thought, he took out the protective case from the briefcase and casually tossed the regular and medium-grade Soul Beads directly into the briefcase before heading out.
Wangjiang Wind and Moon was a famous riverside restaurant in Modu City. Located on a triangular plot of land bordered by the river on three sides, it served as a landmark and the brand center of the Wangjiang Triangle area. Behind Wangjiang Wind and Moon was a bustling commercial street with various establishments integrating tourism, leisure, and entertainment.
The meeting Chen Xiaoping had arranged with Wang Lan was in a private room on the third floor of Wangjiang Wind and Moon.
As Wang Lan stepped out of the flashy sports car, a young man hurried over. "Mr. Jun, you’re here?"
"Let’s go!"
Wang Lan was playing the part of a rich, second-generation heir—the arrogant, domineering type who equated coolness with style. That’s why his tone was deliberately blunt.
Carrying the briefcase, Wang Lan followed the young man into Wangjiang Wind and Moon and took the elevator straight to the third floor.
After several twists and turns, they arrived at the farthest private room. Its window faced the Huangpu River. In case of any sudden events, one could jump directly into the river. Whether for escape or suicide, it was an ideal spot, a place with good feng shui.
"Mr. Jun," Dong Feifei began, "let me introduce you. This is Ping. He’s the one who buys all the extra Soul Beads we get, and his prices are very fair. Ping, this is Mr. Jun—Lu Shaojun, the second son of Modu City’s Lu Family."
"A pleasure to meet you, Mr. Jun," Chen Xiaoping said. "I’ve met your older brother, Lu Changjun. I still get fired up thinking about the time he led a thirty-man squad into the heart of the Exotic Beast defensive line in the East Sea Pioneer Space. He charged in and out seven times—truly awe-inspiring!"
"It seems you don’t know me very well?" Wang Lan said coldly.
"I don’t quite understand what you mean by that, Mr. Jun."
"Anyone who knows me knows not to mention Lu Changjun’s name in my presence! Enough chit-chat. Did you bring the money?"
At this remark, Chen Xiaoping’s expression turned somewhat awkward.
"Mr. Jun, I invited you for a meal today... primarily to get acquainted."
"So, you didn’t bring the money?"
"Mr. Jun, this is our first meeting. I thought we could get to know each other, perhaps become friends..."
"I have plenty of friends. I don’t need another one." Wang Lan stood up, ready to leave.
"Mr. Jun, please wait a moment. It seems you brought the Soul Beads with you?" Chen Xiaoping said, his eyes repeatedly flicking to the briefcase in Wang Lan’s hand. "May I see the merchandise?"
Wang Lan casually placed the briefcase on the table and opened it.
A pile of Soul Beads lay jumbled messily in the briefcase. The loud PINGING and PANGING as they knocked against each other made Chen Xiaoping wince just looking at them.
These are Soul Beads... and there are several medium-grade ones in there too! How can he just toss them together like marbles? What if they get chipped?
Chen Xiaoping thought, distressed.
"Seen enough?" Wang Lan said coldly, snapping the briefcase shut. "I’m leaving. Call me when you have the money ready next time."
"Mr. Jun, perhaps you could leave your phone number? So I can contact you next time?"
"Dong Feifei has it. Contact him. I don’t want any association with you. People like you don’t last long. If you go down one day, don’t drag me with you."
With that, Wang Lan left with the briefcase without looking back.
"Ping... please don’t be upset," Dong Feifei said quickly. "Mr. Jun is always like that. But rest assured, he has quite a few Soul Beads. And at Zhenyu University, there are many students like him, scions of Star Martial families. Even if they haven’t awakened their Innate Abilities, their status is special. They can get plenty of Soul Beads from their families..."
"Do I look upset to you?" Chen Xiaoping smiled faintly, a sharp glint in his eyes.
Wang Lan’s performance indeed irked me. So what if Lu Shaojun is a scion of a Star Martial family? He’s just a mundane after all.
However, Lu Shaojun’s desire to avoid any connection with him seemed perfectly normal. In fact, it made Chen Xiaoping more inclined to believe Wang Lan wasn’t trying to set him up.
After all, if he really wanted to trap me, wouldn’t getting closer be the logical approach?
Chen Xiaoping knew well that engaging in this kind of business was like being a grasshopper in late autumn—he wouldn’t be around for long. Sooner or later, he’d get caught and end up picking up soap in prison for the rest of his life.
But what could he do? He was already on this pirate ship; there was no getting off. It was a choice between possibly ending up in prison picking up soap someday, or definitely ending up there tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 The Fish Took the Bait
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 281 The Fish Took the Bait
"Boss—"
"I warned you that things have been a bit tight recently. Unless it’s something very important, you shouldn’t contact me."
"Boss, Dong Feifei reached out to me today..."
"That useless student? Hold off on those Soul Beads at the school for now. Don’t collect any more for the time being."
"No, it’s about someone Dong Feifei introduced. He’s the second son of the Lu family in Modu City, Lu Shaojun. I thought if I could establish a connection with Lu Shaojun, I could use him as a springboard to get into Zhenyu University. Zhenyu University is full of rich heirs; many direct descendants of Star Martial families who haven’t awakened their Star Martial talent study there. And this Lu Shaojun, he came straight to me today carrying two hundred Soul Beads! He had them loose in a briefcase. It pained me to see them like that."
"Two hundred Soul Beads? That’s not a small number..."
Two hundred beads, even on the black market, would be worth several million.
"Boss, it’s not just two hundred ordinary Soul Beads; there are also ten mid-grade Soul Beads among them."
"Are you sure?" Xiao Qing’s tone finally changed.
"I saw them with my own eyes, how could I not be sure?"
"If it’s the Lu family... coming up with ten mid-grade Soul Beads wouldn’t be too difficult. It’s just... I don’t know if they can be trusted. After all, at a time like this, it could be a set-up."
Xiao Qing pondered for a long while before saying, "Tell me exactly what Lu Shaojun said and did, every single detail."
Subsequently, Chen Xiaoping, imitating Lu Shaojun’s tone, recounted everything that had happened that afternoon in detail.
"He doesn’t want to get involved with you and asked you to only go through Dong Feifei? So he’s trying to keep his distance from you?"
"Exactly, that’s what I was thinking too."
"He’s in a hurry to trade? Is he short on cash?"
"That... I didn’t get the sense he was eager. The impression he gave me was that he was... straightforward. He didn’t want to haggle, nor did he want to waste time with me. His attitude was like he wanted to pay and get the goods immediately, and then for us to owe each other nothing."
"Is that so... You can contact him again. If he’s genuinely interested in trading, money isn’t an issue."
"Boss, what about the price?"
"Ordinary Soul Beads will be thirty thousand each, so that’s six million. The ten mid-grade ones will be four million, for a total of ten million."
"Ah? Isn’t that pressing him too hard?"
"Hard? Don’t be absurd! This is the market rate now. If he’s willing, he’ll buy; if not, then forget it."
"Got it!"
「The next day」
Wang Lan went about his usual routine: attending classes, visiting the library, going to the medical department, and looking for Professor Zheng Gong.
At noon, Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu met for lunch in the cafeteria.
Jiang Xinyu tucked her long hair behind her ears. The gesture, in Wang Lan’s eyes, was particularly attractive, especially the expanse of fair skin revealed behind her ear, making Wang Lan unconsciously gulp.
"Eat your food. Don’t stare."
"Oh!" Wang Lan chuckled and buried his head in his food. Jiang Xinyu ate quickly but elegantly. Remembering Wang Lan’s silly expression just now, a smile touched Jiang Xinyu’s lips.
Suddenly, his phone rang, displaying an unknown number.
"Hello? Who is this?" Wang Lan spoke in such a tone that Jiang Xinyu, across from him, stopped eating and looked at him with a puzzled expression. Clearly, Wang Lan was using a disguised voice and affecting a different personality.
"Mr. Jun, it’s me, Chen Xiaoping."
"How did you get my phone number?"
"I got it from Dong Feifei. I want your goods, for a total of ten million. What do you think?"
"Ten million? Isn’t that a bit steep? Two hundred Soul Beads and ten mid-grade Soul Beads are worth thirty million."
"That’s at the Soul Bead Exchange. Our deal here is unofficial, and this is the price. If you think it’s fair, Mr. Jun, we’ll trade. If not, no hard feelings."
"Fine. When?"
"This afternoon at three, same old place."
"Okay!" With that, he decisively ended the call.
"What’s wrong? Official business?"
"Yeah! Have to catch a Water Ghost. It’s nothing, just a small matter."
"Be careful with everything."
"I know. You don’t trust me?"
Since he had a mission that afternoon, Wang Lan once again "honorably" skipped class. After parting ways with Jiang Xinyu, Wang Lan went straight back to his dormitory for a nap. He got up and left around two o’clock.
「Wangjiang Wind and Moon again, the same private room.」
Only Chen Xiaoping was there this time.
"Mr. Jun, you’re here! Last time you left in such a hurry, you didn’t even touch a single dish. You should at least grace us with your presence this time, right? The cuisine at Wangjiang Wind and Moon is among the best in Modu City..."
"Tch, cut the crap, as if I haven’t eaten here before. Skip the pleasantries. I don’t like to drag things out. Let’s just do a clean exchange: cash for goods." Saying this, Wang Lan casually placed the briefcase on the table.
"Mr. Jun, may I inspect the goods?"
Wang Lan opened the briefcase and gestured for him to proceed. Seeing so many Soul Beads just thrown carelessly into the case, Chen Xiaoping felt a pang of distress. Though they resembled glass marbles, they were worth ten million.
"Mr. Jun, why didn’t you use a molded case to store them individually? Even just... padding it with some cloth would have been better."
"Tch, are these things you play with like marbles really worth all that fuss? Are you done checking? If so, transfer the money."
"May I have your account number, Mr. Jun...?"
"Account number? Just send it to my QQ." With that, he took out his phone. Chen Xiaoping saw how direct Wang Lan was, not asking any probing questions. Plus, he was still hoping to use Wang Lan as a stepping stone to infiltrate Zhenyu University, so he didn’t hesitate to add him on QQ.
After adding him on QQ, Chen Xiaoping made a phone call. A short while later, a notification popped up on Wang Lan’s phone: a deposit of ten million Jade Coins had arrived.
"The transaction is complete. I’m leaving. If I have more goods in the future, I’ll contact you, but you are not to contact me proactively. Understood?"
"Understood! Mr. Jun, won’t you stay for a meal?"
"No need." Wang Lan turned and left without a backward glance.
Chen Xiaoping stood by the window, watching Wang Lan speed off in his sports car, a slow smile spreading across his face.
He really looks down on people... I just don’t get it. What right do you, a Muggle, have to look down on me, a star student from the Modu City Star Martial Academy?
Wang Lan had just returned to the dormitory and hadn’t even had time to take off his mask when his phone rang.
"Hello, Mr. Ming!"
"How did it go?"
"Everything went smoothly!"
"That’s great! When are you meeting his superior?"
"Meeting? There’s no meeting!"
"No? According to the plan, weren’t you supposed to show distrust for Chen Xiaoping and suggest meeting his superior directly? He should have contacted his superior by now. With Soul Beads worth at least twenty million, his superior would have no reason to refuse your request."
"Mr. Ming, your plan doesn’t fit Lu Shaojun’s persona at all. Who is Lu Shaojun? The legitimate second young master of the Lu family in Modu City. He’s never short of money, let alone Soul Beads. Do you understand the mindset of these rich heirs? Not trusting Chen Xiaoping and requesting to negotiate with his superior? Please. These kinds of wealthy kids don’t really care about the business itself, as long as the money is good enough for their lavish spending. Besides, if I were to request a meeting with his superior, they’d immediately become suspicious. Even if they weren’t sure I was bait, they’d definitely be on guard. Things are tight right now; they’d rather lose the business than take the risk."
"So... you changed the plan?"
"Something like this requires improvisation."
"What about the Soul Beads?"
"Sold them."
"PFFT—COUGH COUGH COUGH..."
"Sold them? You really sold them? For how much?"
"Ten million."
"You wastrel! Soul Beads worth thirty million, and you sold them for just ten million... You... you..."
"Relax, the Soul Beads have my Spirit Engraving on them; they’ll start emitting a location signal in twenty-four hours. Then we can follow the signal to find their hideout. Don’t worry, everything is under control."
"You can do that with Soul Beads? How come I didn’t know?"
"That’s a new technique developed by the Modu City Star Martial Academy. My plan is simpler and more effective. Rest assured."
"Next time you change the plan, let me know first."
Ming Baiye hung up, tossed the phone aside, and sprawled out on the bed like a starfish.
BEEP BEEP—
"Is there no end to this?" Wang Lan picked up his phone again, only to see it was Professor Zheng Gong calling.
"Wang Lan, come to the dean’s office immediately."
「Meanwhile」
Chen Xiaoping carefully avoided the surveillance cameras. Then, using his Star Power perception, he confirmed that no one was secretly watching him before leisurely leaving with the suitcase.
That’s right, Chen Xiaoping wasn’t as simple as he appeared. Or rather, no one who could get into the Modu City Star Martial Academy was simple.
Some might say, "I’m a great fighter, so why can’t I get into the Modu City Star Martial Academy?" Yet, some who appear very weak receive early admission offers.
Being a good fighter isn’t a school’s sole criterion for admission; it’s just one of them. Although far fewer students are recruited based on other criteria compared to fighting ability, if fighting were everything, then the Investigation and Auxiliary Departments might as well close down.
Not every healer is as capable in combat as Wang Lan. Besides him, out of the forty-odd students in their class, fewer than five could truly be called skilled fighters. As for the girls in the class, if they were in a provincial martial competition... forget it, they wouldn’t even make the Lian City team.
One could be granted exceptional admission for an extraordinary talent, especially one that far exceeds the norm, or for possessing a very rare ability.
Chen Xiaoping’s talent was Star Power perception. Moreover, his Star Power perception ability ranked among the top three in the Modu City Star Martial Academy.
Sometimes, family background truly isn’t a barrier to development, but even the hardest workers can’t compare to those who start with a royal flush.
Chen Xiaoping could sense any concentration of Star Power within a five-kilometer radius. This meant that even if a Star Martial Warrior didn’t use any Star Martial Skills, Chen Xiaoping could detect them no matter where they simply stood.
If Wang Lan hadn’t been wearing a face-changing mask that could block Star Power, Chen Xiaoping definitely wouldn’t have contacted him again after their meeting. This was also why he, despite being known for such sketchy deals that many were aware of, had always avoided leaving any evidence for the Tianjian Bureau to find.
No one could monitor him; as long as he avoided cameras, he had nothing to fear.
Arriving at a secluded spot, Chen Xiaoping made a call. "Boss, I’ve got the goods. Everything went smoothly."
"Did he do anything unusual?"
"No, he left in more of a hurry than I did, as if I were going to eat him."
"That’s good. I’ll send you the meeting location in a bit."
"Alright, Boss. Boss, considering the great risk I took, couldn’t my commission be a little higher?"
"Forget about a higher commission; that’s the rule. I’ll give you a bonus."
"Thank you, Boss."

chapters.title: Chapter 282 282 Became a Sought-After Item
chapters.content:
In the dean's office, not only was Eld Di present, but also Deputy Dean Nangong. Upon seeing Wang Lan enter, three pairs of eyes instantly turned to him.
"Wang Lan, Professor Zheng said that the Soul Bead Grenade was your invention?" the deputy dean asked urgently.
"Yes!" Wang Lan did not hesitate, hastily answering respectfully.
"What grade of Soul Bead Grenade can you make? C-grade? Can you do B-grade?"
"Theoretically, I can create a Soul Bead Grenade of any grade that matches the Star Martial Skill I have mastered. But the prerequisite is that there must be a Soul Bead with the corresponding elemental properties, and the Star Power within the Soul Bead must also be sufficient to release the Star Martial Skill."
"Is that so? Then, can you make an A-grade Soul Bead Grenade?" Deputy Dean Nangong asked excitedly again.
"That shouldn't be a problem, but it requires a mid-grade Soul Bead."
"What about S-grade?" Eld Di suddenly interjected. His question caught both Deputy Dean Nangong and Professor Zheng Gong by surprise, as only Star Martial Warriors of the Galaxy Stage could master S-grade Star Martial Skills. Wang Lan had only just broken through to the Star Cloud Stage; theoretically, he did not possess that ability.
"I should be able to," Wang Lan replied softly.
"Dean Nangong, give Wang Lan a mid-grade fire-elemental Soul Bead."
"Alright, I'll go get one right away."
Deputy Dean Nangong hurried off. Eld Di looked at Wang Lan with a tender, smiling face.
"I wasn't wrong about you; your talent is even higher than your mother's. I'm not talking about strength improvements, but in terms of creation. You invented the Soul Bead Grenade, which holds far greater value for the human race than a top-tier peerless warrior."
"You flatter me, Dean."
"I am not flattering you. I am incredibly excited at this moment. You first created a Toxin Vaccine for Star Martial Toxins, completely resolving our desperate situation against the Poisonous Beasts. Now, you've invented the Soul Bead Grenade. With just these two achievements, your name will be remembered through the ages. On behalf of the human race, I thank you."
"Dean, please. Am I not also a member of the human race?"
"Indeed!"
Before long, Deputy Dean Nangong returned with a vivid red mid-grade Soul Bead and solemnly handed it to Wang Lan. A mid-grade Soul Bead was worth at least one exotic beast or member of the Demon Clan with Galaxy Stage strength.
The Galaxy Stage represented an immensely powerful enemy. Each rampaging Galaxy Stage exotic beast had claimed the lives of at least several Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warriors.
Wang Lan took the Soul Bead and slowly closed his eyes. His body surged with Star Power, as visible spiritual power was engraved upon the Soul Bead.
It took Professor Zheng half an hour to make a Soul Bead Grenade, and it would only possess the power of a C-grade Star Martial Skill. Wang Lan, however, could engrave an S-grade Star Martial Skill in twenty minutes. To engrave the same Star Martial Skill, Wang Lan only needed one-tenth of the time that Professor Zheng required.
After a patient wait of twenty minutes, the fluctuation of Star Power around Wang Lan subsided.
"Dean, Professor, it's ready."
"What Star Martial Skill did you engrave?"
"Earth Surge Fire Sea!"
"As I thought, Earth Surge Fire Sea—you've been practicing it for what, almost four months now? To what extent have you mastered it?"
"It should be fine for actual combat."
"Let's go to the Stellar Martial Skill Testing Ground to see how effective this S-grade Soul Bead Grenade is."
The four left together and, after a half-hour journey, arrived at the Stellar Martial Skill Testing Ground. Deputy Dean Nangong had already mastered the method of using the Soul Bead Grenade, which was simply to trigger the fuse within the Soul Bead using spiritual power, and then throw the Soul Bead.
Upon activation, the Soul Bead instantly emitted a burst of vibrant, bewitching red light. Deputy Dean Nangong threw it forcefully, and it arced through the air, landing at the center of the Stellar Martial Skill Testing Ground.
Many of the senior students who were practicing their Star Martial Skills at the testing ground also gathered around, curious. Seeing Deputy Dean Nangong throw a mid-grade Soul Bead, they were all baffled.
Suddenly, the mid-grade Soul Bead emitted intense Star Energy Fluctuations, and a red light pattern, like a magical array, spread out from the Soul Bead as its center.
In the blink of an eye, the array spread to a distance of thirty meters. At the moment the array formed, towering flames, three meters high, surged out, leaving all the watching students with their mouths agape, their expressions as if they had seen a ghost.
"The control isn't as flexible as when a person directly executes the skill, but the power is quite good. And the duration... is also quite substantial."
"Unless the Star Power in the Soul Bead is exhausted, the Star Martial Skill will continue to be released."
"If a Star Shine Stage squad carried ten of these Soul Bead Grenades, their combat strength would reach the level of a late-stage Galaxy Stage expert."
"More than that! You're not considering the terrain. In the right terrain, even a single one of these Soul Bead Grenades could yield up to five hundred casualties."
Hearing this, Deputy Dean Nangong became excited, looking at Wang Lan as if he saw a glittering bar of gold.
Struck it rich! The Star Martial Academy of Modu City has found a treasure... No, not just a treasure, a treasure trove! Hahaha...
"Very good, Wang Lan. Make more of these Soul Bead Grenades when you have time from your studies," Deputy Dean Nangong said with an excited laugh.
"Dean, my studies are quite demanding. I have ten courses, and almost all of my time beyond studying is devoted to developing the Toxin Vaccine for Star Martial Toxins. There really isn't any time."
Developing the Toxin Vaccine for Star Martial Toxins earns 5,000 experience points and 200 to 300 skill points. Making a Soul Bead Grenade, on the other hand, yields nothing. Wang Lan wasn't foolish; of course, he knew which to choose.
"Developing the Toxin Vaccine for Star Martial Toxins... there's no need to rush... After all, there aren't many Poison-attribute Different Dimensional Spaces in our Jade Country. On the other hand, Soul Bead Grenades can most directly bring benefits to Jade Country."
"Deputy Dean, I'm just one person. Even if I worked relentlessly without eating or drinking, I couldn't produce many grenades a day. It's like trying to douse a burning cart with a cup of water. To solve the production issue of Soul Beads, we must address the root cause."
"The root cause? How can we solve that?"
"Increase the number of Spiritual Engraving Masters; let them work together to engrave."
"We will naturally plan and arrange for that. But you are the only one who can engrave S-grade Star Martial Skills. Make more Soul Bead Grenades when you have time. If you need Soul Beads, come to me for them."
"It seems we need to raise the graduation threshold for the Spiritual Engraving course," Eld Di said, his eyes flickering with a sharp light. "Wang Lan, what's the minimum requirement for making Soul Bead Grenades?"
"You have to engrave a Star Martial Skill into a Soul Bead; that's the minimum requirement. As for the grade of the Star Martial Skills to be engraved, that depends on the individual's strength."
"Fine. We'll raise the graduation standard for Spiritual Engraving to Level Six. If they can't pass Level Six, they won't graduate."
Eld Di struck the table powerfully and proclaimed loudly. Several of the students watching nearby stumbled in fright, almost falling over. Do they really have to be so ruthless?
And since Eld Di himself had said it, it was as good as confirmed.
Why? Why suddenly raise the standard? Is there any sense of democracy at all? This is directly elevating the difficulty of graduation from Hard to Hell mode!
Wang Lan's gaze swept over them. He saw many classmates were already posting about it. Probably, in no time, the issue of raising the graduation standard for Spirit Engraving would explode across the campus network.
The situation doesn't look good. I'd better slip away quickly.
He hurriedly asked Eld Di and Deputy Dean Nangong for permission to leave. As soon as he got it, he took off running.
It was now dusk, and Wang Lan saw it was about time for dinner. He decided to eat first and then go back.
Back at the dorm, neither He Jing nor Ming Guodong had returned. After taking a shower, Wang Lan took out his phone, a sly smile spreading across his face.
Chen Xiaoping, who lived on the second floor of the men's dormitory, was sitting bare-chested on his bed. Just a moment ago, his account had increased by 200,000 Jade Coins: 100,000 as a commission, and another 100,000 as a red envelope from his boss.
Chen Xiaoping didn't know how long he could keep this up. Perhaps before he even graduated, the Tianjian Bureau would come to the school and take him away. Even so, he firmly believed he was always extremely careful and vigilant.
But he believed even more strongly in a saying: "You reap what you sow." Or, as another saying goes, "Walk by the river long enough, and your shoes are bound to get wet."
Lost in thought, Chen Xiaoping remembered a day last year when his father's company had a serious accident. Due to lax safety precautions, his father's company was made an example of. His father was imprisoned, and the family was burdened with enormous compensation payments.
Even after selling everything they could, they were still short several hundred thousand. At that time, his mother and two younger siblings were even struggling to afford food.
That was when his boss had approached him. Although he knew that once he took this step, there would be no turning back, that he would be on an irreversible path... Chen Xiaoping still did it.
He could have borrowed money from classmates and repaid it slowly, but between the hard way and the easy way, Chen Xiaoping chose the latter. He thought that if he demonstrated his value in the future, the country might grant him clemency. Besides, Chen Xiaoping deeply resented the high prices of Soul Beads. He felt the Soul Bead Exchange monopolized them with exorbitant prices, essentially exploiting Star Martial Warriors.
Driven by a moment of recklessness and wishful thinking, he crossed the line for the first time.
But once he calmed down, he realized there was no going back.
His only hope now was that his boss would keep his promise and that this arrangement would only last until he graduated. After graduation, they would part ways, like a lone boatman on a vast river—strangers once more.
His boss had mentioned they had powerful backers... He wondered how much longer those backers could protect them.
DING!
A soft alert sounded from his phone.
Chen Xiaoping picked up his phone; a transfer notification appeared. Opening his QQ app, his expression froze.
"Mr. Jun transferred you 100,000 Jade Coins."
The accompanying message had only two simple words: Red Packet!
Chen Xiaoping reached out to accept it, but his hand suddenly hesitated. He had a vague premonition, not very strong, just a sense of unease.
But looking at the amount, Chen Xiaoping still tapped "Accept."
"The recipient has accepted the transfer."
Seeing the phone notification, Wang Lan showed a hint of a smile.
"Xiao Ai, was it successfully implanted?"
"It was successfully implanted."
"Search his contacts and recent communications."
"Yes!"
Chen Xiaoping was indeed a very cautious person. The phone Xiao Ai had infiltrated was likely just his burner phone. Even after Xiao Ai thoroughly combed through the phone, Wang Lan didn't find what he was looking for.
No matter. At least the bait had been cast.
The Soul Bead transaction was at 3:00 p.m. This meant that by 3:00 p.m. tomorrow, the spiritual fluctuations would be triggered. Wherever the Soul Bead was then would reveal the location of their hideout.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 283: Eyes Turned Green with Envy
chapters.content:
"Fuck—"
Suddenly, a roar interrupted Wang Lan, who was deep in thought. Hurriedly flipping off the bed and putting on slippers, Wang Lan opened the door.
"Fuck, fuck, fuck—" He Jing, clutching a pillow, furiously threw it at the couch over and over.
Wang Lan looked dumbfounded at He Jing, then turned to Ming Guodong, who was standing beside him with a look of helplessness, "What's wrong with him? Got cucked?"
"Piss off! How could that be possible when I don't even have a girl? Wang Lan, do you know that the graduation rank for Spiritual Engraving just went up by two levels?"
Wang Lan's Adam's apple bobbed slightly. "I... know."
"How do you know?" He Jing had thought Wang Lan would leap up just as excitedly as he was and then curse the school for being out of their minds. Then the two could huddle together and wail.
But... Wang Lan's reaction shattered the image in his mind like a mirror.
"If even you know about it, why wouldn't I?"
"It's not that. Aren't you always the one who is oblivious to the outside world, focusing only on reading the wise books? Normally you're as cut off from news as a caveman. So how come you're so well-informed now?"
"When it comes to my personal interests, I'm not that cut off!"
"ARGH—" He Jing howled to the sky again. "Spirit Engraving, it's already tough enough to pass Level Four. Level Six Spirit Engraving... just thinking about it is horrifying!"
"We're just freshmen, so it's better for us. As long as we study a little harder and stay on top of our academics, there's still hope to pass Level Six. You have to think about the third and fourth-year seniors; they're the ones who are truly miserable."
"True. A lot of the seniors haven't even passed Level Four, and they're still practicing hard just to graduate. Even worse are those who've already passed Level Four—hahahaha! They thought they could rest easy after passing Level Four. Now, they have to pass another two levels. Thinking about them, for some reason, my mood suddenly got a lot better."
"Quick, open up the campus forum. It's in an uproar! But I heard that this decision came straight from Eld Di's mouth. This time, the petition is probably going to sink like a stone in the sea."
"Right, why would Eld Di make such a sudden decision? There was no sign of it before, was there?" He Jing asked Wang Lan curiously, a look that made Wang Lan feel somewhat guilty.
"Why are you looking at me? How would I know? Eld Di must have his reasons for making such a decision."
"I heard it was because of a suggestion from a student. There were some seniors there at the time. One student apparently mentioned something about increasing the number of Spiritual Engraving Masters or something similar. The people present didn't hear clearly, so they don't know the details."
"Anyway, regardless, if the person who made that suggestion is found out, what do you think will happen to them?"
In an instant, Wang Lan's mind conjured an image: himself frantically running through the campus, pursued by a dense, swarming crowd of fellow students. "Wang Lan, you scoundrel! It's all your fault I have to take two more levels!" "I haven't even passed Level Four, and you've doomed me to take Level Six, you inhuman bastard!" "Beast, die!"
Wang Lan shuddered. He absolutely couldn't let this leak out. If it did, he would indeed be beaten to death, right?
Wang Lan returned to his dorm and opened the campus forum. As expected, the hot topic was the increase in the required level for the Spiritual Engraving exam, and the debate was intense. However, some rational students analyzed that the school had suddenly made this decision because Spiritual Engraving had become a national asset.
Although the specific reasons were unknown, it was certain that the country needed Spiritual Engraving Masters—and the more, the better. The previous requirement to pass Level Four was for the inheritance of Star Martial Skills. Therefore, the requirement to pass Level Six was not just for inheritance anymore. Because imprinting Star Martial Skills onto a Soul Bead also counts as a form of inheritance. Compared to imprinting them directly into someone's mind, the fundamental difference isn't large, but the difficulty is doubled.
「The next day, Wang Lan cautiously got through the day.」
Fortunately, no one had paid attention to Wang Lan at the time. Even the seniors who had heard Eld Di's words on the spot didn't remember what Wang Lan looked like.
「By three in the afternoon, Wang Lan took out his laptop on time.」
He opened the Xiao Ai software, and a map was quickly displayed. On the Modu City map, a red dot was flashing continuously.
Wang Lan hastily called Ming Baiye and ran to the school gate. Just five minutes after he had arrived at the gate, a Tianjian Bureau car stopped beside him.
"Get in. Where is it?" Ming Baiye asked urgently.
"The Soul Bead traded this time is shown to be at Dongling Cemetery... Weird. Could this black market's base be in a graveyard? That's fucking creative! But it is indeed quite secretive. Cemeteries are usually deserted, especially at night. If they hold their meetings amongst the graves, they really don't have to worry about being reported."
Their car, along with a dozen others, got on the elevated highway and swiftly headed towards the Dongling District.
Modu City is a super metropolis. Ever since the era of the Jade Country dynasty, Modu City has been the alternative capital of the Jade Country. With the Yangtze River as the boundary, the northern and southern capitals even have separate central systems in operation.
Therefore, the prosperity of Modu City has a deep historical foundation.
Modu City has a permanent population of seventeen million. Nearly twenty million people are packed into such a cramped Modu, which just goes to show how incredibly densely populated it is.
This density of population is precisely what has led to every inch of land in Modu City being worth its weight in gold.
Not only do the living need to buy houses to reside in, but even the dead need to purchase their own spots. The price of a burial plot, just one square meter, soared to two to three hundred thousand yuan.
Outrageous? It is outrageous, indeed. But as the developers argued, the average housing price in Modu City is around eighty thousand yuan, and that's for residential properties. You can't build apartment buildings on burial plots. The deceased deserve to be laid to rest peacefully, not suspended mid-air, right? So, what you're buying is land area. Sell one square meter, and that's one less square meter available. If you're not willing to pay, you can go to state-designated public cemeteries, which are much cheaper.
Therefore, whether for convenience or to showcase filial piety, there are always plenty of fools with more money than sense. The few commercial cemeteries in Modu City almost always sell out as soon as they hit the market. There's speculation in real estate, chestnuts, and gold, but speculation in graves in Modu City is truly a spectacle to behold.
Cemeteries even have property management on regular days! Actually, they're just gravekeepers. But to keep up with the trend, they're now called property management.
After the Tianjian Bureau agents presented their identification and explained their purpose, the gravekeeper allowed them entry without a second thought.
Entering the cemetery, the landscaping was quite well done. It was an endless expanse of tombstones, with an unobstructed view.
"Wang Lan, are you sure you're not mistaken? This place doesn't look like their main base at all."
Wang Lan looked at the coordinates on his computer. "There's no mistake. Even if this isn't their main base, the batch of Soul Beads I sold must be here."
Following the map's guidance, the group arrived in front of a very impressive tomb. A small, Western-style building was constructed on top of the tomb, with an unmarked tombstone outside it.
"The Soul Beads are in the tomb," Wang Lan said, pointing to the grave.
"Open the grave!" Ming Baiye commanded. His Tianjian Bureau subordinates immediately got to work. An Earth Attribute Star Martial Warrior instantly activated Earth Dragon Surge, causing the land within a ten-meter radius of the grave to undulate like waves. In a short while, whatever was buried beneath the soil was churned up.
From beneath the dirt, three massive safes slowly rose.
"Huh? Quite creative, hiding things in a grave. Even grave robbers wouldn't come to a modern cemetery, right?" Ming Baiye revealed a smile upon seeing the safes.
These safes could withstand even a bomb without damage. But to a Star Martial Warrior, safes are nothing but a joke.
A Star Martial Warrior sneered as he approached one safe. He lightly pressed his palm on it, and the alloy steel safe melted as if it had encountered strong acid. In the blink of an eye, the safe door turned into a puddle of iron on the ground.
"What the hell? Spongy Bone Palm?"
"'Spongy Bone Palm? This is Melting. Zhang's Innate Ability is Melting. His hand can melt anything in the world; whatever it touches will disintegrate,' Ming Baiye explained.
"What if it's not touched by his hand?"
"Then it's fine."
The safe was packed with small drawers. Ming Baiye stepped forward, pulled out a drawer, and inside, it was filled with densely packed Soul Beads. Just one drawer held at least two hundred Soul Beads. Judging by the size of the safe, it must have hundreds of drawers, right?
There were some gaps at the top. This was probably because the mastermind behind the scenes had been adding drawers over time to reach this scale. In that case, there must be tens of thousands of Soul Beads in this safe.
My goodness! Even if there were fifty thousand Soul Beads, with three safes, that's at least one hundred and fifty thousand. Even if sold at half-price on the market, they'd be worth nearly ten billion! And that's calculating the price as if all of them were common Soul Beads. But, as everyone knows, common Soul Beads are expensive but worthless compared to medium and high-quality ones. On the black market, the real volume of transactions is mostly in medium and high-quality Soul Beads.
Ming Baiye quickly had his subordinates open the other two safes. As expected, his guess was confirmed. Though fewer in number, most of the Soul Beads in these safes were medium-quality, with a few possessing special attributes.
There were so many Soul Beads that even the seasoned experts of the Tianjian Bureau couldn't help but breathe more heavily. It wasn't just about the monetary value of these Soul Beads; with so many, they could cultivate several masters to the Galaxy Stage.
Fortunately, Wang Lan remained relatively calm. To him, Soul Beads were only valuable for skill points and replenishing Star Power. And whether they were medium or low quality, they all counted for just one point. This was actually quite unfair.
In the past, Wang Lan had even traded a medium-quality Soul Bead for one hundred common Soul Beads. But now, even trading couldn't satisfy his Glutton-like demand for skill points.
Only by completing missions could he sustain his demand for skills.
Destroying the Soul Bead black market warehouse. Reward: 10,000 Experience Points, 1,000 Skill Points.
The system's voice suddenly rang out in his mind.
At the same moment Ming Baiye found the Soul Beads, Xiao Qing, who was in an unknown location, was jolted awake by an alarm. He scrambled off his lover and dashed towards the computer.
Upon seeing the warehouse alarm triggered, with a red warning level displayed on the computer, Xiao Qing collapsed.
This warning level didn't just mean the warehouse had been touched; it meant it had been dug up and the safes opened.
How could someone have discovered it, so well hidden? How could it have been found? What went wrong? Where was the mistake?
Suddenly, Xiao Qing remembered that just recently, a batch of Soul Beads had been deposited in the warehouse. Could it be those Soul Beads were the problem? It must be, it must be! Chen Xiaoping, you dared to betray me!
Xiao Qing couldn't imagine that every one of those Soul Beads had been rigorously tested by professionals to ensure they were problem-free before being sent to the warehouse. He only knew there was an issue with the warehouse, and he needed to vent his fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: I’ve Found the Mastermind
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 284: I’ve Found the Mastermind
"Wang Lan, Chen Xiaoping suddenly left the dorm."
Around five o’clock, Wang Lan was dropped off at the school gate and was about to head to the dormitory when Xiao Ai sent a notification on his phone.
After Chen Xiaoping had received Wang Lan’s red envelope, a clone of Xiao Ai had entered Chen Xiaoping’s phone. Even though there was nothing on that phone, as long as Chen Xiaoping carried it with him, he could be located.
Wang Lan turned left, entering a cafe. Not long after, Chen Xiaoping, looking somewhat flustered, walked towards the school gate. The school closed its gates around 5:30 PM. After that time, unless one had special privileges, no one was allowed in or out. The only exceptions were Saturdays and Sundays, when the gates stayed open until 10 PM.
It looked as if Chen Xiaoping was trying to get out of the school gate before 5:30 PM.
Watching Chen Xiaoping’s retreating figure, Wang Lan did not hurry to follow. As a sensory-perception type Star Martial Warrior, Chen Xiaoping had managed to elude many tracking experts from the Tianjian Bureau, which spoke to his abilities.
Once out of the school gate, Chen Xiaoping hurriedly hailed a taxi, "Go to the bus station."
Wang Lan stirred his coffee, staring at the red marker on his phone’s map, watching it slowly move along the elevated road and then head west. After traveling about ten kilometers, it descended from the elevated road and stopped in the large roundabout in the middle.
Wang Lan stood up, walking towards the school gate.
"Uncle, please let us in, just for five minutes, we are only five minutes late!" Outside the school gate, two girls pleaded with the guard, their faces full of desperation.
"You had an hour and a half to go out for a meal, and you still managed to be late? No, the school has its rules. Call your class instructor to come and get you."
Then, the two girls watched helplessly as Wang Lan walked out of the school gate as if he were invisible.
"What about him? You’re not following the rules now?"
"He has access permissions. Why don’t you go to the guidance office and get yourself an access permission too? Alright, stop dawdling and call them. It’s getting cold; aren’t you two freezing?"
In the roundabout, Chen Xiaoping, sitting in the car, was pale as a ghost, shivering uncontrollably.
Stiffly raising his head, he looked at the back of the driver’s head.
"Chen Xiaoping, Qing wants to see you."
"I really didn’t expect...that Qing would send an ordinary person to fetch me... heh heh... brother, aren’t you afraid of dying?"
"My life was given by Qing, and now I’m returning it to him..."
"SIZZLE—"
Suddenly, the driver’s body violently shook. Stiffly lowering his head, he looked at his chest, where a green wind drill emerged from his torso, spraying blood everywhere, staining the car red.
Chen Xiaoping used a gust of wind to slice open the car, and the door swung open. Just as he was about to leave, his face suddenly changed dramatically. This time, it was not anger nor fear that distorted his features but despair.
In his perception, over a dozen masters were rapidly approaching from all directions. He couldn’t overpower a single one of these many experts.
Soon, ten mysterious figures dressed in unified work clothes and wearing silver-white masks appeared around Chen Xiaoping, encircling him completely.
"Qing invites you for a visit."
Modu City’s Bund is its most bustling area, heavily concentrated with wealthy people. The Bund has tankers, beaches, and natural swimming pools. Nearby, there are places like Happy Palace and grand theaters dating back nearly a century, with luxury brand stores visible at every turn in the streets.
For many aspiring youths, owning a villa on the Bund is the ultimate dream, a goal considered harder to achieve than reaching the sky.
On a hillside near the river at the Bund, a villa with a sea view was brightly lit.
The flapping sound echoed as a Feather flew across the sky and then gently landed on the roof of the villa. Qingniao opened its mouth, dropping a spider that vanished into the darkness in the blink of an eye.
"Qing, it really wasn’t my fault, believe me, I didn’t betray you, I really didn’t..." Chen Xiaoping knelt in the living room, looking at the muscular Xiao Qing in front of him, desperately pleading his case.
"Then...why was my warehouse raided by the Tianjian Bureau?" Xiao Qing, playing with a ring and without raising his head, asked grimly.
"’I don’t know, Qing. Think about it. If it really had something to do with me, the Tianjian Bureau wouldn’t have just destroyed the warehouse; they would have come after you directly. Moreover, I didn’t even know where the warehouse was... Qing!
"Qing, we are in the same boat; if the ship capsizes, we both go down!’"
"’Nobody apart from me and the big boss knew the location of the warehouse. But... the Tianjian Bureau managed to strike accurately and decisively. This can only mean they knew its exact location.
"’And just after I received the Soul Beads you delivered and placed them back in the warehouse, it was raided. It seems there was a problem with those Soul Beads.’"
"Soul Beads? What could be...wrong with the Soul Beads?" Chen Xiaoping suddenly recalled last night when Mr. Jun sent him a hundred thousand in a red envelope. At that moment, he had an ominous premonition but, failing to identify its source, he didn’t pay it much attention.
Could it be...Mr. Jun?
Impossible, Mr. Jun was just a wastrel, and from start to finish, he had shown no intention of befriending him. On the contrary, he had rejected him, looking at Chen Xiaoping with disdain...
Wait a minute!
Suddenly, Chen Xiaoping realized the problem.
Would a person who looked down on him from the bottom of his heart send him a red envelope at night? Even if one hundred thousand yuan was nothing to Mr. Jun, given his attitude towards him, he wouldn’t even give it to a dog, would he?
Cold sweat began to drip down Chen Xiaoping’s forehead.
But he absolutely could not admit to anything. Even though it was very possible that the issue really lay with him, once he admitted it, he would be dead with no place for burial. Even his mother and younger siblings would share the same fate.
"Qing..." Chen Xiaoping cried out in anguish, "Qing, how could there be a problem with the Soul Bead? What problems could the Soul Bead possibly have? Could it be fake? Even if they could be fake, every Soul Bead went through professional testing! How could there be an issue?"
Xiao Qing looked at Chen Xiaoping coldly; he had also considered this question. Each Soul Bead had been tested, and there certainly should be no problems. However, Xiao Qing’s instincts told him that the problem this time must be within this batch of Soul Beads.
His instincts had always been accurate, so Chen Xiaoping had to become his scapegoat.
"’What you say might not be wrong, but... who asked you to know too much about my business? With the current situation, I must be cautious. So don’t you blame me.
"’I’ve called back all the loose ends. You are neither the first nor the last. Go down; you won’t be alone.’"
"Qing... Qing... don’t... don’t..."
Xiao Qing’s palm rested on Chen Xiaoping’s head. Suddenly, a burst of purple flame erupted from the top of Chen Xiaoping’s head and swallowed him up almost instantly.
"AH—"
A brief and sharp scream, and Chen Xiaoping fell dead to the ground.
The purple flame burned intensely, quickly melting away Chen Xiaoping’s flesh. Before long, the flames died down, leaving behind a pile of white ash.
"Clean this up!" Xiao Qing barked a command and turned to walk upstairs.
Several cloaked figures with silver-white masks quickly took brooms and swept up the pile of ashes on the ground. This scene was all witnessed by a spider that had crept in through the gap under the door. In the era where Star Martial Warrior abilities were strange and varied, the infiltration of high-tech products could sometimes be more effective than Star Martial Warrior infiltration.
With this video, Xiao Qing’s crime had irrefutable evidence. But Wang Lan felt it was not enough. Xiao Qing was likely not the hidden mastermind. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to establish such a large operation in Modu City without ever being detected by the Tianjian Bureau.
Patiently waiting until late into the night, Wang Lan commanded the spider to carefully go upstairs, stealthily infiltrating Xiao Qing’s bedroom. Although the lights were off in the bedroom, Xiao Qing wasn’t sleeping. Instead, he stood at the window, silently smoking.
One cigarette followed another without any intention of stopping.
The spider surveyed the room; since Xiao Qing was awake, it was impossible to search. Then it left the bedroom and headed toward other rooms. It took half an hour before the spider found Xiao Qing’s study.
The study was simple, with only a laptop and a few bookshelves. The spider jumped onto the computer desk, initially planning to check the drawers. But as it passed by the computer, it stopped in its tracks.
The laptop was still on, but the network connection displayed was disconnected. The spider carefully approached the computer to check the network connection history and found that this laptop had never been connected to the network.
That was abnormal. What reason could there be for this computer to never have connected to the network?
Suddenly, several strands extended from the spider’s abdomen. What appeared to be silk were actually data cable lines, the type with the connector wrapping peeled off. The silk reached the USB port of the computer, and the spider inserted it. Instantly, the USB connection was successful.
Xiao Ai’s avatar followed the port into the computer. When it successfully broke through the layers of defenses and entered the secret folders, a smile appeared on Wang Lan’s face, who was hiding in the distance under a streetlight.
Although there wasn’t time to see what was in the folders, the fact that so many passwords were set and such complex encryption methods were used meant that it must be something important.
Wang Lan had initially thought that Xiao Qing was just an intermediary in the hidden Soul Bead trade network. But it turned out he was the one who controlled the black market trade of Soul Beads. This could be seen from what he had said today.
The real masterminds behind the scenes were those bosses who provided him with Soul Beads. But finding out this much was enough.
He immediately ordered the spider to copy the confidential files. It took nearly half an hour to copy three gigabytes of data.
Suddenly, footsteps were heard from outside the door. The spider quickly left the desk and hid inside the desk’s cavity. Xiao Qing, wearing his pajamas, came into the study.
He quickly went to the computer and started working, deleting all the data that Wang Lan had copied before, and then shredded the folder. After formatting it back and forth more than a dozen times, he finally let out a long sigh of relief. Standing up, he turned and left the room.
The spider carefully left the study, exiting the villa through every nook and cranny. Once the spider had completely left the villa, Wang Lan made a call to Ming Baiye’s number.
"Mr. Ming? Still busy?"
"’We’ve confiscated over a hundred thousand Soul Beads. Although we haven’t found the hidden mastermind, the black market is bound to suffer a major blow and won’t recover its vitality anytime soon. We’re all busy categorizing these Soul Beads.
"’You’ve made a significant contribution this time; maybe your military rank will move up.’"
"Really? That’s great. By the way, Mr. Ming, I’ve found the hidden mastermind."
The other end suddenly fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Actually, It’s All Luck
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 285: Actually, It’s All Luck
What were we just saying? Even though we didn’t find the shadow mastermind, confiscating so many Soul Beads means we’ve already achieved our goal. But in the blink of an eye, you tell me the shadow mastermind has also been found? Does it have to be this stimulating? And the problem is, we don’t know how you retrieved the Soul Beads, and I damn well don’t know how you found the shadow mastermind either! You, all by yourself and without a peep, managed to solve in two days what we couldn’t in two months? You’re such a prodigy; it’s a real blow to our pride!
Wang Lan’s news had come without any warning, leaving Ming Baiye momentarily at a loss for what to say.
"Who is the shadow mastermind?"
"His name is Xiao Qing, a jewelry tycoon in Modu City. But in fact, he is the real controller behind all the black-market Soul Bead transactions in Modu City. I’m sending you the evidence related to him right now. He’s currently at a seaside villa in the Bund, Villa Number Eight."
After hanging up, Wang Lan turned and walked back to the school, sending all the information about Xiao Qing to Ming Baiye via his mobile phone.
FLAP, FLAP, FLAP—the sound of wings beating echoed above Wang Lan’s head as Qingniao, a spider in its beak, slowly landed on his shoulder. Wang Lan reached out and took the spider.
Carefully returning to the dormitory, he intended not to disturb his two roommates. But to his surprise, as soon as he entered the living room, he heard the intense sounds of battle coming from their rooms.
It’s already three in the morning, and they’re still gaming. Hopeless!
"Action Department, assemble—"
Following Ming Baiye’s order, three squad leaders instantly issued the assembly command. Within three minutes, two hundred fully armed members of the Action Department were gathered.
"Our target is Villa Number Eight at the Bund. Move out!"
Xiao Qing had been lying in bed for an hour, but he still couldn’t fall asleep. The unease in his heart felt like a sword poised at his neck, startling him awake with sudden fear each time he drifted off. It had been many years since he’d felt this kind of terror.
Unable to sleep, Xiao Qing got up once more and lit a cigarette by the window of his study.
Suddenly, a disturbance was heard outside the study.
"What’s going on?"
"Unknown individuals have been spotted nearby; a situation may be developing."
"Are they coming for us?"
"Not sure..."
WOO—
Suddenly, a shrill alarm blared. Xiao Qing’s expression changed drastically. He swung his palm, sending out a purple flame that shattered the computer on the desk.
"Break out—"
Xiao Qing led the way, and twenty mysterious figures wearing silver-white masks emerged from all directions of the villa, converging beside him into a wedge formation like phantoms.
"Earth’s Roar—"
"Earth Dragon Mountain—"
BOOM!
Without any probing attacks or exchanged words, the battle erupted instantly. Although Xiao Qing’s side numbered only twenty, they were all elite fighters.
Xiao Qing was at the peak of the Galaxy Stage. Among the silver-white masked figures were four at the mid-Galaxy Stage, and the rest were either at the peak or late Star Cloud Stage.
Among Ming Baiye’s people, only three were at the Galaxy Stage, while all others were at the Star Cloud Stage. In terms of strength, even the two hundred members of the Action Department might not be able to stop Xiao Qing if he was determined to break through.
However, the presence of just one Ming Baiye from the Tianjian Bureau meant that no matter how desperately Xiao Qing fought, it was in vain.
The power of the Star Cloud Stage couldn’t compare to that of the Galaxy Stage, and likewise, the power of the Galaxy Stage was incomparable to that of the Star Sea Stage.
Xiao Qing and his group charged forward, initially as unstoppable as a torrent, but they came to an abrupt halt upon encountering Ming Baiye.
"Fire Dragon Pillar—"
Ming Baiye stood quietly at the intersection, facing Xiao Qing’s twenty-man team that had just broken through two lines of defense.
Xiao Qing’s team charged with lightning speed, appearing ten meters away from Ming Baiye in the blink of an eye.
In that instant, Ming Baiye’s body seemed to turn to magma, flowing around him, the ground beneath his feet transforming into Hellfire.
A magma dragon coiled around him, then suddenly, like an exploding shockwave, it morphed into a tsunami of magma, rushing towards Xiao Qing and his men.
"Ice Crystal Dark Flower—"
Two masked figures instantly appeared in front of Xiao Qing’s squad. They jointly unleashed a Star Martial Skill, creating a flower-like bloom of frost before them, which rapidly extended vines to envelop them all.
SSS—
Thick smoke rose, and the faces of the two Galaxy Stage Star Martial Warriors executing Ice Crystal Dark Flower changed drastically.
A profound fear crept into their hearts. "Boss, the temperature is too high! We can’t hold it!"
"I’ll handle it—" Xiao Qing suddenly stepped forward, his body thrumming with power. "Shock Wave—"
A ray of white light emanated from his palm. With a palm strike, the entire three-dimensional space filled with a buzzing sound.
BOOM—
The oncoming magma tsunami was shattered by the tremendous vibrational force, instantly dispersing into the distance. One palm strike had carved an escape route for them, but Ming Baiye was nowhere to be seen at the end of it.
"Resonance ability? Are you Bai Xiaoyun?" a voice called from the sky. Ming Baiye floated in the void, emitting a red light.
"To betray Jade Country! Death is too good for you!" As his words fell, a rain of countless magma arrows descended from the sky. They were unimaginably fast; before Xiao Qing and the others could mount a defense, the attack had already overwhelmed them.
AARGH—
Screams rang out as Xiao Qing watched helplessly while his men were struck down one by one by the rain of fire. Just as he was about to counterattack, a Fire Arrow suddenly bombarded his chest.
BOOM—
A terrifying explosive force struck him, and Xiao Qing’s body was immediately thrown backward.
The scorching star power surged through his body like a truck, wreaking havoc on his insides. Xiao Qing struggled to stand, but Ming Baiye was already standing before him.
"Still want to struggle?"
Facing the powerful Ming Baiye, Xiao Qing couldn’t muster any will to resist. He didn’t want to die; even if it meant losing his freedom for life, at least he would still be alive.
Members of the Tianjian Bureau quickly converged. Two of them swiftly sealed Xiao En’s star palace and the meridians through which his star power flowed. Xiao En was apprehended.
"Take him back! Search carefully!"
Even though there was a considerable distance between villas, the commotion from the battle still woke the distant neighbors. Lights in various villas turned on, and many people stepped out to look in the direction of Villa Number Eight.
"Hello, the Tianjian Bureau is apprehending a criminal. It’s dangerous outside. Please return to your homes and do not come out."
"Hello, quickly take your child inside. It’s not safe out here."
Soon, the lights in the villas went out one by one, leaving only the top of the mountain where the Tianjian Bureau was diligently searching for every possible clue.
"Chief, we found some computer fragments. They seem to have been destroyed by Xiao Qing before he left, possibly hiding classified data."
"Take them back. See if we can recover anything."
From four in the morning until the sun was high in the sky, after ensuring that every trace had been thoroughly searched, Ming Baiye finally departed the scene.
「It was another weekend morning.」
Wang Lan didn’t get home until three in the morning, and he slept very soundly. If his phone hadn’t woken him, he felt he could have slept until evening.
"Hello, Mr. Ming? Was the operation successful?"
"Ha ha ha... I finally understand why they call you a lucky charm in Jiang Province. You really are a lucky charm!
"At the beginning of the year, I heard that Suzhou City cracked a Demon Clan spy case one day, discovered Demonic Transformation Potions the next, and then found a production workshop for the potion on the third day. I thought it was unbelievable. I always felt that Suzhou City was exaggerating your achievements to build you up.
"Now I’ve seen it with my own eyes: you found the Soul Bead warehouse during the day, and by that same evening, the mastermind was apprehended. I’m genuinely impressed by your efficiency."
"Did they catch everyone?"
"We captured the main culprit, Xiao Qing. The others were all taken care of. Are you well-rested? If so, come to the bureau. The Director wants to hear how you found the clues so it can be documented as a precedent."
"Okay, I’ll head over."
After Wang Lan hung up, he quickly delved into his Spiritual Sea of Consciousness, but there was no system notification about experience points or skill points being credited.
What’s going on? Is this matter not over yet?
Wang Lan hesitated, then dressed and left the dormitory. He didn’t have to wait long at the school gate before the car sent to pick him up arrived.
Upon reaching the Tianjian Bureau, Ming Baiye came to meet him. "Wang Lan, shouldn’t the bureau assign you a car? Every time you come here, we have to send someone to pick you up."
"Isn’t a car too high-profile? How about a motorcycle?"
"A motorcycle?"
"Yes, the kind of motorcycle from ’Flying Eagle,’ the one that can fly and transform..."
"That’s just in movies, okay? You think that’s real? Even if the bureau had one, Modu City doesn’t allow motorcycles. How about this... we do have custom Tianjian Bureau electric bikes, but they’re quite power-hungry. A single recharge costs twenty."
"Sounds good. There’s a charging station at the school. An electric bike it is then."
"Fine, I’ll put in an application for you. Let’s go, the Director is waiting."
The Tianjian Bureau in Modu City was much larger than the one in Suzhou City, occupying more than three times the area. It was quite a walk to the conference room.
Cheng Jianlong, the Director of the Modu City Tianjian Bureau and one of Jade Country’s Titled Strongmen, oversaw seven departments. Four of these were led by Star Sea Stage experts, and the remaining three by peak Galaxy Stage masters.
The Modu City Tianjian Bureau alone boasted ten Star Sea Stage masters and dozens at the Galaxy Stage. Although it couldn’t compare to the Star Martial Academy, it was more than enough to maintain order in Modu City.
Furthermore, with the Southeast Military Region to the west, the Pioneer Space of the East Sea to the east, and the Star Martial Academy garrisoned in Modu City, one-third of Jade Country’s combat power could be mobilized in the shortest possible time if any crisis occurred in Modu City.
Therefore, although Modu City had always been coveted by the Demon Clan, their activities there were minimal, and its public safety rivaled that of the Imperial Capital.
"Special Agent Wang Lan of the Tianjian Bureau’s Action Department, paying respects to the Director and all senior officers."
"Wang Lan! Before you even came to Modu City, your reputation already preceded you. How is it, getting used to Modu City?"
"You jest, Director. The straight-line distance between Modu City and Suzhou City is only a hundred and twenty kilometers. How could I not be accustomed?"
"Good that you’re accustomed. If so, why not stay in Modu City?"
"Uh..." A wry smile appeared on Wang Lan’s face.
"Ha ha ha... I’m just kidding, but it’s also a serious suggestion. How did you find the Soul Bead warehouse, and how did you find Xiao Qing? Share your methods so we can all learn from your experience."
"This... it was all luck."
"Although they call you a lucky charm, that’s just in jest. Could luck alone earn you the Glory of the Sun Medal? I believe this was all the result of your careful planning and execution. Tell us!"
"Yes, sir!"

chapters.title: Chapter 286 Evidence? I Have It
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 286 Evidence? I Have It
"It all began when I received a task from Director Ming and made backchannel contact with Chen Xiaoping. I cultivated at the Star Martial Academy, specializing in the Spirit Engraving Method, which conveniently allows one to imprint spiritual power onto a Soul Bead.
I embedded a spirit engraving in each of the Soul Beads I used as bait. Once the transaction was completed and the engraving activated, the spiritual power would mix with the Star Power in the Soul Bead within twenty-four hours, generating a Star Energy Fluctuation. It was by locating this fluctuation that I determined the whereabouts of the Soul Beads."
"Tsk, tsk, tsk... There’s such a method? How come I’ve never heard of it before? Director Ming’s original approach was to fish with a hook, but you went and put a tracker in the bait? Your method is more direct and effective..."
"Thank you for the praise, Xie Chengju."
"And what happened next? Even though we found the Soul Beads, there wasn’t a single clue about the puppet master. Besides, after we raided their Soul Bead warehouse, we must have spooked them. How did you manage to find Xiao Qing?"
"This all goes back to the initial plan. Director Ming wanted me to build a good relationship with Chen Xiaoping to connect with his superiors. So, after the Soul Bead transaction was completed, I sent Chen Xiaoping a red envelope worth a hundred thousand yuan.
In that red envelope was a Trojan horse virus I had written.
When Director Ming raided the Soul Bead warehouse, it certainly alarmed them. But with their warehouse wiped out, they were furious. He definitely wouldn’t dare cause trouble for the Tianjian Bureau, so he’d naturally vent his anger on Chen Xiaoping.
Fortunately, Chen Xiaoping’s phone already had my Trojan horse, so I could track his location no matter where they took him. I then followed the signal to Xiao Qing’s villa. There, using a robot, I happened to film Xiao Qing killing Chen Xiaoping, confirming he was the puppet master."
After hearing Wang Lan’s operational process, the group of top brass was momentarily speechless.
Was this plan complicated? Not really; even a police commissioner could devise this method to crack the case.
Why didn’t the Tianjian Bureau think of this? Firstly, no one had considered imprinting spiritual power onto a Soul Bead for tracking, nor did anyone possess the ability to do so. The subsequent parts of the plan all hinged on successfully locating the Soul Beads.
Therefore... this plan’s success hinged on Wang Lan’s ability to approach it from an angle no one else considered.
If this method of using Spirit Engraving to track Soul Beads became public, the black market would likely stop dealing in Soul Beads altogether. After all, who could guarantee the Soul Beads they acquired weren’t already marked with a Spirit Engraving?
Coming out of the conference room, Ming Baiye affectionately slung his arm over Wang Lan’s shoulder.
"Wang Lan, this great achievement is almost entirely thanks to you, a gift to your uncle, so to speak. The original plan had some feasibility, but its chances of success were less than fifty percent. I was just trying it out, figuring there was nothing to lose even if it failed.
Frankly, just recovering so many Soul Beads was already a huge success in my book. I never expected you to directly find the puppet master behind the scenes. This great achievement is certainly enough to make old Xu from the Intelligence Department quite jealous.
You know what he said to me yesterday? ’Wang Lan is from our Intelligence Department in Suzhou City. How did he end up attached to your Action Department? Even if he needed an attachment, it should be to the Intelligence Department!’
Hahaha... As they say, first come, first served. He can only blame himself for not being proactive. Come on, our guys are interrogating Xiao Qing. Let’s go take a look."
"Sure!"
In the interrogation room, Xiao Qing sat rigidly, his expression indifferent. Regardless of how the Tianjian Bureau questioned him, he remained silent. Xiao Qing’s face was bruised and swollen, but this didn’t diminish his imposing aura in the slightest.
"Xiao Qing, our patience is limited. Whether you cooperate or not, your crimes are enough to have you executed many times over. Where did these Soul Beads come from? Where are the ledgers? You might as well confess everything now."
"If you’re merciful enough to execute me quickly, I’ll even thank you for it. I cannot reveal the source of the Soul Beads. Ever since I got into this business, I knew there was no turning back.
"So, quite early on, I sent my wife and kids abroad. As for my mistresses... they know nothing. If you want to find out who the puppet master is, keep an eye on my mistresses. Now that I’m caught, some treacherous bastards will surely wish for my swift death, perhaps even the annihilation of my entire family. Whoever tries to kill my mistresses is most likely the one who supplied me with the Soul Beads."
"Stop beating around the bush. We want the information from you directly. The Tianjian Bureau has no interest in cleaning up your messes."
"I’m the one controlling Modu City’s Soul Bead black market. By arresting me, you’ve crippled the Soul Bead black market for at least five years. Now that you have achieved your goal, why bother to know who supplies them?"
Wang Lan, who was in the monitoring room, asked Ming Baiye with confusion, "Why waste so much breath on him? Why not just go directly into his mind and find out?"
"He had long been wary of this move. He had someone install a sealing Skill Form in his mind. If any Spirit Engraving technique is attempted, it will activate instantly and destroy his brain."
"Is that so?"
"Director Ming!" Just then, the door to the room opened, and a Tianjian Bureau captain walked in, saluting Ming Baiye.
"The Evidence Section just reported that the computer is severely damaged. Xiao Qing formatted the hard drive before physically destroying it. With such extensive physical damage, there’s nothing more we can do."
"Damn it!" Ming Baiye pounded a fist in anger. "We were so close! Xiao Qing destroyed that computer right before he tried to break out; it must have contained something crucial. Tell the Evidence Section to keep trying, to find another way."
Then, Ming Baiye approached the microphone and softly said, "Use any means necessary. Make Xiao Qing reveal the source of the Soul Beads."
"Wait!" shouted Wang Lan suddenly. "Mr. Ming, that computer you mentioned... it wouldn’t happen to be the laptop in Xiao Qing’s study, would it?"
"Yes, that’s right—" Suddenly, Ming Baiye whipped his head around to look at Wang Lan. "You weren’t part of that operation, so how did you know there was a laptop in Xiao Qing’s study?"
