"Mr. Ming, have you forgotten? I sent a spider drone into the villa. That night, the spider robot went to the study and copied all the encrypted files from the laptop to the cloud.
After returning to the dormitory, I went straight to bed. Then I got your call to come to the Bureau, and in the rush, it completely slipped my mind."
"My goodness... you... I’m speechless. Quick, give me the files!"
Wang Lan’s spider drone didn’t have onboard storage, so the files were uploaded to the cloud. Wang Lan provided the cloud file ID and password, and Ming Baiye immediately instructed the Evidence Section to download and process the data.
"Wang Lan, let’s go. Time to meet an old friend."
"Old friend?"
"His real name isn’t Xiao Qing but Bai Xiaoyun. It turns out he’s connected to Eld Di’s faction. Back in the day, he used to trail after the He Jinze brothers. Later, we heard he was killed in action. The He Jinze brothers even grieved for him for a good while.
Hmph! Who would have thought he would betray Jade Country and get involved in such dirty business? I knew from the beginning that this smooth-talking fellow was fundamentally crooked."
Taking Wang Lan to the interrogation room next door, the two interrogators quickly stood up.
"Director Ming."
"You two may leave."
Ming Baiye then looked Xiao Qing up and down, his gaze filled with interest. Xiao Qing’s pupils contracted slightly upon seeing the military rank on Ming Baiye.
"I don’t want to interrogate you now; let’s just have a chat."
Playing this game? Trying to lower my guard and then attack my psychological defenses? That’s an old trick, worn out in the army long ago.
"Don’t get any ideas. The previous interrogation was to extract the source of your Soul Beads. But now, there’s no need. We’ve already got the encrypted folder from your computer."
"Hahaha..." Xiao Qing burst into laughter. "Do you think you can fool me? A hard drive formatted dozens of times and then blasted to pieces. If you can still recover data from that, well, I’d have to see it to believe it."
"You’re overthinking! Do you know why we found you last night?"
"If you found my Soul Bead warehouse, would it be so hard to find me? Would you have made your move if you hadn’t already been tracking me?"
"That’s where you’re wrong. Finding the Soul Bead warehouse was a complete accident. As for finding you... well, you brought that upon yourself.
"Chen Xiaoping was under our surveillance the whole time. You bringing him to your villa just to vent your anger? You were practically asking for it. If you hadn’t grabbed Chen Xiaoping, we might still be wondering how to draw you out."
"Impossible! I have perception-type experts. It’s impossible to be under surveillance without them noticing. Stop trying to fool me."
"There was a tracking device on Chen Xiaoping. Can your perception-type Star Martial Warriors detect something like that?"
Upon hearing this, Xiao Qing’s face changed dramatically.
"Moreover, we recorded the entire process of you killing Chen Xiaoping. With that footage, do you think there’s anything we missed? What I didn’t know during the previous interrogation was that my men had already copied the encrypted files from your computer.
Look here, my friend. This is somewhat related to you too. Your Flame Sword isn’t bad. But compared to this young brother of mine, you’re not even worthy of carrying his shoes. Xiao Qing... no, I should call you Bai Xiaoyun."
"You... impossible, you couldn’t have gotten the encrypted files... you couldn’t have snuck into my bedroom as if it were completely unguarded! My study has a perception barrier!" Xiao Qing cried out agitatedly.
He knew that as long as he kept his secrets, the wife and children he had settled abroad could survive. Once the Tianjian Bureau got hold of these secrets, many people would want his entire family dead, utterly annihilated.
"Indeed, there was a barrier, and my robot did indeed touch it. Your perception barrier is clever and sensitive, seemingly flawless.
"Perhaps... if the barrier’s sensitivity was initially set too high, it would be annoying if it was accidentally triggered by insects like mosquitoes. Every passing fly could potentially set off the alarm.
"Your villa is on a mountaintop, surrounded by dense woods, so there must be plenty of insects. So... you found it bothersome and lowered the barrier’s sensitivity, didn’t you?
"A bird landing on your roof didn’t trigger the alarm, so a spider sneaking into your study naturally went unnoticed as well." As he spoke, Wang Lan opened his palm, revealing a fingernail-sized spider resting there. Upon seeing this spider, Xiao Qing felt a chill run down his spine.
"Last night, while you were in your bedroom smoking all evening, I was in your study, copying your files."
"You..." Xiao Qing looked at Wang Lan in shock. After a long while, as if all his strength had been drained, he slumped down.
"I’ll confess... I’ll tell you everything."
"First, let’s talk about something else. I heard you were killed in action. How did you end up back in Modu City, and as this ’Xiao Qing’?"

chapters.title: Chapter 287: The Source of the Soul Bead Might Be the School
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 287: The Source of the Soul Bead Might Be the School
"Ten years ago, it was you who abandoned me; it was the nation that abandoned me!" Xiao Qing, his eyes bloodshot, yelled. "I could have defended the borders for the nation; I could have died in battle for the nation. But why did you deceive me? It was clear you wouldn’t come to my rescue; clearly, there were no reinforcements. Yet, you told me to cover the retreat, to wait for support. Thirty brothers! Until their deaths, they kept hoping, hoping for reinforcements. They always believed the reinforcements would come, but you had no plan to send them at all. We held on for three days; with Jade Country’s reaction speed, they should have arrived long ago.
"Later, it was Hellfire that saved me. My faith in the nation had already collapsed. Now, I am but a ghost living solely for money. I was placed in Modu City to make a profit through black market trades; it’s that simple."
"Since you’re a man of Hellfire, why do you still keep those people’s secrets?"
"I’ve said it before: I have a woman here, and I have children. Though I sent my woman and children abroad, the moment I reveal the people behind all this, Hellfire will not let them go. I tell you, even if you get those trading details, it’s useless. Nearly all the prominent Star Martial families in Modu City have traded with me. If you really want to dig to the bottom of this, then you’ve got to have the guts to take down all the Star Martial families in one sweep."
"Director Ming!" Just then, the interrogation room door was pushed open. "The Evidence Department has finished downloading; all the transaction details are here."
"Good! Take him away. Wang Lan, let’s go!"
Following Ming Baiye to the Evidence Department, people were rapidly organizing these files behind a dozen or so computers.
"Chief Ding, how are things?"
"Your subordinate truly has the ability to turn the tide; he got his hands on such crucial evidence in advance. One wouldn’t know without looking, but a single glance is shocking. All the well-known Star Martial families in Modu City have been secretly trading Soul Beads. While the individual number of Soul Beads isn’t large, added up, they’re enough to become the largest source of goods on the black market."
"Did you find the goods that suddenly impacted the black market prices?"
"Not yet, still searching."
"Found it!" Suddenly, a short-haired woman raised her hand. "Director Ming, Chief Ding, look! On September 5th, Xiao Qing acquired one hundred thousand Soul Beads in one go."
"One hundred thousand? He really handled that many! We only confiscated about that amount in total, and he acquired that much in a single transaction?"
"One hundred thousand Soul Beads. No wonder it caused such a huge shock to Soul Bead trading. What about the source of the Soul Beads?"
"The ledger records a man named Liu Xiao, but apart from the name, there are no other details. Are there any Star Martial families with the surname Liu in Modu City?"
"Wait! Liu Xiao?"
This name... why does it sound so familiar...
Wang Lan’s mind raced. "There seems to be a teacher named Liu Xiao at the Modu Star Martial Academy."
As soon as he said it, Wang Lan couldn’t help but draw a sharp breath.
If these one hundred thousand Soul Beads came from the Modu Star Martial Academy... that would be a major incident.
Soon enough, Ming Baiye checked the employee list of the Modu Star Martial Academy and indeed found the name Liu Xiao in the finance department. Liu Xiao, Head of the Finance Department, peak Star Cloud Stage cultivation level. Due to injuries sustained on the battlefield, he had been assigned to miscellaneous tasks at the Modu Star Martial Academy. Thanks to his dedication, he was promoted, eventually becoming Head of the Finance Department after twelve years.
This guy... he was patient for twelve years, all for this one big score! Damn impressive. A ruthless man.
"Director Ming, shall we make the arrest?" Wang Lan asked hesitantly.
"Considering he’s from the Star Martial Academy, let’s not cause too much of a stir. We’ll start with routine questioning. Wang Lan, will you take your team this time?"
"Alright!"
「」
Three cars arrived at the Star Martial Academy. It was noontime, and the students had all gone to the cafeteria for lunch. Speaking of which, Wang Lan realized he hadn’t eaten anything since Ming Baiye had summoned him to the Tianjian Bureau that morning.
"Everyone, shall we grab something to eat at the cafeteria?" Wang Lan suggested to his team.
One of them replied, "Wang Lan, how can you think about eating at a time like this? Let’s confirm this quickly so we can rest easy. The mere thought that these one hundred thousand Soul Beads might have come from the academy sends shivers down my spine."
"What’s there to worry about? Even if the sky falls, our superiors will handle it."
Seeing that none of them were in the mood to eat, Wang Lan didn’t feel hungry anymore either. When they reached the finance office, only a female senior student was there, helping out.
One of his men started to say, "Tianjian..." as he reached for his credentials, but Wang Lan quickly stopped him.
"Senior Sister, is Director Liu in?" Wang Lan asked.
The student looked up. Seeing Wang Lan’s sunny smile, her eyes immediately brightened. "Director Liu called in sick today; he didn’t come to school. What do you need Director Liu for?"
"He called in sick? Where does Director Liu live? Or do you have his cell phone number?"
"He lives in the school dormitory. I have his number, but you have to tell me why you need Director Liu. Otherwise, I can’t give it to you."
"Wang Lan, what’s going on?" a voice sounded from behind. Yu Ruoyun approached with two students wearing Student Council armbands.
"Senior Sister Yu, I didn’t expect to alert you so quickly."
"The Student Council isn’t just responsible for assisting with school order; it also maintains school security. The entry of six non-school personnel naturally triggers an alarm. If you weren’t leading them, the Student Council would have intercepted them long ago. Who are these people, and what are you doing here with them?"
"They are my colleagues from the Tianjian Bureau. We’re looking for Director Liu from the finance office."
Yu Ruoyun took out her phone, quickly scrolled through her contacts, and after a moment, dialed a number.
As she waited, Yu Ruoyun’s brows furrowed tightly.
"No one’s answering. Wang Lan, what happened to Director Liu?"
"Either he’s already fled, or something has happened to him. Let’s go to his dormitory!"
Under Yu Ruoyun’s guidance, Wang Lan and the others quickly arrived at Liu Xiao’s dormitory. After calling out and receiving no response, Wang Lan kicked open the dormitory door.
Sure enough, the room was empty. The wardrobe was open, and drawers were pulled out, all suggesting a hasty departure.
"Search the place!" Wang Lan ordered his men. They were professionals when it came to finding clues. After several meaningful glances from Yu Ruoyun, Wang Lan followed her out to the balcony.
"What exactly is going on?" Yu Ruoyun asked.
"The Tianjian Bureau eradicated an underground Soul Bead trading network and seized a large quantity of Soul Beads," Wang Lan explained. "From the network’s transaction records, we discovered a massive shipment volume. A person named Liu Xiao sold one hundred thousand Soul Beads in one go. One hundred thousand Soul Beads! Even the Duanmu family probably couldn’t casually produce that many, right? So, we suspect the Soul Beads came from the academy. And coincidentally, the academy’s Head of the Finance Department is Liu Xiao; he would have the means to access the stored Soul Beads."
"Impossible!" Yu Ruoyun retorted. "Even if it were him, he wouldn’t have the authority to withdraw Soul Beads, much less transport so many out of the academy. Although he’s in charge of finance, he needs to submit an application for anything he handles."
"But currently, that’s the only explanation I can come up with," Wang Lan said.
Just then, an exclamation came from inside. "Found something!"
Wang Lan paused and quickly re-entered the dormitory.
"Wang Lan, we found a finger under the desk."
"A finger? Take it back for DNA comparison." Turning to Yu Ruoyun, he added, "Senior Sister Yu, you see? It seems the situation really is as we suspected."
Yu Ruoyun’s brows were tightly furrowed. Although she wasn’t as strikingly beautiful as Jiang Xinyu, she would still be rated above an 85 out of 100 by conventional standards. And some women, though not possessing top-tier looks, have an exceptional bearing. Her slight frown exuded a dignified authority. Yu Ruoyun had a tall figure, comparable to Xie Sisi’s. She lightly beckoned Wang Lan over. Surprisingly, Wang Lan was only a little taller than her.
"What’s the Tianjian Bureau’s stance on this matter?" Yu Ruoyun asked.
"Recently, a flood of Soul Beads on the black market has caused their prices to plummet. If this continues, the Soul Bead Exchange will become meaningless. That’s why the Tianjian Bureau is determined to investigate the murky dealings of the Soul Bead trade," Wang Lan explained.
"The Tianjian Bureau wants stability in the Soul Bead market, not necessarily to hold any specific party accountable. Of course, a thorough investigation would be ideal. But now, it seems Liu Xiao is likely just a scapegoat. The real culprit tried to stage Liu Xiao’s escape due to guilt but didn’t expect a single finger to expose their ploy. At this point, even if the Tianjian Bureau hadn’t initially intended to investigate thoroughly, they must do so now."
"Only a few people have the authority to secretly transport stored Soul Beads—only high-level officials of the academy. Whether they are current or former high-level officials, if this is exposed, it would bring indelible shame to the academy," Yu Ruoyun stated.
"Senior Sister Yu, do you also consider the academy’s reputation your personal responsibility?" Wang Lan asked, surprised.
"My great-grandfather is the Dean."
"With Elder Di’s prestige and reputation, could he possibly be tainted by scandal? Even if a cesspit is uncovered, not a speck of filth would tarnish Elder Di. No one would dare let him be stained!" Wang Lan declared.
Although the metaphor is unpleasant, it’s apt!
Elder Di’s reputation has reached a level akin to spiritual faith. No one would believe this matter could be connected to him. So... even if the investigation tarnishes the reputation of the Modu Star Martial Academy, it definitely won’t tarnish Elder Di.
"Besides, Senior Sister Yu," Wang Lan continued, "this matter isn’t just about the simple sale of Soul Beads. The suppliers of Soul Beads to the black market exchange include almost all the Star Martial families. The Tianjian Bureau could overlook all that. But the one hundred thousand Soul Beads from the Modu Star Martial Academy must be thoroughly investigated. We should go see the Dean now, without delay."
"Alright!" Yu Ruoyun agreed.
「」
Soon, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun were once again in Elder Di’s office. Vice President Nangong Meng was also present.
"Ruoyun, you’re here." Elder Di then turned to Wang Lan. "Wang Lan, good timing. The patent Professor Zheng Gong helped you apply for has been approved by the state. Here is the authorization document. If you authorize the patent to the state, they will definitely not treat you unfairly. Moreover, if other countries want to use this technology, they’ll have to pay you patent fees, and the state will negotiate the best possible terms on your behalf."
"Thirty years?" Wang Lan looked at the document. "Dean, actually, I’d be fine with giving it away for free. I can grant permanent authorization to the state."
"Let’s start with thirty years for now," Elder Di said.
Wang Lan promptly signed the authorization document.
"We’ll keep the news about the Soul Bead grenade under wraps for now, probably for about half a year," Dean Nangong continued. "The nation needs some time to prepare. Once the news spreads, it will cause a huge worldwide impact. By the way, have you made any Soul Bead grenades during this time?"
This Dean Nangong is quite the chatterbox, and rather exasperating,
Wang Lan thought, noticing Yu Ruoyun hesitate several times, wanting to speak but stopping herself.
"Nangong," Elder Di interjected, "I think Ruoyun and Wang Lan are here to discuss something important with me. You should head back first."
"Ah... alright then. I’ll take my leave, Dean," Nangong Meng said, slightly flustered.
Once Nangong Meng had left, Elder Di’s expression turned serious. "What is it? Speak."
"Great-grandfather," Yu Ruoyun began, "someone might be trafficking the academy’s Soul Beads."
"Oh?" Elder Di raised an eyebrow. "Did the Student Council find this out? Is it students or teachers?"
"No, the Tianjian Bureau discovered it. The amount is huge—one hundred thousand Soul Beads."

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Became Famous
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 288: Became Famous
Eld Di’s expression was somewhat gloomy, but he did not lose his temper. Instead, he asked in a low voice, "Who is it?"
"So far, we have traced it to Liu Xiao, but he may have already been silenced. There must be someone else behind this."
"First, let’s check the inventory to see how many have been illicitly sold."
Those with the capability to steal and sell Soul Beads had to be among the academy’s upper echelon. Yet, at the same time, the upper echelon shouldn’t have any reason to do so.
What could they gain from illicitly selling Soul Beads? Money? But what was money to someone at the top of the academy? Who among them lacked money?
Not to say they were as wealthy as a nation, but an annual income of several million was still easily achievable for them. And that was just net income, not counting benefits and subsidies.
For the academy’s upper echelon, everything from clothing, food, housing, and transportation, even to the livelihood and employment of their family members and the education of their children, were all meticulously arranged. It was truly incomprehensible why they would steal and sell Soul Beads; there was no reason, it was utterly baffling.
Wang Lan, representing the Tianjian Bureau, Yu Ruoyun, representing the Student Council, and Eld Di himself personally led the group to the finance department to retrieve the keys. They entered the Soul Bead warehouse and then the storage room.
"The academy’s inventory should be three hundred thousand Soul Beads," the head of the finance department said nervously, looking at the ledger.
"Inspect—"
"Bin one, full!" Not long after, the Student Council’s quick check results came in one after another.
"Bin two, full!"
"Bin three, full!"
As each full bin was reported, Yu Ruoyun’s expression gradually relaxed. Wang Lan’s brows, however, slowly furrowed.
All bins full? Impossible!
If the culprit really was Liu Xiao from the finance department, where else besides the academy could he have obtained so many Soul Beads? And the finger found in Liu Xiao’s dormitory seemed to confirm it was indeed Liu Xiao.
"Report to the Dean, all bins are full; the three hundred thousand Soul Beads are accounted for."
"Great-grandfather, it seems those one hundred thousand Soul Beads didn’t come from the academy. Although the person might be Liu Xiao, he wouldn’t have the authority to withdraw Soul Beads from the academy, especially not such a large quantity."
"Hmm, as long as they’re not from the academy..." Eld Di said, nodding calmly.
"Wait, let me check again."
Wang Lan still couldn’t figure it out. Other than the academy, he really couldn’t think of any place that could source so many Soul Beads at once.
Could it be the Pioneer Space in the East Sea? If it were the Pioneer Space, then the one who sold those Soul Beads should be a high-ranking official from one of the Pioneer Spaces, not Liu Xiao.
After checking two storage cabinets in a row, he found nothing.
Just as Wang Lan was also beginning to believe those Soul Beads had not come from Modu City Star Martial Academy, he opened the third cabinet.
In that instant, Wang Lan’s expression changed, and a look of shock appeared on his face.
Seeing Wang Lan’s expression, everyone’s hearts rose to their throats again.
"Wang Lan, what’s wrong? Did you find something?"
"Damn it, these... these aren’t Soul Beads!" Wang Lan exclaimed, grabbing a handful of beads to show them. "These... these damn things are glass marbles!"
Everyone was momentarily stunned. Instantly, Yu Ruoyun stepped up to Wang Lan and took a Soul Bead. After just one glance, her face went deathly pale with anger.
Because Soul Beads were so valuable, many fakes made of glass circulated on the market. Glass was a peculiar material; when made into Soul Beads, they looked incredibly similar. From the outside, they looked completely identical.
However, Soul Beads were fundamentally important to Star Martial Warriors as they contained Star Energy Fluctuations. Thus, whether they were glass marbles or Soul Beads could not be concealed from a Star Martial Warrior; only someone completely ignorant could be fooled.
Moreover, even ordinary people couldn’t be easily fooled due to the unique properties of Soul Beads. As long as the Star Power within hadn’t been absorbed, a Soul Bead was indestructible. Even a bomb couldn’t shatter it. But once the Star Power within was absorbed, the Soul Bead would automatically shatter.
So, hitting it with a hammer would quickly reveal if it was a real Soul Bead.
Earlier, the Student Council had only checked the quantity, so they hadn’t imagined that any of the Soul Beads would be fakes made of glass marbles. If it hadn’t been for Wang Lan’s exceptionally keen sense of Star Energy Fluctuations, they might actually have been completely fooled.
Tricking people with glass marbles? Who were they trying to insult?
The faces of those who learned the truth immediately turned livid with anger.
"Uncovering the truth about the Soul Bead fraud, rewarding 10,000 experience points and 800 skill points."
The delayed system notification finally chimed, but Wang Lan was in no mood to celebrate.
"Notify all directors and above to meet in Conference Room Eight," Eld Di said in a deep voice, then turned and left the storage room, his hands clasped behind his back.
The news of the illicit Soul Bead sales spread quickly; soon, almost all the school leaders had heard about it. One hundred thousand Soul Beads being stolen and sold – this was earth-shattering news.
Therefore, in the conference room, everyone’s face was extremely grim.
The academy’s Soul Beads were mainly allocated to the Star Martial Warrior teachers. They had forgone opportunities to achieve fame and fortune, and chances to hunt Exotic Beasts for Soul Beads in the Pioneer Spaces, dedicating themselves to teaching at the academy. These Soul Beads were their rightful due.
Moreover, Soul Beads were used for both teaching props and rewards.
In the world of ordinary people, Gold is hard currency. But in the world of Star Martial Warriors, Soul Beads are money.
One hundred thousand Soul Beads was the Modu City Star Martial Academy’s entire annual quota.
"Everyone has heard about the incident, right? One hundred thousand Soul Beads have been embezzled! Such a thing has never happened in the history of the Modu City Star Martial Academy... no, in the history of all four top Star Martial Academies," Eld Di said slowly, leaning on his cane, his expression somber.
"Dean, whoever managed to illicitly obtain and sell the Soul Beads must be someone of considerable status. At least at the director level or above. And it must be someone from our academy. I suggest we conduct an immediate investigation. There should be records of who went to the warehouse."
"The one who took the Soul Beads was likely Liu Xiao from the finance department. However, he didn’t have the authority to open the Soul Bead safe, and it appears Liu Xiao has been silenced. The Tianjian Bureau found a finger in his dormitory, possibly his."
"Only a few people have authorization to open the Soul Bead safe. Who’s missing?" Nangong Meng’s icy gaze swept across the room and suddenly paused on the third empty seat to his left.
"Why isn’t Vice President Qi here?"
"Vice President Qi’s father passed away suddenly the day before yesterday, and he went home for the funeral..." Eld Di frowned. "Make a call and ask him about it."
Nangong Meng quickly took out his phone, but after trying to connect for a long time, he finally put it down. "No answer! Could it be him? I’ll personally lead the Student Council to find him."
"Let’s pass this lead to the Tianjian Bureau; they’re more professional than we are," Eld Di said coolly after a moment’s hesitation.
"No! This is our academy’s own matter and should be resolved by the academy itself. If the Tianjian Bureau gets involved, it’s bound to leak out and have a major impact on the academy’s reputation."
"I also agree with Dean Nangong’s proposal. With this incident happening at the academy, our priority must be its reputation. The loss of one hundred thousand Soul Beads is secondary; if the academy’s reputation is damaged, regaining our standing will be a huge challenge," someone chimed in.
"Gentlemen! The illicit sale of Soul Beads is a criminal case and should rightly be investigated by the Tianjian Bureau. We are, after all, an academy; we have neither the authority to investigate such cases nor to make arrests. That settles it. We’ll hand it over to the Tianjian Bureau."
Eld Di decisively overruled the dissenting opinions. Nangong Meng wanted to say more, but after receiving a stern look from Eld Di, he reluctantly held his tongue.
"Now that one hundred thousand Soul Beads have been stolen, our inventory is severely depleted. How do you suggest we resolve this?"
"What else can we do but send out those restless students to the five Pioneer Spaces for their internships? By the way, our academy has recently been offered several international aid missions. We were planning to negotiate for better terms... Should we just accept them now?"
"Whether for student internships or international aid, it has been customary for the academy not to collect Soul Beads."
"So what? It’s not like we’re taking them for free. We can have students exchange them for Academic Credits—say, ten Soul Beads per credit."
"That won’t do! Once such a precedent is set, it will lead to endless trouble. Even in these extraordinary times, we cannot open that door. Our academy has many students from Star Martial families; which of their families doesn’t possess Soul Beads? This would be tantamount to using academy resources to purchase Soul Beads from these Star Martial families."
"Eld Di, in my opinion, we should open the Nine-layer Pagoda. It was scheduled to open soon anyway. This time, the Nine-layer Pagoda wouldn’t just be for the fourth-year students’ trials; it could be opened to all students in the academy."
"That’s not feasible. The Nine-layer Pagoda is even more dangerous than the Pioneer Spaces; many of the Exotic Beasts inside are mutated. Even fourth-year students are barely strong enough. Opening it to all students would be too dangerous."
"It’s not as if anyone who wants to can go. The academy can conduct assessments. Individual participation won’t be allowed; students must apply as a team. A team of at least four must have an average strength at the Galaxy Stage."
"While fourth-year students have the highest average strength, there are many students from the first to third years whose abilities would be considered top-tier even among the seniors. If we let them enter to collect Soul Beads and then exchange those beads for Academic Credits, it would prevent the loophole of Star Martial families exploiting the system."
Nangong Meng’s proposal immediately garnered widespread support. This solution seemed quite good.
Meanwhile, as the academy was discussing opening the Nine-layer Pagoda, a breaking news alert suddenly caused an uproar at Modu City Star Martial Academy.
"Genius Youth Solves Ancient Conundrum! Star Martial Toxin Vaccine Emerges! Poisonous Beasts No Longer a Threat to Humanity!"
"Modu City Star Martial Academy Freshman Deciphers Star Martial Toxins, Develops Vaccine!"
"Genetic Coding Formula Successfully Applied in Star Martial Toxin Vaccine! New Chapter Opens in Fight Against Poisonous Beasts!"
These news items swept through nearly all media outlets overnight. Mainstream and alternative media alike frantically reported and circulated the story.
This was because Sun Li’s paper on the successful development of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine had undergone rigorous verification in the Angel Kingdom and was confirmed to be completely feasible and effective.
When Wang Lan saw this news, his lips curled in disdain.
What utter nonsense,
he thought.
The Angel Kingdom boasted the world’s largest number of Medical Star Martial Warriors. The country produced Medical Star Martial Warriors in abundance and was also home to many Medical Star Martial Techniques.
The Angel Kingdom, true to its name.
And yet, such a powerhouse in Medical Star Martial Arts had taken half a month just to verify Sun Li’s paper. During that time, Wang Lan and his team had already developed vaccines for hundreds of Star Martial Toxins.
We’ve already developed and applied them, and you’re only now completing the verification? Is your confirmation even necessary?
Despite Wang Lan’s inner indignation, he knew that verification by the Angel Kingdom was indeed necessary.
Verification by the Angel Kingdom signified that this new technology had received an official seal of approval, classifying it as orthodox and scientifically validated.
Many nations had forms of witchcraft. Even after thousands of years of inheritance, because these practices couldn’t obtain official verification and endorsement, they were often labeled as unorthodox, or even heretical and perverse.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Insane Leveling Up
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 289: Insane Leveling Up
With the validation from the Angel Kingdom, it was not just the whole world that was astounded; Jade Country’s status in the international community was also set to rise substantially.
Over the years, Jade Country had always been a leading figure globally, heading the United Nations Security Council’s five permanent members. However, that status was bought with a war seventy years ago—a war that shattered their lands and cost nearly a billion lives. In the war’s aftermath, the land was devastated. It took nearly thirty years for the country to recover its vitality. Compared to nations like White Eagle Country and Polar Bear, it lagged significantly. Even afterwards, the other four permanent members coveted Jade Country’s position keenly.
If not for the steadfast recognition of Jade Country by over three hundred countries worldwide, it might have long since been pushed to the fifth position.
It was only after thirty years of development that Jade Country once again stood at the zenith of the world. In terms of strength, Jade Country could now rival White Eagle Country and Polar Bear. Yet, these two nations remained unwilling to accept a subordinate position to Jade Country.
This time, the breakthrough in curing the Star Martial Toxins was monumental. These toxins had plagued humanity for countless years, and overcoming them was incredibly significant for Jade Country, and even more so for the entire world.
And as everyone knew, Jade Country itself didn’t have a large population of Poisonous Beasts. The regions truly tormented by them were the South Continental Prairie, the primeval forests of the West Continent, and the northwestern icefields. These areas were all home to smaller, weaker nations. Their people were frequently slaughtered by Exotic Beasts. Furthermore, due to the threat of Poisonous Beasts, other countries were reluctant to intervene even when aid was sought. After all, the damage from Poisonous Beasts was similar for all countries. Without an effective way to counteract the toxins, any rescue attempt was practically a death sentence.
When these smaller countries learned the news, they immediately burst into national celebrations, and some leaders couldn’t wait to visit Jade Country.
As the news coverage reached a fever pitch, Wang Lan was suddenly jolted from his bed, landing on the floor, by a notification from the system in his mind.
"No need to worry about finding kindred spirits along the path, for who in the world does not recognize you? For achieving the ’Renowned Throughout the World’ accomplishment, you are rewarded with two million experience points!"
What did two million mean? Wang Lan needed four hundred thousand experience points to break through to Star Cloud Four. And now, his experience bar was already half full.
In an instant, Wang Lan’s experience bar was filled, leveling him up to Star Cloud Four.
Then, in another instant, the 500,000 experience point requirement for his experience bar was met, and he leveled up to Star Cloud Five.
His experience bar filled again after accumulating 600,000 points, leveling him to Star Cloud Six.
Another 700,000 experience points filled the bar, and he reached Star Cloud Seven.
The process finally stopped when his experience bar for the next level, requiring 800,000 points, was thirty percent full.
He had only experienced leveling up three times at once when he first became a Star Martial Warrior. After reaching the Star Shine Stage, Wang Lan hardly dared to imagine it. Even after breaking through to the Star Cloud Stage, Wang Lan had been prepared to level up only once every six months. He would have been incredibly grateful if he could reach the Galaxy Stage by the end of his four years in college, before his internship.
But now, this massive influx of experience points had engulfed him. In the blink of an eye, he had advanced from the early Star Cloud Stage to the late Star Cloud Stage.
The sensation was wave after wave of ecstasy. Wang Lan was so thrilled he felt as if his soul had left his body, a state of Soul Out of Body, leaving only an empty shell behind.
BOOM! The door to the room was violently kicked open as He Jing and Ming Guodong rushed in, looking anxiously at Wang Lan.
"Wang Lan, what’s wrong with you? Have you lost control of your cultivation?" He Jing asked nervously, helping up the grinning Wang Lan who was lying on the floor.
"Wang Lan, were you just trying to make a breakthrough? Such intense Star Energy Fluctuations! Did you fail?"
"No... I succeeded," Wang Lan pushed He Jing away and sat back on the bed. "I just wanted to practice a bit, and when I gave it a try, I actually managed to break through the barrier."
"Damn!" He Jing shot up a middle finger. "You’re a freak! I remember at the beginning of the semester you were only in the early Star Cloud Stage, and now in just one and a half months, you’re already in the late Star Cloud Stage?"
"Don’t overreact. I didn’t mean for it to happen."
"Damn, you’re a true freak! Your advancement speed is even faster than Princess Yu Ruoyun’s. Although she was at the peak of Star Cloud Stage at the beginning of the semester, it still took her a year to break through to the Galaxy Stage. In just two months, you’ve gone from the early Star Cloud Stage to the late Star Cloud Stage. Perhaps you’ll even break through to the Galaxy Stage before your sophomore year."
"Don’t be ridiculous! Am I really that slow?"
"Damn!"
"By the way, is that genius first-year student mentioned in the news you? The one from Modu City’s Star Martial Academy, who developed the Star Martial Toxins vaccine? Lately, it seems you’ve been running off to the medical department every chance you get."
"Can’t you be more confident? Stop asking. It *was* me."
"Damn! It really is you? Monster! Reveal your true form!" He Jing quickly leaped to the side and shouted.
Ming Guodong pushed He Jing aside. "Wang Lan, how on earth did you do it? Director Sun Li and her team researched the analysis of Star Martial Toxins and the editing of the corresponding codes. But the use of the genetic coding formula to edit the human genome—that was your invention? But... you’re only a freshman. I heard that editing method uses a newly published genetic coding formula. After the formula was published, no one has been able to master it yet, right? Don’t tell me that in less than two months, you outperformed all the scientists in the world combined? I don’t buy that."
"I’m not that amazing. The main thing is, I had already mastered the genetic encoding formula a while ago. So this credit... I really just stumbled into it. After all, Mrs. Sun Li and her team were the ones who established the research direction. I merely provided a tool to overcome the final hurdle."
"You had already mastered it? Even before the formula was published?"
"Wang Qi is my maternal aunt. Didn’t you guys know?"
Actually, they had no idea.
Many people know who the Flame Emperor is and are familiar with his lineage. However, at least half of them are unaware that the Flame Emperor has a sister who is an ordinary person. If their families hadn’t informed them, who was Wang Lan to them? They probably wouldn’t have cared less.
Meanwhile, on Tieba, the forums exploded with activity.
"Fuck, I knew this guy wouldn’t keep his head down. He just dealt with Duanmu Yi, and now he’s stirred up something this massive... But I love it!"
"The Duanmu Yi incident was just an interlude; the research on the Star Martial Toxins vaccine had started much earlier. Wang Lan, truly living up to his reputation as a scholarly genius! His strength improves at lightning speed, and his research is world-class."
"Junior Wang Lan is so handsome, does he have a girlfriend?"
"Swaying senior sister, eating grass online!"
"Reporting to Senior Sister! Wang Lan has a girlfriend. You can consider me instead!"
"Let’s not get ahead of ourselves. We don’t know if he developed a vaccine for just one type of toxin or for many. If it’s only for one type, its usefulness is limited."
"This commenter is just being sour! Go back and read the paper! It’s clearly not a vaccine targeting only one type of Star Martial Toxin, but one applicable to the majority of them."
"The answer to each addition problem might differ, but the calculation method for each problem remains the same. This analogy illustrates the greatest contribution of Wang Lan’s research. I dare say this is worthy of a medal for contribution to human civilization! From now on, Wang Lan will be revered by countless people, like a living saint."
"Indeed, the advent of the Star Martial Toxins vaccine is tremendously significant. From now on, Poisonous Beasts will no longer be an insurmountable threat."
"Go Wang Lan—"
"Long live Jade Country!"
With the news spreading like wildfire online, how could the print media miss such an opportunity? Wang Lan had solved the problem of Star Martial Toxins, an issue that had plagued nations for millennia. This was a cause for universal celebration and a tremendous source of national pride for Jade Country. Countless media outlets flocked to Modu City’s Star Martial Academy. This revered institution, a Holy Land where in the past one wouldn’t even dare to honk their car horn when passing by, was now besieged by a crowd at its entrance.
"You want me to do an interview?" Wang Lan looked perplexed at Dean Nangong in front of him. Any trace of the previous resentment from the Duanmu Yi incident had vanished from Vice President Nangong Meng’s face. Nangong Meng regarded Wang Lan with an affection typically reserved for one’s own grandson.
"Wang Lan, accept the interview and show yourself to everyone. Although your name is already a household word, people don’t know what you look like. You discovered the method to create the Star Martial Toxins vaccine, and you deserve this honor."
"No, the credit isn’t mine alone. Without the entire medical department..."
"I know that, but none of them can serve as the primary representative! Moreover, the formula for an antidote to Star Martial Toxins has been public for thirty years. Scientists worldwide have been researching it, yet in three decades, no one managed to create a vaccine. Ultimately, your gene encoding technique was the key to solving this difficult problem. If not you, then who?"
"But why not Mrs. Sun Li? She’s the one who..."
"She is a teacher at the school, but you are a student. Which generates more buzz: a teacher developing the Star Martial Toxins vaccine, or a student achieving it? Besides, you played the crucial role. No one is asking you to take *all* the credit. And doesn’t your success reflect brilliantly on our academy’s capabilities? You gain honor, the academy gains prestige—it’s a win-win..."
So this was Vice President Nangong Meng’s angle?
It was well known that Vice President Nangong Meng of Modu City’s Star Martial Academy valued the institution’s prestige above all else. He was utterly devoted to elevating the academy’s status, aspiring to make it the top institution in Jade Country, even surpassing the one in the Imperial Capital.
It seemed this old man would seize any chance for fame, whenever and wherever it appeared.
"Dean, I still have to study, continue researching the Star Martial Toxins vaccine, make Soul Bead grenades, and investigate cases for the Tianjian Bureau. I’m so busy I can barely keep my feet on the ground."
"Didn’t the Tianjian Bureau tell you to stop investigating that case? Besides, I’m only arranging a single media interview. It’ll just be for half an hour; it won’t delay you much."
Since Dean Nangong had put it that way, it would be impolite to refuse. After thinking for a while, Wang Lan finally nodded. "Alright, but I don’t have any experience. What should I say when I’m being interviewed?"
"Just tell the truth, but remember to be humble! No matter how extravagantly the host praises you, you must remain humble and not get carried away. The host’s praise is part of their job; you just need to answer their questions properly."
"Oh!"
"Two o’clock this afternoon, Conference Room 7. Remember it, don’t forget." Nangong Meng departed contentedly. His gait was so light and springy, like a willow swaying in the breeze, that it was hard to believe he was a man in his seventies.
The phone vibrated with a call from Jiang Xinyu.
"Wang Lan, congratulations!"
"That ’congratulations’ sounded so perfunctory. I couldn’t detect any genuine congratulatory tone in it."
"So, what do you want? Should I imitate those fawning senior girls on the campus bulletin board? ’Wang Lan is amazing! Wang Lan is the best! Go, Wang Lan!’"
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH..." Wang Lan coughed violently.
"At the very least, you could show a little admiration, right?"
"I always have!" Jiang Xinyu said suddenly. "You are, to this day, the only person who has ever earned my complete and heartfelt admiration."
"I like the sound of that! HAHA... I just agreed to an interview with the Vice President. It’s about to start, so I have to go. Bye!"
Staring at the phone, now emitting a busy signal, Jiang Xinyu was slightly taken aback.
Was my hint still not obvious enough?

chapters.title: Chapter 290 The Nine-layer Pagoda is About to Open
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 290 The Nine-layer Pagoda is About to Open
"Hello, dear friends in the audience, and welcome to ’Up Close.’ The hottest topic right now is undoubtedly the globally renowned genius, Wang Lan.
As a freshman, he conquered the Star Martial Toxins that had troubled human civilization since the dawn of history.
Today, we are fortunate to have Wang Lan as our special guest on ’Up Close.’ Wang Lan, please say hello to our audience."
"Hello, everyone. I am Wang Lan," Wang Lan said formally. "This isn’t a live broadcast, is it?"
"No, it’s a recording. We’ll edit it later."
"Speaking of Star Martial Toxins, many of our viewers may not be familiar with them. Wang Lan, could you explain what Star Martial Toxins are and what makes them so special that scientists and medical experts worldwide are helpless against them?"
"Certainly, Host. Star Martial Toxins are similar to viruses. However, unlike viruses, these toxins are activated by Star Power. They possess characteristics of both viruses and Star Martial Skills.
Like viruses, they are tiny and reproduce quickly, able to enter a person’s body through breathing, contact, and other means. And because they are also a type of Star Martial Skill, neither the human immune system nor the immune system of Star Martial Warriors can intercept them.
In the microscopic world, the strength of a Star Martial Warrior doesn’t make any difference to the virus. It’s just that it takes slightly longer to conquer the body of a stronger person.
That’s why Star Martial Toxins are so feared. Regardless of whether you’re at the Star Shine Stage or a Titled Strongman, once infected, you have no effective defense against it.
A potent Star Martial Toxin can instantly kill a Star Shine Stage warrior, and even those at the Star Sea Stage can only hold on for a few tens of seconds.
Furthermore, Star Martial Toxins are indefensible because they are minuscule and can penetrate anything we manufacture. Since they are also a type of Star Martial Skill, they cannot be captured and isolated by scientific methods.
The attack radius of Star Martial Toxins is vast; some can span several kilometers, even tens of kilometers. Within this radius, any unprotected living being without vaccine immunity will perish rapidly."
"Wow, that sounds really terrifying. Luckily, Wang Lan has already developed a vaccine for the Star Martial Toxins. Wang Lan, could you share how you achieved this incredible feat?"
Wang Lan suddenly recalled Dean Nangong’s instructions. The host’s praise was merely a way to ease the atmosphere; he mustn’t let it get to his head and had to remain humble.
"Actually, I don’t think it’s such a great achievement. I was just reading in the library, then suddenly got an inspiration. Eventually, I figured out how to create a vaccine for Star Martial Toxins using a genetic coding formula.
After that, with the help of Mrs. Sun Li, I completed the production of the first Star Martial Toxin Vaccine."
Wang Lan delivered these words with such modesty and humility that even the host’s expression changed, his mouth twitching slightly.
If this isn’t a great achievement... then what is?
"The genetic coding formula you mentioned, is it the one Dr. Wang Qi received the Human Civilization Progress Contribution Award for not long ago? As far as I know, although this formula has been public for two months, there isn’t a single scientist who claims to have learned how to apply it?"
"Um... I’m not sure. Perhaps those scientists want to study the formula’s evolutionary principles. However, if one simply treats it as a plug-and-play formula, it shouldn’t be difficult."
CRACK—
「Two days later,」
when a group of graduate students, all meticulously trained by Mrs. Sun Li and previously berated by Wang Lan, saw him utter these words on TV, the remote control in one of their hands suddenly shattered.
"Not difficult? You call that modest?! ’Not difficult’ my foot! Even Mrs. Sun, who’s incredibly intelligent, still makes frequent mistakes, alright?"
"Wang Lan, I have heard that you have been an academic overachiever since childhood, and were even known as the ’Academic God’ during your time in Suzhou City. How did you come by this title?"
"Well..." Wang Lan hesitated.
"What’s the matter? Can’t you say it?"
"It’s not that. It’s just a bit embarrassing. From elementary school through high school, I always took first place in every exam and competition, so the title just sort of spread. Honestly, I was against it. I just studied a little harder. If others worked as hard, I’m sure many would be better than me!"
In front of the TV, countless parents’ eyes reddened.
So the difference was effort, not talent!
they thought, looking at their children engrossed in video games. Silently, they stood up and reached for the feather duster.
Anyway, the interview went smoothly, and my responses were fluent,
Wang Lan thought.
It satisfied the school’s requirements and aligned with my principle of staying low-key.
Then, after the interview video was broadcast, the nation’s online forums were suddenly flooded with sarcastic doggerel.
"An ancient marvel considered average, vaccines are merely a spark of inspiration. The throne of Academic God seems mundane, genetic coding hardly a challenge."
"Right! Solving a problem that has plagued humanity for millennia isn’t much of an achievement, sure! But that means all the researchers worldwide who have spent thousands of years trying to find a counter to Star Martial Toxins are the incompetent ones, for failing to solve something so ’simple’."
"Yeah, what’s so hard about being an ’Academic God’? It’s just getting first place every time... If I ’eliminated’ all my classmates, I could be an Academic God too."
"Genetic coding not difficult? The world-recognized smartest, Dr. Drulu, said that without half a year of research, he wouldn’t be confident in mastering its application. It seems in Wang Lan’s eyes, nothing in the world is difficult."
"He sounds humble and low-key, but every sentence is a subtle brag. When it comes to humble-bragging, I’d call you the king!"
"Are you inviting me to team up?"
On the school playground, Wang Lan stared in surprise at Yu Ruoyun.
Actually, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun didn’t have much interaction. Apart from sharing a meal at the very beginning, the only other time they had tacitly cooperated was during the incident with Duanmu Yi.
Even outside of school, debates had arisen about whether Wang Lan or Yu Ruoyun was the leading figure of the Flame Emperor lineage’s younger generation. Wang Lan had pretended not to hear them, and he assumed Yu Ruoyun probably did the same.
From my perspective, I can’t even consider Yu Ruoyun a friend,
Wang Lan thought.
I really didn’t expect her to invite me, and also...
"The Nine-layer Pagoda is about to open? How come I haven’t received any notice?"
"The school just posted the announcement. If you walk around campus now, you should see it. I just didn’t expect you to be so indifferent to your surroundings; it seems... you don’t care about your current achievements either."
"You must be joking, Yu Ruoyun. What achievements?" Wang Lan gave a bitter smile. "I’ve been nearly annoyed to death lately. If I had known, I wouldn’t have accepted any interviews."
Yu Ruoyun smiled charmingly. "Is it really about you accepting interviews? It’s fundamentally because the way you talk is too infuriating. Honestly, when I saw your interview, I wanted to hit you with a brick too."
"Let’s not talk about that; it’s embarrassing just mentioning it. I heard the Nine-layer Pagoda is only for seniors to break through their cultivation stages? Is this some kind of benefit for me?"
"Every year, the Nine-layer Pagoda does indeed open for seniors to break through their stages. And it’s not considered a benefit. Even I haven’t been to the Nine-layer Pagoda before. But this time is a little different. Weren’t a hundred thousand Soul Beads just stolen and sold recently?
So, the academy has granted special permission, allowing Galaxy Stage students below their senior year to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda to collect Soul Beads, which can then be exchanged for Academic Credit."
"Academic Credit? I almost forgot about that. Academic Credit can be exchanged for Star Martial Skills, right?"
"Correct. The academy encourages students to earn more Academic Credits. Only with enough Academic Credits can one access stronger Star Martial Skills. This is how resources are allocated through competition."
"Although the academy promised you one S-rank Star Martial Skill and two B-rank ones, that’s to be fulfilled before graduation. There are many powerful Star Martial Skills in the Star Martial Skills Hall. If you want them, come with me to earn Academic Credits," Yu Ruoyun said enticingly.
"Hmm... How many Academic Credits do I need to buy an S-rank Star Martial Skill?"
"At least five hundred!"
"That cheap?" Wang Lan exclaimed.
It seems... I have over a thousand Academic Credits on my student card. By that count, I could easily get four S-rank Star Martial Skills.
"Cheap?" Yu Ruoyun was shocked. "Many students might not even save up three hundred Academic Credits by graduation! I work part-time as the student union president, helping manage school affairs, and I only get ten Academic Credits a month. For each subject, the highest end-of-term evaluation also yields just ten Academic Credits, and that’s assuming perfect scores. Do you think Academic Credits are easy to come by?"
Not easy to come by? I’ve got over a thousand Academic Credits,
Wang Lan muttered.
"Huh? Where did you get so many?"
"Mrs. Sun Li and Professor Zheng Gong each gave me thirty Academic Credits. The school awarded me five hundred for creating the Soul Bead grenades last time, and another five hundred for developing the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine. Plus, I earned another five or six hundred Academic Credits making Soul Bead grenades for the school at ten Academic Credits apiece. So, it feels alright!"
Watching Wang Lan, hands casually in his pockets, Yu Ruoyun had a phrase on the tip of her tongue but hesitated to say it.
He’s a classic case of someone well-fed who doesn’t understand the hunger of others,
she thought.
At school, students’ eyes practically turn red at the mere mention of Academic Credits.
There was even a slogan: "Never let a single Academic Credit slip away!"
"So, are you going?"
"Of course, I am! How could I miss such a great opportunity? But isn’t there a Galaxy Stage requirement? I’m only at the late Star Cloud Stage, so it seems I don’t meet the criteria, right?"
"This time, applications are team-based. A team must have at least four members, with an average strength at the Galaxy Stage.
I’ve already found two seniors. One is a Swift Battle Type, the top speedster of the senior year, with unfathomable strength. If I were to fight him, there’s a high probability I’d be killed instantly. He’s definitely reliable.
The other is named Bai Ji, at peak Star Cloud Stage strength, with exceptional Star Power and Earth and Water attributes. She and that Xiao Zi you encountered in the provincial martial arts competition both possess unfathomable Star Power.
She excels in Earth Attribute terrain-altering Star Martial Skills, capable of instantly changing the landscape. With her on the team, we can always secure a geographical advantage. Plus, she’s a great beauty.
If we add you, a powerful medical Star Martial Warrior, our team’s combat strength will be perfectly balanced."
"What about you?"
"Me? I’m a five-attribute Star Martial Warrior—Wind, Thunder, Water, Fire, and Wood—with relatively balanced strength in all attributes. As for combat strength... it’s so-so. I can last up to thirty minutes against a Star Sea Stage expert."
"Yu Ruoyun, you have such a tactful way of putting things! Star Martial Warrior battles rarely last over thirty minutes. One-on-one, they usually end within fifteen. Lasting thirty minutes means you’re evenly matched with a Star Sea Stage expert."
Yu Ruoyun shrugged. "Something like that."
"I remember Xinyu is your roommate. Why didn’t you choose her?"
Yu Ruoyun’s expression immediately turned serious. "Wang Lan, you must remember this: The Exotic Beasts inside the Nine-layer Pagoda are completely different from what you imagine. They are extremely dangerous. Even if you activate your Phoenix Form, it will still be very dangerous. As for Xinyu’s strength... it’s better for her to wait until after her senior year to go."
Hearing this, Wang Lan understood.

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Not Allowed to Go
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 291: Not Allowed to Go
After submitting their application, Wang Lan, Jiang Xinyu, and the senior Yue Jifeng met with Bai Ji in the library’s reading room.
"This is everyone’s first time entering the Nine-layer Pagoda, so it’s necessary to understand it. The pagoda has nine levels. The Exotic Beasts on the first level are equivalent in strength to those in the beginner’s proving ground, and the second level is equivalent to the intermediate proving ground.
With each level ascended, the strength of the Exotic Beasts increases by one tier. So far, the Nine-layer Pagoda has only been explored up to the fourth level. Our main battlefield will be on the fourth level.
Although the fourth level is perilous, the rewards are the greatest.
The Exotic Beasts on the fourth level generally range from the early to late Star Cloud Stage, far surpassing those in the high-level proving ground. However, this level also contains a large number of lord-level Exotic Beasts, allowing us to collect mid-level or higher Soul Beads to the greatest extent.
However, it’s crucial to note that the mutation rate of the Exotic Beasts inside is very high. Consequently, many Exotic Beasts, though only at the Star Cloud Stage in terms of Star Power, possess the combat strength of the Galaxy Stage due to these mutations.
Therefore, once we enter, we must not take it lightly. Does anyone have any other opinions?"
"Um... why are we choosing such a high difficulty level? It feels very dangerous... Wouldn’t it be safer on the first level? Although the Soul Beads might be of a lower level, we’d surely kill Exotic Beasts many times faster," Wang Lan hurriedly asked.
For Wang Lan, his purpose in hunting Exotic Beasts was to gain skill points. Since one Soul Bead equaled one skill point, he preferred clearing out weaker enemies. From his perspective, challenging higher difficulty levels was definitely a bad trade-off.
"You’re right, but I omitted something that you might not understand. Just now, I said that the academy has broken through to the fourth level. Think of the Nine-layer Pagoda as a container divided into nine levels, which we clear from bottom to top.
If each container were filled with water at different temperatures, what do you think would be the consequence of us clearing one level?"
"Would the water from higher levels flow down to the lower ones?"
"Correct. Each time we clear a level, Exotic Beasts from the level above can move down to the lower one. The competition between each level is intense. Some Exotic Beasts that fail in the struggle are expelled to the level below.
In the beginning, the Nine-layer Pagoda existed as the academy’s proving ground. Not just seniors, but freshmen through seniors could enter for cultivation. Initially, the first three levels were already cleared.
However, several years later, the academy noticed the Exotic Beasts on the lower levels were becoming increasingly stronger, and student casualties were also rising. That’s when they realized that while lower-level Exotic Beasts could not go up, higher-level ones could come down.
When higher-level Exotic Beasts descended to the lower levels, they wreaked havoc on the local ecology. Only the powerful ones survived, leading to the Exotic Beasts within the Nine-layer Pagoda becoming progressively stronger.
Now, having cleared up to the fourth level, the Exotic Beasts there are such that not even senior students can guarantee a safe return. To contain the overall increase in the strength of Exotic Beasts, the academy assigns tasks every year.
From the first to the third levels, some powerful Exotic Beasts are cleared first to curb the rate at which their overall strength increases. As for the fourth level, it becomes a primary target for culling each time the Nine-layer Pagoda is opened.
So it’s not us choosing the fourth level, but the fourth level being the default. Of course, it’s not impossible to stay on the first, second, or third levels. In the past, many students stayed on the third level.
But Wang Lan... our strength should be fully capable of dealing with the fourth level’s Exotic Beasts. You’re not... scared, are you?"
"Scared... that’s impossible. In that case, let’s go with the fourth level."
"Don’t worry, Junior. Your big sis here will protect you," Bai Ji said, patting Wang Lan on the shoulder with the air of a protective older sister.
"Wang Lan, what type is your Medical Attribute Star Martial Technique, and what are its capabilities?" Yue Jifeng suddenly asked. "I need to evaluate our team’s endurance."
"My Medical Star Martial Technique is called Song of Life. It connects healing rays from my body, and I can currently sustain two such rays.
"Unless interrupted or affected, the healing rays will continue as long as I don’t voluntarily disconnect them. Regarding the healing scope, any physical injury can be rapidly regenerated—even a shattered heart, severed limbs, or spilled intestines."
"Oh?" Yue Jifeng’s eyes flashed with surprise. "That powerful? Your healing ability is S-rank or higher, and highly specialized. Are there any limitations?"
"There are. I can’t heal through spatial barriers, and the healing distance cannot exceed twenty meters. Other than that, there are no restrictions."
"Twenty meters... that’s roughly the attack range of a Star Martial Skill."
"Junior, I’m even more convinced by what I said now. I’ll definitely protect you."
"With Wang Lan here, we basically don’t need to worry about injuries. And we don’t need to worry about Star Power depletion when hunting Exotic Beasts. Unless we run out of physical strength, we can keep fighting indefinitely. That’s why I absolutely had to invite Wang Lan."
"In that case, Yu Ruoyun and I will be responsible for damage output and securing kills. Bai Ji will assist us by creating openings, and Wang Lan will stay with Bai Ji. Bai Ji, you must prioritize Wang Lan’s safety."
"Understood!"
"Wait, I’m also very capable of fighting," Wang Lan protested.
"Your primary duty is medical assistance; your secondary role is providing support from the flanks."
After the main discussion was completed, the conversation started to become more relaxed and enjoyable.
"By the way, Yu Ruoyun, what exactly is the Nine-layer Pagoda? From what you’re saying, it sounds different from the proving grounds or Pioneer Spaces?"
"Of course, it’s different!"
"That’s right," Jiang Xinyu chimed in. "When I first entered the academy, I heard seniors mentioning the Nine-layer Pagoda, but even after all these years, I have no idea what it looks like. During my sophomore year, a senior in my dorm was a fourth-year. I remember she was so excited to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda with her class. But later... she didn’t come out. The school announcement said... she died in battle."
"The origins of the Nine-layer Pagoda are impossible to trace now. Legend says it’s a treasure left behind by immortals," Yu Ruoyun explained.
"What?" Wang Lan lifted his head, looking utterly confused. "Immortals? That’s not sci-fi."
"If the Demon Clan can appear, why can’t immortals appear?"
"Hold on, we can understand the Demon Clan as another kind of life form or civilization in the universe. But this thing about immortals, I really can’t comprehend. Is it like in mythological novels?"
"If you prefer that explanation, then consider this: immortals were simply powerful humans from the Ancient Era. The Nine-layer Pagoda is a Star Palace Artifact they forged. Can you accept that?"
"Alright, no problem."
"The Nine-layer Pagoda is a fifty-meter-high conical pagoda hidden within the back mountains of the academy. Yet the space inside it seems infinitely large, each layer boundless."
"Moreover, it seems the Pagoda contains treasures left by these immortals. At least within the first three layers, students undergoing trials have found Star Palace Artifacts."
"So you’re saying the Nine-layer Pagoda was meant for disciples or descendants of immortals to undergo trials?"
"Very likely! It was discovered in a Different Dimensional Space that opened from Kunlun Valley two hundred years ago. After Modu Star Martial Academy was established, the Pagoda was placed within the academy grounds.
"And I’ve also heard that the Azure Dragon Skill was obtained alongside the Nine-layer Pagoda."
"The Qing Emperor’s Azure Dragon Skill? The signature treasure of Modu Star Martial Academy?" Bai Ji exclaimed, her eyes suddenly sparkling.
"Yes! For everyone, the Nine-layer Pagoda represents an opportunity."
Elsewhere, in the vice dean’s office, Professor Zheng Gong slammed his palm on the desk in front of Nangong Meng.
"Dean Nangong, who authorized Wang Lan to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda? This is ridiculous!"
Nangong Meng was initially bewildered by Professor Zheng Gong’s lion-like fury, but his expression quickly turned grim.
So, Professor Zheng Gong, you’re playing the seniority card now? True, you’re an old hand at the academy, a first-class Spiritual Engraving Master, and a tenured professor. But I am the vice dean! In terms of seniority, reputation, and contributions to the academy, you should know your place. Where do you get the audacity to slam my desk? Are you trying to start a rebellion?
"Professor Zheng Gong, please watch your tone."
"Dean Nangong, I just want to know who permitted Wang Lan to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda?"
"I did!" Nangong Meng shot up from his seat, a cold gleam in his eyes as he retorted.
The other teachers in the office, seeing that the situation was turning sour, quickly slipped out to inform the Dean.
"Why?"
"Although Wang Lan is only in the late Star Cloud Stage, his combat strength is at the peak of the Galaxy Stage. Furthermore, the average strength of his team has already reached the early Galaxy Stage. I had no reason to refuse his application."
"You are not unaware of the dangers within the Nine-layer Pagoda. Every year, dozens of students die. What if Wang Lan has an accident inside?"
"What about it? Wang Lan is a student, but he’s also a warrior. Other students can go, so why can’t he? Even Yu Ruoyun is going. Why should he be an exception?
"Besides, I didn’t tell him to go; he applied himself. I simply approved his application according to regulations."
"His value isn’t merely as a warrior! He invented the Soul Bead grenade and the Star Martial Toxins Vaccine! He’s only eighteen! If he’s lost in the Nine-layer Pagoda, it would be a catastrophe for all of humanity.
"No, his pass must be revoked. Otherwise, I’ll take this matter directly to the Dean."
"Heh..." Nangong Meng chuckled coldly. "If you want to revoke his pass, you do it. I see no grounds for me to do so. As for taking this to the Dean... you’re too slow. Director Sun Li already raised the issue."
"What? And the result?"
"The result? We follow procedure. Besides, aren’t you underestimating Wang Lan?" Nangong Meng said calmly, slowly sitting down and tidying the documents on his desk.
"Wang Lan’s strength is top-tier, even among seniors. And look at his team: Yu Ruoyun, Yue Jifeng, Bai Ji. That’s an exceptional lineup. Even if dozens of students perish each year, it won’t be him."
"Wait, who is this Bai Ji? What level is she?"
After they split up from the library, everyone began preparing to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda. Wang Lan was about to look for Jiang Xinyu when, unexpectedly, she messaged him first.
It was the weekend. Wang Lan, riding the high-tech electric motorcycle recently assigned to him by the Tianjian Bureau, took Jiang Xinyu to Phoenix Plaza.
After getting off the motorcycle, Jiang Xinyu flirtatiously smoothed her long hair. "You know, in all my life, this is the first time I’ve ever ridden an electric motorcycle."
"Then next time, I’ll let you experience what it’s like to ride a bicycle," Wang Lan replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: I Have a Good Gift for You
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 292: I Have a Good Gift for You
"Mr. Fengying told me this morning... next month, he’s leading a group of juniors to assist in the Middle East. He asked if I wanted to go, and I agreed," Jiang Xinyu said, stirring her drink and looking at Wang Lan with some apprehension.
"Mm, you’re always cautious, and your strength isn’t bad. I don’t have much to worry about. Go ahead. Today, Yu Ruoyun also invited me to team up to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda, and I agreed."
A sharp gaze, like a knife, shot towards him.
"Why didn’t you discuss it with me?"
Wang Lan had a retort ready. You agree to go abroad without discussing it with me, and now you’re reacting so strongly to me participating in a school trial? Talk about a double standard...
But under Jiang Xinyu’s intense gaze, Wang Lan didn’t try to argue much.
"She values my medical abilities. I’m going as medical support, and she has specifically arranged for people to protect me. Besides, this is a school trial ground, with teachers supervising. The danger level is far lower than you going abroad. Yu Ruoyun is at the peak of the Galaxy Stage, but I’ve discovered her true strength is likely far greater. Her real strength should be at the Star Sea Stage."
"Yes! I know that. She has the Azure Dragon Skill and a Star Martial Skill similar to your Phoenix Form, called Dragon Emperor Form." Jiang Xinyu’s expression softened considerably after Wang Lan’s explanation.
"You’re different now. You’re not just an ordinary warrior; you’re also a globally renowned scientist..."
"Wait a minute! Me? A scientist?" Wang Lan always felt that title was far removed from him. Besides, he was just a freshman. Without a doctorate or a professorship, how could he be called a scientist?
"Yes! Your contribution to the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine is irreplaceable. Therefore, you’re naturally considered one of the great scientists who have influenced human history. There’s significant international acclaim for your work. So, no matter what, you cannot put yourself in danger."
"You’re overthinking it. I am who I am; I was before, and I will be in the future. These empty titles mean nothing. I’m a scientist now, and soon enough, they’ll call me an inventor. Isn’t it all a bit much?"
"An inventor? What have you come up with this time?"
"I invented a type of Soul Bead grenade. It involves imprinting a Star Martial Skill onto a Soul Bead. When you throw the Soul Bead, it activates the Star Martial Skill, just like a grenade... Wait, are you done eating?"
"Hm?" Jiang Xinyu struggled to keep up with Wang Lan’s scattered thoughts but nodded nonetheless.
"Come with me."
Holding Jiang Xinyu’s hand, Wang Lan hurriedly rode the electric scooter back to the university. Looking at the school gate, Jiang Xinyu felt a little dejected.
She had finally managed to get some time with Wang Lan, planning for it to be a date. And what does he do? After one meal, he drags her right back here?
But seeing Wang Lan’s excited expression, Jiang Xinyu became somewhat curious about where he was taking her.
The university’s laboratory building was primarily for students’ lab classes. Of course, it was also where some professors and scholars conducted their research. To have a private laboratory in this building, one had to be a world-class scientist. And Wang Lan, as it happened, had one.
Although not large, less than seventy square meters, it still made Jiang Xinyu look at him in a new light.
This laboratory had been specially approved for Wang Lan by Dean Nangong after he invented the Soul Bead grenades. The purpose? To have Wang Lan produce more Soul Bead grenades—ideally, a hundred S-level Soul Bead grenades a day. The more, the better. Of course, it wasn’t pro bono work. Besides a salary, he also received Academic Credits.
"This is where I make the Soul Bead grenades. Come, I’ll show you some good stuff."
Saying this, he opened a safe and took out three aluminum alloy briefcases.
"These briefcases contain Soul Bead grenades I made. The fire-attribute, medium-quality Soul Beads are imprinted with the S-level Star Martial Skill, Earth Surge Fire Sea. The non-attribute, medium-quality Soul Beads are imprinted with Purple Flame Arrow, and the blue ones contain Thunder Snake Drill.
And these white ones—I made a few extra. They contain my Medical Star Martial Technique, Song of Life. Medium-quality Soul Beads can heal fatal injuries. The smaller ones are for minor injuries.
Use the small Soul Beads for non-fatal injuries. These are all for you."
"For me? But this is school property! You’re giving them to me? No, I can’t!" Jiang Xinyu quickly waved her hands.
"I’ve already submitted the ones made for the school. These were made from leftover materials, so they’re mine."
"Soul Beads don’t have leftover materials, do they?"
"Soul Beads themselves might not have ’leftover materials,’ but their creation process has failure rates. Do you think making Soul Bead grenades is easy? It’s precision work. A Level Seven Spiritual Engraving Master achieving a thirty percent success rate is already impressive. My success rate is fifty percent, and the school is thrilled."
"Fifty percent?" Jiang Xinyu’s brow twitched slightly. "So, the other fifty percent—the ’failures’—are all here?"
"Yeah. Since Soul Bead grenades are handmade, this is all I could accumulate in a week. Anyway, you’re not going abroad until next month. I’ll make more for you after I come out of the Nine-layer Pagoda."
"This... Is this really okay?" Jiang Xinyu still felt uneasy. Although these were valuable items, and it would be a lie to say she didn’t want them—especially the medical Soul Beads. With Wang Lan not by her side, Jiang Xinyu felt insecure, but having these made her feel as if she were still fighting alongside him.
"What’s not okay about it? Would it be better to let Professor Zheng waste them?"
Jiang Xinyu’s eyes darted. "Wait, does this mean your skill in Spiritual Engraving has surpassed Professor Zheng Gong’s? I remember you only started learning Spiritual Engraving after you came here, right?"
"Probably. Actually, Spiritual Engraving is just like Star Martial Art; once the Ren Du meridians are cleared, learning it is very fast."
"The Ren Du meridians?"
"It’s about fundamental conditions. Think about it: if someone with a photographic memory enters a memorization contest, isn’t that like cheating? Others need to memorize, but he just needs to glance at it.
Similarly, there are only three conditions for Spiritual Engraving: exceptional spiritual power, exceptional control over one’s mind and Star Power, and understanding and mastering the methods of Spiritual Engraving.
I was naturally at the maximum level for the first two conditions. As for the last one, I understood it just by reading some books. So, learning it wasn’t difficult at all. I think Xie Sisi is also excelling in Spiritual Engraving. You two must have been in contact."
"That’s true. Sisi is progressing very quickly. In just two months, she seems to have reached the peak of the Star Shine Stage. Don’t change the subject!" Jiang Xinyu’s gaze swept over the Soul Bead grenades, and a cunning smile suddenly appeared on her face.
"The academy suddenly raised the graduation standard for Spiritual Engraving to Level Seven. That was because of you, wasn’t it?"
"That wasn’t me. I didn’t do it. Don’t spread rumors."
"You just gave the classic three denials. It must have been you. So, that means the production of Soul Bead grenades will soon be part of the curriculum. And passing Level Seven actually means being able to make Soul Bead grenades, right?"
"As expected of Jiang Xinyu. You figured it out so quickly."
"Hmph! Do you know how many upperclassmen have sworn to find the person who caused their graduation to be delayed, or even made it impossible for them to graduate? One senior student even offered a reward of five mid-grade Soul Beads."
"You wouldn’t sell me out, I’m sure."
"Oh, you’re so sure? That’s not just money; that’s five mid-grade Soul Beads. With five mid-grade Soul Beads, I might be able to break through from the middle Star Cloud Stage to the late Star Cloud Stage. You’re already in the late Star Cloud Stage, and I’m still not."
"There are twenty right here in front of you. Besides, how could you bear to see me hunted down by the upperclassmen? Oh, right, I prepared these especially for you."
Saying this, he pushed three mid-grade Soul Beads towards Jiang Xinyu.
"What? More Soul Bead grenades?"
"No, these are Crescent Arrow, Star Cloud Sword Dance, and the Phantom Tracer Star Martial Skill. As soon as I learned Spiritual Engraving, I immediately crafted these three Star Martial Skills. They’re all non-attribute, so you can cultivate them."
"I..." At that moment, Jiang Xinyu was truly moved.
The man before her, though frustratingly dense and never having explicitly confessed his feelings, showed his affection for Jiang Xinyu in such a direct and pure way.
Wang Lan had given her almost everything he could! No amount of sweet talk could compare to what Wang Lan had given her today.
"Thank you..."
"Why are you thanking me? Since it’s just the two of us here in Modu City, of course, we should support each other through thick and thin."
"I’ll just take these three Star Martial Skills then. You keep those Soul Bead grenades for yourself."
"What use would they be to me? They’re all Star Martial Skills I already know. Why would I need Soul Bead grenades? Can’t I cast them myself? Besides, I won’t have to worry about running out of Star Power in the Nine-layer Pagoda, so I don’t need them at all. Don’t be so hesitant; that’s not the Jiang Xinyu I know."
"Hmph! Then, thanks!"
"Attagirl!"
Just as he and Jiang Xinyu left the laboratory building, his phone rang. Seeing it was Sun Li calling, Wang Lan had to part ways with Jiang Xinyu and head to the medical department.
In Sun Li’s office, Wang Lan felt somewhat apprehensive.
His eyes kept darting to Sun Li’s unpredictable expression.
Her expression was a clear signal: *I want to get angry, but I can’t find a reason. Quick, give me a reason to lose my temper!*
Faced with Sun Li in this state, Wang Lan tried to remain as still and unresponsive as a statue, focusing intently inward.
But clearly, Wang Lan’s strategy failed. It wasn’t that Sun Li lacked a reason to be angry; rather, she had too many and couldn’t decide where to start.
SMACK!
Sun Li slammed her hand on the desk. "Wang Lan, what were you thinking? What kind of place is the Nine-layer Pagoda? Even fourth-year students face immense danger there, yet you, a mere freshman, dared to sign up? Are you tired of living?"
"Teacher, my strength isn’t inferior to most fourth-year students..."
"What about combat experience? Can your combat experience compare to theirs? They’ve been to Pioneer Space, helped the military carry out missions, and even gone abroad to fight for other countries. Do you think it’s like playing house in the training grounds?"
