"Teacher, you’re underestimating me, aren’t you? I’m an elite captain in the Tianjian Bureau, after all. No matter how ferocious Exotic Beasts are, can they be more dangerous than spies from the Demon Clan?"
"..."
Sun Li was rendered speechless by his retort and couldn’t think of a comeback.
Exotic Beasts, no matter how ferocious, are certainly no match for the Demon Clan. It seems this young man actually has as much combat experience as a fourth-year...
"That’s still unacceptable! What do you think your status is? Don’t you realize your own value? If I had known, I would have made you follow Professor Zheng Gong and focus on Spiritual Engraving."
"That’s not what you said back then, Teacher. You said..."
"Well, I regret it now! Can’t I?"
"Fine! You’re always right."
"Who’s in your team?"
"Yu Ruoyun, Yue Jifeng, and Bai Ji."
"I know Yue Jifeng; he’s quite capable. Who is Bai Ji? Well, never mind. With Yu Ruoyun and Yue Jifeng, the team’s strength should be adequate."
"Thank you for your concern, Teacher. I’m joining the team as a Medical Star Martial Warrior this time."
"Hmph! The decision is made, so saying more is useless. Anyway..."
As she spoke, Sun Li slowly unfastened the spatial storage item she wore. "This contains a synthesis device, the type we often use, but it’s a miniature version. There are Poisonous Beasts in the Nine-layer Pagoda, so you might need it."
"That’s too valuable, I..."
"You have to return it! Did you think I was giving it to you as a gift?!" Sun Li glared and snapped.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 Buying Star Martial Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 293 Buying Star Martial Skill
Wang Lan could understand Sun Li’s feelings; after all, just moments ago, he had felt the same eagerness to give Jiang Xinyu everything he possibly could. Therefore, Wang Lan was now filled with gratitude towards Sun Li.
"Don’t look at me like that. If you really want to thank me, then make it back alive. There are still tens of thousands of Star Martial Toxins in the school’s inventory waiting for you to develop vaccines."
"Please rest assured, Teacher. I won’t die content until I’ve developed vaccines for all the Star Martial Toxins in the school’s inventory," Wang Lan said earnestly.
Ever since Jiang Xinyu had obtained the two Star Martial Skills from Wang Lan, she had gone into closed-door training. She wasn’t like Wang Lan, who worked sporadically; hence, she had already completed the first semester of Nine Subjects Science on her own. The school always facilitated students who wanted to engage in closed-door training for researching Star Martial Skills.
There were three days left until the opening of the Nine-layer Pagoda. In three days, anyone could, at best, adjust their state of mind. Enhancing one’s strength was out of the question. But for Wang Lan, three days were enough to accomplish a lot. With over sixteen hundred Academic Credits on his student card, Wang Lan decided to visit the Star Martial Skill Collection Museum.
Although he had guessed four months ago that he possessed all attributes, he had never had the opportunity to learn all-attribute Star Martial Skills. Now, it was time. He had previously felt it unnecessary to learn too many attributes; Lightning and Fire Attributes were already enough for him. But "enough" merely meant compensating for the vulnerability of being countered by other attributes.
Now that he had reached the Star Cloud Stage, and with the Solar Seal capable of storing Star Power, Wang Lan’s Star Power reserves had become quite vast—though not as abnormal as those with extraordinary Star Power.
To truly become versatile, he had to master all attributes. He didn’t need many Star Martial Skills of each attribute, but he had to have some.
Eighty percent of the Star Martial Skills in the collection museum were provided by the nation, with only a small part developed by the academy itself. As for many secret techniques and forbidden arts, they weren’t available for exchange even if one had the Academic Credits. One had to apply to the school and get approval to learn them.
The Star Martial Skill Collection Museum was the soul of Modu City Star Martial Academy and a Holy Land in the hearts of all students. Many students, even without enough Academic Credits, would visit the museum just to feast their eyes on those Star Martial Skills.
The collection museum was laid out like a typical museum, categorized by attribute, with specialized areas for each. Next to each Star Martial Skill, LCD screens continuously played footage of its activation, even including its use on the battlefield.
Written introductions coupled with video commentary relentlessly enticed the visiting students. From this, Wang Lan thought he understood the school’s nefarious intentions.
I just love seeing the look on your faces when you’re drooling with envy but can’t have what I have. Truly wicked.
Upon entering the collection museum, the first area was the Water Attribute section. Water is the source of all things, and similarly, the Water Attribute is the most versatile. Water can be used for Elemental Attacks as well as physical attacks; it can provide offensive damage and also serve as a defense; it can change terrain and adapt to land, sea, and air.
Water in its mist form can be used for sensing, scouting, and confusing. In its liquid form, it’s used for cutting, impacting, compressing, and defending. In its solid form, it allows for freezing, shield bashing, cutting, and sealing. According to the introduction, mastering the Water Attribute could make one invincible...
The majority of Water Attribute Star Martial Skills were C-rank or B-rank; even A-rank and above were scarce, with the only one being the Water Severing Knife. Created with a high-pressure water jet to form a blade, it could cut through anything within a thirty-meter radius, including earth and rock, which normally countered water.
Wang Lan liked this Star Martial Skill very much. The Water Severing Knife not only possessed powerful cutting force but also terrifying impact force. Without much hesitation, Wang Lan snapped his fingers. "Senior Sister, I would like the Water Severing Knife Star Martial Skill."
"Junior Brother, give me your student card."
The moment Wang Lan spoke, several girls nearby, who had been drooling over the Star Martial Skills, immediately turned to look at him. Their expressions made Wang Lan quite pleased.
"Junior Brother, are you a freshman?" the Senior Sister asked as she took Wang Lan’s student card. "Junior Brother, Star Martial Skills can’t be bought with money, only with Academic Credits. You’ve just started your first year; your Academic Credits certainly won’t be enough."
"You should check my Academic Credits... I think they’re enough."
"Heh heh heh..." The Senior Sister chuckled softly. "School only started two months ago. The most Academic Credits you could have saved in two months would only buy a C-rank Star Martial Skill, and that’s if you seized every opportunity to earn Academic Credits since the first day. Even without looking..."
As she spoke, the Senior Sister had already placed Wang Lan’s student card on the Magnetic Induction Table.
"BEEP BEEP BEEP—"
The Senior Sister’s voice stopped abruptly. Her eyes widened in disbelief as she stared at the number on the card reader’s display, then back at Wang Lan.
"These Academic Credits... did you steal them?"
"Senior Sister? Can Academic Credits be stolen within the school?"
"No!... But isn’t this too much? Junior Brother, listen to me. This Water Severing Knife is just an A-rank Star Martial Skill. I have an S-rank Star Martial Skill here, Giant Eating Silkworm. Once it captures an enemy, it will devour any number of people completely. Wouldn’t you consider this Star Martial Skill?"
"No, thank you."
"Then, take a look at this one. How about the S-rank Star Martial Skill, Imitation Crystal? This is the ultimate version of the Extreme Wall of Water, hailed as the absolute defense among Water Attribute Star Martial Skills. A Crystal Wall before you, and even a Demon God would be helpless. Any attack will be negated or even reflected by the Crystal Wall."
"Is this evolved from the Extreme Wall of Water?"
"It should be... So, why not buy this one?" the Senior Sister asked, her eyes shining.
"How much is your commission?"
"One percent!" In her haste, the Senior Sister let it slip. As soon as the words escaped her, a blush crept onto her cheeks. "Junior Brother, you’re really cunning."
"Forget it, I’ll look elsewhere."
"Junior Brother, reconsider. Water Attribute Star Martial Skills are all-purpose; there’s always one that suits you..."
Wang Lan left without looking back.
Although the Imitation Crystal was indeed very powerful, and Wang Lan did need such a Star Martial Skill, since it evolved from the Extreme Wall of Water, he could obtain the Extreme Wall of Water from Jiang Xinyu and then upgrade it to Imitation Crystal. Moreover, Wang Lan had never believed in so-called absolute defenses.
A so-called absolute defense simply means the attack power hasn’t reached its tolerance limit yet.
"Senior Sister, Senior Sister, how many Academic Credits did that freshman have?" The girls who had been watching nearby crowded around and asked after Wang Lan left.
"One thousand seven hundred. An A-rank Star Martial Skill is only one hundred Academic Credits; he could buy nearly twenty A-rank Star Martial Skills with that amount!"
"HISS—"
"A freshman can earn that many Academic Credits?"
"Generally speaking, it’s impossible. Many seniors, even by their fourth year, might not accumulate five hundred Academic Credits in total. I really don’t know how he managed to get so many."
"Could he have bought them with money?"
"Impossible. Academic Credits are personal and non-transferable. How could they be bought or sold?"
"Wow, I suddenly realize that guy from earlier was really handsome..." one girl sighed, covering her cheeks.
"Do you think he’s handsome? You’re just drooling over his Academic Credits!"
After passing the Water Attribute Star Martial Skills, Wang Lan arrived at the Wood Attribute section. He had once considered Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills, like Water Attribute ones, to be among the weakest. But as he matured in this world, he gradually realized how significant his cognitive bias had been.
Wood Attribute Star Martial Warriors were rare, but they had forged many mythically powerful existences.
Not to mention others, the Eastern Azure Emperor himself, aside from his powerful Azure Dragon Skill, was most proficient in Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills. His signature secret technique, Life Firmament, could instantly create a defensive expanse capable of withstanding cataclysmic attacks.
The special property of Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills is Star Power absorption. However, not everyone can comprehend the Law of Star Power absorption. This is similar to the Earth Attribute: an Earth Attribute Warrior who cannot master the Law of Gravity is merely a durable punching bag, but once the Law of Gravity is mastered, their power becomes world-shattering.
Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills were the same; if one could not comprehend Star Power absorption, their attack power was merely for show. Duanmu Yi had previously comprehended Star Power absorption, but unfortunately, he encountered an anomaly like Wang Lan. Objectively speaking, Duanmu Yi was considered one of the more formidable experts at Modu City Star Martial Academy.
Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills are mostly control-type skills, an attribute that grows stronger against tougher opponents and excels in the late game.
"Junior Brother, looking for a Star Martial Skill?" an unsavory voice inquired. A middle-aged man with a conspicuously full beard approached Wang Lan.
"Junior Brother, Wood Attribute Star Martial Warriors are quite rare. How come I’ve never seen you?"
"I’m a freshman. It’s normal for an uncle like you to not have seen me," Wang Lan said, his eyes fixed on the S-rank Wood Attribute Star Martial Skill at the very top, not wavering in the slightest.
Uncle?
The temperature seemed to drop several degrees instantly, and Wang Lan snapped back to alertness.
"I’m only twenty-two! You called me uncle?"
"Ah? Sorry, I didn’t mean to."
The man gently stroked his impressive beard. "You think this is a beard? Wrong. This is my fetal hair. How can today’s junior brothers be so unobservant? Well, what do you want?"
"Sentient Beings!"
"COUGH COUGH COUGH—" The man coughed forcefully a few times. "What did you say? Sentient Beings? That’s an S-rank Star Martial Skill, you know! Don’t even think about it without five hundred Academic Credits. Sentient Beings is an area-of-effect Star Martial Skill with a three-hundred-meter range."
"Yes, I know. I’ll buy this one," Wang Lan said, holding out his student card.
"Are you messing with me? You, a freshman... Big Boss!"
When Wang Lan’s student card was placed on the sensor, the man was nearly scared silly.
One thousand six hundred Academic Credits! Did you hack into the academy’s Academic Credit database or something?
But this cynical thought could only remain a thought; it was fundamentally impossible for anyone to hack into the Academic Credit database. After all, Academic Credits weren’t just exchanged by the system; there were also manual operations. Even if you controlled the academy’s system, you couldn’t transfer so many credits into your card.
Sentient Beings was somewhat similar to Deep Forest Emergence from Fire Shadow. However, Deep Forest Emergence spanned several kilometers, even tens of kilometers, while Sentient Beings only covered a few hundred meters.
Their natures were also fundamentally different. Sentient Beings spread vines outward from the Caster, which grew thicker and larger, eventually engulfing a three-hundred-meter radius. This process consumed a vast amount of the Caster’s Star Power.
Once the technique took shape, it no longer consumed Star Power, and the entire network of vines became an extension of the Caster’s body. Any creature entering the area would be sensed by the Caster and attacked.
Furthermore, if the Caster had comprehended the Law of Star Power absorption, they could use this Star Martial Skill to hunt and restore their Star Power. Additionally, any attacks maintained by Star Power could be absorbed.
Combining offense and defense with a large area of effect, it was the most balanced Star Martial Skill in the Wood Attribute.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Entering the Nine-layer Pagoda
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 294: Entering the Nine-layer Pagoda
It was already dark when Wang Lan returned from the Star Martial Arts Collection Museum. This was even after he had quickened his pace while shopping later on.
In the end, Wang Lan only brought himself to return after spending all his points.
For the Water Attribute, he bought a Water Severing Knife. For the Wood Attribute, he purchased Sentient Beings. For the Earth Attribute, he acquired the S-Rank Light and Heavy Replacement Skill and the S-Rank Door to Hell. He already possessed Fire and Thunder Attribute Star Martial Skills, so he didn’t buy any more of those. Finally, he bought an S-Rank Wind Attribute Star Martial Skill called Wind Capturing Net, which was also an area-of-effect cutting Star Martial Skill.
The four S-Rank Star Martial Skills cost him 1,600 points, and that was after receiving a discount for purchasing four S-Rank Star Martial Skills at once.
Back at the dormitory, He Jing and Ming Guodong were playing video games in the living room. "Wang Lan, you’re back? I heard you signed up for the Nine-layer Pagoda?"
"Mhm! Are you guys going?"
"Go? Fat chance! We’re not lucky enough to be escorted by Princess Yu Ruoyun. Freshmen like us, at the Star Cloud Stage, would just be cannon fodder even if we were stubborn enough to go. You be careful too. Even with Princess Yu Ruoyun looking out for you, senior students die in the Nine-layer Pagoda every year. On average, those seniors are at the Galaxy Stage of strength."
"He Jing, stop worrying about Wang Lan. Did you forget he has the Phoenix Form?"
"Oh, right! What was I worried about? With your Phoenix Form, you should be stronger than most senior students. But still, be careful. It’s very dangerous in there."
"Understood. When I get back, I’ll treat you guys to hot pot..."
Before he could finish, He Jing quickly clapped a hand over Wang Lan’s mouth, even forgetting to push the tower in his game.
"Damn it, why are you jinxing yourself by setting up a flag like that?"
Wang Lan smiled, returned to his room, and closed the door. He put down his backpack and took out five metal boxes. Over the past two months, Wang Lan had accumulated 60,000 skill points by developing vaccines and had been reluctant to use them.
Five Star Martial Skills—just enough to learn the basics. As for mastering them, that would be impossible before entering the Nine-layer Pagoda.
「Three days passed in a flash.」
In the blink of an eye, it was time for the Nine-layer Pagoda to open. Outside the academy’s rear mountain, the eight senior year classes lined up in neat formations and entered the Nine-layer Pagoda one by one.
Jiang Xinyu clung tightly to Wang Lan’s hand, her face etched with worry. She had recently spent time browsing the campus forums, specifically looking up posts about the dangers of the Nine-layer Pagoda.
The senior students had ranked the university’s various trials by difficulty. Normal difficulty involved closing suddenly appearing Different Dimensional Spaces. These were often caused by some idiots who used Space Stones to open Different Dimensional Spaces but then couldn’t manage them, so academy students had to clean up their messes. Medium difficulty involved internships in Pioneer Spaces. Hard difficulty meant going abroad to support small nations ravaged by Different Dimensional Spaces. The Nine-layer Pagoda, however, was a trial ranked above hard difficulty but below hell difficulty.
Even those at the Galaxy Stage could die inside if they weren’t careful.
"Xinyu, don’t worry. Leave Wang Lan to me. In ten days, I’ll return a whole Wang Lan to you," Yu Ruoyun said, patting Jiang Xinyu’s shoulder reassuringly.
"Exactly! Junior Sister Jiang Xinyu, don’t worry. Wang Lan will definitely be fine with us."
Jiang Xinyu looked at Yu Ruoyun and Yue Jifeng, a top expert among the seniors, and only then did she finally release Wang Lan’s hand.
"I’ll wait for you out here. In ten days, you absolutely must come out."
"Don’t worry! Am I the kind of person who would act recklessly?"
As the contingent entered the Nine-layer Pagoda, it was just as the rumors described: each floor a different world, each new vista a vast ocean. After passing through a golden gateway, an endless expanse of mountains and rivers stretched before them.
In the distance, mountain ranges undulated endlessly. Some were bare rock, while others were covered in dense, green forests. As far as the eye could see, there was no end in sight.
"First, we’ll follow the main force to sweep the stronger Exotic Beast groups on the first floor. Then, we’ll proceed floor by floor up to the fourth."
The large contingent advanced, sweeping everything before them. Before reaching the fourth floor, all the students, guided by their teachers, split into four columns and advanced in four different directions to hunt. Wang Lan’s group of four was in the fourth column, heading north.
"Bai Ji—"
"Understood!"
Wang Lan’s group of four arrived outside a tribe of Exotic Beasts resembling wild dogs. Under Yu Ruoyun’s command, the four of them executed their tactics with perfect coordination.
Star Power flickered around Bai Ji. RUMBLE—
The earth suddenly began to tremble violently. As it shook, the ground beneath their feet abruptly rose, and the Mane Hunting Dog tribe before them grew alert.
Following a series of barks and howls that rose one after another, countless Mane Hunting Dogs quickly gathered, warily observing their surroundings.
The ground beneath Wang Lan rapidly elevated. From his vantage point, a ring of earthen walls suddenly rose around the Mane Hunting Dogs. It was as if geological transformations that normally take eons were compressed into mere minutes. Several kilometers of terrain were altered, all by a Star Martial Skill deployed by a girl with a baby face.
"Meteor Fire Rain!"
Yu Ruoyun suddenly pointed to the heavens. Fiery red Star Power surged from her body, coalescing into a massive, crimson Array. She flung the Array high into the sky, where it blazed above the Mane Hunting Dogs’ heads like an ornament embedded in the firmament.
Suddenly, hundreds of fiery red meteors erupted from the Array, crashing down with immense force onto the Mane Hunting Dogs’ encampment.
BOOM! RUMBLE!
A barrage of deafening explosions erupted. Hundreds of Mane Hunting Dogs were crushed to death by the dense shower of meteors. Countless more were injured by the concussive shockwaves.
"AWOOOO—" A series of panicked howls erupted. The surviving hundreds of Mane Hunting Dogs quickly converged and charged toward an opening Bai Ji had intentionally left.
The gap was long and narrow, stretching for several hundred meters. At its choke point, Wang Lan and Yue Jifeng had already taken their positions.
Wang Lan crouched slightly, pressing his hands to the ground. "Earth Surge Fire Sea!"
WHOOSH! A sea of fire erupted before Wang Lan. It billowed and rolled like a tidal wave, surging towards the madly charging Mane Hunting Dogs. Even knowing it was a sea of fire ahead, the dogs, already in a full charge, couldn’t stop and plunged headlong into the inferno.
Heat waves shimmered, and Wang Lan narrowed his eyes slightly.
Suddenly, several figures flickered within the blaze. Mane Hunting Dogs, wreathed in flames, burst through the wall of fire and charged at Wang Lan.
They had been peacefully lazing about in their encampment—even though there was no actual sun overhead, they had been relaxed. The sudden attack had already filled them with rage.
While fleeing, they were ambushed by Wang Lan’s Earth Surge Fire Sea. Now, severely wounded, their fury blazed even hotter. Seeing the culprit before them, the Mane Hunting Dogs’ eyes instantly turned bloodshot.
"We’ll kill you—"
Mouths agape, they unleashed torrents of moon-white wind blades that swept toward Wang Lan and Yue Jifeng like a crazed pack of wolves.
"Gate of The Underworld—"
Suddenly, within the narrow passage, a bizarre gate materialized. It was constructed from massive stones and carved with eerie Ghost Face patterns.
Hailed as the strongest defense of the Earth Attribute, the Gate of The Underworld successfully acted as a valve, sealing the passage as if tightening the mouth of a sack.
Wind blades normally possessed strong corrosive power against Earth Attribute defenses, but they were useless against the Gate of The Underworld. The instant the wind blades were blocked, a series of violent impact sounds echoed.
The Mane Hunting Dogs, fearless of death, slammed into the Gate of The Underworld. They battered it until their skulls cracked and brains splattered, yet they couldn’t budge the gate an inch. Their charge was forced to a halt, but Yue Jifeng’s attack had already begun.
In an instant, Yue Jifeng’s figure vanished, transforming into countless afterimages before Wang Lan’s eyes. The afterimages appeared and then disappeared in a flash. By the time the last afterimage faded, Yue Jifeng had already passed through the pack of Mane Hunting Dogs and reappeared on the other side.
"Moon Falling Snow—" Yue Jifeng gently slid his blade back into its sheath, his voice soft, like a wisp of smoke.
SLICE—
All the Mane Hunting Dogs suddenly spurted green blood in unison. Almost instantly, their heads tumbled to the ground.
Witnessing this spectacle, Wang Lan couldn’t help but draw in a sharp, cold breath.
That was terrifying.
Yu Ruoyun’s Meteor Fire Rain had been grand and imposing, but it hadn’t sent a true chill down Wang Lan’s spine. However, Yue Jifeng’s single slash, which decapitated over a hundred Mane Hunting Dogs in less than a second...
Now *that* was chilling.
He truly lives up to his name as the top speedster of the senior year,
Wang Lan thought.
That speed has completely redefined my understanding of the limits of velocity.
A tribe of nearly one thousand Mane Hunting Dogs was effortlessly decimated by Wang Lan’s team of four. Such coordination, such combat prowess—even the teachers observing from a distance and providing support had to describe it as perfect.
The first floor seemed boundless, but in less than half a day, the four columns had swept through, and nearly all the powerful Exotic Beast tribes had been wiped clean.
Within the Nine-layer Pagoda, each floor had four entrances leading to the floor above. This was the reason for splitting into four columns. Wang Lan’s fourth column, apparently the strongest, was the first to enter the second floor.
The Exotic Beasts on the second floor were clearly a tier stronger than those on the first. There was also a greater variety of species, and a higher proportion of powerful individuals. Moreover, they would occasionally encounter mutant Exotic Beasts that appeared harmless but possessed freakishly immense power.
But for a floor where the general threat level was mostly at the peak of the Star Shine Stage, with Galaxy Stage entities being very rare, these slightly stronger Exotic Beasts didn’t feel *that* much more powerful.
After a brief rest, and once the other three columns had arrived, all four columns began to sweep northward again.
Star Martial Warriors with sensory abilities guided the main sweeping force, indicating the direction of attack. This was far more efficient than scouring the mountains and wilderness searching for Exotic Beast tribes.
As the pace of battle quickened, Wang Lan’s four-person squad achieved an even greater level of coordination. If their earlier teamwork had required Yu Ruoyun’s explicit commands, now they could execute perfectly with just a few short words or a single signal.
Besides supporting his own squad, Wang Lan also provided medical assistance to the allied forces they were sweeping alongside.
Having a medical Star Martial Warrior nearby was a boon those without one could scarcely imagine. Injuries? Danger? These became almost non-issues. This was especially true with Wang Lan’s astonishingly potent healing abilities, which made the senior students fighting alongside him feel as if they had an invincibility buff.
The only catch was that Wang Lan’s healing fees were a bit steep: at least two Soul Beads as a base price.
But in the Nine-layer Pagoda, teeming with Exotic Beasts, Soul Beads were practically pocket change.
「Two days passed unknowingly.」
Wang Lan and his companions successfully reached the third floor. Reviewing their spoils, Wang Lan still had the largest haul among the four in his squad.
In addition to the spoils obtained from their squad’s kills, Wang Lan had also earned over a thousand Soul Beads through his healing services. This batch of Soul Beads was his to keep.
"I heard some guy from the third column found a Star Palace Artifact on the second floor?" Bai Ji remarked, a hint of envy in her tone, right after they had finished slaughtering an Exotic Beast tribe.
"Lucky? Well... he got severely injured by an Exotic Beast right after entering. After that, his bad luck continued; he was either ambushed by Exotic Beasts or grazed by stray attacks. But if you say he’s *unlucky*, then how do you explain being blasted away by a Star Martial Skill, only to coincidentally fall into a weathered cave and find a treasure inside? His ’fortune’ was bought with several near-death experiences. Most people couldn’t envy that. If you had his kind of ’luck,’ you might not be so fortunate as to escape danger every single time," Yue Jifeng said with a carefree laugh.
"But I’m still so envious! I really, really want a Star Palace Artifact..." Bai Ji sighed, gazing longingly at the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 Farming Monsters
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 295 Farming Monsters
"Actually, the treasures from the first to the third levels have almost been completely scavenged. It’s indeed very lucky that Han Yu managed to obtain a Star Palace Artifact. But Bai, you don’t need to be envious. We’re about to go to the fourth level. The fourth level is largely unexplored; who knows what treasures we might find?"
"No, no... I was just saying," Bai Ji hurriedly shook her head at Jiang Xinyu.
"Gather round—"
After a brief rest, the leading teacher suddenly shouted from a distance. Wang Lan and the others quickly stood up and ran toward the main group.
"Students, we are about to enter the fourth level. The Exotic Beasts on the fourth level are completely different from those on the third. Even the ordinary beasts are at the middle, later, or even the peak of the Star Cloud Stage.
"Among them, the proportion of mutated Exotic Beasts is astonishingly high. I must remind you all again to be extremely cautious.
"When we reach the fourth level, we cannot hunt in large groups. The Exotic Beasts of the fourth level have a tendency to gather in large numbers; if we group together, it will attract hordes of them, resulting in our party of less than two hundred people facing the charge of thousands, even tens of thousands, of Exotic Beasts.
"So, after reaching the fourth level, we will hunt in small teams. But remember, even in small teams, don’t stray too far from one another.
"If we get separated from the main group, even if we wish to provide aid, it will be too late. Ideally, three to five teams should form a middle squad to hunt down an Exotic Beast tribe..."
Despite the teacher’s repeated warnings about the dangers of the Exotic Beasts on the fourth level, judging by the expressions of these senior students, it was impressive if they’d absorbed even a third of what was said.
It’s just a trial space, how dangerous can it be? Even if it’s dangerous, could it be worse than the beast tides we’ve seen when assisting abroad?
Entering the fourth level one by one and passing through the Space Gate, that hazy, disorienting sensation came over them again.
"Wang Lan, Speedy Wind, Bai Ji, keep up!" Yu Ruoyun took the lead, her figure shooting towards the northern region like the wind.
Watching Yu Ruoyun fly, Wang Lan also gently leaped up, his body floating as if it were a balloon. Soon, he was flying side by side with Yu Ruoyun. Yue Jifeng and Bai Ji were both startled as they watched Wang Lan float into the sky.
According to the information they had, didn’t Wang Lan only possess the Thunderfire Attribute? Neither of those attributes should enable him to fly.
"Earth Attribute S-rank Star Martial Skill, Weight Exchange?" Yu Ruoyun looked at Wang Lan in surprise. "You have the Earth Attribute?"
"I am an all-attribute Star Martial Warrior," Wang Lan reaffirmed. He had told the people around him this more than once, but for some reason, the more familiar they were with him, the less they believed him.
Xu Xiangwen, upon hearing this, had said, "Lanzi, go wash up and go to sleep; you can have anything in your dreams."
He Jing and Ming Guodong, hearing Wang Lan say this, had commented, "Wang Lan, I didn’t realize you were so fixated on having all attributes that you’ve even deceived yourself. When you have time, go see a psychologist; don’t put so much pressure on yourself."
Huh? Is it really that difficult to possess all attributes?
Yu Ruoyun tilted her head, pondering for a while. "Your attribute test only showed Fire. When Thunder later appeared, I guessed you might have already cultivated a second attribute.
"But now, I realize I still underestimated you. Who would have thought that you not only cultivated the Earth Attribute but even mastered an S-rank Star Martial Skill. Wang Lan, you are the most terrifying genius I have ever seen."
"I..."
Just as I thought, another nonbeliever.
"I actually think Wang Lan is right," Bai Ji said from below, stepping on the tumultuous waves of churning earth and laughing. "Strictly speaking, everyone possesses all attributes. As long as one reaches the Galaxy Stage, they can cultivate a second attribute. Then, through the relationships of mutual generation and restraint between attributes, the seven major attributes can be derived.
"The all-attribute Star Martial Warriors we’ve heard of all came about in this manner. As for those who are innately all-attribute... I haven’t heard of any. There might be some, though."
"Wang Lan, tell me honestly, how many attributes have you mastered now?" Yu Ruoyun suddenly asked. She had a premonition that Wang Lan loved to keep trump cards hidden. He had probably mastered the Earth Attribute even before entering university and hadn’t revealed it even during the provincial martial arts competition.
"Let me count... Fire, Thunder, Water, Wood, Earth, and Wind. Those six for now!"
"Holy crap! You’ve mastered six of the seven major attributes? You’ve cultivated all of them except the Gold Attribute? Wang Lan, do you have something against my Gold Attribute?"
"Senior Yue is of the Gold Attribute? I really couldn’t tell."
"The Gold Attribute is just one of my attributes. My Innate Ability is Swift Thunder, which naturally includes both Wind and Thunder attributes."
"We’re here!" Yu Ruoyun suddenly announced.
The land in the distance was a bizarre, reddish-brown rocky terrain. The intense heat distorted the air, making the world before them seem like a twisted Different Dimensional Space.
The reddish-brown rock layers did not form a solid whole but resembled a patchwork of irregular shapes. Enchanting red light flowed within the seams between the pieces.
Wang Lan followed Yu Ruoyun as they descended. Seeing the serious expressions on the others’ faces, he too became vigilant.
"What Exotic Beast is this?"
"The Golden Winged Fire Scorpion. It possesses Gold, Fire, Wind, and Flame attributes. It can shoot Extreme Heat Light Beams from its mouth, crossing distances over five hundred meters in a flash. The high temperature of up to eight thousand degrees can kill a peak Star Cloud Stage expert in an instant.
"Their shells are of the Gold Attribute, with a hardness comparable to alloy steel. If they aren’t killed in one blow, their shells can rapidly regenerate, becoming even harder with each recovery.
"They have wings on their backs and can reach heights of up to thirty meters. Their flight speed isn’t fast, but their movement speed on the ground is extremely quick. They can traverse any terrain, be it flat ground or steep walls, as if it were level.
"The Golden Winged Fire Scorpion also has an Innate Ability for digging; neither stone nor earth can withstand their excavation."
Yu Ruoyun explained the capabilities and attributes of the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion as if reciting from an encyclopedia. After hearing all this, Wang Lan suddenly felt the urge to flip a table and walk away.
"Why bother fighting this thing? Let’s find another target!"
"There are no simple Exotic Beasts on the fourth layer. I chose the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion because they’re not very gregarious and have low intelligence. I’ve already devised a tactic.
"In a moment, I’ll use long-range attacks to enrage them and draw a few dozen over. Bai Ji will use her Earth Attribute to block the remaining Exotic Beasts. Yue Jifeng and I will kill those that get through.
"During these ten days of training, we shouldn’t need to switch targets anymore. There should be enough Golden Winged Fire Scorpions for us to slowly grind."
"Since Yu Ruoyun has already planned everything, I have no objections."
"I’ll follow Ruoyun’s lead."
Wang Lan could only spread his hands. "I can’t guarantee anything else, but I’ll guarantee this much—you all focus on fighting, and leave the medical support to me."
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
In the distance, the sounds of intense battles rose and fell; other squads had already begun fierce fights with Exotic Beasts. Over the past three days, the four members of Wang Lan’s squad had averaged a thousand Soul Beads each, far below their collective basic goal.
Moreover, they were all low-grade Soul Beads, hardly useful. Whether it was Yu Ruoyun or Yue Jifeng, their target was mid-grade Soul Beads—the kind where one was worth dozens of the low-grade ones.
With the tactic set, Yu Ruoyun flew into the sky toward the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion’s habitat. Star Power surged, a blue glow swirling around her.
But just as she initiated the Star Energy Fluctuation, the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions that had been lying on the ground suddenly woke up en masse. In an instant, hundreds of them raised their heads.
"Not good!" Yue Jifeng’s face paled as he cried out in alarm.
The moment his words landed, hundreds of flame beams, like rays of light, streaked toward the sky, shooting at Yu Ruoyun. Her expression changed dramatically, and she quickly altered her Star Martial Skill to unleash a waterfall.
HISS! HISS! HISS!
Dozens of flame beams struck the water-barrier waterfall summoned by Yu Ruoyun, sending up thick white smoke. Yu Ruoyun had clearly underestimated the penetrative power of the scorpions’ beams and was left in a sorry state by this barrage.
The waterfall defense was instantly shattered, and she rapidly retreated, pursued relentlessly by dozens of Golden Winged Fire Scorpions.
"Quick, support her!" Yue Jifeng called urgently, as the three of them rushed to aid Yu Ruoyun.
"Earth Surge—" Bai Ji quickly slapped her palm against the ground, and the earth suddenly surged like raging waves. The pursuing Golden Winged Fire Scorpions’ steps faltered, but their mouths continued to spew dense beams of flame at Yu Ruoyun.
SIZZLE—
Yu Ruoyun frowned, her face instantly paling. A scorpion’s beam had struck her shoulder, leaving a piercing wound.
"Bai Ji, proceed with the plan."
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Suddenly, the ground rose, and cliff faces surged up, altering the terrain. Fewer than a hundred Golden Winged Fire Scorpions were isolated and continued to charge at them. In the blink of an eye, they were before Wang Lan and the others.
"Broken Water Waves—" Wang Lan roared, and a Water Sword burst forth from his mouth, shooting toward the leading fire scorpion. The scorpion, which happened to be opening its massive maw to spew a flame beam, had its head directly blasted apart by Wang Lan’s Water Sword.
BOOM!
The gushing water burst into the scorpion’s body, causing it to explode like an overinflated balloon.
"Kill—" Yue Jifeng’s figure flashed, instantly charging at the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions. Afterimages filled Wang Lan’s field of vision for a moment, then vanished.
However, the results of this attack were not as devastating as his previous ones.
Following Yue Jifeng’s cry of "Moon Falling Snow!" only about five of the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions were torn limb from limb. The carapaces of the rest, though severely injured, healed with astonishing speed, almost as if by a Medical Star Martial Technique.
Yu Ruoyun, who had fallen from the sky, clutched her shoulder, her body trembling uncontrollably. Wang Lan dived to her side, his body flashing with white light as a Song of Life chain connected to her.
PFFT—
A red glow of Star Power suddenly sprayed from the wound on Yu Ruoyun’s shoulder as her flesh visibly regenerated. In less than ten seconds, the wound had healed completely, as if it had never been.
Yet Yue Jifeng was now in a precarious situation, surrounded and pursued by dozens of Golden Winged Fire Scorpions. Though Yue Jifeng’s speed was lightning-fast, he would pause for a brief moment during his attacks.
The Golden Winged Fire Scorpions seized these instants to launch their own attacks at Yue Jifeng. As for friendly fire, the concept was completely alien to them.
Yue Jifeng managed to dodge the attacks, shaken but unharmed, but more than a dozen Golden Winged Fire Scorpions died at the claws of their own kind.
"Speedy Wind, scatter—" Yu Ruoyun shouted, Star Power surging around her. Two Arrays appeared in her palms and merged instantly. Wind and Water converged, and a blizzard, like a cataclysm descending from the heavens, swept towards the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions.
CRACK! CRACK! CRACK!
In an instant, the scorching earth turned to Ice Snow, and the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions’ speed decreased sharply due to the intense cold.
"Good opportunity—"
Yue Jifeng instantly unleashed his ultimate move, his sword transforming into moonlight. "Wind Speed Sword Dance!"
His form flickered like a Ghost, zipping through the midst of the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions. Those restrained by Yu Ruoyun’s attack suddenly froze, as if their pressure points had been struck.
By the time Yue Jifeng returned to Wang Lan’s side, nearly a hundred Golden Winged Fire Scorpions had been simultaneously cleaved in two.
"For assisting in an over-leveled slaughter, you are awarded 3,000 experience points and 200 skill points."

chapters.title: Chapter 296: The Battle is So Much Better with Wang Lan
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 296: The Battle is So Much Better with Wang Lan
"The Exotic Beasts on the fourth layer are indeed stronger than I imagined!" Yu Ruoyun sighed deeply as she watched the battle unfold before her.
"Thankfully, we have Wang Lan," Yue Jifeng said. "Even if we get injured, there’s no need to worry. Let’s not switch targets; let’s hunt this one. Ruoyun, your Ice Attribute attacks greatly restrict the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion, creating an opportunity for me to deliver a fatal blow. It just consumes quite a bit of Star Power."
Bai Ji had already successfully collected the Soul Beads, a total of 98.
"How should we divide them?"
"Let’s not divide them for now," Yu Ruoyun decided. "Bai Ji, you keep them safe and just give us Soul Beads to replenish Star Power as needed."
Since Wang Lan hadn’t consumed much Star Power, he didn’t need Soul Beads for replenishment.
"Although these are also low-grade Soul Beads, their quality is much better than the ones from the lower levels," Bai Ji noted, examining them. "The Star Power they contain is actually twice as much."
"After all, they’re from powerful Exotic Beasts at the peak or late stage of the Star Cloud Stage. That’s to be expected," Yu Ruoyun commented.
"Oh no—" Suddenly, Bai Ji’s expression changed dramatically as she cried out in alarm.
"What’s wrong?"
"A powerful Exotic Beast is coming, at least at the peak of the Galaxy Stage!" Bai Ji had barely finished speaking when the ground suddenly began to tremble. The stone wall sealing them in suddenly began to crack.
"This is bad! Retreat quickly!"
As soon as the words were spoken, the stone wall in front of them burst into pieces. A giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion appeared amidst the thick smoke and, after letting out a roar to the sky, swiftly chased after Wang Lan and his companions.
"Bai Ji!"
"Understood!"
Bai Ji pressed hard on the ground, and numerous earth walls rose behind her. But the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion, tearing through them with ease, continued to smash through the earth walls in relentless pursuit.
"We can’t get away!" Yu Ruoyun analyzed the situation instantly and called out in a deep voice.
"Gate of The Underworld—"
Suddenly, Wang Lan turned around and slapped the ground with his palm. Behind Bai Ji’s earth walls, a sinister stone gate suddenly rose.
BOOM—
A loud noise echoed, and the ground shook violently.
The unstoppable giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion crashed head-on into the Gate of The Underworld.
The four of them, having stopped in their tracks, winced.
Perhaps this is what ’not turning back until you hit a wall’ truly means?
At this moment, the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion appeared extremely miserable. One of its previously majestic horns was now broken, and greenish blood flowed from the stump.
If the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion could talk right now, it would definitely want to scream. Everything was fine with those earth walls—each one I smashed through felt great! As magnificent as I am, shouldn’t my underlings be singing my praises in unison behind me? But why did you have to suddenly conjure such a hard wall, so insidiously? Who are you trying to trap?!
Rage, an incomparable rage.
The giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion’s body shimmered with red light.
Yu Ruoyun’s and Wang Lan’s expressions changed drastically. Without hesitation, they grabbed Yue Jifeng and Bai Ji, soaring into the sky. In the blink of an eye, the ground they had been standing on turned into a boiling sea of molten lava.
It covered a terrifying distance of several hundred meters.
ROAR— A fierce roar sounded. The Gate of The Underworld, having lost its foundation, gradually sank into the lava. From within the molten lava, the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion advanced with a ruthless swagger, step by step.
Even worse, hundreds of its underlings followed it, a sight resembling an army on the march.
"Damn it! I’ve never been this humiliated in my entire life! Yu Ruoyun, let’s do this!" Yue Jifeng roared, still held aloft by Wang Lan.
"Alright! Bai Ji, let’s launch together—Earth Hill Walk!" Yu Ruoyun commanded.
"Understood!"
As soon as Yu Ruoyun spoke, ripples of Star Energy Fluctuation emanated from both her and Bai Ji. Their Star Energy Fluctuation synchronized, and suddenly, they each threw an Array into the sky. The Arrays merged, forming a massive Array that spanned a five-hundred-meter radius above them.
Suddenly, a small hill emerged from within the Array. The hill was porcelain white, like a monolith of Han Baiyu Mountain.
Such an impactful Star Martial Skill left Wang Lan feeling invigorated. Yu Ruoyun then hastily called out to Wang Lan again, "Wang Lan, quick! Weight Exchange!"
"Understood!" Wang Lan promptly set Yue Jifeng down and activated Phantom Tracer in mid-air. In the blink of an eye, he appeared atop the Han Baiyu Mountain.
"Weight Exchange—"
Under Wang Lan’s Law of Gravity, the Han Baiyu Mountain’s weight instantly increased more than tenfold. The terrifying weight descended with a howling force, fiercely pressing down on the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions below.
BOOM—
The earth trembled violently, and even teams several kilometers away heard the horrific noise from this location.
"Damn, which powerhouse is that going all out over there?"
"This commotion is almost on par with a nuclear bomb."
"It seems to be Princess Yu. Truly worthy of her title! Such a disturbance couldn’t be caused by anyone below the Star Sea Stage."
The force of the five-hundred-meter Pyramid Mountain was already extraordinary. After Wang Lan applied Weight Exchange, burdening it with dozens of times more gravity, the pyramid became even more terrifying than a natural mountain.
The surface lava instantly spurted in all directions, and the ground was deeply dented by the pressure. And with this massive strike, the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion and its common underlings alike were all crushed beneath the mountain.
"Earth Flow Bi!" Bai Ji quickly cast an Earth Attribute defensive Star Martial Skill, erecting high walls to block the impact of the splashing lava.
RUMBLE...
The aftershocks gradually dissipated. Under the immense pressure Wang Lan had applied, the Han Baiyu Mountain developed countless cracks and was on the verge of collapse, unable to withstand the terrifying gravity.
"Defeated higher-level enemy. Reward: 10,000 Experience Points, 800 Skill Points."
Wow, this is a huge haul!
Wang Lan’s figure flashed, and he returned to Yu Ruoyun and the others’ side. He was about to declare the job done, but suddenly, his expression changed.
It’s not right, the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion isn’t dead.
The experience points and skill points gained from this kill were clearly from those few hundred ordinary Exotic Beasts. If the giant Exotic Beast were included, it should have been at least 20,000 or 30,000 experience points.
As if to confirm Wang Lan’s guess, the cracked Han Baiyu Mountain suddenly crumbled, and flames soared to the sky. Amidst the flames, a fierce mutated Exotic Beast emerged from the ruins.
Amidst the fiery molten lava, its ravaged body was rapidly regenerating. It took angry steps, charging toward Wang Lan and the others like an avalanche.
A single Exotic Beast, yet it charged with the momentum of an entire army, its terrifying pressure sweeping over them like a gale-force headwind.
"Damn it, it can actually molt and regenerate?"
"With the mountain we just dropped, any backup Golden Winged Fire Scorpions should be delayed. So, this one... how do we deal with it?" Yue Jifeng asked, rubbing his chin with a hint of excitement.
"How else? We charge!" Yu Ruoyun declared. "Bai Ji, you control the field and create favorable conditions for us! Wang Lan, provide cover and be ready to rescue! Speedy Wind and I will take the lead!"
The four-person team charged again at the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion.
The intense battle made Wang Lan lose track of time. Fire and molten lava rained down from the sky like a torrential downpour. Dancing amidst blades, brushing shoulders with death—the thrill was extraordinary.
In this moment, Wang Lan finally understood the saying in the world of Star Martial Warriors: never underestimate a woman. Because when women got serious, they were even fiercer than men.
Yu Ruoyun charged through the barrage of attacks, unleashing five different Star Martial Skills as if they were free. Speedy Wind’s figure darted around the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion, recklessly inflicting wound after wound.
Thanks to Wang Lan’s Song of Life, they fought fiercely, almost trading injury for injury.
After nearly an hour, the four of them finally wore down the giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion to its death.
Even though they won, it was a pyrrhic victory. When Wang Lan dug Yu Ruoyun and Yue Jifeng out from the rubble, both were covered in wounds. Retreating to a safe spot, Wang Lan quickly directed two healing streams to mend their injuries.
In less than a minute, the two, who had been on the brink of death, were fully restored.
"I finally understand how vital a powerful Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior is to a team!" Yue Jifeng said excitedly, moving his arm around. "With injuries like these, we’d normally be out of commission for at least five or six days, if not dead. And you healed us in just a minute?"
"Bai Ji, come with me to change clothes." Yu Ruoyun’s clothes were badly torn, but she couldn’t parade around in rags like Yue Jifeng. Luckily, women like them always brought plenty of extra outfits, so changing was easy.
"Found the Soul Beads!" Bai Ji announced half an hour later, her fingers burrowed into the ground. The earth seemed to dance, and one Soul Bead after another popped out before her, as if spat out by the ground.
"Eight hundred ordinary Soul Beads, three mid-grade Soul Beads, and one high-grade Soul Bead!
A high-grade Soul Bead... That giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion actually dropped a high-grade Soul Bead?
"
"That’s to be expected," Yu Ruoyun smiled thoughtfully. "How else could it have pushed us so hard if it didn’t possess power at the Star Sea Stage level? One high-grade Soul Bead is worth three thousand ordinary ones. This gives me a somewhat audacious idea..."
"What’s audacious about it? I think it’s perfectly sound!" Yue Jifeng exclaimed, turning to Wang Lan. "We have Wang Lan for rapid healing and Soul Beads to replenish Star Power. We can restore health and energy—it’s perfectly sustainable!"
"I’m just here to support. I’ll go with whatever you decide," Wang Lan replied.
「Three days passed quietly.」
Having shifted their tactical focus, the four no longer targeted common Golden Winged Fire Scorpions. Instead, they specifically sought out mutated or leader-class ones.
Almost every day, they engaged in three to four high-intensity battles, and each time they would sustain severe injuries.
Wang Lan didn’t know if getting injured could become addictive, but Yue Jifeng was gradually showing signs of it. While evading the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions’ frenzied attacks, Wang Lan also had to keep an eye on Yue Jifeng, ensuring he didn’t charge too recklessly and get himself killed.
After each fierce battle, the group was surprised to find that even though they primarily targeted stronger individuals, the number of ordinary Golden Winged Fire Scorpion Soul Beads they collected didn’t decrease.
A powerful Golden Winged Fire Scorpion was often followed by a group of lesser ones. In the midst of their intense battles, even the shockwaves were enough to slaughter large numbers of these ordinary Scorpions.
What these lesser Golden Winged Fire Scorpions never expected was that, having come out to cheer for their leader, they would end up as collateral damage, often killed by their own leader’s area-of-effect Star Martial Skills.
Exotic Beasts are indeed ferocious creatures.
Wang Lan’s group’s combat style also attracted several fourth-year senior students, who came to observe. After all, such earth-shattering commotion, lasting from morning till night, inevitably made them uneasy.
When these senior students arrived and took in the battle scene, most promptly turned and left.
"’Pardon the intrusion. We’ll take our leave!’"
What kind of people are these four? They’re basically courting death! But the astonishing thing is, they miraculously survive each brush with death, only to be fully healed by Wang Lan’s abilities. This is how Demons operate; ordinary people definitely couldn’t manage this.

chapters.title: Chapter 297 Sudden Assassination Attempt
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 297 Sudden Assassination Attempt
The sky filled with fireballs, truly raining down like a deluge over the charred landscape. The lava beneath their feet seemed to spew forth from the cracks in the rocks, as if connected to hell itself.
The giant Golden Winged Fire Scorpion before them was much larger than any other the four members of Wang Lan’s team had ever seen.
Its late-stage Star Sea Realm strength swept through the wasteland with overwhelming power.
Facing such a formidable existence, not even Wang Lan—a powerful Close Combat Mage disguised as a Medical Attribute user—could stand aside. Even Bai Ji, whose Earth Attribute abilities were typically reserved for terrain control, had to join the battle.
"I told you we shouldn’t have provoked this thing... You didn’t believe me, and now look, we’re all going to die here."
"Shut up!" Yu Ruoyun instantly summoned an Ironwood Barrier in front of her to block the lava attack, shouting fiercely.
"Speedy Wind, we really didn’t provoke it! It’s clearly seeking revenge for its kin. It’s the Scorpion King!"
"Wang Lan, quick, heal!"
Yue Jifeng flashed forward, chopping off one of the Scorpion King’s leg blades, but a flame beam from a smaller Golden Winged Fire Scorpion below struck his abdomen. Three penetrating wounds appeared on Yue Jifeng’s chest.
"Here it comes!"
Wang Lan abruptly unleashed a Water Severing Knife. The Gold-ranked blade swept across, severing two Golden Winged Fire Scorpions at the waist. His form danced through the air as he instantly reached Yue Jifeng’s side and connected him to the Song of Life.
The rain of fire continued to fall madly, the whole world already swallowed by red light.
"Over here—" In the distance, two squads of four hurried over.
"Damn, is this something we can even get involved in?"
"But Princess Yu Ruoyun is in there! No matter what, we have to provide support! Go—"
But as the two squads set foot on this hellish land, a rain of fire and magma fell indiscriminately from the sky. After they barely dodged a few volleys, terrifying fireballs suddenly rolled toward them like runaway chariots.
"AHHH—"
A sharp, piercing scream sounded as the fireballs rolled over them, and the two teams of seniors were annihilated in the flames.
"Damn it!" Yu Ruoyun roared in anger upon seeing the two teams behind her killed.
A multicolored Star Energy Fluctuation surged as four attributes suddenly fused.
"Blizzard—"
The sky suddenly turned silver-white. Within a massive Array that formed in the sky, icicles like countless javelins rained down from above, assaulting the Scorpion King.
But the Scorpion King’s armor was simply too thick; even the terrifying attack that merged four attributes couldn’t restrict its movements in the slightest.
"Wang Lan, I’m ready!" Yue Jifeng suddenly roared, his form flashing before the Scorpion King’s face. "Whirlwind of Flowers and Snow—"
A sword light lit up in front of Yue Jifeng; his sword transformed into a bright moon in the sky. Under the moonlight, snowflakes danced like scattered petals.
Myriad streams of Sword Qi fell like water from the Milky Way, pouring onto the Scorpion King’s head. The crisp sounds of impact were incessant, and the carapace on the Scorpion King’s head visibly began to melt.
"Flame Thunder Arrows—"
In an instant, Wang Lan used Phantom Tracer. His figure flashed atop the Scorpion King’s head. Grasping the fleeting opportunity, an arrow descended like divine retribution, piercing the Scorpion King’s forehead.
"SQUEAK—"
A piercing, urgent scream rose. The Scorpion King’s movements abruptly halted. In the sky, the heavily injured Yu Ruoyun extended a vine to entangle Yue Jifeng, pulling him back and pushing him toward Wang Lan.
"Finally... No, that’s not right!" Wang Lan suddenly exclaimed. "The Scorpion King looks strange. Why has it turned a glazed color?"
"Not good!" Yu Ruoyun’s face instantly turned pale with fright. "It’s going to self-destruct—"
With no time for hesitation, Yu Ruoyun’s Star Power surged wildly. "Life Firmament!"
Countless vines rapidly spread from Yu Ruoyun’s body, replicating quickly and weaving a massive net in front of her. In the blink of an eye, they formed a gigantic, expanding cocoon that enveloped everyone behind her.
Wang Lan instantly understood Yu Ruoyun’s intention. His Star Power surged, and vines also spread from his body. "Sentient Beings!"
Yu Ruoyun’s Life Firmament focused on defense, its tough ironwood vines capable of blocking attacks and absorbing Star Power. Wang Lan’s Sentient Beings was primarily for attack and Star Power absorption, but at this moment, he couldn’t care less about its usual function.
"Bai Ji, defend—"
In the distance, Bai Ji was still running towards them, but when she heard Wang Lan’s roar, she stopped in her tracks.
"BOOM—"
What terrifying power could a peak Star Sea Realm Scorpion King unleash by self-destructing?
Never mind the intensity of the force; the sheer area of the blast was enough to chill one to the bone.
An area two kilometers in diameter was instantly engulfed in searing red heat. The ground was scorched into crystal, and the complex terrain Bai Ji had created was utterly obliterated by the earth-shattering explosion.
Shockwaves rolled and cascaded, the aftereffects lasting for tens of seconds before subsiding. The sky turned dark, the ground was charred black, and a massive crater marked the former dwelling place of the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions.
Who could have imagined that this place, once home to a terrifying Exotic Beast tribe—a Golden Winged Fire Scorpion colony tens of thousands strong—was now nothing but scorched earth?
"Cross-level kill achieved. Reward: 100,000 experience points, 50,000 skill points—"
In his mind, the kill notification rang out, and the aching Wang Lan regained consciousness. Upon waking, he found himself seemingly buried deep underground, feeling not only terrifying pressure but also an unbearable sensation of suffocation.
After the aftermath had dissipated, the ground suddenly bulged, and a snow-white hand reached out from the dirt. Bai Ji, covered in blood, staggered out of the pit. When she saw what lay before her, she forgot the pain, her eyes widening in utter despair.
Such a powerful explosion, and Wang Lan and the other two had been at its epicenter...
She herself had been so far away and still suffered such a fierce impact despite her Earth Attribute defenses. Yu Ruoyun, Yue Jifeng...
Could they still be alive?
Suddenly, the ground in the distance started to bulge, and a figure emerged from the dirt.
After Wang Lan crawled out, he immediately turned and began to dig into the hole. Before long, he had unearthed Yu Ruoyun and Yue Jifeng, both battered beyond recognition.
The Scorpion King’s final self-destruction was something they hadn’t foreseen. Exotic Beasts, having low intelligence, typically followed their instinct to pursue benefits and avoid harm; very few would resort to self-destruction.
So, having underestimated their opponent for a moment, they paid a terrible price.
Wang Lan’s injuries were actually no lighter than theirs. However, the moment he was injured, his Self Healing skill passively activated. As long as he didn’t die on the spot, he could escape life-threatening danger in a very short time thanks to this skill.
By the time he emerged from the ground, Wang Lan’s injuries were already seventy to eighty percent healed.
"Wang Lan, are you alright? You’re still alive?" Bai Ji exclaimed excitedly. Surviving the disaster together had once again deepened the bond between the team members. At that moment, if Wang Lan had asked for a hug, Bai Ji probably would have agreed without a second thought.
"Quick, give me a Soul Bead! My Star Power is exhausted."
Bai Ji hurriedly took a medium-grade Soul Bead from her bosom and handed it to Wang Lan. He instantly absorbed it, and a white light flickered around him, connecting to Yu Ruoyun and Yue Jifeng. Accompanied by the healing from the Song of Life, their injuries quickly began to mend.
Bai Ji knelt anxiously by Wang Lan’s side, watching the two being treated. Initially, she had only focused on Wang Lan being alive, but now, seeing Yu Ruoyun’s and Yue Jifeng’s injuries, she couldn’t help but gasp.
Without treatment from a Medical Attribute Star Martial Warrior, they would have been doomed. Their bodies were a mangled mess of flesh, with burns covering over ninety percent of their skin. Yue Jifeng was in especially bad shape; one arm and one leg were completely gone, resembling charred sticks.
Wang Lan channeled his Star Power with all his might, and their life forces finally began to revive and strengthen. Only then did Wang Lan let out a slight sigh of relief, the anxiety in his heart finally easing.
"Give me another Soul Bead."
Without hesitation, Bai Ji took out another Soul Bead. Just as Wang Lan reached for it, his expression suddenly changed, and he flung Bai Ji away with a palm strike.
A look of shock crossed Bai Ji’s face, her disbelief evident as she gazed at Wang Lan. She couldn’t understand why he would suddenly attack her for no reason.
The instant Bai Ji’s body flew backward, a Golden Winged Fire Scorpion burst out from a fissure in the ruined cliff and lunged at her.
At the same time, a streak of golden light shot from afar, striking the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion.
BOOM— The Golden Winged Fire Scorpion was instantly engulfed in golden flames.
Snapping back to reality, Bai Ji pressed her palms to the ground. "Golden Buddha Hand!"
Two massive Buddha Hand Seals emerged from the ground and clasped together in mid-air, engulfing the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion. The Golden Buddha Hand Seals twisted and compressed, a violent friction generating terrifyingly high temperatures. Molten rock trickled down the seams of the seals.
"Who’s there!" Wang Lan and Bai Ji turned their heads in unison to look into the distance. From a faraway corner, three figures slowly walked out.
"Wang Lan, Bai Ji, don’t be alarmed," one of the figures said. "We heard the commotion and came to see. We just spotted a Golden Winged Fire Scorpion lurking nearby and I acted quickly. Please don’t misunderstand."
"Detect a Golden Winged Fire Scorpion from that far away? Who are you kidding? Besides, who are you? Why haven’t I seen you before?" Bai Ji demanded, her voice laced with suspicion.
"I’m a Perception Gifted, that’s how I detected it. Also, there are twelve Star Energy Fluctuations beneath you; there might be twelve more Golden Winged Fire Scorpions in ambush. Oh, and it’s not surprising you haven’t seen us. There are so many senior students, who could know everyone? Besides, we’re not really the type to attend classes; we skip a lot."
The three continued talking as they approached.
"Well, thank you then," Wang Lan said with a smile.
"It’s only right to help classmates..."
"SWISH—"
Suddenly, Wang Lan raised his hand and fired an arrow. His polite words had made the three let down their guard. Who would have expected the smiling Wang Lan to attack without warning?
The person in front was utterly unprepared and was impaled through the chest by Wang Lan’s arrow. The other two hastily dragged their injured comrade back in retreat, their forms instantly recoiling as they watched Wang Lan nervously.
"What... what are you doing? We kindly came to help, and you repay kindness with hatred!"
"Hmph, kind? His attack was fired deliberately. If I hadn’t pushed Bai Ji away beforehand, his shot would have killed Bai Ji, not the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion."
"At first, I thought you were just students looking to scavenge. But Bai Ji doesn’t even recognize you. Besides, if you were really senior students from the academy, you wouldn’t be so tactless as to approach this closely. Your way of speaking, your mannerisms—they’re not from Modu City’s Star Martial Academy."
"And another thing, if you’re going to pretend to be students, at least try to look younger. You’re clearly men in your thirties. Do you take me for a fool?"
The last remark was particularly deadly.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 Target: The Death Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 298 Target: The Death Valley
"Ugh—" A light groan escaped as an individual, shot through the chest by Wang Lan’s arrow, suddenly kicked their legs out and died.
"Brother!"
"Attack! Avenge our brother! He’s currently treating Princess Yu and can’t help us."
The two figures flickered, instantly lunging toward Bai Ji with murderous intent.
Bai Ji’s expression changed drastically. Just as she was about to act, the Star Energy Fluctuation within her was suddenly synchronized by a more powerful one, causing the Star Power in her body to surge uncontrollably.
"Synchronization of Star power? Wang Lan, save me!"
"He’s busy treating two critically injured people; he has no time to save you."
"Die—"
The two assailants moved like ghosts, covering dozens of meters almost instantly to reach Bai Ji. One slashed at her neck while the other swept at her waist.
Such a merciless, killing blow left no room for escape.
Just as the blades gleamed, about to strike home, a shadowy figure suddenly flashed before them. The two attackers froze, their blades stopping less than a foot from Bai Ji.
With her Star Power restricted, Bai Ji was like a fish on the chopping block. She had already closed her eyes, awaiting death, but the expected pain never came. When she opened her eyes, she found the two attackers standing motionless, like wooden statues.
"SPURT—" Blood sprayed out, splattering Bai Ji’s face. Only then did she realize that the two before her had been sliced in half down the middle.
"Moon Falling Snow—"
A soft grunt sounded from behind a rock.
"Speedy Wind? You’re alright?" Bai Ji exclaimed in surprise.
"With Wang Lan here, of course, we’re fine," Yu Ruoyun said gently, patting Bai Ji’s shoulder. "Come with me to change clothes."
The four regrouped after changing into fresh clothes. They showed no signs of the life-threatening terror or severe injuries they had suffered earlier. If not for the lingering fatigue on their faces, Bai Ji might have thought the fierce battle was merely a figment of her imagination.
"Why did those three try to kill you just now?" Wang Lan asked, looking at Bai Ji with puzzlement.
Bai Ji was also puzzled. After a long moment of thought, she still shook her head. "I’m just an ordinary student; how could anyone want to kill me... I can’t remember."
"You really can’t remember?" Wang Lan pressed.
Bai Ji continued to shake her head, her furrowed brows making her look pitiably confused. Yue Jifeng quickly tried to smooth things over. "Maybe Bai Ji unknowingly offended someone. Anyway, we’ve dealt with the assassins. We can just report it to the school once we get out."
Wang Lan frowned and shook his head. "I’m afraid it’s not that simple. It wouldn’t surprise me if someone tried to assassinate Ruoyun, or even me.
"But these three ignored Ruoyun and me, solely focused on killing Bai Ji. That, I don’t understand.
"Moreover, sneaking into the Nine-layer Pagoda to assassinate someone is no simple feat. Everyone who enters the Nine-layer Pagoda is registered; any discrepancy would be noticed.
"Going to such lengths to infiltrate the Nine-layer Pagoda surely isn’t just a matter of having offended someone inadvertently."
"But... I really don’t know," Bai Ji said with a troubled expression. "It’s all so baffling. They went through so much trouble, crossing mountains and rivers, just to kill *me*? When did I become so noteworthy?"
"Let’s drop it for now. We’ll have the Tianjian Bureau investigate after we get out," Wang Lan said, then dismissed the question. His expression turned to one of eager anticipation.
"Bai Ji, quickly collect the Soul Beads from the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion. The Scorpion King self-destructed and took its entire tribe with it. We’ve hit the jackpot this time!"
Bai Ji immediately grew excited. She sat cross-legged and manipulated the earth, causing it to tremble slightly. Her expression shifted from shock to ecstatic joy.
Under the gaze of three pairs of eyes, Soul Beads erupted from the ground, piling up into a small mountain before Bai Ji.
"About 8,000 low-grade Soul Beads, 30 mid-grade, and 5 high-grade Soul Beads."
"This is more than enough for the school assignment," Yu Ruoyun said, her face radiant with joy. "Mission accomplished. Shall we withdraw?"
"Withdraw? What for? We’ve only been here six days; we still have four days left. Wouldn’t it be a waste to leave so early? I’ve had an epiphany! With Wang Lan around, we can basically do anything, no matter how dangerous, and we’ll be fine. So, why don’t we go take down another Exotic Beast tribe?"
Yue Jifeng clearly hadn’t learned his lesson from his recent brush with death.
"Don’t talk nonsense. If you get yourself killed outright, I can only help send you to the afterlife; I can’t bring you back from the dead."
"How could I get killed that easily?"
"What about that attack just now? Even someone at the Star Sea realm would have been killed instantly, right?"
"That was just an accident. Exotic Beasts capable of self-destruction are one in a million. Encountering one was already incredibly rare. How could we be that unlucky again? Anyway, stop going on about it, Ruoyun. You’re the team leader; say something."
Yu Ruoyun activated her watch’s projection, and a map materialized in mid-air.
"I’ve found an interesting place."
"What place? What’s so interesting about it?"
"Here, The Death Valley! Designated by the academy as a Life Forbidden Zone. No student is allowed to approach it."
"The Death Valley... I’ve never heard of it." Yue Jifeng thought for a moment, then shook his head. Although he was a senior, this was his first time in the Nine-layer Pagoda. Moreover, he had never come across anything about The Death Valley in old posts or records.
"Of course you don’t know. The Death Valley was declared a forbidden area twenty years ago, and all students are strictly prohibited from approaching. With no one visiting, naturally, there’s no information about it.
"The Death Valley became known as a Life Forbidden Zone because it’s filled with a terrifying Star Martial Toxin. Even those in the Star Sea realm can’t survive inside for more than thirty seconds.
"Within The Death Valley, there’s a type of Exotic Beast called the Ghost-eye. Their bodies are composed of the toxin itself. They lack a physical form, existing instead as strange life forms condensed from toxin, like ghosts.
"That’s why the Ghost-eye has virtually no substantial offensive power. They rely on Star Martial Toxins to poison their targets and decompose the bodies with the toxin. Once decomposition is complete, the corpse is also assimilated into toxin.
"They could be a tribe, or they could be a single entity. You could say there’s only one Ghost-eye in The Death Valley, or you could say there are thousands."
Listening to Yu Ruoyun’s explanation, Yue Jifeng’s Adam’s apple bobbed, and he audibly gulped.
"So, you have a Toxin Vaccine for the Ghost Eye Toxin?" Yue Jifeng asked tentatively.
With a vaccine, Poisonous Beasts would be mere trifles on a chopping block, easily dealt with. But without one, Star Martial Toxins were the most terrifying killers, harvesting lives like a scythe through wheat, swath by swath.
"No! But we have Wang Lan! This great scientist who has ushered in a new era of Star Martial Toxin Vaccines..."
The way Yu Ruoyun said it gave Wang Lan goosebumps all over.
"Ruoyun, stop teasing me."
"I’m not teasing you; that’s what they say in the news."
Faced with three pairs of hopeful eyes, Wang Lan eventually steeled his heart and shook his head. "But I haven’t created a Toxin Vaccine for the Ghost Eye Toxin. Strange. Since such a terrible toxin exists at the academy, why hasn’t the school prioritized having me develop a Toxin Vaccine for it?"
"That... I don’t know. The Death Valley has been a forbidden zone for over twenty years. Perhaps even the school has forgotten about it."
"If Wang Lan hasn’t developed a vaccine, then we can’t go to The Death Valley," Yue Jifeng muttered regretfully.
"Not necessarily. There might be other ways to counteract Star Martial Toxins besides a vaccine. Another method is to fight poison with poison. But before that, I must obtain a sample of the toxin," Wang Lan said hesitantly.
If the Ghost-eye were truly as easy to deal with as Yu Ruoyun described, it would be quite tempting.
"You can leave getting the toxin sample to me. But I have to ask, Wang Lan, how confident are you? By the time I retrieve the sample, I’ll already be poisoned."
"I have no absolute certainty, but rest assured, my Star Martial Skill can treat Star Martial Toxins. However, its healing power isn’t limitless. It can save two people simultaneously, but not three. And these Star Martial Toxins are so potent, lethal within seconds, that I wouldn’t have enough time to save many. So, one person, I can save. Two, possibly. But not a large group."
"I see. Alright then, let’s give it a shot."
The team followed the map’s directions to the outskirts of The Death Valley. The valley resembled a huge basin, filled with dense, churning black fog. Two canyon passages, one at the front and one at the back, served as entry and exit. Strangely, though the fog-like substance swirled actively, it remained confined within the basin, not spilling out even a bit.
Even when fierce canyon winds blew, they only made the toxic mist churn without dispersing it.
Outside the canyon lay a vast river, flanked by dense primeval forests that stretched as far as the eye could see. The team of four stopped at the edge of the forest, Wang Lan curiously eyeing the dense woods.
"What are you looking at?" Yu Ruoyun asked softly.
"No wonder not only The Death Valley is a forbidden zone, but also the surrounding areas. A place pervaded by toxic gas is bound to be teeming with poisonous things; these forests are full of toxic herbs and flowers."
"Is it that terrifying? I suddenly have a bad feeling," Yue Jifeng exclaimed playfully.
"Actually, poisonous plants aren’t so bad. Generally, they don’t release toxins unless harmed. Or unless... they can’t help it."
After all, he’d learned about Star Martial Toxins from library books during his studies. That’s what the books claimed; whether it was accurate was anyone’s guess.
"This patch of forest here is highly toxic, which is perfect. We’ll need to find ingredients in it later to formulate the antidote. Speedy Wind, you’re the fastest. It’s up to you. Go in, get a vessel of the toxin, and come right back." Wang Lan took a vessel from his spatial wristband and handed it to Yue Jifeng.
Yue Jifeng solemnly took the vessel. "Wang Lan, my life is in your hands now!"
With an air of solemn resolve, he turned and headed towards the valley.
Wang Lan’s mouth twitched slightly. "Does this count as... him giving his last words?"
"Are you sure your Star Martial Skill can treat Star Martial Toxins?"
"Of course. I was poisoned by Mrs. Sun Li before, and I used my Star Martial Skill to cure it. Mrs. Sun Li was really thoughtful. She even knew I’d need the Toxin Synthesis Device and prepared it for me in advance."
"Speedy Wind is about to go in," Bai Ji called out nervously.
Wang Lan gave Bai Ji a surprised look. He recalled how Bai Ji and Yue Jifeng’s interactions had noticeably increased over the past few days. Whoa... Something’s definitely up between them! But it was strange; they’d seemed unfamiliar with each other before entering... They had spent these days in intense combat; could they really have gotten together so easily?

chapters.title: Chapter 299: The Spatial Equipment from Fifteen Years Ago
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 299: The Spatial Equipment from Fifteen Years Ago
Although Wang Lan had given his assurances before, the three of them still held their breath when Yue Jifeng entered the Poison Fog Area.
Wang Lan was worried that Yue Jifeng might get disoriented and stay a few seconds too long in the fog, unable to make it out in time. Seeing Wang Lan’s worried expression, Bai Ji’s heart skipped a beat. Even her gaze toward Wang Lan was scrutinizing.
"Bai, looking at me like that makes me feel somewhat uncomfortable."
"Are you feeling guilty? Is Speedy Wind in danger going in?"
"Speedy Wind is out!"
The moment Yu Ruoyun’s words left her lips, a figure rushed out of the dense fog like a shooting star, even dragging a Ghost-eye. But as he approached, the Ghost-eye in Yue Jifeng’s hand dissipated like scattered signal fires, the dense black fog rising and rapidly vanishing.
By the time Yue Jifeng reached the three of them, the Ghost-eye had disappeared. Only a Soul Bead remained in his palm.
Yue Jifeng’s complexion was ashen, his strength completely drained as he collapsed. Wang Lan quickly supported him, his body flashing with white light connecting to Yue Jifeng’s.
As Star Power was rapidly consumed, a strange, faint blue glow surfaced on Yue Jifeng’s face. When the glow gradually turned white, Yue Jifeng regained his strength and slowly sat up.
"Speedy Wind, how are you feeling?" Bai Ji asked with concern.
"I’m fine now, no sign of poisoning, just some muscle pain," he said, pulling out a container from his backpack. "I only managed to get this much. I had planned to catch a whole Ghost-eye."
"I didn’t expect the Ghost-eyes to die once they left The Death Valley. They don’t even have bodies; they just dissipate. These Ghost-eyes are like Ghosts; their bodies are gaseous."
"Physical attacks are useless, but attribute attacks are highly effective. Their weakness is the single eye on their ghostly face, with the Soul Bead located right in the center. If it weren’t for the poison fog, even a Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warrior could easily kill them."
As he spoke, he pinched the newly acquired Soul Bead. "The quality of this Soul Bead is no worse than that of a Golden Winged Fire Scorpion... With such a high-quality Soul Bead, how can their actual strength be so poor?"
