"The Ghost-eye’s strength isn’t weak. Without Wang Lan, you’d be dead by now," Yu Ruoyun said coolly. "That’s a characteristic of Poisonous Beasts. They invest all their attributes into their poison, so their defense and attack power aren’t very strong."
"Wang Lan, is this enough? If not, I can go back and look again."
"It’s enough."
Wang Lan spread his hand, and the Universal Decomposition skill activated, shattering the container instantly. The poison fog, however, didn’t spread but roiled and gathered in his palm. In less than a minute, the toxicity code of the Ghost Eye Toxin appeared in Wang Lan’s mind. Instantly, his mind formulated the corresponding counteracting agent for Star Martial Toxins.
"I’m going into the forest to find materials for the antidote. Don’t come in after me. The forest is full of deadly poison; a careless mistake could be fatal," Wang Lan warned, then turned and walked into the forest.
In this Different Dimensional Space, mountain ranges and dense forests were not uncommon. But the nature of a Different Dimensional Space clearly couldn’t be understood with common sense. The plants inside, though slightly different from those in the outside world, were very similar.
The geography and topography here resembled a tropical rainforest. The ground was moist, the temperature was unusually high, trees blotted out the sky, and poisonous plants and flowers were everywhere.
Fortunately, there was no miasma pervading the dense forest. Otherwise, no amount of Wang Lan’s Star Power could have withstood the consumption for more than ten minutes.
After walking for about ten minutes, he arrived at a colorful patch of flowers. Wang Lan immediately placed his palm over them and activated Universal Decomposition. With the decomposition, the patch of flowers vanished as if Ice Snow were Melting away. In the blink of an eye, they turned into raw code in Wang Lan’s palm.
"
Only five groups of coded matter? Less than one-thousandth!
" Wang Lan sighed, extracting the five groups of coded matter and placing them into a container taken from the Space Backpack on his wrist.
He continued to search deeper, not letting any potentially poisonous thing escape his notice.
This Universal Decomposition is truly incredible. If one had to use scientific instruments to decompose and isolate materials, it would require dozens, or even hundreds, of procedures, and success still wouldn’t be guaranteed. But with Universal Decomposition, it’s as easy and simple as if performed by a creator god.
An hour passed unknowingly. Wang Lan had decomposed at least fifteen poisonous substances. The better ones yielded twenty groups of matter, while the lesser ones only provided three groups of coded matter.
Furthermore, the material assimilation of the poisonous substances was very high. As Wang Lan collected more and more counteracting coded matter, the remaining portions became increasingly difficult to find.
Wang Lan expanded his search area, not only focusing on poisonous things but also targeting plants that seemed harmless and non-toxic.
And, as it happened, Wang Lan inadvertently stumbled upon the truth.
Since they can grow alongside these highly toxic plants, how could they themselves be ordinary?
About three hours later, Wang Lan had successfully collected ninety percent of the coded material.
"Wang Lan—how are things going? How much longer will you be?" Suddenly, Yu Ruoyun’s voice echoed in his ear. This was her wind-attribute communication ability, convenient for long-distance communication in the absence of mobile phones or other devices.
"Just a little bit more, almost there!"
Suddenly, a sense of alarm flared. Before Wang Lan had finished speaking, his body darted away like a phantom.
BOOM—
A loud bang resounded as a gaping maw viciously struck the spot where Wang Lan had just been standing. The gaping maw raised its head. Its pair of tentacle-like appendages quivered slightly in the air, aimed where Wang Lan now stood on a tree branch.
Is this a Man-eating Vine? But why didn’t I notice such a huge vine before? Could it have burrowed up from underground? No, impossible. If it had burrowed up, there would have been sounds of movement from underground. But when it attacked, I didn’t hear a thing. What was originally in the spot where the vine is now?
At this thought, Wang Lan’s expression changed instantly. Without hesitation, his figure transformed into a streak of light, shooting straight into the sky. As Wang Lan used Phantom Tracer to escape, countless trees below suddenly transformed into Man-eating Vines.
The vines were those seemingly harmless trees—they had transformed.
How careless of me to have wandered into a forest of Man-eating Vines!
The Man-eating Vines were incredibly large, with an attack range of over a hundred meters. However, their weakness was also quite obvious: they only possessed physical attacks, and their range was limited.
So, even though the Man-eating Vines thrashed about below like a frenzy of tentacles, they couldn’t reach Wang Lan and naturally posed no threat to him.
In the air, Wang Lan formed a sword sign with his fingers. On his wrist, wings of thundering flame instantly unfurled.
SWOOSH—
A bolt of thunderous flame shot down from the sky. Lightning, carrying intense heat, instantly severed a writhing vine. The severed vine was then engulfed by blue flames. In the blink of an eye, it collapsed, rapidly shriveling and Melting away.
SWOOSH, SWOOSH, SWOOSH—
Seeing his attack was effective, Wang Lan promptly fired several more bolts in quick succession. In the blink of an eye, four or five vines Melted into ash within the flames.
"Meteor Fire Rain!"
Suddenly, a fierce shout erupted. Yu Ruoyun had appeared beside Wang Lan out of nowhere. Flames fell like shooting stars, hundreds of meteor showers plummeting to the earth, smashing a large area of the vine forest below to smithereens.
As the dust settled, the world became tranquil once again.
"How did you get here?"
"I saw you hadn’t come out for a long time, so I got worried and came to check. Are you okay?"
"I’m fine, doing great!" Wang Lan said with a smile, descending slowly from the sky.
The surrounding flames continued to crackle and Scorch, and the thick smoke carried a hint of purple. Seeing Yu Ruoyun about to descend, Wang Lan quickly stopped her.
"Be careful, the smoke is poisonous."
Wang Lan reached into the smoke and activated Universal Decomposition. Soon, a look of delighted surprise appeared on his face.
"Excellent! The last ten percent is found."
"You’ve found all the ingredients for the antidote?"
Avoiding the poisonous smoke, Yu Ruoyun came to Wang Lan’s side.
"Yes! Now we just need to collect more materials. I’m confident about compiling the vaccine, but creating an antidote is impossible without sufficient materials."
Wang Lan went to the source of the smoke and took out a container to collect the ten percent of the components it contained, while Yu Ruoyun kept watch.
"Ruoyun, be careful of those spotted trees. They’re actually the same kind of Man-eating Vines we were just fighting. They transform as soon as someone approaches. Although their attacks aren’t strong, they are definitely highly poisonous."
About an hour later, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun had gathered enough ingredients for the antidote and returned to where the vines had been. Just as they finished stowing the container, Yu Ruoyun suddenly discovered something and ran towards the base of a burnt vine.
"Wang Lan, look! What is this?"
Wang Lan hurried over. In a patch of charred earth, the corner of a metal box was exposed. Yu Ruoyun used an Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill to turn over the soil, and a square box was slowly unearthed.
"A Folding Space Box? How can there be a Folding Space Box here?"
The Folding Space Box was undoubtedly a piece of black technology. Although no one yet understood its principles, that hadn’t stopped its creation. It was like electromagnetism: no one could fully explain its existence, but it existed nonetheless, and people utilized it.
"Modern space boxes are all backpack-shaped; this square type has long been obsolete. It’s probably been here longer than we’ve been alive, right?"
Yu Ruoyun carefully opened the space box. Instantly, bright, shining stones spurted out like a fountain, as dazzling and beautiful as diamonds.
"Space Stones!" Yu Ruoyun’s face immediately turned grim.
"Space Stones? There are Space Stones in the Nine-layer Pagoda?"
"Space Stones aren’t rare in Different Dimensional Spaces. Although not all such spaces contain them, large Different Dimensional Spaces generally have Space Stone mines. After all, Space Stones and Different Dimensional Spaces seem to have a symbiotic relationship."
"Although the Nine-layer Pagoda is special, it’s still fundamentally a Different Dimensional Space, so finding Space Stones here isn’t strange. The production date on this space box is... May 2004. That’s fifteen years ago."
"Fifteen years ago, did someone collect Space Stones in the Nine-layer Pagoda, then come here only to be killed by the Man-eating Vines, leaving this space box behind?"
"Was it a student from the academy?" Wang Lan asked.
"Probably. Students from outside the academy shouldn’t be able to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda..." Suddenly, Yu Ruoyun remembered the three who had assassinated White Beard and shook her head. "Not necessarily. Outsiders might also infiltrate the Nine-layer Pagoda. Didn’t we encounter three such outsiders today? But I don’t even know where the Space Stones are located in the Nine-layer Pagoda... I’ve never even heard that the Nine-layer Pagoda *has* Space Stones.
How did they find out?
"

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Struck it Rich, Big Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 300: Struck it Rich, Big Time
"Let’s not get hung up on that now; it was fifteen years ago. We’ll report it to the school after we get out. Let’s leave."
"Yeah!"
The two flew out from their previous location and then met up with Yue Jifeng and Bai Ji, who were waiting outside.
As soon as Wang Lan stepped out of the woods, he was forcefully subjected to a public display of affection. Seeing the two cuddled up together watching the river flow eastward, Wang Lan felt like throwing a rock. If they had been discreet about it before, now these two were unabashedly open.
"Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun are back? How did it go, did you find the antidote?"
Wang Lan looked oddly at Yue Jifeng, who was all smiles in the sunshine. Caught in the act, and you’re still so calm without a shred of shyness? Do you have any decency?
"We’ve collected everything, but I can’t guarantee we can make it. After all, when we were at the academy, the failure rate for making antidotes was pretty high."
As he said this, Wang Lan activated the Folding Space on his wrist. His watch detached and quickly transformed in front of him. In the blink of an eye, a small laboratory appeared.
Compared to the Space Box they had seen earlier, this was true high-tech.
The medical department’s equipment was all there in miniature form within the lab. Wang Lan couldn’t help but marvel once again at Sun Li’s foresight; she had known he would need these items and had prepared them for him in advance.
Wang Lan re-sequenced the extracted toxins according to the antidote’s coding order and fed them into the Star Martial Toxin Synthesizer one by one. The apparatus’s schematics continuously displayed the genetic toxin codes, resembling a loom at work. Wang Lan carefully added each component, and the synthesizer verified his formulated antidote through reverse-deduction coding.
Sun Li usually had to make multiple attempts to successfully create an antidote for Star Martial Toxins, so Wang Lan didn’t expect to succeed on his first try. But strangely enough, even when Wang Lan fed the last of the toxins into the machine, there were no error messages or indications of failure.
Is my technique that good? Or is my luck just that great?
He patiently waited for half an hour.
"BEEP BEEP BEEP—" A soft alarm sounded, indicating the synthesis was complete. Wang Lan quickly opened the finished product container, where forty capsules appeared.
"Success. We have forty antidotes, ten for each of us. If we run out, we must leave. Take one before we go back in. Remember, the antidote is also a Star Martial Toxin; it will neutralize the Ghost Eye Toxin once we inhale it. Take another capsule when you start to feel dizzy and your vision blurs. Ten pills should be enough to last us a day."
"Wang Lan, I suddenly feel like teaming up with you is damn lucky," Yue Jifeng said, grabbing Wang Lan’s shoulder and giving it a good rub. "If we didn’t have you on our team, we’d still be stuck fighting the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion."
"That’s for sure! Wang Lan, how about we keep teaming up after we graduate? It’s comforting to have you around," Bai Ji chimed in eagerly.
"I don’t even know where I’ll be after graduation... but of course, if there’s a chance, definitely."
"Alright, we have three days left; time is pressing. Let’s deal with the Ghost-eye," Yu Ruoyun commanded immediately.
After distributing the antidotes, the group of four charged toward The Death Valley. Sure enough, the poisonous fog in The Death Valley was the Ghost-eye’s body. When the four of them got closer, the fog clearly scouted tens of meters toward them. When Wang Lan and the others approached further, the fog suddenly expanded, enveloping all four of them.
The four quickly swallowed a capsule, and the dizzy, blurry feeling instantly disappeared. At the same time, uncountable ghost-like figures appeared before their eyes.
A horrifying ghostly face with a giant eye stared back at them. No mouth, no hands, just a face fluttering in the air.
Without hesitation, the group’s attacks launched instantly. Wang Lan’s Star Cloud Sword Dance activated, and Sword Qi weaved in and out; a dozen streams of Sword Qi shot out, almost simultaneously hitting a Ghost-eye in its eye.
The eye was hit and burst instantly, dropping a Soul Bead from the sky.
"Slain fifteen Ghost-eyes, reward of one thousand experience points, three hundred skill points."
"Damn... they’re that easy to kill?" Wang Lan exclaimed in surprise.
They’re easier to kill than Star Shine Stage Exotic Beasts, and they give quite a lot of experience points too!
As Wang Lan instantly killed fifteen Ghost-eyes, Yue Jifeng had already slaughtered nearly a hundred. As the top speed demon of his senior year, Yue Jifeng showcased a terrifying harvesting speed.
"The only scary thing about Ghost-eyes is the Star Martial Toxins. With the toxins gone, they’re nothing," Yue Jifeng was flying high with excitement.
Last time we entered, I couldn’t last more than five seconds, feeling weak all over and nearly thought I’d die here. But this time, I’m clear-headed and refreshed, light as a swallow; my moves are bold. Today, I just want to kill... kill Ghost-eyes!
With the four people’s rapid slaughter, Soul Beads fell from the sky like rain. Thousands of Ghost-eyes died within the first five minutes.
The Ghost-eyes were baffled. Why the hell were our potent toxins having no effect on them?!
But soon, the Ghost-eyes seemed to realize that if this continued, they were doomed to be massacred.
Quickly, countless Ghost-eyes began to gather. Ten of them could even merge into a larger Ghost-eye, which could emit acid mist and launch lightning attacks after the fusion. Their strength instantly increased by several levels compared to the previous Ghost-eyes.
But even having become this strong, they were still not as good in combat as an ordinary Golden Winged Fire Scorpion. Once Wang Lan and the others found their rhythm, it was another one-sided slaughter.
The Ghost-eyes despaired. This is too much for us!
Moreover, Wang Lan and his three companions were ecstatic to discover that the Soul Beads dropped by the fused Ghost-eye were of superior quality, with some even larger Ghost-eyes dropping medium-grade Soul Beads.
At this, everyone’s eyes lit up. Soul Beads couldn’t normally be fused; even a mountain of ordinary Soul Beads could never be combined into a single medium-grade one. But this law didn’t seem to apply to the Ghost-eyes.
The Ghost-eye can actually synthesize high-quality, high-level Soul Beads! Is this really a Ghost-eye? Is this even an Exotic Beast? This is a priceless treasure!
Moreover, the issue was that for all Exotic Beasts, their combat power level was higher than their Soul Bead’s grade. For example, an Exotic Beast clearly possessing Star Cloud Stage combat power might only drop the most ordinary type of Soul Bead. To obtain a medium-grade Soul Bead, one would have to slay an Exotic Beast with at least Galaxy Stage strength. What was more annoying were those mutated Exotic Beasts; their strength was terrifying, but their Soul Beads were sometimes still just ordinary.
This Ghost-eye... it’s a real saint among Exotic Beasts!
A giant Ghost-eye with only Star Cloud Stage strength can drop a medium-grade Soul Bead! I’d take a dozen of these Exotic Beasts!
Yue Jifeng thought.
Yue Jifeng then exclaimed comically, "Did I say that? That wasn’t me!"
That was why Wang Lan and his team, looking at the Ghost-eye’s frightening face that could scare children to tears, suddenly saw it in a kind and adorable light. If the Ghost-eyes knew what they were thinking, they would probably be sobbing in despair.
Finally, someone appreciates our handsomeness...
Sword lights flickered, thunder roared, starlight filled the sky, and fire spread like a prairie blaze.
Under the relentless slaughter by Wang Lan and his group, the Ghost-eyes panicked. From tens gathering, in a blink, they transformed into hundreds merging into one giant Ghost-eye. But being large didn’t necessarily mean being strong.
The giant Ghost-eye floated in the sky like a massive jellyfish, its form flickering like a phantom. When it receded, all attacks were ineffective. The Ghost Mother would recede as if retreating into another dimension, but it would reappear whenever it launched an attack. This reappearance coincided exactly with the moments Wang Lan and his companions attacked.
Three giant Ghost Mothers floated in the sky, each capable of unleashing overwhelming attacks. In terms of attack power, they were indeed comparable to the ultimate skills of a Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warrior.
But the Ghost Mothers were slow, their defenses were weak, and although their attacks covered a wide area, they were also slow. In the eyes of Wang Lan and the others, they were just big, clumsy targets.
"Purple Flame Sword—"
Seizing the moment just before a Ghost Mother unleashed its Thundering Ten Thousand Catties attack, Wang Lan instantly used Phantom Tracer to appear above its head. Then, channeling the Blending of Thunder and Fire, a Purple Flame Sword cleaved down from the heavens.
A vicious blow struck the Ghost Mother’s giant eye, and green blood spurted out. With a successful hit, Wang Lan dared not hesitate and immediately followed up with a barrage of Purple Flame Arrows.
With its eye severely injured, the Ghost Mother couldn’t fade into the void for a moment and was instantly hit by a dozen of Wang Lan’s arrows.
"BOOM BOOM BOOM—"
Explosions rang out one after another, and the giant eye of the Ghost Mother burst open in the sky. A fist-sized Soul Bead fell from the heavens, caught by Wang Lan.
Sure enough, another top-grade Soul Bead!
A top-grade Soul Bead can be exchanged for one hundred Academic Credits. I’ve already acquired four of them! That’s an S-rank Star Martial Skill right there. Sweet!
As Wang Lan finished his battle, Yue Jifeng and Yu Ruoyun also seized a fleeting opportunity and unleashed their ultimate attacks. The devastating force of their attacks was something Wang Lan couldn’t match; he had needed two strikes to kill his target, while they only needed one.
Amid the dazzling explosions, two top-grade Soul Beads fell slowly into their hands.
Suddenly, the poisonous fog unexpectedly began to shrink rapidly.
This scene made Wang Lan and his teammates quickly regroup and stay alert; who knew what kind of powerful move the Ghost-eye was conjuring with such a grand display.
The poisonous fog condensed swiftly, and the pervasive mist that had covered the entire valley vanished as if banished by sunlight. At this moment, Wang Lan and the others finally realized what the fog was up to.
They watched as the poisonous fog seeped into the numerous fissures of the basin.
Did it just... run away?
"Hey, are you even an Exotic Beast anymore? You’re the first damn Exotic Beast I’ve ever seen that runs away!" Yue Jifeng immediately got agitated and chased after it, cursing loudly.
Perhaps hearing Yue Jifeng’s voice, the Ghost-eye fled even faster. In a blink, the last wisp of poisonous fog disappeared into the crevices of the rocks, restoring The Death Valley to its original appearance.
If it weren’t for all the Soul Beads scattered everywhere, I’d almost doubt that the toxic miasma was ever really here,
Wang Lan thought.
"We’ve struck it rich... hahaha... the harvest is more than double that of the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion!" Bai Ji said, her smile sweet and radiant.
"In four years of university, I’ve never seen such a bountiful harvest!" one of them exclaimed.
"Let’s collect all the Soul Beads. Can you store them all, Wang Lan? If not, we’ll use our bags."
"Wait, what’s this?" Suddenly, Bai Ji exclaimed, unearthing a pickaxe head from the loose soil beneath her feet.
It was a pickaxe head with crescent-shaped ends, specifically designed for mining. If it had appeared in the mountains or at a construction site, it would be understandable. But in the poison-filled air of The Death Valley, it was incredibly out of place.
"Wang Lan, could someone get this far in without an antidote?" Bai Ji asked, staring with innocent eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 301 We Have Been Waiting for You for a Long Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 301 We Have Been Waiting for You for a Long Time
"This is impossible!" Yu Ruoyun quietly approached Bai Ji, took the pickaxe, and examined it. "Without an antidote, forget someone at the Star Sea level; even a Titled Strongman, or someone half a step into the Star Soul realm, couldn’t have safely reached this place. Do you think The Death Valley, the Life Forbidden Zone, is falsely reputed? Whoever came here must have already obtained the antidote... Huh?"
Suddenly, Yu Ruoyun exclaimed in surprise, "The production date on this pickaxe is... last December?"
"Last December? Wasn’t the Nine-layer Pagoda closed back then? It only reopened this year... So, this pickaxe only turned up here recently?"
"If the production date stamped on it isn’t random... then this pickaxe has been here for no more than five days, especially since we were on the first three levels for the past three days."
"But why would someone bring a pickaxe into The Death Valley?" Bai Ji asked, somewhat puzzled.
"Just now, Wang Lan and I found a Space Box from fifteen years ago in the dense forest. It was filled with Space Stones, which proves there’s a Space Stone mine on the fourth level."
"If he came here to mine, then based on our speculation, either he was thrown into The Death Valley to die, or The Death Valley was a necessary passage for him. But even if someone was thrown in here to die, they couldn’t have reached this spot, right? And those who sneak in to mine would definitely not be numerous. Taking a detour from another direction would mean facing the danger of encountering powerful Exotic Beasts. If they have an antidote, passing through The Death Valley would be the safest route. The Space Stone mine is either inside The Death Valley, or The Death Valley is a necessary passage to reach it."
"It’s unlikely to be a necessary passage. The Death Valley isn’t that large; at our pace, we could go around it in a day. It wouldn’t be worth braving the dangers of The Death Valley just to save one day."
"Then, why would someone leave a pickaxe here?"
"Either they accidentally dropped the pickaxe here, or they ran into trouble."
As they exchanged their thoughts and speculated, a logical chain of cause and effect was pieced together.
"Should we report this to the academy?"
"I don’t believe it’s just one person here to mine. They might be members of the team that entered with us and could be swinging their pickaxes right now. Let’s go find them. With both witnesses and physical evidence, there’ll be no room for denial. Damn it! No wonder Modu City has had Different Dimensional Spaces opened from time to time these years. I’ve always wondered how so many Space Stones emerged. So, the problem lies here."
"To dare to dig right under the Star Martial Academy’s nose, the person behind this has incredible gall," Yue Jifeng said with a smile, shrugging his shoulders.
The four began exploring The Death Valley. Since Ghost-eye had fled underground, Wang Lan first used the Song of Life to expel the Star Martial Toxins from their bodies. After all, both the antidote and the Ghost Eye Toxin are potent poisons; they only neutralize each other when mixed.
And Wang Lan also pondered where those who came to mine had obtained the antidote for the Star Martial Toxins? Furthermore, the oldest Space Box dated back fifteen years. This meant that the antidote had existed for over fifteen years, and Space Stones had been mined for that long? The Death Valley was designated as a forbidden territory over two decades ago, yet someone had been mining secretly? Was this done behind the academy’s back, or was it an arrangement made by the academy with those people?
"Ruoyun, Speedy Wind, sense any vibrations from an underground space," Bai Ji said suddenly, her fingers inserted into the ground.
"Where? Straight ahead, three kilometers."
"Let’s move out, alert formation."
A three-kilometer distance was virtually nothing for the four of them. In less than ten minutes, they had closed in on the location Bai Ji had mentioned.
From the surface, nothing seemed amiss. At the far end of the basin, the cliff walls were riddled with corroded holes. They resembled the craters on the moon’s surface, densely packed and uneven.
"The knocking sounds are directly below us," Bai Ji said gravely. "There shouldn’t be many, fewer than ten people."
"This aligns with our speculation. It couldn’t be large-scale mining, so there are only about ten people."
"Look over there!" Yue Jifeng pointed to a spot halfway up the cliff, one hole hidden among the many. The deep opening stood out starkly from the other holes.
"Go!"
The four flashed into motion, and in the blink of an eye, they arrived at the edge of the pit. Wang Lan touched the edges of the pit. He noted traces of human carving; it had to lead downwards.
Inside the pit, it was pitch black, so dark one couldn’t see one’s own hand in front of one’s face. But in the world of Star Martial Warriors, eyesight is not the only thing they rely on for action. Sound, airflow, atmospheric pressure, and even smell could serve as tools for navigating space. Especially for Wang Lan, whose heat-sensing vision enabled him to see in the dark. The entrance was small, but inside it was unexpectedly spacious. The winding, two-meter-wide tunnel appeared to have been entirely excavated with pickaxes.
Touching the marks on the tunnel walls, Wang Lan felt a growing sense of unease.
Yu Ruoyun took the lead, with Yue Jifeng bringing up the rear. Wang Lan and Bai Ji, who needed protection, were in the middle. Yu Ruoyun seemed intent on catching those secretly mining Space Stones. Though she appeared to walk at a measured pace, she was actually moving very quickly.
"Ruoyun, slow down a bit. Something doesn’t feel right," Wang Lan said softly.
"What feels off?"
"I can’t quite put my finger on it, but there’s something strange about this tunnel. We’ve descended at least three hundred meters, which means we should be underground by now. So why is the tunnel entrance on a cliff face?"
"Isn’t it for concealment?" asked Yue Jifeng from behind. "With all these similar corroded caves around, choosing one as the mine entrance would be inconspicuous."
"Are you sure?" Wang Lan turned and looked back at Yue Jifeng. "Then why did you spot this cave entrance so easily? Moreover, this tunnel is indeed artificially excavated. But... there are no traces of ores on the rock walls. A normal mine would have signs of ore all over its walls; even if the amounts were too small to be worth mining, they would definitely be present. However, the rock walls inside this tunnel are no different from those outside. Are we sure there are Space Stones here?"
"While everything you’ve said is correct, since we’ve discovered this man-made tunnel, we must find out who excavated it and why," Yu Ruoyun said afterward.
"Who’s there!" Suddenly, a sharp cry came from within the mine tunnel. Hearing the noise, Yu Ruoyun instantly dashed forward.
The other party, seemingly sensing the movement ahead, suddenly had a brilliant Star Energy Fluctuation ignite around him, and his figure flashed towards the depths of the cave at high speed.
"Chase!" The moment Yu Ruoyun finished speaking, she had already transformed into a streak of light and vanished. Wang Lan was too late to stop her, even if he had wanted to. Gritting his teeth, he could only follow reluctantly. Star Power surged around him as the gates to his Star Palace opened. In an instant, the Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth burst forth from his Star Palace and enveloped him.
Wang Lan feared there might be traps inside; in a sudden attack, the Saint Cloth would be the last line of defense. If an attack couldn’t be blocked by the Saint Cloth, then dodging it would also be impossible.
No longer concerned about exposing themselves, the four pursued their quarry with lightning speed. The three hundred meters that had taken them nearly half an hour to traverse before, they now covered in a split second.
In the blink of an eye, they followed the figure ahead into a large cavern, where they found a pyramid constructed from Space Stones. At that moment, a circle of instruments around the pyramid sparked with electrical arcs, yet strangely, without the usual crackling sound.
Activating her Star Power, Yu Ruoyun summoned wind blades that flanked and struck down the fleeing Star Martial Warrior.
Her figure flickered, landing beside the pyramid.
"Who are you? What are you doing here?"
Seeing the pyramid, she had already confirmed that this place was not a mine, and there was no Space Stone ore. Perhaps the Space Box from fifteen years ago wasn’t filled with Space Stones mined in the Nine-layer Pagoda; perhaps Space Stones were transported *into* the Nine-layer Pagoda?
With that thought, Yu Ruoyun’s eyes narrowed slightly. "Who are you? What are you doing here? Why did you transport so many Space Stones here?"
"Princess Yu, we’ve been waiting for you for a long time," suddenly, a figure clad in black appeared atop the pyramid.
"Waiting for me?"
"Yes, waiting for you! My master invites Princess Yu for a trip to a Different Dimensional Space!"
As the other’s words fell, Wang Lan’s expression suddenly changed drastically. His figure shot backward in retreat.
BOOM—
He slammed straight into an invisible barrier. Wang Lan’s expression changed dramatically. They really had stumbled headlong into a trap; their adversaries had already laid a Sky Net, waiting for them.
BOOM—
The pyramid before them suddenly erupted with blinding light. A terrifying energy swept out, engulfing and instantly dissipating the person who had stood atop the pyramid.
"Shatter the Space Stones—" In his urgency, Wang Lan cried out hoarsely.
Instantly, Star Power surged through him as the four interconnected Star Martial Skills he knew converged within his body. He poured all his Star Power unreservedly into this earth-shattering attack.
Beside him, Yu Ruoyun also reacted to Wang Lan’s warning. She fused five attributes, launching a complex Star Martial Skill similar to Wang Lan’s.
"Purple Flame Thunder Spear—"
"Chaos Dragon Elephant—"
"Gale Electric Slash—"
BOOM—
Three devastating attacks instantly struck the Space Stones before them. The pyramid built from Space Stones immediately shattered. Terrifying energy spilled out in all directions, but the anticipated explosive aftermath didn’t occur.
The rampant energy was absorbed by a distorted spatial projection that appeared above them, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
The Space Stones crumbled and disintegrated like a pile of burnt-out firewood, while the space above them distorted violently. However, because Wang Lan and his companions had launched their terrifying coordinated attack, the surrounding barrier had already vanished.
Wang Lan grabbed Yu Ruoyun’s hand. "Let’s go! We need to get out of here quickly!"
However, he felt Yu Ruoyun resisting his pull.
"This situation is beyond our..." Wang Lan’s words suddenly halted.
Something was wrong. It wasn’t just Yu Ruoyun resisting; Wang Lan’s own body was also being pulled backward by an invisible force. Wang Lan whipped his head around. The previously distorted spatial projection above them had now become a gaping rift.
While he held Yu Ruoyun’s hand, Yue Jifeng held Bai Ji’s, both barely resisting the suction from the spatial rift above.
"Ruoyun, you’re smart. Can you explain... why can a Different Dimensional Space be opened within another Different Dimensional Space?"
"Opening one Different Dimensional Space within another would normally only cause the two spaces to merge. Unless... both are fixed spaces. The Nine-layer Pagoda is unique; what happens here can’t be explained by common sense."
"Stop analyzing and think of something... I can’t hold on much longer!" Yue Jifeng shouted desperately, his hand clinging tightly to a rock.
"You *say* you’re about to lose your grip, but I *already* can’t hold on anymore..." Bai Ji’s words were cut short as her body suddenly flew backward. She, along with Yue Jifeng, was swallowed by the spatial rift.
And as the spatial rift swallowed Yue Jifeng and Bai Ji, Wang Lan also lost his grip. He was sucked into the rift as if by a vacuum cleaner and instantly vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Where is this? Did I travel through time?
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Chapter 302: Where is this? Did I travel through time?
BUZZ—
Suddenly, the entire artificial mountain on the back mountain began to shake violently. The Student Council members guarding the Nine-layer Pagoda hurriedly opened the sealed gate and looked towards the Pagoda.
When they saw the signboard on the seventh layer of the Nine-layer Pagoda light up, their faces changed drastically.
"It can’t be real, can it?"
"How is that possible?"
SWOOSH SWOOSH SWOOSH—
Suddenly, several figures appeared on the back mountain; a few tactical teachers, sensing the commotion, hurried over.
"What has happened? Why has the Nine-layer Pagoda suddenly started trembling?"
"Teacher, something’s gone wrong; it seems someone has breached the seventh layer."
"The seventh layer? Impossible! Even if we gathered all the academy’s power, we couldn’t breach the seventh layer."
"But look!" a Student Council member exclaimed, pointing at the flashing signboard on the seventh layer of the Nine-layer Pagoda. "The seventh layer is lit up."
"Damn it! Why didn’t the fifth and sixth layers light up? Could someone really skip the fifth and sixth layers and enter the seventh?"
"Quick, notify the Dean."
In an instant, the entire academy erupted into commotion. What did the seventh layer represent? The Exotic Beasts on the fourth layer were mostly in the middle to late stages of the Star Cloud Stage, with numerous Galaxy Stage and even Star Sea Stage beasts.
By that logic, the beasts on the fifth layer should mostly be in the early to mid-Galaxy Stage, and there would be many at the Star Sea Stage, possibly even some beyond.
If the fifth layer were breached, the Nine-layer Pagoda might become unusable for the Star Martial Academy. Once the fifth layer was breached, many of its Exotic Beasts would cascade down to the lower four layers. This would make it unsuitable for even the genius students of the Modu City Star Martial Academy to attempt trials there.
This was also why access to the Nine-layer Pagoda stopped at the fourth layer.
By the sixth layer, almost all Exotic Beasts were in the late or peak Galaxy Stage, and a third of them were Star Sea Stage or above. What did that imply?
Each layer’s space was vast, containing at least nearly a million Exotic Beasts, with several hundred thousand of them at Star Sea Stage or beyond. Even a team composed entirely of peak Star Sea Stage warriors would face a nine-in-ten chance of death upon entering.
And the seventh layer... all Exotic Beasts there were Star Sea Stage or above, with many so powerful that even Titled Strongmen could not compete with them. Even if the Five Emperors entered, they would most likely not return.
For this reason, let alone the desire to breach the seventh layer, even if they wanted to, the entire Jade Country currently lacked the strength to succeed. If one truly harbored such a thought, they would have to be prepared to risk the combined strength of all Star Martial Warriors in the nation for the attempt.
It wasn’t as if their brains had been squeezed by a door; why would they even attempt to breach the seventh layer?
And yet, the signboard of the seventh layer was now lit. This meant that someone had entered the seventh layer.
It must be a display error, right? Surely?
With the fifth and sixth layers unlit, how could the seventh possibly be lit? How could anyone have reached the seventh layer? It’s fake, absolutely fake.
"What has happened?" Eld Di, accompanied by Deputy Dean Nangong, also arrived at the back mountain.
"Dean, the seventh layer is lit up," a tactical teacher said, approaching Eld Di. "But the fifth and sixth layers aren’t."
"Impossible!" Nangong Meng stated decisively. "It must be a display error. To enter the seventh layer, one must first pass through the fifth and sixth. Besides, who could breach the seventh layer? It cannot be."
Eld Di’s expression was as dark as ink. After a moment’s thought, he said, "Notify those inside that the Nine-layer Pagoda trial is to end early. Have everyone come out and let’s see who’s missing."
"Eld Di, do you believe someone has entered the seventh layer?"
"What if they have? The Nine-layer Pagoda is unfathomably mysterious; who knows if there might be some hidden spatial passages inside? End the trial, and let everyone come out."
In the quiet canyon, ethereal birdsong filled the air.
Wang Lan suddenly became alert, his eyes snapping open. Sitting up, he found he was tightly gripping Yu Ruoyun’s hand. Stirred by Wang Lan’s movement, Yu Ruoyun also let out a slight moan as she slowly awoke. Opening her eyes, she was greeted by a lush and verdant view.
This was a basin, but definitely not like The Death Valley. This basin was several times larger, surrounded by a circle of undulating green mountains and dense forests.
"Where are we... Have we gotten out? Are we still in a Different Dimensional Space? Or still inside the Nine-layer Pagoda?"
"Although I’m not sure where we are, we definitely haven’t left," Wang Lan said, his gaze sharp as he focused on the distance. Suddenly, a terrifying spider as large as a small car emerged from the dense forest, stepping ever closer to Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun.
"Attack! Fire Dragon Flame Bomb!" Yu Ruoyun immediately took action. Star Power surged, and a fire dragon burst forth from a red Array, roaring as it charged the incoming spider.
Suddenly, the spider fiercely spewed out a white substance, which formed a giant web in midair to meet the Fire Dragon Flame Bomb.
Upon contact, the Fire Dragon Flame Bomb was unexpectedly sliced apart by the spider silk and dispersed into the air. Watching this, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun’s expressions changed drastically. Yu Ruoyun’s Fire Dragon Flame Bomb was an A-grade attack Star Martial Skill, after all. They could have accepted the spider dodging it, but for the spider to effortlessly slice it apart was beyond their expectations.
But the two didn’t hesitate. Wang Lan instantly used Phantom Tracer to appear beside the spider.
"Water Severing Knife!"
The Gold-level Water Severing Knife could shoot a Water Sword from the mouth as thin as a little finger. Its cutting force was capable of instantly slicing through a twenty-centimeter-thick steel plate.
The Water Sword exceeded the speed of sound and struck the spider.
However, it seemed as if a transparent magnetic field surrounded the spider’s side. When the Water Sword made contact, a distorted, oscillating field became visible, instantly shattering the Water Sword into mist and rendering it useless.
"This is bad! The strength of this Exotic Beast is beyond imagination!" Wang Lan called out, his expression changing drastically.
The spider suddenly leaped, covering a hundred meters in an instant, bearing down on Yu Ruoyun from above.
"Wumu Falls—"
Yu Ruoyun suddenly flung open her palms, and a straight wooden spear shot out, fiercely striking the spider’s abdomen. The spider was sent flying backward. But in a flash, the spider spat out a thread of spider silk, slicing the Wumu Falls to pieces, then transformed into a web, enveloping Yu Ruoyun.
"Flame Sword!"
Wang Lan’s figure flashed, appearing beside Yu Ruoyun. His palms danced, and a dozen or so purple Flame Swords flew from them, slashing towards the spider silk. Amid a flurry of sword light, the spider silk shattered and melted away in the flames.
"Wind Capturing Net—"
Wang Lan hurriedly executed the S-grade Wind Attribute Star Martial Skill, attacking the spider. The spider had just landed and had not yet managed to stand up when it was engulfed by the wind net. The wind net was woven from the sharpest wind blades, capable of slicing even heavily armored Exotic Beasts into pieces once caught within it.
But the wind net merely pushed the spider backward; the sharp wind blades, astonishingly, couldn’t harm the spider in the slightest.
This unremarkable spider, how can it be so strong? Have we accidentally encountered a leader-class Exotic Beast?
"Hell Swamp—"
Suddenly, a delicate shout rang out. The ground beneath the spider instantly turned into a quagmire of churning mud. The mud surged, transforming into numerous tentacles that engulfed the spider, forcefully dragging it into the mire.
Behind the spider, Bai Ji and Yue Jifeng also arrived.
"Ruoyun, freeze the swamp!" Wang Lan called out urgently.
"Freeze!" Yu Ruoyun didn’t hesitate. Her Wind and Water Attributes instantly fused, and a beam of Rapid Freezing Light shot toward the spider. In an instant, the swamp froze into solid earth, and half of the spider’s body was encased in the frozen mud.
"Speedy Wind, the finishing blow!"
"Coming!"
BOOM—
Suddenly, the frozen earth around the spider shattered, and a huge, bloody maw swallowed the spider whole. A giant, dark snake with a terrifying horn on its head appeared before the four of them.
The shock of that moment left the four of them stunned, their expressions frozen in disbelief.
Wang Lan had never seen such a massive Exotic Beast, and neither had the battle-hardened Yu Ruoyun and Yue Jifeng. Its head alone was as big as a dump truck, and its two eyes glowed like lanterns.
Big meant powerful.
Especially in the world of Exotic Beasts, big meant terrifying.
Being stared at by such an immense black snake, Wang Lan felt a chill piercing through his body.
Yue Jifeng protected Bai Ji, and they slowly moved closer to Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun. However, a single glare from the black snake stopped them in their tracks.
The black snake didn’t launch an immediate attack. Instead, with merciless eyes, it scrutinized the four of them.
"Wang Lan, what do you think this black snake is waiting for? Is it waiting for us to turn and flee, revealing a weakness?" Yu Ruoyun’s voice trembled slightly as she forcefully gathered her Star Power.
If the black snake made the slightest move, she would immediately retaliate with her Star Martial Skill. But... could my Star Martial Skills even injure this black snake? Can I protect Wang Lan and ensure we retreat successfully? And what on earth is this place? Why is every Exotic Beast that appears so terrifying?
"I guess... it might be considering whether to eat us. To eat us—it probably thinks we’re too small to even fill the gaps between its teeth. Not to eat us—it’s reluctant to pass up a rare chance for meat."
"..."
SCREECH—
Suddenly, a clear, piercing cry echoed across the sky. In an instant, the sky dimmed.
Wang Lan quickly looked up, his face paling in fright.
A gigantic bird appeared in the sky—no, it blotted out the entire sky. If one used to describe a giant beast as large as a mountain, that beast was indeed vast.
But upon seeing the colossal Golden Eagle above, Wang Lan felt that previous descriptors were far too insufficient. A mountain? That would be an insult; its beak alone could be described as a mountain.
And at the instant the giant bird appeared, the black snake before them suddenly burrowed into the ground. The earth trembled violently, and Wang Lan and the others felt as if the ground beneath them was flipping over.
"Run—"
Wang Lan shouted explosively, instantly activating his Star Martial Skill to flee. The other three immediately followed suit, transforming into streaks of light and fleeing hundreds of meters in an instant.
BOOM BOOM BOOM—
Another round of violent earth-shaking tremors ensued, and terrifying shockwaves rushed toward them, like a colossal tsunami.
Under such a fearsome aftershock, any defense or resistance was merely a joke. Wang Lan and the others were suddenly thrown into the air, tumbling like driftwood before landing far away.
They rolled on the ground for hundreds of meters before coming to a stop.
Looking back, they witnessed a scene that chilled them to the bone. The several-hundred-meter-long giant black snake was being held in the Golden Eagle’s beak. In the Golden Eagle’s beak, the gigantic snake looked like nothing more than a worm.
Beating its wings created a fearsome hurricane, and the Golden Eagle soared into the sky. In the blink of an eye, it disappeared into the clouds.
The surroundings once again fell into a deathly silence.
Yue Jifeng helped Bai Ji to her feet. GULP. Yue Jifeng swallowed hard.
"What the hell kind of place is this? Where did all these terrifying creatures come from?"
"Such powerful Exotic Beasts... I’m afraid they might only exist above the sixth layer..." As she said this, Yu Ruoyun’s complexion suddenly changed dramatically.
"We couldn’t have... reached the sixth layer, could we?"

chapters.title: Chapter 303 Abnormal Place
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 303 Abnormal Place
As soon as this speculation was voiced, everyone’s countenance changed.
They still remembered being sucked into the space rift before and realized that being transported to higher levels was entirely possible. If indeed they had been sent to a higher level, the only way out would be to fight their way down, level by level.
Are they kidding? Given the ferocity of the Exotic Beasts on just this level, how could the few of them possibly fight their way down?
"Ruoyun... are we... going to die here?" Bai Ji couldn’t help but tremble as she asked.
"No!" Yue Jifeng quickly patted Bai Ji on the shoulder. "If we were transported to a higher level, the academy would definitely realize it immediately. The school will surely come to our rescue."
"Not necessarily," Yu Ruoyun said gravely. "If we are only on the fifth level, it would be fine. However, if we’re on the sixth level, the academy would need to fight through one level at a time to reach us. That would require the combined strength of all the Star Martial Warriors in Jade Country.
"The consequence of breaking through the sixth level is that a large number of powerful Exotic Beasts would enter the five levels below. We’ve just seen how strong the Exotic Beasts here are. If they descended, the Nine-layer Pagoda would be utterly ruined. Would Jade Country marshal all its forces and bear the risk of destroying the Nine-layer Pagoda just to save the four of us?
"Moreover, this might not even be the sixth level. According to our deductions, the common Exotic Beasts on the sixth level are at the latter stages of the Galaxy Stage. But the spider we encountered was already at the early stage of the Star Sea.
"The four of us joined forces, and yet it effortlessly fended us off. This is not the power that could be demonstrated by a creature at the peak of the Galaxy Stage.
"As for that black snake, it was at the very least at the peak of the Star Sea. So, what about that Golden Eagle? Even if my great uncle came, he might not be able to defeat it. This place could be the sixth level, or it might even be the seventh level."
Wang Lan looked at Yu Ruoyun with surprise.
So heartless! Not even willing to tell a well-intentioned lie.
"Is that so?" Bai Ji’s face suddenly revealed a look of sorrow.
"Speaking of which, Bai Ji, now that it’s come to this, aren’t you willing to say why someone went to such lengths to assassinate you in the Nine-layer Pagoda?" Wang Lan asked softly.
Even now, Wang Lan had not forgotten the scene of the assassination attempt.
"Wang Lan, what do you mean? Are you suspecting Bai Ji of deliberately hiding something? We are comrades who have been through life and death together; at this time, we should trust each other even more."
"I don’t distrust Bai Ji, but I also need Bai Ji to trust us. Having come to such a pass, we cannot rule out that after the previous assassination attempt failed, there might be a backup plan in place."
Upon hearing Wang Lan’s words, Bai Ji’s face turned pale once again.
"Wang Lan, I... I really don’t know. I’m just an ordinary student... It’s possible to have conflicts with others, but to go to such lengths to kill me... there really isn’t any reason. I have had a bad relationship with a dormmate. I have also fought with others over Soul Beads and Academic Credits, but these are quite common. I really can’t think of any reason."
Looking at Bai Ji’s expression, which did not seem feigned, Wang Lan sighed deeply.
"Forget it, shall we find a place to rest for a bit? From the beginning, we’ve been meticulously plotted against. The person behind this has grand designs, and it’s not just Ruoyun in their sights; I am included in their scheming as well."
Wang Lan’s words caused Yu Ruoyun’s expression to become unpleasant. Before the adversary activated the Space Stone, they had said, "Princess Yu, I’ve been waiting for you for a long time." This was clearly a trap aimed at her. Wang Lan and the others had fallen into this dangerous situation, all because of her.
"I’m sorry..." Yu Ruoyun suddenly gave the others a deep bow. "It’s my fault you’re in this plight."
"Yue Jifeng might be innocent, but I certainly am not. The mastermind schemed against you and included me in their plans," Wang Lan said with a wry smile. "Otherwise, how could everything have been arranged so transparently?"
"Wang Lan, from the sound of your words, you seem to have guessed something?"
"Why did we come to The Death Valley?" Wang Lan asked as they walked.
"Of course, to hunt Ghost-eye. As long as we can control the Ghost Eye Toxin, Ghost-eye are easier to kill than Star Shine Stage Exotic Beasts..." Bai Ji blurted out, but her voice trailed off as her eyes widened in terror.
"Even you have figured it out..." Wang Lan sighed again. "The Death Valley is indeed a good place, huh? An off-limits area set by the academy, where any actions taken here would definitely not be noticed by other students. And there, it would also be an ideal place for us to be buried. Once the Ghost Eye Toxin gas returns, even our bodies would be completely eradicated. Truly the perfect crime – unsuspected by both gods and ghosts. Choosing The Death Valley is one thing, but getting us into The Death Valley is quite the technical task. The Ghost Eye Toxin is unpredictable, and Ruoyun wouldn’t dare to lay eyes on The Death Valley without someone like me, who is the bane of Star Martial Toxins, in the team, right?"
"Yes! Those ten people in The Death Valley have been waiting for me for a long time."
"Wait, before we drove off Ghost-eye, the entire Death Valley was filled with poison gas. How could they remain unaffected? Could they also have an antidote?" Yue Jifeng was still puzzled.
"They might have an antidote, but I suspect they’ve been vaccinated," Yu Ruoyun said, looking straight at Wang Lan. "Who else could create an antidote and vaccine, if not you?"
"Don’t you already have the answer in your heart? Who else could it be but Mrs. Sun Li? Moreover, she even prepared a Star Martial Toxin Synthesizer for me. Everything has been arranged so transparently.
"If it weren’t for this ambush, everything would have proceeded naturally. But once we encountered an ambush, it means that all that has happened naturally was previously laid out with meticulous planning.
"Mrs. Sun Li, she really has put a lot of effort into this. This is a surefire assassination plot, leaving no room for luck."
"If only I hadn’t suggested coming to The Death Valley, none of this would have happened."
"Even if you hadn’t suggested it, they would have certainly made arrangements; they would definitely have made you think of going to The Death Valley. Unless, of course, you had already taken precautions. Ruoyun, why is Mrs. Sun Li so intent on harming you?"
"Could it really just be because of me?" Yu Ruoyun’s face revealed a bitter smile. "I am the niece of the Qing Emperor, the legitimate second princess of the Yu Family. What I am involved in is the entire force that depends on the royal family.
"At the same time, I would die in Modu Star Martial Academy, perish within a meticulously planned conspiracy. It doesn’t matter who orchestrated the conspiracy. What’s important is that the Qing Emperor Bloodline, those so-called nobles and royals, all need an excuse to start trouble.
"By investigating the cause of my death, under the slogan of avenging me, a chaos that has not been seen in a hundred years will ensue among the Star Martial Warriors of Jade Country. This turmoil will sweep across the entire Jade Country."
Wang Lan looked at Yu Ruoyun with surprise.
This woman, not particularly beautiful, is so narcissistic? Your life and death can stir the entire Jade Country? Jade Country has been rock-solid for decades. Can the death of one person really shake that stability?
"You don’t believe it?"
"A bit!"
"Anyway, we might all die here, so I might as well clear things up. The forces of the Star Martial Warriors of Jade Country can roughly be divided into five major powers, the so-called Five Elders and Five Emperors.
"As for the rest, they are not of much concern.
"Among them, the Eastern Azure Emperor, with my great uncle at the helm, is supported by the scholars, nobles, and high officials from the time when Emperor Jade was in power, two hundred years ago.
"Back then, the benevolent Emperor Jade announced his abdication and returned the governance to the public. But did those noble families really agree? Were they really willing? At first, there was the suppression by the benevolent Emperor Jade, along with the Nine Minister Dukes who didn’t step away from the political stage.
"For seventy years, the noble families governed Jade Country along with elected officials. The invasion of the Demon Clan a hundred and thirty years ago completely broke this balance.
"The war lasted a hundred and thirty years and shattered the land. When the war ended, the noble families realized that they had been completely removed from the political stage.
"And it was no longer possible for them to regain power through normal means; the only way was to restore the Great Jade Dynasty. That’s why in recent years, the rhetoric of restoration has been deliberately spread by them.
"Over the years, with suppression from my great uncle and other leaders, they didn’t dare to act rashly. But the harsher the pressure, the greater the buildup of internal tension. Now, it has come to a point where it could explode at any moment.
"As the legitimate second princess of the royal family, studying under Eld Di was to ease the conflict. To stabilize the situation, my father didn’t dare have more children after I was born."
"Why?" Wang Lan asked subconsciously.
He had never imagined that beneath the calm and prosperous surface of Jade Country, there would be such intense undercurrents. And these were directed only at the world of Star Martial Warriors. But the world of Star Martial Warriors was also part of the human world. If a major upheaval occurred in their world, the human world would undoubtedly undergo great changes as well.
"Because he’s afraid of having a son that could be used by them. My older sister married the youngest son of Emperor Bai, and I am to inherit the Yu Family and cannot marry, so the only option was to become the disciple of Eld Di to suppress the wild ambitions of those people."
"Can’t marry?" Bai Ji looked at Yu Ruoyun in surprise, immediately feeling a surge of pity.
She had always envied Yu Ruoyun’s background, living a life of luxury from a young age. But... she couldn’t enjoy the happiness and joy of an ordinary family.
Yu Ruoyun’s cheeks flushed, and she offered no explanation.
"If I die, it would signal to them that Jade Country... is going to be in chaos."
"If that’s the case... the school might still come to save us," Wang Lan said suddenly.
"Jade Country will not allow such chaos to happen. Compared to your life and death, the value of the Nine-layer Pagoda becomes insignificant."
"But... who will come to the rescue? How?" Yu Ruoyun said with a bitter smile. "With the formidable strength of those Exotic Beasts, even Titled Strongmen would... "
Suddenly, Yu Ruoyun’s voice halted, a look of terror appearing as she glanced behind her.
Wang Lan and the other two turned their heads in unison, and from the dense forest behind them, dozens of giant flying Exotic Beasts with wingspans of tens of meters burst forth. They vaguely resembled Winged Dragons, but much more robust.
What’s more, these Winged Dragons were charging straight at Wang Lan and his companions.
"Run—"
The four of them instantly ran helter-skelter, but after covering not even a hundred meters, Wang Lan and his companions stopped in despair. The Exotic Beasts chasing behind them were too fast; they were Speedy Wind Attribute Exotic Beasts, more than twice as fast as their full-speed running.
"Purple Flame Arrow—"
"Meteor Fire Rain—"
"Night Mourning—"
Wang Lan and the others launched an all-out attack on the Exotic Beasts in the sky, but these Exotic Beasts seemed to share the barrier ability of the spider they had encountered before. All of their attacks were shattered by the strange barriers enveloping the Exotic Beasts, which continued diving toward the group.
"Dodge—"
Wang Lan and the two others instantly dodged, while only Bai Ji utilized her Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill to wrap herself up.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 Fusion of Dragon Emperor Form and Phoenix Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 304 Fusion of Dragon Emperor Form and Phoenix Form
BOOM—
A soft noise erupted, and the earthen shell defending Bai Ji burst instantaneously, turning to powder as if it had been made of flour.
Startled, Bai Ji raised her head, her mind a complete blank.
The Winged Dragon swept through the sky, its ferocious visage filling Bai Ji’s entire field of vision.
WHOOSH—
The sound of Speedy Wind sweeping through the canyon echoed in her ears. Bai Ji stood motionless, but the upper half of her body had already vanished.
This scene left the other three, who had just dodged, completely dumbfounded.
Their previous spirit and splendor, the times they had fought side by side—it all seemed like it had just happened. Yet, in a mere moment, due to a single error in response, Bai Ji met a violent death on the spot.
CLINK— With a soft sound, a necklace rolled to Wang Lan’s feet. The Wind God Wyvern completed another diving attack before soaring back up to the clouds. After circling once, it dove down again.
"Bai Ji... Bai Ji! Aaargh—I’ll give you everything I’ve got!" Yue Jifeng was furious! Furious to the point of madness!
Star Power danced around his body like flames, and the sword in his hand instantly shot out a brilliant green light.
"Jifeng, calm down!" Wang Lan urgently called out, but Yue Jifeng, undeterred, leaped high into the air to meet the diving Wind God Wyvern.
"Purple Flame Arrow!" Wang Lan yelled, his hand blurring as he executed the sword skill.
The Wind God Wyvern was too strong, its might far beyond what Wang Lan could bear. Even activating the Phoenix Form was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
The Phoenix Form can at best exhibit peak Galaxy-level combat prowess. Even though I’ve mastered the Combined Star Martial Skill, I can barely reach the Star Sea realm. Even Yu Ruoyun, whose combat power is stable in the Star Sea realm, is no match for it. How could I be? The Phoenix Form has to be an ace in the hole, reserved for critical situations. Otherwise, if I activate it and can’t change our predicament, once its duration expires, I’ll undoubtedly die. At this moment, I can no longer think about teammates or companions; I can only be responsible for my own life.
The Purple Flame Arrow rushed into the void, striking the Wind God Wyvern overhead a moment before Yue Jifeng could. A strange barrier materialized once again on the Wind God Wyvern’s body, an absolute defense that seemed capable of nullifying all attacks.
BOOM— The Purple Flame Arrow exploded, and in that split second, Yue Jifeng’s sword had already descended.
SWISH—
This was Yue Jifeng’s all-or-nothing strike, one that gathered all of his spirit and vigor.
In a trance-like state, a hazy silhouette seemed to appear around Yue Jifeng. It was the silhouette of a woman with long, flowing hair, as beautiful as a celestial fairy. As Yue Jifeng’s sword fell, the silhouette’s sword seemed to slash down in concert.
The Wind God Wyvern was bisected by Yue Jifeng’s strike, split evenly and neatly in half.
The barrier, seemingly an absolute defense, did not stop Yue Jifeng’s sword.
But this one strike had exhausted all of Yue Jifeng’s spirit and energy.
Looking at the Wind God Wyvern split in two, Yue Jifeng’s lips curled into a faint smile.
"Bai Ji, I have avenged you—"
"Jifeng—"
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH—
Three Wind God Wyverns flashed past Yue Jifeng’s body like lightning. In the sky, Yue Jifeng, looking as helpless as a broken chocolate bar, was snatched up in the maws of the three Wyverns as they soared back into the heavens.
"Next up, it’s us," Yu Ruoyun said with a mournful laugh, her face marred by various scratches and stained with blood. She glanced at the Phoenix Saint Cloth on Wang Lan’s body, envy apparent in her eyes.
"Had I known, I would have brought the Star Palace Artifact. I always thought relying on the Star Palace Artifact wasn’t true skill, that one should stand on the peak through genuine strength. Now I think about it, how foolish! What genuine strength? Being alive is the true strength."
Wang Lan glanced at Yu Ruoyun, surprised. "You’re not coveting my Saint Cloth, are you? I can’t give that to you."
"Heh... you can still joke at a time like this? They’re attacking. Let’s fight! Even if we die, we’ll take a few of them down with us."
"Alright!"
The Wind God Wyverns dove down from the sky, and Wang Lan was about to activate the Phoenix Form.
DONG—
Suddenly, a deep bell toll resonated. The bell toll, accompanied by sound waves visible to the naked eye, seemed to instantly sweep across space and time, traversing the desolate universe.
On hearing the bell, the Wind God Wyverns scattered like frightened sparrows, beating their wings to ascend high into the sky and disappear from sight.
DONG—
The bell continued to toll every three seconds. Within Jiang Xinyu’s perception, Exotic Beasts were rapidly retreating.
"This bell... what’s going on?"
"No idea. But I do know that the bell has a great impact on Exotic Beasts and none on us... Let’s go, find where the sound is coming from. Whether we live or die may depend on it."
Wang Lan quickly picked up the necklace at his feet, then with a swift movement, retrieved Bai Ji’s and Yue Jifeng’s backpacks, and hurried with Yu Ruoyun towards the source of the bell at top speed.
Both of them knew flying Star Martial Arts, so their travel speed was much faster than running on the ground. Though the bell seemed nearby, after covering two kilometers in the blink of an eye, they still hadn’t seen a trace of its source.
"What’s going on?!"
The bell rang ten times and then suddenly stopped.
After the bell ceased, those Exotic Beasts that had been dispersed by the bell seemed to fully recover their vitality and became active once more. Flying Exotic Beasts burst out from the dense forest one after another to circle in the air, while thousands of other beasts in the forest roared up at the sky.
Their expressions changed dramatically, and they instantly accelerated again.
Suddenly, directly ahead of them, hundreds of Wind God Wyverns appeared like a dense swarm of bees deep within the Cloud Sea.
Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun both stopped dead in their tracks, staring in horror at the overwhelming army of Exotic Beasts before them. They couldn’t fathom why this horde of Wind God Wyverns was flying towards them from the opposite direction. All they knew was that they were about to be instantly swallowed by the army of Exotic Beasts.
Retreating to the ground would be useless; the army of Exotic Beasts below was as dense as a swarm of ants. In the sky, they only needed to face flying Exotic Beasts, but descending to the ground would mean confronting an army composed of a hundred different races.
"Wang Lan, I have one last-ditch Star Martial Skill, but I haven’t mastered it yet. Whether I succeed or not, I will try to create a chance for you to survive. So, when I tell you to run later, you must run."
"The Dragon Emperor Form?"
"Yes!"
"Alright! I’ll activate the Phoenix Form too, but I can only maintain it for five minutes. If we can’t break through their ranks in five minutes, I’ll also try to create an opportunity for you."
"Okay!"
Instantly, golden Star Energy Fluctuations shimmered around Yu Ruoyun, and a golden dragon twined around her body in a spiral.
At the same time, Wang Lan activated the Phoenix Form.
A Phoenix Tail Flower insignia lit up on Wang Lan’s forehead. Flames instantly engulfed him, a pair of fiery phoenix wings spread out behind him, and a loud phoenix cry resounded.
ROAR—
At the very moment Wang Lan’s phoenix cry sounded, a dragon’s roar suddenly reached their ears. Both Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun sensed that something was amiss.
After they activated the Phoenix Form and the Dragon Emperor Form, their Star Powers began to attract each other like opposite poles of Yin and Yang. Their bodies were also irresistibly drawn closer and closer.
"What’s going on?" exclaimed Wang Lan in surprise.
"I don’t know, my Star Power is out of control!"
BOOM— Their palms, drawn together as if by Yin and Yang, slapped tightly against each other. The moment their palms connected, their Star Powers also merged wildly.
In an instant, Wang Lan’s mind was flooded with countless pieces of information. In the depths of his Spiritual Sea of Consciousness, the icon for the Phoenix Form on the system interface changed, transforming into a diamond-colored Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious symbol.
As the stream of information flooded his mind, Wang Lan’s eyes snapped open. He stared at Yu Ruoyun in wide-eyed amazement, and she, in turn, looked back at him with utter astonishment.
Yu Ruoyun had also transformed significantly in that moment. Her face was now covered in golden dragon scales, and two cute Dragon Horns had even sprouted from her forehead.
From Yu Ruoyun’s eyes, Wang Lan understood that she had experienced the exact same things he had.
After their Star Martial Skills attracted each other, not only did their Star Power fuse, but their Star Martial Skills also became interconnected.
Wang Lan could unleash all the Star Martial Skills that Yu Ruoyun could, and Yu Ruoyun could unleash all the Star Martial Skills Wang Lan had learned. The fusion of the Phoenix Form and the Dragon Emperor Form wasn’t just a qualitative change; their Star Power reserves had also skyrocketed severalfold.
The two of them were as if sharing one body.
At that very moment, the Wind God Wyverns from ahead had reached them. There was no time for astonishment or hesitation. They both instantly stirred their Star Energy Fluctuations. For aerial combat, the wind attribute was naturally the most suitable.
"Combined Star Martial Skill, Wind Edge Burn!"
With their minds perfectly synchronized, they simultaneously unleashed the Combined Star Martial Skill. The Wind Capturing Net, augmented by scorching flames, formed a giant golden net that hurtled towards the approaching flock of Wind God Wyverns.
SCREECH—
The dozen or so Wyverns that were hit faltered, while the remaining Wind God Wyverns scattered in all directions. Barriers rippled around the Wind God Wyverns, attempting to repel the combined blow, but their vibrating barriers began to visibly and rapidly fade.
"Combined Star Martial Skill, Purple Flame Fire Dragon—"
Suddenly, they both launched another super-S-grade Star Martial Skill at the same time. A purple dragon, glowing like amethyst crystal, burst forth from the array. Accompanied by Flash Thunder, it slammed into their opponents.
BOOM—
The ensnared Wyverns were hit squarely by the Purple Flame Fire Dragon. A loud explosion shook heaven and earth, and five Wind God Wyverns exploded in mid-air, torn to shreds. Another seven or eight Wind God Wyverns were heavily injured and flapped their wings to flee into the distance.
The scattered Wind God Wyverns circled wide and then returned, attacking Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun from behind. Having struck a successful blow, Yu Ruoyun’s fighting spirit blazed. Remembering the tragic deaths of Bai Ji and Yue Jifeng, her killing intent solidified and radiated outwards.
"Ruoyun, I only have five minutes," Wang Lan urgently reminded her.
"Retreat—"
The fiery wings behind Wang Lan suddenly expanded. With a light flap, the two of them broke the sound barrier, shooting into the distance as streaks of light.
Excited shrieks suddenly came from the Wind God Wyverns behind them.
The Wind God Wyverns prided themselves on their speed; in this entire realm, they had never encountered an Exotic Beast that could fly faster.
These two strange-looking creatures... they can actually fly so fast?!
This realization was, of course, intolerable to them.
Instantly, the Wind God Wyverns flapped their wings furiously. Their wind-affinity tails flared like rocket thrusters, propelling them like arrows in pursuit of Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun.
Wang Lan could no longer hear the wind; the world around him was terrifyingly silent.
Although he didn’t know exactly how fast they were moving, it was definitely supersonic. Yet, despite this incredible speed, they hadn’t spotted any signs of human civilization.
Could that bell sound just be a fluke of nature, some kind of geological phenomenon?
Wang Lan even began to doubt.
His skill points were rapidly depleting, and time was ticking away. Yet, the Wind God Wyverns still pursued them relentlessly.
"Wang Lan, look!" Following Yu Ruoyun’s gaze, a solitary peak appeared in their field of vision. Its shape was peculiar, like a colossal sword thrust vertically into the earth.
If this were a sword, it would be one wielded by a giant a thousand feet tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: The Seventh Level is Destroyed
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 305: The Seventh Level is Destroyed
"Whew—"
The wings violently flapped again, and the reflections on both sides turned into virtual lines. Like a meteor, he sped toward the solitary peak, closing in rapidly.
HISS HISS HISS—
Suddenly, dozens of massive exotic beasts burst forth from below. Although they weren’t as huge as the Golden Eagle he had initially encountered, their size alone indicated they were not to be trifled with.
Moreover, as these figures broke through the void, beams of light rained down like dense droplets. If Wang Lan hadn’t already been moving at high speed, he believed he would not have been able to dodge these laser strikes.
And the power of these light beams was such that a graze would leave them severely injured, while a direct hit would mean instant death.
Despite his speed, Wang Lan’s Flame Wings were unexpectedly agile. It was as if each feather could be controlled to make fine adjustments, allowing Wang Lan to maintain high speed while dexterously changing direction.
The exotic beasts below didn’t seem particularly interested in Wang Lan. After a few probing attacks, they surprisingly didn’t give chase, allowing Wang Lan to break through and fly into the solitary peak’s domain.
"Wang Lan, we’re going to crash, we’re going to crash—We’re about to hit it—!" Yu Ruoyun yelled, pale with fright.
"Fuck, I’m out of Star Power—!" Wang Lan’s face also drastically changed with fear.
BOOM—
With a loud crash, Wang Lan tightly hugged Yu Ruoyun in his arms, turning his back at the critical moment to bravely withstand a terrifying impact with the Phoenix Saint Cloth.
BANG BANG BANG—
A series of dense explosions sounded not far away. The relentlessly pursuing Wind God Wyverns had caught up to them. But they didn’t have Wang Lan’s agile dodging abilities.
They were nearly wiped out by a round of attacks from the beasts below.
The protective barriers surrounding the Wind God Wyverns proved utterly useless; even a slight graze from the light beams caused them to explode in mid-air, leaving no corpse behind.
「At this moment, outside at the Star Martial Academy in Modu City.」
After receiving the order to temporarily end the Nine-layer Pagoda trial, the seniors and those students who had signed up for the trial began to walk out the gates one after another. As more people exited, Eld Di’s face grew increasingly grim.
"Eld Di... Has Yu Ruoyun...?" a pale-faced tactical instructor asked. Although he already had a suspicion, he dared not voice it.
All of the students had exited the gate, but the most important student was nowhere to be found.
"Has anyone seen Yu Ruoyun?" Eld Di asked somberly as he approached the neatly lined-up crowd.
"Principal, I saw him five days ago. Yu Ruoyun and three classmates were grinding at the site of the Golden Winged Fire Scorpions. And... the battle was fierce."
"I remember, later it seemed like there was a big battle, and by the time we got there, we couldn’t find Student Yu Ruoyun. But the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion tribe had been wiped out, and there were traces of clean-up at the scene. I guess Yu Ruoyun must have gone somewhere else to grind."
"Has anyone seen Yu Ruoyun after that?"
The students fell silent; the last sighting of Yu Ruoyun was two days ago. The incident at the Nine-layer Pagoda occurred this morning.
"How are the casualties?"
"Twenty dead, one hundred and fifty injured. The rest are either uninjured or slightly injured," reported the leading instructor.
Eld Di looked at the seventh level of the Nine-layer Pagoda mountainous area, which was shining with light. "Nangong, I plan to go to the seventh level. Please take care of the academy in the meantime."
"Principal! Please reconsider."
"Ruoyun must be safe!" Eld Di insisted emphatically.
Just as Eld Di took a step forward, he suddenly trembled all over. Looking up, he saw the signboard of the seventh level had gone out.
Eld Di, who had weathered countless storms and always remained composed, suddenly turned pale.
The extinguishing of the seventh level meant one thing: those who had entered the seventh level were dead. The Nine-layer Pagoda could no longer sense their life energy.
In an instant, everyone’s expression changed, and those who understood what it meant showed various reactions.
There was shock, horror, anger, and even relief.
"Principal, they’re dead!" Nangong Meng suddenly grabbed Eld Di’s arm.
"Open the pagoda!" Eld Di’s cheeks twitched violently as he held back his anger and commanded.
"Principal! They’re already dead, and it’s meaningless for you to go now. Perhaps not even their bodies will be left."
"At least I can find out how they got to the seventh level."
"Principal, not even the Five Emperors are sure about dealing with the exotic beasts on the seventh level. You must remain calm; the academy can’t function without you."
"Principal—"
The teachers who had come to their senses quickly pleaded in unison.
Eld Di shook off Nangong Meng’s arm and stepped toward the entrance of the Nine-layer Pagoda.
"Principal! They’re already dead! Are you really going to ruin the academy’s two-hundred-year foundation for those who’ve already sacrificed themselves? If you fight your way to the seventh layer, what will become of the academy? What about the future students?" Nangong Meng questioned, looking at Eld Di’s back.
"If they were still alive, I would bet the entire academy and accompany you on this journey, but look! The seventh layer has already been extinguished!"
Nangong Meng’s words made Eld Di shudder once more, as if in an instant, all his strength was drained from his body, vanishing into thin air.
「In the Nine-layer Pagoda’s seventh layer, Yu Ruoyun carried Wang Lan across the endless seven thousand steps.」
The fierce impact was finally resisted by the Phoenix Form, but even so, Wang Lan’s inner palace was still severely damaged. However, with the Self Healing talent, as long as he didn’t die on the spot, he could recover quickly.
After the Phoenix Form ended, Wang Lan blissfully passed out.
Yu Ruoyun, who had also used up the Dragon Emperor Form, wasn’t as fortunate as Wang Lan. Despite having exhausted her Star Power and physical strength, she persisted in carrying Wang Lan across the lengthy steps and brought him to the entrance of a great hall.
After placing Wang Lan on the ground, Yu Ruoyun herself slumped down powerlessly. Yet, just three seconds after sitting, Yu Ruoyun forced herself up again, her face full of worry as she looked at Wang Lan, her eyes sparkling with sharpness.
Wang Lan’s condition at this moment was very bad!
Golden flames flickered around his body, and this time, instead of protecting Wang Lan, the flames were crazily eroding his body.
When Yu Ruoyun had picked up Wang Lan, she had already sensed his condition; he was like someone possessed, with boiling Star Power coursing through his body. However, having also experienced Star Power Fusion, Yu Ruoyun’s condition was entirely different from Wang Lan’s.
The Dragon Emperor Form, which had been stuck for nearly three years, had surprisingly made a breakthrough after the fusion of Star Power.
So this is what Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious within the Azure Dragon Skill actually meant.
Even her great uncle, Qing Emperor, who inherited the Azure Dragon Skill, never truly mastered the Dragon Emperor Form because it lacked Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious. But the Qing Emperor, with his dazzling and unmatched talent, had merged the Azure Dragon Skill with the essence of wood, taking a different path to create the Azure Dragon Form. However, this method was too difficult, the conditions too demanding, and perhaps throughout history, only Qing Emperor himself could achieve it.
Yu Ruoyun had planned to wait until her Cultivation Level reached the latter stages of the Star Sea Stage and then attempt to follow in her great uncle’s footsteps.
