Even if it wasn’t the exact same path, it could serve as a reference. But she never imagined that the conditions for Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious would be met so effortlessly.
But... what on earth is happening with Wang Lan’s condition?
Yu Ruoyun bit her lip tightly and extended her hand towards Wang Lan’s forehead. The Phoenix Star Power continuously flowed into Yu Ruoyun’s body, and the worsening of Wang Lan’s body’s condition slowed.
But this was not a sustainable solution. Star Power didn’t appear out of thin air; without absorbing Soul Beads, an abnormal increase in Star Power had only one source—overdrawing cellular life.
In just this short period, a few white hairs had unexpectedly appeared on Wang Lan’s head.
Yu Ruoyun’s eyes flickered. A blush suddenly stained her pretty cheeks as she gazed, transfixed, at Wang Lan’s serene face. Slowly, her ’predatory’ hand reached for the ’tender youth’.
Wang Lan had a deep and terrifying dream. He and Yu Ruoyun collided head-on with an isolated peak and continued their trajectory, smashing through the Earth’s mantle and reaching the core.
In the core, magma was everywhere, its extreme heat almost roasting him alive. But at the crucial moment, Jiang Xinyu crossed time and space to arrive; a single Aurora blossomed and froze the whole mantle, dissipating the oppressive heat.
Returning to a cooler state, Wang Lan felt the heaviness of his eyelids and sluggishly opened his eyes. CLANG. A soft noise echoed near his ear. Wang Lan turned his head to find his Phoenix Saint Cloth had somehow been dismantled, scattered to the side.
Meanwhile, Yu Ruoyun was sitting not far from him, her body surrounded by Star Power that flickered like a pulsating heartbeat.
In an instant, Wang Lan recalled the events that had transpired and quickly sank into his Spiritual Sea of Consciousness. The Phoenix Form had evolved into Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious, and it was now a diamond-level Star Martial Skill.
In a rush, Wang Lan focused his spiritual power on Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious. Possessing the Power of Dragon and Phoenix, its might doubled once activated, yet the consumption of skill points remained ten per second.
Thank goodness, the system still has some integrity and didn’t inflate the cost on the spot.
The only thing that annoyed Wang Lan was that the learning requirement for Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious had climbed a level, from the Galaxy Stage to the Star Sea Stage.
Just as I was about to break through to the Galaxy Stage and completely master the Phoenix Form along with other Star Martial Skills, you freaking evolved too?
Wang Lan sighed and slowly sat up.
"You’re awake?" Yu Ruoyun’s voice carried an unnatural gentleness that struck Wang Lan.
Hmm, maybe she wanted to be gentle but was unaccustomed to it, which made her seem awkward,
he thought.
"Where is this? How did we get here?" Wang Lan curiously scanned the hall. It was a decrepit grand hall. In the center, a deity should have been enshrined, but the altar now held nothing but a pile of rubble, a challenge even for a master puzzler to reconstruct.
"This is the Fairy Cloud Sect! The isolated peak we collided with is the mountain gate of the Fairy Cloud Sect. After we fell, we discovered this complex of buildings, and then I carried you here. How are you feeling? Do you feel any discomfort?"
"My body?" Wang Lan was initially confused. Yu Ruoyun’s tone wasn’t that of a routine inquiry but rather one of deep concern, as if he’d fallen seriously ill.
I must have been unconscious for quite some time,
he instantly realized.
Normally, with my Self Healing ability, I shouldn’t have been unconscious for so long. Even with the aftereffects of the Phoenix Form, I’ve built up quite an immunity. It’s unthinkable that I would have been carried here by Yu Ruoyun without being aware of anything.
"Did something go wrong with my body before?"
"Yes! My Dragon Emperor Form fused with your Phoenix Form to achieve Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious. My Azure Dragon Skill requires Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious for Foundation Establishment, which is why I couldn’t master it for so long. But I succeeded after our Star Power fused. However, because my Star Power level was much higher than yours, I absorbed too much of your Phoenix Star Power, causing your Foundation Establishment to fail. As a result, your Star Power began to backlash against your body. In the end, I had to transfer half of the Dao foundation of my Azure Dragon Skill to you to save your life."
"Sounds very dangerous... Can the Dao foundation really be transferred?"
Yu Ruoyun’s expression turned somewhat unnatural. "There are special methods to do so, indeed. But it’s a secret technique."
"I understand. I’m not planning to learn it."

chapters.title: Chapter 306 Fairy Cloud Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 306 Fairy Cloud Sect
"How long was I in a coma?"
"About two days. There’s no reference to time here, so I can’t accurately determine it," Yu Ruoyun replied.
Wang Lan struggled to stand up, and CLATTER, a necklace fell from his chest and scattered. The pendant of the necklace opened, revealing a photograph inside.
A little girl in her teens, apparently Bai Ji, was pictured, with a man hugging her from behind. When Wang Lan caught sight of the man, his pupils shrank abruptly.
Yu Ruoyun looked at Wang Lan curiously, pursed her lips, and said, "Don’t you have a girlfriend? When did you start falling for Bai Ji?"
"Huh?" Wang Lan looked up at Yu Ruoyun, confused.
"Cut the act! I noticed before when Speedy Wind and Bai Ji got together, you’ve had unnatural expressions on your face several times. Now you’ve been staring at Bai Ji’s necklace for so long, waxing nostalgic?"
"I always thought you were a calm and rational woman; I never imagined you’d show an emotional side," Wang Lan said with a slight smile. "And your ability to imagine things is second to none."
"Are you implying that I’m not a woman in your eyes?"
"Hmm! You’re a goddess, a goddess for the masses."
"Humph... Xinyu called you a blockhead and a clueless oaf, but it seems... She doesn’t know you. You’re good at flirting."
"I’m just telling the truth."
"I don’t want to listen to your nonsense. I know what I look like, and my sense of beauty is no different from the average person’s."
"Do you think I’m complimenting you? Please, we’re teammates, comrades who’ve fought side-by-side, okay? Do you think I’m so superficial? I’m not someone who only cares about looks.
"The ’mass goddess’ label wasn’t even my idea—it was given by all the students at Modu City’s Star Martial Academy. Not to mention, the two guys from my dormitory revere you so much that they nearly stand at attention and salute whenever your name comes up, almost ready to sing the national anthem.
"Don’t you know the image you have in the hearts of our classmates? You’re like a goddess in the Moon Palace, so high up and cold that you can only be admired from a distance but never approached. You’re forever strong, wise, and brilliant in martial arts. Yet... you just don’t connect with being a woman."
"Enough, enough... Stop talking," Yu Ruoyun interjected, waving her hand. "If you keep this up, I won’t dare to look in the mirror anymore."
"Why not?"
"I’m afraid I won’t be able to resist worshipping it."
"Heh heh..."
"So why were you staring at the necklace and daydreaming?"
"There’s a photograph inside the necklace," Wang Lan showed Yu Ruoyun the photo he was holding.
"And? I’ve seen it before. It’s just an ordinary photo, must be from Bai Ji’s childhood," Yu Ruoyun commented.
"But this photo tells me why someone wanted to assassinate Bai Ji."
"Oh? Does it have to do with that man?"
"Yeah, that man is Xiao Qing, the one who was arrested by the Tianjian Bureau recently, the one who controlled the entire underworld Soul Bead trade in Modu City. A lot of people dealt with Xiao Qing, and now that he’s caught, many would prefer him dead immediately.
"Even until his death, he never revealed who was behind him. But the person behind him wanted to eliminate all traces. I didn’t expect that Bai Ji was Xiao Qing’s daughter. Some civilian genius who achieved great success simply through hard work... Turns out it’s just a fairy tale."
"Is that so?" Yu Ruoyun seemed not to be greatly moved. But then again, they were in a desperate situation with no mood to concern themselves with anything else.
"Are there no Exotic Beasts here?"
"For some reason, Exotic Beasts dare not come close."
Wang Lan felt he had mostly recovered and slowly stood up.
"Have you looked around yet?"
"Not yet. I’ve been looking after you this whole time. You nearly died seven or eight times in the past two days. So, how about now? Are you sure you’re okay?"
"I’m fine!"
As long as the Song of Life Star Martial Skill did not flicker, that meant he was okay.
"Let’s go, let’s take a look around. What exactly is this Fairy Cloud Sect? For all we know, it might actually be an Immortal Cultivation Sect. If we could find a scripture, treasure, or Golden Core to let us ascend in broad daylight, that would be wonderful."
"Dream on, ascending in broad daylight. I think daydreaming is more like it," Yu Ruoyun teased, standing up and taking a step forward, but suddenly stumbled and nearly fell.
Wang Lan quickly reached out a hand to support her. "What’s wrong?"
"Nothing, just a bit weak," she replied.
The two supported each other as they walked out of the great hall.
The instant they emerged, they were awestruck by the natural landscape.
The solitary peaks that had violently collided were positioned directly east of the great hall, and the hall itself was located at the summit of a mountain. Outside the hall, there were steps that continued down to the mountain base, each step half a meter high.
The surrounding mountains encircled them, the Cloud Sea fluctuated, and the dense jungle spread as far as the eye could see.
Countless flying Exotic Beasts circled in the distant sky, while the jungle echoed intermittently with the roars of beasts.
"Did you carry me up these stairs?" Wang Lan asked in surprise.
"What do you think? Otherwise, why would I be weak?" Yu Ruoyun replied, her cheeks blushing lightly again. "If it had just been you, it wouldn’t have been too difficult, but your armor alone must weigh at least thirty-three pounds. Carrying nearly two hundred and twenty pounds of you, I climbed for a full day and night."
"You really had it tough!"
"It was okay."
"Did you find that big bell?"
"Haven’t had the chance to look yet."
Following the cobblestone path outside the main hall, Wang Lan turned to arrive at the back of the hall. However, behind the hall was a continuous expanse of ruins.
The ruins had been desolate for who knows how many years. Judging from the scale, the Fairy Cloud Sect was once incredibly splendid and prosperous. Evidence of battle was visible everywhere, likely the result of annihilation and war. Clearly, the Fairy Cloud Sect had been destroyed in this manner.
"Wang Lan, look!" Following Yu Ruoyun’s direction, Wang Lan indeed found scattered white bones among the ruins.
Wang Lan leapt towards the bones in a few bounds. The bones had severely weathered, crumbling into dust at the slightest touch.
Returning to Yu Ruoyun’s side, he said, "These dry bones must be several thousand years old. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be so severely weathered. The Fairy Cloud Sect must have suffered a catastrophe, the entire sect destroyed."
"But if that’s the case, why does the main hall remain intact? And why don’t the Exotic Beasts dare to approach?"
"It might have something to do with that big bell. Did you hear the bell ringing again after that?"
"I heard it twice, ten chimes each time. Maybe the bell rings once every day. But the strange thing is, I can’t tell where the sound of the bell comes from. After arriving at the Fairy Cloud Sect, the bell sounds seemed to come from everywhere."
"Let’s look around. Be careful!"
Wang Lan supported Yu Ruoyun as they circled the Fairy Cloud Sect. Apart from the main hall, the entire sect lay in ruins.
"Strange..."
"DONG—" Suddenly, a bell chimed, resounding right next to Wang Lan’s ear. Wang Lan hastily looked around. But the bell sounded omnipresent; no matter where Wang Lan turned, the chiming was clear.
"DONG—" Birds in the distance flew away in terror, and even the intermittent roars of beasts fell silent.
Suddenly, Wang Lan gazed up at the sky, transfixed.
The sky seemed to ripple, spreading outwards.
"Ruoyun, we... might... be inside that big bell," speculated Wang Lan.
"What? Why can’t I see it."
"This big bell covers the entire Fairy Cloud Sect, and it’s transparent. That’s why we are inside the bell, and when it rings, it seems as if the sound comes from all directions."
Yu Ruoyun, imitating Wang Lan’s action, looked up and after a while nodded in agreement. "That’s the only explanation."
"Ruoyun, have you ever thought, why is the entire Fairy Cloud Sect in ruins, all the buildings collapsed, yet only that main hall remains unscathed?"
"Maybe... the hall is made of more durable materials?" Yu Ruoyun said, then laughed at her own idea. "I’m just spouting nonsense. Logically, the materials of the main hall should be the same as the other buildings."
"I guess... that main hall must’ve been something the Fairy Cloud Sect desperately preserved. But with the sect destroyed, why keep the main hall?" Wang Lan’s eyes suddenly brightened.
"Legacy!"
"It must be. Let’s go back to the main hall to search. They say that one who survives a great disaster is destined for good luck. We’ve been unfortunate enough to be sent to this haunting place; it’d be a shame not to find any fortuitous encounters to make up for this experience."
"Why would you think that?"
"What?"
"That facing danger means there must be fortuitous encounters?"
"Don’t the protagonists in TV dramas always do this? They’re thrown off a cliff by someone, find a peerless divine weapon, and return to the martial world to slay all their enemies. Their Star palace gets destroyed, but then they encounter a Star Martial legend, rebuild their Star palace and return to the peak."
Yu Ruoyun looked at Wang Lan with a gradually weird expression, mixed with deep pity.
"You really are naïve and romantic."
"It’s called not forgetting one’s original aspiration."
Although they were bantering, it was merely to comfort each other’s tense emotions. As for whether there were treasures or legacies inside the main hall...
There probably were.
Wang Lan had analyzed it before. All other buildings had collapsed, so it made no sense for the main hall to be undamaged. Furthermore, the invisible big bell enveloping the Fairy Cloud Sect was clearly protecting something.
What the bell protected certainly wasn’t the expanse of ruins.
Thus, it could only be the main hall.
Yet, the inside of the main hall was in disarray. Even the spots where chairs had once been arranged were now just piles of dust. If not for the marks of the chairs, Wang Lan might have thought the main hall had always been empty.
The central staircase of the main hall had collapsed, and even the statue that was originally enshrined had turned into rubble on the ground. The only thing of note was that pile of stone debris.
Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun approached the rubble of the enshrined statue together. The stones were brittle, easily crushed to pieces.
While sorting through the rubble, Wang Lan suddenly hesitated as he observed a piece of irregularly shaped stone in his hand.
"Ruoyun, the color of this stone seems off. It doesn’t look like a naturally formed stone—it seems more like... concrete?"
"Instructor Wang, please be rational. Concrete has only been around for less than seven hundred years."
"CRACK—" Wang Lan gently pinched, and the concrete crumbled.
A brilliant blue Soul Bead appeared in the palm of Wang Lan’s hand.
Wang Lan raised his eyebrows, looking at Yu Ruoyun.
Though he didn’t speak, his meaning was clear. Now, what do you have to say?
Yu Ruoyun was utterly dumbfounded.
Had he really guessed right?
Suddenly, Yu Ruoyun quickly sifted through the rubble and unearthed a piece of stone resembling concrete. With a light pinch, the stone shattered, revealing a fiery red, top-quality Soul Bead in the palm of Yu Ruoyun’s hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Ancient Cultivation Civilization
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 307: Ancient Cultivation Civilization
After a thorough cleansing, the two of them found eight Soul Beads, all of which were of superior quality. To prevent any oversights, they even crushed all the rocks to dust.
"It must be a deliberate inheritance left by the Fairy Cloud Sect, such painstaking effort," Wang Lan murmured with a sigh.
"All of them are superior Soul Beads. The Star Martial Skills inside must be at least S-grade, or even super S-grade," Yu Ruoyun said, picking up a blue Soul Bead and sinking her spiritual power into it. "Supreme Goodness Like Water? It’s a Water Attribute Star Martial Skill. The grade is indeed very high."
"You’re just going to take a glance?" Wang Lan asked in surprise when he saw Yu Ruoyun withdraw her spiritual power so quickly. "Aren’t you going to learn it?"
"Strictly speaking, these are spoils of war and should be handed over to the country. Besides, we can’t learn so many high-level Star Martial Skills; the nation desperately needs these powerful techniques..."
"What if students obtain a Star Palace Artifact? Do they also have to hand it over to the nation?"
"This... naturally, they don’t have to." Yu Ruoyun had already caught Wang Lan’s drift. "But... Star Martial Skills are different. It’s not that my ideological awareness is really that high, nor am I some kind of saint. An individual’s strength cannot change the strength of a country. Handing these Star Martial Skills over to the country enables it to train more powerful Star Martial Warriors, which will enhance our overall strength. I possess the Dragon Emperor Form, and you have the Phoenix Form. Just mastering one of these skills would be enough to occupy us for a lifetime. Learning more would be biting off more than we can chew. Besides, wouldn’t it be a waste of these other Star Martial Skills?"
"We’ve fallen into such dire straits; we don’t even know if we’ll make it out of here alive..."
"Since we’re taking refuge here, as long as we don’t die, those on the outside will surely try everything to save us. I hadn’t considered that before, but after analyzing it, my life and death are tied to a potential upheaval that could shake Jade Country. Jade Country probably won’t just sit by and watch. If the Five Emperors joined forces, they might be able to reach us here and rescue us."
"Then..." Wang Lan had a look of defeat on his face. "We found eight Soul Beads. It wouldn’t be too much for each of us to learn one, would it?"
"Er..." Meeting Wang Lan’s gaze, Yu Ruoyun hesitated for a long moment before finally nodding. The items were found by them together; it wouldn’t be wrong to call them their fortuitous encounter. If she refused even this request, she would indeed be acting too much like a saint. Yu Ruoyun believed in not biting off more than one could chew, but Wang Lan might not share that sentiment.
"Alright. My innate attribute is fire, so I’ll choose the red one."
"Then I’ll choose the cyan one."
They each selected a Soul Bead and then sat down separately to begin absorbing them.
BUZZ.
As they absorbed the Soul Beads, a vast torrent of information surged into their Spiritual Seas of Consciousness.
"Unlearnable Star Martial Skill detected. Attempting forced loading... Forced loading failed. Host does not meet learning requirements. Seal Star Martial Skill?"
It can be sealed?
Wang Lan’s eyes flickered as he selected ’yes’.
Instantly, a new icon appeared on his skill panel, shaped like a book. Wang Lan focused his spiritual power on the book. The displayed skill name was: Infinite Fire Skill.
Indeed, it’s a super S-grade Star Martial Skill, even higher in grade than the Phoenix Form, especially since the learning requirement is the Star Sea realm. The book is just a representation.
Once Wang Lan had absorbed the skill, he already understood what the Infinite Fire Skill entailed. It was a Cultivation Technique for practicing five specific types of flames, different from the conventional Star Martial Skills he was familiar with.
If I had to point out the difference, the Star Martial Skills I knew were like a complex martial art manual broken down into individual moves. For example, with the Dragon Subduing Palms, one move like ’Regret of the Proud Dragon’ would be one Star Martial Skill, and ’Divine Dragon Swings its Tail’ would be another.
This Infinite Fire Skill, however, was an entire cultivation method for a set of Star Martial Skills. The ’Infinite Fire’ consisted of five types: True Sunfire, which incinerates the earth; Samadhi True Fire, which cannot be extinguished; Netherworld Ghost Fire, which scorches the soul; Red Lotus Karma Fire, which punishes wickedness; and the all-annihilating Nine Heavens Thunder Fire.
Each type of flame had different effects, and their destructive power increased progressively. True Sunfire was pure light and heat, while Samadhi True Fire was undoubtedly the ultimate tool for reducing enemies to ashes. Once touched by Samadhi True Fire, it wouldn’t extinguish until its target was completely incinerated. This flame alone could instantly kill a vast number of foes. The Netherworld Ghost Fire and Red Lotus Karma Fire were even more terrifying, both being insidious attacks that were incredibly difficult to defend against.
Even though I can’t use it yet, I’m very satisfied with this. At least it will be very convenient to use with my Flame Sword in the future.
When Wang Lan opened his eyes, he saw Yu Ruoyun opening hers at the same moment.
"It’s a Wind Attribute Cultivation Technique... This is a Cultivation Technique from the Ancient Era! A Cultivation Technique that could form the foundation of an entire Star Martial System... Wang Lan, these Soul Beads are too important to Jade Country! We must deliver them, even if it means risking our lives!" Yu Ruoyun exclaimed, her voice filled with excitement.
"An Ancient Era Cultivation Technique? Are you saying... that in Ancient Times, we actually had complete Cultivation Techniques?"
"Yes!" Yu Ruoyun’s face was flushed as she nodded vigorously. "Ever since humanity appeared, Star Martial Warriors have been born among us. Many powerful Star Martial Warriors from the Ancient Era left behind myths and legends. Although these legends may have been exaggerated, we once did possess an advanced and complete cultivation system. But all of that was shattered by the invasions of the Demon Clan. According to records, the first invasion by the Demon Clan occurred during the era of the goddess Nüwa. Legend has it that the heavens and earth were fractured, and Extraterrestrial Demons poured into the mortal realm through the cracks in the sky, slaughtering all living beings. Nüwa led the human race in resistance and ultimately refined five-colored stones to mend the heavens, sealing the breach and keeping the Extraterrestrial Demons confined to the outer chaos. But the lands ravaged by the Extraterrestrial Demons were left in ruins, with catastrophic losses of life."
"Afterward, similar legends of great calamities continued to circulate. However, three thousand years ago, legends of ancient powerhouses became scarce. Still, some Qi Cultivator sects continued to widely accept disciples and pass on their teachings. By two thousand years ago, even those Qi Cultivator sects had vanished, with only occasional legends of Land Immortals surfacing. Even with such sporadic traces, some families and individuals connected to the Ancient Immortal Gates have passed down their heritage to this day. Do you know of the Lv Family?"
"The Lv Family?"
"Yes, the Aolai Lv Family. They claim to be descendants of disciples from an Ancient Immortal Gate, the Sunlight Sword Sect. Their family indeed possesses many ancient oracle bone steles. While it’s possible they fabricated this history, there’s also a significant chance it’s true. And now, this Fairy Cloud Sect and its remaining legacy are irrefutable proof. In Ancient Times, there existed a Star Martial Art civilization far superior to our current one, possessing a complete heritage. Yet, due to repeated invasions by the Demon Clan, this heritage was severed, and the civilization was destroyed. The Nine-layer Pagoda, the Azure Dragon Skill, and the Star Palace Artifacts we’ve excavated from Different Dimensional Spaces over the years all attest to this."
"So... assuming the ancient cultivation civilization could have been preserved until now, how much stronger would humanity be?" Wang Lan asked curiously.
A person’s status truly determines their perspective. No matter how exceptional I might be, for the past seventeen years, I was merely an ordinary citizen. An ordinary citizen has limited access to information. Even when exposed to some, it could have been deliberately arranged, meaning what I saw wasn’t necessarily the truth. Without detailed information, without correct materials, even the brightest mind is no different from an ignorant fool.
Wang Lan didn’t feel ashamed about this; asking questions when he didn’t understand had always been his habit.
"It would be a world-altering difference!" Yu Ruoyun declared. "If the ancient cultivation civilization had endured to this day, the Demon Clan probably wouldn’t dare to invade us anymore. With our technological civilization combined with that cultivation civilization, we might even be able to fight our way back into the Demon World!"
"Is it really that exaggerated? If the ancient cultivation civilization was so powerful, why was it gradually driven to decline by the Demon Clan’s attacks?"
"The eras were different! How could the number of Star Martial Warriors in Ancient Times compare to now? Research from the human gene pool indicates that the number of Star Martial Warriors has been continuously increasing with human evolution. Two thousand years ago, during the Great Tang Dynasty, in the reign of Emperor Ming, an inscription from the Mount Tai Fengshan sacrificial ceremony stated, ’I command fifty thousand Heavenly Soldiers, bearing the destiny of millions.’ During Emperor Ming’s era, it had been one hundred and ten years since the last Demon Clan invasion, and the Great Tang Dynasty was at its zenith. The policy of the Great Tang Dynasty was to not overlook a single Star Martial Warrior; all Star Martial Warriors were conscripted into the Heavenly Soldier Army. Even those not actively serving in the military had to be registered with the Heavenly Soldier Army. So, when Emperor Ming claimed to have fifty thousand Heavenly Soldiers, it likely meant the Great Tang Dynasty had fifty thousand Star Martial Warriors. Compared to the population of less than two hundred million at the time, this ratio is only one-tenth of what it is now. Before the advent of Soul Resonance Technology, the most recent census of Star Martial Warriors in Jade Country, with a population of four hundred million, counted two hundred thousand. Compared to the Tang Dynasty period, this ratio has doubled. Extrapolating from that, when the ancient cultivation civilization was flourishing, the total population of the Central Plains was perhaps only fifty to sixty million. The number of naturally awakened Star Martial Warriors might have been only around ten thousand. For ten thousand individuals to repeatedly repel the Demon Clan’s armies... one can only imagine how powerful they must have been back then! The ancient cultivation civilization was diverse and focused heavily on the aspect of ’cultivation,’ unlike now, where the focus is on continuous self-improvement. Some scholars speculate that perhaps in Ancient Times, there was a cultivation system that, like our education system, allowed for gradual progression and wasn’t solely dependent on innate talent. If that ancient civilization’s heritage had survived to this day, with Jade Country’s two million Star Martial Warriors, what would we have to fear from the Demon Clan?"
All Wang Lan could think was,
Impressive! She’s absolutely right, no argument there!
As Yu Ruoyun finished speaking, she looked at the six remaining Soul Beads with a regretful expression.
It’s such a pity. These ancient Cultivation Techniques are too profound. They might be the ultimate God Skill Masteries of the Fairy Cloud Sect. They probably didn’t anticipate that their descendants wouldn’t need these ultimate skills the most, but rather the basic cultivation methods!
"They also wouldn’t have expected that the vast cultivation civilization would be gradually destroyed by the Demon Clan, severing the lineage," Wang Lan remarked. "But then again, if the cultivation civilization hadn’t been destroyed, we might not have developed our technological civilization. Perhaps... it would have been eliminated as heresy in its nascent stages."
"Perhaps," Yu Ruoyun conceded. She stood up and looked at the mess behind them. "We’ve gained so much from this place. Let’s clean up this debris. Since we’ve received their legacy, we can consider ourselves indirect disciples of the Fairy Cloud Sect."
Cleaning up, even without tools, wouldn’t have been a difficult task for two powerful Star Martial Warriors like Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun. However, to show their respect, they went outside to gather some branches and dry grass to fashion simple brooms and dusters.
"Wang Lan—" Yu Ruoyun, who had been busy and was now sweating, turned around to find Wang Lan gone. In that instant, she once again revealed a more vulnerable, feminine side. Not seeing her companion, she called out in a panic.
"I just went to the latrine! Don’t come over here!" Wang Lan shouted hastily, hearing her voice drawing nearer.
As he was zipping up his pants, Wang Lan suddenly froze.
Damn it! I didn’t even realize I’d put my underwear on inside out.

chapters.title: Chapter 308 Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 308 Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record
"Wang Lan—"
Suddenly, Yu Ruoyun called out again.
"Coming, coming..."
"Wang Lan, look!" Yu Ruoyun pointed at the altar where they had been clearing the stones. A pattern resembling immortal runes was revealed on the cleaned-up spot.
"What’s wrong? Isn’t this just an ordinary relief?"
"No, I’ve read ancient texts before. During Ancient Times, the civilization of cultivation was extremely prosperous, but the evolution of writing had just begun. People couldn’t use simple characters to convey complex language."
"In the civilization of cultivation, they had a unique method of recording language called runes. A rune doesn’t represent a character but can store spiritual consciousness within it."
"Wang Lan, look at this pattern in the lines; it very much resembles a rune."
"Like a Soul Bead engraving?"
"Right. Soul Beads are great for saving Star Martial Skills, but runes are like the USB drives of our age."
"Soul Bead engravings first require a Soul Bead. But what do you do when you have no Soul Beads? Rune engravings, however, just need you to carve the runes, although... nobody knows how to carve them."
"The use of runes is clearly recorded in the Yanhuang Period, where Yanhuang engaged in war along the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River. Yan was ambushed and trapped by Huang at Qiu Mountain. Yan then drew a rune in the air, conveying messages over thousands of miles, summoning Qingniao for aid and was thus relieved from the encirclement!"
"From this description, it’s clear that runes were used not only for recording but for many other purposes, such as transmitting messages over long distances."
"Feels... almost like the work of immortals," Wang Lan couldn’t help but snark.
"After all, to ordinary people in Ancient Times, Star Martial Warriors were like immortals. Let’s clean up and look for how to read these runes. Perhaps what’s recorded in the runes is the basic Cultivation Technique we’re in dire need of."
Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun quickly got to work. After cleaning the altar thoroughly, a look of regret appeared in their eyes.
What was previously just the tip of the iceberg led Yu Ruoyun to guess it was a rune. After cleaning, Yu Ruoyun was sure it was a rune. But... the rune inscribed on the altar was already shattered.
As if struck by a violent impact, densely packed cracks began to spread out from the center of the altar, and over a dozen runes were divided by the cracks. With the runes broken, whatever was recorded inside was certainly gone.
All destroyed! What a pity.
Yu Ruoyun inwardly lamented the loss. Still unwilling to give up, she concentrated her spiritual intent on each rune, only to be met with emptiness in return.
"All destroyed! What a pity."
"Let me try." Seeing Yu Ruoyun step back, Wang Lan stepped forward, summoned his spiritual power, and then plunged headfirst into the runes.
BOOM—
In an instant, a bright white light appeared before his eyes, hazy and seemingly empty of anything.
"What’s wrong? Did you read it? What did you see?" Yu Ruoyun, seeing the expression on Wang Lan’s face, immediately asked in a tense manner.
Wang Lan shook his head. "No, I just saw a vast whiteness; I couldn’t see anything... It seems like you said, the runes have been destroyed."
"Vast whiteness? What vast whiteness?" Yu Ruoyun’s face showed astonishment. In the next moment, she burst into ecstatic joy. "Can you read runes? Can you see what’s engraved within the runes?"
"Can’t!" Wang Lan replied decisively.
"Can’t? But you just said..."
"I only saw a hazy white light, nothing more."
"No, the fact that you saw the hazy white light means you did read the content of the rune. I didn’t sense anything just now; these reliefs are just like ordinary reliefs."
"The hazy white light you saw, if I’m not wrong, should be the engraved space inside the rune. The reason why you saw nothing is that this rune is broken. The Spiritual Engravings inside have dissipated."
"Is that so? Then let me check the next one."
Wang Lan channeled his spiritual power, diving headfirst into each of the damaged runes.
"Empty—"
"Still empty..."
"Ruoyun, are you sure I’m not just seeing this white light because I hit my head too hard? They’re all empty."
"Wouldn’t you know if you’ve dazed yourself? Keep going. This rune looks relatively intact. Quick, see if there’s anything inside?"
"Alright!"
BOOM—
As he plunged into this one, stars burst before his eyes. The world was a blur of white, just like before. But just as Wang Lan was about to pull out, suddenly, something seemed to fly over from afar in that world.
Golden runes transformed into streaks of light, rushing toward him. Before Wang Lan could react, he was struck as if by a Pegasus Meteor Fist and was thoroughly dazed on the spot.
Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record, Qi Cultivation Chapter...
Discover a cultivable technique. Would you like to spend one skill point to learn?
"Yes!"
Just one skill point?
Wang Lan didn’t hesitate to agree.
BOOM—
In his mind, the information exploded. On the system’s skill page, a brand new page appeared.
Method Chapter!
Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record Qi Cultivation Chapter, Black Iron Tier One.
With such an awesome name, you’re only Black Iron Tier One?
Wang Lan’s consciousness then delved into the memory of the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record Qi Cultivation Chapter. After a while, he began to understand.
The main difference between the Method Chapter and the Skill that the Black Iron and Bronze tiers in the Method Chapter do not solely indicate the quality of the Cultivation Technique, but rather the Cultivation Level of the cultivator’s practice. With the same technique, some people integrate it thoroughly to reach the Gold level, and others achieve an extremely profound understanding to reach the Platinum level.
Therefore, the role of a good Cultivation Technique becomes clear. It’s just like in martial arts novels, where one person practices ordinary internal strength techniques, and another practices Jiuyang Divine Power. Even if both are at the Bronze Cultivation Level, the one practicing Jiuyang Divine Power could absolutely defeat the one practicing ordinary internal strength techniques.
When Wang Lan opened his eyes, Yu Ruoyun’s face was less than ten centimeters away from his.
Startled by Wang Lan suddenly opening his eyes, Yu Ruoyun took a step back, her face turning red. "How was it? Did you gain anything?"
"The Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record’s Qi Cultivation a method that uses breathing and the recitation of incantations to absorb the natural Star Power from the world through the body’s system, converting it into Star Power."
"If what’s recorded is true, our reliance on Soul Beads as Star Martial Warriors will drop to the minimum. Star Martial Warriors from ordinary families won’t have to overdraw on their cell life to extract Soul Beads and will still be able to obtain a stable source of Star Power."
"Really?" Joy blossomed on Yu Ruoyun’s face.
Yu Ruoyun understood what Wang Lan had just said more clearly and profoundly than he did.
How reliant are Star Martial Warriors on Soul Beads in the early stages? Without Soul Beads, no matter how talented or perceptive Yu Ruoyun is, she wouldn’t even be able to reach the Star Cloud Stage, let alone the peak of the Galaxy Stage.
Don’t look at so many talents who reach the Star Cloud Stage during high school—all of them are propped up by Soul Beads. Without Soul Beads, everyone’s limit would be at most the early to mid-stages of the Star Shine Stage.
Those from ordinary and poor families, unable to provide Soul Beads, can only serve as stepping stones for so-called geniuses.
That’s the reality.
Exactly for this reason, many geniuses take the opportunity during college to soar into the sky like dragons, rising ninety thousand miles with the help of the wind and clouds.
In the early stages, due to the lack of combat experience and insufficient combat skills, it’s not possible for a group of inexperienced and unskilled Star Shine and Starlight warriors to go to training grounds or Different Dimensional Spaces to hunt Exotic Beasts.
The imbalance of resources will only make the gap in talents wider and wider.
But... the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record Wang Lan now obtained could change all of that. If one could indeed absorb Star Power from the vastness of the heavens and the earth, the imbalance of resources would be completely shattered.
Many talented commoners will come forward and shine brightly in the early stages. They would then be discovered by good schools, grow earlier, and become stronger faster.
Thinking of all this, Yu Ruoyun’s excitement made her tremble uncontrollably. Yet Wang Lan let out a long sigh.
"What a pity... Originally, each of these more than ten runes should have been engraved with a Cultivation Technique, and it might even have been the complete inheritance of the Fairy Cloud Sect. But now, only the Qi Cultivation left."
"It’s good enough we found this one..." Although she said this, her face showed reluctance as she caressed the runes.
"Don’t move!" Wang Lan suddenly shouted. He pressed his fingers together like a sword and touched Yu Ruoyun’s forehead. A spiritual intent was shot into Yu Ruoyun’s Spiritual Sea of Consciousness, transferring the recently acquired Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record Qi Cultivation Chapter into her mind.
"This is something we obtained together; it should rightfully belong to both of us."
BONG—
Suddenly, the sound of a bell rang overhead, and its resonating waves rippled outward.
Wang Lan released his fingers and looked up in confusion. "Is it twenty-four hours already? I feel like it hasn’t been long since the last bell."
"It hasn’t been long," Yu Ruoyun also said, her face puzzled.
HUM—
Suddenly, a buzzing sound arose, and a white light descended from the sky, instantly enveloping the entire hall. Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun looked up nervously as the top of the hall vanished swiftly in the white light. Strangely, they weren’t affected by the white light.
Then, a powerful suction force came. Wang Lan, in a hurry, grabbed Yu Ruoyun’s hand. Blinded by the intense white light, they lost consciousness.
「Modu City’s Star Martial Academy was shrouded in clouds.」
In the past two days, who knows how many important figures had arrived at the Star Martial Academy.
For ordinary students of the Modu City Star Martial Academy, they could only understand that Princess Yu Ruoyun of the Jade Country royal family had encountered misfortune in the Nine-layer Pagoda. Although Princess Yu Ruoyun was of high status, the Republican Era had long since replaced the time of royalty and princesses.
As for the other dozens of students who met with disaster, perhaps all of them together were not as important as a single Princess Yu. Otherwise, the Nine-layer Pagoda opens every year, and students die inside every year, so why is it that this year, in particular, the entire academy is cloaked in gloom?
Not many students cared about one inconspicuous Wang Lan on the list.
But at least one person cared.
「Girls’ dormitory, room 305.」
Jiang Xinyu sat by the window with her hair disheveled, gazing outside, her eyes hollow and lost.
In just two short days, Jiang Xinyu had become as haggard as if her lamp had run out of oil.
"Xinyu, you need to be strong. This is the destiny of Star Martial Warriors, a fate no one can avoid. Wang Lan was my student, but he was also a warrior."
"None of us wanted him to perish on the battlefield, but a warrior’s death is inevitable. You should pull yourself together and fulfill the wishes he couldn’t complete," Sun Li said to Jiang Xinyu with a solemn face.
"The wishes he couldn’t complete... Teacher, do you know what Wang Lan’s unfinished wishes were?"
"..." Sun Li hesitated for a while, then shook her head. "I don’t know. But he probably hoped to become a strong Star Martial Warrior, to become a hero remembered by history, right?"
"His dream was very simple. He hoped to have a stable income in the future, find an ordinary wife, have two children—a boy and a girl—and then live quietly until retirement at sixty. After that, he could travel the world with his wife. If there was still time left, he would consider what to do next."
"He never thought about becoming a hero. That was before he awakened his Star Martial talents... Teacher, I don’t believe he’s dead. He’s still alive."

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Dean, it’s showtime...
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 309: Dean, it’s showtime...
"Xinyu, you must accept reality. The seventh floor has gone dark. If he were alive, he would have come out the day before yesterday. Every year, people are forever lost in the Nine-layer Pagoda... You are a Star Martial Warrior; don’t let your emotions get the better of you."
"I’m not being emotional. Although I’m scared and unwilling to believe it, my intuition tells me he must still be alive. My intuition has never failed me, especially concerning him. I refuse to believe he’s dead! Teacher, is there any way for me to enter the Nine-layer Pagoda? I want to go find him."
"You’d be seeking death! With your strength, you wouldn’t even make it to the third floor. Regardless, you need time to cool off. Wang Lan is my student, and I don’t want anything to happen to him either. Moreover, he has made great contributions to humanity. But... I really hope you can pull yourself together soon. I’ll come to see you again tomorrow."
Sun Li sighed, shook her head, opened the door, and walked out. Her footsteps, clad in high heels, echoed in the silent corridor.
Inside the academy’s Conference Room Number One, the atmosphere was even more deathly still and oppressive than in Jiang Xinyu’s dormitory.
The impact of Yu Ruoyun and Wang Lan’s deaths was far more severe than the students of the Star Martial Academy could imagine.
Yu Ruoyun was not merely a princess of the Jade Country’s royal family; her death meant that the imperial restorationist forces, suppressed for seventy years, now had a catalyst.
Once, they were the high and mighty nobility. Even during the decades after the end of the imperial era and the establishment of the republic, they still held the largest share of power in Jade Country. The war of the century shattered the land and, with it, their ruling status. When the nation finally recovered its old territories, they were dismayed to find that the people once beneath them had quietly climbed over their heads.
Regaining their lofty positions through normal processes was no longer possible. Furthermore, to prevent the old nobility from influencing national politics again, the state had been actively suppressing their power. But, as they say, a starving camel is still larger than a horse. Even with their strength greatly weakened, the power they wielded could still contend with the state machinery.
However, this contention depended on championing a cause of great national importance. Otherwise, if they were accused of destabilizing national security and stability, or of treason, they would not only face public condemnation, but even their dependents would abandon them. They had waited seventy years for such a cause.
Most of the noble families’ power was tied to the Qing Emperor’s faction; or rather, the so-called Qing Emperor’s faction *was* the nobles’ faction. This was because the strongest among these powers was, in fact, the imperial family. When the Benevolent Emperor abdicated, ending the imperial rule of the Great Jade Empire, not everyone supported the decision; in fact, the opposition formed the vast majority. The power of the other Four Emperors revolved entirely around each respective emperor, but the Qing Emperor was merely a figurehead for the imperial family’s interests.
Now, the second princess of the direct royal lineage was dead, and her death was likely no accident. If it wasn’t an accident, then it was deliberate. The identity of the mastermind wasn’t important; what mattered was who it *could* be, who it *should* be.
Eld Di is 102 years old this year. He gained fame in his youth, achieved mastery in his middle age, and only at fifty did he attain a profound understanding of the world. It wasn’t until his late eighties that he nurtured Wang Ling, a disciple capable of inheriting his mantle. He was a revered and respected elder. Even though those present were eager to vent their anger and cause a scene, as long as Eld Di was there, no one dared to speak, nor would they even try.
"Does everyone understand what happened?"
To Eld Di’s left sat a refined-looking man of nearly fifty, dressed in a black suit that exuded an air of nobility.
"We only have a rough understanding of the events; we still don’t know the precise cause. Eld Di, you are a guiding light for us all. Tell us, what exactly happened to Her Highness, the Princess? Why did she suddenly go to the seventh floor? The Nine-layer Pagoda has always been under the control of the Modu City Star Martial Academy, hasn’t it?"
"What do you mean by that, King Ning?" Nangong Meng snorted coldly. "Are you suggesting Yu Ruoyun’s incident is related to the academy? Do you actually think the academy would harm its own student?"
"A regular student isn’t worth the academy’s effort to harm. To be targeted, they’d have to be valuable. The power balance of the Five Old Emperors has persisted for twenty years. Controlling the world of Star Martial Warriors... I fear some are discontented and wish to bring all Star Martial Warriors under their thumb. Such cunning, such tactics. Not content with just the second princess, they even plotted against the Flame Emperor’s son, who had just come into prominence. No wonder the Flame Emperor kept his child so well-hidden. If he hadn’t, the boy might have been killed by a ’runaway carriage’ long before his talents could awaken."
"Yu Huailong, watch your tongue," Zuo Ming, his expression grim, snapped from across the table.
"General Zuo, don’t you think the same? I’m merely voicing what you’re thinking but daren’t say. Why did it have to be Princess Yu Ruoyun and Wang Lan? Why not sooner, why not later? Why did it have to happen at the academy, of all places?"
"Have you said enough?" Eld Di quietly exhaled a plume of smoke and asked coldly.
Facing Eld Di, Yu Huailong still didn’t dare to be too insolent.
"Yu Qing, what are your thoughts?" Eld Di turned his head to ask the Qing Emperor, Yu Qing.
"The matter must be thoroughly investigated, but the turmoil must be stabilized as quickly as possible. Jade Country cannot afford chaos, especially not at this time."
"Qing Emperor, your niece has been murdered!" Yu Huailong stated coldly.
"I, too, am deeply grieved by Ruoyun’s death. Therefore, whoever is behind this, I will see them reduced to ashes. However, right now, the overall situation must take precedence."
"Hmph, not his own flesh and blood, after all..." a disdainful sneer was heard.
The Qing Emperor’s expression immediately became strained.
"Enough. You are all people of status; stop this bickering. I hereby announce that I take full responsibility for what happened to Ruoyun and Wang Lan in the Nine-layer Pagoda."
Eld Di’s voice was soft, yet it carried immense weight. For a long while after he spoke, the conference room remained deathly silent.
"What? How can this be?" Yu Huailong leaped up agitatedly. "Eld Di, you are the guiding light of Jade Country, a spiritual symbol! How can you take full responsibility? Besides, this incident definitely has nothing to do with you! How can you take the blame for the mastermind behind the scenes? Aren’t you shielding the real culprit by doing this?"
"The mastermind must be thoroughly investigated. But until the full truth is uncovered, I will bear this responsibility. Due to my negligent management, an accident occurred in the Nine-layer Pagoda. Ruoyun and Wang Lan were teleported into its seventh layer and perished there. Effective today, I resign from my position as Dean of the Modu City Star Martial Academy and will be exiled to lifelong imprisonment in the Nine-layer Pagoda."
"Eld Di, you mustn’t..." Zuo Ming also stood up excitedly to dissuade him.
Eld Di raised his hand, silencing Zuo Ming. "If you truly wish to show me respect, then uncover the truth of this matter swiftly and bring them justice. One is my great-granddaughter; the other, a young man who made outstanding contributions to humanity. They should not become sacrifices in a power struggle, nor should they be victims of hostile forces."
Eld Di’s words were unchallengeable.
The atmosphere in the conference room was as taut as a high-pressure cooker.
By doing this, Eld Di was staking his entire life’s reputation. Throughout his life, he had been beyond reproach—to heaven and earth, to his nation, and to the world. In his youth, he defended and expanded the nation’s territory. In his prime, he participated in the most heroic battle of the war between humans and demons. In his old age, he dedicated himself to teaching, nurturing generations of outstanding students. He was one of the few remaining founding elders of Jade Country, the only living legend who had participated in the great war of the century.
Silently, Eld Di stood up and left the conference room.
The moment Eld Di’s figure disappeared, the expressions of everyone in the room became complicated. A heated debate erupted. Whether they were loyal patriots or individuals with ulterior motives, their scheming had to pause for that moment. Eld Di, by staking his lifelong reputation, had extinguished the lit fuse, catching everyone off guard.
「The Nine-layer Pagoda, Valley of Death.」
Suddenly, a crack tore open in the sky, and two figures tumbled out.
Ghost-eye had been peeking out from a crevice, ready to reclaim the Valley of Death. But when it saw the two figures in the sky, it instantly whisked itself back into the crevice.
Good heavens! To corner me, you’ve actually waited for two whole days and nights? I can’t mess with that. I’ll just hide out for another ten days or half a month.
Wang Lan suddenly found he could control his body. He quickly mobilized his Star Power to stabilize himself and then landed steadily on the ground.
Seeing the familiar surroundings, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun’s faces lit up with wild joy.
"The Valley of Death? We’re back?"
"Hahaha... We cheated death and escaped! We made it out alive! Quick, let’s hurry and regroup with the main party. I’ve never been so desperate to see our dear classmates and respected teachers... GAG!"
Wang Lan’s cheesy words didn’t make Yu Ruoyun cringe; he ended up cringing at himself.
"PFFT—"
"Stop laughing, let’s go!"
However, when the two of them walked out of the Valley of Death area, they couldn’t see a single one of their fourth-year classmates. Instead, the Exotic Beasts, who had been senselessly thrashed by the fourth-year students, seemed particularly irritable. Unable to vent their frustration on humans, they took it out by brutally attacking Exotic Beasts from other tribes.
"How long were we on that other layer? Are you sure it wasn’t three days?" Wang Lan asked, puzzled.
"It should be less than three days. Even without a time reference, my sense of time wouldn’t be off by that much in such a short period. Three days, four at the absolute most."
Yu Ruoyun also frowned. "Could the trial have ended early? Oh, right, I remember now."
"What?"
"When we were teleported to an upper layer, it must have registered on the displays outside, so the academy probably ended the trial early."
"So, now that we’re on the fourth layer, can they sense us outside?"
"If there are people on duty at the back mountain, the fourth layer’s plaque will light up. Someone should notice."
It wasn’t a matter of "should"; they *had* to. Never mind just being on duty. Ever since the incident, the Nine-layer Pagoda on the back mountain had been heavily guarded around the clock. Countless people were staring intently at the seventh layer, desperately hoping for a miracle, praying it would light up again. After all, many more people hoped for Yu Ruoyun’s safety, and an even greater number wished for Wang Lan to be unharmed. The true conspirators were but a tiny minority.
Yet, the seventh layer’s plaque remained dark, while the fourth layer’s plaque suddenly lit up. The students from the fourth layer had all departed, and their plaques had long since gone dark. Besides, the plaques only go dark when no foreign life signatures are detected. So how could one suddenly light up again?
After a brief moment of astonishment, a tactical instructor suddenly turned and sprinted away as if in a frenzy.
"Dean, it’s lit up! It’s lit up—"

chapters.title: Chapter 310 We’re Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 310 We’re Back
The frenzied dash and exclamations brought some vitality to the otherwise slightly gloomy school. He raced from the back mountain towards Wangxue Building, shouting as he ran.
"What’s wrong with that teacher? What is he yelling about?"
"The Dean’s shining? The Dean isn’t even bald, so how could he shine?"
WHOOSH! Eld Di and a group of experts led by the Qing Emperor instantly appeared before the tactical instructor.
"Ma Ji, what’s the matter with you? Making such a fuss."
"It’s lit, Dean! The Nine-layer Pagoda is lit again! This time it’s not the seventh floor, it’s the fourth!" Ma Ji shouted excitedly.
Instantly, the expressions of Eld Di and his group turned solemn. Eld Di quickly stamped his foot and vanished in the blink of an eye.
The Qing Emperor also disappeared in a flash, leaving the group behind him staring at each other in dismay.
"The fourth floor? Weren’t they all evacuated?" Doubt flashed in Nangong Meng’s eyes, quickly replaced by elation.
Could it be that Student Yu Ruoyun and the others are unharmed?
News that the Nine-layer Pagoda was suddenly lit again spread like wildfire throughout the academy. Most students were merely curious and not overly concerned, but a small portion of them began discussing it fiercely.
The clicking of Sun Li’s high heels sounded once again as she approached Jiang Xinyu’s door. Just as she was about to knock, she heard Jiang Xinyu excitedly talking on the phone inside.
"Are you serious? It’s lit again? Okay... okay, I’ll go check it out right away..."
Jiang Xinyu eagerly pulled open the door, only to see Sun Li standing outside, hand raised as if to knock.
"Mrs. Sun."
"What happened? What’s going on?"
"The Nine-layer Pagoda is lit again! There might still be people inside. The Dean and some teachers have rushed over, and I’m planning to take a look too," she said, then dashed towards the distant staircase like the wind.
It’s lit again?
「Inside the Nine-layer Pagoda, at the exit.」
"So, the Nine-layer Pagoda is closed, just as I thought... When will they open the gates again...? I’m starving..." Wang Lan grumbled, lounging bored on a tree branch near the entrance to the first floor of the pagoda. Yu Ruoyun sat cross-legged beneath the tree, practicing the Qi Cultivation Chapter of the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record.
"It still feels a bit off. Wang Lan, could you please be quiet? Your voice is disturbing my focus. The academy must know there are still people in the pagoda; I’m sure they’ll open the gates soon."
"Hmph? Is Princess Yu’s Dao-heart so easily disturbed?" By now, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun’s relationship had deepened to that of close friends, comfortable enough for casual banter and teasing without reservation.
As he got to know her better, Wang Lan found Yu Ruoyun to be no different from any other girl. Her supposed aura and the pressure she exuded?
All self-imposed,
he thought. To him, Yu Ruoyun was just a bit more knowledgeable and prone to lecturing, making her a tad wordy. Otherwise, she was quite nice.
"Heh. Though you can’t shake my Dao-heart, it’s definitely better for you to be quiet than to drone on. Speaking of which... aren’t you cultivating? The path of cultivation is like rowing upstream; even with exceptional talent, you should seize every available moment to improve yourself.
"The world is never short of hardworking people, nor of those who are both talented and diligent," Yu Ruoyun began to lecture again.
"Stop! Master, please stop chanting!"
"Master?"
"No, my mistake. I meant Abbess!"
"You! Blockhead! Even though it’s just the basic Qi Cultivation Chapter, being able to increase Star Power without relying on Soul Beads is significant. If you cultivate it to a profound level, it’s like constantly absorbing a Soul Bead. Don’t you realize how much that would help your improvement?
"Even if your emotions were in turmoil after surviving that ordeal, an hour has passed. It’s time to calm down..."
BLAH BLAH BLAH...
Listening to Yu Ruoyun, Wang Lan’s eyes glazed over.
"Sis, I surrender! I was wrong! I confess, I’ve already learned it..."
"Learned it?" Yu Ruoyun paused, looking up at Wang Lan in astonishment. "When... did you?"
"I learned it back in the main hall. This breathing technique and energy circulation is a gradual, painstaking process. During this, one opens the body’s twelve major meridians, allowing for the natural conversion of Star Power.
"You managed to open two meridians in an hour—that’s already heaven-defying, you know? Don’t put so much pressure on yourself. Take it easy."
"Then what about you? What does that make you?"
"I’m naturally gifted; all my meridians were open from birth, so I didn’t need to go through that process of unblocking them like you. Of course, I learned it instantly. But that’s all. Ten minutes of absorption this way doesn’t even yield as much Star Power as a single low-grade Soul Bead."
If Wang Lan were an NPC, Yu Ruoyun would probably have seen +1, +1, +1 floating above his head as he spoke.
For others, cultivating the Qi Cultivation Chapter of the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record was about enhancing Star Power, absorbing the ambient Star Power between heaven and earth for their use. But for Wang Lan, it seemed he was just gaining experience points.
While it was true that his "mana bar" would replenish if depleted, Wang Lan didn’t even need to cultivate the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record; his energy reserves refilled automatically anyway.
Yu Ruoyun shot Wang Lan a disdainful look and finally fell silent.
BOOM!
Suddenly, a loud BOOM resounded from the sky, like thunder. Yu Ruoyun sprang to her feet with a WHOOSH, and Wang Lan tumbled from the tree branch with a THUD.
The previously illusory space before their eyes slowly split open, revealing a crack. Amidst the distortion, the great gates of the Nine-layer Pagoda gradually materialized before them.
Before the gates fully stabilized, two figures appeared before them. Eld Di and the Qing Emperor immediately spotted Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun standing at the entrance, their tense expressions finally relaxing into long-absent smiles.
"Are you two all right?"
"Great-grandfather. Uncle."
"Dean, we’re fine. It’s just that Speedy Wind and Bai Ji..."
"It’s good that you’re unharmed. That’s all that matters. Come with us for now."
The four of them exited the Nine-layer Pagoda one by one. Although they had anticipated their reappearance would cause a stir and perhaps a large reception, they hadn’t expected such an immense scene.
The moment they stepped out of the Nine-layer Pagoda, countless piercing gazes fixed on them, accompanied by a terrifying pressure like an icy gale. At first glance, everyone present was a prominent figure.
This was especially true for several military figures, their shoulder boards glittering with dazzling gold stars: General, General, Senior General, Senior General...
Heavens!
There were only seven Senior Generals in the entire Jade Country and just over thirty Generals. Yet, before Wang Lan’s eyes, there were a dozen such high-ranking officers combined.
"Wang Lan—!" A cry came from the back of the crowd. Instantly, a slender figure sprinted towards them from a distance, her long, dark hair flowing behind her like silken ribbons. Jiang Xinyu’s delicate face was streaked with heart-wrenching tears.
Wang Lan opened his arms, and Jiang Xinyu flew into his embrace like a swallow returning to its nest, burying her face deeply in his chest.
"I knew you were still alive... I just knew it... I knew you had to be alive," Jiang Xinyu murmured, feeling Wang Lan’s strong, steady heartbeat.
In full public view, under the watchful eyes of so many prominent figures, the two of them shamelessly engaged in a public display of affection.
Meanwhile, Yu Ruoyun was also surrounded by people.
"Thank you all, uncles and elders, for your concern. I’m fine. This isn’t the place to talk. Let’s find another location, and I will recount everything that happened in detail," Yu Ruoyun said, though her gaze kept drifting to the embracing couple, who seemed almost like a backdrop to the current scene.
A hint of envy flickered in her eyes.
How nice,
she thought.
After Wang Lan comforted Jiang Xinyu and her emotions settled, Nangong Meng came looking for him.
"Wang Lan, quickly now. Many people are waiting for you."
"Xinyu, I have to go for now. We’ll go out for a good meal later. You look so haggard; you haven’t been eating properly these past few days, have you?"
"Of course not! If I had died in there, do you think you’d be able to eat?" Jiang Xinyu retorted, pinching Wang Lan hard.
"Well, that’s not entirely certain. Isn’t there a saying? ’Channel grief and indignation into appetite’..."
"Get lost—!"
WHOOSH! The brand-new cell phone he’d bought just that summer vacation flew towards him like a projectile.
Following Nangong Meng to Conference Room One, Wang Lan found the atmosphere serious but not oppressive. Yu Ruoyun was already seated in the main position at the head of the conference table. When Wang Lan entered, Eld Di gestured for him to sit next to her.
"Great-grandfather, esteemed uncles and elders," Yu Ruoyun began. "The experiences of our four-person team—Wang Lan, Yue Jifeng, Bai Ji, and myself—were quite extraordinary. Allow me to start from when we entered the Nine-layer Pagoda.
"After we joined the main group on the fourth floor, everything proceeded as expected. Once we exterminated the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion, we encountered the Scorpion King’s self-detonation. Yue Jifeng and I were both seriously injured. Fortunately, Wang Lan possesses remarkable healing abilities, and we recovered quickly.
"It was then that we began to encounter unusual circumstances. Three Star Martial Warriors from the outside had infiltrated the Nine-layer Pagoda with the intent to assassinate Student Bai Ji."
"Wait, their target was Bai Ji? Not you?" Yu Huailong suddenly interrupted.
"Yes, it was Bai Ji."
"King Ning, please refrain from interrupting Princess Yu Ruoyun. If you have questions, kindly wait until she has finished speaking," Zuo Ming said coolly.
"Once we confirmed their target was Bai Ji, and after we dealt with them on the spot, we suspected there might be security flaws in the Nine-layer Pagoda’s management. However, this didn’t raise our immediate alarm, as we planned to report it to the academy upon our exit.
"After the Golden Winged Fire Scorpion was eliminated, we still had four days remaining. We decided to hunt another type of creature. We chose The Death Valley because, apart from their terrifying Star Martial Toxins, the Ghost-eyes there possess minimal combat capabilities.
"Our teammate, Wang Lan, happens to be a natural counter to Star Martial Toxins. While Wang Lan was gathering components for an antidote, we discovered a metal box in the forest on the outskirts of The Death Valley, apparently left there fifteen years ago. Inside this box was a large quantity of Space Stones.
"We speculated that someone had been secretly pilfering Space Stones from the Nine-layer Pagoda. In retrospect, however, this discovery might have also been a part of the hidden mastermind’s scheme.
"We successfully created the antidote and eliminated a large number of Ghost-eyes. Everything was proceeding very smoothly. However, while we were collecting our spoils, we discovered a mining pickaxe deep within The Death Valley.
"Its manufacturing date indicated it was made at the end of last year. This led us to believe that someone among the current entrants was secretly mining Space Stones. Therefore, we decided to investigate. Sure enough, in the deepest part of The Death Valley, we found a deep, artificially excavated tunnel.
"However, we didn’t expect that this tunnel contained no Space Stones at all; it was merely a trap set for us. When we reached the bottom of the excavation, we saw large piles of Space Stones.
"Upon seeing us arrive, they activated the Space Stones, intending to annihilate us within the turbulent spatial currents. However, what no one anticipated—likely not even they—was that the activated Space Stones would tear open a passage to another dimension. All four of us were pulled into the resulting spatial rift."

chapters.title: Chapter 311 All Turned Over to the State
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 311 All Turned Over to the State
"Then you arrived at the Seventh Layer?" Dean Nangong asked eagerly.
"That was the Seventh Layer?" Yu Ruoyun and Wang Lan were equally shocked. Earlier, Yu Ruoyun had speculated it was the Sixth Layer, an estimate made generously based on the strength of the Exotic Beasts. But to say it was the Seventh Layer—their survival was truly a miracle.
"Correct, and the timing matches as well. The Seventh Layer’s plaque lit up the moment you were absorbed by the time-space rift."
"It was actually the Seventh Layer! No wonder the Exotic Beasts there were so powerful."
"How did you survive on the Seventh Layer?" a general voiced the question, which was also what most of the people present were curious about.
Although the vast majority hoped Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun could survive, nobody truly believed they could emerge alive after mistakenly entering the Seventh Layer.
"After we woke up, we found ourselves in a valley where the Exotic Beasts were extraordinarily powerful. Yue Jifeng and Bai Ji were killed by these formidable Exotic Beasts. Just when we were despairing, the sound of bells suddenly rang out."
"Bells? There are people on the Seventh Layer?"
"Let me finish, and you will all understand. Just as we faced complete demise, the sound of bells suddenly rang out. The bells seemed to have a deterrent effect on the Exotic Beasts. The Beasts left, and Wang Lan and I headed towards the source of the bell sounds. There, we discovered an Ancient Immortal Sect, the Fairy Cloud Sect."
At this point, Yu Ruoyun paused. All those listening showed significant interest, especially Dean Nangong, whose eyes widened as his breathing became heavy.
An Ancient Immortal Sect? That represents a mysterious and powerful ancient cultivation civilization! He, too, was a researcher of ancient civilizations and had often lamented. How wonderful it would be if ancient civilization could have survived to the present! The powerful ancient civilization, combined with the current number of human Star Martial Warriors and modern technology, would undoubtedly prevent the Demon Clan from daring to invade.
"How many people were in the Fairy Cloud Sect?" Eld Di, still composed, asked in a low voice.
"None! The Fairy Cloud Sect perished in the endless eons past. Only one great hall was preserved; the rest had all collapsed and were ruined.
We went to the ruins of the Fairy Cloud Sect, and the Exotic Beasts did not follow. Wang Lan speculated that the entire Fairy Cloud Sect was likely within an invisible bell. We were sequestered within the bell, which offered some protection. Therefore, the Exotic Beasts didn’t detect us, nor did they find the ruins of the Fairy Cloud Sect."
"No wonder," Eld Di sighed. "This explains why the Seventh Layer’s plaque suddenly went out again, and we all thought you were dead. If an invisible artifact isolated your life signs, the Nine-layer Pagoda would naturally assume you had perished."
"After that, we rested for a moment in the great hall, and Wang Lan found another clue. We searched the Fairy Cloud Sect but couldn’t find the bell. All the buildings of the Fairy Cloud Sect had collapsed; only the great hall remained intact.
Wang Lan suspected that the great hall was intentionally left by the Fairy Cloud Sect.
Then, we cleared the great hall and found eight high-quality Soul Beads, each imprinted with a Cultivation Technique of the Fairy Cloud Sect."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expressions could no longer be contained. Especially those from the royal lineage; their eyes blazed with fervor as they looked at Yu Ruoyun.
"What kind of Cultivation Techniques? What level are they?"
"I learned a Cultivation Technique called Supreme Goodness Like Water. It’s a Water Attribute Super S-Level Star Martial Skill, which I currently cannot cultivate. This Cultivation Technique is different from those we’ve encountered. It seems to be more of a general framework, an ability, and its application in combat must be developed by the cultivator."
Super S-Level...
This level of Star Martial Skill sent a burst of dazzling light into everyone’s eyes.
In the entire Jade Country, there weren’t even ten Super S-Level Star Martial Skills combined. You found eight Soul Beads at once, all of them Super S-Level? What did that mean? If there were suitable cultivators, it would mean the rapid emergence of a new set of the Five Emperors.
If they are widely applicable, then not just a new set of Five Emperors, but even ten or a hundred such figures would not be a mere dream.
"Are all the other Star Martial Skills... Super S-Level?"
"They should be. I also learned a Star Martial Skill, the Infinite Fire Skill."
"What gives you the right to cultivate a Super S-Level Star Martial Skill?" Suddenly, an ill-timed voice rang out. "It’s one thing for the Princess to learn one, but you too? Super S-Level Star Martial Skills are a national strategic asset. There were only eight, and you wasted one."
"Nanjun King! Are you provoking us?"
The Nanjun King’s words instantly infuriated Zuo Ming. If Eld Di hadn’t been present earlier, Zuo Ming would have dispensed with courtesies long ago. "And now, you dare to insult Wang Lan in front of us? Are you bullying us, thinking the Flame Emperor’s lineage has no one to stand up for us?"
"Zuo Ming, who is provoking you? It’s a Super S-Level Star Martial Skill. Can just anyone waste it like that?"
"Strictly speaking, these Star Martial Skills are the spoils of war belonging to Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun. Even if they learn all of them, you have no say. Moreover, if Princess Yu Ruoyun can learn one, why can’t Wang Lan? It’s just a Super S-Level Star Martial Skill, right? It’s not like Wang Lan hasn’t learned one before. Lord Qing Emperor, you are here today, and I’ve been exercising restraint out of respect for you. But this time, he’s clearly using someone else as a pretext to insult us, and we cannot tolerate it. If Lord Qing Emperor doesn’t provide a satisfactory explanation, we won’t be able to remain on good terms."
"General Zuo, calm down. He doesn’t know that Wang Lan is the Flame Emperor’s son."
"Hmph! This explanation from the Qing Emperor is hard to accept. The news about Wang Lan being the Flame Emperor’s son has long been widespread."
"The Nanjun King spent the last year in the State of Yi and only returned last month. It’s understandable that his information is outdated and he wasn’t aware."
"He is the Flame Emperor’s son? Then I take back what I said earlier. I thought he was just a student accompanying Princess Yu Ruoyun on her training expedition."
"Whether I am the Flame Emperor’s son has nothing to do with whether these spoils of war belong to me, right?" Wang Lan responded coldly, taking off his backpack and removing the six Soul Beads from within.
As six goose-egg-sized Soul Beads were placed on the table, everyone’s eyes became fixed on them, and their breathing grew rapid.
"Ruoyun, it seems our original intention of submitting the Soul Beads to the nation may not be fulfilled after all. In that case, let’s divide the Soul Beads now. Half for you, half for me. You pick first."
Wang Lan’s words immediately surprised everyone.
Dividing the spoils in front of so many people? Was that really appropriate?
Wang Lan decided to change his mind precisely because he was provoked by the current situation. He hadn’t anticipated the matter to be so clear-cut. His original plan was to submit them to the nation by handing them over to the academy, which would then pass them to the national government. But with this group of people greedily eyeing them, who knows whose hands these Soul Beads would really end up in if they were submitted.
"Wang Lan, don’t be ridiculous. Do you know where you are?"
"Dean Nangong, I am not being ridiculous. According to the rules, these items should all be the spoils of war belonging to Yu Ruoyun and me."
"But these are Super S-Level Star Martial Skills."
"Is there a substantial difference?"
"Our rules are established by the people and enacted through the approval of the Representative Assembly. To change the rules, it must go through the Representative Assembly. Is the academy attempting to forcibly seize students’ spoils of war?" Zuo Ming said indifferently, supporting Wang Lan.
"Yu Ruoyun, will you choose?"
"I..." Yu Ruoyun looked at Wang Lan uncertainly, but there was no hint of jest in Wang Lan’s expression. And from her understanding of Wang Lan, he wasn’t the type to act rashly out of emotion.
"Go ahead, you choose."
"Alright then!" Wang Lan casually took three Soul Beads in his hand, stood up, and said, "Is a representative from the Ministry of Defense here?"
Someone in the crowd chuckled softly, "Interesting. I am Yi Zuguo, a member of the Ministry of Defense’s Military Commission."
Wang Lan stole a glance at Zuo Ming, who covertly nodded. Wang Lan strode over to Yi Zuguo, stood at attention, and said, "Captain Wang Lan, Special Operative of the Suzhou City Tianjian Bureau’s Intelligence Department, reporting! I am submitting three Super S-Level Star Martial Skills obtained from the Nine-layer Pagoda."
As he spoke, he offered the three Soul Beads in his hand to Yi Zuguo.
"Hahaha... Good lad! These are Super S-Level Star Martial Skills, you know. Even if you kept them all for yourself, no one could say a word against it. Are you really willing to part with them?"
"It’s not about having many Star Martial Skills. Besides, I can’t learn that many. Handing them over to you, sir, will allow these items to serve a greater purpose."
"Alright! Then I, on behalf of the Ministry of Defense, will accept them." Yi Zuguo did not refuse and took the Soul Beads immediately.
This scene, however, was gut-wrenching for Dean Nangong.
"Wang Lan, these were seized from the Nine-layer Pagoda; even if you’re submitting them, you should..."
"Nangong!" Eld Di suddenly spoke up, interrupting Nangong Meng. "The Nine-layer Pagoda belongs to the nation, and so does the academy."
"Yes!"
Seeing this, Yu Ruoyun also picked up three Soul Beads and approached Yi Zuguo. "I will also submit mine to the Ministry of Defense."
"Ruoyun!" At this, Yu Huailong could no longer sit still. "What are you doing?"
"Uncle Huailong, Ruoyun is also a part of the Jade Country. Submitting her spoils of war to the nation is not wrong."
At this moment, Yu Huailong had many things he wanted to say, but with so many eyes and ears present, how could he speak those private words?
"Yu Qing, aren’t you going to say something?" Helpless, Yu Huailong could only say to the Qing Emperor in a hushed voice.
"There’s nothing wrong with what Ruoyun is doing."
Yi Zuguo smiled and accepted Yu Ruoyun’s three Soul Beads. And so, in front of everyone, the six seized Soul Beads ended up in the hands of the Ministry of Defense.
"It seems this trip was not in vain; there’s an unexpected gain," Yi Zuguo said teasingly, nodding to Yu Ruoyun and Wang Lan. "Please return to your seats and continue. I suspect this matter isn’t so simple."
"Yes!"
The two returned to their seats.
"Afterward, we obtained the rune legacy of the Fairy Cloud Sect from the great hall. But unfortunately, nine out of ten runes were damaged, with only one preserved intact. This one rune contained the Qi Cultivation Chapter of the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record.
Wang Lan has already learned the Qi Cultivation Chapter. He confirmed that this ancient Qi cultivation method allows us to absorb Star Power from the heavens and earth into our Star Palace by controlling our breathing and circulating Star Power through the body’s energy pathways.
This way, Star Martial Warriors can obtain a stable source of Star Power without needing to rely on absorbing Soul Beads."
"What?"
As the words fell, more than a dozen individuals representing various factions, including Nangong Meng, Yu Huailong, and Zuo Ming, sprang to their feet.
This news exploded like a bolt from the blue, leaving everyone feeling as if they were in a dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Last Letter
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 312: Last Letter
Compared to the shock of others, the imperial faction represented by Yu Huailong was truly terrified.
How to absorb and utilize the natural Star Power that fills the heavens and earth had been a problem that plagued the entire world for countless years. But in Ancient Times, there was definitely a way. Eastern ancient texts had long mentioned the practice of breathing exercises to cultivate Qi, and the Western world also had records of meditative gathering of magical power.
