Breaking through to the Star Sea Stage is only a matter of time for him. The family wouldn’t treat him unfairly; he has no reason to join any other organization."
Galaxy Stage strength?
Wang Lan’s pupils narrowed sharply.
Someone that strong couldn’t even resist and was killed just like that?
"Officer, my son was a good, warm-hearted boy. Everyone who knew him said so. Perhaps he heard a commotion and went to see what was happening, only to get tragically involved," the old woman added, still sobbing.
Wang Lan patiently recorded the elderly couple’s statements, a process that lasted until around eight or nine in the evening.
The police captain ordered takeout for Wang Lan’s team of five. Knowing they were Star Martial Warriors with hearty appetites, he even ordered three servings per person.
It seems the misconception that Star Martial Warriors are all gluttons won’t be dispelled anytime soon.
Star Martial Warriors had large appetites because absorbing Star Power from their cells could otherwise lead to severe malnutrition. However, Wang Lan’s group never lacked Soul Beads, so their food intake was similar to that of ordinary people. Of course, even eating portions meant for three, or even ten people, wouldn’t be an issue for the five of them. After all, Star Martial Warriors didn’t have to worry about their figures. If they ever gained weight, they could simply absorb some cellular energy and be slim again in three days.
"It seems this Duanmu Jing had nothing to do with those people and was merely killed in passing," Wang Lan summarized their findings so far. "His movements raised no suspicion; he indeed set out alone this afternoon, even went shopping and had coffee. He headed to the ancient street district at dusk and was then killed in a back alley. His whereabouts were completely open, with no attempt to avoid surveillance."
Later that night, as the team continued to mull over the clues, Zhang Xiao finally voiced his frustration. "We finally catch a lead, and it ends up being a dud... Damn it, who are these people? In my opinion, let them sort out their own grievances.
"After all, unregistered people aren’t citizens of Jade Country. We might as well consider it a dog-eat-dog matter and let the dead rest."
"Zhang Xiao, don’t speak out of frustration. Even if they have no registration or records, we must take responsibility for violent incidents that occur in Jade Country," Yang Yang said with a low reprimand.
"Alright, it’s late. Everyone, go get some rest. We’ll continue with the case tomorrow," Wang Lan said. "The captain has arranged dormitories for you. If you need anything, just tell him; all expenses will be reimbursed."
"The captain is mighty!"
"Then, Captain, we’re off to rest. You should get some rest too. Even though you’re young, don’t make a habit of staying up late."
"Mm, I plan to rest now as well."
Lying in bed, Wang Lan couldn’t fall asleep. Images of Duanmu Jing and the mysterious figures kept flashing through his mind. As for the friends Duanmu Jing was supposedly meeting, even his parents didn’t know who they were. They could only speculate that these were companions Duanmu Jing had met during a previous mission. But Wang Lan found no trace of any Star Martial Warriors near the ancient street. The killer and the other victims remained as elusive as a fog. Even if the killer’s identity was unknown, the other victims seemed to have appeared out of thin air.
What kind of organization were they from?
Even if they were Demon Clan spies, they knew to hide behind fake identities. If these individuals weren’t actually human, Wang Lan might have suspected they were members of the Demon Clan infiltrating the human world.
As the saying goes: what you ponder by day, you dream of by night. But Wang Lan’s dream was utterly bizarre: he dreamed he was an emperor, then an undercover agent, then targeted for assassination by death squads. It was completely illogical.
When Wang Lan woke up, he couldn’t recall the details of his dream, only that it involved ancient settings filled with grudges, betrayal, and deceit. The one element that stood out clearly was ’death squads.’ In the dream, he had been critically injured in an assassination, but his subordinates couldn’t find any trace of the attackers. These death squad members were orphans and beggars, taken in as children and trained for over a decade, to the point where they themselves didn’t even know their own original identities.
He stood up and began to dress. Suddenly, Wang Lan froze.
Death squads? Death squads!
This keyword was like a key, unlocking the tangled mess in Wang Lan’s mind.
What if these people are death squads? Whose death squads? Trained from childhood, no identity... Only major families would train death squads.
Instantly, Wang Lan went back to the table, spreading out the documents once again. He discarded all his previous theories and considered the victims as death squad members.
Death squads are meant to carry out covert missions that must not be exposed. Why could the killer find these unidentified people so precisely? No, wait... what if they were sent deliberately? Death squads are usually kept in secret locations and are only deployed for missions. If they were death squads from the Duanmu Family, then Duanmu Jing being with them would make sense.
Moreover, the explanation given by Duanmu Jing’s parents seemed plausible but contained a flaw.
According to eyewitness reports, the killer didn’t take much time to kill them, about five seconds. Even from the moment the first sound was heard, no more than ten seconds could have passed.
In under ten seconds, the ’enthusiastic’ young Duanmu Jing just happened to arrive? And was ’unfortunately’ killed?
Additionally, judging by the distribution of the bodies, Duanmu Jing wasn’t at the end but in the middle. This arrangement looked more like he was being protected in the center.
If this theory holds, why would the Duanmu Family send death squads here? What couldn’t they do openly that required death squads?
Wang Lan looked at the map again. The locations where the victims were found formed an arc.
All the victims were aged between twenty-five and thirty-five; all were without identities.
The Duanmu Family must be up to something... but what?
Wang Lan tapped his fingers on the desk. After about ten minutes, his hand suddenly stilled.
He quickly pulled out his phone and used his clearance to access the Tianjian Bureau’s intelligence system.
I knew I was right!

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Messing Up Could Be Deadly
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 319: Messing Up Could Be Deadly
After coming out of the Nine-layer Pagoda, Wang Lan immediately informed the Tianjian Bureau of the relationship between Xiao Qing and Bai Ji. The Tianjian Bureau did not hesitate and promptly began their investigation. Soon, they found a property registered under Bai Ji’s name.
Located in a mid-range residential area in East Forest Town, the Tianjian Bureau immediately proceeded to search. They turned Bai Ji’s room upside down but found nothing significant. Last week, Wang Lan received a reply from the Tianjian Bureau stating that this lead had likely gone cold.
But now, the very fact that all the incidents occurred precisely in East Forest Town—that was too much of a coincidence.
After freshening up, Wang Lan stepped out of his room to find the four team members had already been training on the training ground for a while.
Wang Lan knew that Star Martial Warriors needed to maintain peak condition through regular training. Jiang Xinyu, for example, had been systematically training every morning and evening since the age of nine.
After ten years of persistence, it was actually Wang Lan, the anomaly, who wasn’t enthusiastic about training at all. If he thought about training, he would; if not, he wouldn’t move a muscle. Since coming out of the Nine-layer Pagoda, Wang Lan hadn’t exercised at all.
It seems... I’m not putting in any effort at all.
"Captain!" a voice called out.
"Captain! Do you always get up this late? It’s half past eight and you’re just getting up?" Bai Xu, who felt most at ease with Wang Lan, blurted out.
"Exactly. We got up at half past four and have been training for more than three hours."
"You went to bed so late last night and got up so early? Lack of sleep can affect your case-solving efficiency. Never mind, let’s go. We’ll head out for breakfast."
Wang Lan drove the four of them to a teahouse. Since it was Sunday, the area around the teahouse was filled with parked cars. After circling around, they couldn’t find a single parking spot.
"Captain, just park the car here. Even if we circle for an hour, we won’t find a place. How about this: I’ll go buy breakfast while you all stay in the car. With people inside, we won’t get a ticket."
"You talk as if traffic police would ticket a car with Tianjian Bureau plates," Zhang Xiao retorted, leaving Liu Yifeng speechless.
In the end, Wang Lan got out to place the order, returning to the car later with a large bag of Baozi and fried dough sticks.
The Baozi were crab roe-filled, the siu mai were beef and sticky rice, and the fried dough sticks were cheese-filled. Breakfast for the five of them cost Wang Lan nearly six hundred yuan. Even if his teammates were all elites from the Tianjian Bureau, such extravagance was unsustainable.
"Captain, these crab roe soup buns are forty-eight yuan each, and you bought five of them?" Bai Xu asked, her eyes flashing and her tone coquettish. "Be honest, are you a super-rich tycoon? Why don’t you even own a car?"
"Why do you ask? Also, your reaction is a bit off. Zhang Xiao, let’s switch seats; I’ll sit in the passenger seat."
"Don’t be scared, I won’t bite. Captain, do you have a girlfriend? You could consider me?"
"I’m only eighteen! Would you really make a move on me? Yifeng, protect me!"
Amidst playful banter, the five of them finished breakfast in the car. The crab roe soup buns of Modu City truly lived up to their reputation.
"Captain, where are we headed now?"
"Jinghua Mansion."
"Huh? What are we doing at Jinghua Mansion?"
"Investigating the case! I suspect these murder victims were all death soldiers, and their deaths are related to Jinghua Mansion."
Although the four of them didn’t understand how Wang Lan had come up with new leads overnight, they didn’t ask further. Yang Yang drove into Jinghua Mansion Residential Area and, under Wang Lan’s direction, stopped at a parking spot in front of Building Fifteen.
"This place... I think I’ve been here before. Last week, I accompanied the Intelligence Division here for a search," Zhang Xiao said, stroking his chin as he looked at the residential building.
"Did your search last time yield any results?"
"Nothing. The room was very clean, furnished for a single woman. There were only women’s items, nothing out of the ordinary."
"Let’s go and search again," Wang Lan led the four inside.
It wasn’t that Wang Lan distrusted his teammates’ search abilities, nor did he hope to find any evidence in Bai Ji’s home. Instead, Wang Lan suspected that these death soldiers had come to Bai Ji’s house and been marked for death by the murderer.
The premise was that if they really were the Duanmu Family’s death soldiers, then their presence in the East Forest District, assuming it was related to Xiao Qing, could only be to search Bai Ji’s home. Because they couldn’t let it be known that the Duanmu Family was responsible, they had to send death soldiers.
Then, might the death soldiers have left behind any clues while searching?
With leads so scarce, Wang Lan couldn’t afford to miss any potential opportunities.
Opening the door, they were met with a scene of utter chaos.
Liu Yifeng turned to Zhang Xiao. "Was it this messy after you guys finished your search last time? That’s unlikely. Our Tianjian Bureau brethren are all men of integrity. How could they have rummaged through the place like bandits?"
"No, we didn’t make a mess during our search last time. Even if we moved things, we put them all back. It didn’t look like this. Here, not only were belongings scattered everywhere, but even the walls, ceilings, and floors had been completely smashed!"
"Looks like my guess wasn’t wrong," Wang Lan chuckled. "These unidentified victims were indeed death soldiers, and they did search this place thoroughly.
Just as I suspected...
"
"Captain, did you... find a new clue? How did you find it?" Bai Xu asked, an admiring look on her face. If she had just been joking earlier in the car, by now, Bai Xu genuinely admired this team leader who was a few years younger than her.
"It can’t really be called a clue; it’s more of a new hypothesis," Wang Lan explained. "As for how I thought of it... I had a dream last night.
Of course, a hypothesis is just that until we find evidence to prove it. While we don’t have evidence yet, the likelihood of this hypothesis being correct has significantly increased.
Everyone, start looking carefully. See if we can find any evidence."
The five of them split up and began their search.
Bai Ji’s apartment wasn’t large, only about 120 square meters, with a living room, a master bedroom, a secondary bedroom, two bathrooms, one shower room, and a separate study.
Having been thoroughly wrecked, its original state was impossible to discern. Despite being in a modestly priced residential area of Modu City and only 120 square meters, its value shouldn’t be underestimated.
In Modu City, with an average price of 80,000 yuan per square meter, this apartment was worth over ten million.
"Captain, I don’t think it’s necessary to look any further. The entire place has been stripped bare. If there was anything to find, it would have been turned up already."
"I’ve seen people who can turn eating fish, chicken, or crabs into an art form. But I’ve never seen a search so thorough that even the underlying electrical conduits are exposed. Impressively excessive."
While the five were meticulously searching inch by inch, Wang Lan suddenly caught a flash of light in the corner of his eye. Instantly, he moved to the balcony. Star Power surged. Enhanced vision, activate!
The buildings in Jinghua Mansion were spaced closely, only about thirty meters apart. Consequently, many of the lower and middle floors received very little sunlight each day. However, Bai Ji’s apartment was favorably located; it was only ten in the morning, and sunlight already bathed the balcony.
Through his enhanced vision, Wang Lan spotted a telescope on the floor just below the top of a building two hundred meters away from Bai Ji’s. Behind the telescope stood an old man who looked like a wild man.
The old man seemed to sense something, quickly retracting his telescope and retreating into his room.
"Captain, what are you doing on the balcony? We’ve searched here; there’s nothing."
"I haven’t found anything on my side either. Nothing at all."
"I, however, might have discovered something," Wang Lan said with a faint smile. "How strong are each of you? The murderer is a powerful individual capable of instantly killing even a Galaxy Stage warrior. If things go wrong, you could be killed."
"Early Star Sea Stage."
"Peak Galaxy Stage."
"Peak Galaxy Stage."
"Middle Galaxy Stage," Bai Ji confessed, her face reddening. Among the four, she seemed the most self-conscious about her rank.
"Don’t look at me, I’m only twenty-one!" Feeling Wang Lan’s gaze, Bai Xu blurted out, completely forgetting that a woman’s age is her greatest secret.
The peak period of strength growth for Star Martial Warriors is between eighteen and thirty years of age. During this time, they generally reach their full potential.
Even prodigies who took ten years to advance from Starlight to Star Cloud before turning eighteen would find their cultivation speed up even faster during this peak period. It might only take a few years to progress from Star Cloud to Galaxy Stage.
Moreover, during their university years, many civilian Star Martial Warriors also experience explosive growth due to the resources schools allocate in their favor. Reaching the Galaxy Stage by twenty-four or twenty-five isn’t remarkable. If you haven’t broken through to the Galaxy Stage by then, there’s little chance you’ll advance to the Star Sea Stage in your lifetime.
Wang Lan knew Yang Yang was twenty-eight this year and at the early Star Sea Stage, but his time for growth was running out. At this rate, becoming a Titled Strongman seemed unlikely.
On the other hand, twenty-one-year-old Bai Xu was at the middle Galaxy Stage. With nine years of peak growth remaining, she had the potential to go the furthest.
A fair assessment: all four team members would certainly be among the very best, even when compared to the geniuses and Demons as common as dogs at Modu City’s Star Martial Academy.
They truly lived up to their reputation as an independent S-ranked group from the Tianjian Bureau; their quality was extremely high.
With one at the early Star Sea Stage as a baseline, Wang Lan felt reassured. His normal strength was already at the late Galaxy Stage, and in his Phoenix form, he could even contend with those in the Star Sea Stage.
With two at the Star Sea Stage against one, Wang Lan didn’t believe the opponent could still be a Titled Strongman.
"Follow me. Yang Yang, you must always be ready to protect the other three. The murderer’s strength is at least at the Star Sea Stage. If possible, leave him to me."
"Captain, are you sure you can handle it?" Yang Yang voiced a hint of doubt towards Wang Lan for the first time.
After all, who would believe an eighteen-year-old could be at the Star Sea Stage? In the seventy years since the war, Jade Country had seen hundreds, if not thousands, of leading geniuses. But none had broken into the Star Sea Stage at the age of eighteen.
One would expect it to happen by twenty, right?
Even Yu Ruoyun, hailed as a rare genius of the ages, is at the peak Galaxy Stage at nineteen. If she breaks into the Star Sea Stage this year, she might be the first to do so before turning twenty.
Could Wang Lan possibly be at the Star Sea Stage?
"Yeah, I probably shouldn’t ask this, but Captain, can you really handle it?"
"Bai Xu," Liu Yifeng said with a mysteriously profound look, "some things Yang Yang and I can say, but you cannot."

chapters.title: Chapter 320 The murderer surfaces
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 320 The murderer surfaces
"BANG—"
The front door was kicked open fiercely. Star Power surged, and Wang Lan instantly locked onto a sloppy person in the living room.
"Don’t, don’t hit me..." The scruffy beggar seemed to reflexively kneel down, huddling and covering his head with his hands.
This scene made the world incredibly quiet. Zhang Xiao and Bai Xu stared with dumbfounded eyes, their gazes sweeping back and forth between Wang Lan and the man before them.
Is this the murderer you mentioned? At least a master at the Star Sea Stage?
Wang Lan’s brow furrowed as he surveyed the man’s home with a glance around. Although it was in the same community as Bai Ji’s, his home was still the rough apartment from when it was handed over. The lamp on the ceiling was just the most common screw-in light bulb. Apart from the front door, none of the rooms had doors installed.
The room was cluttered with various kinds of trash, as well as some junk picked up from who knows where.
After waiting a long time without any action from Wang Lan and the others, the middle-aged man looked up in confusion. One of his eyes was obviously blind, flashing an eerie and chilly light.
"Who are you... What are you doing in my home?"
Wang Lan did not reply but instead turned and walked to the balcony, where he saw an old telescope that had been packed away. A very worn observation telescope.
"Were you using this telescope to spy on us just now?"
"Ah?" The unkempt middle-aged man looked up blankly. "No, I was just looking... just looking casually." While speaking, the sloppy man’s face had a sleazy smile, yet also a hint of fear.
"Captain, I don’t detect any Star Energy Fluctuation from him. Could you have made a mistake?" Bai Xu quietly came to Wang Lan’s side and asked.
"Not necessarily! Do you think there are no Perception-type Star Martial Warriors among those death soldiers? He can still kill unnoticed. That means Perception-types are ineffective against the murderer."
"But... no matter how I look at him, he doesn’t seem like a Star Martial Warrior."
"Though his home is just a rough apartment, it’s still a two-bedroom flat in Modu City. It’s worth at least seven million. Don’t be fooled by his appearance."
"What if he’s just renting it?"
"Do you think any landlord would be willing to rent their property to him?" Wang Lan asked with a cold sneer.
"Young man, I bought this house with lottery winnings seven years ago. That was my one stroke of good luck, winning five million and buying this place. All my money went into this house."
"Five million? Now the house price has risen to seven or eight million, why don’t you sell it? Sell the house, and you’ll instantly become a rich man."
"Where would I live if I sold the house? You may see me as poor, but I’m not stupid. I know the house will retain its value; it won’t be a loss whenever I decide to sell it. When I first won the five million, there were many women who wanted to throw themselves at me.
But I knew they were after my five million. If I fell for it, in a few years I’d be out of money. I’m an old bachelor, with no children, so when I get older, I’ll just sell the house and move to an old age home."
"You’re not dumb! Where did you get all these things?"
"Picked them from the trash. I work at the garbage processing plant to the south, sorting waste."
"Really? How much is the monthly wage?"
"Two thousand! It doesn’t include food or housing."
Through a series of questions and answers, Wei Laohan’s information was quickly gathered. Yang Yang also swiftly verified through the Tianjian Bureau’s intelligence network that everything was exactly as Wei Laohan had said.
"Captain, the information checks out. It seems there’s nothing suspicious about Wei Zheng."
"But within a minute after we entered Bai Ji’s home, he was watching us through the telescope. That can’t be a coincidence, can it? ’Just casually looking’—that’s a bit too coincidental."
"Young man, I wasn’t just watching you..."
"Who else were you watching?"
"There are many residents here; many of them don’t close their bathroom or bedroom curtains properly, sometimes leaving a gap. This telescope is good... as long as it’s unobstructed, I can see hundreds of meters away as if I’m looking right through their windows.
I’ve been single my whole life, so when I think about women, I just look to satisfy my eyes." As he spoke, his face revealed a sleazy smile that all men would understand.
"Tsk, old reprobate!"
"Is that so? Yang Yang, hand me the suppression handcuffs."
Yang Yang took the suppression handcuffs from his waist and handed them to Wang Lan. "Captain, do you need to take him back for interrogation?"
"Since he’s a suspect, let’s take him back for a thorough investigation." Wang Lan took the suppression handcuffs and step by step approached Wei Laohan.
"What... what are you going to do? Don’t mess around... you..."
"Don’t be afraid, it’s nothing. We’re just inviting you to the Tianjian Bureau for an investigation. Rest assured, if you’re innocent, you’ll naturally be released."
"What Tianjian Bureau? I don’t know it. You’re not the police, do you have an arrest warrant... this is kidnapping, help, help—"
"Don’t shout. When the Tianjian Bureau arrests someone, even if you scream your throat raw, no one will care," Wang Lan sneered coldly.
These words, heard by the two young girls, instantly caused smiles to appear on their faces. They must have watched plenty of dramas.
Wang Lan gradually approached Wei Laohan and opened the handcuffs to shackle the latter’s wrists. Once the suppression handcuffs were locked on, they might not be able to suppress everyone’s Star Power. However, they had a strong inhibitory effect on the control of Star Power.
A momentary obstruction of Star Power could lead to an unnatural death. That’s why, even if one could break free from the suppression handcuffs, they dared not do so publicly. If they were discovered in the process of escaping, their death would be in vain.
The moment the handcuffs were about to be clamped on, a terrifying Star Energy Fluctuation burst forth like an exploding oil barrel. In an instant, Wang Lan’s Zanpakuto automatically appeared in his hand.
BOOM—
A loud noise thundered, and a wave of energy swept through. Bai Xu, who had been unguarded, was blown away by the terrifying impact. Although the other three weren’t as disheveled as Bai Xu, they didn’t fare much better.
It wasn’t that the so-called elite team’s response capabilities were poor; it was that their very first official mission had them facing someone who could completely conceal their Star Energy Fluctuation.
Concealing Star Energy Fluctuation is something all Star Martial Warriors try to do. However, fluctuations undetectable even by Perception-type Star Martial Warriors are extremely rare.
Even the Five Emperors couldn’t conceal their presence completely; at best, they could only reduce the strength of the fluctuations.
To Perception-type Star Martial Warriors, as long as it exists, it will definitely be sensed. As long as one is a Star Martial Warrior, they must have a Star Palace. As long as they possess a Star Palace and have Star Power in their body, it can be sensed even if completely still.
And the ability to completely shield from perception is a rarity among rare talents.
Encountering such a case on their first mission was truly an unlucky stroke for them.
The energy wave stirred the dust in the room, and thick smoke billowed in an instant.
Wang Lan’s figure retreated, his sword held horizontally in front of him, his legs dragging long scars on the ground.
In the midst of the rolling dust, Wei Laohan’s body slowly straightened. The upright Wei Laohan emanated a majestic aura like a great hill. At this moment, he stood tall like a vigorous pine.
Wei Laohan reached out with both hands. SWOOSH, SWOOSH—
A katana and a long sword flew out of a pile of junk, landing in Wei Laohan’s hands.
"You stubborn kid! I gave you explanations for all your doubts, yet you still persist? I didn’t want to cause unnecessary trouble and was willing to spare your lives, but you chose not to take the broad Yangguan road before you," he said.
"It is indeed you! Yang Yang, secure the formation, the barrier!"
The barrier is a skill that Tianjian Bureau teams must master. The strength of team members varies, and so does the power of the barriers they create. With people like Yang Yang, all at or above the Galaxy Stage, the Seal Array they cast could not be broken even by those in the later Star Sea Stage.
Moreover, another function of the barrier is to prevent suspects from escaping. Once trapped within, it is very difficult for the suspect to get away. So when Wang Lan’s words ended, Wei Laohan’s figure flashed, appearing before Bai Xu with eerie speed.
CLANG—
The Zanpakuto blocked Wei Laohan’s beheading strike. At that moment, Bai Xu’s face was already pale with fright.
Wei Laohan’s blade was near her delicate neck, yet Bai Xu was completely unaware. Had it not been for Wang Lan’s immediate intervention, she would have died.
Bai Xu was elite, praised as a genius wherever a twenty-year-old at mid-Galaxy Stage went. But she was close to becoming a cautionary example of a gifted life cut short.
"Hmm? You can keep up with my speed?" Wei Laohan cried out in surprise.
Normally, Wei Laohan’s speed was already at a certain limit. Among those in the Star Sea Stage, no more than ten could be faster. This was Wei Laohan’s confidence.
But no matter how fast you are, speed is just speed.
Wang Lan’s Phantom Tracer is essentially a blink ability.
With the blink ability of Phantom Tracer combined with the Gold-level Basic Swordsmanship and Basic Sword Skill, Wang Lan was fearless in close combat.
In an instant, Wei Laohan’s katana and long sword attacks came, and Wang Lan was engulfed in a flurry of blade and sword light.
Wei Laohan must have embodied the wind attribute, and he had developed the sharpness of the wind to perfection. His moves might not be the most sophisticated, but as the saying goes, no martial arts can prevail over speed.
With both his katana and long sword dancing different attack moves while still being as fast as lightning, it was no wonder the Duanmu Family’s dispatched assassins, and even Duanmu Jing, were killed by him as easily as chopping vegetables.
CLANG, CLANG, CLANG—
A series of intense clashes rang out. The sounds of striking metal melded into a continuous roar. Though only two were fighting, it sounded like two armies in battle.
Wei Laohan had always been invincible in close combat, and Wang Lan was never one to back down from such close-range encounters.
After Wang Lan repeatedly thwarted Wei Laohan’s attempts to kill Yang Yang and the others, the four finally completed their positioning.
"Seal Array, Purple Flame Seal!"
As the four’s Star Power surged, the Seal Array gathered like a giant windmill. In an instant, walls of purple flames rose into the sky, enclosing the entire room and trapping Wang Lan and Wei Laohan in the middle.
BOOM—
With a loud crash, Wang Lan and Wei Laohan separated after their exchange of blows. Wei Laohan did not dare attempt to destroy the barrier before defeating Wang Lan. If he tried, Wang Lan would instantly deliver a lethal blow.
"At such a young age, you can match me blow for blow. When did Jade Country have such a young talent? Could you be from the Kirin Institute?" Wei Laohan asked, puzzled.
Although Wang Lan was not aware of what the Kirin Institute was, he did not bother to engage in pointless conversation.
In his hand, the Zanpakuto, even if a disguise, was a God Soldier Sharp Edge of the highest order. Yet, in this round of clashing, it had been chipped densely by the opponent’s katana and long sword.
The opponent’s mastery over the sharp attributes of the wind element was so profound that it left Wang Lan in awe.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 My Name is Mu Fanghua
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Chapter 321 My Name is Mu Fanghua
"What is your relationship with Xiao Qing?" Wang Lan asked in a deep voice.
"Fifteen years ago, in the Northwestern Military Region, the Seventh Battalion of the Third Star Martial Army received orders to rescue a squad trapped in a Different Dimensional Space. The Exotic Beasts inside were far more powerful than we had imagined, and we paid the price of fifty casualties before we finally found the besieged squad.
"The battalion commander ordered us to cover their retreat and wait for reinforcements while holding off the enemy. For three days, we held the line in the Different Dimensional Space. But in the end, what we received was the closure of the portal, with only two of us left out of thirty brothers.
"My younger brother, dying in my arms, asked me, ’Have the reinforcements arrived yet? When will they come?’ Heh heh heh... Hahaha... He was worried about reinforcements until his last breath. But the higher-ups had already abandoned us.
"Thirty brothers, along with the fifty who died fighting their way in—their lives were exchanged for the life of a young master from the Yu Family. The military’s initial plan was to trade our lives for one person’s.
"Why? Are the lives of those of us who fight and die for the country not lives? Are they worthless?
"You ask if I knew Xiao Qing? Heh heh heh... We are just lonely ghosts returned to the world of the living."
"So that’s how it is. You lurk in the shadows while Xiao Qing was out in the open. Xiao Qing died, and you’re seeking revenge for him?"
"No. Taking this path, we all knew we’d have to pay eventually. We hold no grudges against anyone for Xiao Qing being captured and executed. Until his death, Xiao Qing kept his promise and did not betray us.
"We, who are like betrayed wandering spirits, hate traitors the most. Yet they still refused to let him go; they even aimed to eradicate his family completely.
"If Xiao Qing’s lover had died, fine. Even if the woman and child he had overseas had died, fine. But they shouldn’t have touched Bai Ji! We had hidden Bai Ji so well, yet they still refused to let her be.
"If that’s the case, then don’t blame us for a fight to the death. Since you’ve found this place, you can take whatever Xiao Qing left behind. However, you must let me go first."
"Huh? It’s not even dark yet, and you’re already this drunk?"
"Then die—"
In an instant, Wei Laohan’s twin weapons danced, blade light gleamed, and Sword Qi surged forth, forming a wheel of sword light that he hurled at Wang Lan.
Wang Lan swiftly raised his sword to his chest. In a flash, he unleashed fifteen bursts of Sword Qi, ultimately shattering the oncoming sword energies.
But his Zanpakuto could no longer bear the strain and was covered in alarming cracks.
Wang Lan took a deep breath. Due to the small area, his Star Martial Skill didn’t offer much advantage. Fortunately, the same limitation also constrained Wei Laohan. Moreover, close combat was where Wang Lan excelled.
Wang Lan held his sword horizontally before him. "Bloom, Sword of Light."
As his words fell, the Zanpakuto exploded into a sky full of starlight. When the starlight converged, it formed a long sword made of pure light.
This scene appeared astonishingly before Wei Laohan. He looked at Wang Lan with an unnatural expression.
Is this a Star Martial Skill or a Star Palace Artifact? If it’s a Star Martial Skill, that sword was clearly transformed from the blade just now. But if it’s a Star Palace Artifact, how can a Star Palace Artifact also unleash a Star Martial Skill?
With a flash, Wang Lan instantly appeared at Wei Laohan’s side, and the Sword of Light slashed down.
CLANG—
Wei Laohan raised his saber to block, and light burst forth in all directions.
Wang Lan’s sword instantly danced again, its path leaving a trail of luminous afterimages. The blade of light swiftly attacked Wei Laohan, who hastily defended with his own sword. However, as he blocked, Wang Lan’s thrust was already piercing towards him.
Wei Laohan was forced to block with the saber in his left hand. If it weren’t for Wei Laohan’s ability to use different bladed weapon techniques with each hand, that move would have killed him instantly.
"Arrow Rain!"
Suddenly, Wang Lan leaped backward, soaring into the sky. With a flick of his sword, countless beams of light transformed into a dense volley of arrows raining down on Wei Laohan.
Seeing this, Wei Laohan’s face turned pale with fright.
He had seen Sword Qi before—a thrust of the sword would produce a burst of Sword Qi. To instantly launch multiple streams of Sword Qi would require several thrusts. Thus, anyone able to instantly unleash more than ten streams of Sword Qi was definitely a Sword Dao pinnacle expert.
But Wang Lan had clearly only thrust once, yet countless arrows fell like a torrential downpour.
What the hell is this?
Although filled with terror, Wei Laohan’s movements didn’t slow. He frantically wielded his weapons to ward off the arrow rain. But just as he blocked it, Wang Lan’s Zanpakuto danced again, and numerous crescent-like blades of light carved arcs as they blitzed towards him.
Not only were there many, but they were also fast.
In that moment, Wei Laohan had three words stuck in his throat. Even though Wang Lan’s Star Power rank was two levels lower than his own, he felt as if he were being crushed by a Titled Strongman, utterly powerless to fight back.
BOOM—
The saber in his hand shattered, turning into a sky full of starlight.
The sword in his hand broke, its tip falling helplessly from the fractured blade.
Wang Lan gently thrust his sword. It instantly extended three meters, the golden blade of light piercing deeply into Wei Laohan’s chest, shattering his heart.
Wei Laohan stared at Wang Lan with wide eyes and suddenly opened his mouth, vomiting a mouthful of black blood.
"You actually beat me in close-quarters combat with bladed weapons? Hahaha... COUGH, COUGH, COUGH—"
Wang Lan sheathed the Sword of Light, which once again returned to its disguised katana form. The scabbard closed slowly.
At this moment, shouldn’t I softly say, "Moon Falling Snow"?
Unfortunately, Yue Jifeng was already dead.
From the moment Wang Lan released the initial form of his Zanpakuto to killing Wei Laohan, the entire process took no more than a minute. Moreover, this victory wasn’t a fluke; it was a solid, head-on defeat of a Star Sea realm expert.
If his teammates had any concerns about Wang Lan’s strength before, all those worries had now completely dissipated.
Defeating a Star Sea realm expert head-on? Go ahead and try if you think you can. Although this Star Sea realm expert seemed to only be skilled with blades and his movements were restricted, wasn’t Wang Lan under the same limitations?
Bai Xu gazed at Wang Lan, her eyes sparkling like a myriad of stars, completely a smitten fangirl. Even Zhang Xiao’s look towards Wang Lan had become notably different.
"System prompt: Defeated higher-level opponent. Reward: 1,000 experience points, 80 skill points," the system’s notification sounded, but Wang Lan didn’t care at all. This meager amount of experience and skill points wasn’t even worth mentioning.
"The barrier’s down, huh? What, did you plan on dragging me back?" Once Wang Lan came back to his senses, he was immediately irritated. These four were actually still maintaining the barrier.
It wasn’t that his teammates were slow to react due to incompetence. Wang Lan’s battle had simply been too masterful, and they were still replaying it in their minds. If they had been in Wang Lan’s situation...
The conclusion was stark: they would have been utterly, irrevocably dead.
"Quick, everyone search carefully! We must find the recording Xiao Qing left behind, even if we have to dig three feet into the ground!"
In truth, there wasn’t much need to dig three feet down. Using his earth-attribute Star Martial Skill, Zhang Xiao indeed found seven or eight metal boxes hidden in the cement floor. Upon opening them, they were stunned. All the boxes contained average-quality Soul Beads, except for one which held a dozen or so low-quality Soul Beads.
Wang Lan walked over to the box of low-quality Soul Beads with a puzzled look, examining them before picking one up. After a mere glance, understanding dawned on his face.
Indeed, it seemed odd to have one box of low-quality Soul Beads among so many average-quality ones. But to Wang Lan, these low-quality Soul Beads were the most valuable items.
"Take these things and go back," Wang Lan commanded grandly. "Also, notify the police to come and manage the scene and confirm if he was the killer. We’ve confirmed it, but objective evidence is still needed."
"Understood!" one of his teammates confirmed.
Wang Lan walked to the window, looking out at the peaceful neighborhood, suddenly feeling a bit sentimental.
It has been eighteen years since I came to this world, and I’ve always felt like I don’t quite fit in. Perhaps it’s a certain sense of belonging that I’m missing.
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s eyes narrowed slightly. In the distance, on the internal road of the complex, a faintly familiar figure appeared at the entrance, walking slowly towards them.
Why has he come?
A sharp light flickered in Wang Lan’s eyes.
"I’ll leave this to you. I’m going to step out for a bit."
"Captain, did you discover something?" Bai Xu hopped over to Wang Lan’s side. Her liveliness made one wonder if she was born in the Year of the Rabbit.
That’s not right, though, I mused. She’s three years older than me, so she should be a Tiger. A Tigger, perhaps?
"No, I just bumped into a senior. I’m going to say hello."
Duanmu Fanghua carried a convenience store bag, walking leisurely along the internal road. His somber face seemed to conceal his thoughts, and his brow furrowed occasionally as he walked.
"Senior Fanghua!" Suddenly, a call interrupted Duanmu Fanghua’s reverie. Duanmu Fanghua stopped and turned his head to look, his face immediately breaking into a smile.
"Wang Lan."
Perhaps at this moment, a voice sounded simultaneously in both their hearts:
Pah! Honeyed words, but a belly of swords.
Each knew that their relationship was not harmonious; on the contrary, they had previously had a significant falling-out.
That time with Duanmu Yi, Wang Lan had intended to kill two birds with one stone. Duanmu Yi deserved to be dealt with, and he suspected this Duanmu Fanghua was no good either. However, Duanmu Fanghua was Vice President Nangong Meng’s disciple, and since Duanmu Yi’s actions were found to be unrelated to him, he was released that same night.
After that, Wang Lan never saw Duanmu Fanghua at school again. He’d heard from classmates that Duanmu Fanghua was still in the student council, but Wang Lan hadn’t seen him because Duanmu Fanghua had been actively avoiding him.
When the two met, it was impossible for them to show genuine smiles of a long-awaited reunion. Yet, both being passable actors, they instantly put on a show of old friends unexpectedly meeting in a foreign land.
"Wang Lan, what are you doing here?"
"I’m here to visit a friend. What about you, Senior Duanmu? Are you also here to visit a friend?"
Duanmu Fanghua lifted the convenience store bag slightly. "Green onions, ginger! Who brings these things when visiting a friend? I live here."
Huh? Isn’t Duanmu Fanghua from the Duanmu Family? Why is he living here? Could it be a rented place? That’s not right either; this place isn’t close to the school.
"Live with the Duanmu Family? Who told you that?" Duanmu Fanghua’s smile seemed forced. "I’m not fit to live with the Duanmu Family. My mom and I have always lived here."
"It’s rare to run into you, Senior Duanmu. Aren’t you going to invite me to your place to take a look?" Wang Lan asked with a smile.
Duanmu Fanghua’s expression changed slightly, his smile faltering, but he still nodded. "Alright. But when you see my mom later, please don’t call me Senior Duanmu or Duanmu Fanghua. Call me... Mu Fanghua."

chapters.title: Chapter 322 I Don’t Want to Show Off
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 322 I Don’t Want to Show Off
"Why?"
"Actually, many people at the school know, but because they want to save my face, few spread it around. I am Duanmu Qingshuang’s illegitimate child, an existence the Duanmu Family doesn’t acknowledge.
"Do you think Duanmu Yi would let this kind of thing go? Ever since he came to Modu City Star Martial Academy, he’s been proclaiming it everywhere.
"Twenty years ago, my mother was deceived by Duanmu Qingshuang’s hypocrisy, thinking she had really found a man she could entrust her life to. But Duanmu Qingshuang didn’t keep his promise. To inherit the position of family head, he abandoned my mother and married a woman from the Lv Family.
"In a fit of anger, my mother cut all ties with Duanmu Qingshuang and moved here alone. I’ve lived here for fifteen years. My mother forbids me from having any connection with the Duanmu Family. The name on my ID is my mother’s surname; my real name is Mu Fanghua."
Upon hearing this, Wang Lan nearly thought Duanmu Fanghua was going to release his "shikai" or something—his real name had come out.
"Then why do you meddle in Duanmu Yi’s business? Seems like you didn’t listen to your mother, huh."
"If I didn’t rely on the Duanmu Family, would I have the Cultivation Level of the Galaxy Stage now? Could I have been admitted to Modu City Star Martial Academy? Could I have Mr. Nangong as my master? Wang Lan, the fates of us lowly ones, you people who grew up nestled among stacks of Soul Beads, can never understand."
"Heh... Why does everyone think I’m someone born with a golden key in his mouth? Half a year ago, I was just an unknown passerby, alright.
"Soul Beads are important, but it’s not impossible to obtain them through your own efforts. Anyway, all my Soul Beads were earned by me; I didn’t rely on anyone’s charity."
"Alright, maybe I can’t win an argument against you. This is my place—take the elevator to the tenth floor.
But still, I have to ask you, please don’t give anything away later."
"Okay!"
"Mom, I’m back."
"Hmm, eh? You have a friend over?"
"Hello, Auntie. I’m Senior Mu’s classmate, a freshman this year."
"You child, why didn’t you call me in advance if you were bringing a guest? I haven’t prepared anything," Duanmu Fanghua’s mother said to him, a little crossly.
"There’s no need, Auntie. Fanghua and I ran into each other in the residential area, so I just came to see the place. I’ll only stay for a little while."
Duanmu Fanghua’s mother was a very intellectual woman. She had a problem with her legs and was in a wheelchair. She had neatly cropped short hair and wore a pair of scholarly-looking glasses.
From her skill in maneuvering the wheelchair, it was clear she had been using it for a long time.
"Sit down for a moment; I’ll get you some water."
"No, no, really, please don’t trouble yourself," Wang Lan quickly said, standing up.
"Mom, he’s my classmate; you don’t need to be so formal. Don’t get up, I’ll do it."
This mother-son duo was making Wang Lan feel a bit embarrassed.
The apartment didn’t look large, probably around seventy to eighty square meters. It was fine if just the two of them lived there, but it might feel cramped if Duanmu Fanghua started a family later.
The decor was very retro; it looked like it had been done quite some time ago. There was no suspended ceiling, just plaster cornices overhead. The apartment wasn’t large, but it was very tidy.
It seemed Duanmu Fanghua hadn’t lied. He really did live in the Jinghua Mansion Residential Area.
"Senior, Auntie, really, there’s no need to go to any trouble. I know where it is now; I’ll come find Senior to hang out another time."
"Goodness, child, you just sat down. Why are you leaving already? Why not stay for dinner?"
"No, no, I promised to play games with some classmates. Uh... Senior, Auntie, I should be going now."
"Well... I won’t keep you then. Fanghua, see your classmate out."
"I’m watching the pot..."
"I’ll watch it, you go."
"No need, no need..."
Duanmu Fanghua enthusiastically walked Wang Lan to the door. Duanmu Fanghua smiled. "Don’t mind her. My mom has trouble with her legs, and she’s usually very lonely at home. It’s rare for someone to visit, so she got a little overexcited."
"Although your mother’s legs don’t seem to be in good condition, at least you have a mother. I remember a song from a few years ago that put it well: ’Listen to your mother’s words, don’t let her get hurt.’"
Leaving this remark behind, Wang Lan’s figure vanished into the elevator.
The smile on Duanmu Fanghua’s face disappeared the instant the elevator doors closed on Wang Lan. He snorted coldly, turned, and re-entered his home.
"Have you gotten involved with the Duanmu Family again?"
"No... I haven’t?" Perhaps accustomed to lying, Duanmu Fanghua uttered this falsehood naturally, his face showing no trace of guilt or unease.
"Still saying no? That classmate of yours isn’t just any ordinary student. When he entered our home, he first looked at me, then scrutinized our home’s decor. After seeming to confirm something, he stood up to leave."
"Mom, have you been alone at home for too long? Are you overthinking things? What are you even talking about? Isn’t it normal for my classmate, when visiting our house, to observe you?
When I visit someone else’s house, I also observe the host’s expression to see if I’m welcome. Besides, it’s normal for him to look at our decor; our house’s decor is so retro, it must be quite rare."
"Am I overthinking it?"
"You’re definitely overthinking it."
"Really? You’ve never brought a classmate home before, and now you suddenly bring someone. Those two good friends of yours from the student council, you’ve never brought either of them here. But this Wang Lan, I’ve never even heard his name, yet you bring him home? That’s not like you."
"Mom, it’s because I need to curry favor with him. Don’t overthink it. I’ve really and completely cut ties with the Duanmu Family."
"You better have. I heard Duanmu Yi is dead. Don’t think his death means your chance has come. Even if the Duanmu Family wants to take you in, that will have to wait until after I’m dead. I’m warning you: if you set foot in the Duanmu Family’s home, I’ll die to show you."
"Mom, that won’t happen. Wang Lan is a much bigger ’backer’ than the Duanmu Family. I’m not stupid enough to board their sinking ship."
"It’s good that you understand. Now go watch the pot; be careful it doesn’t burn."
「」
After Wang Lan left Duanmu Fanghua’s home, the four team members were already waiting downstairs. The police had also arrived, setting up a perimeter and maintaining order.
"Captain, let’s go."
"Hmm!"
The off-road vehicle started, drove out of the residential area, and onto the viaduct. It was noon. Although there weren’t as many vehicles as during the evening rush hour, because it was the weekend, the viaduct was already packed with cars, bumper to bumper.
"Is the case cracked?" Suddenly, Liu Yifeng, sitting beside Wang Lan, asked as if he had risen from the dead.
"Are you still sleepwalking? It’s cracked, alright. The captain executed the murderer on the spot."
"But... I feel like I didn’t do anything. It’s cracked just like that? It’s only been a day and a half."
"What more do you want? Do we have to go through countless hardships, chasing the culprit from south to north, before you consider the case solved?" Zhang Xiao sneered from the passenger seat.
"This was too fast. This was such a tricky case. The bureau had it for nearly a month with no progress. We solved it in a day and a half? This is enough for me to brag about for a year."
"Did you solve it? The captain solved the case."
"Captain, something’s not right," Yang Yang, who was driving, suddenly said. His tone was more respectful. If Yang Yang’s previous tone towards Wang Lan was merely due to hierarchical duty, now, after Wang Lan had single-handedly killed a Star Sea Stage expert, Yang Yang fully acknowledged Wang Lan’s strength.
In terms of military rank, Yang Yang was a Lieutenant Colonel, one rank higher than Wang Lan.
"There are four cars behind us, frequently overtaking and rapidly approaching. I suspect they’re after us."
"Can you shake them?"
"I can’t. There are too many cars on the viaduct. If I try to maneuver like them, I’ll cause a major accident."
"Take the next ramp down. Go to a less crowded area."
"Okay!"
Yang Yang quickly turned onto the ramp. As expected, the four cars behind them followed closely down the ramp.
Perhaps the other party also didn’t want to cause a scene in a crowded place. After Wang Lan’s vehicle left the viaduct, they weren’t pursued as aggressively, but rather followed from a distance. This continued for over ten minutes until they reached a remote area.
Wang Lan’s vehicle stopped, and the four pursuing cars also stopped about a hundred meters away. Soon, another seven or eight vehicles converged from all directions, surrounding Wang Lan’s off-road vehicle.
The doors of the opposing vehicles opened, and five men emerged from each car. By this estimate, well over fifty people had appeared.
"Friends, we don’t want to make a big deal out of this. Just hand over the person you captured at Jinghua Mansion and whatever you took, and there’ll be no trouble between us.
Moreover, each of you will receive a token of gratitude substantial enough to ensure you live comfortably for the rest of your lives. Otherwise, we’ll have no choice but to ask you to die."
A deep voice emanated from one of the cars.
"Heh?" Yang Yang chuckled. "Daring to surround a Tianjian Bureau vehicle? I’ve been with the Tianjian Bureau for so many years and have never encountered this. Captain, what are your orders?"
"Not only have I never seen it, I’ve never even heard of it. What else can we do? Yifeng, Bai Xu, Zhang Xiao, stay in the car and protect the evidence. Yang Yang, you take the east, I’ll take the west. Let’s make it quick."
"Yes!"
Yang Yang slowly pushed the car door open. The moment it opened, his body liquefied, seemingly transforming into a silver, liquid robot. The moment Wang Lan landed, he pointed a finger straight at the sky.
Star Power surged instantly, and an Array materialized in the sky above.
"Scatter!" someone in the convoy shouted.
"Meteor Fire Rain."
His warning came too late. The moment his shout echoed, the Meteor Fire Rain was already crashing down from the sky.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!—
A continuous series of explosions erupted, leaving Wang Lan’s besiegers utterly dumbfounded.
Did it have to be this terrifying? Did he *really* have to go all out from the start? Even if you’re a damn Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warrior, can’t you act like a normal one?! An S-rank Star Martial Skill right off the bat? Is that humanly possible?!
The Meteor Fire Rain barrage killed at least seven or eight of them, and those fortunate enough to survive weren’t much better off, amidst the car explosions, the fiery rain, and the billowing smoke.
This wasn’t a group ganging up on one person; it was a group being completely crushed by a single individual.
But that wasn’t all. After unleashing Meteor Fire Rain, Wang Lan slammed his palm on the ground. Before his opponents could even react, a compound S-rank Star Martial Skill activated.
"Earth Surge Lava."
Blazing scarlet lava erupted from the ground, instantly engulfing a fifty-meter radius in front of Wang Lan. Anyone caught within the range of the Earth Erupting Magma, unless they possessed a defensive Star Martial Skill, was swallowed by the searing molten rock.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 All Are Suicide Warriors
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 323 All Are Suicide Warriors
This scene left the three people in the car dumbfounded.
Just a moment ago, the three of them were unhappy that Wang Lan had told them to stay in the car.
As members of the team, how could we just stand by and watch?
They were already displeased when the four of them had set up the barrier, and Wang Lan’s one-on-one fight with Wei Laohan had only added to their frustration.
Moreover, before making his move, Wang Lan had even told Yang Yang to protect the three of them, treating them as if they were a burden. Of course, since Wei Laohan was a quick-kill type Star Martial Warrior and at the Star Sea Stage—posing too great a threat—they had swallowed their complaints.
But now, some unknown Star Martial Warriors dared to block the Tianjian Bureau’s car, and he still wanted them to just watch?
Isn’t that going too far? What protecting evidence? I think you just look down on our independent squad! But now, Wang Lan, you’re incredible! You were right!
An S-grade Meteor Fire Rain, followed by another S-grade composite Star Martial Skill? Forget a bunch of unknown-level scrubs; even those at the Star Sea Stage would have to kneel! You say Wang Lan is at the Star Cloud Stage? Is there even such a thing as this kind of Star Cloud Stage? Earlier, when Wang Lan and Wei Laohan were trading blows at close quarters, we thought Wang Lan specialized in sword techniques, and Wei Laohan was just unlucky to have encountered this freak. But now, I’m sorry, I was wrong. Wei Laohan, you died unjustly. To die without witnessing Wang Lan’s Star Martial Skill bombardment... that’s too pitiful.
Wang Lan felt exhilarated! His strength had significantly improved after coming out of the Nine-layer Pagoda. For instance, he had mastered both Meteor Fire Rain and Earth Surge Lava only after emerging.
Learning Star Martial Skills and not showing them off is like wearing brocade robes in the dark of night. But to show off casually would be an insult to these S-grade Star Martial Skills. Finally, some scrubs popped up out of nowhere to block the way. I’ve been holding back for a long time and can’t restrain myself anymore!
The power of these two Star Martial Skills... I’m pretty satisfied. Meteor Fire Rain was always an all-terrain coverage-type Star Martial Skill; Yu Ruoyun has used it many times. As an S-grade Star Martial Skill, its power naturally far exceeds Earth Surge Fire Sea. That’s why I’ve been so envious of it for a long time. And after fusing Earth Surge Fire Sea and Meteor Fire Rain into Earth Erupting Magma, its power is incredible! It shot straight up to nearly the Super S-grade category. If only the attack range reached a satisfying one hundred meters, this Star Martial Skill would definitely be Super S-grade. Who can swim in magma? Unless you happen to possess some innate divine ability. Otherwise, I’ll turn every last one of you into stone statues.
Originally, there were thirty to forty people on the enemy’s side. The Meteor Fire Rain took out a third of them, and after one blast of Earth Surge Lava, only six or seven stragglers remained, like frightened kittens and puppies.
If that show-off from earlier were here, I’d really like to ask him: What was that you were saying?
"Captain, you’re too incredible! Three seconds! You dropped two S-grade Star Martial Skills and completely wiped them out?"
"Give me a Soul Bead. I’m running low on Star Power." A single Meteor Fire Rain had consumed more than half his Star Power, and Earth Surge Lava had drained all the Star Power in his Solar Seal. So now, Wang Lan was feeling quite depleted.
Thinking of Bai Xu’s words made Wang Lan’s expression turn a bit grim.
Three seconds, you’re too incredible? Who is he trying to mock?
Anyway, plenty of mid-grade Soul Beads were obtained from Wei Laohan, so taking one isn’t a big deal. Besides, this is a battle expenditure, not embezzlement.
After absorbing a mid-grade Soul Bead, his Star Power was instantly replenished.
"Captain, there are still some alive!"
BOOM—
A loud explosion ripped through the earth. The erupting lava instantly sank back into the ground, and when it disappeared, five or six three-meter-tall Buddha statues appeared where the lava had been.
The Buddha statues shattered instantly, and figures charged out from them, rushing towards Wang Lan with fierce, death-defying momentum.
"Don’t be afraid, everyone!" a disheveled middle-aged man yelled while charging, trying to rally his subordinates. "He’s just a Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior! Using two S-grade skills must have taken a huge toll. His lack of further attacks proves he’s exhausted! Kill him!"
But at his words, even the emotionless deathsworn warriors couldn’t help the corners of their mouths twitching.
How can you lie so blatantly? Look at his calm and composed appearance. Does he look like he’s paid a price? Does he look exhausted? We might be deathsworn, but we’re not stupid, okay? Still, you said one thing right: troops are trained for a thousand days to be used in a single moment. As deathsworn, we still have some professional integrity.
Knowing full well that Wang Lan was overwhelmingly strong, they still charged at him fearlessly.
Star Power once again flickered around Wang Lan, and the charging deathsworn warriors paused slightly.
Wang Lan’s Star Palace opened, and two streaks of light shot out from it. The Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth disassembled and instantly clad Wang Lan, and the Zanpakuto was unsheathed in a flash.
"Hit him with Star Martial Skills—" one of the enemies yelled.
Almost at the same instant, Wang Lan unleashed his own, "Wind Capturing Fire Net—!"
It was a composite Star Martial Skill combining Wind Capturing Net and Flame Sword.
"Damn, what is this? An all-out attack from sea, land, and air?" Liu Yifeng couldn’t help but shout from the car.
"What do you mean by that?" Yang Yang asked.
"First came the Meteor Fire Rain from the skies, then the lava gushing from the earth, and now this frontal, overwhelming fire net!" Liu Yifeng exclaimed. "It’s like missiles, then torpedoes, and finally tanks rolling over everything! A full-on assault from sea, land, and air, leaving no room for escape!"
The few deathsworn at the forefront didn’t even have time to react before the fire net swept over them, instantly slicing them into pieces in mid-air. A few behind them managed to activate their Star Martial Skills to defend, but it was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot; they, along with their skills, were shredded by the fire net.
Only the early-stage Star Sea Stage expert who had been issuing commands was left, dumbfounded, after managing to block the Wind Capturing Fire Net, realizing all the men he’d brought were gone and he was now alone.
Suddenly, a sense of danger flared. He whirled around abruptly. Wang Lan’s figure had appeared beside him, the Shikai of his Sword of Light already slashing down.
The opponent’s body instantly turned pitch-black. Wang Lan’s sword struck viciously, cleaving down from the man’s head to his chest.
"Elementalization?" Wang Lan observed.
"Heh heh heh..." the man chuckled, "The hallmark of the Star Sea Stage is the ability to elementalize. In this state, one is immune to all physical attacks. Unless there’s a countering attribute, one is also immune to all Star Martial Skill attacks..."
Suddenly, his words caught in his throat. He stared at Wang Lan with wide, horrified eyes.
"Your sword..."
"Oh, I forgot to tell you," Wang Lan said calmly. "This sword also has a name—Zanpakuto. As the name suggests, it can cut souls, slaughter spirits. You’re impressive for being able to elementalize, but I wonder, can your soul elementalize too? Die!"
The Sword of Light instantly erupted with myriad golden rays. In a splendid, fleeting moment, the golden light pierced the opponent’s body, riddling it with countless holes.
Wang Lan slowly withdrew his sword. A formidable Star Sea Stage expert had actually met such an ignominious end, killed by the Zanpakuto’s soul-cutting property. Had he not chosen to tank the hit with Elementalization, the Zanpakuto’s blade itself might not have struck him true, and he might have had a fighting chance.
The fallen body gradually reverted to its original form, now pierced like a sieve by the Sword of Light.
While Wang Lan was finishing off the majority of the attackers, Yang Yang found himself in a tough fight. His opponents included two Star Sea Stage leaders and a host of Galaxy Stage deathsworn. Needless to say, the Duanmu Family had spared no expense.
Wang Lan, Sword of Light in hand, rushed to join him. As he approached, the rhythm of the opponents attacking Yang Yang noticeably slowed.
Even though they were engaged in combat with Yang Yang, they had all witnessed Wang Lan’s earlier Demon King-like rampage.
In the span of a few breaths, a Star Sea Stage expert, along with a host of Star Cloud Stage and Galaxy Stage members, were all killed? And he claims he’s at the Star Cloud Stage? Is there any Star Cloud Stage cultivator as terrifyingly powerful as him?
"Radiant Rain—!" Wang Lan shouted.
He leaped high into the air, and countless points of light, like raindrops, poured down.
"Myriad Buddhas Assemble!" the Star Sea Stage opponent suddenly roared, launching an S-grade Star Martial Skill. Countless golden lights burst forth from his body.
To be honest, when I heard the name of this Star Martial Skill, I was genuinely startled,
Wang Lan thought.
I half-expected the legendary Buddha’s Palm to appear!
But in reality, it was a composite Star Martial Skill activated by a combination of Metal and Earth attributes, somewhat similar to Xu Xiangwen’s Pure Yang Skill. However, the Pure Yang Skill was a Yang Attribute Star Martial Skill, while this opponent was using a mix of Metal and Earth attributes to create a giant, thousand-armed Buddha statue.
Countless arms waved out, capable of unleashing terrifying attacks. A thousand palms descended, crashing down with the force of a collapsing sky.
The Star Sea Stage expert thought grimly,
The Patriarch’s orders were direct: whether we retrieve it or destroy it, it absolutely must not fall into the hands of the Tianjian Bureau. Otherwise, the Duanmu Family is finished! We originally planned to retrieve it, but looking at things now, that’s clearly impossible. Our only choice is to risk our lives in one final gamble!
Facing the colossal palms descending from above, the expressions of Yang Yang and the three in the car turned grim. It wasn’t just that this attack seemed fatal; its coverage area was too vast. Even if they could dodge it, the vehicle probably couldn’t.
But in Wang Lan’s eyes, this move was nothing. A disdainful sneer touched his lips. "Trash!"
He brought his hands together, and his Star Power surged.
"Sentient Beings!"
Innumerable vines erupted from Wang Lan’s body, spreading instantaneously.
The Buddha statue’s palms suddenly froze in mid-air, swiftly ensnared by the vines emerging from Wang Lan.
The main reason I called that move trash,
Wang Lan thought,
is this: It’s too slow! How can an S-grade Star Martial Skill be so sluggish? No matter how powerful, if it can’t hit its target, it’s useless!
As the vines multiplied exponentially, in the blink of an eye, the entire area within a three-hundred-meter radius was filled with writhing tendrils.
The true power of Sentient Beings wasn’t merely the entangling vines but their ability to absorb Star Power.
Other Star Martial Skills required a constant supply of Star Power to be maintained. Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills, however, were the opposite. Once successfully activated, as long as they were clashing with an opponent’s Star Martial Skill, they not only didn’t require the Star Martial Warrior to supply Star Power but could also absorb the enemy’s Star Power to sustain themselves.
Deprived of Star Power sustaining it, the Buddha statue seemed to enter a time warp, rapidly weathering and crumbling. An arm of the Buddha, ensnared by vines, visibly cracked and disintegrated into dust.
Gradually, more and more arms, and then the entire Buddha statue, began to crack and collapse.
Suddenly, a figure burst from the center of the crumbling statue, transforming into a streak of light and shooting towards the sky in an attempt to flee.
He’s already within my Sentient Beings,
Wang Lan thought.
If I let you escape now, how could I ever show my face again?
The Star Sea Stage expert, already depleted of Star Power, found his reactions sluggish. Just as he realized he needed to dodge, vines had already wrapped around his ankles. Instantly, countless more vines swarmed him, binding him like mummy wrappings until he resembled a cocoon.
「When the dust settled」
Yang Yang and the three team members in the car finally snapped back to their senses.
"C-Captain? You... you’re too incredible!" one of them stammered. "Just how many S-grade Star Martial Skills do you know? You either don’t act, or when you do, it’s always an S-grade move? Do you have to be so devastating?"
"Captain," Yang Yang reported, approaching several of the fallen deathsworn warriors. "They’ve all committed suicide." He had found that, upon realizing the situation was hopeless, they had all shattered their own hearts, dying instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 324: Is the Duanmu Family Really Behind This?
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 324: Is the Duanmu Family Really Behind This?
"What a bunch of diehards. Let’s go; we’ve got a live one here. You guys can cast seals, right?"
"Sealing is a basic skill for an independent squad."
Wang Lan, controlling the tendrils of Sentient Beings, loosened his grip, revealing a middle-aged man inside. The man’s eyes were rolled back as if he had been ravaged by a dozen wealthy matrons—worn and haggard. Yang Yang and Zhang Xiao swiftly took action, their movements shimmering with Yin and Yang Star Power as they almost simultaneously slapped their palms against the man’s forehead.
Three seconds later, they released him, and a Tai Chi fish mark appeared on the man’s brow.
"Done!"
"Take him away!"
The group of five got into the car, Wang Lan constantly feeling a pair of eyes staring at him.
Wang Lan turned his face and flashed a smile at Bai Xu. "Miss Bai Xu, you’ve been eyeing me the entire way. Can’t you be a little more reserved?"
"Captain, are you from the Yu Family?"
"What’s going through your mind? My surname is Wang. How could I possibly be from the Yu Family?"
"It’s close, though, right? If you add a little stroke, ’Wang’ becomes ’Yu,’ doesn’t it?"
"..."
"No reply, so is that a tacit agreement? Don’t worry, Captain. We’re an elite squad; we understand confidentiality rules and will ensure nothing leaks."
"Give me a break! The way you’re going, people will soon be unable to tell Wang from Yu. My identity is perfectly clear; isn’t your imagination a bit too wild?"
"But you use Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills. Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills are quite rare, and the most famous practitioners are from the Yu Family."
"However rare Wood Attribute might be, could it be rarer than the Medical Attribute? Actually, Wood Attribute Star Martial Warriors aren’t that scarce. It’s just that the only well-known experts are from the Yu Family and the Duanmu Family. Add to that the prominent rise of the Qing Emperor, and many Wood Attribute Star Martial Warriors, seeking to align with the Qing Emperor’s faction, claim to be from the Yu Family externally. This has caused misunderstandings among uninformed spectators."
"Oh... wait, are you implying that I’m one of the uninformed spectators?"
"Please, remove the ’implying’ part. If you can understand it, how can it be an implication?"
"Hahaha..."
Wang Lan and his team departed, and the wailing sirens of police cars arrived once more.
Today was somewhat frustrating for the police, who had spent the whole day trailing the Tianjian Bureau, either cleaning up or covering their rear.
The four arrived at Ming Baiye’s office to report. When Ming Baiye heard Wang Lan discussing the case results, his expression froze for a full five seconds.
Then, after swallowing his tea, he feigned calmness and asked, "It’s only been a day and a half? The case is solved?"
"Yes, it’s solved. This case wasn’t actually that difficult," Wang Lan said modestly.
Behind him, Liu Yifeng’s mouth twitched.
Not difficult? Are you kidding me? I still haven’t figured out how the case was solved! How did you even find Jinghua Mansion? I went to bed last night with no leads, and this morning you woke me up saying there was a major breakthrough? It feels like a piece of history is missing.
"Who’s the murderer? And why did he kill?"
"The killer is Wei Zheng. He was once Xiao Qing’s teammate, responsible for covering their retreat, and miraculously survived a great disaster. He is at the initial stage of the Star Sea realm. His combat style is close-quarters and swift, and he possesses innate abilities to conceal himself and his Star Power. His swordsmanship is also extremely high."
"Wei Zheng? That name sounds familiar... I think he was Bai Xiaoyun’s team leader. If it’s him, then he must be one of Hellfire’s men. Why the killings? Revenge against society?"
"After Xiao Qing was suppressed, the puppet master behind the scenes still attempted to eradicate everyone involved. That’s why an assassin was sent to kill Bai Ji. Although Xiao Qing didn’t reveal the puppet master, he didn’t truly leave himself without a contingency plan. If the puppet master tried to root them out completely, Xiao Qing would play his last card, ensuring mutual destruction. And that last card was in Wei Zheng’s hands. Wei Zheng’s murders were merely a way to vent his anger. In his own words, he hates traitors the most. That’s all."
"Wait, are you saying you have information on Xiao Qing’s puppet master? Is it the Duanmu Family?" Ming Baiye lost his composure, standing up abruptly to ask.
"It should be the Duanmu Family, but I have no concrete evidence. However, we found some Spiritual Engraving Soul Beads in Wei Zheng’s house. They should contain evidence left by Xiao Qing that can pinpoint the puppet master."
"Let’s go. I’ll report to the Chief, and then we can examine the evidence together."
"By the way, Chief, could you help me investigate someone?"
"Who?"
"Duanmu Fanghua, also known as Mu Fanghua. Please be as detailed as possible—include his family, relatives, friends, social network, and so on."
"Why investigate him?"
"I always get an unsettling feeling from him, like he’s a poisonous snake. Plus, he was at Jinghua Mansion today when we arrested Wei Zheng. Although his home is indeed in Jinghua Mansion, we were immediately ambushed by diehards on our way back. How were our movements exposed? I don’t believe the Duanmu Family could know my every move that quickly. If they were that capable, they would have taken control of Modu City by now."
"You suspect... Duanmu Fanghua tipped them off?"
"Yes. I suspect Duanmu Fanghua had also just found Wei Zheng, because I saw him walking below Wei Zheng’s apartment building. His own home is near the north gate. Even if he was returning from grocery shopping, there was no need to bypass the closer north gate and enter through the south gate. But this is just a suspicion; I have no proof."
"Alright! I’ll arrange for someone to look into it as soon as possible."
「An hour later, Chief Cheng Jianlong brought a middle-aged man into the meeting room.」
"This is Special Envoy Yu Ruozhen from the General Staff. This is Ming Baiye, Head of the Action Department of the Modu City Tianjian Bureau. And this is Major Wang Lan from the Action Department."
"Greetings, Special Envoy!"
"Wang Lan, I have long admired your reputation! In the future, I hope you will continue to look after matters concerning Princess Yu Ruoyun." The man politely shook Wang Lan’s hand but was noticeably colder towards Ming Baiye.
"Baiye, tell us, have you made any significant discoveries?"
"Chief, Special Envoy. Yesterday morning, I called Wang Lan in and assigned him the recent bizarre serial murder case. Wang Lan truly lived up to expectations; he identified the killer in just a day and a half. The killer, Wei Zheng, was an accomplice of Xiao Qing. His motive for the murders was to avenge Xiao Qing. In Wei Zheng’s home, we collected a large number of mid-grade Soul Beads. Most importantly, we also found the Spiritual Engraving Soul Beads left by Xiao Qing—items he refused to reveal even up to his death. After classification with the Evidence Department, we confirmed that Xiao Qing’s backer was none other than Duanmu Qingsuang, the patriarch of the Duanmu Family. Xiao Qing left multiple images of his visits to Duanmu Qingsuang and of him taking orders from Duanmu Qingsuang."
"The Duanmu Family? Hmph, I should have thought of it sooner!" Yu Ruozhen exclaimed, his expression displeased. "The Star Martial families of today are becoming increasingly disgraceful. It’s only been seventy years of peace, and many of these families are rotten to the core. Smuggling Space Stones, trafficking Space Stones, smuggling Soul Beads, trafficking Soul Beads... The Duanmu Family, after all, is one of Jade Country’s top Star Martial families, and Duanmu Qingsuang is the head of a clan, yet he shows no regard for his own reputation!"
"Is that all?" Cheng Jianlong asked calmly after listening.
The purpose of targeting Xiao Qing was to stabilize the Soul Bead market, not to pursue the matter to its absolute end. As for who was supporting Xiao Qing from behind... that wasn’t particularly important. If they could be dealt with, then they would be. If not, the matter would be set aside for now.
"Chief, there’s one piece of footage that is very unusual. Wang Lan!"
"Yes!"
Wang Lan took out a Soul Bead and read its contents. Then, extending his left hand, Star Power surged, and a green, shimmering screen made of Star Power materialized before him, displaying an image.
It was a dimly lit secret room. Duanmu Qingsuang sat in the main seat, while Xiao Qing stood before him, head bowed respectfully.
"Xiao Qing, I’ve just received one hundred thousand Soul Beads. Dispose of them as quickly as possible."
"Quickly? How much time do I have?"
"One month!"
"Isn’t that too rushed? The demand for Soul Beads hasn’t been very high lately."
"I don’t want to hear about your difficulties; I just want results. I need a large sum of money now. My clients want a large quantity of Space Stones."
"Dumping one hundred thousand Soul Beads onto the market at once will impact their price significantly, and profits will shrink considerably."
"I need five billion."
"Even if one hundred thousand Soul Beads are sold at the normal market price, that’s only five billion. Dumping so many at once means we’ll have to sacrifice a portion of the profit, and it has to be done within a month. It will be very difficult to reach five billion. At most... at most three billion."
"Xiao Qing, don’t think that just because I’ve entrusted everything to you, I’m unaware of your little schemes. I can build you up, and I can just as easily replace you and build someone else up. Among those one hundred thousand Soul Beads, ten thousand are mid-grade. And you’re telling me you can’t get five billion?"
"Yes, sir. I’ll do my best."
"If there’s nothing else, you may leave. The one hundred thousand Soul Beads will be delivered to you tonight."
"Boss, may I be so bold as to ask the source of these hundred thousand Soul Beads?"
"You can record it under Liu Xiao’s name."
"Understood. Then I shall take my leave."
The footage froze, and the information it contained caused the expressions of everyone present to turn grave.
"The hundred thousand Soul Beads from Star Martial Academy weren’t sold off by Liu Xiao... but by Duanmu Qingsuang. What a cunning old fox! Truly reckless and audacious," Yu Ruozhen exclaimed indignantly.
"That’s not even the most important part," Ming Baiye said, sharing the conclusions he and Wang Lan had discussed. "Before this, the Tianjian Bureau was investigating who assisted Liu Xiao in selling off Star Martial Academy’s hundred thousand Soul Beads. Liu Xiao had already been silenced, and the lead provided by Star Martial Academy pointed to Deputy Headmaster Qi Changling. The Tianjian Bureau rushed to Xishan Province, but Qi Changling had already disappeared. We initially thought the mastermind behind the sale of the Soul Beads was Qi Changling and that he had fled to escape punishment. However, there were still many doubts. Qi Changling didn’t seem like the kind of person who would do such a thing. But with no further leads, the investigation had to be halted. Since these hundred thousand Soul Beads came from Duanmu Qingsuang, he must know who stole them."
"I’m afraid that’s not the most important thing," Yu Ruozhen interjected darkly. "Do you think that big rat hidden in Star Martial Academy would only stoop to petty deeds like selling Soul Beads?"
"Special Envoy, you mean..."
"Chief Cheng, have you forgotten? A major incident occurred at Star Martial Academy. Someone dared to frame Princess Yu Ruoyun. To successfully infiltrate the Nine-layer Pagoda, the rat in Star Martial Academy must be highly placed. Since your Tianjian Bureau has already confirmed that the Duanmu Family once sent diehards to the Nine-layer Pagoda to assassinate Bai Ji, could the person who set the trap in The Death Valley also be him?"
Wang Lan’s eyes glinted with understanding. "It’s highly possible. Even if it wasn’t the same person, there must have been collusion."
"Then what are we waiting for? Arrest Duanmu Qingsuang!" Ming Baiye exclaimed eagerly.
"The Duanmu Family... what a Duanmu Family. After raising a dog for hundreds of years, it finally starts to bite its master. Chief Cheng, for this arrest, let the Tianjian Bureau and the Yu Family act together."

chapters.title: Chapter 325: Raid on the Duanmu Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 325: Raid on the Duanmu Family
