"The Duanmu Family is, after all, one of the top families in Jade Country. The power of the Tianjian Bureau alone may not really be enough to suppress them, and it would naturally be best if the Yu Family could act together with us."
The Modu City branch of the Duanmu Family, a powerful Star Martial clan, also ranked among the top ten in Jade Country. The entire family was full of talented people and boasted five Titled Strongmen.
However, the strength of Duanmu Qingsuang was unknown. According to the information collected by the Tianjian Bureau, Duanmu Qingsuang’s strength could only be at the peak of the Galaxy Stage at most.
When Wang Lan saw this intelligence, a hint of doubt appeared on his face.
"Do you feel that Duanmu Qingsuang, as the patriarch of the Duanmu Family, has a strength that somewhat belies his status?" Ming Baiye asked with a smile, noticing the expression on Wang Lan’s face.
"I have some doubts."
Yu Ruozhen said to Wang Lan with a beaming smile, "No one has stipulated that the patriarch of a family must necessarily be the strongest in the clan."
Ever since meeting Yu Ruozhen last night, Yu Ruozhen had been especially friendly toward Wang Lan. He spoke in a formal tone to Cheng Jianlong, but towards Wang Lan, he acted as though they were old friends.
Perhaps it’s because of my good relationship with Yu Ruoyun,
Wang Lan thought.
Yu Ruozhen continued, "In fact, quite the contrary, many patriarchs of Star Martial families are not particularly strong. Take our Yu Family, for instance. The strongest, of course, is my eldest uncle, but he is not the patriarch.
"The patriarch is my second uncle, who, though not mediocre and also a Titled Strongman, ranks only in the middle tier among the Titled Strongmen. In the Yu Family, there are at least twenty others stronger than him.
"A patriarch needs not only strength but also the ability to manage the entire family. A single policy can lead to the rise and fall of a clan. Hence, even though the patriarch can command the entire family, he is actually the most tired and the hardest working.
"With the slightest lack of attention, he could cause the family inestimable losses. With so many things to worry about, one naturally would not invest too much effort in cultivation. It’s considered good if one’s strength doesn’t decline, to say nothing of a significant increase.
"Even some Star Martial family disciples, if they have high talent and great potential for growth, may be removed from the list of candidates for patriarch. The families need them to be stronger to stabilize the family’s status."
Wang Lan remarked, "Is that so? It seems I misunderstood."
Yu Ruozhen then explained, "Power and family have a fundamental significance. If it’s about power, the banner must be the strongest, as it’s the symbol of power. Only with a banner is there cohesion.
"But a family itself is connected by bloodlines, naturally possessing cohesion, and what a patriarch needs even more is the ability to run the family. It’s just unfortunate that the Duanmu Family chose Duanmu Qingsuang, this miscreant.
"The Duanmu Family secretly summoned back their five Titled Strongmen three days ago. They think they have eluded detection, heh heh heh... In reality, they have always been under our surveillance."
"Five Titled Strongmen..." Cheng Jianlong heaved a long sigh. "There are only a little over three hundred Titled Strongmen in Jade Country; what a tremendous loss this is!"
Yu Ruozhen assured Chief Cheng, "Rest assured, if they are willing to turn from darkness to light, we are not seeking their utter annihilation. The eldest uncle will personally take action tonight."
The street lamps had just started to light up; a pale yellow moon had already quietly risen into the sky. The sun had only just set in the west.
Wang Lan, along with his four squad members—Yang Yang and three others—sat in a coffee shop on a bustling street. Yang Yang and these three junior members, in particular, seemed somewhat excited.
Normally, aside from Yang Yang, the other three wouldn’t be qualified to participate in this mission. The opposition was the Duanmu Family, with over fifty Galaxy Stage masters. No one with less than Galaxy Stage cultivation would even think of participating in an operation against such a formidable force.
This operation was a joint operation between the Tianjian Bureau of Modu City and the Yu Family. The Yu Family dispatched thirty Galaxy Stage masters and five Titled Strongmen. On the side of the Tianjian Bureau, there were twelve Galaxy Stage fighters plus Cheng Jianlong, a Titled Strongman.
As for the other personnel of the Tianjian Bureau, they were merely stationed at various junctions to prevent any Duanmu Family members from slipping away unnoticed.
At first glance, the balance of power did not seem optimistic, and the Duanmu Family might even appear to be slightly stronger. But this operation had the backing of the Qing Emperor, who alone could resolve the entire Duanmu Family issue. Otherwise, how could the Yu Family only send thirty Galaxy Stage experts?
"You three, don’t get too excited. Although we’ve been assigned to the action team, let me remind you not to blindly charge forward once the action starts. That’s the Duanmu Family, not a Different Dimensional Space.
"The Duanmu Family is an established Star Martial clan with hundreds of years of heritage, and their strength is unfathomable. We’re just here to make a token appearance, capture some lesser targets, and gain some experience. Don’t foolishly take on tough challenges; otherwise, I’ll have to apply for a hero’s medal for you," Yang Yang’s deep voice suddenly interjected.
"Vice-captain, aren’t you underestimating us? We are, after all, an elite squad," one of them protested.
"Elite squad, true, but the Duanmu clan is a behemoth. Don’t be senseless," Yang Yang cautioned.
"Got it, got it. We’ll just follow you two and pick up what’s left over."
"The Duanmu Family must have noticed something’s off by now; the action is about to start," Wang Lan suddenly said, putting away his phone.
About ten action teams, entirely composed of Galaxy Stage members, coordinated through mobile phones and converged from all directions towards the Duanmu Family’s stronghold. Each independent team had a dedicated battlefield communicator.
Wang Lan and Yang Yang each wore an earpiece.
"Attention, Team Twelve, please proceed to Coordinate C within five minutes and launch an attack in ten minutes. Your task is to secure the family members in the shelter located in Building C’s underground parking lot as quickly as possible. Team Seven will coordinate with you during the operation," came the command.
"Understood!"
Wang Lan stood up and began to move. The five-person squad whooshed out of the cafe and, like fish swimming through water, they weaved through the bustling streets. In the blink of an eye, they crossed two streets and arrived on the outskirts of the Duanmu Family’s compound.
Although the Duanmu Family’s location was very serene, it was less than a kilometer away from the bustling downtown area. They truly achieved the feat of "building their abode amid the hustle and bustle without the noise of passing carriages and horses."
At this moment, a blue light screen rose above the walls of the Duanmu Family compound—an electromagnetic barrier.
Wang Lan’s own electromagnetic barrier used for cultivation was equipment that made Jiang Xinyu and the others green with envy. Yet, the Duanmu Family had an electromagnetic barrier that enveloped their entire family residence.
The Duanmu Family compound itself was a large residential complex. If viewed from the sky, it wouldn’t look any different from other high-end neighborhoods.
The only difference was that its layout resembled that of a Taiji and Bagua formation.
The outer perimeter consisted of residential buildings, each six stories tall, housing Star Martial Warriors affiliated with the Duanmu Family and their families. In the middle were branches of the Duanmu Family and the leaders of the Duanmu Family’s forces, living in duplex mansions.
Located at the innermost ring were the direct descendants of the Duanmu Family, as well as the upper echelons of the Duanmu clan’s power. At the very center of the complex was a large training ground bearing the pattern of a Taiji symbol.
The complex had clinics, supermarkets, shopping centers, and kindergartens, with facilities so complete it was like a small town within the city. The total population living in the complex was around seven thousand people, but four to five thousand of them were family members.
But don’t underestimate these family members. The wives of Star Martial Warriors were typically Star Martial Warriors themselves; the only ones truly harmless were the children. Even the elderly could be seasoned Star Martial Warriors.
When a signal rocket burst through the sky, the operation began.
Wang Lan instantly opened his Star Palace, and the Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth and Zanpakuto flew out. Normally, Wang Lan would seldom wear the Saint Cloth in advance, but this time was different, as he was facing the Duanmu Family.
Although the Saint Cloth covered only fifty percent of his body, in principle, it offered one hundred percent coverage. Even areas not directly covered by the Saint Cloth would have any damage they received transferred to the cloth itself.
Unless the defense of the Saint Cloth was directly breached, the damage Wang Lan received would be minimal. Coupled with his healing ability, the combination might not realistically make him all-conquering, but ensuring his survival wouldn’t be difficult.
As Wang Lan and his squad rushed out, four black-clad Star Martial Warriors suddenly charged out from one side. Each had a ribbon tied around their forehead, and on the ribbon was the design of a pair of hooked jades.
The four moved twice as fast as Wang Lan’s team. In a blink, Star Power surged and thunder roared forth, instantly creating a gap in the electromagnetic barrier that rose above the Duanmu Family’s walls.
The figures of the four, like ghosts, passed through the breach, which was quickly closing under the relentless force of the electromagnetic energy.
"Quick—" Wang Lan roared, raising his finger sharply. Electromagnetic thunder unfolded into wings at his wrist, and three lightning arrows, in a triangular formation, struck the slowly closing electromagnetic void.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The electromagnetic barrier was once again torn open, and the five-person team shot through it like streaks of light.
"There are intruders here!" a shout of alarm rang out, and dozens of figures moved swiftly. Just as Wang Lan and his team landed, over twenty Star Martial Warriors dressed in the Duanmu Family’s uniform rushed out from the green belt in the distance.
"Who dares invade the Duanmu Family?"
"Hmm? Hooked jade badges? Are you... from the Yu Family? What is the Yu Family trying to do?"
"What are we trying to do? The Duanmu Family attempted to assassinate Princess Yu Ruoyun, and now the truth has come to light. Those with sense will surrender; we will deal leniently with unrelated parties."
"Nonsense!"
"Tianjian Bureau’s Action Department! By order, we are arresting the key members of the Duanmu Family. Unrelated individuals should lay down their weapons and surrender; you will be released after screening. You are merely affiliated with the Duanmu Family; is it worth dying for them?" Wang Lan took out his credentials and shouted.
"Don’t listen to his nonsense! The Tianjian Bureau is a spy agency; today’s invasion, in collaboration with the Yu Family, is an act of aggression! Since we are affiliated with the Duanmu Family, our interests are closely linked. If the Duanmu Family falls, do we have any hope of rising again?"
"That’s right! The Infinite Commander is here! Hold them back!"
Amidst the clamor, both sides assumed battle formations. Wang Lan heaved a sigh, realizing that his previous words had been in vain.
"Take action!" Suddenly, the captain of the Yu Family team shouted, and Wang Lan’s team instantly responded.
The Duanmu Family’s Star Martial Warriors also quickly launched their attacks. The melee was about to erupt.
Phantom Tracer activated, and Wang Lan’s figure instantly appeared next to one of the opponent’s Galaxy Stage experts. The Zanpakuto turned into a stream of light and slashed down.
"Clay Armor!"
The opponent knew they could not parry in time and instantly activated an Earth Attribute Star Martial Skill. A torrent of clay surged up, forming a layer of mud on their body. In an instant, the soft clay hardened into solid concrete, successfully blocking the Zanpakuto’s attack at the last second.

chapters.title: Chapter 326
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: 326
CRACK—
A sound like a jammed mechanism rang out as the Zanpakuto was firmly lodged in the opponent’s defensive armor. But the moment the sound arose, a clap of thunder echoed. The Zanpakuto was instantly enveloped in lightning, slicing into the opponent’s body amidst the thunder.
HISS—
A slash accompanied by lightning streaked by; the blade sliced across the opponent’s shoulder, and, in an instant, Wang Lan brushed past him.
"HISS—" Fresh blood instantly burst from the shoulder of the Galaxy Stage Star Martial Warrior.
Such an injury would normally be insignificant to a Galaxy Stage Star Martial Warrior, as long as it didn’t penetrate deep into their vital organs. What was a three-centimeter-deep wound to the shoulder?
But Wang Lan’s strike was peculiar; it left half the body paralyzed.
The man’s expression changed drastically. "Not good!" he exclaimed, then warned, "Be careful of his blade! It has Star Martial Toxins—"
Amidst the warning, Wang Lan had already found his next target.
"Water Burst—" The opponent’s Star Power surged, and his chest swelled suddenly; in an instant, a water bullet furiously shot toward Wang Lan.
"Unleash, Sword of Light—"
In a split second, the Breaking Swords transformed into a long sword made of converging golden light, and it thrust toward the opponent in the nick of time.
HISS—
The water stream parted around the sword, but the powerful impact made it difficult for Wang Lan to advance even an inch.
Seeing Wang Lan’s figure halted, a hint of a smile appeared on the opponent’s face. However, that expression changed dramatically in a flash.
A beam of golden light had somehow penetrated his shoulder.
Under such powerful impact, even a large truck could be flipped over.
How could Wang Lan’s sword have gone upstream to pierce his shoulder?
It was simply... incomprehensible.
An ordinary sword naturally couldn’t go upstream. But Wang Lan wielded the Sword of Light, possessing the properties of both sword and light. Water cannot block the penetration of light. So... the late-Galaxy Stage expert felt his strength drain away as his body grew numb.
"Captain—"
Taking down two men took less than two seconds. Although he struck both of them, neither suffered substantial harm; their bodies simply became numb. Wang Lan would not kill unless it was necessary.
While they belonged to the Duanmu Family’s camp, it didn’t necessarily mean they were all guilty. Especially those at the lower levels who were simply following orders.
Besides, such ignominious crimes wouldn’t be known to the underlings. Within the entire Duanmu Family, only a few were truly guilty.
Procedurally, the Tianjian Bureau only needed to arrest Duanmu Qingsuang and several high-ranking members of the Duanmu Family. With the Yu Family and the Tianjian Bureau joining forces, the Duanmu Family wouldn’t dare to resist.
But... with undercurrents swirling, even though Yu Ruoyun was unharmed, she had indeed been the target of an assassination attempt. The mere fact that the attempt occurred was enough to violently agitate the public.
When emotions ran high, people were easily incited, so they needed an outlet. Conveniently, the Duanmu Family was a perfect ’chicken’ to make an example of.
Furthermore, the best strategy in the current situation was to cut the Gordian knot. The Yu Family and the Tianjian Bureau had no time to engage in a drawn-out dispute with the Duanmu Family, and they couldn’t rest easy with a poisonous snake that might bite at any moment left unattended.
As for any inquiries from the outside world about why the Yu Family and the Tianjian Bureau were taking such drastic action against the Duanmu Family?
The answer would be: it was related to the assassination attempt on Princess Yu.
What exactly was the relation?
People could fill in the gaps with their imagination.
That’s why, if they were to act, they had to go all out against the Duanmu Family. Since the Duanmu Family wasn’t being wrongly accused, they had no grounds to feel aggrieved.
Although anyone who dared to resist upon knowing that the Tianjian Bureau had come knocking could be executed without mercy, Wang Lan still had a bit of kindness in his heart and deemed it unnecessary to engage in a massacre.
Of course, if his own safety was threatened, he would not hesitate to deliver a lethal blow when necessary.
In total, there were just over twenty of the Duanmu Family’s subordinates. Among them were five at the Star Sea Stage and three at the Galaxy Stage. With Wang Lan—who appeared to be at the Star Cloud Stage but unleashed numerous S-rank Star Martial Skills as if they cost nothing—the battle was resolved in less than a minute.
BOOM—
Suddenly, a loud noise erupted, and from within the Duanmu Family residence, a colossal two-headed beast burst forth. The beast stood forty meters tall, as large as a building.
"Damn it, the Duanmu Family actually released a Contracted Beast!" a Star Martial Warrior from the Yu Family cursed.
"What’s a Contracted Beast?"
"It’s a subdued Exotic Beast, bound by a soul contract to serve as its master’s fighting force. It’s normally kept in a Different Dimensional Space and summoned for battle. The Duanmu Family’s Double-headed Shark is extremely powerful, at least on par with a Titled Strongman."
Seeing Wang Lan’s squad performing so well, the Yu Family warrior explained a bit more.
"We’ll go support the other side. Leave the task here to you. Make sure to find the women and children of the Duanmu Family and get them out safely."
"Yes!"
Breaching the Duanmu Family stronghold naturally involved capturing prisoners. The women and children of the Duanmu Family were of utmost importance; they had to be protected at all costs. If any of them died during the operation, their actions would lose all claim to justice. That was the bottom line.
The Duanmu Family, when cornered, was capable of anything. And this was not the first time something like this had happened.
It had almost become a pattern: when raiding a crime syndicate’s den, the heartless criminals would take their own children and relatives hostage to negotiate with Law Enforcers.
At such moments, they were not husbands, sons, or fathers. They were nothing but raw, naked demons.
They killed their own kin with no more hesitation than they would a mortal enemy. As long as they could escape legal sanction, they would do anything.
After splitting from the Yu Family’s squad, Wang Lan immediately pressed forward. The battle where the Contracted Beast had appeared seemed to have reached a stalemate. Many people were rushing towards that area, from which horrific explosions and powerful Star Energy Fluctuations surged wildly.
"Go!" Wang Lan commanded, and the five-man squad successfully advanced a hundred meters.
"Stop, kill!"
Another dozen or so Star Martial Warriors appeared before them. Their average strength was Star Cloud Stage, with three or four among them at the Galaxy Stage. Such power was mere fodder for Wang Lan’s squad.
Wang Lan’s form transformed into a streak of light. A Galaxy Stage opponent, sensing Wang Lan’s Star Energy Fluctuation level, sneered contemptuously.
A mere Star Cloud Stage cultivator dares to charge so brazenly?
He clearly doesn’t know how the word ’death’ is written!
Just as this thought arose, in an instant, Wang Lan’s figure vanished from sight.
The Galaxy Stage master was still in shock when suddenly he felt a chill on his back. Wang Lan had appeared behind him at some point, and the Sword of Light gently swept across his back.
The Zanpakuto’s attack struck both body and soul. So, even if the wound wasn’t severe or seemed negligible in combat, the spiritual paralysis would stiffen his body, rendering him incapable of resistance.
How to describe the intercepting team rushing towards them? They were like instant coffee. Upon colliding with the overwhelming momentum of Wang Lan’s five-man squad, *whoosh*—they vanished.
They headed downstairs. Reaching the entrance to the underground parking lot, the five stormed in, their momentum irresistible. Although dozens attempted to intercept them, these Galaxy Stage and Star Cloud Stage individuals were no match for Wang Lan’s elite squad.
The Duanmu Family’s main forces had all gone to the central battlefield, making the family seem less formidable than imagined. The five-man squad advanced, slaying gods and Buddhas who dared to stand in their way.
In less than ten minutes, the five reached the second basement level of the underground garage, where a thick iron door was already closed. But such a barrier could only stop ordinary people; it couldn’t even hinder a Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warrior.
Wang Lan struck with his sword, carving a three-meter diameter circle on the iron door. He then kicked the section open, and the five strode unimpeded into the garage.
What met their eyes were countless pairs of terrified eyes. Many women and elderly people clutched children, staring at them in horror. This scene left three of Wang Lan’s men momentarily at a loss.
We clearly represent justice... so why... why do they look at us as if we’re murderous demons?
"We are special operatives from the Modu City Tianjian Bureau’s Action Department," Wang Lan announced. "We are tasked with protecting and relocating the ordinary people, the dependents of Star Martial Warriors, and the children of the Duanmu Family. Your situation is perilous, so please cooperate with us.
If you comply, we will not harm a single one of you. Remember, we represent the state, not murderous bandits or executioners."
The children might not understand, but the adults should.
Wang Lan then said, his voice like a soothing breeze reaching everyone’s ears, "Now, everyone form a line and follow me."
"Officer!" Suddenly, a young girl stood out and shouted, "I want to know exactly what crime the Duanmu Family has committed that warrants such a massive operation for their arrest?"
"The Duanmu Family has violated very serious laws, and the evidence is irrefutable," Wang Lan replied. "Moreover, many individuals participated in these crimes; it’s possible that not everyone among you is entirely innocent. But rest assured, we only convict based on solid evidence. If you have done nothing illegal or disorderly, you have nothing to worry about."
In the end, the girl didn’t get to hear from Wang Lan exactly what the Duanmu Family had done. But she didn’t press further; they knew the working style of the Tianjian Bureau, which had very strict confidentiality protocols.
Although many children were crying, the adults were relatively cooperative. Besides, the Duanmu Family’s order for them to stay in the underground shelter, rather than evacuate the dangerous family residence, had already given them a bad premonition.
Perhaps in the end, the Duanmu Family would use them as hostages. After all, such incidents were not uncommon, and women married to Star Martial Warriors had heard plenty of such stories.
The large group of nearly five hundred people streamed out of the underground garage, heading towards a sealed entrance not far away. Wang Lan led the way with Yang Yang at the rear, while Liu Yifeng and his two companions kept watch in the middle.
Having walked only about two hundred meters, Wang Lan suddenly stopped in his tracks. Dozens of people suddenly emerged from the surrounding flower beds. Without uttering a word, they raised their firearms and began shooting at the crowd.
"Defense—" Wang Lan bellowed. Zhang Xiao and Bai Xu quickly took action.
"Vacuum Pressure—"
"Earth Flow Bi."
BOOM—
A violent series of explosions erupted. The children, shielded in the center, immediately burst into tears again. The women holding them had complex expressions on their faces.
Many young girls had tears in their eyes.
They didn’t recognize the people who had suddenly appeared, but they had to be from the Duanmu Family. But what were they doing? They opened fire without a single word!
Most of these women were associated with the Duanmu Family. But among them, how many were truly ordinary, non-cultivating individuals? Probably less than one in ten.
In the world of Star Martial Warriors, virtually all who married and had children were Star Martial Warriors themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 Sentient Beings
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 327 Sentient Beings
"Why... why is the family...?" a woman suddenly cried, covering her face. "What did we do wrong? Why is the family treating us like this?"
"What else can they do? Kill us to force the Tianjian Bureau to stop. Then, they’ll use public opinion to counter-accuse us!"
"But we’re also members of the Duanmu Family—"
Indeed, all those affiliated with the Duanmu Family were Star Martial Warriors, and the wives Star Martial Warriors married were also Star Martial Warriors. However, there were still some in the Duanmu Family who were unable to awaken their Star Martial Warrior talent.
Although this group lacked Star Martial Warrior talent and were ordinary people, the blood of the Duanmu Family still flowed in their veins. They never imagined their family could be so heartless as to use their lives to force the Tianjian Bureau to compromise.
"Captain, we can’t hold on—" Bai Xu called out, her face pale.
"We have to hold on, even if we can’t!" Wang Lan was currently using Sentient Beings, but Sentient Beings was not primarily a defensive Star Martial Skill. It could defend for a moment, but it couldn’t withstand the bombardment of dozens of people.
Because the five of them had to protect five hundred people, their mobility was severely restricted. The range of Sentient Beings was three hundred meters, but when it had to envelop five hundred people, the outer wall’s strength was insufficient.
What was even more infuriating was that the Duanmu Family was using firearms. This was not a Different Dimensional Space; firearms could be used here. In the outside world, the lethality of firearms was no less than that of Star Martial Skills, especially hand grenades, which were simple to make and deadly.
Sentient Beings could not absorb Star Power to replenish itself, so it naturally required Wang Lan’s Star Power to maintain. A Star Martial Skill with a three-hundred-meter range consumed a terrifying amount of Star Power. If Wang Lan hadn’t secretly hoarded a dozen or so medium-quality Soul Beads, they would probably be in danger by now.
"Sisters, they want to kill us! We can’t just stand here and let them! Our men fought to the death for the Duanmu Family; we can’t let them slaughter us like disposable tools! Defensive Star Martial Warriors, gather on the perimeter! We need to save ourselves!" Amid the crowd, a voice rang out like a shot of adrenaline.
Suddenly, Star Power surged within the protected group, and dozens of defensive Star Martial Warriors deployed their defensive Star Martial Skills. Although their Star Martial levels were not high, they managed to relieve considerable pressure for Wang Lan and the others.
Damn it, do they think they’re the only ones with grenades?
In a lull, Wang Lan suddenly remembered he had a few S-grade Soul Bead grenades lying in his space equipment.
He had thought he would never need to use them. Now was the perfect time, since maintaining the Sentient Beings defense prevented him from using other Star Martial Skills.
He took out a Wind Capturing Net Soul Bead grenade and controlled the vines to WHIP it into the enemy’s position—the very spot from which most grenades had been thrown and the fiercest firepower launched.
THUMP—
A muffled sound, as a medium-quality Soul Bead rolled into the middle of the crowd.
The frenzied gunmen merely glanced down before indifferently turning their heads away.
Throwing a medium-quality Soul Bead over here? Are you trying to bribe us? Hah... As fanatics trained by the Duanmu Family, we have professional integrity. You think a mere medium-quality Soul Bead will tempt us to betray it?
Suddenly, the medium-quality Soul Bead pulsed with waves of Star Energy Fluctuation.
In an instant, terrifying wind blades erupted from the Soul Bead, rapidly expanding to a fifty-meter radius and forming a deadly cutting network.
Within that fifty-meter radius, forty fanatics were sliced into pieces before they even realized what had happened, utterly dead.
The gunfire ceased abruptly. Not only at the site overwhelmed by the wind blades but even at the smaller encampments nearby, the fanatics were stunned by the scene, their minds blank.
Who am I? Where am I? What should I do?
Suddenly, a streak of light flickered.
A shower of light spread out like a heavenly canopy.
They would never need to ponder the answers to those bewildered questions.
Wang Lan’s sword had severed their necks.
Wang Lan showed no mercy to trash who would harm ordinary people, even their own kin. With this group of fanatics slain, the crisis was finally averted.
The remaining two hundred meters passed without incident. Wang Lan blasted through the north gate’s electromagnetic defense net, successfully leading the five hundred women and children out. Members of the Tianjian Bureau and police commissioners were waiting outside to receive them. They would be taken to the Tianjian Bureau for isolation and investigation.
"Liaison, Squad Twelve has completed the mission. Requesting further instructions."
"Captain Wang, the Duanmu Family is furiously hunting down women and children! Squad Seven requests backup! Coordinates at..."
After receiving the orders, Wang Lan quickly led his squad to their aid.
The Duanmu Family’s main combat forces and affiliates were engaged on the central battlefield, fighting desperately against the Tianjian Bureau and Yu Family experts a kilometer away. Yet, their own relatives were being ruthlessly hunted by Duanmu Family fanatics in the rear.
The scene was not just ironic to describe, but even to contemplate.
The very people you’ve sworn your lives to are killing your wives and children, while those fighting against you are desperately trying to save your families.
But such matters couldn’t be explained in the heat of battle. Even if you told someone, they wouldn’t believe it. The whole truth could only be revealed after the fighting ended.
When they arrived at Squad Seven’s location, the squad was struggling to move while maintaining a barrier. The enemy was entirely equipped with modern firearms, shooting from distances greater than five hundred meters.
The effective range of Star Martial Skills was generally only tens of meters, not even a hundred. Even for Star Sea Stage experts, their range wouldn’t exceed two hundred meters.
Under normal circumstances, modern firearms wouldn’t even graze a Star Sea Stage practitioner. But to protect these several hundred ordinary people, children, or other vulnerable individuals, they had no choice but to deploy defensive barriers and endure the hail of bullets.
Frustrating? It was incredibly frustrating. These five Star Sea Stage warriors from the Yu Family had never fought such a suffocating battle in their lives. But what could frustration achieve? They could only endure.
Suddenly, the dense gunfire in the distance paused.
"Our reinforcements have arrived," a woman with an impassive expression stated calmly.
"So soon?" Although he voiced doubt, he knew in his heart it was true. The gunfire had stopped, extinguished as if by water, snuffed out in an instant. The few sporadic shots that followed also fell silent after a few rounds.
"Captain, I’ve dealt with my side."
"This side is clear too. Let’s move to the next location."
The Duanmu Family had placed their thousands of non-combatants in different locations, making it convenient to use them as hostages if necessary. This tactic was understood by the Duanmu Family, as well as by the Tianjian Bureau and the Yu Family.
Rather than saying the battle at the front was fiercely contested, it was more accurate to say that our warriors were buying time for the innocents in the rear to retreat. The Duanmu Family undoubtedly understood this as well, which was why they spared no effort in dispatching their death squads to obstruct and even slaughter.
In just half an hour, Wang Lan had reinforced several battlefronts, but not every mission was completed successfully.
Two defensive positions had faltered, resulting in more than a hundred people dying under machine-gun fire. In terms of reaping lives, machine guns possessed greater killing power than Star Martial Warriors. Firing thirty bullets a second, dozens of machine guns firing simultaneously could slaughter hundreds in mere seconds.
Ultimately, out of five thousand people, four thousand six hundred were successfully evacuated; about four to five hundred died under gunfire. These victims were then used by the Duanmu Family as tools to incite their affiliated Star Martial Warriors into a "perish together" mentality.
"Tianjian Bureau! You don’t even spare unarmed old folk, women, and children! Everyone, look! The Tianjian Bureau wants to exterminate us! We’ll fight them to the death!"
Projected in the sky were images of bodies lying in pools of blood. Blood flowed like rivers. This sight instantly turned the eyes of the Duanmu Family’s wavering affiliated Star Martial Warriors bloodshot with rage.
"Nonsense! You killed them yourselves!"
"Hehehe... You bastards! After killing people, you even want to damn our souls so we never find peace! The leaders we placed in the shelters are of our Duanmu Family’s direct bloodline! You all know this! Would we kill our own people? Would we strike down our own brothers and sisters? Warriors of the Duanmu Family, kill! Killing one breaks even, killing two is pure profit!"
A host of Galaxy Stage and Star Cloud Stage warriors from the Duanmu Family launched a frenzied, suicidal counterassault against the Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warriors from the Yu Family and the Tianjian Bureau. In an instant, Star Power swept through heaven and earth like a colossal tsunami.
"KILL—!"
"We’ve already been merciful enough. Since you’re so insensible, then we have no choice but to..." a Star Sea Stage warrior from the Yu Family declared coldly.
"No need to hold back! Kill!"
"Director!" Wang Lan and Yang Yang appeared by Cheng Jianlong’s side, surrounded by the heads of various Tianjian Bureau departments.
"Why are you here? Your task was to escort the innocents to safety."
"The mission is complete."
"Complete, huh... Even so, you shouldn’t have come. Never mind. Just be careful and protect yourself if anything happens. It seems the worst-case scenario has indeed occurred."
With those words, Cheng Jianlong led a group of Tianjian Bureau experts toward the opposing battlefield.
On the battlefield, the ratio of top-tier experts was roughly equal; the Tianjian Bureau’s side even had an additional Titled Strongman.
What did "Titled Strongman" signify? Although also at the Star Sea Stage, a Titled Strongman possessed the power to independently alter a battle’s outcome and could single-handedly eliminate a squad of Star Sea Stage experts.
But the Duanmu Family’s release of their Contracted Beasts threw the balance of high-end combat power into uncertainty once more.
One-on-one, a Star Sea Stage Exotic Beast was definitely no match for a Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warrior. It was like a sports car racing a large truck.
No matter how much stronger or more powerful the truck is, it’s not as light or agile as the sports car, which can easily leave it behind.
However, on a chaotic battlefield like this, the weaknesses of the Exotic Beasts were compensated for by expert Star Martial Warriors, while their advantages could be maximized.
Exotic Beasts naturally held an advantage in Star Power, and the damage output of a Star Sea Stage Exotic Beast was terrifying. They could unleash devastating Star Martial Skills—attacks that might be ultimate moves for Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warriors were merely A-rank abilities for these beasts.
As the Exotic Beasts unleashed their fury, the Tianjian Bureau’s side had to simultaneously dodge enemy Star Martial Warrior attacks while fending off the terrifying assaults of the beasts.
The battlefield erupted. Watching the colossal, rampaging Exotic Beasts, Wang Lan suddenly had an idea.
"Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious—activate!"
Instantly, a Phoenix Tail Flower insignia appeared on Wang Lan’s brow, and simultaneously, two cute little horns sprouted from his forehead.
A dragon’s roar echoed. In that instant, Wang Lan’s figure materialized before an Exotic Beast.
"Sentient Beings—!"

chapters.title: Chapter 328 The Collapse of the Duanmu Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 328 The Collapse of the Duanmu Family
In his Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious form, Wang Lan’s strength instantly soared to the early stage of the Star Sea realm. When he unleashed Sentient Beings, its tendrils spread with overwhelming speed and power.
In almost the span of a breath, countless vines entangled the massive Exotic Beast like a spiderweb, quickly forming a forest made entirely of vines.
At this moment, the people of the Duanmu Family were already like frightened birds. Fear made them frantic, filled with violence and aggression, but the underlying cause was still fear.
The activation of Wang Lan’s Sentient Beings was like toppling a domino. Fear spread in an instant.
"The Qing Emperor has come?"
"The Qing Emperor! We’re done for... done for... That’s the Qing Emperor..."
"The Qing Emperor has arrived, we’re finished..."
"We’re dead. I heard the Qing Emperor has always been in Modu City..."
"He’s not the Qing Emperor, you fools! This is Sentient Beings, not the Descent of the Tree Realm!"
Noisy voices kept rising; even many Star Sea realm experts exposed flaws in their panic and were killed by the Yu Family’s masters with a single move.
Against monstrous beasts of terrifying size and endless Star Power, only Star Martial Skills of a similar scale could contend with them. Wood Attribute Star Martial Skills naturally countered giant Exotic Beasts, so when Sentient Beings was successfully deployed and entwined the beast, the effect was immediate and striking.
The Exotic Beast howled towards the heavens, struggling to break free from the entanglement of Sentient Beings. But the more it struggled, the more the vines multiplied, growing wildly with the absorption of Star Power. Each vine moved as flexibly as Wang Lan’s fingers, and in his senses, he felt as if he had become the forest of vines itself.
BOOM—
Enraged, the Exotic Beast spouted a breath of flame that instantly shattered the vines entangling it, ferociously advancing into the distance. However, visibly to the naked eye, the massive fireball shrank drastically during its flight, disappearing after traveling less than two hundred meters.
Yet the vines continued to grow crazily, in the blink of an eye, subduing the Exotic Beast once again. No matter how it struggled, for every vine it broke, countless more took its place.
Star Power was continuously drained, and the beast, which had never experienced exhaustion, gradually began to feel fatigued. At this moment, the battling Duanmu Family side descended into chaos.
The battle was already not in their favor, and they were waiting—waiting for the Duanmu Family’s public relations to step in, waiting for that glimmer of hope.
As the head of a top Star Martial Aristocratic family, Lord Duanmu naturally had a set of emergency measures in place. All he had to do was muddy the waters, create a national stir, manipulate public opinion to put pressure on the state, and get the Tianjian Bureau and the Yu Family to stop their actions.
All it would take was one day of respite for the Duanmu Family, and they would find a way to shift from a defensive to an offensive position.
The Tianjian Bureau and the Yu Family needed to reach a quick, decisive conclusion before an order from above was issued. The Duanmu Family, on the other hand, needed to delay as much as possible and then position themselves as the weaker party to gain sympathy from the whole country and perhaps the world.
In today’s era, exterminating a family, sweeping a Star Martial Aristocratic family in one fell swoop, was not as simple as one might imagine.
In the era of empires, an imperial decree was all it took to lead to the extermination of a family! But in today’s society, battles are fought on different dimensions, and strategies are far more complex and elusive.
The Duanmu Family’s weapon for delaying the battle was this Exotic Beast with unlimited firepower. With it present, even if the combined strength of the Tianjian Bureau and the Yu Family slightly surpassed the Duanmu Family’s, they were not daunted.
But with the Exotic Beast restrained, the precarious balance they were barely maintaining would be instantly shattered. The total assault by the Tianjian Bureau and the Yu Family began.
"Damn it, die—"
A Titled Strongman from the Duanmu Family suddenly pushed Cheng Jianlong back with a move. His figure flashed, and he dived instantly into Wang Lan’s Sentient Beings.
"Not good! Wang Lan, be careful—"
There was no need for Cheng Jianlong to remind him. Wang Lan was aware the moment the opponent appeared within Sentient Beings.
He controlled the vines to block quickly, but the opponent was a Titled Strongman. The vines were too slow to catch up. Even with a blockading tactic, the opponent could break through in an instant.
Almost in the blink of an eye, the opponent charged in front of Wang Lan.
"Die—"
A punch with earth-shaking might. Before the fist arrived, terrifying magma surged from the ground around Wang Lan. A Titled Strongman, with every move, could provoke Star Power collisions and create area-of-effect damage. Without time to think, Wang Lan summoned all his Star Power and threw a punch toward the Titled Strongman.
"Dragon Emperor Form?" The opponent saw the Dragon Horn on Wang Lan’s forehead and paused for a moment.
But it was only a brief pause, and the attack did not slow down as it hammered down.
As long as Wang Lan was not the Qing Emperor, anything else was manageable.
"Canglan—"
Wang Lan fused the power of Inch Strength with Star Power, and combined with the terrifying strength of the Dragon Emperor Form, he unleashed the most powerful punch in his history.
BOOM—
The fists collided, and a terrifying shockwave spread out. The surrounding vines seemed to be shredded by spatial distortions, rapidly disappearing. Around the two fighters, a hundred-meter vacuum was blasted open in an instant.
BOOM—
Wang Lan’s body was thrown backward, a fierce jet of blood spurting from his mouth.
Even with the combat power of a Star Sea realm expert, against a Titled Strongman, the gap was significant.
As he was flung backward, Song of Life activated automatically, swiftly healing his injuries. Wang Lan had just landed when the Titled Strongman leaped forward, a punch carrying the might of thunder hurtling towards him.
Suddenly, Wang Lan felt a figure appear behind him. Before he had time to look back, a familiar voice rang in his ear.
"Kid, not bad at all..."
This old rascal had finally arrived.
BOOM—
The Titled Strongman’s punch descended, yet it froze less than a foot from Yu Qing’s face. Within the distortion of the punch’s force, a barrier resembling an electromagnetic shield blocked the earth-shattering blow.
Even the figure of the Qing Emperor showed not the slightest tremor.
"This is..." Wang Lan’s pupils contracted sharply. The barrier seemed somewhat familiar.
"You are..." The face of the Titled Strongman opposite changed dramatically. "Qing Emperor?"
BOOM—
A violent explosion sounded, and before the Titled Strongman could even react to what had happened, his figure was blown away in an instant.
The Qing Emperor took a slow step forward, yet his figure had already traversed a hundred meters.
Watching the departing figure of the Qing Emperor, Wang Lan had an incredibly surreal feeling. It was as if two different movies had merged into one.
The fierce battle between the Tianjian Bureau’s and Duanmu Family’s experts was at a deadlock, but the Qing Emperor seemed like a mere passerby leisurely walking into the fray. As he intervened, the battling Duanmu Family experts were all sent flying with screams.
The afterimages of the Qing Emperor passed through the battlefield like the wind.
The Duanmu Family experts, whether they were Galaxy, Star Sea, or Titled Strongmen, were instantly blown away and then lay motionless on the ground.
From beginning to end, the Qing Emperor seemed so slow. From beginning to end, it was as if the Qing Emperor had never made a move.
Beneath the Five Emperors, all are ants.
So this is what it means?
"Take them down!" Cheng Jianlong commanded. Immediately, Ming Baiye and others swarmed forward, subduing all the Duanmu Family’s Titled Strongmen.
What had been a deadlocked struggle moments ago was settled in the blink of an eye.
BANG—
A loud noise sounded as Duanmu Qingsuang’s door was kicked open.
Sitting behind his desk, Duanmu Qingsuang suddenly looked up.
"Duanmu Qingsuang, you are under arrest."
"Cheng Jianlong... heh... Who would have thought that one day, a petty chief of the Tianjian Bureau would actually barge into my study? Under arrest... The head of the Duanmu Family will not be arrested."
"You still want to resist..."
Suddenly, flames surged around Duanmu Qingsuang. Purple flames instantly engulfed him.
"Water Breakthrough—"
"Water Tornado—"
Wang Lan and Ming Baiye both launched Water Attribute Star Martial Skills towards Duanmu Qingsuang. The fire was extinguished, but Duanmu Qingsuang was already dead on the spot.
"Sigh! A formidable figure of his generation, to end like this," Cheng Jianlong said, a hint of complex emotion in his voice as he gazed at Duanmu Qingsuang, who had taken his own life.
"Chief, the problem now is... with Duanmu Qingsuang dead, how do we investigate the mastermind connected to the academy?"
At Ming Baiye’s words, Cheng Jianlong’s expression suddenly changed. Staring at the charred corpse before him, he stepped over to Duanmu Qingsuang’s side. "Damn it, wake up! You can’t die yet! Wang Lan, quick, save him!"
"Chief, are you serious? He’s completely cooked!" Wang Lan sighed in exasperation.
I never imagined Chief Cheng had such a ridiculous side.
Although the battle had come to an end, the dust had not yet settled.
The rumors spread by the Duanmu Family and the ensuing public criticism would keep the Tianjian Bureau busy for a long time, not to mention the task of identifying the innocent among the Duanmu Family members.
But these no longer had anything to do with Wang Lan. His mission was already complete—or rather, it was complete the moment Wei Zheng was captured.
Returning to the dormitory, Wang Lan asked for a few more days off from school. The school, perhaps aware of Wang Lan’s actions this week, didn’t ask any questions and promptly approved his leave.
Apart from the successful resolution of the Wei Zheng case, which awarded him 20,000 experience points and 3,000 skill points, the Duanmu Family case surprisingly yielded no experience or skill points.
Furthermore, the Duanmu Family was annihilated, yet Ma Chuchu’s task was still not completed.
At this moment, Wang Lan almost wanted to emulate Cheng Jianlong, grab Ma Chuchu’s urn, and yell, "What the hell more do you want? I’ve wiped out the entire Duanmu Family! What else could you possibly be unsatisfied with? Huh?" Alas, such scenes could only play out in his imagination.
「Three days went by.」
The judgment on the Duanmu Family had been concluded.
Due to Duanmu Qingsuang’s death, subsequent investigations had to be abruptly halted. Other members of the Duanmu Family could not be convicted due to a lack of evidence. However, resisting law enforcement was an indisputable charge.
The verdict was announced: the stripping of the Duanmu Family’s title as a Star Martial Aristocratic family and the confiscation of all their assets. Key leaders of the Duanmu Family were sentenced to three to ten years of imprisonment for resisting law enforcement, while the younger generations of the Duanmu Family were to be educated and released.
As for those Star Martial Warriors associated with the Duanmu Family, their contracts were annulled unconditionally, and they were to be redistributed by the state to the five major Pioneer Spaces to develop new territories.
Compared to the dynastic era, when families were exterminated at the drop of a hat, this era was much better. But for the other Star Martial Aristocratic families in Modu City, there was a sense of chill, as if the loss of the lips would soon doom the teeth.
The vast Duanmu Family had vanished overnight.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Another Clue
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 329: Another Clue
DING DONG—
Wang Lan sat up in bed as his phone chimed with a notification. He picked it up to take a look. It was from the Tianjian Bureau, containing the information on Mu Fanghua that he had requested.
Mu Fanghua, born in 1997, was twenty-two years old this year. She was a senior student at the Star Martial Academy in Modu City and had been taken as a disciple by Vice President Nangong Meng last year. Although her registered name was Mu Fanghua, she was, in fact, the illegitimate child of Duanmu Qingsuang. Her mother, Mu Qiaoli, had fallen in love at first sight with Duanmu Qingsuang, who was then thirty-two, and they quickly became deeply involved. Mu Qiaoli herself was a highly gifted Star Martial Warrior. She had graduated from the Star Martial Academy in Zezhou, having already reached the mid-phase of the Galaxy realm by then.
In her three-year career as a professional Star Martial Warrior, Mu Qiaoli had made quite a name for herself. With her strength and reputation, marrying Duanmu Qingsuang would have been considered appropriate. However, at that time, Duanmu Qingsuang was vying for the position of family head. To secure enough leverage, he married a woman from the Lv Family, another top-tier Star Martial family. Heartbroken, Mu Qiaoli, pregnant with Mu Fanghua, left him. Ten years after giving birth to Mu Fanghua, she suffered an accident that severely damaged both her legs; even Star Martial medics couldn’t heal them.
According to the Tianjian Bureau’s investigation, Mu Qiaoli’s accident was likely connected to the Lv Family. After that incident, Mu Qiaoli severed all ties with the Duanmu Family. The information seemed to confirm this. The rest of the report detailed Mu Qiaoli’s financial information. Notably, Mu Qiaoli had a bank account under her name containing one billion in funds. However, she had never used this account. It had been opened twelve years ago, around the time Mu Qiaoli was injured. It might have been compensation from Duanmu Qingsuang, or perhaps the Lv Family’s attempt to settle the matter and compensate her. But it seemed as if even Mu Qiaoli was unaware of the money’s existence; in twelve years, not a single transaction had been made.
Duanmu Fanghua must harbor resentment towards the Duanmu Family, right? Then it makes sense that he would help push Duanmu Yi. Duanmu Yi has been living in Jinghua District longer than Bai Ji... could it really be a coincidence?
Wang Lan muttered to himself.
On social media, the Yu Family had also begun to exert their influence. Their justification for taking action against the Duanmu Family? The Duanmu Family was connected to the assassination of Princess Yu. However, the specifics of their involvement were not elaborated upon. Moreover, new evidence kept surfacing online: the Duanmu Family was involved in the Space Stone trade, the Soul Bead trade, illegal business operations, commercial crimes, smuggling... This barrage of evidence caused those who had previously sympathized with the Duanmu Family to switch sides and openly lambast them.
However, the most significant and closely watched issue was whether the Tianjian Bureau had mercilessly slaughtered the vulnerable members of the Duanmu Family—the old, weak, women, and children—and whether there had been an attempt to exterminate the entire Duanmu Family. In fact, doubts about this had been numerous from the very beginning. Times had changed, and public trust in the government was very high. Jade Country’s legal system was sound; even in the world of Star Martial Warriors, the extermination of an entire family was unthinkable. Especially when the Duanmu Family released videos of innocent family members being killed, creating a public opinion bombshell. Even with photographic evidence, many criticized, "Could you be any more dramatic? Are you going to bring up the execution of all nine degrees of kinship next?"
But there were always some people who acted thoughtlessly. Coupled with the Tianjian Bureau’s mysterious and fearsome reputation, and its association with other official departments, it was often likened to ominous historical agencies like ancient suppression offices and the Guard. It seemed entirely plausible for such ruthless departments to commit any act.
However, all these doubts were utterly dispelled after the Tianjian Bureau released another video. It showed the Tianjian Bureau erecting a protective barrier to shield the innocent Duanmu Family members during their evacuation, while intense gunfire from the periphery targeted them. The Tianjian Bureau and the Yu Family had never used a single firearm in their operations. Yet, the Duanmu Family’s own death warriors were slaughtering their kin.
Are these even human? They’re worse than beasts!
Subsequently, some Star Martial Warriors affiliated with the Duanmu Family came forward with accusations, completing the public relations takedown. Virtually overnight, public opinion flipped, and the Duanmu Family was irrevocably nailed to the pillar of shame.
The Yu Family went even further, pinning deeds not even committed by the Duanmu Family onto them, even fabricating baseless accusations. It didn’t matter; they just piled it on. This pushed the Duanmu Family deeper into an abyss from which they could not rise. The Duanmu Family wanted to protest, "I didn’t do it! That wasn’t me! Stop your slander!"
But the public sentiment was, "Go ahead and argue; if I believe a single word you say, I lose."
The explosive battle of public opinion concluded within three days. The Duanmu Family, despite striking first, was swiftly routed and cast into hell.
However, even after the dust settled, the system still hadn’t issued a notification for rewards or skill points. This caused Wang Lan’s relaxed brows to furrow involuntarily.
Could it be that the Duanmu Family’s affair isn’t truly over? That’s impossible. Duanmu Qingsuang already self-immolated, the Duanmu Family has been eradicated, and even their clandestine Space Stone trading has been thoroughly investigated. What could possibly be left unfinished?
In the system tasks, two unfinished items remained, like thorns stuck in his throat.
The sensational topic quietly faded from public attention after a few days. Originally, the Yu Family had planned to press their advantage, aiming to permanently disgrace the Duanmu Family. However, considering international repercussions and Jade Country’s reputation, the state actively suppressed further discussion of the Duanmu Family.
「Another three days passed in silence.」
Wang Lan continued his routine: editing the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine in the mornings and crafting Soul Bead grenades in the afternoons. Jiayi Biotech Company’s independent production line had also been set up, and the first batch of Star Martial Toxin medical products had begun production. This venture promised considerable profits for Jade Country, Wang Qi, and the Star Martial Academy in Modu City.
"Wang Lan—"
While Wang Lan was in the medical department leading his team on Star Martial Toxin research, his phone suddenly chimed.
"Xiao Ai, what’s up?"
"You asked me to monitor all of Mrs. Mu’s activities. Just a moment ago, Mrs. Mu’s one billion fund was transferred overseas."
"Oh?" Wang Lan finally paused his work, stood up, and walked into his private office.
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow... a small nation located within the Arctic Circle. It was an island nation situated in a volcanically active region. So, although the surrounding temperatures were polar and the island was perennially covered in ice and snow, a considerable part of its land area still enjoyed spring-like conditions year-round. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow possessed abundant energy mineral resources and had originally also had various calcium, phosphorus, and potassium resources. However, due to the opening of Different Dimensional Spaces within its borders, and the fact that most Exotic Beasts emerging from these spaces were Poisonous Beasts, the kingdom had been in dire straits for the past ten years.
Wang Lan occasionally came across news about the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Compared to the chaotic situation in the Middle Eastern regions, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow seemed almost invisible. Yet, from these sporadic news reports, it was clear that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s predicament was even more miserable than that of the small nations in the Middle East. Jade Country, possessing the magnanimity and responsibility of a major power, provided aid to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow annually, but this assistance was mostly a drop in the bucket.
Mrs. Mu transferring one billion in funds to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?
Wang Lan found it puzzling; he wouldn’t have figured it out even if he racked his brains.
Tapping his fingers on the desktop, Wang Lan sank into deep thought. After a long while, his expression suddenly changed, and he stood up abruptly. "I’ve got it."
Hurriedly, Wang Lan left the academy and rode his bike to the Tianjian Bureau.
The investigation into the mastermind behind Yu Ruoyun’s assassination had also been successfully concluded, attributed to the Duanmu Family’s involvement in Space Stone trading. Although, to this day, there was no definitive proof that the Space Stones laid in The Death Valley originated from the Duanmu Family, nor was it possible to learn from the remnants of the Duanmu Family who had orchestrated this astonishing death trap. After all, Duanmu Qingsuang was dead. But since someone had taken the fall, the higher-ups were unwilling to expend further effort investigating, so closing the case by blaming the Duanmu Family was considered an excellent outcome.
This time, when Wang Lan arrived at the Tianjian Bureau, his colleagues seemed less busy than before. Quite a few of them greeted him warmly. Yang Yang’s team had already parted ways with Wang Lan; their previous collaboration had been temporary, and Wang Lan never expected a colonel to genuinely serve under him, a major. In terms of hierarchical standing, an independent team was not inferior to an operations brigade.
He knocked on Ming Baiye’s office door. Ming Baiye and the head of the intelligence department were inside, bantering and boasting, their faces creased with laughter.
"Report!"
"Wang Lan? What wind blew you here? It’s not the weekend today, is it?"
"No, Mr. Ming," Wang Lan said, getting straight to the point. "I suspect that Duanmu Qingsuang isn’t dead."
At his words, the smiles instantly vanished from the faces of the two men in the office.
"Wang Lan, what are you saying? Duanmu Qingsuang isn’t dead? Impossible! Weren’t you also present when Duanmu Qingsuang self-immolated?"
"Did the bureau perform a DNA comparison on Duanmu Qingsuang’s body?"
"Well... no, that hasn’t been done. After all, so many people saw it was Duanmu Qingsuang, and witnessed him self-immolate in public..."
"Mr. Ming, if the Duanmu Family could have three hundred death warriors, couldn’t Duanmu Qingsuang have had a body double?"
Wang Lan’s question immediately made Ming Baiye’s expression change. They hadn’t considered this. At the time, they had only seen Duanmu Qingsuang in his office and then watched him burn to death before their very eyes. Coupled with the arrests and reckonings of the Duanmu Family members, they indeed hadn’t thought of that possibility. But the idea that Duanmu Qingsuang might have had a body double was quite plausible.
"Wang Lan, how did you figure this out?"
The system told me!
Wang Lan thought, but of course, he couldn’t say that aloud.
"Mr. Ming, do you remember I asked you to help investigate Duanmu Fanghua some time ago? I’ve reviewed the investigation results. On the surface, Duanmu Fanghua and the Duanmu Family seem unrelated—even hostile. But from what I’ve gathered, Duanmu Fanghua isn’t as principled as his mother. Although his name is Mu Fanghua, he has repeatedly identified himself as Duanmu Fanghua at school. Moreover, he shows no aversion whatsoever when others call him Duanmu Fanghua. Also, I’ve been discreetly monitoring intelligence on Mu Qiaoli and discovered a fund of one billion under her name."
"I saw that too," Ming Baiye said. "It was compensation given to Mu Qiaoli by the Duanmu Family twelve years ago, with some of it being atonement money from the Lv Family."
"But just now, that one billion fund was transferred to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
Ming Baiye’s brows furrowed slightly. "That money is Mu Qiaoli’s private property. Where she transfers it... is her freedom, isn’t it?"
"The Country of Frost is teeming with Exotic Beasts. Compared to the Middle East Countries, the Exotic Beasts in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow are predominantly Poisonous Beasts. Is transferring money to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow an act of poverty alleviation? Surely, no one with any sense would throw money into a place where their assets are under extreme threat?"

chapters.title: Chapter 330 No Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 330 No Escape
"You suspect it’s..."
"First, I suspect that Duanmu Qingsuang isn’t dead. Duanmu Qingsuang doesn’t seem like the kind of overlord who would be destroyed along with his schemes. Moreover, Mr. Ming, have you noticed that although the Duanmu Family was annihilated, Lv Fengchi seems to have been unaffected? She had the protection of the Lv Family and apparently took a large amount of assets back to the Lv Family. On the day that Duanmu Qingsuang self-immolated, knowing full well he was certain to die, why would he set himself on fire?
Second, Mu Qiaoli had nothing to do with Duanmu Qingsuang for over twenty years. Everyone might know about that billion in funds, but Mu Qiaoli may not necessarily be aware of it. And during this sensitive period, the billion in funds that hadn’t moved in twelve years suddenly made its way to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Don’t you think the timing is too coincidental?"
"Are you saying Duanmu Qingsuang has already reached the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?"
"Possibly."
"Impossible!" Ming Baiye said decisively. "With the current situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, they have almost been abandoned by the entire world. There are only three countries maintaining contact with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Moreover, recently there has been an increase in checkpoint inspections at national borders. It wouldn’t be so easy for Duanmu Qingsuang to leave Jade Country, and it certainly wouldn’t be easy for him to arrive in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"Given Duanmu Qingsuang’s status and strength, slipping away from Jade Country unnoticed wouldn’t be very difficult," Wang Lan said gravely. "When I was still in Suzhou City, my guide and superior, Wang Qianfeng, once said to me that we shouldn’t delude ourselves into thinking we can stop spies from the Demon Clan from infiltrating. No matter how tight our defenses, they always find a way to sneak in. If they couldn’t, they wouldn’t be fit to be spies lurking within our ranks. Likewise, no matter how vigilant our border checkpoints are, don’t expect to stop someone like Duanmu Qingsuang. If we did, then he wouldn’t be Duanmu Qingsuang."
"Alright, I’ll make a call to the embassy in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
Ming Baiye immediately picked up the phone, searched the intelligence network for the embassy number in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and dialed through.
"Hello, this is the Action Department of the Tianjian Bureau in Modu City. I’d like to inquire about something. Today, a billion in funds was transferred to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow from Modu City. Can you check the identity of the recipient of that transaction for me? Also, could you check if there have been any Jade Country people or individuals with an Eastern appearance who have arrived in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow within the last week? Thank you!"
After a wait of less than half an hour, the other end called back.
"Hello, Senior Colonel Ming. The investigation result for that billion-dollar transaction is out; the recipient is someone named Yi Xianxing. However, this Yi Xianxing is not among the registered Jade Country nationals in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. This account was only registered last year. Second, given the current situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, there haven’t been any people entering the country for nearly a month. There have been no entries via airplane, passenger transport, or cruise ship."
"Alright, thank you," said Ming Baiye, giving Wang Lan a look as if to say, "See?"
"Wait, hello, Ambassador. Are there any plans for visits to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow recently? Including any on an international scale?"
"Yes, there are. Since the beginning of this year, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow has been continuously requesting aid from the United Nations, and Jade Country has accepted their request for assistance. There will be an aid inspection team arriving in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow tomorrow morning to conduct surveys. Right, this inspection team seems to be organized by your Modu City Star Martial Academy."
"Arriving in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow tomorrow morning? Then their departure time would be..."
"According to our local time, it should be this afternoon."
Wang Lan quickly took out his mobile phone to browse through the academy’s data, and sure enough, he soon found a notification about the school’s inspection trip to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow had been almost destroyed by Exotic Beasts in the past fifteen years. All the Exotic Beasts in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow are Poisonous Beasts. Consequently, they pose a great threat to Star Martial Warriors from various countries, and not many nations are willing to take such a risk to help them. If the Star Martial Academy in Modu City hadn’t developed the Star Martial Toxins Vaccine technology, Jade Country wouldn’t have arranged for an inspection team to go there. This inspection team is led by Vice President Nangong Meng of the Modu City Star Martial Academy. Their main objectives are to investigate the situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow and the types of Poisonous Beasts. They will also attempt to bring back samples of Star Martial Toxins to produce vaccines for support. From what the school’s announcement indicated, this inspection embodied the great spirit of internationalism, selflessly aiding the weaker Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Yet, all of this happening at this specific time helped Wang Lan connect the dots, revealing a comprehensive plan.
"As the saying goes, the grain must arrive before the troops do; hence Mu Qiaoli’s billion first went to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. I suspect that Duanmu Qingsuang might very well be hidden within this inspection team."
With the analysis reaching this point, Ming Baiye fully understood. He quickly stood up and phoned Modu Qiaohong Airport. "Hello, is this Modu Qiaohong Airport? I am Ming Baiye, the director of the Tianjian Bureau’s Action Department. Could you tell me if the charter flight from the Modu City Star Martial Academy to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow has taken off?"
"Two more hours until it takes off? That’s great. I’d ask for your cooperation to prevent the charter from leaving before we arrive. Also, do not disclose any information about the Tianjian Bureau’s involvement to avoid startling the snake. You should understand such matters. Alright, thank you for your trouble."
After hanging up the phone, there was a look of excitement on Ming Baiye’s face. "We might catch a big fish this time."
"Old Ming," Chen couldn’t help but say, "how about assigning this mission to our Intelligence Department? The Action Department has really been working hard lately, and it troubles me to see the lads running around so busy. How about this, your big brother here will take over for you, and please, don’t thank me—we’re comrades, it’s only right."
"I’ll thank your grandma! Old Chen, I never thought you could be so shameless," Ming Baiye retorted.
"How is this being shameless?" Chen responded. "I’m just considering how hard the Action Department has been working lately and that they really deserve to rest. Besides, the Intelligence Department has been conserving strength and keeping idle recently."
"No, please, don’t worry about us. The brothers told me they don’t mind the hard work. Our Action Department’s ideological awareness has always been top-notch, and our motto is, as long as we’re not dead, we work to the bone. Wang Lan, don’t bother with that shameless guy; let’s go."
Wang Lan gave a simple acknowledgment and followed Ming Baiye out of the office.
"Action Squad One, assemble—Independent Action Teams A and S, assemble—"
In less than five minutes, a hundred-member action squad and two independent action teams had gathered at the assembly point. Yang Yang looked at Wang Lan, who was following Ming Baiye, and clicked his tongue.
I think the captain has made another major discovery, why can’t he ever rest? We’ve just taken down the Duanmu Family, and now this?
"Team Leader Yang, that just rolled off your tongue, didn’t it? Have you forgotten that *you’re* the team leader?"
"Uh..."
Five off-road vehicles and two transport trucks majestically left the Tianjian Bureau and headed for Modu Qiaohong Airport.
Modu Qiaohong Airport is located northeast of Modu City, about seventy kilometers from the city center. Although it is said to be part of Modu City, it is actually on the very outskirts. The airport covers a vast area and from a bird’s-eye view is almost the size of a county town. It is also the sixth-largest international airport in the world, with seventy-two runways and over five thousand passenger flights a day.
In the waiting hall of Modu Qiaohong Airport, the twenty-seven members of the inspection team led by Dean Nangong had been waiting in the departure lounge for half an hour.
"Mr. Zhang, since we’re taking a chartered flight, we don’t need to stick strictly to the takeoff schedule, right? Wasn’t it immediate departure once everyone was here in the past? And what was that earlier about a flight path conflict? I looked just now; there’s only one flight path to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and there aren’t any other flights, so how could there be a conflict?"
"I apologize, Dean Nangong. I wasn’t clear earlier. Aside from the earlier route conflict, there was also an issue discovered during the plane’s self-check. Our technicians are urgently fixing it, and I am deeply sorry for the valuable time this has cost you. Please forgive us."
"An issue with the plane? If I remember correctly, the charter request was submitted last week, wasn’t it?"
"Yes, there were no problems with the aircraft yesterday. It’s just that there was a sudden alarm earlier. Don’t worry, it’s not a major issue; otherwise, it wouldn’t be a simple, last-minute alarm. Please understand."
"So, that means we can’t depart early, and our flight might even be delayed."
"I’m sorry for the inconvenience this has caused you."
"Alright, enough!" Vice President Nangong Meng said, waving his hand in irritation. "Make it quick."
As Nangong Meng lit a cigarette in the private boarding lounge and read the newspaper, the five Tianjian Bureau vehicles silently entered Modu Qiaohong Airport.
"Immediately isolate the airport passengers, and please, make sure to move them to the standby runway without arousing their suspicion."
"Understood!"
"Dean Nangong, the maintenance of the aircraft is now OK, please follow us," said two flight attendants as they led the way. Dean Nangong’s inspection team stood up and followed, carrying their hand luggage.
As they walked, an old scholar suddenly frowned. "Wait, I remember the boarding passage isn’t this way?"
"Good day, sir. The gate we’re heading to is at Runway 5," they replied.
"Runway 5? Isn’t that the standby runway?"
"Yes, that’s just a colloquial term. As of last Friday, Runway 5 was designated as a dedicated runway for private jets. Since their departures and landings are quite flexible, they were given a separate runway."
As the people filed out of the passage, they saw five empty runways—with not a trace of their private plane in sight.
In front of them, Ming Baiye, Wang Lan, and the two independent action teams stood lined up, as the hundred-member action squad suddenly appeared, encircling the twenty-seven members of the inspection team.
All of them looked baffled at the scene before them, except Dean Nangong, whose eyes were fixed on Wang Lan, his expression souring instantly.
"Tianjian Bureau, what is the meaning of this?"
"Please excuse us, Dean Nangong. We suspect that there is a dangerous fugitive wanted by Jade Country hiding among your inspection team, which is why we had to resort to this measure."
"Nonsense! Everyone in the inspection team is a highly respected scientist. We’re about to travel to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow for a field inspection. This is absurd! Who are you accusing of being a fugitive? Me, or these esteemed individuals behind me?"
"Dean Nangong, rest assured, we’re just delaying everyone slightly. We only need to take a small blood sample. After all, Star Martial Warriors might be able to transform and disguise themselves, but they can’t fake DNA. It won’t take long, just ten minutes for the results. Please line up for a quick blood test."
With that said, the side doors of the nearby off-road vehicles opened, and two medical personnel dressed in white lab coats were already waiting inside.
"Alright, fine. I’ll go first," said Nangong Meng without much thought, stepping forward towards the off-road vehicle.
BOOM—
Suddenly, a thick cloud of smoke erupted, covering a three-hundred-meter radius before anyone had time to react.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 Why Is It You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 331 Why Is It You?
"Great Gale—"
A soft shout rang out, and the thick smoke was instantly swept away by a fierce wind. Within seconds, the smoke that had spread throughout the venue dispersed. Nangong Meng was forced back dozens of meters, his neck clutched by a scholar in white.
"Professor Li, what are you doing?" Nangong Meng’s face immediately darkened as he asked in a deep voice.
"Professor Li? Hahaha... It seems you really are a confused soul, not even knowing who they are looking for." The Professor Li behind him let out a sinister laugh, his skin visibly rotting at a rapid pace. With a gentle tear, a gloomy face appeared before everyone.
"Duanmu Qingsuang, you’re indeed not dead!"
"You’ve already plunged the Duanmu Family into an abyss, why still insist on wiping us out? I had already planned to leave Jade Country and never return, why must you press so hard?" Duanmu Qingsuang retorted.
"If we don’t wipe you out, how can we face all those innocent people you killed? If we don’t press you so hard, how can we face those families you persecuted? Since you are a criminal of Jade Country, then don’t even think about leaving Jade Country alive."
"Now that I have Nangong Meng in my grasp, so be it! I’ll take someone down with me." As his words fell, Duanmu Qingsuang’s body surged with Star Power in a frenzy.
"Wait! Do you really plan on repeating your mistakes? Let go of Dean Nangong, and I promise to apply for a lighter sentence for you," one of the Tianjian Bureau members shouted.
"Hahaha... What a joke! I, Duanmu Qingsuang, am flattered by the Tianjian Bureau’s high regard, to think that the mightiest executioner of Jade Country and the Yu Family would unite to annihilate my Duanmu Family. Even with a lighter sentence, I cannot escape death. If I don’t die, can the Yu Family sleep peacefully at night? It’s death either way, so I might as well take someone with me. It’d be less lonely to have someone to talk to on the Netherworld Road."
"You truly are beyond salvation. Speak then, what do you want?"
"I only wish to leave Jade Country. This is why I troubled Dean Nangong to escort me out. As long as I safely reach the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, I will not pressure Dean Nangong on whether he goes or stays."
"Dream on!" Nangong Meng shouted explosively. "Wang Lan, don’t mind me! The Star Martial Academy of Modu City can do anything but compromise. In its more than two hundred years, the Star Martial Academy has never compromised with anyone. Wang Lan, Ming Baiye, make your move! I’d rather die at your hands than at the hands of such a traitor."
"Oh? Dean Nangong seems to have quite the backbone, doesn’t he? It’s just a pity that I’ve sealed your Star Power, so it’s not up to you whether you like it or not," Duanmu Qingsuang sneered.
Wang Lan furrowed his brow, at a loss for what to do in the current situation.
Duanmu Qingsuang definitely can’t be allowed to leave Jade Country. Think of the massive loss Jade Country suffered when Wang Mingling escaped thirty years ago! Duanmu Qingsuang, as the head of one of Jade Country’s top Star Martial Art families, is an even greater threat than Wang Mingling.
Moreover, although the situation just now was dangerous, it was far from being so critical that there was no time to react. Dean Nangong was a Titled Strongman in his youth! How could he fall to this state? Even if his cultivation realm has declined and his reactions have slowed due to old age, he shouldn’t have fallen to a level below even my Star Cloud Stage, right?
If Nangong Meng knew what Wang Lan was thinking, he would probably want to spray him dead with a mouthful of soda.
Him, at the Star Cloud Stage? He’s probably the only one in the world who considers himself merely at the Star Cloud Stage! Has anyone ever seen someone at the Star Cloud Stage defeat a Star Sea Stage cultivator? Not even Yu Ruoyun was that monstrous.
Ming Baiye’s face also twisted with conflict. Letting Duanmu Qingsuang leave was absolutely out of the question. But to stand by and watch Duanmu Qingsuang escape the country? That was even more impossible.
At that moment, a Soul Bead suddenly slipped from the sleeve of Nangong Meng’s robes, falling gently like a raindrop, as if the world had slowed the flow of time just for this bead.
BOOM—
A Purple Flame Arrow suddenly shot out from the Soul Bead, instantly piercing through Duanmu Qingsuang’s chest.
Seizing this opportunity, Nangong Meng broke free from Duanmu Qingsuang’s grasp and retaliated with a thunderball that struck Duanmu Qingsuang squarely in the chest. Duanmu Qingsuang’s chest visibly caved in.
BOOM—
