With a loud noise, Duanmu Qingsuang’s body was sent flying backward, tumbling dozens of meters away.
The Tianjian Bureau members took action instantly, rushing towards Duanmu Qingsuang. Wang Lan was one of those who moved without hesitation.
"Dean Nangong, how are you?" Ming Baiye quickly came to Nangong Meng’s side and asked with concern.
"I’m old, very old..." Nangong Meng sighed deeply, shaking his head silently. "I never accepted getting old. Eld Di is already a hundred years old and still improving, so why couldn’t I? But now... indeed, I am old. In my prime, someone like him couldn’t even get within three steps of me, but today, he managed to capture me. Sigh..."
"Didn’t you also counterattack at the last moment and kill that scoundrel?" Ming Baiye asked.
"That was also thanks to Wang Lan’s Soul Bead grenade..."
Meanwhile, Wang Lan saw the basketball-sized hole in Duanmu Qingsuang’s chest and inhaled sharply. Without delay, his Star Power flashed as he established a connection with Duanmu Qingsuang.
"Captain? He’s more dead than dead, is this really necessary?" Yang Yang asked Wang Lan, his expression constipated.
Wang Lan leaned close to Duanmu Qingsuang’s mouth. "What? What did you say?"
Hearing Wang Lan’s words, Ming Baiye and Nangong Meng both paused. Ming Baiye wore a look of disbelief.
How could someone with such injuries not be dead? Even if it’s said that good people don’t live long while calamities last for a thousand years, it shouldn’t be to this extent, right?
Nangong Meng’s expression, however, was rapidly changing.
Wang Lan suddenly looked up at Nangong Meng, his expression incredulous, his eyes filled with panic.
Seeing that look in his eyes, Nangong Meng’s face turned deathly pale in an instant.
"Dean Nangong, I have always regarded you as an upright, selfless, and revered senior," Wang Lan said, his voice trembling. "Although you were strict with us and often scolded us, we never complained. We even thought of you as the most respectable person in the entire academy, second only to the Head Dean. Why? Why did you do it?"
"Wang Lan, what... what are you talking about?" Although Ming Baiye voiced doubt, his body involuntarily created distance from Nangong Meng. His Star Power even began to surge, ready to erupt at any moment.
"You’ve never married, have no children, spent the first half of your life risking death for the country, and devoted the second half of your life to the academy, pouring your heart and soul into it. What exactly are you after..." Wang Lan continued, his voice filled with pain.
"Sigh—" Watching the pained look in Wang Lan’s eyes, Nangong Meng let out a soft sigh.
"This moment has finally come! I thought I would hate the person who would bring about my downfall and expose my true nature. But now, there is no anger or resentment in my heart. Only regret. ’A single misstep leads to eternal sorrow; by the time one looks back, a lifetime has passed.’
"If I hadn’t met that ungrateful wretch, I imagine none of this would have happened. I dreamed of being buried with the national flag draped over my coffin. I wanted my name to be engraved on the campus monument.
"Hahaha... Hahaha... I’ve lived my life with a clear conscience, weathered decades of storms, and yet, in these last two years, I fell victim to a despicable, shameless villain! Oh, how I hate this!"
As he spoke, Nangong Meng’s skin became redder and redder, just like the state of the Scorpion King before he self-destructed in the Nine-layer Pagoda.
"Damn it!" Wang Lan and Ming Baiye almost simultaneously became alert. "Everyone, spread out! Get away quickly!"
"Dean Nangong, calm down!" Wang Lan urged. "Self-destruction is the act of a coward. If you’re not even afraid of death, there’s no need to die like one, is there?"
"A coward? I am one now... Wang Lan, I was the one who sold off the academy’s Soul Beads. I was the one who bought large quantities of Space Stone from the Duanmu Family, and I also orchestrated the plot that led to Yu Ruoyun’s death."
"Why did you do this?" Wang Lan demanded.
"Because of Duanmu Qingsuang. I fell for his trap and was dragged onto his sinking ship. He was furious that you killed his son and enraged that the Yu Family kicked him when he was down, so he devised this plan to kill two birds with one stone. It would not only avenge Duanmu Yi but also stir up turmoil in Jade Country, allowing him to fish in troubled waters. Whether the royal forces succeeded in seizing power or were suppressed, he stood to benefit."
"Is that so? Wait a minute!" Wang Lan exclaimed.
BOOM— Suddenly, a loud explosion sounded, and Nangong Meng’s body burst open.
But the powerful explosion that was expected didn’t occur. Nangong Meng’s body just fell apart like a smashed watermelon, the blast radius not exceeding five meters.
As the dust settled, everyone’s faces became complicated.
There was no joy, no sense of relief, just disbelief, as if waking from a surreal dream.
"Who would have thought the true mastermind would turn out to be... Nangong Meng! But on reflection, it makes sense. As a veteran Titled Strongman and a high-ranking member of the academy, he had the capability to do these things. Thirteen years ago, after the old Head Dean retired, Nangong Meng was supposed to take over. If Eld Di hadn’t been parachuted in... I suppose Nangong Meng must have been very resentful."
"Mr. Ming, I feel... something isn’t right," Wang Lan said quietly.
"Oh?" Ming Baiye looked curiously at Wang Lan.
"I keep feeling he was hiding something, protecting someone. Take Mrs. Sun Li, the head of the medical department. She’s only in her thirties, a young and promising figure within the academy system. Yet, she’d rather commit suicide than expose the true mastermind. This mastermind must be someone of immense power and status. While Dean Nangong certainly held a high position and wielded considerable authority, I doubt he was influential enough to make Mrs. Sun Li sacrifice herself for his protection. That’s why I suspect Nangong Meng wasn’t the real mastermind. Also, he mentioned that if he hadn’t met that ’ungrateful wretch’... that person might not be Duanmu Qingsuang. It’s not that I underestimate Duanmu Qingsuang, but he simply doesn’t have that kind of strategic depth or influence. The Duanmu Family, though powerful, was merely a sharp knife, easily wielded by others. Nangong Meng’s final confession felt more like he was forcing an end to this matter."
Wang Lan analyzed to himself, oblivious to the increasingly strange expression on Ming Baiye’s face.
"Wang Lan..." Ming Baiye said gravely, "there are some people whom we cannot show even a hint of suspicion towards, even if we harbor doubts internally. We can be secretly vigilant, even investigate covertly, but we must never voice those suspicions."
Ming Baiye’s words caused Wang Lan’s expression to change slightly. He looked up at Ming Baiye. "Mr. Ming, do you already know who it is?"
"I don’t know, and no one can claim to know. Until ironclad evidence is presented, no one can say they know. I know you’re not the type to act recklessly; you understand priorities. I will tell you about one person’s identity. However, you must keep it to yourself. Do not speak of it without solid evidence and absolute certainty of being able to take them down. And you absolutely must not investigate privately without permission."
"Who is it? Is their identity so sensitive?" Wang Lan asked.
"The Martial God. Yu Changdong!"

chapters.title: Chapter 332: The Infiltration Plan Revisited
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 332: The Infiltration Plan Revisited
If the Five Elders and Five Emperors have already ascended to godhood and are irreplaceable in the world of Star Martial Warriors, then there are also a group of legendary figures who have achieved the same status in that world.
Their fame may not equal that of the Five Emperors, and their prestige may not match that of the Five Elders.
The Five Elders and Five Emperors are the top-tier legends, followed by the second and third tiers.
And without a doubt, Martial God Yu Changdong ranks first among those in the second tier.
Yu Changdong, a direct descendant of the royal Yu Family, is one of the current patriarchs of the Yu Family and the great-uncle of Yu Ruoyun. Twenty years ago, he nearly reached the realm of the Five Emperors, but since then, it has seemed as though he disappeared from the world.
Everyone knew he was still alive, but he kept such a low profile, as if he were invisible. Some said he went mad from his failed attempt and had to explode his Star Palace to save his life. Others believed he actually succeeded and, having no more desires, retired from worldly conflicts.
But how could that be?
Wang Lan looked at Ming Baiye with confusion. "Isn’t Yu Changdong Yu Ruoyun’s great-uncle? How could he possibly..."
"In this world, those who can harm you are not always enemies; sometimes they can be friends, or even close kin. With enough benefit, what couldn’t happen?
Yu Changdong is not only a patriarch of the Yu Family, but fifteen years ago, he was also the dean of Modu City’s Star Martial Academy. He had both the opportunity and ability."
"What about the motive?"
"To restore the Great Jade Dynasty. Yu Changdong is a typical restorationist."
"But can’t it be investigated thoroughly?" Wang Lan asked with a wry smile.
"No, it can’t be investigated openly, but a secret investigation is still possible. This is going to be a long process; leave it to us. Don’t worry about it anymore."
"..." Wang Lan looked with a baffled expression at Ming Baiye, who dismantled the bridge after crossing it so smoothly and naturally.
"After all, you’re still a student, and given the significant implications behind this, if the Yu Family were to catch on, they are capable of anything. I’m also doing this for your safety..."
"Fine... wait a second!" Suddenly, Wang Lan’s expression changed as if he had thought of something.
"No, something’s wrong. Nangong Meng previously said ’one misstep leads to eternal regret’... If there’s someone behind Nangong Meng, or if he is someone’s pawn, then why would he say that? That’s not something a person who has picked sides would say; at that time, he should’ve been spouting ’winner takes all, loser is nothing’ or something similar."
"Is it necessary to pay attention to such a detail?" Zhang Xiao murmured quietly from behind.
"There’s a saying that details determine success or failure. Words spoken in different states of mind carry different meanings. ’One misstep leads to eternal regret’; that is, if I hadn’t met that ingrate... Who is usually described as an ingrate?"
"A child!" Bai Xu raised her hand and said, "My mom always calls me an ingrate."
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH..." Yang Yang coughed lightly, covering his chest.
"I get it now... it’s Mu Fanghua." A sharp glint flickered in Wang Lan’s eyes. "Duanmu Qingsuang, Nangong Meng, there’s another key figure connecting them: Mu Fanghua.
Or rather, Mu Fanghua is the bridge between them."
"Isn’t it because Duanmu Qingsuang and Nangong Meng are in collusion, and they needed a go-between? That’s why they chose Mu Fanghua?" In just a short while, Wang Lan’s reasoning had completely confounded Ming Baiye.
"Mu Fanghua was originally Duanmu Qingsuang’s illegitimate child, and his mother had instilled a lot of hatred for the Duanmu Family in him from a young age. If you were Duanmu Qingsuang, would you send someone who possibly hated you to be a liaison? Would Duanmu Yi not do? Even if Duanmu Yi were unsuitable, the Duanmu Family has many trustworthy people. The only explanation is that Mu Fanghua became Nangong Meng’s man first before serving as the bridge to the Duanmu Family."
"Makes sense. Come on, let’s go to Star Martial Academy to arrest Mu Fanghua."
Ming Baiye left some people to handle the aftermath and led the rest towards Modu City’s Star Martial Academy.
Under Wang Lan’s guidance, they quickly arrived at Mu Fanghua’s dorm. Since it was a time when students were in class, the dormitory was empty. As Ming Baiye was about to ask the academy which class Mu Fanghua was attending, Wang Lan found a note in Mu Fanghua’s bedding.
Moreover, the note was addressed to Wang Lan.
"Classmate Wang Lan, I await you at the summit of the academy. I will answer all your queries there."
"The summit of the academy..." Wang Lan looked up thoughtfully. "Mr. Ming, he’s at the back mountain."
If you speak only of the summit of the main school building, that is undoubtedly the clock tower, the tallest structure, standing one hundred seventy meters tall with sixty floors. But if one refers to the summit of the academy, indisputably, it’s the back mountain, home to the Nine-layer Pagoda, which is three hundred meters high.
Wang Lan and the others swiftly made their way to the back mountain. There, dressed in the blue uniform of the academy, Mu Fanghua stood distantly atop the mountain summit, basking in the warm sun and gentle breeze.
"Mu Fanghua!"
Wang Lan stepped forward with Yang Yang’s squad, while Ming Baiye and dozens of Tianjian Bureau brothers surrounded them for support.
"My name is Mu Fanghua." Mu Fanghua said with a light smile, slowly turning around. "When I realized you went to the airport, I knew it wouldn’t be difficult for you to trace this back to me. After all, even the Demon Clan’s high-level spy teams have been brought down by you, let alone a small fry like me."
"So, the ingrate Dean Nangong spoke of... It was you after all! What exactly did you do to Dean Nangong that made him prefer suicide to revealing it?"
"Of course, he was unwilling to speak. If he died embracing the ’winner takes all, loser is nothing’ mentality, he could at least preserve a reputation as a formidable figure. But if you were to learn that he had failed to maintain his integrity in his later years by assaulting his own student, then after his death, he would only be known as a beast.
Dean Nangong valued reputation above all, and that was his weakness."
"Violated a student?"
"I remember you investigated a matter two months ago, a girl named Ma Chuchu?"
Wang Lan’s eyes narrowed slightly. "Correct! Could it be that Ma Chuchu didn’t really commit suicide?"
"She certainly did commit suicide, but only after being violated by Nangong Meng and forced into a corner. Ma Chuchu... she once fancied me... but because she liked me, she was doomed to misfortune.
First, she was drugged and violated by Duanmu Yi, and then similarly violated by Nangong Meng. And I have the complete record of all these things done by Nangong Meng.
When the effects of Nangong Meng’s drug wore off, he became furious and wanted to kill me. However, I told him that all of this was a part of the Duanmu Family’s scheme. Hence, Nangong Meng had no choice but to follow my lead.
I played the role of the go-between for Nangong Meng and Duanmu Qingsuang. On one hand, I was Duanmu Fanghua of the Duanmu Family, and on the other, I was the direct disciple of Nangong Meng. But we didn’t belong to either side.
I used the name of the Duanmu Family to make Nangong Meng obediently sell Soul Beads. I also used Nangong Meng’s name to have the Duanmu Family purchase a large quantity of Space Stones. The Duanmu Family never suspected, even at their deaths, whether Nangong Meng actually requested these Space Stones. And Nangong Meng likely died without knowing that it wasn’t the Duanmu Family who had him sell the Soul Beads for money."
"Heh... how ironic. You managed to toy with the Duanmu Family and Nangong Meng so effortlessly? So you’re saying... the mastermind behind the assassination of Yu Ruoyun was you?"
"Flattered as I am, I’m just a small fry. The plan was devised by the person backing me, but I’m not sure if that’s all. My feeling is that the person behind me is also cooperating with someone else.
But at least, that batch of Space Stones was indeed bought through the Duanmu Family. And the money used to purchase that batch of Space Stones came from the Soul Beads stolen from the academy.
If Yu Ruoyun died, it would not only cause turbulence in Jade Country but also eliminate two individuals who posed a great threat to the Divine Clan. It might even make Elder Di pay a heavy price. Maybe Elder Di, out of sheer frustration, would just pass away? This plan can truly be said to be beneficial in every way and harmless."
Wang Lan furrowed his brows instantly, but then his expression cleared as he had an epiphany. "So you’re from the Demon Clan!"
"I am not from the Demon Clan, but I have worked for them. If there was even a glimmer of hope in my life, I wouldn’t have betrayed my own kind to become a dog for the Demon Clan.
My mother’s legs were not broken by the Demon Clan, and the hardships I’ve endured didn’t come from them. It was our own kind that hurt me, blood relatives at that. If even my kin could harm me, what reason do I have left to be loyal to such a people?"
"The infiltration plan?"
"It seems you’re quite informed. Correct, it’s the infiltration plan."
"Who’s your contact?"
"He is right in..." Suddenly, Duanmu Fanghua’s head twisted violently, his eyes grotesquely bulging out of their sockets.
"AAAH—"
A scream emanated from Duanmu Fanghua’s mouth. With a loud pop, Duanmu Fanghua’s head exploded right in front of Wang Lan.
A spider-like Brain-eating worm burst forth from Duanmu Fanghua’s brain. Wang Lan instantly waved his hand, and a Flame Sword swept out, killing the spider Brain-eating worm in mid-air.
"Congratulations, host, for uncovering the final mystery. Reward: 100,000 experience points, 30,000 skill points."
"Congratulations, host, for finding the true cause of Ma Chuchu’s death. Reward: 20,000 experience points, 5,000 skill points."
The moment the two notification sounds arose, on the system interface, the experience bar, which had only ten percent remaining, was instantly filled; its 900,000 experience points were topped up.
"Wang Lan..." Ming Baiye was about to step forward but suddenly stopped in his tracks.
A clear Star Energy Fluctuation rippled out, and Wang Lan once again achieved a breakthrough, ascending from Star Cloud 8 to Star Cloud 9.
There’s a fundamental difference between Star Cloud 8 and Star Cloud 9; Star Cloud 8 is referred to as the late stage of Star Cloud, while Star Cloud 9 is known as the peak of Star Cloud.
Although the people from the Tianjian Bureau of Suzhou City had grown accustomed to Wang Lan’s sudden breakthroughs, the group from the Tianjian Bureau of Modu City had not yet adapted.
Wang Lan’s breakthrough was not particularly loud and was already very low-key compared to others. But, discreet as it was, it still couldn’t conceal his shameless tendency to break through without warning.
So, when Wang Lan opened his eyes, he found dozens of eyes staring straight at him.
Wang Lan smiled awkwardly and said, "It’s basic practice, don’t be alarmed."
He was tired of it all, so tired of explaining.
Enough. Let destruction come. The Earth is mine anyway.
"COUGH—" Ming Baiye coughed lightly. After his expression changed several times, he managed to calm down. He knew some information about Wang Lan, as the records transferred from the Tianjian Bureau of Suzhou City were very detailed.
Among them was a special note: Wang Lan likes to break through post-battle. This is basic for him, so please do not act too surprised.
"Um... Wang Lan, are things about cleared up to this point?" Ming Baiye was somewhat dazed. The day had been full of too many reversals: first Duanmu Qingsuang, then Nangong Meng was implicated, and now an infiltration plan and a Demon Clan spy had been revealed.
Ming Baiye was a bit scared; it felt like the waters were getting murkier.
"We can only say that this concludes one Chapter thus far; the entire case can be connected. Shall we go back and make a closing report?"
"That’s what I mean. It’s a shame, though. Duanmu Fanghua didn’t get to reveal the identity of the Demon Clan spy; otherwise, we could have followed the vine to find the melon."
"A Demon Clan spy capable of blending in and surviving in Modu City is definitely hidden much deeper than those in Suzhou City."

chapters.title: Chapter 333 Straight Man Cancer is an Illness, It Needs Treatment
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 333 Straight Man Cancer is an Illness, It Needs Treatment
"Director, the overall situation is actually not that complicated. Earlier this year, around April and May, we had already grasped a corner of the mastermind’s plan.
In April, we discovered that someone in Modu City was conducting secret Space Stone transactions, so we sent a seasoned team member to investigate undercover. During his investigation, he infiltrated the enemy’s ranks and uncovered a Space Stone Smuggling Gang.
In September, during our operation, they used a Space Stone to open a spatial node. Afterward, the Space Stone Smuggling Gang was silenced by the mastermind, and our trail went cold.
Now we can be certain that it was the Duanmu Family who silenced the Space Stone Smuggling Gang.
The incident dates back to June when a large number of Soul Beads flooded the Black Market Soul Beads Trading Market, causing a significant impact. In October, I entrusted Wang Lan with the investigation. He lived up to expectations; within three days, he not only uncovered the mastermind but also acquired account books detailing nearly all the origins of the black market Soul Beads.
From Xiao Qing’s account books, we learned that one hundred thousand Soul Beads had leaked from Star Martial Academy of Modu City. This was the first time Star Martial Academy of Modu City was implicated.
In truth, both the Soul Bead trade and Space Stone smuggling share a common source: the Duanmu Family. The Duanmu Family has been secretly controlling both the Soul Bead trade and Space Stone smuggling.
Previously, both businesses were very stable because the Duanmu Family was extremely cautious, remaining unnoticed in the shadows. But this time, perhaps due to years of smooth sailing or their own arrogance, they lost their sense of reverence.
After one hundred thousand Soul Beads leaked from Star Martial Academy of Modu City, the Duanmu Family, without hesitation, accepted them all. They also readily agreed to exchange Soul Beads for Space Stones.
Perhaps the Duanmu Family’s judgment was clouded by profit, or perhaps the Duanmu Family was also part of the mastermind’s cohorts.
This explains why those Soul Beads were resold, as well as the origin of the Space Stones used in the assassination attempt on Yu Ruoyun and Wang Lan in the Nine-layer Pagoda."
Ming Baiye paused for a moment before continuing, "Now, let’s talk about the mastermind’s plan.
One party we can confirm as the mastermind is the Demon Clan. This is the definitive answer we obtained from Mu Fanghua.
Mu Fanghua was approached by the Demon Clan when he was very young and was included in their infiltration plan. This plan first came to light last year in Suzhou City. Director, and everyone present, you should be familiar with it, right?
Mu Fanghua was one of the ’Poison Stings’ of the infiltration plan. With the Demon Clan’s covert support, his talents gradually emerged, and he successfully gained admission to Star Martial Academy of Modu City. Through the Demon Clan’s arrangements, he met Nangong Meng and was accepted as his disciple.
Simultaneously, another girl named Ma Chuchu was also accepted as a disciple by Nangong Meng. However, any hidden details about their connection were completely erased, so the true situation is unknown.
The only known fact is that Mu Fanghua orchestrated a scheme leading Nangong Meng to assault Ma Chuchu, and he recorded the entire incident. He then used this video footage to blackmail Nangong Meng.
Nangong Meng, who valued his reputation above all else, was forced to comply and become Mu Fanghua’s pawn. Nangong Meng was the one who smuggled out the Soul Beads and also the one who placed orders with the Duanmu Family for Space Stones.
Therefore, we can conclude that a Demon Clan spy definitely had a hand in assassinating Yu Ruoyun and inciting unrest in Jade Country. However, the Demon Clan is likely not the sole mastermind."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianlong frowned.
Now that the Demon Clan has been identified, I can finally breathe a little easier,
Cheng Jianlong thought.
As long as it was the Demon Clan’s mischief, and there’s sufficient evidence, they’re the perfect scapegoat.
Martial God Yu Changdong was untouchable. Moving against him would have the same consequences as Yu Ruoyun being killed. The Yu Family’s faction needed an excuse.
With the Demon Clan taking the blame, everyone was content. However, Ming Baiye’s words suggested this blame was only partially accurate, at best.
Seeing Cheng Jianlong’s slightly furrowed brow, Ming Baiye hastily added, "Sun Li, the medical department teacher at Star Martial Academy of Modu City, is not a Demon Clan spy, nor is there any indication she cooperated with the Demon Clan. On the contrary, her relationship with Martial God Yu Changdong is very close.
Sun Li played a crucial role in the plan to assassinate Yu Ruoyun. Without her arrangements, the assassination could never have succeeded. Therefore, the Demon Clan was only one party involved in the plan, not the entirety."
"Do you have any evidence?" Cheng Jianlong asked.
"No, just speculation," Ming Baiye admitted.
Cheng Jianlong lightly tapped the table. "If it’s just speculation, we can’t publicize this. I suggest we conclude the case by identifying the Demon Clan spy as the mastermind.
This will provide an explanation to the public and all factions, and it will also lull the true mastermind into a false sense of security. We will continue the investigation covertly, step by step, without rushing."
"Understood! Then... Wang Lan’s case report..."
"Seal and file it as S-level classified. You will draft another case report for public release."
"Understood!"
「Returning from the Tianjian Bureau, it was dusk.」
After eating dinner in the canteen and returning to the dormitory, Wang Lan suddenly felt a wave of emptiness. Counting the days, it had been more than ten days since he last saw Jiang Xinyu. Suddenly, he missed her deeply.
He quickly typed a message on his phone, but after a moment’s thought, he deleted it. Jiang Xinyu was training with the Qing Emperor, and every minute was precious.
Being guided by one of the Five Emperors for even a single day is a lifelong benefit,
Wang Lan mused.
She has the chance to train for a month; I daren’t disturb her for a single moment.
Back at the dormitory, he chatted and joked with his two roommates for a bit before heading to his room to sleep. Most of the skill points he’d saved up went into Flame Sword and Phantom Tracer.
Actually, given Wang Lan’s current combat strength, he was best suited to using Flash and Zanpakuto for instant kills. His lack of Star Power meant he could primarily function as a one-hit assassin. The reason for investing in Flame Sword was to prepare for learning the Infinite Fire Skill in the future.
As for Star Cloud Sword Dance, Crescent Arrow, and Thunder Snake, Wang Lan planned to improve them gradually. If conditions allowed in the future, these skills definitely warranted enhancement.
The Tianjian Bureau’s case report spread among the various factions of the Star Martial world overnight. Most powers were quite satisfied with the Bureau’s findings.
So, it was the Demon Clan’s doing? That makes sense. The despicability and shamelessness of the Demon Clan are deeply ingrained in people’s minds. How could our human race possibly have internal strife? With the Demon Clan’s invasion looming, humans should stand united. The Duanmu Family? They’re a disgrace! But most of the Duanmu Family members are still good.
Such were the prevailing sentiments.
Similarly, those aligned with the imperial powers also breathed a long sigh of relief. With the Demon Clan taking the blame, a great weight was lifted from their hearts.
In a quiet study, an elderly man with thinning hair and reading glasses slowly raised his head, removed his spectacles, and rubbed the corners of his eyes.
"Let this matter rest here," he said firmly. "Without my orders, no one is to act rashly."
"Yes! But since the Tianjian Bureau has pinned it on a Demon Clan spy, shouldn’t we be less tense now?" a voice asked.
"You know nothing!" the elderly man retorted. "What do you take the Tianjian Bureau for? The Tianjian Bureau is the Ministry of Defense’s most elite intelligence agency; every member is an elite among elites. Do you think the Tianjian Bureau is so easily fooled?
They claim it’s the Demon Clan, but do you really believe they’ve identified the Demon Clan as the true mastermind? They’re trying to lull us into a false sense of security. Pass this on: if anyone under you has dirty hands and the Tianjian Bureau gets wind of it, don’t blame me for being merciless."
"Yes!" The middle-aged man in a gray suit exited, his forehead drenched in sweat.
「Time flew by like a white steed glimpsed through a crack; in the blink of an eye, ten more days had silently slipped away.」
Over the past ten days, Wang Lan continued his fulfilling, routine life. It wasn’t until he saw a poster on Star Martial Academy of Modu City’s bulletin board proclaiming, "Heroes’ Expedition, Awaiting Your Return," that he realized the internship support season for third-year students was beginning.
The main focus for third-year students was internships and skill enhancement. If the first and second years were for accumulation, the third was for growth, and the fourth was for breakthroughs. First and second-year students at Star Martial Academy of Modu City rarely left the campus, but from the third year onward, time spent there drastically decreased. This was especially true for the fourth year, when students might only be on campus for a month or two.
Jiang Xinyu would be going to the Middle East to provide support with the senior students, which meant she was about to return.
Just as Wang Lan was thinking this, a familiar figure suddenly appeared at the edge of his vision.
Perhaps this is what they mean by telepathy—I was just thinking of you, and you appeared before me.
Jiang Xinyu slowly approached Wang Lan and naturally sank into his embrace.
After a long hug, the two parted. Wang Lan examined Jiang Xinyu closely. "Good, you haven’t tanned."
"We were training in the Folding Space, so how could I get tanned?" Jiang Xinyu said with a playful laugh. "I’ve made a lot of progress this past month. Besides my Star Martial level reaching the late Star Cloud stage, my application of Star Martial Skills and combat awareness have improved significantly. The Qing Emperor even taught me a Star Martial Sword Skill, Moon Brilliance. I’ve never seen such a beautiful sword technique!"
"You’ve learned the Star Martial Skill the Qing Emperor taught you, but what about the ones I taught you?" Wang Lan asked.
"I’ve become very proficient with Crescent Arrow and Phantom Tracer. Star Cloud Sword Dance isn’t really suitable for me, so I didn’t spend much time on it. In just one month, this is the fastest progress I’ve ever made in my life."
"I’m not blaming you... Did you just get back?"
"Yes! I came back with Ruoyun."
"Come on, let’s go out."
"Go where?"
"My place."
Jiang Xinyu had always known Wang Lan had a home in Modu City, though she had never visited. With Phoenix Plaza so close to Star Martial Academy of Modu City, Wang Lan could have easily commuted. However, since Jiang Xinyu boarded at the academy, he chose to live on campus too.
If the two of us lived off-campus together... Hmm? That’s an idea worth considering.
In Wang Lan’s room, Jiang Xinyu felt a bit restless.
Previously, she wouldn’t have felt the slightest shyness bursting into his room and flipping his covers, let alone just sharing a room with him. But ever since they officially became a couple, she found herself less bold in his presence.
Wang Lan, on the other hand, was his usual self.
He proudly displayed the bounty of treasures he had prepared for Jiang Xinyu over the past month, spreading them across the bed.
"Look," he said, "these red ones are Purple Flame Arrows for long-range attacks. This is Meteor Fire Rain, and these are Earth Erupting Magma. The white ones are Song of Life. I’ve prepared mid-grade and low-grade Soul Beads for you too.
I don’t know how long you’ll be gone, so use them sparingly. Of course, don’t hesitate when you really need to use them."
Listening to Wang Lan’s earnest explanations, Jiang Xinyu’s face was filled with a blissful smile. As for his advice on using the items sparingly but without hesitation when needed, she hadn’t absorbed a single word.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Please Leave the Country
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 334: Please Leave the Country
Time we’re reluctant to part with always seems so fleeting. We used to think there was plenty of time ahead, but only upon reflection do we realize that what seemed like ordinary days were filled with many missed moments of emotion.
That’s exactly how Wang Lan felt at the moment, as he took Jiang Xinyu to the airport, watching her walk step by step towards the gathering crowd with reluctance. At that moment, Wang Lan wanted nothing more than to call out to Jiang Xinyu and embrace her tightly in his arms once again.
How long had they known each other... Seventeen years, wasn’t it?
The memories of the past, now like a series of still photographs, lingered in Wang Lan’s mind—chasing butterflies together on the grassy slopes, racing on bicycles along streets lined with cherry blossoms, flying kites against the setting sun, and so much more.
From elementary school, to middle school, to high school, and now to college.
He and Jiang Xinyu had never been apart.
But this time, she was about to leave the warm and safe Jade Country to head to the Middle East, a land filled with gunsmoke and rampaging Exotic Beasts, to join the battlefield.
No matter how much Wang Lan prepared for Jiang Xinyu, it would never be enough in his heart.
"Xinyu!" Wang Lan suddenly called out without thinking.
Jiang Xinyu stopped in her tracks abruptly, turned around, and threw herself into Wang Lan’s embrace, holding him tightly.
"I’m kind of reluctant to leave."
"Then just stay."
"I’m just kidding with you. If I backed out now, I’d be marked as a deserter."
"You must be careful and come back safely."
"Don’t worry, I will. Same to you. I hope when I get off the plane, you’ll be the first person I see."
"Okay!"
With a final sense of reluctance, Jiang Xinyu ran back to join the team. She feared that if she didn’t hurry back, she wouldn’t be able to resist looking back or keep from crying.
There were many more pairs like Wang Lan and Jiang Xinyu. Most Star Martial Warriors left their most beautiful memories and purest love in college. Once they truly stepped onto the battlefield, they lived each day with extreme caution, hardly in a position to entertain thoughts of love.
The airplane taxied down the runway and slowly ascended into the sky. Wang Lan waved helplessly at the departing plane.
「Later that night.」
Wang Lan received a call from Jiang Xinyu. They had successfully arrived in Keli Country and settled in. Their support work would start tomorrow, and their phones would be turned off.
With Jiang Xinyu gone, he missed her!
Wang Lan immersed himself in his studies and work, hoping that the heavy academic load would dispel the longing in his heart. As it turned out, a study god is still a study god. A fully invested Wang Lan, with his skill points maxed out in studies, was terrifyingly efficient.
Apart from developing the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine, Wang Lan spent his days in the library, seldom seen by He Jing and Ming Guodong. There were even a few times when they both suspected that Wang Lan might have joined some overseas support mission and had run off without a trace.
However, Wang Lan had already quietly started studying the subjects of his sophomore year and even planned to secure all his sophomore year’s Academic Credits before the end of his freshman year. Although Wang Lan didn’t lack Academic Credits, he never forgot the advice from his seniors to never let go of any opportunity to earn every Academic Credit available.
"Hello, Mr. Ming! Is there a mission? Great, I’ll be right there."
Wang Lan, who was studying in the library, suddenly received a call from Ming Baiye. After hanging up, he closed his books without a second thought and rode his electric scooter to the Heavenly Sword Bureau.
He knocked on Ming Baiye’s office door. Ming Baiye was busy with paperwork. After Wang Lan sat for a minute, Ming Baiye finally finished his tasks.
"Wang Lan, according to the Heavenly Sword Bureau’s investigation, the Duanmu Family’s smuggling of Space Stones is closely linked to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"Kingdom of Ice and Snow? Their country is in such a state, and they still have the inclination to smuggle Space Stones?" Wang Lan exclaimed in surprise.
The current situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow... Although there was little domestic reporting, Wang Lan had a general understanding through Xiao Ai. This country, except for their lives, had virtually nothing.
Once, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was a rich and beautiful small nation. Its unique geographical environment created this emerald of snow and ice. The stark contrast of its environment led to many extraordinary natural wonders.
Twenty years ago, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was a very famous tourist destination. Areas radiated by active volcanoes in the country enjoyed spring-like conditions all year round, with an average temperature of twenty-five degrees, allowing crops to be harvested three to four times a year.
Furthermore, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow possessed abundant energy mineral resources—a type more efficient and cleaner than oil. However, these resources were primarily concentrated deep within the earth’s core, beyond current technological reach for mining. They were extremely rare near the surface, with discoveries barely amounting to one-thousandth of existing oil resources.
Only the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had surveyed reserves exceeding ten times the amount of exploitable reserves found globally. Therefore, barring any accidents, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow could have thrived by selling energy resources alone, allowing everyone in the country to live luxuriously.
Regrettably, all of that was destroyed by a sudden event twelve years ago.
Twelve years ago, a Different Dimensional Space suddenly opened in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. The Exotic Beasts emerging from it all possessed the bizarre attributes of ice and poison. These beasts surged out, ravaging the land, leaving nothing but ice and snow wherever they went, with no grass growing.
After paying a heavy price, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow successfully repelled the Exotic Beasts. But then, a second Different Dimensional Space opened. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow immediately sought international aid. However, since these were Poisonous Beasts, the peacekeeping forces sent by the International Security Council suffered heavy losses. Many nations also dispatched aid, only for their teams to suffer great losses and be forced to return.
Gradually, the once prosperous and beautiful Kingdom of Ice and Snow was destroyed by the Exotic Beasts, losing all its economic sources in just five years.
With Exotic Beasts running rampant, no foolhardy tourists dared visit the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. The land, eroded by toxins, could no longer grow a single crop—not even weeds. Similarly, energy mines could not be exploited.
Having lost its sources of income, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow could only rely on international aid to survive. According to recent rumors, it seems the people of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow have started eating dirt.
You’re telling me a country in such a state still has the inclination to smuggle Space Stones? Smuggling Space Stones is strictly prohibited by the United Nations, and if discovered, the United Nations will impose severe sanctions. With the current situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, the United Nations could easily wipe them out before next spring with just the flick of a finger.
"In fact, it is indeed coming from there, and we have also negotiated with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. They did not deny it. But they denied that it was the government’s doing. In the past ten years, anti-government armed forces have emerged in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and it could be their doing. Moreover, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow might just be a transit point; after all, this route would avoid most checkpoints and directly reach the northern sea of Jade Country."
"Is that so?
The more tumultuous the country, the more likely such things are to occur. But... what does this have to do with my mission?
" As he spoke, Wang Lan suddenly looked at Ming Baiye in astonishment. "Mr. Ming, you’re not going to send me to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to investigate, are you? I’m still in school."
"To my knowledge, you are soon to be sent to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
Wang Lan looked at Ming Baiye, stunned.
...
"Do you remember the last expedition led by Nangong Meng? Although there was an accident, the mission of the expedition was not called off. Ever since you developed the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine, many countries have sent out letters of request for help to Jade Country. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is at the forefront.
"The country has dispatched twelve expedition teams to various nations ravaged by Poisonous Beasts, aiming to retrieve toxin samples to produce vaccines. The situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is the most severe. If it’s not addressed immediately, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow will soon be completely wiped from existence.
"This time the Kingdom of Ice and Snow has paid a heavy price and specifically requested you. There’s no choice; you are currently the only one who has mastered the editing of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine."
"Nonsense, a few of my seniors at school have barely gotten a grip on it, and didn’t the Angel Kingdom also announce that they have mastered it?"
"But you are the authority; they only trust you."
This reason... Wang Lan couldn’t refute. But... deep down Wang Lan wasn’t all that keen on going abroad. Wang Lan wasn’t the type of hot-blooded individual; if his own country needed him, Wang Lan would be duty-bound to help, but as for harboring a sense of global responsibility, Wang Lan lacked such enthusiasm.
Moreover, just hearing about the situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow made it clear that it was a high-risk zone. As for his own strength, he could barely survive in medium-difficulty dungeons. As for hard ones, Wang Lan felt it was better to cultivate and lie low.
Besides, there were so many Star Martial Toxins in the academy waiting for him—experience points, skill points—enough for Wang Lan to farm for a year. Plus, the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record Qi Cultivation Chapter that he had upgraded to Gold level allowed him to see experience points rise every day. Breaking through to the Galaxy Stage before the end of the year was no issue, so why bother with this mess?
"What’s the matter? You don’t seem too keen? This isn’t like your usual style," Ming Baiye said.
"Mr. Ming, I’m not some brainless teen with a one-track mind. The situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is already very dangerous. I think staying alive is quite nice."
"What if the country needs you to go?" Ming Baiye asked seriously.
"Then, of course, I am duty-bound," Wang Lan quickly stood at attention and responded.
What else could I do when you put it so seriously?
"Energy is the basic driving force for a country’s development," Ming Baiye continued, his tone grave. "Jade Country, although vast and rich in resources, is sorely lacking when it comes to energy. White Eagle Country has signed strategic alliances with the twelve Middle Eastern nations, ensuring a steady stream of energy. If we can save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, Jade Country will no longer face an energy crisis."
Now that it had come to this, what else could Wang Lan say? Aiding the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was related to the century-long plan of Jade Country; no price was too high to pay.
"My people have already gone ahead to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow and have taken over the role of the Duanmu Family’s agent in Jade Country. The Duanmu Family’s affairs have been forcibly suppressed, and the international community is unaware."
"Mr. Ming, our Heavenly Sword Bureau focuses on internal matters, not external ones. What business is it of ours if other countries smuggle Space Stones? Do we really need to be so persistently after them?"
"The Duanmu Family controls just one of the larger routes in this Space Stone smuggling network, but they are not the only ones. In recent years, smaller Different Dimensional Spaces have been opening frequently, and we cannot afford to ignore this trend.
"So, this time we are going directly to the source to extinguish it. Rest assured, your role during the visit is merely to be on standby; there’s no need for you to get involved in the action. In fact, we won’t be directly involved either.
"We only need to find the source, then inform the United Nations to dispatch personnel to eradicate it. This mission is just a secondary concern. Had you not been coincidentally heading to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, I wouldn’t have burdened you with it."
"Fine... I’ll take it on."
"I’ll send you the method to contact our people a little later."
Returning from the Heavenly Sword Bureau, Wang Lan dived back into the library as if he knew nothing.
"Wang Lan, Wang Lan, if you hear this, please come to the Dean’s office immediately. The Dean has something to discuss with you," the small speaker next to Wang Lan in the library suddenly called out, leaving him stunned.
"Wang Lan, you heard correctly."
"Alright!" Wang Lan pointed at the camera above him.
This must be Yu Ruoyun’s peculiar sense of humor.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Bloodline Ah, Awesome Ah
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 335: Bloodline Ah, Awesome Ah
"Wang Lan, come, take a look at this." Eld Di enthusiastically invited Wang Lan to sit down as Yu Ruoyun handed him a file.
"Energy Stone Application Assessment... global reserves distribution of Energy Stones, the stockpile of Energy Stones in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s diplomatic strategy..."
Even to someone as politically clueless as Wang Lan, these assessment reports clearly indicated that securing the Kingdom of Ice and Snow meant securing Jade Country’s rapid development for the next two hundred years.
Two hundred years? It had been less than eighty years since Jade Country rose from the ruins. One could only imagine how powerful it would become after two hundred years of rapid development; Wang Lan could figure that out even with his knees.
Thus, at this moment, there was only one thought in Wang Lan’s mind: the Country of Frost is our long-lost brother, separated for thousands of years; it is essential to reintegrate the Country of Frost into our lineage.
"Wang Lan, what are your thoughts after reading this?"
"When will we recover the Country of Frost?" Wang Lan blurted out what was on his mind unconsciously.
"Recover?" Yu Ruoyun was slightly taken aback, then suddenly laughed lightly.
"Wang Lan, Jade Country is a peace-loving nation; you must not speak carelessly in the future. This is especially true when traveling abroad, as every word and action represents the national image. You must be careful."
"Is the Dean asking me to go to the Country of Frost?"
"Yes! The Country of Frost is eagerly hoping for Jade Country’s assistance, and in line with the demeanor and responsibility of a great nation, we have no reason to refuse their request. I plan to dispatch one hundred senior students and thirty leading teachers to support the Country of Frost. You and Ruoyun are also among these volunteers."
Eld Di’s tone left no room for negotiation, making the decision for Wang Lan. Of course, showing Wang Lan those assessment reports never implied the possibility of refusal.
"Ruoyun is going too?" Wang Lan asked in surprise, glancing at Yu Ruoyun.
"What do you mean? In just one month’s absence, have you become so arrogant?" Yu Ruoyun snorted coldly without missing a beat. In terms of ability, she was more than capable of overpowering Wang Lan, wasn’t she?
"It’s not that I’ve become arrogant, but just one month ago, someone nearly got ambushed and killed. The wound hasn’t even scarred yet."
"The last time was an accident, and I won’t give anyone that chance again. Besides, this is a trip abroad, and with so many teachers and classmates around me overseas, the mastermind behind the scenes won’t have the opportunity to strike."
"I am principally against Ruoyun’s participation, but I won’t oppose her if she insists. But Wang Lan, you definitely must participate. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow specifically requested you."
"Understood! When will it be?"
"Next week. Shortly, a batch of Star Martial Toxins will be sent to you, and you must quickly develop a vaccine for your aunt to urgently begin production."
"Alright, then I’ll take my leave now."
"Wait! Because of your invention of the Toxin Vaccine, as well as your outstanding contributions to all humanity, the International Security Council has specially awarded you the Angel Medal. Initially, they invited you to the City of Angels to receive the award, but due to the conflict in your schedule, I declined on your behalf and asked them to mail the certificate and medal here."
As he spoke, he pulled out a metal box from the drawer and placed it in front of Wang Lan. "In addition to the medal, there is an S-class Star Martial Skill, the Holy Shield! It is hailed as the strongest defensive S-class Star Martial Skill."
"Schedule conflict?"
"That was just our excuse to decline. The City of Angels... how should I put it? They can be despicable, and we feared they wouldn’t let you return once you went there."
"The City of Angels would dare to assassinate me?" Wang Lan asked in surprise.
"They wouldn’t go that far, but the City of Angels has inherited a very strange Star Martial Skill called Divine Blessing, which can forcibly change a person’s will," Yu Ruoyun stated plainly. "Fifty years ago, the White Eagle Country’s Unparalleled Knight was invited to support the City of Angels and ended up being converted by their so-called god, relinquishing his citizenship in the White Eagle Country to join the City of Angels. Under normal circumstances, the City of Angels would not stoop to such despicable acts, but if they encounter talents that they desperately need, there’s no guarantee they wouldn’t. Back then, the City of Angels suffered from the rampage of Demons, and the Unparalleled Knight was immune to the curse of evil spirits and perfectly countered them. Each time they requested the Unparalleled Knight, they had to pay a significant price. So they went all out and used the Divine Blessing."
"Such things happen either never or excessively. Since the City of Angels was willing to award you the Angel Medal, you are highly coveted in their eyes."
"So, it’s like Kotoamatsukami? And the White Eagle Country just let it slide? That doesn’t sound like their style at all."
"Afterwards, of course, the City of Angels paid a substantial price, and the White Eagle Country didn’t dare to wage war against God’s Country. An Unparalleled Knight was not worth instigating a war for the White Eagle Country. For the White Eagle Country, exchanging the Unparalleled Knight for those benefits was worth it. But for Jade Country, you are invaluable."
"Thank you, Dean, for the high regard." Wang Lan accepted the iron box containing a milky white Soul Bead and a dazzlingly shiny medal.
"Has the Soul Bead been checked?"
"Eld Ci had already inspected it. Indeed, a slight modification had been made. They added a psychological suggestion to make you yearn for God’s Country. Hehehe... Eld Ci effortlessly erased it. You can use it with peace of mind."
"Alright, then... If there is nothing else, Eld Di, I will take my leave."
"Hmm."
Wang Lan left with the metal box, his face a mixture of confusion and amusement. After Wang Lan had developed the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine and his fame skyrocketed, he was rewarded with three million experience points, allowing him to level up to Star Cloud Tier Seven in one go.
Back then, the internet was already predicting that I might win some international award. Later, the Tianjian Bureau awarded me the medal for outstanding contributions to all humanity, and I thought this was that international award. But the real grand prize turned out to be this.
The Kingdom of God, the City of Angels! This nearly mythical realm, where hundreds of millions firmly believe in the existence of a True God and in real angels, holds an extraordinary status around the world.
The Heaven God Sect is the most widespread religious sect on the planet with the most followers. Even many scientists, who are supposed to be atheists, are believers in the Heaven God Sect.
God’s Country, founded upon religion, may not have been established for long, but its heritage is by no means inferior to that of the old powers of the Five Constants. Moreover, nearly all authoritative scientific awards are established by God’s Country.
Jade Country also has its own science awards, but their credibility cannot compare to that of God’s Country.
Furthermore, God’s Country possesses the most extensive collection of Star Martial Skills in the world, which is one of the reasons why Star Martial Warriors from various nations flock to it. God’s Country accepts dual nationality and is open to immigrants. As long as you are talented, God’s Country welcomes you.
From this point of view, the Heaven God Sect is far superior to Buddhism. The Heaven God Sect truly achieves inclusiveness and salvation for all beings—once you come, you’re one of us.
Upon returning home, Wang Lan first picked up the Angel Medal. His taut face finally relaxed, his mouth splitting into an enormous grin.
Yet another special medal, a special medal that can be sacrificed.
Among the system rewards, experience points and skill points are essentials, just like food and water, while sacrifice-worthy medals are like gourmet delicacies.
Especially with lottery draws, which are like gambling, you never know what surprises you’ll get. Unlike gambling, where you have a high chance of ending up empty-handed, with draws, you are sure to get something.
"Sacrifice-worthy item detected, would you like to sacrifice it?"
"Yes!"
The scene before his eyes suddenly distorted, and a golden carousel appeared before Wang Lan’s eyes.
Winning the Zanpakuto was an unexpected pleasure for Wang Lan, but what he had wanted even more last time was the Bumblebee, which he barely missed. It can drive and fight, doesn’t consume fuel or require charging—truly a man’s dream.
Unfortunately, this time as the carousel spun, Wang Lan seldom saw scenes from sci-fi movies. Instead, there were mostly cartoons he had watched as a child and adult animations he had seen as a youth.
The carousel gradually came to a stop, but the image that it fixed on was... a lollipop drawn by Stephen Chow?
Dammit! Even if you were going to draw from Kung Fu Hustle, you could have given me the Buddha Palm! Why give me a hand-drawn lollipop?
Suddenly, a stream of information poured into Wang Lan’s mind, and for a moment, his expression was frozen.
It was a false alarm; not a lollipop. However, Wang Lan could never have guessed that the image with circles upon circles was the mark of The Whirlpool Clan.
The bloodline of The Whirlpool Clan! This was what he had garnered using the Angel Medal. What is The Whirlpool Clan’s bloodline known for? Remarkable healing abilities, extraordinary amounts of chakra, red hair?
Compared to the bloodline of the Six Tao Immortal, or the Uchiha and Senju clans, it seemed somewhat inferior, but having an extraordinary amount of chakra and using it well could also make you a legendary warrior.
This world is not the Fire Shadow World; naturally, there’s nothing like chakra here. But Star Power works much the same.
The instant Wang Lan completed the lottery draw, the bloodline that was exchanged through the sacrifice had already appeared on the system interface. A new tab, Bloodline, had emerged on his character page.
Focusing his spiritual power on the bloodline icon, the bloodline description instantly appeared in Wang Lan’s view.
"The Whirlpool Clan bloodline possesses extraordinary vitality, innate prodigious Star Power, and Star Power regeneration ability, with endurance boosted to an almost game-breaking degree—Mom won’t have to worry about me running out of mana."
Since when did you become so cheeky?
Wang Lan muttered to himself.
At that moment, he looked at the bloodline page and fell into deep contemplation.
This system wasn’t always consistent. Although it has never told me I could unlock more functions or given me any conditions for upgrades, it’s so low-key and silent that most of the time I forget it even exists. But ever since it was activated, it has been evolving, constantly unlocking more abilities. At first, I had no attributes, then I unlocked the Attribute module. Then medals, ranks, certificates, and so on were added, followed by the Cultivation Technique page, and now the Bloodline page has appeared.
All these clues made Wang Lan delve into how much help the system had really given him.
I initially thought Star Martial Skills would be my fundamental reliance for the future, but now that the Cultivation Technique page has appeared, I realize Star Martial Skills are just a few isolated moves learned from Cultivation Techniques—an incomplete version of something already incomplete.
With the appearance of bloodline, I now realize that Cultivation Techniques may not be the ultimate trump card. Everyone who has read web novels knows that a bloodline is the ultimate foundation of strength. No matter how good the technique is, without the right bloodline, you don’t even meet the conditions to learn it.
Bloodline is like talent; Cultivation Techniques are like resources. Even the best resources are wasted without talent.
The Whirlpool Clan’s bloodline has arrived; can the bloodline of the Six Tao Immortal be far behind? Besides Fire Shadow, there are so many sci-fi movies: Thor’s bloodline, the Kryptonian bloodline... or even the Saiyan bloodline would be barely acceptable!
Fuck, I can’t think anymore! If I keep this up, my mind will break!

chapters.title: Chapter 336: The Mutating Star Martial Toxins
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 336: The Mutating Star Martial Toxins
After what seemed an eternity, the genetic modification was finally complete. Describing Wang Lan’s feeling during this transformation process...
It was as if his body was gradually turning into a turbo engine.
At the site of his heart, a robust vitality surged, transforming cellular energy into Star Power. The outcome was directly reflected: Wang Lan’s Star Power reserve had increased tenfold.
To make a comparison, Wang Lan previously could only unleash Earth Surge Lava once, but now he could do so ten times. The increase in his Star Power reserve also led to an increase in the Solar Seal’s storage capacity. Although it couldn’t store an additional amount equal to his current total Star Power reserve, storing half that amount posed no problem.
S-level Star Martial Skills were so potent that even Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warriors wouldn’t dare use them unless absolutely necessary. This was especially true for powerful S-level Star Martial Skills like Earth Surge Lava.
Should they fail to achieve results and exhaust their Star Power in the process, it could be fatal.
The ability to consecutively cast five S-level Star Martial Skills is the Star Power benchmark for the Star Sea Stage. After acquiring the bloodline of The Whirlpool Clan, Wang Lan could now unleash it ten times, yet he was only at the Star Cloud Stage. In a sense, Wang Lan’s Star Power had become extraordinary. Although it wasn’t as monstrously high as Xiao Zi’s, his previous weakness in Star Power capacity was now compensated.
The three sacrifices had transformed Wang Lan to a profound degree. The first, the Phoenix Saint Cloth, had enhanced Wang Lan’s defensive capabilities. Though it was now somewhat outpaced by Wang Lan’s current strength, it had been invaluable assistance when he was still at the Star Shine Stage.
The Zanpakuto compensated for Wang Lan’s shortcomings in close combat.
Even though Wang Lan’s Basic Skills had reached the Gold level, the highest attainable by ordinary people, were his opponents ever ordinary? Never! Which of the Demon Clan’s elite spies didn’t possess Gold-level close combat skills?
Then there was Wei Zheng, whom he had encountered before, whose Talented Skills were Unpredictable and Swift. Against speed that transcended dimensions, even the most impressive fighting moves were powerless.
Basic Skills are, after all, fundamental and hold no advantage against Star Martial body techniques. When an opponent struck with a sword imbued with an elemental attack, you dared not make a direct block. This held true no matter how refined your swordsmanship or sharp your sword skill.
But the Zanpakuto changed that, allowing Wang Lan to hold his ground in close combat. Once the Sword of Light was initiated, it could morph into any form of attack. The number of variations and their power depended entirely on Wang Lan’s imagination.
With his Gold-level swordsmanship and Close Combat Sword Skill complementing the Sword of Light’s initiation, and further augmented by Phantom Tracer,
Wang Lan couldn’t imagine any remaining weaknesses in his close-combat abilities.
Now, having obtained the bloodline of The Whirlpool Clan, even his deficiency in long-range Star Martial Skill confrontations had been rectified.
At that moment, Wang Lan felt an overwhelming urge to stand atop the academy, roar to the heavens, and ask, "Who else dares to challenge me?"
Calming his emotions, Wang Lan slowly turned his head to look at the medium-grade Soul Bead inside the iron box.
It was a spotless Soul Bead. Had he not known that it contained the Holy Shield Star Martial Skill, he might have mistaken it for some Medical Star Martial Technique.
He picked up the Soul Bead, and it shattered instantly. A stream of information flowed into Wang Lan’s mind.
"Detectable learnable Star Martial Skill. Do you wish to spend one thousand skill points to learn it?"
"Yes!"
The skill points were spent, and a brand-new Star Martial Skill icon appeared on his Star Martial Skill page.
Holy Shield, an S-level Light Series Star Martial Skill. The Light Series is a variant of the Solar Series and is an exceptionally rare attribute. Even in God’s Country, where the Light is worshipped, Star Martial Warriors who awaken the Light Series are few and far between.
No wonder the City of Angels was so generous as to send an S-level Star Martial Skill. It was because the Light Series was too scarce.
The three great Light Series Star Martial Skills were Holy Sword, Holy Shield, and Divine Light. Very few people learned them, yet their fame was immense, largely because films and dramas were very fond of featuring these three S-level Star Martial Skills. In the hands of protagonists in these stories, these three skills even possessed the power to slay gods.
The Holy Sword possessed indomitable power. The Holy Shield offered divine protection.
When Wang Lan opened his eyes, he had instinctively grasped the power and usage of the Holy Shield. He gently extended his hand. A light began to condense before him, instantly forming a disc-like mirror of light in his palm.
The Holy Shield had the characteristic of blocking all physical, elemental, and poison-type attacks; it could even defend against attacks of mysterious attributes. Of course, this was contingent on deploying the Holy Shield in advance and successfully intercepting the attack.
For defensive Star Martial Skills, Wang Lan already had the Gate of The Underworld. Its defensive capabilities had never disappointed him. But the two had different applications. The Gate of The Underworld could only defend against large-scale attacks from a fixed direction.
The Holy Shield, however, was wielded in Wang Lan’s hand, allowing him to flexibly block attacks coming from any direction.
The Holy Shield in his left hand, the Sword of Light in his right... perfect.
After stowing away the award certificate, he opened the cabinet door. Unbeknownst to him, the cabinet he had reserved for medals and award certificates was already brimming with them.
Less than two years, yet so fulfilling.
Back at school, as soon as he arrived at the medical department, he was informed that the Star Martial Toxin sample from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had been delivered.
Editing Star Martial Toxin Vaccines had become second nature for Wang Lan. Without hesitation, he decomposed the Star Martial Toxins, formulated the corresponding code in his mind, and then wrote it down.
In just half an hour, the editing for the first Star Martial Toxin was successfully completed.
However, when the first Star Martial Toxin Vaccine formula was complete, his mind did not prompt him that he had finished editing a Star Martial Toxin, nor were there any rewards of experience points or skill points.
This defied common sense.
Wang Lan immediately reviewed the code he had edited, checking it three times without finding any issues.
"How is it?" Teacher Sun Xing asked eagerly, approaching Wang Lan, who was scrutinizing the code with a furrowed brow.
"The vaccine code for the Star Martial Toxin should be correct... but... there’s still something wrong. Although I don’t know what the issue is."
"What’s the issue?"
"Didn’t I just say I don’t know where the problem lies?"
Sun Xing was left speechless by Wang Lan’s retort for a long moment. However, the sample sent from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow this time was extremely important, which was why Sun Xing was closely monitoring Wang Lan’s vaccine development.
"Perhaps... we should produce a sample vaccine first? To see how it goes?"
"Alright!"
Through a fax, the vaccine code was transmitted to the Jiayi Biotech Company, located in the isolated safe zone of Suzhou Park.
"Boss, the Modu City Star Martial Academy has sent another batch for sampling, specially marked as urgent."
"Got it, I’ll handle it personally. By the way, what were you saying earlier?"
"The advance payment of seven billion Green Currency from White Eagle Country has arrived. They’re asking when the three hundred types of vaccines can be delivered."
"Reply to him that the earliest will be next March," Wang Qi said, standing up, putting on protective clothing, and walking out of the office.
"Boss, White Eagle Country has proposed building a branch factory in Bailan State..."
"Jiayi Biotech has no plans to open global factories yet."
"They’ll sue us under antitrust laws..."
"I’ve already published the formulas. Whether they can learn to produce it is a matter of their capability. God’s Country has already replicated the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine. What monopoly can he sue me for? I’ve given them everything on a silver platter; do they expect me to spoon-feed them too?"
The secretary paused, watching Wang Qi’s departing figure with admiration blooming on their face.
The boss is so commanding!
The Star Martial Toxin Vaccine samples were completed that same day, and five vaccine doses were sent directly to the Modu City Star Martial Academy by helicopter. As soon as the vaccines arrived, the academy’s medical department began testing.
Wang Lan, although not directly involved in the experiments, watched attentively from the sidelines. He wouldn’t have bothered to observe the testing of a regular vaccine. But this was different; the system hadn’t issued a reward, which made Wang Lan feel somewhat uneasy.
"Test Subject One injection complete. Physical condition stable. Proceeding with toxin exposure test."
"Test Subject One data stable. No apparent symptoms of poisoning."
"Test Subject Two injection complete. Physical condition stable. Proceeding with toxin exposure test."
"Test Subject Two data stable. No apparent symptoms of poisoning."
As the data for each subject was announced, Sun Xing secretly breathed a sigh of relief and glanced somewhat reproachfully at Wang Lan beside him.
Isn’t the vaccine perfectly fine?
But Wang Lan’s brow furrowed slightly.
The test subjects’ feedback is normal, so why wasn’t there a notification for completing the vaccine editing and no reward issued?
"BEEP! BEEP! BEEP! Test Subject Five physical data abnormal! Test Subject Five showing clear signs of poisoning! Test Subject Five’s immune system rapidly collapsing! Test Subject Five exhibiting severe poisoning reaction!"
The sudden turn of events threw everyone into a flurry of activity.
Sun Xing stared blankly at the scene unfolding before him. "This is the same batch of vaccines, and they were exposed to the same Star Martial Toxin. Could vaccine number five have been mixed up? Quick, call Jiayi Technology! Ask if they sent the wrong vaccine for number five!"
"Hold on. First, analyze the composition of vaccine number five and compare it with the previous four."
The experts in the medical department quickly sprang into action.
"Director Sun, the composition of vaccine number five is identical to numbers four and three. It is indeed the same vaccine."
The medical department of the Modu City Star Martial Academy had achieved significant results. Consequently, its equipment and personnel were now top-notch, and high-tech equipment made analysis very simple.
Although it wasn’t as convenient as Wang Lan’s Universal Decomposition, the speed was not slow at all.
"
The same... How could this be? The same Star Martial Toxin, the same vaccine... why were the first four tests fine, while only the fifth subject had a problem? Could it be related to the subject’s constitution?
" Sun Xing muttered in confusion.
"The Star Martial Toxin has mutated!" a low voice suddenly interjected.
"Vice President Han!"
"Vice President Han!"
An elderly man with a full head of silver hair walked over briskly. This was Han Gongting, the medical department’s new leader and a top Medical Star Martial Warrior from Jade Country.
"Bring the virus sample from Subject Five for analysis."
"Give me a sample as well."
When it came to Star Martial Toxin Vaccines, Wang Lan was also an authority. Thus, even though he was just a freshman, his status in the medical department was extraordinary.
The analysis results came out quickly. "Vice President Han, they’re the same..."
"No, they’re not," Wang Lan’s low voice cut in. "Although the five toxin samples appear identical now, the sample I used to edit the vaccine at noon differs by 0.7 percent from these. Even a 0.1 percent difference is worlds apart, let alone 0.7 percent."
"So, this type of Star Martial Toxin can indeed mutate," Han Gongting concluded. "The virus hadn’t had time to mutate when the first four test subjects underwent toxin exposure. By the time it reached the fifth subject, the mutation had already occurred."
Hearing that the Star Martial Toxin could mutate, everyone’s expression turned grim, except for Wang Lan’s, which noticeably brightened.
At least he now knew why the system hadn’t registered the task as complete; he had found the reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 337: The Tragic Kingdom of Ice and Snow
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: Chapter 337: The Tragic Kingdom of Ice and Snow
"What should we do? The aid to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is about to start. If this happens..." Sun Xing was immediately sweating profusely from anxiety. However, he was the only one in the room who seemed anxious.
Researchers who did not understand the significance of the situation naturally would not feel anything, while a person like Vice President Han, who had weathered many storms, could keep his composure. It was only someone like Sun Xing, who knew something about the severity but did not fully understand, who was most on edge.
Vice President Han slowly turned to look at Wang Lan, a youth of only eighteen, but one whom Vice President Han had to take seriously.
"Wang Lan, what are your thoughts?"
"What else can I think? Just make another vaccine."
"But what if the virus mutates again?" Sun Xing asked anxiously.
"Then we make another one!"
The mutation of Star Martial Toxins is an objective reality that Wang Lan cannot prevent. The whole world’s research on Star Martial Toxins is still in its embryonic stage. Do you expect our current technology to stop a Star Martial Toxin from mutating? Even ordinary viruses can’t be stopped from mutating.
"The mutation of Star Martial Toxins is not an exception; a large portion of Star Martial Toxins will mutate. However, the mutation of Star Martial Toxins is different from the random mutation of traditional viruses. If we consider Star Martial Toxins as a form of Star Martial Skill, then their mutation is akin to different stages of increasing power.
Every time a Star Martial Toxin mutates, its lethality also erupts. For example, Test Subject Five, even after being injected with a similar vaccine, was quickly overcome by the mutated Star Martial Toxin." Vice President Han, with his wealth of experience, managed to invigorate everyone with his words, similar to a shot of adrenaline, dispelling their gloom.
"Normally, mutable Star Martial Toxins mutate two to four times. In the past, the standard procedure was to develop an antidote for each mutation and inject the corresponding antidote after detecting the Star Martial Toxin mutation. We can use the same approach."
"Creating a vaccine for a mutated strain is not difficult, but we just don’t know which mutation this is."
"The mutation of Star Martial Toxins does not have a time limit. It is in its initial form at the beginning, but mutation only triggers when it encounters difficulties during the conquest process. So, the first form is always the initial form.
The test subjects just underwent a toxin experiment. Since they had all been injected with the vaccine, the virus realized it was having difficulty conquering and thus mutated. It should now be on its second mutation."
"Is that so? Vice President Han, you are indeed like the North Star of the Medical Star Martial World. With you in charge, we can feel at ease." Sun Xing was quick to flatter him.
"When it comes to Star Martial Toxins, Wang Lan is the authority."
At this moment, Wang Lan was swiftly editing the new Star Martial Toxin vaccine. Because the Star Martial Toxin was a mutation based on the original, only parts of the new vaccine needed changes; the majority could still be used.
"Fax it over," Wang Lan said in haste the moment he put down his pen.
BEEP BEEP BEEP... In the president’s office of Jiayi Biotech Company, the pretty secretary connected the fax and took out the document from the machine.
"BXG008 Star Martial Toxin vaccine? Type B?"
"What has been sent from the Star Martial Academy of Modu City?"
"The vaccine samples were just delivered, and now, less than two hours later, Type B has arrived."
Wang Qi took the paper and looked at it closely, her eyes twinkling. "A mutated toxin. The BXG008 virus has mutated."
Within less than three hours, the new vaccine was delivered by helicopter to the academy, where another round of experiments was performed. The virus mutated again, and then Wang Lan wrote another vaccine.
Although this war had no smoke of gunpowder, it made many people feel the pressure and tension. A single mutation might be manageable. However, with four consecutive mutations, if one were to use the traditional method of making antidotes, it would require twenty-four hours of non-stop work. Even then, one couldn’t expect to produce an antidote for all four mutations in less than seven days.
But Wang Lan managed to produce five vaccines in one day. Jiayi Biotech couldn’t even manufacture them at half the speed Wang Lan was editing them.
Han Gongting is like the North Star of the Medical Star Martial World, but Wang Lan is the needle that stabilizes the sea of Star Martial Toxins.
Everyone’s hearts gradually settled, except for those of the few test subjects. Apart from Test Subject Five, who had been killed first by the mutated toxin, the rest of the trials were performed on animals.
But they watched as batch after batch of test animals, covered with white cloths, were carried out. Each time, they felt they could be next.
"Congratulations, Host, for developing a set of vaccines for the mutated Star Martial Toxins! Awarding 50,000 experience points and 10,000 skill points!"
After experiencing seven mutations, Wang Lan had edited the eighth Star Martial Toxin vaccine, and a long-awaited reward alert came. Wang Lan let out a light sigh of relief; finally, he had sorted it out.
No wonder no country dared to take on the aid request of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Bloody hell, it was because of the mutated Star Martial Toxins. Without Wang Lan developing vaccines, no matter how many people went, they would all be brought to their knees.
Of course, the rewards provided by a Star Martial Toxin that had mutated seven times were quite delightful: 50,000 experience points and 10,000 skill points. At this moment, Wang Lan felt an impulse.
Maybe I shouldn’t go to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow? Should I hunker down in the rear instead and develop vaccines for them? I could settle one in an entire day, level up in ten days, and then go gallivanting around once I reach the Galaxy Stage?
Of course, Wang Lan could only think about it in secret. Immediately after, Sun Xing came scurrying over with the second sample of Star Martial Toxins.
"Director Sun, it’s already twelve o’clock," Vice President Han said as he glanced at the clock indifferently.
"What? So soon?"
Not just Sun Xing, but nearly everyone had lost track of time. It seemed like just a moment ago, but they had already been working continuously for over ten hours.
"Let’s call it a day, everyone. We’ll work again tomorrow. You must all be hungry, right? Supper is on me."
Five types of samples were brought back from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and it was not only Jade Country that formed the survey team. However, after a few days, only Jade Country had confirmed they would come to aid.
What demonstrates the bearing of a great nation? What illustrates the grace of a great power?
Well, that was what the Jade Country news media touted.
Wang Lan had been busy for six straight days, producing a set of Star Martial Toxin vaccines almost every day. To be honest, the vision of the scientists who went to inspect the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was indeed sharp, as they had picked out the most difficult ones at a glance.
The sixth day was Wang Lan’s preparation time. After all, it was his first time going abroad on a mission, and he was a bit excited, so he went on a big shopping spree at the supermarket.
"Wang Lan, I can tolerate you buying replacement clothes, and even getting some local souvenirs to exchange for their local specialties. But what’s with buying so many compressed biscuits, canned foods, and instant noodles? We’re going there to help, and we’re considered honored guests in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Are you worried there won’t be food to eat?" Yu Ruoyun looked at Wang Lan’s overflowing shopping cart with a speechless expression.
