Yu Ruoyun was a woman, and a love for shopping is often considered a woman’s nature. This trait is said to originate from ancient times when women were responsible for gathering food, evolving over time. However, loving to shop didn’t necessarily mean loving to go to the supermarket.
Yu Ruoyun bumped into Wang Lan at the school gate. When she found out he was going shopping, she happily requested to go along. But now, it seemed as though Wang Lan was dragging her there.
"What if their food doesn’t agree with our stomachs? I asked the seniors, and they said one must always bring some food. You never know what kind of dark cuisine you’ll be served as an esteemed guest in the country you’re aiding.
"Like our neighbors in India; when a support team came back the year before last, just mentioning them made them feel nauseous. Or the aid teams to South Africa—have you heard of the insect feast? No? What about braised great ape, or grilled monkey?"
Yu Ruoyun turned pale after Wang Lan’s rant, snorted coldly, and rolled her eyes at him. She silently picked up a bag of bread, thought for a moment, then grabbed three more bags.
"Ruoyun, bread tastes good but takes up too much space. Compressed biscuits and instant noodles are better. They stave off hunger."
"Consider it my diet," Yu Ruoyun responded coldly.
The aid team, comprising students and teachers, totaled one hundred and twenty people and utilized a large passenger plane—an indulgence comparable to that of tycoons. Therefore, each student brought a fair amount of luggage, making Wang Lan’s two large bags not seem out of the ordinary.
The team was a mix of teachers and students, generally one teacher leading three students. The teachers were all at the Star Sea Stage, with most of the students at the Galaxy Stage. The deployment of thirty Star Sea Stage cultivators, along with the Galaxy Stage students, was more than enough to besiege a city.
But that wasn’t the full extent of the relief forces. In addition to the elites from the Star Martial Academy of Modu City, there were also one thousand volunteer soldiers from the Star Martial Army, dispatched from the northwestern military region, expected to arrive a day later than Wang Lan’s group.
On the plane, the leading teachers briefed the students about the situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. After all, this country was not well-known. If the last twenty years for Jade Country had been a history of thrilling ascendancy, then the figures for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had been in complete contrast.
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow was located to the northwest, with a territory only as large as three cities of Jade Country. Twelve years ago, when the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was known as the "City of Beauty," the total population was just seven million; now, having four million would be considered decent.
Twelve years ago, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow ranked among the top three in the global happiness index, a country as beautiful as a dream. But all of this was destroyed by the sudden emergence of Different Dimensional Spaces.
In such a tiny country, five large Different Dimensional Spaces appeared. Each Different Dimensional Space was swarming with Poisonous Beasts, numbering over an astonishing one hundred thousand in each.
If it had been any other small country, it would have undoubtedly been obliterated. It’s truly amazing that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow endured for twelve years under such hellish conditions, managing to hang on until Wang Lan made his timely appearance.
It must be said, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s persistence to survive exceeded the imagination of many countries around the world. Their desperate struggle to live and their tenacity left the students genuinely feeling that if they didn’t lend a hand, they would be overcome with guilt.
Moreover, the five Different Dimensional Spaces were extremely troublesome, distributed in five directions of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, virtually surrounding the entire country. The only way to enter the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was by airplane.
Originally, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow planned to relocate their entire population five years ago, but no country in the world was willing to take them in. Jade Country is vast and rich in resources. However, there was a problem: the races were different. What if the influx of these millions of Caucasian descendants turned the bloodline of Huaxia white or their eyes green?
White Eagle Country flatly refused. They only welcomed talent, not refugees. The Polar Bear Nation was itself in a precarious situation and didn’t even respond. When three of the five permanent members of the UN Security Council didn’t accept them, no other country could manage to accommodate them.
Eventually, the application was left unsettled, and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow continued to gasp for breath under the teeth and claws of the Exotic Beasts for another five years.

chapters.title: Chapter 338 Star Martial Skill Hits the Missile
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Chapter 338 Star Martial Skill Hits the Missile
In short, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is no easy place, and its Exotic Beasts are fiercely savage. We are rushing to their aid as saviors, to rescue the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
After arriving in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, it’s imperative to follow commands, as Jade Country has a comprehensive assistance plan in place.
The flight duration is fifteen hours; we’ll only arrive in the early hours of the morning. However, due to traveling westward and the time difference, it may still be noon when we arrive in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Having completed the briefing on precautions, the lead tactical instructor Longya directly assigned teams on the plane. Thirty Star Sea Stage tactical teachers were paired with ninety elite senior students, one teacher for every three students. Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun had already fought alongside the seniors against the Nine-layer Pagoda, so they were fairly acquainted with each other.
Wang Lan was part of the twelfth team, led by an instructor named Wu Shaohua, a dual-attribute Star Martial Warrior with fire and earth elements. Being a teacher from his own academy, Wang Lan was quite familiar with Wu Shaohua’s abilities.
Wu Shaohua graduated from the Xiangjiang Star Martial Academy and then served in the military. By the age of thirty, he broke through to the Star Sea Stage. Afterward, he was invited to Modu City Star Martial Academy as a tactical instructor. He had abundant combat experience, especially strong guerrilla combat skills in harsh environments.
His initial attribute was fire, and upon breaking through to the Galaxy Stage, he developed the earth attribute. He never developed any other attributes thereafter. He had already mastered the magma Star Martial Skill, a fusion of fire and earth, while at the Galaxy Stage.
Once he reached the Star Sea Stage, he completed the Magma Elementalization transformation. In combat mode, he became one with magma—magma was him. Among the thirty leading instructors, his strength was also at the top.
However, Wu Shaohua’s team had only Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun as members, which was an obvious favor.
Across the desolate land and continuous ice and snow, a white military vehicle trudged over the snow-covered road, swaying as it came. Perhaps due to the extreme cold, the engine suddenly cut out, bringing the vehicle to a wobbly halt.
Suddenly, a dozen white camouflage covers were flipped back from the snowy ground around the vehicle, revealing an equal number of armed militants in white attire. They carried firearms and pointed them at the stopped vehicle.
"I really dislike this sort of welcome ceremony," one said.
"I know, because this isn’t a welcome ceremony. Why would Jade Country send aid? You promised me no nation would dare aid the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, at least not until the end of this year. And now you’re telling us to take action right over the head of Jade Country? Do you think we’re no longer of any use and just sending us to our deaths?"
"Dear Qiu, calm down, calm down, this is an accident. The inspection team from the Twelve Nations all successfully brought back samples, and I’ve prepared five mutated Star Martial Toxins for Jade Country. Just think, five toxins capable of seven mutations, any nation would think twice before intervening, right?
"But... my God of Heaven, Jade Country is simply miraculous—they’ve actually managed to create a vaccine. And not just any vaccine, but one for all seven mutations of five different toxins.
"If I were the King, I would kneel and beg Jade Country for aid, even if it meant turning the Kingdom of Ice and Snow into a province of Jade Country. So, this was an accident."
"Then the original plan is off."
"No can do, the original plan has already commenced, and once started, it cannot be halted midway. If you insist on canceling it, then I can’t guarantee what accidents might happen in the Different Dimensional Space."
"What’s the capability of the forces Jade Country has sent this time?"
"Thirty leading teachers and ninety wet-behind-the-ears students with no real combat experience. Easy to handle, I believe in you!"
"Bullshit! Thirty leading teachers? Be clear, those are thirty tactical instructors from the Modu City Star Martial Academy, all at least at the Star Sea Stage in strength. Ninety students with no combat experience? Those are Modu City Star Martial Academy seniors, who have all been through three years of battle, each one with rich combat experience. This lineup could annihilate a small country in less than ten days!"
"Yes, they are indeed strong and have a formidable presence, but it’s different with you, my dear King. You are the Paradise Birds, a constant headache for the United Nations, which is powerless against you. And besides, aren’t they up in the sky? Isn’t the sky the divine domain of the Paradise Birds?"
"Fine, state your purpose for being here."
"I’m just telling you, the plan is non-negotiable, or our cooperation ends!"
"Got it, now get lost. If you’re not out of my sight in three minutes, I might not be able to resist killing you."
BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!—
While Wang Lan and the others were engaged in spirited conversation, the alarm on the plane suddenly sounded.
While the students were still confused, the instructors swiftly stood up and rushed to the cockpit.
"What’s going on?"
"Not good, we’ve been locked on by a missile," shouted the pilot, sweating profusely.
"What?" The group of instructors’ faces turned pale.
Star Martial Warriors are powerful, particularly those at the Star Sea Stage, for whom most conventional weapons pose no threat. But this immunity doesn’t mean they can stand still and be unharmed by conventional weapons. Rather, it means such weapons usually can’t hit Star Sea Stage Warriors.
In a Star Martial Warrior’s world, the strongest offense is useless if it fails to hit.
The Galaxy Stage can withstand the impact of bullets, but a rocket or grenade could turn a Galaxy Stage Warrior to dust. And missiles—aside from those at the level of the Five Emperors—no one else can withstand them.
If this were on the ground, they could simply run from an incoming missile. With a single flash, they could cover hundreds of meters and, by activating a defensive Star Martial Skill, they might emerge unscathed.
But now they were in the sky, with nowhere to run.
And even if they could run, what about the hundred students on the plane? These were the academy’s lifelines. Even if all the instructors died here, they had to ensure the safety of every student—it was their duty.
So, when they heard the plane was locked onto by a missile, their faces instantly turned grim.
This was a covert flight path. Apart from Jade Country and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, no one knew the plane’s route and takeoff time. How could there be a missile attack on them? Almost instantly, they thought of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"Is it possible to shake it off?"
"Sir, that’s a Punisher Missile we’re talking about, with a speed of Mach 6. There’s not a single plane in the world that can shake that off."
"What about evading it?"
"This is a large passenger airliner, not a fighter jet. Any abrupt evasive action could cause the plane to disintegrate mid-air. I can only make some minor evasive maneuvers... Not good, they’re coming."
Suddenly, several dots appeared on the plane’s radar sensor, rapidly approaching.
Upon seeing the number of these dots, the color drained from the pilot’s face.
"Twelve missiles—" His voice was a shrill crack, as if his throat was being torn apart.
"What do we do?"
"You evade; I’ll reinforce the plane’s defenses," Instructor Wen Liang barked, his figure flashing towards the inner wall of the cabin, slapping his palm against the aircraft’s fuselage.
Almost instantly, the instructor’s body turned a silver color, like liquid mercury. This liquid metal rapidly spread across the entire fuselage.
But the airplane was too large. Even as a Gold Attribute Star Martial Warrior at the Star Sea Stage, it was unlikely he could cover the entire aircraft with his Star Martial Skill.
Suddenly, the airplane dipped dramatically, and everyone inside lurched violently. Fortunately, since everyone had fastened their seat belts when the alarm sounded, no one was sent flying.
Wang Lan glanced out of the corner of his eye and saw the plane’s wing outside the window seemingly turn into actual wings and flap.
Right after, streaks of light flashed over the top of the plane.
Damn!
Wang Lan’s scalp tingled intensely. Even though those streaks of light only flashed by in a fraction of a second, he was certain he hadn’t misseen. If they weren’t UFOs, then they could only be missiles.
"The main cabin in the middle—" the pilot let out another roar.
BOOM—
A loud explosion resounded, and a burst of fire erupted on the airplane.
It’s over!
In that one-thousandth of a second, this thought crossed Wang Lan’s mind.
Indeed, it was over. The airplane had been hit by a missile. Given the plane’s armor, it was almost certain to disintegrate in mid-air.
However, the anticipated disintegration did not happen. Instead, a black carapace suddenly rose at the point of impact, firmly covering the outer wall of the airplane like a tortoise shell.
At the very last moment, the Gold Attribute teacher had conjured the protective armor. Although he saved the plane, he violently coughed up blood, his elementalized body weakening and slumping against the aircraft’s exterior.
Elementalization might change the structural makeup of a Star Martial Warrior’s body, but the elements used are still part of the warrior’s actual body. Using Elementalization to conjure up a metallic shield to block a missile was equivalent to taking the blow with his body.
"Wang Lan—" Wu Shaohua’s voice erupted.
"Coming!" Wang Lan immediately unbuckled his seat belt, his figure flashing towards the area outside the cockpit. Just then, the airplane started shaking violently again.
"What’s happening?"
"Sir, quickly remove the armor around the plane! You’re affecting the airflow," the pilot yelled, struggling to stabilize the airplane.
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH— Understood!"
The armor around the exterior of the plane vanished in a shimmer of light. But Wen Liang still dared not let his guard down. Of the dozen or so Punisher Missiles, only one had been successfully intercepted, and these missiles all had tracking capabilities.
Light shone brightly around Wang Lan as the Song of Life activated to quickly heal the instructor’s injuries.
"Instructor Wen, are you okay?"
"Took one hit, body damaged by thirty percent. But now it’s already recovered by ten percent... Not bad, not bad, kid, your Medical Star Martial Technique is no less effective than Vice President Han’s."
BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!— The urgent alarm sounded again. "Not good, they’re coming again."
"How many can you evade?"
"At most seven. But there are four I can’t evade."
"Report the positions of the four!"
"Wen, you’re going to die."
"Better me than all of us, right?"
"Fellow teachers, can’t we intercept the missiles?" Wang Lan hurriedly asked.
That question drew a few incredulous looks.
"With speeds over Mach 6, how can we intercept? We don’t even have time to activate Star Martial Skills."
"I’ll try it!"
Wang Lan didn’t wait for approval. In a flash, using Phantom Tracer, he appeared at the airplane’s cabin door. He quickly fastened a safety strap to his own belt and then hurriedly opened the door.
The moment the cabin door opened, everything loose inside was instantly sucked out of the airplane. If not for everyone being buckled up, they all would have been ejected along with the plane’s contents.
No sooner was he sucked out of the cabin than Wang Lan saw three dots whizzing towards the plane’s belly with terrifying speed.
"Dynamic vision, activate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 339 Survived
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Chapter 339 Survived
The intense pain seared Wang Lan’s right eye, giving him the sensation of an eyeball about to burst like an overinflated balloon.
Dynamic vision slowed everything down fifty-fold. Even at this reduced speed, missiles were still extremely fast, but fortunately, their agility was limited during high-speed movement.
Wang Lan lifted his hand, instantly predicting the trajectory of four missiles.
"Sword of Light—"
The Zanpakuto instantly appeared before Wang Lan, transforming into a cross-shaped sword of light. The moment his will commanded, four streaks of light flashed by.
Dynamic vision only captured the trails of the missiles; it did not slow their actual speed. So even when Wang Lan used his Star Martial Skills to intercept, the speed of the skills fired still appeared stationary to his eyes.
This was why a whole group of Star Sea realm powerhouses on the plane could do nothing about missiles flying at Mach six. Only something much faster than that could intercept them, and light definitely possessed that quality.
The Sword of Light could instantly switch between light and sword. As pure light, it had the speed of light but lacked the offensive power of a sword. When it turned into a sword, it would lose the properties of light.
"BOOM, BOOM, BOOM—"
Three explosions sounded, and the plane once again shook violently in the turbulent air.
I was still a moment too slow, only managing to intercept three missiles...
Wang Lan thought regrettably, but there was only one chance.
Unlike Wang Lan’s regret, the powerhouses inside the plane were so astounded they nearly bit off their tongues.
Snipe missiles? Sniping missiles flying at high speeds? It’s said that hitting a Star Martial Warrior with a missile is a joke, but what about a Star Martial Warrior hitting a missile? Even if one could track it, the attack speed wouldn’t be enough. But Wang Lan actually did it! Shoot down three missiles in an instant? Is this the work of a deity?
The three missiles exploded in midair, deeply shocking the many teachers ahead but leaving Mr. Wen no room to be shocked. A missile, breaking through Wang Lan’s interception in just one second, was already upon them.
In the nick of time, a bulge suddenly appeared on the external hull of the plane. The moment the bulge emerged, the missile crashed violently into it.
"BOOM—"
The plane abruptly nosedived, the intense shaking causing it to spiral downward. Inside the cabin, it was again a world turned upside down.
"Comrade, steady it, steady the plane—"
"I’m trying—"
The pilot howled, grabbing the control stick tightly. After falling two thousand meters, he finally stabilized the plummeting aircraft, and the plane slowly steadied itself.
"SPURT—"
Having taken another hit, Mr. Wen suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, staining the cabin ceiling a gruesome red. This injury seemed even more severe than the last.
But, before the teachers could even begin to show concern for their colleague, the BEEP, BEEP, BEEP of the radar alarm sounded ominously, like the call of the Grim Reaper.
Seven missiles, once again, turned around and rushed towards the plane.
This time, Wang Lan hung outside the aircraft, unable to treat Mr. Wen. If even one of the missiles grazed the plane, it would certainly disintegrate in midair without any hesitation.
"What do we do?"
"Can we dodge a few?"
"Three... we can only dodge three at most," the pilot was nearly in tears.
As Jade Country’s ace pilot from the Ministry of Defense, evading missiles in a fighter jet was part of routine simulation training. However, even if flying the Huaxia-20 Supersonic Stealth Fighter, the chances of successfully dodging one wave of attacks when locked on by enemy missiles were eighty percent, two waves forty percent, and three waves ten percent.
But he was piloting a passenger plane—a large, slow, sluggish target that couldn’t handle rough maneuvering. Under such dire circumstances, the ace pilot managed to perform two successful evasions in a row. This was no longer ace-level; this was godlike.
If I survive this, I’ll be able to boast about it for the rest of my life! Back in the day, I piloted a passenger plane and survived an attack by twelve Punisher Missiles! How about that? But... that’s only if I survive.
Seven missiles, with three possible to avoid, meant the remaining four could reduce everyone on the plane to dust.
"Don’t evade—" Suddenly, Wang Lan’s voice, carried by Star Power, entered the cockpit. "Maintain a horizontal position with the missiles..."
The moment the pilot heard Wang Lan’s words, it was as if their minds had synced, and he instantly executed the maneuver. The plane took a sharp turn, halting its previous evasive actions and accelerating to climb into the sky.
The wings on both sides trembled ever more violently, as if they might fall off the plane at any moment.
At this moment, Wang Lan’s right eye was filled with fresh blood. Drops fell from the corner of his eye, swiftly dissipated by the rushing wind.
With slightly blurred vision and enduring the pain, the Sword of Light instantly transformed into seven streaks of light shooting towards the seven missiles.
"BOOM, BOOM, BOOM—"
Four missiles exploded in the sky, but three failed to detonate as the timing for the Sword of Light’s materialization was off. Suddenly, however, these three also exploded in midair.
The wreckage from the four detonated missiles became obstacles for the remaining three, which exploded immediately upon contact. Seven explosions nearly merged into one.
The deadly blips on the radar disappeared.
At that moment, the pilot was utterly baffled. A single thought repeated in his mind like a song on loop.
Holy crap, I actually survived... I actually survived... I survived...
"WOW—" The pilot exclaimed, springing to his feet. "Damn it, we survived! Twelve Punisher Missiles, and not one brought us down!"
The aircraft suddenly took a nosedive.
Wu Shaohua quickly pushed the pilot back into his seat. "Dude, you’re flying a plane."
"Oh, right... climbing now, climbing now—"
The alarm was silenced, and the aircraft regained stable flight. Wang Lan struggled back into the cabin and shut the door. Only then did he take a deep breath, leaning against the aircraft, his entire body soaked and limp.
The Song of Life Star Martial Skill sparked to life automatically, sending a cool sensation through his stinging right eye. But a prickling itch soon followed, and tears trickled from the corners of his eyes—bright red tears of blood.
A fragrant breeze wafted by, and Yu Ruoyun quickly supported Wang Lan, helping him up. "Wang Lan, how are you doing? Quick, any fire-attribute Star Martial Warrior, come and warm him up. He’s nearly frozen to death."
Under high-speed flight, especially at high altitude, a person could be frozen in an instant. When Wang Lan got back to the plane, he was no different from an icicle.
Wang Lan weakly patted Yu Ruoyun’s shoulder. "Are you daft? I’m a fire-attribute, aren’t I?"
As he spoke, Wang Lan’s body temperature rapidly rose. For a fire-attribute Star Martial Warrior to be frozen to death would be the most shameful way to die, akin to an eagle plummeting from the sky to its demise.
With the plane stabilized, the instructors returned to the cabin. With Yu Ruoyun’s support, Wang Lan approached Mr. Wen. Song of Life connected him with Mr. Wen; they looked like miserable brothers-in-arms in a hospital ward, staring forlornly at the aircraft’s ceiling.
"How far are we from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?"
"We are already in the airspace of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"So you’re saying this missile attack happened over the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?" Wu Shaohua said, turning his head to look at Longya, who stood with folded arms, lost in thought.
Longya was the overall commander of this reinforcement mission and also the head of the Tactical Department, to whom all tactical instructors reported.
"There’s only one flight route from Modu City to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, this one. The departure time and flight path were not leaked to the outside world. For the missiles to ambush us exactly on our route, they must have had prior knowledge of our departure time, flight path, and possibly even the aircraft’s satellite positioning. Either the problem originated from Jade Country, or from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"It’s unlikely that there was a leak from Jade Country," Han Zhong said coldly, toying with his ring. "The missile launch site is near the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Setting up a launch site within the less than thirty-six hours from when we determined our route and departure time is impossible."
"Then it must be the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"But why? We were invited to support them. Besides Jade Country, no other nation could save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"My fellow instructors, I might have some information," Wang Lan said thoughtfully. "There are anti-government forces in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. If it wasn’t the government’s doing, then it must have been the work of the anti-government forces."
"Anti-government forces? Does the Kingdom of Ice and Snow even have the conditions for that?" Wu Shaohua asked in disbelief. "The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is in such a dire state that the whole nation needs to huddle together for warmth. Anyone with means has fled, and the nation could collapse at any moment. What’s the goal of these anti-government forces? To steal tombstones?"
"I... am not at liberty to disclose that," Wang Lan replied. "However, according to intel from the Tianjian Bureau, it is indeed so, and the anti-government forces have existed for at least five years."
At the moment the plane was safe, Jade Country had just received information that the support flight departing from Modu City had been hit by missiles. Though the status of the plane was unknown, one could guess that a missile attack meant it was certainly brought down.
Had it not been for the fact that the plane was full of Star Martial Warriors, making it impossible to confirm casualties, Jade Country would have been ready to declare the loss of all one hundred and twenty members of the support team.
As soon as the initial intelligence was relayed back to the country, within a minute it landed on the desk of the First.
At just fifty years of age, the First was the youngest ever in Jade Country’s history. Moreover, he grew up during Jade Country’s economic surge, and his approach to matters was starkly different from his predecessors.
"BANG—"
The solid wood desk shook with a thunderous clap that left the office staff as though they were under a paralyzing spell.
The First picked up the phone. "Foreign Affairs, this is Liang Weimin. I will not accept negotiation, compromise, or delays on this matter. Within three days, give Jade Country a satisfactory explanation. You may respond directly to me through the hotline."
The major countries around the world knew that the usually amiable Jade Country could discuss nearly anything. But that was because their bottom lines had not been crossed. Once they were, one had better be prepared to face Jade Country’s fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 Safe Landing
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 340 Safe Landing
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow, the skies gray and overcast.
The makeshift airport, hurriedly established, still looked somewhat dilapidated. Surrounding the airport, however, stood a group of ceremonially dressed honor guards, craning their necks in anticipation.
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow extended its highest honors in response to the aid dispatched by Jade Country. The King of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, accompanied by members of the royal family and all the nation’s dignitaries and nobility, had gathered at the airport, anxiously waiting.
This was aid that concerned the very fate of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow—a hope nurtured across countless days and nights over twelve years.
If during the first seven years the Kingdom of Ice and Snow could still tirelessly sustain itself, the last five years had been a struggle on the brink of annihilation. Countless moments of despair and innumerable brushes with death had instilled an obsession within the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Just once, if only a powerful nation could extend its full support, offering more than just material supplies, there was a chance for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to survive.
Even at its most dire, the King of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had beseeched the major nations in the lowliest of manners, proclaiming, "If you can save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, you will be its God of Heaven, and henceforth the Kingdom of Ice and Snow will worship only you."
But... for five years, no major nation was willing to send an army of Star Martial Warriors to their aid; the Exotic Beasts of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were too terrifying.
Who would have thought? It seemed the God of Destiny had not abandoned them. At their most desperate, those who had previously fled from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow returned through pre-arranged channels with news that made the people of the Kingdom feel as if they were hearing the hymns of heaven.
From the Star Martial Academy in Modu City of Jade Country, a student had successfully invented a method to manufacture a vaccine counteracting Star Martial Toxins. The long-standing helplessness against Star Martial Toxins was about to change.
While other nations were still trying to verify the veracity of this news, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was already seething with excitement and had immediately requested aid from Jade Country. After a two-month wait, the day had finally arrived.
King Cain had never felt an evening stretch as long as this one. In the span of just ten minutes, he had checked his watch nearly twenty times.
Why haven’t they come? Why aren’t they here yet?
BEEP, BEEP, BEEP—
The phone of Jade Country’s ambassador to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow suddenly rang. Heze discreetly took out his mobile phone, and after just a glance, his expression turned grave.
"Hello, Prime Minister, I’m..."
Starting a decade ago, a hundred countries had successively withdrawn their embassies. Now, it turned out that only Jade Country remained. This fact alone made the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s regard for Jade Country far surpass that for others.
Because when the whole world had given up on the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, only Jade Country was still willing to treat it as a nation worthy of diplomatic relations, even if, in their hearts, they too believed it was a kingdom like a setting sun, soon to disappear.
"What? How is that possible... I understand... Yes! Yes!" Ambassador Heze’s voice suddenly rose, his expression turning exceptionally solemn.
After hanging up the phone, King Cain looked at Heze with a tense face. "Ambassador Heze, has something unforeseen happened?"
Heze regarded King Cain with a scrutinizing gaze for several seconds. In those few seconds, King Cain felt a chilling dread, as if plunged into an ice cellar.
"The aid delegation from Jade Country’s Modu Star Martial Academy, which took off from Modu City, encountered a missile attack en route to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
Though spoken softly and with an unnervingly steady tone, the words hit King Cain and the members of the royal family like a clap of thunder on a clear day.
Upon hearing the news, a few nobles even staggered unsteadily.
"What? How could this happen... Who wants to harm the Kingdom of Ice and Snow... How dare they? Which country did it?" Princess Aier, the legendary princess of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, asked urgently.
"The plane was attacked over the airspace of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow!"
Heze’s words made everyone’s faces change drastically again. King Cain’s face instantly turned pale.
An attack over the airspace of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow meant it was not some other nation; the assault had originated from within the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. This meant that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow itself had destroyed its last hope.
"Respected King Cain, Jade Country needs your explanation. Why would our aid delegation be hit by a missile attack over the airspace of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow? Why, when we are risking our lives to help you selflessly, would we be attacked by your military?"
"I..." King Cain stood with his mouth agape, at that moment incapable of thought.
Why? I damn well want to know why too. This is the last hope for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow...
"Selfless? Hmph!" A discordant voice sounded. Heze immediately looked toward the source, locking eyes with Kester, King Cain’s brother, who met his gaze unflinchingly.
"Now, I expect the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to immediately dispatch a search and rescue team. Save whoever can be saved. Secondly, I want the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to provide an explanation for this incident and a response that satisfies Jade Country."
"I..."
"King Cain!" Ambassador Heze, seeing the king still looking utterly bewildered, suddenly became furious, stepped forward, and shouted sternly.
In an instant, a figure flashed, appearing before King Cain. The radiant Princess Aier blocked Heze from approaching.
"Ambassador Heze, I will immediately lead the Royal Guard to conduct the search and rescue. Please, you must believe that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow would absolutely not launch an attack against Jade Country, much less attack the selfless individuals who came to aid us.
"They are our benefactors, our God! We have no reason to do such a thing."
"I want to believe you, but I trust the facts more!"
"Holing, notify the Royal Guard to assemble immediately!" Aier commanded loudly, turning her head.
"Yes—"
Princess Aier departed, but the commotion suddenly erupted. In those few short minutes, news of the missile attack on the aid delegation had spread like wildfire.
"Everyone, be quiet!" Prince Kester snapped, and the cacophonous buzz instantly vanished.
Ambassador Heze’s gaze swept over Prince Kester again, a sharp gleam in his eyes. Although he had long known of Prince Kester’s unparalleled influence, seeing it firsthand made him regard the prince with even greater caution.
But what was that hint of hostility from him earlier all about?
King Cain came back to his senses and pulled out a handkerchief, continually wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.
"Ambassador, please believe us, we would never attack the aid delegation. Without them, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow could be destroyed by Exotic Beasts at any moment. They are our hope..."
"I personally believe what you say, but the attack was indeed launched from within the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. I don’t think any other country has the capability to do that."
"It was T! It must have been T! Ambassador, you know that the T organization has always tried to drag the Kingdom of Ice and Snow into hell. They are the incarnation of the devil—no, they *have become* devils."
"Even if it was T, why didn’t you take precautions? You should have dealt with any potential threats before our aid delegation set off."
"Ambassador, you know our current situation. We can barely protect ourselves, let alone deal with T," Prince Kester replied, having restored order at the scene and approached King Cain’s side.
"That’s your problem. If you can’t even guarantee the safety of the people coming to help you, how can you expect Jade Country to provide assistance?
"Do you know how important the people on that plane are to Jade Country? Even Princess Yu Ruoyun of Jade Country was on that plane. We offered the Kingdom of Ice and Snow our most sincere goodwill, but what we received in return was a ruthless missile strike..."
Sweat streamed down King Cain’s face.
Even Prince Kester frowned. "Jade Country’s Princess Yu Ruoyun? The one known as the Pearl of Jade Country?"
"Correct!"
Prince Kester’s complexion turned deathly pale. Looking at Ambassador Heze, he gently placed a hand over his chest and bowed deeply. "I had no idea Jade Country had shown such profound sincerity, sending even Princess Yu herself to assist us.
"We deeply apologize for what happened today. We will mobilize the entire nation’s resources to search for survivors. May the God of Heaven keep Princess Yu safe and sound."
No sooner had he finished speaking than a clamor of surprise rose from behind him.
Prince Kester, a displeased expression on his face, turned to scold but was immediately stunned by the sight before him.
A plane, piercing through the thick clouds, was slowly approaching.
The airport in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was almost derelict, with only two or three planes arriving throughout the year. And today, at this time, only one plane was expected.
Almost instantly, countless eyes fixed on Ambassador Heze.
The intensity of their stares was such that even Heze, a man who had weathered countless storms, found it difficult to maintain his composure.
"Ambassador Heze? Were you joking with us just now? You said the aid delegation was attacked by missiles?" King Cain’s expression was a complex mix of a desire to rage and the ecstatic relief of one who has narrowly escaped disaster.
"I don’t think Jade Country would suddenly play such a joke on me." Heze, too, had only learned of the situation after receiving the call. "I need to make a call back to my country to inquire."
The plane slowly landed and came to a steady stop on the runway. Prince Kester quickly arranged for the honor guard to play welcoming music.
Ambassador Heze put away his phone and approached King Cain. "Your Majesty, I just inquired with my country. The plane was indeed attacked by missiles—twelve Punisher Missiles, to be exact. However, my country is unaware that the plane is safe. I too am puzzled as to how they managed to escape disaster."
"It’s all right as long as they’re safe. As long as they’re safe."
After these several dramatic turns, King Cain’s mind had lost most of its capacity for thought. He joined Heze in greeting the arrival of the aid delegation beside the plane.
The boarding stairs were gently lowered, and the students, led by their teachers, disembarked in an orderly fashion.
"Welcome! Welcome!" Enthusiastic cheers erupted, spoken in the language of Jade Country. Although delivered very awkwardly, the words were somewhat understandable.
But everyone disembarking from the plane wore a gloomy expression. Anyone who had nearly been shot down by missiles wouldn’t be in a better mood.
"Hello, everyone. I am Ambassador Heze from the Jade Country Embassy to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow." Ambassador Heze stepped forward, shaking hands warmly with Captain Longya.
"Ambassador Heze, hello. I am Captain Longya, the leader of the delegation."
"Captain Longya, I heard you just encountered a missile attack? Is that true?"
"We nearly lost our lives. If not for the high skill level of the students we brought, we would have been lucky if even half of us had survived."
"Our country is already aware of the incident, and the Premier places great importance on it. The nation is immensely relieved that you are all safe. We have arranged accommodations for you. Let’s discuss the details later."
"All right!"
Welcomed by the band and the honor guard, Wang Lan and the others boarded three buses. As for their luggage, personnel from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow naturally took responsibility for transporting it to their encampment.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 Rescue
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 341 Rescue
"Just one hour ago, at 22:00 Imperial Capital time, 11:00 your time, we had just arrived at the border of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow when our aircraft suddenly came under attack by twelve Punisher Missiles. The plane made three evasive maneuvers and endured direct hits from two missiles; the rest were shot down by us. It was an unforgettable experience. Although we narrowly escaped death, we will not carry out any aid operations until this matter is thoroughly investigated and resolved."
Captain Longya summarized after recounting the experience.
"Captain Longya, this attack has nothing to do with our royal government..." King Cain quickly explained.
"We are not accusing your nation, but the objective fact is that we were ambushed on our way to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Our safety cannot be guaranteed here. By safety, I don’t mean the dangers posed by Exotic Beasts and Different Dimensional Spaces, but the possibility of being stabbed in the back when we least expect it. Apologies, but we are here on a mission to assist, not to court death."
As his words fell, the atmosphere in the conference room suddenly grew oppressive.
The only people in the conference room were King Cain, Prince Kester, Captain Longya, Ambassador Heze, and Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun, who stood behind Captain Longya.
Compared to King Cain’s panic, Wang Lan paid more attention to Prince Kester. This man’s demeanor and adaptability were far superior to King Cain’s.
Since arriving at the conference room, Kester might not have spoken much, but every time he did, he touched upon critical points, managing to keep the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s nearly collapsing morale from completely breaking, maintaining a sliver of room for negotiation.
From this short half-hour alone, Wang Lan could ascertain that Kester’s political acumen was far above Cain’s.
While Wang Lan’s focus was on Kester, Kester’s attention shifted from Yu Ruoyun to Wang Lan.
Yu Ruoyun was the princess of Jade Country. Even though Jade Country no longer publicly acknowledged a royal family, the international community still implicitly recognized its existence. Even without the official title, she possessed the true status of a princess. Compared to Princess Aier, Yu Ruoyun was like a resplendent phoenix perched on a branch; her presence as an observer in such a high-level meeting was perfectly natural.
But this young man puzzled Kester. He was similar in age to Yu Ruoyun, with an equally striking presence. Yet Kester had never heard of a prince in Jade Country’s royal family. And how could an ordinary student be allowed to observe such a high-level meeting?
The oppressive atmosphere lingered for a long while before Kester suddenly chuckled.
"Dragon Captain’s concern is perfectly reasonable. If we cannot even provide security beyond the scope of assistance, it is indeed a dereliction of duty on the part of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. But you should also understand our kingdom’s predicament. The severity of our situation is even worse than that of Jade Country after its great victory. Our people lack food, the nation lacks resources, talent is draining away in droves, and our warriors cannot even fill their own stomachs. What’s more despicable is that some ambitious individuals have been stirring up public sentiment and, with the help of certain notorious international organizations, have established the anti-government militia T.
"Ambassador Heze is aware of this as well. T was established five years ago and has consistently opposed the government. They have perpetrated several heinous acts, and this latest one is especially intolerable. In the past, we tolerated T because we genuinely lacked the strength to annihilate them. But now things are different. You have arrived. With your power, let alone T, even Jade Country’s own government army could likely be wiped out by your team in less than a day."
"Prince Kester, eliminating an anti-government militia for you doesn’t fall under the scope of our aid, does it? Moreover, Jade Country cannot and should not intervene in your civil war," Longya stated.
"But now it’s not us asking you to intervene in our civil war; it’s them dragging you into it. T took the initiative to attack you. Jade Country’s dignity will not tolerate provocation by terrorists."
Kester’s words plunged both Heze and Longya into silence.
"Ambassador Heze, Dragon Captain, upon hearing that you encountered a terrorist attack, my daughter Aier immediately led the Royal Guard to search for and rescue you. We swear that T will face the harshest sanctions!" King Cain quickly added.
"The Royal Guard? What kind of army is that?" Wang Lan, who had been silent until now, suddenly asked.
"The Royal Guard is composed entirely of Star Martial Warriors from our Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Although there are only a thousand of them, they are all battle-hardened, possess the most extensive combat experience, and their average strength is at the Star Cloud Stage," King Cain hurriedly explained.
Such average strength was considered high-quality among the Star Martial Warrior units of major powers, but if one knew the price paid for it, it’s unlikely any nation would be envious. The weaker ones had all perished in battle.
"Is this the strongest force in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?"
"No, it should be the *last* force of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
A glint flashed in Wang Lan’s eyes, and his expression suddenly changed slightly. "Head Instructor, this situation might be serious."
"What are you thinking?"
"Since T dared to attack us, they clearly couldn’t have failed to consider that they would incur the wrath of both us and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Yet, they still launched the attack. So, it stands to reason that we would retaliate. They couldn’t have overlooked this. This isn’t a Different Dimensional Space; even if T’s members are ordinary people, Star Martial Warriors don’t necessarily have an advantage if their opponents are prepared."
As Wang Lan spoke, King Cain still looked bewildered, but Prince Kester instantly shot to his feet. "Quick! Contact Princess Aier immediately! Inquire about their situation!"
Prince Kester hastily rushed out of the conference room. After a moment, a commotion erupted outside, and a figure burst into the room. "Brother King, it’s terrible! Aier has been ambushed! The enemy possesses a large number of firearms, and she’s currently trapped in a minefield!"
"What?!" King Cain sprang to his feet.
Large beads of cold sweat instantly streamed down his face like rain.
"Dragon Captain... I beg you, save my daughter..." As King Cain regained his senses, his gaze swept over Captain Longya, and he pleaded as if clutching at a lifeline.
At this moment, he resembled not a king, but an ordinary father.
"Has the Kingdom of Ice and Snow truly run out of troops to dispatch?"
"Dragon Captain, you may not be aware, but the gender ratio in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow has reached an alarming ten females to one male. The entire nation’s armed forces are reduced to the Royal Guard and the Royal Defense Forces. The Defense Forces are deployed to guard five Different Dimensional Spaces, leaving the Royal Guard as the only combat unit we can mobilize. And it is this very force, our only force, that is now ambushed and in grave danger."
This time, it was Ambassador Heze who spoke. Frankly, he had been a diplomat for ten years, visited five countries, and possessed a broad understanding of the history and current affairs of nations across the globe. Yet, he had never encountered a situation as dire as that of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"I implore you, Dragon Captain!" King Cain bowed deeply before Captain Longya.
"This... Without orders from the Ministry of Defense, we cannot intervene," Captain Longya said, his expression troubled. "Moreover, I cannot put my students at risk. Who knows if the enemy has a plan targeting us?"
"Dragon Captain, you are all formidable warriors. As far as I know, your team leaders all possess Star Sea Stage strength. Within my Royal Guard, the only Star Martial Warrior with Star Sea Stage strength is my daughter, Aier. Your one hundred cadets are all Galaxy Stage warriors, while in my Royal Guard, there are a pitiful twelve at the Galaxy Stage.
"Dragon Captain, the team you command possesses the strength to easily destroy our entire country. If T truly posed a threat to you, we would have been annihilated by them long ago. Please, I beg you. Aier is my only daughter, the jewel of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and the spiritual pillar for our two million citizens. We cannot lose her."
"Without orders from Jade Country, we cannot..."
"Dragon Captain, if Aier and the Royal Guard are lost, then tomorrow, you can return. We will pay the agreed-upon fee for this aid mission. Afterward, we will have our last meal and sink together with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow," Prince Kester said in a low, cold tone. "We have long been prepared for this day."
Dragon Captain frowned and looked towards Ambassador Heze, who stood up. "I will request instructions from our country."
Jade Country’s objective was not merely to save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow itself, but also to secure the mining rights for its Energy Stones afterward. If the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were to fall, its Energy Stone mines would become international public property. Jade Country would then have to contend with other predators eager for a share. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow had held on for so long; Jade Country would not allow it to perish. Barring unavoidable circumstances, Jade Country had to ensure the kingdom’s survival, no matter how firm a stance it had to take.
Ultimately, Jade Country approved King Cain’s request, ordering Captain Longya to lead the support team from Modu City Star Martial Academy to rescue Princess Aier.
As for the potential risks to the cadets, that was merely an excuse. Just as King Cain had said, with such a lineup and such strength, they had deployed virtually the entire top combat power of Modu City Star Martial Academy. Eradicating a small country would be effortless. If T truly possessed such strength, would the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s royal family still be breathing? T would have conquered the Kingdom of Ice and Snow long ago. Besides, an overseas expedition without any risk? If they weren’t even willing to face such dangers, what were they doing talking about closing five Different Dimensional Spaces for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow? They might as well pack up and go home.
Rescuing Princess Aier did not require the full mobilization of the support team; four elite squads would suffice.
Wang Lan’s squad was among these four.
After receiving a map from King Cain showing Aier’s last reported location, the four squads boarded helicopters under the gloomy sky and slowly ascended.
The pilot maneuvering the helicopters was the same ace who had flown them in, though the helicopter ride was far less comfortable than the passenger jet. There was turbulence, noise, and, from time to time, cold air seeping in through cracks in the fuselage.
"Damn, this chopper... it’s so beat up, but it can still fly! Qi, you’re truly amazing!"
"I’m not just bragging, you know. Forget this Model 5 Mashi; even if it were a Zero fighter, I could put on an aerial acrobatics show for you. Ever since that near-death escape today, I feel like I’ve reached a higher state. My skills have practically achieved perfect human-machine integration!" The pilot, who had grown familiar with the academy students, was now boasting up a storm.
"Qi, why not perform a stunt then?"
"Let’s skip it. My skills are top-notch, but this chopper isn’t. The slightest maneuver, and it might just fall apart."
"Qi!" Wang Lan, who had been deep in thought, suddenly raised his head. "Have you figured out the launch position of the missiles from earlier?"
"I’ve analyzed it. When we first detected the missile, its speed hadn’t yet reached Mach five. Only after the second and third salvos did the speed increase. This suggests that the initial point of attack was within a three-kilometer radius of their launch base. But as for the exact location, I can’t say."

chapters.title: Chapter 342 The Descent of the God of Heaven
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Chapter 342 The Descent of the God of Heaven
"Wang Lan, what are you trying to do?" Wu Shaohua turned his head to glance at Wang Lan.
"Being played like this? If we don’t get even, it wouldn’t be quite in line with my usual style," Wang Lan replied.
"Don’t act recklessly. Our mission is to rescue the trapped Royal Guard and Princess Aier. Besides, we don’t know T’s strength. Rashly attacking their base could easily lead us into an ambush."
"I got it. I was just asking casually."
The map from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow showed the target in the dense forests southeast of the kingdom. The Royal Guard had set out immediately after learning the support team’s plane was attacked. While searching the estimated crash site, they encountered an ambush by T.
In an area riddled with landmines, exchanging fire with terrorists wielding firearms severely limited their mobility. If the Royal Guard members had strength comparable to the academy’s support team, these so-called ambushes would be as ineffective as trying to stop a car with one’s arm.
But even the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s most elite Royal Guard members were, at best, equivalent to students from an ordinary Star Martial Academy in Jade Country. Out of a force of one thousand, their average strength was only at the Star Cloud Stage, with barely a dozen experts at the Galaxy Stage or higher. For a nation’s ultimate fighting force, they were pitifully weak.
They landed on the outskirts of the target area. Pathfinders, consisting of Sense-type Star Martial Warriors and Earth Attribute Star Martial Warriors, took the lead, heading directly into the target zone to search.
Eight hundred Royal Guard members were scattered across a five-square-kilometer area, forming a defensive perimeter against surprise attacks from all directions.
The barriers erected by the Earth Attribute Star Martial Warriors could withstand ordinary rifle fire but not the precise shots of distant snipers. Even when hidden behind an earthen wall, an armor-piercing sniper bullet could easily penetrate it and lodge in an Earth Attribute Star Martial Warrior’s chest.
"Nine o’clock position—" A Star Martial Warrior fell dead. The nearby Royal Guard commander roared.
"We’re on it!" a three-man squad yelled in response.
"We’ll cover you! Brothers, clear the way with Star Martial Skills!"
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! The Royal Guard launched a barrage of Star Martial Skill attacks into the dense forest before them; flames, water pillars, and lightning bolts flashed.
The three-man squad moved stealthily towards the sniper’s suspected position. In less than ten minutes, the trio reached it, nine hundred meters away. A brown-camouflaged blind blended seamlessly with the cold, damp earth.
"Found you!" one of them roared. Fueled by rage, he transformed into a streak of light and charged the blind.
"Kewei, come back!" the captain yelled urgently, but it was too late. The squad member’s war saber plunged fiercely downward, only to meet empty air. He ripped aside the camouflage, revealing an empty position.
BANG! Just as the squad member realized it was a decoy, a bullet shot from behind, piercing his chest.
"Damn it!"
"Three o’clock!"
The remaining two immediately leaped through the tree branches, covering dozens of meters in mere moments.
BANG! The captain had just leaped when a bullet shattered the branch behind him.
"Found you!" Fire blazed in the captain’s eyes as he stared intently in the direction the shot originated.
The enemy sniper, likely realizing he was no longer at a safe distance from the two Royal Guard members, hastily abandoned his cover and sprinted away.
But how could an ordinary person’s speed compare to that of Star Martial Warriors, whose physical conditioning was superhuman? The sniper hadn’t gotten far before a whistling sound cut through the air behind him.
The sniper dove forward, but a wind blade grazed the back of his head, tearing away a piece of flesh and drawing blood.
With a pained grunt, the sniper rolled over and drew his pistol. Before he could fire, another wind blade whistled past his throat.
The pistol slipped from his grasp. The sniper’s body twitched briefly, then stilled.
"You damned bastard! You killed five of our men!" A guard, overcome with fury, charged the sniper’s body, drawing his war saber to hack at the sniper’s neck.
"Jier, what are you doing?"
"I’m going to take his head to avenge our brothers!" he roared, swinging the war saber down fiercely.
"Don’t move—"
BOOM!
The moment the war saber struck, the sniper’s corpse suddenly exploded. A fierce fireball erupted, and the shockwave sent Jier flying.
"Damn it!" Xiao Ke slammed his fist against a nearby tree trunk in anger.
Even in death, the sniper had booby-trapped his body. Touching the corpse would trigger a tripwire connected to a grenade.
These were no ordinary terrorists; they were clearly world-class elite soldiers.
How could ordinary armed militants possess such potent combat capabilities and terrifying tactical acumen? Even with the limitations imposed by a minefield and the enemy’s long-range firearms, they shouldn’t be able to overwhelm a group of Royal Guard members whose average strength was at the Star Cloud Stage.
Only the special forces of a few major powers could achieve this.
Only the best of the best, soldier kings selected from tens of thousands and forged through brutal training, could possess such high-level combat skills and formidable fighting power.
They had been ordered to search for the crashed support team. However, before they could even approach the target area, terrorists attacked them. Right from the outset, a dozen Star Martial Warriors were picked off by snipers.
The pervasive landmines restricted their ability to spread out and engage in guerrilla warfare. They could only hunker down in one spot, defending against stealth attacks from all directions. This was the seventh sniper they had managed to kill, yet these seven snipers alone had inflicted thirty casualties upon them.
Since when could ordinary humans take down Star Martial Warriors at a five-to-one ratio—with the Star Martial Warriors being the five, and the ordinary human being the one?
Star Martial Warriors were never meant to fight their own kind, so their use of firearms wasn’t encouraged. Some countries even explicitly restricted Star Martial Warriors from using them. Guns were considered tools for ordinary people; Star Martial Warriors were expected to focus all their energy on Star Martial Skills.
This led to the current situation where Star Martial Warriors rarely use firearms. Against an external enemy, this specialization was perfectly complementary. However, when Star Martial Warriors faced ordinary people proficient with guns, the scales of victory weren’t as heavily tilted in their favor as they might have imagined.
This was true even though Star Martial Warriors were far superior to ordinary people in all other aspects.
"Xiao Ke, how is it?"
"That sniper’s dealt with, but Jier and the others..."
"Damn it! We’ve been ambushed here. Who knows what’s happening with the Princess..."
"We don’t need to worry about the Princess! She’s the War God of our Kingdom of Ice and Snow! A top-tier warrior at the Star Sea Stage! If the Princess were here, she could slaughter this bunch of bastards all by herself."
"Do you think the support team from Jade Country... could they all have been wiped out? Otherwise, this battle has been raging for nearly two hours. Why haven’t they followed the sounds to us?"
"I heard this support team has thirty Star Sea Stage powerhouses! My God, thirty Star Sea Stage powerhouses... all annihilated? I can’t even imagine it."
"But if they weren’t wiped out, why haven’t they followed the sounds and reached us by now? Could it be... they turned back?"
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! Suddenly, a series of violent explosions thundered in the distance, like the rumbling of the earth or the roar of a colossal beast.
Then, just as suddenly, the gunfire around them intensified, as if in a final, desperate frenzy.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! On the Royal Guard’s perimeter, a rapid series of explosions erupted, like a string of firecrackers.
"Commander, what’s happening? This doesn’t sound right!"
"Is that... landmines exploding? Could someone have chained them together and detonated them?"
"Reinforcements are here! Earth Attribute Star Martial Warriors, quickly, reinforce the defenses! Reinforce defenses!"
"Commander, we have more reinforcements? We’re the last of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s forces... Wait, are you saying..."
"The support team from Jade Country. They’ve arrived."
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! The explosions drew rapidly closer, and the distant gunfire began to subside.
Suddenly, the world around them was bathed in crimson light.
The Royal Guard members all looked up in unison, witnessing a scene they would never forget.
A colossal red Array materialized in the sky, seeming to cover the entire heavens. Its bewitching crimson light spilled over the land. Then, a voice like that of the God of Heaven thundered from above.
"Heavenly Fire Extinguishing World!"
From within the crimson Array, clusters of terrifying, blazing red meteorites rained down from the sky.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
All the Guard members stood dumbstruck, staring blankly as a rain of fire descended, consuming everything within a five-hundred-meter radius in its fiery maw.
Those brief thirty seconds felt like an eternity. When they snapped back to reality, only scorched earth remained in their field of vision.
In just thirty seconds, the surrounding hundreds of meters had been transformed into a hellscape of molten lava.
This must be the power of a god, right?
To students from Star Martial Academies like Wang Lan, this was merely an S-class composite Star Martial Skill, albeit one with a larger area of effect and greater power. It certainly wasn’t astonishing enough to be mistaken for divine intervention.
But the people of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were different. They couldn’t even conceive of such a ceiling of power, let alone have heard of it. The most potent force they knew was their princess’s ’Ice Snow kingdom’.
The visual impact of the ’Ice Snow kingdom’, which could cover hundreds of meters in ice and snow, paled in comparison to this cataclysm that transformed hundreds of meters of forest into a molten hellscape. If Princess Aier wielded power closest to a god’s, then this had to be the work of a god themself.
SWOOSH! SWOOSH! SWOOSH! With a few swift movements, a twelve-member rescue team materialized before the stunned crowd as if stepping out of the very void.
Wang Lan glanced at the group of dazed individuals. Some stared with mouths agape, their jaws practically unhinged. He turned to Wu Changfeng and asked softly, "Have they been hit with an Illusion Technique?"
"Doesn’t look like it," Wu Changfeng replied. "Their heart rates are quite fast. People under an Illusion Technique usually have slower heart rates."
"Hey! Are you the Royal Guard? Is Princess Aier here?" Wu Changfeng produced a translation device and called out to the group.
"Ah? You’re the support team from Jade Country, right? Heavens be praised, you’re still alive! We are the Royal Guard of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, under orders to search for and rescue the Jade Country support team! Is it just you few? Did the others... perish?" A Royal Guard member proficient in the Jade Country’s language quickly recovered his senses and hurried forward to ask.
Since someone here speaks Huaxia, this will be much easier.
"Our plane wasn’t shot down by a missile; we managed to land successfully. We had just arrived in Ice City when we learned you’d been ambushed. At your King’s request, we came to escort you back. Also, where is Princess Aier?"

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Arriving Just in Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Chapter 343: Arriving Just in Time
Listen to those words, how casual the tone. There’s no denial of a missile attack, confirming it really happened. But we weren’t shot down, and we managed to land successfully.
What’s called the invisible swagger of a major power? This is it.
Regardless of how countries hyped up their fighter jets—touting engine power, stealth capabilities, and various high-tech equipment—missiles remained their top nemesis.
No matter how fast a plane flies, in front of missiles that easily reach four or five times the speed of sound, some even reaching six or seven, it’s nothing but a little brother.
Once a fighter jet is locked on by a missile, you can pretty much just bail out. All that dodging air-to-air missiles and chasing them for half an hour, that’s movie stuff, okay?
Moreover, this time the volunteers were on a passenger plane—a sitting duck for missiles, with virtually no chance of missing.
In the world of Star Martial Warriors, targeting them with missiles was considered a joke because missiles lacked a locking function for such targets. And on the ground, missiles only had one chance to attack, while Star Martial Warriors could use Star Martial Skills to defend, dodge, and employ various other maneuvers.
Hitting a Star Martial Warrior with a missile is almost unrealistic, but if a Star Martial Warrior is inside a plane, that’s a sure hit.
Just like that, not a hair was harmed, the plane’s fine too. How strong must one be? They couldn’t imagine.
After waiting for three seconds and seeing that the young Major in front of him showed no reaction, Wang Lan’s brows couldn’t help but furrow.
"Jim, he’s waiting for you to reply," the Guard commander suddenly slapped the translator’s shoulder and exclaimed.
"Oh, the Princess? Her Highness Princess Aier separated from us at the beginning, taking the deputy commander and several Galaxy Stage adults to the T organization base, swearing to give them a painful lesson," he replied.
"T organization base? Do you have intel on the T organization base?"
"No, but the princess said setting up a missile launcher isn’t simple; it requires construction work. So she deduced that the location from which T launched the missiles is where the T organization base is located."
Having received an answer, Wang Lan turned his head and looked at Wu Shaohua. This rescue operation was led by Wu Shaohua as the overall commander, with the other three squads under his command.
Wu Shaohua’s expression also became conflicted in an instant. Their primary objective for this rescue was Princess Aier, and now Princess Aier had gone to raid the T organization. From Wang Lan’s analysis, it was very likely that a trap awaited there.
But if they didn’t rescue her, this mission would be meaningless.
"Mr. Wu, Princess Aier set out on an emergency mission only after learning we were attacked. Morally and logically, we can’t just stand by and do nothing," Yu Ruoyun said gravely.
"But... it’s too dangerous. Being in a large group risks exposure, while a small group might not have sufficient strength... and if they have a trap..."
"Teacher, I think our strength might just cut it," Yu Ruoyun confidently raised her head. "Don’t underestimate me just because I’m a student. If I really get into a fight, there aren’t many in the Star Sea Stage who can beat me."
"Heh?" Wu Shaohua swept a disdainful glance at Yu Ruoyun, his eyes conveying a single message:
Are you serious?
Even if you’re Yu Ruoyun, hailed as the once-in-a-millennium genius, you’re not that inflated. I believe you if you say you have the strength of the Star Sea Stage as someone from the Galaxy Stage, but to say that there aren’t many in the Star Sea Stage stronger than you is going too far.
The gap in strength between those in the Star Sea Stage is immense; even a Titled Strongman wouldn’t dare claim that there aren’t many who can beat him in the Star Sea Stage.
But... he did recognize Yu Ruoyun’s strength.
"Mr. Wu, I don’t think the T organization is necessarily ready with a trap for us. Or rather, they might not have prepared specifically for us. The fact that we could block the Punisher Missile attack unharmed was already beyond T’s plan, and even their retaliation against Princess Aier is likely just an emergency measure. The opponent is still just a terrorist organization after all, lacking the resources and strength of a nation—they don’t have the conditions to develop several different contingency plans."
"A small squad should be enough to rescue Princess Aier. The team leader is an assault expert; Ruoyun is versatile. Moreover, with Ruoyun’s full strength unleashed, she really could walk sideways through the Star Sea Stage. And I’m not weak either. The three of us form a squad—it’s an exceptional Star Sea Stage team configuration."
Wu Shaohua looked at Wang Lan surprisingly.
Are young people these days all such braggarts? Yu Ruoyun can boast; at least she’s at the peak of the Galaxy Stage. But for you, a Star Cloud Stage warrior, to brag like that is too much, right?
But he soon remembered that Wang Lan actually used a Star Martial Skill to intercept a missile... perhaps he did have some tricks up his sleeve.
"Li, Zhang, we must rescue Princess Aier. How about this: you escort them back, and I’ll take the squad to rescue Princess Aier?"
"That’s... not quite right, is it? How about we let these students escort them back, and the three of us team up?"
"Mr. Zhang, Mr. Li, both Wang Lan and I have the Phoenix Form and Dragon Emperor Form respectively. Both are advanced super S-grade Star Martial Skills, and we’re not weak," Yu Ruoyun said again.
"In that case... Old Wu, you must act according to your abilities," Mr. Li said. "If it’s dangerous, ensure your safety first. If you can’t rescue Princess Aier, it can’t be helped—just do what you can."
"All right, that’s settled," Wu Shaohua agreed.
Having concluded the discussion, Wu Shaohua snapped his fingers softly, disappearing on the spot with Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun.
"Wang Lan, have you estimated the location of the T organization?"
"I figured it out on the plane: seven o’clock direction, thirty kilometers away."
"Great! Let’s hurry, but make sure to keep your Star Power balanced. Don’t exhaust it just getting there."
"Understood!"
It wasn’t just Wu Shaohua who thought Yu Ruoyun was getting ahead of herself; even Wang Lan could sense it. Despite her calm appearance and steady speech, her heartbeat was consistently a bit too fast, always keen and eager to try.
So what if she was secretly trained by Qing Emperor for a month? Is that reason enough to be so carried away?
Although Jiang Xinyu was also trained by Qing Emperor, the main focus was undoubtedly on Yu Ruoyun. Jiang Xinyu mentioned that Yu Ruoyun had apparently managed to successfully release the Dragon Emperor Form.
But... is Yu Ruoyun the only one who’s getting carried away? Our esteemed young master Wang Lan is feeling quite inflated now.
After supplementing his lack of Star Power with the bloodline of The Whirlpool Clan, Wang Lan felt that his body, techniques, and spirit were all comprehensively balanced.
Does he possess the close-quarters combat strength of a Gold-tier? Wang Lan dared to say that when it comes to close combat, he could rank in the top ten even among those in the Star Sea Stage. Plus, with the Zanpakuto in hand, only Titled Strongmen would dare face him in a direct clash.
Although his Star Power wasn’t as freakishly abundant as some, it had reached the level of the Star Sea Stage. With ten S-level Star Martial Skills in hand, even the non-S-level ones had been elevated to S-level. Ask me to perform an A-level skill, and I might be unable to. But for an S-level skill, I assure you, I can provide quantity and fill you up.
Such invincibility in close combat and a bulldozer from afar, coupled with the defense of the Holy Shield, the intimate protection of the Phoenix Saint Cloth, and the foundation of the Self Healing Star Martial Skill, whether it’s a blitz or a war of attrition, Wang Lan dares to claim he’s unrivaled in the world.
If he couldn’t feel inflated with all this, Wang Lan wouldn’t know what else there could be to inflate his ego.
Yu Ruoyun and Wang Lan, both having greatly increased in strength, were very eager to show off their skills, while Wu Shaohua watched tensely for any movements on either side, fearing an ambush.
After all, the two treasures under his care were no ordinary ones; they were Divine Beast babies that couldn’t bear even a single scratch.
「Elsewhere, Princess Aier, dubbed the Ice Snow War God by the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, wasn’t in a good situation right now.」
Although Aier successfully located the base of the T organization and managed to approach the entrance of the T organization’s base without alerting their overt and covert guards, she inevitably put them on alert.
Princess Aier decided to storm in directly.
With her Star Sea Stage strength, there was no one in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow who could stop her.
And indeed, that was the case. Elite warriors armed with thermal weapons could fight on equal footing with a Star Martial Warrior under certain advantageous conditions. But when facing someone at the Star Sea Stage, unless bombarded with heavy fire, small arms or slow missiles were like using a cannon to kill a mosquito.
Leading the charge, Princess Aier successfully penetrated the base, leaving no blade of grass alive wherever she went, and everyone who saw her was frightened out of their wits.
Many T organization warriors rushed out with their guns, only to be instantly frozen mid-run into ice sculptures, and would then crumble into pieces at the slightest touch.
The scene was cold and cruel, yet beautiful. Death was as simple as snowflakes melting away.
The T organization didn’t have many members; in a state like the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, it was impossible for a large-scale anti-government force to emerge. From the entrance of the base to its interior, Aier killed about two thousand people along the way.
Unstoppable, Aier burst directly into the headquarters and froze the five individuals who looked to be leaders into popsicles. Just as Princess Aier thought everything was settled, and that it was all over, suddenly the lights in the command center brightened.
CLAP, CLAP, CLAP— Clear applause resounded.
Princess Aier quickly spun around and saw a distinct-looking Caucasian appear in the command center like a ghost.
"Princess Aier truly lives up to the name of Ice Snow War God. I’ve been waiting for you a long time."
"Waiting for me? You knew I was coming? Or should I say, you were targeting me?"
"My leader would like to invite the princess to dine. How does that sound to you?"
"My idea is to twist your head off."
"Frozen Breath!"
"Earth Surge Fire Sea—"
The two voices sounded almost simultaneously, and in an instant, ice and fire violently collided.
Two S-level Star Martial Skills collided in a confined space, blowing a huge crater in the base’s headquarters.
A pillar of energy shot straight into the sky, piercing through the cloud cover and creating a huge donut-shaped hole.
Wu Shaohua’s rescue team, which had just set off, suddenly stopped and looked in the direction of two o’clock in the sky.
"It seems my estimate of the distance was a bit off!" Wang Lan remarked.
"That’s the shockwave from the collision of Star Martial Skills! Let’s go!" Wu Shaohua urged.
As the aftershocks cleared, Princess Aier’s Star Power boiled around her, and her beautiful eyes vigilantly scanned her surroundings.
In a duel between masters, a single move could determine the opponent’s strength. This was an opponent whose strength was not below her own, so Aier no longer took them lightly.
Not behind, not in front... The ground beneath her feet was her own frozen soil; an Earth Attribute warrior couldn’t have approached unnoticed. Could it be in the sky?
Aier instantly looked up, but the sky was empty too.
Could they have run away?ŸŸŸ
This thought had barely formed when suddenly a figure sprang out of the ground from a distance behind Aier and shot toward the Galaxy Stage Star Martial Warrior with the speed of light.
"Kemi, be careful—" In the moment Aier cried out, an ice spike was already flung toward the shadow.
THUD, THUD, THUD—
The ice spike hit the shadow, and the figure immediately fell to the ground and shattered into pieces.
Aier turned around while watching the fallen shadow. The moment she saw the shadow break into pieces, her heartstrings immediately tensed.
"Not good—"
At the same time, a figure burst out from the frozen ground behind her, their fingers transformed into the Thunder Snake Drill, aiming for Aier’s back.

chapters.title: Chapter 344
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: 344
"Thousand Illusions Ice Crystal!"
In an instant, six ice crystal barriers rose around Aier. The white man’s Thunder Snake Drill shattered the crystals in a flash, grazing past Aier like a bolt of lightning piercing the night.
BOOM—
The aftershocks burst forth, and Aier’s figure hurriedly retreated to her three subordinates’ side.
"Are you all okay?"
"Princess, we’re fine... Ah! Princess, are you injured?"
On Aier’s arm, blood suddenly spread like a blossoming rose, the stain so vivid.
"This little injury is nothing..." Suddenly, Aier’s footsteps faltered. She appeared slightly weak-kneed, her face losing all color in an instant.
"Star Martial Toxins!"
"Correct. Star Martial Toxins, a specialty of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, eh!" the white man said with a sneer, licking his lips.
"Protect the princess! Retreat!" one of the subordinates commanded. Two Galaxy Stage warriors drew their swords and charged at the white man.
"Come back! You’re no match for him!"
"Earth Summon Dragon—"
BOOM—
A resounding blast echoed. Suddenly, a massive dragon head emerged from the ground. It bit the two men before plunging back into the earth and vanishing, as if the scene had merely been a temporal illusion.
The two Galaxy Stage experts had been devoured in an instant, unable to even resist.
"Princess Aier, I would advise against any resistance. The more you use your Star Power, the quicker the Star Martial Toxins will conquer your body. By then, even an antidote would be useless."
"Ice Snow White Whale—"
Aier let out a cold snort. Instantly, a strong current of cold overflowed from her body. A whale, as if made of crystal, burst forth from the Array, charging directly at the white man.
The white man fiercely clenched his fist. Flames erupted around him, causing the ground beneath to fracture. Fiery red magma flowed through the cracks. With one punch, he met the white whale head-on.
The white whale instantly turned fiery red, then exploded mid-air. Its scattered ice fragments fell like cherry blossom rain.
The white man took a step forward, but Princess Aier’s figure had already disappeared from sight.
"You can’t escape."
The remaining Galaxy Stage master carried Princess Aier on his back, swiftly weaving through the dense forest. Suddenly, he stopped by a huge tree root. He skillfully tucked Princess Aier into a cavity within the main root and used a Star Martial Skill to create a disguise.
"Your Highness, I’ll lead him away. You must stay safe," he said. With a flash, the young Galaxy Stage man was gone.
In a daze, Aier frowned slightly, struggling to stay awake. At this crucial moment, she couldn’t afford to lose consciousness. If she did, she might never wake up.
"AH—"
