A scream echoed from afar, jolting Princess Aier’s spirit.
She knew all three of her Galaxy Stage subordinates had met their end.
But who is this white man? He couldn’t possibly be from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow; the kingdom only has one Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warrior. But if he’s from an international organization, why come to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow? The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is a forsaken land; in five years, not a single nation has wanted to take it over, even for free. Why would he come to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow? He earlier said he was waiting for me... could it be because of me?
"Princess Aier, you might as well come out. Even if you hide, the Star Martial Toxins will still claim your life. You’re still young; it would be a pity to die at this age."
"Still not willing to come out, huh... then don’t blame me."
Princess Aier held her breath, trying to reduce the activity of the Star Power within her body. Suddenly, she felt an immense Star Energy Fluctuation. Before she could think, her body shot out of hiding and soared into the sky.
The moment Princess Aier flashed out, the ground beneath her erupted with endless molten lava. Only when Aier leaped out did she clearly see that an area hundreds of meters around had become a sea of churning lava.
She had only managed a quick glance at the molten rock when an intense sense of danger struck her. A figure cut through the red, twisted lava and flashed beside Princess Aier, hand transforming into a claw reaching for her throat.
At this critical juncture, another figure suddenly appeared. A flash of blade light swept by, forcing the white figure to retract its claw and dodge the eerie strike.
Startled, Aier felt an arm wrap around her chest. Suddenly, her vision blurred. When it cleared, she was no longer in the same place.
To the white man, Wang Lan had appeared like a ghost, delivered a single slash, and then vanished without a trace just as quickly.
When her vision settled, Wang Lan was already a hundred meters away with Aier, flanked by a man and a woman.
"Mr. Wu, leave him to me!" Yu Ruoyun declared, his voice low and determined. As soon as the words were spoken, his figure vanished instantly.
"Wait..." The word was still in Wu Shaohua’s throat when Yu Ruoyun had already charged forward. His speed surpassed even Wu Shaohua’s ability to track him visually.
This meant that if Yu Ruoyun charged at Wu Shaohua with that speed, Wu Shaohua might not be able to react effectively in time. In the world of Star Martial Warriors, the strong are not necessarily fast, but those who are fast are certainly strong.
Being fast enough to catch an enemy off guard meant that even a degree of recklessness was no longer a significant issue.
Indeed, Yu Ruoyun’s movement technique troubled his Caucasian opponent. Even though Yu Ruoyun’s Star Martial Warrior level was still at the Galaxy Stage peak, his speed far exceeded that of a Star Sea expert.
The white man had instantly killed two Galaxy Stage opponents earlier. Now, however, he could only hurriedly defend against Yu Ruoyun’s attacks.
Wang Lan gently placed Princess Aier down. A white light flickered around him, and a chain of white light connected to the princess. Just after connecting, Wang Lan couldn’t help but frown.
"Wang Lan, what’s wrong?"
"Star Martial Toxins," Wang Lan replied grimly. "And it’s a difficult variant to deal with; my healing might take a full minute."
"It needs that long?"
Wu Shaohua knew Wang Lan’s capabilities. Even when healing someone on the brink of death, thirty seconds were usually enough. Princess Aier, however, barely had any wounds, yet her treatment would take a minute. This demonstrated just how resistant Star Martial Toxins were to Medical Star Martial Techniques.
Meanwhile, the battle between Yu Ruoyun and the white man suddenly intensified.
This time, Yu Ruoyun’s fighting style had greatly changed. When teaming with Wang Lan, Yu Ruoyun’s combat method primarily involved long-range attacks, fitting a Mage. But this time, Yu Ruoyun focused on close combat, and the Star Martial Skills he used were suited for melee attacks.
Sharp, instantaneous, fast!
This style was very similar to Wang Lan’s current combat approach: Phantom Tracer plus Zanpakuto, combined with the Thunder Snake Flame Knife. Unpredictable, with instant kills and swift vanishes.
A perfectly good Mage, and yet the Qing Emperor managed to turn him into an agile warrior within a month. Qing Emperor, your remodeling is quite thorough.
Yu Ruoyun’s attack speed was extremely fast, and his power was incredibly strong. Gradually, the white man realized something was amiss. He couldn’t handle Yu Ruoyun alone. If the nearby warrior, who clearly emitted Star Sea Stage Star Energy Fluctuation, joined the fray along with Wang Lan and a healed Princess Aier, he was certain to die here.
I work for the society, but I didn’t plan on sacrificing my life for it!
In an instant, the white man’s movements faltered slightly. Yu Ruoyun seized the opportunity. A rapidly spinning wind drill materialized in his palm and, in a flash, struck the white man’s chest.
BOOM—
The white man had only a bowl-sized wound in his chest, but his entire back had exploded outward.
Scattered flesh and blood landed on the ground, turning into countless sparks.
"He ran?" Yu Ruoyun’s brows furrowed, and he fiercely stomped the ground.
The earth trembled violently. The ground surged, and terrifying energy currents rampaged beneath the surface. If the opponent had fled underground, this stomp was sure to force him out, unless the white man’s subterranean escape speed surpassed the activation speed of Yu Ruoyun’s Star Martial Skill.
But... even after a long wait, there was no sign of movement.
"It seems he really got away," Wu Shaohua said softly with a sigh.
Yu Ruoyun turned towards Wang Lan. "How is Princess Aier?"
Princess Aier was still somewhat weak, but her vital signs had stabilized. Suddenly, her expression changed drastically. "Careful—"
Behind Yu Ruoyun, a paper-thin figure suddenly appeared. It rose from the ground and lunged towards Yu Ruoyun’s back. Instantly, Star Power surged from Yu Ruoyun’s body. The violent gust of wind, filled with countless needle-like wind blades, tore the paper-thin figure to shreds.
At that moment, Yu Ruoyun finally realized how the opponent had evaded his detection. The foe hadn’t fled underground. Instead, he had flattened himself into a two-dimensional state, clinging closely to the ground’s surface. By maintaining this transformation and disguise, he avoided Yu Ruoyun’s stomp, as its force was directed deep into the ground, not along the surface.
From this, it was clear Yu Ruoyun still lacked experience. Of course, such a peculiar ability was extremely rare; even the experienced Wu Shaohua hadn’t detected it.
Yu Ruoyun thought he had completely dealt with the opponent this time, but he underestimated this kind of desperado, one who constantly fought on the brink of life and death.
Behind Wang Lan, a strange figure materialized—the blood-drenched white man. He was suddenly behind Wang Lan, holding a javelin seemingly pulled from nowhere, and thrusting it towards Wang Lan’s back.
It appeared silently and struck with the speed of Swift Thunder, too fast to react.
If it were Wu Shaohua, he could have evaded the attack through Elementalization. But Wang Lan, at the Star Cloud Stage, had obviously not yet mastered this skill.
As the javelin thrust down, a full moon manifested behind Wang Lan. It was as pure and flawless as a jade disk and as large as a pot lid. The javelin clashed fiercely with the disk and shattered before it like glass.
This was the white man’s last-ditch sneak attack. If this failed, he would turn and flee. No matter how severe the punishment for failing the mission, it was better than death.
But just as the thought of escape surfaced, he suddenly discovered that he couldn’t move.
Wang Lan still had his back to the white man. However, his right hand, at some unknown moment, had drawn a knife in a reverse grip. The sharp blade effortlessly pierced the white man’s abdomen. The blade was so sharp that the white man didn’t even realize he had been impaled.
Only when he found he couldn’t move did he realize his final sneak attack hadn’t been an attack at all, but a fatal miscalculation.
Wang Lan stood up, turning around coldly.
"Who sent you?"
"Wang Lan... you’re dead! From now on, we will become your nightmare, making you live forever in fear and despair! You’re done for..."
Wang Lan reached out his hand, intending to perform a Spiritual Engraving.
Instantly, the white man’s bald head burst open like a smashed watermelon.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Grasping the Lifesaving Straw Firmly
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Chapter 345: Grasping the Lifesaving Straw Firmly
"Are you the volunteer group sent by Jade Country?" Princess Aier, having recovered, asked in standard Huaxia language.
"Yes."
"I am deeply saddened and outraged by what happened to you. We came to rescue you as soon as we got the message... Although it’s like locking the stable after the horse has bolted... we’ve done our best. It was our fault for not taking adequate safety measures, and I am very sorry." Princess Aier respectfully bowed to Wang Lan and the other two.
The sensation from that touch earlier was indeed unmistakable... so impressive!
Wang Lan hastily averted his gaze, while Wu Shaohua looked on with helpless resignation, silently gazing skyward.
"Princess Aier, you need not feel guilty. Our helicopter was not shot down, and we successfully landed in Iced City. It was King Cain who requested our assistance for you."
"..." Princess Aier’s eyes instantly widened like light bulbs, then a sincere smile spread across her face. "That’s excellent news."
"Let’s head back; it’s going to be dark soon," Wu Shaohua said indifferently.
Even though Princess Aier was still weak, she had no problem traveling. An hour later, Wang Lan returned to their landing spot, where the helicopter was still waiting.
Since several hundred members of the Royal Guard had been rescued, it obviously wasn’t suitable for everyone to take the helicopter back, so the group decided to walk. Even a Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warrior, when moving at full speed, could travel faster than a car.
Of course, not the kind of car on a highway, but rather one moving at typical city speeds, around forty to fifty miles per hour.
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is not large, covering an area equivalent to three Suzhou Cities, and more than half of it is dense mountainous forests. Even if the other rescue team was on foot, they could return within four hours.
On the helicopter, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun exchanged names. When Princess Aier heard Wang Lan’s name, her eyes, already wide as light bulbs, seemed to become glowing ones.
"Are you the peerless Princess Yu of Jade Country? I often heard your name while studying abroad in Elan Country. You awakened your Star Martial Art talent at the age of six, possessing innate talent in four elements, and by the age of ten, you had already reached the level of a professional warrior. In terms of talent, no one in any royal family around the world can compare to you."
"Princess Aier, you praise me too highly. Jade Country is a republic; we have no royalty, and therefore no princesses."
"But Jade Country is unique. It was the great Benevolent Emperor who, with such foresight two hundred years ago, realized that the monarchical system was no longer suitable for Jade Country. Compared to the constitutional monarchies of other countries, Jade Country’s reform was the most thorough and successful.
"The royal family of Jade Country are the nation’s benefactors. Although your status as a princess is unofficial, it is very real. Unlike my title, which is merely nominal."
"How could Princess Aier, known as the ’Pearl of Ice and Snow,’ be a princess in name only? You have already become the spiritual beacon of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"Have you ever seen a princess who has to worry each day whether she will survive until the next dawn?"
As the conversation reached this point, the atmosphere suddenly turned solemn.
"Why don’t you two stop with the mutual flattery? You’re both genuine princesses, alright?" Wang Lan said with a playful laugh, breaking the silence.
"It’s not mutual flattery. I’ve actually known about Princess Aier since I was very young. I once even regarded her as my idol." Yu Ruoyun’s lips curved into a slight smile. "Princess Aier was once the genius most likely to break through to the Star Sea Stage before the age of twenty. Had it not been for the upheaval in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow... perhaps that record would have been broken five years ago?"
"Oh?" Wang Lan looked at Aier in surprise. Although she had clearly suffered greatly, her Star Sea Stage strength was undeniable. Moreover, since Westerners’ features often made their age difficult to guess, Wang Lan had misjudged Princess Aier’s age, assuming she was at least in her late twenties.
"Princess Aier awakened her Star Martial Art talent at eight and was then sent to Elan Country to receive a high-standard education. She broke through to the Star Shine Stage at eleven, the Star Cloud Stage at fourteen, and by eighteen, she was a genius at the mid-Galaxy Stage.
"At that time, at least ten Titled Strongmen expressed their desire to take Princess Aier as their disciple; even the Pope from God’s Country conveyed this sentiment. But at nineteen, when she was preparing to challenge the Star Sea Stage, she resolutely gave up her advantageous conditions to return to her country.
"Afterward, news of Princess Aier became scarce, apart from the announcement a year ago that she had broken through to the Star Sea Stage."
"My country nurtured me, and my people need me. As the princess of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, I had to return. This is my mission."
As they spoke, the helicopter returned to the Imperial Courtyard Airport of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. From the air, Wang Lan had seen a group of royal family members eagerly waiting outside the tarmac. When the helicopter landed, the royal family members surged forward.
"Thank heavens, my daughter, you’re back safe and sound!"
"Thank you, Mr. Wu, and thank you, Princess Yu, and thank you, Mr. Wang!" Kester sincerely thanked the three of them. Compared to Cain, who was solely focused on his beloved daughter, Kester was impeccable in his diplomacy.
Fortunately, Wang Lan and the others weren’t concerned with such details. It was understandable for a father to be terrified and worried when his daughter had so narrowly escaped death.
As for the group leading the Royal Guard on foot, they had not yet returned. However, Longya had already contacted them; they had left the dense forest and reached a border town, and were now on their way back by car.
"Mission: Rescue the Princess - Complete. Reward: 10,000 Experience Points, 800 Skill Points."
After Wu Shaohua disbanded the team, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun returned to their dormitories. The volunteer group’s dorms were single rooms, each equipped with a dedicated attendant who could be addressed for any needs.
This arrangement showed the sincerity of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Wang Lan’s luggage had already been delivered to his room; since it contained personal items, the attendant had not touched it. From the moment he disembarked the aircraft upon arrival, Wang Lan had been taken to a meeting room, followed immediately by the mission to rescue Princess Aier. He had been busy for three full hours without rest. Coupled with the energy expended shooting down missiles during the flight earlier, Wang Lan was now utterly exhausted, both physically and mentally.
However, the two large bags in the room were too conspicuous to ignore. With no other choice, Wang Lan got up and took some necessities out of his luggage. After taking a shower, he lay on the bed and took out his cell phone. He suddenly realized he was in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, a country struggling for basic survival, let alone possessing a functional network. Without a network, his phone was essentially useless.
KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK— Someone knocked on the door.
Opening the door, the female attendant responsible for his room stood at the entrance. "Respected sir, Princess Aier invites you to dine with her this evening."
"Just me alone?" Wang Lan frowned.
"I... I don’t know about that."
"Never mind, I’ll eat with my comrades. It’s not good to receive special treatment."
"Sir, you’re overthinking it. The princess’s dinner is the same as the one for the aid team. It’s just in a different location. Princess Aier would like to have a chat with you."
"I see... Should I consult my superior first?"
"Of course!"
Wang Lan found Wu Shaohua. After explaining the situation, Wu Shaohua, without a second thought, gave his immediate consent with a wave of his hand.
Guided by the maid, Wang Lan entered the inner court of the palace and was then led into Princess Aier’s sleeping quarters.
Princess Aier seemed to have just taken a bath. Her hair was still slightly damp, and she had changed into a tight-fitting, purple long dress. Her curvaceous figure and majestic peaks sent Wang Lan’s pulse racing.
Fortunately, Wang Lan had strong willpower. His gaze only lingered on Princess Aier for an instant before he offered a smile. "Did you only invite me, Princess? I thought Ruoyun would be here as well."
"I invited Princess Yu as well; she just hasn’t arrived yet." Hearing this, Wang Lan let out a quiet sigh of relief.
The moment Wang Lan stepped into Princess Aier’s chambers and laid eyes on her, he tensed up. It wasn’t that Princess Aier’s beauty set off his hormones, but her attire was clearly a honey trap.
If Princess Aier were to tear her dress now and cry for help, he figured he’d be doomed.
This wasn’t unfounded paranoia. The dress Princess Aier wore was designed to stir a man’s desire, provocative from head to toe. Although he didn’t know why she would do such a thing or what she stood to gain, Wang Lan had to remain on guard as long as there was any possibility.
Unable to discern the expression she hoped for on Wang Lan’s face, Princess Aier gestured with her hand, and two maids brought over a fur-lined cloak to put on her. Clothed in the cloak, Princess Aier instantly transformed from seductive to regal and dignified, devoid of any trace of tempting allure.
Alright... she was definitely doing this on purpose.
"Princess Yu has arrived."
"Wang Lan, how come you’re here so quickly?"
"I thought I was moving quite slowly," Wang Lan said with a light smile, knowing Yu Ruoyun would surely understand his meaning.
"Both of you came to aid the Kingdom of Ice and Snow in its time of need, braving dangers from afar. I am deeply grateful. With this cup, I toast our friends who have journeyed so far." With that, she lifted her glass of red wine.
"Princess Aier, Jade Country and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow have maintained diplomatic relations for nearly a hundred years. Our countries share a profound friendship. Jade Country could never stand by idly while the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is in trouble. Our friendship doesn’t require thanks; this is simply what we should do."
"Twelve years ago, I was still studying in Elan Country. Whenever friends around me asked, ’What is your homeland like?’ I would tell them, ’My homeland is an emerald nestled in a vast snowfield.’
"It enjoys spring-like weather year-round, always blossoming with flowers. It has chilling snow but also warm springs. It boasts the world’s most magnificent natural wonders and the most enchanting blue skies and white clouds. The people living in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow are fortunate; they never worry about food or the cold. They simply live happily, governed by my father and uncle. I deeply love my country.
"But all this changed when I was ten years old. That day, I learned from the news that a Different Dimensional Space had appeared in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, spewing out numerous vicious Exotic Beasts.
"At that time, like all my countrymen, I wasn’t overly concerned, because we all believed we could easily overcome the difficulty.
"However, we hadn’t anticipated that the cost of closing that Different Dimensional Space would be so immense. It took half our national strength and the sacrifice of thirty thousand elite warriors to seal it. In that battle, twelve of our country’s fifty Star Sea realm experts perished.
"Just as we were cheering that we’d finally closed that accursed Different Dimensional Space, another, even more brutal one, opened up.
"What we thought was the worst moment proved to be only the beginning..."

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Everything is Ready
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 346: Everything is Ready
"Ten years ago, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow could no longer protect its citizens with its own strength. In 2010, the number of Star Martial Warriors in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had plummeted to fewer than 10,000, and those at the Star Sea Stage numbered less than ten.
"And I was still studying abroad in Elan Country. I repeatedly requested my father to let me return, but he refused every time. It wasn’t until 2015 that General Aibula, a five-star general from the Ministry of Defense, died in a tide of Exotic Beasts. With his death, the last Pillar of Heaven in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow fell.
"Upon my insistent requests, I returned to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. For the next five years, we could only gather the citizens for passive defense.
"After returning to my country, I couldn’t believe that this impoverished and decaying nation was the beautiful and prosperous homeland of my memory. When I saw the emaciated children, their eyes filled with despair and lifelessness, I swore deep in my heart that I must survive and protect them.
"Five years passed. Although many major international powers extended a helping hand, their assistance was limited to materials, food, and medicine. While we desperately needed these, what we truly required was the closure of those damned Different Dimensional Spaces.
"But... the Poisonous Beasts of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were too terrifying; even a Titled Strongman couldn’t last more than ten minutes in an atmosphere thick with poison gas. Volunteer groups arrived one after another, only to leave helplessly, one by one.
"Do you know? Every time a volunteer group came, I regarded them as messengers from the gods. But seeing them depart in helplessness, I felt the despair of being forsaken by the gods.
"At that time, I swore in my heart that if anyone could save my country, I would willingly serve them faithfully, dedicating the rest of my life to them.
"Hope alternated with despair, again and again. Since 2017, not a single country has been willing to come to our rescue. We could only watch helplessly as the Exotic Beasts gradually devoured the territory of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, devouring my people.
"Until that day, when those who had fled the Kingdom of Ice and Snow brought news: at the Star Martial Academy in Jade Country’s Modu City, a young man had invented a Star Martial Toxin Vaccine that would forever change humanity’s disadvantage against Poisonous Beasts.
"Hearing this news, I felt as if I were listening to a heavenly choir. For two whole months, I eagerly awaited your arrival every day—especially yours, my godsent youth."
Princess Aier’s earnest gaze, like the intense vision of a Kryptonian, made Wang Lan feel as if he were burning.
Wang Lan had never experienced the joy of being needed.
"Princess Aier, your wait was worth it. Haven’t we arrived?" Yu Ruoyun said with a gentle smile. Her words dissolved the awkwardness, and the atmosphere instantly thawed. Princess Aier quickly composed herself.
"Princess Yu, Mr. Wang, please have a seat."
"Princess Aier, why does ’T’ want to target you?" Wang Lan suddenly asked curiously.
"Targeting me? It might be... because of despair. The current situation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is not of our making; our royal family has been making tremendous efforts. To be honest, the royal family could leave the Kingdom of Ice and Snow at any time and live a wealthy life in any other country.
"However, even in the most difficult times, we never abandoned our citizens. I dare not claim that the royal family’s actions are flawless, but we strive to do our best. Still, some people attribute the sufferings of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to the royal family’s inaction.
"Even if they can’t directly blame us, they claim my father was cursed by the God of Heaven, bringing punishment upon the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Then they incite the uninformed populace, and through the escalating conflict, the ’T’ organization gradually formed."
"I’m afraid the ’T’ organization isn’t that simple. Given the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s current state, not even its military possesses such advanced armaments. And it’s certain that someone within the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is colluding with the ’T’ organization."
As Wang Lan finished speaking, Princess Aier’s expression instantly darkened.
Princess Aier was no fool. The moment she heard that the volunteer delegation had been attacked by missiles, she instantly understood. The aircraft was attacked after entering the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s airspace; it had to be the ’T’ organization. Furthermore, details of the delegation’s flight path, departure point, and so on, were known only to Jade Country and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Jade Country would not have leaked the information, so the leak must have originated from within the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"Those with access to the volunteer delegation’s flight schedule and route information would be either members of the royal family or high-ranking officials in the Ministry of Defense..."
"By the way, Princess Aier, your uncle, Prince Kester, seems to wield considerable power?" Wang Lan suddenly asked with curiosity. "When the news of your ambush arrived, King Cain was panic-stricken. It was Prince Kester who quickly arranged everything and requested our immediate support. It seems your country’s officials are quite accustomed to this?"
"Yes, my uncle is my father’s only brother and the first in line to the throne. Honestly, my father has said more than once that my uncle far surpasses him in the ability to govern the country.
"But I don’t know what my grandfather was thinking when he passed the throne to my father." Princess Aier said with a wry smile, "If I weren’t the princess of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, I don’t know if I would possess this sense of duty. Perhaps I would have stayed in Elan Country, like many of the wealthy who fled the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"Wang Lan, what are you thinking about?"
"I’m thinking about the motive! The volunteer groups came to save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Considering the Kingdom’s plight, this should benefit everyone. No faction would have a reason to attack us. So why did they? What benefit does a constantly imperiled, possibly doomed Kingdom of Ice and Snow offer them?"
"Could it be the Demon Clan?"
"It makes no sense!" Wang Lan shook his head. "Even though Princess Aier is present, I must speak the truth. The fate of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow alone won’t alter the balance of power for humanity. If the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were to fall, dealing with these Exotic Beasts would actually become simpler. Intercontinental ballistic missiles could scourge the land, eradicating the beasts. Even the Different Dimensional Spaces could likely be dealt with by five nuclear warheads."
Wang Lan’s words made both women frown.
"That is indeed true. Then why?"
"Unless someone wants to maintain the status quo because maintaining it benefits them."
After the meal, Princess Aier invited them for a stroll in the rear garden, but Wang Lan declined, citing exhaustion. Before he left, Princess Aier specifically told Wang Lan that he could make any request of her.
This hint was already quite blatant.
From the initial attempts at seduction to this current insinuation, Wang Lan was no naive man and naturally understood Princess Aier’s intentions. Yet, he didn’t feel any aversion towards her. In moments of despair, anyone would clutch at a lifesaving straw.
For that lifesaving straw, she would do anything.
Even if sacrificing her dignity was merely to curry favor with Wang Lan, hoping he would apply himself more diligently and expedite the development of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine—even if just a little faster—many lives could be saved.
Wang Lan smiled wryly and shook his head.
Forget noble status. When someone has nothing left and only a desperate plea, who can claim they would act any better? In chaotic times, human life is worth less than a dog’s.
「The next day,」 a thousand soldiers from the International Security Council’s International Peacekeeping Troops successfully arrived. Though nominally dispatched by the International Security Council, the contingent was, in fact, Jade Country’s Star Martial Skill Legion. While these thousand peacekeepers weren’t as formidable as the elites from Modu City’s Star Martial Academy, they included three Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warriors, and their average strength was at the Star Cloud Stage—significantly superior to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s Royal Guard.
「Also, on the next day,」 Wang Lan began his work. Before Jade Country’s volunteer delegation arrived, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had already commenced preliminary preparations. Over the years, samples of Star Martial Toxins from the various Different Dimensional Spaces had largely been collected. It took Wang Lan only a day to formulate the vaccines for twenty kinds of Star Martial Toxins, including two mutated variants.
This speed was much faster than when he was at the academy.
If someone asked, it was due to improved proficiency; if no one asked, then it didn’t matter.
Once the vaccine formulations were complete, they were immediately transmitted back to Jade Country via satellite network. Jiayi Biotech promptly requisitioned half of its production lines for manufacturing, ensuring that the vaccines could be produced and airlifted to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow within a week.
This time, Jade Country truly demonstrated to the royal family of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow what "Jade Country speed" meant.
Princess Aier, in particular, now looked at Wang Lan with even greater sincerity and fervor. Previously, her enthusiasm towards Wang Lan stemmed from the hope that he would swiftly save her country.
But after witnessing Wang Lan dive into work on the second day, send the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine formulations for development within a single day, and then receiving Jade Country’s confirmation that 10,000 doses of the vaccine would be airlifted within five days, Aier was astounded by Jade Country’s speed.
Were you worried Jade Country might drag its feet, taking its sweet time? Well, now the concern shifted to whether the Kingdom of Ice and Snow itself would hinder Jade Country’s progress.
In fact, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was indeed caught off guard by Jade Country’s pace and was, to some extent, falling behind. Although they received support from Jade Country, this support consisted of top-tier combat power; the Kingdom of Ice and Snow still needed to provide its own regular fighting forces.
Fewer than 3,000 Star Martial Warriors remained in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and most of them were mere child soldiers. It couldn’t be helped; battle-ready warriors perished in large numbers each year, and the only thing the Kingdom of Ice and Snow could do was protect the young generation.
Therefore, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had to issue international invitations for mercenaries. They couldn’t afford the fees charged by renowned mercenary armies, so they had to cast a wide net and recruit individual fighters. For a daily wage of 80,000 Jade Coins, they could hire some Star Shine Stage Star Martial Warriors willing to travel great distances.
But at this rate, it was estimated that it would still take at least seven days for the mercenaries to assemble.
"What? Jade Country can be fully prepared in five days, but we won’t be ready for another seven? Damn it, speed things up! If necessary, offer more money to get those mercenaries here faster! Anyone not arriving within five days will be dismissed!"
Prince Kester roared like an enraged lion during the defense council meeting.
And after formulating the twenty-odd vaccines, Wang Lan earned 200,000 experience points, 50,000 of which came from the mutated Star Martial Toxins.
Two hundred thousand experience points pushed Wang Lan’s experience bar forward by one-fifth. At this rate, advancing to the Galaxy Stage after completing this aid mission no longer seems like an impossible dream. After reaching the Galaxy Stage, all skills can be upgraded to the platinum tier. Platinum-level Star Martial Skills are already the signature techniques of Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warriors.
A single platinum-level Star Martial Skill is enough to make a Star Sea Stage Star Martial Warrior stand out from the crowd. If Wang Lan could achieve all platinum-level skills... the prospect was too beautiful to comprehend.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Breakthrough to Galaxy Stage
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 347: Breakthrough to Galaxy Stage
Five days later, Wang Lan completed the final variant of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine.
"Congratulations Host, you’ve completed the full set of mutated Star Martial Toxin Vaccines. Awarded 100,000 experience points and 20,000 skill points."
During these days, while Wang Lan waited for the Star Martial Toxin Vaccines to arrive, he wasn’t idle. Under the personal leadership of Princess Aier, he and the Star Martial Academy volunteer group ventured into Different Dimensional Spaces. They collected 80 types of Star Martial Toxin samples, encompassing nearly all toxins from the five Different Dimensional Spaces of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Wang Lan naturally synthesized the vaccines for all these toxins and sent them back to his country. Besides unimaginable exhaustion, the 80 types of Star Martial Toxins brought him a massive amount of experience points. Unbeknownst to him, the 1,000,000 experience points requirement had dwindled to less than 100,000.
When the final set of mutated Star Martial Toxin Vaccines was completed, the experience bar instantly filled. In that moment, a wave of Star Energy Fluctuation spread out from Wang Lan.
Princess Aier, who had just arrived outside Wang Lan’s dormitory intending to check on him, suddenly halted, her face showing an expression as if she’d seen a ghost.
These past few days, Princess Aier would visit Wang Lan whenever she had free time. She couldn’t quite explain her feelings, but seeing Wang Lan work with such earnestness always made her feel that this boy was incredibly handsome. While Wang Lan was indeed somewhat handsome, he was by no means drop-dead gorgeous, especially considering their different races and aesthetic standards. Yet, Princess Aier’s feelings were strangely intense. She swore it wasn’t flattery or self-hypnosis; Wang Lan’s focused state had truly made her fall for him at first sight. How to describe this love at first sight? Just one look, and I’d already thought of names for our future children.
Although she knew it wasn’t good to disturb Wang Lan while he worked, Princess Aier couldn’t help but come to see him, even if it meant just sitting quietly to the side and watching. But... what was happening now? This commotion... wasn’t it the sound of someone making a breakthrough? Moreover, it wasn’t just any breakthrough, but the kind that signified a major leap in realm. Wang Lan had been synthesizing Star Martial Toxin Vaccines these past days. Could he really manage his cultivation simultaneously? No wonder he achieved such brilliant successes at only eighteen... And Yu Ruoyun said Wang Lan only awakened his Star Martial talents at sixteen. Compared to Wang Lan, my own reputation as a genius deserves to be flushed down the toilet.
The noise of Wang Lan’s breakthrough alarmed many of his classmates and instructors at the camp. WHOOSH, WHOOSH, WHOOSH. Led by Yu Ruoyun, several people quickly arrived outside Wang Lan’s dormitory.
"Princess Aier, is Wang Lan breaking through?"
"I don’t know. I just got here myself. I hadn’t even knocked when the Star Energy Fluctuation came from inside."
"This is the Star Energy Fluctuation of advancing to the Galaxy Stage! Everyone, be quiet for now and guard Wang Lan," Wu Shaohua hurriedly commanded.
"No need. He has completed his breakthrough," Yu Ruoyun said indifferently as she glanced at the door, a look of resignation on her face. She had long grown accustomed to Wang Lan’s frequent breakthroughs.
When the semester began, Wang Lan had just broken through to the Star Cloud Stage. Students at Modu City Star Martial Academy typically didn’t get many chances to fight in their first year, meaning few Soul Bead gains. Yet, this guy managed to advance from the early Star Cloud Stage to its peak in just one semester. Now, he had been in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow for just a few days, and before a real battle could even start, he broke through first. It was time for me, a once-in-a-millennium genius, to abdicate and make way for someone more worthy.
After completing the breakthrough, Wang Lan could finally upgrade his Gold skills again.
Speaking of which, my skills haven’t been elevated to their ultimate state. Only Song of Life, Phantom Tracer, Flame Sword, Meteor Fire Rain, and Earth Surge Fire Sea have reached Gold Nine. Even Crescent Arrow and Thunder Snake haven’t reached Gold Nine. Not to mention, many of my S-rank Star Martial Skills are still at Gold One or Two, such as Sentient Beings, Holy Shield, Gate of The Underworld, and so on. By the time I reached the Star Cloud Stage, I had already realized that skill points were becoming scarce, and I had to forgo enhancing some Star Martial Skills. Before reaching the peak of the Star Cloud Stage, having obtained Zanpakuto, I geared myself towards a swift combat approach, primarily focusing on Phantom Tracer and Flame Sword, occasionally coupled with Star Cloud Sword Dance. In large battles, I would deploy Meteor Fire Rain and Earth Surge Fire Sea, two area-effect Star Martial Skills. But who could have anticipated that I would obtain the talent of The Whirlpool Clan? With my Star Power replenished, I can now follow the Mage’s path. In that case, those S-rank Star Martial Skills I’ve mastered will come in handy: Flame Sword, Water Severing Knife for long-distance attacks; Sentient Beings for taking on ten opponents at once; Gate of The Underworld for defense; Meteor Fire Rain to clear the field. I can just stand afar, and a casual wave of my hand will bring Heaven Rupturing Earth Splitting. It has both style and safety, much stronger than charging forward with Zanpakuto and Holy Shield for close-quarters combat. But in the later stages, supporting so many Star Martial Skills will require too many skill points. It might not seem like it, but my system only has 70,000 or 80,000 skill points left. These are just enough to max out S-rank Star Martial Skills like Sentient Beings. So, should I upgrade Weight Exchange? Should I upgrade Thunder Snake? What about Gate of The Underworld and Holy Shield? Water Severing Knife, Inch Strength Fist, and so on... there’s a whole lot to upgrade. Learning too many S-rank Star Martial Skills... is not necessarily a good thing,
Wang Lan thought.
"I’m finally done..." Wang Lan’s voice came from behind the door as it was slowly opened.
Wang Lan, who was stretching, abruptly froze mid-action. The crowd outside stared at him, wide-eyed.
"You’re all here... what’s up? Is something the matter?"
This question made Princess Aier feel as if she’d turned to stone. Didn’t he have any clue what was going on?
"You just had a breakthrough. You’d better spend some time to solidify it," Yu Ruoyun said, somewhat resigned. "I’ve never seen anyone break through as smoothly or as frequently as you do."
"Forget you, I haven’t seen anyone like that either... Don’t all stare at me, alright? High talent isn’t my fault, is it? Are you guys hungry? How about we get something to eat?"
"You should consolidate your realm as soon as possible. Tonight, the first batch of vaccines will arrive, and tomorrow we’re heading out to the first Different Dimensional Space."
"Wang Lan, if you’re hungry, I can have the kitchen prepare something for you immediately. What would you like to eat?"
"Do you have noodles?"
"Yes, please wait a moment." Princess Aier hurriedly left.
"Wang Lan... um, I know I shouldn’t ask, but... was your sudden breakthrough because of the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record? Is it that powerful?"
The news about the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record was no longer a secret in the Star Martial Academy, but it was not yet ready for widespread implementation. Even if the nation urgently needed to promote it, it couldn’t be announced all at once. Promotion had to be planned and purposeful. Wu Shaohua and the others had only heard of it but hadn’t seen it.
"Mr. Wu, even without the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record, he breaks through casually. It’s not the first or second time he’s broken through after a battle. But speaking of the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record... although its effects are good, they’re not as abnormal as his. I estimate that even with cultivating the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record, it would take about two and a half years to break through from the peak of the Star Cloud Stage to the Galaxy Stage. He went from the early Star Cloud Stage to the Galaxy Stage in less than a semester."
"It takes two and a half years? That’s not fast at all," Wu Shaohua said, suddenly losing interest.
"I mean, under the condition of having no Soul Beads at all. And this is, after all, the Qi Cultivation Chapter, which mainly focuses on the early stages. If one still lacks a substantial source of Soul Beads by the peak of the Star Cloud Stage, then that Star Cloud Stage cultivation is practically useless."
"Mr. Wu, the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record does help those above the Star Cloud Stage, but it’s not decisive. However, for the early stages, especially for newly awakened Star Martial Warriors, it’s something that could give them a five-year lead. If their talent is high, breaking through from the Starlight Stage to the Star Shine Stage wouldn’t even take half a year, and breaking through from the Star Shine Stage to the Star Cloud Stage would take at most two years. Think about it, how many geniuses have been stuck in the early stages for five, six, seven, or even eight years?"
With this explanation, it sounded truly impressive.
Take those who awaken at nine years old, for example. If they had the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record, they could reach the Star Cloud Stage by twelve. At that point, they’d have enough strength to hunt Exotic Beasts in the trial grounds, and their power would soar rapidly. In another three years, they could reach the Galaxy Stage by fifteen or sixteen. Thinking about it this way... my goodness. By that time, will a large number of high school students at the Galaxy Stage emerge? Maybe even a flood of eighteen-year-olds breaking through to the Star Sea Stage? And those who break through to the Star Sea Stage before twenty-two could aim to challenge the Five Emperors, a realm that transcends the Star Sea. In 20 years, there could be hundreds, if not thousands, of powerhouses like the Five Emperors. Damn!
Wu Shaohua trembled with excitement at the thought that he might witness such a magnificent scene in his lifetime.
The crowd quickly dispersed; Wang Lan’s breakthrough was just a minor episode.
Shortly after, Princess Aier arrived at Wang Lan’s dormitory carrying an exquisite food box.
Although the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was at a point of desperation with scarce resources, thanks to aid from other nations and a recent donation of food from Jade Country, they wouldn’t skimp on treating Wang Lan and his group of saviors, even if they had to scrimp and save for themselves. For the past five days, the volunteer group’s meals couldn’t be called lavish, but they included meat at every meal.
Cooked rice with side dishes tasted decent, but Wang Lan had a strong preference for noodles. He had been missing them for many days and was actually planning to make instant noodles in his dorm after getting some fresh air. But since the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had real noodles, Wang Lan, of course, opted for the delicious alternative.
SLURP, SLURP...
"Is it good?" Princess Aier propped her chin on her hands, her eyes shining as she watched Wang Lan devour his meal with gusto.
"Mhm, delicious. Give that chef an extra chicken leg later. His noodles are very authentic."
"I made them."
"Huh?" Wang Lan looked at Princess Aier in surprise. "You can cook? No, wait, you can make Jade Country’s noodles? Even among Jade Country people, not many can make them—eight or nine out of ten southerners can’t."
"I just learned. I guess I have a bit of a talent for it."
"That’s very thoughtful of you," Wang Lan said, his tone carefully neutral. "How are the preparations for the upcoming battle?"
Regarding Princess Aier’s feelings for him, even Wang Lan, who could be as dense as a pig’s trotter, had finally figured them out. Unfortunately, he wasn’t in a position to accept such affection. Dealing with just Xie Sisi was already a puzzle for him, let alone this princess. A princess of a nation, how could he dare to make a move?
After considering for a split second, Wang Lan decisively shifted the conversation.
"Currently, 1,500 mercenaries have arrived. Perhaps another 500 will come tonight. By the time we depart tomorrow, we should have 2,300 to 2,400 mercenaries. Including 1,000 from our Kingdom of Ice and Snow and another 1,000 from the Jade Country’s Star Martial Army, our total force will be over 4,000. With the high-level experts from the Star Martial Academy stabilizing the battlefront, it should be enough to attack the Exotic Beasts of one Different Dimensional Space."
"By the way, how strong are the Exotic Beasts? I’ve heard that poison-type Exotic Beasts aren’t that formidable once their poison is neutralized."
"No, quite the contrary. The Exotic Beasts from these five Different Dimensional Spaces are very strong; poison might just be an ancillary ability for them. Their strength is generally at the Star Shine Stage. Some of their leaders are at the Star Cloud Stage, and the chiefs of the Exotic Beast tribes are at least at the Galaxy Stage. So far, no Exotic Beasts at the Star Sea Stage have been discovered, so it shouldn’t be too much of a problem."

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Dance of the Dark Butterfly
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 348: Dance of the Dark Butterfly
Princess Aier didn’t linger long in Wang Lan’s dormitory. Although she wanted to, Wang Lan’s businesslike and distant attitude made her leave with a heavy heart.
The dormitory once again became quiet. Wang Lan returned to his bed and sat cross-legged. He had ascended to the Galaxy Stage, finally catching up with his peers.
Wang Lan held himself to extremely rigid standards, a fact evident from his pursuit of the "Scholarly God" title. While activating the system was a reason, it was merely an excuse.
If it were someone else, even with a reason, could they muster such self-discipline? Most people might persist for a month, but persevering for five years is a different matter entirely.
In terms of raw power, he had caught up with, and even surpassed, his contemporaries—the so-called geniuses—half a year ago. But Wang Lan aimed to catch up in all aspects, to be at least on par with Jiang Xinyu.
My conventional strength has reached the Galaxy Stage.
*You’re only at the Star Cloud Stage.*
I possess the Phoenix Form; at full combat power, I can contend with those at the Star Sea Stage.
*You’re only at the Star Cloud Stage.*
The Star Cloud Stage is still just the Star Cloud Stage. No matter how high one’s combat power, the cultivation level itself remains lower.
But now, with the first semester of his freshman year not yet over, breaking through to the Galaxy Stage placed him among the small elite at the very top of all first-year students. As far as Wang Lan knew, only seven freshmen in his year had reached the Galaxy Stage.
The advancement brought not only a qualitative change to his Star Power but also an explosive increase in its reserves. In terms of quality, the Star Power consumed by the same Star Martial Skill was now about half of what it was during the Star Cloud Stage. This wasn’t because the Star Martial Skill required less Star Power, but because the quality of his Star Power had improved. As for his reserves, they had surged by about threefold from their previous base. Factoring in the tenfold increase he had already experienced due to his The Whirlpool Clan bloodline, Wang Lan now possessed enough Star Power to unleash Star Martial Skills without restraint. This held true even if all these Star Martial Skills were S-rank.
He could now launch Earth Surge Lava fifty times consecutively.
And if fifty times weren’t enough? What then? Heh... Who could even withstand fifty volleys to begin with?
The surge in Star Power filled Wang Lan with an unprecedented sense of plenitude. However, he now needed to complete another kind of transformation. Advancing to the Galaxy Stage meant the metamorphosis of his Star Power was only half done; the other half lay in the evolution of his Star Martial Skills.
Closing his eyes, Wang Lan immersed his consciousness into the system, immediately opening the Star Martial Skill panel and focusing on his Talented Skill, Song of Life.
Upgrading Song of Life from Gold LV1 to Gold LV9 had been no easy feat. Ordinary Gold-rank Star Martial Skills might only require 10,000 skill points for a significant upgrade, but Song of Life had needed a whopping 55,000 experience points to reach this stage. Especially now: Song of Life, Gold LV9 (0/10,000).
The 10,000 skill points required for the next upgrade pained Wang Lan so much that he hadn’t invested in it for a long time. He had accumulated 30,000 skill points in the last five days, which, added to his previous savings of 50,000, totaled 80,000.
Eighty thousand skill points. It sounds like a lot, but in reality... it isn’t. Upgrading Song of Life to Platinum-rank now wouldn’t even leave enough to push it all the way to Platinum LV9. Besides, there are so many other skills waiting for upgrades. Just having enough to get my main skill to Platinum-rank would be a good start.
After a brief hesitation, Wang Lan began allocating points to Song of Life. Although previous upgrades to Song of Life hadn’t yielded new abilities, Wang Lan had always sensed it was nurturing something. This feeling was difficult to articulate, much like a pregnant woman struggling to describe the sensation of carrying a child. Unfortunately, even after reaching Gold LV9, that indistinct nurturing process hadn’t completed. Yet, Wang Lan had a strong premonition it was close. Once upgraded to Platinum-rank, his Talented Skill would undergo a completely new transformation.
After 10,000 skill points were invested into the Talented Skill, a dazzling white light instantly filled Wang Lan’s vision, so brilliant it momentarily blinded him. Gradually, the light faded, and Wang Lan’s first true Platinum-rank skill appeared before him. It had a white, metallic texture, shimmering with golden light, resembling a gemstone embedded in the skill interface.
"Life Light: A Star Martial Skill evolved from Song of Life.
1. Self-Repair (Passive): Automatically triggers when the practitioner sustains critical, life-threatening injuries, rapidly repairing fatal bodily harm.
2. Spiritual Awakening (Passive): Automatically activates when the host receives fatal injuries. Induces a state of absolute clarity, granting immunity to all mental attacks, self-protective unconsciousness, and paralysis. Doubles the speed of thought processes.
3. Life Transfer (Active): Fires ten Life Lock Chains to connect with a target, transferring Life Force through the chains to heal the target’s physical damage. Characteristics: Cannot be interrupted, cannot be distorted. Range: Thirty meters.
4. Substitute Rebirth (Active): Cultivates an Original Life Orb within the heart using Life Force. When a fatal blow is received, the Life Orb, carrying the soul, can detach from the physical body. Once detached, the Life Orb immediately uses Life Force to stimulate growth, regenerating a completely new body within thirty seconds. Note: Substitute Rebirth is akin to a complete rebirth. Using this skill consumes 90% of Star Power. It is recommended that the host hide the Life Orb in a concealed location during activation to avoid a secondary attack."
Song of Life evolving to Platinum-rank and deriving so many abilities left Wang Lan stunned, his heart pounding uncontrollably in his chest. Platinum-rank skills were equivalent to Ultra S-rank Star Martial Skills in the Star Martial Art world’s hierarchy. Of course, the classification beyond Ultra S-rank was quite vague; any skill stronger than S-rank was generally termed Ultra S-rank. However, this Life Light undoubtedly held a significant place even among Ultra S-rank skills.
Two new abilities had emerged. One was immunity to all Illusion Technique attacks. Illusion Techniques had always been Wang Lan’s Achilles’ heel; he still smarted from the memory of how a mere glance from someone in Mingyue Wucheng had nearly killed him.
Although I now have methods to counter Illusion Techniques, many sophisticated ones can ensnare you without your even realizing it. If you’re unaware, you naturally won’t think of breaking free. And if you can’t break free, you could die without ever knowing how. The only drawback is that it’s a passive skill, and it only activates upon suffering life-threatening injuries.
And the final ability is incredible—essentially a simplified version of Blood Droplet Rebirth!
Wang Lan’s Self Healing Star Martial Skill was already formidable. He could fight, endure, and even regrow a shattered heart in seconds, with severe injuries healing rapidly.
But my biggest worry has always been: what if my head gets chopped off? What if I’m killed so instantly that Self Healing doesn’t even have time to react? Now, there’s a solution! With Substitute Rebirth, even decapitation isn’t a death sentence! If my head is severed, I can still launch the Life Orb, and a brand-new body will regenerate within thirty seconds! What’s that saying? ’Kill one of me, and thousands more will rise...’ Something like that. No wonder it’s my Innate Ability; it always gives me exactly what I need!
Suppressing the urge to spend another 20,000 skill points on upgrading Life Light, Wang Lan turned his attention to his other Star Martial Skills. The Phoenix Form, still grey and inactive, made him wince.
Now that I’ve reached the Galaxy Stage, I should have been able to convert Phoenix Form into a regular skill. Heaven knows how many skill points this blasted skill has devoured over the past year and a half! Those points should have been enough to upgrade Phoenix Form to Platinum or even Diamond rank by now. But because it merged with the Dragon Emperor Form, Phoenix Form directly evolved past its second stage, meaning it can only be converted at the Star Sea Stage. The Star Sea Stage... it feels like an eternity away.
Glancing over his numerous Gold-rank Star Martial Skills, his gaze finally settled on the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record. Unlike the other skills, which were focused on increasing damage output, the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record directly influenced his cultivation speed.
To progress through the entirety of the Galaxy Stage and reach the Star Sea Stage would require over 50,000,000 experience points—a truly terrifying amount! All the experience points I’ve earned so far are just a tiny fraction of that. Relying solely on completing missions, I’d probably have to save the entire galaxy to earn that much experience, right? Currently, the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record is at Gold LV2, and it needs 8,000 skill points to upgrade. It’s painful, but I have to upgrade it.
Every skill point spent on the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record felt like a piece of his own flesh being carved away. Soon, all 8,000 skill points were invested. Another flash of white light, and his second Platinum-rank skill lit up, bright as a newly born star in the heavens.
"Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record Qi Cultivation Chapter, Platinum LV1 (0/20,000). Perfection: Gain 100 experience points per minute."
One hundred experience points per minute? That’s more than I expected! At this rate, it’s 6,000 per hour. I’ve already mastered conscious control, so I can keep the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record active anytime. Except during combat and sleep, I can cultivate while walking, eating, studying, or working. It takes 2,000,000 experience points to go from Galaxy Stage LV1 to LV2. Practicing eight hours a day, I could level up in less than three months. Even advancing from Galaxy Stage LV1 to the Star Sea Stage is estimated to take less than three years! In other words, just by relying on the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record, I could potentially break through to the Star Sea Stage before finishing my senior year of university. And that’s not even counting experience points from other sources! If I factor in developing the Star Martial Toxins Vaccine, the experience gain could double. It’s a pity the Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record only provides experience points. Otherwise, why would I even bother with missions? Just quietly cultivate until graduation, reach the Star Sea Stage, and then venture out... that would have been perfect, wouldn’t it?
The Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record had solved the biggest bottleneck for his explosive growth phase. The prime period for strength development for all Star Martial Warriors was between the ages of eighteen and thirty.
If other students surged ahead rapidly during this period while my own initially explosive growth started to slow, it wouldn’t look good. I’d inevitably be labeled as a talent who had peaked too early. With the Platinum-rank Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record, advancing from the early Galaxy Stage to the Star Sea Stage in three years isn’t slow at all. Reaching the Star Sea Stage by twenty-one would truly live up to the ’genius’ moniker. That would still leave me nine years to strive for the rank of one of the Five Emperors. Excellent!
Upgrading just two skills to Platinum-rank had cost him nearly 20,000 skill points.
What should I upgrade next? After some thought, Phantom Tracer is essential. It’s the top choice for ambushes and escapes.
He invested 10,000 skill points, upgrading Phantom Tracer to Platinum-rank. As the white light faded, Phantom Tracer’s name changed.
"Dance of the Dark Butterfly?"

chapters.title: Chapter 349 I Don’t Usually Hold Grudges
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 349 I Don’t Usually Hold Grudges
After reading the introduction to Dance of the Dark Butterfly and experiencing its activation method, Wang Lan’s expression was wooden. It wasn’t that Dance of the Dark Butterfly wasn’t strong, but that it was overwhelmingly powerful.
Even the potent transformation of Song of Life hadn’t shocked Wang Lan as much as Dance of the Dark Butterfly did, causing him to forget what expression could possibly describe this Star Martial Skill.
Dance of the Dark Butterfly existed between the tangible and the illusory. Activating the Star Martial Skill instantly scattered ten black butterflies from his body. Fluttering their wings, the butterflies could appear anywhere within a hundred-meter radius as if teleporting, each one an ephemeral embodiment of Wang Lan. The moment a Nether Butterfly vanished marked Wang Lan’s reappearance.
Furthermore, since the Nether Butterfly was an illusory creature, it couldn’t be attacked during its manifestation. This skill was not only aesthetically beautiful and dazzling but also incredibly stylish.
Simply put... I am in love with this ability.
However, the skill upgrade for Dance of the Dark Butterfly was terrifyingly cumulative, and Wang Lan’s remaining fifty thousand skill points were insufficient. Flame Sword was at Gold Seven, Star Cloud Sword Dance at Gold Two, and both Crescent Arrow and Thunder Snake were at Gold Five.
Especially the powerful S-grade Star Martial Skills—Sentient Beings, Holy Shield, Gate of The Underworld, Weight Exchange, and Universal Decomposition—were all still at Gold One.
Hm? Was something odd mixed in there?
Wang Lan decided he should still take care of the two skills that had reached Gold Nine.
Upgrading Meteor Fire Rain to Platinum level: Heavenly Fire Extinguishing World!
Upgrading Earth Surge Fire Sea to Platinum level: Earth Fire Roar!
Wang Lan stood up from the bed and pushed open the door. The slanting rays of the sun filtered through the doorway, warmly spilling across his face.
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s body vanished. Ten black butterflies flickered their wings, shimmering like ripples on water. With each flutter, his form disappeared, only to reappear some ten-odd meters away in the next instant.
Then, Wang Lan’s figure materialized from one of the butterflies. In a flash, his image flickered through the previous position of each butterfly before he came to stand quietly at the door, as if he had never moved at all.
"The speed and safety have improved severalfold, but the stealth aspect is still lacking. If someone could instantly memorize the positions of all the butterflies, they could predict where I’ll appear...
But then, can anyone really predict the flickering positions of the butterflies?
"
「As night fell, a heavy atmosphere of pre-war tension suddenly permeated the camp.」
Although missions on global battlefields were familiar to senior students, every sortie carried the risk of classmates dying in action. This was an unavoidable reality of war; how could there be no casualties?
No one could guarantee they wouldn’t be the next to fall.
「Meanwhile, in the royal court meeting room of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, a fierce pre-war conference was underway.」
It was attended by King Cain of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow; Prince Kester; Danmailu, Minister of Defense; Jin Wenbing, Captain of the Black Tiger Army from the Northwest War Zone; and the Captain of Longya from Modu Star Martial Academy.
"I still propose attacking Different Dimensional Space number three first," Prince Kester passionately presented his argument. "The virus samples from number three were the first to be collected, and eighty percent of the initial batch of vaccines targets it. The Exotic Beasts from Different Dimensional Space number three are also the weakest. This will allow our warriors to familiarize themselves with the war environment and quickly adjust their morale. Once number three is dealt with, we can immediately clear out four, one, and five, leaving number two—the one with the most Exotic Beasts and the harshest environment—for last."
"Uncle," Princess Aier quickly interjected after Prince Kester finished speaking, "although the blueprint for the first batch of vaccines comes from number three, the Exotic Beasts in the five Different Dimensional Spaces are almost identical; the main difference is the environment. Though Space Node Two has the most Exotic Beasts and the most severe conditions, it’s the closest to our residential areas and poses the greatest threat to our citizens. Securing Space Node Two would immediately alleviate the survival pressure on the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Even if we cannot achieve a swift victory and must endure a protracted struggle, eliminating the threat from Space Node Two would give us breathing room."
"Aier, you say Space Node Two poses the greatest threat? Is the threat from Space Node One any smaller? Number one and number two, one to the south and the other to the north, both directly threaten our living areas. Why do you favor number two? Your Majesty, we should start with number three, at least to build some confidence. The size of Space Node Three is only a quarter of Space Node Two, and with fewer than eighty thousand Exotic Beasts, our chances are better."
Cain was not a decisive or opinionated king; both Kester and Aier surpassed him in that regard. As a king, Cain’s greatest virtue was likely his character rather than his personal abilities.
He was a benevolent ruler, concerned with the people’s livelihood and loving them as his own children, but that was the extent of it.
As expected, King Cain hesitated and finally looked towards his Minister of Defense. "Danmailu, what is your opinion?"
A contrived smile appeared on Danmailu’s face as he inwardly cursed King Cain three times over. On one side was Prince Kester, and on the other was Princess Aier, the nation’s idol—both of them the most esteemed members of the royal family. Which one could I, a mere Minister of Defense, afford to offend? My position as Minister of Defense was practically forced upon me. You want me to make a statement? Can’t you two argue behind closed doors? What’s the point of dragging me into this?
"Your Respected Majesty," Danmailu began, "Prince Kester’s strategy of gradual progression is the safest and most secure. Princess Aier’s strategy, on the other hand, aims to strike at the heart of the problem, potentially changing the country’s difficult situation with a single battle. Both approaches are viable. As for which proposal to adopt... that requires Your Majesty’s decision."
Fuck, he’s such an expert at muddying the waters.
Even King Cain, usually good-tempered, showed an annoyed expression.
With a huff, King Cain eventually turned to Jin Wenbing and Longya.
"I am a teacher at the Star Martial Academy," Longya began, then looked at Jin Wenbing. "If you ask me about localized strategies, I might be able to offer some thoughts. But for a strategy concerning the overall situation like this, my abilities are somewhat lacking. When it comes to warfare, you are the expert, Jin Wenbing. You should speak."
Jin Wenbing said, "If this choice were presented in Jade Country... hahaha... there wouldn’t even be a need to think about it. Of course, we would wage war on multiple fronts! But the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is in a difficult position; they can only focus their forces in one place. I still lean towards Princess Aier’s suggestion: stabilize Space Node Two first."
"Hmph! Is it because Space Node Two threatens the energy ore veins?" Prince Kester’s face immediately darkened.
"No, it’s because we have absolute confidence in our strength. It’s only one Different Dimensional Space. If our combined forces of five thousand troops can’t handle it, then our assistance would be a joke. Moreover, we need a secure rear area. Eleven years ago, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had a chance to close Space Node One. As far as I know, you almost reached the space-time node of Space Node One, but then Space Node Two suddenly opened. To save your citizens, you had to withdraw from Space Node One, leaving only a small force to guard the entrance. But after that, while defending Space Node Two, you no longer had the strength to launch a full-scale assault on Space Node One. I don’t want the same situation to happen again. Space Node Two is too close to the civilian residential areas. I don’t want to be on the brink of victory at the front, only to be unexpectedly stabbed in the back."
"But Space Node Two has over two hundred thousand Exotic Beasts, and we only have five thousand warriors."
"But we have over thirty Star Sea realm masters. With such power, we could expand our territory by fifty kilometers even in a Pioneer Space. What’s a mere Different Dimensional Space in comparison?"
Jin Wenbing’s words seemed to instill confidence in King Cain, who silently nodded. "Fine, let’s focus on Space Node Two then. Second item: tactical planning."
「The royal court was brilliantly lit; even though it was past midnight, there was no sign of the lights being extinguished.」
Wang Lan also felt restless and couldn’t sleep, so he climbed onto the rooftop to gaze at the sky.
The night sky of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was beautiful, filled with brilliant stars. Having spent a long time in Suzhou City and then in Modu City, Wang Lan’s memories of such a starry sky had become a blurred recollection.
"Can’t sleep?" a voice suddenly asked beside him. Wu Shaohua, who had appeared beside Wang Lan without notice, continued, "First time participating? Feeling excited?"
"How could I? I’m not some greenhorn who’s never been on a battlefield. I’ve been through many life-and-death battles, each one extremely perilous."
"Oh, I almost forgot, you’re a senior special agent with the Tianjian Bureau. I heard you’ve already been promoted to Lieutenant Colonel?"
"Yeah!"
"Awesome! A lieutenant colonel in the Tianjian Bureau is considered equivalent to someone at least three ranks higher in the regular military. If you were in the military hierarchy, wouldn’t that make you a high-ranking commander?"
"That’s just a rumor. At best, one might get a one-level promotion when assigned outside, and there’s a greater chance of being dispatched to special departments. By the way, Mr. Wu, why didn’t you attend the meeting?"
"What’s there to attend? It’s none of our business anyway."
"Why?" Yu Ruoyun’s voice suddenly interjected from the side. Her arrival had gone completely unnoticed by the two of them.
"We’re responsible for guarding the rear. Especially you, Wang Lan. If a new type of Star Martial Toxin is discovered at the front line, you must create a vaccine and produce an antidote as soon as possible. The rest of the time, you’ll provide Star Martial medical treatment for us."
"I can understand that arrangement for Wang Lan, but what about me?"
"Your task is to ensure Wang Lan’s safety," Mr. Wu sighed leisurely. But everyone understood that Yu Ruoyun’s *actual* primary concern was her own safety—or rather, ensuring she *remained* safe.
She might have forgotten the pain once her scar healed, but others hadn’t. If she were to have another accident, could Jade Country even manage?
Besides, as a princess of Jade Country, her personal presence in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow for aid carried more political significance than the aid itself. Her greatest value was to demonstrate Jade Country’s sincerity to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow and to tell the whole world that Jade Country was determined to secure this feast that was the Kingdom of Ice and Snow; not even the God of Heaven could take a share.
"Sigh! To think that our Team Seven, despite being the strongest of the thirty squads in the Academy’s volunteer group, has been assigned to the rear..." Yu Ruoyun understood the reasoning behind the arrangement, but she still felt a pang of melancholy.
"It’s precisely because of our strength that we’ve been uniquely tasked with holding the rear."
"Is there really a need to guard the rear?"
"Yes!" Before Mr. Wu could speak, Wang Lan interjected sternly, "That T, and the people behind T, won’t let us complete our assistance mission so easily. The medical teams outside the Different Dimensional Space and the delivery of supplies are the responsibility of the Defense Forces. However, Mr. Wu, I suggest that you and Ruoyun covertly escort them, especially the vaccines. Any small accident could completely ruin our efforts."
"I understand. We almost forgot about that, but you still remembered?"
"Of course. I may not hold grudges, but if someone slaps me and I haven’t been able to return the favor, I might dwell on it for a very long time."

chapters.title: Chapter 350: The Front Line is Blazing, The Rear is Ablaze
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 350: The Front Line is Blazing, The Rear is Ablaze
There were no cheers, no goodbyes—the road was shrouded in smoke and utterly silent. Everyone’s gaze was fixed on the passing army, as if to imprint their faces onto their hearts.
"What kind of experiences have made their emotions so heavy?" Wu Shaohua sighed softly as he turned his face away in the vehicle.
"They’re betting on the nation’s fate, their hope, their everything. This is the last international assistance. Victory means peace and clear skies forever; defeat means the entire country will be beyond redemption," Princess Aier said solemnly, tears welling in her eyes.
The second Different Dimensional Space was located directly east of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Further east lay the Ice Sea, the kingdom’s maritime economic lifeline. If the second space was eliminated, it would solve the immediate danger for the Kingdom. It would also open up trade, allowing a steady stream of resources to enter the Kingdom from the Ice Sea.
Before they even neared the Different Dimensional Space, the constant sound of gunfire and cannons erupted.
"We don’t have the strength to contain the Exotic Beasts within the space, so we can only set up defenses outside. As long as the beasts dare to break out, our firepower will tear them to shreds."
However, when Wang Lan and the others arrived outside the second Different Dimensional Space, they were incredulous to find that Princess Aier’s so-called defenses consisted of merely three lines. Three lines of defense, without impregnable fortifications or significant bastions, were nothing more than a human wall formed by soldiers wearing gas masks.
Occasionally, an Exotic Beast would poke its head out of the Different Dimensional Space. Before it could clearly see the mysterious world outside, a bullet would pierce its eye socket, blowing off the top of its skull.
But most of the time, the beasts didn’t emerge that way; dozens or even hundreds would swarm out at once, as fast as Speedy Wind, and a single round of gunfire could only momentarily stall their advance. Some beasts possessed digging abilities, vanishing underground in the blink of an eye.
In such an environment, the soldiers of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had innovatively developed countless methods to deal with various Exotic Beasts, some so ingenious they were breathtaking.
For instance, every soldier was strapped with explosives. If an Exotic Beast rushed them and they had no time to retaliate or evade, they would detonate the explosives, perishing together with the beast.
This 5,000-strong army, tasked with pacifying the space, was named God’s Gift—the army bestowed by the God of Heaven to save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. When the vanguard reached the second Different Dimensional Space, they acted instantly, managing to block the beasts within the space.
The medical trucks set up a temporary frontline hospital on the battlefield outside the second Different Dimensional Space. After all, in an era lacking Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors, hospitals were the main force in treating the injured.
Wang Lan led his medical team to immediately analyze the Star Martial Toxins in the periphery. They quickly matched them with vaccines and then, at the hospital, inoculated every warrior before the battle. One inoculation meant lifelong immunity—such was the potency of the vaccine.
There were no pre-battle pep rallies, no rousing war songs.
Once all the warriors had been inoculated, they were led by the volunteer corps from the Academy and plunged headlong into the Different Dimensional Space.
If one were to describe the environment of the second Different Dimensional Space with an era, it would be the Permian period’s hellscape of molten lava. The ground seemed to be drenched in lava, and the clouds above were black. The lakes and rivers emitted steam from boiling water. The rocky terrain occasionally cracked open, spewing scorching magma.
In such an environment, human survival time was certainly measured in seconds. However, the Exotic Beasts here seemed to revel in this environment, leaping between rocks and bathing in the lakes.
The appearance of the human army instantly drew the attention of the Exotic Beasts. They roared and charged towards the humans, hundreds, even thousands of them bellowing with a ferocity that vibrated eardrums.
According to past experience, humans entering their territory wouldn’t last long before feeling dizzy and stumbling. When the beasts charged into their ranks, it would inevitably result in a one-sided slaughter. The occasional, somewhat stronger individual might hold out for 10 or 20 minutes before succumbing to weakness. For the Exotic Beasts near the entrance, this was a common, accustomed sight. Oh? Quite a few of them this time, but no matter, they’re all just weaklings. We won’t need 10 minutes to finish this battle. Finally, fresh, tender meat again! The flesh of the Exotic Beasts in this space is tougher than any other.
Facing the surging charge of Exotic Beasts, some of the mercenaries at the rear showed signs of agitation and fear. But for the volunteer corps, which was both shoring up the rear and leading the charge at the front, this was just child’s play.
Princess Aier assessed her body’s condition; indeed, she felt not the slightest discomfort. The vaccine truly provided immunity to Star Martial Toxins.
It’s perfect, absolutely perfect!
"Ice Snow, Solitary Frost of Nightfall—" Princess Aier initiated the attack. Her Star Power surged, and she took a deep breath, her chest visibly expanding.
A frigid blast of air erupted, instantly coating the ground before her in frost, turning the first dozen charging Exotic Beasts into ice sculptures.
BOOM, BOOM, BOOM—
The beasts following behind slammed into them, and the dozens of ice sculptures shattered into fragments before they even comprehended what had happened.
"Hell Swamp!" a leading teacher shouted, slamming his palm onto the ground. A black quagmire, over a hundred meters wide, appeared before him. More than 20 Exotic Beasts, unable to stop in time, plunged headfirst into the mire.
"Hell Fire Burning!"
The swamp suddenly began to churn violently. As it spun, flames erupted, instantly drying the mire. When the swamp stilled, the more than 20 Exotic Beasts that had fallen in had fused with the swamp itself.
With a gentle wave of the teacher’s hand, more than 20 Soul Beads shot out from the swamp and landed in his palm.
The Exotic Beasts in the second space were indeed quite strong, much stronger than those in Jade Country’s advanced training grounds. But... it all depended on the comparison.
If it weren’t for the 30 Star Sea Stage experts and the many Galaxy Stage elites from the academy, this Different Dimensional Space would have been a tough fight, even for the Black Tiger Army. For those mercenaries, it would have been an absolute meat grinder, a hellish battlefield.
But with this contingent from Modu City Star Martial Academy, these Exotic Beasts were as docile as rabbits—not fierce at all, almost cute. With only four or five Star Sea Stage masters taking action, the first few hundred Exotic Beasts that rushed forward were all finished off.
"We will advance another kilometer and establish this as our rear base."
"Okay!"
In this battle, the Black Tiger Army barely had a chance to act, let alone the throng of highly-paid mercenaries, making them feel as if they were just there to make up the numbers.
"Truly one of the top four Star Martial Academies... Their strength is comparable to one of our entire military regions."
