"Now you see the difference between your unaccredited college and the top four, right? A single student of theirs could be the principal of your school. Tactical teachers, all at Star Sea Stage. Tsk, tsk... No wonder they say, ’One of the Four Great Academies can destroy a nation.’"
In less than half a day, a large rear base, about a kilometer in depth, was cleared outside the second space. Emergency supplies and all other necessary items were transported into the space.
Next came the large-scale search for the Different Dimensional Space’s spatial-temporal nodes. This Different Dimensional Space was about a third the size of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Its environment was harsh and teeming with Exotic Beasts, and no one knew where the spatial nodes were located.
Without detection equipment, they could only search bit by bit, like finding a needle in a haystack. The subsequent strategy involved 30 squads, along with Black Tiger Army squads, leading teams of "cannon fodder" to spread out and search for the spatial-temporal nodes.
This was a lengthy and dangerous task. No one could guarantee that an Exotic Beast wouldn’t leap out from an unseen corner and claim your life. The mercenaries, driven by money, understood this clearly; as the saying goes, fortune is found in peril. As long as they could survive and return, their small stake could turn into a fortune.
The main mission of Wang Lan’s squad was to guard the rear. This involved ensuring the safe transportation of materials. They also had to quickly identify corresponding vaccines for any unknown Star Martial Toxins discovered on the front lines and administer injections. If a corresponding vaccine didn’t exist, Wang Lan would have to concoct an antidote on the spot.
The Star Martial Toxin Synthesizer was still lying in Wang Lan’s spatial equipment.
After resting for an hour, the troops dispersed once more, heading deeper into the Different Dimensional Space. Three hours later, the rear base also began to bustle.
Wounded soldiers were brought back intermittently, and new types of Star Martial Toxins appeared. Although Wang Lan had already developed over 80 kinds of Star Martial Toxin vaccines, the second space might not contain all the toxins found across five such spaces. There were certainly undiscovered toxins.
As the battle progressed, the situation developed much better than Wang Lan had anticipated. Although there were casualties on the front lines, the numbers were not substantial. As for the Star Martial Academy and the Black Tiger Army, they had their own Medical Attribute Star Martial Warriors with them.
Besides matching toxins with vaccines, Wang Lan also frequently took on Star Martial medical treatments to earn some extra cash.
Ten Soul Beads for one treatment! Too expensive? The three days you’d spend lying in a hospital bed aren’t free, you know. And how many Soul Beads could you earn in those three days? Calculate it yourself! Payment upfront, treatment follows. Now, be good...
The biggest obstacle hindering Wang Lan’s advancement was no longer experience points, but skill points. In the past year, hadn’t his skills always hit their ceiling, just waiting for a mission-level upgrade to advance further?
Unlike now; after upgrading to the Galaxy Stage, most of his Star Martial Skill interfaces were still at the Gold stage—some even at Gold Level One.
It was like having OCD. Even if he didn’t raise all his Basic Skills to Platinum, wouldn’t it be much neater and more aesthetically pleasing if all the Star Martial Skill interfaces were Platinum?
Ten Soul Beads yielded only 10 skill points, but even a mosquito’s leg is meat.
Gradually, more and more mercenaries were sent back injured, and Wang Lan actually managed to earn a few thousand Soul Beads in a single day. Yu Ruoyun, who had just returned from escorting a batch of vaccines, looked on with sheer exasperation.
While I’m out here running myself ragged, you’re back here with business booming, huh? Treating 10 people at once, earning at least 100 Soul Beads per session. Just a few seconds of work, and 100 Soul Beads are yours? Spending only an hour or two a day on treatments and raking in several thousand Soul Beads?
No wonder those mercenaries were green with envy; even Yu Ruoyun felt a pang of sourness.
Three days later, the number of fatalities began to climb dramatically. By the fifth day, most areas of the second Different Dimensional Space had been searched, but the spatial-temporal nodes remained elusive. However, ferocious Exotic Beasts within the Different Dimensional Space emerged one after another, leading to an exponential increase in casualties.
The academy’s volunteer group lost two Galaxy Stage students. The Black Tiger Army lost 20 Star Cloud Stage Star Martial Warriors. The casualties among the mercenaries were significant: after five days, over 1,000 had fallen.
This was even with Wang Lan providing potent medical treatment from the rear; otherwise, the death toll would have been several hundred higher.

chapters.title: Chapter 351: The Paradise Bird is up to Something
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 351: The Paradise Bird is up to Something
Seven days passed quietly, and the battle on the front lines had reached a stalemate. Although they had successfully resisted the onslaught of the Exotic Beasts time and again, people’s hearts were growing increasingly restless.
They had searched almost every corner of the Different Dimensional Space but still hadn’t found the space-time node. Logically, the strongest Exotic Beasts should be guarding the space node, accompanied by very obvious anomalies.
The God-given Army had scouted all the dangerous places but failed to find the space-time node. If they couldn’t find the space-time node, they couldn’t close the space. And if they couldn’t close the space, did that mean they had to kill all the Exotic Beasts in this Different Dimensional Space?
You’re kidding, right? There were more than two hundred thousand of them. Even if Star Sea Stage teachers from the Star Martial Academy in Modu City led the team, it would be impossible to kill over two hundred thousand Exotic Beasts.
If it weren’t for Wang Lan, a powerful Medical Attribute in the rear, and Soul Bead supplements for Star Power loss, even those at the Star Sea Stage would have to kneel here.
The mercenary legion’s casualty rate had already exceeded two-thirds. If they still couldn’t close this space, it wouldn’t be about seeking fortune amid danger; it would be pure suicide.
The front lines were as intense as a raging fire, but the rear was stable and peaceful. Under the alternating escort of Yu Ruoyun and Wu Shaohua, the vaccine transport was very smooth. Although mysterious forces had attempted to attack the vaccine a few times, Yu Ruoyun and Wu Shaohua successfully repelled them.
After learning that a Star Sea Stage expert had been arranged to escort the vaccine, those who had designs on it extinguished the thought.
Wang Lan walked through the rear field hospital, where mercenaries with missing arms and broken legs lay wailing on stretchers. At this moment, Wang Lan, with a healer’s compassion, naturally couldn’t just stand by.
"Bro, this isn’t just simple treatment; we’re talking limb regeneration here. Charging you fifty Soul Beads isn’t too much, right? What? Thirty beads? No way, can’t make this deal. Next..."
"Bro, your injury is worth at least twenty Soul Beads. Agreed? You’re a straightforward guy, bro. Beads first, then treatment."
"Ah? You figured it out so quickly? If you’d figured it out sooner, you would’ve bled less. Fifty Soul Beads. Here, let me connect a Life Lock Chain."
Yu Ruoyun, who was on break, watched with folded arms and a cold gaze as Wang Lan bustled about among the wounded like a diligent little bee.
This guy... how can he be so shameless? As comrades, isn’t treating one another a given? He’s even trying to earn the mercenaries’ hard-earned money. His conscience is utterly rotten.
"Hey bro, whoa, you’re covered in blood! How’d you get so badly injured? At least twenty Soul Beads. You’re a man of action, my friend. Alright."
"All done, no worries. You don’t need a stretcher anymore. Huh? You’re not going back to the front lines?"
"No, Mr. Wang Lan. We came here hoping to make a fortune but almost lost our lives instead. I’m going back to my hometown; it’s safer there," the Caucasian man in front of him said with a broad smile, waving his hand and leaving with the companion Wang Lan had just saved.
"Mr. Wang, quick, there’s someone severely injured over here..."
"Coming! It’ll just take a few seconds, what’s the rush?" Wang Lan dashed to where the call came from and connected a Life Lock Chain.
"By the way, do you know my name?"
"I only know your surname is Wang and that you’re a noble from Jade Country. May I have the honor of knowing your esteemed name, Mr. Wang?"
Wang Lan’s expression suddenly changed. He turned to look at a Star Martial Art warrior from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow beside him.
"Do you know my name?"
"Well... I was just told you’re Mr. Wang, our distinguished guest, and the inventor of the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine..."
"You lot over there, halt!" Wang Lan suddenly barked.
At the sound of Wang Lan’s voice, everyone’s movements slowed for a beat. Yu Ruoyun quickly turned her serious gaze toward the seven individuals.
"Which country are you from?"
"We... we’re from Kowil Country."
"The Middle East? Isn’t the Middle East a major disaster zone overrun by Exotic Beasts? Warriors from there are all daredevils. You were scared that easily? You said earlier you wanted to go back to your hometown? Your hometown doesn’t seem any safer than here, does it?"
"My hometown isn’t ravaged by Exotic Beasts, so it’s fine."
"Is that so..." Wang Lan walked over slowly. "If it’s convenient, please cooperate with an identity verification. If there are no issues, we’ll let you pass. Ruoyun, take them..."
Before he could finish speaking, the seven individuals suddenly leaped up and, in a flash, tried to dash towards the exit.
The moment they ran, Wang Lan instantly realized something was wrong. Before Yu Ruoyun could even react, Wang Lan’s body dispersed into ten black butterflies.
The butterflies gently flapped their wings, vanished in an instant, and reappeared beside the seven fleeing figures.
Wang Lan’s form materialized almost simultaneously beside all seven, a single palm strike sending them flying backward. Less than a second had passed from their synchronized leap to their synchronized flight.
By the time Yu Ruoyun reacted, it was all over. The dust had settled.
"It seems there really is a problem with your identities. Would you care to tell me who you are?"
BOOM—! Suddenly, a terrifying Star Energy Fluctuation erupted in the distance. The powerful force was palpable even to Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun in the rear.
"Wang Lan, I’ll go check it out..." Yu Ruoyun said urgently.
"No need. The front line has the Titled Strongman Longya.
What concerns me more right now are these seven.
" As Wang Lan’s gaze fell upon the seven, their heads suddenly twisted, exploding like watermelons.
"Mind Skill Form! Paradise Bird!"
Wang Lan hurriedly searched the seven men and quickly found a map on their leader, a route clearly marked on it.
But this map covered an extremely large area, featuring lakes and seas. The territory it depicted was at least half the size of Jade Country. It definitely couldn’t be a map of this Different Dimensional Space; even a Pioneer Space was unlikely to be this large.
After the distant commotion, a long silence followed. But soon, three Star Martial Academy teams came rushing over, carrying stretchers.
"Wang Lan, quick... save them—!"
Wang Lan instantly teleported to the stretchers. His expression changed drastically when he saw the three figures, mangled beyond recognition. Without hesitation, he connected Life Lock Chains to the three tactical teachers.
"Senior, what happened?"
"Fuck! Someone set up a Space Stone trap! We found a relatively hidden, dangerous area and suspected a space node might be inside. The Exotic Beasts were very strong, so four teams attacked together."
"But when we fought our way in, we found a pyramid made of Space Stones. The Space Stones activated, creating spatial turbulence within a five-hundred-meter radius."
"The four teachers risked their lives to protect us. Teacher Ai didn’t make it; he was torn apart by the spatial turbulence and died on the spot. We haven’t suffered such a heavy loss since entering this Different Dimensional Space."
"Didn’t it open a spatial passage?" Wang Lan asked anxiously.
"What spatial passage? No, it just blasted open into spatial turbulence."
This setback at the front line further demoralized the God-given Army. Many mercenaries were no longer willing to continue fighting. They risked their lives for money—their own lives. Who would willingly throw their life away for someone else?
That spatial turbulence was clearly man-made. If the Kingdom of Ice and Snow couldn’t provide a satisfactory explanation, no one was willing to move. Subsequently, the academy’s volunteer group and the Black Tiger Army also retreated from the front line.
The army receded like the tide, while the Exotic Beasts at the front roared to the sky as if in victory.
On the army’s retreat path, a disheveled Princess Aier and her remaining three hundred royal guards blocked their way.
"Princess Aier, it’s useless to block us. This was a man-made ambush. We are fighting on the front lines; if the rear isn’t stable, we can’t fully commit to battle. Morale is low now. We can’t continue fighting," Longya said through gritted teeth, his voice low.
THUD—
The three hundred royal guards and Princess Aier all knelt.
"Please, we’re so close to finding the space node... Please save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"Don’t do this. I also want to save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, but we must first identify the enemies behind us. Until we catch the mastermind, we face too much danger."
"You’ve seen it; a single spatial turbulence cost us three Star Sea Stage teachers and five Galaxy Stage students. If this happens a few more times, our entire army will be annihilated."
"I’m sorry, but please, you must persist a little longer. We’ve worked so hard to achieve these results and explored this far. We can’t give up now."
"Princess Aier, your request is very difficult for me to grant. I must consider the safety of my colleagues and students."
Suddenly, Longya stopped speaking. Three figures were rapidly approaching from the distance like lightning.
Princess Aier turned, and a glimmer of hope flashed through her tear-filled eyes.
"Wang Lan, Yu Ruoyun, what are you two doing here? Your mission is to stabilize the rear." Longya felt a surge of displeasure upon seeing Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun.
Longya was well aware of the mission’s importance. But compared to the mission, Wang Lan’s and Yu Ruoyun’s safety was paramount. They were accompanying the team to gain experience, and these two young, ambitious geniuses couldn’t be allowed to realize it. Otherwise, knowing the typical nature of geniuses, they would undoubtedly attempt some reckless feat, like knowingly walking into a tiger’s den.
"Director Long, I think I know who the mastermind is," Wang Lan said, approaching Longya without even noticing Princess Aier still kneeling.
"Who?"
"Paradise Bird!" Wang Lan said somberly. "Just now, I spotted a few suspicious individuals. As soon as they realized I was onto them, they immediately chose to flee. When they knew there was no escape, they killed themselves."
"I’ve seen this method of suicide before with Paradise Bird and Demon Clan spies, so they must be connected. Therefore, I speculate their purpose for infiltrating the mercenaries was to set up the Space Stone traps."
"So what? What we need now is to find them and eliminate the threat. If the threat isn’t resolved, we can’t continue to fight," Jin Wenbing interjected grimly.
"There are two problems now. First, where did they get their Space Stones? Second, why do they want to prevent us from closing the Different Dimensional Space? The Kingdom of Ice and Snow holds no value for Paradise Bird. In fact, leaving the Kingdom of Ice and Snow intact would be more beneficial to them."
"And from their leader, we found a hand-drawn map. This map has a clear route marked on it."
Saying this, Wang Lan took out the map and handed it to Longya.
"Jin, take a look."
"A map of what place is this? No, what country is this? Do we have such a place on Sky Blue Star?"
"This is a map of the Different Dimensional Space," Yu Ruoyun quickly added.

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Finding the Paradise Bird Base
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 352: Finding the Paradise Bird Base
"How is that possible? Is there really such a vast Different Dimensional Space? Even the five Pioneer Spaces of Jade Country aren’t this big."
"Wang Lan decrypted this map earlier. It’s the map of Space Number Five. If the lakes and oceans are removed, the fragmented continental plates can be pieced together. After piecing them together and reducing the map by fifty times, you get the map of Space Number Five."
"The map of Space Number Five..." Aier quickly stepped forward to take the map. "What does this route mean?"
"Princess Aier may not know this. Besides being a student of Star Martial Academy in Modu City, I have another identity: a senior special operative from the Tianjian Bureau of Jade Country." Wang Lan solemnly announced this.
In the Tianjian Bureau, a lieutenant colonel was indeed considered a senior special operative. If one were to hold a position in a municipal-level Tianjian Bureau, it would certainly be equivalent to a department head.
"Before I was ordered to come for support, the Tianjian Bureau in Modu City cracked a Space Stone smuggling case. The source of these Space Stones... is likely the Kingdom of Ice and Snow," Wang Lan said gravely, looking into Aier’s eyes.
"What? That’s impossible..." Aier exclaimed reflexively.
"It indeed seemed impossible at first. We analyzed it too. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is already in such a state; where would they find the means to smuggle Space Stones? Moreover, Space Stones are produced in Different Dimensional Spaces, and Different Dimensional Spaces are nearly rendering your nation extinct. How could you have the capability to mine Space Stones?
Furthermore, a month ago, when we proposed negotiations with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, the response we received was a denial. You also replied that T might be responsible. So, our initial conjecture was that the Space Stones were being transited through the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, with the real source being elsewhere.
But now it seems that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow may not just be a transit point, but the origin itself."
"Wait, Jade Country negotiated with us? Why don’t I know about this?" Princess Aier shouted in shock. As the princess of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow and their strongest combatant, she had the right to be involved in the kingdom’s highest-level decision-making. There was no reason she wouldn’t be aware of negotiations between Jade Country and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"But we did negotiate, and we received a response. As for why you don’t know... it must be an internal issue within your ranks.
And... now I finally understand why T attacked us. If there were no benefits, why would they want Different Dimensional Spaces to exist? There must be a large Space Stone mine within the fifth Kong family’s territory. The T organization wants to continue smuggling Space Stones for profit, and for that, the Space Stones must continue to exist."
"Damn it—it must be them! They must be behind this!" Princess Aier trembled with anger.
Jade Country was now the only lifeline for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Whoever prevented them from clutching that straw to safety was an enemy they could not coexist with. The T organization had already struck twice.
Aier wished she could find T’s headquarters right now and pulverize them.
"The so-called T is probably not T. Perhaps they are Paradise Bird," Yu Ruoyun said indifferently.
"What do we do now?" Wang Lan looked towards Longya.
The identity of the troublemakers was confirmed, and the location... was also potentially determined. Should they leave Space Number Two to engage in Space Number Five? If they did so, the hard-earned advantage in Space Number Two would be lost.
"Director Long, I suggest deploying a small team to enter Space Number Five and destroy the mines. The T organization’s forces are not strong; they probably can’t even field an expert at the Galaxy Stage. The reason they can pose a threat is that we don’t know when they might set a trap for us," Yu Ruoyun promptly proposed.
"This indeed seems like an appropriate proposal. In that case, I will select two small teams to infiltrate Space Number Five for reconnaissance."
"I must join," Wang Lan quickly said.
Longya’s brow immediately furrowed.
The usual problem with geniuses had arisen – they were completely unaware of the dangers of the world. Do they not know what level of national treasures they are? Each one is just acting recklessly.
"You stay and provide logistical support from the rear; this place can’t do without you."
"No, Director Long, I have studied this route. We don’t have a vaccine for the Star Martial Toxins along this route. Without a vaccine, the only solution is to create an antidote on the spot, and I’m the only one capable of making it."
"Why are there no vaccines?"
"Isn’t it obvious? Paradise Bird is smuggling Space Stones. They couldn’t carry on their activities without cover from Gaocheng of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, right? Since they have someone within the upper echelons of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, it’s understandable that we couldn’t obtain the critical toxin samples."
Longya’s frown deepened at Wang Lan’s explanation. If Wang Lan was to go, as a member of Wang Lan’s squad, Yu Ruoyun would naturally go as well.
If both of them went... who would they be looking after?
"Director Long, you should be aware of my strength and student Yu Ruoyun’s. Both of us possess true Galaxy Stage combat power, and together with Mr. Wu, we would be equivalent to a pure Galaxy Stage elite squad. For infiltrating Space Number Five, it’s best to keep the team small; just our squad plus Princess Aier will suffice. After all, the main mission is reconnaissance."
Longya hesitated for a long time. Looking at the favorable situation in Space Number Two, he was unwilling to give it up. After pondering for a long time, he solemnly nodded.
"Alright, but remember, your safety is more important than anything else."
"Don’t worry, Director, we haven’t lived out our lives yet," Wang Lan replied.
Yu Ruoyun’s true power was likely at the Peak of the Galaxy Stage; the last time she thrashed that bald foreigner at the Galaxy Stage, it was almost child’s play. And Wang Lan’s strength had skyrocketed tenfold since his breakthrough to the Galaxy Stage. Even in his normal state, he wasn’t far behind Yu Ruoyun. Together, they also had a lethal technique, Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious. Under its power, they could probably unleash strength exceeding that of a Titled Strongman. With such capability, venturing into Space Number Five actually posed a low degree of danger.
Danger is merely a manifestation of insufficient strength. With enough power, one can disregard all danger.
The four-person squad included Wu Shaohua and Princess Aier, both elite masters of the Galaxy Stage. With such a lineup, even if the academy’s thirty squads banded together to encircle them, they could easily slip away. Did the people sent by Paradise Bird possess such strength? Dream on.
"Since that’s the case, all squads, pay attention: continue to secure each stronghold and search for space nodes as usual. If the mercenaries wish to withdraw, negotiate officially with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"Attention, Black Tiger Army: return to your respective strongholds, do not initiate attacks, and defend your positions. Squads are to maintain contact every half hour."
With both the academy’s volunteer group and the Black Tiger Army having given their orders, what else could the mercenaries do? They were just there to make up the numbers, lingering near the powerful to handle connections and miscellaneous tasks. If they protested, they’d lose their pay.
Since there were enemy spies among the higher-ups of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, Wang Lan’s four-person squad had to carry out their mission in secret. They quietly left the Different Dimensional Space. Outside, it was night, and the sky was full of dazzling stars.
Both Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun could fly. Together, they carried Wu Shaohua and Princess Aier through the air, heading directly north towards the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Space Number Five was to the north, forming a wedge with Space Number One and Space Number Four.
Space Number Five was the most stable among the five spaces, with the fewest Exotic Beasts escaping. This meant the forces guarding the area around Space Number Five were the weakest. Precisely for this reason, the abnormalities within Space Number Five had never been discovered by the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
When the four arrived at the periphery of Space Number Five, defensive fortifications were only set up a kilometer away. The entrance to Space Number Five was within a canyon. Any Exotic Beasts emerging from the space would inevitably rush towards the open basin. The fortifications were built on the high ground of the basin, allowing defenders to easily kill the Exotic Beasts from an elevated position.
However, due to the distance, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s military couldn’t detect any subtle movements happening in Space Number Five. At least, Wang Lan and his team had remained there secretly, undetected, for more than ten minutes.
Entering the Different Dimensional Space, the environment resembled the gloomy dusk of an overcast day, with the sky occasionally sprinkled with aurora-like colorful light bands.
With the map in hand, the four quickly moved forward, scouting the area. Along the way, they avoided any Exotic Beasts they encountered if possible.
At full speed in the Galaxy Stage, they could easily travel at 120 kilometers per hour. After half an hour of sprinting, Wang Lan and the others suddenly stopped.
"We’ve reached the first node segment. The map must mark these nodes for a reason. I’ll scout ahead." With these words, Wang Lan’s figure instantly vanished.
Not a few hundred meters ahead lay a sea of flowers within the jungle, which, according to the map, they needed to pass through.
One didn’t need to think too hard to guess that the Star Martial Toxins in this sea of flowers would be different from those outside. The so-called nodes likely indicated the need to switch antidotes.
Wang Lan approached the edge of the sea of flowers. Before he even got close, the flowers suddenly emitted colorful gases, as vibrant as a rainbow. Universal Decomposition activated, rapidly breaking down the Star Martial Toxins.
Indeed, this type of Star Martial Toxin had no existing samples; it was a completely new toxin.
In Wang Lan’s mind, the components of the antidote were rapidly assembled, and he turned back to rejoin his squad.
"Wang Lan, how is it?"
"Just as I suspected, there’s a sea of flowers ahead containing an entirely new Star Martial Toxin. We need to create an antidote to get through," Wang Lan said, turning towards the nearby plants.
Poisons were ubiquitous throughout the Different Dimensional Space. Wang Lan had noticed while formulating the vaccine earlier that these poisons exhibited a severe mutual dependency, having reached a point where they were intertwined, each containing elements of the other.
Wang Lan collected ingredients from just over twenty kinds of toxic substances to formulate the antidote. He opened the Folding Space on his wrist, and the Star Martial Toxin Synthesizer appeared before him.
The synthesizer beeped rhythmically—BEEP, BEEP, BEEP—as Wang Lan sequentially placed the toxin components into it. In about half an hour, a dozen or so capsules were produced.
"Three capsules each. Take one at a time. Let’s hurry through the sea of flowers."
The four resumed their journey. Perhaps the toxin from this sea of flowers was so unique that the anticipated Exotic Beast ambush did not occur. The sea of flowers stretched for about ten kilometers, and it took Wang Lan and his team twenty minutes to cross it.
There were seventeen nodes marked on the map. This meant Wang Lan needed to develop seventeen different antidotes to ensure the squad’s safe passage. From this perspective, Paradise Bird’s toxic defensive line was as solid as a fortress.
Without Wang Lan, no matter how many experts they had, they wouldn’t be able to breach these defenses; not even a Titled Strongman leading the way could do it. Too bad these defenses were virtually non-existent to Wang Lan.
After three full days, Wang Lan and his team finally reached the location marked on the map.
"Be careful!" Princess Aier pressed Wang Lan down with one hand, pulling his face into her chest.
"There’s an enemy Star Martial Warrior with sensing abilities!" As she spoke, a wave of Star Energy Fluctuation emanated from Princess Aier’s body, and instantly, a silent barrier spread out like the expansion of the universe.
"All set."
"What did you do?"
"That sensing-type Star Martial Warrior has fallen for my Illusion Technique. Let’s go take them out," Princess Aier whispered, a proud look on her face.

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Time-Space Gemstone
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 353: Time-Space Gemstone
The reconnaissance team of Paradise Bird was still nestled in a corner, admiring the scenery, completely unaware that these were nothing but illusions.
Suddenly, a strong premonition of danger struck. The team had no time to react; within an instant, they were pulled into the earth and vanished without a trace.
The soil churned slightly as Wang Lan slowly emerged from the ground. From beginning to end, the five-member squad did not emit a sound. Soon after, Yu Ruoyun and the other two joined Wang Lan.
"All settled," Wang Lan confirmed.
"Is Princess Aier still a perception-type Star Martial Warrior?" one of them asked.
"I possess a Wind Speaker’s Star Martial Skill that allows me to perceive everything within a kilometer through the wind," Princess Aier said proudly. "By the way, since there’s a Paradise Bird reconnaissance squad here, we shouldn’t come back empty-handed, right?"
"We can’t let our guard down," Wang Lan cautioned. "What if those Paradise Bird members intentionally exposed themselves? If this is a trap, it could leave us with no place to die."
The four-member squad proceeded stealthily, and after about ten kilometers, they finally found a canyon. Within the canyon was a bustling construction site.
Out in the open of the canyon, there were giant mechanical arm-like devices erected, each approximately ten stories tall by estimation.
"What are they doing?" Princess Aier asked curiously.
"I don’t know, but anything that must be constructed in a Different Dimensional Space is never simple," Yu Ruoyun said gravely. "The physical laws in Different Dimensional Space differ vastly from the outside world. Although with development, we’ve mastered the use of Soul Beads as an energy source for conversion machines, most machinery still cannot function in Different Dimensional Space."
"It feels... like they’re building something similar to the time-space doors in science fiction movies," Wang Lan mused.
"That’s possible," Yu Ruoyun agreed.
Suddenly, several trucks slowly moved out from the base. Wang Lan quickly activated his dynamic vision and, through the gaps in the truck’s tarpaulin, detected that they were carrying glittering items.
"Space Stones!" Wang Lan said in a low voice.
"Have we found the whereabouts of the Space Stones? Is that it? Should we launch an attack?" one of them asked.
"Paradise Bird has not yet been alerted. If we attack from within, we can achieve greater results. Let’s infiltrate their base," Yu Ruoyun whispered.
"No, it’s too dangerous. Who knows what kind of dragon’s den or tiger’s cave awaits inside the Paradise Bird base?" Wu Shaohua quickly shook his head in disagreement.
"If the inside of the Paradise Bird base is indeed a dragon’s den or tiger’s cave, then trying to break in from the outside is nothing but a fantasy. Even if we lack the strength, shouldn’t we at least gather some useful intelligence?" Wang Lan quickly added.
The young people these days...
Wu Shaohua shook his head helplessly. Although he was the captain, the squad was not his to command alone. Especially for decisions of this nature, deliberation was a must.
After Princess Aier voiced her support for infiltration, Wu Shaohua could only reluctantly agree.
Wu Shaohua’s objection to the infiltration operation wasn’t because the tactic was flawed. If it had been anyone other than Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun, Wu Shaohua wouldn’t hesitate to choose infiltration.
It’s just that these two were so important that it made Wu Shaohua apprehensive. Fortunately, although they were precious, their strength was by no means weak.
Under the guidance of Princess Aier’s perception and Wang Lan’s far-sight, they successfully avoided patrols and infiltrated deep into the base. Inside, the appearance of the base took Wang Lan and the others by surprise.
What kind of base was this? It hardly looked like a place suitable for people—it resembled a cave formed by snakes with its pitch-blackness and utter silence, broken only by the occasional drip of water.
"There are a lot of knocking sounds deep in the cave... this place might be a Space Stone mine," Princess Aier reported, using her perception.
"Let’s go down and take a look!"
As they ventured deeper into the cave and successfully avoided several patrols, Wang Lan and the others entered the Space Stone area. The sight of the Space Stone mine left Wang Lan stunned.
A huge, sparkling wall of Space Stones had been hollowed out to form a seemingly bottomless hole, glaringly conspicuous like a worm-eaten hole on a massive fruit.
"Is a Space Stone mine supposed to look like this?" Wang Lan asked in surprise.
"Not at all, this Space Stone mine is unlike any I’ve ever seen," Wu Shaohua said, equally stunned by the sight.
"The Space Stone mines I’ve seen are like iron mines or crystal mines, fused with rocks, requiring us to dig through the rocks to extract grains of Space Stones.
But this mine—this isn’t a mine, it’s a mountain of Space Stones. With such purity and such a quantity, no wonder Paradise Bird is doing everything possible to stop us. How much money could this be worth?"
The four made their way into the cave, which snaked downwards, but soon there were many branching tunnels, each one stretching deep into the interior like an abyss.
The further in they went, the more winding passages they encountered.
"Strange!" Wang Lan suddenly whispered.
"What’s wrong?"
"Doesn’t it seem like they’re not mining but rather searching for something?" Wang Lan elaborated. "If they were simply extracting Space Stones, why bore deep holes in the middle of them? Why not mine from the outside bit by bit? Moreover, why go hundreds of meters deep?"
"Now that you mention it, it does seem that way," Wu Shaohua mused. "The cocoon-like holes in the Space Stone mine were excavated, not like they plan to build a nest inside, so why dig like that? Digging deep holes multiplies the difficulty of mining by hundreds if not more."
As Princess Aier and Wang Lan were discussing, Yu Ruoyun, who was in front, suddenly halted.
"Something’s not right, trouble might be brewing."
"Ruoyun, what’s wrong?"
"I once saw a top-secret report," Yu Ruoyun began. "It was sent at the risk of death by a high-ranking spy who had infiltrated deep into the Demon Clan a hundred years ago. Before the demons retreated, they left behind twelve Time-Space Gemstones. These are temporal artifacts of the Demon Clan.
The Time-Space Gemstones possess terrifying Power of Space, capable of opening the Portal of the Demon World. No one knows where the Demon Clan has hidden the Time-Space Gemstones, but what is certain is that they are concealed within Different Dimensional Space.
Although the likelihood is small, if a Time-Space Gemstone fell into the hands of the Demon Clan, they could open the Portal of the Demon World at any time."
"What?" Wu Shaohua’s scalp tingled intensely upon hearing this.
"I’m only saying it’s possible, albeit a very small one," Yu Ruoyun hastily explained.
"Who goes there!" Suddenly, an angry shout sounded as a team carrying Space Stones appeared in the distance of the corridor. The shocking intelligence Yu Ruoyun voiced caused Wang Lan and Princess Aier’s hearts to skip a beat, and they inadvertently neglected their surveillance, being caught red-handed by Paradise Bird.
"Enem—"
"Dance of the Dark Butterfly!" Wang Lan shouted.
In an instant, Wang Lan’s body dispersed, and ten Nether Butterflies suddenly appeared amidst the crowd of the opposing team. A blade of light flashed, and the entire squad was killed by Wang Lan within a second.
But even with the timely killings, their alarm had already been raised.
"Enemy attack—"
The alarm sounded, declaring Wang Lan’s squad’s infiltration plan a failure.
"Let’s just charge in," Yu Ruoyun snorted coldly, taking the lead and rushing towards the depths of the corridor. "Princess Aier, sense the place with the most tapping noises."
"Okay!" Princess Aier confirmed.
Inside the Space Stone, a group of mysterious people were frantically swinging their pickaxes, desperately mining the Space Stone. The Space Stone was one of the hardest materials in the world, as tough as raw iron.
And the Space Stone didn’t possess any physical properties; any method you can think of to quarry stone had no effect on it.
Using explosives? Ha, are Star Martial Skills less effective than explosives? But it was useless. The Space Stone could absorb and release ninety-nine percent of energy. Moreover, in the Different Dimensional Space, explosives couldn’t be used.
The only way to deal with Space Stone was to dig it out bit by bit.
But this particular Space Stone mountain had definitely been buried for more than a century, with surrounding Space Stones fused together like a massive mountain. A group of melee Star Martial Warriors wielding pickaxes had been digging for two or three years and still hadn’t reached the center.
Fortunately, they were close. The super-dimensional energy fluctuations emitted by the Time-Space Gemstone had already been detected.
"Leader, this is not good, there’s been an enemy attack!" members of Paradise Bird rushed in frantically to report.
"Have they found us after all? How many people are outside?" the leader asked.
"We don’t know, but it shouldn’t be many. So far we’ve only seen four."
"Only four? Maybe it’s just a scouting team?" The four-star leader of Paradise Bird revealed a surprised smile on his face.
"Sang Guo, it seems they are from Jade Country, sent to scout the terrain and find the spatial nodes. They stumbled here, detected something amiss, and came to investigate..." a white man wearing a duckbill hat spoke indifferently.
"Possibly," Sang Guo replied. "Although I don’t know how they made it through the dozen or so seas of Star Martial Toxins, since they could infiltrate this far, they must be experts too. Aide, Kraman, Doris, let’s go welcome our friends from afar."
"Sang Guo, why do we all need to take action? I alone am enough," one of them said.
"The Time-Space Gemstone is too important; better to be cautious," Sang Guo stated.
On the other side, Wang Lan’s squad rushed wildly towards the depths of the corridor, constantly confronted by Paradise Bird Star Martial Warriors. But this group, all at the Star Cloud Stage and at most the Galaxy Stage, couldn’t even stall Wang Lan and his team.
"Infinite Steam—"
Suddenly, an angry shout came from behind the army of Paradise Bird, and a stream of bright red steam surged forth, instantly engulfing the vanguard of Paradise Bird soldiers. These soldiers didn’t even have time to scream before they were melted by the steam.
In the blink of an eye, the attacker charged in front of Wang Lan’s party.
"Ice Crystal Jade Screen!" Princess Aier cried out.
A wall of ice instantly erected in front of the corridor, quickly thickening until it became a three-meter-thick barrier.
Not only was the ice shield sturdy, but it was also crystal clear, providing a clear view of the outside situation while defending against attacks.
"Infinite Wind Blade." Suddenly, behind Wang Lan in the corridor, a terrifying Speedy Wind accompanied by countless wind blades assailed them. Without hesitation, Wang Lan fiercely slapped the ground.
"Gate of The Underworld!"
BOOM—
In an instant, Wang Lan’s expression turned grim. It seemed that both the front and rear paths were blocked.
TAP, TAP, TAP—
Footsteps sounded as a strange man, drenched in blood and resembling a skeleton, walked step by step towards the Ice Crystal Jade Screen in front of Princess Aier. "I thought we’d be dealing with small fries, but it turns out we’ve got some big fish.
The Ice Snow War God of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, Princess Aier; the heavenly princess of the Jade Country, Her Highness Yu Ruoyun. And you, Wang Lan, ranked second on Paradise Bird’s kill list.
Targets that were impossible to approach even with all our efforts have all come today... Are you trying to gift me a fortune?"
"Don’t misunderstand; we can’t afford to gift you a fortune, but we can certainly send you on your way," Wu Shaohua said as he suddenly punched the Ice Crystal.
BOOM—
Terrifying lava erupted from Wu Shaohua’s fist. His fist hadn’t even struck yet, but the lava had already submerged the corridor. As his punch landed, the Ice Crystal shattered, and the surging lava instantly flowed down the corridor towards the depths.
"Charge!" Wu Shaohua roared.

chapters.title: Chapter 354: The Powerful Titled Strongman
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 354: The Powerful Titled Strongman
BOOM—
Suddenly, a violent explosion resounded. Fragments of Space Stones scattered in all directions like a shower of diamonds, peppering the surrounding corridor walls until they were riddled with holes, as if struck by bullets.
The corridor’s layout severely restricted the Star Martial Warriors’ combat abilities. Since their opponents had the home-field advantage, Wu Shaohua had no choice but to unleash his full power, hoping to secure a chance for his team to reach more advantageous terrain.
Following Wu Shaohua’s lead, the four of them sprinted furiously and vanished into the corridor in an instant.
"Think you can run?" a cold voice rose from amidst the diamond rain. Countless shooting fragments, as if restrained by an invisible force, halted mid-air before him before clattering to the ground.
Their figures, swift as lightning, quickly reached a vast cavern. They leaped from the corridor’s exit. Above them, the massive Space Stone mine shimmered with resplendent light, like a crystal ceiling.
The four landed, maintaining their Four Symbols formation, vigilantly sensing every slight movement around them. Towering, gigantic statues with grotesque and eerie appearances stood around the cavern, exuding an atmosphere of mysterious oppression.
"This must be one of the Demon Clan’s Temples..." Yu Ruoyun said gravely. "They might genuinely be searching for the Time-Space Gemstone."
"Princess Yu actually knows about the Time-Space Gemstone..." a voice suddenly interjected. From behind a statue, a long-haired man with a gloomy, cold expression slowly emerged. He had a katana strapped to his back and wore black warrior armor.
Recognizing the man, Wu Shaohua’s expression turned thoughtful, then abruptly changed. "Black Crow Sang Guo?"
"Oh? I didn’t expect anyone to still remember me." Sang Guo smiled faintly, his gaze sweeping over the wary Wu Shaohua. "Since you know who I am, you should understand that your resistance is futile. Commit suicide."
Damn!
Wang Lan stared in surprise at Sang Guo, who stood with his arms crossed.
He’s looking at an idiot. How can someone his age still say such moronic things?
"Black Crow Sang Guo... A Titled Strongman from the Jade Country twenty years ago. He became a global S-rank fugitive after a failed assassination attempt on the Prime Minister. The most outstanding successor of the Royal Sword Stream Ninjutsu, he once escaped unscathed from the pursuit of seven senior agents of the World Security Council," Wu Shaohua calmly recited Sang Guo’s profile.
"Mr. Wu, that wasn’t much useful information, but you certainly made him sound impressive. Are you trying to help him build up his ego?" Wang Lan muttered, dumbfounded.
"What do you know? He’s a Titled Strongman at the pinnacle of his power! He’s killed almost everyone who knew anything about him... I’m telling you, don’t take him lightly. This could be fatal!"
"You brat... are quite irritating!" Sang Guo chuckled, a cold, half-joking smile on his face as he slowly drew his katana.
Instantly, an intense killing intent washed over them.
"Then let’s start with you, kid. Are you prepared to embrace death?" As his words faded, Sang Guo’s form flickered out like a candle flame. When he reappeared, he was already beside Wang Lan.
A streak of light flashed, slashing towards the nape of Wang Lan’s neck.
CRASH—
Suddenly, Wang Lan’s body dispersed into ten scattering Nether Butterflies. The sword light swept through them.
"Hmm?" Sang Guo let out a soft sound of surprise. His swordsmanship, honed to the peak of the Sword Dao, should have cleaved all ten butterflies in two with a single strike. Yet, after the blade’s light swept past, the butterflies remained unharmed, still fluttering their wings. Not only were they not struck down, but they even began to dance gracefully around him.
"An interesting Star Martial Skill."
SHICK—
Suddenly, a cold glint flashed like lightning. Sang Guo instantly brought his katana up horizontally to block.
CLANG—
Wang Lan had mysteriously appeared at Sang Guo’s flank, his Zanpakuto already unsheathed, slashing towards Sang Guo’s waist.
"The interesting part is just beginning."
With his Gold Level Basic Swordsmanship and Basic Sword Skill, who had Wang Lan ever feared in a close-quarters blade fight?
"Good katana, good sword skill!" Sang Guo’s eyes lit up, a hint of appreciation in his gaze as he looked at Wang Lan.
SHICK—
Both moved simultaneously. In an instant, the light of clashing blades flared between them.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!—
Suddenly, three columns of red smoke erupted from the cavern floor, threatening to engulf Yu Ruoyun and her two companions. The attack was so sudden it was nearly impossible to react.
At the critical moment, Yu Ruoyun reacted fastest. Using her Wind Dance Whip, she swept up Wu Shaohua and Princess Aier, then launched a counterattack with her Rice Planting Skill against one of the Paradise Bird experts.
Countless wooden stakes rained down from above, embedding themselves in the ground like arrows. Upon piercing the soil, the stakes instantly sprouted roots. In the blink of an eye, a dense network of roots and tendrils spread hundreds of meters beneath the surface.
The three landed on the massive wooden stakes, warily surveying their surroundings.
"Mr. Wu, Princess Aier, I’ve nullified all Earth Attribute Star Martial Skills. Neither side can use them now."
"Well done!" Wu Shaohua praised immediately.
"Truly worthy of being the pride of the Jade Country, Princess. You shouldn’t be underestimated... I almost feel reluctant to kill you." As the voice spoke, three Star Martial Warriors in red cloaks slowly descended from above.
Meanwhile, Wang Lan and Sang Guo were exchanging blows rapidly. Wang Lan had always believed that his Gold Level Basic Swordsmanship and Basic Sword Skill put him ahead of most Star Sea Stage experts.
But Wang Lan still underestimated the world’s masters.
At least this fellow before him was more adept at swordsmanship. They both wielded katanas, but their sword skills were vastly different. Wang Lan had no flashy moves, only cultivating his sword skill to the state of Return to the Original. However, his opponent, in addition to solid fundamentals, employed an endless array of bizarre techniques that left Wang Lan somewhat flustered.
"Twin Dragon Flash—"
Suddenly, Sang Guo split into two identical figures. Each attacked one of Wang Lan’s vital points with a different move.
CLANG! CLANG!—
Instantly, Wang Lan reversed his grip on his katana, blocking both fatal strikes. He hastily retreated, creating a safe distance.
That move definitely wasn’t a Star Martial Skill; it was pure sword skill.
Pure sword skill can create the effect of afterimages? Were all the sword skills I practiced before fake?
No! When did I ever actually practice? Wasn’t it all just about allocating points?
"Strange. You haven’t learned sword skills from any school, yet you possess such exquisite and flawless Basic Swordsmanship. How did you achieve that, kid?" Sang Guo asked in a low voice, executing a graceful flourish with his katana.
The fighting in the distance receded as the Paradise Bird experts led Yu Ruoyun and the others further away.
Damn it, if something happens to them, I won’t have time to help!
"Daring to be distracted while fighting me? You’re courting death!" Sang Guo was furious. "I showed you the respect due to a warrior, and you dare to let your attention wander when facing me?"
In a flash, his figure vanished again, this time reappearing as six copies looming above Wang Lan, all slashing downwards.
"Holy Shield—"
Wang Lan snapped back to his senses, urgently deploying the Holy Shield. He raised one hand, and a circular, moon-like disc of light appeared above his head, deflecting all six attacks.
Sang Guo was thrown back, flipping in mid-air before landing steadily on the ground.
"You actually used a Star Martial Skill? How unbefitting of a warrior!"
That’s right, I’m a damn Star Martial Warrior!
Wang Lan had almost forgotten, under Sang Guo’s influence, that his greatest trump card wasn’t his Gold Level close-combat strength.
A subconscious part of Wang Lan had always told him:
With your full set of Gold Level Basic Skills, you’re not weaker than anyone in fundamental close combat.
It was because of this mindset that when facing Sang Guo, who had also reached the pinnacle of close-combat sword skill, Wang Lan had subconsciously wanted to compete with him in swordsmanship. Coupled with Sang Guo’s relentless, fast-paced attacks, Wang Lan hadn’t had a chance to shift his thinking, leading to several minutes of intense, face-to-face clashing.
But is my true strength really in swordsmanship? I’m the one who wields a Zanpakuto, after all!
At this thought, a sly smile touched Wang Lan’s lips. "Release, Sword of Light!"
Instantly, the blade of his Zanpakuto shattered, dissolving into a sky full of Starlight. As the Starlight coalesced, it reformed into the Sword of Light. With the Holy Shield of Light in his left hand and the Sword of Light in his right...
This setup... why does it feel like the Sword of Light and the Holy Shield are a matched pair of Star Martial Skills?
Wang Lan wasn’t the only one who thought so; Black Crow Sang Guo, his opponent, had the exact same impression.
"A Holy Sword?"
With the Sword of Light’s initial release complete, a single swing sent a blade of light hurtling across space and time, instantly appearing before Sang Guo. Yet, Sang Guo neither dodged nor evaded. He simply lifted a hand, and the light blade shattered.
"A Star Martial Sword Skill? I know a few of those myself!"
Instantly, Sang Guo raised his hand. His katana blurred, and an intangible Sword Qi shot across space and time, reaching Wang Lan in a heartbeat. Though Wang Lan couldn’t see it, he could feel the imminent danger.
With no time for thought, Wang Lan hastily brought the Holy Shield up to defend himself.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!—
Powerful impacts slammed into the Holy Shield. The terrifying force sent Wang Lan flying backward, and the Holy Shield rapidly began Melting and shattering under the assault of the invisible Sword Qi.
Wang Lan tumbled through the air for ten meters before finally crashing to the ground.
Only then did Wang Lan become acutely aware of the vast gulf in power between himself and Sang Guo.
When they had clashed for five minutes earlier, Wang Lan, though pressured, could still manage a few counterattacks. He had mistakenly believed that this was the extent of a Titled Strongman’s power.
He had thought that by using the Holy Shield and Sword of Light, he could turn the tables. So, Sang Guo had just been toying with me all along?
The Holy Shield, supposedly renowned as the strongest defense, had shattered under a single attack from Sang Guo. Although Wang Lan had never truly believed any claims of an "absolute strongest defense," he had still acknowledged the Holy Shield’s formidable defensive capabilities.
It could even block an S-rank single-target Star Martial Skill.
But now... it seems I was far too arrogant.
"Is that all you’ve got? It’s been a long time since I met anyone interesting. I thought we could have a fair duel, warrior to warrior. Unfortunately, I misjudged you. You’re no warrior at all. If this is the extent of your strength... then I’ll just have to send you on your way."
Wang Lan scrambled to his feet, bowing slightly as he watched Sang Guo warily.
His Sword Qi is formless, faster than my Sword of Light, better concealed, and more powerful. To beat him with the Sword of Light, I’d have to use Swastika... But that’s still a distant prospect.
Suddenly, Star Power surged through Wang Lan’s body, and the gate to his Star Palace swung open.
When Sang Guo saw the Star Palace gate open, he abruptly halted his intended attack.
"Galaxy Stage? You’re still only at the Galaxy Stage?" Sang Guo’s expression became exceedingly unnatural.
A mere Galaxy Stage cultivator held out against me—someone who considers himself a top-tier Titled Strongman—for so long? Are all Galaxy Stage practitioners on some kind of super-drug these days?
From within the Star Palace, a phoenix suddenly burst forth. It disintegrated in mid-air, instantly reforming as the Saint Cloth that enveloped Wang Lan’s body.
"Phoenix Form, activate—"

chapters.title: Chapter 355 Yu Ruoyun Really Drifted Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 355 Yu Ruoyun Really Drifted Away
Blazing flames erupted from Wang Lan’s body, the fire behind him even taking the shape of phoenix wings. The vibrant Phoenix Tail Flower shimmered on Wang Lan’s forehead, and the bright red eyeshadow added a touch of androgynous, exotic charm.
Seeing Wang Lan in this state, Sang Guo’s mocking gaze vanished, his expression instantly turning grave.
"Phoenix Form? What relation do you have to the Flame Emperor?"
Wang Lan gave a cold laugh but said nothing as the color of the Sword of Light in his hand turned red under the Phoenix Form.
With a flash, he vanished from Sang Guo’s view.
Wang Lan’s speed was like a streak of light, but to Sang Guo, it was merely adequate. Sang Guo’s blade was instantly covered in a layer of thunder, and he too disappeared.
Echoes of slicing through the air filled the void, a moment of stillness marked by the clash of the two.
In Phoenix Form, Wang Lan believed his strength had reached the peak of the Star Sea Stage. He had thought this power, if not enough to defeat Sang Guo, should have at least narrowed the gap between them. Especially in close combat, Wang Lan’s strength under the Phoenix Form had surged once again, and he should have been unrivaled. Yet Sang Guo was still able to effortlessly parry every attack from Wang Lan.
True, Wang Lan was incredibly fast, and Sang Guo’s speed couldn’t keep up. However, it was as if Sang Guo could predict his moves. No matter how many times Wang Lan changed his attack mid-course, Sang Guo could always precisely predict the point of attack, thus easily defusing it.
But Sang Guo’s blade felt Unpredictable to Wang Lan.
BOOM—
A cold gleam from the blade swept past Wang Lan’s throat. The Lurking Butterfly Dance was so graceful. As the Nether Butterfly flapped its wings and vanished, Wang Lan’s Sword of Light transformed into a spear of thorns, thrusting towards Sang Guo.
Sang Guo’s waist twisted slightly, and he disappeared in that instant of distortion.
A rumbling of thunder reached Wang Lan’s ears, and he quickly dodged.
A brutal arc of electricity grazed Wang Lan’s back as he vanished and reappeared in the distance near the Nether Butterfly.
A tingling sensation spread from his back, and another crack appeared on his bronze Saint Cloth.
Since he had offered up the Phoenix Saint Cloth, this was the first time he had been injured—and it wasn’t just a single wound. With every brief exchange, Sang Guo managed to easily penetrate Wang Lan’s defenses and leave a cut on his body.
By now, there were no fewer than a dozen sword injuries on the Saint Cloth. The Saint Cloth indeed had the power of Self-Repair, but that required time. If it were shattered in a single blow, only the Goddess’s Blood could repair it.
In this world, where was Wang Lan to find a goddess? And one that was Athena?
"The Flame Emperor must be terrified of you dying, to have forged such sturdy armor for you. I’ve seen quite a few Star Palace Artifacts, and shattered more than a dozen of them with my own hands, but I’ve never seen one with such high defense as yours."
Sang Guo looked at Wang Lan with interest, the Thunderbolt Sword in his hand crackling with sparks.
"You live up to your reputation, having made it onto the Paradise Bird’s hit list, to have fought me for so long. But it’s getting late; time to end this game."
Sang Guo’s presence grew heavy, his expression turning even more solemn. He bent slightly forward, holding the Thunderbolt Sword horizontally before him.
His momentum suddenly surged, Star Energy Fluctuation rippled out, and the entire underground cavern trembled.
Wang Lan’s heart leaped to his throat. This terrifying momentum surpassed that of any enemy he had faced before. It was a feeling of despair similar to when he had refused the Qing Emperor’s wild matchmaking proposals.
Sang Guo might not have reached the level of the Qing Emperor, but he had definitely glimpsed the view from the mountaintop.
"Lan Moon!" Sang Guo exclaimed, and a sense of alarm instantly rose in Wang Lan’s heart.
A bright moon suddenly rose into Wang Lan’s view. But this was no Illusion Technique; it was a sphere of energy Sang Guo had mustered with his hands crossed before him.
As Sang Guo initiated Lan Moon, he caught not just the bright moon but the entirety of the space around them. In that moment, Wang Lan felt as if the space around him were as solid as hardened earth.
BOOM—
An energy column blasted out instantly, crossing space to reach Wang Lan. Though his mind knew it might not hold, he stomped the ground in an instant.
"Gate of The Underworld!"
BOOM—
The Gate of The Underworld rose instantly, but it was shattered by that beam of light. The intense shockwave paused only momentarily before rushing at Wang Lan’s face again.
"Dance of the Dark Butterfly—"
Just as his body began to disintegrate, in an instant, it was as if time reversed and everything reformed. Nothing had changed, as if nothing had happened. This sudden turn caused Wang Lan’s heart to quake.
The Star Martial Skill had actually failed?
But in this dire moment, there was no time for shock. Wang Lan extended his arm, and a Holy Shield appeared in front of him.
BOOM—
Lan Moon struck the Holy Shield fiercely, shattering it on the spot. The residual force hammered into Wang Lan’s chest, and he was flung backward like a cannonball.
BOOM—
He crashed deeply into the wall behind him, creating a human-shaped tunnel.
Ouch...
That was the only sensation Wang Lan received as feedback after a momentary lapse in focus.
Had it not been for the Phoenix Saint Cloth, that strike would have shattered Wang Lan’s body to pieces; likely only a rebirth could have saved him.
But even though the Phoenix Saint Cloth blocked the terrifying attack, it was now covered in cracks and looked like it could fall apart at any moment.
At Wang Lan’s lower abdomen, a massive through-and-through wound was dripping with fresh blood. For anyone else, such an injury would definitely mean being carried off in a coffin.
The instant he was injured, Wang Lan’s Self Healing Star Martial Skill activated, and his passive ability of absolute rationality also triggered.
COUGH—
Wang Lan coughed, blood spraying from his mouth.
"Still not dead, huh... Could it again be because of this armor?" A mocking voice drew closer. Wang Lan’s heart rose to his throat; he was still recovering. If Sang Guo hit him again, he would definitely be boxed up.
Although it was often said that among the top masters at the Star Sea Stage, a select group of supreme powerhouses were known as Titled Strongmen. Even though they too were at the Star Sea Stage, their power had already surpassed the Star Sea Stage.
Wang Lan had advanced to the Galaxy Stage and mastered three platinum Star Martial Skills and a large number of gold Star Martial Skills. He could also activate Phoenix Form. He had thought his strength could probably compete with a Titled Strongman.
Now, it seemed he had indeed overestimated himself.
Up until now, everything had gone smoothly for him. Even when facing powerful enemies, he might not be guaranteed victory in Phoenix Form, but he could remain undefeated.
Had Wang Lan ever thought there were enemies he couldn’t handle in Phoenix Form?
Now, Sang Guo had delivered a crisp slap to the face, telling Wang Lan: Yes, there are!
Titled Strongmen and the Star Sea Stage, as you understand it, are not on the same level. They seemed to have grasped some sort of Law. Even at the peak of the Star Sea Stage, one would be as helpless as a baby before a Titled Strongman.
Sang Guo, merely an unremarkable figure among the second-tier powerhouses, had managed to beat Wang Lan into submission effortlessly.
Did Wang Lan have any cards left to play? Of course, adding points. There were tens of thousands of skill points lying in the system, enough to develop one or two platinum-level skills. But... in the face of the current situation, the skills Wang Lan possessed weren’t very useful. For example, platinum-level Star Martial Skills like Heavenly Fire Extinguishing World or Earth Fire Roar had no chance to be used. Skills like Sentient Beings or Weight Exchange were suitable for large-scale battlefields. In a one-on-one situation against the uncannily powerful Sang Guo, it didn’t matter which skill Wang Lan chose to upgrade; none seemed appropriate.
Suddenly, a terrible Star Energy Fluctuation erupted not far away—a powerful sublimation of Star Power. Naturally, Wang Lan knew what that energy fluctuation was: Yu Ruoyun had activated Dragon Emperor Form.
But Sang Guo was unaware. Instead, he stopped in his tracks, his face serious as he sensed every movement in the distance.
Speaking of Yu Ruoyun, she really takes the cake. You wastrel woman, now you activate Dragon Emperor Form? Having a good time, aren’t you! Trained by the Qing Emperor for a month, you’ve certainly gotten bolder. But could you have picked a better time? This is a life-and-death struggle, and you still have the mood to play with them? Were you not going to use your full power until you’d had your fun? Don’t you realize I’m facing a Titled Strongman alone? Do you trust me that much, thinking I’m so incredible? I’m about to be beaten to death here!
BOOM—
Suddenly, with a loud noise, Sang Guo’s view was engulfed in a terrifying cloud of smoke.
Sang Guo’s face turned stern as he retreated hastily, even forgetting about taking Wang Lan’s life. As the dust gradually settled, three figures slowly emerged from the dense smoke.
Well, that entrance was quite impactful. Add some heart-stirring BGM, and it’s definitely the Ice Throne’s king returning, with the Fire Shadow theme playing at full blast. But... couldn’t you have come sooner?
"Where’s Red Skull? None of you are hurt?" Sang Guo looked at the three slowly approaching, a twisted, perverse smile on his face.
Even though he knew the odds were stacked against his three men, he didn’t care in the slightest. Who was he, Sang Guo? A Titled Strongman. Only a Five Emperors-level powerhouse could make him take things seriously.
"Those three pieces of trash were taken care of by Princess Yu in no time flat," Aier said, looking at Yu Ruoyun with an admiring expression.
No wonder the Jade Country is legendary; they have such powerful secret techniques.
Especially the two Dragon Horns rising from Yu Ruoyun’s forehead. Far from being horrifying, they gave Aier a sense of majesty and dominance.
"Where’s Wang Lan?"
"COUGH, COUGH, COUGH... You could have come later; you’d still have been in time to collect my corpse!" Wang Lan climbed out from the human-shaped pit, his chest injury already healed, but his armor was covered in spider-web-like cracks.
"Ruoyun, I just want to ask you one thing right now: what were you thinking?"
Yu Ruoyun’s cheeks turned red, and she didn’t dare to look at Wang Lan. "I thought you could handle it."
These words, however, hurt Sang Guo the most, not Wang Lan.
What do you mean, he could handle it? Are you treating me, a Titled Strongman, like a common cabbage?
"No more nonsense. We can’t handle him one-on-one. His abilities are very strange," Wang Lan said, moving to Yu Ruoyun’s side. "Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious!"
As soon as the words were spoken, Yu Ruoyun didn’t hesitate. Instantly, Star Power erupted from both Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun. A golden dragon coiled around one, while Phoenix Wing Sky Soaring appeared behind Wang Lan.
Beautiful and splendid like mythical creatures, the sight made Princess Aier’s heart tremble.
And their combined Star Power Fusion put substantial pressure on Sang Guo. He moved instantly; this development had exceeded his control.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: The Time-Space Gemstone Activation
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 356: The Time-Space Gemstone Activation
Something is wrong. Their Star Powers can fuse? And after fusion, they unleash even greater power? But I’ve never heard of the Phoenix Form and Dragon Emperor Form being able to merge. Otherwise, wouldn’t the Flame Emperor and Qing Emperor have been invincible if they had joined forces back then?
With only a slight hesitation, Sang Guo’s body instantly emitted a potent Star Energy Fluctuation. The moment the fluctuation rippled out, he vanished.
BOOM!
A ripple shimmered through the void, and a figure was suddenly smashed out of it. Sang Guo’s body flew backward, a look of horror on his face.
My Night Tour God Skill was broken without any warning... Not only was it broken, but I didn’t even see how my opponents did it! How is this possible...?
At this moment, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun vanished. An instant later, they reappeared, flanking Sang Guo. Yu Ruoyun, now clad in radiant red armor, appeared even more majestic in her Dragon Emperor Form. She threw a punch straight at Sang Guo’s face.
Sang Guo instantly raised his hand to block Yu Ruoyun’s punch, his left hand, forming a blade, swiftly deflecting Wang Lan’s incoming Sword of Light.
Yu Ruoyun’s cheeks suddenly puffed, and a pillar of purple fire erupted. The purple hue of the flames told Sang Guo the temperature was approaching ten thousand degrees.
BOOM!
An afterimage seemed to flicker across Sang Guo’s face as an invisible force erupted from him. It was like a powerful magnetic repulsion, instantly scattering Yu Ruoyun’s flames.
Wang Lan was sent flying backward, transforming into a swarm of scattering butterflies. The Nether Butterfly’s wings beat, its form flickering like stars in the night sky, each individual butterfly flashing at least ten times per second.
Sang Guo’s eyes darted constantly, tracking the position of each Nether Butterfly’s appearance.
Suddenly, an intense sense of crisis assaulted him from below. Wang Lan burst from the earth, his blade, glittering with Starlight, aimed for Sang Guo’s lower body.
Sang Guo’s form twisted abruptly, as if he had swapped positions with the space itself, instantly moving more than ten meters to the side. He had barely steadied himself when Wang Lan’s Water Severing Knife descended upon his head.
"Sky Shock!" Sang Guo slapped a palm upwards. Suddenly, the surrounding space began to vibrate violently, as if caught within an ultrasonic device. Amidst the vibrations, the Water Severing Knife dissolved into a watery mist.
Just as Sang Guo breathed a sigh of relief, finally feeling he had stabilized the battle, a crimson figure appeared eerily in his peripheral vision. Yu Ruoyun punched fiercely toward Sang Guo’s cheek.
BOOM!
The spatial vibrations ceased, and Sang Guo was sent flying backward again, crashing into the rock wall behind him. The rock wall shattered, debris flying everywhere. When the dust settled, it revealed a rich, crystalline deposit of Space Stone behind the fractured wall.
To think there are so many reserves of Space Stone here.
Sang Guo’s body was firmly embedded in the Space Stones, cracks spreading through the stones behind him like a spiderweb.
Sang Guo gently wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth. He had never imagined that he, Sang Guo, the Titled Strongman who struck terror into the hearts of nations, would one day be injured by two young people under twenty.
"Leader! Great Leader—!" Yells echoed from a passage on the side. In the blink of an eye, more than a dozen Paradise Bird footsoldiers ran out.
"We found it, Great Leader! We’ve found the Time-Space Gemstone!" one of the Paradise Bird subordinates exclaimed excitedly, holding a twenty-centimeter square block of pitch-black crystal.
"So you really were looking for the Time-Space Gemstone!" Princess Aier cried out in shock, poking her head out from the ruins.
"Idiot!" Sang Guo slapped the fool presenting the treasure, causing his brains to splatter. He spun around, and a ripple spread through the void.
Before his figure could vanish, Wang Lan appeared out of nowhere and punched Sang Guo again, sending him flying.
BOOM!
Once more, Sang Guo slammed into the rock wall, leaving another human-shaped crater. Yet, even then, he did not release his grip on the Time-Space Gemstone.
"Think you can run? Did you ask for our permission?"
"Cough, cough, cough—" A soft cough sounded. Clutching the Time-Space Gemstone, Sang Guo climbed out of the man-shaped hole, a deep fist imprint on his chest. It was the mark of Wang Lan’s enraged Great Blood Deficiency Fist.
Under Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun’s combined Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious state, even Sang Guo at his peak would not be their opponent, let alone now that he was gravely injured.
"Hand over the Time-Space Gemstone, and I can still escort you to the international court for trial. Otherwise... you’ll be executed on the spot!"
"You two juniors, truly arrogant!" Sang Guo retorted with a sinister smile. "But... I wonder, did you happen to notice the activation devices built outside when you arrived?"
Sang Guo’s words made Wang Lan and the others instantly recall the strange, portal-like structures they had seen in the open area before sneaking in.
"It seems you did... Do you know what those are? Giant Spatial Stone Activation Devices! If I’m destined not to escape with the Time-Space Gemstone, then let us all be lost to the turbulence of spacetime forever! HAHAHA—"
Sang Guo’s mad laughter turned the faces of Wang Lan and the others deathly pale. At the same time, Wang Lan sensed faint tremors from outside, like the roar of an engine starting up.
"Not good! They’ve activated the devices!" Yu Ruoyun’s face was also ashen.
Back at the Nine-layer Pagoda, a Space Stone pyramid, less than ten meters tall, had transported them to the seventh layer. In the Number Two Space, a five-meter-high Space Stone pillar had caused a Star Sea Realm expert to perish in the spatio-temporal turbulence, leaving the other two gravely injured.
And here, the amount of Space Stone was thousands, if not tens of thousands, of times greater! If this much Space Stone was activated, the resulting spatio-temporal turbulence would be enough to destroy heaven and earth! Forget the Phoenix Form and Dragon Emperor Form; they’d all be turned into mincemeat!
"Teacher, Aier, go destroy the devices!" Wang Lan roared. His mind connected with Yu Ruoyun’s, and they both instantly unleashed their full power, striking the ceiling above.
BOOM!
An unimaginably colossal force surged skyward, piercing through hundreds of meters of geological strata. A beam of light shot straight into the clouds, creating a breathtaking spectacle in the Different Dimensional Space.
"Up!" Wu Shaohua knew he could no longer help his two students here. With a bellow, his body soared towards the sky.
"Do you think they’ll make it in time?" Sang Guo taunted.
"Whether they make it or not, there should be enough time to kill you first!" Wang Lan was also infuriated. Everything had been under control, yet this madman had to cause trouble. Now, Wang Lan had only one thought: kill him. The moment his words fell, he appeared before Sang Guo, his hands a blur as his fists hammered down like a machine gun.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
A barrier suddenly twisted into existence around Sang Guo, seemingly distorting Wang Lan’s attacks and deflecting most of their power.
But even the residual force of the attacks was enough to pulverize Sang Guo’s internal organs, causing him to spurt blood wildly.
AARGH—
Sang Guo suddenly let out a furious roar, and the gate of his Star Palace exploded violently. From within the shattered gate, Starlight surged like an ocean tide, each crashing wave containing countless stars.
BOOM!
The violent energy blasted outwards. The explosive force from the detonating Star Palace sent Wang Lan flying backward. Yu Ruoyun rushed to catch him. Just as she embraced Wang Lan, the entire cavern suddenly collapsed.
Sang Guo plummeted into a seemingly bottomless chasm, disappearing from sight.
Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun could fly, so naturally, they wouldn’t be swallowed by the dark chasm beneath them. But the Time-Space Gemstone, clutched in Sang Guo’s hand, fell with him.
"We’re going down," Wang Lan decided instantly after a moment’s thought.
"This chasm is strange. Who knows what’s down there?" Yu Ruoyun voiced her concern.
"No matter what’s down there, as long as the Time-Space Gemstone is there, we must brave it, even if it’s a dragon’s den or a tiger’s lair," Wang Lan reminded her in a low voice.
Yu Ruoyun knew, of course, that the Time-Space Gemstone could open the Portal of the Demon World and allow the Demon Clan’s armies into the human realm. She had only forgotten for a moment in her panic. With this reminder, she would insist on going down even if Wang Lan tried to stop her.
Star Power flared around them, and using the light it emitted, they rapidly descended. The depth of the enormous pit exceeded Wang Lan’s expectations. They flew straight down for at least two thousand meters before reaching the bottom.
The chasm was so vast that even their fully unleashed Star Power couldn’t illuminate their surroundings. It was as if they had landed in a world of pure darkness, existing alone.
"Fire Dragon Dance Skill." Yu Ruoyun suddenly activated an S-rank Star Martial Skill. It wasn’t to attack but to control the fire dragon to roam and provide illumination.
Using an S-rank Star Martial Skill purely for illumination was a luxury only someone like Yu Ruoyun could afford.
As the fire dragon roamed, Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun finally saw their surroundings. It was a basin-like valley, enclosed by sheer cliffs.
For ordinary people, such an environment would be an inescapable prison. But for the two of them, who could fly, it posed no significant problem. The only issue was the continued presence of many eerie statues.
The surrounding cliffs were densely covered with these statues. They were colossal, each one more than ten times larger than those Wang Lan had seen in the previous cavern.
"Is this a sacrificial altar of the Demon Clan? What do they sacrifice to?" Wang Lan wondered aloud.
"Ancient Demon Gods!" Yu Ruoyun replied softly. "The Demon Clan’s societal structure is somewhat peculiar. They operate on a caste system yet possess a brilliant civilization.
"The upper castes hold absolute dominion over the lower-caste demons. They worship the Ancient Demon Gods, legendary beings said to be powerful enough to traverse interstellar space independently. However, these gods vanished into spatio-temporal turbulence during a great war hundreds of thousands of years ago. Through sacrificial rites, they hope to guide the Ancient Demon Gods back to lead them once more in conquering the universe.
"They revere individual power yet have also developed a technological civilization. These two aspects rarely coexist in human society. It’s like... if the cultivation civilization of the Ancient Times hadn’t been destroyed by the Demon Clan, perhaps we humans would never have developed a technological civilization, right?"
"There he is!" Wang Lan exclaimed. As the fire dragon swept past a cliff face, they had spotted a figure arduously climbing it.
Their minds linked, they shared the thought and instantly teleported to Sang Guo’s position.
"Die!" Wang Lan roared, attacking.
CRACK!
Completely ignoring Wang Lan’s incoming fist, Sang Guo slammed the Time-Space Gemstone into a recess in the wall.
BOOM!
Suddenly, a barrier rose from the wall, blocking Wang Lan’s punch.
"HAHAHA... I never expected... I truly never expected the Demon Clan to have left a Time-Space Gemstone activation array here! HAHAHA... I originally thought we’d need to construct our own activation device to open the spatio-temporal portal.
"Wang Lan, Yu Ruoyun, you’ve lost in the end! HAHAHA... Tremble! Tremble and welcome the advent of the Demon Clan! The Jade Country is finished! Sky Blue Star is finished! Everything will be destroyed!"

chapters.title: Chapter 357 Space Phoenix Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 357 Space Phoenix Form
As the barrier rose, Sang Guo’s body was suddenly flung out as if he had been hit by an electromagnetic projectile.
BOOM—
With a loud explosion, Yu Ruoyun’s fist smashed down on Sang Guo’s head. Without the protective barrier, Sang Guo’s head burst like a watermelon, brains splattering everywhere, mingling with the blood and the deep crater in the ground.
The once esteemed Titled Strongman who, after his betrayal, had made the entire Eastern Host Nation tremble in fear, met his obscure end in this remote corner.
After smashing Sang Guo’s head with a punch, Yu Ruoyun withdrew her fist and slightly raised her head, looking at Wang Lan, who was desperately pounding on the Array barrier, with a mixture of heartache and regret in her eyes.
"This is an Array specially set up by the Demon Clan; not even the Five Emperors can disturb it. Wang Lan, stop wasting your strength. The war has begun."
As if to echo Yu Ruoyun’s words, a brilliant beam of light suddenly shot up into the sky from the Time-Space Gemstone.
Elsewhere, Wu Shaohua and Princess Aier, despite their injuries, had fought through the Paradise Bird’s desperate resistance and finally cleared the way to the Space Stone activation device. Just as Wu Shaohua was about to launch his Star Martial Skill to destroy the device, its preheating completed.
In an instant, terrifying energy was unleashed, blanketing the world in a dazzling, aurora-like curtain of light.
