At that moment, Wu Shaohua’s expression was one of utter despair.
Just a little bit more, just that tiny bit more... We’ve tried so hard... Why... In the end, we were defeated by time, lost everything.
The immense amount of energy released by such a large vein of Space Stone would be beyond comprehension. Astronomical amounts of energy would instantaneously shred everything around them, perhaps even space itself.
His death is insignificant; he’s just a minor Star Sea realm warrior. But Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun can’t die. One is a once-in-a-millennium talent, the other a peerless prodigy unseen since ancient times. Their deaths would rob Jade Country of an opportunity for a great leap forward and might even plunge the nation back into civil strife.
Massive amounts of Space Stone energy were unleashed but didn’t result in a space-time maelstrom. Endless energy gathered, condensing the intangible energy into a liquid state and casting an energy tide towards the Time-Space Gemstone.
Such energy was not only sufficient to open the Portal of the Demon World but also to build a safe passageway between the human and demon realms.
"Host has detected loadable Pure Energy; please do not miss it." In Wang Lan’s mind, the usually reticent system suddenly spoke up, stubbornly yet mischievously telling Wang Lan that it was, in fact, an intelligent system, not a low-grade mindless one.
"The war has started, huh? Then let me end it!" As he spoke, Wang Lan made a sudden leap towards the pillar of light with the determination of a moth flying into a flame.
"Wang Lan!" Yu Ruoyun had never expected Wang Lan to make such a move, but it was too late to stop him. She watched helplessly as Wang Lan crashed headlong into the column of energy.
The energy from the Time-Space Gemstone is powerful enough to open the Portal of the Demon World; one can only imagine the space energy it contains. It doesn’t matter if he charged into it head-first; even if the Five Emperors linked hands and did the same, it would mean certain death!
"Idiot!" Yu Ruoyun cursed uncontrollably after Wang Lan had vanished.
"Loadable energy detected. Do you wish to load it?"
"Yes!" At that moment, Wang Lan felt a numbness throughout his body, followed by the Saint Cloth of the Phoenix Constellation on him disintegrating into a shower of Starlight.
Such intense energy! Even a Bronze Saint Cloth couldn’t withstand it, let alone a Gold one.
"Please select the Star Martial Skill to load."
"Heavenly Fire Extinguishing World!"
"The level of the Star Martial Skill is too low to load."
"Damn it! You’re telling me a Platinum-level Star Martial Skill is too low? Load Phoenix Form!"
"Energy loading in progress."
Suddenly, the endless void in the sky twisted. A forming space-time gate ceased spreading due to the loss of energy input, then disappeared as quickly as a snuffed-out flame.
This scene made the previously despairing Yu Ruoyun abruptly stop crying, two tears still hanging in the corners of her eyes. She looked up at the changes above with a blank, dazed expression.
Despite the unrestrained release of energy from the Time-Space Gemstone, which even stirred the space-time energy released by the Space Stone towards the sky, it seemed as though a valve in the barely visible void above was locking away the incessant flow of space-time energy.
Some time passed, perhaps a very long time.
The dispersal of energy weakened, and the energy transfer channels gradually became more unstable.
"Ruoyun, where is Wang Lan?" an anxious voice sounded. Wu Shaohua, who was outside, had also realized that events were not progressing as he had anticipated. Massive amounts of Space Stone had been activated, but the terrifying space-time turbulence had not occurred. He hurried back with Princess Aier to regroup with Wang Lan.
"The Time-Space Gemstone was activated, and Wang Lan jumped into it to block the entrance. I just don’t know... how Wang Lan did it," Yu Ruoyun said, pointing at a tiny, node-like dot in the sky.
"Block it with his body?" Wu Shaohua felt like his scalp was about to explode. Looking up at where Wang Lan was supposed to be, a ridiculous thought suddenly rose in his mind.
Are you the son of Heaven’s Path or something?
How much energy did the Time-Space Gemstone contain? Even if I couldn’t imagine it, I knew it wasn’t something a mortal could endure. It was like a person trying to stop an industrial cutting machine with their bare body and somehow succeeding—utterly absurd!
Suddenly, the column of released energy shrank and vanished like a drawn shower curtain, revealing Wang Lan’s body high in the sky, completely bare. His bare white backside was stark and glaringly conspicuous.
The two young women didn’t avert their gaze as Wang Lan fell from the sky.
At a time like this, who cares if he’s clothed or not? We’re all close comrades, after all.
Upon landing, Wang Lan didn’t pause. His body leaped high once more, and he threw a punch toward the location of the Time-Space Gemstone. This time, with no barrier to obstruct him, Wang Lan’s fist shattered the rock wall, and he retrieved the Time-Space Gemstone from its slot.
"Wang Lan, how are you?" Yu Ruoyun asked, rushing to his side.
"Could the two princesses please turn around?" Wang Lan’s face was as red as a cooked crab, his cheeks burning.
"Mr. Wu, could you spare some clothes?"
Those who went into battle usually prepared a few spare sets of clothes, not because they feared their clothes getting ragged, but for situations exactly like Wang Lan’s. Wang Lan had also prepared several sets, but the spatial energy moments ago had been so strong and terrifying that everything on his person had vanished into thin air. Even of his Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth, only the Heart Mirror remained.
Forget the clothes in his folding backpack; even the Star Martial Toxin Synthesizer on his Folding Space wristband had been disintegrated into particles.
Although Wu Shaohua’s mind was still befuddled, his actions were swift. He quickly pulled a set of clothes from his Space Backpack and tossed them to Wang Lan. Wang Lan placed the Space Gem on the ground and hurriedly dressed.
"I managed to complete the mission. I might be a bit special; I have an Inborn Talent of the Bloodline that absorbs Pure Energy. This talent is actually quite weak, not comparable to the Black Emperor’s form, which absorbs all kinds of energy. Pure Energy is very rare in this world, but fortunately, the Time-Space Gemstone emits pure space-time power. I took a risky gamble just now, and it seems I bet correctly."
No sooner had his words fallen than a rumbling noise suddenly erupted from the spot where the Time-Space Gemstone had been removed. Amidst the roar, countless stones and thick smoke rained down, and in the blink of an eye, the mountain wall before them collapsed.
If one could look down from the sky upon the entire area, they would see that the Paradise Bird’s base had now become a huge basin. Originally, this immense cavern had contained a complete Space Stone deposit as large as a mountain.
However, with the Space Stone ignited and consumed, a vast hollow had formed. This hollow was extremely fragile; the slightest touch would cause it to collapse like a house of cards.
Wang Lan’s removal of the Space Gem was the last straw that caused the entire cavern to collapse. The collapse was so vast and sudden that Wang Lan and his companions had no chance to escape and were buried under the rubble.
After a long while, amidst rubble several meters thick, mounds began to rise. Wang Lan and the others emerged from the debris as if climbing out of a grave, each vehemently spitting out a mouthful of dust.
This level of burial would have killed a hundred thousand ordinary people, but for Star Martial Warriors, it wasn’t a major issue, especially for four individuals who were either at the Star Sea realm or possessed Star Sea realm combat power.
"Is everyone okay?"
"All good!" Yu Ruoyun said with disgust, dusting off dirt from her clothes that was as thick as ash from a cement factory.
"The human race’s extinction crisis... we just resolved it like that?" Wu Shaohua looked bewildered as he stared at Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun. He asked incredulously, even though he had already heard their detailed accounts.
"Let’s go, we’re heading back! You two, write a report immediately. I’m going to request commendations for you. Damn it, Jade Country must make a grand showing on the international stage this time! Hell, I never thought I, Wu Shaohua, would encounter something so incredible in my lifetime!"
He continued, "Even when I’m old, I’ll be able to tell my grandson, ’Your grandpa once led two students to save the entire world!’ That’s so damn prestigious!"
"Old Wu," Wang Lan said with a sympathetic smile, "do you even have a girlfriend? Aren’t you thirty already? If you don’t have a girlfriend, where’s this grandson coming from?"
Wu Shaohua’s expression froze instantly.
"Wang Lan, don’t say that," Yu Ruoyun interjected seriously, defending Wu Shaohua. "Although Mr. Wu might not be conventionally handsome, he’s very strong. If he wants to marry, many women would be willing to marry Mr. Wu for his excellent genes. Perhaps he’ll be married with children by next year."
You really didn’t need to help with that defense...
Wu Shaohua thought, tears streaming down his face.
Yu Ruoyun looked at Princess Aier, who seemed to want to say something but hesitated. Then, as if remembering something, Yu Ruoyun quickly said, "We barely survived coming all this way into the interior of Space Number Five. Since we’re here and managed to live, why don’t we find the space-time node and close this space off?"
"Good idea!" Wu Shaohua nodded.
"The space-time node... I think I saw it just now," Princess Aier said eagerly.
"Where?"
"It seemed to be behind the collapsed rock wall. I only caught a fleeting glimpse before the large-scale collapse, so I didn’t see it clearly."
"Then let’s dig!" Wu Shaohua exclaimed hastily. "I remember the rock wall was in that direction."
"No need for all that trouble," Wang Lan said with a faint smile. "Light and Heavy Replacement Skill."
Accompanied by the surge of Wang Lan’s Star Power, the loose rubble at their feet suddenly broke free from gravity and rose into the sky. Soon, amidst the ascending rocks, a blue, vine-like space-time node appeared, beckoning to the four of them like a seductive woman.
"Princess Aier, go ahead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 358: A Sudden Windfall
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 358: A Sudden Windfall
The larger the Different Dimensional Space, the more solid its space nodes become. After all, the space nodes maintain the strength of the entire space. Small Different Dimensional Spaces can be shattered even by those at the Star Cloud Stage, but when it comes to the strength of a Pioneer Space like this, even the Five Emperors would have to fight for several days and nights.
The fifth Different Dimensional Space wasn’t particularly large or small, but even Princess Aier, with her Star Sea Stage strength, had to strike more than twenty times to shatter the space node.
The moment the space node fractured, the space began to distort and collapse, twisting around the space node as its center. The Annihilation of a Different Dimensional Space is reminiscent of the formation of a black hole, with the space node as the singularity, continually swallowing space until the whole area is engulfed. However, unlike black holes, the disappearance of a Different Dimensional Space doesn’t leave behind a terrifying black hole to consume everything.
After the last piece of space was engulfed, the Different Dimensional Space would break apart and disappear just like a soap bubble.
"Wang Lan, run! What are you doing?" Wu Shaohua saw the space node break and was about to leg it, but then he saw Wang Lan standing there dumbfounded like an idiot.
"Skill cooldown time... is up!" Wang Lan said with difficulty, then his whole body collapsed. Wu Shaohua caught Wang Lan in a flash and heaved him onto his shoulder, sprinting madly.
「In the depths of the universe, there is a dark Star Cloud.」
The Star Cloud looks like a dark, icy, and deadly cloud floating in the midst of space, as black as the universe’s backdrop itself.
But if you pass through the Star Cloud, which is like hell itself, you would see a dazzling Galaxy inside. The Galaxy seems to be sealed within the Star Cloud, constantly having stars drift into the dark clouds, then being devoured by terrifying energy and broken down into parts of the Star Cloud; stars also perpetually rush towards the Star Cloud like moths to flame.
Within the Galaxy, a radiant civilization spreads across an entire star system. Countless gargantuan spaceship beetles patrol around colossal hive-like structures in the cosmos. If human scientists were here, they’d be astounded by the wondrous creations of the universe, to find such an extensive hive society civilization in space.
"Report, Marshal, the space channel to the Human World was just activated," said a high-ranking member of the Demon Clan, entering an eerie, worm-shaped chamber within a huge cluster of buildings, and speaking to a beetle-like humanoid creature within.
"The Human World’s space channel? So soon? Only seventy years have passed; are the spies we left in the human realm that impatient to open the channel? Has something happened in the Human World, or are they just bored?"
"Not sure, the space was merely sensed and not opened, and the space signature extinguished within a few seconds. But we can confirm that it was the energy fluctuation from the Eighth Time-Space Gemstone."
"Eighth... Isn’t that the Time-Space Gemstone that was last activated ten thousand years ago? Since the twelve Time-Space Gemstones were implanted a hundred thousand years ago, only a few have been frequently activated; most gemstones activate once every few thousand years. The eighth has been dormant for ten thousand years..."
"Indeed, but a Time-Space Gemstone being activated without opening a channel is unprecedented. Marshal, could something have happened?"
"What could have happened? It’s just a lower civilization."
"But... the people from the Science Academy said that the civilization developing this time in the Human World is a rare one that has never appeared before and could become the greatest threat to the Divine Clan. They propose we shouldn’t just treat it as a hunting ground, but completely annihilate the human race."
"Annihilate? Do you really think the slumbering Ancient God is just for show? Why did the Ancient God confine the remaining three million of the human race to the Galaxy? That was to leave behind the last seeds of humanity.
If we destroy their seeds, he will fight to the death with us. The Demon God hasn’t returned; we’ve no power to resist him. That’s precisely why we’ve repeatedly destroyed their civilization but not their race.
Without the Demon God, the Ancient God is our eternal threat."
"Don’t we also have..."
"But we don’t need to risk it, do we? The Demon God is merely lost in the Multi-Universe; once they return, not even a Gaia or the entire resurrection of the Ancient God Clan could withstand us, they’d be annihilated in the blink of an eye. Right now, we need to maintain this situation. If human civilization perpetually remains in its savage stage, its foundation will be cut, and we can abolish them at any moment."
"But Marshal, those from the Science Academy have repeatedly reported to the Empire Alliance, stressing the high threat level of human civilization. The Emperors take the Academy’s words seriously."
"Not only do the Emperors believe them, I do too. It’s just they have a penchant for exaggeration. I’ve studied this so-called technological civilization of humanity; they began their enlightenment about two to three thousand years ago, and after over two thousand years of history, their civilization is still stuck in the tool-making age. Even the gun they invented a hundred years ago is laughably weak.
The only real threat to us are their Star Martial Warriors. The cultivation civilization of the human race is now just a disorganized mess in the Magellan Galaxy, and the strongest of the Star Martial Warriors in the Earth’s realm are mere low-level Demon Soldiers.
Without the domain of the Ancient God constraining us, we could easily turn Sky Blue Star into rubble with just one of our people. You don’t need to overemphasize it, what the Science Academy folks say may become reality, but that’s tens of thousands of years from now. Do you think human civilization can survive until then?"
"Marshal, you are wise; it seems I was a bit too hasty..."
"No, being cautious and vigilant is a valuable quality, every potential threat must be taken seriously. The Science Academy isn’t wrong to paint human civilization as formidable; they’re just too impatient. Anyway, let’s erase their technological civilization after the next opening of the space channel, so we won’t have to deal with the old fellows preaching about the threat of scientific civilization every day. Annoying!"
"Alright! Then I’ll instruct the monitoring department to be more careful and closely monitor the activation state of the Time-Space Gemstones."
"Hmm!" The Marshal waved his hand, and just as his subordinate was about to leave, the Marshal suddenly called out, "When are you and Mora getting married?"
"Ah? I... I"
"What’s the matter? You don’t plan to marry my daughter?" While speaking, the Marshal was already prepared to kill the scumbag in front of him.
"If Miss Mora is willing, I can consummate the marriage tonight."
"Hmm! There’s no need to be so hasty, wait until I notify you, you may go now."
「Wang Lan was groggy and didn’t know how much time had passed, but when he regained consciousness, the first thing he saw was the twinkling stars in the sky.」
One cannot see stars in a Different Dimensional Space.
At the moment, he was sitting in a car that was bumping along a potholed road. However, his sudden revival was not because of the bumpy road or the fading aftermath of his skills, but because of prompts that suddenly popped up in his mind.
"Congratulations to the host for successfully preventing the Demon Clan’s army from descending, rewarding seven million experience points and two hundred thousand skill points."
"Congratulations to the host for successfully closing the fifth Different Dimensional Space, rewarding three hundred thousand experience points and ten thousand skill points."
Both prompts rang out almost simultaneously.
Closing a Different Dimensional Space can award three hundred thousand experience points? That’s already a very high reward. But compared to the previous reward, it’s not even worthy to carry its shoes, right?
Seven million experience points? Even after reaching the Galaxy Stage, where leveling up starts at two million experience points, I had never received so many experience points at once. And to add twenty thousand skill points in an instant? Twenty thousand skill points could upgrade all my Star Martial Skills that I previously dared not level up.
The increase in Star Power due to my physical transformation let me see that I could follow the Pure Mage system route. But the Pure Mage system route consumes a lot of skill points, and now my usable skills were only a few. A bunch of S-rank Star Martial Skills had to be learned and then left to collect dust.
The previously set route of Zanpakuto combined with Dance of the Dark Butterfly for close combat seemed wonderful, but in the fight against Sang Guo, I also discovered problems.
Although the Sword of Light was powerful, that was true for those at the Galaxy Stage and Star Sea Stage. Once facing a Titled Strongman like Sang Guo, Zanpakuto’s attack power was too weak.
What use is the ability to change a thousand ways if you can’t break through the defense?
It’s like the Light Feather Attack. Sang Guo could just stand still, and with just the Protect Body Star Energy Shield, he could completely withstand the attack of Light Feather. To continue down this path, the only way was to improve the attack power of Sword of Light.
But Sword of Light is not a skill point and can’t be strengthened by adding points. So this path cannot be said to have failed, but an alternative Star Martial Skill must be found to replace it.
When I broke through to the Galaxy Stage, I had upgraded the Dance of the Dark Butterfly, Heavenly Fire Extinguishing World, and Earth Fire Roar among others to platinum grade Flame Sword Skills. Among them, when Flame Sword was upgraded to the platinum grade, it evolved into Extreme Heat Light Beam.
Platinum One, the initial temperature is ten thousand degrees. Ten thousand degrees, which surpasses the temperature of purple flames and is already quite strong. But the lethality of ten thousand degrees is not as high as one would imagine. The upgrade path for Extreme Heat Light Beam is to increase the heat of the light beam, which I clearly felt. To make Extreme Heat Light Beam replace Sword of Light as a strong output, its temperature must be increased several times.
And with each upgrade at the platinum level being progressively more expensive, starting at twenty thousand points, I simply couldn’t afford it. Even my destiny Star Martial Skill, Life Light, was only at Platinum One. When lacking skill points, those beautiful futures could only be dreamt of during the day.
Now with an influx of two hundred thousand skill points all at once, Wang Lan was so excited that he sprang up.
BANG—
A loud noise jolted the car upward with a tremendous impact, startling Wu Shaohua who was driving to quickly look back.
"Wang Lan, the fight is over, calm down."
This kind of situation, Wu Shaohua had often seen before. Many Star Martial Warriors would fight until they fainted and were carried to the rear hospitals for treatment. Upon waking up, their first instinct was to strike out. That’s why every battlefield medic had mastered the art of exquisite dodging—if you can’t dodge well, you’re not allowed to serve at the front-line hospitals.
What if you save someone, only to be punched to death by the person you saved? Wouldn’t that be a loss?
"Ah? Oh, it’s over? Good." Wang Lan deflected the awkward situation by playing along.
But Yu Ruoyun, who had been by Wang Lan’s side the whole time, watching him for a long while, knew that Wang Lan had been awake for at least three seconds. Three seconds might seem short, but for a Star Martial Warrior, three seconds is enough to get pregnant.
So there was no reason for Wang Lan to bounce like that.
But within an instant, Yu Ruoyun figured it out.
If she were Wang Lan, she would have bounced too.

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Annoyances Only Geniuses Have
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 359: Annoyances Only Geniuses Have
Wang Lan’s breakthrough to the Galaxy Stage felt like it was just yesterday, but even if it wasn’t, it would have been no more than seven or eight days ago. Yet, at this moment, his body was once again emanating a surge of breakthrough Star Energy Fluctuation.
Right now, Wang Lan was lying beside Yu Ruoyun’s legs. He wasn’t leaning on them, but the distance was still very intimate. However, the look Yu Ruoyun gave Wang Lan was no longer filled with the tender affection of before; instead, a devilish thought unexpectedly bubbled up from within her.
Why not just strangle him right now? This is too damn infuriating!
Breaking through to the Galaxy Stage requires one million experience points, and progressing from Galaxy Stage One to Galaxy Stage Two needs two million. Hence, even though he had acquired seven million experience points, it could only elevate Wang Lan to Galaxy Stage Three, leaving him two million points short of Galaxy Stage Four.
So, even though the breakthrough was complete, Wang Lan’s realm remained in the early Galaxy Stage, not yet reaching the mid-stage. Princess Aier couldn’t help but wonder,
What is the meaning of this breakthrough? I thought he was about to unleash some ultimate move, but did he just yawn instead?
Since there was no substantial breakthrough, Yu Ruoyun’s composure returned.
There shouldn’t have been a breakthrough in the first place... How can someone who just advanced to the Galaxy Stage a few days ago break through again? Such a person shouldn’t even exist!
"I never expected... that this ordeal would be countless times more severe than I imagined," Princess Aier said suddenly, leaning against the car window with a somber tone. "We originally just intended to scout the whereabouts of the Paradise Bird and, if possible, take down this terrorist organization."
"But who would have thought we actually saved the entire world? We averted a crisis of the Demon Clan’s descent!"
"So, you see, life is unpredictable," Wang Lan commented. "Our near-death experience tonight, for many people around the world, was just a quiet and peaceful night. Now, if we think about it from their perspective, could it be that during every night we consider peaceful, there’s another group of people experiencing a life-and-death struggle similar to ours? Could they also be facing terrifying crises like we did?"
"If one day someone suddenly tells me the world has ended, we shouldn’t be surprised. The end of the world isn’t sudden; it’s just that we were unaware of it."
"Ruoyun, do you have to be so pessimistic?" Wang Lan felt goosebumps rise as he looked at Yu Ruoyun’s misty eyes and her expression, which seemed to carry the weight of the world’s sorrows.
"Do you know that the Demon Clan left behind twelve Time-Space Gemstones?" Yu Ruoyun countered. "Each one can open a portal to the Demon World and allow the Demon Clan’s armies to descend. We were just lucky to stop it once."
"If I can stop it once, I can certainly stop it a second time," Wang Lan declared.
"Right," Wu Shaohua, who was driving, suddenly interjected, "Wang Lan, can you really absorb the energy of the Time-Space Gemstone? Is this Time-Space Gemstone now empty?"
"I can indeed absorb pure energy," Wang Lan replied, "but whether this Time-Space Gemstone is empty or not, I don’t know."
"So, you’re saying you’re currently the only one in the world who can counter the Time-Space Gemstones? If the Demon Clan or human traitors activate a Time-Space Gemstone, we just need to throw you over there, and everything will be fine?" Wu Shaohua pressed.
"Theoretically, yes." Wang Lan looked at Wu Shaohua’s smile with suspicion, feeling that something was off.
"Old Wu, your smile is giving me the chills."
"Not at all! I’m just thinking that you might become our ultimate trump card to save the world. The activation of a Time-Space Gemstone creates a huge disturbance; such powerful energy fluctuations would be detected immediately. When that happens, all we need to do is send you over."
"That’s a pretty crude plan, isn’t it? Let’s not even discuss the fact that the Portal of the Demon World opened by a Time-Space Gemstone only lasts for a few minutes. Even if it lasted for dozens of minutes, what then? Am I supposed to traverse the globe in minutes?"
"You can’t traverse the globe in minutes, but doesn’t our Jade Country have the Divine Wind Express? Divine Wind Express, mission guaranteed!"
"Are you going to tie me to a rocket?"
"That’s ridiculous! Could a speed of Mach eight even restrain you? We’ll just pack you into a missile warhead. When I get back, I’ll report this. From now on, you’ll be our strategic nuclear weapon against the Time-Space Gemstones."
Having survived the ordeal, everyone, regardless of their usual personalities, abandoned their previous reserve and joked all the way. Before they knew it, the four of them had returned to Ice City and proceeded directly to the royal court.
The four-person squad’s independent investigation of Different Dimensional Space No. 5 was known only to Longya and Jin Wenbing; not even King Cain was aware. So when Princess Aier suddenly returned, King Cain came rushing out in his pajamas.
"Aier, why have you returned so suddenly? Has something happened in the space? Why are there rumors that your advancement has halted? Did you encounter some difficulty?"
"Father, there was no trouble," Princess Aier began, but her voice trailed off as she looked at the car that had stopped nearby. Longya and Jin Wenbing were getting out.
Longya then said, "Your Majesty King Cain, let’s discuss this in the conference room."
"Okay... okay..."
Inside the conference room, Wang Lan, carrying the Time-Space Gemstone wrapped in clothes, followed them in. After everyone sat down, Longya curiously glanced at the bundle in Wang Lan’s hands.
"What’s this?"
"A Time-Space Gemstone."
"A Time-Space Gemstone?" Jin Wenbing and Longya exchanged looks, confusion evident in their eyes.
"The Time-Space Gemstone," Wang Lan explained, "is a device the Demon Clan left behind to open a portal to the Demon World. You can think of it as a wormhole opening and closing device. From the intelligence we’ve gathered, the Demon Clan left a total of twelve Time-Space Gemstones, and this is the only one discovered so far."
As soon as this explanation was given, everyone unconsciously sprang to their feet.
What was this? Something that could allow the Demon Clan’s army to enter the Human World? This thing could bring devastating blows to human civilization! And they actually found it? How... how surreal!
"Daughter, you’d better explain to me properly... exactly... what happened," King Cain said, his voice trembling as he dabbed at the sweat on his forehead with a handkerchief.
"Father, the events began when we encountered a terrorist ambush in Different Dimensional Space No. 2. Just yesterday, a volunteer group in a Different Dimensional Space was ambushed, and a powerful Star Sea Stage warrior was killed by spacetime turbulence triggered by a Space Stone..."
Princess Aier then recounted the events in Different Dimensional Space No. 2, how Wang Lan had noticed the Paradise Bird’s suspicious movements, and how they deduced their secret activities in Different Dimensional Space No. 5.
The four of them then entered Different Dimensional Space No. 5 and, after overcoming countless difficulties, found the Paradise Bird base, discovering their search for the Time-Space Gemstone. A battle ensued, and they narrowly prevented the Time-Space Gemstone’s activation.
Especially at the end, Wang Lan had desperately blocked the Time-Space Gemstone’s activation, preventing the Portal of the Demon World from opening and the Demon Clan’s army from descending. Princess Aier tried to describe the events without exaggeration, but the inherent danger of the process still made everyone present break out in a cold sweat.
After Princess Aier finished her account, Wang Lan presented the Time-Space Gemstone to Longya. "This is the Demon Clan’s Time-Space Gemstone. I’ve tried, but its material is incredibly hard, and I can’t destroy it. It’s best if I hand it over to you to deal with."
"Good... good..." Longya was also dumbfounded, his mind momentarily blank.
"In that case, since Princess Yu and Mr. Wang Lan have survived a great ordeal and must be very tired, let them go back and rest first," Kester said, standing up and addressing the two.
"Yes, you two go back and rest," King Cain agreed. "Mr. Kester, please summon Ambassador Heze. This intelligence is too significant; we need to report it to the Jade Country immediately."
"Understood."
「Back at the dormitory, Wang Lan took off his clothes and enjoyed a refreshing bath.」
After changing into clean clothes, Wang Lan didn’t go directly to bed. Instead, he sat cross-legged on the bed and immersed himself in the system.
This time, he had not only gained a vast amount of experience and skill points but also acquired a tremendous amount of the Power of Space. Wang Lan had obtained the Power of Space once before, when he first arrived in Modu City and helped an expert from the Tianjian Bureau destroy a Different Dimensional Space.
But back then, the amount of Power of Space he received was so minimal that Wang Lan barely felt it. This time, however, it was completely different.
Within the system, the Phoenix Form skill was still on cooldown, but Wang Lan could already understand certain changes through its description.
"Phoenix Form, Dragon and Phoenix Auspicious Form, Time-Space Phoenix Form."
The initial Phoenix Form only had the primal sublimation mode, which was the one Wang Lan first used, providing an explosive increase in overall strength. But as Wang Lan’s strength progressively increased, the augmentation from this Phoenix Form had become weaker and weaker.
Later, in the Nine-layer Pagoda, due to the intermingling of his Star Power with Yu Ruoyun’s, the Phoenix Form advanced to its second stage: the Mimicry Form.
This stage of the Phoenix Form was the most versatile, allowing for the integration of various abilities. From the information his mother, the Flame Emperor, had provided, Wang Lan knew that Wang Ling had once used seven different mimicry transformations at this stage.
For example, the Ice Phoenix Form could leave everywhere it went frozen solid and blanketed in snow.
However, compared to Wang Ling’s second-stage transformations, Wang Lan’s second form had a much more high-end start. The first mimicry form he used was the Dragon Emperor Form, which alone could match the quality of all of Wang Ling’s mimicry transformations combined.
And now, the second mimicry form had appeared: the Space Form.
Time-Space Phoenix...
Wang Lan mused.
Never mind its actual power; the name alone sounds incredibly formidable.
The Time-Space Phoenix Form allowed him to leave a fixed coordinate at a specific location, enabling instantaneous spacetime jumps regardless of distance. Essentially, it was teleportation, making this ability a top-tier tool for immediate support and rapid escapes.
With this, I’m practically invincible!
Of course, the energy source for the Time-Space Phoenix Form was the Power of Space rather than energy generated by Wang Lan himself. It was like a power bank; once the energy was exhausted, the form would become unusable.
But with such massive spatial energy from the Time-Space Gemstone, it should last a long time, right?
Reluctantly tearing his gaze away, he turned to the next few Star Martial Skills. With plenty of skill points in the system, Wang Lan hesitated.
Should I change my current combat style?
These skill points offered Wang Lan two paths. The first was to raise the level of multiple skills, upgrading all his all-attribute Star Martial Skills to platinum level. This would enable Wang Lan to cope with any emergency.
The second option was to maintain his current style, focusing on reinforcing his Flame Sword, Holy Shield, and Dance of the Dark Butterfly, pushing these few skills to new heights. This combat style wasn’t bad. Its only shortcoming, however, was insufficient offensive power.
While almost everyone else was worrying about how to painstakingly proceed down a single difficult path, Wang Lan was agonizing over which of two broad, easy roads to take.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 The Asteroid is Going to Crash Down
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 360 The Asteroid is Going to Crash Down
Wang Lan didn’t waver for long before he made up his mind. Being part of the Pure Mage System was indeed cool and exhilarating, but his vision should no longer be restricted to his peers or even the Star Sea realm.
Among his peers, Wang Lan could be said to be invincible. Of the young generation he knew, only Yu Ruoyun possessed the strength to fight him on equal terms. Even facing Princess Aier, a genuine Star Sea realm combatant, Wang Lan was confident he could kill her within half an hour.
Therefore, Wang Lan ultimately set his sights on the category of Titled Strongmen.
By following the Pure Mage System, he could indeed promote all his S-grade Star Martial Skills to the Platinum level. But the raw damage output of simple Platinum-level skills still left him unsatisfied.
Earth Fire Roar and Heavenly Fire Extinguishing World were both powerful, but their area-of-effect spread the damage too thin. Take Sentient Beings, for example; even if upgraded to Platinum level, while it could kill a group of Star Sea realm fighters, it might not be able to kill a single Titled Strongman.
I still need to focus on single-target Star Martial Skills.
Having made this decision, Wang Lan set his focus on Extreme Heat Light Beam.
Extreme Heat Light Beam was supposed to be a powerful attribute developing from the Flame Attribute, much like how the Ice Attribute, upon reaching a very high level of mastery and undergoing a qualitative change, would transform into Extreme Cold Beam.
Extreme Cold Beam, commonly known as Aurora, was the ultimate dream of Ice Attribute Star Martial Warriors. It could emit a beam close to Absolute Zero, where even atomic movement could be frozen. For thousands of years, however, the corresponding Extreme Heat Light Beam never appeared. Only the legendary East Emperor Red Bird from the Mythical Era was said to possess the Extreme Heat Light Beam ability.
A week ago, Wang Lan upgraded his Flame Sword to Extreme Heat Light Beam. However, the initial temperature of Platinum Level 1 was only ten thousand degrees, just slightly higher than the purple flame. This left Wang Lan quite dissatisfied with Extreme Heat Light Beam, so much so that he didn’t even use this move in his battle with Sang Guo.
Is an Extreme Heat Light Beam with just ten thousand degrees worthy of the name?
In the universe, temperatures exceeding one hundred million degrees were not rare. Forget other places; in the Light Country alone, any random Warrior of Light’s beam attack could reach temperatures over one hundred thousand degrees.
Wang Lan stared at the Extreme Heat Light Beam’s stats panel: Extreme Heat Light Beam, Platinum LV1 (0/20,000).
I’ll take a gamble. It’s only twenty thousand skill points at most. If it’s too far from what I expect, I might as well ditch this skill in the future.
After investing twenty thousand skill points into Extreme Heat Light Beam, it instantaneously moved from Platinum Level 1 to Platinum Level 2. Wang Lan hurriedly focused his spiritual power on Extreme Heat Light Beam.
"Extreme Heat Light Beam, Platinum LV2, beam temperature: fifteen thousand degrees. As this skill evolved from Flame Sword, it inherits all usage techniques of Flame Sword."
An increase of a full five thousand degrees?
This increase finally allowed Wang Lan to feel at ease.
Is five thousand degrees a lot? Hmm, not much, if you compare it to cosmic explosions that easily reach millions or even billions of degrees. But let me ask you: do you think thirty-five degrees Celsius is bearable? What about forty degrees? At fifty degrees, you could be hospitalized within minutes.
An increase of five or ten degrees might be unbearable, so can you imagine what an increase of five thousand degrees would be like? At ten thousand degrees, metal could be instantly melted. At fifteen thousand degrees, metal could be turned into a pool of liquid on the spot.
After adding another thirty thousand skill points, the temperature of Extreme Heat Light Beam reached twenty thousand degrees. At twenty thousand degrees, it could instantly turn metal into a gaseous state, just like boiling water.
Wang Lan continued to upgrade Extreme Heat Light Beam to Platinum Level 4 before stopping.
Damn it, skill points burn too quickly!
A total of ninety thousand skill points were used up, leaving only one hundred and twenty thousand in the system.
Wang Lan couldn’t upgrade Extreme Heat Light Beam any further; he still had Holy Shield to consider. Holy Shield was currently only at Gold Level 1. It was the Star Martial Skill he learned last, but it was so damn useful in close combat. Its activation was almost instant, and the skill had no cooldown period.
Besides its defensive power, which Wang Lan found unsatisfactory, Holy Shield greatly complemented Zanpakuto. So this time, Wang Lan spent ten thousand skill points to upgrade Holy Shield to the Platinum level without hesitation.
When a flash of white light passed before Wang Lan’s eyes, the newly upgraded skill appeared in his vision.
"Holy Shield, Platinum LV1 (0/20,000)"
"Holy Light Guardian: Immunizes against three hundred percent of physical attacks, Elemental Attacks, mysterious attacks, and soul attacks!"
What does three hundred percent mean? If my threshold for enduring attacks is one hundred percent, an attack sufficient to kill me three times over could be blocked! If I had been holding Holy Shield back then, Sang Guo’s attack would have been perfectly defended against, and I wouldn’t have been beaten so badly.
At that thought, Wang Lan felt so frustrated that he wished he could dig Sang Guo up and fight him all over again.
If he had used up his skill points back then, he wouldn’t have felt so aggrieved. But at that time, he still had thirty thousand skill points lying in his system.
Damn, how could I not have thought to strengthen Holy Shield?
If Sang Guo knew this from the afterlife, he would once again be speechless with frustration.
Please, show some decency! You’ve already killed me; what more do you want? I am a Titled Strongman; don’t I deserve some respect?
Suppressing the urge to upgrade Holy Shield further, Wang Lan’s gaze moved to Crescent Arrow. In terms of single-target lethality, Crescent Arrow, Thunder Snake, and Flame Sword were the strongest. However, Thunder Snake’s evolution path in the later stages might lean towards a thunder body, which was somewhat redundant for Wang Lan, who already possessed Holy Shield and Dance of the Dark Butterfly.
Crescent Arrow’s ranged attack power, on the other hand, was something Wang Lan urgently needed. Crescent Arrow was now at Gold Level 7. The cost of upgrading it wasn’t high, so he decided to raise it to Platinum and see the results.
After Crescent Arrow was upgraded in a flash of white light, a brand new skill appeared before Wang Lan’s eyes.
"Star Sky God Arrow! When you gaze upon the starry sky, are you also moved by the vast Starlight? Star Sky God Arrow—under the stars, you become the most dazzling child.
Void Purple Eyes: Lock onto any target you see. No matter what kind of evasion they attempt, your arrows will always pursue the target until it falls.
One-Hit Kill Arrow! Pour all your life’s Star Power into one shot—it’s either your death or mine. Firing this arrow will leave you completely drained. If enemies are still nearby, run immediately."
Damn, so this is how an R-skill appears?
Wang Lan looked at Star Sky God Arrow and was momentarily at a loss for words. He knew that Star Martial Skills would experience a qualitative change upon leveling up to the Platinum level, but he never imagined it would be so far beyond his expectations.
So many Star Martial Skills had been upgraded to Platinum level. The first few seemed normal, but each subsequent one was more surprising than the last. This gave Wang Lan the impulse to upgrade Star Cloud Sword Dance to Platinum level too.
After thinking it over, he decided against it. With Dance of the Dark Butterfly, Star Cloud Sword Dance wasn’t that useful. Plus, his battle with Sang Guo had already confirmed the practical effectiveness of Dance of the Dark Butterfly. This skill had saved his life many times from Sang Guo’s attacks; its evasion capabilities were already sufficient.
There were still one hundred thousand skill points left in the system, and they had become very precious. Wasting them needlessly on anything was now out of the question.
Better to wait...
With that thought, Wang Lan indulged in a good sleep.
「The next day」
The sun was already high when Wang Lan got out of bed, puzzled by the time.
No one woke me up today?
After washing up, he was surprised to find that some people had returned to the camp.
There were fellow students from the academy, as well as warriors from the Black Tiger Army.
"Good morning, everyone!" Wang Lan greeted them.
"Morning my ass! The sun is already up. Tell me, Wang Lan, are you always this lazy? How can you still be so strong?" Yang Xian, a classmate familiar with Wang Lan, joked.
"Well, you can’t blame me. My strength seems to grow like it’s breeding while I sleep, constantly rising. It troubles me too, you know."
"Damn! Well, get up and go eat in the canteen. Today, they made big meat buns."
"Really? But weren’t you guys stationed in the Second Space? How come I see so many people back?"
"The Second Space was closed last night. Damn it, the spatial node was in such a godforsaken place, making us waste a whole week for nothing."
"It’s closed? That’s great! Which space is next? When do we leave?"
Wang Lan felt like he had slept through major events, as if he’d lost his connection with the world.
"About that... it’s hard to say," Yang Xian said, his expression turning mysterious and serious.
"What happened?"
"I’m not too clear about the specifics, but it seems to be related to an asteroid. I don’t know the details; Director Long didn’t say. Don’t you have good connections with the higher-ups? Can you ask around for us?"
Wang Lan agreed and left for the canteen. He satisfyingly devoured six large meat buns and let out a contented belch.
BEEP BEEP BEEP—His phone rang. It was a call from Yu Ruoyun.
"Wang Lan, are you still sleeping? Get up quickly and come to the command center’s Meeting Room Number Three."
Full of curiosity, Wang Lan arrived at Meeting Room Number Three. This room served as Jade Country’s conference room for providing aid. Only a group of Star Sea realm teachers and high-ranking members of the Black Tiger Army were present. Including Yu Ruoyun and Wang Lan, all the high-end Star Sea realm combat power was accounted for.
"Is everyone here? I’ll get straight to the point. Just one hour ago, at 17:00 Jade Country time, our homeland urgently contacted Ambassador Heze. The World Space Observation Team discovered a small asteroid outside Sky Blue Star."
"The asteroid has a diameter of about fifty meters and weighs around one hundred thousand tons. The International Astronomical Observatory is closely monitoring its trajectory. As of ten minutes ago, the latest data indicates a ten percent chance it will enter the atmosphere, and a ninety percent probability it will be torn apart by the gravitational forces of the Moon and Sky Blue Star."
"If this asteroid crashes onto Sky Blue Star, based on the estimated trajectory, it’s predicted to fall in the Ice Sea region of the Northern Hemisphere. The impact force would be equivalent to... fifty megaton-class hydrogen bombs."
"Uh... that doesn’t seem like a huge threat, right?" one tactical teacher scratched his head. "The Arctic Ocean region is vast, and over ninety-five percent of it is uninhabited. Even if fifty megaton-class hydrogen bombs fell there, it wouldn’t be much of an issue, would it?"
"Xu, have you forgotten that we are also within the asteroid’s impact range?"
"Damn, such a huge area and it just so happens to be heading for us? Does it have to be this ironic?"
Getting hit by a meteorite was a chance in billions. Even with precise data, it was still a chance of one in tens of thousands.
Meteorites fall onto Sky Blue Star every day. However, most are so small that they burn up upon entering the atmosphere, long before reaching the ground.
An asteroid with a diameter of fifty meters would melt rapidly during its descent; it would be fortunate if even ten percent of it made it to the ground.
"Although the possibility is small, we still can’t be careless. Current human technology allows for accurate predictions of these events. If the asteroid does indeed head for impact, there will be at least twenty hours before it reaches the ground. That’s enough time to calculate the precise point of impact. Let’s wait and see; we cannot disregard the unexpected."

chapters.title: Chapter 361 Connection
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 361 Connection
This kind of event, rare for decades, had actually been encountered by Wang Lan. But having already experienced something as extraordinary as opening the Demon World’s gate with the Time-Space Gemstone, facing an asteroid collision didn’t seem like such a big deal anymore.
The volunteer group and the Black Tiger Army both returned to camp for rest and reorganization. Successfully closing two Different Dimensional Spaces should have been an unprecedented victory for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. But this victory didn’t incite an all-out celebration among its citizens.
Two were closed, but three still remained. Unless all five Different Dimensional Spaces were shut down, even a single one could easily destroy the already shattered Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
In the royal palace of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, King Cain repeatedly urged the Foreign Minister to inquire with the International Security Council about the asteroid’s status. All the while, he ceaselessly wiped the copious sweat from his forehead.
Survival was too difficult!
Barely scraping by for twelve years under the fangs and claws of Exotic Beasts, they had scarcely seen a glimmer of hope before an asteroid, like the reaper’s call, loomed over the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Although the chances of the asteroid falling were only ten percent, and even if it did fall, the odds of it hitting the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were one in tens of thousands.
But what if?
"What if" had tormented King Cain for twelve years.
Back then, he also believed that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow would not open a Different Dimensional Space, but it happened nonetheless. At that time, Cain thought that if the Kingdom of Ice and Snow did open a Different Dimensional Space, there would be at most one. But in the end? Six were opened in succession.
Even if he didn’t want to believe it, over the years, Cain had always felt that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow must have been cursed by the God of Heaven. Otherwise, why would such bad luck, which hit no other countries, befall the Kingdom of Ice and Snow time and again?
"BANG—" The office door was suddenly thrust open, and Prince Kester rushed into Cain’s office with urgent strides.
"Big brother, what are you doing? We’ve closed two Different Dimensional Spaces. We should push our advantage and close the remaining three. Why are you here listening to the radio? Haven’t you seen that the people from Jade Country have already returned to camp to rest?"
"I’ve seen it. But Kester, don’t you know there’s an asteroid above our heads?"
"My God, it’s a one-in-a-million chance! What are you worried about? Instead of worrying about an asteroid falling from the sky, you should be more concerned about the possibility of Exotic Beasts suddenly breaking free from all the Different Dimensional Spaces. Big brother, go push the people from Jade Country. We can take care of the remaining spaces—Numbers One, Three, and Four—within a week, and our nation can rise from the ashes."
"’The stone in the sky is not the key issue. The biggest problem is... we have no more money.’ Cain’s face showed bitterness as he spread his hands. ’The Minister of Finance just came to see me, telling me that hiring mercenaries has exhausted all our savings, and there is less than a hundred thousand left in the national treasury.’"
"Out of money?"
"Out of money! After this battle, all one thousand surviving mercenaries have chosen to leave. We must immediately hire a new batch of mercenaries, but we can’t even afford to pay one person for a day. If we rely solely on Jade Country’s volunteer group... the possibility of successfully closing the three spaces is slim. Wasn’t a mercenary the one who discovered the node of Space Two?"
"What about a loan?"
"Most international banks are unwilling to lend to us. Just a moment ago, I secured a loan of one hundred million Green Currency from Citibank in White Eagle Country, using the Kerweite Region’s energy mines as collateral."
"That’s robbery! Damn it, can’t we get a loan from Jade Country?"
"Jade Country doesn’t have an international bank, and the loan process takes a long time. The banks in White Eagle Country can transfer the funds within seventy-two hours. This way, we can continue to recruit mercenaries. Moreover, this time the price might have to go up to ten Jade Coins a day."
"’Did you sign the contract?’ Kester asked, his gaze as fierce as a bloodthirsty demon, his tone dark."
"Not yet. Their fax will be sent over soon."
"Don’t you dare sign!" Kester spoke through gritted teeth.
"Don’t sign? If we don’t, where will we get the money? With what will we hire Star Martial Warriors?"
"I said don’t sign! That is the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s last hope for revival. If you sign it, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow won’t have a chance to recover for the next hundred years. A hundred years later, what may be left is only devastation. Don’t sign. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is the inheritance left to us by our ancestors. We can’t let it be destroyed in our hands."
Challenged by Kester’s questioning and bellow, Cain’s expression suddenly became somber.
He slammed the table and stood up fiercely. "If we can’t even survive the coming year, what’s the point of talking about a hundred years from now? If we don’t sign, where will we get the money?"
"I’ll figure something out!" Kester said coldly, throwing down those words. He gave Cain a deep look and turned to leave.
「By noon,」 the International Astronomical Observatory gave the authoritative result: in the next three hours, the asteroid would enter the gravitational tug-of-war magnetic field between Sky Blue Star and the moon. It would be crushed into dust by the gravitational forces within the magnetic field.
Upon receiving this outcome, not only the Kingdom of Ice and Snow but the whole world heaved a sigh of relief. An asteroid collision, no matter where it fell, was a cause for global concern. Who knew what it might trigger?
Especially since the Arctic region had a long line of volcanic activity. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow was located on this volcanic range, basking in eternal spring, which created this uniquely beautiful country.
The asteroid crisis was averted, but the volunteer group needed at least three more days of rest to be operational again. Injuries required three days to heal, but what was chiefly lacking was cannon fodder.
This wasn’t Jade Country’s home turf. There was no reason for the volunteer group to risk their lives in small teams to search for and destroy space nodes. This battle strategy was very risky; it was possible that seven or eight teams could be lost to close a single Different Dimensional Space.
They’re not my parents, so why should I try so hard?
Enjoying some rare downtime, Wang Lan followed everyone’s habit of engaging in combat training when there was nothing much to do, discussing the techniques of using Star Martial Skills with others. He started with enthusiasm, but after a while, he found it boring again.
Skills that others struggled desperately to master came to Wang Lan as if by instinct. However, if asked to explain how, he could only grasp it intuitively but couldn’t put it into words.
It wasn’t that Wang Lan was hiding his own shortcomings. He genuinely didn’t know how to articulate it. The drawback of adding points had finally emerged: experience gained from adding points couldn’t be shared with others. To share it, one would have to use Spiritual Engraving. But Wang Lan wasn’t so generous as to selflessly share the skills he had learned with such effort.
Although the process of adding points wasn’t hard, the process of earning those skill points was still quite tough.
Even though three Different Dimensional Spaces remained unclosed, they had ultimately achieved a great victory. Thus, tonight’s dinner was exceptionally lavish, with each person receiving five pounds of beef. In the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, it was a luxury to eat meat and drink alcohol to one’s content. Discipline meant no alcohol, but they truly enjoyed the meat.
"BEEP BEEP BEEP—" Suddenly, his cellphone rang, and Wang Lan’s expression changed slightly.
It was a notification from the work cellphone of the Tianjian Bureau. Since arriving in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, this phone had been basically out of commission, its only function being to check the time.
Wang Lan discreetly pulled out the cellphone, glanced at the message, and silently put it back in his pocket.
Having been in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow for over ten days, the Tianjian Bureau field agent Ming Baiye had mentioned had never contacted Wang Lan, leading him to wonder if the mission had been canceled outright.
After dinner, in the deep quiet of the night, Wang Lan donned a face-changing mask and, relying on his excellent stealth techniques, successfully evaded the camp’s sensors and left.
The rendezvous point was in a midnight bar in Ice City. Even though Ice City had reached desperate straits, entertainment still flickered like stars. Especially in the Arctic Ocean region, it seemed as if people lost their purpose to live if they didn’t drink alcohol.
Therefore, bars were probably the best-surviving industry among all forms of leisure and entertainment in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Following a pre-arranged script, Wang Lan made contact with the other party quite smoothly. The person, wearing a harmless-looking face, gave Wang Lan a toothy smile.
"I have no name. You may call me Number 31. This face has been surgically altered. The original owner of this face was a foreign affairs steward of the Duanmu Family. He planned to quietly escape from Jade Country through concealed channels, but we apprehended him.
"All the clues and evidence I have gathered will be duplicated and stored in the safe house. If everything goes smoothly and the mission is completed, I will return to my country, and you won’t need to do anything. But if something happens to me, you can go to the safe house, retrieve the evidence and clues, and then continue the investigation."
"Is this meeting purely a meet-up, or is there... a mission?"
Wang Lan didn’t like the current state of secrecy, which made it seem like he was a spy. Although Wang Lan was indeed a spy, he preferred to operate openly and honorably.
"No mission, but I have some information to pass on to you. The sellers here have finally contacted me. They urgently need to sell twelve tons of Space Stone, pricing it at two hundred million."
"Twelve tons? Have they gone mad?"
"That’s why I feel this deal is somewhat unusual, but it is, after all, the best opportunity to make contact with our target. I have a safe house in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. This is the safe house’s address and the key.
Wang Lan solemnly took the envelope the other party handed him. "Need any help?"
"No need. Your job is just to be a backup. There’s a high probability that I will complete the mission successfully. I’ve done missions like this dozens of times; it’s second nature to me."
Wang Lan looked deeply at the other person. Even though the face was fake, Wang Lan oddly felt a sort of sacred radiance from him.
"Alright!"
"I’ll go first. Have another drink and leave half an hour later," he said, downing the drink in front of him, waving his hand casually, and walking away.
Stepping out of the bar, the alley outside was pitch black. There were neither streetlights nor pedestrians. Wang Lan slowly made his way back to the camp, retracing his steps.
Even in the capital, nighttime Ice City was as dark as deathly silence, its occasional flickering lights unable to illuminate the city.
"BOOM—"
Suddenly, a loud explosion sounded.
Along with the explosion, a strong wave of Star Energy Fluctuation swept through.
Wang Lan furrowed his brow tightly and paused. He had secretly left the camp to engage in espionage; someone in his position really shouldn’t meddle. But he still stopped, hesitating.
The intensity of this Star Energy Fluctuation had reached the Star Sea realm. In all of Ice City, there were only a few people with Star Sea realm strength, all closely related to Wang Lan.
Was it one of the academy’s teachers fighting someone?
After hardly two seconds of hesitation, Wang Lan suddenly leaped forward, his form turning into a streak of light as he rushed toward the direction of the explosion.

chapters.title: Chapter 362: The Whereabouts of the Nuclear Bomb
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 362: The Whereabouts of the Nuclear Bomb
By the time Wang Lan arrived, all he saw was a field of ruins. If he remembered correctly, this should have been the most famous hotel in Ice City. But now, the entire hotel had vanished, and scattered throughout the rubble were bodies, battered and broken.
Wang Lan’s eyes quickly swept around, and suddenly his pupils contracted. Lying in a corner of the debris was a stark white corpse. While closely resembling the typical features of the Iceland Country, Wang Lan could still discern the subtle differences.
This burly Caucasian was likely one of the Arctic Bear people, whose nation is internationally known as Bear Country.
"Who’s there? Hands on your head and get down!" Suddenly, a loud shout came from behind, and the royal guards rushed towards Wang Lan, yelling at him. When Wang Lan turned around, the man came to an abrupt halt.
Perhaps because the halt was too sudden, the man’s body lost balance and he fell to the ground with a THUMP. His kneeling posture made Wang Lan’s tense face instantly break into a smile.
"Brother, there’s no need to be so polite, right?"
"Wang Lan?" A soft exclamation sounded as Princess Aier slowly walked up from behind the crowd. "What are you doing here? Did you do this?"
"No!" Wang Lan immediately shook his head. He had originally wanted to explain why it wasn’t him, but Princess Aier didn’t even ask.
"Search the area. See if there are any survivors."
Being Star Martial Warriors, sifting through ruins was almost as easy as flipping through a book. In almost an instant, the entire site had been searched.
By piecing together the mangled corpses, it was established that at least seventy people had died in the explosion; among them, two were from Bear Country. Surprisingly, there was one person who had merely fainted.
Wang Lan checked and found that this person was a Star Martial Warrior. That made things easy. A Life Lock Chain formed a connection, and in less than five seconds, the person’s injuries were healed.
Princess Aier exhaled a breath of cold air, and the person lying amongst the dead bodies shuddered and came to.
"Ah? Princess Aier."
"Who are you? What happened here?"
"I... I am a senior agent from the Intelligence Bureau. Today, I accompanied Prince Kester in a nuclear arms deal, but Bear Country suddenly demanded a price hike, and our negotiations broke down. We were ordered to stay here and secretly monitor Bear Country. Suddenly, a mysterious person appeared and seized Bear Country’s nuclear weapons. I heard their conversation, and the mysterious person who appeared later seemed to be... from Jade Country."
The man evidently assumed that Wang Lan couldn’t understand their language and spoke openly. But Wang Lan understood clearly.
"Jade Country people?" Wang Lan’s brows furrowed tightly. He didn’t dare to outright deny whether people from Jade Country had been sent on a mission. But then another thought instantly crossed his mind, "You’re trading nuclear weapons? What do you want them for?"
"The nuclear weapons trade is a state secret. But shouldn’t Jade Country provide a reasonable explanation for entering our country without permission and using force?" the man asked sharply, his tone shifting upon realizing Wang Lan understood his words.
"Shut up!" Princess Aier interjected. "Jade Country is our eternal friend. Are you trying to incite conflict between the Kingdom of Ice and Snow and Jade Country?"
"Princess, your subordinate wouldn’t dare. But... the one leading them was indeed from Jade Country, and he’s a well-known powerful figure from Jade Country... known as the Envoy of the Netherworld, Wang Mingling!"
"Wang Mingling?" Hearing this name, Wang Lan was taken aback, then he breathed a sigh of relief.
It seems this scourge isn’t so easy to kill, after all.
"Princess Aier, I think you just need to look up the International Security Council’s most wanted list to find out who Wang Mingling is," Wang Lan said. "Thirty years ago, he defected from Jade Country and has been active in the Middle East for the past thirty years.
He’s an international terrorist with an S-level danger rating, and he even launched a terrorist attack on Suzhou City in Jade Country half a year ago. Moreover, we have received reliable intelligence that Wang Mingling is a member of the Paradise Bird.
So the people who seized the nuclear weapons belong to Paradise Bird. However, I can’t ignore the fact that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is trading nuclear weapons." Saying this, Wang Lan gave Princess Aier a solemn look and then turned to leave.
"Wang Lan..." Princess Aier called out instinctively, but all she saw was the dark night and the lonely stars in the distance.
Returning to the camp, Wang Lan went directly to the Central Command. After identifying himself, he was immediately taken inside by the security guards.
"What? The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is buying nuclear weapons from Bear Country?" Jin Wenbing immediately slammed his hand on the table and stood up. "What is the Kingdom of Ice and Snow trying to do? What are their intentions?"
Nuclear weapons are the ultimate armament of human scientific civilization. These things are so powerful that even the humans who created them cannot control them. When nuclear weapons were first invented, the great scientist Einstein had all nations sign the Nuclear Protection Treaty before the technology was made public.
Nuclear weapons can only be used to protect human civilization and must never be turned against our own kind. During an invasion by the Demon Clan, nuclear weapons are our last defense for civilization.
The technology to manufacture nuclear weapons can only be held by the nine strongest countries of the current age. Any other country needing to use nuclear weapons against the Demon Clan must apply to these nine principal nuclear-weapon-producing countries. Unless there is a compelling reason to refuse, these nine countries are obligated to unconditionally support the requesting nation’s use of nuclear weapons to repel a Demon Clan invasion.
The Nuclear Protection Treaty details hundreds of clauses, one of which stipulates that nuclear weapons are not allowed to be traded and are not to be used outside of Demon Clan invasions.
The Demon Clan has not invaded, so what does the Kingdom of Ice and Snow want with nuclear weapons? Who are they planning to use them against?
Longya took a deep breath and slowly stood up. "Let’s go. We need to get an explanation from King Cain."
Wang Lan followed Longya, Jin Wenbing, and Yu Ruoyun as they charged into the royal palace with great indignation. That night, the palace was also abuzz with activity. It seemed as if they had anticipated the impending questioning from Wang Lan and his party, as a greeter was already waiting for them upon their arrival.
Following the greeter, they were led to a secluded underground chamber, where Wang Lan met King Cain and Prince Kester. However, Princess Aier was not present.
"It seems King Cain is aware of the purpose of our visit," Jin Wenbing said, folding his arms and letting out a faint, cold laugh.
"It must be about our purchase of nuclear weapons," King Cain acknowledged.
"I didn’t expect you wouldn’t even try to cover it up," Longya said with a sarcastic laugh.
"We always treat friends with sincerity," Prince Kester replied with a faint smile.
"But the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is violating the Nuclear Protection Treaty," Jin Wenbing stated firmly. "As one of the permanent members of the United Nations, Jade Country cannot sit idly by. If you do not provide a reasonable explanation, we will withdraw from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. What happens next will be none of our concern."
"No trade means no harm," Prince Kester retorted. "It’s not just the Kingdom of Ice and Snow that has violated the Nuclear Protection Treaty. Hasn’t Bear Country been secretly selling nuclear weapons for years? You can’t sanction Bear Country, so you sanction us? There’s an old saying in Jade Country that’s very true: ’Always pick on the softer target.’"
"How do you know we won’t sanction Bear Country?" Longya challenged.
"Hmph!" Kester scoffed.
"Kester, hold your tongue. Gentlemen, please follow me," King Cain said as he pressed a button. The floor of the secret chamber began to descend slowly, revealing that the chamber was actually an elevator.
Surrounded by 360-degree reinforced glass, the elevator allowed a view of each floor. Outside the viewing glass, densely packed armaments and weapons were visible.
The entire palace was built over a massive armory.
"Twelve years. Do you know what the past twelve years have been like for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow? We live in constant fear every day. Every single day. I am the King, and he is the Prince of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"We were prepared long ago to live or die with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. But we cannot abandon the people of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"Five years ago, we made plans for the worst-case scenario. If the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s defensive lines completely collapsed, we would arm every citizen. After sending just one thousand children out of the country, our entire population of two million would perish along with the Exotic Beasts.
"And these nuclear weapons are our last resort.
"We purchased five such devices from Bear Country. They are very small—suitcase-sized nuclear devices. But their power is immense. A single one could destroy everything within a two-kilometer radius."
As he finished speaking, the elevator stopped.
Outside the glass of the elevator were three elegant suitcases. If not for Cain’s explanation, Wang Lan would have thought they were just ordinary travel bags.
Such weapons probably don’t have long-range strike capability, do they?
Wang Lan thought.
Suddenly turning around, Cain’s deep eyes, filled with tears, pierced Wang Lan’s heart like a spear.
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow, lacking sharp claws for offense or strong sinews for defense, lived a harmless existence, seeking only to scrape by. But fate had dealt the Kingdom of Ice and Snow the cruelest of judgments.
Five Different Dimensional Spaces, any one of which could lead to the Annihilation of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Faced with such despair, Cain could only think of mutual destruction, of perishing together with their enemies.
Such eyes, such a plight, softened even the heart of the usually stoic General Jin Wenbing.
He stated, "The nuclear weapons cannot stay in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Once we deal with the other three Different Dimensional Spaces, the weapons must be confiscated. Furthermore, at the United Nations committee, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow must denounce Bear Country and provide sufficient evidence."
"Of course, that’s no problem," Cain replied, a hint of relief in his voice. "We only wanted the nuclear weapons to take some enemies with us if we had to die. If the Kingdom of Ice and Snow can be reborn from the ashes, who would want to die?"
BEEP BEEP BEEP— Suddenly, the cell phones of Cain, Kester, Jin Wenbing, and Longya rang simultaneously.
This scene left Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun completely dumbfounded.
Could their timing be any more perfect? This must be something major.
Sure enough, as the faces of the four who answered their calls changed dramatically almost in unison, Cain’s phone slipped from his grasp, shattering into several pieces on the ground.
"Wang Lan, Ruoyun, we must return to Jade Country immediately," Longya said grimly, lowering his phone.
"Return to our country? Why?" Wang Lan asked, puzzled.
"The astronomical observatory’s prediction was wrong. The asteroid wasn’t torn apart. Instead, it’s accelerating towards the Arctic Ocean region."
"Prediction wrong? Didn’t the observatory announce the crisis was averted after seeing the asteroid enter the gravitational field between Sky Blue Star and the moon? How could they miscalculate that?"
"They did observe it, but strangely, the asteroid wasn’t pulled apart by the gravitational forces. It’s heading intact towards Sky Blue Star, and its speed has exceeded estimates. It’s projected to hit in one hour."
"But the Arctic Ocean is so vast..." As he spoke, Wang Lan’s eyes suddenly widened as he looked at the devastated King Cain. "It can’t be that precise, can it? Is it going to hit the Kingdom of Ice and Snow exactly?"
"No, but it’s close," Longya explained gravely. "The point of impact is the Ice Volcano, the one right beneath the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. If it’s struck, the volcano will erupt. This volcano has been dormant for a thousand years, and its eruption would be tens of thousands of times more powerful than the asteroid’s impact.
Forget the Kingdom of Ice and Snow; the entire Arctic Ocean could be finished. We need to leave immediately."
"Don’t go!" Suddenly, Cain, as if snapping back to his senses, cried out, "Please, don’t go! Save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow!"
"King Cain," Longya said gently, "this is a natural disaster. It’s beyond human control."

chapters.title: Chapter 363: Hou Yi Shooting the Suns in the New Era
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 363: Hou Yi Shooting the Suns in the New Era
The words "natural disaster" left King Cain expressionless.
Natural disaster... asteroid impact... triggering volcanic eruptions, which would soon turn the entire Arctic Ocean region into a sea of magma. The coldest Arctic Ocean would quickly become the hottest place on Earth.
"King Cain, please send us up," Longya said indifferently.
Cain remained stunned. Kester placed his hand on the elevator’s sensor area, and the elevator once again began to ascend slowly.
Upon reaching the ground floor, Jin Wenbing hurried off to the camp to gather the warriors and prepare for departure. At the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s airport, five planes, vehicles sent from Jade Country to aid, were lined up one by one.
At the entrance to the palace, Longya felt a pang of reluctance. "King Cain, I am very sorry, but this is where we part ways. We hope the International Astronomical Observatory’s estimate is wrong. If this asteroid does not cause severe consequences, we will return as soon as possible."
"Mr. Longya, could you take my daughter with you?"
"If Princess Aier is willing, we would be glad to."
"I don’t want to." Princess Aier’s voice suddenly rang out as she walked over with light steps. Then, she suddenly ran towards Wang Lan and, to everyone’s astonishment, flung herself into his arms.
Wang Lan felt a chill on his lips as Princess Aier’s pressed against his.
The scene left King Cain and the others astonished. Yu Ruoyun’s face changed drastically, and Wang Lan was utterly befuddled.
"Wang Lan, whether I live or not, you must remember that in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, there was a girl who fell in love with you, and that love never changed, even until the last moment of her life."
Princess Aier whispered into Wang Lan’s ear, then slowly stepped away from his chest as if nothing had happened, returning to her father’s side.
"I will not leave. I am the Princess of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and I should share its fate."
"Aier, this is different. Human effort cannot change a natural disaster. There’s no point in you staying."
"My purpose is... to ensure that the people of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow are not afraid when disaster strikes, because I am facing it with them." Princess Aier said with a tender smile, "I am known as the Goddess of War by my people, but this ’Goddess of War’ has hardly ever won a battle.
"It is not because my strength truly makes me a Goddess of War, but because... they need a Goddess of War. They need the protection of a Goddess of War."
"Then... Mr. Longya, could you take some of the people of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow with you? Not many, just a thousand."
"We should be able to..."
BEEP BEEP BEEP— Longya’s phone rang again. His expression changed dramatically as he hurriedly took it out to answer.
"What? Okay, I understand! I’m leaving immediately."
After hanging up, Longya said to Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun, "We have to go now. The asteroid has begun its descent, and it’s expected to hit the Ice Volcano in forty minutes."
Wang Lan took a deep look at Princess Aier, the coolness still lingering on his lips.
"Wang Lan, this is an order!" Longya barked again.
"Yes!"
In the end, Wang Lan still followed Longya to the camp. No matter how unwilling he felt, all reluctance and pity crumbled in the face of reality.
One might have the benevolence to aid the world, but one can’t risk one’s own life and fortune for it, can one?
Wang Lan was an ordinary person, not a great man, nor a saint; he wasn’t that noble.
As for Princess Aier, Wang Lan admitted she was beautiful, but he didn’t lust after her. He certainly wasn’t going to fly into a passionate rage and champion her cause just because of her confession.
By the time he returned to the camp, a thousand Black Tiger Army soldiers and over a hundred members of the academy support group were already prepared to depart. The proposal to take some people from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow with them was not brought up again.
Dozens of buses quickly drove out after Wang Lan’s arrival. The atmosphere inside was very oppressive. Aside from the roaring engines, not another sound could be heard.
Suddenly, a commotion arose from within the bus. Wang Lan looked up to see that, at some point, a group of civilians from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had appeared along the sides of the road.
They stood silently, just as before, watching the vehicles pass one by one. Many civilians from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow held banners.
Written in Chinese, they bore messages such as, "Wishing you a triumphant return," and others.
"The civilians of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow still don’t know that an asteroid is about to fall and strike the Ice Volcano... They think we’re going to fight in a Different Dimensional Space..." a choked, sorrowful voice said.
As the person spoke, the sound of sobbing began to rise and fall within the bus. Even the hardened warriors, faced with those hopeful gazes, couldn’t imagine the despair the civilians would feel upon learning that the support team wasn’t going out to fight for them but was instead leaving the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Wang Lan stared blankly out the window, his mind a whirl of confused thoughts and emotions.
For the first time, Wang Lan faced such powerless despair. He truly recognized how insignificant humans were in the face of natural disasters.
"Director Long, can’t we just blast the asteroid to bits mid-air?" a student suddenly asked in a low voice.
"Blast it apart? Do you know how fast an asteroid falls? At the very least, it’s twenty times the speed of sound, and the greater its mass, the faster it falls. The fastest missile we have today is only Mach 6.
"Moreover, an asteroid’s trajectory is extremely unstable, changing direction every second. To hit an asteroid with a missile, human technology would need to advance for several hundred more years."
When Wang Lan heard this, his whole body jolted. Sensing his change, Yu Ruoyun gripped his arm with concern. "What’s wrong?"
Wang Lan’s body was rigid, as if carved from stone. Yu Ruoyun gently patted his shoulder. "You don’t have to blame yourself. This is beyond our capabilities; it’s a natural disaster, not our fault."
