Wang Lan didn’t blame himself. Even if the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were destroyed by the asteroid, he would feel regret at most, not guilt. But now, several key phrases kept surfacing in his mind:
Too fast... missile can’t lock on... shoot down...
Platinum-level Star Martial Skill, a derivative of the Star Sky God Arrow: Void Purple Eyes. Locks onto a visible target. Regardless of how the target evades, an activated Star Sky God Arrow skill will ultimately hit the locked target. Heart-Piercing Shot: gather all Star Power into one lethal arrow, delivering the strongest attack. Could this skill lock onto the asteroid? Could it prevent this disaster?
BEEP BEEP BEEP— Longya’s phone rang again. Each time it rang, his heart pounded. No matter how many times it happened, it still filled him with trepidation.
"Hello, this is Longya. I’m on the bus right now, heading to the airport. Estimated time? About fifteen minutes. What?"
That "What?" instantly plunged the entire bus into silence. Longya suddenly stood up, banging his head against the bus’s luggage rack without even feeling it.
"Half an hour? How is half an hour enough? We still need to board the planes, don’t we?"
After a long silence, Longya hung up. "Speed up! The asteroid will impact in half an hour! We must take off before then! Hurry!"
「Far Across the Ocean」
The International Astronomical Observatory had brought together the world’s top astronomers and the most advanced astronomical observation equipment. In the control room, a dozen elderly, grey-haired scientists intently stared at the data on the monitoring screens.
"How is this possible? What on earth is this asteroid made of?" an old man suddenly roared. "Entering the combined gravitational field of Sky Blue Star and the Moon, it can withstand the gravitational forces of two celestial bodies? Even if it were pure metal—no, even a chunk of rock—it should have been ground to dust!
"To pass through the gravitational field unscathed, still following its original trajectory as it falls... but why is it burning so slowly in the atmosphere? At this rate, when it impacts, its size will only have been reduced by a third at most. A nearly twenty-meter asteroid impact is enough to destroy everything in the Arctic Ocean!"
"Our only hope now is that the asteroid’s impact point shifts a bit. Please don’t let it actually hit the Ice Volcano range! If it triggers the eruption of the Ice Volcano range, the entire world will be affected."
TICK TOCK TICK TOCK— Suddenly, a new detection report printed out. Several scientists grabbed the freshly printed report like hungry tigers pouncing on prey.
The moment they saw the report’s conclusion, despair etched itself onto everyone’s faces.
The probability of hitting the Ice Volcano range was 97.8%.
"This is bad!" one of the technicians exclaimed.
"What is it?"
"The asteroid has begun to spin violently at high speed! The intense air pressure is increasing its rotational speed. The asteroid’s descent speed has increased by a quarter, the impact force will double, and the time to impact is now... less than twenty minutes!"
"It’s over!" a scientist from Jade Country cried out in shock. "Will planes still be able to take off after the asteroid hits?"
"If there’s a build-up delay before the Ice Volcano erupts, there might be a window of about twenty minutes. But if the Ice Volcano was already on the verge of erupting, it could explode immediately."
Dozens of buses arrived at Ice City’s open-air airport, all skidding to a halt, almost drifting as they stopped.
"Quick, stop dawdling! Forget the luggage! Hurry up and board! We only have a few minutes left! Hurry and get on board!" Longya and the other instructors bellowed, their voices like booming bells.
"What’s that...?" Suddenly, a student glanced up inadvertently and froze completely.
In the western sky, a bright, miniature sun had abruptly appeared, its brilliance illuminating the entire sky. This "sun" grew larger and closer by the moment.
"Fuck! Weren’t we supposed to have more than ten minutes?"
"Hey, Heze? The asteroid is going to hit early? Board immediately? Don’t bother telling me now, I can fucking see it already! We’re boarding, but this asteroid... it looks like it’s headed right for us—"
In just a minute, the asteroid’s brightness surpassed the sun. Even though it was night, its light illuminated the land as if it were day.
And its trajectory was taking it directly over Ice City’s airport.
It’s a gamble. There’s nothing to lose by trying. If I don’t try, and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is destroyed because of it, I might regret it for the rest of my life. To try or not to try?
The question swayed in Wang Lan’s mind for only a second.
Fuck it! I’m going all in! Star Sky God Arrow, add points!

chapters.title: Chapter 364: A Shot to Fury
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 364: A Shot to Fury
After investing 20,000 skill points, Star Sky God Arrow upgraded to Platinum Level Two. Before yesterday, Wang Lan wouldn’t have even dared to imagine wasting his last skill points on Star Sky God Arrow.
After reaching Platinum Level Two, the power of Void Purple Eyes and Critical Strike was strengthened once more; killing a Titled Strongman with a single hit would be no problem. However, this asteroid’s mass was incredibly high, and its structural integrity could withstand the gravitational friction between two planets. After hesitating, Wang Lan added more points.
He spent a total of 90,000 points to reach Platinum Level Four before stopping. There were no skill points left in the system; this was the utmost he could do. In those few seconds, the asteroid overhead had already drawn extremely close to Earth’s surface.
Because the asteroid was rotating at high speed, this increased its flight speed but also stabilized its trajectory.
"Void Purple Eyes, activate!"
Star Power exploded around Wang Lan in an instant, his left eye turning gold, and his right eye turning purple. His purple eye, in particular, radiated a deep violet light, as brilliant as the stars.
"Wang Lan, what are you doing? Why aren’t you boarding?" Wu Shaohua shouted as he approached.
"You guys go first, I’ll board last!" As he spoke, Wang Lan’s Star Power surged even more fiercely.
"No way? Wang Lan, have you gone mad? You want to use a Star Martial Skill to hit an asteroid?" When Wu Shaohua guessed what Wang Lan might be up to, he was completely aghast.
You previously used Star Martial Skills to hit a missile, but can that even compare? What’s the speed of a missile? Only Mach five or six. Moreover, a missile explodes on impact, but an asteroid is a solid chunk of iron! Even if it’s not a solid chunk of iron, it’s still a solid chunk of rock. What kind of Star Martial Skill could intercept an asteroid moving at this speed? What Star Martial Skill could possibly shatter a solid asteroid? I’ve seen people get cocky after one success, but I’ve never seen anyone as delusionally arrogant as you!
"Don’t be ridiculous..." Wu Shaohua’s words were suddenly interrupted by a hand that patted his shoulder. Longya shook his head slightly at Wu Shaohua. "Maybe... he can create a miracle?"
"Wang Lan, I’ll help you!" Without hesitation, Yu Ruoyun flashed to Wang Lan’s side. "Dragon Emperor Form, activate!"
"Phoenix Form, activate!"
When both had activated their transcendent forms, their Star Power automatically linked. In that instant of compatible Star Power, Yu Ruoyun finally understood the true extent of the monstrous power Wang Lan had kept concealed.
Their Star Power was compatible, their minds linked, and even their skills could be shared.
Yu Ruoyun saw Star Sky God Arrow for the first time. It was a Star Martial Skill that even her royal family, with its centuries of accumulated knowledge, had never heard of.
Instantly, Yu Ruoyun’s eyes also became one gold and one purple, with the purple eye emitting an arcane violet light.
In their shared vision, the asteroid in the sky now appeared elliptical, its surface covered in spiral grooves. These grooves might have been caused by the intense burning after entering the atmosphere, or from weathering due to being caught in whirlwinds.
These spiral grooves caused the high-speed elliptical asteroid to spin rapidly as well. It hurtled towards Earth at a terrifying speed.
Both of them simultaneously raised their right arms; resplendent wings, like golden halberds, erupted from their wrists. They placed their left hands over their right wrists and drew back as if nocking an arrow, accumulating power. As they charged, a terrifying energy formed from the frenzied convergence of Star Power coalesced in their arms, condensing into a sword-like arrow.
"Locked on?" Wang Lan asked indifferently.
"Locked on."
"Fire!"
WHOOSH! WHOOSH—
Two Critical Strikes burst from their arms, streaking into the void. As the arrows flew, it was as if all the strength had been drained from their bodies. The seething Star Power enveloping them dissipated, and they both collapsed almost simultaneously.
The Critical Strike, when unleashed with full power, inevitably resulted in complete exhaustion.
Quickly, two female classmates dashed forward and caught the falling pair, while everyone else stared skyward, transfixed by the dazzling light.
"What’s that?" At the World International Astronomical Observatory, footage from eight high-powered satellite cameras tracking the asteroid’s descent suddenly showed two beams of light erupting from the ground. The speed of the beams was not fast, moving at a snail’s pace compared to the asteroid’s descent.
"Don’t know. Could it be a missile launched from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?"
"Since when do missiles glow?" one scientist sarcastically remarked. "Quickly, calculate the light beams’ trajectory!"
"Holy shit! These two beams of light are on a precise intercept course with the asteroid! Impact in three... two... one!"
BOOM—
A deafening explosion ripped through the sky. All those at the airport gazing upward felt as if a red-and-blue, donut-shaped explosion had suddenly erupted. The shockwave spread out in concentric ripples, and for a fleeting moment, the miniature sun in the sky scattered like fireworks.
The shock of that scene left everyone present in a daze.
On their craned necks, Adam’s apples bobbed up and down.
"I..." Wu Shaohua managed, his chest so tight that nearly ten seconds passed before he could force out the next word, "FUCK—"
It wasn’t that Wu Shaohua lacked vocabulary, unable to find the right words to express the shock he was experiencing. It was because words to describe this kind of shock hadn’t been invented yet.
That single expletive, in this instance, spoke volumes more than any elaborate speech could.
That one word perfectly encapsulated what everyone present was thinking.
Using Star Martial Skills to shoot down missiles had already shattered their understanding of the world. But now, Wang Lan had demonstrated something even more incredible.
Star Martial Skills taking on an asteroid? And damn it, he actually blew the asteroid up!
But in reality, the strength of the combined Star Martial Skill from Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun that destroyed the asteroid wasn’t quite so overwhelmingly powerful on its own. Even if the asteroid had hit Earth, it would have disintegrated upon impact anyway; Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun had merely hastened its end.
The asteroid exploded, and the sky instantly filled with a rain of fiery debris. Countless fragments scattered downwards, like a Star Martial Skill manifesting as a meteor shower.
"Fuck, get your defenses up!"
A tactical instructor finally reacted and shouted urgently. All students who knew defensive Star Martial Skills swiftly activated them to block the meteor shower falling above their heads.
After a barrage of falling debris, the world fell silent.
The asteroid impact event, which had garnered the attention of countless countries and people, thus ended rather anticlimactically.
Of course, they were confused. But... what on earth were those two beams of light?
"Congratulations, Host, for successfully shattering the falling asteroid and saving the ecology of the Arctic Ocean Region. Reward: 1,500,000 experience points and 70,000 skill points."
He had just spent 90,000 skill points to improve Star Sky God Arrow and was immediately rewarded with 70,000 skill points. It seemed like a net loss of 20,000 points, but could it truly be considered a loss? The skill enhancement was undeniably real.
With that last arrow, if a Titled Strongman dared to face it, I’d bet my life it would blow him to smithereens!
What’s more important, the 1,500,000 experience points pushed Wang Lan’s experience gauge to close to ninety percent. According to convention, reaching nearly ninety percent of the experience needed for Star Martial Grade Four meant he was effectively in the middle stage of that grade.
Even if no more experience points came in, just relying on the Platinum-grade Immortal Cloud Mysterious Green Record, leveling up to Galaxy Four would only take another day or two.
RING RING RING—
BEEP BEEP BEEP—
The phones of Longya, Heze, and Jin Wenbing rang almost simultaneously.
"Hello? Minister, good to hear from you..."
"Hello? Eld Di? We’re still in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow; we haven’t taken off. What’s going on? Well, what do you think? It was Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun; they joined forces to unleash a Star Martial Skill. They’ll have to give you the specifics themselves... but they’ve both passed out from exhaustion..."
After receiving the rewards, Wang Lan also succumbed to a deep unconsciousness. He didn’t know how long he’d been out when a cool touch on his forehead slowly brought him back to awareness.
Slowly opening his eyes, the first thing he saw was the exquisite face of Princess Aier. Princess Aier was gently wiping his face with a snow-white towel.
"Don’t move. You sweated a lot while you were unconscious. I’ll have someone bring you some hot water soon. You can take a bath and change your clothes before you go out."
Her tone was so tender it almost melted Wang Lan.
"Princess Aier... I’m sorry..." Wang Lan stuttered.
"Sorry for what? You saved millions of people in our country; you’re our hero. Everyone in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is grateful to you. Why are you apologizing?"
"It’s not that... I mean... I have a girlfriend now."
"I know," Princess Aier’s expression was natural, her smile just as tender as before. "Her name is Jiang Xinyu; I’ve heard Princess Yu talk about her. But just because you have a girlfriend doesn’t mean I can’t like you, right? I’m not going to interfere in your life. I’ll just be here in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow... thinking of you."
"I’m sorry!"
Soon, hot water was brought over, and Princess Aier even wanted to bathe Wang Lan. Wang Lan, of course, couldn’t agree to that, and then the limp, powerless shrimp was effortlessly carried by Princess Aier into the bathtub and given a wash.
The experience was both intimate and awkward.
About two hours later, Wang Lan regained a bit of strength in his limbs. The aftereffects were not as painful as those from the Phoenix Form, just leaving his limbs weak. However, the weakness lingered for quite a while.
Supported by Princess Aier, he walked outside to bask in the sun. At the door, Princess Yu Ruoyun was covered with a blanket, looking boredly at the sky. Seeing Wang Lan come out, Yu Ruoyun revealed a smile that spoke volumes of shared hardship.
"You’re here?"
"How do you feel?"
"Would my condition be any different from yours? By the way, how long have we been unconscious?" She directed the question at Princess Aier, who was beside Wang Lan.
"Two days. The relief team has gone to participate in the celebrations. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow narrowly averted disaster. We have you both to thank."
"Right," Wang Lan said to Aier, "the matter of the nuclear bomb was delayed because of the unexpected asteroid incident. What’s the status on that?"
"That was delayed by the asteroid incident. The Ministry of Defense’s intelligence agency began their investigation the day before yesterday. All external borders have been sealed, and a nationwide search is underway."
"If it’s Wang Mingling, the chances of you finding him are slim," Wang Lan said with a light smile. "He’s an S-class traitor from Jade Country with strength at the peak of Star Sea Realm, and he might even have reached Sang Guo’s level of power."
"I expected as much. Terrorists stealing nuclear bombs usually have two objectives: one is to carry out a terrorist attack, the other is to blackmail the government. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow is hanging by a thread right now, so carrying out a terrorist attack against us is pointless. As for extortion..." She chuckled bitterly. "A country so poor it’s barely clinging to life—what could they possibly extort from us?"

chapters.title: Chapter 365: The Hope of Repairing the Saint Cloth
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 365: The Hope of Repairing the Saint Cloth
"They didn’t necessarily steal the nuclear bombs with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow in mind," Yu Ruoyun said indifferently, leaning against the wall.
"Due to the nuclear non-proliferation treaty, nuclear weapons are firmly controlled by the nine major nations. Terrorist organizations can buy any conventional armaments from the White Eagle Country, but they absolutely cannot obtain nuclear bombs. Paradise Bird has acquired two nuclear bombs, and with their capabilities, they could deliver those bombs to any city in any country. We must find the whereabouts of these two bombs. Otherwise, the death toll could reach the millions."
As soon as Wang Lan finished speaking, Princess Aier’s face turned deathly pale. This was a responsibility the Kingdom of Ice and Snow could not bear under any circumstances.
"Oh, you’re all up!" From a distance, a senior student waved as she approached, gracefully sitting down beside Wang Lan. "My name is Aiwei, and I’m a senior in the Close Combat Department."
"Huh?" Wang Lan looked at the senior in surprise, not expecting such a sweet-looking young woman to be from the Close Combat Department. He had heard from two louts in his dormitory that the male-to-female ratio in the Close Combat Department was a terrifying twenty to one. Even if there were a dozen or so women in the department, each supposedly looked like a muscle-bound monster.
Just as Wang Lan was about to return the beauty’s greeting, a system alert suddenly appeared in his mind: "Special metal detected. Can repair damaged Saint Cloth."
The last time, his Saint Cloth had shattered in the Time-Space Gemstone explosion, leaving only a Heart Mirror fragment. After that, he’d encountered a series of misfortunes before even having a chance to mourn its loss. Although the Phoenix Saint Cloth possessed a Self-Repair ability, the damage was so severe that the chances of it repairing itself were slim.
The sudden system alert left Wang Lan somewhat dumbfounded.
Special metal? Where is it? Why can’t I see it?
Staring intently at Aiwei, Wang Lan was on the verge of activating his Void Purple Eyes when he noticed a pendant on her chest. It was a silvery-white, teardrop-shaped piece of metal, somewhat twisted and with an uneven surface.
Could it be this?
Wang Lan’s unabashed staring at Aiwei’s chest made even a typically casual Close Combat Department student blush instantly.
I didn’t expect Wang Lan to be so lecherous... What if he makes some excessive demand? If I refuse... Wang Lan is so outstanding, being his girlfriend wouldn’t be a loss, would it? Powerful men all seem to be playboys. They say Lord Qing Emperor also has several confidantes... But... I haven’t graduated yet... What if I accidentally get pregnant?
Who truly knows what goes through a woman’s mind at times, or how far their thoughts can drift when they’re caught up in them?
"Um, Senior Aiwei, could you let me see the pendant on your chest?"
"Ah?" Aiwei’s cheeks immediately burned crimson. Princess Aier, standing nearby, quietly sighed in relief.
Indeed, Wang Lan wasn’t interested in this girl. She doesn’t have a figure like mine, nor is she as beautiful as I am; how could Wang Lan reject me for her? Yes, it must have been a misunderstanding.
Without hesitation, Aiwei removed the necklace and held it out to Wang Lan.
"Where did you get this?"
"I pried it off a meteorite fragment. It looked pretty, so I made it into a necklace."
Wang Lan quickly opened his Star Palace and summoned the Phoenix Saint Cloth, now reduced to a single piece of chest armor. No one would believe that this battered piece of metal before them was once the magnificent Star Palace Artifact that had danced like a phoenix before disassembling and fitting itself onto Wang Lan.
If Yihui were here, he would probably fight Wang Lan to the death over this, the kind of fight where neither would rest until the other was dead.
The Phoenix Saint Cloth possessed the ability to Self-Repair. However, this required the correct materials. With only a palm-sized piece of metal remaining, even a thousand years might not be enough for it to recover.
"This pendant is incredibly hard; my warhammer broke trying to damage it, yet it remained pristine. It must be some special material from outer space. My family is in the steel business, so I was planning to take it back for them to research," Aiwei explained.
Wang Lan placed the pendant on the Heart Mirror. He was about to open the system and ask how to repair the Saint Cloth when, in an instant, the bead melted on the Heart Mirror and then seeped into it. In the blink of an eye, the bead vanished without a trace.
"Was it... eaten?" Aiwei asked, dumbfounded. Princess Aier and Yu Ruoyun also stared at Wang Lan, awaiting his explanation.
"My Star Palace Artifact is called the Phoenix Saint Cloth. It has a Self-Repair ability, but the materials required are very hard to find. I thought repair was hopeless, but I never expected Heaven itself to deliver the necessary materials."
"Are they in the meteorites? I’ll send people to collect them immediately!" Princess Aier exclaimed.
The meteorites had fallen right near their location, and almost everyone present had witnessed it. Thus, collecting the meteorite fragments was not a difficult task for Princess Aier. The asteroid impact had been an accident for Wang Lan, but now, it was an unexpected blessing.
Perspectives differ; what constitutes a disaster for one can be a boon for another. For the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, this asteroid was a catastrophe. But for Wang Lan, damn it, this was a surprise bonanza!
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow operated with remarkable efficiency. Almost as soon as Princess Aier issued her orders, the people of the Kingdom sprang into action. Furthermore, the support team from the Jade Country, having little else to do, also joined the effort to collect meteorite fragments.
By afternoon, the first batch of meteorites had been delivered. The meteorites were dark and smudged, resembling lumps of charcoal. Wang Lan picked up a meteorite and placed it on the Heart Mirror. He stared at it for a long time, but nothing happened.
Could I have guessed wrong?
"Wang Lan, even if the Phoenix Saint Cloth has Self-Repair capabilities, you can’t expect it to eat rocks, can you? I think we should first refine the metal from the meteorites. It’s even possible that only one specific type of metal within them is the required repair material," Yu Ruoyun said with a speechless expression, watching Wang Lan tap a rock against the Heart Mirror.
He’s so silly, it’s almost endearing,
she thought.
"That’s true. Do we have the means to refine it? I recall the Kingdom of Ice and Snow doesn’t have any heavy industry, right?"
"Indeed, we don’t have heavy industry for steel production. However, extracting some metal from the meteorites should still be possible. If we know the method, we can even do it ourselves. We should start by melting them at high temperatures to separate the rock from the liquid metal. Then, through forging, we can remove impurities. Let’s first isolate the metals, then send them to a testing facility for compositional analysis," Princess Aier suggested softly.
"Alright! Let’s build a furnace and melt the metal into a molten state!"
"Is all this trouble really necessary?" Yu Ruoyun walked past Wang Lan with a look of disdain, gently nudged him, and said, "Move over. Let me handle this."
She picked up a meteorite the size of a fist, and Star Power surged within her. Instantly, a purple flame erupted in her hand. The purple flame, far hotter than the bluish flames of a steel mill, could not only melt iron but could even turn rock into magma.
After a minute, Yu Ruoyun’s brow furrowed; the meteorite in her palm showed no change whatsoever.
Could the purple flame not be hot enough?
She increased her Star Power output, and the purple flame shot skyward like a roaring bonfire.
Despite maintaining the output for nearly three minutes, the meteorite remained unchanged.
"Strange. What kind of meteorite is this? It can’t even be melted by my purple flame."
"That’s to be expected." Director Longya suddenly appeared, his long hair flowing as he slowly approached. "I heard the students were all looking for meteorite fragments," he said. "I was curious, so I came to ask: what do you need the meteorites for?"
"Last time in Space Five, my Phoenix Saint Cloth shattered when I was preventing the Time-Space Gemstone from activating. Although it can be repaired, the materials needed for its repair are extremely rare. By chance, I discovered that these meteorites contain a metal that can repair the Saint Cloth, which is why I asked my classmates to help collect the fragments."
"The meteorites do indeed contain an exceptionally hard metal. We sent the first fragment we found for analysis. This metal is unlike anything previously discovered on Sky Blue Star. It’s thirty times harder than titanium found on Sky Blue Star and also possesses incredible toughness. Objects made from it would be virtually indestructible. But this metal has an extraordinarily high melting point. Currently, our scientists haven’t yet figured out a method to extract this metal. It’s precisely because of this metal that the meteorites didn’t disintegrate upon entering the gravitational fields of Sky Blue Star and the moon, nor did they burn up significantly when passing through the atmosphere. How to refine this metal is something our scientists are still researching. You lot should save your energy."
"Director Longya, would it work if the temperature were high enough?" Wang Lan quickly asked.
"Theoretically, every substance can exist in solid, liquid, and gaseous states; metals are no different. High-temperature refining is one of the most common methods. But where would you find such extreme temperatures? Purple flames are already at the upper limit for flame temperatures. Your only other option would be something like a laser beam."
Wang Lan held a meteorite and activated his Extreme Heat Light Beam Star Martial Skill. His Extreme Heat Light Beam, at Platinum Four, could generate temperatures of twenty-five thousand degrees—more than double that of purple flames.
As Wang Lan’s Star Power surged, his palm instantly emitted a dazzling light. The light wasn’t blinding, but it was intensely bright, reminiscent of the captivating glow the asteroid had emitted as it fell.
"This... this is..." Director Longya’s face instantly filled with disbelief.
Considering Wang Lan had already demonstrated so many incredible abilities—using Star Martial Skills to shoot down missiles and asteroids, and breaking through cultivation realms with casual ease—Director Longya thought he should have been desensitized to any further bizarre displays.
But... he couldn’t remain numb to this!
As the tactical director of the Modu Star Martial Academy, Director Longya was known as an invincible warrior, second only to those with bestowed titles. While his strength might not be peerless, his breadth of knowledge certainly was.
The light emanating from Wang Lan’s palm... could it be the Extreme Heat Light Beam, a power that supposedly existed only in theory? In the Star Martial world, the Aurora developed by high-level Ice Attribute Star Martial Warriors is considered a pinnacle of combat. The difference in strength between an Ice Attribute warrior who can’t use Aurora and one who has mastered it is as vast as that between an ocular power at its three-tomoe stage and one that has achieved the full Kaleidoscope Vision. Once Aurora is unleashed, it can freeze thousands of miles in an instant; even powerhouses like the Five Emperors might not dare to face it directly. If the Extreme Freezing Light exists, then an Extreme Heat Light Beam should also be possible. After all, if the Nine Yin Scripture has appeared, a corresponding Jiuyang Divine Power wouldn’t be out of place, would it? Yet, for millennia, the Extreme Heat Light Beam has remained a mere legend. Countless Fire, Flame, and Sun Attribute warriors have poured their lifeblood into trying to manifest it, only to fail and die with regrets. They even charged their descendants to burn paper offerings at their graves if the Extreme Heat Light Beam ever came into being—a wish unfulfilled for ages. But now... this light in Wang Lan’s hand... what else could it be, if not the Extreme Heat Light Beam? What else could generate such intense heat that it warped space, distorted gravity, and made the very air shimmer as if it were a vacuum?

chapters.title: Chapter 366: Rebirth of the Saint Cloth
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Chapter 366: Rebirth of the Saint Cloth
No one paid any attention to Longya’s shock; not even Yu Ruoyun realized what the light in Wang Lan’s hand was. She simply saw the meteorite in Wang Lan’s hand melting bit by bit, with droplets of liquid falling.
"Is this... the dissolved metal?" Princess Aier asked in confusion. "Why is it red?"
"This isn’t metal, but the stone component of the ore, mixed with soluble metals. The truly hard metals actually remain intact under my Extreme Heat Light Beam. It’s hard to imagine a metal in the world with such a high melting point."
Wang Lan’s words directly confirmed Longya’s guess: the light in Wang Lan’s hand was indeed the Extreme Heat Light Beam.
Actually, apart from the Extreme Heat Light Beam, another method to decompose the meteorite was Universal Decomposition. Even if Gold-level Universal Decomposition couldn’t manage it, it could be upgraded to Platinum-level. However, the characteristic of Universal Decomposition was to break matter down into its molecular structure; even at the Platinum level, it decomposed into an atomic structure.
Wang Lan needed to extract the metal to repair the Saint Cloth, not to analyze its composition. Once decomposed, it could never be reassembled.
The higher the melting point of this metal, the more satisfied Wang Lan felt. It didn’t take a rocket scientist to figure out that this metal would be stronger than the metal of the previous Phoenix Saint Cloth. At least, the Phoenix Saint Cloth probably couldn’t have withstood his Extreme Heat Light Beam without undergoing some change.
If the Saint Cloth were repaired with this metal, its defensive power would undoubtedly rise to another level.
About a minute later, the meteorite in his hand had shrunk to about one-tenth of its original size, leaving behind a silver-white metal block that resembled a severely weathered tree root, riddled with chilling hollows.
Wang Lan placed the metal piece onto the Heart Mirror. Indeed, the metal melted quickly and was gradually absorbed by the Heart Mirror. After absorption, it seemed as though an additional small ring of armor plates had grown on the edge of the Heart Mirror. It was just a very small ring, but it proved that repairing the Saint Cloth was feasible.
However, even with the Extreme Heat Light Beam, the speed of refining this metal was still far from ideal. The meteorite fragments before him already weighed about three tons, and a continuous stream of newly found meteorites was being transported over. After all, the asteroid Wang Lan had shot down earlier had a diameter of over thirty meters.
Looking at the seventy thousand skill points on his system panel, Wang Lan hesitated slightly.
Fuck, repairing the Saint Cloth is urgent. It doesn’t matter; skill points are meant to be used, sooner or later. Fifty thousand skill points to upgrade the Extreme Heat Light Beam to thirty thousand degrees!
Wang Lan once again picked up a meteorite the size of a washbasin and held it in front of him. Star Power surged around his body, his hands overlapped, and instantly, a beam of light shone upon the meteorite.
The Extreme Heat Light Beam had been intensified by five thousand degrees, and the effect was immediately apparent. The stone began to melt at a noticeably faster rate; in just three seconds, the entire surface of the meteorite started to liquefy.
Golden-yellow magma sloughed off the meteorite, flowing away like streams and revealing a silver, bizarrely honeycomb-shaped piece of metal within. This metal was a beautiful silver-white but possessed a golden luster that silver lacked.
About ten minutes later, another metal block, weighing about two jin, was refined.
"Wang Lan, what Star Martial Skill is this?" Princess Aier finally reacted, realizing that the seemingly ordinary Star Martial Skill in Wang Lan’s hands was likely extraordinary. A meteorite that a purple flame couldn’t even scorch after half a day of burning was actually melting and being refined under Wang Lan’s light beam.
"Extreme Heat Light Beam!" Longya, who had been watching silently, stated calmly. "Princess Aier, since you’re an Ice Attribute Star Martial Warrior, you should know about Aurora, right?"
"Aurora? I know. It’s a crucial sublimation for Ice Attribute Star Martial Warriors. Anyone who can comprehend Aurora is certain to become a Titled Strongman and secure a prominent place among them."
"That’s right. But do you know the official name for Aurora? It’s Extreme Cold Beam. What Wang Lan is using is the Extreme Heat Light Beam, a powerful skill that is poles apart from Aurora. However, unlike Aurora, for which Star Martial Warriors are common, no Star Martial Warrior capable of using the Extreme Heat Light Beam has appeared in hundreds of years."
"What?" Aiwei exclaimed in astonishment at this revelation. "Why? If the Extreme Cold Beam exists and is so powerful, why hasn’t anyone researched its counterpart, the Extreme Heat Light Beam?"
"Do you really think no one has researched it? It’s not that no one has tried; it’s that they simply couldn’t achieve results. Over the centuries, countless great figures have poured their hearts and souls into studying the Extreme Heat Light Beam, but all ultimately failed. The difficulty of mastering the Extreme Heat Light Beam hasn’t just stumped one or two individuals, but entire generations of heroes."
"Who would have thought, Wang Lan, that you silently comprehended the Extreme Heat Light Beam? Wang Lan, wait a moment, I have something to say!"
Wang Lan continued to direct the Extreme Heat Light Beam at a pile of meteorites. "Director Long, I know what you’re going to ask. You want to know when I developed it, right?"
"Correct. If you had mastered the Extreme Heat Light Beam, how could Sang Guo have suppressed you so miserably, to the point where you needed to fuse with Yu Ruoyun to counter him?"
"I hadn’t developed the Extreme Heat Light Beam back then. After the battle ended, I reflected deeply on myself. I realized it wasn’t that I had too few techniques or that there was an issue with my strength, but that my damage output was simply too poor.
"My attacks did nothing to him, while his attacks could take me down. After some introspection, I focused on increasing my damage output.
"It just so happened that I learned a Flame Sword technique, with purple flames already at the peak of fire. But didn’t I also obtain an ultra S-class Star Martial Skill, the Infinite Fire Skill, from the Nine-layer Pagoda? By referencing the Infinite Fire Skill, I finally spent a few days and figured out the Extreme Heat Light Beam."
When Wang Lan said this, he tried to make his tone deep, aiming to make his audience understand that creating the Extreme Heat Light Beam hadn’t been easy.
You see, it took me many days, and I don’t know how much hair I pulled out to research it.
If it weren’t for Longya’s earlier explanation of its difficulty, this claim might have seemed plausible. But with Longya having just detailed how incredibly hard it was to develop, Wang Lan’s words were now sorely testing everyone’s patience. At this moment, the three young women around him felt their hands itch; an itch that burrowed deep into their hearts, a desperate urge to throttle Wang Lan.
Oh, so arduous! So terribly difficult! Couldn’t you try to make it sound even *more* challenging?
But I *did* work hard!
Wang Lan thought.
It took so many skill points to upgrade this skill. Earning skill points is incredibly hard, isn’t it? So arduous!
"Ruoyun, do you have any Soul Beads? I’m running low on Star Power."
"Soul Beads? Yes, I have plenty after closing two Different Dimensional Spaces," Princess Aier hurriedly said, pulling out a stack of Soul Beads from her foldable backpack.
With the Soul Beads, Wang Lan increased his Star Power output again. About half an hour later, the large pile of meteorites that had been transported back was melted down by Wang Lan, piece by piece, leaving behind about thirty kilograms of the mysterious silver-white metal.
He stacked the metal pieces together and then placed the Heart Mirror into the pile. Very quickly, as if a chemical reaction were occurring, the stack of metal rapidly dissolved and melted. Correspondingly, within the metal pile, a phoenix statue with spread wings began to form rapidly, like a plant growing quickly.
After all the metal had been consumed, a silver-white phoenix statue, just thirty centimeters tall, appeared before them.
"Huh?" Yu Ruoyun exclaimed in surprise. She flashed to Wang Lan’s side, inspecting the statue closely.
"This looks different from the phoenix statue formed by your previous Saint Cloth. Your old Phoenix Saint Cloth statue looked like a lone golden phoenix, wings spread as if about to take flight. But this one has a more graceful posture, like it’s dancing, and the details are more precise and splendid."
"Well, the Saint Cloth was repaired with such excellent metal, so a little upgrade is normal. We’re out of meteorites, Aier. Can you check if any more have been found? If so, have them sent over quickly."
Just then, a truck rumbled up and stopped in front of Wang Lan. The tarp covering its bed was lifted, revealing a gigantic meteorite inside, over two meters tall. Besides this massive meteorite—larger than all the ones Wang Lan had previously melted combined—there was also a pile of smaller ones.
"Hurry and unload it!" Wang Lan called out impatiently.
Once the load of meteorites was unloaded, Wang Lan eagerly applied the Extreme Heat Light Beam to them. After about an hour, over ten tons of meteorites had been dissolved, yielding one to two hundred jin of the special metal.
He placed the Phoenix Saint Cloth into the metal. The metal visibly melted, and the Saint Cloth visibly grew. As the Saint Cloth expanded, its design became more exquisite. Cracks began to appear on the originally connected pieces, which gradually transformed into individual, wearable armor plates.
The reborn Saint Cloth was indeed different from before. Not only was the way it assembled into a phoenix different, but the shape of each armor piece had also changed. Previously, part of the phoenix’s tail formed the helmet; now it had become part of the chest piece. The positions of the shoulder and knee guards had also shifted.
From the original animations, it’s known that Saint Cloths can evolve. The Saint Cloths of the Five Little Powerhouses were shattered more than once. After being repaired by Aries Mu, their shapes changed. However, even with these changes in form, a Bronze Saint Cloth remained a Bronze Saint Cloth; no true evolution occurred.
Their final evolution happened when they received the Goddess’s Blood, transforming them into Holy Cloths. The Phoenix Saint Cloth before them had clearly increased in size after its rebirth and was now covered with exquisite patterns, indicating an evolution of sorts.
However, Wang Lan couldn’t determine the current level of the Saint Cloth. Being silver-white, it should have been a Silver Saint Cloth by color, but Silver Saint Cloths didn’t emit that kind of golden light.
HUM—
Suddenly, the Saint Cloth emitted a humming sound, and a visible wave of energy rippled out from it like concentric circles in water.
The Saint Cloth’s rebirth was complete. About a few dozen jin of metal remained where it had been.
"It’s done!" Wang Lan said softly, taking a light step forward. His spiritual power reached out, resonating with the Saint Cloth.
CHEEW—
A loud, clear phoenix cry rang out. The Saint Cloth instantly exploded into the air and disassembled. Piece by piece, the armor plates flew towards Wang Lan and automatically fitted themselves onto his body.
In a flash of white light, the Saint Cloth was fully donned. The ninety percent coverage rate told Wang Lan that this Saint Cloth, reborn from the ashes, was no longer the low-grade item it once was. The silver-white Saint Cloth emitted a faint golden light.
Clad in the Saint Cloth, Wang Lan looked so heroically valiant that it was almost blinding. Princess Aier was already lost in a daze, completely captivated. Even Aiwei, watching from the side, wore a starstruck expression.
The amplification from the Saint Cloth didn’t feel any stronger, and its movement and weight were just as before, not hindering his actions in the slightest.
Perhaps because he hadn’t received the Goddess’s Blood, the Saint Cloth hadn’t truly upgraded in essence. However, due to the extraordinary materials used, its defensive power was definitely incomparable to its previous form. Wang Lan didn’t need the Saint Cloth to provide much of an offensive boost; as long as its defense was sufficient, that was good enough.

chapters.title: Chapter 367: You Want to Arrest Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Chapter 367: You Want to Arrest Me?
The dazzling armor, adorned with pale golden patterns, featured a silver-white cloak that fluttered slightly in the wind behind him. Beneath the platinum-gold glow, Wang Lan’s features were faintly visible. At this moment, people would believe it if someone claimed Wang Lan was a God of Heaven who had descended.
The problem is, where the hell did the cloak come from?
Given that repairing the Phoenix Saint Cloth required metallic materials, Wang Lan hadn’t added even a shred of fabric.
He curiously reached out and touched the fabric of the cloak. It was silky, soft, and light, yet Wang Lan was certain it wasn’t ordinary cloth or silk, but rather something possessing the fluidity of liquid metal.
Since he couldn’t figure it out, there was no point dwelling on it.
He’d shown off enough.
With a mere thought, the Saint Cloth on Wang Lan instantly disassembled, reassembling once more into a phoenix sculpture.
Wang Lan opened the gates of the Star Palace, and the phoenix let out a piercing cry, flapping its wings as it rushed inside.
"My Saint Cloth’s repairs are complete. Alright, that’s all for now..."
"Wang Lan, what do you think about using this metal to make weapons?" Yu Ruoyun suddenly asked.
"They would absolutely be the finest divine weapons in the world. I’ve never encountered a metal with such hardness and heat resistance. It remained unchanged even at thirty thousand degrees Celsius, and I couldn’t even get it close to its melting point."
"Princess Aier, could you help me continue collecting this type of meteorite?" Yu Ruoyun’s request wasn’t excessive. Wang Lan was the one who had brought down the asteroid, and considering her status as a princess of the Jade Country assisting the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, it was perfectly reasonable for her to take a few meteorites.
「For the next few days, Wang Lan lived an idle life like a panda cub—eating, sleeping, and then eating again.」
The royal court of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow offered a daily salary of one hundred thousand, and sure enough, countless Star Martial Warriors from all over the world continued to flock to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"Take a gamble, and your bicycle might become a motorcycle"—this saying wasn’t just empty words. Coupled with the innate adventurous spirit of Star Martial Warriors, even though the battlefields in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were so perilous, tens of thousands still dared to take the risk.
Three peaceful days passed quietly.
The Black Tiger Army volunteer corps and the reassembled army of four thousand Star Martial Warriors once again set out for Different Dimensional Space Number One. The threat level of Different Dimensional Space Number One was no less than that of Number Two. Together, Number One and Number Two formed a north-south pincer, directly threatening the densely populated areas of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Twelve years ago, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had hoped to close Different Dimensional Space Number One. A spatial-temporal node had already been sighted back then. However, Different Dimensional Space Number Two suddenly opened up behind them, and the Exotic Beasts that poured out of it began to brutally slaughter the citizens of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Forced to retreat, the army had no choice but to withdraw. This eventually led to the current situation where five Different Dimensional Spaces ravaged the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Even though the intensity of the Exotic Beasts in Different Dimensional Space Number One was no less than in Number Two, everyone was absolutely confident about this expedition. After all, they had wasted a whole week searching for the spatial node in Different Dimensional Space Number Two, whereas the approximate location of Number One’s spatial node was already known.
Wang Lan had intended to join the expedition, but Longya decisively vetoed the idea with a wave of his hand. Not just Wang Lan, even Yu Ruoyun obediently stayed put in the camp, lying low. Longya was thoroughly wary of these two. In Longya’s eyes, Different Dimensional Space Number One could be annihilated with a snap of his fingers; there was no need to bring along two Divine Beasts.
The night sky was brilliant and dazzling with stars.
Wang Lan sat on the eaves of a camp building, silently gazing up at the sky. At this moment, he felt homesick.
At this moment, if only I had some alcohol,
he thought.
The thought had barely formed when a bottle of alcohol was offered to him.
"Er..." Wang Lan stared in astonishment at Yu Ruoyun, who had once again unpredictably appeared by his side. "What are you doing here?"
"I thought you might need this, so I brought it for you." Yu Ruoyun casually sat down beside Wang Lan, flicked the beer cap off with a finger, tilted her head back, and took a swig of beer while gazing at the sky.
"Homesick? Is this your first time being abroad for so long?"
"Who says? And why are you drinking beer?" Wang Lan picked up the bottle and, imitating Yu Ruoyun, tried to flick the cap off with his finger. However, the cap didn’t budge; instead, the entire neck of the bottle shattered and flew off.
"Guess I didn’t control my strength properly..." Wang Lan muttered.
"Tch! That requires technique!" Yu Ruoyun said, quite pleased with herself as she gave a little wiggle. "And why can’t I drink beer?"
"It’s not that. It’s just that in my mind, you’re the type to sip red wine with luxurious Western cuisine, or at least enjoy Moutai at an imperial banquet. Isn’t beer what we broke commoners drink?"
"If I recall correctly, you’re a super-rich tycoon, aren’t you? With a net worth of ten billion. If a mega-tycoon like you with a ten-billion fortune calls himself a ’broke commoner,’ why can’t I be a bit more down-to-earth?
You might not believe this, but I’ve tried all sorts of alcoholic drinks, and beer is my favorite."
"Why?"
"Because only when I’m drinking beer do I not have to worry about my composure or mind my etiquette. I don’t have to overthink what I should or shouldn’t say, what others mean by their words, or how my own words will be interpreted.
When drinking beer, everyone can sing, chat, and tell jokes... That’s why every summer vacation, I love going to my maternal grandfather’s place. The people there don’t know who I am, nor do they care."
"Anyway, how did we end up talking about me? Let’s talk about you. Judging by the look in your eyes just now, you were missing home, weren’t you?"
"Not really. I was just worried about Xinyu." Wang Lan smiled faintly. "We’re both assisting abroad. It’s so dangerous where we are; I wonder how things are for her."
"Then you don’t have to worry. I’ve asked a few classmates to secretly keep an eye on Xinyu. She just broke through to the Galaxy Stage and is already one of the main combatants in her aid mission.
With all the Soul Bead grenades and medical Soul Beads you prepared for her, she hasn’t even had a single hair on her head harmed."
"Really? That’s great! Mr. Wu and the others left a day ago; I wonder how they’re doing."
"Hey, do you really dislike talking to me that much? Why do you keep trying to change the subject?"
"Not at all!"
"Then let’s talk about something I’m interested in... For example, what do you usually like to do? What are your hobbies?"
"I love studying!"
"And that’s it?"
"That’s it! The best gift I ever received was in my second year of middle school when my aunt gave me a complete set of confidential national college entrance exam practice papers..."
Like hell I believe you!
Suddenly, a bright light flashed, and several cars abruptly appeared outside the camp, braking sharply with an imposing air. A dozen men in black suits emerged from the vehicles. Judging by their movements, they likely had military backgrounds.
"Who goes there?" a Black Tiger Army warrior on duty quickly stepped forward and shouted vigilantly.
"Respected sirs of the Volunteer Army, we are from the National Security Intelligence Agency of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. We wish to see Mr. Wang Lan."
"You’re looking for me? What is it?" The moment Wang Lan’s voice was heard, several colorful butterflies began to flutter about, and then, suddenly, Wang Lan’s figure appeared out of thin air.
"Hello, Mr. Wang Lan. I am a senior special agent from the National Security Intelligence Agency of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. We’ve recently been ordered to trace the whereabouts of a nuclear weapon stolen by a terrorist organization. We require your assistance in our investigation. Would you be willing to accompany us?"
"If you have any questions, you can ask them here!" Wang Lan’s brow furrowed slightly. Although the man’s tone was exceedingly polite, Wang Lan keenly sensed a menacing undercurrent beneath the humility.
"It’s not very convenient here. The matters I need to discuss are highly confidential. We still kindly request Mr. Wang Lan’s cooperation with our investigation."
"And if I choose not to cooperate?"
"Mr. Wang Lan, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is not a lawless land, and naturally, no one is above its laws. We urge you to respect our country’s laws and cooperate with our investigation."
"So... you intend to arrest me?" A cold smirk played on Wang Lan’s lips, and fury instantly welled up within him.
I traveled thousands of miles to help you, and you repay my kindness with malice? How utterly unreasonable!
"Do you have any evidence?" His gaze, sharp as a sword, seemed to pierce the other man’s eyes. "If this is an arrest, then you need an arrest warrant. Do you have one?"
"Special circumstances require us to act with expediency. Please, Mr. Wang Lan, refrain from doing anything that could damage the friendship between our two countries. We wouldn’t be inviting you to cooperate with this investigation if we didn’t possess solid evidence."
"Oh? Solid evidence?" Yu Ruoyun’s icy voice rang out as she stepped before them. "Is your ’solid evidence’ the fact that we traveled thousands of miles to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, nearly got shot down by missiles, and then risked life and limb to infiltrate Different Dimensional Space Number Five and close it for you?
Or is the ’solid evidence’ that Wang Lan single-handedly neutralized the Star Martial Toxins in all of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s Different Dimensional Spaces, making it possible to destroy these very spaces that plague your nation? Given such actions and contributions, what could your so-called ’solid evidence’ possibly be? It’s not Wang Lan who is undermining the friendship between our countries—it’s you!
I’ve heard of people dismantling the bridge after crossing the river, but you’ve barely made it halfway across, and you’re already eager to tear it down? Such behavior is truly unsightly, isn’t it?"
"Princess Yu has a point, but the matter still needs to be investigated. If it genuinely has nothing to do with Mr. Wang Lan, we will offer our formal apologies."
"Apologies won’t be necessary. I’d just like to see who here today dares to take Wang Lan away!"
As her words landed, the faces of the dozen or so men instantly showed anger. Yet, beneath that anger lay boundless trepidation. Who was Wang Lan now? He was the national hero of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. If they clashed with Wang Lan, forget about whether the King, princesses, or princes would spare them—the entire populace of the country wouldn’t let them off the hook.
However, suddenly, another rumbling sound echoed from the distance, and a convoy of buses and trucks began to approach.
So soon?
Wang Lan exclaimed inwardly in surprise.
The vehicles stopped and their doors opened. Smiling figures disembarked one after another, accompanied by bursts of cheerful voices and laughter.
The closure of Different Dimensional Space Number One had gone smoother than anyone could have imagined. After determining the general direction of the spatial node, a strike team composed of seven Star Sea Stage experts, under the cover of the main army, had successfully penetrated the Exotic Beast-infested region where the node was located. Then, shielded by the army’s Star Martial Skills, they had successfully shattered the spatial node.
From entry to the shattering of the spatial node, the entire operation took less than five hours. If every spatial node could be closed this easily, they could be heading home in just a few more days.
However, when Princess Aier, her face wreathed in smiles, stepped off her vehicle, her brow furrowed the moment she saw Wang Lan and the group gathered around him.
In a flash, she appeared before Wang Lan. "What happened? Are you from the National Security Intelligence Agency? What are you doing here?"
"Princess Aier, they’re here to arrest Wang Lan," Yu Ruoyun stated. "I believe you owe us a reasonable explanation; otherwise, this aid mission may not be able to continue."
Yu Ruoyun had previously developed a very close relationship with Princess Aier, but her tone now was extremely distant, causing Princess Aier’s expression to darken instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 Covert Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Chapter 368 Covert Action
SLAP—
A crisp slap landed on the face of a senior agent from the intelligence bureau.
"What are you trying to do? Are you trying to drive the Kingdom of Ice and Snow into a desperate situation? Who gave you the authority to arrest Wang Lan? Was it my father the king, or my uncle?"
"It was... it was... General Stephen from our bureau!"
"Stephen?" Princess Aier’s expression darkened again. "What authority does he have, and what evidence?"
At this moment, a car slowly drove up. Everyone halted their actions and turned to look at the car.
The car stopped, and an elderly general adorned in a stunning military uniform, his chest covered with medals, stepped out.
"Princess Aier, please don’t be angry. It was I who ordered them to bring Mr. Wang Lan back for questioning."
"General Stephen, you are one of our Elders, and you have a great reputation in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. I know you would not betray the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. But I cannot understand your actions. You know who Wang Lan is and how important he is. How could you want to arrest him? Do you understand the consequences of arresting Wang Lan?"
"But I believe Jade Country is reasonable. We have justifiable and lawful reasons."
"What reasons?"
"We have found the terrorists who stole the nuclear bombs," Stephen said, his authority matching Princess Aier’s as he met her sharp gaze.
"And the evidence?"
Stephen produced a photograph, holding it up to Princess Aier. "This is the temporary base of the terrorists that I traced after receiving reliable intelligence. Regrettably, I was too late when I arrived. Apart from one who was killed on the spot, the others escaped using their formidable power.
"This person, also from Jade Country, belongs to the Duanmu Family. He was responsible for dealing in Space Stones with the terrorist organization hidden in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. We’ve traced the trade records of the past three years through this person. During that period, a significant quantity of Space Stones was transported to various places across the galaxy through him.
"Furthermore, at their temporary hideout, we discovered detailed plans for the nuclear bomb heist and some unfinished electronic devices. Upon examination by our experts, we found these devices to be bomb detonators.
"Although not complete, most of it was finished. This meant the terrorists still intended to make bombs for terrorist activities."
"Very well!" Princess Aier said with a cold sneer. "To think that in less than a week, you’ve found such a breakthrough clue. But what does this have to do with Wang Lan?"
Suddenly, Stephen took out another photo from his pocket. "This was captured by a CCTV camera across from the Midnight Bar. On the night of the incident, Wang Lan secretly met with this terrorist in the bar.
They talked for a full ten minutes. Ten minutes later, the terrorist left, and half an hour after that, Mr. Wang Lan also left. Subsequently, the nuclear bombs were stolen, and Mr. Wang Lan was, coincidentally, the first to arrive at the scene.
Princess Aier, in light of this evidence, why wouldn’t I ask for Mr. Wang Lan’s cooperation in our investigation? I requested Wang Lan’s presence privately because I did not want this matter to affect the relationship between our two countries.
But with two missing nuclear bombs, and hundreds of thousands, even millions of lives at stake, no matter how important Wang Lan is, I must still ask. Mr. Wang Lan, I hope you can honestly tell me their whereabouts?"
In that moment, Wang Lan felt utterly screwed over.
Such a cunning setup, such a logical chain of evidence. If I were in their shoes, I would be convinced by this evidence on the spot. Faced with these proofs, I’m even starting to doubt whether I’m in league with the terrorists.
"Mr. Wang Lan, do you have any explanation?" Stephen stepped forward, pressing aggressively.
"General Stephen, you should look for clues elsewhere. Wang Lan couldn’t possibly be allied with terrorists, and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow will not allow you to doubt his identity. You can report this matter to my father and my uncle. I believe they will make the same decision as I have."
"Your Highness, I only need an explanation from Mr. Wang Lan now. Of course, if he can provide the whereabouts of the terrorists and help us recover the stolen nuclear bombs, he will still be our hero."
"I said, that’s enough! Stop it!" Princess Aier shouted angrily, her Star Power surging out like flames, flaring up like a mother hen protecting her chicks.
"That won’t be necessary." Wang Lan said with a faint smile. "General Stephen, is it? I can provide an explanation. My identity is actually no secret. Besides being a student at the Star Martial Academy of Modu City, I’m also a senior special agent with the Tianjian Bureau of Jade Country’s intelligence system.
"Before I came to assist the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, the Tianjian Bureau also assigned me another mission: to investigate the source of the Space Stones that had flooded world markets in recent years. We had reliable intelligence indicating the source was in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"As for the terrorist in your photo... he’s actually not a terrorist. He’s also a special agent of the Tianjian Bureau, who underwent cosmetic surgery to pose as a member of the Duanmu Family and infiltrate the enemy ranks to gather intelligence."
This explanation was far from satisfactory for Stephen. Could Wang Lan really argue both sides so easily? Just because he claimed the dead man was an undercover agent for the Tianjian Bureau, did that make it true? With the man dead, Wang Lan’s assertion left them with no evidence to refute it.
Stephen had weathered countless storms in his life, but never before had he been so thoroughly outmaneuvered by mere words when he held what seemed like conclusive evidence.
"Mr. Wang Lan, are you serious? To my knowledge, that person is from the Duanmu Family, one of Jade Country’s top Star Martial families. And the quantity of Space Stones he was involved in trafficking is astronomical. If you’re claiming he’s from the Tianjian Bureau, isn’t that tantamount to admitting that Jade Country has been orchestrating the worldwide smuggling of Space Stones all these years?"
"General Stephen, please don’t jump to conclusions. The Duanmu Family was responsible for the Space Stone smuggling these past years, a matter Jade Country thoroughly investigated over a month ago. The Duanmu Family has since been stripped of their Star Martial family status, and all its leaders have been imprisoned and punished. This particular agent, posing as a member of the Duanmu Family, was put in place before I came to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. His purpose was to infiltrate the smuggling ring."
Wang Lan’s words made Stephen’s expression turn exceptionally grave. While he couldn’t yet confirm the truth of Wang Lan’s statements, it was unlikely to be false, considering the Duanmu Family’s international influence.
Beyond his shock at the Duanmu Family’s demise, Stephen also felt a deep apprehension regarding Jade Country’s decisive and ruthless methods. The Duanmu Family had been an international calling card for Jade Country; their effortless removal, without any international outcry, was chillingly efficient.
"I will verify this. For today’s offense, I, on behalf of myself and my subordinates, apologize to you. I hope this misunderstanding has not affected the friendship between our two nations."
With these words, Stephen bowed slightly to Princess Aier. "Your Highness, you are the God of War of our Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Although your strength has reached its peak, your temperament still needs to be honed. I hope you will not allow personal emotions to override the authority of the nation. Your Highness, I will take my leave now."
Stephen’s departure seemed to signal the end of the misunderstanding. However, in his heart, Wang Lan muttered to himself,
This is just the beginning.
「The crowd dispersed, and the night grew quiet.」
Once again, Wang Lan found himself on the rooftop, this time with a drink in his hand. He gazed up at the Galaxy to the east—his homeland, and Agent 31’s as well.
There was no way Agent 31 was simply killed by mistake, and he could not possibly have been involved in a terrorist attack to steal nuclear weapons. All this evidence must have been fabricated to frame him.
The world appears so beautiful, and Jade Country seems so peaceful, but who knows how many people like Agent 31 are silently fighting in the shadows to protect Jade Country’s peace.
They live under false identities, performing life-threatening operations in the darkest corners of the world. No matter how great their achievements or contributions, their names will never be remembered.
Even in death, they cannot reclaim their own names or have their remains buried in their homeland. Serene times... what dark humor!
Gently, Wang Lan poured out the drink in his hand. "Unnamed hero, this cup is for you. May you rest in peace."
A slight sound came from behind him, and a fragrant scent, carried by the evening breeze, wafted past Wang Lan’s nose. It was Princess Aier’s scent, quite intoxicating.
"Wang Lan, I’m sorry... Please, don’t be angry."
"I’m not angry. Considering the evidence they had, their restraint in not immediately mobilizing a large force for the arrest was considerable. They were just doing their duty."
"About that Duanmu..."
"His name wasn’t Duanmu Geshu; he was Agent 31! He didn’t have a name, only a designation. I only met him once, but he left a deep impression on me. He was a free-spirited man, even in the face of life and death. He never addressed me by name; he just said ’people like us’."
"I’m sorry... It’s all the terrorists’ fault."
"Princess Aier, can I trust you?" Wang Lan suddenly asked.
"Why do you ask? We’ve fought side by side, faced life and death together. We are close friends, partners who can entrust our lives to each other. Don’t you trust me by now?"
"You must have guessed that someone in the upper echelons of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is secretly colluding with Paradise Bird. And this person still hasn’t been caught, right?"
"I... am I also a suspect?"
"No, actually, deep down, I do trust you. Come with me to a place."
"Where?"
"A place where we might learn the truth, or at least continue to pursue it. Agent 31’s death was definitely meticulously orchestrated."
"Okay!"
No sooner had Princess Aier spoken than a figure appeared as silently and eerily as a Ghost. "Take me with you."
"Ruoyun, I’ve always been curious. How do you manage to appear by my side so silently every time? Theoretically, our strengths should be similar, right? With you around like this, I don’t even dare to close my eyes to sleep."
"Afraid I’ll eat you?" Yu Ruoyun retorted, sounding exasperated.
"Uh... I’m just afraid you’ll scare me in the middle of the night. Let’s go!"
Like phantoms, the three of them vanished into the night. Leaving the camp, Wang Lan weaved through the main streets and narrow alleys of Ice City.
"Wang Lan, where exactly are we going?" After several twists and turns, Princess Aier finally couldn’t hold back her question.
"To a safe house."
"Where is this safe house? Tell me the location... I know Ice City well."
"Don’t worry, I’ve memorized the route. Are you worried I’ll get lost?"
"It’s not that I’m worried, but... which direction are we heading now?"
"East."
"We’re heading south now."
"..."

chapters.title: Chapter 369: Why is it You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Chapter 369: Why is it You?
Wang Lan, who possessed the Earth Attribute Weight Exchange technique, also developed a minor ability to sense geomagnetic fields. Thus, to Wang Lan, he was like a human compass.
The direction of the magnetic poles is unfailing, so Wang Lan’s sense of direction is also unfailing. However, because the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is situated in the Arctic Ocean, the sunrise and sunset here deviate from the norm, resulting in the sun rising from the southeast and setting in the northwest.
Nevertheless, the people living in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow still adhered to the globally unified natural laws, where the sun is supposed to rise from the east and set in the west. It proved that when everyone is wrong, being the only one right means you’re wrong.
After Princess Aier updated his bearings, Wang Lan indeed found the correct direction. Yu Ruoyun quietly told Wang Lan that they had just passed the same intersection three times already.
Upon finding the safe house No. 31 had informed Wang Lan about, he unlocked it with a key. It was a gloomy warehouse. Following the messages left by No. 31, Wang Lan removed a floor tile in the center of the warehouse to find an iron box underneath.
The box could only be opened after entering the correct password.
After opening the box, it was found to contain some Soul Beads, some discs, and some recording devices. Seeing these, Wang Lan let out a sigh of relief.
As expected of a veteran agent, the preparations were indeed thorough.
The trio left with the materials. Soon after their departure, a group quietly approached the vicinity of the safe house. As they infiltrated the warehouse and had barely started searching, a loud explosion suddenly rang out.
The violent explosion erupted, deafeningly loud in the still and dark night of Ice City, akin to thunderclaps at midnight. The entire area around the safe house, within a radius of dozens of meters, was devastated by the fierce explosion.
At this moment, Wang Lan had already returned to the royal courts. The camp barracks didn’t have the necessary equipment, but Princess Aier’s chamber did. Once, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was immensely prosperous, and as its cherished princess, she naturally had everything one could need.
To play the Soul Beads, Wang Lan alone was sufficient. The contents of the discs were also engraved from the Soul Beads, including the dialogues recorded by the devices. Memories typically only contain images, which can also include text but not sound. Now, text, sound, and images were all fully available.
In the footage, there was a mysterious white man, rather weaselly-looking. The two met in a secluded spot, discussing a deal to sell twelve tons of Space Stones at once.
Upon hearing this figure, No. 31 was also startled.
Selling a few hundred kilograms is already frightening, but smuggling over a ton of Space Stones counts as large-scale smuggling. Twelve tons at once! Truly befitting the world’s largest Space Stone production base.
The other party’s intentions were also clear: this sale would be their last transaction. The Jade Country Volunteer Corps was advancing irresistibly, and the Different Dimensional Spaces where they could obtain a large amount of Space Stones had been sealed. After completing this business, they would vanish like a lone boat on a chilly river, treading a solitary path.
Although the person’s tone tried to remain steady, Wang Lan still detected an underlying urgency. It gave him the impression that the person was in dire need of money. They hoped to complete the transaction of the twelve tons of Space Stones as soon as possible, for a value of two billion Jade Coins. The other party would cover all transportation and delivery within the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Once the money was in place, No. 31 would board a ship and leave the Arctic Ocean, severing all ties with the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. From then on, they would delete each other’s contact details and never meet again. No. 31 recorded this entire process. From this, it could be inferred that this shadowy figure held enormous power and could act with impunity in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"Have you found anything?" Wang Lan asked after sorting through the materials.
"That man from the footage seems familiar," Princess Aier said gravely. "I’ve seen him before at the National Defense Bureau. I’ll check it out now."
Princess Aier held the Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s highest access rights, and she quickly found results. "This man is named Bailey, a senior agent of the National Defense Bureau with peak Star Cloud Stage strength. However, he reportedly died three years ago in a defense battle against an Exotic Beast incursion."
"Clearly, he’s not dead," Yu Ruoyun stated flatly.
"Since he was declared dead three years ago, finding him won’t be easy. It’s possible that by now, he’s been silenced."
Wang Lan paused for a moment, then rapidly flipped through the information left inside the iron box. As was customary, since No. 31 had locked onto a lead, he would undoubtedly continue to investigate the lead’s identity. There was no reason for him not to have discovered this person’s whereabouts.
Sure enough, after flipping through a few papers, they saw an address written in Chinese characters on one piece of paper, with a date beneath it.
Wang Lan then replayed the video and indeed saw the same date in the footage, matching the handwritten note.
The date wasn’t meant to record a specific time but to match the person corresponding to the address. This was a cryptic method recorded in the Tianjian Bureau agents’ manual; it was common knowledge among Tianjian Bureau agents.
"He’s at this place. Let’s go!"
Princess Aier hurriedly put away the iron box, and Yu Ruoyun took it, placing it into her Folding Space bracelet. Their movements were smooth and practiced, as though finely honed over countless repetitions.
After stowing everything away, Wang Lan and his companions quietly left the palace once more, heading for the target address. This time, they did not get lost. However, while hurrying to their destination, they saw police cars with sirens blaring, and police imposing a citywide curfew.
Wang Lan had no time to guess what the police were doing, leading his group through the void. In less than half an hour, they arrived at a remote suburb near snow-capped mountains, an area only frequented by hunters.
The ground was frozen permafrost, impossible to cultivate for crops, and the frigid climate was unbearable for more than seven days without adequate food. The opening of Different Dimensional Spaces had brought not only catastrophic impacts on humans but also disastrous consequences for the animals of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
Still, some small animals managed to survive by chance. Hunters skilled in their craft sometimes appeared here, and with a bit of luck, they could even catch some frozen animals to make a bowl of soup.
It was a rarely trodden, vast and desolate expanse.
Wang Lan and his two companions carefully descended from the sky, arriving outside a wooden hut hidden in the forest. The hut was quiet, and the snow accumulated at the door had turned into solid ice.
Wang Lan silently approached the door, effortlessly passing through the closed wooden door and into the house.
The interior was in disarray, reeking of a foul stench. From these signs, it seemed no one had lived here for quite some time. Wang Lan’s eyes, sharp as lightning, swept over everything in the vicinity, then he suddenly cracked a slight smile.
This person actually has some skill, disguising the hut to appear long uninhabited, while their actual living quarters are in a passage beneath the bed. If I couldn’t sense their Star Power, I might have actually been fooled by this trick.
Wang Lan noiselessly descended through the secret passage beneath the bed. About three meters down, he entered what appeared to be a cellar with simple furnishings: a bed, a blanket, a large water tank, and a large rice container.
The moment Wang Lan arrived, the person inside suddenly woke with a start. Seeing a vague figure in the darkness, they abruptly grabbed a grenade from beside the pillow, about to detonate it.
Suddenly, as if time had stopped, everything froze. Wang Lan slowly moved toward the person, taking the grenade from their hand. He carefully examined the person’s face.
Yes, this is the one I’m looking for.
He promptly sealed the person’s Star palace and, in a flash, disappeared with them from the cellar.
"How did it go?"
"Found him," Wang Lan replied with a smile, giving the person he held a little shake. "Let’s go back. Prepare a Soul Bead for me; I need to perform a Spirit Engraving."
"Oh, and the safe house we visited earlier exploded violently, killing a few agents from the National Security Intelligence Bureau. Now the whole city’s police force is out, searching for the perpetrator."
"That was a trap set by Number 31. If the lock isn’t opened with a key, it triggers an internal self-destruct mechanism. It seems the mastermind is within the National Security Intelligence Bureau; otherwise, how could they have found the safe house so quickly?"
The three of them flew back to Princess Aier’s chamber. Wang Lan immediately began the Spirit Engraving on the captured person. When the results of the Spirit Engraving emerged, Princess Aier’s eyes immediately reddened.
"How is this possible... Why would it be him?"
"I’ve heard General Stephen is a very tough general with high prestige in the military. Besides, he’s the true controller of the national forces; the Minister of Defense can’t even compare," Yu Ruoyun commented calmly.
"Indeed. General Stephen has lived a life of integrity, growing up alongside my grandfather. He is fiercely loyal to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. During the kingdom’s most difficult times, all the powerful and influential chose to flee. He alone did not. He even sent his daughter and son-in-law, who attempted to escape, to prison.
"I never imagined that he would be the one colluding with terrorist organizations behind the scenes."
"The world is unpredictable, and no one can foresee such turns of events. What comes next is your own affair," Yu Ruoyun gently patted Princess Aier’s shoulder. "How you deal with him is up to you, but we have a bottom line—he cannot be given another chance to stab us in the back."
"I understand. I’ll escort you back," she offered.
"No need, we can go by ourselves. You better deal with this matter swiftly," Wang Lan declined as he and Yu Ruoyun stealthily left Princess Aier’s chamber.
「By now it was the dead of night, yet the royal court of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow suddenly lit up.」
All court personnel, whether on duty or off, rose and gathered at their respective stations in a flurry of activity.
After a long while, the doors of the hall opened, and General Stephen, in full military attire, walked in with a firm pace.
"This old servant, Stephen, pays his respects to Your Majesty and to the Prince."
"General Stephen!" King Cain finally lifted his head and spoke faintly to Stephen. Prince Kester remained with his back to them, gazing at the twinkling stars and sighing deeply.
He dared not look back at Stephen, fearing that a single glance would soften his resolve.
"Aier just showed me something concerning you. I want you to take a look at it, too, and tell me it’s not true. Can you do that?" King Cain’s voice carried a tinge of pleading. Stephen had watched him and his brother grow up. To them, Stephen was an uncle, an elder, a great man who had labored for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow his entire life.
They found the thought unbearable and were unwilling to believe that Stephen could betray the nation.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 All for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 370 All for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow
"Your Majesty, I have already guessed what Princess Aier has sent concerning me. Ever since the volunteer group from Jade Country was attacked by the Paradise Bird, haven’t we been speculating that someone in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was in collusion with the Paradise Bird?"
"Yes, the person collaborating with the Paradise Bird is me!"
Stephen concealed nothing, nor did he resort to any tricks. He simply admitted it openly, catching Cain off guard.
At that moment, Cain would have preferred to see Stephen make excuses, cover up, or even explain.
Even something slightly reasonable would have allowed him to leave Stephen with some dignity. Stephen was already eighty years old. What could a man of that age do with grand ambitions? Strip him of his power and let him live out his remaining years in peace?
But Stephen’s direct confession made it impossible for Cain to let him off the hook.
Gazing at the sky, Prince Kester’s brows furrowed slightly, while his hand, clutching the windowsill, grew white from the force of his grip.
"Tell me, why?"
