"My initial intention was for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. About three years ago, a man named Sang Guo found me. His identity was special. He made me swear to keep his identity a secret. If a second person learned about his meeting with me, he would disappear instantly.
"Three years ago, my son Kappa died in battle. He was my youngest son, ten years younger than Kester. Kappa’s death caused me great sorrow, but compared to the fall of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, Kappa’s death was insignificant.
"I, Stephen, have lived for eighty years, watching the place we labored over our entire lives, the once thriving and happy Kingdom of Ice and Snow, wither away day by day. I couldn’t accept it. I couldn’t bear it.
"I went on diplomatic missions to various countries, and over ten years, I secured aid more than twenty times. Each time, I was filled with hope, only to be let down again and again, leading to despair.
"In the last five years, no country was willing to aid us anymore. Some countries even demanded real silver in exchange for the food they provided us.
"At that time, I wouldn’t just cooperate with a terrorist organization. I would even have considered the devils from hell as gods if they could save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
"Did the Paradise Bird save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow? Uncle Stephen, you’ve been wise your whole life, how could you be so foolish now? Can you really trust the words of terrorists?"
"Cain, do you still remember the story of the Demon Law? Compared to making wishes to the God of Heaven, making deals with demons seems more tangible. At least, the God of Heaven might fulfill your wishes, or he might choose to ignore them.
"Since you do not have to give anything, the God of Heaven does not guarantee you will receive anything. But demons are different. You must offer a sufficient chip to get something in return. As long as you have the right chip, demons are more reliable than gods.
"You ask me how I can trust the promises of the Paradise Bird, but my king, without the Paradise Bird’s promises, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow would have perished three years ago. Do you understand?
"You don’t understand. You are the king; you are responsible for giving your people hope. You pray to the God of Heaven, hoping he will save your people as if the God of Heaven had heard your prayers.
"These three years have been very difficult, but at least we have survived. But my king, haven’t you wondered why, according to past patterns, at least two to three beast tides should have occurred each year, but none happened in these three years?
"In these three years, Exotic Beasts occasionally appeared but never once invaded our Kozmi Area. Have the Exotic Beasts learned mercy, or have our valiant warriors protected our people?
"Neither. It was the Paradise Bird that secretly eliminated the potential threats.
"Why did I agree to collaborate with the Paradise Bird? Because at that time, the Paradise Bird was the only force in the world that possessed the means to counteract the Star Martial Toxins from the five Different Dimensional Spaces. If it had been you, would you have agreed?"
"I..." Cain was at a loss for words, his face revealing a deep heartache. "Why didn’t you tell me the truth back then?"
"Tell you? How could I tell you? You are the king, the king of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. If I had told you, would you have cooperated with the Paradise Bird? And then, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow would have become a vassal of the Paradise Bird? What is the nature of the Paradise Bird? If I had told you back then, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow would have truly been doomed. At that point, it wouldn’t be the Exotic Beasts destroying us, but missiles.
"My king, for the future of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, you must be pure, you must be flawless, and you must be oblivious, misled by your scheming old minister. The day the cooperation between the Kingdom of Ice and Snow and the Paradise Bird was revealed, it would be I, the minister who was blinded by greed, who had betrayed the nation. Execute me alone and save the people. This old minister would die content."
"Uncle Stephen... you!" Cain was shocked. He could never have imagined that Stephen’s reason for cooperating with the Paradise Bird was this. Yet in an instant, Cain forced himself to calm down again.
"Then why did you smuggle Space Stones?"
"Money, of course! For money! The Kingdom of Ice and Snow was utterly destitute, and other nations were kicking us when we were down. Just relying on the food aid from Jade Country, could you save your people?
"To prevent our people from starving to death, I had to smuggle Space Stones to earn money to buy food and supplies. The money earned was split fifty-fifty with the Paradise Bird. Detailed accounts are all recorded. You can find them under the bed in my bedroom."
"Why didn’t you stop after Jade Country developed the Toxin Vaccine?"
"After so many years of cooperation, it wasn’t a business I could simply stop on my own."
"And what about Organization T?"
"They were not really T, but the Paradise Bird. The members of the Paradise Bird’s peripheral organization are wanted criminals from various countries, disguised as T, secretly engaging in underground Space Stone smuggling operations."
"So, you knew that Jade Country was here to save us, and that their aid was aimed at sealing off the five Different Dimensional Spaces once and for all. Why did you still cooperate with the Paradise Bird to attack the Jade Country aid team?"
When Cain asked this, his voice had turned as cold as ice. If what had been done before could be said to have any justifiable reason, then those twelve missiles that targeted the volunteer group were an unforgivable sin.
With all this done, every reason he had given before was a disguise, a shameful deception.
"I did not cooperate!" Stephen took a deep breath and closed his eyes. "The Paradise Bird approached me to provide the flight path and take-off time of the Jade Country volunteer team, but the route I gave was false, and the time was off by two hours."
"Yet those twelve missiles were precisely ambushed on their inevitable path."
"I didn’t know. They might have gotten accurate intelligence through other channels. As for the Space Stone trap that the Paradise Bird used in the second space, I didn’t know about that either. In fact... after the volunteer team from Jade Country arrived, I had almost completely cut off contact with the Paradise Bird."
"So you’re saying that the nuclear robbery wasn’t based on your intelligence?"
"No! Because of my cooperation with the Paradise Bird, they managed to establish themselves in our country. They developed their own intelligence system, and even people in our government departments have been bought by them. The Paradise Bird... they can do many things without my involvement now."
"Is this everything you have to confess?"
"It is everything..."
"Since you have already decided not to cooperate with the Paradise Bird any longer, why didn’t you come clean to me? Why did you wait until this moment to tell the truth?"
"Who knew if Jade Country’s aid would start strong only to fizzle out? As long as the five spaces are not all sealed, I cannot rest assured. Once all five spaces are closed, I would be ready to atone with my death immediately.
"Now there are only two Different Dimensional Spaces left. I thought I could hold on a little longer. But, unexpectedly..."
"Uncle Stephen..." At this moment, Prince Kester silently turned. "Was framing Wang Lan for terrorist connections your doing behind the scenes?"
"Yes!"
"Why? Don’t you know how important Wang Lan is to us? Don’t you know that framing Wang Lan would cause great harm to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?"
"I do know, that’s why I dared to! Because I was certain that no matter what I said or did, he would not be harmed one bit.
"The Minister of Finance came to me a week ago, and he told me the nation was out of money. His Majesty the King was even considering selling the energy mines in the Coteville Area to obtain loans from Citibank.
"This is the lifeblood of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, and without it, what hope does the country have? I told him to stay calm, and that I would find a way to get the money. That’s why I was so eager to sell off the twelve tons of Space Stones in stock.
"It just never occurred to me that the man from the Duanmu Family would have already become an agent of Jade Country, and he had quietly begun to investigate me. I could be honest about everything I had done to His Majesty, but it absolutely could not fall into the hands of Jade Country.
"I had no choice but to kill the man and create evidence that he was a Paradise Bird terrorist. As for framing Wang Lan, that was a spur-of-the-moment action. The purpose was to get some leverage in negotiations with Jade Country, to gain some initiative and give up fewer interests.
"Between nations, there is no sincere friendship, only eternal interests. Jade Country is just one of the greedy sharks, the one with the most cultured appearance, but that doesn’t mean they don’t want to devour us."
"And then? Your plan fell apart and Jade Country caught your weakness, putting us in a completely passive situation!"
"Passive? All of this has been within my plans, my dear King. On the way here, I have already ingested poison, and the wax capsule wrapped around it should be almost digested by now.
"As long as I die, Your Majesty can push all the blame onto me, and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow remains the immaculate Kingdom of Ice and Snow. It was me... conspiring with the Paradise Bird... it was me... plotting to snatch away the Kingdom of Ice and Snow for the Paradise Bird... everything... is my... fault..."
With the fading of the last word, Stephen’s pale face, covered with silver hair, was beaded with sweat. The dripping sweat, along with the blood seeping from the corner of his mouth, fell drip by drip.
In the end, the elderly man who had dedicated his life to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow slowly collapsed.
「That night, Wang Lan had a good sleep.」
He was not at all concerned that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow would cover up or conceal anything. The evidence of Stephen’s actions was in his hands, and before the evidence, all cover-ups would not be able to block the wrath of Jade Country.
The next morning, bright sunshine spread across the land. Just as Wang Lan had finished washing up and was about to head to the canteen for breakfast, a senior notified him to go to the headquarters meeting room.
Wang Lan quickly changed his route and coincidentally ran into Yu Ruoyun on the way.
"Good morning!"
"It seems the Kingdom of Ice and Snow has reached a result," Yu Ruoyun said, her expression not as relaxed as Wang Lan’s, her voice low.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 Conditions of the Paradise Bird
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 371 Conditions of the Paradise Bird
Indeed, in the command headquarters’ meeting room, Wang Lan saw the stern-faced King Cain and Prince Kester.
"My dear friends from Jade Country, I am very sorry. The former General Stephen of the National Security Council is the spy we’ve been searching for for so long, hidden within the high ranks of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
Next, Cain displayed the clearly edited video of Stephen’s interrogation from the previous night. In the video, Stephen, desperate for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to cling to survival, collaborated with Paradise Bird until he was in too deep and forced to become complicit in their dirty deeds. Everything, including the missile attack on the volunteer corps, the terrorist attack in the Number Two Different Dimensional Space, and Paradise Bird’s theft of two nuclear bombs from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, could be seamlessly linked together.
Paradise Bird needed the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to maintain the status quo, so naturally, they didn’t want Jade Country’s assistance. Relying on the massive Space Stones from the Number Five Different Dimensional Space to make a huge profit, Paradise Bird also naturally needed to sabotage Jade Country’s aid plans.
With the misunderstandings cleared, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow sincerely apologized and offered some compensation for the losses; the matter could then be settled privately.
But Wang Lan’s brow inadvertently furrowed.
Why hasn’t the mission completion prompt appeared in my mind?
he wondered.
Is it because we haven’t recovered the nuclear bombs? Or because we haven’t found the Paradise Bird terrorists?
Possibly. After all, finding a high-level spy from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow isn’t a great merit for me. Only finding the mastermind and recovering the nuclear bombs will truly settle this.
「The next day.」
Another large batch of mercenaries arrived from around the world. Among this group, a significant portion had yellow skin and black hair. Curious students from the Star Martial Academy approached them to talk and unexpectedly discovered that these people had all come from Jade Country.
"What are you guys thinking? Don’t you know the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is dangerous? It’s stable back home, and you’re not exactly struggling to survive, so why come here and take risks?"
"Exactly! Do you have any idea what the casualty rate was for the last batch of mercenaries? Fifty percent! Three thousand went in, and only sixteen to seventeen hundred came out."
"Ah? That brutal?" Instantly, a group of fellow Jade Countrymen exclaimed in surprise, gathering around.
"I just heard that the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is strongly supported by Jade Country. So I thought, if Jade Country is backing it, isn’t that like free money? Warriors from other countries earn eighty thousand a day, but we mercenaries from Jade Country earn one hundred twenty thousand a day."
"Right! If the Kingdom of Ice and Snow is like a little brother to Jade Country, what do we have to fear? What vicious Exotic Beasts could possibly be a match for us from Jade Country? By the way, you guys arrived before us, so tell us, what level are the Exotic Beasts in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow?"
"Their level... isn’t very high. Basically, it’s a proportion of about sixty percent at the Star Shine Stage and thirty percent at the Star Cloud Stage."
"A four-to-six ratio?" Immediately, the hundreds of Jade Country mercenaries before them gasped collectively.
In any Different Dimensional Space, lower-level Exotic Beasts definitely constitute the majority. The worst kind of Different Dimensional Space has Starlight Stage beasts as its baseline. A Different Dimensional Space where the baseline Exotic Beasts are at the Star Shine Stage is considered relatively difficult to handle.
Of course, it was normal for the Exotic Beasts of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to be difficult. If they weren’t, how could they have nearly brought a nation like the Kingdom of Ice and Snow to ruin? But just how difficult they were depended on the proportion of baseline Exotic Beasts.
A one-to-nine ratio was easy mode, with ninety percent being Star Shine Stage, which was manageable for a Star Cloud Stage squad. But a four-to-six ratio? Only a Galaxy Stage squad could hope to contend with that.
Those who would travel thousands of miles to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow for one hundred twenty thousand a day were definitely not overwhelmingly powerful. Most were a single Star Cloud Stage warrior leading several Star Shine Stage warriors; larger teams might consist of four or five Star Cloud Stage members leading a group of Star Shine Stage warriors.
"Lad, you’re not pulling our leg, are you? A real four-to-six ratio? With that kind of ratio, you’re saying there’s a fifty percent casualty rate? I can’t believe eighty thousand a day could attract Galaxy Stage experts. At this intensity, no matter how many people come, it wouldn’t be enough, right?"
"Yeah, you’re not just tricking us because our mercenary fees are high, are you?"
Hearing this, a few seniors immediately sensed an opportunity to show off.
"What does your high pay have to do with us? We’re not the ones being hired."
"You guys are...?"
"Us?" One of the seniors tilted his head slightly, gazing into the distance. "We were sent by the school to aid the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. We are senior students from Modu City’s Star Martial Academy."
"Shit! Big shots from the Big Four?"
"Big boss, have a cigarette! Big boss, you gotta cover us when we go in there..."
"We’re compatriots! Our chances of getting back alive depend on you, boss..."
Suddenly, a chorus of flattering voices made the seniors feel utterly elated.
"Wang Lan, Director Long would like to see you," a girl approached Wang Lan and whispered in his ear. Wang Lan nodded and turned to head outside.
One hundred twenty thousand a day?
Wang Lan couldn’t help but ponder.
Logically, Stephen’s batch of Space Stones wasn’t successfully traded, and the Kingdom of Ice and Snow didn’t acquire a large sum of funds. So where did they get the money to recruit mercenaries at such a high price?
Just yesterday, Princess Aier mentioned that the treasury was empty and asked Longya and the others to overcome the difficulties. After discussion, Longya and his team were already planning to close the smaller Different Dimensional Spaces. Fortunately, only two Different Dimensional Spaces remained, and their combined difficulty didn’t compare to the Number Two Different Dimensional Space. Yesterday, Longya and Jin Wenbing were discussing estimated casualties for infiltrating these spaces with small units.
Arriving at the central command, Longya and Jin Wenbing were waiting by a vehicle outside the headquarters. They beckoned Wang Lan over as he approached.
"Director Long, are we heading out?"
"King Cain just called. He said the terrorists have proposed a trade."
"Oh? What kind of trade?"
"King Cain didn’t say. We’ll find out when we get to the royal court."
As they spoke, Yu Ruoyun also arrived. The four of them got into the off-road vehicle, which started with a roar and left the camp, heading towards the royal court.
King Cain’s attendants had been waiting at the entrance of the royal court for some time. Seeing Wang Lan and his group arrive, they quickly welcomed them and led them into His Majesty’s study. Inside, Princess Aier and Prince Kester were already seated on either side.
"You’re here!" King Cain quickly stood up to greet them. "This morning, someone claiming to be from Paradise Bird contacted us. You must help the Kingdom of Ice and Snow."
As he spoke, he turned on the television screen on the back wall of the study. A non-mainstream youth with wildly colored hair appeared on the screen.
"Our people have already planted two nuclear bombs in the Averill Concentration Zone. Based on population density estimates, I guarantee each bomb will kill at least one hundred thousand people. If the timing is perfect, we guarantee we can kill at least half a million. Don’t ask where I am, and don’t expect more information from me. Since our leader dared to send me to deliver this message, it means I definitely don’t have access to critical intelligence."
"What do you want?"
"The Time-Space Gemstone! Exchange the two nuclear bombs for it. You have only two days to consider. Exceed forty-eight hours, and you’ll hear two explosions and see two magnificent mushroom clouds."
The video went out. Three pairs of eyes looked eagerly at Longya and his companions.
Exchange nuclear bombs for the Time-Space Gemstone? What a ridiculous idea,
Jin Wenbing was the first to sneer.
"The Time-Space Gemstone is key to opening the gates of the Demon World. Once they get it and open those gates, war will ignite. By then, the dead won’t be counted in the hundreds of thousands, but an astronomical figure in the hundreds of millions," Longya said coldly, meeting the pleading gazes of the three royals.
The Time-Space Gemstone is non-negotiable; that’s our bottom line.
"Can we probe his memory?" Wang Lan suddenly asked.
"No. His head is inscribed with a Skill Form. As soon as any spiritual power tries to enter, his head will explode instantly. And if he dies, it’s considered a breach of the deal, and they will detonate the nuclear bombs immediately."
"There’s no way around it. The Time-Space Gemstone definitely can’t be handed over to Paradise Bird. The deal is impossible," Jin Wenbing said indifferently.
At these words, the faces of King Cain and Prince Kester turned deathly pale.
"General Jin, Captain Longya... there is no spatial energy left in the Time-Space Gemstone..." Princess Aier said quickly.
"How do you know they won’t be able to recharge it once they get their hands on the Time-Space Gemstone?"
"This..." Princess Aier’s face fell.
"But, those are the lives of hundreds of thousands from the Kingdom of Ice and Snow!" King Cain stood up tremblingly, his eyes filled with desperate helplessness.
"Should we be blamed? You were the ones who violated the nuclear non-proliferation treaty by purchasing nuclear bombs. You were the ones who leaked information about that transaction. I cannot make the entire world pay for your mistake with their lives."
"This... this... is there really no way?" Cain’s eyes gradually filled with despair.
"This matter is non-negotiable. The Time-Space Gemstone must not be lost."
"Wait!" Wang Lan suddenly said, "Director Long, Captain Jin, may I have a word with you in private?"
The two looked at Wang Lan in confusion and nodded silently. The three of them left the study and went to a corner.
"Wang Lan, I know you and Princess Aier are close, but you’re a mature man and should understand the priorities here. Even if the Time-Space Gemstone currently has no energy, it absolutely must not fall into Paradise Bird’s hands."
"Director Long, I understand." As he said this, Star Power suddenly surged around Wang Lan, and he activated his Phoenix Form. Seeing Wang Lan like this, Director Long and Captain Jin’s confusion had just begun to rise when, before they could react, Wang Lan suddenly flashed to their side.
WHOOSH—
The two only felt their vision blur, as if the scene had switched instantaneously like in a fully immersive projection. When their vision stabilized, they found themselves unexpectedly in a room.
"Wang Lan, what are you doing? Where is this place?" Longya demanded, somewhat angry.
No, this isn’t an illusion! Is this real?!
Longya suddenly exclaimed.
"This is my dormitory," Wang Lan said calmly, still maintaining his Phoenix Form. "The last time I absorbed the energy of the Time-Space Gemstone, I never mentioned what I gained from it. This is it: the Phoenix Form, the Space Phoenix Form. In this form, I possess the ability of Instant Space Movement. As long as I set coordinates in a location beforehand, I can ignore distance and perform ultra-long-distance instantaneous movement. If the Time-Space Gemstone were in my hands, in case of any sudden developments, I could instantly transport myself to a predetermined coordinate. This is teleportation within the spatial domain; as long as it’s within the same space, distance and time mean nothing to me."
GASP—
Longya took a sharp breath.
This ability... it’s frighteningly powerful,
he thought.
"I think I can take the Time-Space Gemstone and try," Wang Lan continued. "If the conditions are right, I can snatch back the two nuclear bombs. After all, hundreds of thousands of lives are at stake."
Longya and Jin Wenbing exchanged glances. They weren’t inherently heartless, but the sheer importance of the Time-Space Gemstone had forced their hearts to become like steel.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 Boom, It Exploded
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Chapter 372 Boom, It Exploded
If this kind of incident happened in Jade Country, the safety of hundreds of thousands of citizens would be enough to make anyone spare no effort. The Space Gem must be protected, and the lives of these hundreds of thousands of citizens must also be protected.
But this is the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, where conditions do not allow for such measures. However, Wang Lan had now shown them a way to potentially achieve the best of both worlds. Time-space ability—that was the most elusive and powerful of abilities.
"How confident are you?"
"If the Time-Space Gemstone doesn’t leave my hands, I’m one hundred percent confident. If they propose an exchange, I’ll stay behind with the Time-Space Gemstone, and Princess Aier will leave with the nuclear bomb. Once Princess Aier is at a safe distance, I’ll immediately use Space Movement to return."
"What if the other party doesn’t agree to your terms?"
"I’ll just bring Princess Aier back directly. Regardless, the Time-Space Gemstone cannot fall into Paradise Bird’s hands. But... the moment they proposed the trade, they were already destined to lose. As long as we get them to agree to exchange both nuclear bombs simultaneously, they’ll have to bring out both bombs. That way, even if the trade fails, we can pinpoint the location of the two bombs and implement a regional lockdown."
"The other side is bound to have thought of this."
"But they definitely won’t expect me to have my Space Movement ability. We have the Time-Space Gemstone, they have nuclear bombs; both parties have bargaining chips. Overall, though, we have greater initiative than them. Because we represent Jade Country, their nuclear bombs can only threaten the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. They also understand that Jade Country would never allow them to seize the Time-Space Gemstone. If we agree to a trade, our goal will be to snatch the nuclear bombs, just as their plan will be to steal the Time-Space Gemstone. It’s simply a matter of who gets the opportunity to act first."
After listening to Wang Lan’s analysis, Longya and Jin Wenbing exchanged glances once more and ultimately nodded silently. Indeed, that was the case.
"Wang Lan, remember this: I know you sometimes choose to take risks, but this time you absolutely cannot. Your life is insignificant when weighed against the Time-Space Gemstone. We are willing to try to save the lives of the hundreds of thousands of citizens in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow; this is us fulfilling our humanitarian spirit. If there’s even the slightest complication, if the Time-Space Gemstone is in any danger whatsoever, you must bring it back immediately."
"Yes!"
Wang Lan sent the two of them back once more. During the time they were discussing, King Cain had secretly sent people to search for the trio multiple times, but to no avail.
"King Cain, we can agree to make one final effort, but we hope you understand that an actual trade is impossible. It’s merely a pretense, a way to see if there’s an opportunity to retrieve the nuclear bombs. Moreover, once it’s confirmed that there’s no chance to grab the bombs, we will withdraw immediately. Regarding the fate of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, we can only offer our apologies."
"This... Alright then!" Cain wanted to argue further, but seeing Longya’s resolute gaze, he could only give up reluctantly.
"Mr. Longya, may I ask a question?" Cain asked indifferently in a low voice. "If Jade Country faced the same situation, would you act the same way? Would you rather let hundreds of thousands of innocent lives vanish into smoke than agree to an exchange?"
"In Jade Country, such a situation would be impossible. Jade Country’s national security agencies would not cooperate with terrorists, nor could terrorists possibly obtain nuclear bombs from Jade Country. Most importantly, terrorists would never even get the chance to propose an exchange."
"Alright then! We still hope your country will make the utmost effort."
"Certainly!"
To be on the safe side, the plan was formulated by Longya and Jin Wenbing. Only they, along with Wang Lan and Princess Aier, knew the detailed plan. No one else was privy to it.
The next day, Wang Lan and Princess Aier, bearing the Time-Space Gemstone, got into the car with the punk.
"Let’s go. Where’s the location?"
"Are the goods you’re carrying genuine?"
"You guess!" Wang Lan snorted coldly.
"Don’t expect to bluff us with a fake. We have ways to tell the difference. If you’ve brought a fake, exchange it for the real one now; otherwise, many people will die."
"Drop your compassionate act. What would a terrorist like you know about mercy?"
"I’m just making sure you haven’t deceived us. Really, I don’t want trouble, and I certainly don’t want to die. If you have a fake, our leader will definitely recognize it. He’ll detonate the nuclear bomb immediately, and then you’ll surely kill me."
"It’s real. Cut the crap. Where’s the location?"
"Just follow my instructions. Make sure the car is gassed up, okay? It’d be bad if we broke down halfway."
Though the punk talked tough in front of Wang Lan, he was actually terrified inside. Even a casual scratch of Wang Lan’s forehead would make him tremble.
So timid,
Wang Lan wondered.
Why did this guy even get involved with Paradise Bird?
After driving around for an entire day, the car completed a long, 600-kilometer loop around the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"What are you really up to? If you want to trade, just get it over with. Don’t keep driving us around in circles."
"A covert trade like this, of course, can’t have too many onlookers. Do you want the whole world to know by tomorrow that you traded the Time-Space Gemstone, which can open the gates of time and space, with Paradise Bird?"
"Hmph!"
"Keep going north!"
As dusk approached, the SUV suddenly headed directly north. After about a hundred kilometers at breakneck speed, it arrived at the coast of the Arctic Ocean.
The car slowed to a stop, and Wang Lan and Princess Aier got out. They were on a protruding beach, surrounded by water on three sides, with dense forest and massive rocks all around.
"We meet again, Wang Lan?" a slightly hoarse voice sounded. Wang Lan felt his vision blur, and a familiar figure appeared before him.
"Wang Mingling!"
"It’s been half a year. I’ve really missed you, Wang Lan..."
Wang Lan’s aura surged around him. Although he didn’t release any Star Energy Fluctuations, his presence overflowed like boiling water.
"In just half a year, you’ve grown to this extent. Truly worthy of being the Flame Emperor’s son, a peerless genius. Even at my peak, I might not be able to defeat you easily now..."
"You’re welcome to try."
"Let’s not... I came here to trade today, and I have no plans to fight you," Wang Mingling said, his gaze shifting towards the package in Wang Lan’s hands. "You actually brought the real Time-Space Gemstone... I thought you would bring a fake to deceive me and then try to snatch the nuclear bombs. I even prepared so many contingencies for that scenario... and it seems they weren’t needed. You lot are truly arrogant, aren’t you? Do you believe I can’t snatch the Time-Space Gemstone from your hands, no matter what?"
"You can try, but I can’t guarantee I won’t accidentally kill you." A sharp gleam flashed in Wang Lan’s eyes. Facing Wang Mingling once more, Wang Lan no longer felt the pressure he once had. His strength had greatly increased, enough to fight even a Titled Strongman, let alone this mere corpse puppet before him.
"Since you’re so sincere, I’m naturally willing to trade fairly."
"The nuclear bombs?"
Wang Mingling gestured lightly, and someone behind him walked slowly over, carrying a briefcase.
"Why is there only one?"
"The second one is, of course, still in the place most threatening to you... Do you really think I’m so foolish as to bring both nuclear bombs? If you were to try any tricks, I wouldn’t be able to escape."
"I said we would exchange all the nuclear bombs. Since you only brought one, the deal is off."
"I can tell you the location of the other nuclear bomb. Besides, each nuclear bomb has only one independent detonator. I can trade the detonator to you. This way, it’s as good as trading both nuclear bombs. After all, we have no use for nuclear bombs... You can’t eat them."
"But they can be used for terrorist attacks."
"Wang Lan, it seems I need to correct a misconception of yours. Don’t lump us together with those aimless organizations, okay? They only know destruction, creating terror to satisfy their own desires. Our goal has never been to create terror; terror is merely a tool to achieve our goals."
"Hmph, you think you can deceive me?"
"How could someone as smart as you, Wang Lan, not know this basic common sense? Every nuclear bomb detonator has a matching special code. Don’t believe me? Ask Princess Aier."
"That’s right," Princess Aier confirmed, staring at Wang Mingling. "Each suitcase nuclear bomb has only one detonator, and even the manufacturer can’t replicate another one. If the detonator is destroyed, the nuclear bomb can only be decommissioned. I need to verify that it’s real."
"Of course." Wang Mingling ordered his subordinate to open the briefcase, revealing a metallic box inside that resembled an engine, with a few dim indicator lights on it.
"This is the nuclear bomb’s detonation switch," Wang Mingling said, gently pressing the switch. The lights on the nuclear bomb suddenly lit up. "The signal is connected. All I have to do is press this button, and this nuclear bomb will explode immediately. How about it? The detonators for both are here. Hand over the Time-Space Gemstone, and I’ll give them to you."
BEEP! BEEP! BEEP!—
As Wang Mingling finished speaking, a sudden beeping sound erupted from the nuclear bomb.
The sound immediately made Wang Lan’s scalp tingle intensely. Without any hesitation, he instantly activated his Phoenix form.
On the other side, Wang Mingling’s expression was frozen in utter confusion. Looking at the flashing indicator lights on the nuclear bomb, he looked completely bewildered.
BOOM—
A thunderous roar spread out, as if to awaken the entire world.
BOOM—
Almost simultaneously, explosions erupted on the Arctic Ocean coast and from its seabed, sending a massive cloud of mist and debris surging skyward. Even from ten kilometers away, the rising mushroom cloud was visible.
Even thirty kilometers away, the terrifying roar could be heard.
"Shit—"
Hiding five kilometers away, Longya and the other Star Sea realm teachers from the academy were suddenly jolted violently by the sound. Staring at the terrifying smoke in the distance, despair was written all over their faces.
"Wrong... We were all wrong..." Longya muttered, his face contorted in pain. "Paradise Bird’s goal was never the Time-Space Gemstone... They wanted to... bomb Wang Lan to death!"
"Captain, look out!" Wu Shaohua suddenly grabbed Longya, pressing him down into their cover. A deafening blast whooshed overhead, and the howling shockwave ripped a layer of turf from the top of their shelter, flinging it high into the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 373: Why the Paradise Bird Does This
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Chapter 373: Why the Paradise Bird Does This
The violent commotion lasted a long time before gradually subsiding. The terrifying sound of two huge explosions was like a train crashing against the hearts of everyone focused on the incident.
"Captain, intense nuclear radiation detected!"
"What?" Jin Wenbing sprang to his feet. "How could there be intense nuclear radiation? Which direction is it coming from?"
"It’s spread out across the sky. The source of the radiation can be determined to be from the direction of the Arctic Ocean. Captain, the data analysis almost certainly indicates a nuclear bomb explosion!"
"A nuclear explosion? So it actually exploded?"
At the same time, King Cain, who had received the news, collapsed to the ground, drained of strength. "It exploded? It really exploded... SOB SOB SOB... My subjects... SOB SOB SOB..."
"Brother, this was already anticipated. If we do not avenge this, we swear we are not men! Hereafter, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow will do nothing but seek revenge against Paradise Bird!"
"Kester... am I really so incompetent?"
"Your Majesty must not say such things."
"I’ve been thinking... is it because I became the king that led the Kingdom of Ice and Snow into this misfortune? Why else was the Kingdom of Ice and Snow safe and sound during Father’s reign, while under my rule, it seemed as if cursed by the God of Heaven.
Over the years, I have been striving to be a qualified king. I have been diligent, I have loved my people, I have poured my heart and soul out for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow... but in the end, nothing has changed...
Kester, I might not really be suited to be a king. After this matter is taken care of, I will pass the crown to you."
"Brother, please do not say that. If even you can’t be a good king, what qualifies me to be one? The people of this country adore you; they trust you.
If you abdicate at this time, it will cause unrest amongst the people. During this time of internal and external troubles, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow cannot afford any more turmoil. Brother, please pull yourself together and persevere."
"Where are we?" Princess Aier’s voice rang out as she nervously clutched Wang Lan’s shoulders. Just a moment ago, her heart had inexplicably raced, and she had just felt Wang Lan embrace her before her vision changed, leaving her no time to be astonished.
When they reappeared, it was within this familiar room.
Wang Lan’s dormitory, which Princess Aier had visited countless times, was very familiar to her. But just a second ago, she and Wang Lan had been over two hundred kilometers away in the Arctic Ocean. How could they have returned to Ice City in the blink of an eye, and to Wang Lan’s dormitory, of all places?
Because it was too strange, she dared not believe it.
At this moment, Wang Lan was drenched in sweat and utterly drained, struggling to lean on a table as he carefully sat down. The exhaustion in his body, like a tsunami, kept washing over him.
Wang Lan had miscalculated. The energy cost of Space Movement increased exponentially with distance. Teleporting within a one-kilometer range might consume negligible energy, but the cost for ten kilometers was a hundred times greater, and that only resulted in some fatigue. But... a hundred-kilometer teleportation not only consumed a massive amount of the Power of Space but also a great deal of physical Star Power.
The sensation that hit Wang Lan during that instantaneous teleportation was as if gravity had suddenly increased a hundredfold. This increase wasn’t felt externally; rather, it was as if his very soul and all his internal organs were experiencing this immense pressure.
Surviving a sudden hundredfold increase in gravity was a true miracle.
After resting for over ten minutes, Wang Lan finally regained his senses. "Quickly send a message. Say we are okay, and the Time-Space Gemstone is fine too."
"Oh, oh!"
Wang Lan looked very weak, so Princess Aier stayed to take care of him. A short while later, the door to Wang Lan’s room was kicked open, and Jin Wenbing and Yu Ruoyun stormed in almost simultaneously.
Jin Wenbing, seeing the briefcase next to Wang Lan, let out an unintentional sigh of relief. Yu Ruoyun showed a relieved smile upon seeing that Wang Lan was unharmed.
"What happened? Did the negotiations break down? Did Paradise Bird set off the nuclear bomb?"
"The situation... is probably much more complicated than we thought," Wang Lan panted, taking several deep breaths before calming himself.
"How many nuclear bombs exploded?"
"Two," Jin Wenbing hurriedly said. "Longya just called me; they’re on their way back. They thought you were dead and cursed me out over the phone for a good while."
"Where’s the other one?"
"Also in the Arctic Ocean. The two nuclear bombs exploded almost simultaneously in the same place."
Just as I thought...
Wang Lan slightly closed his eyes, countless possible guesses flashing through his mind, but he dismissed them one by one.
"Strange... really strange. There’s no reason at all."
"What exactly happened?"
"Both our plans were going smoothly. From our perspective, the nuclear bomb’s detonation device was right in front of us; we just needed a little more effort to get our hands on it. As for Wang Mingling, we were practically in their grasp.
At that time, Princess Aier was inspecting the goods when the indicator lights on the nuclear device suddenly lit up. I instinctively felt that something was wrong and immediately teleported back with Princess Aier. But at the very least, at the moment I initiated the teleport, I saw the briefcase nuke explode."
Hesitating for a second, Wang Lan raised his head and continued, "And there was Wang Mingling’s astonished face. His expression shouldn’t deceive me—he didn’t know the nuclear device would suddenly explode."
"You mean... the nuclear device wasn’t detonated by Paradise Bird?"
"It’s very possible it wasn’t, but it’s not certain. After all, nobody knows what Paradise Bird is really about or what they’re planning. Maybe the people behind Wang Mingling detonated the nuclear device."
"Aier, my Aier—" Suddenly, Cain’s exclamation came from outside, and with his call, he also rushed in. The already small room felt even more crowded.
"Your Majesty, shall we go somewhere else to discuss this in more detail?"
"Yes, yes!"
The group arrived at the royal court. In a medium-sized reception room, Cain kept asking Princess Aier about what had happened.
"Mr. Wang Lan has mastered the ability of instant movement?" Prince Kester suddenly looked at Wang Lan with curiosity. "That’s a miraculous ability. Are you sure you’re not a Son of God?"
"Prince Kester seems surprised?"
"Indeed. As everyone knows, Space-Time Talents are the rarest and most powerful. Throughout history, anyone with Space-Time Talents has been legendary. And currently, I’ve not heard of anyone with space-time abilities."
"Fortunately, I am one of them."
"Kester, maybe you’re right. Mr. Wang Lan could indeed be a Son of God, sent by the God of Heaven to save the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. Looking back, all the disasters that befell the Kingdom of Ice and Snow were resolved by Mr. Wang Lan.
The Kingdom of Ice and Snow suffered from the ravages of Poisonous Beasts, and it was Wang Lan who invented the Star Martial Toxin Vaccine. The Kingdom of Ice and Snow was threatened by an asteroid from outer space, and it was Wang Lan who shattered the asteroid to save us.
This time, our country was threatened by Paradise Bird with nuclear weapons, and once again it was Mr. Wang Lan who resolved the crisis. Mr. Wang Lan, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow will forever remember the help you’ve given us. You are our Kingdom of Ice and Snow’s closest and dearest friend."
Being addressed so politely by Cain all of a sudden made Wang Lan a bit embarrassed, and for a moment, he didn’t know how to respond.
"King Cain, you flatter me. I’ve merely done what I could."
"No, what may be simple for you is a life-saving grace for us. Your deeds will be recorded in our annals, and every person in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow should remember them forever."
*For successfully resolving the nuclear bomb crisis of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, you have been awarded 100,000 experience points and 30,000 skill points.*
Suddenly, the system notification popped up in his mind. And at that instant, the experience bar, which had been just a little short, was completely filled.
Cain was still organizing his words to express his gratitude to Wang Lan when he suddenly felt that the atmosphere seemed a bit odd. Everyone present was staring at Wang Lan as if, in that moment, he was light, he was electricity, an eternal myth.
Cain was just an ordinary person, without the talents of a Star Martial Warrior. Naturally, he couldn’t sense the Star Energy Fluctuation emanating from Wang Lan.
But among those present, except for Cain, everyone was a Star Martial Warrior. Even Kester, who was only at the Star Cloud Stage and considered a weakling, was a genuine Star Martial Warrior.
The Star Energy Fluctuation grew more rapid and sublime, and Princess Aier’s eyes lost focus.
The commotion of Wang Lan’s breakthrough to the Galaxy Stage had been quite significant; it happened just over ten days ago, about half a month back.
It is said that after the age of eighteen, a Star Martial Warrior’s strength experiences an explosive growth period. But even during such a period, a surge in power shouldn’t be *this* explosive, should it? He’s at the Galaxy Stage, not some Star Cloud Stage weakling! To advance from the early Galaxy Stage to the middle Galaxy Stage in just half a month?
The question is, did he consume a Soul Bead just now? No, right? Is it really necessary to break through at the slightest disagreement, or without any provocation at all?
This scene dealt everyone present a profound shock, an impact so strong it felt almost like a physical blow. But for Wang Lan, it merely felt like being doused with cold water, sending a pleasant shiver down his spine.
How satisfying!
When Wang Lan came back to his senses, he looked somewhat dazed at King Cain, as if he had just blacked out for a moment after a yawn. "Sorry, Your Majesty, just now... I think my mind wandered."
"No... no problem. Just, Mr. Wang Lan, are you alright?"
"I’m fine," Wang Lan replied weakly, especially noticing General Jin Wenbing, who looked utterly flabbergasted.
You might be fine after showing off so grandly, but shouldn’t you consider the circumstances first?
With Wang Lan’s breakthrough causing such a disturbance, Cain’s cringeworthy praise finally subsided. The conversation returned to pressing matters.
"Two nuclear bombs detonated simultaneously in the Arctic Ocean. So it seems their claim to have planted bombs in densely populated areas was just to deceive us. Now that both bombs have detonated, the nuclear threat should be considered over," General Jin Wenbing said coolly, leaning on his hand.
"Thank the gods..." Even after everything had settled, Cain was visibly shaken, knowing that a careless mistake could have irrevocably doomed the Kingdom of Ice and Snow.
"But Wang Lan said that the Paradise Bird terrorists he last saw seemed unable to believe the nuclear bombs would suddenly explode... Perhaps there’s more to this situation."
"For the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, the hidden details no longer matter. What’s important is that there are still two Different Dimensional Spaces that haven’t been closed. This can wait until after those have been dealt with," Kester interjected quickly.
"Each nuclear bomb has only one remote, and the remote only works with its corresponding bomb. If the remote was in Wang Mingling’s hands, how was the bomb detonated? If we don’t clear up this issue, I’m worried trouble might still be brewing."
"What’s so difficult about that? The remote in Wang Mingling’s hands must have been a fake. Do you really think Wang Mingling would give us a real remote in exchange? I think it’s more likely that the people behind Wang Mingling planned to eliminate all of his subordinates to cut off any loose ends."

chapters.title: Chapter 374 I’ve Figured It Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Chapter 374 I’ve Figured It Out
Wang Lan looked up at Prince Kester in astonishment, admiring the man’s odd way of thinking.
Using a nuclear bomb to silence his own men? He had to give Kester credit for such a ludicrous idea. Wang Lan preferred to believe it was an operational mistake rather than using a nuclear bomb for silencing.
However, a previous speculation made by Longya during an exchange with Jin Wenbing seemed somewhat plausible—the nuclear bomb might have been detonated by someone of higher authority than Wang Mingling, perhaps with the intention of killing Wang Lan.
But this possibility seemed slim. No one knew before the transaction whether Wang Lan would even show up. Besides, using a nuclear bomb to kill Wang Lan? Although Wang Lan was ranked second on Paradise Bird’s hit list, surely they wouldn’t go to such lengths for him.
Soon, the team of academy teachers led by Longya returned. While the process was fraught with danger, the outcome was a cause for universal rejoicing. Wang Lan’s side didn’t lose a single hair, while Paradise Bird didn’t gain a thing.
Since it was a joyous occasion for all, the campaign against the Third and Fourth Different Dimensional Spaces was put on the agenda.
In celebration of everyone coming through unscathed, Princess Aier invited Wang Lan and Yu Ruoyun to her backyard for a barbecue. With the crisis in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow gradually resolving and one danger after another safely overcome, Princess Aier’s smile became more radiant.
"Wang Lan, see how my culinary skills are?" Princess Aier proudly presented a grilled chicken wing to Wang Lan.
"You eat it; mine will be ready soon. The joy of barbecuing is cooking what you want yourself. Food you grill with your own hands always tastes better. And if it doesn’t turn out delicious, well, crying while you eat it is also part of the fun..."
Yu Ruoyun slightly averted her gaze upon hearing this. In the trash can beside her lay a chicken leg that was charred on one half while barely cooked on the other.
"Aier," Wang Lan suddenly called out, "I still don’t think the incident today was that simple. Those two nuclear bombs definitely weren’t an accidental explosion; they must have been meticulously planned."
"Meticulously planned? For what purpose?"
"The problem is, we don’t know who’s behind this, so we can’t determine their motive. But I have a gut feeling the bombs exploded just as we got close. That means... they were meant for us."
"Do you have any guesses as to who it might be?"
"No idea. Besides, this is the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. It’s not appropriate for me to investigate, nor would it be convenient."
"..." Princess Aier looked at Wang Lan in bewilderment. "Does reversing your sentence carry any special meaning?"
Wang Lan looked at her delicate expression and had a realization. No matter how well one learns a foreign language, it remains just that—a foreign language.
Heck, many native Chinese speakers don’t fully grasp the depth and subtlety of their own language.
"It means I want you to conduct a covert investigation. I even suspect that Stephen isn’t the biggest fish hiding in the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, or at least he’s not the only one."
"Alright, I’ll arrange for someone to investigate tomorrow. Let’s eat now; there’s plenty of delicious food today."
Yu Ruoyun sat quietly by the charcoal grill, carefully inspecting the barbecue fork in her hands.
A seemingly simple task felt surprisingly difficult. What does ’about right’ cooking time mean? How much is ’about right’ anyway?
As Yu Ruoyun struggled with the grand task of grilling, she suddenly smelled a rich fragrance. Wang Lan placed a freshly grilled chicken wing in front of Yu Ruoyun.
"Here!"
"I’ll grill my own."
"Forget it. You’re just like two other people I know. I can tell how you’d grill just by one glance."
"Two people? The same kind? Which two?"
"One is Jiang Xinyu," Wang Lan said, "and the other is my aunt."
"Oh?" For a moment, Yu Ruoyun felt a sweet surge in her heart.
Was this a sign of closeness?
"The kind who are naturally hopeless in the kitchen. No matter how high your IQ is, you turn into an idiot once you step into the kitchen."
CRACK! The pure steel barbecue fork in her hand snapped.
「On the third day,」 the newly assembled force of four thousand headed towards the Third Different Dimensional Space. Since the Third Different Dimensional Space was the weakest of the five, and with an ample supply of vaccines, they reached the spatial node in just two days.
Wang Lan, Yu Ruoyun, and Princess Aier stood at the entrance to the Different Dimensional Space. Princess Aier, her expression solemn, took measured steps towards the node.
"Aier, maybe you should consider preserving this space as a Pioneer Space. A country’s survival cannot always rely on the help of others. If the Kingdom of Ice and Snow wants to rise, it must develop its own Star Martial Warriors."
"Given the current predicament of the Kingdom of Ice and Snow, we don’t have the strength to maintain a Pioneer Space. We don’t even have five hundred Star Martial Warriors left," said Princess Aier with a bitter smile.
She was all too aware of the importance of having the capacity to independently develop Star Martial Warriors for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow. The third space was indeed very suitable, but alas, even with the opportunity at hand, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow had no chance to seize it.
Perhaps in the future, new Different Dimensional Spaces will emerge for the Kingdom of Ice and Snow; maybe... history will repeat itself. But their present dilemma left them no choice but to let go.
BOOM—
A fierce punch landed on the spatial node. A sharp crack followed, and fine fissures spread across the node.
"The friendship between the Kingdom of Ice and Snow and Jade Country will endure forever with the heavens and the earth. If I ever face difficulty again in the future, you’ll come to help me, right?"
Faced with Princess Aier’s loaded question, Wang Lan flashed a brilliant smile. "Of course!"
With minimal losses, the Third Different Dimensional Space was closed. Not only were the senior students from the academy at ease, but even the mercenaries who had traveled thousands of miles found the task to be a breeze.
Some mercenaries even thought that those who described the Kingdom of Ice and Snow as a harrowing training ground had exaggerated the difficulty—or, perhaps, those previous individuals were simply too weak to complete even such an easy mission.
「After closing a Different Dimensional Space, the army took a brief three-day rest.」
In the dead of night, when all was quiet, Wang Lan sat cross-legged on his bed, staring at his system in a daze.
He had just earned another thirty thousand skill points. Where should he allocate them? Thirty thousand skill points were only enough to upgrade a platinum-level skill once, or to enhance a gold-level skill to platinum.
However, a Star Martial Warrior’s greatest taboo is to waver after establishing their combat style. Since he had settled on a close-combat instant-kill approach, coveting mage skills would simply be a waste. And Wang Lan’s close-combat strength had already reached his expectations.
The Dance of the Dark Butterfly was very useful. Now he could escape using it or teleport instantly. For damage output, he had the Extreme Heat Light Beam, and for defense, the Holy Shield. For clearing wide areas, there were the Earth Fire Roar and Heavenly Fire Extinguishing World.
Eventually, Wang Lan’s gaze settled on the Holy Shield and the Dance of the Dark Butterfly.
Both of these Star Martial Skills were Platinum Rank One, and thirty thousand skill points could upgrade either one once.
After considering his recently upgraded Phoenix Constellation Saint Cloth, Wang Lan decided to invest the points into the Dance of the Dark Butterfly.
He could now split into twenty Nether Butterflies at once, and the duration of the Nether Butterfly form could be extended to three seconds. Previously, the Nether Butterfly state only lasted about one second; Wang Lan would be forced to reappear even if he didn’t want to.
The Nether Butterfly state is practically a cheat; it can ignore physical and elemental attacks, as if it were an illusory product. This state is colloquially known as ’invincibility mode.’
After allocating his points, just as Wang Lan was about to undress and go to bed, he heard some noises outside his door. The footsteps were familiar, making his heart pound.
With only the fourth space left unsealed, Wang Lan and the others’ trip to the Kingdom of Ice and Snow was nearly over. Once the last space was sealed three days later, the Kingdom of Ice and Snow would be reborn, and they would return to their homeland.
With departure imminent, Princess Aier was visiting stealthily in the dead of night...
What did she want to do?
This wasn’t Wang Lan overthinking; he had been through similar situations before. Even though it was Wang Lan who had taken advantage of Xie Sisi, slipping away after reaping the benefits wasn’t his style. Precisely because of this, even though it was in his nature as a man, he diligently restrained himself and kept his distance from Princess Aier. It wasn’t that Wang Lan didn’t want to, nor that he had the desire but lacked the nerve; he simply didn’t want to be a scoundrel. Before things with Jiang Xinyu were clear, Wang Lan might have had an excuse, but he couldn’t be a beast now.
"Who is it?" Wang Lan asked in a low, tense voice, his body taut.
"Wang Lan, it’s me! I think I have some leads on the investigation."
Oh...
It seems I was overthinking," Wang Lan thought as he got up and opened the door. Princess Aier was dressed normally.
"Today, a clerk secretly told me that when they were clearing the ruins of Ger Hotel, they found some evidence, but Stephen ordered two pieces destroyed. The clerk found it suspicious, so he secretly kept them and claimed they had been destroyed."
"What kind of evidence?"
"After I obtained them, I immediately had them studied. They said it’s some sort of signal transmission device. Come with me; we should find out its true purpose soon."
"Alright!"
Wang Lan put on his clothes and left with Princess Aier. They hadn’t exited the camp when they saw Yu Ruoyun, in a trench coat, standing outside gazing at the sky.
"You came out so quickly?"
"What do you mean quickly? What are you doing here?"
"Nothing much, just taking a walk because I couldn’t sleep. What about you two...?"
"Princess Aier has made some progress. Come on, let’s go see."
The three of them followed Princess Aier to a research institute in Ice City. The institute was brightly lit. Led by the Guards, they entered the laboratory.
"Your Highness, we can confirm this is a signal transmission device. Moreover, this type of signal transmitter is a fixed device, not a variable frequency transmitter. The signal transmission pattern is extremely complex, intricate, and precise. Any slight discrepancy in a single component would cause a deviation in the signal’s frequency. It’s like a mechanical lock with thousands of unique features, where one lock only matches a single key."
Upon hearing this, the faces of Wang Lan, Yu Ruoyun, and Princess Aier changed dramatically.
"A nuclear detonation signal transmitter?" Wang Lan exclaimed.
"There should be no mistake. But... why would a nuclear detonation signal transmitter be destroyed?" Yu Ruoyun asked, puzzled. "This one was destroyed in the explosion.
Could it be that the explosion wasn’t from the battle, but rather the person from Bear Country self-destructed to prevent the nuclear detonation device from falling into Paradise Bird’s hands?
"
"It should be so," Wang Lan murmured, scratching his chin and falling into contemplation. "If the detonators for those two nuclear bombs were here... where did Paradise Bird get their detonator from? If the nuclear detonators were already destroyed, how did those two nuclear bombs explode?"
"Could it be that Paradise Bird also has the same type of nuclear bombs?" Princess Aier wondered aloud.
"No, that’s not right!" Suddenly, a flash of insight crossed Wang Lan’s eyes. "I think I know!"
